metadata.schemeName: Agro Tourism Villa Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote high-value tourism in Meghalaya by encouraging the development of agro-tourism villas, empowering local youth through entrepreneurship, improving accommodation facilities, and preserving the state’s cultural and natural heritage.

page_content:
# Agro Tourism Villa Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Meghalaya | **Categories:** Travel & Tourism | **Tags:** Tourist, Villas, Tourism, Loans | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Agro Tourism Villa Scheme is a component of the Chief Minister's Elevate Program launched under the Tourism Department of the Government of Meghalaya. The program aims to employ, engage, and empower the youth of Meghalaya by promoting entrepreneurship and providing easy access to credit through the onboarding of various banks as financial partners. To meet the rising demand and promote high-value tourism, the Meghalaya government is investing in luxury tourist facilities and infrastructure. However, there is a need to further enhance accommodation facilities to meet the expectations of high-value tourists while preserving the state's heritage.
## Benefits 1. 35% of total project cost supported (5% by entrepreneur, 25% as front-ended subsidy, 10% as EMI copayment by Government of Meghalayasemi_colon max project cost ₹1.5 Cr, max subsidy ₹52.5 lakh). 1. Loan up to 95% of project cost with a 15-year repayment term and 18-month moratorium Government-funded villa design consultancy blending ethnic aesthetics with modern comfort, tailored to location. 1. Priority allocation in scenic rural/agricultural/tourist clusters to boost visibility and occupancy. 1. Training in hospitality and bookkeeping with reputed institutes/hotels in Meghalaya. 1. Regular, monitoring, and need-based training during the initial years, with a dedicated app/dashboard for progress tracking.
## Eligibility Criteria **Individuals should:** 1. The applicant should be a resident of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The applicant should not be a defaulter at any financial institution. 1. The applicant should apply only for new projects sanctioned under the scheme. 1. The applicant should own the land for the project and possess valid land documents, or the applicant should have a notarized lease agreement for a minimum period of 15 years. **Registered Entities should:** 1. The entity should be a registered society, cooperative, or similar organization involved in tourism-related activities. 1. The entity should be legally registered with the Government of Meghalaya. 1. The entity should provide an Incorporation Certificate or Registration Certificate, whichever is applicable. 1. The entity should not be a defaulter at any financial institution. 1. The entity should hold land ownership for the project site or have a valid lease certified by competent authorities.
## Exclusions **Individuals** **Applications shall not be ordinarily considered for:** A. Pressure groups and organizations primarily political in nature B. More than one member from a single family C. Following individuals and their immediate family members (spouse, parents, children up to age 30): i. State and Central Government employees ii. Employees of public sector undertakings, their subsidiaries, or divisions iii. Politically affiliated individuals (MLAs, MLCs, MPs, etc.) or those seeking public office iv. Registered class-1 contractors v. Consultants currently engaged with State or Central Government **Registered Entities** **Applications shall not be ordinarily considered for:** A. Pressure groups and organizations primarily political in nature B. Entities led by or involving: i. State and Central Government employees ii. Employees of public sector undertakings, subsidiaries, or divisions iii. Politically affiliated individuals (MLAs, MLCs, MPs, etc.) iv. Registered class-1 contractors v. Consultants currently engaged with State or Central Government

It encourages entrepreneurship by providing financial assistance for operating motorcaravans and aims to create employment opportunities while offering unique travel experiences across Meghalaya.

page_content:
# Meghalaya Motorcaravan Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Meghalaya | **Categories:** Travel & Tourism, Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Tourist, Transport, Travel Agents, Tour Operators | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Meghalaya Motorcaravan Scheme is a component of the CM-ELEVATE Program under the Tourism Department, Government of Meghalaya. The scheme aims to promote alternative tourism models and encourage rural and eco-tourism by supporting motorcaravan (campervan)–based travel experiences. It provides 50% financial support on the project cost and facilitates credit access through partner banks, enabling entrepreneurs to purchase and operate motorcaravans across the state. Through this initiative, the government seeks to create new tourism opportunities, support local entrepreneurship, and enhance sustainable travel experiences in Meghalaya.
## Benefits **Down Payment/Margin Money Support:** Total down payment will be 50% of the price of the vehicle. Of this: 1. 5% of the caravan price is to be paid by the entrepreneur to the bank. 1. 45% of the caravan price will be paid by the Government of Meghalaya to the entrepreneur through the bank. **EMI Support:** 1. To reduce the operational cost burden in the first year, the Government of Meghalaya will pay 5% of the vehicle cost, distributed equally over twelve months, as EMI co-payment. **Additional Support** 1. Vehicles will be installed with GPS devices with a 5-year warranty, the cost of which will be borne by the government (one-time only). 1. Branding cost of the vehicle will be borne by the entrepreneur and included in the total project cost. **Maximum Government Support:** 1. Maximum support will be 50% of the project cost or ₹ 25,00,000, whichever is lower. 1. Vehicle permit costs will be borne by the entrepreneur.
## Eligibility Criteria **Individuals** 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The applicant must hold a valid driving license. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant must have a minimum of 3 years of experience in the tourism service sector. 1. The applicant shall not be a credit defaulter from any bank. **For Registered Entities:** 1. The entity must be a recognized and registered tourism operator or tourism society with the Tourism Department, Government of Meghalaya. 1. The entity must have a minimum of 3 years of experience in the tourism service sector. 1. The entity shall not be a defaulter at any financial institution. 1. The entity must provide an Incorporation Certificate or registration certificate, whichever is applicable. 1. The entity shall not be a credit defaulter from any bank. **For Unregistered Entities:** 1. The entity can be any unregistered organization such as village organizations, self-help groups, or traditional communities based in Meghalaya. 1. The entity must be actively involved in the tourism sector. 1. The entity must have a minimum of 3 years of experience in the tourism service sector. 1. The entity shall not be a credit defaulter at any financial institution.
## Exclusions **Individuals** **Applications shall not be ordinarily considered for the following** A. Following individuals (currently employed as full-fledged or contractual, or retired and drawing pension) and their Immediate family members which includes spouse, parents, and children up to the age of 30 i. State and Central Government employees ii. Employees of public sector undertakings, subsidiaries of public sector undertakings and divisions of public sector undertakings etc. iii. Any individual whose job is concerned with politics such MLAs, MLCs, MPs etc. or seeking to hold a similar position in government iv. Registered class-1 contractors v. Consultants who are currently engaged with state or central government vi. Pressure groups and organizations that are primarily political in nature shall not be ordinarily considered B. Only one member from a family is eligible for the scheme. **Registered Entities** **Applications shall not be ordinarily considered for the following** A. State and Central Government employees B. metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, ₹1,20,000 financial assistance is provided for self-constructed houses in rural south Gujarat to support housing needs of Halpati (Talaviya, Nayaka) caste members included in Scheduled Tribes.

page_content:
# Halpati Housing Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Housing & Shelter | **Tags:** Housing, Financial Assistance, Schedule Tribe, Rural Development | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Halpati Housing Scheme” was launched by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Halpati (Talaviya, Nayaka) families belonging to Scheduled Tribes for building safe and sustainable housing. Under this scheme, monetary aid is provided in phases directly into the bank accounts of the Halpati beneficiaries residing in South Gujarat districts such as Surat, Tapi, Valsad, Navsari, Narmada, Bharuch, Chhotaudepur, and Vadodara.
## Benefits - Financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 provided for construction of housing.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should belong to the Halpati (Talaviya, Nayaka) caste, which is recognized under Scheduled Tribes. 1. The applicant should be a resident of South Gujarat districts: Surat, Tapi, Valsad, Navsari, Narmada, Bharuch, Chhotaudepur, or Vadodara. 1. The applicant should be a resident of rural areas within the specified districts.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the Gandhinagar Head Office and Sub-Offices at Surat and Valsad and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the sub-offices located at Surat and Valsad. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the sub-offices located at Surat and Valsad to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission and a unique identification number (if applicable).

metadata.schemeName: Padma Awards
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize distinguished and exceptional achievements across various fields of public service and national importance.

page_content:
# Padma Awards **Ministry:** Ministry Of Home Affairs | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Skills & Employment, Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Award, Public Service, Art, Social Work, Civil Service | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Padma Awards” has been launched by the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India. Under this scheme, civilian honours in the form of Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri are provided to individuals for their outstanding contributions. The awards emphasize excellence combined with public service across disciplines such as art, science, literature, sports, medicine, and social work.
## Benefits **Tangible Benefits** - Conferment of Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, or Padma Shri. - Sanad (Certificate) signed by the President of India. - Medallion along with a miniature replica for ceremonial use. - National recognition and prestige. - Publication of awardee’s name in the Gazette of India. **Mode of Disbursement** - Physical conferment of certificate and medallion at Rashtrapati Bhavan. - Announced annually on 26th January (Republic Day). - Presentation ceremony is usually held in March or April.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant can be any person without distinction of race, occupation, position, or gender. 1. The applicant should have rendered distinguished or exceptional service in any field. 1. The applicant should demonstrate “excellence plus,” meaning excellence combined with public service. 1. The applicant may belong to fields such as Art, Social Work, Public Affairs, Science & Engineering, Trade & Industry, Medicine, Literature & Education, Civil Service, Sports, or others. 1. The applicant should not be a serving Government employee; however, doctors and scientists are exempted. 1. The applicant may be considered posthumously only in rare and highly deserving cases within 1 year of demise. 1. The applicant should have a minimum gap of 5 years for receiving a higher category award. 1. The applicant should not misuse the award as a title.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Nominations are invited between 15th March and 31st July each year.** **Step 01:** The applicant visits the official [Padma Awards Portal](https://www.padmaawards.gov.in/). **Step 02:** Register/Login using official credentials of the recommending authority **Step 03:** Fill in the nomination form with complete details **Step 04:** Upload required documents, including citation and verification certificate **Step 05:** Ensure accurate entry of nominee details (including Hindi name) and submit the application online before the deadline. > **Post-Application Process** **Step 01:** The Committee evaluates candidates based on merit, impact, and public service contribution. **Step 02:** Recommendations are submitted to the Prime Minister and the President of India. **Step 03:** Final approval is granted by the President of India. **Step 04:** Awards are announced on Republic Day and presented at Rashtrapati Bhavan.

# National Award to Teachers (For Excellence in Vocational Training and Entrepreneurship Development) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Skill Development And Entrepreneurship | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** National Award, Teachers, Training, Entrepreneurship | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The objective of the National Award for Excellence in Vocational Training & Entrepreneurship Development, under the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Government of India, is to honor excellence among faculty, trainers, and master trainers in long-term and short-term training as well as entrepreneurship development, who have achieved outstanding performance and set benchmarks for others to emulate. **No. of Awardees** **A total of sixteen awards will be conferred each year. There shall be five award categories as per the details below:** 1. Category I: Best Skill Trainers – Long Term Training (09 Awards) 1. Sub Category (i): Best Skill Trainer in top 5 trades under CTS in ITIs - 05 1. Sub Category (ii): Best Skill Trainer in remaining engineering trades - 01 1. Sub Category (iii): Best Skill Trainer in remaining non-engineering trades - 01 1. Sub Category (iv): Best Skill Trainer Divyang trades - 01 1. Sub Category (v): Best Skill Trainer New Age Courses - 01 1. Category II: Best Skill Trainers – Short Term Training (03 Awards) 1. Category III: Best Master Trainers - Long Term Training (02 Awards) 1. Sub Category (i): Best Master Trainer in Engineering trades - 01 1. Sub Category (ii):Best Master Trainer in Non-Engineering trades - 01 1. Category IV: Best Master Trainers - Short Term Training (01 Award) 1. Category V: Excellence in Entrepreneurship Development (01 Award)
## Benefits **Each awardee shall be presented with:** - A Medal - A Certificate - Cash Prize of ₹50,000/-
## Eligibility Criteria **Category I & III: Best Skill Trainers and Master Trainers – Long-Term Training** 1. The applicant should be engaged as a trainer or master trainer on a regular basis. 1. The applicant should have at least five years of full-time experience at CTS and/or CITS, as applicable. 1. The applicant should not be above 55 years of age on the last date of receiving applications. 1. The applicant should not have received any category of the Kaushalacharya Award or National Award for Excellence in Vocational Training & Entrepreneurship Development in previous years. **Category II & IV: Best Skill Trainers and Master Trainers – Short-Term Training** 1. The applicant should be engaged as a trainer or master trainer on a regular basis. 1. The applicant should not be above 55 years of age on the last date of receiving applications. 1. The applicant should be a registered trainer on Skill India Digital Hub from a government institution with valid certification (at least up to October 2025) and delivering/have delivered short-term training programs. 1. The applicant should be a certified trainer/master trainer from an awarding body with valid certification (at least up to October 2025) and delivering/have delivered short-term training programs. 1. The applicant should not have received any category of the Kaushalacharya Award or National Award for Excellence in Vocational Training & Entrepreneurship Development in previous years. 1. The applicant should apply under only one category. **Category V: Excellence in Entrepreneurship Development** 1. The applicant should be a regular faculty member engaged in teaching entrepreneurship development programs/courses in a University/College/Institution recognized by UGC/AICTE or institutes established by an Act of Parliament. 1. The applicant should be engaged on a regular basis in the implementation of entrepreneurship development programs in Central or State Government institutions, including autonomous institutions. 1. The applicant should have at least five years of full-time experience. 1. The applicant should not be above 55 years of age on the last date of receiving applications. 1. The applicant should not have received any category of the Kaushalacharya Award or National Award for Excellence in Vocational Training & Entrepreneurship Development in previous years.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Registration:** **Step 1:** Visit the o[fficial website](https://awards.gov.in/) and click on the[ Registration button.](https://awards.gov.in/Registration/SignUp) **Step 2:** Select your category: Individual or Organization. **Step 3:** Fill in the required details: Individual: Name, Date of Birth, Nominator Type, Mobile, Email, Aadhaar Number. Organization: Type, Authorized Person Name, Date of Birth, Organization Description, Designation, Mobile, Email, Aadhaar Number. **Step 4:** Click Submit to complete registration. **Apply:** **Step 1:** [Log in](https://awards.gov.in/Login) to the portal using your registered credentials. **Step 2:** Select the scheme from the list of awards and click ["Nominate / Apply Now".](https://awards.gov.in/Home/AwardLibrary) **Step 3:** Fill in all mandatory fields in the online application form. **Step 4:** Click Submit to complete your application.

metadata.schemeName: The Lokpal of India Internship Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The Lokpal of India Internship Scheme offers students exposure to anti-corruption laws and institutions. Interns learn about governance, legal frameworks, and contribute ideas to enhance transparency and accountability in public administration.

page_content:
# The Lokpal of India Internship Scheme **Ministry:** The Lokpal of India | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Student, Internship, Stipend | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Lokpal of India launched "The Lokpal of India Internship Scheme". The interns will get an opportunity to learn about the implementation of the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, the Prevention of Corruption Act, the Central Vigilance Commission Act, the Delhi Police Establishment Act and other related laws and procedures. They will also learn about the functioning of various institutions like, the Lokpal, the Central Vigilance Commission, The Delhi Police Establishment (CBI), etc.
> **Duration:** The duration of the internship will be 6 weeks.
> **Attendance:** The interns will have to attend the office on all working days. ## Benefits - A stipend of ₹10,000/- per month. - The Lokpal of India gives a certificate to the interns completing the internship successfully. - The Lokpal of India provides working space, internet, and other appropriate facilities to the interns.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should be pursuing a regular undergraduate or postgraduate degree course in the field of Law, Political Science, Public Administration, Public Policy, Management, Economics, or Human Rights. 1. The applicant must have secured at least 75% or equivalent marks in the 12 class. 1. The undergraduate student must have completed at least two years of study in the undergraduate course. 1. The undergraduate student must have a minimum aggregate of 55% or equivalent marks in years completed till the date of application. 1. The postgraduate students must have a minimum aggregate of 55% or equivalent in the graduation course. 1. The applicant must have his own laptop for the internship. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested Candidate can apply through their Institute/College/University in the annexed [application form](https://lokpal.gov.in/pdfs/Advertisement_2023-24_Internship_Scheme_04012024.pdf). **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents by post or E-mail to the Deputy Secretary (Admn.), Lokpal of India: > **Plot No.6, Phase-II, Vasant Kunj, Institutional Area, New Delhi-110070.** > **Email – lokpal.us@gov.in** **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the Deputy Secretary (Admn.), Lokpal of India to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable). **NOTE:** The final list of selected interns will be displayed on the Lokpal of India website/notice\board.
> **Selection Procedure:** The interns will be selected by a committee appointed by the Hon'ble Chairperson. Criteria for selection would be (1) the course pursued, and (2) academic performance.

metadata.schemeName: Police Medal for Meritorious Service
metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, medals, official recognition, and service distinction are provided to the personnel serving in police, CAPFs, CPOs, and other public safety organizations.

page_content:
# Police Medal for Meritorious Service **Ministry:** Ministry Of Home Affairs | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Public Safety,Law & Justice, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Meritorious Service, Professional Excellence, Award, Police | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Police Medal for Meritorious Service (PM)” scheme has been launched by the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, under Police-I Division. The scheme aims to recognize consistent meritorious service, professional excellence, and dedication to duty among police and allied forces. Under this scheme, medals, official recognition, and service distinction are provided to eligible personnel serving in police, CAPFs, CPOs, and other public safety organizations.
## Benefits **Tangible Benefits** - Award of Police Medal for Meritorious Service. - National recognition and prestige. - Entry of award in official service records. - Enhanced career prospects and credibility. - Recognition of long-term service excellence. **Mode of Disbursement** - Physical medal and citation conferred by the competent authority. - Awarded annually on national occasions.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a serving police officer or personnel of CAPFs/CPOs. 1. The applicant should have a clean service record without major penalties. 1. The applicant should demonstrate meritorious and consistent service. 1. The applicant should have a minimum service of 18 years. 1. The applicant should have ACRs available for the last 10 years. 1. The applicant should have at least 8 Very Good or above ACRs; at least 1 should be Outstanding. 1. The applicant should not have any average ACR during the review period. 1. The applicant should have at least 1 ACR after the Non-Initiation Certificate (NIC) period (if applicable). 1. The applicant should not have more than 1 missing ACR. 1. The applicant should ensure the last year ACR is available. 1. The applicant should be physically fit and fall under SHAPE 1 category; relaxation to SHAPE 2 may be given in exceptional cases. 1. The applicant should not have more than 3 nominations (for Group A officers). 1. The applicant should not have adverse vigilance or disciplinary issues.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Application Process** **Step 01:** Visit the National Awards Portal: [https://www.awards.gov.in.](https://awards.gov.in/) **Step 02:** Register/Login using the official credentials of the recommending authority. **Step 03:** Fill in the nomination form with complete details. **Step 04:** Preparation of nomination proposal is done with complete service records and ACR/APAR details. **Step 05:** Upload required documents and the submission of recommendation is made by State Government or Central Organization. > **Post-Application Process** **Step 01:** Verification of ACR/APAR, vigilance, and service records is conducted thoroughly. **Step 02:** Screening and evaluation are undertaken by committees constituted under the Ministry of Home Affairs. **Step 03:** Final recommendation is prepared based on merit and eligibility conditions. **Step 04:** Approval is granted by the competent authority and the President of India after due consideration. **Step 05:** Announcement and conferment of the award are carried out on national occasions, where the medal and citation are formally presented to the selected awardees. > **Provision for Preparation of Duplicate Medal (In Case of Loss)** In exceptional cases, a duplicate medal shall be prepared only once. **Step 01:** The applicant should submit a copy of FIR for loss of medal with full justification through proper channel. **Step 02:** The cost of preparation shall be paid by the individual awardee through Bank Draft as suggested by India Government Mint. **Step 03:** A penalty of ₹10,000 (Rupees Ten Thousand only) shall be paid by the individual in favour of Pay and Accounts Officer, Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, through Demand Draft. **Step 04:** The duplicate medal will be issued only after verification and payment confirmation.

metadata.schemeName: Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar
metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
metadata.briefDescription: The Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar (RKVP) aims to honor scientists and technical experts for outstanding contributions and innovations in agriculture and allied sciences.

page_content:
# Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar **Ministry:** Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Krishi, Award, Farmer, Sciences, Technologies | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar under Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR),Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India, recognizes and honors scientists and technical personnel who have made outstanding contributions in agriculture, agricultural education, extension, and allied sciences. This includes the development of new processes, products, tools, technologies, and innovative practices that enhance agricultural productivity and sustainability in India. **Fields Covered:** **The awards are categorized under three main streams, each covering the following four fields:** 1. Crops & Horticultural Sciences 1. Natural Resources Management & Agricultural Engineering 1. Animal & Fisheries Sciences 1. Social Sciences **Award Categories & Number of Awardees:** 1. Innovation & Technology in Agriculture & Allied Sciences – 4 awardees 1. Research in Agriculture & Allied Sciences – 4 awardees 1. Outstanding Interdisciplinary Team Research in Agriculture, Agricultural Education, Extension & Allied Sciences – 1 awardee 1. Outstanding Woman Scientist in Agriculture, Agricultural Education, Extension & Allied Sciences – 1 awardee 1. Outstanding Young Scientist in Agriculture & Allied Sciences – 4 awardees
## Benefits i. In the Award Ceremony, the Awardees shall be presented a Sanad (certificate) signed by the Hon'ble Union Minister (Agriculture & Farmers Welfare) & President, ICAR. A commemorative brochure, containing the citation and photograph of the awardees shall also be released on the day of the ceremony. ii. The decoration to such persons who are not able to attend the award ceremony due to personal reasons (including indisposition, preoccupation, etc.) shall be deemed to have been conferred. No other person (including the spouse/next of kin) should be allowed to receive the award on behalf of the absentee awardee except in posthumous cases.
## Eligibility Criteria **General Conditions:** 1. The applicant should be an Indian scientist working in agriculture or allied fields in ICAR institutes, public agricultural institutions, or Krishi Vigyan Kendras, and must have made significant contributions in India. 1. The applicant should have work (research, innovation, or extension) that shows clear and proven impact on society, economy, or environment, supported by the Head of the Institution. 1. The applicant can apply at any stage of their career, as no minimum service period is required. 1. The applicant should submit only one application for a particular contribution in a year, and the application will be valid only for that year. 1. The applicant should have a clean service record, with no pending enquiry or major punishment in the last five years. 1. The applicant should apply under only one category and cannot be considered for multiple categories. **Category-wise Conditions:** 1. The applicant can apply individually or as part of a team (maximum five members) for innovation and research awards, and must be below 60 years of age. 1. The applicant applying for interdisciplinary research should be part of a team of at least three members from different disciplines, and the team leader must be below 60 years of age. 1. The applicant applying for the women scientist category should be a woman working in agriculture or allied fields, and must be below 60 years of age. 1. The applicant applying for the young scientist category should have a doctoral degree, hold a regular position, and must be below 45 years of age.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Registration:** **Step 1:** Visit the o[fficial website](https://awards.gov.in/) and click on the[ Registration button.](https://awards.gov.in/Registration/SignUp) **Step 2:** Select your category: Individual or Organization. **Step 3:** Fill in the required details: Individual: Name, Date of Birth, Nominator Type, Mobile, Email, Aadhaar Number. Organization: Type, Authorized Person Name, Date of Birth, Organization Description, Designation, Mobile, Email, Aadhaar Number. **Step 4:** Click Submit to complete registration. **Apply:** **Step 1:** [Log in](https://awards.gov.in/Login) to the portal using your registered credentials. **Step 2:** Select the scheme from the list of awards and click "[Nominate / Apply Now".](https://awards.gov.in/Home/AwardLibrary) **Step 3:** Fill in all mandatory fields in the online application form. **Step 4:** Click Submit to complete your application.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize and celebrate the outstanding efforts of States, UTs, Districts, and Indian Missions Abroad in promoting local products. It also seeks to boost economic development and support the Hon’ble Prime Minister’s vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat.

page_content:
# One District One Product (ODOP) Awards **Ministry:** Ministry Of Commerce And Industry | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Awards, Industry, E Commerce, Indian Missions Abroad | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The One District One Product Awards (here in after, the 'Award') have been instituted by the **Department for the Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India,** to acknowledge the extraordinary work done by States/ UTs, Districts, and Indian Missions Abroad, for the economic development of the State and contribute towards the realization of the Hon’ble Prime Minister’s vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat. **No. of Awardees** There will be total 38 awards under 5 heads (States/UTs, Districts, Indian Missions Abroad, E-Commerce platforms and Central Ministries/Departments) - 9 Awards for States/UTs - 12 Awards for Districts - 15 Awards for Indian Missions Abroad - 1 Award for E-Commerce platforms - 1 Award for Central Ministries/Departments - The above division is tentative and subject to change.
## Benefits Under this scheme, each awardee will receive a commemorative trophy and certificate recognizing excellence in their respective award category. The award will reflect the recipient’s unique contribution to promoting One District One Product (ODOP) and will be customized according to the specific category.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. All States/ UTs, Districts, Indian Missions Abroad, E-Commerce platforms, and Central Ministries/departments are eligible for the award. 1. The applications will be considered valid for the progress achieved in the promotion of the identified product from the respective district identified under DPIIT’s ODOP initiative only. The [list of products ](https://static.investindia.gov.in/s3fs-public/2025-07/v31_odop_product_list_20250702.pdf)identified under the initiative can be accessed.
## Exclusions **Non-Eligible Applicants under the ODOP Awards:** 1. Private companies, individual artisans, and businesses cannot apply directly. 1. NGOs are not eligible to apply for the awards.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Registration:** **Step 1:** Visit the o[fficial website](https://awards.gov.in/) and click on the[ Registration button.](https://awards.gov.in/Registration/SignUp) **Step 2:** Select your category: Individual or Organization. **Step 3:** Fill in the required details: Individual: Name, Date of Birth, Nominator Type, Mobile, Email, Aadhaar Number. Organization: Type, Authorized Person Name, Date of Birth, Organization Description, Designation, Mobile, Email, Aadhaar Number. **Step 4:** Click Submit to complete registration. **Apply:** **Step 1:** [Log in](https://awards.gov.in/Login) to the portal using your registered credentials. **Step 2:** Select the scheme from the list of awards and click ["Nominate / Apply Now".](https://awards.gov.in/Home/AwardLibrary) **Step 3:** Fill in all mandatory fields in the online application form. **Step 4:** Click Submit to complete your application.

metadata.schemeName: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote innovations in individuals, start-ups, and Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (PRISM). It offers financial support (up to ₹20,00,000/-) for Indian Citizens working on innovation projects requiring fabrication of working models, patenting, or technology transfer.

page_content:
# PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer **Ministry:** Ministry Of Science And Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Science, IT & Communications, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Innovation, Patent, Invention, Prototype, Technology | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Promoting Innovations In Individuals, Start-Ups And Micro, Small And Medium Enterprises (PRISM)" was launched by the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research, Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India. The scheme aims to promote innovations in individuals, start-ups and micro, small and medium enterprises. The scheme provides support for Individual Innovator Proposals under Phase-I, Category II, focusing on Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer. Key features include comparatively more rigorous demonstrability of original idea/invention/know-how in the form of working prototype/processes and its testing and trial/patenting/technology transfer. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR). The applications for this scheme are accepted by submission to the nearest TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centres (TOCICs) or directly to the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research.
## Benefits ***The maximum support under Category II is ₹20,00,000/- or 90% of the approved project cost, whichever is lower. The approved project cost must be more than ₹5,00,000/- and up to ₹35,00,000/-.***
##### ***Eligible Components for Support*** - Research and Development/Design Engineering/Consultancy charges. - Rental charges for laboratory/workshop facilities. - Essential equipment that cannot be taken on rent (reasons for purchase must be given). - Raw material/spares/consumables cost. - Fabrication/synthesis charges. - Manpower cost of technical assistants, not exceeding 20% of the approved project cost. - Testing and trials. - Travel cost, not exceeding 5% of the approved project cost. - Patent filing (actual fee paid to the patent office). - Process know-how development. - Proposals involving scientifically characterizing or testing the efficacy and toxicity of herbal formulations. ##### ***Exclusions from Support*** - Innovator’s salary. - Rental expenses for use of own facilities. ##### ***Disbursement*** - The first release is based on milestones/deliverables projected in the project proposals and as recommended by the PRISM Advisory and Screening Committee (PASC). - Subsequent releases are based on the assessment of the progress of the project by the Project Review Committee (PRC). ##### ***Conditions*** - The applicant has to sign "Terms & Conditions" prior to the actual release of grants-in-aid. - The approved projects will be monitored by the TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centre/other network partners, including technical expert(s). - The TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centres will be periodically reporting project status to the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research at an interval of 3 months. - The Project Review Committees, consisting of external experts, will meet at least once in nine months to review the progress of the project. - For student innovators, the institution will be responsible for final completion of the project in case the Innovator leaves the Institute/Organization without completion of the project.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an Indian Citizen. - The applicant must have an innovative idea or an invention. - The applicant must propose a project where the project cost is more than ₹5,00,000/- and up to ₹35,00,000/-. - The applicant must ensure the project duration does not exceed 24 months. - The applicant must ensure the proposal involves the fabrication of a working model/process know-how/testing and trial/patenting/technology transfer. - The applicant must ensure the proposal does not involve only software development. - The applicant must ensure the proposal is not for basic scientific research having no immediate commercial implications. ##### ***Specific Conditions*** - **Students:** The applicant must provide a `No Objection Certificate’ from the head of their institution on the institution’s letterhead.- **Students:** The applicant must ensure the commitment from the institution that the project will be taken to its logical conclusion by the student/concerned faculty.- **Individuals Working in Organizations:** The applicant must furnish a `No Objection Certificate’ from their employer. ##### ***Desirable Criteria (Preference)*** - The proposals should preferably be in the following focus sectors: Green Technology, Clean Energy, Industrially utilizable smart materials, Waste to wealth, Affordable healthcare, Water & sewage management, or any other technology or knowledge-intensive area. - Preference: Student innovators making it to the final of any competition are eligible, but they should take the project as a full-time activity after graduation to ensure their studies are not adversely affected. - The applicant should ensure the proposal is submitted through the nearest TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centre, even if scouted, documented, and mentored by other agencies, and must include evaluation by the assisting agency.
## Exclusions - Proposals involving only software development. - Proposals involving only patenting (unless patenting is along with prototype development). - Proposals for basic scientific research having no immediate commercial implication
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Proposals can be submitted to the following -** - The nearest TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centres (TOCICs). - The Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR).
##### **Step 1:****** ***Consultation and Preparation*** - The innovator should meet coordinators of TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centres (TOCICs) and take their advice before submitting the application. - The applicant must prepare the [application form](https://www.dsir.gov.in/sites/default/files/2019-09/guide_ph1_cat2.pdf), ensuring all mandatory details like the Title of the proposed project, Name, Address, Date of Birth, Educational qualification, Annual Income, Permanent Account Number (PAN) (mandatory), and Aadhaar Number are included. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Submission of Proposal*** - The applicant must submit the application either directly to the nearest TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centre (TOCIC) or directly to the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR). - Proposals submitted directly to the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research will be forwarded to the relevant TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centre for counselling and local screening.
##### **Post-Application Processes** ##### **Step 1:****** ***Initial Screening for Completeness*** The proposals will initially be screened for completeness at the point of receipt by the coordinators of the TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centres. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Evaluation by Domain Knowledge Experts*** After initial Screening, the complete and screened proposals are evaluated by the Domain Knowledge Experts associated with the TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centre. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Submission to the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research*** The TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centres will send complete and evaluated proposals to the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research for further action. ##### **Step 4:****** ***Committee Recommendation*** The proposals will then be considered by the PRISM Advisory and Screening Committee (PASC) for final recommendation. ##### **Step 5:** **Final Approval and Sanction** The sanction will finally be released to those projects that are approved by the Department. ##### **Step 6:****** ***Signing of Terms and Conditions*** The applicant has to sign the "Terms & Conditions" document prior to the actual release of the grants-in-aid.
##### ***Disbursement*** ##### **Step 1:****** ***First Release*** The first release of funds is based on milestones and deliverables projected in the project proposals and as recommended by the PRISM Advisory and Screening Committee (PASC). ##### **Step 2:****** ***Subsequent Fund Release and Monitoring*** Subsequent releases of funds are based on the assessment of the progress of the project by the Project Review Committee (PRC). The approved projects will be monitored by the TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centre/other network partners, including technical expert(s), and the Project Review Committees will meet at least once in nine months to review the progress of the project. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Project Closure*** The project completion report will be accepted by the Competent Authority in the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research, based on the Project Review Committee recommendation, after the successful closure of the project.

metadata.schemeName: Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme “Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence (TARE)” was launched by Science & Engineering Research Board, Department of Science & Technology, Government of India which aims to facilitate mobility of faculty members working in State Universities /Colleges/Private Academic institutions.

page_content:
# Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence

**Ministry:** Ministry Of Science And Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Science, IT & Communications | **Tags:** TARE, Teacher, Research, Faculty, Fellowship, SERB | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme “Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence (TARE)” was launched by the Science and Engineering Research Board, Department of Science & Technology, Government of India which aims to facilitate the mobility of faculty members working in a regular capacity in State Universities / Colleges and in private Academic Institutions to carry out research work in an established public-funded central institution such as IITs, IISc, IISERS, National Institutions (NITs, CSIR, ICAR, ICMR labs and other central institutions) and Central Universities, located preferably nearer to the institution where the faculty member is working. Research work will be carried out in such a manner to ensure that the PI continues to work in the host institute as well as his / her parent institute on mutually agreed terms between the PI and Mentor.
**Areas Covered under the scheme:**
The scheme covers areas under Life Sciences, Physical Sciences, Chemical Sciences, Engineering Sciences, Earth and Atmospheric Sciences, and Mathematical Sciences, including interdisciplinary areas.
> **Duration of Support:**

The duration of support is three years.

## Benefits
1. Research fellowship of ₹60,000/- per year (in addition to the researcher’s own salary) will be provided subject to completion of a minimum of 90 days of research work per year in the host institution.
   1. Research grant of ₹5 lakhs per annum (50% each to host and parent institution) and overheads (as per SERB norms) will be provided.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. Indian citizens residing in India holding a Ph.D. degree in Science/Engineering or MS/MD in Medicine are eligible to apply.
   1. The applicant(s) must hold a regular academic/research position in State Universities/ Colleges and private Academic Institutions.
   1. Applicant should not hold any ongoing research projects or any fellowship at the time of submission of application.
   1. The upper age limit for the award is 45 years at the time of the submission of the application. Age relaxation of 5 (five) years will be given to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/Physically Challenged & Women candidates.
   1. Mentor should be at the level of Associate Professor/Scientist E, or higher level.
   1. Only one candidate will be allowed to work with a mentor at any given point of time.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
**Step 01:** The call for proposals will be notified through the website [www.serbonline.in](https://www.serbonline.in/SERB/HomePage) and [www.serb.gov.in](https://serb.gov.in/page/english/awards_fellowship#Teachers%20Associateship%20for%20Research%20Excellence%20(TARE))
**Step 02:** Applicant(s) should first register on the online website.  [Click here to register](https://www.serbonline.in/SERB/Registration)
**Step 03:** After login, the applicant(s) are required to fill all the mandatory fields in the Profile Detail section under User Profile, which includes Bio-data, Photo, and Institute Address, etc.
**Step 04:** Summary of the project proposal; Project Title (max 500 characters), Abstract of the proposed work (max 3000 characters), Keywords (max 6), Objectives of the project (max 1500 characters), Expected output and outcome of the proposal (max 1500 characters), have to be entered at the time of proposal submission.
**Step 05:** Other relevant information of the proposal must be uploaded in a single PDF file not more than 10 MB as other technical documents (OTD).
**Note:** The proposals will be evaluated through peer review processes as per SERB guidelines.

metadata.schemeName: Personality Development and Yogasan Training Camp for Schedule Caste
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "Personality Development and Yogasan Training Camp for Schedule Caste Youth" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to promote the physical, mental, and spiritual development of Scheduled Caste youth through 7-day training camps.

page_content:
# Personality Development and Yogasan Training Camp for Schedule Caste **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Youth Development, Yoga Training, Personality Development, Physical Fitness | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Personality Development and Yogasan Training Camp for Schedule Caste Youth" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to foster the overall development—physical, mental, and spiritual—of youth 14–35 years)belonging to the Scheduled Castes through structured yogasana and personality development programs. Each camp runs for 7 days and selects 50 beneficiaries per district from across Gujarat. The initiative serves to empower socially disadvantaged youth and enhance their self-esteem, discipline, and holistic well-being. The scheme is implemented by the District Youth Development Officers across all districts of Gujarat.
## Benefits - **Training:** The selected Scheduled Caste youth will receive 7 days of training focused on personality development and yogasana.


## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be between the age of 14 to 35 years.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant should download the [application form](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in/ViewForm.aspx) or applicants may visit the Sports Directorate and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form. **Step 2:** All required fields in the form should be completed carefully, and copies of the necessary documents must be enclosed (self-attestation may be required). **Step 3:** Submit the properly filled and signed application form, along with all attached documents, to the District Youth Development Office. **Step 4:** Ensure to obtain a submission receipt or acknowledgment slip from the official receiving the application for future reference.

# Scheme of Financial Assistance to Literary/Educational Institutions for Organizing Programs/Conferences **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Educational Conferences, Seminar, Sahitya Sammelan, Cultural Events | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Scheme of Financial Assistance to Literary/Educational Institutions for Organizing Programs/Conferences" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide grants to registered institutions for organizing events such as seminars, dialogues, conventions, workshops, and literary festivals. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Sahitya Academy, and financial assistance is disbursed based on actual expenses, subject to a maximum limit. Institutions must comply with language usage norms, use appropriate branding and logos, and submit reports and financial documentation after event completion. Events can be state-level, national, or international, and must involve recognized speakers, literary scholars, and culturally relevant topics.

## Benefits > **Funding Assistance for Institutions:** - Up to ₹50,000/- or 75% of the actual expenditure, whichever is lower, is provided for organizing approved literary or educational events. > **Honorarium for Speakers:** - An honorarium of up to ₹2,000/- per speaker can be paid to invited speakers participating in the event. > **Note:** - Any honorarium amount exceeding ₹2,000/- will not be reimbursed by the Gujarat Sahitya Academy and must be borne by the organizing institution. - Events must be reported with bills, photos, invitation cards, and video recordings.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. A registered literary or educational institution shall be eligible. 1. Only 2 programs can organize per year by the institution. 1. The program must be related to literature, education, or cultural discourse. 1. The institution must use the Gujarati language in all materials (alongside any other language). 1. The event must clearly acknowledge Gujarat Sahitya Academy through logos and name placement. 1. The program must involve a minimum 5 speakers. 1. All payments above ₹5,000/- must be made through banking channels only (RTGS/NEFT/Cheque).
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the online [application form](https://gujaratsahityaacademy.com/user/yojana/add/Njc1MjQxNQ==) page. **Step 2:** In the application form, provide all the mandatory details, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents. **Step 3:** Click on the checkbox and verify the captcha. **Step 4:** Click on the "Submit" button to complete the application process. > **Contact Us:** > Gujarat Sahitya Academy > Jawerchand Meghani Bhavan,Behind Krishi Bhavan,Sector 10-A,Gandhinagar -382010. > Phone: 079 - 23256797, 23256798; 7621005656 > Email: gsagandhinagar@gmail.com

# Assistance to Women for Trainer and Coaches Training Course **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Women Coaches, Girls, Sports | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Assistance to Women for Trainer and Coaches Training Course” by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat aims to promote and enhance the participation of women in sports through structured academic training by supporting them financially for pursuing diploma courses in sports. It seeks to enable women to take up professional training to become certified coaches and trainers, thereby boosting employment opportunities and representation in the sports sector. page_content:
# Financial Assistance to Helpless Artists **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Senior Citizen, Artist, Physically Disabled, PwD | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Financial Assistance to Helpless Artists” scheme was launched by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial security to artists who are aged, physically disabled, and living in extreme poverty. Under this scheme, monthly financial assistance is provided to artists and their dependents who are physically disabled, above 60 years of age, have a monthly income of less than ₹600, and are unable to sustain themselves due to age or disability.
## Benefits Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to artists to help them sustain themselves in old age or in case of disability.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be an artist who has made significant contributions in the field of art and literature. 1. The applicant must be 60 years of age or above. 1. The applicant must have a monthly income of less than ₹600/- (₹7,200/- annually). 1. The applicant must be physically disabled. 1. The applicant must be in poor economic condition.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should write the application on plain paper. **Step 2:** Attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required) along with the application. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application along with the documents to the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department.

metadata.schemeName: Satfera Samuhlagna (DCW) Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage community marriages among economically and socially backward classes. Incentives are provided to couples and the organizing institutions.

page_content:
# Satfera Samuhlagna (DCW) Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Marriage, EBC, SEBC, Female | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Satfera Samuhlagna (DCW)" scheme was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. It aims to promote social welfare and support financially weaker sections through community marriages. Under this scheme, an incentive amount is given to newly married couples belonging to socially and educationally backward classes and economically backward classes. Additionally, ₹3,000 per couple (up to ₹75,000) is provided to the organizing institution.
## Benefits **Monetary Incentive to Couples:** - ₹12,000 is provided to each newly married couple from socially and educationally backward classes and economically backward classes. **Support to Organizing Institutions:** - ₹3,000 per couple is granted to the organizing institution, up to a maximum of ₹75,000 per event.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a newly married female. 1. The applicant should belong to a Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC) or Economically Backward Class. 1. The applicant’s annual individual income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 01:** The eligible applicant may visit the e-Samaj Kalyan Portal: [https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/) **Step 02:** On the home page, under the tab ‘Citizen Login’, click on New User ‘[Please Register Here](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/Registration.aspx)’. **Step 03:** Enter your Full Name as per Aadhaar Card, Gender, Date of Birth, Aadhaar Card Number, Email ID, Caste etc. and then click on ‘Register’. **Step 04:** After successful registration, the applicants can login through their User ID and Password. **Step 05:** Now, click on ‘User Profile’ to update your profile. **Step 06:** Fill in all the mandatory information and then click on ‘Update’. **Step 07:** After updating the profile successfully, select the scheme appearing on the home page; an application form will open. **Step 08:** Fill in all the mandatory details in the application form and upload all the relevant documents. **Step 09:** Now agree with the terms & conditions and click on ‘Save Application’. **Step 10:** Submit the application form and take out the print of the application for future reference. The applicant can note down the application number to track the application status by logging into the portal using their User ID and Password. [User Manual](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/HelpManual/Citizen-HelpManual.pdf)

page_content:
# Financial Loan for Training of Commercial Pilot **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Loan, Training, Opportunity, Skill Development, Interest Rate, SEBC | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Financial Loan for Training of Commercial Pilot" scheme was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to support students from Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC) in obtaining Commercial Pilot License (CPL) training through financial assistance. Under this scheme, a loan is offered at a concessional interest rate to eligible students who meet the educational and institutional requirements for CPL training.
## Benefits **Loan Amount:****** - Up to ₹25,00,000 for Commercial Pilot License training. **Interest Rate:****** - 4% simple interest per annum. **Penal Interest:** - 2.5% additional interest for late or defaulted payments. **Repayment Period:** - Principal: To be repaid within 10 years from the date of disbursement. - Interest: To be paid within 2 years, making the total repayment duration 12 years. > **NOTE:** Loan recovery will begin one year after the loan is disbursed to the student.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must belong to a Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC). 1. The applicant must have passed Matriculation, Higher Secondary, Indian School Certificate, or an equivalent examination. 1. The applicant must meet all academic, technical, and other criteria as specified by the training institution. 1. The applicant must provide one solvent guarantor. 1. The applicant or their guardian must own property to mortgage in favor of the government.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Application Process:** **Step 01:** The eligible applicant may visit the e-Samaj Kalyan Portal: [https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/) **Step 02:** On the home page, under the tab ‘Citizen Login’, click on New User ‘[Please Register Here](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/Registration.aspx)’. **Step 03:** Enter your Full Name as per Aadhaar Card, Gender, Date of Birth, Aadhaar Card Number, Email ID, Caste etc. and then click on ‘Register’. **Step 04:** After successful registration, the applicants can login through their User ID and Password. **Step 05:** Now, click on ‘User Profile’ to update your profile. **Step 06:** Fill in all the mandatory information and then click on ‘Update’. **Step 07:** After updating the profile successfully, select the scheme appearing on the home page; an application form will open. **Step 08:** Fill in all the mandatory details in the application form and upload all the relevant documents. **Step 09:** Now agree with the terms & conditions and click on ‘Save Application’. **Step 10:** Submit the application form and take out the print of the application for future reference. The applicant can note down the application number to track the application status by logging into the portal using their User ID and Password. [User Manual](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/HelpManual/Citizen-HelpManual.pdf) **NOTE:** Submit two physical copies of the form with documents to the concerned District Office. > **Post-Application Process:** **Step 01:** The District Office verifies the application and forwards it to the Director, Office of Welfare of Developing Castes. **Step 02:** Incomplete applications are returned to the student for corrections. **Step 03:** Once approved, the guardian must mortgage their property with a registered deed in favor of the government. **Step 04:** After submitting the original registered mortgage deed, the loan amount is disbursed to the student’s bank account.

metadata.schemeName: Loan For Foreign Study (S.E.B.C.)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support higher education abroad for eligible students from the Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC). It provides a maximum Foreign Study Loan of ₹15,00,000/- at an annual interest rate of 4% to SEBC students.

page_content:
# Loan For Foreign Study (S.E.B.C.) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Student, Loan, Education, Mortgage, College | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Loan for Foreign Study (S.E.B.C.)" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide students belonging to the Socially and Educationally Backward Class (S.E.B.C.) with financial assistance for higher education abroad. The scheme provides a maximum loan of ₹15,00,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Lakh) for higher studies in foreign countries. The applications for this scheme are accepted online via the official website [https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/).
## Benefits ##### ***Financial Assistance*** - A maximum Foreign Study Loan of ₹15,00,000/- is provided for higher education abroad. - The loan is offered at a simple annual interest rate of 4%. - The loan covers costs such as air tickets, registration fees, tuition fees, education fees, hostel fees, books, and other expenses associated with the first year of the course abroad. ##### ***Disbursement Conditions*** - The full loan amount of ₹15,00,000/- will be disbursed to the student in a single installment. - The money will be deposited into the student's bank account after the submission of the original registered mortgage deed. ##### ***Post-Selection Obligations*** - After the sanction order is received, the student's parent or guardian must obtain the prescribed mortgage deed form from the District Office. - The property presented by the student's parent/guardian or the guarantor must be registered as a mortgage in favor of the government. - The loan repayment must begin one year after the completion of the student's study. - The loan must be repaid in monthly or quarterly installments. - The principal loan amount must be fully repaid within a maximum period of 10 years. - The interest amount must be fully repaid within a maximum period of 2 years. - The student must ensure all required documentation is completed within the prescribed time limit.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Class (S.E.B.C.). - The applicant's family annual income must be less than ₹10,00,000/- (Rupees Ten Lakh). - The applicant must have secured a minimum of 60% or more marks in 12th standard. - The applicant must have secured a minimum of 50% marks if they belong to Notified Tribes/De-notified Tribes (NT/DNT), More Backward, or Extremely Backward categories. - The applicant must be pursuing higher education abroad. - The applicant must be pursuing a Diploma, Graduate, Post Graduate, Post Graduate Diploma, Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.), or higher-level courses in any field. - The course must be for a minimum duration of 1 (one) academic year or more, or at least two semesters. - The applicant must apply before traveling abroad or within six months of arriving abroad. - The applicant must submit one solvent guarantor.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Website of [eSamajkalyan](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/index.aspx). **Step 2:** In the right pane of the home page, click "[New User? Please Register Here!](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/Registration.aspx)". You will be taken to the Registration Form. **Step 3:** In the form, provide all the mandatory fields, fill in the captcha code, and click "Submit" to complete the registration process. A popup will appear acknowledging successful registration and displaying your User ID for Login.

In the "Citizen Login" section provided in the right pane of the home page, provide your User ID and Password, fill in the Captcha Code, then click "Login". **Step 2:** In the ribbon provided at the top of the website, click the "Corporation" menu, then click "Gujarat State Divyangjan Finance and Development Corporation". metadata.schemeName: Meghalaya Sericulture & Weaving Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship in sericulture and weaving by providing financial support. It also focuses on strengthening Eri and Muga silk production and promoting Meghalaya’s yarn and fabric in national and global markets.

page_content:
# Meghalaya Sericulture & Weaving Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Meghalaya | **Categories:** Skills & Employment, Business & Entrepreneurship, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Yarn And Fabric, International Silk, Eri Silk, Sericulture | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The **Meghalaya Sericulture and Weaving Scheme**, implemented by the Department of Textiles under the Planning, Investment Promotion & Sustainable Development Department of the Government of Meghalaya, is a credit-linked scheme that provides up to 75% financial assistance on the total project cost to support entrepreneurs and collectives in starting sericulture and weaving activities. The scheme focuses mainly on Eri silk, a traditional and exclusive fabric of Meghalaya, and also supports Muga silk due to the state’s favorable climate. It aims to promote the silk industry by helping set up grainages for producing Disease-Free Layings (DFL), spinning or reeling and natural dyeing units, and weaving units, thereby unlocking entrepreneurial potential and placing Meghalaya yarn and fabric on the international silk map.
## Benefits 1. 75% of project cost supported by Government of Meghalaya as upfront margin money (5% by entrepreneur, 20% as bank loan) 2. Credit linkage through partnered banks – State Bank of India (SBI) and Indian Bank 3. Guidance in application process through implementing agencies 4. Support in project realization and facilitation for unit setup under CM-ELEVATE framework 5. Training and capacity building for entrepreneurs to successfully operate grainage, spinning, reeling, dyeing, and weaving units 6. Financial assistance applicable for multiple unit types, including Eri Spinning, Muga Reeling, Weaving, and Grainage (with or without infrastructure support) 7. One-time infrastructure support (500 sq ft/1000 sq ft shed) for eligible applicants, as per selected option 8. Equipment cost coverage for spinning, reeling, weaving, dyeing, and grainage operations as per model estimates

## Eligibility Criteria **For Collectives (Registered & Unregistered Entities):** 1. The collective must be based in the village where the program is being implemented. 1. The registered entity must have at least 10 members. 1. The collective must have prior experience in spinning and weaving, with a bonafide certificate from the District Sericulture Officer/District Handloom Officer stating that at least 5 members are spinners, reelers, or weavers, or valid Handloom ID cards for at least 5 weavers issued by the Government of Meghalaya. 1. The collective should employ a minimum of 5 spinners or weavers, supported by an undertaking. 1. The collective applying for Grainage must have staff with a minimum educational qualification of 10th pass and a bonafide certificate from the District Sericulture Office confirming at least 2 years of experience in the production of layings. 1. The collective must have an active bank account and submit bank statements for the last 6 months. 1. The collective must have been operating for at least two years. 1. The collective must possess land, either self-owned or leased, verified by the competent authority. **For Individuals:** 1. The individual must be a permanent resident of Meghalaya. 1. The individual must have completed training in spinning or weaving, supported by a certificate from a registered training provider, a bonafide certificate from the District Sericulture Officer/District Handloom Officer, or a valid Handloom ID issued by the Government of Meghalaya. 1. The individual applying for Grainage must have a minimum educational qualification of 10th pass and at least 2 years of experience in the production of layings, certified by the District Sericulture Office. 1. The individual must be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The individual must not be a credit defaulter from any bank.
## Exclusions

metadata.schemeName: Interest Subsidy Scheme on Education Loan
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "Interest Subsidy Scheme on Education Loan" by the Education Department, Gujarat, aims to provide financial support to students by offering 100% interest subsidy on education loans.

page_content:
# Interest Subsidy Scheme on Education Loan **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Education Loan, Higher Education, Interest Subsidy, Abroad Study | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Interest Subsidy Scheme on Education Loan" by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide complete financial relief to students through 100% interest subsidy on education loans for the entire moratorium period. This includes the study period and 1 additional year after course completion.
## Benefits - **Interest Subsidy Assistance:** 100% interest subsidy on education loans up to ₹10,00,000/- for the moratorium period (course duration + 1 year).
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must have passed HSC (Higher Secondary Certificate) with at least 60 percentile. 1. The applicant must have taken an education loan from a recognized bank for pursuing higher education in India or abroad. 1. The applicant must have a family income not exceeding ₹6,00,000/- per year.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit [https://isel.guj.nic.in](https://isel.guj.nic.in/) and register using your mobile number and email ID. **Step 2:** Log in with OTP and change the password. **Step 3:** Enter name, Aadhaar number, Ration Card number, and enrollment details correctly. **Step 4:** Provide parent/guardian contact details and complete registration.
> **Application Process:** **Step 1:** Log in to [https://isel.guj.nic.in](https://isel.guj.nic.in/) and click “Apply.” **Step 2:** Enter course details and fill out the online form. **Step 3:** Upload all required documents in the specified format. **Step 4:** Visit the designated help center within 7 days for document verification and submit the application set and collect the acknowledgement receipt. (For students abroad – parent/guardian with Power of Attorney signs and submits documents).
> **Contact Us:** **Kcg E-Mail Id:** isel-kcg[at]gujgov[dot]edu[dot]in **Helpline No:** 9909039380 (10:30 AM to 6:00 PM)

metadata.schemeName: Swami Vivekananda Utkrisht Chhatravriti Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme “Swami Vivekananda Utkrisht Chhatravriti Yojana” is a Scholarship Scheme by the Dept. of Education, Govt. of Himachal Pradesh. An amount of ₹ 18,000/- per year will be given to the general category students for two successive years after matric. 2000 scholarships are awarded every year.

page_content:
# Swami Vivekananda Utkrisht Chhatravriti Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Himachal Pradesh | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** School, Student, Financial Assistance, Scholarship, Education | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Swami Vivekananda Utkrisht Chhatravriti Yojna" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Department of Education, Government of Himachal Pradesh. The scheme aims to support meritorious students in their pursuit of higher education. Under this scheme, an amount of ₹ 18,000/- will be given to the eligible students per year for two successive years after matric. Every year, 2000 scholarships are awarded to excellent students from the general category.
## Benefits A scholarship of ₹ 18,000/-. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The student should be a resident of Himachal Pradesh. 2. The applicant should be a Student. 3. The applicant should have passed Class 10th. 4. The applicant should have come in merit (in top 2000). 5. The applicant should be from the general category. 6. The applicant should be enrolled in Class 11th or any professional/technical course in a recognized institute.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Go to the Official Website of the[ National Scholarship Portal](https://scholarships.gov.in/). and click “New Registration”. Guidelines for Registration will appear. Scroll to the bottom. Read carefully the undertaking. Accept the Terms. Click “Continue”. **Step 2:** A Registration Form will appear. The fields marked as * are mandatory. Fill in the details and click “Register”. Your Application ID and password will be displayed. The same will also be sent as an SMS to your registered mobile number. **Step 3:** Go to [https://scholarships.gov.in/fresh/newstdRegfrmInstruction ](https://scholarships.gov.in/fresh/newstdRegfrmInstruction) Click on “Login to Apply”. Enter your Application ID and password. Type the Captcha and click “Login”. On the next screen, provide the OTP received on your registered mobile number. You will be directed to the Password Reset screen. Create a new password and confirm. Click “Submit”. You will be directed to the “Applicant’s Dashboard”. **Step 4:** On the left pane, click “Application Form”. The fields marked as * are compulsory. Fill in the details and upload the documents. You can either click on “Save as Draft” to complete the application later. Else, click “Final Submit” to apply. **NOTE: All the applicants are advised to fill the form correctly, no changes can be made once submitted. The applicants are also advised to fill in only one application as multiple applications will cancel the form.**
