metadata.schemeName: Mamasaheb Phadke Management of Govt Adarsh ​​Residential Schools (SC) Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to expand access to quality residential education for scheduled caste students in standards 9 to 12. Through this scheme, eligible SC students receive free boarding, lodging, textbooks, uniforms, meals, and additional support services to enhance academic participation.

page_content:
# Mamasaheb Phadke Management of Govt Adarsh ​​Residential Schools (SC) Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Housing & Shelter | **Tags:** Hostel, Student, Textbooks, Uniform, Scheduled Caste | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Mamasaheb Phadke Management of Government Adarsh Residential Schools (SC)” scheme was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to expand access to quality residential education for scheduled caste (SC) students in standards 9th to 12th. Under this scheme, eligible SC students receive free boarding, lodging, textbooks, uniforms, meals, and additional support services to enhance academic participation.
## Benefits **Free Services Provided:** - Board and lodging, meals, textbooks, uniforms, and water - Study materials, mid‑day meals, and other academic support - Ration card, PH identity card, and other entitlements, as applicable
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be currently studying in standard 9th to 12th in a recognized institution.1. The applicant must have passed the previous annual exam with at least 50% marks (or a government-sanctioned exemption). > **NOTE:** Returning students must have passed with at least a second class with  50% to be considered for re-admission.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 01:** The eligible applicant may visit the e-Samaj Kalyan Portal: [https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/) **Step 02:** On the home page, under the tab ‘Citizen Login’, click on New User ‘[Please Register Here](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/Registration.aspx)’. **Step 03:** Enter your Full Name as per Aadhaar Card, Gender, Date of Birth, Aadhaar Card Number, Email ID, Caste etc. and then click on ‘Register’. **Step 04:** After successful registration, the applicants can login through their User ID and Password. **Step 05:** Now, click on ‘User Profile’ to update your profile. **Step 06:** Fill in all the mandatory information and then click on ‘Update’. **Step 07:** After updating the profile successfully, select the scheme appearing on the home page; an application form will open. **Step 08:** Fill in all the mandatory details in the application form and upload all the relevant documents. **Step 09:** Now agree with the terms & conditions and click on ‘Save Application’. **Step 10:** Submit the application form and take out the print of the application for future reference. The applicant can note down the application number to track the application status by logging into the portal using their User ID and Password. [User Manual](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/HelpManual/Citizen-HelpManual.pdf)

metadata.schemeName: Mahila Samruddhi Yojana (DAADC)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-employment and financial independence among women from the Antyodaya Samaj, especially from Scheduled Castes. Under this scheme, loan up to ₹50,000/- is provided at a concessional interest rate to eligible women for starting small-scale businesses.

page_content:
# Mahila Samruddhi Yojana (DAADC) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship, Women and Child | **Tags:** Loan, Woman, Scheduled Caste, Self-employment, Antyodaya Samaj | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Mahila Samruddhi Yojana" is implemented by the Dr. Ambedkar Antyodaya Development Corporation (DAADC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to promote self-employment and financial independence among women from the Antyodaya Samaj, especially from Scheduled Castes. Under this scheme, loans are provided at a concessional interest rate to eligible women for starting small-scale businesses.
## Benefits - **Loan Amount:** ₹50,000/- provided to eligible women for starting micro or small businesses.- **Interest Rate:** 6% per annum.- **State Government Contribution:** 95% of the loan amount, i.e., ₹47,500/-, is borne by the state.- **Beneficiary Contribution:** 5% of the loan amount, i.e., ₹2,500/-.- **Possible Monthly Installment Amount:** ₹1,445/- per month.- **Duration:** 36 Months (3 years)
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a woman. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant should belong to the Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) family or be from the economically backward class. 1. The applicant’s annual family income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant should be planning to start a self-employment venture or micro-enterprise.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](https://daadconline.gujarat.gov.in/) of the Dr. Ambedkar Antyodaya Vikas Nigam (SC). **Step 2:** On the top menu bar, click on "Apply Now". **Step 3:** Click on the loan scheme name. **Step 4:** Select the loan category and fill in the loan amount. **Step 5:** Fill out the Application Form, enter the following details: - Personal Information: Name, gender, date of birth, caste, etc. - Address Information: Permanent and correspondence address - Income Details: Monthly family income and source - Loan Requirement: Amount needed, proposed use (e.g., business, self-employment) - Bank Account Details: For loan disbursement **Step 6:** Upload scanned copies of the Caste certificate, Income certificate, Aadhaar card, Passport-size photo, Bank passbook (first page), and Residence proof. **Step 7:** Double-check all details. Click on “Preview” to verify. If all details are correct, click “Submit”. **Step 8:** Applicant will receive an Application ID/Reference Number. Save or print the acknowledgement for future tracking.

# Loan for Small Businesses (DAADC) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Loan, Self-employment, Scheduled Caste, Small Business, Antyodaya Family | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Loan for Small Businesses" scheme is implemented by the Dr. Ambedkar Antyodaya Development Corporation (DAADC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to promote self-employment among Scheduled Caste (SC) individuals belonging to Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) families by providing financial assistance for starting small businesses or self-employment ventures. Under this scheme, eligible beneficiaries are provided a loan of up to ₹1,25,000 at a concessional interest rate.
## Benefits **Loan Amount:** - Up to ₹1,25,000/- ***Interest Rate***_:_ - 4% per annum ***Loan Tenure:***__ - 60 months (5 years) ***Guarantors Required:***__ - Two guarantors ***State Government Contribution:*** - 100% (no beneficiary share required) ***Approximate Installment Amount:*** - ₹2,302/- per month (maximum)

The applicant should intend to start or expand a small business or occupation. 1. The applicant should be able to provide two guarantors.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](https://daadconline.gujarat.gov.in/) of the Dr. Ambedkar Antyodaya Vikas Nigam (SC). **Step 2:** On the top menu bar, click on "Apply Now". **Step 3:** Click on the loan scheme name. **Step 4:** Select the loan category and fill in the loan amount. **Step 5:** Fill out the Application Form, enter the following details: - Personal Information: Name, gender, date of birth, caste, etc. - Address Information: Permanent and correspondence address - Income Details: Monthly family income and source - Loan Requirement: Amount needed, proposed use (e.g., business, self-employment) - Bank Account Details: For loan disbursement **Step 6:** Upload scanned copies of the Caste certificate, Income certificate, Aadhaar card, Passport-size photo, Bank passbook (first page), and Residence proof. **Step 7:** Double-check all details. Click on “Preview” to verify. If all details are correct, click “Submit”. **Step 8:** Applicant will receive an Application ID/Reference Number. Save or print the acknowledgement for future tracking.

metadata.schemeName: Term Loan Scheme (GSKVN)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to uplift scavengers & their dependents by offering term loans of ₹1,00,000/- to ₹15,00,000/- to support them in starting self‐employment ventures in various trades & professions, enabling them to pursue income‐generating activities and lead dignified lives.

page_content:
# Term Loan Scheme (GSKVN) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Loan, Self-employment, Safai Kamdar, Scavenger | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Term Loan Scheme" is implemented by the Gujarat Safai Kamdar Vikas Nigam (GSKVN) under the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to uplift safai kamdars (scavengers) and their dependents by providing financial assistance in the form of term loans to help them take up various trades or professions for self-employment. The scheme also aims to integrate them into the mainstream society by enabling them to move away from the traditional, inhuman, and hazardous occupation of manual scavenging and lead a life of dignity. Under this scheme, beneficiaries are eligible to receive term loans ranging from ₹1,00,000 to ₹15,00,000 to start income-generating self-employment activities or projects. The scheme is implemented with the support of the National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation (NSKFDC), New Delhi, in collaboration with the State Government, through the Gujarat Safai Kamdar Vikas Nigam.
## Benefits ***Loan Amount:***__ - loans from ₹1,00,000/- to ₹15,00,000/- are provided at an interest rate of 6% for various businesses.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a scavenger/sanitation worker or a dependent of one. 1. The applicant should be willing to use the loan for starting income-generating self-employment activities or projects.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the Social Justice & Empowerment Department website: [https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/index.aspx) **Step 2**: Click on “Please Register Here” on the homepage. **Step 3:** Fill in your personal details as per Aadhaar. **Step 4:** Create a password and submit the form. **Step 5:** Verify details and click “Confirm”. **Step 6:** You will receive your User ID & Password via SMS/email. > **Login Process:** **Step 1:** Go to the portal homepage. **Step 2:** Enter your User ID, Password, and Captcha. **Step 3:** Click “Login” to access your dashboard. > **Application Process:** After login, complete your User Profile (first-time only). **Step 1:** Homepage will show eligible schemes – click on the one you want. **Step 2:** Fill out the scheme application form. **Step 3:** Upload the required documents. **Step 4:** Review all entries, agree to terms, and click “Save Application” & note down your Application Number for tracking. > **Track Application:** **Step 1:** Click on “[View Application Status](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/ViewApplicationStatus.aspx)” **Step 2:** Enter your Application Number and Date of Birth **Step 3:** Click “View Status” to check progress

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to assist SEBC and economically backward students in coaching for premier Indian and international exams, the eligible candidates receive up to ₹20,000/- or the actual fee paid.

page_content:
# Coaching Assistance for Pre-preparation for Competitive Exams of ALL INDIA level like IIM, CEPT, NIFT, NLU and IELTS, TOFEL, GRE for going Foreign **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Student, Foreign, Competitive Exam | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Coaching Assistance for Pre-Preparation for Competitive Exams of All India Level like IIM, CEPT, NIFT, NLU and IELTS, TOEFL, GRE for Going Foreign" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to financially support SEBC and economically backward students preparing for national-level and international entrance exams. Under this scheme, eligible candidates receive up to ₹20,000/- or the actual tuition fee paid, whichever is lower, as assistance for coaching fees.
## Benefits **Financial Assistance:** - ₹20,000/- or actual coaching fee paid (whichever is lower) for pre-preparation of one competitive exam (IIM, CEPT, NIFT, NLU, IELTS, TOEFL, GRE) **Mode of Disbursement:** - Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to trainee’s bank account.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant must belong to the SEBC or Economically Backward Class category. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must have passed Class 10 or Class 12 (SSC or HSC). 1. The applicant must be preparing for one of the eligible competitive exams (IIM, CEPT, NIFT, NLU, IELTS, TOEFL, GRE). 1. The applicant must have paid tuition/coaching fees for the exam preparation. 1. metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to economically empower women from Thakor and Koli castes through self-employment opportunities via Self Help Groups (SHGs). Under this scheme, eligible members of SHGs receive a loan up to ₹60,000/- at low interest to start or expand small-scale businesses/enterprises.

page_content:
# Micro Finance Scheme for Self Help Groups (GTKVN) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Women and Child, Business & Entrepreneurship, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** SHG, Business, Loan, Enterpreneurship, Self-employment, Thakor Caste, Koli Caste | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Micro Finance Scheme for Self Help Groups" is implemented by the Gujarat Thakor and Koli Vikas Nigam (GTKVN) under the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to economically empower women from Thakor and Koli castes through self-employment opportunities via Self Help Groups (SHGs). Under this scheme, eligible members of SHGs receive a loan at low interest to start or expand small-scale businesses/enterprises.
## Benefits - **Loan Amount:** Up to ₹60,000/- for eligible small businesses.- **Interest Rate:** 5% per annum.- **Loan Coverage:** 95% of the project/business cost is covered; 5% contribution is to be made by the beneficiary.- **Repayment Term:** 48 equal monthly installments (4 years), including interest.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a member of a Self Help Group (SHG). 1. The applicant should belong to the Thakor or Koli caste. 1. The applicant's age should be at least 21 years and not more than 50 years as on the date of application. 1. The applicant’s annual family income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant should have relevant experience in the proposed trade/business field. 1. The applicant will have to provide suitable collateral to get the loan. > **Note:** At least 50% of the total loan allocation is reserved for those with family income up to ₹1,50,000/-.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](https://gtkdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) of the Gujarat Thakor and Koli Vikas Nigam. **Step 2:** On the top menu bar, click on "Apply Now". **Step 3:** Click on the loan scheme name. **Step 4:** Select the loan category and fill in the loan amount. **Step 5:** Fill out the Application Form, enter the following details: - Personal Information: Name, gender, date of birth, caste, etc. - Address Information: Permanent and correspondence address - Income Details: Monthly family income and source - Loan Requirement: Amount needed, proposed use (e.g., business, self-employment) - Bank Account Details: For loan disbursement **Step 6:** Upload scanned copies of the Caste certificate, Income certificate, Aadhaar card, Passport-size photo, Bank passbook (first page), and Residence proof. **Step 7:** Double-check all details. Click on “Preview” to verify. If all details are correct, click “Submit”. **Step 8:** Applicant will receive an Application ID/Reference Number. Save or print the acknowledgement for future tracking.

metadata.schemeName: Tuition Sahay Yojana (Unreserved Category)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "Tution Sahay Yojana (Unreserved Category)" by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance of ₹15,000/- annually to unreserved category students in the science stream of Class 11th and 12th.

page_content: # Tuition Sahay Yojana (Unreserved Category) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Unreserved Category, Science, Tuition Fee Assistance, Education | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Tution Sahay Yojana (Unreserved Category)" by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Gujarat aims to support meritorious students from the unreserved category pursuing science in Classes 11 and 12 by providing them annual tuition fee assistance. This scheme ensures that students who scored 70% or more in their Class 10 board examination receive ₹15,000 through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to pursue science education. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Unreserved Educational & Economic Development Corporation. ## Benefits - **Monetary Assistance:** ₹15,000/- per academic year is provided as tuition assistance to each eligible student. ## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must belong to the unreserved category. - The applicant must be studying in Class 11th or Class 12th in the science stream. - The applicant must have secured 70% or more marks (from total marks in all subjects) in Class 10. - The applicant’s family income must not exceed ₹6,00,000 annually. - The applicant must apply in the same academic year. - The institution should be registered under a valid Act (such as Trust Act, Companies Act, etc.), with at least 3 years of experience in Class 11-12 science tuition. - The institution should have filed IT returns for the past 3 years, including income from tuition classes, - The institution should have a mandatory GST. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Go to the Corporation's [official website](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/) and navigate to the "Gujarat Unreserved Education and Economical Development Corporation" section under the Corporation menu. **Step 2:**Click on "Tuition Sahay Yojana" and then Apply Now. **Step 3:** Click on "New User? Please Register Here". **Step 4:** Enter the required details and click Register. > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** Enter your User ID, Password, and Captcha Code, then click "Login". **Step 2:** Read the scheme details carefully and click OK. **Step 3:** If your permanent address is correct, confirm it. Otherwise, enter your correct address. **Step 4:** Click Save & Next to proceed. Upload the relevant documents. **Step 5:** If you need to make changes, click "No, Cancel". If all details are correct, click "Yes, Submit". **Step 6:** Click Save Application. Note down your Application Number for future reference. You can also take a printout by clicking Print Application. > **Check Application Status:** [Click here](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/ViewApplicationStatus.aspx). > **Post Online Application Procedure:** After submitting the online application, the applicant must take a printout of the application, sign it, and submit it along with all uploaded documents (certificates, mark sheets, etc.) to the concerned Deputy Director (Non-Reserved Category) or the District Social Welfare Officer through courier, post, or by visiting in person. > **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://gueedc.gujarat.gov.in/contact-us.html).

metadata.briefDescription: This scheme aims to instill a sense of self-reliance in the youth belonging to backward classes after receiving vocational education/training. Under this scheme, eligible youth are provided loans at a low-interest rate to start self-employment ventures.

page_content:
# Swayam Saksham Yojana (GBCDC) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Enterpreneurship, Loan, Backward Classes, Youth, Self-employment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Swayam Saksham Yojana" is implemented by the Gujarat Backward Classes Development Corporation (GBCDC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to inculcate the spirit of self-reliance among socially and educationally backward class youth who have received vocational or professional training. Under this scheme, low-interest loans are provided to educated unemployed youth for setting up self-employment ventures like clinics, law offices, engineering units, and more. The initiative focuses on empowering beneficiaries to start independent businesses with financial assistance, promoting economic inclusion and entrepreneurship.
## Benefits **Loan Amount:** - Up to ₹5,00,000/- per applicant. **Interest Rate:** - 6% per annum. **Loan Share:** Under the scheme, the loan will be distributed in a unit cost ratio where- - 85% will be covered by a national corporation - 10% by State Government - 5% contribution by the beneficiary **Repayment Terms:** - This loan will have to be repaid in 60 equal monthly installments including interest.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC). 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 35 years of age on the date of application. 1. The applicant should be unemployed but professionally educated (e.g., doctor, engineer, lawyer, CA, etc.). 1. The total annual family income of the applicant should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant should have completed a professional course (degree or diploma). 1. The applicant should intend to start a professional business such as clinics, nursing homes, physiotherapy clinics, biomedical labs, legal offices, medical stores, architect offices, engineering units, C.A. offices, etc.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](https://gbcdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) of the Gujarat Backwards Caste Development Corporation. **Step 2:** On the top menu bar, click on "Apply Online". **Step 3:** If you’re a new user, click on "New Registration" Enter personal details (name, mobile number, email, aadhaar number, etc.), create a password, and complete OTP verification. **Step 4:** Use your registered credentials (User ID and password) to log in. **Step 5:** Click on “New Application”. Select “Swayam Saksham Yojana” from the list of available schemes. **Step 6:** Fill out the Application Form, enter the following details: - Personal Information: Name, gender, date of birth, caste, etc. - Address Information: Permanent and correspondence address - Income Details: Monthly family income and source - Loan Requirement: Amount needed, proposed use (e.g., business, self-employment) - Bank Account Details: For loan disbursement **Step 7:** Upload scanned copies of the Caste certificate, Income certificate, Aadhaar card, Passport-size photo, Bank passbook (first page), and Residence proof. **Step 8:** Double-check all details. Click on “Preview” to verify. If all details are correct, click “Submit”. **Step 9:** Applicant will receive an Application ID/Reference Number. Save or print the acknowledgement for future tracking.

# Saraswati Sadhana Yojana to Economically Backward Class Girls studying in Class 9 **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Education, Bicycle, Girl Student, Economically Weaker Sections | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Saraswati Sadhana Yojana to Economically Backward Class Girls studying in Class 9" is a welfare scheme by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department of Gujarat. The scheme offers free bicycles to girls enrolled in Class 9 in government and grant-in-aided schools, facilitating easier access to education and encouraging regular school attendance. This physical aid helps in improving educational participation and empowering female students from economically weaker backgrounds. ## Benefits - Free bicycle provided to each eligible girl student.

## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be a female student. - The applicant must be studying in Class 9. - The applicant must be enrolled in a government or grant-in-aided school in Gujarat. - The applicant must belong to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS). - The applicant's family income must not exceed ₹6,00,000 per annum. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the official website: [www.digitalgujarat.gov.in](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/) **Step 2:** Click on the “Register” button on the homepage. **Step 3:** You will be redirected to the registration form page. **Step 4:** Fill in the required details such as: Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, Password, etc. **Step 5:** Submit the registration form to create your account. > **Log In Process:** **Step 1:** Go to [www.digitalgujarat.gov.in](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/) **Step 2:** Click on the “Login” button. **Step 3:** Select the suitable login option (e.g., Citizen Login). **Step 4:** You will be redirected to the login form page. **Step 5:** Enter your registered Email ID/Mobile Number and Password. **Step 6:** Click Login to access your account. > **Apply for a New Service:** **Step 1:** Log in to the portal using your registered credentials. **Step 2:** After login, your user profile will appear showing all previously taken services. **Step 3:** Click on “Request a New Service” or the relevant option. **Step 4:** You will be redirected to a list of services. **Step 5:** Select the desired service from the list. **Step 6:** Click “Continue to Service”. **Step 7:** A form will open—fill in all the required information. **Step 8:** (Optional) Click to auto-fill details from your profile. **Step 9:** Click “Next” after completing each section. **Step 10:** Upload/attach the necessary documents or import them via DigiLocker. **Step 11:** Review all information and click “Submit” to complete the application. > **Contact Us:** [Click here.](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/SchemPortal/ContactUs.aspx)

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "Loan for Training of Commercial Pilot (GUEEDC)" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, provides financial loan assistance of up to ₹25,00,000/- at 4% simple interest per annum is provided to Unreserved category candidates for pursuing commercial pilot training.

page_content:
# Loan for Training of Commercial Pilot (GUEEDC)

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Loan, Education Loan, Commercial Pilot Training | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Loan for Training of Commercial Pilot (GUEEDC) implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, aims to offers financial support to candidates from the Unreserved category in the form of loan of up to ₹25,00,000/- at a concessional interest rate of 4% per annum to undergo training for obtaining a Commercial Pilot License (CPL). The objective of the scheme is to support meritorious students who aspire to build a career in aviation but face financial constraints.

## Benefits
- **Loan Assistance:** Up to ₹25,00,000/- at a concessional interest rate of 4% per annum.

## Eligibility Criteria
- Applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat.


  - Applicant must belong to the Unreserved (General) category.
  - Applicant must have passed HSC (12th standard).
  - Applicant must have secured admission to a recognized commercial pilot training institute.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the office of the District Social Welfare Officer and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the [application form](https://sje.gujarat.gov.in/dsd/downloads/nirathar-apang-yojana.pdf).
**Step 2:** In the application form, provide all the mandatory details, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the supporting documents to the office of the District Social Welfare Officer.
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted.

page_content:
# Assistance for Planting Vegetable Crops for Raw and Ripe Mandap **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Vegetable Crops, Farmer, Raw And Ripe Mandap | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Assistance for Planting Vegetable Crops for Raw and Ripe Mandap" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to offer financial support to farmers across Gujarat for constructing vegetable trellises (mandaps) using wooden/bamboo supports and GI/plastic wires. ## Benefits > **Raw Mandap (Tomato/Chilli and other vegetables):** - General Farmers: 50% subsidy, up to ₹26,000/ha. - SC/ST Farmers: 75% subsidy, up to ₹39,000/ha. > **Semi-ripe Mandap (Vine vegetables):** - General Farmers: 50% subsidy, up to ₹40,000/ha. - SC/ST Farmers: 75% subsidy, up to ₹60,000/ha. > **Ripe Mandap (Vine vegetables):** - General Farmers: 50% subsidy, up to ₹80,000/ha. - SC/ST Farmers: 75% subsidy, up to ₹1,20,000/ha. > **Other Support Details:** - Maximum area eligible: 2 hectares per farmer. - Construction material: 1600 wooden/bamboo poles per hectare, 400 kg GI wire (12-18 gauge) or plastic wire. - Recommended spacing: 2.50 x 2.50 meters.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The applicant must be residing in Gujarat.

# Scheme for the Award of Scholarship for Post Graduate Students of Various Faculties of Junagadh Agricultural University **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Agricultural Scholarship, Fellowship, Higher Education, Student, Post Graduate, Ph D | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Scheme for the Award of Scholarship for Post Graduate Students of Various Faculties of Junagadh Agricultural University" launched by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to provide monthly financial assistance to eligible Under Graduate students at Junagadh Agricultural University. The objective is to attract the bright and talented students to seek admission in various faculties of P.G. level, it is necessary to provide financial assistance. ## Benefits - **Master’s degree students:** ₹2,000/- per month for 2 years. - **Ph.D. degree students:** ₹3,000/- per month for 3 years. ## Eligibility Criteria - Applicant must be domiciled in Gujarat. - Applicant must have obtained a minimum first-class or equivalent grade/OGPA in UG (for Master’s) or Master’s (for Ph.D.). - Applicant must be newly admitted (fresh) to the Postgraduate program at JAU. - Applicant must have a basic degree in Agriculture or allied sciences.

metadata.schemeName: Prime Tourism Vehicle Scheme-Meghalaya
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme boosts tourism by providing 50% financial assistance for adventure tourism vehicles, along with easy credit, operator training, and GPS and branding support.

page_content:
# Prime Tourism Vehicle Scheme-Meghalaya **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Meghalaya | **Categories:** Travel & Tourism, Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Tourism, Vehicle, Tourist Guide, Training, Drivers | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The **PRIME Tourism Vehicle Scheme**, implemented by the Tourism Department under the Chief Minister’s CM-ELEVATE Program of the Planning, Investment Promotion & Sustainable Development Department, Government of Meghalaya, aims to boost tourism in the state by providing 50% financial assistance for the purchase of adventure tourism vehicles. The scheme also offers easy credit through partner banks, training for operators, and government-funded GPS and branding support, thereby enabling entrepreneurs and entities to enhance tourist transport services and promote economic growth.
## Benefits 1. 50% of on-road vehicle cost supported (5% by the entrepreneur, 45% by the Government of Meghalaya) 1. 5% EMI co-payment support for 12 months 1. Credit linkage through partnered banks 1. Pre-fitted GPS device with 5-year warranty (cost borne by Government, one-time) 1. Branding cost of vehicle borne by the Government (first time only) 1. Mandatory capacity building and training programs under Meghalaya Tourist Operator Program (MTOTP) by the Tourism Department 1. Support from PRIME – Tourism Vehicle Cell for promotion, grievance redressal, and training 1. Eligibility for multiple vehicle types, including 8–17 seater luxury buses, 4x4 vehicles, and MPVs for tourism and adventure tourism
## Eligibility Criteria **Individuals** 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant should possess a valid commercial driving license. 1. The applicant should be involved in the tourism sector. 1. The applicant should be associated with the adventure tourism sector if applying for a 4x4 vehicle. 1. The applicant should not be a credit defaulter with any bank or financial institution. **Registered Entities** 1. The applicant should be a recognised and registered tour operator, tourism society, or similar entity based in Meghalaya. 1. The applicant should have experience in the tourism sector. 1. The applicant should be associated with the adventure tourism sector if applying for a 4x4 vehicle. 1. The applicant should not be a beneficiary under the first phase of the PRIME Tourism Vehicle Scheme. 1. The applicant should not be a credit defaulter with any bank or financial institution. 1. The applicant should provide an Incorporation Certificate or Registration Certificate, as applicable. **Unregistered Entities** 1. The applicant should be an unregistered entity such as a village organization, self-help group, or traditional community based in Meghalaya. 1. The applicant should be involved in the tourism sector. 1. The applicant should provide certification from the Block Development Officer (BDO) to support involvement in the tourism sector. 1. The applicant should not be a beneficiary under the first phase of the PRIME Tourism Vehicle Scheme. 1. The applicant should not be a credit defaulter with any bank or financial institution.
## Exclusions **Individuals** **Applications shall not be ordinarily considered for the following** A) Following individuals (currently employed as full-fledged or contractual, or retired and drawing a pension) and their Immediate family members, which include spouse, parents, and children up to the age of 30. i. State and Central Government employees ii. Employees of public sector undertakings, subsidiaries of public sector undertakings and divisions of public sector undertakings, etc. iii. Any individual whose job is concerned with politics, such as MLAs, MLCs, MPs, etc. or seeking to hold a similar position in government iv. Registered class-1 contractors v. Consultants who are currently engaged with the state or central government vi. Pressure groups and organisations that are primarily political in nature shall not be ordinarily considered B) Only one member from a family is eligible for the scheme. **Registered Entities** **Applications shall not be ordinarily considered for the following** i) State and Central Government employees ii) Employees of public sector undertakings, subsidiaries of public sector undertakings and divisions of public sector undertakings, etc. iii) Any individual whose job is concerned with politics, such as MLAs, MLCs, MPs, etc. or seeking to hold a similar position in government iv) Registered class-1 contractors v) Pressure groups and organisations that are primarily political in nature shall not be ordinarily considered vi) Consultants who are currently engaged with the state or central government **Unregistered Entities** **Applications shall not be ordinarily considered for the following** i) State and Central Government employees ii) Employees of public sector undertakings, subsidiaries of public sector undertakings and divisions of public sector undertakings, etc. iii) Any individual whose job is concerned with politics, such as MLAs, MLCs, MPs, etc. or seeking to hold a similar position in government. iv) Registered class-1 contractors. v) Pressure groups and organisations that are primarily political in nature. vi) Consultants who are currently engaged with the state or central government.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Citizen Registration for Member ID** **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](https://meghalayaone.gov.in/meghalaya-one/view-detail?U2FsdGVkX1%2Fbx1MNs1L1wWQ%2FTPWqLi5TLS2A375JtcEMmpy5YeIvaIDiGXmaVxs3jWD%20a80RupQqTlzvXlUo%20YbOrymzTR8ZtOWUN80V9%20X3zA4S2XB8mqgetsbs%20UcMPdq622mczpsVlXyzWrSr2xeJ4wqnKmaRqmMbW1z%20C8%2FO%20qjrv65kx15XOadQXdjF7c7a7q79NIy6aBlA%20beqmQKsIL5K0%20EwP42WuLofhwgFKGeikfX%20YdxnMJppxTAb=) of the scheme and click on the “Login to Apply” button to start the application process. Carefully read all the instructions provided on the website before proceeding. **Step 2:** If you are a first-time user, click on “[Registration for New User](https://meghalayaone.gov.in/meghalaya-one/citizen-login?U2FsdGVkX1%2Fj0VpCC5AKaBYOcVsO207ea%20qs40JOarPgwkZtFDg03EVeDNMjhzMNgt66jk7HLKmzLFayU0wTM0EjpeKCRqApCovt2efa%2F0KbydwrFt8QNtiK1L9FEGK0rwHWPMZNxfJ2oG84okmekHM%20w2UWsypPf7HznEGzXJ9yzUevH2GxeNY6GrVN64Nc5vLWhdycsyVT5gxYjOQ7aTLfMjvUcaNNg56%20lFH6Z87ejSfF5hcowpsYT63w1IVyMGXXLjTCwVX1J7zigJST3KvW3SAkeGKZbQ4pl9jSHq16%2FowHqRFwaSZ2hZHgvcAel7SmNx0C4xFN5oap8U%20rLA=%3D)” and complete the registration process to create your account. **Step 3:** Select your Authentication ID from the available options, such as - PDS (Ration Card) - Election Photo ID Card (EPIC). **Step 4:** Enter your card number, select your name from the displayed list, and click on “Next” to continue. **Step 5:** Your EPIC ID will appear on the screen. If the details are correct, click on “Accept.” If the details are incorrect or rejected, manually enter your EPIC number and proceed. **Step 6:** Click on “Validate” to verify the entered EPIC number, and then click on “Next” to move to the application form. **Step 7:** Fill in all required details in the application form, upload the necessary documents, carefully review all the information, and click on “Submit.” After successful submission, you will receive a unique application number for future reference. **Sign In** **Step 1:** Click on [“Sign In](https://meghalayaone.gov.in/meghalaya-one/citizen-login?U2FsdGVkX1%2Fdu5Z2a1hGWoNI9swJd%2F0ipy%2F8BIg8oHzgeQ8x8B%206kEL5r6nzjssTJEkSC6a%2FSWz7TWB3omsCH8BvMqNoVkXYB3r12F2IIJu4JPz98fEyQ9bC3ERAjVoMX%2FaXvBWvVd34iUrwhVjn5iB2jCAqiKeCkjFBb9FIzX%203uUzYAhHc35dE4aSDFDctKc13r1MR%2FNuq4idI8ilaZQ5JUjUgutxygxHcnRmHRuYW0dbzfMIpBADd90WhKa76ESANqQ4hUqAzhMpEd1WWAxerZ55GBq1cWB8NmElKfsgqW%20Go8qlNIhySwptuQ1imQF4xKBa437k7OlxbylI9ig=%3D)” and choose your preferred sign-in method from Mobile Number, PDS, EPIC, or Member ID. **Step 2:** Enter your User ID and Password, then click on “Login” to access your account. **Step 3:** After logging in, click on “Apply for Services/Scheme” to start your application. **Step 4:** Fill in all the required details in the application form, upload the necessary documents, carefully review the information, and click on “Submit.” **Note:** **Online Submission:** Apply via Meghalaya One Portal with all supporting documents and DPR (if requested). **Screening:** District and State committees shall verify and shortlist applications. The committees can also conduct physical background verification for shortlisted candidates if required **Interview & Inspection:** Virtual pitch, physical interview and site inspection by Department and bank teams shall be done as and when required. **Final Approval:** State Sanction Committee issues approval letters.

metadata.schemeName: Mahila Adhikarita Yojana under NSKFDC- Haryana
metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, loan is provided to woman Safai Karamchari and their dependent daughters for projects with a maximum project cost of up to ₹2,00,000/- for small and petty trade/businesses, and various income-generating activities such as beauty parlors, boutiques, cosmetic shop, bangle shop, etc.

page_content:
# Mahila Adhikarita Yojana under NSKFDC- Haryana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Women and Child | **Tags:** Mahila, Adhikarita, NSKFDC, Woman, Self-Employment, Loan, HSFDC, Safai Karamchari | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Mahila Adhikarita Yojana under NSKFDC" is implemented by the Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (HSFDC) in collaboration with the National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation (NSKFDC). The HSFDC is a Company registered under the Companies Act, 1956 on 02.01.1971. It is a wholly Government-owned Corporation with a 51% share of the State Government and a 49% share of the Government of India. Under this scheme, the loan is provided to woman Safai Karamchari and their dependent daughters for projects with a maximum project cost of up to ₹2,00,000/- for small and petty trade/businesses, and various other income-generating activities such as beauty parlors, boutiques, cosmetic shops, bangle shop, etc. ## Benefits **Project Cost Ceiling:** - The Corporation (HSFDC), in collaboration with NSKFDC, provides loans of up to ₹2,00,000/- per beneficiary/unit for small and petty trade/business and various income-generating activities. **Margin Money:** - The Corporation provides margin money @ 10% of the project cost. **Subsidy:** - The corporation provides a subsidy @ 50% of the total project cost (Maximum subsidy amount is ₹10,000/-). **Note:** The subsidy is only provided to the beneficiary below the poverty line. > **Interest criteria for the loan amount recoverable by HSFDC:** **Upto Amount (₹)****Interest % P.A.****Penal Interest % P.A**.2,00,000/-54
**Interest Starts on****Penalty Start After****Principal Recovery Starts After****Installment Starts After** **Installment Period**Same day30 days120 days120 days30 days ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should be a female. 1. The applicant's age should be between 18 and 55 years. 1. There is no income limit. 1. The applicant should be either a woman Safai Karamchari or a dependent daughter of Safai Karamchari. **Note 1:** Permanent Safai Karamchari means a person engaged in, or employed for any sanitation work and includes his/her dependents. **Note 2:** The applicant shall have to produce a Certificate of Safai Karamchari or dependent of Safai Karamchari from the Head of the Government Departments (i.e. School, Colleges, Forest, Health, Education, Animal Husbandry having rank not less than Gazetted Officer), elected members of Municipal Body/ Corporation and Pradhan of Gram Panchayats, Local Revenue Officer or an Officer of Local Municipal Office, or Cantonment Executive Officer of the Cantonment or an officer of the Railways not below the rank of gazette officer. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process on Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation:** **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](http://hsfdc.org.in/) of Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation and select the scheme under ‘NSKFDC Assisted Scheme’. **Step 2:** Click on "[Apply for Loan](http://hsfdc.org.in/register.php)" to begin the registration process. **Step 3:** Fill in your details, including your name, Aadhaar number, email, mobile number, and captcha code, then click "Register." **Step 4:** Enter the OTP sent to your mobile and click "Submit." **Step 5:** The application form will open. **Step 6:** Enter your details and upload the required documents. **Step 7:** Click "Submit" to complete your application, and you will receive your user ID and password. **Login to apply for the scheme:** **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](http://hsfdc.org.in/) of the Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation and on the home page, click on ‘Login’ option. **Step 2:** Enter your user ID/Username, password, and captcha code. **Step 3:** Click "[Login](http://hsfdc.org.in/login/loneeLogin.php)." **Step 4:** Once logged in, the dashboard will open in front of you Click on "Edit Profile." **Step 5:** Fill in all the required details, upload required documents, and update other details. **Step 6:** Click "Final Submit." **Step 7:** After submitting, you can print out your application for your records
> **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 1:** The eligible applicant may apply online through the Official Portal- [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal. ](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** If the applicant is not registered on the portal, he/she gets registered there. Step 3: For registration, click “[New User](https://saralharyana.gov.in/citizenRegistration.html)” under ‘Sign In Here’ and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, Password & State. Click on ‘Submit’. Step 4: Verify your mobile number and email ID through the received OTP and complete the registration process. **Login to apply for the scheme:** **Step 1**: To avail the benefits of the scheme, visit the Official [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) and log in through the email ID used while registering. **Step 2:** Enter Password & Captcha and click on ‘Login’. **Step 3:** After successful login, click on ‘Apply for Services’ and then ‘View all Available Services’ **Step 4:** Now, you can search for the scheme and click on the scheme to go ahead and fill out the application form. **Step 5:** Fill in all the mandatory details and upload all the mandatory documents. **Step 6:** Preview the application form and click on ‘Submit’. **Tracking of Application:** Applicants can track their applications through the Official [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal](https://status.saralharyana.nic.in/) by entering their Department Name, Scheme Name, and Application Reference ID. > **Note:** The loan applications so received are scrutinized and got verified by the District Managers concerned to ascertain the genuineness of the beneficiaries. Thereafter, cases of eligible applicants are sent to NSKFDC for sanction of loan. After the sanction of the loan by NSKFDC. The requisite sanction is issued for grant of loan to the beneficiaries concerned.

metadata.schemeName: Awarding Laptops To Meritorious Students Of Meghalaya
metadata.briefDescription: The aims to award laptops to meritorious students of Board Examination. Through this scheme, laptops are provided to eligible students who meet the published merit criteria.

page_content:
# Awarding Laptops To Meritorious Students Of Meghalaya **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Meghalaya | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Laptop, Toppers, Students, Awards, Academic Excellence | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Awarding of Laptops to Meritorious Students of Meghalaya " has been implemented by the Directorate of Information Technology & Communications, Government of Meghalaya aims to award laptops to meritorious students who passed the Board Examination of MBOSE SSLC, MBOSE HSSLC, ICSE, ISC and CBSE X & XII. Through this scheme, laptops are provided to eligible meritorious students who have secured marks equal to or more than the last student in the published list.
## Benefits - The eligible student will be awarded a laptop.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must have studied in the State of Meghalaya; or the applicant should be a resident of Meghalaya who studied outside the State. 1. The applicant must have topped in the respective Annual School Board Examinations in a particular year. 1. The applicant must have passed the examinations conducted only by: - Meghalaya Board of School Education (MBOSE); - Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE); - Central Board for School Education (CBSE). 1. The applicant must have appeared in Class X or Class XII Annual Board Examinations of the above-mentioned Boards/Council. 1. The applicant of Class X of CBSE Board shall be selected as per [Section 3 II (a)](https://ditmeghalaya.gov.in/pdf/9.Policy%20for%20awarding%20Laptops%20to%20meritorious%20students%20of%20the%20State%20of%20Meghalaya.pdf).1. For Class XII, the applicant should have topped in any stream, namely Arts, Commerce or Science. > **Subject-Specific Eligibility (MBOSE Only):** 1. For Class X (MBOSE), the applicant who is a subject topper in Mathematics, Science or Computer Application shall also be eligible for the award. 1. For Class XII (MBOSE), the applicant who is a subject topper in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Computer Application or Biology shall also be eligible for the award. 1. The applicant whose name appears as an MBOSE top ranker as well as a subject topper (in one or more subjects) shall be eligible for only one award in a particular year. 1. However, in recognition of such achievement, the applicant shall be awarded a Laptop of configuration higher than those of other awardees.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** The applicant must visit the official website of the Directorate of Information Technology & Communications: [https://megedistrict.gov.in/](https://megedistrict.gov.in/renderApplicationForm.do?serviceId=12960005&UUID=2d25b33d-9b80-4950-9b8b-8fb1f2845366&directService=true&tempId=5187&serviceNameToDisplay=Registration+for+IT+Awards+for+Meritorious+Students+2025&grievDefined=0&serviceLinkRequired=No&userLoggedIn=N&source=CTZN&OWASP_CSRFTOKEN=EWQU-J0G2-VHX3-S9B1-NX57-5YCO-I79S-ZQNR) to fill the application form. **Step 2:** Select the service “Registration for IT Awards for Meritorious Students.” **Step 3:** Click on Apply Online and Select the serivice Specific details ( Category [Qualifying Examination], School Name, and Name of Student). **Step 4:** Enter the basic details (Father's Name, Mother's Name, Date of Birth, Gender, Mobile Number) and Upload the passport-size photograph (20 KB to 300 KB). **Step 5:** Enter address details and complete captcha verification. **Step 6:** Click on "Submit" to submit the application. > **Instructions:** - The applicant should check the probable list of meritorious students eligible for the IT Award. - If the applicant has scored marks equal to or more than the last student in the published list but the name does not appear, the applicant should approach the Directorate of Information Technology & Communications, Meghalaya, Shillong. - The applicant should submit the original Mark Sheet, Identity Proof and other relevant documents for verification. - The applicant may submit claims or objections, if any, in writing on or before closing date. - The process concludes upon completion of registration and verification by the Directorate.

page_content:
# A Program to Provide 90 Percent Assistance in Planting Material of Horticultural Fruit Crops **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Agriculture, Horticultural, Fruit Crops | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description "A Program to Provide 90 Percent Assistance in Planting Material of Horticultural Fruit Crops" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to support farmers by providing 90% subsidy on the cost of planting materials like grafted/tissue culture saplings and seedlings for various fruit crops. ## Benefits - Farmers receive up to 90% financial assistance on the cost of planting materials. > **Pre-fixed assistance rates per hectare for different crops:**
Fruit Assistance Mango₹32,000/haSapota (Chiku)₹22,000/haPomegranate₹20,000/haGuava₹16,650/haAonla (Indian Gooseberry)₹5,560/haMandarin / Orange₹5,560/haBer₹2,780/haCoconut₹13,000/ha
> **Note:** - Only saplings costing up to ₹250/- per unit are eligible for subsidy. - **For fruit crops and cuttings:** Planting material will have to be purchased from nurseries accredited by NHB/Agricultural University/Horticulture Department.- **For coconut crops:** seedlings prepared from seeds will have to be purchased from nurseries accredited by NHB/Agricultural University/Horticulture Department.- **For tissue culture:** Planting material (planting) will have to be purchased from tissue labs approved/accredited by DBT, GNFC, GSFC, Tissue Labs of Agricultural University, Government Public Institutions like ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must purchase planting materials from approved/accredited sources.

metadata.schemeName: Youth Engagement through Empowered Youth Organisations (YESS)
metadata.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to empower young people and youth organisations by providing financial support for development activities. It aims to encourage youth participation in community service, sports, cultural events, and leadership initiatives across Meghalaya.

page_content:
# Youth Engagement through Empowered Youth Organisations (YESS) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Meghalaya | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Youth, Empowerment, National Events, Youth Clubs | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The **Youth Engagement through Empowered Youth Organisations (YESS Meghalaya)** scheme, under the Department of Sports and Youth Affairs, Government of Meghalaya, provides financial assistance to registered youth organisations and eligible individual youth to carry out activities that promote youth development. The scheme is designed to strengthen networking, collaboration, and meaningful community-level engagement. **Targeted Stakeholders** **Financial assistance is extended to the following entities and individuals:** 1. Societies and Cooperatives 1. Voluntary and Not-for-Profit Organisations 1. Youth Clubs and Associations 1. Socio-Cultural Clubs 1. Alumni Associations 1. Community-level Youth Institutions or Groups 1. Individuals selected for competitions or events with valid proof of participation
## Benefits 1. Financial assistance of up to INR 1.00 lakh per financial year may be sanctioned to eligible youth organisations or individuals. 1. Up to 10% of the total applications may receive a higher amount of financial support.
## Eligibility Criteria **For Youth Organisations** 1. The organisation should be a registered society, trust, charitable organisation, Section 8 company, or not-for-profit entity under the Societies Registration Act of 1860 for at least 3 months. 1. The organisation should maintain financial accounts with a clear framework for effective and transparent management. 1. The organisation should have primary beneficiaries under the age of 35 and be open to all citizens of the state without distinction of religion, race, caste, or language. 1. The organisation should have at least 50% of registered members under the age of 35 as of the application date. 1. The organisation should not be blacklisted or barred by any government or private entity and should have no pending or ongoing litigation related to misconduct, misappropriation of funds, or sexual harassment. **For Individuals** 1. The applicant should be a citizen of Meghalaya and under the age of 35 as of the application date. 1. The applicant should have a bank account in their name (single or joint account). 1. The applicant should be able to provide proof of selection for the competition or event for which the grant is being requested.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Sign In/Register** Step 1: Visit the official YESS Meghalaya [website.](https://www.yessmeghalaya.in/signinviaotp2.php) Step 2:Enter your mobile number and click Get OTP; enter the OTP received on your mobile to verify. Step 3: For first-time users, fill in your basic details marked with *, such as name, village, gender, and district. Step 4: Fill in the organisation details (if applicable) and list of registered members; multiple members can be added using the + icon. Step 5: After completing all details, review the form, save it as a draft if needed, and then submit the application.

metadata.schemeName: Banglar Yuba Sathi
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance to educated unemployed youth of West Bengal to support them until they get employment or join another scheme. The objective is to ensure income support for eligible unemployed youth for a maximum period of 5 years.

page_content:
# Banglar Yuba Sathi **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** West Bengal | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Unemployed Youth Allowance, Youth Welfare, Monthly Allowance, Banglar Yuba Sathi | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Banglar Yuba Sathi” by the Department of Youth Services & Sports, Government of West Bengal aims to support educated unemployed youth by providing ₹1,500/- per month through direct bank transfer for up to 5 year or till they get employment or enroll in any other scheme, whichever is earlier.
## Benefits - **Financial Assistance:** ₹1,500/- per month. - **Mode of Disbursement:** Financial Assistance under the scheme will be credited by Direct Bank Transfer (DBT) to an AADHAR Linked Bank Account held solely by the eligible unemployed youth. - **Frequency of Disbursement:** The benefit is disbursed monthly or at regular intervals. - **Validity of Benefit:** The benefit is valid for a maximum period of 5 years, subject to continued eligibility or till employment or enrollment in any other scheme, whichever is earlier.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a permanent resident of West Bengal. - The applicant must be aged between 21 and 40 years as on 01.04.2026. - The applicant must be unemployed. - The applicant must have passed the Madhyamik or equivalent examination. > **Notes:** - **Yearly verification of live status of the beneficiary of the scheme:** Once a year, the status of the beneficiary, whether alive or not will be verified. - **Stopping or withholding of financial assistance:** The Government may, after giving the beneficiary of the scheme an opportunity of being heard, stop or withhold financial assistance if: 1. The Financial Assistance has been found to be sanctioned on mistaken grounds. 1. The eligibility condition for the granting of financial assistance no longer exists.
## Exclusions - The applicant must not be covered under any other social security scheme. - The applicant must not be receiving any State Government allowances (except scholarship/educational benefits).
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Open the [Official Website](https://apas.wb.gov.in/) & Click on the "Click to Apply" icon. **Step 2:** The applicant must enter a valid and active mobile number along with the captcha. Upon submission, a secret PIN (OTP) will be sent via SMS to the registered mobile number, which must be used to complete the login process. **Step 3:** Upon successful login, the application page will be displayed. The applicant is then required to complete and submit the online application form with the necessary details. **Step 4:** The applicant is required to upload all mandatory supporting documents as per the prescribed list before final submission of the application. **Step 5:** Click on Final Submit for submission of the application. **Step 6:** After successful submission, download the application form and retain it for future reference. > **Check Application Status:** [Click here](https://apas.wb.gov.in/ds11/PUblic/BYS/BYS_Quick_Tips.aspx).
> **Help & Support:** 18003450117 / 033-22140152
**Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The [application form](https://sportsandyouth.wb.gov.in/storage/uploads/sports/announcements/7PLWMRElFd1771055800-Application%20Form%20for%20Bangler%20Yuba%20Sathi%20Scheme%20Final.pdf) will be available free of cost at camps to be organized at different assembly constituencies of this state. **Step 2:** The forms may also be downloaded from the [departmental](https://sportsandyouth.wb.gov.in/wbyouthservices/news-events) website (News & Events > 2026 > Application Form for Bangler Yuba Sathi Scheme). **Step 3:** All eligible applicants will submit the duly filled-in and signed application form along with the self-attested copies of all the mandatory documents at the above-mentioned camps and other places as notified. > **Find Your Nearest Camp:** [Click here](https://apas.wb.gov.in/ds11/public/page/KnowYourCampLocation.aspx).

metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase productivity and wages of Khadi artisans, improve production infrastructure, boost employment and sales, revive traditional rural skills, modernize sales outlets, and promote marketing and exports.

page_content:
# Khadi Gramodyog Vikas Yojana: Khadi Vikas Yojana **Ministry:** Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Khadi, Gramodyog, Khadi Production, Village Industries, Khadi Artisans, Interest Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Khadi Vikas Yojana" is an umbrella scheme under "Khadi Gramodyog Vikas Yojana" and has been implemented by the Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC), Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME), Governemnt of India. It aims to support Khadi institutions and artisans by providing financial assistance, infrastructure development, interest subsidy, and marketing support. The scheme offers subsidies on Khadi production, reduces the interest burden on bank loans, facilitates the construction of worksheds for artisans, strengthens existing weak Khadi institutions, and enhances marketing infrastructure, including the renovation and modernization of sales outlets. Additionally, the scheme supports quality assurance initiatives, exhibitions, science and technology interventions, and the establishment of Centres of Excellence for Khadi
## Benefits ***Assistance provided under different components of Scheme:*** ***Modified Market Development Assistance (MMDA):*** - Subsidy @ 35% on Prime Cost for Cotton/Muslin, Wool and Polyvastra and @ 20% on Prime Cost for Silk Khadi ***Interest Subsidy Eligibility Certificate Scheme (ISEC):*** - Khadi Institution is required to pay only 4% interest rate. The difference between the actual Interest charged by the Bank and 4% is borne by the KVIC as “Interest Subsidy”. ***Work-shed Scheme for Khadi Artisans:*** - Individual workshed (20 Sq. mtrs): ₹1,20,000/- or 75% of the cost of workshed including toilet (90% for NER), whichever is less. - Group workshed (10 Sq. mtrs per artisans): ₹80,000 or 75% of the cost of the workshed including toilet (90% for NER), whichever is less. ***Strengthening Infrastructure of Existing Weak Khadi Institutions and Assistance for Marketing Infrastructure:*** - Financial assistance for revival of khadi institution with ceiling limit of ₹15.00 lakh(Capital Expenditure +working fund). - Financial assistance under Marketing Infrastructure for renovation of departmental sales outlets of KVIC /KVIB and institutional sales with the ceiling limit of ₹25.00 lakh. **Other Components:** - Centre of Excellence for Khadi - Khadi Quality Assurance - Marketing(Exhibition) - Science & Technology (S&T)
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a Khadi artisan or Khadi Institution registered with KVIC or KVIB. 1. The applicant must be between 18 to 55 years of age. 1. The applicant must have a valid Aadhaar card or government-issued ID. 1. One person per family is eligible under the scheme. 1. The applicant should not have availed benefits from any other government scheme for the same purpose. 1. Preference is given to SC/ST, women, unemployed youth, and BPL category applicants. 1. The beneficiaries may be identified by KVIC, KVIBs, NGOs, DICs, FPOs, or Khadi Institutions.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Visit [official website ](https://www.kviconline.gov.in/)to apply under the scheme. **Step 2:** On the [KVIC online portal](https://kviconline.gov.in/mdaclaims/certKhadi/index.jsp) and click on “[Online Registration of Khadi Institutions](https://kviconline.gov.in/mdaclaims/certKhadi/khadiCertificateRenew.jsp?app=1).” **Step 3:** Fill in all required details of the institution, including name, address, type of registration, authorised person, number of artisans, and infrastructure information, then save the form. **Step 4:** After submission, receive a Username, Password, and Unique ID on your registered email and mobile, and download the acknowledgement for reference. **Step 5:** [Login](https://kviconline.gov.in/mdaclaims/certKhadi/certApplicantLogin.jsp) using your credentials and upload all required documents such as registration certificate, list of artisans, workshed details, and bylaws. **Step 6:** The KVIC office verifies the application and documents, and once approved, the Certificate of Registration (CoR) is issued online for download.

metadata.schemeName: Special Incentive to OBC Meritorious Students (Boys & Girls)
metadata.briefDescription: This scheme offers a financial incentive of up to ₹10,000/- to meritorious Other Backward Classes (OBC) students who have achieved 80% or higher marks in the HSSLC examination. The objective is to motivate and encourage OBC students to pursue higher education.

page_content:
# Special Incentive to OBC Meritorious Students (Boys & Girls) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Assam | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Student, OBC, Incentive, Merit, Social Welfare | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The 'Special Incentive to OBC Meritorious Students (Boys & Girls)' scheme, administered by the Directorate of Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes, Government of Assam, provides financial assistance to deserving Other Backward Classes (OBC) students. Eligibility is extended to those who have achieved 80% or higher marks in the HSSLC examination. The scheme's objective is to motivate and encourage OBC students to pursue higher education, thereby fostering their academic parity with the broader population through a substantial incentive. Assistance is contingent upon the applicant satisfying the stipulated eligibility criteria and the successful submission of required documentation. An incentive of up to ₹10,000/- will be disbursed to students as approved by the Selection Committee.
***The applications will be accepted through the myScheme platform from 04/07/2025 to 31/10/2025.*** ***A DigiLocker account is required for application. Please refer to the Application Process section for details.***
## Benefits A financial incentive of upto ₹ 10,000/-. ## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be currently enrolled as a student. - The applicant must belong to the Other Backward Class (OBC) community of Assam. - The applicant must have secured a minimum of 80% marks in the HSSLC examination held in 2025. - The annual income of the applicant's parents/guardians must not exceed ₹5,00,000/-. _*In instances where multiple applicants achieve an identical percentage in the HSSLC examination, preference will be given to those with a higher percentage in the HSLC examination._
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **The applications will be accepted through the myScheme platform from 04/07/2025 to 31/10/2025.**
**Signup to DigiLocker** **Step 1:** Visit the [_DigiLocker Portal_](https://www.digilocker.gov.in/) or download the DigiLocker Mobile App ([_Android_](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.digilocker.android) _/_ [_iOS_](https://itunes.apple.com/in/app/digilocker/id1320618078)). **Step 2:** Click _"_[_Login/Register_](https://www.digilocker.gov.in/web/signup)_"_ and provide these details: Full name, Gender, Mobile number, Email ID, and Aadhaar Number. Create a 6-digit PIN. **Step 3:** Finally, click "Submit". Note the 6-digit PIN for future reference.
**Signin to myScheme** **Step 1:** At the top right corner of this page, click "Sign In". Provide your DigiLocker Mobile Number and the 6-digit PIN. **Step 2:** Click the "I consent to terms of use" checkbox, then click "Sign In". You will be directed to the DigiLocker Consent Page. **Step 3:** At the bottom of the page, click "Allow". You have now successfully signed in to myScheme.
**Scheme Application** **Step 1:** At the top of this page, click "Apply Now". The application form of the scheme will open. **Step 2:** Fill in all the mandatory fields of the application form, and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. **Step 3:****** Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections. **Step 4:** Click "Submit". You'll receive the following confirmation message: "Form Submitted Successfully!". **Step 5:** For future reference, click "Print" to print the form or to download the filled form as a PDF file. Else, click "Ok" to get redirected to the myScheme landing page.
**Helpdesk Contact Details** **Email:** assamdirectorateofwelfareofsc@gmail.com **Mobile Number:** 8638922415

page_content:
# Dr Ambedkar Central Sector Scheme of Interest Subsidy on Educational Loans for Overseas Studies for Other Backward Classes (OBCs) and Economically Backward Classes (EBCs) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Loan, Subsidy, Interest, Education, Other Backward Class, Economically Backward Class | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description "Dr Ambedkar Central Sector Scheme of Interest Subsidy on Educational Loans for Overseas Studies for Other Backward Classes (OBCs) and Economically Backward Classes (EBCs)" is an Education Loan Scheme by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
Implementing Agency The Scheme will be implemented by the Nodal Bank as per the MoU between the Banks and the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment.
Scope The scheme provides interest subsidy to the students belonging to the OBCs and EBCs on the interest payable for the period of the moratorium for the Education Loans for overseas studies to pursue approved courses of studies abroad at Masters, M.Phil. and PhD level.
Objective To award interest subsidies to meritorious students belonging to the Other Backward Classes and Economically Backward Classes to provide them with better opportunities for higher education abroad and enhance their employability. ## Benefits 1. Under the scheme, interest payable by the students availing the education loans of the IBA for the period of moratorium (i.e. course period, plus one year or six months after getting a job, whichever is earlier) as prescribed under the Education Loan Scheme of the IBA, shall be borne by the Government of India. 1. For a student, the eligible loan component shall be the actual loan taken subject to a maximum of ₹ 20,00,000 for the purpose of an Interest subsidy claim. **NOTE 1:** After the period of moratorium is over, the interest on the outstanding loan amount shall be paid by the student, in accordance with the existing Educational Loan Scheme as may be amended from time to time. **NOTE 2:** The candidate will bear the Principal instalments and interest beyond the moratorium period.
> **Release of Funds** The funds will be released to the applicants on a first-come-first-served basis, subject to a maximum amount to be worked out every year based on the total budget made available that year, under the scheme. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a Student. 1. The student should have secured admission in the approved course at Masters, M.Phil or PhD levels abroad for the [listed courses](https://socialjustice.gov.in/writereaddata/UploadFile/Guidelines%20ISEL%20Scheme%20(wef%2001%20Oct%202017).pdf).1. The applicant should have availed loan from a scheduled bank under the Education Loan Scheme of the Indian Banks Association (IBA) for the purpose. 1. The total income of the applicant (from all sources) shall not exceed ₹ 8,00,000 per annum.
> **Reservation/ Relaxation/ Preference/ Priority** Out of the total outlay in a year, a minimum of 50% amount will be earmarked for Interest Subsidy to the girl candidates. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interest Subsidy shall be linked with the existing Educational Loan Scheme of the Indian Banks Association (IBA) and restricted to students enrolled for courses at Master, M.Phil and PhD levels. **Step 2:** The Nodal Bank will lay down the detailed procedure for processing and sanctioning interest subsidies to eligible students in consultation with the Ministry. **Step 3:** The Recommendatory Committee headed by the Joint Secretary in charge of the Backward Classes Division with representatives of the Finance Division, a representative of Nodal Bank and the concerned Director/Deputy Secretary as convener will examine and recommend the applications for the award of interest subsidy on a quarterly basis.

page_content:
# Study in India Programme **Ministry:** Ministry of Education | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** International Student, Higher Education, Financial Assistance, Courses | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Study in India Programme” has been launched by the Ministry of Education under the Department of Higher Education, Government of India. The scheme aims to position India as a global education destination by providing international students with a single centralized digital platform, access to quality institutions, and end-to-end admission and visa support for pursuing higher education in India. > **Scheme Implementation** The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Education in coordination with the Ministry of Home Affairs and the Ministry of External Affairs through the Study in India portal.
## Benefits **Single Centralized Admission Platform:****** - One portal for registration, course search, application submission, visa and FRRO processes. **Access to Quality Institutions:** - Admission to NAAC-accredited, NIRF-ranked, autonomous, and globally ranked institutions. **Unique Study in India Student ID** - Mandatory unique ID generated at registration. - Required for admission and visa issuance. **Wide Range of Courses** - Access to 8,000+ courses including Engineering, Management, Science, Humanities, Artificial Intelligence, Medicine, Yoga, Buddhist Studies, and Vocational Courses. - Ability to apply to multiple institutions simultaneously and receive multiple offer letters. **Financial Assistance through Institutes** - Tuition fee waivers ranging from 10% to 100%, subject to institute discretion. - No direct scholarship is provided by the Study in India Programme. **Visa and Immigration Support** - Assistance through coordination with Indian Embassies and High Commissions. **24×7 Student Support** - Continuous support through toll-free contact center, email, and social media.


## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a foreign national seeking admission in India. 1. The applicant should have completed the required qualifying education as per course norms. 1. The applicant should apply through the Study in India portal. 1. The applicant should possess a valid passport. 1. The applicant should meet academic and language requirements of the chosen institution. 1. Indian nationals are not eligible under the Study in India Programme. 1. Admissions outside the Study in India portal are not covered.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > To join the Study in India programme, the applicant needs to ‘Register’ on the website and apply to the institutes of your choice and preference. All applicant need to do is follow the ‘6 Steps to Study in India’ which are: **Register Here:** The applicant must register on the [Study in India portal](https://www.studyinindia.gov.in/Index) for the current academic year by creating a user account. **Plan Your Budget:** The applicant should assess and plan the estimated expenditure, including tuition fees, accommodation, living expenses, and other related costs. **Submit Application:** The applicant must select the preferred course and institution and submit the online application through the portal. **Check Result:** The applicant should check the portal for the allotted course and institution based on merit and preferences. **Prepare for Departure:** The applicant should complete admission formalities and begin preparations for travel and study in India.
