metadata.schemeName: Bhagwan Birsa Munda Lakshya Siddhi Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance, in the form of a Scholarship, proportionate to the fees paid by Scheduled Tribe students at the Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC) level in order to take offline coaching assistance through reputed institutions for preparation for NEET & JEE.

page_content:
# Bhagwan Birsa Munda Lakshya Siddhi Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Scholarship, Scheduled Tribe, Examination, Student, Education | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Bhagwan Birsa Munda Lakshya Siddhi Yojana" was launched by the Department of Tribal Welfare, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to give financial support for talented tribal students to encourage and empower them to take up admissions for undergraduate professional courses in reputed institutions in Goa as well as outside Goa. The scheme provides financial assistance, in the form of a Scholarship, proportionate to the fees paid by Scheduled Tribe students at the Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC) level in order to take offline coaching assistance through reputed institutions for preparation for the All India Common Competitive exams such as the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) and Joint Entrance Examination (JEE).
## Benefits ##### ***Financial Assistance*** - Financial assistance for coaching fees for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) course, subject to a maximum limit of ₹3,00,000/- (Rupees three lakhs only). - Financial assistance for coaching fees for the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) course, subject to a maximum limit of ₹3,00,000/- (Rupees three lakhs only). - 100% of coaching fees shall be reimbursed to students whose family income is up to ₹8,00,000/- (Rupees eight lakhs) per annum. - 75% of coaching fees shall be reimbursed to students whose family income is above ₹8,00,000/- (Rupees eight lakhs) per annum, subject to the maximum limit. - If the course fee exceeds the admissible amount, the student has to arrange for the remaining funds from his/her own sources. ##### ***Disbursement*** - **Duration:** The benefit under the scheme shall be given for two years.- **Mode of Payment:** The course fee shall be released directly into the bank account of the students in two instalments through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode.- **Frequency:** Instalments are paid during the two-year course upon submission of fee receipts (First Installment in the XIth Standard and Second Installment in the XIIth Standard).- **Advance Claim:** If selected students have already paid registration, admission, or tuition fees in advance to the coaching institute for booking seats, they are eligible to claim such fees under the scheme, subject to the maximum benefit amount. ##### ***Conditions*** - The applicant must submit the passing marksheet of the XIth standard; failing this, the scholarship will not be awarded for the XIIth standard. - The student shall attend at least 90% of the classes. - If the student remains absent for more than 15 days without any valid reason or leaves the coaching midway, the entire amount released to the student shall be recovered. - If the student opts out in the 2nd year (i.e., in the XIIth standard), the student shall refund the full amount released under the scheme within 30 days. - If any student furnishes any false information/documents and it is established as false, action shall be initiated for recovery of the amount released, with 15% compound interest thereon.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe Community of Goa. - The applicant must have scored at least 65% in the Secondary School Certificate Examination (SSCE) Board Examination. - The applicant must be a regular, full-time student studying in a Higher Secondary School. - The Higher Secondary School must be recognised by the Central/State Goa Board of Higher Secondary Education. - The applicant must apply for the benefit under the scheme in the XIth standard only. - The Coaching institute through which the student desires to take admission must be a registered body or run by any organisation registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860/Companies Act, 2014, or any other relevant Act of the State. - The applicant must be precluded from availing benefits under any other coaching scheme of the Centre or the State Government. - The applicant must provide a declaration to the effect that they are not availing benefits under any other coaching scheme of the Centre or the State Government.
##### ***Selection Criteria (Post-Application)*** - Selection shall be strictly done by drawing a merit list. - The merit list shall be drawn up for each course from the marks secured at the Goa Board/Central Board Secondary School Certificate Examination (SSCE) Examination among eligible students. - In case of two candidates having the same score for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) course, the score in the Science subject followed by the Mathematics subject shall be considered to decide the order of merit. - In case of two candidates having the same score for the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) course, the score in the Mathematics subject followed by the Science subject shall be considered to decide the order of merit. - If students have secured equal marks in both the primary deciding subjects, then the score in English shall be considered for deciding the order of merit. - A waitlist of students beyond 150 for each course shall be drawn up. - If there are vacant slots after drawing the merit list, candidates shall be selected from those students who have applied for the other course, subject to a maximum total of 300 students seats.
## Exclusions - Online coaching shall not be supported under the scheme. - If the applicant fails to clear the XIth standard, then the student shall be ineligible to continue under the scheme.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://goaprintingpress.gov.in/downloads/2526/2526-11-SI-OG-1.pdf) of the application form. Alternatively, the interested applicant should visit one of the following Offices and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the designated staff: - **Office of the Director, Tribal Welfare, Panaji-Goa** - **Office of the Deputy Director, Tribal Welfare, Margao-Goa** **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the copies of the required documents. ##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** The Director, Tribal Welfare, shall rest the entire power for scrutinizing the applications and sanctioning the benefits. A merit list shall be drawn up based on the marks secured in the Secondary School Certificate Examination (SSCE) among eligible students for selection. **Step 2:** Upon approval, the Director of Tribal Welfare shall convey the approval of sanction to the student and release the benefit. The coaching fees shall be reimbursed in two instalments, and the student must submit the required fee receipts for the release of the First Installment, which occurs in the XIth Standard. **Step 3:** For the release of the Second Installment, which occurs in the XIIth Standard, the student must submit the passing marksheet of the XIth standard, along with the required fee receipts and attendance certificate. The payments are made directly into the student's bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode.

page_content:
# Development of Manures & Fertilizers: Assistance for Construction/Installation of Vermi-Compost Units **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Agriculture, Farmer, Crop, Soil, Plant | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Development of Manures & Fertilizers" was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Goa. The "Vermi-compost Units" component of the scheme aims to convert available on-field and farm waste material into chemical-free farm resources as farm input for organic farming through vermicomposting processes. The payment of the sanctioned subsidy is through Electronic Clearance System (ECS). The applications for this scheme are accepted offline via the Zonal Agriculture Officer.
## Benefits - Construction/Installation of Vermi-compost unit would be provided 75% subsidy limited to Rs.1,950/- per cu.mt for Vermi-compost units for all categories of farmers. - The Standard cost for Vermi-compost unit would be Rs. 2600/- per cubic meter which includes 90% cost on construction/installation including mason cost and 10% will be the cost of earthworms, etc. - The unit can have one or more pits with or without internal chambers and has to be above ground level, of bricks, laterite stones, cement blocks, shahabadi/kadappa or RCC cement rings, having a cement floor with proper water outlet, with clean internal side walls and a proper ant proofing and should be protected from sun, rain and from attack of birds, lizards and rodents feeding on earthworms. - The portable Vermi-composting unit of HDPE material i.e.Vermi-bed or Vermi composting bins of 100 litre and above laid on prepared hard surface free from sharp objects, and protected as above, maximum of 3 units would also be considered for subsidy @ 90% subsidy on the standard cost fixed and maximum amount of Rs 7,500/- per farmer.
## Eligibility Criteria - Any farmer carrying out agricultural activities in the State of Goa and having a Krishi card. - Institutions and private limited companies involved in agricultural activities and having a Krishi card will also be assisted under this scheme.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the [Zonal Agriculture Officer](https://www.agri.goa.gov.in/ContactUs;jsessionid=8C0446B54FFF58D0E14D99C1661A85D6?0) and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the Zonal Agriculture Officer.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide timely financial assistance to farmers for crop damage caused by wildlife, assessed and compensated within 30 working days as per revenue book circular guidelines.

page_content:
# Compensation for Crop Damage Caused by Wildlife (in Revenue and Forest Villages) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Madhya Pradesh | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Farmer, Financial Relief, Wild Animal, Crops | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Compensation for Crop Damage Caused by Wildlife (in Revenue and Forest Villages)" scheme is launched by the Forest Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial relief to farmers whose crops are damaged by wild animals in both revenue and forest villages.
## Benefits **Financial Benefits** - Compensation is provided to farmers whose crops are damaged by wild animals. - Loss assessment is conducted as per Madhya Pradesh Revenue Book Circular, Volume 6, Clause 4. - The compensation amount depends on the extent of damage assessed by the designated authority. **Mode of Disbursement** - Payment is made through e-payment directly into the farmer’s bank account. **Expected Time of Disbursement** - Compensation is provided within 30 working days from the date of loss assessment.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must be a farmer whose crops have been damaged. - The damage must be caused by wild animals and not by domestic or stray animals.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ##### ***Registration*** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Website of "[Madhya Pradesh Lok Sewa Guarantee Portal](https://mpedistrict.gov.in/MPL/CitizenRegistration.aspx)". **Step 2:** On the homepage, click "Citizen Registration". You will be taken to the registration page. **Step 3:** On the registration page, fill in all the mandatory fields (name, mobile number, gender, and captcha) and click "Verify Mobile Number." **Step 4:** A verification code will be sent to your mobile number. Enter the code and complete the registration. ##### ***Application*** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Website of "Madhya Pradesh Lok Sewa Guarantee Portal". **Step 2:** Enter your User ID, Password, and Captcha Code, and click "Login." **Step 3:** Click on "Apply Online Service" and select the scheme you intend to apply for. **Step 4:** In the scheme's online application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size (fields marked with * are mandatory), and click "Submit".
**NOTE:** The applicant must inform the incident within 3 days of the damage as per Revenue Book Circular, Volume 6, Clause 4.
**Mode:** Offline > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the Tehsildar, Additional Tehsildar, or Naib Tehsildar Office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Tehsildar, Additional Tehsildar, or Naib Tehsildar. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the Tehsildar, Additional Tehsildar, or Naib Tehsildar Office to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable). > **Post- Application Process:** **Step 1:** The Revenue Officer, in coordination with the Forest Department, assesses the extent of crop damage as per Madhya Pradesh Revenue Book Circular, Volume 6, Clause 4. **Step 2:** Based on the assessment, the compensation amount is determined and sanctioned. **Step 3:** The sanctioned amount is disbursed to the farmer via e-payment within 30 working days. **Note 1:** The applicant must inform the incident within 3 days of the damage as per Revenue Book Circular, Volume 6, Clause 4.

metadata.schemeName: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy Towards Annual Interest Rate Payable On Loans
metadata.briefDescription: The subsidy aims to support the logistics and warehousing sector by reimbursing 50% of the annual interest paid on construction loans. The benefit is capped at ₹25,00,000/- (Indian Rupees Twenty-five Lakhs) annually per project and is available for up to 05 consecutive years for eligible entities.

page_content:
# Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy Towards Annual Interest Rate Payable On Loans **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Subsidy, Interest, Loan, Finance, Entrepreneur | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme” was launched by the Department of Industries, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the development of the logistics and warehousing industry in the State. The “Subsidy Towards Annual Interest Rate Payable On Loans” component of the scheme offers financial assistance for the development of the logistics and warehousing industry in the State. The component provides a reimbursement of 50% of the annual interest amount payable by the eligible entity on loans taken for the construction of projects. This subsidy is implemented by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce (DITC), which also monitors effective implementation and ensures sanctioning is completed within 90 days from the date of application. Applications for this scheme are accepted through the Goa online single-window system.
## Benefits - Subsidy towards annual interest rate payable on loans. - The subsidy rate is 50% of the annual interest amount payable by the entity on loans taken for the construction of projects. - The entitlement per project shall not exceed an annual sum of ₹25,00,000/- (Indian Rupees Twenty-five Lakhs).
##### ***Period of Subsidy*** - Standard projects are eligible for 03 consecutive years from the date the loan was taken. - Projects constructed in Backward Talukas OR owned by Women Entrepreneurs/Entrepreneurs belonging to Schedule Caste/Schedule Tribe Communities are eligible for 05 consecutive years from the date the loan was taken.
##### ***Subsidy Computation and Disbursal*** - The subsidy calculation will take into account the interest amount paid up to the end of the previous fiscal year, for the claim submitted for the year or part of the year. - The subsidy calculation will be based on the actual interest amount incurred, as determined by the prevailing interest rate applicable to the concerned financial transaction. - The reimbursement shall not include penal interest, liquidated damages, or similar charges paid to the financial institutions/banks.
##### ***Claim Submission*** - If an Entity fails to file the annual claim after the first year, it may still submit the delayed claim in the following year, provided it falls within the overall subsidy eligibility period specified in Table 7.1. - If interest cannot be claimed due to non-payment before filing, the unit shall be eligible to claim such interest subject to payment of the same in the subsequent year.
##### ***Loan Compliance*** - In case of default in payment of term loan (i.e., not paid as per schedule of repayment) reimbursement of interest shall be reduced to the extent of default. - Only the limit of original loan granted and not rescheduled loan shall be considered for interest reimbursement. - In case an Entity procures loans from multiple financial institutions, the aggregate sum of interest paid across these loans shall qualify for subsidy consideration, provided the total claimed does not surpass the prescribed maximum allowable amount. - In case of more than one unit with a consolidated balance sheet, a certificate from a Chartered Accountant giving interest details unit-wise shall be submitted by the applicant, and the claim shall be made only for the eligible unit.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be applicable only for non-mega industries. - The applicant must own a business unit in Goa and provide Logistics and Warehousing services in Goa. - The applicant must be a Logistics and Warehousing services provider. - The applicant must have Permanent Account Number (PAN) and must regularly file the Income Tax Returns in the name of the legal entity. - The applicant must be in continuous operations for a minimum period of six months post the date of notification of Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The applicant must have incurred the expenses (loan availed) post the date of launch of the Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The applicant must not have claimed similar benefit under any other scheme/program of State or Central Government. - The applicant must provide minimum 40% local employment (employees who are employed continuously during the claim year and are on the payroll of the unit for that year shall be considered). - The applicant must have availed the loan as term loan and/or working capital loan for conducting business of the unit claiming the benefit. - The applicant must have procured the loan from a nationalized bank, scheduled private bank, Co-operative Bank, Economic Development Corporation Limited (EDC Ltd.), or any Non-Banking Financial Institutions recognized by the Reserve Bank of India. - The applicant must ensure the relevant loan quantum for determining the subsidy is the aggregate amount borrowed for the construction of the project, including the cost of land acquisition and all construction-related expenses. - The applicant must ensure the loan is not covered under the Modified Interest Rebate Scheme 2012, or the interest paid is not under the Chief Minister Rojgar Yojana Scheme or any other employment generation scheme of the Government of India/Government of Goa.
##### ***Preference and Quantum Criteria*** - The benefit is subject to a first come first serve basis, contingent upon the availability of funds in a particular fiscal year. - The quantum of benefit shall be defined by the proportion of Goan employees on payrolls: - 60% or above Goan employment results in 100% of the benefits. - More than 40% but less than 60% Goan employment results in 80% of the benefits. - Less than 40% Goan employment results in ineligibility.
##### ***Project Category and Minimum Land Area Requirements*** _The project must be one of the following eight categories, subject to the minimum land area specified:_ **Logistics Park (Multi-modal/Integrated), Inland Container Depot (ICD), Container Freight Stations (CFS)** - Standard Minimum Land Area: 1 Acre - Backward Talukas/SC/ST/Women Minimum Land Area: 1 Acre. **Air Freight Stations (AFS)** - Standard Minimum Land Area: 1,000 square meters - Backward Talukas/SC/ST/Women Minimum Land Area: 1,000 square meters. **Warehouses, Truck Terminals** - Standard Minimum Land Area: 1,000 square meters - Backward Talukas/SC/ST/Women Minimum Land Area: 500 square meters. **Cold Chain Unit, Testing Facilities** - Standard Minimum Land Area: 200 square meters - Backward Talukas/SC/ST/Women Minimum Land Area: 100 square meters.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online _*The entity who wishes to avail incentives must first be registered on the Goa Online portal (www.goaonline.gov.in) and must have already obtained necessary business approvals through the portal._ **Step 1:****** Visit the [Official Web Portal](https://goaonline.gov.in/) of Goa Online. At the top right corner, click "[Register](https://goaonline.gov.in/Public/userRegistration_af)". **Step 2:****** On the next page, verify your Email ID and Mobile Number using OTP. You will be redirected to the Registration Page. **Step 3:****** On the Registration Page, fill in all the mandatory fields of the registration form. Create a Login Name and a strong Password. Carefully read the Declaration and the Terms & Conditions, and tick the checkboxes. Fill in the Captcha Code, and click "Register/Signup". **Step 4:****** Login to the website using your Login Name and Password. Fill in the Captcha Code, and click "Login". **Step 5:****** In the top ribbon, click on "Services", then click on "[IT Services](https://goaonline.gov.in/AllServices?cat=IT)". Click on **"Incentives on Logistics and Warehousing Sector"**. You will be taken to the application form for the scheme. Fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents. **Step 6:****** Submit the application. A unique registration number will be generated. Note this number for future reference.
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** Upon receiving the application, the DITC should raise any queries to the applicant regarding shortfalls in the application form or submitted documents. After verification, the DITC designates an official to inspect the Entity, verify all records/documents, including verifying the list of structures created and civil works completed as per the Civil Engineer Certificate (Annexure X). The inspecting officers are required to upload the inspection reports to the portal within 48 hours. **Step 2:** The application and Inspection Report are subsequently marked to the Chief Executive Officer, Goa Investment Promotion and Facilitation Board (Goa-IPB) for due diligence. Following the recommendation from the CEO (Goa-IPB), the DITC prepares an appraisal note to be placed before the Incentive Review Committee (IRC). **Step 3:** The DITC calls for the IRC meeting where the committee deliberates on the incentive application, scrutinizes the details, and sanctions the claims. The decisions of the IRC are final and binding in sanctioning the incentives and deciding the eligible investment.
##### ***Disbursement of Funds*** After receiving IRC recommendations, DITC prepares an approval note for the Accounts Department to process the disbursement. The DITC disburse funds to the entities, observing the chronological order of sanctions approved by the IRC. The entire process, from application receipt until amount disbursement, must be completed within a maximum period of 90 days.

metadata.schemeName: Promotion of Acting in Tiatr for School Children
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage school children to improve their acting abilities in Goan tiatr through organized competitions. It provides cash prizes and certificates to winners in comedy and non-comedy acting categories.

page_content:
# Promotion of Acting in Tiatr for School Children **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Acting, School, Children, Artist, Culture, Comedy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Promotion of Acting in Tiatr for School Children" by the Tiatr Academy of Goa aims to encourage interested artistes to improve their acting abilities through organized competitions related to Goan tiatr dramatic activity, addressing the need to develop theatrical skills among school students at primary and secondary levels. The scheme provides acting competitions in comedy and non-comedy categories with both monologue and dialogue formats, along with cash prizes ranging from ₹2,000/- to ₹5,000/- and participation certificates for winners and best script writers. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
## Benefits ##### ***Cash Prizes and Recognition*** - **Monologue (Comedy Acting):** 1st Performance - ₹3,000/-; 2nd Performance - ₹2,000/-- **Best Script Writer:** ₹2,000/-- **Dialogue (Comedy Acting):** 1st Performance - ₹5,000/-; 2nd Performance - ₹3,000/-- **Best Script Writer:** ₹2,000/-- **Monologue (Non-Comedy Acting):** 1st Performance - ₹3,000/-; 2nd Performance - ₹2,000/-- **Best Script Writer:** ₹2,000/-- **Dialogue (Non-Comedy Acting):** 1st Performance - ₹5,000/-; 2nd Performance - ₹3,000/-- **Best Script Writer:** ₹2,000/- ##### ***Additional Benefits*** - Participation certificates awarded to all winners. - Transport charges remuneration paid to each participating school as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - Development of acting abilities through structured competition and professional judging. ##### ***Conditions*** _*Minimum four entries required in each category for competition to be conducted in that particular category._ _*Performance duration must be between 4 to 7 minutes._ _*Scripts must not contain adverse remarks against any governments, individuals, institutions, or anything against caste, creed and religion._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a school student at primary school level or secondary school level. - The applicant must participate through their respective school. ##### ***Participation Rules*** - The applicant (one student of a school) can participate in each category. - The applicant must submit separate applications if participating in more than one category. - The applicant must ensure their performance is between 4 to 7 minutes duration. - The applicant must submit a typed copy of the script along with the application form. ##### ***Content Requirements*** - The applicant must ensure their script/performance does not contain any adverse remarks against any governments, individuals, institutions, or anything against caste, creed and religion. - The applicant must ensure their performance does not hurt the sentiments of anybody. ##### ***Competition Categories Available*** - The applicant can participate in Monologue (Comedy Acting) category. - The applicant can participate in Dialogue (Comedy Acting) category. - The applicant can participate in Monologue (Non-Comedy Acting) category. - The applicant can participate in Dialogue (Non-Comedy Acting) category. ##### ***Judging Criteria*** Acting abilities are evaluated based on six specific criteria: - Delivery of dialogues - Facial expression - Reaction to others on the stage - Movement on the stage - Costumes - Overall impact ##### ***Performance Guidelines*** - Light effects and background music are not considered during judging. - Performances are limited to acting ability assessment only. - Professional judges with expertise in acting and direction conduct the evaluation.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields. Attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment_
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:****** ***Await Competition Schedule*** Wait for Tiatr Academy of Goa to organize the competition once minimum four entries are received in each category, as competitions will only be conducted when this minimum requirement is met. **Step 2:****** ***Performance Evaluation*** Participate in the competition where your acting abilities will be judged on six criteria: delivery of dialogues, facial expression, reaction to others on the stage, movement on the stage, costumes, and overall impact by a panel of judges well versed in acting and direction. **Step 3:****** ***Receive Results and Benefits*** Accept the final and binding decision of the judges, and if selected as a winner, receive cash prizes and participation certificates as per the category and position achieved in the competition.

metadata.schemeName: Scheme To Provide Assistance To Students Seeking Education Outside Goa In Any Field Of Art And Culture
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage young talents in Goa to achieve the highest possible standard in fields of Art and Culture by providing financial support for training outside the State. Assistance is provided to eligible students for basic or advanced education in art.

page_content:
# Scheme To Provide Assistance To Students Seeking Education Outside Goa In Any Field Of Art And Culture **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Student, Art, Culture, Education, Scholarship, Training | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Scheme To Provide Assistance To Students Seeking Education Outside Goa In Any Field Of Art And Culture" was launched by the Directorate of Art and Culture, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage and give opportunity to the young talents in the State to excel their talent to reach the highest possible standard/merit under the guidance of a renowned teacher/artist outside the State. The scheme provides financial support to students seeking to get basic or advanced education/training in any field of Art and Culture, such as music, dance, theatre, fine arts, folk arts, or photography (fields of visual and performing art). The applications for this scheme are accepted when the Directorate of Art and Culture releases an advertisement/press note on local daily newspapers thereby inviting applications. The scheme shall remain in force up to 31st March 2027.
## Benefits ##### ***Financial Assistance*** - Financial assistance is given to acquire basic or advanced education in any field of Art and Culture (like music, dance, theatre, fine arts, folk arts, photography, etc.) at State, National, and International levels. - Maximum assistance up to ₹1,20,000/- is provided for acquiring education outside Goa or the actual cost of the education, whichever is less. - Maximum assistance up to ₹3,00,000/- is provided for acquiring education outside India or the actual cost of the education, whichever is less. ##### ***Disbursement*** - The committee may scrutinize and decide upon the quantum of assistance, from case to case, depending upon the nature of training, reputation of the Institution/Guru, and eligibility of the applicant. - The assistance shall be disbursed by the Director of Art and Culture only after obtaining Government approval for the names selected by the Sub-Committee. ##### ***Conditions*** - The student shall undergo training on full time or part time basis. - The student must maintain 75 % attendance for the total course period or for one year period of the course (whichever is less). This shall not be applicable where there are regular examinations recognized by the University or Board or Government. - The student can apply for assistance for a maximum of five years (initially for three years and upon review if showing progress, extended for two years). - A review report of the student shall be taken every six months. - The student shall be bound to present performance as and when asked by the Directorate of Art and Culture. - The scholarship amount shall be recovered if the student fails to maintain 75% attendance (where applicable). - The amount shall be recovered from the student if the course is not completed.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must intend to seek advanced education in any field of Art and Culture, such as music, dance, theatre, fine art, folk art, photography, etc. (fields of visual and performing art). - The applicant must seek this education outside Goa or outside India. - The applicant should have outlined knowledge about the art form in which the education is desired. - The applicant should be born in Goa. - The applicant must be residing in Goa for a substantial period or at least for the last fifteen years to the date of application. - The applicant shall not be above the age of thirty-five years. - The applicant must be the only student per family applying under this scheme per financial year. - The applicant’s annual family income must not cross the limit fixed by the Government from time to time. - If the applicant is receiving a grant or scholarship from any other Government or non-Government bodies for the training, the total amount raised from different sources must be less than the actual cost of the education. ##### ***Relaxation/Exception*** - The application to seek training outside Goa shall be considered for assistance in exceptional cases wherein not even the basic education is available in a particular field of art within Goa. - In rare cases, a second application in the same family, but in a different stream of art to that of the first, may be considered depending upon his/her contribution or merit. The decision regarding this exception is to be taken by the committee.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ##### ***Step 1: Notification of Application Cycle*** - The Directorate of Art and Culture releases an advertisement or press note on local daily newspapers, officially inviting applications from eligible students for availing benefits under this scheme. - Applicants are advised to monitor the local daily newspapers for the release of this advertisement, as it signals the official opening of the application window. ##### ***Step 2: Submission of Application and Supporting Documentation*** - Interested students shall prepare all the requisite supporting documents and formally apply directly to the Director of Art and Culture. - This submission package must comprehensively include the applicant's photograph, age proof (birth certificate or school leaving certificate), residence certificate, reports of previous training and competition participation, income certificate, and a recommendation letter from a recognized person or Institution working in the field of Art and Culture. ##### ***Step 3: Disclosure of Personal Contribution and External Grants*** - The application requires the student to clearly mention the amount of contribution or capital that they are personally putting forth for the particular course they are undertaking. - Furthermore, if the student is receiving any grant or scholarship from other Government or non-Government bodies for the same training, a document in that regard, along with the detailed breakdown of the financial grants, must be submitted while applying for assistance. ##### ***Step 4: Scrutiny and Recommendation by Sub-Committee*** - The application and supporting documentation will be processed and reviewed by the designated Sub-Committee. - This committee is responsible for scrutinizing the application, assessing the eligibility of the applicant, the nature of the training, and the reputation of the Institution or Guru to decide upon the quantum of assistance to be recommended. ##### ***Step 5: Obtaining Government Approval and Fund Disbursement*** - Once recommendations are officially received from the Sub-Committee, the Director of Art and Culture shall proceed to obtain the necessary Government approval for the names of the students selected for assistance under the scheme. - Following this formal approval, the Director shall then disburse the sanctioned amount of assistance to the eligible students.

page_content:
# Scheme To Provide Grant To The Institution(s)/Individual(s) For Long Term Project In The Field Of Art And Culture **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Institution, Art, Culture, Grant, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Scheme To Provide Grant To The Institution(s)/Individual(s) For Long Term Project In The Field Of Art And Culture" was launched by the Directorate of Art and Culture, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to give financial support to the institution(s)/individual(s) involved in long term projects in the field of Art and Culture. The scheme provides grants up to 80% of the total expenditure involved, subject to a maximum ceiling of ₹5,00,000/- per annum. It also aims to encourage young talents in the State to excel under guidance outside the State and provides financial support to students seeking basic or advanced education/training in Art and Culture by way of scholarships. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Art and Culture/Government. The applications for this scheme are accepted when the Sub-Committee is constituted and meets as and when required to consider applications.
## Benefits - ***Financial Grant:*** Eligible institutions or individuals shall be entitled for a grant to the extent of 80% of the total expenditure involved.- ***Maximum Ceiling:*** The maximum financial grant limit provided under this scheme is ₹5,00,000/- (Indian Rupees Five Lakhs) per annum.- ***Support for Talent and Education:*** The scheme encourages young talents in the State to excel their talent to reach the highest possible standard/merit under the guidance of a renowned teacher/artist outside the State.- ***Scholarships:*** Financial support is given to students seeking to get basic or advanced education/training in any field of Art and Culture by way of scholarships.- ***Disbursement Conditions:*** The actual financial grant received shall be decided by the Sub-Committee/Department of Art and Culture/Government. This decision is based on the nature and scope of the project, the reputation of the institution, and taking into consideration the overall impact on the society.- ***Fund Restriction:*** The Department/Government may restrict the number of institutions according to the availability of funds.- ***Disbursement:*** The amount is disbursed to the eligible institution(s)/individual(s) in the form of a cheque, after the Director of Art and Culture obtains Government approval based on the Sub-Committee's recommendations.
## Eligibility Criteria ##### ***For Institutions*** - The applicant must be registered under the Society’s Registration Act, 1860. - The applicant must be registered under the Indian Trust Act. - The applicant must be involved in a long term project in the field of Art and Culture. ##### ***For Individuals*** - The applicant must be from the Goan community. - The applicant must be a resident of Goa for 15 years or more. - The applicant must be involved in a long term project in the field of Art and Culture. - The applicant must have contributed at least 15 years in the relevant field.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ##### ***Step 1: Application Submission in Writing*** - The applicant, whether an eligible institution or an individual, should apply for financial assistance under the scheme by submitting an application in writing. - This written application must be submitted along with all the stipulated documentation relevant to the applicant type (Institution or Individual), such as the Detailed Project Report and eligibility proof documents. ##### ***Step 2: Consideration by Sub-Committee*** - Once the application is received, the appointed Sub-Committee shall meet as and when required to consider the applications received under this scheme. - The Sub-Committee is responsible for assessing the applications and giving its formal recommendations, including the names of the approved institutions and the specific amount sanctioned to each, for further government approval. ##### ***Step 3: Obtaining Government Approval*** - After the recommendations are formally received from the Sub-Committee, the Director of Art and Culture is responsible for obtaining the necessary Government approval for the recommendations. - This government approval confirms the sanctioning of the grant amount to the eligible applicant(s). ##### ***Step 4: Disbursement of Financial Assistance*** - Following the successful obtaining of the Government approval, the Director of Art and Culture shall disburse the sanctioned amount to the eligible institution(s) or individual(s). - This financial assistance will be provided to the beneficiary in the physical form of a cheque. ##### ***Help & Support / Grievance Redressal*** - If any grievance arises out of implementation of this scheme, the concerned matter shall be heard and decided by the Minister for Art and Culture. - The decision rendered by the Minister for Art and Culture regarding such grievances shall be considered final.

page_content:
# Empowering Schedule Tribe/Schedule Caste Communities Using Information And Communication Technology Tools **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Technology, Training, Schedule Tribe, Schedule Caste, Student, Youth, Skill | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Empowering Schedule Tribe/Schedule Caste Communities Using Information And Communication Technology Tools" by the Department of Information Technology, Government of Goa, aims to provide Information Technology related trainings to the Schedule Tribe/Schedule Caste communities free of cost. The scheme provides various job oriented Information Technology training courses. The key features and provisions offered include providing basic computer skills to local youth, housewives, and other citizens, providing structural training programs depending on needs, and making at least one person in each family in the State Information Technology literate.
## Benefits - **Free Information Technology Related Trainings:** The scheme provides Information Technology related trainings to the Schedule Tribe and Schedule Caste beneficiaries free of cost.- **Training Content:** The trainings cover basic computer skills, various job oriented Information Technology training courses, and structural training programmes depending on the needs of the community.- **Implementing Agency Funding:** M/s Info Tech Corporation of Goa Limited (ITG) is nominated as the implementing agency and receives a Grant-in-Aid under the Tribal Sub Plan (TSP) and the Schedule Caste Sub Plan (SCSP) on a yearly basis for providing these free trainings.

The application is addressed to The Managing Director, Info Tech Corporation of Goa Limited, Panaji-Goa.

metadata.schemeName: Ashramshalas (Grant in Aid)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide schooling, boarding and lodging to Scheduled Tribe students at a single location, enabling better employment opportunities and competitive equality with other sections of society. The scheme offers residential education with complete support including free education.

page_content:
# Ashramshalas (Grant in Aid) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Student, Education, Tribal, Grant, School, Scholarship, Accommodation | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Ashramshalas (Grant in Aid)" was launched by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide comprehensive educational support to Scheduled Tribe students who cannot afford education due to weak economic conditions, addressing the issue of children being forced into traditional occupations or other jobs to support their families instead of attending school. The scheme provides residential schooling facilities with complete boarding and lodging arrangements, where tribal students receive free education, hostel facilities, books, food, and items of daily necessity through 100% grant-in-aid to Non-Governmental Organizations operating these schools across standards 1st to 12th.
## Benefits ##### ***Financial Grant to Ashramshalas*** A grant of ₹1,500/- per month is provided to the Ashramshala for every enrolled child to cover all expenses related to education, boarding, and lodging. _*The grant is provided on a monthly basis to the Ashramshalas for continuous support of enrolled students._ ##### ***Benefits Provided to Students*** - Free education without any tuition fees. - Free hostel facilities and accommodation. - Free books and educational materials. - Free food and meals. - Items of daily necessity free of cost. _*All benefits (education, boarding, lodging, food, books, and daily necessities) are provided continuously throughout the academic year._ ##### ***Conditions*** - The Ashramshala must maintain the minimum enrollment requirements as specified in the eligibility criteria. - The Ashramshala must continue to provide all stipulated facilities (education, boarding, lodging, food, books, and daily necessities) to the enrolled students. - The Ashramshala must comply with all regulations and guidelines set by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat.
## Eligibility Criteria ##### ***For Ashramshalas (Educational Institutions)*** - The Ashramshala must enrol a minimum of 15 boys and 15 girls for the first time on inception. - The Ashramshala must enrol a minimum of 10 boys and 10 girls every year till 7th standard after the inception year. - The Ashramshala must be operated by a Non-Governmental Organization working in tribal areas. - The Ashramshala must be located within any district of Gujarat. - The Ashramshala must provide education for standards 1st to 8th (Ashramshala), standards 9th to 10th (Uttar Buniyadi Ashramshala), or standards 11th to 12th (Uchchattar Uttar Buniyadi Ashramshala). ##### ***For Students (Beneficiaries)*** - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. - The applicant must be seeking admission to an Ashramshala for education from standard 1st to standard 12th.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://tribal.gujarat.gov.in/application-forms) of the application form. Alternatively, the interested applicant may visit the Tribal Development Department, Govt. of Gujarat, and request the hard copy of the [prescribed format](https://tribal.gujarat.gov.in/application-forms) of the application form from the designated staff.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Prepare a detailed proposal outlining your organization's capabilities, infrastructure facilities, proposed location, staff arrangements, and plan for providing education, boarding, and lodging to Scheduled Tribe students. Submit the completed application form along with the comprehensive proposal and all supporting documents to the Tribal Development Department.
> ***Inspection and Approval*** - The Tribal Development Department will conduct an inspection of the proposed Ashramshala premises to verify the infrastructure, facilities, and readiness to operate the residential school. Cooperate fully during the inspection and provide any additional information or clarification requested by the inspection team. - Upon successful verification and approval, the Tribal Development Department will issue a formal sanction letter approving the grant-in-aid with terms and conditions, grant amount of ₹1,500/- per month per student, and guidelines for operation.

metadata.schemeName: Exhibition of Books on Tiatr, Its Song and Music
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to help Roman Script Konkani writers and publishers who face difficulties in marketing their books related to Tiatr, its song and music, while promoting Tiatr culture among enthusiasts. The scheme provides bulk purchase of books at 80% of the fixed rate and organizes book exhibition.

page_content:
# Exhibition of Books on Tiatr, Its Song and Music **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Exhibition, Book, Song, Music, Culture | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Exhibition of Books on Tiatr, Its Song and Music" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to help Roman Script Konkani writers and publishers who face difficulties in marketing their books related to Tiatr, its song and music, while promoting Tiatr culture among enthusiasts. The scheme provides bulk purchase of books at 80% of the fixed rate and organizes book exhibitions to facilitate better market reach for publishers. The applicant must be a writer or publisher of books related to Tiatr, its song and music, and must submit 3 copies of their published book for evaluation. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy Goa through its appointed Recommendation Committee. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
## Benefits **Book Purchase:** Tiatr Academy Goa will purchase books at 80% of the rate fixed as per Tiatr Academy Goa conditions. **Marketing Support:** Books are sold through book exhibitions organized by Tiatr Academy Goa and participation in exhibitions by various Book Houses and Institutions. **Promotional Platform:** Books receive exposure to Tiatr lovers and enthusiasts through organized exhibitions.
***Conditions*** _*Tiatr Academy Goa reserves the right to sell books at discounted rates during exhibitions._ _*Payment will be made only after Tiatr Academy Goa's final decision to purchase the books._ _*Books will be purchased on 'First-come-First' serve basis._ _*The final purchase decision remains at the discretion of Tiatr Academy Goa even after Committee recommendation._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a writer or publisher of books related to Tiatr, its song and music. - The applicant should have published books in any script or language (not limited to Roman Konkani script).
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the office of Tiatr Academy of Goa to collect the prescribed application form for the scheme. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). The application should express the intent to avail benefit under this scheme. Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._
> ***Committee Review & Recommendation*** **Step 1:** The Tiatr Academy Goa appointed Recommendation Committee will scrutinize the submitted book and evaluate its relevance to Tiatr, its song and music. **Step 2:** The Recommendation Committee will recommend to Tiatr Academy Goa whether the book can be purchased or not based on their evaluation. **Step 3:** Tiatr Academy Goa will make the final decision on book purchase, reserving the right not to purchase even if recommended by the Committee.
> ***Price Negotiation, Book Purchase and Exhibition*** **Step 1:** If the book is approved, the price will be fixed as per Tiatr Academy Goa conditions, with Tiatr Academy Goa paying 80% of the agreed rate. **Step 2:** If Tiatr Academy Goa decides to purchase the books, the applicant will be informed in writing about the decision and further procedures. **Step 3:** Tiatr Academy Goa will purchase the books on 'First-come-First' serve basis and include them in their book exhibitions and promotional activities.

metadata.schemeName: Financial Assistance for encouraging production of Traditional Khell-Tiatr
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage and preserve the traditional Khell-Tiatr folk musical drama of Goa by promoting quality productions. It offers financial assistance and infrastructure support for staging shows, including video documentation, benefiting dramatic troupes and individuals.

page_content:
# Financial Assistance for encouraging production of Traditional Khell-Tiatr **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Culture, Artist, Stage, Performance, Drama, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Financial Assistance for Encouraging Production of Traditional Khell-Tiatr" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage dramatic troupes and individuals to produce Khell-Tiatrs of better quality and preserve this folk musical drama. The scheme provides financial assistance to compensate for expenditures related to staging four shows, including the provision of an auditorium or hall, or financial aid for temporary village setups, along with video filming and a free Digital Versatile Disc copy for the applicant. The applicant must adhere to traditional Khell-Tiatr format, performance guidelines, advertising requirements, and submit detailed proposals with all required documentation in advance. The scheme is implemented by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted by submission to the Tiatr Academy of Goa at least 30 days prior to the proposed performance date.
## Benefits ##### ***Financial Assistance for Staging Performances*** - Financial assistance (as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa) is provided for staging four shows. - Payment will be made directly to the applicant after a statement of expenditure enclosing all original bills (with stamped receipts if the amount exceeds ₹5,000/-) is submitted to the Tiatr Academy of Goa. ##### ***Infrastructure Support*** - An auditorium or hall is provided to stage the programme. - For Village Programmes: Financial assistance (as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa) is provided for erecting a temporary pandal or stage, chairs, sound, etc. ##### ***Archival and Personal Use Video Documentation*** - The Khell-Tiatr will be video filmed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa for its library and other uses. - One copy of the Digital Versatile Disc (DVD) of the video-filmed Khell-Tiatr will be given to the applicant free of cost. - The dramatic troupe will have the freedom to use the Digital Versatile Disc in any manner, but cannot make use of the logo of Tiatr Academy of Goa on the said Digital Versatile Disc.
##### ***Conditions*** **Ongoing Compliance regarding Content** - There must not be any adverse remark made in any form, either written or verbal, against any Government, Individual, Institution, etc., or anything against one’s caste, creed, and religion which may lead to hurting of religious sentiments of anybody. - If proved so, Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) reserves the right to disqualify the performance and refrain from making any payment or recall the payment if already made to the concerned. **Show Access Obligation** All shows must be presented to the public free of charge. **Advertising and Branding Obligation** In all advertisements, whether oral, print, or electronic media, banners, etc., the statement ‘This programme is held in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa’ must be inserted, published, or announced. **Guest of Honour Coordination** - The organizing dramatic troupe or individual will need to discuss with Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) and decide about the Chief Guest or Guest of Honour well in advance. - The President or Vice President of Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) will serve as the Chief Guest or Guest of Honour at the function.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a dramatic troupe or an individual producing Khell-Tiatrs. - The Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant should be a new or old script. - The Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant must conform to the traditional format of the Khell-Tiatr. - The Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant must be one in which just one-story flows from beginning to end with an interval of 10 to 15 minutes. - The Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant must have 12 to 14 cantos which are related to the theme of the play. - Out of these cantos, at least 7 must be of an interactive nature. - The band for the Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant should include at least two blowing instruments, one keyboard, one bass guitar, and a drum set. - The applicant must not have any adverse remark made in any form, either written or verbal, against any Government/Individual/Institution, etc. - The applicant must not have anything against one’s caste, creed, and religion which may lead to hurting of religious sentiments of anybody.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. The form may also be obtained directly from the office of the Tiatr Academy of Goa, requiring a physical visit to the office for collection. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the copies of the mandatory documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** **Deadline:** This submission must occur at least 30 days in advance of the proposed performance date. _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ *The application will be considered on a 'First Come First Serve' basis and is subject to the availability of funds.

metadata.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Dramatic Troupes participating in Kala Academy’s Annual Tiatr Competition
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage non-commercial dramatic troupes participating in Kala Academy’s Annual Tiatr Competition to produce higher quality Tiatrs. It provides financial support for various production aspects, video recording, and expert workshops, benefiting dramatic troupes.

page_content:
# Financial Assistance to Dramatic Troupes participating in Kala Academy’s Annual Tiatr Competition **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Culture, Artist, Drama, Workshop, Financial Assistance, Music | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Financial Assistance to Dramatic Troupes participating in Kala Academy’s Annual Tiatr Competition" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage non-commercial dramatic troupes participating in Kala Academy’s yearly Tiatr Festival to produce Tiatrs of better quality. The scheme provides financial support for specific aspects of drama, including Direction, Stage Setting, Live Band Music with at least 2 blowing instruments, Light Effects, Background Music, Costumes, Make-up, and Transport. It also features the video recording of the Tiatr for the Tiatr Academy of Goa Library, with a free Digital Versatile Disc copy provided to the institution, and offers expertise through compulsory workshops in various Tiatr components.
## Benefits ##### ***1. Financial Support*** - For improving aspects of Tiatr production, including Direction, Stage Setting, Live Band Music with at least 2 blowing instruments, Light Effects, Background Music, Costumes, Make-up, and Transport. - The extent of the financial support shall be fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - Direct payment to the Institution based on submitted bills. ***Conditions*** _*The troupe must compulsorily participate in workshops organized by Tiatr Academy of Goa by deputing at least one of its members; otherwise, they will not be entitled to avail the benefits of this scheme._ _*The Tiatr must not contain any adverse remark in any form, either written or verbal, against any Government/Individual/Institution, etc., or anything against one’s caste, creed, and religion which may lead to hurting of religious sentiments; if proved so, Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to disqualify the performance and refrain from making any payment or recall the payment if already made._ _*All advertisements, oral, print or electronic media, banners/standees, etc., must insert/publish and announce before the performance and during the interval that ‘This Tiatr is staged in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa’._
##### ***2. Video Recording of Tiatr and Digital Versatile Disc Copy*** - Tiatr Academy of Goa will video record the said Tiatr for its Library and other uses. One copy of the Digital Versatile Disc will be given to the Institution free of cost. To preserve the presentation of Tiatr for future generations. - The dramatic troupe will have the freedom to use the Digital Versatile Disc in any manner, but cannot make use of the logo of Tiatr Academy of Goa on the said Digital Versatile Disc. *The videographer will be appointed by Tiatr Academy of Goa.
##### ***3. Expertise and Workshops*** Tiatr Academy of Goa will provide expertise to the troupes in the different compartments of Tiatr (Direction, Stage Setting, Live Band Music, Light Effects, Background Music, Costumes, Make-up, Transport) by organizing workshops in those aspects. ***Conditions*** _*The troupe will have to compulsorily participate in these workshops by deputing at least one of the members of the troupe._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a dramatic troupe. - The applicant must be participating in the Tiatr Competitions organized by Kala Academy. - The applicant must fulfill the conditions laid down in the scheme as per the format enclosed. - The applicant's Tiatr script will be scrutinized by a scrutiny committee who will submit a report on whether the Tiatr is as per the format. - The applicant must ensure that one typed copy of the Tiatr script and one typed copy each of the lyrics of the songs are submitted to Tiatr Academy of Goa along with the application form. - The applicant must ensure that handwritten copies of scripts and lyrics will not be accepted. - The applicant's Tiatr, in any form either written or verbal, must not contain any adverse remarks against any Government/Individual/Institution, etc., or anything against one’s caste, creed, and religion which may lead to hurting of religious sentiments of anybody. - The applicant must compulsorily participate in workshops organized by Tiatr Academy of Goa by deputing at least one of the members of the troupe.
## Exclusions The applicant will not be allowed to take benefit of the scheme “Production of Tiatr in Villages/ urban areas/ Educational Institutes” if the benefit of this scheme is already availed for a particular Tiatr.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the copies of the mandatory documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ *The application will be considered on a 'First Come First Serve' basis and is subject to the availability of funds. ##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** ***Await Script Scrutiny*** Upon submission, the Tiatr script will be scrutinized by a scrutiny committee to determine if it aligns with the prescribed format. The Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to disqualify the performance and recall or refrain from payment if any adverse remarks against Government/Individual/Institution, caste, creed, or religion are found. **Step 2:** ***Participate in Workshops*** The applicant troupe must compulsorily participate in workshops organized by Tiatr Academy of Goa by deputing at least one member to receive benefits. Failure to participate will result in ineligibility for the scheme's benefits. **Step 3:** ***Ensure Proper Public Announcement and Promotion*** The applicant must ensure that all advertisements, whether oral, print, or electronic media, banners, or standees, prominently include the statement: ‘This Tiatr is staged in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa’. This announcement must also be made before the performance and during the interval. **Step 4:** ***Submit Financial Documents for Disbursement*** To receive financial assistance, the institution must submit original bills along with a statement of expenditure to the Tiatr Academy of Goa. Payments will be made directly to the Institution for services rendered, and service providers must provide receipts, with stamped receipts mandatory for amounts exceeding ₹5,000/-.

metadata.schemeName: Machhali Palan
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support to fishermen for repairing, reconstructing, and replacing damaged boats and nets due to disasters.

page_content:
# Machhali Palan **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Fish Farming, Fishermen, Boat, Net, Fish Seed Farm | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Machhali Palan” is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Disaster Management Authority under the Department of Disaster Management, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support to fishermen for repairing, reconstructing, and replacing damaged boats and nets due to disasters.
## Benefits Under this scheme, the following compensation is provided to fishermen for the repair or replacement of damaged boats and nets: - ₹6,000/- for the repair of partially damaged boats - ₹3,000/- for the repair of partially damaged nets - ₹15,000/- for the repurchase of completely damaged boats - ₹4,000/- for the repurchase of completely damaged nets An investment subsidy of ₹10,000/- per hectare is provided for fish seed farms.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a fisherman from Uttarakhand. 1. Fishermen are provided assistance for the repair or replacement of damaged boats and for damaged or lost nets caused by natural disasters.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Information about the disaster and the resulting damage is received from various sources. The concerned Patwari verifies the damage and records it in the P-20 form. The Patwari’s report is subsequently verified by the Tehsildar and the Sub-Divisional Magistrate. Approval is then obtained from the District Magistrate. Once the District Magistrate’s approval is received, relief funds are disbursed to the concerned beneficiaries at the Tehsil level.

# Maitri Prashikshan Karyakram - Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Artificial Insemination, Livestock Development, Animal Husbandry, Training, Livestock | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Maitri Prashikshan Karyakram” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board (ULDB) under the Department of Animal Husbandry, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to enhance livestock productivity and improve artificial insemination services across the state through the training and capacity building of local youth.
## Benefits - **In Hilly Districts:** ₹100/- per artificial insemination, with a minimum target of 25 to 30 inseminations.- **In Plain Districts:** ₹100/- per artificial insemination, with a minimum target of 50 to 60 inseminations.
## Eligibility Criteria It is mandatory for registered Artificial Insemination workers to record all AI-related data on the Bharat Pashudhan App. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must possess a minimum educational qualification of High School. 1. The applicant must obtain a recommendation in the prescribed format from both the Local Veterinary Officer and the Chief Veterinary Officer.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - The prescribed application format can be downloaded from the ‘Training’ subhead under the ‘Services’ section of the Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board (ULDB) website - [https://www.uldb.org](https://www.uldb.org/). The application, duly recommended by the Local Veterinary Officer and the Chief Veterinary Officer, will be considered for approval by the Chief Executive Officer, ULDB.

# National Livestock Mission: Livestock Insurance Scheme - Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Livestock, Animal Husbandry, Insurance, Cattle | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Livestock Insurance Scheme”, a sub-component of the National Livestock Mission, is implemented by the Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board (ULDB) under the Department of Animal Husbandry, Government of Uttarakhand. # 6% Interest Subsidy on Loans taken through Banks for Study Abroad **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Student, Higher Education, Scheduled Tribe, Loan, Foreign Study | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "6% Interest Subsidy on Loans taken through Banks for Study Abroad" scheme was launched by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to support Scheduled Tribe (ST) students pursuing higher education abroad by reducing their financial burden. Under this scheme, beneficiaries receive an interest subsidy on education loans with a maximum subsidy for three years.
## Benefits - Interest subsidy of 6% per annum on loans taken through banks for foreign education. - Maximum subsidy of ₹1,50,000 for 3 years. - Applicable on loans up to ₹25,00,000.

The applicant must have passed Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) or equivalent examination. 1. The applicant must have secured admission in a recognized foreign university for higher studies.

Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage documentation and digitisation of valuable Tiatr-related materials to prevent their loss to posterity. It provides assistance and incentives to holders of such materials and pays honorarium to documentation assistants.

page_content:
# Documentation And Research Assistantship Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Documentation, Digitisation, Assistantship, Artist, Culture, Honorarium, Manuscript | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Documentation And Research Assistantship Scheme" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage documentation and digitisation of valuable Tiatr-related materials such as manuscripts, photos, handbills, advertisements, newspaper or magazine clippings, video and audio recordings that are with Tiatr artistes, tiatr lovers and institutions, addressing the high degree of risk that some of these materials may be lost to posterity if efforts are not undertaken to preserve and document them. The scheme provides assistance to possessors of Tiatr-related materials to organize and document their holdings.
## Benefits - One-time Incentive: A reasonable amount as decided by Tiatr Academy of Goa will be paid to the holder for converting materials into electronic formats. - Hourly Honorarium: Documentation assistants will be paid an honorarium on clock-hour basis as determined by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - Reimbursement: Tiatr Academy of Goa will reimburse costs incurred towards conversion according to rates determined by it if services of other agencies become necessary. - Assistance provided to organize and document materials in holdings. - Copy of digitised material provided to the holder on Digital Versatile Disc or Pen-drive. - Professional documentation and preservation services. > ***Conditions*** _*The work done must be certified by the holder of the material._ _*Tiatr Academy of Goa will periodically review the work undertaken and accordingly extend or curtail the assistantship._ _*Holders must indicate willingness to permit and facilitate documentation tasks._
## Eligibility Criteria > ***For Material Holders*** - The applicant must be a possessor of materials related to Tiatr such as manuscripts, photos, handbills, advertisements, newspaper or magazine clippings, video and audio recordings. - The applicant must indicate willingness to permit and facilitate documentation and organization tasks. > ***For Documentation Assistants*** - The applicant must be willing to serve as Documentation Assistant. - The applicant must be capable of performing tasks including compilation and organisation of materials, typing or word-processing of textual materials, scanning and converting by Optical Character Recognition, conversion of images by scanning or photographing with digital camera, and converting video or audio recordings from analogue to digital format.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. The form requires details including name of artiste or documentation assistant, complete address, contact number, email identification, Aadhaar Card number, and specific aspect of Tiatr on which documentation can be done. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields including personal details, contact information, and specify the aspect of Tiatr on which documentation work can be undertaken. Attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - **Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001** _*For material holders, indicate willingness to permit and facilitate documentation tasks, and may also indicate proximate candidates willing to undertake the documentation work._ _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment received for future reference._
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:****** ***Assignment of Tasks*** Tiatr Academy of Goa will assign documentation tasks to candidates according to the requests received from the holders of materials. The academy will match documentation assistants with appropriate holders based on proximity and requirements. **Step 2:** ***Work Execution and Certification*** Documentation assistants will perform assigned tasks including compilation, organization, digitisation, and conversion of materials under the supervision and certification of the material holder. The quality and progress of work will be periodically reviewed by Tiatr Academy of Goa. **Step 3:** ***Payment and Delivery*** Upon completion and certification of work, documentation assistants will receive honorarium payment on clock-hour basis as determined by Tiatr Academy of Goa. A copy of digitised material will be provided to the holder on Digital Versatile Disc or Pen-drive, while Tiatr Academy of Goa will retain a similar copy for its uses. _*The Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to make any changes in the rules of the scheme._
