metadata.schemeName: Promotion of Tiatr Music
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage individuals to learn blowing instruments crucial for Tiatr music, such as Trumpet & Saxophone, addressing a decline in musicians. It provides financial assistance for tuition and instrument purchase, benefiting youth and other interested persons to preserve Tiatr music.

page_content:
# Promotion of Tiatr Music **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Music, Training, Subsidy, Artist, Culture | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Promotion of Tiatr Music" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage youth and others to learn to play blowing instruments, particularly Trumpet and Saxophone, by providing them with financial assistance. The scheme provides financial support for tuition fees, a 50% subsidy on the cost of medium-priced blowing instruments such as Saxophone, Trumpet, or Clarinet, and opportunities for advanced certification from institutions like Trinity College or Royal School of Music. It also offers music classes at the Tiatr Academy of Goa's Conference Hall and awards certificates upon successful course completion. The applicant must identify a suitable tutor, purchase a blowing instrument, submit an undertaking to serve the tiatr stage, and undergo periodical tests. The scheme is implemented by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted by submitting the prescribed application form available at the office of the Tiatr Academy of Goa.
## Benefits - Reimbursement of tuition fees paid to the tutor, with the exact amount to be decided by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. - A 50% subsidy (refund) on the cost of a blowing instrument (Saxophone, Trumpet, or Clarinet), based on the value of a medium-priced instrument. - Appropriate financial support for students to register and get themselves certified by institutions such as Trinity College or Royal School of Music. - To cover tuition costs incurred for learning blowing instruments vital for Tiatr music. - To reduce the financial burden of purchasing an essential blowing instrument, making learning more accessible. - To support the pursuit of advanced musical qualifications and professional certification. **Conditions:** _*The student must complete the full course._ _*The refund is subject to the availability of funds._ _*The chosen tutor should maintain a record of attendance for the students and submit it to the Tiatr Academy of Goa._ _*Students must undergo periodical tests to verify their performance, and those unable to cope with the syllabus or found not serious may be terminated after evaluation._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be any interested person, young or adult, free to avail the benefit of this scheme. - The applicant must identify a tutor having the credentials to teach him/her the blowing instrument, which will be verified and accepted by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must serve the tiatr stage by playing in any tiatr band or musical group for at least one year after completion of the course.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ##### ***Pre-Application Process*** The interested person must identify a tutor who possesses the necessary credentials to teach the chosen blowing instrument. The Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) will then verify and accept the tutor's credentials. It is advisable to consult with the music teacher regarding the brand or make of the instrument to be purchased. ##### ***Application Process*** **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the copies of the mandatory documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ *The application will be considered on a 'First Come First Serve' basis and is subject to the availability of funds.
##### ***Post-Application Process*** **Step 1:** ***Purchase the Instrument and Submit the Bill Copy*** Upon acceptance into the scheme, the student is required to purchase a blowing instrument, such as a Saxophone, Trumpet, or Clarinet. While the student has the flexibility to purchase an instrument of higher cost, the Tiatr Academy of Goa will consider only the value of a medium-priced instrument for subsidy calculations. Immediately after purchasing the instrument, a self-attested Xerox copy of the bill must be submitted to the Tiatr Academy of Goa, and the original bill must be carefully preserved by the student.
**Step 2:****** ***Undergo Course Training and Periodical Assessments*** The student will commence and undergo the music course, which will follow a syllabus framed by a panel of expert musicians appointed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. The course duration is structured into two levels and is spread over a period of two years, or as otherwise determined by the expert panel. Students are required to undergo periodical tests to verify their progress and performance. The tutor is responsible for maintaining and submitting attendance records to the Tiatr Academy of Goa. Students who cannot cope with the syllabus or are deemed not serious in their learning may be terminated from the scheme after an evaluation report from the expert panel. The Tiatr Academy of Goa also encourages students to register and get certified by institutions such as Trinity College or Royal School of Music through appropriate financial support.
**Step 3:****** ***Submit Undertaking and Original Bill for Reimbursement*** Upon the successful completion of the full course, the student must submit the original bill of the purchased instrument to the Tiatr Academy of Goa in order to claim the 50% subsidy on its cost. Concurrently, the student must provide a formal undertaking to the Tiatr Academy of Goa, committing to serve the tiatr stage by actively playing in any tiatr band or musical group for a minimum period of one year following the completion of the course.
**Step 4:** ***Receive Financial Subsidy and Course Completion Certificate*** After successful verification of all submitted documents and subject to the availability of funds, the Tiatr Academy of Goa will process and refund 50% of the cost of the instrument (calculated based on a medium-priced instrument) to the eligible student. Additionally, upon the successful completion of the course, students will be awarded official certificates by the Tiatr Academy of Goa, acknowledging their achievement and new skills.

metadata.schemeName: Higher Education Assistance Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage children of workers and reduce financial burden of education through higher educational assistance. It provides ₹20,000/- for Bachelor of Medicine Bachelor of Surgery admission and ₹10,000/- for other graduate courses to merit students.

page_content:
# Higher Education Assistance Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Education, Labour, Financial Assistance, Student, Welfare, Merit | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Higher Education Assistance Scheme" by the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board, Labour & Employment Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide encouragement to children of workers and reduce the financial burden of education by offering higher educational assistance to meritorious students, addressing the economic challenges faced by workers' families in pursuing quality education for their children. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹20,000/- for students securing admission in Bachelor of Medicine Bachelor of Surgery courses and ₹10,000/- for students securing admission in any other graduate level courses for students who have passed Standard 12 board examination in the year 2024 with 70 percent or above percentile. The applicant must be a child of a worker whose parent is working in a factory or institution in Gujarat state and whose parent has been contributing to the Labour Welfare Fund office for the last one year. The applications for this scheme are accepted online. The application deadline is the last date of February of the respective year.
## Benefits > **Financial Assistance for Medical Education** Direct Benefit Transfer of ₹20,000/- for students securing admission in Bachelor of Medicine Bachelor of Surgery courses. > **Financial Assistance for Other Graduate Courses** Direct Benefit Transfer of ₹10,000/- for students securing admission in any other graduate level courses.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a child of a worker employed in a factory or institution in Gujarat state. - The applicant must have passed 12th Standard board examination in the respective year. - The applicant must have secured 70% or above percentile in 12th Standard board examination. - The applicant must have secured admission in Bachelor of Medicine Bachelor of Surgery or any other graduate level course. - The applicant must ensure that their parent is working in a factory or institution located in Gujarat state. - The applicant must ensure that their parent has been contributing to the Labour Welfare Fund office for the last one year continuously. - The applicant must submit the application by the last date of February of the respective year. - The applicant must have completed 12th Standard examination specifically in the respective year.
## Exclusions - The applicant must not have secured admission in any foreign educational institution. - The applicant must not be pursuing education abroad under this scheme.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process** **Step 1:** The applicant must visit the [Sanman Portal](https://sanman.gujarat.gov.in/) of the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board. **Step 2:** On the home page, navigate to the ‘Citizen Login’ tab, and click ‘Please Register Here’. **Step 3:** On the Registration page, provide your Aadhaar Card Number, select user type and then enter your Labour Welfare Fund Account Number. Click on ‘Fetch’ & verify the details. Enter user details and create a password. > **Application Process** **Step 1:** The applicant must visit the Sanman Portal: https://sanman.gujarat.gov.in/ of the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board. **Step 2:** On the home page, navigate to the ‘Citizen Login’ tab, and click ‘Login’. Login using your User ID and Password. **Step 3:** Navigate to the Online Application Page of the scheme. In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. For each uploaded document, the corresponding document number must be entered wherever required. **Step 4:** Click "Submit" to submit your application. You'll receive a confirmation message. A confirmation email with the application Number will be sent on the registered email ID. _*Applications made with incomplete/wrong details will not be entertained._ _*The final decision regarding assistance will be with the Welfare Commissioner. The jurisdiction will be Ahmedabad._

metadata.schemeName: Sponsorship Scheme (90% Centrally Funded)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to children upto age of 18 years, including those who have lost both parents, those whose main earning parent has died, & children who have suffered due to violation of laws, child labor, child trafficking, child marriage & similar circumstances.

page_content:
# Sponsorship Scheme (90% Centrally Funded) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child | **Tags:** Sponsorship, Child Labour, Orphan Child, Child Victims, Child Marriage, POCSO Victims | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Sponsorship Scheme” is implemented by the Women Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to children up to the age of 18 years who are in need of care and protection. It is a centrally sponsored scheme, funded 90% by the Government of India.
## Benefits Beneficiaries are provided assistance of ₹4,000/- per month till the age of 18 years, directly deposited into their bank account.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The child/beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. Children up to 18 years of age belonging to families with an annual income of up to ₹72,000/- in rural areas and ₹96,000/- in urban areas. 1. Children who have lost both parents/guardians. 1. Children covered under the PM CARES scheme, children belonging to families that have lost their primary breadwinner. 1. Children in conflict with the law (CCL). 1. Child labor victims, child trafficking victims, children affected by child marriage, POCSO victims, children registered on the Bal Swaraj Portal, as well as other children in need of care and protection.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - To avail the benefits of the scheme, applicants must obtain an application form from the District Probation Office. Along with the completed application form, the following documents must be submitted: the child’s Aadhaar card, the child’s bank account (or the guardian’s bank account in case of a minor), death certificates of both parents (in case of parental death), and a medical certificate in case of critical illness or disability of the parents. Additionally, the Aadhaar card of the guardian or parent must also be attached. - After that, the application form is submitted to the District Probation Office. Thereafter, approval is given by the district level committee headed by the District Magistrate. However, not all applicants may receive the benefit, as the Government of India sets target limits for each district. Only those applications selected within the prescribed target limit are granted the benefit.

page_content:
# AYUSH Health and Wellness Centre - Ayushman Bharat Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Health & Wellness | **Tags:** AYUSH, Health And Wellness, Yoga, Medicinal Plants, Ayurvedic, Unani, Homeopathy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “AYUSH Health and Wellness Centre - Ayushman Bharat Yojana” is implemented by the Ayush Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide accessible, affordable, and holistic healthcare services based on Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani and Homeopathy systems to people of all age groups.
## Benefits A total of 300 AYUSH Health and Wellness Centres are operating in the state. At these centres, medicines are distributed according to the specific disease, and yoga and naturopathy treatments are provided as per the condition. - Counselling based on nature testing and seasonal routines- screening and diagnosis of non-communicable diseases such as diabetes, hypertension, oral cancer, breast cancer, and cervical cancer, are conducted. - Medicinal plants are also distributed. - OPD charges have been fixed at ₹1.00 per person in rural areas and ₹2.00 per person in urban areas.
## Eligibility Criteria - The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The beneficiary may belong to any age group. - The beneficiary must be registered at a government-recognized Ayurvedic, Unani, or Homeopathic dispensary or hospital.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline The beneficiary needs to register at a government-recognized Ayurvedic, Unani, or Homeopathic dispensary or hospital.

metadata.schemeName: Sri Ram Janmabhoomi Shabari Smriti Yatra Sahay Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to scheduled tribes and tribal communities for pilgrimage to Sri Ram Janmabhoomi in Ayodhya in memory of Maa Shabari. The scheme offers ₹5,000/- financial assistance per pilgrim to enable darshan of Lord Sri Ram for eligible tribal beneficiaries.

page_content:
# Sri Ram Janmabhoomi Shabari Smriti Yatra Sahay Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Travel & Tourism | **Tags:** Pilgrimage, Financial Assistance, Tourism, Travel, Scheduled Tribe | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Sri Ram Janmabhoomi Shabari Smriti Yatra Sahay Scheme" by the Industry and Mines Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance to scheduled tribes and tribal communities for pilgrimage to Sri Ram Janmabhoomi in Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh, in memory of "Maa Shabari" and to enable darshan of Lord Sri Ram. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹5,000/- per pilgrim and covers railway travel expenses through Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited arrangements. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat for twelve years or more and belong to the scheduled tribe or tribal community category. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas Board, Gandhinagar.
## Benefits > ***Financial Assistance*** ₹5,000/- per pilgrim as financial assistance towards travel expenses for pilgrimage to Sri Ram Janmabhoomi, Ayodhya. > ***Travel Arrangements*** - Travel arrangements through the Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited. - Railway journey assistance and booking support. > ***Coverage Details*** - First 1,500 scheduled tribe and tribal pilgrims will be eligible for the scheme benefits. - Benefits are available once per person per year for the pilgrimage to Sri Ram Janmabhoomi, Ayodhya. > ***Conditions*** - Pilgrims must complete the journey and submit proof of pilgrimage completion. - Travel must be undertaken within the approved timeframe after receiving permission. - Registration and prior approval from the Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas Board is mandatory. - Submission of travel documents and pilgrimage proof within one month of journey completion is required.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat state for twelve years or more from the current age. - The applicant must belong to the scheduled tribe or tribal community category. - The applicant must be eligible for only one pilgrimage assistance per person per year to Sri Ram Janmabhoomi, Ayodhya. - The applicant must be above 12 years of age. - The applicant can include up to 8 family members in the group application. - The applicant must obtain prior approval from the Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas Board before undertaking the journey. ***Priority/Preference*** Priority will be given to the first 1,500 registered applicants from the scheduled tribe and tribal communities.
## Exclusions - The applicant cannot carry any prohibited or illegal items during the pilgrimage journey. - The applicant cannot undertake travel without prior registration and approval from the implementing board.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > ***Registration Process*** **Step 1:** Visit the [YatraDham portal](https://yatradham.gujarat.gov.in/) of the Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas Board. In the top ribbon, hover on "Booking" and click "Shree Ram Janmabhumi Registration". You will be taken to the [online registration page](https://yatradham.gujarat.gov.in/SRJApplicantRegistration). **Step 2:** Complete the registration process by providing all the mandatory details: Name, Mobile Number, and Email. Create a password and confirm. Provide the captcha code and click "Submit".
> ***Application Process*** **Step 1:** Visit the [YatraDham portal](https://yatradham.gujarat.gov.in/) of the Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas Board. In the top ribbon, hover on "Booking" and click "Shree Ram Janmabhumi Registration". You will be taken to the [online registration page](https://yatradham.gujarat.gov.in/SRJApplicantRegistration). **Step 2:** Click on "Click Here to Login if Already Registered". You will be taken to the [Login Page](https://yatradham.gujarat.gov.in/SRJApplicantLogin). Provide your Username and Password. Click "Login". **Step 3:** The online application form for "Shree Ram JanmBhumi Yatra" will open. In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. **Step 4:** Acknowledge the declaration by ticking the designated checkbox. Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections. Click "Submit" to submit your application. You'll receive a confirmation message. _*Apply online before the deadline of 31st March of the respective year._ _*Save and print the acknowledgment receipt or confirmation message containing the application reference number for future tracking and correspondence._
> ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** _Approval and Travel Permission_ Wait for approval notification from Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas Board, Gandhinagar office, which will be communicated via post or through the online portal. Once approved, the board will provide detailed travel arrangements and booking confirmations for the pilgrimage journey. **Step 2:** _Pre-Travel Coordination_ Contact the Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas Board office at least 10 days before the intended travel date to coordinate final arrangements and receive travel instructions. Confirm accommodation arrangements and travel schedule as per the approved itinerary provided by the implementing board. **Step 3:** _Journey Undertaking and Documentation_ Undertake the pilgrimage journey as per the approved schedule and maintain all travel documents, including railway tickets, accommodation receipts, and capture required photographs at the temple premises. Follow all prescribed guidelines and temple regulations during the visit to Ayodhya. **Step 4:** _Post-Travel Submission_ Submit all travel proof documents, including railway tickets, accommodation receipts, and temple photographs to Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas Board office within one month of journey completion. Upload the required documentation through the official website portal for benefit processing and disbursement.
> **Grievance Redressal / Help & Support** Office Address: Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas Board, Block 2 & 3, 1st Floor, Dr. Jivraj Mehta Bhavan, Gandhinagar - 382016. Phone Numbers: +91 79 23250708, 23251862. Fax Number: +91 79 23256775. Email: sectourism@gujarat.gov.in For scheme-related queries and grievances, contact the above-mentioned office during working hours.

metadata.schemeName: Vidhya Sadhana Yojana Gujarat
metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, free bicycles are gifted to girl students across Gujarat to reduce school dropouts among scheduled tribe girls after class 8.

page_content:
# Vidhya Sadhana Yojana Gujarat **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Free Bicycles, Girl, Scheduled Tribe, Cycle, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Vidhya Sadhana Yojana" scheme was launched by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat. It aims to encourage Scheduled Tribe girls to continue education beyond class 8th, especially in remote areas where schools are located several kilometers away. Under this scheme, free bicycles are gifted to Scheduled Tribe girls studying in class 9th, enabling them to commute conveniently to schools.
## Benefits - Free bicycles given to the scheduled tribal girl students as a gift.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a girl student. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The applicant should be studying in class 9th in a recognized school.1. The applicant’s annual family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-.

## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit the Digital Gujarat Portal: [https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/) **Step 2:** On the home page, click on ‘Register’ and the applicant will be redirected to the registration form page. **Step 3:** Enter your Mobile Number, Email, Set Password, and then click on ‘Save’. **Step 4:** After successful registration, the applicant can login through his/her User Name (Mobile No./Email ID) and Password. **Step 5:** Now, click on ‘My Profile’ to update your profile and fill in all the mandatory information. **Step 6:** After filling in profile details, click on ‘Update Profile’. The profile will be updated after entering the verification Code (OTP). **Step 7:** Now under services, select ‘Scholarship Services’ and then click on ‘SC Scheme’. **Step 8:** Select the Financial Year for which you want to apply for and then click on ‘Change Financial Year’. **Step 9:** Select the scheme, read the interaction carefully, and then click on ‘Continue to Service’. **Step 10:** Fill in the application form completely and upload all the relevant documents. **Step 11:** Now, click on ‘Save as Draft’ and agree with the terms & conditions, and submit the application form by clicking on ‘Confirm & Final Submit’. > **Instructions:** **Note 1:** Photo uploading for all applicants is mandatory. **Note 2:** Application will be considered complete only when all sections are completed. **Note 3:** Only one application per applicant will be acceptable for a scholarship. If any student submits more than one application either from a single institute or from multiple institutions his/her all applications will be rejected by the competent authority and no request from any side will be entertained. **Note 4:** In case of any wrong/misleading information provided in the application shall lead to rejection of the application by Department Authorities. **Note 5:** All required documents must be carefully scanned as per the instructions given. **Note 6:** The student has to fill his/her application carefully as there is no provision for institution change once the application is submitted successfully. **Note 7:** The unreadable uploaded documents will allow the competent authority to reject the student application. **Note 8:** Direct Individual submission of this application form will not be accepted in case of students studying inside the state. Only outside students have to fill out their form online and submit his/her application form to their native district officer. metadata.schemeName: PMMSY: Motorcycle with Ice Box - Gujarat
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the purchase of motorcycles with ice boxes. Through this scheme, eligible beneficiaries receive subsidies to enhance their livelihood opportunities.

page_content:
# PMMSY: Motorcycle with Ice Box - Gujarat **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Construction Of Plant, Storage, Fishermen, Fish Sellers | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)” with the component of "Motorcycle with Ice Box", introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to modernise cold chain infrastructure to preserve fish health, uplift fishermen, and enhance value chain efficiency. Through this scheme, financial support is provided to fishermen and related beneficiaries for constructing ice plants or storage units with a minimum capacity of 30 tonnes, ensuring hygienic fish storage and better returns. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State Governments, with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% contribution from the State Government.
> **Objective of the scheme** - Marine production in the Gujarat state is one of the leading in the country. The state lags behind in exports due to non-norms. So, cold storage/ice plant modernisation is necessary to keep the fish in healthy condition. - Insulated vehicle, three wheeler with ice box including e-rickshaw, and live fish vending center to deliver the fish in hygienic condition to the consumer, so that the consumer (customer) can get fresh and clean fish from the local area and get good returns to the sellers. - Around 27,000 small and large boats are operating in the state. To strengthen the safety and security of the fishermen and increase the income of the boat owner, replacement of the existing boats is necessary to increase the sea growth of the existing boats.
## Benefits 1. The unit cost of a motorcycle with an ice box is ₹75,000/-. 1. General category beneficiaries receive 40% assistance, i.e., up to ₹30,000/-. 1. Women and Scheduled Tribe (ST)/Scheduled Caste (SC) beneficiaries receive 60% assistance, i.e., up to ₹45,000/-. 1. Assistance is provided once in a lifetime. 1. The benefit is available as per the target (category) allocated by the Government of India.
> **Mode of Disbursement:** Contribution is shared as 60% by the Government of India and 40% by the respective State Governments. > **Frequency of Disbursement:** The benefit is provided once in a lifetime. > **Validity:** Applicable only for one-time support per beneficiary.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. # Saksham Scholarship **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Technical Education, Differently Abled Student, PwD, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Saksham Scholarship” is implemented by the Department of Technical Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to support meritorious differently-abled students pursuing graduate-level studies in the state by providing them with financial assistance in the form of scholarships.
## Benefits Financial assistance of ₹50,000/- per annum is provided for Graduate-level studies.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have at least 40% disability. 1. The applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000/-.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - These scholarships are administered by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). Under the AICTE scheme, applications are invited through the [National Scholarship Portal](https://scholarships.gov.in/) (NSP) between September and December, and scholarships are awarded on the basis of merit. - Applicants are required to submit their high school and intermediate mark sheets and certificates, along with an income certificate. For the Saksham Yojana, a valid disability certificate of at least 40%, issued by the competent authority, is also mandatory. - For all AICTE schemes, students must first apply online through the institute where they are studying. The application is verified by the Principal of the institute, then by the State Level Officer (S.L.O.), and finally forwarded to the AICTE, New Delhi, for approval.

Through this scheme, financial support is provided to fishermen and related beneficiaries for constructing ice plants or storage units with a minimum capacity of 30 tonnes, ensuring hygienic fish storage and better returns. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State Governments, with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% contribution from the State Government.
> **Objective of the scheme** - Marine production in the Gujarat state is one of the leading in the country. The state lags behind in exports due to non-norms. So cold storage/ice plant modernization is necessary to keep the fish in healthy condition. - Insulated vehicle, three wheeler with ice box including e-rickshaw, and live fish vending center to deliver the fish in hygienic condition to the consumer, so that the consumer (customer) can get fresh and clean fish from the local area and get good returns to the sellers. - Around 27,000 small and large boats are operating in the state. # Sanskrit Chhatra Pratibha Samman **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Talent Award, Sanskrit, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Sanskrit Chhatra Pratibha Samman” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Sanskrit Academy, Haridwar, under the Department of Sanskrit Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage and motivate students to pursue higher studies in Sanskrit by rewarding those who achieve top positions in the subject at the high school, intermediate, undergraduate, and postgraduate levels.
## Benefits **Awards:** • First Place: ₹5,100/- • Second Place: ₹4,100/- • Third Place: ₹3,100/-
## Eligibility Criteria Students securing First, Second, or Third position in Sanskrit subject in the following examinations will be eligible: - High School Examination (Uttarakhand Vidyalaya Shiksha Parishad) - Intermediate Examination (Uttarakhand Vidyalaya Shiksha Parishad) - Purva Madhyama Examination (Uttarakhand Sanskrit Shiksha Parishad) - Uttar Madhyama Examination (Uttarakhand Sanskrit Shiksha Parishad) - Shastri and Acharya Examinations (Uttarakhand Sanskrit University, Haridwar and Central Sanskrit University, Campus Devprayag, etc.) - Graduate and Postgraduate classes of higher education institutions (on the basis of marks obtained in Sanskrit subject).
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - The Academy obtains information about the highest-scoring students in Sanskrit in the relevant High School and Intermediate Examinations through correspondence with the Secretary of the respective Board. Similarly, the list of students securing First, Second, and Third positions in Sanskrit at the undergraduate and postgraduate levels is obtained through correspondence with the Controller of Examinations/Registrar of the respective University. - An award ceremony is organized, during which payment is made through cheque, and the students are honoured with certificates and other recognitions.

metadata.schemeName: Funeral Assistance Scheme for Unorganized Workers (Except Construction Workers)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to heirs of deceased unorganized sector workers for funeral expenses. It offers ₹10,000/- to eligible heirs of e-Shram card holders.

page_content:
# Funeral Assistance Scheme for Unorganized Workers (Except Construction Workers) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Funeral, Unorganized, Worker, Death, Financial, Support | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Funeral Assistance Scheme for Unorganized Workers (Except Construction Workers)", launched by the Gujarat Rural Workers Welfare Board, Labour & Employment Department Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance to the heirs of deceased unorganized sector workers to help with funeral expenses and last rites, addressing the financial burden faced by families during such distressing times. The scheme provides a one-time financial assistance of ₹10,000/- to one heir of the deceased worker and is specifically designed for e-Shram card holders in the unorganized sector. The applicant must be an heir of an e-Shram card holder (except e-Nirman card holders and Scheduled Caste individuals) and must have an annual income within specified limits of ₹1,20,000/- for rural areas and ₹1,50,000/- for urban areas. The scheme is implemented by the Labour & Employment Department Government of Gujarat and applications for this scheme are accepted offline through designated government labour offices.
## Benefits > **Financial Assistance:** ₹10,000/- paid to one heir of the deceased unorganized worker, to assist with funeral expenses and last rites (funeral ceremonies).
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an heir of a deceased e-Shram card holder from the unorganized sector. - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must apply within 3 (three) months from the date of death of the deceased worker. - The deceased worker must have between 16 to 70 years of age at the time of death. - The applicant must have an annual income not exceeding ₹1,20,000/- (One Lakh Twenty Thousand Rupees), if residing in rural areas. - The applicant must have an annual income not exceeding ₹1,50,000/- (One Lakh Fifty Thousand Rupees), if residing in urban areas. - Only one heir per deceased worker is eligible to receive the assistance.
> **Priority Order for Heirs** The legal heirs of the deceased shall be considered in the following order of priority: 1. Husband or Wife. 1. Children (Son/Daughter) - in absence of spouse. 1. Parents - in absence of spouse and children. 1. Grandchildren (Grandson/Granddaughter) - in absence of spouse, children and parents. 1. Unmarried, widowed or abandoned sisters - in absence of spouse, children, parents and grandchildren. 1. Other heirs declared under Indian Succession Act, 1925 - in absence of all above categories.
## Exclusions - The applicant must not be a construction worker or e-Nirman card holder. - The applicant must not belong to Scheduled Caste category (as they are covered under separate scheme by Social Justice and Empowerment Department). - The applicant must not have received assistance from any other similar scheme.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant should obtain the prescribed application form as per "Annexure-1" from any of the designated government offices mentioned in the Steps below. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** The applicant must submit the completed application form along with all required documents to any of the following offices: - Office of Assistant Government Labour Officer. - Office of Government Labour Officer. - Office of Assistant Labour Commissioner. - Office of Deputy Labour Commissioner. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable). _*Applications must be submitted within 3 (three) months from the date of death of the unorganized worker. Applications submitted after this deadline will be automatically cancelled._
> **Post-Application Processes** **Step 1:** Upon receipt of the application, the concerned office will conduct necessary verification and approve/reject the application within 10 working days. If the application contains incomplete documents or information, the applicant will be notified accordingly. **Step 2:** In case of incomplete documentation, the applicant must complete the requirements within 15 days from the date of notification. The concerned office will then process the completed application within 10 working days of receiving the additional documents. **Step 3:** After successful verification and approval, the financial assistance of ₹10,000/- will be disbursed to the eligible heir's bank account as provided in the application.

metadata.schemeName: Khiladi Protsahan Chhatravriti Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote sports among talented youth sportspersons aged 14 to 23 years from Uttarakhand by providing a scholarship of ₹2,000/- per month and financial assistance of ₹10,000/- once a year for sports equipment.

page_content:
# Khiladi Protsahan Chhatravriti Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Sports, Sportsperson, Scholarship, Player | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme 'Khiladi Protsahan Chhatravriti Yojana' was launched by the Department of Sports, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote sports among talented youth aged 14 to 23 years from Uttarakhand by providing scholarships and financial assistance for sports equipment.
## Benefits - Under this scheme, players/sportspersons aged 14 to 23 years are selected annually based on the P-SAT (Physical and Sports Aptitude Test). - A total of 100 boys and 100 girls are selected per district, and they are provided a scholarship of ₹2,000/- per month along with ₹10,000/- once a year for sports equipment.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a boy or girl between 14 and 23 years of age. 1. The boy or girl who obtain the highest marks based on merit in the final district-level competition, conducted through various stages of the Physical and Sports Aptitude Test (P-SAT) assessing physical abilities such as strength, flexibility, endurance, speed, and coordination, will be eligible for the sports scholarship. 1. Scholarships are awarded on a priority basis in the following sports: (1) Athletics, (2) Badminton, (3) Boxing, (4) Taekwondo, (5) Kabaddi, (6) Football, (7) Volleyball, (8) Basketball, (9) Hockey, (10) Table Tennis, (11) Karate, and (12) Judo.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - There is no selection at the school or Nyaya Panchayat level. - Players independently participate in competitions held directly at the municipality, municipal corporation, or district level, and selections are made based on merit. - Six competitions will be organized to test physical efficiency: (1) 30-meter flying run (2) Standing broad jump (3) Forward bend and reach (4) 6 × 10 shuttle run (5) Medicine ball throw (6) 600-meter run - The district-level selection committee will issue a final list in each age group who secure the highest marks based on merit. These players will be eligible for the sports scholarship, which will be directly transferred to their accounts through DBT.

page_content:
# Rishi and Milan Khosla Scholarship Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Women and Child | **Tags:** Scholarship, Girl Student, Meritorious Student, Postgraduate | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Rishi and Milan Khosla Scholarship Scheme” was launched by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote higher education among girl students in the state by providing scholarships to those pursuing their first year of post-graduation in various government colleges across Uttarakhand.
## Benefits A scholarship of ₹51,000/- per student is given to 50 girl students enrolled in the first year of post-graduation at various government colleges across the state.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant (girl student) must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The girl student must be studying in a government college in Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the first year of a postgraduate (PG) course. 1. The applicant’s family annual income from all sources should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-. 1. The girl student must have obtained a minimum of 60% marks in graduation.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - The scheme is implemented under a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Government of Uttarakhand and the Rishi and Milan Khosla Foundation, Noida, Uttar Pradesh. - Applications are generally invited by the Department of Higher Education during December–January, after informing the respective colleges. - To avail the scholarship, the girl student must apply online at [www.vidyasaarathi.co.in](https://www.vidyasaarathi.co.in) during the specified period. Along with the application, the student is required to submit her Aadhaar card, bank account details, permanent residence certificate, income certificate, mark sheets of all years of graduation, college ID, and proof of admission in post-graduation.

# Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Puraskar Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Student, Post-Graduation, Undergraduate, Meritorious, Award | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Puraskar Yojana” was launched by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage academic excellence among students and provides cash prizes to those who secure first, second, or third positions in their graduation or post-graduation studies at the university level.
## Benefits **At the university level, students securing first, second, and third positions in graduation examinations are awarded:** - 1st Position: ₹50,000/- - 2nd Position: ₹30,000/- - 3rd Position: ₹15,000/- **Students securing first, second, and third positions in post-graduation examinations are awarded:** - 1st Position: ₹75,000/- - 2nd Position: ₹60,000/- - 3rd Position: ₹30,000/-
## Eligibility Criteria 1. This scheme is applicable to the top three students who have obtained the highest marks at the university level after completing their courses in the Arts, Science, and Commerce faculties at the graduate and post-graduate levels in the state’s Shridev Suman University, Kumaon University, Soban Singh Jeena University, and their affiliated colleges. 1. Students who have obtained less than 60% marks will be ineligible under the scheme. 1. Students who have appeared in improvement examinations in graduation or post-graduation, backlog examinations, or those who have dropped out in any year and then progressed to the next class will also be ineligible for the scheme.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - The department requests a faculty-wise list of students who have obtained the highest marks in government universities and their affiliated colleges. - The scholarships are credited directly to the students’ accounts after their data is verified through the Samarth portal. - Students do not need to apply for this themselves.

page_content:
# PMMSY: Support for Acquisition of Deep Sea Fishing Vessels for Traditional Fishermen - Gujarat **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Construction Of Plant, Storage, Traditional Fishermen, Fish Sellers, Support For Acquisition Of Deep Sea Fishing Vessels | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)” with the component of "Support for Acquisition of Deep Sea Fishing Vessels for Traditional Fishermen", introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to modernise cold chain infrastructure to preserve fish health, uplift fishermen, and enhance value chain efficiency. Through this scheme, financial support is provided to fishermen and related beneficiaries for constructing ice plants or storage units with a minimum capacity of 30 tonnes, ensuring hygienic fish storage and better returns. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State Governments, with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% contribution from the State Government.
> **Objective of the scheme** - Marine production in the Gujarat state is one of the leading in the country. The state lags behind in exports due to non-norms. So cold storage/ice plant modernization is necessary to keep the fish in healthy condition. - Insulated vehicle, three wheeler with ice box including e-rickshaw, and live fish vending center to deliver the fish in hygienic condition to the consumer, so that the consumer (customer) can get fresh and clean fish from the local area and get good returns to the sellers. - Around 27,000 small and large boats are operating in the state. To strengthen the safety and security of the fishermen and increase the income of the boat owner, replacement of the existing boats is necessary to increase the sea growth of the existing boats.
## Benefits - Unit cost is ₹1,20,00,000/-. 40 percent assistance for general category i.e. assistance up to ₹48,00,000/- - And for women and ST/SC category beneficiaries 60 percent assistance i.e. assistance up to ₹72,00,000. - The benefit will be available as per the target (category) allocated by the Government of India.
> **Remarks:** 60% contribution from Government of India and 40% contribution from State Governments is paid. > **Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits:** Once in a lifetime.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. The applicant should hold a fishing license. 1. The applicant should complete the online registration on the [iKhedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/).1. The applicant should obtain in-principle approval before purchase of the floor plan. 1. The applicant should have his/her own bank account. > **Preference/Reservation/Relaxation:** - Women, SC, and ST beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance of the unit cost. - General category beneficiaries are eligible for 40% assistance of the unit cost.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side, then click on "Beneficiary Registration" and select any one from the 'Farmer' or 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. **Step 3:** Enter the 'Company Name' and Address if you have selected 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. And for all select the District, Taluka, and Village, choose 'what type of account holder you are?', enter your Account Number and Name, solve the Captcha, and click 'Save and Next'. **Step 4:** Enter your Mobile Number and E-mail address, click 'Send OTP', enter the received OTP, create and confirm a Password, solve the Captcha, and click 'Submit'.
> **Login Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side of the homepage. On the home page, click on ‘Schemes’ and then click on ‘Agricultural Schemes’. **Step 3:** Now select the scheme, click on the ‘Apply’ button, and an application page will open. **Step 4:** Click on the "Apply New" button and submit a new application. **Step 5:** Click on the "Update Application" button to add corrections to the application. **Step 6:** Once the application is done, confirm it. **Step 7:** Take a printout of the confirmed application.
> **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_Contacts.aspx).

page_content:
# Integrated Horticulture Development Program for Tribal Area Farmers (TASP) HRT-3 **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Horticulture, Tribal Farmers, Farm Mechanization, Post Harvest Management, Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Integrated Horticulture Development Program for Tribal Area Farmers (TASP) HRT-3" by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to strengthen horticulture-based livelihoods and promote modern horticultural practices among tribal farmers through financial assistance for farm mechanization, processing units, crop protection, post-harvest management, and export-related infrastructure. The scheme provides targeted subsidies on equipment, units, and inputs to ensure sustainable horticultural growth in tribal areas.
## Benefits > **Capacity Building & Promotion:** - Assistance for publication and promotional materials related to horticultural crops. - Financial support for organizing and participating in exhibitions, competitions, and seminars. - Subsidy for organizing or participating in Krishi Melas and payment for stall rentals. > **Farm Mechanization Support:** - Subsidy for purchase of power tillers and mini tractors to enhance horticultural productivity. - Financial aid for harvesting equipment and crop protection equipment. > **Processing & Value Addition:** - Support for establishment of new distillation units for medicinal and aromatic crops. - Subsidy for setting up new processing units for cashew and other fruit crops. - Assistance for processing equipment for value addition. > **Export Promotion:** - Sea fridge subsidy for export of fruits, vegetables, flowers, and plants. - Air fridge subsidy to promote export of horticultural produce. > **Price Stabilization:** - Minimum Support Price (MSP) assistance to ensure stable market prices for horticultural crops. > **Infrastructure & Utilities Support:** - Subsidy on electricity bills for operating greenhouses and tissue culture laboratories. - Support for hi-tech greenhouses (with fan and pad system). - Support for naturally ventilated polyhouses and net houses. > **Post-Harvest Management:** - Subsidy for packing materials used in post-harvest handling of horticultural produce. - Support for setting up kaccha mandaps for tomato/chilly and other vegetable marketing. - Construction of vegetable trellises and half-lined pedestrian paths for climbing vegetable crops.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. - The applicant should be practicing horticulture in tribal areas.

# Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Castor cake/Neem cake/ Liquid Fermented Organic Manure / Green manure seed (For mix in the soil) Gujarat **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Adivasi Farmers, Crop Production, Livelihood, Castor Cake, Fertilizer, Subsidies | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Distribution of Seeds of more productive varieties / Hybrid varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area (TASP)" with a component "Castor cake/Neem cake/ Liquid Fermented Organic Manure / Green manure seed (For mix in the soil)" is introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to help Adivasi farmers in Tribal Areas (TASP) and tribal cultivators outside these areas achieve higher production of agricultural crops. Through this scheme, subsidies are provided on various agricultural inputs such as high-yield variety seeds, hybrid seeds, and fertilizers. Farmers are also provided with plant protection equipment, tarpaulins, field demonstrations, micronutrients, water carrying pipelines, and pump sets to increase their crop yield and improve their livelihoods. The scheme's benefits are provided to farmers belonging to Scheduled Tribes and tribal cultivators residing outside tribal areas.
## Benefits **SCHEDULE-IV and V under FCO 1985:-** 1. **Castor cake/Neem cake/ Liquid Fermented Organic Manure:** 75% of the purchase price or ₹9,000/- per hectare, whichever is less. This assistance is for a maximum of two hectares per account. OR 1. **Green manuring (hemp/Ikkad seeds):** 75% of the purchase price or ₹3,000/- per hectare, whichever is less. A total of ₹6,000/- per person, whichever is less, is provided for hemp (60 kg) or Ikkad (50 kg) seeds per hectare. This assistance is for a maximum of three hectares per account.
> **Frequency of Disbursement:** The benefit for Castor cake/Neem cake/Liquid Fermented Organic Manure/Green manure seed is provided every year. > **Remark:** As per conditions No. 5, 16, 17, 19 and 22 of [Appendix-1](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in/Schemeatoz.aspx). (Refer Scheme No. 35)
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Tribe. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should be located in tribal areas OR be a tribal cultivator residing outside tribal areas. 1. The scheme excludes farmers from Dang district.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Approach the Gram Sevak in your village for access to the "Castor cake/Neem cake/ Liquid Fermented Organic Manure / Green manure seed (For mix in the soil)" under the scheme.

# 6% Interest Subsidy on Loans taken through Banks for Study Abroad **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Student, Higher Education, Scheduled Tribe, Loan, Foreign Study | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "6% Interest Subsidy on Loans taken through Banks for Study Abroad" scheme was launched by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to support Scheduled Tribe (ST) students pursuing higher education abroad by reducing their financial burden. Under this scheme, beneficiaries receive an interest subsidy on education loans with a maximum subsidy for three years.
## Benefits - Interest subsidy of 6% per annum on loans taken through banks for foreign education. - Maximum subsidy of ₹1,50,000 for 3 years. - Applicable on loans up to ₹25,00,000.

metadata.schemeName: Documentation And Research Assistantship Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage documentation and digitisation of valuable Tiatr-related materials to prevent their loss to posterity. It provides assistance and incentives to holders of such materials and pays honorarium to documentation assistants.

page_content:
# Documentation And Research Assistantship Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Documentation, Digitisation, Assistantship, Artist, Culture, Honorarium, Manuscript | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Documentation And Research Assistantship Scheme" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage documentation and digitisation of valuable Tiatr-related materials such as manuscripts, photos, handbills, advertisements, newspaper or magazine clippings, video and audio recordings that are with Tiatr artistes, tiatr lovers and institutions, addressing the high degree of risk that some of these materials may be lost to posterity if efforts are not undertaken to preserve and document them. The scheme provides assistance to possessors of Tiatr-related materials to organize and document their holdings.
## Benefits - One-time Incentive: A reasonable amount as decided by Tiatr Academy of Goa will be paid to the holder for converting materials into electronic formats. - Hourly Honorarium: Documentation assistants will be paid an honorarium on clock-hour basis as determined by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - Reimbursement: Tiatr Academy of Goa will reimburse costs incurred towards conversion according to rates determined by it if services of other agencies become necessary. - Assistance provided to organize and document materials in holdings. - Copy of digitised material provided to the holder on Digital Versatile Disc or Pen-drive. - Professional documentation and preservation services. > ***Conditions*** _*The work done must be certified by the holder of the material._ _*Tiatr Academy of Goa will periodically review the work undertaken and accordingly extend or curtail the assistantship._ _*Holders must indicate willingness to permit and facilitate documentation tasks._
## Eligibility Criteria > ***For Material Holders*** - The applicant must be a possessor of materials related to Tiatr such as manuscripts, photos, handbills, advertisements, newspaper or magazine clippings, video and audio recordings. - The applicant must indicate willingness to permit and facilitate documentation and organization tasks. > ***For Documentation Assistants*** - The applicant must be willing to serve as Documentation Assistant. - The applicant must be capable of performing tasks including compilation and organisation of materials, typing or word-processing of textual materials, scanning and converting by Optical Character Recognition, conversion of images by scanning or photographing with digital camera, and converting video or audio recordings from analogue to digital format.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. The form requires details including name of artiste or documentation assistant, complete address, contact number, email identification, Aadhaar Card number, and specific aspect of Tiatr on which documentation can be done. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields including personal details, contact information, and specify the aspect of Tiatr on which documentation work can be undertaken. Attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - **Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001** _*For material holders, indicate willingness to permit and facilitate documentation tasks, and may also indicate proximate candidates willing to undertake the documentation work._ _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment received for future reference._
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:****** ***Assignment of Tasks*** Tiatr Academy of Goa will assign documentation tasks to candidates according to the requests received from the holders of materials. The academy will match documentation assistants with appropriate holders based on proximity and requirements. **Step 2:** ***Work Execution and Certification*** Documentation assistants will perform assigned tasks including compilation, organization, digitisation, and conversion of materials under the supervision and certification of the material holder. The quality and progress of work will be periodically reviewed by Tiatr Academy of Goa. **Step 3:** ***Payment and Delivery*** Upon completion and certification of work, documentation assistants will receive honorarium payment on clock-hour basis as determined by Tiatr Academy of Goa. A copy of digitised material will be provided to the holder on Digital Versatile Disc or Pen-drive, while Tiatr Academy of Goa will retain a similar copy for its uses. _*The Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to make any changes in the rules of the scheme._

metadata.schemeName: Promotion of Tiatr Music
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage individuals to learn blowing instruments crucial for Tiatr music, such as Trumpet & Saxophone, addressing a decline in musicians. It provides financial assistance for tuition and instrument purchase, benefiting youth and other interested persons to preserve Tiatr music.

page_content:
# Promotion of Tiatr Music **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Music, Training, Subsidy, Artist, Culture | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Promotion of Tiatr Music" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage youth and others to learn to play blowing instruments, particularly Trumpet and Saxophone, by providing them with financial assistance. The scheme provides financial support for tuition fees, a 50% subsidy on the cost of medium-priced blowing instruments such as Saxophone, Trumpet, or Clarinet, and opportunities for advanced certification from institutions like Trinity College or Royal School of Music. It also offers music classes at the Tiatr Academy of Goa's Conference Hall and awards certificates upon successful course completion. The applicant must identify a suitable tutor, purchase a blowing instrument, submit an undertaking to serve the tiatr stage, and undergo periodical tests. The scheme is implemented by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted by submitting the prescribed application form available at the office of the Tiatr Academy of Goa.
## Benefits - Reimbursement of tuition fees paid to the tutor, with the exact amount to be decided by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. - A 50% subsidy (refund) on the cost of a blowing instrument (Saxophone, Trumpet, or Clarinet), based on the value of a medium-priced instrument. - Appropriate financial support for students to register and get themselves certified by institutions such as Trinity College or Royal School of Music. - To cover tuition costs incurred for learning blowing instruments vital for Tiatr music. - To reduce the financial burden of purchasing an essential blowing instrument, making learning more accessible. - To support the pursuit of advanced musical qualifications and professional certification. **Conditions:** _*The student must complete the full course._ _*The refund is subject to the availability of funds._ _*The chosen tutor should maintain a record of attendance for the students and submit it to the Tiatr Academy of Goa._ _*Students must undergo periodical tests to verify their performance, and those unable to cope with the syllabus or found not serious may be terminated after evaluation._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be any interested person, young or adult, free to avail the benefit of this scheme. - The applicant must identify a tutor having the credentials to teach him/her the blowing instrument, which will be verified and accepted by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must serve the tiatr stage by playing in any tiatr band or musical group for at least one year after completion of the course.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ##### ***Pre-Application Process*** The interested person must identify a tutor who possesses the necessary credentials to teach the chosen blowing instrument. The Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) will then verify and accept the tutor's credentials. It is advisable to consult with the music teacher regarding the brand or make of the instrument to be purchased. ##### ***Application Process*** **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the copies of the mandatory documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ *The application will be considered on a 'First Come First Serve' basis and is subject to the availability of funds.
##### ***Post-Application Process*** **Step 1:** ***Purchase the Instrument and Submit the Bill Copy*** Upon acceptance into the scheme, the student is required to purchase a blowing instrument, such as a Saxophone, Trumpet, or Clarinet. While the student has the flexibility to purchase an instrument of higher cost, the Tiatr Academy of Goa will consider only the value of a medium-priced instrument for subsidy calculations. Immediately after purchasing the instrument, a self-attested Xerox copy of the bill must be submitted to the Tiatr Academy of Goa, and the original bill must be carefully preserved by the student.
**Step 2:****** ***Undergo Course Training and Periodical Assessments*** The student will commence and undergo the music course, which will follow a syllabus framed by a panel of expert musicians appointed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. The course duration is structured into two levels and is spread over a period of two years, or as otherwise determined by the expert panel. Students are required to undergo periodical tests to verify their progress and performance. The tutor is responsible for maintaining and submitting attendance records to the Tiatr Academy of Goa. Students who cannot cope with the syllabus or are deemed not serious in their learning may be terminated from the scheme after an evaluation report from the expert panel. The Tiatr Academy of Goa also encourages students to register and get certified by institutions such as Trinity College or Royal School of Music through appropriate financial support.
**Step 3:****** ***Submit Undertaking and Original Bill for Reimbursement*** Upon the successful completion of the full course, the student must submit the original bill of the purchased instrument to the Tiatr Academy of Goa in order to claim the 50% subsidy on its cost. Concurrently, the student must provide a formal undertaking to the Tiatr Academy of Goa, committing to serve the tiatr stage by actively playing in any tiatr band or musical group for a minimum period of one year following the completion of the course.
**Step 4:** ***Receive Financial Subsidy and Course Completion Certificate*** After successful verification of all submitted documents and subject to the availability of funds, the Tiatr Academy of Goa will process and refund 50% of the cost of the instrument (calculated based on a medium-priced instrument) to the eligible student. Additionally, upon the successful completion of the course, students will be awarded official certificates by the Tiatr Academy of Goa, acknowledging their achievement and new skills.

metadata.schemeName: Higher Education Assistance Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage children of workers and reduce financial burden of education through higher educational assistance. It provides ₹20,000/- for Bachelor of Medicine Bachelor of Surgery admission and ₹10,000/- for other graduate courses to merit students.

page_content:
# Higher Education Assistance Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Education, Labour, Financial Assistance, Student, Welfare, Merit | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Higher Education Assistance Scheme" by the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board, Labour & Employment Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide encouragement to children of workers and reduce the financial burden of education by offering higher educational assistance to meritorious students, addressing the economic challenges faced by workers' families in pursuing quality education for their children. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹20,000/- for students securing admission in Bachelor of Medicine Bachelor of Surgery courses and ₹10,000/- for students securing admission in any other graduate level courses for students who have passed Standard 12 board examination in the year 2024 with 70 percent or above percentile. The applicant must be a child of a worker whose parent is working in a factory or institution in Gujarat state and whose parent has been contributing to the Labour Welfare Fund office for the last one year. The applications for this scheme are accepted online. The application deadline is the last date of February of the respective year.
## Benefits > **Financial Assistance for Medical Education** Direct Benefit Transfer of ₹20,000/- for students securing admission in Bachelor of Medicine Bachelor of Surgery courses. > **Financial Assistance for Other Graduate Courses** Direct Benefit Transfer of ₹10,000/- for students securing admission in any other graduate level courses.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a child of a worker employed in a factory or institution in Gujarat state. - The applicant must have passed 12th Standard board examination in the respective year. - The applicant must have secured 70% or above percentile in 12th Standard board examination. - The applicant must have secured admission in Bachelor of Medicine Bachelor of Surgery or any other graduate level course. - The applicant must ensure that their parent is working in a factory or institution located in Gujarat state. - The applicant must ensure that their parent has been contributing to the Labour Welfare Fund office for the last one year continuously. - The applicant must submit the application by the last date of February of the respective year. - The applicant must have completed 12th Standard examination specifically in the respective year.
## Exclusions - The applicant must not have secured admission in any foreign educational institution. - The applicant must not be pursuing education abroad under this scheme.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process** **Step 1:** The applicant must visit the [Sanman Portal](https://sanman.gujarat.gov.in/) of the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board. **Step 2:** On the home page, navigate to the ‘Citizen Login’ tab, and click ‘Please Register Here’. **Step 3:** On the Registration page, provide your Aadhaar Card Number, select user type and then enter your Labour Welfare Fund Account Number. Click on ‘Fetch’ & verify the details. Enter user details and create a password. > **Application Process** **Step 1:** The applicant must visit the Sanman Portal: https://sanman.gujarat.gov.in/ of the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board. **Step 2:** On the home page, navigate to the ‘Citizen Login’ tab, and click ‘Login’. Login using your User ID and Password. **Step 3:** Navigate to the Online Application Page of the scheme. In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. For each uploaded document, the corresponding document number must be entered wherever required. **Step 4:** Click "Submit" to submit your application. You'll receive a confirmation message. A confirmation email with the application Number will be sent on the registered email ID. _*Applications made with incomplete/wrong details will not be entertained._ _*The final decision regarding assistance will be with the Welfare Commissioner. The jurisdiction will be Ahmedabad._

metadata.schemeName: Sponsorship Scheme (90% Centrally Funded)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to children upto age of 18 years, including those who have lost both parents, those whose main earning parent has died, & children who have suffered due to violation of laws, child labor, child trafficking, child marriage & similar circumstances.

page_content:
# Sponsorship Scheme (90% Centrally Funded) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child | **Tags:** Sponsorship, Child Labour, Orphan Child, Child Victims, Child Marriage, POCSO Victims | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Sponsorship Scheme” is implemented by the Women Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to children up to the age of 18 years who are in need of care and protection. It is a centrally sponsored scheme, funded 90% by the Government of India.
## Benefits Beneficiaries are provided assistance of ₹4,000/- per month till the age of 18 years, directly deposited into their bank account.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The child/beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. Children up to 18 years of age belonging to families with an annual income of up to ₹72,000/- in rural areas and ₹96,000/- in urban areas. 1. Children who have lost both parents/guardians. 1. Children covered under the PM CARES scheme, children belonging to families that have lost their primary breadwinner. 1. Children in conflict with the law (CCL). 1. Child labor victims, child trafficking victims, children affected by child marriage, POCSO victims, children registered on the Bal Swaraj Portal, as well as other children in need of care and protection.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - To avail the benefits of the scheme, applicants must obtain an application form from the District Probation Office. Along with the completed application form, the following documents must be submitted: the child’s Aadhaar card, the child’s bank account (or the guardian’s bank account in case of a minor), death certificates of both parents (in case of parental death), and a medical certificate in case of critical illness or disability of the parents. Additionally, the Aadhaar card of the guardian or parent must also be attached. - After that, the application form is submitted to the District Probation Office. Thereafter, approval is given by the district level committee headed by the District Magistrate. However, not all applicants may receive the benefit, as the Government of India sets target limits for each district. Only those applications selected within the prescribed target limit are granted the benefit.

# AYUSH Health and Wellness Centre - Ayushman Bharat Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Health & Wellness | **Tags:** AYUSH, Health And Wellness, Yoga, Medicinal Plants, Ayurvedic, Unani, Homeopathy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “AYUSH Health and Wellness Centre - Ayushman Bharat Yojana” is implemented by the Ayush Department, Government of Uttarakhand.
