metadata.schemeName: Sri Ram Janmabhoomi Shabari Smriti Yatra Sahay Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to scheduled tribes and tribal communities for pilgrimage to Sri Ram Janmabhoomi in Ayodhya in memory of Maa Shabari. The scheme offers ₹5,000/- financial assistance per pilgrim to enable darshan of Lord Sri Ram for eligible tribal beneficiaries.

page_content:
# Sri Ram Janmabhoomi Shabari Smriti Yatra Sahay Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Travel & Tourism | **Tags:** Pilgrimage, Financial Assistance, Tourism, Travel, Scheduled Tribe | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Sri Ram Janmabhoomi Shabari Smriti Yatra Sahay Scheme" by the Industry and Mines Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance to scheduled tribes and tribal communities for pilgrimage to Sri Ram Janmabhoomi in Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh, in memory of "Maa Shabari" and to enable darshan of Lord Sri Ram. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹5,000/- per pilgrim and covers railway travel expenses through Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited arrangements. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat for twelve years or more and belong to the scheduled tribe or tribal community category. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas Board, Gandhinagar.
## Benefits > ***Financial Assistance*** ₹5,000/- per pilgrim as financial assistance towards travel expenses for pilgrimage to Sri Ram Janmabhoomi, Ayodhya. > ***Travel Arrangements*** - Travel arrangements through the Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited. - Railway journey assistance and booking support. > ***Coverage Details*** - First 1,500 scheduled tribe and tribal pilgrims will be eligible for the scheme benefits. - Benefits are available once per person per year for the pilgrimage to Sri Ram Janmabhoomi, Ayodhya. > ***Conditions*** - Pilgrims must complete the journey and submit proof of pilgrimage completion. - Travel must be undertaken within the approved timeframe after receiving permission. - Registration and prior approval from the Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas Board is mandatory. - Submission of travel documents and pilgrimage proof within one month of journey completion is required.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat state for twelve years or more from the current age. - The applicant must belong to the scheduled tribe or tribal community category. - The applicant must be eligible for only one pilgrimage assistance per person per year to Sri Ram Janmabhoomi, Ayodhya. - The applicant must be above 12 years of age. - The applicant can include up to 8 family members in the group application. - The applicant must obtain prior approval from the Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas Board before undertaking the journey. ***Priority/Preference*** Priority will be given to the first 1,500 registered applicants from the scheduled tribe and tribal communities.
## Exclusions - The applicant cannot carry any prohibited or illegal items during the pilgrimage journey. - The applicant cannot undertake travel without prior registration and approval from the implementing board.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > ***Registration Process*** **Step 1:** Visit the [YatraDham portal](https://yatradham.gujarat.gov.in/) of the Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas Board. In the top ribbon, hover on "Booking" and click "Shree Ram Janmabhumi Registration". You will be taken to the [online registration page](https://yatradham.gujarat.gov.in/SRJApplicantRegistration). **Step 2:** Complete the registration process by providing all the mandatory details: Name, Mobile Number, and Email. Create a password and confirm. Provide the captcha code and click "Submit".

In the top ribbon, hover on "Booking" and click "Shree Ram Janmabhumi Registration". You will be taken to the [online registration page](https://yatradham.gujarat.gov.in/SRJApplicantRegistration). **Step 2:** Click on "Click Here to Login if Already Registered". # Vidhya Sadhana Yojana Gujarat **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Free Bicycles, Girl, Scheduled Tribe, Cycle, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Vidhya Sadhana Yojana" scheme was launched by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat. It aims to encourage Scheduled Tribe girls to continue education beyond class 8th, especially in remote areas where schools are located several kilometers away. Under this scheme, free bicycles are gifted to Scheduled Tribe girls studying in class 9th, enabling them to commute conveniently to schools.
## Benefits - Free bicycles given to the scheduled tribal girl students as a gift.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a girl student. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The applicant should be studying in class 9th in a recognized school.1. The applicant’s annual family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-.

## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit the Digital Gujarat Portal: [https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/) **Step 2:** On the home page, click on ‘Register’ and the applicant will be redirected to the registration form page. **Step 3:** Enter your Mobile Number, Email, Set Password, and then click on ‘Save’. **Step 4:** After successful registration, the applicant can login through his/her User Name (Mobile No./Email ID) and Password. **Step 5:** Now, click on ‘My Profile’ to update your profile and fill in all the mandatory information. **Step 6:** After filling in profile details, click on ‘Update Profile’. The profile will be updated after entering the verification Code (OTP). **Step 7:** Now under services, select ‘Scholarship Services’ and then click on ‘SC Scheme’. **Step 8:** Select the Financial Year for which you want to apply for and then click on ‘Change Financial Year’. **Step 9:** Select the scheme, read the interaction carefully, and then click on ‘Continue to Service’. **Step 10:** Fill in the application form completely and upload all the relevant documents. **Step 11:** Now, click on ‘Save as Draft’ and agree with the terms & conditions, and submit the application form by clicking on ‘Confirm & Final Submit’. > **Instructions:** **Note 1:** Photo uploading for all applicants is mandatory. **Note 2:** Application will be considered complete only when all sections are completed. **Note 3:** Only one application per applicant will be acceptable for a scholarship. If any student submits more than one application either from a single institute or from multiple institutions his/her all applications will be rejected by the competent authority and no request from any side will be entertained. **Note 4:** In case of any wrong/misleading information provided in the application shall lead to rejection of the application by Department Authorities. **Note 5:** All required documents must be carefully scanned as per the instructions given. **Note 6:** The student has to fill his/her application carefully as there is no provision for institution change once the application is submitted successfully. **Note 7:** The unreadable uploaded documents will allow the competent authority to reject the student application. **Note 8:** Direct Individual submission of this application form will not be accepted in case of students studying inside the state. Only outside students have to fill out their form online and submit his/her application form to their native district officer. # PMMSY: Motorcycle with Ice Box - Gujarat **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Construction Of Plant, Storage, Fishermen, Fish Sellers | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)” with the component of "Motorcycle with Ice Box", introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to modernise cold chain infrastructure to preserve fish health, uplift fishermen, and enhance value chain efficiency. Through this scheme, financial support is provided to fishermen and related beneficiaries for constructing ice plants or storage units with a minimum capacity of 30 tonnes, ensuring hygienic fish storage and better returns. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State Governments, with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% contribution from the State Government.
> **Objective of the scheme** - Marine production in the Gujarat state is one of the leading in the country. The state lags behind in exports due to non-norms. So, cold storage/ice plant modernisation is necessary to keep the fish in healthy condition. - Insulated vehicle, three wheeler with ice box including e-rickshaw, and live fish vending center to deliver the fish in hygienic condition to the consumer, so that the consumer (customer) can get fresh and clean fish from the local area and get good returns to the sellers. - Around 27,000 small and large boats are operating in the state. To strengthen the safety and security of the fishermen and increase the income of the boat owner, replacement of the existing boats is necessary to increase the sea growth of the existing boats.
## Benefits 1. The unit cost of a motorcycle with an ice box is ₹75,000/-. 1. General category beneficiaries receive 40% assistance, i.e., up to ₹30,000/-. 1. Women and Scheduled Tribe (ST)/Scheduled Caste (SC) beneficiaries receive 60% assistance, i.e., up to ₹45,000/-. 1. Assistance is provided once in a lifetime. 1. The benefit is available as per the target (category) allocated by the Government of India.
> **Mode of Disbursement:** Contribution is shared as 60% by the Government of India and 40% by the respective State Governments. > **Frequency of Disbursement:** The benefit is provided once in a lifetime. > **Validity:** Applicable only for one-time support per beneficiary.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. The applicant should hold a fishing license. 1. The applicant should complete the online registration on the [iKhedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/).1. The applicant should obtain in-principle approval before purchase of the floor plan. 1. The applicant should have his/her own bank account. > **Preference/Reservation/Relaxation:** - Women, SC, and ST beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance of the unit cost. - General category beneficiaries are eligible for 40% assistance of the unit cost.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side, then click on "Beneficiary Registration" and select any one from the 'Farmer' or 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. **Step 3:** Enter the 'Company Name' and Address if you have selected 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. And for all select the District, Taluka, and Village, choose 'what type of account holder you are?', enter your Account Number and Name, solve the Captcha, and click 'Save and Next'. **Step 4:** Enter your Mobile Number and E-mail address, click 'Send OTP', enter the received OTP, create and confirm a Password, solve the Captcha, and click 'Submit'.
> **Login Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side of the homepage. On the home page, click on ‘Schemes’ and then click on ‘Agricultural Schemes’. **Step 3:** Now select the scheme, click on the ‘Apply’ button, and an application page will open. **Step 4:** Click on the "Apply New" button and submit a new application. **Step 5:** Click on the "Update Application" button to add corrections to the application. **Step 6:** Once the application is done, confirm it. **Step 7:** Take a printout of the confirmed application.
> **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_Contacts.aspx).

page_content:
# Saksham Scholarship **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Technical Education, Differently Abled Student, PwD, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Saksham Scholarship” is implemented by the Department of Technical Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to support meritorious differently-abled students pursuing graduate-level studies in the state by providing them with financial assistance in the form of scholarships.
## Benefits Financial assistance of ₹50,000/- per annum is provided for Graduate-level studies.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have at least 40% disability. 1. The applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000/-.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - These scholarships are administered by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). Under the AICTE scheme, applications are invited through the [National Scholarship Portal](https://scholarships.gov.in/) (NSP) between September and December, and scholarships are awarded on the basis of merit. - Applicants are required to submit their high school and intermediate mark sheets and certificates, along with an income certificate. For the Saksham Yojana, a valid disability certificate of at least 40%, issued by the competent authority, is also mandatory. - For all AICTE schemes, students must first apply online through the institute where they are studying. The application is verified by the Principal of the institute, then by the State Level Officer (S.L.O.), and finally forwarded to the AICTE, New Delhi, for approval.

# Sanskrit Chhatra Pratibha Samman **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Talent Award, Sanskrit, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Sanskrit Chhatra Pratibha Samman” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Sanskrit Academy, Haridwar, under the Department of Sanskrit Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage and motivate students to pursue higher studies in Sanskrit by rewarding those who achieve top positions in the subject at the high school, intermediate, undergraduate, and postgraduate levels.
## Benefits **Awards:** • First Place: ₹5,100/- • Second Place: ₹4,100/- • Third Place: ₹3,100/-
## Eligibility Criteria Students securing First, Second, or Third position in Sanskrit subject in the following examinations will be eligible: - High School Examination (Uttarakhand Vidyalaya Shiksha Parishad) - Intermediate Examination (Uttarakhand Vidyalaya Shiksha Parishad) - Purva Madhyama Examination (Uttarakhand Sanskrit Shiksha Parishad) - Uttar Madhyama Examination (Uttarakhand Sanskrit Shiksha Parishad) - Shastri and Acharya Examinations (Uttarakhand Sanskrit University, Haridwar and Central Sanskrit University, Campus Devprayag, etc.) - Graduate and Postgraduate classes of higher education institutions (on the basis of marks obtained in Sanskrit subject).
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - The Academy obtains information about the highest-scoring students in Sanskrit in the relevant High School and Intermediate Examinations through correspondence with the Secretary of the respective Board. Similarly, the list of students securing First, Second, and Third positions in Sanskrit at the undergraduate and postgraduate levels is obtained through correspondence with the Controller of Examinations/Registrar of the respective University. - An award ceremony is organized, during which payment is made through cheque, and the students are honoured with certificates and other recognitions.

# Funeral Assistance Scheme for Unorganized Workers (Except Construction Workers) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Funeral, Unorganized, Worker, Death, Financial, Support | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Funeral Assistance Scheme for Unorganized Workers (Except Construction Workers)", launched by the Gujarat Rural Workers Welfare Board, Labour & Employment Department Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance to the heirs of deceased unorganized sector workers to help with funeral expenses and last rites, addressing the financial burden faced by families during such distressing times. The scheme provides a one-time financial assistance of ₹10,000/- to one heir of the deceased worker and is specifically designed for e-Shram card holders in the unorganized sector. The applicant must be an heir of an e-Shram card holder (except e-Nirman card holders and Scheduled Caste individuals) and must have an annual income within specified limits of ₹1,20,000/- for rural areas and ₹1,50,000/- for urban areas. The scheme is implemented by the Labour & Employment Department Government of Gujarat and applications for this scheme are accepted offline through designated government labour offices.
## Benefits > **Financial Assistance:** ₹10,000/- paid to one heir of the deceased unorganized worker, to assist with funeral expenses and last rites (funeral ceremonies).
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an heir of a deceased e-Shram card holder from the unorganized sector. - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must apply within 3 (three) months from the date of death of the deceased worker. - The deceased worker must have between 16 to 70 years of age at the time of death. - The applicant must have an annual income not exceeding ₹1,20,000/- (One Lakh Twenty Thousand Rupees), if residing in rural areas. - The applicant must have an annual income not exceeding ₹1,50,000/- (One Lakh Fifty Thousand Rupees), if residing in urban areas. - Only one heir per deceased worker is eligible to receive the assistance.
> **Priority Order for Heirs** The legal heirs of the deceased shall be considered in the following order of priority: 1. Husband or Wife. 1. Children (Son/Daughter) - in absence of spouse. 1. Parents - in absence of spouse and children. 1. Grandchildren (Grandson/Granddaughter) - in absence of spouse, children and parents. 1. Unmarried, widowed or abandoned sisters - in absence of spouse, children, parents and grandchildren. 1. Other heirs declared under Indian Succession Act, 1925 - in absence of all above categories.
## Exclusions - The applicant must not be a construction worker or e-Nirman card holder. - The applicant must not belong to Scheduled Caste category (as they are covered under separate scheme by Social Justice and Empowerment Department). - The applicant must not have received assistance from any other similar scheme.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant should obtain the prescribed application form as per "Annexure-1" from any of the designated government offices mentioned in the Steps below. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** The applicant must submit the completed application form along with all required documents to any of the following offices: - Office of Assistant Government Labour Officer. - Office of Government Labour Officer. - Office of Assistant Labour Commissioner. - Office of Deputy Labour Commissioner. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable). _*Applications must be submitted within 3 (three) months from the date of death of the unorganized worker. Applications submitted after this deadline will be automatically cancelled._
> **Post-Application Processes** **Step 1:** Upon receipt of the application, the concerned office will conduct necessary verification and approve/reject the application within 10 working days. If the application contains incomplete documents or information, the applicant will be notified accordingly. **Step 2:** In case of incomplete documentation, the applicant must complete the requirements within 15 days from the date of notification. The concerned office will then process the completed application within 10 working days of receiving the additional documents. **Step 3:** After successful verification and approval, the financial assistance of ₹10,000/- will be disbursed to the eligible heir's bank account as provided in the application.

page_content:
# Khiladi Protsahan Chhatravriti Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Sports, Sportsperson, Scholarship, Player | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme 'Khiladi Protsahan Chhatravriti Yojana' was launched by the Department of Sports, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote sports among talented youth aged 14 to 23 years from Uttarakhand by providing scholarships and financial assistance for sports equipment.
## Benefits - Under this scheme, players/sportspersons aged 14 to 23 years are selected annually based on the P-SAT (Physical and Sports Aptitude Test). - A total of 100 boys and 100 girls are selected per district, and they are provided a scholarship of ₹2,000/- per month along with ₹10,000/- once a year for sports equipment.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a boy or girl between 14 and 23 years of age. 1. The boy or girl who obtain the highest marks based on merit in the final district-level competition, conducted through various stages of the Physical and Sports Aptitude Test (P-SAT) assessing physical abilities such as strength, flexibility, endurance, speed, and coordination, will be eligible for the sports scholarship. 1. Scholarships are awarded on a priority basis in the following sports: (1) Athletics, (2) Badminton, (3) Boxing, (4) Taekwondo, (5) Kabaddi, (6) Football, (7) Volleyball, (8) Basketball, (9) Hockey, (10) Table Tennis, (11) Karate, and (12) Judo.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - There is no selection at the school or Nyaya Panchayat level. - Players independently participate in competitions held directly at the municipality, municipal corporation, or district level, and selections are made based on merit. - Six competitions will be organized to test physical efficiency: (1) 30-meter flying run (2) Standing broad jump (3) Forward bend and reach (4) 6 × 10 shuttle run (5) Medicine ball throw (6) 600-meter run - The district-level selection committee will issue a final list in each age group who secure the highest marks based on merit. These players will be eligible for the sports scholarship, which will be directly transferred to their accounts through DBT.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote higher education among girl students in the state by providing scholarships to those pursuing their first year of post-graduation in various government colleges across Uttarakhand.

page_content:
# Rishi and Milan Khosla Scholarship Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Women and Child | **Tags:** Scholarship, Girl Student, Meritorious Student, Postgraduate | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Rishi and Milan Khosla Scholarship Scheme” was launched by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote higher education among girl students in the state by providing scholarships to those pursuing their first year of post-graduation in various government colleges across Uttarakhand.
## Benefits A scholarship of ₹51,000/- per student is given to 50 girl students enrolled in the first year of post-graduation at various government colleges across the state.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant (girl student) must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The girl student must be studying in a government college in Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the first year of a postgraduate (PG) course. 1. The applicant’s family annual income from all sources should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-. 1. The girl student must have obtained a minimum of 60% marks in graduation.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - The scheme is implemented under a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Government of Uttarakhand and the Rishi and Milan Khosla Foundation, Noida, Uttar Pradesh. - Applications are generally invited by the Department of Higher Education during December–January, after informing the respective colleges. - To avail the scholarship, the girl student must apply online at [www.vidyasaarathi.co.in](https://www.vidyasaarathi.co.in) during the specified period. Along with the application, the student is required to submit her Aadhaar card, bank account details, permanent residence certificate, income certificate, mark sheets of all years of graduation, college ID, and proof of admission in post-graduation.

# Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Puraskar Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Student, Post-Graduation, Undergraduate, Meritorious, Award | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Puraskar Yojana” was launched by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage academic excellence among students and provides cash prizes to those who secure first, second, or third positions in their graduation or post-graduation studies at the university level.
## Benefits **At the university level, students securing first, second, and third positions in graduation examinations are awarded:** - 1st Position: ₹50,000/- - 2nd Position: ₹30,000/- - 3rd Position: ₹15,000/- **Students securing first, second, and third positions in post-graduation examinations are awarded:** - 1st Position: ₹75,000/- - 2nd Position: ₹60,000/- - 3rd Position: ₹30,000/-
## Eligibility Criteria 1. This scheme is applicable to the top three students who have obtained the highest marks at the university level after completing their courses in the Arts, Science, and Commerce faculties at the graduate and post-graduate levels in the state’s Shridev Suman University, Kumaon University, Soban Singh Jeena University, and their affiliated colleges. 1. Students who have obtained less than 60% marks will be ineligible under the scheme. 1. Students who have appeared in improvement examinations in graduation or post-graduation, backlog examinations, or those who have dropped out in any year and then progressed to the next class will also be ineligible for the scheme.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - The department requests a faculty-wise list of students who have obtained the highest marks in government universities and their affiliated colleges. - The scholarships are credited directly to the students’ accounts after their data is verified through the Samarth portal. - Students do not need to apply for this themselves.

tags: Support For Acquisition Of Deep Sea Fishing Vessels
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to strengthen fish storage infrastructure for hygienic preservation. Through this scheme, beneficiaries receive financial assistance for the support for acquisition of deep-sea fishing vessels for traditional fishermen.

page_content:
# PMMSY: Support for Acquisition of Deep Sea Fishing Vessels for Traditional Fishermen - Gujarat **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Construction Of Plant, Storage, Traditional Fishermen, Fish Sellers, Support For Acquisition Of Deep Sea Fishing Vessels | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)” with the component of "Support for Acquisition of Deep Sea Fishing Vessels for Traditional Fishermen", introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to modernise cold chain infrastructure to preserve fish health, uplift fishermen, and enhance value chain efficiency. Through this scheme, financial support is provided to fishermen and related beneficiaries for constructing ice plants or storage units with a minimum capacity of 30 tonnes, ensuring hygienic fish storage and better returns. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State Governments, with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% contribution from the State Government.
> **Objective of the scheme** - Marine production in the Gujarat state is one of the leading in the country. The state lags behind in exports due to non-norms. So cold storage/ice plant modernization is necessary to keep the fish in healthy condition. - Insulated vehicle, three wheeler with ice box including e-rickshaw, and live fish vending center to deliver the fish in hygienic condition to the consumer, so that the consumer (customer) can get fresh and clean fish from the local area and get good returns to the sellers. - Around 27,000 small and large boats are operating in the state. To strengthen the safety and security of the fishermen and increase the income of the boat owner, replacement of the existing boats is necessary to increase the sea growth of the existing boats.
## Benefits - Unit cost is ₹1,20,00,000/-. 40 percent assistance for general category i.e. assistance up to ₹48,00,000/- - And for women and ST/SC category beneficiaries 60 percent assistance i.e. assistance up to ₹72,00,000. - The benefit will be available as per the target (category) allocated by the Government of India.
> **Remarks:** 60% contribution from Government of India and 40% contribution from State Governments is paid. > **Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits:** Once in a lifetime.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. The applicant should hold a fishing license. 1. The applicant should complete the online registration on the [iKhedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/).1. The applicant should obtain in-principle approval before purchase of the floor plan. 1. The applicant should have his/her own bank account. > **Preference/Reservation/Relaxation:** - Women, SC, and ST beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance of the unit cost. - General category beneficiaries are eligible for 40% assistance of the unit cost.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side, then click on "Beneficiary Registration" and select any one from the 'Farmer' or 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. **Step 3:** Enter the 'Company Name' and Address if you have selected 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. And for all select the District, Taluka, and Village, choose 'what type of account holder you are?', enter your Account Number and Name, solve the Captcha, and click 'Save and Next'. **Step 4:** Enter your Mobile Number and E-mail address, click 'Send OTP', enter the received OTP, create and confirm a Password, solve the Captcha, and click 'Submit'.
> **Login Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side of the homepage. On the home page, click on ‘Schemes’ and then click on ‘Agricultural Schemes’. **Step 3:** Now select the scheme, click on the ‘Apply’ button, and an application page will open. **Step 4:** Click on the "Apply New" button and submit a new application. **Step 5:** Click on the "Update Application" button to add corrections to the application. **Step 6:** Once the application is done, confirm it. **Step 7:** Take a printout of the confirmed application.
> **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_Contacts.aspx).

page_content:
# Integrated Horticulture Development Program for Tribal Area Farmers (TASP) HRT-3 **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Horticulture, Tribal Farmers, Farm Mechanization, Post Harvest Management, Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Integrated Horticulture Development Program for Tribal Area Farmers (TASP) HRT-3" by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to strengthen horticulture-based livelihoods and promote modern horticultural practices among tribal farmers through financial assistance for farm mechanization, processing units, crop protection, post-harvest management, and export-related infrastructure. The scheme provides targeted subsidies on equipment, units, and inputs to ensure sustainable horticultural growth in tribal areas.
## Benefits > **Capacity Building & Promotion:** - Assistance for publication and promotional materials related to horticultural crops. - Financial support for organizing and participating in exhibitions, competitions, and seminars. - Subsidy for organizing or participating in Krishi Melas and payment for stall rentals. > **Farm Mechanization Support:** - Subsidy for purchase of power tillers and mini tractors to enhance horticultural productivity. - Financial aid for harvesting equipment and crop protection equipment. > **Processing & Value Addition:** - Support for establishment of new distillation units for medicinal and aromatic crops. - Subsidy for setting up new processing units for cashew and other fruit crops. - Assistance for processing equipment for value addition. > **Export Promotion:** - Sea fridge subsidy for export of fruits, vegetables, flowers, and plants. - Air fridge subsidy to promote export of horticultural produce. > **Price Stabilization:** - Minimum Support Price (MSP) assistance to ensure stable market prices for horticultural crops. > **Infrastructure & Utilities Support:** - Subsidy on electricity bills for operating greenhouses and tissue culture laboratories. - Support for hi-tech greenhouses (with fan and pad system). - Support for naturally ventilated polyhouses and net houses. > **Post-Harvest Management:** - Subsidy for packing materials used in post-harvest handling of horticultural produce. - Support for setting up kaccha mandaps for tomato/chilly and other vegetable marketing. - Construction of vegetable trellises and half-lined pedestrian paths for climbing vegetable crops.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. - The applicant should be practicing horticulture in tribal areas.

# Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Castor cake/Neem cake/ Liquid Fermented Organic Manure / Green manure seed (For mix in the soil) Gujarat **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Adivasi Farmers, Crop Production, Livelihood, Castor Cake, Fertilizer, Subsidies | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Distribution of Seeds of more productive varieties / Hybrid varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area (TASP)" with a component "Castor cake/Neem cake/ Liquid Fermented Organic Manure / Green manure seed (For mix in the soil)" is introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to help Adivasi farmers in Tribal Areas (TASP) and tribal cultivators outside these areas achieve higher production of agricultural crops. Through this scheme, subsidies are provided on various agricultural inputs such as high-yield variety seeds, hybrid seeds, and fertilizers. Farmers are also provided with plant protection equipment, tarpaulins, field demonstrations, micronutrients, water carrying pipelines, and pump sets to increase their crop yield and improve their livelihoods. The scheme's benefits are provided to farmers belonging to Scheduled Tribes and tribal cultivators residing outside tribal areas.
## Benefits **SCHEDULE-IV and V under FCO 1985:-** 1. **Castor cake/Neem cake/ Liquid Fermented Organic Manure:** 75% of the purchase price or ₹9,000/- per hectare, whichever is less. This assistance is for a maximum of two hectares per account. OR 1. **Green manuring (hemp/Ikkad seeds):** 75% of the purchase price or ₹3,000/- per hectare, whichever is less. A total of ₹6,000/- per person, whichever is less, is provided for hemp (60 kg) or Ikkad (50 kg) seeds per hectare. This assistance is for a maximum of three hectares per account.
> **Frequency of Disbursement:** The benefit for Castor cake/Neem cake/Liquid Fermented Organic Manure/Green manure seed is provided every year. > **Remark:** As per conditions No. 5, 16, 17, 19 and 22 of [Appendix-1](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in/Schemeatoz.aspx). (Refer Scheme No. 35)
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Tribe. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should be located in tribal areas OR be a tribal cultivator residing outside tribal areas. 1. The scheme excludes farmers from Dang district.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Approach the Gram Sevak in your village for access to the "Castor cake/Neem cake/ Liquid Fermented Organic Manure / Green manure seed (For mix in the soil)" under the scheme.

Through this scheme, the purchase price of tarpaulin assistance provided to tribal cultivators is used to improve productivity and livelihood.
## Benefits 1. The assistance covers 75% of the purchase price of the tarpaulin or ₹1,875/-, whichever amount is less.
> **Conditions:** A maximum of two tarpaulins can be claimed per account. > **Frequency of Disbursement:** The benefit can be reclaimed once every 3 years. > **Remark:** As per conditions No. 5, 16, 17, 19 and 22 of [Appendix-1](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in/Schemeatoz.aspx). (Refer Scheme No. 35)
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Tribe. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should be located in tribal areas OR be a tribal cultivator residing outside tribal areas. 1. The scheme excludes farmers from Dang district.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side, then click on "Beneficiary Registration" and select any one from the 'Farmer' or 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. **Step 3:** Enter the 'Company Name' and Address if you have selected 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. # Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Agriculture, Vegetable Farming, Trellis Mandap, Farming Infrastructure | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops" by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to promote sustainable and structured vegetable crop cultivation by extending financial assistance to eligible farmers for building kachha, semi-pucca, and pucca trellis mandaps using materials like wood, bamboo, GI wire, and plastic wire. This initiative not only supports effective vegetable cultivation techniques but also improves the productivity and longevity of vegetable crops grown on trellises.
## Benefits > **Monetary Assistance:** - **General Farmers:** 50% of unit cost or ₹80,000/- per hectare- **SC/ST Farmers:** 75% of unit cost or ₹1,20,000/- per hectare- **Devipoojak Farmers:** 90% of cost or ₹46,800/- per hectare > **Input Support:** - **Wood/Bamboo Supports:** 1,600 units per hectare- **GI Wire (12–18 gauge) or Plastic Wire:** 400 kg per hectare- **Recommended Plant Spacing:** 2.5 x 2.5 meters (approximate) > **Coverage Limit:** - **Maximum Area:** 2.00 hectares per Khata **Validity:** - **Assistance duration:** 3 years
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a farmer - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be engaged in vegetable cultivation. - The applicant should be willing to construct trellis mandaps.

metadata.schemeName: Shridev Suman State Merit Scholarship
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides monthly scholarship of ₹1,000/- to meritorious students who qualify in eligibility test conducted by SCERT Uttarakhand. The scholarship is awarded to the next 5 students from each development block of Uttarakhand who are not selected for the Dr. Shivanand Nautiyal Scholarship.

page_content:
# Shridev Suman State Merit Scholarship **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Secondary Education, Student, Sridev Suman | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Shridev Suman State Merit Scholarship" scheme is implemented by the Secondary Education Department under the Department of Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students who qualify in the eligibility test conducted by SCERT Uttarakhand. The scholarship is awarded to the next five students from each development block of Uttarakhand who are not selected for the Dr. Shivanand Nautiyal Scholarship.
## Benefits - On the basis of the declared results of the eligibility test conducted by SCERT Uttarakhand, the scholarship is awarded to the next five students from each of the 95 development blocks of Uttarakhand (95 × 5 = 475) who are not selected for the Dr. Shivanand Nautiyal Scholarship. - Each selected student receives ₹1,000/- per month for a duration of 10 months.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an institutional student of Class 8 in any government, local body, or government-aided school (excluding central and residential schools) in Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have passed the annual Class 7 examination with a minimum of 50% marks (40% for reserved categories). 1. There is no restriction on the annual income of parents or guardians. 1. The scholarship will be awarded for a period of 4 years, from Class 9 to Class 12.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - To appear in the scholarship examination, students can obtain the application form from the office of the Block Education Officer or download it from the School Education Department’s website ([https://schooleducation.uk.gov.in](https://schooleducation.uk.gov.in/)) or SCERT Uttarakhand’s website ([https://scert.uk.gov.in](https://scert.uk.gov.in/)) during September–October every year. A photocopy of the application form is also valid. No application or examination fee is charged. - While filling out the application form, students must attach a passport-size photograph, Aadhaar card, Class 7 mark sheet, caste certificate, and disability certificate (if applicable). All information must be filled in correctly, and the completed form should be submitted to the Principal of the school where the student is enrolled. - The Principal will verify the form based on the attached documents and school records, attest the photograph, and forward the verified form to the Block Education Officer’s office by the tentative date of 12 November. - After submission, the Block Education Officer issues the admit card. Students can collect the admit card either from their school or the Block Education Officer’s office. - The examination is conducted every year in the month of January. - After the successful completion of the process, the school Principal informs the student. The student must provide their Aadhaar card and Aadhaar-linked bank account details to the school, following which the scholarship amount is transferred directly to the student’s bank account.

# National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm: Planting Materials **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Edible Oil, Oil Palm, Planting Materials, Imported Plant, Seedlings, Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme component "Planting Materials" launched under the "National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm" scheme by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation, Government of Gujarat, aims to enhance oil palm cultivation in Gujarat by providing subsidized planting materials to farmers, thereby reducing import dependency and promoting self-reliance in edible oil production. page_content:
# Kishori Balika Yojana- Uttarakhand **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Women and Child, Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Adolescent Girls, Awareness On Nutrition, Awareness On Health, Teenage Girl | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Kishori Balika Yojana" is implemented by the Department of Women Empowerment & Child Development, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to create awareness among adolescent girls aged 14 to 18 years about nutrition, health, and life cycle issues, and also provides supplementary nutrition for 300 days in a year.
## Benefits Under this scheme, awareness is created among adolescent girls about nutrition, health, and life cycle issues. They are also provided supplementary nutrition (fortified rice and wheat for 25 days each month) for 300 days in a year.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an adolescent girl in the age group of 14 to 18 years. 1. The applicant must be residing in one of the aspirational districts of Uttarakhand- Haridwar or Udham Singh Nagar.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Registration of beneficiaries is carried out through the [Poshan Tracker App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.poshantracker&pli=1), for which the Aadhaar card and birth certificate of the adolescent girl are required.

metadata.schemeName: Financial Assistance as Interest Subsidy on Home Loan
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide 50% reimbursement of interest on home loans up to ₹1,00,000 for eligible war widows, war bereaved families, war disabled personnel, and attributable peacetime casualties.

page_content:
# Financial Assistance as Interest Subsidy on Home Loan **Ministry:** Ministry Of Defence | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Housing & Shelter, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Housing, Loan, Ex-servicemen, Disabled | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Financial Assistance as Interest Subsidy on Home Loan" scheme was launched by the Kendriya Sainik Board (KSB), Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare, Ministry of Defence, Government of India. The scheme aims to provide a small measure of relief to war bereaved, war disabled and attributable peace time casualties(all ranks). Under this scheme, reimbursement of 50% of the interest on a home loan up to ₹1,00,000 is provided for a maximum of five years.
## Benefits - **Interest Subsidy Amount:** 50% of the interest charged on the home loan.- **Loan Limit for Subsidy:** Up to ₹1,00,000 (even if the loan amount is higher).- **Duration:** Maximum of 5 years or until loan repayment is completed, whichever is earlier.- **Applicable Loan Sources:** Banks, Government/Public Sector undertakings, Life Insurance Corporation (LIC), General Insurance Corporation (GIC), and Housing and Urban Development Corporation (HUDCO).
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a war widow, war bereaved family member, war disabled personnel, or attributable peacetime casualty (all ranks). 1. The applicant must have taken a home loan from a bank, government/public sector undertaking, LIC, GIC, or HUDCO. 1. The loan amount considered for subsidy must not exceed ₹1,00,000, regardless of the actual loan amount.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ***Interested and eligible students need to apply online at the*** [***Kendriya Sainik Board Secretariat***](https://www.ksb.gov.in/)***.*** **New User Registration** 1. Select the "Register" option. 1. Complete the registration form with the requisite details, including your name, Aadhaar card number, email ID, mobile number, and bank details. 1. Establish a password for your account. 1. Upon successful registration, the applicant will receive a User ID and password. ***Login & Application Process:*** 1. Log in using the provided User ID and password to access the application form. 1. Click "New Application" and select the scheme name. 1. Fill in the complete application form. 1. Upload the required documents, including a photograph, caste certificate, residential certificate, and bank passbook etc. 1. Click on the "Save & Forward" and take the printout of the application form. 1. The applicant submits the printed application along with all the required documents to the District Sainik Board.” > **NOTE:** Once the application reaches KSB Sectt., the staff and officers at KSB carry out vetting and approval of the application. Final payment is made online in due course based on the availability of funds in AFFD.

metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
metadata.briefDescription: This fellowship is meant for Young Faculty having regular position at their institution and proven track record in research. Support is provisioned for 50 candidates, for an initial period of support of 2 years, extendible till 5 years based on performance review.

page_content:
# Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Young Faculty Research Fellowships **Ministry:** Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Science, IT & Communications, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Visvesvaraya PhD, Electronics And IT, Young Faculty, Research, Fellowship | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Young Faculty Research Fellowship (YFRF)” is a component of the “Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT”, implemented by the Digital India Corporation under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India. The objective of the scheme is to promote R&D, create an innovative ecosystem, and enhance India’s competitiveness in the knowledge-intensive sectors of Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES). This fellowship is meant for Young Faculty having regular position at their institution and proven track record in research. Support is provisioned for 50 candidates, for an initial period of support of 2 years, extendible till 5th year based on performance review.
## Benefits ***Nature of Support:*** - **Research Fellowship:** ₹20,000/- per month, in addition to the regular salary - **Research Contingency Grant:** ₹5,00,000/- per year for a maximum of 5 years - The fellowship is tenable only in India and can be implemented in any of the recognized & eligible academic and R&D institution. - Research Contingency Grant can be used for minor equipment, consumables and domestic travel. The host institution should provide necessary administrative and infrastructural support for YFRF. - The fellows are not eligible to receive any other fellowship from any Government or Non-Government source during the tenure of the fellowship. - YFRFs are non-transferrable. The research work is to be carried out in the same eligible institution though which YFRF proposal was submitted. ***Duration of Support:*** - The fellowship is purely a temporary assignment, and is tenable for a maximum period of 05 years. - The award will initially be for 2 years and further extendible, based on performance review.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be an Indian citizen. 1. The applicant must have obtained PhD degree from a recognized University with first class (in terms of grades, etc.) in all preceding levels and a good academic record throughout. 1. The applicant must have a regular position in the institute and should be engaged in research. 1. The upper age limit for the fellowship is 40 years on the date of submission of application. 1. YFRF under Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme can be availed only once by a candidate in his/her career. 1. The applicant availing any other fellowship is not eligible to apply. 1. Proposals for allotment of YFRF are to be submitted through eligible institutions only. 1. Each institution in the proposal may submit up to three nominations for the award for each round of call for applications. ***Discontinuation of the Fellowship:*** 1. The performance of YFRF would be reviewed periodically as per the discretion of PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY. 1. A detailed performance assessment/review of award would be conducted annually and decision on continuation of YFRF would be taken accordingly. 1. If any fellow wishes to discontinue the fellowship, the institution should inform Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme immediately. One month's notice is to be given to DIC through the institution before the date of discontinuation. 1. The implementing institution should not incur any expenditure from the date of termination of the project or the date of resignation of the fellow. The institution will ensure the submission of work report and other requisite documents from YFRF awardee. 1. PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY reserves the right to hold/ stop/ terminate the Fellowship at any stage because of reasons including, but not limited to the following: - Appropriate progress is not being made. - The grant is not being utilized properly. - Violation/ Non-compliance of guidelines. - Any other reason, which is deemed appropriate by PhD Cell, DIC, MeitY.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ***The scheme is an institutional scheme wherein nominations for YFRF are submitted by the eligible institution againt Call for Proposal (Invitation for Nominations) by PhD Cell, Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme***
***Selection & Mode of Application:*** PhD Cell invites nominations periodically from eligible institutions for award of YFRF under the scheme. Subsequently the nominations are evaluated by experts and accordingly, the fellowships are awarded. 1. The call for applications for YFRF will be notified by PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY through the web portal [https://phd.dic.gov.in](https://phd.dic.gov.in/) 1. Each eligible institutions can submit up to a maximum of three nominations for the YFRF award to PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY through the web portal [https://phd.dic.gov.in/](https://phd.dic.gov.in/) 1. The proposal should define clear objectives, outcomes and deliverables against the award. 1. The eligible institutions will be allowed to submit nominations for the award once in a year against a call for nominations by PhD Cell. PhD Cell will scrutinize and evaluate these nominations periodically. The stages of evaluation will be decided by PhD Cell considering different aspects including but not limited to: - No. of nominations received. - Suitability of the received nominations, etc. ***Note:*** - PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY reserves the right to screen and consider suitable candidates. - Just fulfilling the minimum eligibility criteria would not entitle one to be selected. - PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY may change the T&C at its discretion, if deemed necessary. ([User Manual](https://phd.dic.gov.in/guidelines/UserManualYFRF.pdf))

page_content:
# Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Part Time PhD Candidates **Ministry:** Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Science, IT & Communications, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Visvesvaraya PhD, Electronics And IT, Part Time PhD, Research | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Part Time PhD Candidate” is a component of the scheme “Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT”, implemented by the Digital India Corporation under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India. The scheme aims at generating a total of 150 Part-time PhDs in emerging research areas of Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES) sectors over a period of 5 years. ***Objectives:*** - To enhance the number of PhDs in Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES) sectors in the country. - Give thrust to R&D, create an innovative ecosystem and enhance India’s competitiveness in these knowledge intensive sectors. Part-Time PhD seats are provisioned for professionals working at a reputed place/organisation. The seats are allotted to the institutions based on the assessment of the proposals of the institute, research strength, and the working places of the prospective applicants.
## Benefits - Part-time PhD candidates will receive a one-time incentive of ₹3,00,000/- upon successful completion of their PhD degree and reporting of the same to PhD Cell through their institution with PhD completion documents.
## Eligibility Criteria Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme is an institutional scheme wherein eligible institutions submit proposals requesting Part-time PhD seats against an active call for proposal by Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme, DIC, MeitY. <br> 1. The call for proposal for Part-time PhD seats will be notified by PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY through the web portal https://phd.dic.gov.in/. 2. Proposals for allotment of Part-time PhD seats are to be submitted by eligible institutions only. Suitable number of seats would be allotted to institutions for further enrollment of Part-time PhD fellows on these seats following the scheme guidelines. <br> <br> - Part-time PhD seats are provisioned for professionals working at reputed places/organizations. - The selected candidates should not be availing any PhD Fellowship/scholarship from any other scheme of Central or State Government.
***Termination of the Support*** PhD Cell, DIC, MeitY reserves the right to hold/ stop/ terminate the support for this component at any stage, including but not limited to: -  Appropriate progress is not being made. -  Violation/ Non-compliance of guidelines. -  Any other reason, which is deemed appropriate by PhD Cell, DIC, MeitY.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme is an institutional scheme wherein eligible institutions submit proposals requesting Part-time PhD seats against an active call for proposal by Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme, DIC, MeitY.
1. The call for proposal for Part-time PhD seats will be notified by PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY through the web portal https://phd.dic.gov.in/. 1. Proposals for allotment of Part-time PhD seats are to be submitted by eligible institutions only. Suitable number of seats would be allotted to institutions for further enrollment of Part-time PhD fellows on these seats following the scheme guidelines. - Interested candidate to join the scheme, need to contact respective institutions for admission formalities.

page_content:
# Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Full Time PhD Candidates **Ministry:** Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Science, IT & Communications, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Visvesvaraya PhD, Electronics And IT, Full Time PhD, Fellowship | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The 'Full Time PhD Candidate' is a component of the scheme “Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT”, implemented by the Digital India Corporation under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India. It is an institutional scheme, where PhD seats are allocated to the institutions and the institutions enroll PhD candidates on these seats following their admission procedures. ***Objectives:*** - To enhance the number of PhDs in Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES) sectors in the country. - Give thrust to R&D, create an innovative ecosystem and enhance India’s competitiveness in these knowledge intensive sectors. ***Salient Features:*** - 1000 Full Time PhD seats in the areas of ESDM & IT/ITES - One time support for selected 250 Full-time PhD candidates (50 candidates/year) for 6 months Visit to Labs Abroad - Support for International Conference up to Rs. 1.50 Lakh/ per Full Time PhD once under the support tenure - Contingency Research Grant @ Rs. 1.20 Lakh/ year per Full Time PhD
## Benefits [***Financial Support for Full-time PhD candidates***](https://phd.dic.gov.in/guidelines/SOPFullTime.pdf)***:*** 1. **Fellowship:** ₹38,750/- per month in 1st & 2nd year and @₹43,750/- per month in 3rd, 4th and 5th years of PhD. (support till PhD completion or 5 years whichever is earlier). 1. **Reimbursement of Rent (RoR):** This component is linked with the fellowship of a PhD Candidate. The rate of RoR is 24%, 16% & 8% (of fellowship) for X, Y & Z class cities/towns respectively. 1. **Institutional Overheads:** An amount of ₹25,000/Year/Full-time PhD candidate for support duration of PhD candidate to be given to the institution. The institutional overhead will be released after completion of required tenure by the respective candidate on pro-rata basis. 1. **Research Contingency Grant Support:** An amount of ₹1,20,000/Year/Full-time PhD candidate for support duration of the PhD candidate. 1. **Support to attend selected International Conferences** up to ₹1.5 Lakh per Full Time PhD candidate from 3rd year. 1. **One time support for selected 250 Full Time PhD candidates from 3rd year for 6 months “Visit to Labs Abroad”.** The support would be available to the selected Full Time PhD candidates with following guidelines: - During the visit, the Monthly Fellowship will be ₹1.50 Lakh. - The Travel/Visa expenses up to ₹1.50 Lakh is provided. - During this period, the domestic Fellowship and Reimbursement of Rent (RoR) will be suspended.
## Eligibility Criteria Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme is an institutional scheme wherein eligible institutions submit proposals requesting Full Time PhD seats against an active call for proposal by Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme, DIC, MeitY. 1. The call for proposal for Full Time PhDseats is notified by PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY through the web portal https://phd.dic.gov.in/ 2. Proposals for allotment of Full Time PhD seats are to be submitted by eligible institutions only. Suitable number of seats would be allotted to institutions for further enrollment of Full Time PhD fellows on these seats following the scheme guidelines. 3. The institutions with PhD seats, allotted under the scheme, would conduct their admission process for enrolment of candidates on those seats. 4.**** Only the candidates enrolled/registered for PhD during the period of the scheme would be eligible to apply for the financial support. This scheme will be applicable for new PhD Scholars after notification of the scheme 5. Candidates already availing financial support from other government schemes are not eligible.
***Terms and Conditions for support*** 1. The support will be for additional PhD candidates taken up by an institution. No support would be provided for current levels of enrolment in the PhD programme at the institutions. Transfer from other scholarship schemes would not be permitted. 1. Only the candidates enrolled/registered for PhD during the period of the scheme would be eligible to apply for the financial support. This scheme will be applicable for new PhD Scholars after notification of the scheme. 1. The candidate would be eligible for Fellowship for the period during which the candidate is in good standing, and fulfills the requirements of the PhD successfully. The maximum period for which the support would be available for any Full-time candidate would be five years or till the completion of PhD whichever is earlier. 1. The participating Institution will ensure that a candidate receiving fellowship under this scheme is not receiving any financial support for PhD from any other scheme of Government of India/States etc. at the same time, The candidates who have availed support for their PhD from any other scheme of Government of India/States etc. will be automatically be disqualified for support under this scheme. 1. The PhD seats allotted for a particular year should be utilized in the same academic year only as per the prescribed timelines. The unfilled seats would be automatically pulled back to the general pool of the scheme. 1. The institutions, in the event of any drop-out, need to report it to PhD Cell/DIC immediately. The institutions cannot enroll a substitute candidate on their own. 1. The institution will be responsible for furnishing utilization certificates of the funds released to them based on the scheme parameters, and as per conditions of the sanctioned grant-in- aid.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme is an institutional scheme wherein eligible institutions submit proposals requesting Full-time PhD seats against an active call for proposal by Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme, DIC, MeitY. - The call for proposal for Full-time PhD seats is notified by PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY through the web portal https://phd.dic.gov.in/ - Proposals for allotment of Full-time PhD seats are to be submitted by eligible institutions only. Suitable number of seats would be allotted to institutions for further enrollment of Full-time PhD fellows on these seats following the scheme guidelines. - Only the candidates enrolled/registered for PhD during the period of the scheme would be eligible to apply for the financial support. This scheme will be applicable for new PhD Scholars after notification of the scheme. - Candidates already availing financial support from other government schemes are not eligible.
Interested candidates need to contact respective institutions for admission formalities.

page_content:
# National Mission on Edible Oil- Oil Palm: Nursery **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Edible Oil, Nursery, Farmer, Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme component "Nursery" launched under the "National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm" scheme by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation, Government of Gujarat, aims to promote oil palm cultivation in the state by providing financial assistance to farmers for establishing oil palm nurseries. This initiative seeks to increase domestic production, thereby reducing the import of oil palm from abroad and strengthening the agricultural economy.
## Benefits - **Subsidy:** ₹40,00,000/- per nursery.- **Capacity:** 10 hectares for ₹1,00,000 worth of saplings.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/) Portal. **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side, then click on "Beneficiary Registration" and select any one from the 'Farmer' or 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. **Step 3:** Select the District, Taluka, and Village, choose 'what type of account holder you are?', enter your Account Number and Name, solve the Captcha, and click 'Save and Next'. **Step 4:** Enter your Mobile Number and Email address, click 'Send OTP', enter the received OTP, create and confirm a Password, solve the Captcha, and click 'Submit'. > **Login Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/) Portal. **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side of the homepage. On the home page, click on ‘Schemes’ and then click on ‘Agricultural Schemes’. **Step 3:** Now select the scheme, click on the ‘Apply’ button, and an application page will open. **Step 4:** Click on the "Apply New" button and submit a new application. **Step 5:** Click on the "Update Application" button to add corrections to the application. **Step 6:** Once the application is done, confirm it. **Step 7:** Take a printout of the confirmed application. > **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_Contacts.aspx)

metadata.schemeName: Vishesh Katan, Vankari & Vanat Sahay (Spinning & Weaving Assistance Scheme)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance in addition to the central government assistance to spinners and weavers. It provides production incentives to Khadi spinners and weavers with category-wise differential assistance rates.

page_content:
# Vishesh Katan, Vankari & Vanat Sahay (Spinning & Weaving Assistance Scheme) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Artisan, Spinner, Weaver, Yarn, Khadi | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Vishesh Katan, Vankari & Vanat Sahay (Spinning & Weaving Assistance Scheme)" by the Gujarat Rajya Khadi Gramodyog Board, Industries & Mines Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance in addition to the central government assistance to spinners and weavers. The scheme provides production incentive for spinning of yarn and weaving of Khadi with additional financial assistance ranging from ₹1/- per hank for general and Scheduled Caste spinners to ₹4/- per square meter for Scheduled Tribe weavers, along with weaving equipment aid of ₹1/- per square meter. The applicant must be Khadi spinners and weavers engaged in production activities. The scheme is implemented by Gujarat Rajya Khadi Gramodyog Board under Industries & Mines Department and applications are accepted as per the board's procedures.
## Benefits > **For Spinners** - General and Scheduled Caste Categories: Additional ₹1/- per hank for spinning of yarn. - Women and Scheduled Tribe Categories: Additional ₹1.5/- per hank for spinning of yarn. > **For Weavers** - General and Scheduled Caste Categories: Additional ₹3/- per square meter for weaving of Khadi. - Scheduled Tribe Category: Additional ₹4/- per square meter for weaving of Khadi. - Weaving Equipment Aid: ₹1/- per square meter weaving equipment aid.
> **Mode and Frequency of Disbursement** - Production incentive based on actual spinning and weaving output. - Payment structure linked to per hank for spinning and per square meter for weaving. > **Conditions for Availment/Continuation** - Beneficiaries must be actively engaged in Khadi spinning and weaving activities. - Incentives are provided in addition to central government assistance. - Must maintain production records for verification purposes.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must EITHER be Khadi spinners engaged in spinning of yarn activities, OR Khadi weavers engaged in weaving of Khadi activities. - The applicant must be provided production incentive for spinning of yarn/ weaving of Khadi.
> **Categories and Preferences** **General Category:** Eligible for standard assistance rates. **Scheduled Caste:** Eligible for standard assistance rates same as General category. **Women:** Eligible for enhanced assistance rates for spinning activities. **Scheduled Tribe:** Eligible for highest assistance rates for both spinning and weaving activities.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Steps for New Registration** **Step 1:** Visit the [eKutir portal](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in). In the right pane of the landing page, click "[For New Individual Registration, click Here](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in/Registration.aspx)". **Step 2:** On the registration page, fill in all mandatory fields (marked with an asterisk): Full Name (in English), Aadhaar Card Number, Gender, Date of Birth, Mobile Number, E-mail, Password (confirm the password by typing it again). Fill in the Captcha Code, and click "Register". **Step 3:** A confirmation pop-up will display the entered name, mobile number, and other details. If all the details are correct, click "Confirm" to proceed. If any information is incorrect, click "Cancel", make the necessary corrections, and then click "Register" again. **Step 4:** Upon successful registration, the User ID and Password will be sent to your registered mobile number via SMS. If an email address has been provided, the credentials will also be sent via email.
**Steps for Login Procedure and User Profile Update** **Step 1:** Visit the [eKutir portal](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in). In the right pane of the landing page (in the "Login to Portal" section), provide your User ID, Password, and the Captcha Code. Then click "Login". **Step 2:** Upon first login, the user must complete the "User Profile" by providing personal and organisational details. All fields marked with an asterisk are mandatory. Some fields will already be pre-filled based on the information provided during registration. _*Most of these details can later be updated from the “View Profile” section, except for the fields initially filled during registration._
**Steps for Scheme Application** **Step 1:** After logging in and completing the profile, the system displays schemes relevant to the user on the homepage. Click on the name of the scheme that you intend to apply for. You will be redirected to the online application form of the scheme. The application form is divided into multiple tabs. **Step 2:** In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. For each uploaded document, the corresponding document number must be entered wherever required. Click the “Save & Next” button to proceed to the subsequent tabs. **Step 3:** Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections. Acknowledge and agree to the terms and conditions, declaration, and privacy policy (if any) by ticking the designated checkbox. **Step 4:** Clicking “Save & Next” in the last tab of the application form generates an application number, which is displayed on the screen. The applicant must record this number for future reference.
