metadata.schemeName: Scheme for Integrated Development for Horticulture (HRT-2)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "Scheme for Integrated Development for Horticulture (HRT-2)" aims to promote holistic horticultural growth through financial assistance for production, processing, marketing, and infrastructure support to farmers across Gujarat.

page_content:
# Scheme for Integrated Development for Horticulture (HRT-2) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Horticulture, Farm Mechanization, Greenhouse Subsidy, Crop Protection, Post Harvest Management | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Scheme for Integrated Development for Horticulture (HRT-2)" by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat aims to ensure the integrated development of horticulture in the state by providing financial support to farmers for activities such as post-harvest management, farm mechanization, crop processing, market linkage, and infrastructure development. The scheme enables support for exhibitions, seminars, krishimelas, stall rentals, sea/air fridge subsidy for exports, electricity subsidy for greenhouse and tissue culture labs, and assistance for hi-tech greenhouse/polyhouse/net house development.
## Benefits - **Promotional Activities Support:** Provides assistance for publications, exhibitions, competition seminars, Krishi Mela, and stall rental payments related to horticultural crops. - **Farm Mechanization:** Offers support for farm mechanization, including subsidies for power tillers and mini tractors. - **Processing Unit Establishment:** Facilitates the establishment of new distillation units for medicinal/aromatic crops and new processing units for cashew and other fruit crops. - **Export Subsidies:** Provides sea freight subsidy for the export of fruits, vegetables, flowers, and plants, and air freight subsidy for the export of horticultural produce. - **Market Rate Control:** Supports Minimum Support Price (MSP) to horticultural crops for control of market rates. - **Utility Bill Subsidies:** Offers subsidy on electricity bills for Greenhouse and Tissue Culture Laboratory. - **Equipment Provision:** Aids in the provision of harvesting equipment, processing equipment, and crop protection equipment. - **Post-Harvest Management:** Provides subsidy on packing materials for Post-harvest management of horticultural produce. - **Protected Cultivation Infrastructure:** Supports the establishment of various structures including Hi-tech Greenhouse (Fan and Pad), PolyHouse (Naturally Ventilated), Net House, kaccha mandap of tomato/chili and other vegetable trellises, Half-lined pedal for climber vegetables, Lined pedal for climber vegetables, and Plug Nursery. - **Irrigation Infrastructure:** Supports the establishment of Water storage tanks for Drip Irrigation.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a farmer based in Gujarat. - The applicant should be engaged in horticultural activities eligible under the scheme. - The applicant must possess valid land ownership records such as 7/12 Certificate.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online &gt; **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/) Portal. **Step 2:** Click on &amp;#39;Login&amp;#39; from the top right-hand side, then click on &amp;quot;Beneficiary Registration&amp;quot; and select any one from the &amp;#39;Farmer&amp;#39; or &amp;#39;Institutional&amp;#39; or &amp;#39;Except For the Farmer&amp;#39; as the Beneficiary Type. **Step 3:** Select the District, Taluka, and Village, choose &amp;#39;what type of account holder you are?&amp;#39;, enter your Account Number and Name, solve the Captcha, and click &amp;#39;Save and Next&amp;#39;. **Step 4:** Enter your Mobile Number and Email address, click &amp;#39;Send OTP&amp;#39;, enter the received OTP, create and confirm a Password, solve the Captcha, and click &amp;#39;Submit&amp;#39;. &gt; **Login Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/) Portal. **Step 2:** Click on &amp;#39;Login&amp;#39; from the top right-hand side of the homepage. On the home page, click on ‘Schemes’ and then click on ‘Agricultural Schemes’. **Step 3:** Now select the scheme, click on the ‘Apply’ button, and an application page will open. **Step 4:** Click on the &amp;quot;Apply New&amp;quot; button and submit a new application. **Step 5:** Click on the &amp;quot;Update Application&amp;quot; button to add corrections to the application. **Step 6:** Once the application is done, confirm it. **Step 7:** Take a printout of the confirmed application. &gt; **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_Contacts.aspx).

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance fish production and provide employment through inland fisheries. It offers financial support to construct new grow-out ponds for eligible beneficiaries.

page_content:
# Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Construction of New Grow-out Pond - Gujarat **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Fish Farming, Construction, Ponds, Freshwater Hatcheries | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland)", with the component of Construction of New Grow-out Pond, introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat. Through this scheme, assistance is provided for the construction of new grow-out ponds to individuals and organisations involved in inland fisheries. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State Governments, with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% from the Government of Gujarat.
> **Objective:** - Increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. - Assistance is provided for accelerating inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodies, increasing inland fish production and boosting inland fisheries. - Except for water bodies or ponds, in less land, less water, Biofloc with source as well, Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS). By creating fish tanks with this method, more fish production can be obtained in less land and less water. If more beneficiaries get the benefit of the subsidy of this scheme, more fish production can be achieved with less water sources and less land. - Inland fish production capacity can be increased by the establishment of freshwater hatcheries.
## Benefits > Financial assistance is provided for the Construction of the New Grow-out Pond (PMMSY). The unit cost of the project is ₹7,00,000/- per hectare. - **General Category:** 40% of the unit cost (₹2,80,000/- per hectare).- **Women/Scheduled Caste (SC)/Scheduled Tribe (ST) Category:** 60% of the unit cost (₹4,20,000/- per hectare).
> **Conditions Associated with Benefits:** 60% of the contribution is from the Government of India and 40% from the State Government. > **Frequency of Disbursement:** Once in a lifetime.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be an individual, society, self-help group, association, reservoir lease holder, or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-owners, the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhar Card/Passport as proof of identity.
> **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:** - All categories (General, Women, Scheduled Caste, and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side, then click on "Beneficiary Registration" and select any one from the 'Farmer' or 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. **Step 3:** Enter the 'Company Name' and Address if you have selected 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. And for all select the District, Taluka, and Village, choose 'what type of account holder you are?', enter your Account Number and Name, solve the Captcha, and click 'Save and Next'. **Step 4:** Enter your Mobile Number and E-mail address, click 'Send OTP', enter the received OTP, create and confirm a Password, solve the Captcha, and click 'Submit'.
> **Login Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side of the homepage. On the home page, click on ‘Schemes’ and then click on ‘Agricultural Schemes’. **Step 3:** Now select the scheme, click on the ‘Apply’ button, and an application page will open. **Step 4:** Click on the "Apply New" button and submit a new application. **Step 5:** Click on the "Update Application" button to add corrections to the application. **Step 6:** Once the application is done, confirm it. **Step 7:** Take a printout of the confirmed application.
> **Contact Us:** [**Click here**](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_Contacts.aspx)**.**

metadata.schemeName: "Marketing Incentive" under the "Handloom Marketing Assistance" Component of the National Handloom Development Programme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to develop and promote marketing channels for handloom products to bring greater visibility to the sector and ensure commensurate remuneration to weavers. It provides Marketing Incentive to eligible handloom agencies for creating conducive conditions for marketing handloom products.

page_content:
# "Marketing Incentive" under the "Handloom Marketing Assistance" Component of the National Handloom Development Programme **Ministry:** Ministry Of Textiles | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Marketing, Incentive, Handloom, Weaver, Textile | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Marketing Incentive" under the "Handloom Marketing Assistance" Component of the National Handloom Development Programme by the Ministry of Textiles, Government of India, aims to develop and promote marketing channels in domestic and export markets in a holistic and integrated manner to bring greater visibility to the sector and ensure commensurate remuneration to weavers. The scheme provides Marketing Incentive calculated at 10% on average sales of handloom products of the last 3 years with maximum caps of ₹1,00,00,000/- for state level organizations and ₹15,00,000/- lakh for primary societies, equally shared between State Government and Central Government except for National Level Handloom Organizations where entire assistance is borne by Government of India. The scheme is implemented by the Office of Development Commissioner (Handlooms) under Ministry of Textiles with applications accepted through prescribed proformas and State Government recommendations.
## Benefits > **Financial Assistance Structure** - Marketing Incentive Rate: 10% on average sales of handloom products of the last 3 years. - State Level Organizations: Maximum ₹100.00 lakh (Central Government share). - Primary Level Organizations: Maximum ₹15.00 lakh (Central Government share). > **Category-wise Maximum Caps** - State Level Organizations (Handloom Corporations, Apex Cooperative Societies, National Level Handloom Organizations): ₹1,00,00,000/- Central Government share. - Primary Handloom Weavers Cooperative Societies, Producer Companies, Self Help Groups, Joint Liability Groups, Federations and Other Eligible Handloom Entities: ₹15,00,000/- Central Government share. > **Financial Assistance Sharing** - General Cases: 50:50 sharing between Government of India and State Government. - National Level Handloom Organizations/Societies: Entire assistance borne by Government of India. - Benefit Distribution: 10% benefits shared equally between Organizations and Member Weavers through Direct Benefit Transfer.
> **Mode and Frequency of Disbursement** - Marketing Incentive will be given maximum for 3 years during the scheme period of 5 years. - Release through Direct Benefit Transfer mechanism. - Nodal Agency must release amount to eligible handloom agencies and their member weavers within 7 days of receipt. > **Conditions for Availment/Continuation** - Amount to be used towards activities that attract consumers to gear up overall sales of handloom goods. - Enable handloom agencies to adjust prices towards increasing cost competitiveness, improve designs, and invest in infrastructure. - State Government recommendation subject to matching contribution by concerned State Government. - Claims must be Goods and Services Tax compliant. - No similar incentive/rebate received under any other Central Government scheme.
## Eligibility Criteria The applicant must be one of the following: - Handloom agencies including State level organizations such as Handloom Corporations, Apex Cooperative Societies and National Level Handloom Organizations, Primary Handloom Weavers Cooperative Societies, Producer Companies, Self Help Groups, Joint Liability Groups, Federations and Other eligible Handloom entities. - The applicant must have made the final transaction of product sale to the consumer. - The applicant must use Handloom Mark or India Handloom Brand for their handloom products. - The applicant must have average sales turnover of handloom products for the last 3 years for incentive calculation.
## Exclusions - Sales by one handloom agency to another handloom agency are not eligible. - Sales of handloom products by Primary Handloom Weavers Cooperative Societies or any other Handloom Agency to Apex Societies, Federations, Producer Companies, Corporations are excluded. - Sales by handloom agencies to Government departments/agencies are excluded. - Sales made under barter system by handloom agencies are excluded. - Agencies that have received similar kind of incentive/rebate under any other Central Government scheme are not preferred.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline > **For State Level and Primary Level Organizations** **Step 1:** **Prepare Claim Documentation** Compile sales bills/invoices, yarn purchase bills, and average sales turnover details for the last 3 years ensuring Goods and Services Tax compliance. **Step 2:** **Complete Application Form** Fill the prescribed proforma (Annexure - B8) with all required details including sales data and beneficiary information. **Step 3:** **Submit to State Government** Submit the completed Marketing Incentive claim to the concerned State Government with all supporting documents. **Step 4:** **State Government Verification** State Government will verify claims, ensure matching contribution availability, and complete prescribed certificates (Annexure - B9). **Step 5:** **State Level Project Committee Recommendation** Obtain recommendations from State Level Project Committee for the Marketing Incentive claims. **Step 6:** **State Government Consolidation** State Government prepares consolidated statement, sanction order for state share release, and certificate as per Annexure - B10. **Step 7:** **Nodal Agency Identification** State Government identifies suitable nodal agency for fund aggregation and onward release to eligible agencies. Step 8: Forward to Development Commissioner (Handlooms) State Government forwards verified claims to Office of Development Commissioner (Handlooms) with all required documentation. **Step 9:** **Central Government Processing** Office of Development Commissioner (Handlooms) processes claims and releases Central Government share to identified Nodal Agency. **Step 10:** **Fund Distribution** Nodal Agency releases amount to eligible handloom agencies and their member weavers through Direct Benefit Transfer within 7 days of receipt.
> **For National Level Handloom Organizations** **Step 1:** **Direct Application Preparation** Prepare Marketing Incentive claim with all supporting documents and prescribed proforma (Annexure - B8). **Step 2:** **Submit to Development Commissioner (Handlooms)** Submit claims directly to Office of Development Commissioner (Handlooms) with complete documentation. **Step 3:** **Central Government Processing** Office of Development Commissioner (Handlooms) processes and approves claims for National Level Organizations. **Step 4:** **Direct Release** Marketing Incentive assistance released directly to National Level Handloom Organizations by Government of India.

metadata.schemeName: Pre-Matric Scholarship for the Students of Notified Tribes and Denotified Tribes Castes
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme supports school education by providing annual scholarships to students from Notified Tribes and Denotified Tribes studying in standards 1st to 10th.

page_content:
# Pre-Matric Scholarship for the Students of Notified Tribes and Denotified Tribes Castes **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Student, Notified Tribes, Denotified Tribes Caste | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Pre-Matric Scholarship for the Students of Notified Tribes and Denotified Tribes Castes” was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. It aims to reduce school dropout rates and improve educational access among students belonging to Notified Tribes and Denotified Tribes. Under this scheme, annual financial scholarships are provided to students from classes 1st to 10th studying in government and aided primary schools, ensuring they continue their education without financial hardship.
## Benefits > **Scholarship Amounts:** - Boys (Class 1st to 8th): ₹750/- per annum- Boys (Class 9th to 10th): ₹1,000/- per annum- Girls (Class 1st to 5th): ₹500/- per annum- Girls (Class 6th to 10th): ₹1,000/- per annum
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must belong to Notified Tribes or Denotified Tribes as recognized by the Government of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a student and studying in standard 1st to 10th. 1. The applicant must be studying in a government or government-aided primary or secondary school. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. There is no income limit for students from standard 1st to 8th. 1. The applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹6,00,000/- for classes 9th to 10th.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Application Process:** **Step 01:** The applicant may visit the Digital Gujarat Portal: [https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/) **Step 02:** On the home page, click on ‘Register’ and the applicant will be redirected to the registration form page. **Step 03:** Enter your Mobile Number, Email, Set Password, and then click on ‘Save’. **Step 04:** After successful registration, the applicant can login through his/her User Name (Mobile No./Email ID) and Password. **Step 05:** Now, click on ‘My Profile’ to update your profile and fill in all the mandatory information. **Step 06:** After filling in profile details, click on ‘Update Profile’. The profile will be updated after entering the verification Code (OTP). **Step 07:** Now under services, select ‘Scholarship Services’ and then click on ‘SC Scheme’. **Step 08:** Select the Financial Year for which you want to apply for and then click on ‘Change Financial Year’. **Step 09:** Select the scheme, read the interaction carefully, and then click on ‘Continue to Service’. **Step 10:** Fill in the application form completely and upload all the relevant documents. **Step 11:** Now, click on ‘Save as Draft’ and agree with the terms & conditions, and submit the application form by clicking on ‘Confirm & Final Submit’.
> **Instructions:** **Note 01:** Photo uploading for all applicants is mandatory. Note 02: Application will be considered complete only when all sections are completed. **Note 03:** Only one application per applicant will be acceptable for a scholarship. If any student submits more than one application either from a single institute or from multiple institutions his/her all applications will be rejected by the competent authority and no request from any side will be entertained. **Note 04:** In case of any wrong/misleading information provided in the application shall lead to rejection of the application by Department Authorities. **Note 05:** All required documents must be carefully scanned as per the instructions given. **Note 06:** The student has to fill his/her application carefully as there is no provision for institution change once the application is submitted successfully. **Note 07:** The unreadable uploaded documents will allow the competent authority to reject the student application. **Note 08:** Direct Individual submission of this application form will not be accepted in case of students studying inside the state. Only outside students have to fill out their form online and submit his/her application form to their native district officer. # Scholarship to SC students studying in selected schools under Talentpool Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Scheduled Caste, Students, Meritorious, Residential Schools, Education | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Scholarship to SC students studying in selected schools under Talentpool Scheme" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide the best education to meritorious Scheduled Caste students in high-quality residential schools to help them build their careers and improve their living standards. Through this scheme, financial assistance per student is provided to the meritorious Scheduled Caste students. The scheme targeted 330 students across 33 districts, with 5 meritorious students from Std-5 and 5 from Std-10 from each district. The scheme is implemented by the Office of the concerned District Deputy Director (Ajak).
The following 8 schools have been empanelled out of 15 schools: 1. Late P.U. Chavda Edu. Trust operated Nalanda Vidyalaya Educational Complex, Bhorigada, Amreli. 1. Futurelink School, operated by Gujarat Child Development Board, Vill. Kharedivav, Tal. Jambughoda, Dist. Panchmahal. 1. Shri J.R. Desai School, operated by Gujarat Bal Vikas Mandal, Mora, Morwa, Dist. Panchmahal. 1. Shri Neelkanth Education and Social Welfare Trust, Bayad, Aravalli. 1. Shri Brahmanand Vidya Mandir, Chaparda, operated by Brahmacharishree Bhagwati Nandji Education Trust 1. Satkeval Vidyamandir, Sarsa, run by Gyan Sampradaya Kelavani Trust 1. Chanakya Education and Charitable Trust (Takshashila Vidyalaya), Halvad, Morbi. 1. Nalanda Vidyalaya, run by Shri Swami Vivekananda Education and Welfare Trust, Puna Village, Ta. Choryasi, Surat.

## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste. 1. The applicant should from Standard 5 and Standard 10. 1. (whose income is between ₹2,00,000/- and ₹3,00,000/-, are eligible for 50% assistance). 1. The applicant must be a student.

metadata.schemeName: Protection Against Domestic Violence
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "Protection Against Domestic Violence" by the Women and Child Development Department, Government of Haryana, aims to provide legal, emotional, and social support to women facing domestic violence through grievance redressal, offering protection, counseling, and mediation to victims.

page_content:
# Protection Against Domestic Violence **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Women and Child, Public Safety,Law & Justice | **Tags:** Women Protection, Domestic Violence, Counseling, Mediation | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Protection Against Domestic Violence" by the Women and Child Development Department, Government of Haryana, aims to support women who are subjected to physical, emotional, verbal, sexual, or economic abuse within a domestic relationship. The scheme facilitates timely and confidential intervention by trained counselors and protection officers. Women victims can receive emotional and legal assistance, mediation, and safety measures, including shelter and medical aid where needed. ## Benefits - **Counseling and Mediation Support:** Victims are provided with trained counselors for psychological support and help in mediation between the victim and the perpetrator if required. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. # Testing Equipment Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Business | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Government of Haryana launched the Testing Equipment Assistance Scheme to support Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) in enhancing product quality through financial aid for procuring testing equipment. Eligible units can receive a 50% subsidy, up to ₹5,00,000/- annually, for purchasing new testing equipment.
In order to ensure, Zero Defect‟ in the quality of products to make globally competitive, the Micro and small enterprises have to upgrade the quality of the products for which they are required to create testing facilities for testing of raw-materials and end products. The Micro and Small entrepreneurs find it difficult to purchase the testing equipment's because of limited resources. In order to meet this objective, State Govt. has made provision for Testing Equipment Assistance Scheme.
## Benefits 1. **50% Subsidy on Purchase of Testing Equipment :** - Financial support of 50% of the cost, limited to a maximum of ₹5 lakh per year, for purchase of new testing equipment. 1. **Support for Quality Enhancement** - Assists Micro and Small Enterprises in establishing testing facilities for raw materials and end products to ensure zero defect and global competitiveness. 1. **Encouragement to Upgrade Infrastructure** - Aims to overcome resource constraints faced by MSEs in acquiring essential testing infrastructure.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The unit should have filed Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) and Haryana Udhyam Memorandum (HUM) on the portal for the statistical purpose, at any stage. 1. The unit should not have been placed in the restrictive list as notified by the State Government from time to time. 1. The unit should have obtained NOC/CLU from competent Authority if applicable. 1. The unit should be in commercial production. 1. The unit should be in regular production at the time of disbursement and the subsidy shall not be released to a closed unit. 1. No subsidy shall be admissible on the secondhand Testing Equipment and the equipment shall not be disposed of for 05 years from the date of purchase without approval of Competent Authority. The Joint Director/ Deputy Director, District MSME Centre shall conduct annual inspection of the unit to ensure that Testing Equipment is intact. 1. The Scheme shall commence with effect from 01.01.2021 for the Testing Equipment Assistance and shall remain in operation for a period of 05 years. The assistance shall be admissible on the purchase of testing equipment on or after 01.01.2021 and before 31.12.2025.

metadata.schemeName: Foreign Study Loan
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from non-reserved categories for pursuing higher studies abroad in medical and post-graduation courses. It offers loans up to ₹15,00,000/- at 4% simple interest per annum to eligible students.

page_content:
# Foreign Study Loan **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Education, Loan, Foreign, Student, University | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Foreign Study Loan" implemented by the Gujarat Unreserved Educational and Economical Development Corporation (GUEEDC), Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, provides financial assistance to students from non-reserved categories pursuing higher studies abroad. The scheme provides overseas study loans of up to ₹15,00,000/- for specific courses, including Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery, post-graduation courses (valid even if obtained after diploma), post-graduation diploma, and equivalent courses after Class 12th. To be eligible, the applicant must have scored 60% or more in Class 12 and belong to a family with an annual income of ₹6,00,000/- or less. The loan carries simple interest at the rate of 4% per annum with repayment terms varying based on the loan amount.
## Benefits **Loan Amount:** Up to ₹15,00,000/- for overseas study. **Interest Rate:** Simple interest at 4% per annum. **Repayment Grace Period:** 1 year after completion of study before repayment begins. **Flexible Repayment:** Borrower can repay the loan before the stipulated time limit.
**Repayment Schedule** - For loans up to ₹5,00,000/-: Equal monthly installments over 5 years. - For loans above ₹5,00,000/-: Equal monthly installments over 6 years.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must belong to the non-reserved category. - The applicant must be pursuing higher studies abroad. - The applicant must be enrolled in Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery, post-graduation courses (valid even if obtained after diploma), post-graduation diploma, or equivalent courses after Class 12th. - The applicant must have scored 60% or more in Class 12th. - The applicant must belong to a family with an annual income of ₹6,00,000/- or less.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1: Register on the Official Portal** - Open the [official website](https://gueedc.gujarat.gov.in). Navigate to the “How to Apply” section and select “Foreign Study Loan.”- You will be redirected to the [e-SamajKalyan](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/) Portal. On the home page, under the tab ‘Citizen Login’, click on New User ‘[Please Register Here](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/Registration.aspx)’. Enter your Full Name as per Aadhaar Card, Gender, Date of Birth, Aadhaar Card Number, Email ID, Caste etc. and then click on ‘Register’.- Log in using your credentials once registration is complete. **Step 2: Access and Fill Out the Application Form** - After logging in, locate the application Form. Enter personal, academic, and family information in the respective modules: Name, gender, category, address, educational background, institution details, passport number, family income, occupation of guardians, and bank details (to be used for loan disbursement). - Use dropdown selections in the "Patrata Column" (પાત્રતાની કોલમ) to correctly indicate your eligibility parameters. It is mandatory to select from the dropdown so that your application is processed under the right criteria. **Step 3: Prepare and Upload Required Documents** - Scan and upload clear, legible documents in the upload section. - Ensure each file is within the portal’s size and format limitations (usually PDF, JPEG or PNG) and named properly to avoid confusion during review. **Step 4: Review and Final Submission** - Carefully review each module. Use the preview option to examine the application before final submission. - Save a local PDF copy of the completed form for your records. Click “Final Submit”. **Step 5: Application Verification by GUEEDC** - Upon submission, your application and uploaded documents will be reviewed by GUEEDC officials. - You may be contacted via phone or email if: Any clarification is required, Additional documents are needed, or Corrections must be made. - Maintain active communication channels and respond promptly to any such requests. **Loan Sanction and Disbursement** - If the application is accepted, a formal sanction letter will be issued. - You may be asked to sign an agreement accepting the terms and repayment conditions of the loan. - The sanctioned loan amount will be disbursed directly into your verified bank account. - If any post-sanction verification or usage confirmation is required, comply as per instructions provided by GUEEDC.

metadata.schemeName: Educational Loan Scheme (GBCDC)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial support to students from socially and educationally backward classes for higher technical and professional education. It offers loans at concessional interest rates for approved graduate and postgraduate courses like engineering, medical, MBA, MCA, and more.

page_content:
# Educational Loan Scheme (GBCDC) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Student, Graduate, Post Graduate, Professional Education, Technical Education, Backward Classes, Loan | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Educational Loan Scheme" is implemented by the Gujarat Backward Classes Development Corporation (GBCDC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial support for higher technical and professional education to students belonging to belonging to socially and educationally backward classes. Under this scheme, loans are provided at concessional interest rates to eligible students pursuing approved graduate and postgraduate professional & technical courses in fields such as engineering, medical, MBA, MCA, etc.
## Benefits 1. The maximum loan limit under this scheme is up to ₹ 15,00,000/-. 2. **The interest rate:** - 4% per annum for male students. - 3.5% per annum for female students. 3. **Loan Contribution Breakdown:** - 90% by the National Corporation. - 5% by the State Government. - 5% by the beneficiary. 4. **The loan amount will include the following:** - Admission fees and tuition fees - Accommodation and food expenses > **Validity:** This loan is to be repaid in 60 equal monthly instalments, including interest. The loan must be repaid within 6 months of completing the course or 1 month after getting a job, whichever is earlier.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to a socially and educationally backward class. 1. The total annual family income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The student must have secured admission through a recognized entrance examination conducted by the Central or State Government, or through a selection process, with at least 50% marks in Class 12 or the qualifying examination. 1. The applicant should have secured admission in a recognized institution for one of the following courses: - MBA or its equivalent (recognized by AICTE) - Master of Computer Applications (MCA) or its equivalent (recognized by AICTE) - Graduate-level engineering courses conducted by IITs or other institutions (recognized by AICTE) - Medical or allied education such as Ayurvedic, Homeopathy, Unani, etc., from institutions recognized by the Medical Council of India - Diploma course in Hospitality Management recognized by the National Council of Hotel Management > **Note:** Priority will be given to applicants whose family income is up to ₹1,50,000/- per annum.
## Exclusions 1. The applicant admitted under the management quota is not eligible. 1. The applicant with ATKT (Allowed to Keep Terms) or those who have failed in the previous semester will not be paid the fee for the second semester. 1. The loan amount will be sanctioned after deducting the amount received under the Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](https://gbcdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) of the Gujarat Backwards Caste Development Corporation. **Step 2:** On the top menu bar, click on "Apply Online". **Step 3:** If you’re a new user, click on "New Registration" Enter personal details (name, mobile number, email, aadhaar number, etc.), create a password, and complete OTP verification. **Step 4:** Use your registered credentials (User ID and password) to log in. **Step 5:** Click on “New Application”. Select “Educational Loan Scheme” from the list of available schemes. **Step 6:** Fill out the Application Form, enter the following details: - **Personal Information:** Name, gender, date of birth, caste, etc.- **Address Information:** Permanent and correspondence address- **Income Details:** Monthly family income and source- **Loan Requirement:** Amount needed, proposed use (e.g., business, self-employment)- **Bank Account Details**: For loan disbursement **Step 7:** Upload scanned copies of the Caste certificate, Income certificate, Aadhaar card, Passport-size photo, Bank passbook (first page), and Residence proof. **Step 8:** Double-check all details. Click on “Preview” to verify. If all details are correct, click “Submit”. **Step 9:** The Applicant will receive an Application ID/Reference Number. Save or print the acknowledgement for future tracking.

metadata.schemeName: Pashupalan (GBCDC)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide an amount for animal husbandry activities. Low-interest loans are provided to Pashu Palaks.

page_content:
# Pashupalan (GBCDC) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Cow, Buffalo, Agriculture Activities, Loan | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Pashupalan (GBCDC)" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, owned by the Centre and the Gujarat Government, aims to provide financial assistance for agriculture-related activities. Through this scheme, a low-interest loan amount is provided to support Pashu Palaks (Animal Rearers) in undertaking animal husbandry activities such as purchasing cows and buffaloes. The scheme's core objective is to offer financial aid at low-interest rates, supporting eligible individuals from socially and educationally backwards classes.
## Benefits 1. **Low-Interest Loan:** A loan is provided at an interest rate of 6 per cent per annum.1. **Maximum Loan Limit:** The maximum loan limit in this scheme is up to ₹1,00,000/-.1. **Unit Cost Coverage:** 85 per cent of the unit cost will be loaned. - Out of this 85 per cent, 85 per cent will be from the national corporation. - 10 per cent will be from the state government. - 5 per cent will be from the beneficiary's contribution.
> **Intended Use:** The loan is for agriculture-related activities, specifically animal husbandry (cow-buffalo). > **Repayment Terms:** This loan is to be repaid in 60 equal monthly instalments, including interest.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be from a Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC). 1. The total annual income of the applicant's family should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 and 45 years on the date of application. 1. The applicant must have experience in a business requiring technical and other skills.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1: Visit the Official Website:** Go to the [[Official Website](https://ggdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) Gujarat Backwards Caste Development Corporation.](https://gbcdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) **Step 2: Locate and Apply for Scheme:** Scroll down on the homepage, find the "Pashupalan," and click on "Apply Now". **Step 3:** **Access Application Form:** You will be directed to the [application form](https://gbcdconline.gujarat.gov.in/SchemePasupalan/AddEdit). **Step 4: Scheme Selection & Loan Details:** Select "Pashupalan", enter Unit Cost, and specify the Required Loan Amount. **Step 5: Applicant's Details:** Provide Aadhaar, Ration, Voter ID, full name (Last, First, Father/Husband), address, district, taluka, village, PIN, date of birth, age (21-45 as of 14/08/2023), caste, subcaste, phone, mobile, email, gender, and marital status. **Step 6: Income Details:** Enter income certificate number, issue date, issuing officer's name, total annual family income (up to ₹ 3,00,000/-), and parent/guardian's occupation. **Step 7: Disability Details (if applicable):** If "Physically Handicapped," select "Yes" or "No". If you selected "Yes", provide the percentage (in %). **Step 8: Employment Details (if applicable):** Indicate if any family member works in a government or private job. If "Yes," provide their Name, Designation, Place, and Salary details. **Step 9: Educational Qualification:** Select your Education Qualification: Uneducated, Educated, Graduation, Post Graduation, or Other Degree. **Step 10: Loan History:** If you have taken a past loan, select "Yes" or "No". If you selected "Yes" provide loan details (date, amount, paid, remaining) and your account number. **Step 12: Bank Account Details:** Provide bank account number, bank name, branch name, name as per account, account type (Saving/Current), MICR code, and IFSC code. **Step 13: Submission:** Click the "Submit" button to complete your application.

metadata.schemeName: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (for women only) GNTDNT
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to create self-employment for women of nomadic and denotified castes and support women entrepreneurs doing independent business. Through this scheme, microfinance is provided to women beneficiaries to pursue a business/occupation of their choice.

page_content:
# Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (for women only) GNTDNT **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Women and Child | **Tags:** Entrepreneurs, Self Employment, Business, Micro Finance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Mahila Samriddhi Yojana" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to create a microfinance scheme for women of target groups and women entrepreneurs doing independent business to create self-employment for women of nomadic and denotified castes. Under this scheme, women beneficiaries will be able to pursue a business/occupation of their choice. Gujarat Nomadic and Denotified Castes Development Corporation implement the scheme.
## Benefits 1. The maximum loan limit will be up to ₹1,25,000/-. 1. The interest rate will be 4% per annum. 1. Under this scheme, 100% loan of the business/occupation amount is provided. 1. The loan amount will consist of 95% National Corporation contribution, 5% State Government contribution and zero beneficiary contribution. > **Repayment:** The loan amount will have to be repaid in 48 equal monthly instalments, including interest.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a woman from a Nomadic or Denotified Caste. 1. The annual income limit of the family for income eligibility will be up to ₹3,00,000/- with effect from 1/4/2018. At least 50 percent of the total loan amount will be allocated for families having an annual income of up to ₹1,50,000/-. 1. The applicant's age should be at least 21 years and not more than 50 years as on the date of application. 1. The applicant must have experience in a technical and skilled trade/business. 1. The applicant will have to provide suitable collateral to get the loan.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1: Visit the Official Portal** - Go to the [Official Website](https://gndcdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) Gujarat Nomadic and Denotified Tribes Development Corporation. - Scroll down on the homepage, find the "Mahila Samriddhi Yojana" and click on "Apply Now". - You will be directed to the application form. **Step 2: Access and Fill Out the Application Form** - Complete all sections under "Applicant information," including full name, father/husband's name, gender, complete address details, contact numbers, Aadhaar No., parents/husband/guardian occupation and income details. metadata.schemeName: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (GTKVN)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to empower women entrepreneurs from Thakor & Koli communities by providing access to micro-loans for self-employment. Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of low-interest loans is provided to eligible beneficiaries to set up small businesses based on their skills.

page_content:
# Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (GTKVN) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Women and Child, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Self-Employment, Business, Thakor Caste, Loan, Woman, Koli Caste | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Mahila Samriddhi Yojana" is implemented by the Gujarat Thakor and Koli Vikas Nigam (GTKVN) under the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to empower women entrepreneurs from the Thakor and Koli communities by providing access to micro-loans for self-employment. Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of low-interest loans is provided to eligible women beneficiaries to help them set up small businesses or trades based on their skills.
## Benefits - **Maximum Loan Amount:** Up to ₹60,000/-.- **Interest Rate:** 4% per annum.- **Loan Coverage:** Up to 100% of the loan will be given for the proposed business/trade.- **Repayment:** The loan amount will have to be repaid in 48 equal monthly installments (4 years) including interest.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a woman from Thakor or Koli caste. 1. The applicant should be between 21 to 50 years of age at the time of application. 1. The applicant’s annual family income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant should have relevant technical skills and experience in the proposed trade/business. 1. The applicant will have to provide suitable collateral to get the loan. > **Note:** At least 50% of the total loan amount will be allocated for families with annual income up to ₹1,50,000/-.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](https://gtkdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) of the Gujarat Thakor and Koli Vikas Nigam. **Step 2:** On the top menu bar, click on "Apply Now". **Step 3:** Click on the loan scheme name. **Step 4:** Select the loan category and fill in the loan amount. **Step 5:** Fill out the Application Form, enter the following details: - Personal Information: Name, gender, date of birth, caste, etc. - Address Information: Permanent and correspondence address - Income Details: Monthly family income and source - Loan Requirement: Amount needed, proposed use (e.g., business, self-employment) - Bank Account Details: For loan disbursement **Step 6:** Upload scanned copies of the Caste certificate, Income certificate, Aadhaar card, Passport-size photo, Bank passbook (first page), and Residence proof. **Step 7:** Double-check all details. Click on “Preview” to verify. If all details are correct, click “Submit”. **Step 8:** Applicant will receive an Application ID/Reference Number. Save or print the acknowledgement for future tracking.

# Pre-Matric Scholarship for the Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Class **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Backward Class, Primary School Students, Secondary School Students, Financial Assistance, Scholarship | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Pre-Matric Scholarship for the Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Class" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance to promote education among socially and educationally backwards students. Through this scheme, scholarships per annum are provided to boys and girls studying in Standards 1 to 10 in government and aided schools. The scheme is implemented by the Director, Developing Caste Welfare, Gandhinagar, Gujarat.
## Benefits 1. **For Boys (Std. 1 to 8):** ₹750/- scholarship.1. **For Boys (Std. 9 to 10):** ₹1000/- scholarship.1. **For Girls (Std. 1 to 5):** ₹500/- scholarship.1. **For Girls (Std. 6 to 10):** ₹1000/- scholarship.

metadata.schemeName: Handicraft Rebate Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides 5–20% rebates on sales of handicraft goods to cooperatives, with higher incentives for women-led groups and during festivals. Applications are submitted online via e-Kutir.

page_content:
# Handicraft Rebate Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Handicraft, Rebate, Festival, Artisan, Women | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Handicraft Rebate Scheme" launched by the Commissioner of Cottage and Rural Industries, Government of Gujarat, aims to support artisans and cooperatives by providing financial rebates on the sale of handicrafts. The scheme offers a 5% permanent rebate on retail sales and an additional 10% special rebate during festivals (totaling 15–20% for women-led cooperatives). Implemented via the e-Kutir portal, it ensures transparency through an e-voucher system for toolkit distribution and rebate disbursement. The scheme targets industrial cooperatives, apex societies, and women-led groups, promoting market competitiveness and artisan welfare.
## Benefits **Permanent Rebate:** - 5% on retail sales of handicraft. - 15% for women-led cooperatives. **Special Festival Rebate:** - Additional 10% (total 15% for general cooperatives, 20% for women-led groups) for 120 days during festivals. **Targeted Support:** - Enhanced rebates for Scheduled Castes/Tribes and BPL artisans.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a registered cooperative society, apex institution, or women-led group. - The applicant must produce handicrafts. - The applicant must obtain prior rebate certification from the Commissionerate.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Steps for New Registration** **Step 1:** Visit the [eKutir portal](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in). In the right pane of the landing page, click "[For New Individual Registration, click Here](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in/Registration.aspx)". **Step 2:** On the registration page, fill in all mandatory fields (marked with an asterisk): Full Name (in English), Aadhaar Card Number, Gender, Date of Birth, Mobile Number, E-mail, Password (confirm the password by typing it again). Fill in the Captcha Code, and click "Register". **Step 3:** A confirmation pop-up will display the entered name, mobile number, and other details. If all the details are correct, click "Confirm" to proceed. If any information is incorrect, click "Cancel", make the necessary corrections, and then click "Register" again. **Step 4:** Upon successful registration, the User ID and Password will be sent to your registered mobile number via SMS. If an email address has been provided, the credentials will also be sent via email.
**Steps for Login Procedure and User Profile Update** **Step 1:** Visit the [eKutir portal](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in). In the right pane of the landing page (in the "Login to Portal" section), provide your User ID, Password, and the Captcha Code. Then click "Login". **Step 2:** Upon first login, the user must complete the "User Profile" by providing personal and organisational details. All fields marked with an asterisk are mandatory. Some fields will already be pre-filled based on the information provided during registration. _*Most of these details can later be updated from the “View Profile” section, except for the fields initially filled during registration._
**Steps for Scheme Application** **Step 1:** After logging in and completing the profile, the system displays schemes relevant to the user on the homepage. Click on the name of the scheme that you intend to apply for. You will be redirected to the online application form of the scheme. The application form is divided into multiple tabs. **Step 2:** In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. For each uploaded document, the corresponding document number must be entered wherever required. Click the “Save & Next” button to proceed to the subsequent tabs. **Step 3:** Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections. Acknowledge and agree to the terms and conditions, declaration, and privacy policy (if any) by ticking the designated checkbox. **Step 4:** Clicking “Save & Next” in the last tab of the application form generates an application number, which is displayed on the screen. The applicant must record this number for future reference. If the applicant wishes to print the application, they may click the “Print Application” button. _*If you do not wish to continue with the application at that point, you may click "Cancel"._
**Application Printing and Modification** - If the user wishes to print the application, they may click “Print Application.” - If the application has been returned for revision, a “Modify” button will appear. The user can then edit the application and resubmit it.
**Helpdesk/Grievance Redressal** - Call 9909926280 / 9909926180. - Connect with the [District Industries Centre (DIC)](https://www.cottage.gujarat.gov.in/Home-2140795B5D2D-282472282472-2824725B5D2D) of your district.
**Check Application Status** Visit the [Application Status](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in/ViewApplicationStatus.aspx) page Provide the Application Number of the scheme, and your Date of Birth. Then click "View Status".

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure long-term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and to incentivize manufacturers to move from Crush, Tear, Curl tea to Orthodox tea production. page_content:
# "Agricultural Income Tax Holiday" under the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme" **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Assam | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Holiday, Tea, Income Tax, Incentive, Industry | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched in 2020, the scheme "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme (ATISIS)" by the Finance (Institutional Finance) Department, Government of Assam, aims to ensure long-term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and to incentivize manufacturers to move from Crush, Tear, Curl tea to Orthodox tea production. The scheme is implemented by the Finance Department and the Industries & Commerce Department, Government of Assam, through multiple implementing agencies, including banks and the District Industries & Commerce Centre. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through a dedicated portal with a Direct Benefit Transfer mechanism for reimbursement.
## Benefits **Benefit Period:** 3 years of Agricultural Income Tax holiday. **Applicable Financial Years:** 2022-23 to 2024-25. **Condition:** Returns must be filed within the due date; if not filed on the due date, interest and penalty will be applicable.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a tea plantation across all sizes. - The applicant must be a tea manufacturing unit manufacturing Crush, Tear, Curl Tea, Orthodox Tea, or Speciality tea including Green tea, Oolong Tea, White tea, Yellow tea and Purple tea. - The applicant must be located entirely in Assam. - The applicant must not have any part of the plantation or manufacturing facility located outside the State of Assam.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Registration Process** **Step 1:** Visit the [dedicated portal](https://atisis.assam.gov.in/atsisver/login.html) of "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives" Scheme. Click on the "New User Registration" option. **Step 2:** In the registration form, fill in basic details including name, mobile number, and email address. Create a username and password following the portal's password policy. Verify your mobile number through one-time password verification. Complete Captcha Code verification. Submit the registration form. **Step 3:** Check your registered email for the account activation link. Click on the activation link to activate the account. Log in to the portal using registered credentials. **Step 4:** Upload all supporting documents of eligibility in the prescribed format. Fill in complete unit details, including location, type of tea production, and capacity. Submit the unit registration form. Wait for registration approval.
**Application Process** **Step 1:** Log in to the portal using registered credentials. Navigate to the "Apply for Benefits" section. Select the scheme component that you intend to apply for. **Step 2:** Fill in the prescribed application form with all mandatory fields. Upload all supporting documents as mentioned in the portal. Ensure file formats and file size restrictions are followed as per the portal guidelines. Review all entered information for accuracy. **Step 3:** Upload documents in the specified format and size. Ensure all documents are clear and legible. Complete document verification checklist. **Step 4:** Review the complete application before submission. Apply online. _*Note down the application reference number. Save a copy of the submitted application form._ _*Applicants are strongly encouraged to save a copy of the submitted application, confirmation message, and application reference number for future reference and tracking purposes._
**Application Status Tracking** Log in to the portal to check application status. Track application progress through different stages of verification. Receive Short Message Service alerts throughout the process, including registration, fund release, etc. _*For Technical Support, please write to atisis.assam@gmail.com._
**Disbursement Process** The Finance Department releases the benefit directly to the beneficiary's bank account. Short Message Service alerts sent for funds disbursement. The beneficiary receives the Direct Benefit Transfer in a registered bank account.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for technical and non-technical education that creates employment or job opportunities for beneficiaries. Through this scheme, loans are provided to eligible students from minority communities for studies within India and abroad.

page_content:
# Educational Loan Scheme (GMFDC) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Higher Education, Loan, Abroad Study, Minority | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Educational Loan Scheme" is implemented by the Gujarat Minorities Finance and Development Corporation (GMFDC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance in the form of loans for all types of education, including various technical and non-technical courses, that help beneficiaries gain employment or enhance their job prospects. Under this scheme, low-interest loans are offered to eligible students from minority communities to pursue graduate and postgraduate courses in technical, vocational, professional, and medical fields, either in India or abroad.
## Benefits 1. For studies within India, a maximum loan of ₹1,50,000/- per year and up to ₹7,50,000/- for a five-year course can be obtained. 1. For medical courses within India, ₹2,50,000/- for 1 year and ₹12,50,000/- for 5 years can be obtained. 1. For abroad studies, a maximum loan of ₹3,00,000/- for 1 year and ₹15,00,000/- for 5 years is provided. 1. The annual interest rate on this loan is 3%. **Note 1:** If the applicant’s annual family income is up to ₹98,000 in rural areas or ₹1,20,000 in urban areas, the loan is provided at a concessional interest rate of 3% per annum. **Note 2:** According to the National Corporation's Credit Line-2, for families with an income of ₹1,20,000/- up to ₹8,00,000, the interest rate is 5% for female students and 8% for male students. **Note 3:** The loan and interest amount is to be repaid in 60 equal monthly installments within five years from the date of completion of studies or from the date of getting a job, whichever is earlier. **Note 4:** Penalty interest at the rate of 2% is payable on delayed payments.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to a minority religious community (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Jain, Buddhist, Parsi, and Jewish) or a linguistic community (Sindhi, Marathi, Urdu) of Gujarat State. 1. The applicant or any family member should not have received a loan from Gujarat Minorities Finance and Development Corporation Limited, Gujarat Backward Class Development Corporation, Gandhinagar, or any other central/state government corporation/institution or bank. 1. The annual income of the applicant's family should be: - ₹98,000/- for rural areas. - ₹1,20,000/- for urban areas. - However, families with income exceeding ₹1,20,000/- and up to ₹8,00,000/- are also eligible, albeit with different interest rates 5. The applicant's age should be between 16 and 32 years.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration** **Step 1:** Visit the Gujarat Minority Finance and Development Corporation [official website](https://gmfdconline.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Register as a new user with name, mobile number, email, Aadhaar number, and create a password. **Step 3:** In the form, provide all the mandatory fields, fill in the captcha code, and click "Submit" to complete the registration process. A pop-up will appear acknowledging successful registration and displaying your User ID for Login. > **Application** **Step 1:** Visit the Gujarat Minority Finance and Development Corporation [official website](https://gmfdconline.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Log in using your registered credentials. Select the Education Loan Scheme from the available schemes. **Step 3:** Fill in personal details, income information, business details, and bank account details. **Step 4:**[ ](https://gmfdconline.gujarat.gov.in/)Upload required documents: Identity Proof, Address Proof, Income Certificate, Minority Certificate, Educational Qualification Certificate, and Bank Passbook. **Step 5:** You will be taken to the online application form of the scheme. In the form, provide all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. **Step 6:** Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make corrections, if any. **Step 7:** Click "Submit" to submit your application. You'll receive a confirmation message. Note down your Application Number for future reference. You can also take a printout of the submitted application form. > **Track Application Status** **Step 1:** Visit the Gujarat Minority Finance and Development Corporation [official website](https://gmfdconline.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Navigate to the bottom of the home page, and click "Your Application Status". **Step 3:** On the next page, provide your Application Number, Date of Birth, and click "View Status". The current status of your application will be displayed. > **Contact:** > For any assistance, contact 079-23253843, 23254583, 23253757 or email md-gmfdcl@gujarat.gov.in.

The scheme aims to promote self-employment among individuals from the minority communities by providing financial assistance for agriculture and allied activities, small-scale businesses, craftsmanship, transport sector, traditional occupations, and service-based businesses/trades. Under this scheme, beneficiaries can avail loans at concessional interest rates to purchase equipment, raw materials, or working capital.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "Retired Sportsperson Pension Scheme" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat aims to ensure financial security to retired state-level medal-winning sportspersons aged above 50 years through monthly pension assistance.

page_content:
# Retired Sportsperson Pension Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Sport, Retired Sportsperson, Pension, Athletes | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Retired Sportsperson Pension Scheme" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat aims to recognize and support the contributions of state-level sportspersons who have won medals in national-level sports events by offering them a financial pension after the age of 50 years. The scheme ensures dignified post-retirement sustenance for these individuals, thereby encouraging younger generations to pursue sports professionally. The scheme is implemented by the Sports Authority of Gujarat.


## Benefits - **Financial Assistance:** A Pension of ₹3,000/- per month.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a male. - The applicant should be a sportsperson. - The applicant should be aged above 50 years at the time of application. - The applicant should have won medals in national-level sports competitions representing the state.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant should download the prescribed format of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, provide all the mandatory details, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the supporting documents to the Commissioner of Youth Services and Cultural Activities Office. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. > **Commissioner, Youth Services and Cultural Activities Office,** > **Block No. 11, 3rd Floor, Dr. Jivraj Mehta Bhavan,** > **Gandhinagar, 382010.**

metadata.schemeName: Handicraft Mela Participation
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme enables artisans and handicraft organizations to participate in government-sponsored melas across Gujarat and other states, fostering market access and preserving traditional crafts. Benefits include subsidized stall fees, promotional support, sales opportunities for handmade products.

page_content:
# Handicraft Mela Participation **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Handicraft, Exhibition, Artisan, SHG, Embroidery, Pottery | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Handicraft Mela Participation" by the Industrial Extension Cottage (iNDEXT-C), Industries & Mines Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to promote traditional handicrafts by providing artisans and organizations with platforms to showcase and sell their products at state and national-level fairs. The scheme facilitates participation in designated melas (fairs) by covering logistical support and stall allocations. Eligible applicants include individual artisans, self-help groups (SHGs), and registered handicraft organizations. The scheme is implemented by Indext-C (Industrial Extension Bureau, Gujarat), and applications are accepted offline through district offices or the Indext-C portal. ## Benefits **Stall Allocation:** Free or subsidized stalls at designated melas. **Promotional Support:** Marketing and branding assistance for participants. **Sales Platform:** Direct access to customers and bulk buyers. **Logistical Aid:** Basic infrastructure (tables, signage) provided at mela venues. **Financial Incentives:** Priority for artisans from SC/ST/SEBC/EWS categories. ## Eligibility Criteria **For Individual Artisans** - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must possess a valid Artisan ID Card issued by Indext-C or a recognized authority. - The applicant must specialize in a traditional handicraft listed under the scheme (e.g., embroidery, pottery, woodwork).
**For Organizations/SHGs** - The applicant must be a registered cluster/cooperative society/NGO. - The applicant must have a minimum of 10 artisans affiliated with the organization. - The applicant must submit audit reports and registration certificates. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://craftofgujarat.gujarat.gov.in/Documents/SubDeal__2025-2-13_96.pdf) of the application form from the Indext-C website. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields ( personal/organization details, artisan ID, and handicraft category, etc), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form, along with the documents, either to your nearest [District Industries Office](https://www.cottage.gujarat.gov.in/Home-2140795B5D2D-282472282472-2824725B5D2D) or to the following address: **Indext-C Headquarters, Industrial Extension Cottage, Block No. 7, 1st Floor, Udyog Bhavan, Sector-11, Gandhinagar - 382 011.** The Indext-C will review the applications and notify the selected participants via SMS/email.

metadata.schemeName: PMMSY: Live Fish Vending Centres Scheme - Haryana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support fishers by providing financial assistance for live fish vending centers. A subsidy per unit is provided under PMMSY.

page_content:
# PMMSY: Live Fish Vending Centres Scheme - Haryana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Fish Farmer, Transportation, Subsidy, Marketing | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Live Fish Vending Center" Scheme was launched by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY). It aims to promote hygienic fish vending and improve fish transportation and marketing infrastructure. Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of a subsidy is provided for setting up a live fish vending center, which may be a fixed center, mobile unit, or a combination of both.
## Benefits **Monetary Benefit:** - Financial assistance of ₹20,00,000/- per unit for setting up a live fish vending center. - Subsidy of 40% of unit cost for general category beneficiaries. - Subsidy of 60% of unit cost for Scheduled Caste and women beneficiaries.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a fisherman. 1. The applicant must have a valid Family Identity Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant should be engaged in fishery-related activities. 1. The applicant must ensure proper operation and maintenance of the vending center. 1. The applicant will receive assistance for only one live fish vending center. 1. The government will not be responsible for any operational loss or damage. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number & password. Fill in the required credentials and click on the ‘Login’ button. **Step 3:** In the opened window, click on “Scheme/Services list”, and a list of schemes will appear on the screen. **Step 4:** Now, select the scheme and click on “Apply for Service/Scheme”. **Step 5:** Fill in all the details in the online application form and click on "Submit".

metadata.schemeName: Mill Gate Price Subsidy Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides 15% subsidy on yarn purchases from NHDC depots to handloom weavers, cooperatives, and NGOs, along with freight reimbursement (1–8.5%). Intended beneficiaries include weavers below the poverty line.

page_content:
# Mill Gate Price Subsidy Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Yarn, Subsidy, Silk, Jute, Freight, Handloom | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched in 2007, the "Mill Gate Price Subsidy Scheme", implemented by the Commissioner of Cottage and Rural Industries, Industries & Mines Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide quality yarn at subsidized rates to handloom weavers, ensuring affordability and improved product quality. The scheme offers freight reimbursement (1–8.5% based on yarn type and region) and a 15% subsidy on yarn purchases from NHDC-recognized depots. Eligible beneficiaries include handloom cooperatives, NGOs, and development centers. The scheme is implemented through District Industries Centers (DICs) and aims to sustain employment for economically weak weavers, especially from Scheduled Castes. ## Benefits **Yarn Purchase Subsidy** 15% subsidy on yarn bought from NHDC-recognized depots.
**Freight Reimbursement** - Non-Silk/Jute Yarn: Plain Area: 1.00%, Hills/Remote: 1.75%, North-East: 3.00% - Silk Yarn: Plain Area: 1.00%, Hills/Remote: 1.25%, North-East: 1.50% - Jute/Jute Blended Yarn: Plain Area: 7.00%, Hills/Remote: 8.00%, North-East: 8.50% _*Additional 2.5% depot operating charges._
**Disbursement Mode** 15% subsidy credited via RTGS/e-payment. Freight reimbursement is processed separately. ## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a handloom cooperative society, NGO, or development center. - The applicant must purchase yarn from NHDC-recognized depots (e.g., Gujarat State Handloom & Handicrafts Development Corporation). ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should first purchase the yarn from NHDC-recognized depots (e.g., 12 depots in Surendranagar, 1 in Ahmedabad). **Step 2:** Visit the District Industries Centre (DIC) of his district, and request the hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the designated staff. **Step 3:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the designated staff at the DIC. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned staff to whom the application has been submitted.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the establishment of new freshwater finfish hatcheries. Through this scheme, financial assistance in the form of subsidies is provided to beneficiaries for setting up these hatcheries.

page_content:
# PMMSY: Establishment of New Freshwater Fin Fish Hatcheries-Haryana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Subsidy, Setting Up, Hatcheries | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana: Establishment of New Freshwater Fin Fish Hatcheries" by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to support the establishment of new freshwater finfish hatcheries. Through this scheme, financial assistance in the form of subsidies is provided to beneficiaries for setting up these hatcheries.

## Benefits > The project cost for one unit is ₹25,00,000/-. - The subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for beneficiaries belonging to the General Category. - The subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for beneficiaries belonging to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category or women beneficiaries.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The freshwater finfish hatchery should have a minimum capacity of 15 million fry per year per unit or 6.00 crore spawn per year per unit. 1. The hatchery should have a minimum area of 0.50 hectares. 1. The fish hatchery should be managed by qualified technical staff. 1. The applicant will ensure the supply of seed produced from the centrally assisted hatcheries to farmers at an affordable and reasonable price. 1. The fish hatchery will include a brooder pond, nursery ponds, rearing tanks, a small laboratory, water and electric supply, and required infrastructure facilities. 1. The cost of accreditation of the hatchery must be mandatorily included in the project estimates. 1. The projects having land on long-term registered lease will also be considered for Central financial assistance under the scheme. 1. The lease period or agreement shall not be less than a minimum period of 10 years. 1. The applicant, having their own land, must furnish revenue records with a clear land title. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details, i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number & password.
