metadata.briefDescription: This scheme provides capital subsidy for setting up fish feed plants with a minimum production capacity of 100 tons per day, under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) to general , schedule caste and women beneficiaries .

page_content:
# PMMSY: Fish Feed Plants of Production Capacity of at least 100 Ton/Day - Haryana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Business & Entrepreneurship, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Fish, Affordable Feed, Capital Subsidy, FFPO | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Fish Feed Plants of Production Capacity of at least 100 Ton/Day, introduced by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to provide capital subsidy for setting up fish feed plants with a minimum production capacity of 100 tons per day. The objective is to enhance the availability of high-quality and affordable feed for fish farmers, supporting the expansion of aquaculture in Haryana. This is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, under which the project is jointly funded by the Central and State Governments: 50% of the subsidy amount is contributed by the Central Government, and 50% is provided by the State Government. Beneficiaries are expected to operate and maintain the plant independently and ensure the supply of feed to fishers at affordable prices.
## Benefits - The project cost is ₹650,00,000/- > **Subsidy Distribution :** 1. A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category. 1. A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant must own land or hold a registered lease of at least 10 years. 1. The applicant must be willing to operate, maintain, and manage the feed plant after its construction. 1. The applicant must ensure that the feed plant provides an affordable feed supply to fishers and fish farmers. 1. The applicant must submit a valid Detailed Project Report (DPR) or Self-Contained Proposal (SCP) in accordance with PMMSY guidelines. 1. The applicant must hold a valid training certificate relevant to feed mill operation and maintenance. 1. The applicant must ensure that the land is free from legal disputes and must provide a valid land title. ## Exclusions

metadata.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Medium Scale Ornamental Fish Rearing Unit (Fresh Water) - Haryana
metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of a subsidy is provided to eligible beneficiaries for setting up infrastructure such as sheds, breeding units, and rearing and culture tanks for ornamental fish.

page_content:
# Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Medium Scale Ornamental Fish Rearing Unit (Fresh Water) - Haryana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Fish Production, Fish, Fish Farmer, Subsidy, Ornamental Aquaculture, Fish Rearing Unit, Fresh Water | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Subsidy for Medium Scale Ornamental Fish Rearing Unit (Fresh Water)” is a scheme component under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY), implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. This Centrally Sponsored Scheme aims to promote ornamental fish farming as a sustainable livelihood option. Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of a subsidy is provided to eligible beneficiaries for setting up infrastructure such as sheds, breeding units, and rearing and culture tanks for ornamental fish. The assistance will be provided to beneficiaries who own a minimum of 150 square meters of vacant land with an adequate fresh water facility.
## Benefits **Tangible Benefits:** - Project Cost: ₹8,00,000/- per unit - Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for General Category applicant. - Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Scheduled Caste (SC)/Women beneficiaries.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID). 1. The applicant should have at least 150 square meters of vacant land with adequate water supply. 1. The applicant should either own the land or possess a registered lease deed valid for at least 7 years.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number & password. metadata.schemeName: State Art Exhibition Competition
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "State Art Exhibition Competition" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat aims to promote fine arts and recognize artistic talents by providing awards and scholarships to artists, art students, and school children across Gujarat.

page_content:
# State Art Exhibition Competition **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** State Art Exhibition, Fine Arts Competition, Awards, Cash Prize, Artist Scholarship | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "State Art Exhibition Competition" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat aims to encourage and appreciate the creative pursuits of artists, art students, and school children through state-level art exhibitions and competitions in disciplines like painting, sculpture, graphic arts, applied arts, and visual arts. Participants are invited through public advertisements in newspapers, and entries are judged by expert panels. Winners receive cash prizes, certificates, and an opportunity to exhibit their work at the Ravi Shankar Rawal Kala Bhavan. Prize-winning art institute students are also eligible for a monthly scholarship. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Fine Arts Academy. 2 entries each from artists and students of art institutions and a maximum of 14 entries from classes 1 to 5 and 14 entries from classes 6 to 10 from a school are invited through the school in a prescribed format.
## Benefits - **Artists Category:** 23 prizes totaling ₹1,74,500/-. - **Art Institute Students Category:** 16 prizes totaling ₹48,000/-. - **School Children Category:** 50 prizes totaling ₹25,000/-. - **Scholarship:** Winning students in the art institution category are eligible for a monthly scholarship of ₹1,000/-.


## Eligibility Criteria - Artists/ art institute students and school children in Gujarat are eligible under this scheme. - Students should be studying in classes 1st to 10th in Gujarat.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should download the prescribed format of the application forms for the "State Art Exhibition Competition" scheme. - [Application Form for State Art Exhibition-Competition](https://lalitkalaacademy.gujarat.gov.in/writereaddata/Portal/Magazine/Document/1_38_3_59th-state-art-form-28112018.pdf). - [Application form for providing Scholarship to Student](https://lalitkalaacademy.gujarat.gov.in/writereaddata/Portal/Magazine/Document/1_13_3_Form_2.pdf). **Step 2:** In the application form, provide all the mandatory details, including career details in the field of art, photographs, or color slides of work (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the supporting documents to the Gujarat State Fine Arts Academy. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority at the Academy office to whom the application has been submitted. > **Contact Us:** > Gujarat State Academy of Fine Arts > Ravi Shankar Rawal Kala Bhavan, > Opposite Bhaikaka Bhavan, > Law Garden, Ellisbridge, > Ahmedabad - 380006. > 079-26425562 > 079-26562558

metadata.schemeName: Varanasi and Amritsar Yatra Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: This scheme aims to facilitate pilgrimages to Varanasi and Amritsar for individuals belonging to the Scheduled Castes category. The scheme provides financial reimbursement for second-class train travel, enabling eligible beneficiaries to undertake these religious journeys with ease.

page_content:
# Varanasi and Amritsar Yatra Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Travel & Tourism | **Tags:** Journey, Pilgrim, Travel, Pilgrimage, Scheduled Caste | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Varanasi and Amritsar Yatra Scheme" is a scheme under the "Celebration of Birth Anniversaries of Great saints Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, Guru Ravidas, Maharishi Valmiki and Sant Kabir Dass Jayanti Scheme", implemented by the Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes Department, Government of Haryana. This scheme aims to facilitate pilgrimages to Varanasi and Amritsar for individuals belonging to the Scheduled Castes category. To support their spiritual and cultural engagement, the scheme provides financial reimbursement for second-class train travel, enabling eligible beneficiaries to undertake these religious journeys with ease.
## Benefits - Reimbursement of ₹1,000/- or the actual cost of a second-class train ticket (to and fro) per person, whichever is less, will be provided. **Note:** This facility will be given one time only. **Expected Time of Disbursement:** Reimbursement will be made after the journey on the submission of railway tickets. **Mode of Disbursement:** Payment will be made directly into the bank account of the beneficiary.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste. 1. This facility will be given one time only.
## Exclusions 1. The applicant should not be a Government Employee (including Boards/Corporations/Authorities/Government Undertakings and such Establishments).

## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline The applicant shall contact the concerned Antodaya Bhawan for registration, along with the required documents and intimation of the expected date of journey for this purpose. > **Notes:** - The number of persons are fixed for registration, i.e. 100 per constituency. Registration will be done on a first-come, first-served basis. - Reimbursement will be made after journey on the submission of railway tickets. - The budget will be allotted to the District Welfare officers for this purpose.

metadata.schemeName: Sindhu Darshan Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹15,000/- to pilgrims from Gujarat undertaking the Sindhu Darshan Yatra in Leh-Ladakh, fostering national unity. Intended beneficiaries include native Gujaratis who complete the yatra and apply within 60 days.

page_content:
# Sindhu Darshan Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Travel & Tourism, Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Culture, Pilgrim, Heritage, Pilgrimage, Travel, Tourism | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched in 2017, the scheme "Sindhu Darshan Scheme" by the Tourism Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance to pilgrims from Gujarat undertaking the Sindhu Darshan Yatra in Leh-Ladakh, promoting cultural unity. The scheme provides a one-time financial assistance of ₹15,000/- to eligible pilgrims and supports a maximum of 300 pilgrims per financial year. To be eligible, the applicant must be a native of Gujarat and must submit proof of completing the yatra within 60 days of its conclusion. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Holy Pilgrimage Development Board. The applications are accepted offline via a prescribed form available on the official website. ## Benefits **Financial Assistance:** One-time grant of ₹15,000/- per pilgrim. **Beneficiary Cap:** Limited to 300 pilgrims per financial year. **Disbursement Condition:** Proof of yatra completion must be submitted within 60 days. **Validity:** Once in a lifetime per pilgrim. ## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a native of Gujarat. - The applicant must have completed the Sindhu Darshan Yatra. - The applicant must submit the application within 60 days of completing the yatra. - The applicant must not have availed the benefit before under this scheme. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://yatradham.gujarat.gov.in/Documents/Scheme_2022-8-23_752.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields (details of the authorized travel agent/organizer, details of the pilgrims), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to **"Gujarat Holy Pilgrimage Development Board, Old Secretariat, Gandhinagar"** within 60 days of yatra completion. _*Retain a copy of the submitted application for future reference._
**Verification & Disbursement** The board processes applications, and financial assistance is credited to the beneficiary’s account.

page_content:
# Kailash Darshan Yatra **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture, Travel & Tourism | **Tags:** Travel, Tourism, Pilgrim, Culture, Heritage | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched in 2001, the scheme "Kailash Darshan Yatra" by the Gujarat Holy Pilgrimage Development Board, Tourism Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance to pilgrims from Gujarat undertaking the sacred Kailash Mansarovar pilgrimage. The scheme offers one-time financial assistance to selected applicants who complete the yatra. **Verification & Disbursement** The board processes applications, and financial assistance is credited to the beneficiary’s account.

metadata.schemeName: Self-Employment Scheme for Scheduled Castes and Tribes
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support scheduled castes and scheduled tribes families below the poverty line through concessional loans and subsidies for self-employment in various sectors.

page_content:
# Self-Employment Scheme for Scheduled Castes and Tribes **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Skills & Employment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Self-employment, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, BPL, Loan, Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Self-Employment Scheme for Scheduled Castes and Tribes" scheme by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote self-employment and sustainable livelihood among scheduled caste/ scheduled tribe families living below the poverty line. Under this scheme, provides loans through various banks to scheduled caste families living below the poverty line for projects up to ₹20,000 to ₹7,00,000/- in agriculture, services, business, and transport. The scheme offers a government subsidy of 50% of the project cost or a maximum of ₹10,000/-.
> **Illustrative Ventures:** Agricultural Equipment, Automobile Workshops, Band Parties, Orchestras, Beauty Parlors, Bicycle Repair, Biogas Plants, Barber Shops, Bookbinding, Brick Making, Bullock Carts, Cable Tv, Candle Making, Greeting Card Making, Carpet Industry, Cloth Business, Copper Industry, Departmental Stores, Dhabas and Restaurants, Driving Schools, Fruit and Flower Production, Flour and Rice Mills, Goat Rearing, Bakeries, General Stores (Pansari Ki Dukan), Hosiery, Bamboo Furniture Making, Wooden Furniture Making, Leather Goods Manufacturing, Shoe Making, Cement Block Making, Beekeeping, Nursing Homes, Poultry Farming, Printing Presses, Pottery Work, Sweet Shops, Tailoring Shops, Tire Servicing, Lamination, PCO/STD Booths, Tent Houses, Auto-taxis, Marble Polishing, Sale and Repair of Electrical Goods, Fast Food Shops, Etc. ## Benefits > **Financial Assistance:** - **Loan Amount:** Project loans from ₹20,000/- to ₹7,00,000/- through nationalized banks.- **Subsidy:** 50% of the project cost or up to ₹10,000/- as government subsidy.- **Margin Money:** 25% of project cost provided at 4% annual interest.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Castes and Tribes community. 1. The applicant must be living below the poverty line. 1. The applicant annual income must not exceed ₹15,975/- in rural areas and ₹21,206/- in urban areas. 1. The applicant must not be a defaulter of any bank or financial institution. 1. The applicant must not have availed any subsidy from any government scheme earlier. 1. The applicant must possess a commercial driving license. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline > ***Application Process:*** **Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the [application form](http://www.ukbvvn.org.in/Download/SES_loan_form.pdf) from the official website. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Village Development Officer/Assistant Social Welfare Officer/Block Development Officer. <br> > ***Selection Process:*** **Rural Areas:** Beneficiaries are selected through open meetings in Gram Sabha. **Urban Areas:** Selection is done through interviews. <br> <br>

page_content:
# Sero Positive Illness Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Sero Disease, Children, Scholarship, Education | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched in 2009, the scheme "Sero Positive Illness Scheme" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat aims to support the education of children affected by or born into families impacted by Sero Positive illness. Through this scheme, financial scholarships and support for school uniform, books, tuition fees, food, and hostel expenses are provided to destitute and orphaned children across education levels—from primary school to postgraduate studies. The scheme is implemented by the Director, Social Security Department, Gujarat State, Gandhinagar, and at the district level, by the District Social Security Officer or District Child Protection Officer. ## Benefits
Level of Study Day Scholars HostellersStd. 1 to 5 ₹500 (₹50/month for uniform) + ₹1,500 annually-Std. 6 to 10₹1,000/- (₹100/month for uniform) + ₹1,500 annually -Class 11-12 ₹4,000/- (₹400/month for fees and books for ten months)₹10,000/- (Rs. 400/- per month for fees and books for ten months and ₹600/- per month for food and hostel charges)B.A./B.Com./B.Sc and equivalent degree courses ₹6,000/- (₹600/- per month for fees and books for ten months)₹12,000/- (₹600/- per month for fees and books for ten months and ₹600/- per month for food and hostel charges)degree courses like B.E., B.Tech., L.L.B., MBA and equivalent courses as well as Diploma courses in Medical and Ayurvedic and Homeopathic courses.₹10,000/- (₹1,000/- per month for fees and books for ten months)₹16,000/- (₹1,000/- per month for fees and books for ten months and ₹600/- per month for food and hostel charges)Postgraduate level courses like M.Sc./ M.Phil./ LLM./ M.Ed./ M.B.A. etc.₹10,000/- (₹1,000/- per month for fees and books for ten months)₹1,000/- per month for books for ten months and ₹600/- per month for food and hostel charges)
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a child affected by Sero Positive illness or should have one or both parents who are Sero Positive. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should be studying in any following standard: - Standard 1 to 5. - Standard 6 to 10. - Higher Secondary Class-11 and 12. - B.A./B.Com./B.AC. and equivalent degree courses. - Degree courses like B.E., B.Tech., LLB., MBA and equivalent courses as well as Diploma courses in Medical and Ayurvedic and Homeopathic courses. - Postgraduate level courses like M.Sc./ M.Phil./ LLM./ M.Ed./ M.B.A. etc.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the office of the District Social Security Officer or the District Child Protection Officer and request a hard copy of the prescribed application form for the Sero Positive Illness Scheme. **Step 2:** In the application form, the applicant should provide all the mandatory details and attach self-attested copies of all the required documents, including Aadhaar Card, Birth Certificate, Civil Surgeon’s Certificate, and other supporting documents. **Step 3:** The applicant should submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the supporting documents to the District Social Security Office or District Child Protection Office. **Step 4:** The applicant should request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted for future reference.

page_content:
# Operation of Sports Hostels

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Sports & Culture, Housing & Shelter | **Tags:** Hostel, Scheduled Tribe, Sports Training, Sports, Tribal Students | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Operation of Sports Hostels" was introduced by the Tribal Area Development Department, Government of Rajasthan. It aims to encourage tribal students in Scheduled Areas to participate in sports and prepare them for national and international competitions. Under this scheme, tribal students from Class 6 to 12 are provided with free residential facilities, training in archery and athletics by skilled coaches, nutritious meals, uniforms, and modern sports equipment. The scheme is implemented in the following District:	Banswara, Dungarpur, Sirohi, Udaipur & Pratapgarh.

## Benefits
The following facilities are provided in the sports hostel:

- Free residential accommodation in sports hostels.
- Nutritious meals, snacks, and special dietary arrangements as per approved pattern.
- Sports training with modern equipment by expert coaches (especially in archery and athletics).
- Free school uniforms and educational materials.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe community.
1. The applicant should be studying in class 6th to 12th.1. The applicant should not have any disability or suffering from any serious illness.
1. The applicant’s parents/guardians should not be income tax payers.
1. The applicant should not be a failed student in the last examination.

**Note:** Only those students who pass the selection test will be admitted to the sports hostel.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online - via CSC
**Step 1:** The applicant should gather copies of the necessary documents needed to apply for the concerned scheme.
**Step 2:** The applicant should visit the nearest E-Mitra Center and complete the Biometric Verification Process.
**Step 3:** The applicant should ensure that the E-Mitra Center agent completes all mandatory fields in the application form and uploads copies of all required documents.
**Step 4:** Keep the acknowledgment receipt for future reference.

metadata.briefDescription: The Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR) offers Doctoral Fellowships to support full-time Ph.D. scholars engaged in high-quality research in the field of social and human sciences. These fellowships are awarded to Indian research scholars registered in Ph.D. programs at UGC-recognized u

page_content:
# ICSSR Doctoral Fellowship

**Ministry:** Ministry of Education | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** ICSSR Fellowships, Doctoral Fellowship, Social Science Research, PhD, Research Scholars | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The Fellowship is aimed at promoting original, socially relevant, and policy-focused research in the social sciences. The fellowship provides financial support through a monthly grant of ₹20,000 and an annual contingency grant of ₹20,000 for up to two years, with an initial award period of one year, which is renewed for the second year subject to fulfilment of requisite criteria. It also offers institutional and short-term fellowships including a six-month short term fellowship for scholars nearing Ph.D. submission (minimum three years of completed PhD research) and a standalone contingency grant of ₹62,500 for specific research needs. Applications are invited through ICSSR’s website and social media platforms. Fellows are expected to pursue full-time research, submit regular progress reports, and provide a final submission that includes published work, a book-length thesis, and audited financial records.  Given India's social science ecosystem, it seeks to promote research excellence, evidence-based research, and scholarship that is also relevant to policymakers.

## Benefits
1)	Monthly Fellowship amount @ Rs.20,000 per month
2)	Contingency Grant @ Rs.20,000 per annum

## Eligibility Criteria
1)	Applicant must be an Indian citizen.
2)	Must be a full-time bonafide Ph.D. scholar in a social science discipline in a UGC-recognized university, deemed-to-be university, institute of national importance, ICSSR Research Institute, or college with approved Ph.D. programme.
3)	The Ph.D. topic must have been confirmed by the DRC/authorised statutory body of the institution on or before the last date of call for applications.
4)	Age must be below 40 years as on the last date of application.
5)	Age relaxation of 5 years allowed for SC/ST/OBC-(NCL) candidates and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwD).
6)	Must have secured a minimum of 55% marks in post-graduation, with 5% relaxation for reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC-(NCL)/PwD).

## Exclusions
1)	Those who are not fulfilling the eligibility criteria.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
Step 01: Visit [ICSSR website](https://www.icssr.org) - www.icssr.org - and navigate to Fellowships section.
Step 02: Click on Doctoral Fellowship Scheme.
Step 03: Register/Login to the ICSSR portal.
Step 04: Fill the online application form.
Step 05: Upload documents and submit.

# Samajik Sewa Bhatta Scheme

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Sikkim | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Pension, Traditional Faith Healers, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Samajik Sewa Bhatta Scheme" was launched by the Culture Department, Government of Sikkim. It aims to provide financial support to traditional faith healers across the state. Under this scheme, traditional faith healers receive a monthly pension to recognize and support their cultural and social contributions. It covers a total of 1,500 beneficiaries and seeks to preserve the traditional healing practices that are integral to the cultural heritage of Sikkim.

## Benefits
- A monthly pension of ₹1,500/- is provided to traditional faith healers such as Dhami, Jhakri, Bijjuwa, Bhungthing, Mangpa, Phedengba, Paw, Baidang, Janapa, Yeba, Yema, Sambas, and Pheriwala.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a resident of Sikkim.
   1. The applicant should be a traditional faith healer such as Dhami, Jhakri, Bijjuwa, Bhungthing, Mangpa, Phedengba, Paw, Baidang, Janapa, Yeba, Yema, Sambas, or Pheriwala.

## Exclusions
1. Applicants related to Sudeni Bhatta (home delivery childbirth practitioners) are excluded under this scheme.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should write the application on plain paper. 
**Step 2:** Attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required) along with the application.
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application along with the documents to the Secretary, Culture Department.

metadata.schemeName: Laado Protsahan Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage the birth of girl children in poor families and promote their holistic development. Under this scheme, financial support ₹1,50,000/- is provided in seven installments to the parents or guardians of girls born in Government/authorized Medical Institutions.

page_content:
# Laado Protsahan Yojana

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Women and Child | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Maternity, Childcare, Girl Child, Education | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The Scheme "Laado Protsahan Yojana" was launched on 1st August 2024 by the Department of Women Empowerment, Government of Rajasthan. The scheme aims to encourage the birth of girl children in poor families and promote their holistic development. Under this scheme, financial support is provided in seven installments to the parents or guardians of girls born in Government/authorized Medical Institutions.
> **Objectives:**


- Promote a positive mindset towards the birth of a girl child and ensure her holistic development.
- Eliminate gender discrimination in childcare, education, and health.
- Promote institutional deliveries and reduce maternal mortality.
- Reduce infant mortality among girls and improve the child sex ratio.
- Ensure enrollment and retention of girls in schools.
- Encourage higher education for girls and reduce child marriage.

## Benefits
> **Monetary Benefit:**


- **Total financial benefit of ₹1,50,000/- disbursed in 7 installments:**

**Installment****Description****Amount (₹)**1Girl&amp;#39;s birth in eligible medical institutions2500/-2Girl completes one year of age and all vaccinations2500/-3Girl&amp;#39;s admission to Class 1st in a government/government-recognized private school4000/-4Girl&amp;#39;s admission to Class 6th in a government/government-recognized private school5000/-5Girl&amp;#39;s admission to Class 10th in a government/government-recognized private school  11000/-
6Girl&amp;#39;s admission to Class 12th in a government/government-recognized private school25000/-7Girl passes graduation from government-recognized educational institutions and completes 21 years of age   1,00,000/-
**Total Amount                                                                                                                                 ₹1,50,000**> **Mode of Disbursement:**


   1. A commitment letter of ₹1.50 lakh will be issued at the birth of a girl child.
   1. The entire amount will be disbursed online through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) in seven installments.
   1. Until the girl attains adulthood, the first six installments will be transferred to the bank account of her parents or guardian, and the seventh installment will be transferred to the girl's own bank account through DBT.

> **Notes:** 


  - If the benefit of any installment is not availed at any stage after the first two installments of the scheme, the eligible girl child may still be granted the next installment, provided a valid and reasonable justification is given.
  - There is no limit on the number of girl children eligible to receive the third and subsequent installments under the scheme. All girls who have already received the first two installments will be entitled to continue receiving benefits under the scheme.
  - The Rajshree Yojana will be merged with the Laado Protsahan Yojana, and the remaining installments of the Rajshree Yojana will be provided under the Laado Protsahan Yojana as per eligibility.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a woman who is a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should deliver the girl child in a government medical institution or a private medical institution authorized under the Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY).
1. The applicant should ensure full immunization of the child (for second installment).
1. The applicant's child should be enrolled in a recognized school or institution for subsequent installments.
1. The applicant’s daughter should graduate from a recognized higher education institution and attain the age of 21 to receive the final installment.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
> **Application process for the Applicant:**

**Step 1:** The applicant should gather copies of the necessary documents needed to apply for the concerned scheme.
**Step 2:** The applicant should visit the nearest office of the Department of Medical, Health & Family Welfare. 
> **Application process for the Department of Medical, Health & Family Welfare**

**For First and Second Installments:**

- Data is entered on PCTS portal during antenatal checkups and post-institutional delivery.
- DBT is done automatically by the Department of Medical, Health & Family Welfare.

**For Second Installment:**

- Full immunization record must be uploaded on the [PCTS](https://pctsrajmedical.rajasthan.gov.in/private/login.aspx)/[OJAS](https://ojspm.rajasthan.gov.in/Private/login.aspx) portal.- Based on verification, payment is made to parent/guardian’s account.

**For Installments 3 to 6 (School Admissions):**

- Automatically tracked by schools through the portal using earlier installment IDs.
- No fresh application is required from parents/guardians.

**For Final (Seventh) Installment:**

- The Department of Higher Education uploads the girl’s graduation documents.
- Payment is made to the girl’s own bank account after verifying she is 21 years old.

# Rajasthan Varishth Patrakar Samman Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Journalist, Senior Citizen, Honorarium | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Rajasthan Varishth Patrakar Samman Yojana" was implemented by the Information and Public Relations Department, Government of Rajasthan, to recognize and support the contributions of senior accredited journalists. Under this scheme, a monthly financial assistance of ₹15,000/- is provided to full-time accredited journalists who are 60 years of age or older and have served continuously for at least 20 years in daily, weekly, fortnightly newspapers, independent publications, electronic media, or news agencies (including editors, publishers, and owners). ## Benefits **Financial Assistance:** - Monthly Honorarium: ₹15,000/- per month to the senior accredited journalists. - In case of the journalist's death, 50% of the amount is provided to the widow. **Duration:** - Paid for a maximum period of 5 years, subject to review. **Mode of Disbursement:** - Direct Bank Transfer to the journalist’s savings account. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a full-time accredited journalist. 1. The applicant must have continuously worked for at least 20 years in daily newspapers, weekly newspapers, fortnightly news publications, independent journalism, electronic media, or news agencies, including roles such as editor, publisher, or owner of such media organizations. 1. Accredited journalists who have been regularly accredited with the Department of Information and Public Relations, Rajasthan for at least 10 years will be eligible for this scheme. 1. The journalist should be 60 years of age or older as of the application date. 1. The applicant should not be receiving any salary, pension, or regular financial assistance from any newspaper, institution, or any other regular assistance from the State Government. 1. The applicant must declare (via affidavit) that they do not fall under the category of an income tax payee. 1. The applicant should not have any criminal case registered against them. **Note:** The honorarium will be given for an initial period of five years. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline > **Application Process** **Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the [application form](https://jankalyanfile.rajasthan.gov.in//Content/UploadFolder/Advertisement/Achievements/2022/Apr/2602_ACH_0919f4fa-eb86-4c9d-b1b7-a76b45a881c4.pdf) from the official website. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the respective Information and Public Relations Department, Rajasthan or Accreditation Committee. > ***Post-Application Process*** **Step 1:** The Accreditation Committee will verify the documents and credentials. **Step 2:** Upon recommendation, final approval will be given by the State Government. **Step 3:** On approval, the monthly honorarium will be directly credited to the applicant's bank account. **Note:** The scheme is subject to review and honorarium can be withdrawn in case of misconduct or legal violation.

page_content:
# Travel Grants To Goan Authors

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Transport & Infrastructure, Travel & Tourism, Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Travel, Grant, Author, Culture, Artist | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Travel Grants To Goan Authors" is a state-level cultural scheme by the Kala Academy, Department of Art and Culture, Government of Goa. The objective of the scheme is to enable the Goan writers to come in close contact with the senior writers of a language-region other than their own within India to acquaint them with the writers and the people of that region, and to widen their awareness and sensibility about the country as a nation.

## Benefits
The grant amount will be decided by Kala Academy with provision for an advance upto 75% of the total grant for a maximum of two Goan authors.

## Eligibility Criteria
- The applicant should be a writer.
- The applicant should be from Goa.

_*A copy of the rules and regulations is available at Kala Academy free of charge._

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
**Step 1:** The entries are invited by releasing press announcements in local print and electronic media. The announcement consists of the proforma prescribed by the Kala Academy for application to the scheme.
**Step 2:** In the provided entry form, the interested applicant should fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the supporting documents.
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed form along with the supporting documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the **Member Secretary, Kala Academy, Goa, Campal, Panaji**.
**Step 4:** Applications are placed before the Advisory Committee (Literature of Kala Academy) for their recommendation and subsequent approval by the authorities of Kala Academy.
**Authority for Redressal of Grievances:** Member Secretary/Chairman, Kala Academy, Goa.

metadata.schemeName: The Goa State Journalist Awards Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: "The Goa State Journalist Awards Scheme" aims to encourage journalists to publish commendable news items, articles, or reports, fostering mass awareness. It provides awards, including a cash prize of ₹10,000/-, to eligible journalists in Goa.

page_content:
# The Goa State Journalist Awards Scheme

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Science, IT & Communications | **Tags:** Journalist, Media, Award, Cash, Newspaper | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "The Goa State Journalist Awards Scheme" by the Department of Information & Publicity, Government of Goa aims to encourage journalists to exhibit their talents by publishing commendable news items, articles, or reports, thereby fostering mass awareness in society. The scheme provides recognition through awards and financial incentives, with a cash prize of ₹10,000/- per category. Eligible journalists must be affiliated with registered daily or weekly newspapers or private sector electronic media recognized by the Department. The scheme is implemented by the Director of Information & Publicity, Goa, and awards are conferred annually on National Press Day (16th November).

## Benefits
- Each award includes a certificate, a memento, and a cash prize of ₹10,000/-.  
- A total of seven awards, amounting to ₹70,000/-, are distributed annually.  
- Judges receive an honorarium of ₹2,000/- each.  
- Awards are conferred on National Press Day (16th November).

## Eligibility Criteria
- The applicant should be a journalist working in a registered daily or weekly newspaper published in English, Konkani, or Marathi, or private sector electronic media recognised by the Department of Information & Publicity, Government of Goa.  
- The applicant's work (news items, articles, or reports) must have been published during the previous calendar year.  
- Nominations must be sponsored by the Editors of eligible publications.
- The nomination of the journalist can only be for the news items and articles published during the previous calendar year under one of the following categories: 

a) Best Editor Award on National Integration and Communal Harmony. 
b) Rural Reporting. 
c) Reporting on Public Health and Hygiene. 
d) Reporting with special reference to Women and Children/Social issues. 
e) Sports Reporting. 
f) Reporting on Art and Culture. 
g) Photo Journalism (Best photograph of the year).

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
**Step 1: Invitation for Nominations**
The Department of Information & Publicity (DIP) invites nominations from Editors of eligible publications.
**Step 2: Submission of Nominations**
Editors submit the particulars of sponsored journalists along with relevant press/video clippings to the Director, Information & Publicity, by the deadline fixed by DIP.
**Step 3: Selection by Judges**
Judges appointed by the State Government evaluate submissions based on objectivity and reliance on authentic sources.
**Step 4: Announcement of Awards**
The awards are distributed on National Press Day (16th November).

metadata.schemeName: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to journalists in Goa for emergencies like medical treatment, marriage, and education. Benefits include aid up to ₹2,00,000/and scholarships for dependents. Eligible journalists must be registered and working in Goa for at least three years.

page_content:
# Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Science, IT & Communications, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Journalist, Financial Assistance, Education, Marriage, Medical | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
Launched in 2010, the scheme "Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)" by the Department of Information and Publicity, Government of Goa aims to provide immediate financial assistance to needy journalists in indigent circumstances for various emergencies such as medical treatment, marriage expenses, funeral costs, and self-employment ventures. The scheme offers benefits like financial aid up to ₹2,00,000/per case and scholarships for journalists' wards. Eligible applicants must be journalists born or working in Goa for at least three years and registered with the Department of Information and Publicity. The scheme is implemented by a Sub-Committee constituted by the Government of Goa, which includes representatives from the Goa Union of Journalists and the Goa Editors Guild.

## Benefits
> **Financial Assistance and Purpose**


- Marriage of Daughter: Up to ₹2,00,000/-
- Major/Minor Operation/Medical Treatment for Self or Family: Up to ₹2,00,000/-
- Funeral Expenses of the Journalist: Up to ₹2,00,000/-
- Travel/Incidental Expenses for Treatment: Up to ₹2,00,000/-
- Medical Reimbursement for General Expenses: Up to ₹2,00,000/-
- Scholarship/Incentives for Wards Pursuing Higher Education: Up to ₹2,00,000/-
- Financial Assistance for Self-employment Ventures: Up to ₹2,00,000/-
- House Repair/Construction Due to Natural Calamities: Up to ₹2,00,000/-
- Lump-sum Grant on the Death of the Journalist to Next Kin: Up to ₹2,00,000/-

_*All disbursements are made through cheques._
> **Conditions for Disbursement**


- Original bills and photocopies of hospital/institution documents must be submitted for medical claims.
- For super-specialty treatment, bills must be submitted within three months.

## Eligibility Criteria
- The applicant should be a journalist.
- The applicant should have been born and brought up in Goa.
- The applicant should be working in a newspaper establishment in Goa for at least three years continuously.
- The applicant should be registered with the Department of Information and Publicity, Government of Goa, and renew registration by June 30th every year.
- The applicant should not be engaged in any other profession.

## Exclusions
Journalists who have availed benefits under other government schemes (e.g., Kanyadan Scheme, Mediclaim, CMRY, Disaster Management Scheme) for the same purpose are ineligible.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should take print of the [prescribed format](https://dip.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/The-Patrakarb-Kritadnyata-Nidhi-Scheme.pdf) of the application form.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the Director of Information and Publicity, Government of Goa.
> **Post-Application Processes**

**Step 1:** The Director will scrutinize the application and forward it to the Sub-Committee for review. The Sub-Committee will decide the quantum of assistance and seek government approval.
**Step 2:** Once approved, the financial assistance will be disbursed via cheque to the eligible applicant.

metadata.schemeName: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to journalists in Goa for purchasing e-bikes at a subsidised rate. The benefits include making it more convenient for journalists to gather and disseminate news, with the intended beneficiaries being eligible Goa-based journalists.

page_content:
# Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Transport & Infrastructure, Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Subsidy, Transport, Journalist, Environment, Pollution, Road | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme “Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists” by the Department of Information and Publicity, Government of Goa, aims to provide journalists based in Goa with e-bikes at a subsidised rate, facilitating easier access to essential technology for their profession. This initiative acknowledges the crucial role of journalists in educating the public and the time they spend gathering news. Two significant benefits of the scheme are providing financial assistance for purchasing e-bikes and empowering journalists with better means to disseminate information vital for a democratic system. Two significant eligibility criteria include being a resident of Goa for at least 15 years and being a full-time working journalist for at least eight years. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Information and Publicity. Every year, the Government will grant subsidies to purchase 65 e-bikes to 65 beneficiaries based on their years of working.

## Benefits
- Subsidy up to 50% of the value on quotation or ₹ 50,000/-, whichever is less, and the remaining 50% value shall be borne by the beneficiaries. 
- The payment shall be effected directly to the beneficiaries upon receipt of the purchase of the e-bike document. 
- The subsidy shall be disbursed in a single instalment to the beneficiary, i.e., 100% on the purchase of the vehicle and production of purchase documents, i.e., the Registration Certificate book and insurance by the Beneficiary.
- Disbursement of subsidy for the purchase of e-bikes will be done on a first-come-first-served basis or a maximum of two for each organisation per meeting, also considering eligibility criteria.

## Eligibility Criteria
- The applicant should be a journalist.
- The sole livelihood of the applicant should be through journalistic activities.
- The applicant should be residing in Goa for at least 15 years.
- The applicant should be working for a Media organisation.
- The applicant should not be more than 58 years of age.
- The applicant should not have availed benefit to purchase an e-bike (two-wheeler) under any other Government scheme.

## Exclusions
Beneficiaries who have availed the benefit from any other such Government schemes shall not be entitled to this scheme.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://dip.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/notification-e-v-bike.pdf) of the application form. 
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and enclose the copies of all the mandatory documents (endorsed, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the Director, Department of Information and Publicity, Udyog Bhavan, 3rd floor, Panaji.
> **Post-Application Processes**

**Step 1:** After approval of the application, the Beneficiary will have to provide purchased documents (Registration Certificate book and insurance) along with bank details to release the subsidy directly to the beneficiary.
**Step 2:** The Screening Committee, constituted under the Chairmanship of the Director of Information and Publicity, will scrutinize/sanction applications and may ask for additional documents if required.
**Step 3:** The subsidy will be disbursed in a single instalment upon purchase of the vehicle and production of the necessary documents.

page_content:
# Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Punjab)

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Punjab | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Pension, Indira Gandhi, Disability, PwD | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The "Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)" is implemented by the Department of Social Security and Development of Women and Children, Government of Punjab. Under this scheme, persons with disabilities aged 18 years and above, having a disability level of 80% or more, are eligible to receive a pension of ₹300/- per month. After attaining the age of 80 years, the pension amount increases to ₹500/- per month. Dwarfs are also included as an eligible category under this scheme.

## Benefits
- Pension is Rs. 300/- per month (age 18-79 year)
- Pension is Rs. 500/- per month (age 80 and above year)

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a resident of Punjab.
   1. The applicant should be a person with a disability.
   1. The percentage of the disability should be 80% or more.
   1. The applicant’s age should be between 18 and 80 years.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
**Step 1:****** The interested applicant should visit the District Social Security Officer and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the concerned staff.
**Step 2:****** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:****** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the [District Social Security Officer](https://sswcd.punjab.gov.in/en/contact-us/district-social-security-officer).
**Step 4:****** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

**Mode:** Online
**Step 1: Register on the UMANG Portal**
Visit the [official website](https://web.umang.gov.in/landing/) of UMANG. In the top right corner of the landing page, click "Register." You will be taken to the Registration Page. Fill in all the mandatory fields.
**Step 2: Mobile Number Verification and MPIN Creation**
You will be redirected to the mobile number verification page. Enter your mobile number and get it verified via OTP. Create an MPIN to complete the registration process. You will be taken to the UMANG homepage. Login using your Mobile Number and MPIN.
**Step 3: Accessing Services on UMANG**
Visit the "[National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)](https://web.umang.gov.in/landing/department/national-social-assistance-programme-nsap.html)" page on UMANG and click "Apply Online".
**Step 4: Completing the Application**
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the required documents in the specified format and size.
**Step 5: Review and Confirmation**
Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections, if required. Acknowledge and agree to the terms and conditions, declaration, and privacy policy, if any.
**Step 6: Submitting the Application**
Click the "Submit" or "Apply" button to submit your application. You'll receive a confirmation message upon successful submission of the application.

page_content:
# Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (Punjab)

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Punjab | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Pension, Old Age, Below Poverty Line, BPL, Senior Citizen | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The "Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)" is a social welfare initiative by the Department of Social Security and Development of Women and Children, Government of Punjab. In this scheme, persons aged between 60 and 79 years receive a pension of ₹200/- per month, while those aged 80 years and above receive ₹500/- per month. The scheme applies only to persons belonging to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.

## Benefits
- ₹200/- month, for persons aged 60 to 79 years.
- ₹500/- month, for persons aged 80 years and above.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a resident of Punjab.
1. The applicant should be 60 years of age or older.
1. The applicant should be from a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
1. The applicant should not be receiving pension benefits under any social security scheme.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
**Step 1:****** The interested applicant should visit the District Social Security Officer and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the concerned staff.
**Step 2:****** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:****** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the [District Social Security Officer](https://sswcd.punjab.gov.in/en/contact-us/district-social-security-officer).
**Step 4:****** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

**Mode:** Online
**Step 1: Register on the UMANG Portal**
Visit the [official website](https://web.umang.gov.in/landing/) of UMANG. In the top right corner of the landing page, click "Register." You will be taken to the Registration Page. Fill in all the mandatory fields.
**Step 2: Mobile Number Verification and MPIN Creation**
You will be redirected to the mobile number verification page. Enter your mobile number and get it verified via OTP. Create an MPIN to complete the registration process. You will be taken to the UMANG homepage. Login using your Mobile Number and MPIN.
**Step 3: Accessing Services on UMANG**
Visit the "[National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)](https://web.umang.gov.in/landing/department/national-social-assistance-programme-nsap.html)" page on UMANG and click "Apply Online".
**Step 4: Completing the Application**
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the required documents in the specified format and size.
**Step 5: Review and Confirmation**
Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections, if required. Acknowledge and agree to the terms and conditions, declaration, and privacy policy, if any.
**Step 6: Submitting the Application**
Click the "Submit" or "Apply" button to submit your application. You'll receive a confirmation message upon successful submission of the application.

page_content:
# Rajya Pratibha Khoj Pariksha Chhatravriti Yojana

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Student, Talent Search, Secondary Education, Higher Education | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Rajya Pratibha Khoj Pariksha Chhatravriti Yojana" was implemented by the Secondary Education Department, Government of Rajasthan. Under this scheme, students are provided with scholarships or a one-time incentive for pursuing education up to the postgraduate level, after being selected through the State Talent Search Examination organized by the Board of Secondary Education Rajasthan, Ajmer.
Students studying in Classes 10 and 12 in all government schools, recognized private schools, and Swami Vivekanand Model Schools in the state, who have secured a minimum of 50% marks in Classes 9 and 11 respectively, are eligible to apply for the examination. Students selected through this examination will be entitled to the benefits provided under the scheme.

## Benefits
**Type of Benefit: Scholarship and One-Time Incentive**
**Class at the time of application****No. of Selected Students &amp;amp; Basis of Selection Basis****Scholarship Rate (For a period of 10 Months)****One-Time Incentive (20 students in each)**Class 10th50 students (≥80% marks)₹1,250/month (for Class 11-12)₹4,000 for topper, ₹2,000 each for othersClass 12th - Arts50 students (≥80% marks)₹2,000/month (for UG &amp;amp; PG)₹4,000 for topper, ₹2,000 each for othersClass 12th - Commerce50 students (≥80% marks)₹2,000/month (for UG &amp;amp; PG)₹4,000 for topper, ₹2,000 each for othersClass 12th - Science50 students (≥80% marks)₹2,000/month (for UG &amp;amp; PG)₹4,000 for topper, ₹2,000 each for others**NOTE:**

- Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary’s bank account.
- Monthly (for up to 10 months per academic year).

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
   1. The applicant should be a student currently enrolled in Class 10 or Class 12.
   1. The student should be studying in a government school, a recognized private school, or a Swami Vivekanand Model School located in Rajasthan.
   1. For Class 10 applicants, a minimum of 50% marks should have been secured in Class 9. For Class 12 applicants, at least 50% marks should have been obtained in Class 11.
   1. The applicant should have appeared for and qualified in the State Talent Search Examination conducted by the Board of Secondary Education, Rajasthan.
   1. To be considered for selection, the applicant should have scored a minimum of 80% marks in the Talent Search Examination.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
**Step 1:** To avail of the benefits of the scheme, the applicant needs to contact their respective school or college administration.
**Step 2:** Submit copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required) to the school/college.
**Step 3:** The school will visit the [Shala Darpan, Rajasthan](https://rajshaladarpan.rajasthan.gov.in/SD4/Home/Public2/Default.aspx) Portal.
**Step 4:** Using the school's login credentials (Login ID and Password), the school will fill and submit the application form.

page_content:
# Monthly/Family Pension for Freedom Fighters and their Widows of Uttarakhand State **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Pension, Widow, Freedom Fighter | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Monthly/Family Pension for Freedom Fighters and their Widows of Uttarakhand State" scheme is implemented by the Police Department under the Department of Home, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension to the freedom fighters of Uttarakhand and to the widows of deceased freedom fighters, in recognition of their contribution to the nation.
## Benefits **Monthly/Family Pension Amount:** ₹25,000/-
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be either a Freedom Fighter or the widow of a Freedom Fighter.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - Freedom Fighters and their widows are required to obtain the application form from the office of the District Magistrate. - The list of documents to be submitted along with the application form is specified in pages 13 to 17 of the Uttar Pradesh Freedom Fighters and their Families Grant and Freedom Pension Rules, 1975 (as applicable in Uttarakhand). - After attaching the required documents, the completed application must be submitted to the District Magistrate. Following verification by the District Magistrate and based on their report/recommendation, the case is forwarded for approval by the Hon’ble Departmental Minister/Hon’ble Chief Minister. - Once the approval is granted at the Government level, the pension is sanctioned and disbursed to the beneficiary.

metadata.schemeName: Merit Scholarship: Polytechnic Institutions
metadata.briefDescription: "Merit Scholarship: Polytechnic Institutions" is a scholarship scheme by the Technical Education Department, Government of Chhattisgarh. The scheme provides ₹600/- per month to eligible students for pursuing education from recognized polytechnic institutions in Chhattisgarh.

page_content:
# Merit Scholarship: Polytechnic Institutions **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Chhattisgarh | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Student, Education, Scholarship, Financial Support, Polytechnic | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description "Merit Scholarship: Polytechnic Institutions" is a scholarship scheme by the Technical Education Department, Government of Chhattisgarh. The scheme provides ₹600/- per month to eligible students for pursuing education from recognized polytechnic institutions in Chhattisgarh. Eligible applicants include (a) Students who have passed the 10th/12th class examination under the 10+2 system from any recognized institution located in Chhattisgarh with a minimum of 60% marks, (b) Students newly admitted to the second year of the Diploma program who are ITI / 12th vocational certificate holders and have passed the qualifying examination with a minimum of 60% marks. ## Benefits (a) For students newly admitted to the first year of the Diploma program: ₹600/- per month. (b) For students admitted to the second year through lateral entry: ₹600/- per month. ## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a native resident student of Chhattisgarh. - The applicant must be currently studying in a recognized polytechnic institution in Chhattisgarh. - The applicant must have secured a minimum of 60% marks in the qualifying examination. - Students who have passed the 10th/12th class examination under the 10+2 system from any recognized institution located in Chhattisgarh with a minimum of 60% marks will be eligible. - Students newly admitted to the second year of the Diploma program who are ITI / 12th vocational certificate holders must have passed the qualifying examination with a minimum of 60% marks.
**Other Conditions -** - Without special approval from the government, no student will receive more than one scholarship at the same time. However, if the institution where he is studying has given him any fee concession, then he will be entitled to continue receiving it. - If any scholarship becomes vacant during its duration, then the approving authority can give such scholarships for its unexpired period to the next eligible and deserving candidate from the merit list. - Only those students will be eligible to receive scholarships who have passed the qualifying examination from any testing body of Chhattisgarh. But children of such permanent government employees of Chhattisgarh can be exempted from this condition who are on deputation to the Government of India or any other state government. - Such students will not be eligible to receive scholarships who are in full-time employment. In this regard, only one concession can be given that any such student, who is regularly studying in a recognized institution and is receiving any scholarship, can be allowed to do part-time work. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the **Office of the Principal of the Institution** and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the institute staff. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the staff. The Principal will verify the documents and forward the application to the Directorate for approval (New applications) or process the renewal (for existing beneficiaries). **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the staff to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

The applicants can either be students who have passed their 10th and 12th standard examinations with a minimum of 60% marks, or Diploma holders newly admitted to the second year of B.E. must have passed the final year examination of their diploma with a minimum of 60% marks. ## Benefits - For studying in the first year of the B.E. (Bachelor of Engineering) program: ₹1,000/- per month. - For students newly admitted to the second year of B.E. through lateral entry: ₹1,000/- per month. ## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a native resident student of Chhattisgarh. - The applicant must be currently studying in a recognized engineering college in Chhattisgarh. - The applicant must be pursuing an engineering degree course. - Students who have passed their 10th and 12th standard examinations with a minimum of 60% marks from any recognized institution located in Chhattisgarh will be eligible. - Diploma holders newly admitted to the second year of B.E. must have passed the final year examination of their diploma with a minimum of 60% marks will also be eligible.

# Scheme for Upgradation of Gaushala/ Panjrapole **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Agriculture, Animal Husbandry, Cattle Development | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Scheme for Upgradation of Gaushala/ Panjrapole" launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat, is designed to preserve and promote indigenous breeds of cows in Gujarat, such as Gir and Kankrej, which hold spiritual, scientific, and health value.
Objective: The world famous Gir and Kankarej cows of Gujarat state and other indigenous breeds have great importance in terms of spiritual, scientific and health. To preserve these is the main aim by increase the breeding of cows by encouraging gaushalas and panjarapol institutions that ideally keep cows. The scheme also aims to increase the consumption of Panchagavya products of Gir and Kankrej cows and make rearing of cows economically viable.
## Benefits
**Component****Standard of Assistance****Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Constituent Benefits**1. Water Fogger; 2. Mechanized Reaper Machine or Reaper Machine; 3. Chaff cutter 4. Drip irrigation; 5. 500 liters bulk milk cooling machine with generator; 6. Mini Tractor or Big Tractor/Hydraulic Trailer or Trailer; 7. Solar Gau Arc Machine/ Gau Arc Machine; 8. Milking machineAssistance upto 75% of the total expenditure incurred by the article up to a maximum of ₹4,00,000/- to be paid.1 Year

While Panjarapol must have more than 100 livestock. 1. At least 3 (three) acres of land on which the institution has to purchase/develop the development work, must be in the institution's own name or on a lease of 99 years. There is no maximum land limit.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage local youths in photography and photojournalism, providing cash prizes and exhibition opportunities. The scheme offers cash prizes of ₹20,000/-, ₹16,000/-, and ₹12,000/- in each category. Entries from applicants born and residing in Goa are preferred.

page_content:
# The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Science, IT & Communications, Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Exhibition, Photography, Photojournalism, Contest | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
"The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme" by the Department of Information & Publicity, Government of Goa, aims to encourage young talents in photography and photojournalism, promote self-employment, and provide a platform for local youths to exhibit their work. The scheme offers cash prizes of ₹20,000/-, ₹16,000/-, and ₹12,000/- in each category. Benefits also include exhibitions for selected entries. Applicants born and residing in Goa for at least 15 years are given preference.

## Benefits
- First prize: ₹20,000/- in each category.
- Second prize: ₹16,000/- in each category.
- Third prize: ₹12,000/- in each category.
- Five consolation prizes: ₹2,000/- each.
- Certificates are presented to the best entries.
- Judges' Honorarium: ₹5,000/- each for three judges.

## Eligibility Criteria
Individuals who were born and residing in Goa for 15 years or more will be given preference, though the scheme does not bar others.

## Exclusions
- The applicant must not be an employee of the Department of Information & Publicity.
- Mobile images are not accepted.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
The interested individuals should send their entries along with the required documents and details to the "Director of Information & Publicity, 3rd Floor, Udyog Bhavan, Panaji, Goa", superscribing the envelope as “Entries for The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition”. A soft copy of high-resolution photographs will also be required to be submitted.

metadata.briefDescription: Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹2,100/- per year is provided to girls studying in Class 1 to 8 in government schools, belonging to families living below the poverty line (BPL) and whose both or one parent has passed away. Girls studying in Class 9 to 12 receive ₹2,500/- per year.

page_content:
# Aapki Beti Yojana

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Women and Child | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Girl Student, BPL, Below Poverty Line, Daughter | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The "Aapki Beti Yojana" scheme was launched by the School Education Department, Government of Rajasthan, to support girls in continuing their education in government schools from Class 1 to 12. Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹2,100/- per year is provided to girls studying in Class 1 to 8 in government schools who belong to families living below the poverty line (BPL) and whose one or both parents have passed away. For girls studying in Class 9 to 12, the assistance is ₹2,500/- per year. The scheme is implemented by the Rajasthan Balika Shiksha Foundation.

## Benefits
> **Financial Assistance:**


- ₹2,100/- per annum for girl students in classes 1st to 8th.- ₹2,500/- per annum for girl students in classes 9th to 12th.
> ***Mode of Disbursement:***


- Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the bank account linked with Jan Aadhaar of the family head or the girl child.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a girl student 
1. The applicant should be studying in a government school in Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be studying in classes 1st to 12th.1. The applicant’s family should fall under the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
1. The applicant should have lost either one parent (single parent) or both parents.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
> ***To avail of the benefits of the scheme, the parents/guardians need to contact their respective government school.***

**Data Entry on Shala Darpan Portal:**

- School authorities log in through the [Shala Darpan School Login](https://rajshaladarpan.rajasthan.gov.in/SD2/BSP/Home/HomePage.aspx).- Navigate to the "Student" tab and fill required details in Form-9.

**Category Selection for Eligible Girls:**

- Under the “Mandatory Student Information for Beneficiary Schemes” section, select class-wise eligible girls under “BPL” and “Orphan/Single Parent” categories.

**Beneficiary Approval:**

- Visit the Beneficiary Scheme Portal through School Login.
- Select the appropriate scheme and approve and lock the displayed list of eligible girls.

**Verification by District Education Officer (DEO):**

- Locked data is reflected on the DEO (primary/secondary) office login.
- DEO completes final verification using OTP-based approval.

**Jan Aadhaar Verification:**

- Before submission, ensure that the girl’s Jan Aadhaar is verified on the Shala Darpan Portal, as funds are transferred via DBT.

page_content:
# Educational Study Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Study Loan, Education, Tuition Fee | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Educational Study Scheme" introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, aims to support students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate professional courses by providing affordable education loans. The loan is available for courses accredited by the relevant councils and is applicable for students studying within Gujarat as well as in other states/UTs for select higher education institutions like IIM, IIT, NID, NIFT, IRMA, and TISS. The scheme is being implemented by the Gujarat Unreserved Education and Economical Development Corporation. ## Benefits **Financial Assistance:** A loan of the total tuition fee of the entire course or ₹10,00,000/-, whichever is less, will be provided by the Corporation at a simple interest of 4%. **Collateral:** - For loans of total loan amount of ₹7,50,000/- or less for the entire course, a charge of one and a half times the loan amount will have to be registered on the beneficiary's own or relative's property. - If the total loan amount for the entire course is more than ₹7,50,000/-, the immovable property of oneself or any other relative equal to that total amount will have to be mortgaged in favor of the Corporation. **Loan repayment:** - In case of total loan up to ₹5,00,000/-, the loan amount along with interest will have to be repaid in equal monthly installments over 5 (five) years, 1 year after completion of studies. - In case of loan of more than ₹5,00,000/-, the loan amount along with interest will have to be repaid in equal monthly installments over 6 (six) years, starting 1 year after completion of studies. - The loan amount being repaid will be credited first as interest. - The borrower can repay the loan even before the specified time limit. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be from Gujarat 1. The applicant must belong to the unreserved category. 1. The applicant must have passed Standard 12 with 60% or more from any school in the state of Gujarat. 1. The annual family income limit for state educational loan schemes will remain at ₹6,00,000/- or less.
**Note:** 1. Priority is given to widows and orphans when sanctioning loans under this scheme. 1. The loans of those who drop out mid-studies or fail to obtain a degree within the stipulated time frame will be subject to recovery at once and interest subsidy will not be available. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Go to the Corporation's [official website](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/) and navigate to the "Gujarat Unreserved Education and Economical Development Corporation" section under the Corporation menu. **Step 2:**Click on "Training Assistance for Competitive Examinations" and then Apply Now. **Step 3:** Click on "New User? Please Register Here". **Step 4:** Enter the required details and click Register.
> **Application Process:** **Step 1:** Enter your User ID, Password, and Captcha Code, then click "Login". **Step 2:** Read the scheme details carefully and click OK. **Step 3:** If your permanent address is correct, confirm it. Otherwise, enter your correct address. **Step 4:** Click Save & Next to proceed. Upload the relevant documents. **Step 5:** If you need to make changes, click "No, Cancel". If all details are correct, click "Yes, Submit". **Step 6:** Click Save Application. Note down your Application Number for future reference. You can also take a printout by clicking Print Application.
> **Check Application Status:** [Click here](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/ViewApplicationStatus.aspx). > **Post Online Application Procedure:** After submitting the online application, the applicant must take a printout of the application, sign it, and submit it along with all uploaded documents (certificates, mark sheets, etc.) to the concerned Deputy Director (Non-Reserved Category) or the District Social Welfare Officer through courier, post, or by visiting in person. > **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://gueedc.gujarat.gov.in/contact-us.html).
