metadata.schemeName: To Opt Composition Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enable eligible GST taxpayers to opt for the Composition Scheme for simplified tax compliance and payment under the Goods and Services Tax (GST) regime.

page_content:
# To Opt Composition Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Delhi | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** GST, Composition Levy, Goods And Services Tax, Regular Taxpayer, Stock Intimation | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "To Opt Composition Scheme" is a centrally sponsored scheme implemented by the Finance Department, Government of NCT of Delhi, which aims to enable eligible GST taxpayers to opt for the Composition Scheme through a simplified tax payment and compliance mechanism under the Goods and Services Tax (GST) system. Eligible new and existing taxpayers can apply online through the GST Portal by submitting the prescribed application form. Existing taxpayers must submit the application before the commencement of the relevant financial year. Applicants are also required to file Stock Intimation within 30 days from the date of opting for the Composition Levy. Composition taxpayers are required to file the prescribed quarterly statement and annual return under GST.
## Benefits - **Simplified GST Compliance:** Eligible taxpayers can opt to pay tax under the Composition Scheme instead of the regular GST scheme, enabling a simpler tax payment and compliance process.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a regular GST taxpayer. - The applicant must have an aggregate annual domestic PAN-based turnover within the limit specified from time to time under GST. - **New Taxpayers:** Any person who becomes liable to register under GST Act, after the appointed day, needs to file his option to pay composition amount in the Application for New Registration in Form GST REG-01. - **Existing Taxpayers:** Any taxpayer who is registered as normal tax payer under GST needs to file an application to opt for Composition Levy in Form GST-CMP-02 at GST Portal prior to the commencement of financial year for which the option to pay tax under the aforesaid section is exercised.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** To opt for composition levy, access the URL [https://www.gst.gov.in/.](https://www.gst.gov.in/) The GST Home page will be displayed. **Step 2:** In case of New Registration, click on "Register" and proceed. **Step 3:** Log into the GST Portal by entering your login Credentials. **Step 4:** Once you have logged in, select ‘Application to Opt for Composition Levy’ from the Registration Menu. **Step 5:** You will be directed to a new screen – Application to Opt for Composition Levy. Your GSTIN, Legal Name of Business, Trade Name (if any), and Address of Principal Place of Business will be displayed. **Step 6:** Below that, your Nature of business and Jurisdiction will be listed. **Step 7:** Below these details, there is a Composition Declaration that you must check to pledge to abide by the conditions and restrictions for Taxpayers who are under the Composition Levy. **Step 8:** Before submission, you must also check the box for Verification (below the Composition Declaration) that states that all the information given is true and that nothing has been concealed from the authority. **Step 9:** Finally, before submission, select the Authorized Signatory from the drop-down menu and enter the Place. **Step 10:** Once you select the Authorized Signatory and enter the Place, the options to submit the form will get activated. Select the desired mode – DSC, E-sign, or EVC – and click the corresponding submission option. For the purpose of this manual, we will submit the application using DSC. **Step 11:** You will get a prompt to confirm your action, click on PROCEED to move forward. **Step 12:** The system will retrieve the installed digital signatures available on your system using the emSigner and you will get a pop-up to select the desired DSC. Select the desired signature. **Step 13:** Once you select the desired digital signature (it will get highlighted in blue), click Sign. If your digital signature is authenticated, you will get a SUCCESS message. **Step 14:** The system will perform some validations and if they are successful your ARN for the work item will be generated and sent to you via e-mail and SMS within the next 15 minutes.

page_content:
# National Disabled Finance and Development Corporation **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Himachal Pradesh | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Disabled, Finance, Unemployed, Loans, Corporation | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Scheme "National Disabled Finance and Development Corporation", launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Himachal Pradesh, aims to make Persons with Disabilities self-reliant by providing loans for self-employment through the Himachal Pradesh Minority Finance and Development Corporation.

## Benefits Loans of up to ₹25,00,000/- are provided for establishing various businesses at an interest rate of 5% to 8%, with an additional 1% interest concession for women with disabilities.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Himachal Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be an unemployed Person with Disability. 1. The applicant should have a disability of 40% or more, certified by a competent authority. 1. The applicant should have an annual income of less than ₹3,00,000 in rural areas or ₹5,00,000 in urban areas.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 1: Fill the prescribed application form and attach the disability certificate, income certificate, project estimate for the proposed work, and surety documents. Step 2: Submit the completed application to the District Welfare Officer or Tehsil Welfare Officer for onward submission to the concerned authorities.

# Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Polisher for Small Cardamom, Large Cardamom, Turmeric, etc (nos) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Commerce And Industry | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Agriculture, Small Cardamom, Large Cardamom, Turmeric, Spices Board | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement – Polisher for Small Cardamom, Large Cardamom, Turmeric, etc. (Nos.) is implemented by the Spices Board, India, under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India. The scheme aims to encourage spice growers to adopt proper polishing methods for spices such as small cardamom, large cardamom, and turmeric to improve their appearance, quality, and marketability. By promoting the use of modern polishing equipment, the scheme helps produce high-quality spices that meet export standards and enhances the competitiveness of Indian spices in international markets. The scheme is being implemented in accordance with the modalities and guidelines approved by the Competent Authority under the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom during the 15th Finance Commission period (2021–22 to 2025–26).
## Benefits 1. 50 % of cost of unit, subject to a maximum of ₹ 94,000/- per unit for General Category and 75% subject to maximum of ₹ 1,40,000 per unit for NE/SC/ST & 90% Spice Producer's Groups in Identified Clusters subjected to maximum of ₹ 1,70,000/- 1. Individual farmers having minimum of 0.40 ha - 8 ha of spices. 1. Assistance for groups/FPOs will be as in QGBG
## Eligibility Criteria 1.All spice growing States and regions in India/UT 2.Designated Officials will conduct final inspection and recommend the eligible cases. > The facility can be used for polishing other suitable spices also and for availing assistance necessary approval may be taken from Director(Dev.) Spices Board with recommendation of Regional Officer.

Step 5: An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number or email; enter the OTP and click “Verify.” Step 6: Registration will be completed successfully, and a confirmation message will be displayed or sent via email. **Login** Step 1: The applicant should visit the ServicesPlus website and click on [“Login.”](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/loginWindow.do) Step 2: Enter your Email ID, Password, and Captcha. Step 3: Select the relevant service/scheme name. Step 4: Fill in the required details in the application form. Step 5: Submit the application.

page_content:
# Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) 2022- for Thrust Sectors: Scheme For Vaccine Manufacturing Units

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Thrust Sectors, Vaccine Manufacturing, Incentives, Entrepreneurship, Subsidy, Reimbursement, IPS | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme “ Scheme For Vaccine Manufacturing Units” is a sub scheme under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)” for Thrust Sectors. It was launched on 3rd July, 2015 for a period of five years by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu. Now it has been extended further from 20th May, 2022 and shall be operative till 19th May, 2027.
> **Objective of the "Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)”:**

The scheme envisages to provide further fillip to the specialized Thrust Sectors such as Plastic Furniture, Steel Furniture, Brass Furniture, Metal Furniture, Cane Furniture, Wooden Furniture, Bamboo Furniture, Fibre Glass Furniture and Marble Furniture etc, therefore making the U.T. a Special Hub for the furniture sector: maximize Women participation in the business sector, reduce unemployment among the local residents and incentivize the industries to employ resident laborers etc.
**Objective of the " Scheme For Vaccine Manufacturing Units" Sub-scheme:**
Under this scheme, Credit-Linked Interest Subsidy and Capital Subsidy shall be provided to Vaccine Manufacturing Units.

## Benefits
- **Credit Linked Interest Subsidy:** 70% per annum limited to maximum of ₹60,00,000/- lakhs per annum for Five years OR, for the period of repayment of loan whichever is earlier.  - **Capital investment Subsidy:**  15% of the investment upto a maximum of ₹10,00,00,000/-.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. Should be a New Manufacturing/ Service units or Existing Manufacturing/ Service units which undertakes Expansion/ Diversification in MSME sector.
   1. The unit should have commenced the commercial production between 20.05.2022 to 19.05.2027.
   1. Unit should be located in the U.T. of Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu.
   1. Enterprise shall have to apply at online portal within one year from the date of first disbursement of loan or on or before the date of commencement of commercial production.

## Exclusions
- The Enterprise will not be eligible for Interest Subsidy under this Scheme if, term loan is sanctioned after one year from the date of commencement of commercial production.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
> **Registration Process****:**

Step 1: Visit the [Registration ](https://swp.dddgov.in/registration)page of the Official Website.
Step 2: Provide the information in the respective input spaces and click on “Register”.
Step 3: Verify your email address using the verification link sent on your email (If Mail is Not Received Your Inbox. Please Check the Spam).
Step 4: Click the Link/URL in the received email or Paste Link/URL in browser's address bar to complete your Account Verification.
Step 5: Now enter “111111” as OTP to verify your mobile number. Mobile Number and Pin Successfully will be sent to the registered Email Address.
Step 6: On successful registration the login credentials will be received in the registered email.
> **Application Process**:

Step 1: Visit the user [Login ](https://swp.dddgov.in/login)page of the Official Website.
Step 2: Enter registered Mobile Number along with PIN sent on your email then click “Log In”.
Step 3: On successful Log In, from the left side menu bar click on “Departments & Services” tab.
Step 4: Scroll down to “District Industries Centre DD & DNH” and click on the “Click Here” button to apply for “Investment Promotion Scheme : 2022 to 2027 (20 May 2022 to 19 May 2027)”. 
Step 5: “Common Application Form” will be open. Enter all the details in required input fields and upload all the mandatory documents.
Step 6: After successful entry of the information, verify all the details and click on the “Submit” button to complete the application process.
> **Helpdesk****:**

District Industries Centre,
**Contact No.:** 0260-2260871 / 0260-2260310
**E-mail Address:** dic-dd@nic.in
For Technical Assistance on Single Window Portal (i.e. https://investdd.in)  Contact No. : 0260-2231885 / 2231886  E-Mail : ddegs-dd@nic.in

metadata.schemeName: Manohar Parrikar Goa Scholars Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote postgraduate and Doctor of Philosophy studies among talented students from Goa, encourage admission to reputed institutions in India and abroad, and foster quality education, research, development, and innovation.

page_content:
# Manohar Parrikar Goa Scholars Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Post Graduate, PhD, Higher Education | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Manohar Parrikar Goa Scholars Scheme, 2025" has been launched by the Directorate of Higher Education, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to promote postgraduate and Doctor of Philosophy studies among talented students from Goa, encourage admission to reputed institutions in India and abroad, and strengthen quality education, research, development, and innovation. It provides financial assistance for studies in India and abroad to meritorious scholars pursuing postgraduate or Doctor of Philosophy programmes. **Objectives of the Scheme** To promote postgraduate and Doctor of Philosophy studies among talented youth of Goa. To recognize and support meritorious and outstanding candidates. To encourage admission in reputed institutions in India and abroad. To motivate students to undertake cutting-edge research. To promote quality education, research, development, and innovation. To contribute towards sustainable development through human capital creation.
## Benefits **Scholarship for Studies in India:** - Financial assistance of ₹6,00,000 is provided to each selected scholar pursuing postgraduate or Doctor of Philosophy studies in India. **Scholarship for Studies Abroad:** - Financial assistance of ₹15,00,000 is provided to each selected scholar pursuing postgraduate or Doctor of Philosophy studies abroad. **Number of Awards:** - Up to 40 scholars are selected every year. - In exceptional circumstances, the number of awards may be increased. - The total number of awards shall not exceed 50 in a year. **Mode of Disbursement:** - Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary's bank account.

## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should not be more than 35 years of age as on 1 January of the year for which the scheme is disbursed. 1. The applicant should be a resident of Goa for a minimum period of 15 years. 1. The applicant who is of Goan origin may also apply, provided the applicant has resided in Goa for at least 7 years. 1. The applicant of Goan origin should submit proof that either parent or grandparent was born in Goa. 1. The applicant should have passed the qualifying degree examination from an institution, preferably located in Goa. 1. The applicant should have secured a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade in the qualifying degree examination. 1. The applicant should have obtained a minimum aggregate score of 70% as per the criteria prescribed under the scheme for shortlisting. 1. The applicant should be a bonafide student of the institution in which the applicant is pursuing a postgraduate or Doctor of Philosophy programme. 1. The applicant should be pursuing the postgraduate or Doctor of Philosophy programme during the academic year for which assistance is sought. 1. The applicant should provide a bonafide certificate mentioning the programme name and the start and end dates of study. 1. The applicant may pursue a postgraduate or Doctor of Philosophy programme in any discipline. 1. The applicant should provide rank, grade, position, or accreditation details if the institution is listed in QS World University Rankings, Times Higher Education Rankings, National Institutional Ranking Framework rankings, or accredited by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council.

## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - Register on the [SUGAM portal](https://sugam.gshec.edu.in/) and log in using your credentials.- Select the Bursary Scheme from the available schemes on the dashboard. - Click “New Application”, choose the applicable academic year, and create a new application. - Fill in the required personal details and proceed to the next section. - Enter your address details and provide information on past and current academic qualifications. Upload the bonafide certificate. - Enter fee details and upload the fee receipt and textbook fee receipt (if applicable). - Provide parent/guardian details, family annual income information, and upload supporting documents such as income certificates and death certificates (if applicable). - Enter bank account details and upload the required banking and identity documents. - Complete the undertaking by downloading it through the e-sign process using Aadhaar authentication, then upload the signed undertaking. - Preview the application, submit it online, and receive a confirmation email upon successful submission. > **NOTE:** [**Student User Manual**](https://goascholar.dhe.goa.gov.in/Manual) **to know more about the application process.**

# Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom:Small Cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Rain water harvesting structure (nos) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Commerce And Industry | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Rain Water Harvesting, Agriculture, Land Development, Farmer, Small Cardamom | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Rain Water Harvesting Structure Scheme implemented by the Spices Board under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India, and as per the Modalities and Scheme Guidelines approved by the Competent Authority for the implementation of the “Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion and Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom” during the 15th Finance Commission period (2021–22 to 2025–26), financial assistance is provided to motivate growers to bring more area under irrigation and land development through the construction of rain water harvesting structures. The scheme aims to increase productivity and improve the quality of small cardamom.
## Benefits 1. 33.33 % of cost of construction subject to a maximum of ₹18,000 per structure for General and 75% subject to maximum of ₹40,000 /- per structure for SC/ST. 1. The above assistance will be for a structure of 200 cu. Mt. capacity lined with silpauline sheet. For lesser capacity the assistance will be limited proportionate to the water holding capacity. 1. Devices can be for harvesting water from direct rainfall as well as surface run off without blocking the natural flow of water including streams. 1. Registered cardamom growers having land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a registered small cardamom grower eligible under the scheme guidelines of the Spices Board. 1. The rain water harvesting structure should not block the natural flow of water, streams, or drainage channels, and should not create objections from the local community or concerned authorities. 1. The constructed structure must be inspected by the designated officials, and assistance will be recommended only for eligible cases as per the approved delegation. 1. The Inspecting Officer must ensure that all scheme conditions are complied with before recommending the case for sanction. 1. Random checking of the approved structures may be conducted by the respective controlling officers.
## Exclusions

Step 3: Select the relevant service/scheme name. Step 4: Fill in the required details in the application form. Step 5: Submit the application.

Through this scheme, nutritional support, health services, nutrition education and skilling support are provided to adolescent girls aged 14-18 years in identified areas.

page_content:
# Scheme For Adolescent Girls **Ministry:** Ministry of Women and Child Development | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Health & Wellness, Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child | **Tags:** Female, Health, Medicine, Free Meal, Nutrition, Youth, Empowerment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description A support scheme by Ministry of Women & Child Development enabling self-development and empowerment of out-of-school adolescent girls, and improving their nutritional, health & hygiene status.
The scheme aims at supporting out of school AGs to successfully transition back to formal schooling or bridge learning / skill training. Upgrade their home-based skills and life skills. Provide information/guidance about existing public services such as Primary Health Centers, Rural Hospitals/CHCs, Post Office, Bank, Police Station, etc.
Scheme for Adolescent Girls - SAG is implemented using the platform of Anganwadi Services of Umbrella ICDS Scheme through Anganwadi Centers (AWCs). ## Benefits **Nutrition Component:** 1. Take Home Ration or Hot Cooked Meal for out of school girls - Nutrition Provision ₹ 9.50 per day (600 calories; 18‐20 gram of protein and recommended daily intake of micronutrients per day for 300 days in a year.). 1. The financial norms will be ₹ 9.5/- per beneficiary per day for 300 days in a year. This would be inclusive of the cost of micronutrient fortification.
**Non Nutrition Component:** 1. IFA supplementation. 1. Health check‐up and Referral services. 1. Nutrition & Health Education (NHE). 1. Counseling / Guidance on family welfare, ARSH, child care practices. 1. Life Skill Education and accessing public services. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a **FEMALE**.1. The age of the applicant must be between **11 and 14 years**. ## Exclusions NA ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline The out-of-school adolescent girls (11 - 14 years age) are identified by the State / UT through a Base Line Survey, a one-time activity carried out by the Anganwadi Workers (AWW) who should go from house to house to meet every family in the area covered by her AWC, and gather information about the details of such girls. Such girls are provided the benefits through the Anganwadi Centre (AWC).

page_content:
# Annapurna Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** West Bengal | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Women Empowerment, Financial Assistance, Women Welfare, DBT | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Annapurna Yojana” implemented by the Women and Child Development and Social Welfare Department, Government of West Bengal aims to provide assured monthly financial assistance to eligible women residing in the state for their empowerment and socio-economic upliftment. Under the scheme, eligible women receive ₹3,000/- per month through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). The financial assistance is credited directly into the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary. Existing beneficiaries of the "Lakshmir Bhandar" Scheme are migrated to the "Annapurna Yojana" subject to prescribed conditions. Online application facilities for new applicants are available through the Annapurna Yojana Portal from 1st June, 2026.
## Benefits - **Monthly Financial Assistance:** Eligible women receive ₹3,000/- per month. > **Note:** - **Mode of Disbursement:** The financial assistance is transferred through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). - **Bank Account Requirement:** The amount is credited to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a woman. - The applicant must be aged between 25 to 60 years, - The applicant must not be in any permanent government employment getting regular salary/ pension under the union or this state government, any statutory body, government undertaking, panchayat, municipal body, local body; teaching or non-teaching employment under this state government's aided educational institution, etc. - The applicant must not be paying any Income Tax. > **Notes:** - All the existing beneficiaries of the "Lakshmir Bhandar" Scheme shall be migrated to the "Annapurna Yojana" except dead, shifted, deleted, and absentee electors identified during SIR-2026, deletion in the 2™ list after publication of draft list, deleted after adjudication, ASDD found during voter slip distribution. - Beneficiaries who have filed an appeal before the SIR Tribunal/applications under the Citizenship (Amendment) Act shall get financial assistance under the New Scheme till disposal of their applications. Likewise, names of dead and shifted beneficiaries will be deleted in the future on a regular basis.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** The applicant must visit the official "[Annapurna Yojana](https://socialregistry.wb.gov.in/citizen/#/)" application portal. **Step 2:** Select the district name from the dropdown and enter the mobile number. **Step 3:** In the next window, the "Family Level Data Collection" form will appear. **Step 4:** Enter all the required details of the Head of the Family, followed by the other members' details as well. **Step 5:** Upload relevant documents and click on the "Submit" button. **Step 6:** Note down the Application ID for future reference.

metadata.schemeName: Kisan Credit Card
metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
metadata.briefDescription: The Kisan Credit Card (KCC) scheme was introduced in 1998 for issue of Kisan Credit Cards to farmers on the basis of their holdings for uniform adoption by the banks so that farmers may use them to readily purchase agriculture inputs and draw cash for their production needs.

page_content:
# Kisan Credit Card **Ministry:** Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Kisan, Credit Card, Farmer, Farming, Banking | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The KCC Scheme was introduced with the objective of providing adequate and timely credit to the farmers for their agricultural operations. The Government of India provides interest subvention of 2% and Prompt Repayment Incentive of 3% to the farmers, thus making the credit available at a very subsidized rate of 4% per annum. The scheme was further extended for the investment credit requirement of farmers viz. allied and non-farm activities in the year 2004 and further revisited in 2012 by a working Group under the Chairmanship of Shri T. M. Bhasin, CMD, Indian Bank with a view to simplify the scheme and facilitate issue of Electronic Kisan Credit Cards. The scheme provides broad guidelines to banks for operationalizing the KCC scheme. Implementing banks will have the discretion to adopt the same to suit institution/location-specific requirements.
**Objective / Purpose** The Kisan Credit Card scheme aims at providing adequate and timely credit support from the banking system under a single window with the flexible and simplified procedures to the farmers for their cultivation and other needs as indicated below : 1. To meet the short term credit requirements for the cultivation of crops; 1. Post-harvest expenses; 1. Produce marketing loan; 1. Consumption requirements of farmer household; 1. Working capital for maintenance of farm assets and activities allied to agriculture; 1. Investment credit requirement for agriculture and allied activities
**Type of Card** - A magnetic stripe card with PIN (Personal Identification Number) with an ISO IIN (International Standards Organization International Identification Number) to enable access to all banks ATMs and micro ATMs - In cases where the Banks would want to utilize the centralized biometric authentication infrastructure of the UIDAI (Aadhaar authentication), debit cards with magnetic stripe and PIN with ISO IIN with biometric authentication of UIDAI can be provided. - Debit Cards with magnetic stripes and only biometric authentication can also be provided depending on the customer base of the bank. Till such time, UIDAI becomes widespread, if the banks want to get started without inter-operability using their existing centralized bio metric infrastructure, banks may do so. - Banks may choose to issue EMV (Europay, MasterCard and VISA, a global standard for the interoperation of integrated circuit cards) and RUPAY compliant chip cards with magnetic stripe and pin with ISO IIN. - Further, biometric authentication and smart cards may follow the common open standards prescribed by IDRBT and IBA. This will enable them to transact seamlessly with input dealers and also enable them to have the sales proceeds credited to their accounts when they sell their output at mandies, procurement centres, etc
**Delivery Channels :** The following delivery channels shall be put in place to start with so that the Kisan Credit Card is used by the farmers to effectively transact their operations in their KCC account. 1. Withdrawal through ATMs / Micro ATM 1. Withdrawal through BCs using smart cards. 1. PoS machine through input dealers 1. Mobile Banking with IMPS capabilities / IVR 1. Aadhaar enabled Cards ## Eligibility Criteria **Eligibility** 1. Farmers - individual/joint borrowers who are owner cultivators; 1. Tenant farmers, oral lessees & share croppers; 1. Self Help Groups (SHGs) or Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers including tenant farmers, share croppers etc ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Mode:** Offline

# Pre Matric Scholarship For Students With Disabilities **Ministry:** Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Persons With Disability, Student, Scholarship, Pre-Matric, Social Welfare, School, Education, Students With Disabilities, Book Grant | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description A scholarship scheme by DoEPwDs for Students with Disabilities (SwDs) studying in class 9th and class 10th in a government school or a school recognized by the government or CBSE or State Board.

metadata.schemeName: National Food Security Mission NFSM
metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
metadata.briefDescription: National Food Security Mission was launched in 2007-08 to increase the production of rice, wheat and pulses. Later, coarse cereals, nutri cereals, commercial crops (sugarcane, jute, and cotton) were also added to the mission.

page_content:
# National Food Security Mission NFSM **Ministry:** Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Demonstration, Seed Distribution, Seed Hub, Seed Production, Pulses, Rice, Wheat, Nutri Cereals, Millets | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The core objective of the Mission is to bridge the yield gap in respect of these crops through dissemination of improved technologies and farm management practices. Under the programme, various incentives like production and distribution of seeds, supply of seed mini kits, Front Line/Cluster Demonstrations, improved farm implements, bio-pesticides, micronutrients, bio-fertilizers etc. are provided to the farmers.
S. No.ComponentBenefit1DemonstrationThe incentives for demonstration in one ha area for sole crop (excluding coarse cereals) will Rs 9000/- and Rs. 15000/- for a cropping-system based demonstration.For coarse cereals, the incentive for demonstration in one ha area will be Rs. 6000/-2Seed DistributionAssistance for purchase of seeds will be available to selected farmers for the area not exceeding 2 ha each in a crop season as per provisions in the DBT. The rate varies for each crop.
## Benefits The scheme targets to provide following benefits: 1) Enhance production and productivity of crops 2) Promotion and extension of improved technologies and seed varieties through Cluster Demonstration, Cluster Frontline Demonstration, and Frontline Demonstration 3) Assistance for quality / certified seeds production and distribution 4) Support for nutrient management and pest management 5) Provision of flexi component for Interventions covering farm implements/ machines, capacity building of farmers, water carrying pipes, post-harvest technologies like Dal Mill/de-stoning/ grading, etc. ## Eligibility Criteria All farmers can apply for the scheme.
**Criteria for Identification of Areas and Beneficiaries** 1) In accordance with the decision of the GoI regarding implementation of Special Component Plan (SCP) for Scheduled Castes and Tribal SubPlan (TSP) for Scheduled Tribes, 16% of the total allocation for SCP and 8% for TSP will be earmarked. However, States will be allowed to make allocation to SC/ST farmers proportionate to their population in the States/districts. 2) At least 33% allocation of the fund is to be made for small and marginal farmers. 3) At least 30% allocation of the fund is to be made for women farmers. 4) All the farmers are entitled to avail the assistance for various components of the Mission limited to 5 hectares in a season.
**Criteria for selection of districts:** 1) Districts with area more than 50,000 ha and yield below State average yield under NFSM-Rice and NFSM-Wheat have been selected. 2) All districts of north-eastern states (except Assam) with at least 5000 ha area under rice have been selected. 3) Districts with at least 15000 ha area under rice or wheat in hill states of Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir and Uttarakhand have been selected. 4) All districts of 29 states have been included under NFSM pulses. 5) In case of coarse cereals (Maize and Barley), the districts covering 70% of the total coarse cereals area of the state have been selected. 6) All States growing Jowar, Bajra, Ragi and Small Millets will be covered under the programme of NFSM-Nutri-Cereals (Jowar, Bajra, Ragi and Small Millets).
For a Cluster Front Line Demonstration (CFLD) organised by ICAR, each cluster must be atleast 25 ha For a Front Line Demonstration (FLD) organised by ICAR, each cluster must be atleast 1 ha For a Demonstration organised by state government, each cluster must be atleast 100 ha (25 ha for Hilly and North East states)

## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 01: Identification of individual beneficiary in a transparent and time-bound manner. Gram Panchayat should be involved in selection of beneficiary farmers. Panchayati Raj Institutions will be actively involved in selection of beneficiary and selection of interventions under Local Initiatives in the identified districts.
Step 02: Funds for implementing the Mission's programme will be released to the State governments with the approval of the NFSM-EC.
Step 03: The State Governments will release the funds to the State Level Agency through PFMS/Treasury.
Step 04: The State Level Agency would make funds available to the District Level Agency in accordance with approved programme of the district.
Step 05: District level agency would release the fund to the Implementing Agency/ beneficiary.

metadata.schemeName: NPS Vatsalya Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: NPS Vatsalya is a contributory saving cum long-term financial security scheme designed exclusively for minors for the purposes of enhancing financial literacy and financial planning and to encourage empowerment of children, emanating from the vision of "Viksit Bharat@2047.

page_content:
# NPS Vatsalya Scheme **Ministry:** Ministry Of Finance | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** NPS, Minor, Pension Fund, PFRDA, Long Term Financial Security, Financial, Saving | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description “NPS Vatsalya” Scheme was announced by the Hon’ble Finance Minister in the Union Budget for FY 2024-25 as a plan for contributions by parents and guardians for minors to be converted into a normal NPS account on the attainment of majority. Under this scheme, parents or guardians can open an NPS account for their children and contribute an amount every month or year till the child reaches 18 years. The minimum contribution is ₹ 1,000 per year, and there is no limit on the maximum contribution. This scheme allows parents to open accounts for their children and contribute towards their retirement savings.
**The NPS Vatsalya Scheme offers the following:** **Investment Choices:** - **Default Choice:** Moderate Lifecycle Fund - LC-50 (50% equity).- **Auto Choice:** Aggressive Lifecycle Fund - LC-75 (75% equity), Moderate Lifecycle Fund - LC-50 (50% equity), or Conservative Lifecycle Fund: LC-25 (25% equity).- **Active Choice:** Parents can actively decide the allocation of funds across equity (up to 75%), government securities (up to 100%), corporate debt (up to 100%), and alternate assets (up to 5%).
**Contribution:** - Account Opening contribution: Min. ₹ 1,000/- and Max no limit. - Subsequent contribution: Min. ₹ 1,000/- p.a. and Max no limit.
**Upon Attainment of the age of 18 Years:** - Seamless shift to NPS Tier-I (All Citizen) fresh KYC of the minor within three months from the date of attaining 18 years.
**Exit and withdrawal from the account:** - For education of the subscriber, treatment of specified illnesses, disability more than 75%, or the reasons as may be specified by PFRDA in the interest of the minor subscriber under the regulations, the guardian shall be allowed to partially withdraw up to 25% of subscribers’ contribution excluding returns thereon after minimum 3 years from the date of opening of the account, for maximum three times till the subscriber attains 18 years of age. Such facility shall be made available on a declaration basis. - In the case of the death of the minor subscriber, the entire accumulated pension wealth is to be paid to the guardian. - In case of the guardian's death registered under the account, another guardian is to be registered on behalf of the minor subscriber by submitting the KYC documents as specified by the PFRDA from time to time. - In case of the death of both parents, the legally appointed guardian may continue the account with or without making contributions to the account, and upon attainment of 18 years of age by the subscriber, the subscriber shall have the option to continue or exit from the scheme. - The subscriber shall be allowed to exit only upon attainment of 18 years. On such exit, at least eighty percent of accumulated pension wealth available in the account shall be utilized for the purchase of an annuity, and the remaining balance shall be paid in a lump sum. In case, the accumulated pension wealth available in the account is equal to or less than ₹ 2,50,000/-, or the purchase of annuity is not available from empanelled Annuity Service Providers (‘ASPs’), the subscriber shall have the option to withdraw the entire accumulated pension wealth. - The exits and withdrawals under the scheme shall be governed by the provisions of the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (Exits and Withdrawals under the National Pensions System) Regulations, 2015 and amendments thereof. ## Benefits 1. Opening an NPS Vatsalya account provides the child with a head start on saving for retirement and offers valuable financial lessons from an early age. It instills the importance of financial planning and discipline. which can benefit the child throughout their life. 1. Upon reaching 18 years, the account automatically transitions into a regular NPS Tier I account, maintaining investment continuity with no additional administrative steps. 1. For the purpose of education of the subscriber, treatment of specified illnesses, disability more than 75%, or the reasons as may be specified by PFRDA in the interest of the minor subscriber under the regulations, the guardian shall be allowed to partially withdraw up to 25% of subscribers’ contribution excluding returns thereon, after a minimum of 3 years from the date of opening of account, for maximum three times till the subscriber attains 18 years of age. Such facility shall be made available on a declaration basis. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. Any minor who is a Citizen of India is eligible for opening account under the scheme, until attaining the age of eighteen years. 1. The account should be opened by a natural or legal guardian in the minor's name, as they will operate the account exclusively for the benefit of the minor. 1. If the guardian is court-appointed, they must submit a copy of the court order confirming the guardianship and KYC documents. 1. The guardian must comply with KYC norms as per the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) requirements. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Visit the [NPS Trust Website](https://npstrust.org.in/open-nps-vatsalya) https://npstrust.org.in **Step 2:** On the home page click, “Open NPS Vatsalya” **Step 3:** Subscriber will be directed to the page where the choice of any of the three CRAs can be made. **Step 4:** On selecting the CRA, subscriber needs to enter the basic details of the Minor and the Guardian and complete OTP authentication. **Step 5:** KYC details of the guardian such as Name, Date of Birth, Gender, Address, and Photo will be fetched from UIDAI database or CERSAI database and rest of the details to be filled. Proof of Date of Birth of minor should be uploaded. **Step 6:** FATCA details and declaration to be entered and the choice of Investment Option should be made. **Step 7:** Details to be verified through OTP authentication through email and mobile number. **Step 8:** Initial contribution amount of Min Rs 1000/- to be made **Step 9**: PRAN will be generated after successful payment.


**Mode:** Offline You may also visit any Point of Presence (PoP) registered by the PFRDA which are Public Sector Banks, Private banks, RRBs, Pension Funds and brokers etc, to open NPS Vatsalya account.

# AICTE - Distinguished Chair Professor Fellowship

**Ministry:** Ministry of Education | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Fellowship, Financial Assistance, Research | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
A Fellowship Scheme by the All India Council for Technical Education, Ministry of Education. The Distinguished Chair Professor Fellowship intends to utilize the expertise of highly qualified and experienced superannuated professionals who have made unparalleled, exceptional professional contributions to society in their respective fields/disciplines for motivating and inspiring students/faculty of AICTE-approved institutes. The fellowship is tenable for a period of three years or the age of 75 years whichever is earlier, extendable till 80 years of age subject to fitness. The Fellowship consists of an honorarium of ₹10,000/- for full-day interaction with the Faculty/ Students of the host institute and nearby located institutions for up to a maximum of five days in a single trip.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The awardee must be a highly qualified superannuated Professional in his / her field.
1. The awardee should be an acknowledged leader (expert) in that particular field of specialization having actively engaged in research and development.
1. The awardee should have contributed to the development of society through his / her excellent fieldwork.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline

metadata.briefDescription: The scholarship aims to support meritorious students by providing financial assistance of ₹3,000 per month during their undergraduate studies.

page_content:
# National Talent Scholarship Undergraduate **Ministry:** Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Student, Scholarship, Agriculture, Education | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description National Talent Scholarship (NTS) was launched by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research for students pursuing a Bachelor's program in an ICAR-recognized agricultural university located outside of his/her state of domicile and duly funded under the planning scheme “Strengthening and Development of Higher Agricultural Education in India" of the Education Division of the ICAR. The amount of the scholarship is ₹ 2,000/- per month for Bachelor's (Under Graduate). The scholarship will be awarded initially for a period of one year from the date the student actually takes admission and shall be renewed for the remaining duration of the undergraduate degree program subject to his/her maintenance of good academic performance and conduct as specified by the concerned university.
The Scholarship will be awarded initially for a period of one year from the date the student actually take admission in the Agricultural University for pursuing under Graduate degree programme in agriculture and related disciplines with both course work and practice leading to the award of Bachelor's Degree. The scholarship is will be renewed for the remaining duration of the undergraduate degree programme subject to his/her maintenance of good academic performance and conduct as specified by the concerned univcnity.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a student pursuing a Bachelors's from an Agricultural University recognized by ICAR, located outside his/her state of domicile. 2. The applicant should be admitted into the university through the All India Entrance Examination (AIEE). 3. The university should be duly funded under "Strengthening and Development of Higher Agricultural Education in India" of the Education Division, ICAR.
**The student shall be eligible for the scholarship provided he/ she -** 1. Maintains merit and good conduct as certified by the Head of the College / University / Institution. 2. Does not remain absent without prior permission and does not participate in any agitation/strike etc. during the period. 3. Takes up studies on a whole-time basis and does not take up any job even on a part-time basis. 4. Does not accept any other financial assistance/scholarship during the course of undergraduate study. 5. Does not leave his/her course of study within one month of admission. 6. Does not subsequently change the initial subject allocated for which he/she has been awarded the NTS during his studies. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** https://icar.nta.ac.in

page_content:
# Post Matric Scholarship Students With Disabilities **Ministry:** Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Persons With Disability, Post-Matric, Student, Scholarship, Diploma, Degree, Graduation, Post-Graduation | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description A scholarship scheme by DoEPwD for students with disabilities pursuing a post-matric qualification from UGC/AICTE recognized universities, i.e. students of Class 11th, Class 12th, including Polytechnics, Post-Matriculation Diploma/Certificates and Bachelor’s Degree/Diploma in India and Master’s Degree/Diploma.
The students with the specified disabilities defined in Schedule of the "Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016" will be eligible under this scheme. This includes persons with visual, hearing, speech, loco-motor, mental retardation, and other disabilities. NOS is implemented offline by the DEPwD.
At times SwDs are deprived of harnessing their latent skills and thereby miss the opportunity. This scheme aims to support SwDs to study further in order to prepare themselves to earn their livelihood and to find a dignified place for themselves in the society as they face several barriers physical, financial, psychological, mental in pursuing studies and living with dignity. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be pursuing a post-matric qualification, i.e. Class 11th, Class 12th, including Polytechnics, Post-Matriculation Diploma/Certificates and Bachelor’s Degree/Diploma in India and Master’s Degree/Diploma. 1. The applicant must be disabled, with disability percentage of 40% or above. 1. The Total Annual income of parents/guardians of the applicant (from all sources) must not exceed ₹ 2.50 Lakh per Annum. 1. The applicant must not be availing any other scholarship by the govt. 1. The applicant must not be the third sibling of the family who has been given this scholarship. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** http://www.scholarships.gov.in/

## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline 1. No separate application is required. 1. Eligible students enrolled in government schools are automatically covered under the scheme.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
metadata.briefDescription: UDID Card or Unique Disability Identity card is an initiative by Government of India with a view of creating a National Database for Persons with Disabilities (PwDs). Under the UDID project Disability Certificate and Unique Disability Identity Card is issued to each PwD through online platform.

page_content:
# Unique Disability Identity - DNH & DD **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu | **Categories:** Women and Child, Social welfare & Empowerment, Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Disability Card, Swavlamban Card, Unique Disability Identity Cards, Medical Boards, UDID, Persons With Disabilities, PwDs | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Unique Disability ID (UDID)” has been launched by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Government of India, aiming to create a national database of Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) and issue a Unique Disability Identity Card to each individual to ensure transparency, efficiency, and ease in delivering government benefits. Through this scheme, Disability Certificates and Unique Disability Identity Cards are provided to Persons with Disabilities across the country. The scheme is implemented by competent medical authorities notified by the respective State Governments and Union Territories through the centralised UDID portal. The project supports online application submission, assessment of disability percentage by hospitals or Medical Boards, online renewal and updating of information, and integrated management of government schemes and benefits for PwDs. It also eliminates duplicate records and enables tracking of the physical and financial progress of beneficiaries at the village, block, district, state, and national levels. District Welfare Officers assist in registration camps and application management, while District Collectors monitor implementation through reporting features available on the portal. **Objectives:** - To create a national database of Persons with Disabilities (PwDs). - To issue a Unique Disability Identity Card (UDID) to each individual. - To ensure transparency, efficiency, and ease in delivering government benefits to PwDs. - To maintain uniformity across regions in disability certification and identification. - To eliminate duplicate records of Persons with Disabilities. - To enable online renewal and updating of disability-related information. - To support integrated management of government benefits and schemes for PwDs. - To provide nationwide availability of PwD data through a centralized web application.
## Benefits The Unique Disability Identity (UDID) card, also known as the Swavlamban Card, is a mandatory document for persons with disabilities (PwDs) in the Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu to access various central and state government welfare schemes. The UDID card ensures a uniform, digitized record that eliminates the need for carrying multiple documents and provides a single, nation-wide proof of disability.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be suffering from any of the 21 specified disabilities listed under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016. 1. The applicant should apply for issuance of a Disability Certificate and Unique Disability Identity (UDID) card through the UDID portal. 1. The applicant should undergo disability assessment by the concerned hospital, Medical Board, or competent medical authority for the determination of disability percentage. 1. The applicant should get the disability verified and certified by medical authorities notified by the respective State Government or Union Territory Administration. 1. The applicant should provide the required personal, medical, and disability-related details during the application process.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Visit the official [UDID Portal](https://swavlambancard.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on “Apply For UDID” on the homepage. **Step 3:** Register as a Person with Disability (PwD) on the portal. **Step 4:** Log in using the registered credentials. **Step 5:** Fill in the online application form for the Disability Certificate and UDID card with the required details. **Step 6:** Upload the required documents, including medical and identity-related documents. **Step 7:** Submit the application through the portal. **Step 8:** The concerned Medical Authority/Medical Board verifies the application and conducts disability assessment for the calculation of disability percentage. **Step 9:** The Medical Authority issues the Disability Certificate and UDID card electronically through the portal upon approval. **Step 10:** Track the application status using the “Track Your Application” facility available on the portal. **Step 11:** Download and print the Disability Certificate and UDID card after approval. **Step 12:** Use the portal for renewal, replacement, or updating of information whenever required.

metadata.schemeName: Hari Om Ashram Prerit Doctor Vikram Sarabhai Research Award
metadata.briefDescription: The Shri Hari Om Ashram Prerit Doctor Vikram Sarabhai Research Awards are biennial awards established with funds from Pujya Shri Mota of Hari Om Ashram, Nadiad, to recognize outstanding contributions by Indian scientists under the age of 45 in the fields of Space Sciences etc.

page_content:
# Hari Om Ashram Prerit Doctor Vikram Sarabhai Research Award **Ministry:** Ministry Of Science And Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Award, Scientist, Research, Cash Prize | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Shri Hari Om Ashram Prerit Dr. Vikram Sarabhai Research Awards are biennial awards established with funds from Pujya Shri Mota of Hari Om Ashram, Nadiad, to recognize outstanding contributions by Indian scientists under the age of 45 in the fields of Space Sciences, Space Applications, Electronics, Informatics, Telematics, Automation, and Systems Analysis or Management. The awards consist of a cash prize of ₹50,000, a medal, and recognition for original research work done in India.
> ***Fields of Disciplines:*** - Space Sciences (including Astronomy, Astrophysics, Planetary and Atmospheric Sciences). - Space Applications (in the areas of Meteorology, Hydrology, Remote Sensing, and related Ground Truths). - Electronics, Informatics, Telematics and Automation. - Systems Analysis or Management, including non-linear, non-equilibrium systems in natural and social sciences and technology. ## Benefits - **Cash Prize of ₹50,000/- and Medal.** ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be an Indian citizen. 1. The applicant should be a scientist. 1. The applicant's age is below 45 years (born on or after January 2, 1972, for the 2017 awards). 1. The applicant's contributions should be in the areas mentioned, such as Space Sciences, Space Applications, Electronics, Informatics, Telematics, Automation, etc. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step-01:** The applicant visits the [PRL website](https://www.prl.res.in/prl-eng/) and navigate to the "Opportunities" section. **Step-02:** Click on "Awards Administered By PRL" and select scheme "Hari Om Ashram Prerit Doctor Vikram Sarabhai Research Award" **Step-03:** The candidate downloads the prescribed format of the application form. **Step-04:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step-05:** Candidate can email or post their applications in the prescribed format to: hoa@prl.res.in OR The Director, Physical Research Laboratory, Navrangpura, Ahmedabad-380009.

metadata.schemeName: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility - Soil Health Card
metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote soil test-based nutrient management by providing Soil Health Cards containing soil analysis results and fertilizer recommendations to farmers across India.

page_content:
# RKVY Soil Health and Fertility - Soil Health Card **Ministry:** Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Soil Health, INM, Soil Testing, Farmer, RKVY | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description SHC can be downloaded by the farmers from the SHC portal or through SMS link received on mobile. It will contain the status of his soil with respect to 12 parameters, namely N,P,K, S (Macro-nutrients); Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo (Micro - nutrients) ; and pH, EC, OC. Based on this, the SHC will also indicate fertilizer recommendations and soil amendment required for the farm.
ComponentRateSoil sampling, testing, and generation of SHCRs 300 per SHC (Rs 40 for soil collection + Rs 150 for testing (analysing soil samples + cost of chemical) + Rs. 110 for awareness
The key objectives of the scheme are as follows: • To promote soil test based nutrient management across the country • To issue soil health cards to all farmers across the country • Strengthen the functioning of soil testing laboratories and associated infrastructure • Capacity building of district and state level staff for promotion of nutrient management practices • To diagnose soil fertility related constraints with standardized procedures for sampling uniformly across states; and analyse and design fertilizer recommendations.
## Benefits The scheme targets to provide following benefits: 1) Provide free / affordable access to soil test 2) Provide farmers with timely and accurate soil analysis results 3) Facilitate customized soil nutrient recommendations based on test results 4) Enable farmers to optimize their fertiliser use and minimise input costs, and hence avoid under- or over- application of fertiliser
## Eligibility Criteria The scheme is applicable for all farmers in India. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 01: Farmer approaches a District Agriculture Officer / Block Agriculture Officer for soil testing and generation of a SHC.
Step 02: The concerned officer shall initiate the process for the concerned farmer wherein they assess whether the applicant’s district / village falls under State Annual Action Plan for generation of SHC.
Step 03: Agent visits the farmer and collects farmer details, land details and geo-tags the land through mobile app and takes a sample of the soil for testing
Step 04: The soil is tested on set parameters and a Soil Health report is generated for the farmer’s land
Step 05: The report contains results as well as recommendations on suitable crops for the soil type, and the quantity and type of fertiliser to be used.

metadata.schemeName: National Savings (Monthly Income  Account) Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides a fixed monthly income to investors through periodic interest payments on a one-time deposit made at the time of account opening.

page_content:
# National Savings (Monthly Income Account) Scheme **Ministry:** Ministry Of Finance | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Investment, Savings, Financial Assistance, Post Office | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Post Office Monthly Income Scheme (POMIS) is an investment scheme recognized and validated by the Ministry of Finance. It is one of the highest-earning schemes with an interest rate of 6.6%. The interest in this scheme is disbursed monthly. After opening a POMIS account, individuals can invest a suitable amount based on affordability, which, however, should not be less than ₹1500. It provides low risk and steady income where an investor can deposit every month and get interested of MIS in the post office according to their applicable monthly rate. The income on investment is given by the concerned post office every month.
> **Features of the POMIS scheme:** 1. Maturity period- The maximum tenure of the Indian post office monthly income scheme is 5 years. 1. Number of holders- At least 1 and at most 3 individuals can hold post office MIS. 1. Nomination- Only the nominee will get all scheme benefits after the investor’s demise. Nominee can be assigned later on after opening an account. 1. Transfer- Individuals can transfer their MIS account in one post office to another anywhere in India. 1. POMIS bonus- Accounts opened after 1st Dec 2011 have no bonus facility. However, those opened before that enjoy a 5% bonus. 1. Taxability- Any income from this scheme does not come under TDS or tax deduction. The post office monthly income scheme tax benefit is zero.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a citizen of India. 1. The applicant must be residing in India. 1. The applicant should be at least 18 years old.
**Note:** You can open an account on behalf of a minor who is 10 years old or older. When kids reach the age of 18, they will be able to access the fund. After reaching the age of majority, a minor must apply for conversion of the account in his name. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Official Portal/Link:** https://www.indiapost.gov.in/VAS/DOP_PDFFiles/form/Accountopening.pdf

metadata.schemeName: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the education of Scheduled Caste students at the pre-matric stage, reduce dropouts, and improve educational participation. Through this scheme, annual academic allowances are provided to eligible Scheduled Caste students studying in Classes IX and X.

page_content:
# Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students **Ministry:** Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Pre Matric, Scholarship, Scheduled Caste, Student, Social Welfare, Person With Disability | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description A scholarship scheme by Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment for regular, full-time students from Scheduled Castes studying in Class 9th and 10th in a Govt. School / a School recognized by Govt. / CBSE / State Board of Secondary Education. The Total Annual income of parents/guardians of the applicant (from all sources) must not exceed ₹ 2.50 Lakh per Annum. The scholarship for studying in any class will be available for only one year. The scholarship will be available for studying in India only. The scholarship will be awarded by the govt. of the state/UT to which the applicant belongs (domiciled). **ALL eligible Scheduled Caste candidates will be given scholarships as prescribed in this Scheme.**
## Benefits 1. **Scholarship** (₹ per month) (for 10 months in an academic year): ₹ 225 for Day Scholars, ₹ 525 for Hostellers.1. **Books and Ad hoc Grant** (₹ per annum): ₹ 750 for Day Scholars, ₹ 1000 for Hostellers.
**Additional Monthly Allowances for Person with Disability (PwD)** studying in private unaided Schools - 1. Reader Allowance (for Blind students) – ₹ 160 1. Transport Allowance (if the students do not reside in the hostel which is within the premises of the Educational Institution) – ₹ 160 1. Escort Allowance (only for Severely Disabled Day Scholars / Students with low extremity disability) – ₹ 160 1. Helper Allowance (admissible to any of the hostel willing to extend help to a severely orthopaedically handicapped student residing in the hostel of an Educational Institution who may need the assistance of a helper) – ₹ 160 1. Coaching Allowance to Mentally Retarded and Mentally ill Students – ₹ 240 ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be studying in Class 9th or Class 10th. 1. The applicant must be from Scheduled Caste. 1. The Total Income of parents/guardian of the applicant must be less than or equal to ₹ 2.5 lakh per annum. ## Exclusions 1. If a student has to repeat a class, she / he would not get scholarship for that class for a second (or subsequent) year. 1. If a student is found to have obtained a scholarship by false statements. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The application form (as prescribed by the State Govt. and made available on the website of the state govt.) complete in all respects should be submitted by the student to the Head of the Institution/School by 30th November of the academic year. **Step 2:** The duly filled application forms received from the students shall be forwarded by the Head of Institution, after scrutiny and with his recommendation, to the Block / District level authorities. **Step 3:** State Governments/UT Administrations will delegate powers to sanction scholarships under the scheme to appropriate District / Block level authorities/ Heads of Institutions, as appropriate.
**NOTE:** Ensure that the application is submitted within the prescribed period, if any.

# Term Loan Scheme of NMDFC **Ministry:** Ministry Of Minority Affairs | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Term Loan Scheme Of NMDFC | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Under this scheme of NMDFC, credit is extended for financing economically viable income generation ventures. Loan of upto Rs. 20 lacs under Credit Line-1 and upto Rs. 30 lacs under Credit line -2 is extended to beneficiaries at 6% p.a. & 8% p.a. respectively. ## Benefits Concessional Credit to the beneficiaries among minority communities.

metadata.schemeName: Production Linked Incentive Support on JDPs
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to make Indian Jute Diversified Products globally cost-competitive and increase their export market share. It provides a financial reimbursement of up to ₹12,00,000/- per annum on raw material costs for Jute Mill Companies and MSME units engaged in exporting JDPs.

page_content:
# Production Linked Incentive Support on JDPs **Ministry:** Ministry Of Textiles | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Jute, Manufacturer, Exporter, Enterprise, Incentive, Reimbursement, Subsidy, Export | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Production Linked Incentive Support on JDPs" was launched by the National Jute Board, Ministry of Textiles. The scheme aims to make Indian Jute Diversified Products cost-competitive globally, increase market share, attract more entrepreneurs, and increase export values to ₹16,00,00,00,000/- by 2026. The scheme provides a financial incentive by reimbursing five percent of the cost of jute raw material used in manufacturing exported Jute Diversified Products, limited to three percent of the sales value, subject to a maximum of ₹12,00,000/- per unit per annum. The applicant must be a Jute Mill Company or Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprise unit set up within India engaged in manufacturing and exporting Jute Diversified Products. The scheme is implemented by the National Jute Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
## Benefits - Financial incentive reimbursing 5% of the cost of Jute Raw Material used in manufacturing exported Jute Diversified Products. - The reimbursement is limited to 3% of the sales value of Jute Diversified Products exports, whichever is less. - The maximum financial support provided is ₹12,00,000/- per unit per annum. ##### ***Disbursement*** - Payment for all Jute Material purchased and receipt of export proceeds must be made only through electronic means or banks. No cash transactions will be considered for the incentive. - Claims are paid on a quarterly basis within two months of submission, provided the claims are complete in all respects with the required documentation. - If a claimant misses a quarter, they can submit it with the immediate next quarter's claims along with a written explanation. ##### ***Conditions*** The beneficiaries under the scheme must be Aadhaar-seeded. - The claimants must give an undertaking to the National Jute Board that they have not availed nor will they avail of any other incentive on the Jute Diversified Products production and exports on which this incentive has been claimed. - Claimants must update their documents and data at the beginning of every financial year. - Any unit availing the benefits is liable to return the amount of subsidy with interest (at prevailing bank interest rates for commercial loans) if found to have claimed benefits using false or fraudulent documents.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a Jute Mill Company or a Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise unit set up within the geographical boundary of India. - The applicant must be actively engaged in the manufacturing and export of Jute Diversified Products. - The applicant must ensure the manufactured products contain more than 50% jute content by weight, or more than 33% by weight in the case of multifibres where jute is the dominant fibre.
## Exclusions - The applicant must not claim incentives for the manufacturing of sacking of any weave and geometry, or yarn for sale. - The applicant must not avail any other parallel incentive on the same Jute Diversified Products production and exports on which this Production Linked Incentive is being claimed.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ##### ***Registration*** **Step 1:****** ***Accessing the Portal*** The applicant must visit the official portal of the National Jute Board at www.jute.com to initiate the process. They must navigate to the prescribed online form titled ‘PLI Beneficiaries Registration’. **Step 2:****** ***Submitting Online Registration*** The applicant must accurately fill out the registration form with their business details and upload all the necessary compliance documents. Upon successful registration, the applicant will be provided with an online registration password to facilitate future claim submissions. ##### ***Application*** **Step 1:** ***Accessing the Claim Form*** Using the provided online registration password, the applicant must log into the portal at www.jute.com. The applicant must locate and open the prescribed form titled ‘PLI Claim Submission’. **Step 2:****** ***Submitting Quarterly Claims*** The applicant must submit their claims online on a quarterly basis by detailing their production and exports of Jute Diversified Products for that period. All mandatory proof documents, such as shipping bills, bank transaction details, and certified chartered accountant reports, must be uploaded before final submission. ##### ***Post-Application Process*** **Step 1:****** ***Verification and Disbursement*** The National Jute Board will review the submitted claims and cross-verify the uploaded documents. Once validated, the incentive amount will be paid on a quarterly basis within two months of the submission of a complete claim. **Step 2:****** ***Grievance and Clarification*** Any shortcomings found during the examination of the claims will be communicated to the claimants through email. The applicants must submit their compliance or clarifications via email only to ensure speedy disposal. ##### ***Grievance Redressal / Help & Support*** - Head Office, Kolkata: Shri T. Ayyappan, Head Market Promotion & Scheme Implementation, National Jute Board, 3A & 3B, Park Plaza, Park Street, Kolkata – 700069. Email: jute@njbindia.in, director.mkt@njbindia.in. Telephone: 033 22172107. - Regional Office, New Delhi: Shri Kishan Singh Ghughtyal, Joint Director, National Jute Board, 508 & 509, Prakash Deep Building, 7 Tolstoy Marg, C.P., New Delhi -110001. Email: njbdel@gmail.com, kishan870@gmail.com. Telephone: 011 2335 2652.

# Micro Finance Scheme of NMDFC **Ministry:** Ministry Of Minority Affairs | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Micro Finance Scheme Of NMDFC | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Under this Scheme of NMDFC, credit is extended to the members of the Self Help Groups (SHGs), predominantly comprising of the minority women scattered in remote villages and urban slums, who are not able to take advantage of the formal banking credit. Under the scheme, an amount of Rs. 1 lacs under credit Line-1 & upto Rs. 1.5 lacs under Credit Line-2 is extended to each member of SHG at interest rate of 7% & 10% respectively.
