metadata.schemeName: Atithi Uttarakhand Home-Stay Registration
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote rural tourism and generate local employment by enabling residents to register their homes as certified home-stays that offer safe, affordable accommodation and meal facilities to tourists in Uttarakhand.

page_content:
# Atithi Uttarakhand Home-Stay Registration **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Travel & Tourism, Housing & Shelter | **Tags:** Homestay, Tourism, Guest, Registration, Tourist | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Atithi Uttarakhand Home-Stay Registration” scheme has been introduced by the Department of Tourism, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote rural tourism and generate local employment by enabling residents to register their homes as certified home-stays that offer safe, affordable accommodation and meal facilities to tourists in Uttarakhand.
## Benefits Under this scheme, any house owner in the state who wishes to make the residential rooms of their house available to tourists can register their home with the Tourism Department as a home-stay. After registration, the owner can provide night stay and meals to guests and charge a fee for these services. The main objective of this scheme is to offer accommodation and food facilities to tourists and to provide employment opportunities to rural residents at their homes. After registration, the respective accommodation is listed on the department’s website under the Home Stay directory, allowing any tourist to obtain information from the website and avail night stay facilities.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. For registration under this scheme, a No Objection Certificate (NOC) must be issued by the Development Authority/Local Body in urban areas, and by the Gram Pradhan in rural areas. 1. The accommodation unit must be entirely residential, and the house owner must reside there with their family. 1. There must be at least one and a maximum of six rooms available for guests/tourists. 1. The residential unit must have a toilet, should be clean and well-maintained, equipped with fire safety equipment, and built in a structurally robust manner.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online Registration for Atithi Uttarakhand Home-Stay has to be done online at [https://uttarakhandtourism.gov.in](https://uttarakhandtourism.gov.in/)> Trade > Homestay Registration, for which Aadhaar number and the Aadhaar-linked mobile number are mandatory, and during the registration process, the applicant must attach the affidavit mentioned in the application form, PAN card, a copy of the approved building map (plan), photographs of the home-stay (including the home-stay name, room interiors, toilet, and kitchen), a copy of land ownership documents (Khata, Khatauni/Registry papers), the old registration certificate of the Paying Guest House (in case of an old unit), the registration fee - ₹500 through NEFT/online/offline, the character certificate issued by the district administration, and the Fire Department NOC/fire extinguisher bill (as specified by the District Tourism Development Officer). Thereafter, an inspection is carried out by departmental officers and the registration number is provided to the applicant; Once registered, the owner can offer night stay facilities to guests/tourists by charging the prescribed fee.

metadata.schemeName: The Goa Archaeological Research Fellowship Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage scholars to undertake research activities in the field of Archaeology of Goa and West Coast based on primary archaeological sources. It offers financial fellowship assistance of up to ₹40,000/- per month to eligible Post-Graduate or PhD scholars for 24 months.

page_content:
# The Goa Archaeological Research Fellowship Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholar, Fellowship, Research, Postgraduation, Doctorate, PhD | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "The Goa Archaeological Research Fellowship Scheme" was launched by the Department of Archaeology, Government of Goa, to encourage scholars to undertake research activities in the field of Archaeology of Goa and West Coast. The scheme provides financial assistance through four research fellowships (two Junior level and two Senior level), each awarded for a period of 24 months, with an objective to encourage research based on primary archaeological sources, promote research culture, and promote interdisciplinary research in educational organizations.
## Benefits - Eligible scholars under the Junior category shall be awarded a fellowship of ₹25,000/- per month for a period of 24 months. - Eligible scholars under the Senior category shall be awarded a fellowship of ₹40,000/- per month for a period of 24 months. - Maximum two fellowships shall be awarded under the Junior category. - Maximum two fellowships shall be awarded under the Senior category. ##### ***Other Non-Monetary Outcomes*** - Unexplored archaeological treasure will be brought to light which will help to carry out further research in the field of Archaeology of Goa. - A database of archaeological heritage of Goa will be created. - More and more researchers will come to visit the Protected Monuments of the Department of Archaeology for research activities. - Researchers will help in creating awareness about the Protected Monument and Sites of Goa and archaeological treasure of Goa in general. - The Department will generate research on the archaeological past of Goa for publication. ##### ***Conditions*** - A half yearly progress report shall be submitted by the research fellow. - The project report, in the form of two hard copies and a soft copy, must be submitted within a period of 30 days after the completion of her/his 24 months of fellowship. - The project submitted shall be exclusively the property of the Department of Archaeology, Government of Goa.
_*The fellowship shall be awarded to any scholar only once in her/his lifetime under each of the two categories._ _*A fellow will not be eligible for any other fellowship offered by the Department in any other category for a period of five years from the date of the submission of her/his project._ _*Any grace period or extension will not be considered under the quantum of the fellowship financial assistance._
## Eligibility Criteria ##### ***For Junior Research Fellowship*** - The applicant must have completed her/his post-graduation (M.A. in Ancient Indian History Culture and Archaeology/History/Indology). - The applicant must be up to 35 years of age as on the closing date of application. - The applicant, if applying as a Goan Scholar, must have 15 years of Residence in Goa. - The applicant, if applying as an Indian Scholar, must have Indian citizenship. ##### ***For Senior Research Fellowship*** - The applicant must have completed her/his Doctorate (in Ancient Indian History Culture and Archaeology/History/Indology). - The applicant must be up to 45 years of age as on the closing date of application. - The applicant, if applying as a Goan Scholar, must have 15 years of Residence in Goa. - The applicant, if applying as an Indian Scholar, must have Indian citizenship.
## Exclusions - The applicant cannot be awarded the fellowship more than once in her/his lifetime under each of the two categories. - The applicant must not be currently eligible for any other fellowship offered by the Department in any other category for a period of five years from the date of the submission of her/his previous project.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ##### **Step 1:****** ***Invitation For Applications Is Released*** - The Department of Archaeology shall release a press advertisement inviting applications for the Junior and Senior Research Fellowship Scheme for scholars. - Applicants must monitor official channels and respond to this notification to begin the application process. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Submission Of Application And Research Proposal*** - Scholars must submit their complete applications and detailed research proposals, adhering to the instructions provided in the press advertisement. - The research proposal is critical as it will be examined and scrutinized by the Monitoring/Reviewing Committee for selection. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Selection Of Scholars By The Committee*** - The committee constituted by the Department of Archaeology shall select the scholars for the fellowship. - The Monitoring/Reviewing Committee will hold periodic meetings specifically to examine and scrutinize the research proposals to select the scholars. ##### **Step 4:****** ***Final Decision And Award Of Fellowship*** - The decisions of the Committee regarding the selection of the scholars for the fellowship shall be final and binding. - The maximum number of fellowships awarded is two under the Junior category and two under the Senior category.
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Submission Of Progress Reports:** The selected research fellow must regularly submit a half yearly progress report to the Department of Archaeology throughout the entire duration of the fellowship. **Submission Of The Final Project Report:** The final project report must be submitted to the Department of Archaeology within a period of 30 days after the completion of the research fellowship's 24 months. The required submission format consists of two hard copies and a soft copy. Note that the submitted project shall become exclusively the property of the Department of Archaeology, Government of Goa.
##### ***Grievance Redressal / Help & Support*** Any grievance arising out of the implementation of this scheme shall be heard by the Minister of Archaeology who will decide on the matter. The decision made by the Minister for Archaeology in this regard shall be final and binding.

page_content:
# Financial Assistance to Launderers and Barbers **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Puducherry | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Industry, Entrepreneur, Loan, Furniture, Barber | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Financial Assistance to Launderers and Barbers" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC), Department of Industries & Commerce, Puducherry. The scheme aims to extend financial assistance to the Launderers and barbers for the purchase of worktables & furniture, etc. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.
## Benefits Loan of upto ₹1,00,000/- for purchase of worktables & furniture, etc.

# Scheme For Women Entrepreneurs Mahila Udyam Nidhi (MUN) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Puducherry | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Women, Entrepreneur, Loan, Capital, Equity, Finance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Scheme For Women Entrepreneurs Mahila Udyam Nidhi (MUN)" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC), Department of Industries & Commerce, Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide a Term Loan covering 65% of the project cost and Seed Capital covering 25% of the project cost, structured around a maximum project cost of up to ₹10,00,000/-. The applicant must be a woman entrepreneur setting up a new Small Scale Industrial unit or service activity. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
## Benefits - The scheme provides financial assistance for projects with a cost up to ₹10,00,000/-. - The assistance includes a Term Loan component covering 65% of the project cost. - The assistance includes a Seed Capital component covering 25% of the project cost. - The applicant receives a concessional rate of interest that is 0.5% less than the normal interest rate charged for loans. - The applicant receives a 50% concession on the investigation fee. - The calculated Debt-Equity Ratio (D.E.R) for the project is 1.857:1. ##### ***Repayment and Term Details*** - The repayment period for the Term Loan is 6 to 8 years, which includes a moratorium period of 1 to 2 years. - The repayment period for the Seed Capital is 10 years. - The Promoter's contribution required is 10% of the project cost. ##### ***Conditions*** - _Collateral security in the form of immovable property must be offered, in addition to the mortgage or hypothecation of proposed fixed assets._ - _For units promoted by women entrepreneurs, the value of the immovable property to be offered as security is reduced and fixed at 50% of the loan amount._ - _The valuation of the properties offered as security must be assessed by engaging Chartered Engineers/valuers from the approved panel of the Corporation._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a woman entrepreneur. - The applicant must be setting up a new Small Scale Industrial unit. - The applicant must be setting up a service activity. - The applicant must propose a project with a maximum cost of up to ₹10,00,000/-. _*The applicant is eligible for a concessional rate of interest that is 0.5% less than the normal rate._ _*The applicant is eligible for a 50% concession on the investigation fee._ _*The collateral security requirement is relaxed, mandating the value of the property offered to be fixed at 50% of the loan amount._
## Exclusions

page_content:
# Coaching For Higher Studies **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Assam | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Youth, Coaching, College, Education, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Coaching for Higher Studies" was launched by the Directorate of Tea Tribes and Adivasi Welfare, Government of Assam. The scheme aims to provide coaching to students of Tea Tribes and Adivasi community for preparing them for various competitive examinations like Civil Services, Medical, Engineering, Staff Selection Committee (Graduate level), Banking (Probationary Officers), etc. so that they are able to compete with other candidates and succeed. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
## Benefits Provision of coaching to students for preparing them for various competitive examinations like Civil Services, Medical, Engineering, Staff Selection Committee (Graduate level), and Banking (Probationary Officers), to enable them to compete with other candidates and succeed.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam. - The applicant must belong to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community. - The applicant must secure the requisite percentage of marks in the qualifying examination prescribed for the desired coaching, based on subject matter and on the available seats. - **For Undergraduate students who are preparing for medical entrance examinations,** the applicant should be from the science stream with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology.- **For Undergraduate students who are preparing for engineering entrance examinations,** the applicant should be from the science stream with Physics, Chemistry, and Maths.
## Exclusions A candidate who underwent coaching for any examination under financial assistance from this Directorate shall not be eligible for any other coaching in the same year.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ##### ***Step 1:*** ***Portal Access and Scheme Selection*** **A. Navigating to the Portal:** The applicant must first open the official Tea Tribes Welfare Department URL, www.ttwd.assam.gov.in, and then click the "Online Application" link to be redirected to the [SIRISH application portal](https://sirishassam.in/). **B. Initial Login or Registration:** New users must register themselves on the online portal, while existing users will log in using the username and password created during prior registration. **C. Selecting the Scheme:** Once the applicant is logged into the Dashboard, they must select the appropriate scholarship scheme from the dropdown menu available. ##### ***Step 2:********* **Entering Personal Details** **A. Inputting Mandatory Data:** Enter "Personal Details" where all required information in the application form must be accurately provided. **B. Specifying Location Details:** Location data, including District, Assembly Constituency, and Sub-Division, must be selected, along with other essential address details like Village/Town. **C. Saving Personal Information:** After filling in all necessary fields in this step, click on the "Save Form Details" button to proceed further with the application. ##### ***Step 3:********* **Document Upload** **A. Uploading Required Files:** Under the "Upload Documents" tab, upload all required supporting documents in the specified image formats (e.g., JPG/JPEG). **B. Document Formatting Check:** All uploaded documents must adhere to specified maximum file sizes (e.g., photo maximum 50 KB, other documents generally 100 KB) before they can be saved. ##### ***Step 4:********* **Updating Bank Details** **A. Providing Account Information:** Enter the Bank Account Number and the name of the bank under the "Update Bank Details" tab. **B. Entering Branch Identification:** Details essential for electronic transfer, specifically the Bank Branch Name and the corresponding IFSC Code, must be accurately provided. **C. Securing Financial Data:** Once all bank details have been correctly entered, click on the "Save Bank Details" button to confirm the information. ##### ***Step 5:********* **Preview and Final Submission** **A. Application Review:** "Preview Application" displays all details entered in the form for a thorough and final check. **B. Final Confirmation:** After cross-checking all information and uploaded documents for accuracy, the applicant must confirm the application by clicking the "Proceed with Submit Application" button. **C. Tracking Status:** Upon successful submission, an application number will be visible on the screen, allowing the applicant to view the status under the "APPLICATION STATUS" tab.

page_content:
# Financial Assistance for Higher Studies **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Assam | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Youth, Financial Assistance, College, Education, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Financial Assistance for Higher Studies" was launched by the Tea Tribes Welfare Department, Government of Assam. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community pursuing higher studies. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
## Benefits - Financial assistance for students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community. - This assistance supports students pursuing higher studies such as Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS), Master of Business Administration (MBA), Engineering, and such other technical/higher education. - The assistance covers higher studies in Administration, Medical, Engineering, Law, Research, and Education within and outside the State/Country for the students.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam. - The applicant must belong to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community. - The applicant must be pursuing higher studies such as Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS), Master of Business Administration (MBA), Engineering, and such other technical/higher education. - The applicant's family income must not exceed ₹5,00,000/- per annum. - The applicant should not be a Government Service holder. - Students studying through correspondence course are also eligible to apply.
## Exclusions - In case of detained students, the applicant shall not be eligible to apply for scholarship for the same class twice. - The applicant eligible under this scheme will not be eligible for other schemes except for the scheme “Simon Sing Horo (Special Post-Matric) Scholarship,” if eligible, in the same year.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ##### ***Step 1:*** ***Portal Access and Scheme Selection*** **A. Navigating to the Portal:** The applicant must first open the official Tea Tribes Welfare Department URL, www.ttwd.assam.gov.in, and then click the "Online Application" link to be redirected to the [SIRISH application portal](https://sirishassam.in/). **B. Initial Login or Registration:** New users must register themselves on the online portal, while existing users will log in using the username and password created during prior registration. **C. Selecting the Scheme:** Once the applicant is logged into the Dashboard, they must select the appropriate scholarship scheme from the dropdown menu available. ##### ***Step 2:********* **Entering Personal Details** **A. Inputting Mandatory Data:** Enter "Personal Details" where all required information in the application form must be accurately provided. **B. Specifying Location Details:** Location data, including District, Assembly Constituency, and Sub-Division, must be selected, along with other essential address details like Village/Town. **C. Saving Personal Information:** After filling in all necessary fields in this step, click on the "Save Form Details" button to proceed further with the application. ##### ***Step 3:********* **Document Upload** **A. Uploading Required Files:** Under the "Upload Documents" tab, upload all required supporting documents in the specified image formats (e.g., JPG/JPEG). **B. Document Formatting Check:** All uploaded documents must adhere to specified maximum file sizes (e.g., photo maximum 50 KB, other documents generally 100 KB) before they can be saved. ##### ***Step 4:********* **Updating Bank Details** **A. Providing Account Information:** Enter the Bank Account Number and the name of the bank under the "Update Bank Details" tab. **B. Entering Branch Identification:** Details essential for electronic transfer, specifically the Bank Branch Name and the corresponding IFSC Code, must be accurately provided. **C. Securing Financial Data:** Once all bank details have been correctly entered, click on the "Save Bank Details" button to confirm the information. ##### ***Step 5:********* **Preview and Final Submission** **A. Application Review:** "Preview Application" displays all details entered in the form for a thorough and final check. **B. Final Confirmation:** After cross-checking all information and uploaded documents for accuracy, the applicant must confirm the application by clicking the "Proceed with Submit Application" button. **C. Tracking Status:** Upon successful submission, an application number will be visible on the screen, allowing the applicant to view the status under the "APPLICATION STATUS" tab.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to give benefits under the Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan and Tribal Sub-Plan to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe trainees enrolled under various Labour Welfare Centres in the State of Goa. Eligible trainees receive a monthly stipend of ₹1,000/- to support their training in crafts.

page_content:
# Scheme for Giving Stipend to the Trainees Belonging to the Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Community Enrolled under Various Labour Welfare Centres in the State of Goa **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Trainee, Stipend, Welfare, Labour, Training, Employment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Scheme for Giving Stipend to the Trainees Belonging to the Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Community Enrolled under Various Labour Welfare Centres in the State of Goa" was launched by the Department of Labour, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to give benefits under the Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan and Tribal Sub-Plan to the trainees belonging to the Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Community enrolled under various Labour Welfare Centres operating in different parts of Goa. The objective of the program is to train members of industrial workers in crafts like embroidery, needle work, cutting, and tailoring so that they become self-employed and earn income to help their families.
## Benefits - A stipend of ₹1,000/- per month shall be provided to the eligible applicant/trainee. - The scheme's main objective is to train the members of Industrial workers so that they become self-employed. Trainees can earn to some extent to help their family. - The stipend shall be paid monthly. - The stipend will be paid till the completion of the course of that particular academic year. - The period of stipend will commence from July to April of a particular academic year. ****If the attendance of the applicant/trainee is less than 75% for a particular month, no stipend will be paid to that trainee.***
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be enrolled under the respective Labour Welfare Centre for a particular academic year. - The applicant must have resided in Goa for atleast 15 years. - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Community. - The applicant must not have any source of income of her own. - The applicant must not be owing business. - The applicant must not be drawing any stipend from any other source.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/3.-Revised-rates-for-service-charges.pdf) of the application form. Alternatively, the applicant can obtain the application form from the concerned Sewing Mistress of the respective Labour Welfare Centre where the training is being imparted. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the Office of the Commissioner, Labour and Employment, Panaji. This submission must be routed through the concerned Labour Inspector of the area. ##### ***Approval*** The application to claim the benefits under the scheme shall be reviewed and must be approved by the Commissioner, Labour and Employment. ##### ***Stipend Disbursement*** The stipend of ₹1,000/- per month shall be paid to the approved applicant/trainee commencing from July to April of that particular academic year, provided the attendance requirements are met.

metadata.schemeName: Bee Keeping
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote beekeeping as a sustainable livelihood by providing subsidized bee boxes, bee colonies, and training support to farmers, thereby increasing honey production, enhancing farm income, and strengthening the beekeeping sector in Uttarakhand.

page_content:
# Bee Keeping **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Bee, Bee Colonies, Bee Boxes, Subsidy, Honey Bees | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Bee Keeping” is implemented by the Department of Horticulture, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote beekeeping as a sustainable livelihood by providing subsidized bee boxes, bee colonies, and training support to farmers, thereby increasing honey production, enhancing farm income, and strengthening the beekeeping sector in Uttarakhand.
## Benefits Under this scheme: - Bee families (bees, including the queen bee) and bee colonies (bee boxes) are provided with a 40% subsidy (maximum cost per bee box is ₹2,000/- and per bee colony is ₹2,000/-). 50 bee boxes are provided in plain areas and 25 in hilly areas. - For example, if a bee box and bee colony cost ₹200/-, the farmer has to deposit ₹120/- at the concerned Horticulture Mobile team Centre. The government bears a subsidy of ₹80/-, and the farmer receives the box for ₹120/-. - If a farmer wishes to keep bee colonies in their own orchards, financial assistance of ₹350/- per bee colony is provided. - If a farmer wants to receive training, the department provides a free seven-day beekeeping training program. Along with the training, the farmer is given ₹100/- per day (totaling ₹700/-) and ₹50/- per day (totaling ₹350/-). A total of ₹1,050/- is provided to each beneficiary.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer interested in beekeeping.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - The concerned farmer must submit an application for bee boxes and bee colonies at the respective Horticulture Mobile team Centre and attach their address, mobile number, Aadhaar card, residence certificate, and bank account details. After submission, the Horticulture Mobile team Centre forwards the application to the district office or the Jeolikote Centre. If the application is approved, the farmer is informed over the phone, and an acceptance letter is also issued. - The farmer can then collect the bee boxes and bee colonies from the Jeolikote Centre or the district office at a 40% subsidy. Beneficiary selection is made on a first-come, first-served basis and depends on budget availability. - For training, farmers must submit a separate training application at their Horticulture Mobile team Centre, along with their address, mobile number, Aadhaar card, residence certificate, and bank account details. The application is forwarded to the district office. When 10-30 farmers in a district express interest in beekeeping, a group is formed, and the department schedules the training date and informs the farmers by phone. On the scheduled date, farmers must attend the training. After completing the training, each farmer receives ₹1,050/-, either in cash or through a bank transfer.

metadata.schemeName: Shooting Permission Certificate
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to simplify the process of granting official permission for film shooting in Uttarakhand through a single-window online system, ensuring timely approvals and promoting the state as a film-friendly destination.

page_content:
# Shooting Permission Certificate **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Shooting, Film, Film Producer | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Shooting Permission Certificate” is implemented by the Department of Information and Public Relations, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to simplify the process of granting official permission for film shooting in Uttarakhand through a single-window online system, ensuring timely approvals and promoting the state as a film-friendly destination.
## Benefits Permission is provided for shooting films in the state.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a film producer.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online Before obtaining permission for film production, the producer must apply online on the "Single Window System" portal at [https://investuttarakhand.uk.gov.in/filmshooting](https://investuttarakhand.uk.gov.in/filmshooting/). While submitting the application, the producer must attach the Aadhaar Card, synopsis of the film, Registration Certificate/GST of the production house, or, in the case of a line producer handling the production, an authorization letter for the line producer, along with the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) form filled online. Once the department grants permission, a copy of the Film Shooting Permission Certificate is automatically sent to the relevant departments through the portal. The list of departments is as follows: 1. Office of the District Magistrate 1. Senior Superintendent of Police / Superintendent of Police 1. Concerned DFO/Ranger/Forest Officer 1. Concerned Kotwali / Police Station / Outpost In-charge If the film is to be shot in a centrally operated forest area, the Film Development Council corresponds with the Chief Conservator of Forests (CCF) and the concerned Divisional Forest Officer (DFO) for the issuance of a No Objection Certificate. Permission for film shooting is also provided to the filmmaker free of cost within 14 days through email at ufdc2015@gmail.com.

metadata.schemeName: Incentives to Green Investment Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to incentivize investments by existing and new units in environmentally friendly initiatives. It provides financial support through reimbursement for Water and Energy Audits and Capital Reimbursement for Energy Conservation Equipment to eligible manufacturing units.

page_content:
# Incentives to Green Investment Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Industry, Reimbursement, Subsidy, Investment, Equipment, Audit, Energy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Incentives to Green Investment Scheme” was launched by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce (DITC), Government of Goa. The scheme aims to give financial support to industrial units for adopting environmentally friendly equipment and processes, and to support the adoption of new technology and renewable energy aimed at conserving the use of natural resources. The scheme provides reimbursement for Water and Energy Audits and Capital Reimbursement for Energy Conservation Equipment. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
## Benefits ##### ***Water and Energy Audit Reimbursement*** - Reimbursement of 25% of the cost of water and energy audits. - Subject to a maximum of ₹1,00,000/- per unit during the validity of this scheme. ##### ***Energy Conservation Equipment Capital Reimbursement*** - Reimbursement of 40% of the capital cost incurred on the purchase of the equipment. - Subject to ₹10,00,000/- per unit. - A unit can avail this benefit multiple times, subject to the maximum ceiling mentioned above. - This benefit shall be in addition to benefits availed under State and Central Subsidy Schemes. ##### ***Maximum Benefit Cap Conditions*** - The total subsidy received by the applicant towards the purchase of the said equipment must not exceed 100% of the purchase value of the respective equipment. - For the purpose of calculation, total subsidy includes: Subsidy under this scheme + Any other Subsidy received from Government of Goa/Government of India + Interest subsidy received/receivable under any soft loan or low interest loan availed for purchasing the said equipment under any State/Central Government scheme. - Benchmark interest for calculating interest subsidy as received due to a subsidized rate of interest will be 10%. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The benefits under this scheme are subject to budgetary allocation._ - _No Promissory Estoppel shall be applicable if benefits are discontinued because allocation is exceeded._ - _The applicant must allow and/or grant free access to any official authorized by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce for conducting inspection/supervision of the unit or registers or holding discussions with employed employees for ensuring proper utilization of the financial incentives/subsidies granted by the State Government._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a manufacturing unit. - The applicant must fall under the micro, small, medium, or large category. - The applicant must ensure the water and energy audits, if claimed, are carried out by a recognised institution/consultant certified by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency, Ministry of Power and Government of India. - The applicant must ensure the energy conservation equipment, if claimed, is certified as an energy conserving fixed asset of capital nature by a recognised institution/consultant certified by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency, Ministry of Power, Government of India. - The applicant must ensure the total subsidy received (Subsidy under this scheme + Any other Subsidy received from Government of Goa/Government of India + Interest subsidy from soft loan/low interest loan schemes) does not exceed 100% of the purchase value of the respective equipment.
## Exclusions - The applicant must not have received benefits under the Capital Subsidy Scheme towards the purchase of energy conservation equipment, if claiming the Energy Conservation Equipment Capital Reimbursement under this scheme. - Commercial loans not backed by any State/Central scheme where interest is less than 10% shall not be taken into consideration for calculating the total subsidy received due to a subsidized rate of interest.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ##### ***Step 1:*** ***Access the Application Proforma and Complete the Self-Declaration*** The eligible unit must apply using the specified proforma, ensuring to include a self-declaration in the format provided. ##### ***Step 2:*** ***Obtain Mandatory Technical Certifications or Audit Reports*** The applicant must acquire documentary proof, such as the Water and Energy Audit report or certification for Energy Conservation Equipment, conducted/certified by a recognised institution/consultant certified by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency, Ministry of Power, Government of India. ##### ***Step 3:*** ***Secure Chartered Accountant Certificates Detailing Expenditure and Other Subsidies*** - The applicant must obtain a Certificate from a Chartered Accountant (CA) certifying the equipment purchase value, accompanying invoices, and detailing the quantum and percentage of all subsidies (including soft loans and interest paid thereon) related to the equipment. - The CA must also certify any benefits obtained under similar schemes of the Government of India. ##### ***Step 4:*** ***Submit the Complete Application Package to the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce*** The eligible unit shall submit the completed specified proforma along with all required documents and certificates to the ***Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce (DITC), Udyog Bhavan, Panaji*****.**
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** ##### ***Step 1:*** ***Application Scrutiny and Recommendation*** The application will be scrutinised and recommended by the Task Force Committee (TFC), which includes the Member Secretary of Goa Energy Development Corporation or its representative. ##### ***Step 2:*** ***Maintain Post-Disbursement Compliance*** The applicant must agree to grant free access for inspection/supervision by authorised officials of the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce and submit necessary reports and documents as required.

metadata.schemeName: Interest Subsidy Scheme, 2017
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to incentivize units for making their enterprises financially viable. It provides interest subsidy on term loan and/or working capital loan (up to ₹25,00,000/- per year, or ₹27,50,000/- for women/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe applicants) to eligible industries.

page_content:
# Interest Subsidy Scheme, 2017 **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Subsidy, Interest, MSME, Industry, Business, Enterprise, Loan | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Interest Subsidy Scheme, 2017” was launched by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce (DITC), Government of Goa. The scheme aims to incentivize units for making their enterprises financially viable. The scheme provides interest subsidy on term loan and/or working capital loan availed from specified financial institutions. The subsidy is subject to minimum engagement of 60% Goan manpower, with maximum benefits up to ₹25,00,000/- per annum (or ₹27,50,000/- for all women and Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe applicants).
## Benefits - For claims of interest paid on term loan, subsidy will be calculated to the extent of 30% of the interest paid, subject to the scheme ceiling. - For claims of interest paid on working capital loan, subsidy will be calculated to the extent of 1½% of the total turnover or 30% of the interest paid by the units/enterprise, whichever is less. - The subsidy payable shall not exceed the ceiling of ₹25,00,000/- per annum, calculated on pro-rata basis for part of the year as claimed. - The subsidy payable shall not exceed the ceiling of ₹27,50,000/- per annum for all women and Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe applicants, calculated on pro-rata basis for part of the year as claimed. ##### ***Disbursal Conditions/Criteria*** - _The period of grant of subsidy shall not exceed seven years, that is 27 continuous quarters subsequent to the quarter in which the subsidy is first claimed._ - _The benefits under this scheme shall be disbursed to eligible applicants beyond the validity of this scheme, provided, application for at least one claim is submitted to the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce (DITC) during the validity of this scheme._ - _In case the unit fails to file the yearly claim after the first claim within the stipulated time frame, the unit shall be eligible to file the delayed claim in the subsequent year within the time frame as specified in the Umbrella Scheme._ - _The facility of filing delayed claims shall not be available for the last claim._ - _The lapsed claim shall not be revived by any authority._ - _In case the unit fails to include any portion of interest that cannot be claimed due to non-payment before filing of application, the unit shall be eligible to claim such interest subject to payment of the same in the subsequent year._ - _In case of default in payment of term loan (i.e. not paid as per schedule of repayment) reimbursement of interest shall be reduced to the extent of default._ - _Only the limit of original loan granted and not rescheduled loan shall be considered for interest reimbursement._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must represent one of the following - (a) A Micro, Small and Medium manufacturing industry. (b) A project of Hinterland Eco tourism in lesser developed talukas registered with/recognized by the Department of Tourism/Goa Investment Promotion Board/Town & Country Planning/Planning & Development Authority/Eco Sensitive Zone Authority. - The industry must be listed under White category, Green category and Orange category. - The industry must have commenced production after 01-10-2017. - The industry must engage a minimum of 60% of Goan manpower on regular employment. - The industry must have availed loan as term loan and/or working capital loan for conducting business of the unit claiming the benefit. - The loan must be availed from any nationalized bank, scheduled private bank, Co-operative Bank, Economic Development Corporation Limited, or any Non-Banking Financial Institutions recognized by the Reserve Bank of India.
## Exclusions - The scheme is not applicable to cases which have claimed similar benefit under any other scheme/program of Government of Goa. - The enterprises must not be taking or have taken any benefit under any policy of the Department of Information Technology, Government of Goa. - Loans of Economic Development Corporation Limited, if covered under the Modified Interest Rebate Scheme, 2012, are not eligible for the purpose of this scheme. - Interest paid under Chief Minister Rojgar Yojana Scheme or any other employment generation scheme of Government of India/Government of Goa is not eligible. - Units under Goa State Financial Relief Scheme for Sick Industrial Units, 2016, are not eligible. - Charges/overdue and penal interest shall not be eligible for the purpose of this scheme.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/target-schemes.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the ***Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce (DITC), Goa***. *If the applicant has more than one unit with a consolidated balance sheet, a Chartered Accountant certificate giving interest details unit-wise must be submitted, and the claim should only be made for the eligible unit.
##### ***Scrutiny by the Task Force Committee*** - The Task Force Committee is responsible for the scrutiny and recommendation of the applications under this scheme. - This committee includes the Director, Department of Tourism, as a Member, in addition to the members specified in the Umbrella Scheme. ##### ***Disbursement of Benefits*** Upon approval, the benefits under this scheme shall be disbursed to eligible applicants, which may occur even beyond the scheme's validity, provided at least one claim application was submitted to the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce during the scheme's period of force.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide stipend and financial assistance to students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community. The benefits include financial assistance and stipends for poor students from Class 9th up to normal Three Years Degree Courses (e.g. Bachelor of Arts, Bachelor of Science, etc.

page_content:
# Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Assam | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Student, Scholarship, Stipend, Education, School, College | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship" was launched by the Tea Tribes Welfare Department, Government of Assam. The scheme aims to provide stipend to Pre-Matric and Post-Matric Scholarship to the students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community for the benefit of poor students. The scheme is also intended to provide financial assistance to students of the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community pursuing their studies at the post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education. The applications for this scheme are accepted through the SIRISH-Online Application Portal.
## Benefits - The benefits are to provide stipend to Pre-Matric and Post-Matric Scholarship to the students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community for the benefit of poor students. - The scheme is to provide financial assistance to the students of the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community pursuing their studies at the post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education. ##### ***Conditions for Availment/Continuation*** - _The scholarship holder under this scheme shall not hold any other scholarship or stipend disbursed by any Government Department._ - _Students who are also undergoing coaching in any of the pre-examination training centers with financial assistance from the Government will not be eligible._ - _In case of detained students, he or she shall not be eligible to apply for scholarship for the same class twice._ - _The applicant eligible for the "Post-Matric Scholarship" will not be eligible for other schemes, except for the scheme "Simon Sing Horo (Special Post-Matric) Scholarship," if eligible, in the same year._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam. - The applicant must belong to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community. - The applicant must produce a valid Caste certificate which is duly certified or issued by the District Commissioner of the concerned district or his or her designated officer. - The applicant must submit an undertaking on the annual family income stating that it is not exceeding ₹5,00,000/- per annum. - The Pre-Matric Scholarship is awarded to students from Class 9th to Class 10th. - The Post-Matric Scholarship is awarded to students pursuing studies from Class 11th to normal Three Years Degree Courses (Bachelor of Arts, Bachelor of Business Administration, Bachelor of Commerce, Bachelor of Science, Integrated Graduate plus Post Graduate courses like integrated Master of Business Administration / Bachelor of Arts-Bachelor of Law / Bachelor of Arts-Bachelor of Education / Master of Social Work, etc.). - The scholarships are available for all recognized post-matriculation or post-secondary courses in recognized institutions. ##### ***Special Provisions*** - All children of the same parents or guardians are eligible. - Students studying through correspondence course are also eligible to apply.
## Exclusions - The scholarships are not available for identified Higher Studies courses and Vocational 3 (three) years Degree Courses or equivalent. - The scholarship holder shall not hold any other scholarship or stipend disbursed by any Government Department. - Students applying repeatedly from different Sub-Divisions shall in no case be considered for the scholarships. - Students who are undergoing coaching in any of the pre-examination training centers with financial assistance from the Government will not be eligible. - In case of detained students, he or she shall not be eligible to apply for scholarship for the same class twice. - The applicant eligible for the "Post-Matric Scholarship" will not be eligible for other schemes except for the scheme "Simon Sing Horo (Special Post-Matric) Scholarship," if eligible, in the same year.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ##### ***Step 1:*** ***Portal Access and Scheme Selection*** **A. Navigating to the Portal:** The applicant must first open the official Tea Tribes Welfare Department URL, www.ttwd.assam.gov.in, and then click the "Online Application" link to be redirected to the [SIRISH application portal](https://sirishassam.in/). **B. Initial Login or Registration:** New users must register themselves on the online portal, while existing users will log in using the username and password created during prior registration. **C. Selecting the Scheme:** Once the applicant is logged into the Dashboard, they must select the appropriate scholarship scheme from the dropdown menu available under STEP 1: Select Scheme. ##### ***Step 2:********* **Entering Personal Details** **A. Inputting Mandatory Data:** The applicant proceeds to STEP 2: Enter Personal Details where all required information in the application form must be accurately provided. **B. Specifying Location Details:** Location data, including District, Assembly Constituency, and Sub-Division, must be selected, along with other essential address details like Village/Town. **C. Saving Personal Information:** After filling in all necessary fields in this step, the applicant must click on the "Save Form Details" button to proceed further with the application. ##### ***Step 3:********* **Document Upload** **A. Uploading Required Files:** Under the STEP 3: Upload Documents tab, the applicant must upload all required supporting documents in the specified image formats (e.g., JPG/JPEG). **B. Document Formatting Check:** All uploaded documents must adhere to specified maximum file sizes (e.g., photo maximum 50 KB, other documents generally 100 KB) before they can be saved. ##### ***Step 4:********* **Updating Bank Details** **A. Providing Account Information:** The applicant must enter the Bank Account Number and the name of the bank under the STEP 4: Update Bank Details tab. **B. Entering Branch Identification:** Details essential for electronic transfer, specifically the Bank Branch Name and the corresponding IFSC Code, must be accurately provided. **C. Securing Financial Data:** Once all bank details have been correctly entered, the applicant must click on the "Save Bank Details" button to confirm the information. ##### ***Step 5:********* **Preview and Final Submission** **A. Application Review:** The final step, STEP 5: Preview Application and Final Submission, displays all details entered in the form for a thorough and final check. **B. Final Confirmation:** After cross-checking all information and uploaded documents for accuracy, the applicant must confirm the application by clicking the "Proceed with Submit Application" button. **C. Tracking Status:** Upon successful submission, an application number will be visible on the screen, allowing the applicant to view the status under the "APPLICATION STATUS" tab.

metadata.schemeName: Grid Connected Rooftop Scheme (Phase-II) - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the installation of rooftop solar systems among domestic households, group housing societies, and residential welfare associations in Uttarakhand, enabling consumers to reduce their electricity bills, earn income by feeding surplus power into the grid.

page_content:
# Grid Connected Rooftop Scheme (Phase-II) - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** UREDA, Grid Connected Rooftop, Electricity, Solar Rooftop Plant | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Grid Connected Rooftop Scheme (Phase-II)” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency (UREDA) under Department of Energy, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote the installation of rooftop solar systems among domestic households, group housing societies, and residential welfare associations in Uttarakhand, enabling consumers to reduce their electricity bills, earn income by feeding surplus power into the grid.
## Benefits - By installing a rooftop solar plant, households can significantly reduce their electricity bills by utilizing the power generated by the system. Any surplus electricity can be fed into the grid, allowing consumers to earn additional income. - For individual domestic consumers, the Government of India provides a subsidy of ₹17,662/- per kW for solar plants up to 3 kW capacity and ₹8,831/- per kW for plants up to 10 kW, directly credited to the consumer’s account. Additionally, the Uttarakhand State Government offers a subsidy of ₹17,000/- per kW for installations up to 3 kW. - For group housing societies and residential welfare associations, the Government of India provides a subsidy of ₹8,831/- per kW for rooftop solar plants up to 10 kW capacity.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. All domestic consumers, group housing societies, and residential welfare associations in Uttarakhand are eligible for the scheme.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline After registering on the MNRE portal [www.solarrooftop.gov.in](https://pmsuryaghar.gov.in/), the consumer can submit an online application, for which the NOC is also issued online by UPCL. The solar plant can then be installed through any UPCL-registered vendor. After installation, UPCL connects the plant to the grid by installing a net meter, and all related records are uploaded on the portal. Finally, the consumer provides their bank account details on the portal, through which the grant amount is directly released.

metadata.schemeName: Cultivation of Aromatic Plants under MGNREGA - Centre for Aromatic Plants
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage farmers in rural areas to grow aromatic plants by providing them free planting material, technical help, and wage support through MGNREGA.

page_content:
# Cultivation of Aromatic Plants under MGNREGA - Centre for Aromatic Plants **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Aromatic, Farmer, Aromatic Plants, Cultivation, MGNREGA | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Cultivation of Aromatic Plants under MGNREGA” scheme is implemented by the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP), Selaqui, Dehradun, under the Department of Horticulture, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage farmers in rural areas to grow aromatic plants by providing them free planting material, technical help, and wage support through MGNREGA.
## Benefits - Under MGNREGA, when aromatic cultivation is undertaken, the wages for the work done by the labourers in land preparation and related activities are paid by the Rural Development Department, and the farmer does not have to pay the wages. - The Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP) provides free planting material along with technical support, consultancy, and monitoring services to the farmers.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a farmer residing in a rural area of Uttarakhand. 1. The farmer must be interested in aromatic plant cultivation. 1. The farmer must either legally own agricultural land or have leased land for a minimum period of 10 years.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - Farmers interested in aromatic farming must pass a resolution in an open meeting of the Gram Sabha and submit the proposal to CAP, Selaqui, through the Block Development Officer. After receiving the proposal, CAP prepares a financial estimate or assessment for the relevant crop, which is then forwarded to the office of the Block Development Officer or Chief Development Officer. - The proposal is approved by the concerned authorities. Once approved, the Block Development Officer requests planting material from the CAP office. CAP provides the selected farmers with planting material free of charge at the nearest site or roadside location and offers technical assistance during planting. The village head arranges for the aromatic cultivation work to be carried out under MGNREGA on the interested farmers’ fields.

metadata.schemeName: Chief Minister’s Award for Excellence in Public Administration
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize and reward innovative and extraordinary work done by a team of officials to encourage good governance, high standards of services, and replication of best practices. It recognizes outstanding and exemplary performance by a team of officials with a scroll and cash award.

page_content:
# Chief Minister’s Award for Excellence in Public Administration **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Puducherry | **Categories:** Public Safety,Law & Justice, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Award, Administration, Governance, Excellence | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Chief Minister’s Award for Excellence in Public Administration" was launched by the Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms (DPAR), Union Territory of Puducherry. The scheme aims to recognize outstanding and exemplary performance by a team of officials under the Union Territory of Puducherry for achievements of initiatives and projects whose qualitative and quantitative outcomes/results are of very high order and which have benefitted a large number of citizens. The applications for this scheme are accepted by the Secretary to the Government (Administrative Reforms Wing), Chief Secretariat, Puducherry-605001.
## Benefits ##### ***Chief Minister's Award for Excellence in Public Administration*** - The award carries a Commendation Scroll and a Cash Award of ₹10,00,000/- each. - Two such awards are given: one each for Departments’ and Organizations/Institutions’ categories. ##### ***Chief Minister's Appreciation for Initiative in Public Administration*** - The award carries a Commendation Scroll and a Cash Award of ₹5,00,000/- each. - Two such awards are given: one each for Departments’ and Organizations/Institutions’ categories. ##### ***Conditions*** - The amount of the cash award can be varied by the Government from time to time subject to the availability of funds. - The Government reserves the right not to present an Award in any year.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must represent one of the following: a) A Local Body under the UT of Puducherry. b) An Autonomous Body under the UT of Puducherry. c) A Corporation under the UT of Puducherry. d) An Agency under the UT of Puducherry. e) A Public Sector Undertaking under the UT of Puducherry. f) A Government Department under the UT of Puducherry. - The applicant must be nominated only through the Administrative Secretary. - The applicant must submit an application that contains the recommendation of the Departmental Committee. - The applicant must propose achievements of initiatives and projects whose qualitative and quantitative outcomes/results are of very high order and which have benefitted a large number of citizens. - The application should be made for rewardable work done during the previous one calendar year as on the date of nomination.
## Exclusions - Self-nomination will summarily be rejected at an early stage itself. - Canvassing in any form at any point of time will not be entertained and such departments or organizations will be debarred as may be decided by the Chief Secretary.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The application should be submitted in the [prescribed format](https://dpar.py.gov.in/CIRCULARS/GO.1_2025_ARW.pdf), ensuring it clearly mentions the approving authority with relevant details. **Step 2:** The applicant must prepare a narrative of the project/initiative (not more than 2,500 words) clearly bringing out the background, priorities, strategies adopted, innovative method used, period of implementation, outcome, exceptional achievements, sustainability, and replicability. The application must include supporting documents like field photographs (maximum 10) and flow charts detailing uniqueness and success story of the initiatives. **Step 3:** The Administrative Secretary of the Department must constitute a Departmental Committee to shortlist and verify facts before forwarding nominations. The application should be submitted along with the recommendation of the Departmental Committee and a document of proof for approval from the Administrative Secretary. Nominating authorities are requested to forward nominations if the initiatives/accomplishments are truly innovative, extraordinary, and outstanding in nature. **Step 4:** The nomination must be made ONLY in the format prescribed (in soft and hard copy) and mailed directly by Registered Post/Speed Post and email directly to the ***Secretary to the Government (Administrative Reforms Wing), Chief Secretariat, Puducherry-605001***. The corresponding Email Address is ***usar@py.gov.in***.
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** **Screening and Shortlisting of Nominations** - The Screening Committee shall screen the applications in the first stage, considering, among other things, the efforts, impact/outcomes, constraints, sustainability, and scope for replication. - The Committee may conduct spot studies wherever required and will endeavor to shortlist sufficient nominations for consideration of the Empowered Committee with specific recommendations. **Step 2:** **Consideration by the Empowered Committee** - The recommendations made by the Screening Committee shall be considered by an Empowered Committee. - The Empowered Committee may ask the nominees to make a presentation on their respective projects/works if required, and it would take into account the study reports and make its recommendations for the approval of the Chief Minister. **Note:** The Chief Secretary may permit a one-stage selection process through the Empowered Committee if the number of applications is less. ##### ***Application Deadlines*** - Receipt of nomination: 15th June. - Recommendation by Screening Committee: 7th July. - Recommendation by Empowered Committee: 31st July. - Announcement and Distribution of Awards: 25th August. **Note:** In case of insufficient nominations, the receipt of nominations may be extended.

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Saur Swarojgar Yojana - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among the residents of Uttarakhand by enabling them to establish and operate solar power projects, thereby generating clean energy, providing a sustainable source of income, and encouraging entrepreneurship.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Saur Swarojgar Yojana - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** UREDA, Solar, Self-Employment, Loan, Solar Power Plant | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Mukhyamantri Saur Swarojgar Yojana” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency (UREDA) under the Department of Energy, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote self-employment among the residents of Uttarakhand by enabling them to establish and operate solar power projects, thereby generating clean energy, providing a sustainable source of income, and encouraging entrepreneurship.
## Benefits Under the scheme, self-employment is provided to eligible applicants/beneficiaries through the allocation of solar power projects with capacities of 20, 25, 50, 100, and 200 kW, as detailed below: - 20 kW: Project cost ₹10 lakh; land required – 300 sq. meters. - 25 kW: Project cost ₹12.50 lakh; land required – 300 sq. meters. - 50 kW: Project cost ₹25.00 lakh; land required – 700–1000 sq. meters. - 100 kW: Project cost ₹50.00 lakh; land required – 1500–2000 sq. meters. - 200 kW: Project cost ₹100.00 lakh; land required – 3000–4000 sq. meters. ***(Selected candidates will be provided loans from Uttarakhand State/District Cooperative Banks at an interest rate of 8%. Additionally, beneficiaries will be eligible for incentives and benefits under the MSME Policy-2023, provided by the Industries Department.)*** The electricity generated from the allotted solar projects will be purchased by Uttarakhand Power Corporation Limited (UPCL) for a period of 25 years. Payments to beneficiaries will be made according to the prevailing tariff rates for the electricity sold.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. Only one solar power plant will be allotted per family, and each applicant is eligible for only one project. 1. To avail benefits under the current MSME Policy, the allottee must apply under this scheme as a proprietorship. Applications in the form of a partnership firm, company, trust, or society will not be permitted.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online Under the scheme, applications must be submitted online through the portal [https://msy.uk.gov.in/](https://msy.uk.gov.in/). For the application, the applicant must provide a permanent residence certificate, Aadhar card, identity card, application fee, affidavit, and documents related to the proposed land. After submission, the application is sent to UPCL for technical feasibility and review (TFR). Once this process is complete, UPCL returns the application to UREDA, after which the district office presents it to the allotment committee. Upon recommendation by the committee, UREDA allocates the solar power plant to the applicant.

page_content:
# National Bio Energy Programme - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** UREDA, Bio Energy, Cooking Gas, Biogas, Livestock Farmer, Cattle Rearer | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “National Bio Energy Programme” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency (UREDA) under Department of Energy, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote the use of biogas as a clean and renewable energy source, help livestock farmers set up biogas plants, reduce the use of conventional fuels, and support eco-friendly rural development in the state.
## Benefits The gas produced from biogas plants can be used for cooking, and high-quality compost manure can also be obtained as a byproduct. The grant for establishing biogas plants is payable as follows: - 1 cubic meter – ₹17,000/- - 2–4 cubic meters – ₹22,000/- - 6 cubic meters – ₹29,250/- - 8–10 cubic meters – ₹34,500/- - 15 cubic meters – ₹63,250/- - 20–25 cubic meters – ₹70,400/- The estimated cost of a small biogas plant is approximately ₹40,000/-, and the department provides a grant of ₹22,000/-.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The beneficiary must be a livestock farmer residing in Uttarakhand. 1. To install a biogas plant, 12 sq. meters of land (4 × 3 m) and at least 3 animals are required.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - Applications can be submitted online through the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) portal at [https://biogas.mnre.gov.in](https://biogas.mnre.gov.in/) or through the district-level UREDA office. - To apply online for establishing a biogas plant, the applicant will need an Aadhaar card, ration card, and bank account. No PCB or NOC from any other department is required. - If you are unable to apply online, you can submit your application offline, and the district-level UREDA office will provide assistance.
**Mode:** Offline Applicants can submit their applications offline by visiting the district-level UREDA office and the staff at the district-level UREDA office will provide assistance.

metadata.schemeName: Interest Free Loan Scheme To Teachers For The Purchase Of Laptops
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance the quality of teaching in schools in the State of Goa by equipping teachers with necessary Information Technology knowledge and skills. It offers an Interest Free Loan up to a maximum of ₹1,00,000/- for purchasing a Laptop to regular/permanent, full-time teachers.

page_content:
# Interest Free Loan Scheme To Teachers For The Purchase Of Laptops **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Teacher, Laon, Laptop, School, Technology | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Interest Free Loan Scheme To Teachers For The Purchase Of Laptops" was launched by the Directorate of Education, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to get full exposure to changing technology for teachers, who need to handle computers daily and enhance the quality of teaching through visual effects, Multimedia presentation, and Graphics in schools in the State of Goa. The scheme provides an Interest Free Loan up to a maximum of ₹1,00,000/- for the purchase of a Laptop, which is issued via Cheque through Messers Goa Education Development Corporation (GEDC), Government of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted through the respective educational institution and subsequently forwarded to the Directorate of Education.
## Benefits - An Interest Free Loan up to a maximum amount of ₹1,00,000/- is granted for the purchase of a Laptop. - The loan is disbursed in the form of a Crossed Cheque. - The Cheque is drawn in favor of the dealer. - The Cheque is issued through Messers Goa Education Development Corporation (GEDC), Government of Goa. ***Conditions*** - _The purchase of the Laptop must be made from any registered or authorized dealer of the branded manufacturer._ - _The Cheque amount sanctioned shall not exceed the maximum amount of ₹1,00,000/-._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a regular/permanent full-time teacher. - The applicant must be teaching in Secondary schools or Higher Secondary schools. - The applicant must be working in a Government school or in a Government Aided school. - The applicant must be covered under the Administrative control of the Directorate of Education in the State of Goa.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant must obtain a quotation for the laptop from a registered dealer of their choice, which includes details such as a pre-receipt, specifications, and the cost of the laptop, to be submitted along with the application. **Step 2:** The applicant must obtain the prescribed format of the application form of the scheme from the institution where he/she is currently working. **Step 3:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 4:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the Head of the Institution. The application must be recommended by the respective Head of the Institution. The Head of the Institution must forward the recommended application to the Directorate of Education. ##### ***Post-Application Process*** **Step 1:** **Processing at the Directorate of Education and Forwarding** - The Directorate of Education takes utmost care to process the application forwarded by the applicant teacher within a period of forty-five days. - Once processed and approved, the Directorate of Education forwards the application and related documentation to Messers Goa Education Development Corporation (GEDC). **Step 2:** **Final Verification and Release of Payment** - Messers Goa Education Development Corporation processes and verifies the application for the release of the payment or Cheque. - This processing and the release of the Cheque are dependent upon the availability of funds. **Step 3:** **Cheque Issuance to the Dealer** - The Crossed Cheque, amounting to the price of the Laptop, but not exceeding the maximum sanctioned amount of ₹1,00,000/-, is drawn in the favor of the dealer chosen by the teacher. - This cheque is then released by Messers Goa Education Development Corporation to the respective party.

page_content:
# Simplification of Sale Process of Herbal Products - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Herbal Products, Herbs, Marketing, Cultivator Of Medicinal Plants, Cultivator Of Aromatic Plants, Sale Process | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Simplification of Sale Process of Herbal Products” is implemented by the Herbal Research and Development Institute (HRDI), mandal gopeshwar chamoli under the Department of Horticulture, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to simplify the sale process of medicinal and aromatic products produced by cultivators, enabling them to legally and easily sell their produce through authorized markets or buyers.
## Benefits This policy has been formulated with the objective of simplifying the sale of medicinal and aromatic products produced through cultivation. Farmers can sell the medicinal and aromatic products grown on their own agricultural land to markets operated by the Forest Department or to any other buyer. This arrangement has simplified the marketing process of medicinal and aromatic plant products produced through cultivation.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must be a cultivator producing medicinal and aromatic plants on measured land. - The applicant must be legally cultivating medicinal and aromatic plants on the measured land.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline The cultivator must have a registration certificate issued by the Institute. Along with a copy of the registration certificate, the cultivator must apply to the Bhesaj Vikas Ikai, the partner organization authorized by the Institute. After physical verification, the permit is issued.

page_content:
# State Award To Two Anganwadi Workers Under Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Schemes **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Women and Child, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Anganwadi, Award, Mother, Child, Citation, Incentive | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "State Award To Two Anganwadi Workers Under Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Schemes" was launched by the Directorate of Women and Child Development (DW&CD), Goa. The scheme aims to recognize the exemplary performance of Anganwadi Workers. The objective is to highlight their success in improving the coverage and quality of services delivered to children and pregnant and lactating mothers under the Integrated Child Development Services Scheme. Furthermore, the scheme recognizes their contribution towards the implementation of various programmes and schemes of the central Government, state Government, or local bodies. The award provides each selected Anganwadi Worker with a cash prize of ₹5,000/- and a citation. The selection process is based on recommendations made by various authorities, which are then forwarded to a Scrutiny Committee.
## Benefits - Each selected awardee receives a Cash Award of ₹5,000/-. - Each selected awardee receives a citation.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an Anganwadi Worker under the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Schemes. - The applicant must demonstrate exemplary performance in improving the coverage and quality of services provided to children and pregnant and lactating mothers under the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Scheme. - The applicant must show contribution towards the implementation of programmes or schemes of the central Government, state Government, or local bodies.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ****The process detailed below describes the pathway for nomination and selection, as the Anganwadi Worker does not apply directly for this award.*** **Step 1:** The recommendation for the award must be initiated by authorized officials or bodies, which include District/Block level Public Representation Institutions (PRIs), Members of Legislative Assembly (MLAs), Members of Parliament (MPs), Women’s Organisations, Child Development Project Officers (CDPO), District Programme Officers of Integrated Child Development Services Scheme, or the District Collector. **Step 2:** The initiated recommendation, detailing the exemplary performance of the Anganwadi Worker, must then be put forward to the designated Scrutiny Committee for further review and selection.
