metadata.schemeName: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Investment of Fixed Capital
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for developing the logistics and warehousing industry in Goa. It offers a capital subsidy of 10% or 15% (up to ₹50,00,000/- yearly) towards fixed asset investment for eligible logistics and warehousing entities.

page_content:
# Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Investment of Fixed Capital **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Business, Subsidy, Investment, Capital, Logistics, Warehousing | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme” was launched by the Department of Industries, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the development of the logistics and warehousing industry in the State. The “Subsidy towards Investment of Fixed Capital” component of the scheme offers a capital subsidy rate of 10% or 15% (for special categories) of fixed capital invested in Fixed Assets, capped between ₹25,00,000/- to ₹50,00,000/- per unit per year, depending on the project category and location. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce. The applications for this scheme are accepted through the Goa Online Portal.
## Benefits ##### **Standard Projects** - Eligible entities (Logistics Parks (Multi-modal/Integrated), Inland Container Depots, Container Freight Stations, Air Freight Stations, Warehouses, Cold Chain Units, Testing Facilities, Truck Terminals) are entitled to 10% of fixed capital invested in Fixed Assets. - **Maximum Amount:** Capped at ₹25,00,000/- per unit per year. ##### **Special Category Projects** - Eligible entities (Projects constructed in Backward Talukas OR owned by Women Entrepreneurs/Entrepreneurs belonging to Schedule Caste/Schedule Tribe Communities) are entitled to 15% of fixed capital invested in Fixed Assets. - **Maximum Amount:** Capped at ₹50,00,000/- per unit per year. ##### ***Benefit Disbursal Criteria/Conditions*** - **Mode and Frequency:** The processing of the application and the disbursement of the incentive amount must be completed within a maximum period of 90 days from the date of application received. Disbursement is performed by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce (DITC).- **Time/Chronology:** All sanctioned claims will be organized chronologically and disbursed to the respective entities following due procedure.- **Sanction Basis:** The subsidy shall be sanctioned to aided entities within the project cost approved by the Financial Institution and an empanelled Chartered Accountant.- **Employment Criteria:** The quantum of benefit sanctioned is determined by the proportion of Goan employees on payrolls:- If Goan employment is 60% or above, the entity receives 100% of the calculated benefit. - If Goan employment is more than 40% but less than 60%, the entity receives 80% of the calculated benefit.
##### ***Conditions*** - The entity must grant free access to any official authorized by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce for conducting inspection/supervision of the unit or the registers or holding discussions with the employed employees for ensuring proper utilization of the financial incentives/subsidies granted. - The entity must submit all necessary reports, information, and documents specified under the scheme or as required or directed by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce (DITC) time to time or as and when required. - The entity must ensure that the information and documents submitted are correct, otherwise, if found incorrect or false, the financial incentive shall be revoked. - The entity undertakes to refund 10 times the concessions claimed if the benefits were obtained by misrepresentation of facts or in case of misuse.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must not be classified as a Mega Project. - The applicant must own a business unit in Goa. - The applicant must provide Logistics and Warehousing services in Goa. - The applicant must be a Logistics and Warehousing services provider, as the categories of business activities listed in Annexure-XI are exhaustive. - The applicant must have a Permanent Account Number (PAN). - The applicant must regularly file Income Tax Returns in the name of the legal entity. - The applicant must be in continuous operations for a minimum period of six months post the date of notification of Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The applicant must have incurred the expenses post the date of launch of the Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The applicant must provide a minimum of 40% local employment. - The applicant must submit claims in the prescribed application form (ANNEXURE-II) through the Goa Online Portal. - The applicant must ensure that the unit was not set up with second-hand machinery. - The applicant must ensure that the value of plant, machinery, and equipment procured has not previously enjoyed any incentives under any earlier incentive schemes. ##### ***Minimum Land Area Requirements (Must be met at time of application/claim)*** - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 1 Acre for Logistics Park, Inland Container Depot, or Container Freight Stations. - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 1,000 square meters for Air Freight Stations, Warehouses, or Truck Terminals. - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 200 square meters for Cold Storage or Testing Facilities. ##### ***Minimum Land Area Requirements (For Special Categories)*** - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 1 Acre for Logistics Park, Inland Container Depot, or Container Freight Stations if constructed in Backward Talukas OR owned by Women Entrepreneurs/Entrepreneurs belonging to Schedule Caste/Schedule Tribe Communities. - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 1,000 square meters for Air Freight Stations if constructed in Backward Talukas OR owned by Women Entrepreneurs/Entrepreneurs belonging to Schedule Caste/Schedule Tribe Communities. - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 500 square meters for Warehouses or Truck Terminals if constructed in Backward Talukas OR owned by Women Entrepreneurs/Entrepreneurs belonging to Schedule Caste/Schedule Tribe Communities. - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 100 square meters for Cold Storage or Testing Facilities if constructed in Backward Talukas OR owned by Women Entrepreneurs/Entrepreneurs belonging to Schedule Caste/Schedule Tribe Communities.
## Exclusions - The applicant must not have claimed a similar benefit under any other scheme/program of State or Central Government. - The following items are not computable towards fixed Capital Investment: Cost of Land, Diesel Generator, Transformer cost, and Value of the Motor Vehicles. - The cost of building purchased from an existing entity that has already availed incentives will not be considered as part of Fixed Capital Investment. - Values of leased building will not be considered in the computation of fixed capital investment. - Information and Communication Technology (ICT) equipment for office use, all types of furniture, and Enterprise Resource Planning software in the office will not be considered for fixed capital investment. - Investment made outside the project cost approved by the Chartered Civil Engineer/Structural Engineer and items not covered by the project are not computable towards fixed Capital Investment.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online _*The entity who wishes to avail incentives must first be registered on the official Goa Online portal._ **Step 1:****** Visit the [Official Web Portal](https://goaonline.gov.in/) of Goa Online. At the top right corner, click "[Register](https://goaonline.gov.in/Public/userRegistration_af)". **Step 2:****** On the next page, verify your Email ID and Mobile Number using OTP. You will be redirected to the Registration Page. **Step 3:****** On the Registration Page, fill in all the mandatory fields of the registration form. Create a Login Name and a strong Password. Carefully read the Declaration and the Terms & Conditions, and tick the checkboxes. Fill in the Captcha Code, and click "Register/Signup". **Step 4:****** Login to the website using your Login Name and Password. Fill in the Captcha Code, and click "Login". **Step 5:****** In the top ribbon, click on "Services", then click on "[IT Services](https://goaonline.gov.in/AllServices?cat=IT)". Click on **"Incentives on Logistics and Warehousing Sector"**. You will be taken to the application form for the scheme. Fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents. **Step 6:****** Submit the application. A unique registration number will be generated. Note this number for future reference.

metadata.schemeName: Bal Shakti Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to reduce severe malnutrition and child mortality by providing free institutional care, diet, and medical treatment to severely malnourished children below 5 years of age.

page_content:
# Bal Shakti Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Madhya Pradesh | **Categories:** Women and Child, Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Childcare, Medical, Diet, Rehabilitation | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Bal Shakti Yojana” was launched by the Department of Public Health and Medical Education, Government of Madhya Pradesh. It aims to reduce child mortality caused by severe malnutrition among children below 5 years of age. The scheme provides free medical care, nutrition rehabilitation, diet, and transport through 315 Nutrition Rehabilitation Centres (NRCs) across the state.
## Benefits - Free institutional management and treatment for severely malnourished and sick children at Nutrition Rehabilitation Centres (NRCs). - Free balanced diet - Free medical check-up, medicines, and diagnostic services for enrolled children. - Free transport facility. - Counselling and training sessions. - Nutritional awareness.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The child should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a child below 5 years of age. 1. The child must be severely malnourished or sick and meet at least one of the following criteria: - Mid-Upper Arm Circumference (MUAC) less than 11.5 cm. - Weight-for-height Z-score less than -3 SD (standard deviation). - Bilateral pitting oedema (swelling on both feet).
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - The child is identified by health workers (ANM/ASHA/AWW) during community surveys or health check-ups. - Eligible children are referred to the nearest Nutrition Rehabilitation Centre (NRC). - On arrival, the child undergoes medical examination and anthropometric assessment to confirm eligibility. - Upon meeting admission criteria, the child and mother/caregiver are admitted free of cost.

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Dairy Plus Programme (Provision of 02 Murrah Buffaloes on Subsidy)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase milk production and promote improved livestock breeding by providing two Murrah buffaloes to eligible farmers on a subsidy basis.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Dairy Plus Programme (Provision of 02 Murrah Buffaloes on Subsidy) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Madhya Pradesh | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Subsidy, Farmer, Buffaloes, Livestock, Farmer | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Mukhyamantri Dairy Plus Programme (Provision of 02 Murrah Buffaloes on Subsidy)" scheme is implemented by the Animal Husbandry Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to enhance milk production, promote improved livestock breeding, and support small and marginal livestock farmers by providing two high genetic quality, pregnant Murrah buffaloes (five months or more), each yielding an average of 8 to 10 liters of milk per day, on a subsidy basis to ensure early productivity.
## Benefits > **Subsidy Process:** - General Category: 50% subsidy and 50% beneficiary contribution. - Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), and Scheduled Caste farmers: 75% subsidy and 25% beneficiary contribution. - Provision of 2 Murrah Buffaloes with high genetic quality, each yielding 8–10 liters of milk daily. - Pregnant buffaloes (5 months or more) are provided to ensure immediate milk production.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Sehore, Vidisha, or Raisen district, where the scheme is currently implemented. 1. The applicant must be a livestock farmer. 1. The applicant must belong to the General, Schedule Caste, or Schedule Tribe category. 1. The applicant must have basic infrastructure for maintaining two dairy animals, such as a shed and water availability.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the Veterinary Officer, Veterinary Hospital In-Charge, or Deputy Director of Veterinary Services in their respective district (Sehore, Vidisha, or Raisen) and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Veterinary Officer, Veterinary Hospital In-Charge, or Deputy Director of Veterinary Services office. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the Veterinary Officer, Veterinary Hospital In-Charge, or Deputy Director of Veterinary Services office to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable). > **Post-Application Process:** **Step 1:** The application is first approved by the Gram Sabha of the applicant’s village. **Step 2:** The list of Gram Sabha-approved beneficiaries is then forwarded to the Janpad Panchayat meeting for further approval. **Step 3:** After approval at the Janpad Panchayat level, the application is finalized by the District Panchayat Agricultural Standing Committee. **Step 4:** Once approved, two Murrah buffaloes are provided to the selected beneficiary at the prescribed subsidy rate.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide concession in bus fare fees to the students studying in Primary, Secondary, Higher Secondary, and Higher Secondary Technical Education in Government and Non-Government schools. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation (GSRTC).

page_content:
# S.T. Bus Pass Fee Concession Scheme For Government/ Non Government Primary, Secondary & Higher Secondary and Higher Technical Education Students **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Travel & Tourism, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Bus, Transport, Student, School, Girl | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "S.T. Bus Pass Fee Concession Scheme For Government/ Non Government Primary, Secondary & Higher Secondary and Higher Technical Education Students" was launched by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide concession in bus fare fees to the students studying in Primary, Secondary, Higher Secondary, and Higher Secondary Technical Education in Government and Non-Government schools. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation (GSRTC). The application for this scheme is accepted online.
## Benefits Concession in Fees of the Buses of Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation (GSRTC).
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be a Student. - The applicant must be a Girl. - The applicant must be studying in Primary / Secondary / Higher Secondary / Higher Secondary Technical Education. - The applicant must be studying in a Government or Non-Government School.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Visit the Official GSRTC E-Pass System website at [https://pass.gsrtc.in](https://pass.gsrtc.in). Alternatively, use the GSRTC mobile app (available on the Google Play Store). **Step 2:** From the list of "Pass Type" categories, select "Student Pass". On the next page, click "New Pass Request". **Step 3:** The online application form will open. In the form, fill in the following mandatory fields: ***Personal Details*** - Full name, complete postal address, date of birth, and gender. - Category details (General, SC, ST, SCBC) and educational qualification level. - Mobile number and email address for communication. ***Organization/Institution Information*** - Name and address of the educational institution or workplace related to the pass application. ***Travel Route and Service Details*** - Journey details including starting and destination points with route code. Add any via places and select the bus pass issue location. - Class of bus service required options include Express, AC Seater, AC Sleeper, City Service, Volvo, Luxury, etc. - Duration and number of days for the pass validity. **Step 4:** Upload the following mandatory attachments in the specified format and size. A recent passport-size photo (less than 10 KB in size). **Step 5:** The form displays fees for bus pass, ID card amount if applicable, and any toll charges. The student concession will be applied automatically. Make the payment via UPI or counter payment at bus depots. **Step 6:** Check the box agreeing to GSRTC's terms and conditions. Authenticate application submission by entering OTP sent to the registered mobile number. Submit the completed application form. An application number will be received for future tracking and status updates.
***Important Information*** - Valid identity proof and enrollment certification from the educational institute may be required during verification. - Students are eligible for up to approximately 82.5% fare concession on the pass fare. - The pass is valid only on GSRTC buses as per the specified routes and class. - The online system supports registration, new applications, renewals, and application status inquiries. - Video tutorials and guides in Gujarati are available online to assist applicants throughout the process. - The GSRTC app facilitates easy access to pass details, bus schedules, and related services.

page_content:
# Compensation for Livestock Loss Caused by Wild Animals **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Madhya Pradesh | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Wild Animal, Relief, Livestock | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Compensation for Livestock Loss Caused by Wild Animals” scheme is launched by the Forest Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial relief to individuals whose livestock is injured or killed by wild animals. The scheme applies to both urban and rural areas and covers a variety of livestock including cows, buffaloes, camels, goats, sheep, donkeys, mules, and pigs.
## Benefits **Compensation Amounts:** - Dairy animals (cow, buffalo, camel): ₹30,000 - Sheep/Goat: ₹3,000 - Non-dairy animals (bull, buffalo, camel, horse): ₹25,000 - Young animals (calf of cow/buffalo/horse/camel), Donkey/Mule: ₹16,000 - Pig: ₹3,000 **Injury Compensation:** - 50% of the amount payable for injury under revenue circular provisions. **Mode of Disbursement:** - Compensation is paid directly to the beneficiary via e-payment. **Expected Time of Disbursement:** - Compensation is provided within 30 working days of claim verification.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be the owner of the livestock injured or killed by wild animals.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Registration** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Website of "[Madhya Pradesh Lok Sewa Guarantee Portal](https://mpedistrict.gov.in/MPL/CitizenRegistration.aspx)". **Step 2:** On the homepage, click "Citizen Registration". You will be taken to the registration page. **Step 3:** On the registration page, fill in all the mandatory fields (name, mobile number, gender, and captcha) and click "Verify Mobile Number." **Step 4:** A verification code will be sent to your mobile number. Enter the code and complete the registration. **Application** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Website of "Madhya Pradesh Lok Sewa Guarantee Portal". **Step 2:** Enter your User ID, Password, and Captcha Code, and click "Login." **Step 3:** Click on "Apply Online Service" and select the scheme you intend to apply for. **Step 4:** In the scheme's online application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size (fields marked with * are mandatory), and click "Submit". **Note 1:** The incident must be reported within 48 hours to the nearest Forest Range Officer, either verbally or in writing. **Note 2:** The dead or injured animal should remain at the site for verification by the forest authority.
**Mode:** Offline > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the nearest Forest Range Office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Forest Range Office. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the Forest Range Office to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable). > **Post-Application Process:** **Step 1:** The Forest Range Officer verifies the incident and prepares a recommendation. **Step 2:** Approved claims are processed for e-payment to the beneficiary within 30 working days. > **Appeal Process:** If the application is rejected **Step 1:** First appeal can be made within 30 days to the Divisional/Assistant Conservator of Forests. **Step 2:** Second appeal within 60 days to the Conservator of Forests. **Note 1:** The incident must be reported within 48 hours to the nearest Forest Range Officer, either verbally or in writing. **Note 2:** The dead or injured animal should remain at the site for verification by the forest authority.

metadata.schemeName: USERC Establishment and Operation of Entrepreneurship Development Centers
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to establish and operate Entrepreneurship Development Centers to provide structured training in entrepreneurship to students, women, and the general public of Uttarakhand.

page_content:
# USERC Establishment and Operation of Entrepreneurship Development Centers **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Science Education, Research Centre, Student, Entrepreneurship, Training, Woman | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Establishment and Operation of Entrepreneurship Development Centers” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Science Education and Research Centre (USERC) under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to establish and operate Entrepreneurship Development Centers to provide structured training in entrepreneurship to students, women, and the general public of the state.
## Benefits In the U-SERC Entrepreneurship Development Centres, training in entrepreneurship development is provided to students of the area, women, and the general public.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. All students, women, and general public in Uttarakhand will be eligible to receive the training.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - Tissue culture labs and hi-tech nurseries have been developed through the establishment of Harela Peeth at P. L. M. Sharma, Shri Dev Suman University campus, Rishikesh, and Sovan Singh Jeena University, Almora. Additionally, HARC was established in Naugaon, Uttarkashi, and CIMS, Dehradun, to facilitate high-quality spawn mushroom production and related training activities. - The U-SERC Entrepreneurship Development Centre was set up in Satpuli, Pauri, to provide entrepreneurship development and self-employment-oriented training for students, regional women, and the general public. - Benefits and training opportunities can be availed by contacting the respective Entrepreneurship Development Centre.

# Organization of Various Conclaves and Felicitations to Encourage Women, Women Scientists, Teachers and Young Students **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Science, IT & Communications | **Tags:** Woman, Student, Teachers, Woman Scientist, Conclave | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Organization of Various Conclaves and Felicitations to Encourage Women, Women Scientists, Teachers and Young Students” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Science Education and Research Centre (USERC) under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote and enhance scientific attitude and skill development of women, women scientists, teachers, and young students of the state by organizing conclaves and felicitating them.
## Benefits Under this scheme, to promote and enhance scientific attitude and skill development among students, teachers, and women of the state, the following conclaves are organized and felicitations are given: - Yuva-Bal Samagam: Medhavi Chhatra Samman - Teacher/Science Conclave: Vigyan Prasar Samman - Woman Scientists Conclave: Utkrisht Yuva Mahila Vaigyanik Samman - Mahila Prayogdharmi Samman
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand state. 1. The applicant must be a student, teacher, woman, and the general public.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - USERC organizes district-wise Bal Yuva Samagams. The top five meritorious students from each district, who achieve the highest marks in High School/12th Grade under the Uttarakhand Board, are honored. The merit list is provided by the District Education Officer of the respective district. - The Science Teachers' Conclave honors Uttarakhand’s science teachers and science-oriented educators with the Vigyan Prasar Samman to encourage and promote the exchange of ideas. Applications are invited from teachers across the state for the award, and advertisements are also published in newspapers. - USERC organizes the Women Scientists Conclave and the Utkrisht Yuva Mahila Vaigyaanik Samman Programme every year to encourage women scientists. Applications are invited from women scientists across the state, and advertisements are published in newspapers. - To identify and encourage women making exemplary contributions to the integration of science in the state, they are honored with the Mahila Prayogdharmi Samman on the occasion of International Women’s Day.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance not exceeding ₹50,000/- or the actual cost, whichever is less, to needy Goan artists or their families for setting up self-employment ventures, helping them establish sustainable income sources. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline.

page_content:
# Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Incentive for Self Employment **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Skills & Employment, Sports & Culture, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Artist, Employment, Entrepreneur, Livelihood, Income, Training | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi" was launched by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. The "Incentive for Self-Employment" component of the scheme aims to provide financial assistance not exceeding ₹50,000/- or the actual cost, whichever is less, to needy Goan artists or their families for setting up self-employment ventures, helping them establish sustainable income sources. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline.
## Benefits > ***Financial Assistance*** - ₹50,000/- or the actual cost, whichever is less, shall be provided for setting up self employment venture. - The financial assistance amount shall be disbursed to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode. - The assistance is provided as a one-time grant. > ***Conditions*** - The details of the expenditure incurred along with the vouchers must be furnished to the department after utilizing the grant. - The unutilized amount out of the sanctioned amount, if any, shall be refunded to the Government within the stipulated timeframe.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be Goan, i.e., born and brought up in Goa. - The artist must be an artist recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. - The income of the family of the applicant (from all sources) must not exceed ₹2,00,000/- per annum. - The applicant must not be less than 50 years in age. (The Government may relax the age criteria for deserving cases under special circumstances.) - The applicant must not be employed or self-employed at the time of application.
## Exclusions Individuals who have already availed self-employment benefits earlier under any Government scheme, Autonomous bodies, or Corporations are not eligible.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Visit the office of the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa, and collect the prescribed application form for the scheme. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the completed application form along with all required documents directly to the ***Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa.***
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** The Directorate shall forward the application to the sub-committee for scrutinizing the application thoroughly. The Director shall give its recommendations to the sub-committee. **Step 2:** The sub-committee shall consider the received applications and recommend the names of the artists which are considered fit by the sub-committee to avail the benefits under this scheme. The committee shall decide the quantum of assistance to be released to the needy artist. **Step 3:** After the committee decides on the quantum of assistance, the approval from the Government shall be obtained for disbursement of the financial assistance. **Step 4:** After obtaining Government approval, the Director shall disburse the one-time financial assistance amount to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode to the bank account.

metadata.schemeName: Vidhyadeep Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide accidental insurance cover to students studying in all Primary, Secondary, and Higher Secondary schools across Gujarat State. It offers financial assistance up to ₹50,000/- in case of accidental death or permanent disability to the student's parent or successor.

page_content:
# Vidhyadeep Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Student, Education, Insurance, Accident, Death, Disability | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Vidhyadeep Yojana” was launched by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide insurance cover to students studying in primary, secondary, and higher secondary schools in the State. The scheme provides maximum financial assistance up to ₹50,000/- per student in case of accidental death or permanent total disability. The scheme is implemented by the State Insurance Fund (Directorate of Insurance) or private/public sector general insurance companies. The applications for this scheme are accepted by the Office of the District Primary Education Officer / District Education Officer / Administrative Officer (through the Principal of the school concerned).
## Benefits > ***Accidental Death*** ₹50,000/- per student. > ***Accidental Permanent Disability*** - In case of loss of two eyes or both limbs or arm/leg due to accident: ₹50,000/-. - In case of loss of one eye and one limb due to accident: ₹50,000/-. - In case of loss of one eye or one limb due to accident: ₹25,000/-. > ***Conditions*** - The incident must be unexpected, sudden, and unintentional, and show visible signs of external violence. - The claim application must be submitted to the Nodal Officer within ninety (90) days from the date of the accident or death. - The benefit amount must not be paid for more than one category if the beneficiary is covered under multiple categories of the overall scheme.
## Eligibility Criteria > ***For the Student Beneficiary*** - The beneficiary must be a student studying in all Primary, Secondary, and Higher Secondary schools of Gujarat. > ***For the Applicant/Claimant*** - The applicant must be the successor or the disabled beneficiary themselves in case of permanent disability. - The applicant must appear in person with the original identity card. - The applicant must submit the written application in the prescribed format to the local Nodal/Competent Officer. - The application must be submitted within ninety (90) days from the date of death or accident.
## Exclusions - The claim will not be accepted if the death or injury is due to suicide or attempted suicide, natural death, or any act against the law. - The claim will not be accepted if the death or injury is caused by any disease, age-related factors, food poisoning, or polio. - The claim will not be accepted if the death or injury is due to the deceased's gross negligence, such as driving a vehicle without an effective and valid driving license as per the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988, Section 3.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant must obtain the necessary application forms and annexures through the Principal of the concerned school where the student was studying. **Step 2:** The applicant must fully and comprehensively fill out the prescribed application form and gather all mandatory supporting documents to substantiate the claim. The application must be accompanied by the original Identity Card. **Step 3:** The applicant (the heir in case of death, or the beneficiary in case of permanent disability) must submit the completed application along with all required proofs to the local Nodal/Competent Officer of the controlling office of the relevant department. This submission must be done in person (not via post) within ninety (90) days from the date of the accident or death. **Step 4:** The Nodal Officer is responsible for fully checking and verifying the application and must forward the application, along with a certification in the prescribed format, to the Office of the Director of Insurance or the Insurance Company. This forwarding must occur within thirty (30) days of the Nodal Officer receiving the application.
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:****** ***Resolution by Insurer*** The Insurance Company or the State Insurance Fund must decide on the claim approval or rejection within sixty (60) days of receiving the application with complete and satisfactory information/documents. **Step 2:****** ***Claim Closure Timeline*** If the applicant fails to provide all requested documentation and fulfillments within the stipulated time, the claim will be closed automatically. The claim will also be permanently closed twelve months after the date of the accident/death, and no reconsideration request will be accepted thereafter.
_*If a claim is rejected, the beneficiary or their heir must first submit a representation to the designated Review Committee within thirty (30) days._ _*Legal action against the Review Committee's decision can only be pursued after filing the review, and the legal/quasi-judicial/judicial jurisdiction is exclusively in Gandhinagar._ _*Claim inquiries or representations must be made only by the applicant or beneficiary themselves, excluding any third parties like agents or lawyers._

metadata.schemeName: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to aged and needy Goan artists and their dependent family members for medical treatment expenses. It covers major or minor surgical treatment costs in local or outstation hospitals, including travelling and accommodation expenses.

page_content:
# Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture, Health & Wellness, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Artist, Medical, Healthcare, Surgery, Subsidy, Hospital | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi" was launched by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. The "Medical Treatment" component of the scheme aims to provide financial assistance to aged and needy Goan artists and their dependent family members in indigent circumstances to meet expenses towards major or minor surgical treatment in local or outstation hospitals, including travelling and accommodation expenses outside the state for treatment. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Art & Culture. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline.
## Benefits ##### ***Financial Assistance*** - Financial assistance shall be sanctioned to meet the expenses towards major or minor surgical treatment in local or outstation hospitals. - Financial assistance shall be provided to meet the expenses towards travelling and accommodation outside the state for treatment for self and or wholly dependent family members. - The maximum financial assistance under this category shall not exceed ₹50,000/-. - The Government may relax the ceiling in case of major chronic ailments. ##### ***Disbursement*** - The financial assistance amount shall be disbursed to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode. - The disbursement shall be one-time financial assistance. ##### ***Conditions*** - The beneficiary shall not avail the benefit of medical reimbursement from any other Government department or under any schemes or policies for the medical treatment for which the financial assistance is granted under this scheme. - The details of the expenditure incurred along with the vouchers shall be furnished to the department after availing the treatment. - The unutilized amount out of the sanctioned amount if any shall be refunded to the government within 3 months from completion of the treatment.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be any Goan aged needy artist, born and brought up in the state of Goa. - The applicant must be recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. - The applicant must have an annual family income from all sources not exceeding ₹2,00,000/- per annum. - The applicant must be not less than 50 years of age. **Relaxation** The Government may relax the age criteria for deserving cases under special circumstances.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Visit the office of the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa, and collect the prescribed application form for the scheme. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the completed application form along with all required documents directly to the ***Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa.***
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** The Directorate shall forward the application to the sub-committee for scrutinizing the application thoroughly. The Director shall give its recommendations to the sub-committee. **Step 2:** The sub-committee constituted by the Government shall meet as and when required and shall consider the applications received for this purpose. The committee shall recommend the names of the artists which are considered fit by the sub-committee to avail the benefits under this scheme. The committee shall decide the quantum of assistance to be released to the needy artist. **Step 3:** After the committee decides on the quantum of assistance, the approval from the Government shall be obtained for disbursement of the financial assistance. **Step 4:** After obtaining Government approval, the Director shall disburse the one time financial assistance amount to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode to the bank account. **Step 5:** After availing the treatment, the beneficiary shall furnish the details of the expenditure incurred along with the vouchers to the department within 3 months from completion of the treatment. _*If there is any unutilized amount out of the sanctioned amount, the same shall be refunded to the government within 3 months from completion of the treatment._

metadata.schemeName: Young Achievers Awards
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize young talented artistes who have contributed and continue to work for the development of tiatr, its song and music, and have enriched Konkani Tiatr and Song through All India Radio, Doordarshan and other platforms at national and international levels.

page_content:
# Young Achievers Awards **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Artist, Youth, Award, Culture, Achievement | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Young Achievers Awards" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to recognize young talented artistes who have contributed and continue to work for the development of tiatr, its song and music, and have enriched Konkani Tiatr and Song through All India Radio, Doordarshan and other platforms at national and international levels. The scheme provides recognition through awards consisting of a memento, citation and cash burse, given to one male and one female artiste annually. The scheme also provides a special honour function held on 16th November on the occasion of the Birth Anniversary of Regina Fernandes, the First Lady of the Tiatr Stage.
## Benefits **Award Components:** The Young Achievers Award consists of a memento, a Citation and a Cash Burse as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa. **Recognition Ceremony:** Selected artistes are honoured at a special function on 16th November on the occasion of the Birth Anniversary of Regina Fernandes, the First Lady of the Tiatr Stage. **Annual Awards:** The award is given to a male and a female artiste every year. _*The selected artistes must be compulsorily present in person to receive the award._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be not more than 35 years of age. - The applicant must have contributed in the field of tiatr for at least 10 years. - The applicant must have performed in at least 15 tiatrs. - The applicant's contribution should be considered in areas such as acting, script writing, directing, singing, lyricist work, set designing, etc. ***Relaxation*** The age limit may be relaxed if the health of the artiste is not well.
***Selection Criteria*** - The applicant's contribution as an actor, script writer, director, singer, lyricist, set designer, etc. - The applicant should have received or won any awards in his/her field. - The applicant should have done any innovation on the tiatr stage. - The applicant, if a singer/musician, should have songs recorded on Compact Discs, Digital Versatile Discs, All India Radio, Doordarshan, online, etc. - The applicant should have acted/directed/sung/composed music/composed lyrics/designed sets/provided background music/designed light effects for dramas in other languages or in films. - The applicant, if script writer or lyricist, should have published any books of his/her scripts/lyrics. - The applicant, if a writer/director, should have written/directed at least 7 tiatrs. - The applicant's contribution in acting/singing/providing live music/stage setting/background music, providing lights, as a makeup artiste should be at least for 10 years and should have performed in at least 15 tiatrs.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ***Selection for Young Achievers award is done through recommendation from individuals/institutions and also through advertisements in local newspapers. However, the Executive Board may also select the deserving artistes from outside the recommended list.*** **Step 1:** _Obtain Application Form_ The applicant must visit the Tiatr Academy of Goa, and request for the application form. **Step 2:** _Fill the Mandatory Details_ The applicant must fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). The form contains sections for both nominee details and recommender details. **Step 3:** _Sign and Submit Application_ Both the applicant and recommender must sign the application form. The applicant must declare that they have read and understood the rules and that all information provided is true to the best of their knowledge. ***Selection Process*** The Executive Board will evaluate applications based on the stated criteria and may also select deserving artistes from outside the recommended list. Selection considers years of service, awards received, innovations, recordings, publications, and overall contribution to tiatr.

page_content:
# CM-Vashistha Guru Puraskar **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Teacher, School, Award, Merit, Recognition | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “CM-Vashistha Guru Puraskar” was launched by the Directorate of Education, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to celebrate the unique contribution of some of the finest teachers in the state and to honour those teachers who through their commitment and industry have not only improved the quality of school education but also enriched the lives of their students. The scheme provides State Awards to Teachers, with each award consisting of a cash amount of ₹1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh) and a citation.
## Benefits **Cash Award:** ₹1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh). **Citation:** Provided with each award. **Total 10 Awards:** - Primary Teacher: Two Awards (One in each District). - Secondary Teacher: Four Awards (Two in each District). - High School Headmaster: Two Awards (One in each District). - Higher Secondary Teacher: One Award (One in entire State). - Higher Secondary Principal: One Award (One in entire State). _*The recipients will be felicitated at the hands of the Chief Minister of Goa during the Teacher’s Day function._ _*The selected teachers will have to make a presentation before the State Level Committee._
## Eligibility Criteria ***Target Group Definition*** ◦ The applicant must be a school teacher, special educator, or Head of School. ◦ The applicant must be working in a recognized government or aided primary, middle, high, or higher secondary school. ◦ The applicant must be an in-service teacher. ◦ The applicant must fulfill the required academic and professional qualifications as per their cadre for the State Award to Teachers. ***Service Requirements*** ◦ The applicant, if an in-service Regular Teacher or Special Educator, must have completed at least 15 years of regular teaching service in the State of Goa as on June 30th of the academic year for which they are applying. ◦ The applicant, if a Headmaster, must have 5 years of administrative experience out of the required 15 years of regular teaching service in the State of Goa. ***Preference/Reservation*** ◦ One award out of the 10 is reserved for a differently abled teacher or Head of the School/Special Educator from Regular or Special Schools. ◦ The applicant applying for the Differently Abled Category must attach a disability certificate indicating more than 40% disability.
## Exclusions - The applicant must not be due for retirement for the year to which the State Awards relates. - The applicant must not have indulged in tuitions. - The applicant must not be a contractual teacher. - The applicant must not be a Para Teacher. - The applicant must not be a Part-time Instructor. - The applicant must not be a National Skills Qualifications Framework Instructor. - The applicant must not have any vigilance or criminal case pending against them. - The applicant who has been penalized by the Goa Board of Secondary and Higher Secondary Education (GBSHSE) shall not be considered. - The applicant against whom any inquiry is being conducted shall not be considered.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ##### ***Step 1:*** - The applicant must visit the official website of the Directorate of Education at www.education.goa.gov.in and take a printout of the prescribed format of the application form. - The prescribed forms and guidelines are also available at the office of the respective Taluka Assistant District Education Inspectors (ADEI’s) and Educational Zones. ##### ***Step 2:*** - The applicant must complete Part I (Mandatory) and Part II (If applicable) of the form. - In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). - Inspectors (ADEI’s) and Educational Zones. ##### ***Step 3:*** - The applicant must submit the completed application and portfolio by hand directly to the respective Zonal Head. - The registration for self-nominations for the 2024-25 cycle is accepted from June 24, 2025, to July 31, 2025. Submission must occur at all Educational Zones located at Panaji, Mapusa, and Margao. ##### ***Help & Support/Grievance Redressal*** The Directorate of Education, Alto - Porvorim, Bardez - Goa, can be contacted via Email at dir-educ.goa@nic.in or by Fax at 0832-2416136. metadata.schemeName: Assistance for Completely Damaged/Destroyed Houses
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to individuals whose residential houses have been completely or partially damaged due to natural disasters in Uttarakhand. Under this scheme, compensation is provided to disaster-affected families to support them in rebuilding or repairing their homes.

page_content:
# Assistance for Completely Damaged/Destroyed Houses **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Housing & Shelter | **Tags:** Damaged House, Destroyed House, Disaster, Disaster Affected House | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Assistance for Completely Damaged/Destroyed Houses” is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Disaster Management Authority under the Department of Disaster Management, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to individuals whose residential houses have been completely or partially damaged due to natural disasters in Uttarakhand.
## Benefits Under this scheme, the following assistance is provided: - Pucca house, Kutcha house, severely damaged/destroyed house, or partially damaged/destroyed house: ₹1,20,000/- per house in plain areas. - For hilly areas (including districts covered under the Integrated Action Plan): ₹1,30,000/- per house. - Pucca house (other than hut) with at least 15% damage: ₹6,500/- per house. - Kutcha house (other than hut) with at least 15% damage: ₹4,000/- per house. - Damaged/destroyed hut: ₹8,000/- per hut. (A “hut” means a temporary, transferable, and below-grade unit constructed with materials such as thatch, mud, or plastic, and is traditionally recognised as a hut by the State/District Administration.) Note: The damaged house must be verified as an authorised construction by the competent authority of the State Government. - Cattle shed attached to the house: ₹3,000/- per cattle shed.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be the owner of a disaster-affected house.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Information about the disaster and the resulting damage is received from various sources. The concerned Patwari verifies the damage and records it in the P-20 form. The Patwari’s report is subsequently verified by the Tehsildar and the Sub-Divisional Magistrate. Approval is then obtained from the District Magistrate. Once the District Magistrate’s approval is received, relief funds are disbursed to the concerned beneficiaries at the Tehsil level.

metadata.schemeName: Samriddhi – Scheme for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Students for Setting Start-Ups
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide opportunities for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe students to design, launch, and run their own business or startup after formal education is completed or during their final year of education. The scheme provides a limited one-time financial assistance of ₹20,00,000/-.

page_content:
# Samriddhi – Scheme for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Students for Setting Start-Ups **Ministry:** Ministry of Education | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Student, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Startup, Entrepreneurship, Funding | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Samriddhi – Scheme for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Students for Setting Start-Ups" was launched by the All India Council for Technical Education. The scheme aims to provide opportunities for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe students to design, launch, and run their own business or startup after formal education is completed or during their final year of education. The scheme provides a limited one-time financial assistance of ₹20,00,000/- (of which ₹1,00,000/- per year is a recurring grant) to the institute, which then selects nine registered startups of Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe students and provides ₹2,00,000/- seed money to each startup.
## Benefits - Total funding provided is ₹20,00,000/-. - Limited one-time financial assistance of ₹20,00,000/- is provided to the Institute. - Seed money of ₹2,00,000/- per startup will be given, and this amount is non-refundable. - Funding is allocated for nine startups of Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe students. - ₹2,00,000/- will be given to the institute specifically for meeting the expenditure associated with the selection procedure. - ₹1,00,000/- per year shall constitute a recurring grant portion of the total funding. > ***Other Details*** - The total duration of the Scheme shall be for a period of 2 years. - 100% of non-recurring funds are released at the time of the award of the scheme. - ₹1,00,000/- each is released as recurring funding for two consecutive years. - The seed money is provided to passed out or present students for starting their own enterprise after completion of the formal education from the same institute. > ***Conditions*** - The Institute must set up a committee to select nine already registered startups of Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe students. - It is essential that the center has dedicated faculty serving as the Principal Coordinator and dedicated support staff to ensure smooth functioning and effective meeting of its objectives. - The Institute must devise a feedback mechanism to assess the importance of the program. - Feedback shall be obtained after each program from each of the beneficiaries. - If deemed necessary based on feedback, the Institute can update its curriculum for these programs. - Exclusions from Benefit - Startup beneficiaries who are already receiving benefits from other schemes of the All India Council for Technical Education or the Government of India will not be entitled to this scheme.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) approved institute or an All India Council for Technical Education approved University Department. - The applicant (Institute/University Department) must have been in existence for a period of at least 10 years. - The applicant (Institution) must possess a good incubation center. - The incubation center's activities must have been happening for at least 5 years. - The applicant (Institute) must have a minimum of 50 Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe students enrolled on average during the last 3 years. - The applicant (Institute) must comply with the guidelines of the Tribal Sub Plan and the Scheduled Caste Sub Plan of the Government of India. - Student Eligibility (For selection by the Institute) - The applicant (Student) must be in the final year of their degree or diploma course. - The applicant (Student) must have a registered company or startup in their name.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ##### ***Step 1: Accessing the Portal and Initial Login*** - The applicant (Institute) must first log in to the existing [All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) Portal](https://www.aicte-india.org/) utilizing the credentials previously provided by the All India Council for Technical Education.- Following successful login, the institution must navigate to the All India Council for Technical Education Quality Improvement Schemes (AQIS) Application screen by clicking on the designated tab. ##### ***Step 2: Reviewing and Inputting Institute Details*** - The system will automatically populate various Institute Details on the AQIS Application – Institute Details form, such as the Permanent Institute Identification, Name of the Institute, Address, and Institution Type; these fields cannot be edited by the Institute. - The Institute must then manually complete the required editable details, including the Institute District, Percentage Grant received from the Government, Permanent Account Number (PAN) details, the reference number of the Extension of Approval letter for the current year, and the official Email Identification of the Institute. ##### ***Step 3: Entering and Confirming Bank Details*** - The Institute must provide comprehensive Bank Details, specifying the Name of Bank (selected from a dropdown), Branch details, Account Number (entered and re-entered, converting to asterisks for security), Indian Financial System Code (IFSC Code, entered and re-entered, requiring 11 digits), Bank Magnetic Ink Character Recognition (MICR) Code, Bank Code, and Pin Code. - After entering the data, the applicant must check the Declaration flag and click the "Save Bank Details" button, which renders the fields read-only and activates the "Confirm Bank Details" button. - The institution must click "Confirm Bank Details" and then "Ok" to finalize the bank details, which makes this section read-only and enables the "New" button necessary for starting the AQIS Application. ##### ***Step 4: Starting the Application and Scheme Selection*** - The user must click the "New" button, which is enabled only after confirming the Bank Details, to create a new All India Council for Technical Education Quality Improvement Schemes (AQIS) Application. - An error message will be displayed if the Institute is not approved by the All India Council for Technical Education. - A unique AQIS Application Identification will be generated, and the applicant must select the "SAMRIDDHI-Programme Centre for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Students" from the scheme dropdown list. ##### ***Step 5: Defining the Principal Investigator (PI) Details*** - The Institute must click the selection menu icon in the Faculty Identification field to add the Principal Investigator’s details, selecting the Faculty Identification from the subsequent list. Data such as Title, Name, Designation, Date of Birth, Qualifications (Undergraduate/Postgraduate/Doctorate), and contact information are auto-populated from existing faculty records. - The Institute must then fill in mandatory fields for the Faculty, including the Technical Field of the Proposal, Abstract, Objective, Expected Outcome, and required details such as the Principal Investigator's Aadhaar Card (Unique Identification Document, 12 digits long) and Permanent Account Number (PAN, 10 digits long). If the faculty added is not Full Time and Regular, an error message will be displayed. ##### ***Step 6: Completing Mandatory Application Tabs*** - The applicant must navigate through and complete several required tabs applicable to the SAMRIDDHI scheme, which include: AQIS Application Details, Budget Estimates – Non Recurring Samriddhi, Academic Credentials of Coordinator, Justification of Project, Credentials of Institute, and Budget Recurring. ##### ***Step 7: Inputting Budget and Credential Specifics*** - For the "Budget Estimates – Non Recurring Samriddhi" tab, the Institute must click "New" to add details for proposed startups, specifying the Student's Name, Qualification, Phone Number, Email, Project Specification, and the Estimated Cost in Indian Rupees (₹). - In the "Academic Credentials of Coordinator/PI/Applicant" tab and the "Credentials of Institution/Department" tab, the user must add exactly one record for each required Parameter/Criteria by selecting values from dropdown lists and providing associated Counts/Numbers and Details. ##### ***Step 8: Final Application Validation*** - After completing all required data entry in the necessary tabs, the user must click on the "Validate Application" button located on the AQIS Application tab. - This action initiates a complete validation of the entire AQIS Application, and upon successful completion, a confirmation message will be displayed. - Error messages will appear if required fields are missed or validation rules (like data length or format) are violated.

metadata.schemeName: AVYAY - National Action Plan for Senior Citizens: Health and Shelter for Senior Citizens
metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve the quality of life of Senior Citizens, particularly those who are indigent, by providing basic amenities like shelter, food, medical care and entertainment opportunities. The scheme provides financial assistance for projects such as maintenance of Senior Citizen Homes.

page_content:
# AVYAY - National Action Plan for Senior Citizens: Health and Shelter for Senior Citizens **Ministry:** Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Housing & Shelter, Social welfare & Empowerment, Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Shelter, Healthcare, Welfare, Senior Citizen, Health | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "AVYAY - National Action Plan for Senior Citizens: Health and Shelter for Senior Citizens" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India. The scheme is a component of the umbrella scheme " Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana (AVYAY)". The scheme aims to improve the quality of life of Senior Citizens, particularly those who are indigent, by providing basic amenities like shelter, food, medical care and entertainment opportunities. The scheme provides financial assistance for projects such as the maintenance of Senior Citizen Homes (popularly known as Old Age Homes), Continuous Care Homes, Regional Resource and Training Centres (RRTCs), Mobile Medicare Units, and Physiotherapy Clinics under its two sub-schemes: the Integrated Programme for Senior Citizens (IPSrC) and the State Action Plan for Senior Citizens (SAPSrC).
## Benefits **Grant-in-Aid (GIA) for Senior Citizen Homes (25 beneficiaries)** Annual recurring expenditure grants are provided based on the classification of the city (X, Y, or Z), ranging from ₹25,04,355/- (X Category) to ₹24,38,355/- (Z Category). **Grant-in-Aid (GIA) for Senior Citizen Homes (50 beneficiaries/50 elderly women only)** Annual recurring expenditure grants range from ₹42,11,228/- (X Category) to ₹41,12,228/- (Z Category). **Grant-in-Aid (GIA) for Continuous Care Homes (minimum 20 beneficiaries)** Annual recurring expenditure grants range from ₹30,77,310/- (X Category) to ₹30,11,310/- (Z Category). **Non-Recurring Grant for Senior Citizen Homes (25 indigent)** A grant of ₹3,09,105/- is admissible every five years, which includes the cost of Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV) cameras and website development charges. **Non-Recurring Grant for Senior Citizen Homes (50 indigent)** A grant of ₹4,12,140/- is admissible every five years. **Non-Recurring Grant for Continuous Care Homes (20 indigent)** A grant of ₹3,09,105/- is admissible every five years. **Funeral Expenses** Reimbursement of funeral expenses is provided at ₹10,000/- per person or the actual expenses incurred, whichever is less, in case of the demise of any inmate. **State Action Plan for Senior Citizens (SAPSrC) Funding** Financial support equivalent to 90% of the project cost is provided for admissible programmes proposed under State Action Plans.
##### ***Disbursal Mode, Frequency, and Conditions*** - Grant-in-aid is provided through the E-anudaan portal and the Public Financial Management System (PFMS)/Expenditure, Audit and Tender (EAT) module. - The total annual grant is released in two equal half-yearly instalments. ***Conditions for Disbursement*** - Recurring Grant-in-aid for Senior Citizen Homes is based on the number of days of attendance of beneficiaries as recorded through a contactless Information Technology (IT) system. - The second half-yearly instalment is released only after the inspection report of the State Government, the officers of the Central Ministry, or the Project Monitoring Unit (PMU) is received. ***Conditions for Continuation*** - Implementing Agencies must maintain the standards laid down in the scheme guidelines. - Implementing Agencies must use the Expenditure, Audit and Tender (EAT) module of the Public Financial Management System (PFMS). - Implementing Agencies must provide live streaming of the institution's functioning via Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV) cameras on their websites/E-anudaan website. - The assistance provided is subject to the Implementing Agency maintaining the institution in the manner prescribed in the guidelines and standards.
## Eligibility Criteria ##### ***For Senior Citizens*** 1. The applicant must be a Senior Citizen. 2. The applicant must be one of the following: - Indigent, having no sufficient means to maintain himself/herself, as determined by the State Government. - Afflicted with Alzheimer's disease/Dementia or seriously ill requiring continuous nursing care, for admittance into Continuous Care Homes. ##### ***For Implementing Agencies (General)*** 1. The applicant must be one of the following: - State/Union Territory Government. - Panchayati Raj Institution (PRI). - Urban Local Body (ULB). - An Institution or Organization set up by the Government as autonomous/subordinate bodies. - A Government Recognized Educational Institution. - A recognized youth organization such as Nehru Yuva Kendra Sangathan (NYKS). ##### ***For Implementing Agencies (Non-Governmental Organizations/Voluntary Organizations)*** 1. The applicant must be registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 (XXI of 1860) or any relevant Act of the State/Union Territory. 2. The applicant must be one of the following: - A Public Trust registered under the law for the time being in force. - A charitable company licensed under Section 25 of the Companies Act, 1958. - Indian Red Cross Society or its branches. - Any other public body or institution having a legal status of its own. - Any other organization of repute, which may be approved by the Secretary, Department of Social Justice and Empowerment. 3. The applicant (Voluntary Organization) should have been registered for at least two years. 4. The applicant should have had at least two years' experience in the social sector at the time of applying for the grant. 5. The applicant must have a Bank Account maintained and operated in the joint name of the Non-Governmental Organization/Voluntary Organization. 6. The applicant (for Continuous Care Homes) must have shown a credible track record in running Charitable Hospitals/Nursing Homes/Medical Institutions/Colleges. ##### ***Preference/Priority*** The applicant agency will be selected in the order of preference as follows: Self Help Groups of the senior citizens, Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Foundations/Charities already in the field of elderly care, Start-ups in the segment of elderly care, and Non-Governmental Organizations/Trusts operating in the elderly care segment.
## Exclusions - New Mobile Medicare Units shall not be supported under the Integrated Programme for Senior Citizens (IPSrC) scheme. - No Grant-in-Aid shall be released for new Physiotherapy Clinics under State Action Plan for Senior Citizens (SAPSrC).
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ##### ***Step 1: Survey and Notification*** - The State/Union Territory Government must first conduct a district-wise survey of existing homes and upload the details of Gap Districts or Districts of having insufficient capacity onto the [E-anudaan Portal.](https://grants-msje.gov.in/)- If the State/Union Territory Government records that it is unable to establish the Home on its own, the Central Government publishes an open notification inviting applications with wide publicity. ##### ***Step 2: Submission of Proposal*** - **New Proposals:** All fresh proposals for project sanction must be submitted online on the E-anudaan portal in the prescribed proforma along with relevant documents within the stipulated timeline.- **On-going/Renewal Proposals:** Applications for the release of grants must be made in the prescribed proforma along with relevant documents and the Utilization Certificate of expenditure from the previous Financial Year before April 30th each year. ##### ***Step 3: Verification and Approval*** - **District Level Authentication:** Once uploaded, the proposal is made available to the Central Ministry and the District Administration/State Government level for examination. The District Collector (or representative) is required to authenticate all certificates submitted by the applicant.- **Recommendation:** District Administration/State Government shall recommend New/Fresh proposals, along with Inspection reports, by June 15th each year.- **Screening and Sanction:** The Screening Committee meeting is held by June 20th each year to assess and recommend new proposals based on fund availability. After approval by the Secretary, Department of Social Justice and Empowerment and concurrence of the Finance Division, sanction orders are issued by the programme division in one lot by June 25th each year. ##### ***Step 4: Fund Disbursement*** - **First Instalment Release:** Grants should be released before June 30th each year. The total annual grant is released in two equal half-yearly instalments.- **Recurring Grant Calculation:** Recurring Grant-in-aid is calculated based on the number of days of attendance of beneficiaries, using a contactless IT system that seamlessly ports data into the E-anudaan portal.- **Second Instalment Release:** The second half-yearly instalment (balance based on attendance) is released before December 31st each year, only after the inspection report of the State Government, Central Ministry officers, or the Project Monitoring Unit is received.

page_content:
# Information, Monitoring, Evaluation and Social Audit (I-MESA): Project Monitoring Unit (PMU) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Monitoring, Graduate, Welfare, Reporting, Inspection | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Information, Monitoring, Evaluation and Social Audit (I-MESA)" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India. The component “Project Monitoring Unit (PMU)” aims to intensely examine the implementation of schemes at the ground level and monitor scheme outputs and outcomes to ensure the quality of services being provided under these schemes. The scheme component provides for physical inspection of every scheme of the Ministry, such as Grant-in-Aid institutions, scholarship holders, free coaching schemes, implementation of projects under Special Central Assistance to Scheduled Caste Sub Plan, hostel schemes, and Pradhan Mantri Adarsh Gram Yojana villages.
## Benefits - ***Financial Outlay:*** The total financial outlay for the Project Monitoring Unit component for 5 years (2021-22 to 2025-26) is ₹52,50,00,000/- (52.5 Crore). - ***Annual Financial Outlay Breakdown (in Indian Rupee):*** ◦ 2021-22: ₹9,90,00,000/- ◦ 2022-23: ₹10,20,00,000/- ◦ 2023-24: ₹10,50,00,000/- ◦ 2024-25: ₹10,80,00,000/- ◦ 2025-26: ₹11,10,00,000/- - ***Field Inspections Target:*** A total of 32,049 field inspections are targeted to be conducted by the Project Monitoring Unit over the 5-year period from 2021-22 to 2025-26.- ***Human Resource Requirement:*** The number of Project Monitoring Unit members needed will increase from 40 (initially) to 49 by the year 2025-26.- ***Flow of Funds:*** Funds will be provided by the Ministry to the National Institute of Social Defence (NISD), which is the implementing agency for the Project Monitoring Unit.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a fresh graduate. - The applicant must be selected from top Colleges/Universities/Research Institutes as per the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) ranking. - The applicant must possess knowledge of Information Technology (IT) skills. - The applicant must be selected based on modalities determined by the Ministry to ensure they are among the brightest and best students along with social consciousness.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ##### ***Step 1: Selection Modality Determination*** - The Ministry will determine the modalities for the selection of the Project Monitoring Unit members from time to time. - This process is designed to ensure that the brightest and best students, who also possess social consciousness, are selected for the unit. ##### ***Step 2: Selection of Members*** - Candidates are selected from top Colleges/Universities/Research Institutes as per National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) ranking. - Selection is contingent upon the candidate possessing essential knowledge of Information Technology (IT) skills. ##### ***Step 3: Appointment and Location*** - The Project Monitoring Unit will initially have 40 members who would be located in the States or Delhi, according to the functional requirements of the Ministry. - The PMU will be set up/expanded and placed in the National Institute of Social Defence (NISD), which serves as the implementing agency for the PMU.

page_content:
# Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise (SMILE): Composite Medical Health for Transgender Persons **Ministry:** Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Transgender, Healthcare, Insurance, Surgery, Medical, Health | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched on 12th February 2022, “Composite Medical Health for Transgender Persons” is a component of the “Comprehensive Rehabilitation for Welfare of Transgender Persons” sub-scheme of the “Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise (SMILE)” scheme. The scheme was launched by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India. The scheme aims to provide health Insurance coverage to all Transgender persons living in India to improve their health condition through proper treatment including sex re-assignment surgeries as well as medical support. The scheme provides health insurance in the form of Ayushman Bharat Plus, inclusive of gender reaffirmation surgery and comprehensive transition-related healthcare, covering hormone therapy and post-operation formalities, redeemable at all private and government healthcare facilities.
## Benefits - Health insurance cover of ₹5,00,000/- (Five Lakh Rupees) per year. - Coverage is provided in the form of Ayushman Bharat Plus health insurance. - Coverage is inclusive of gender reaffirmation surgery within the health benefit package under Ayushman Bharat Yojana. - The comprehensive package covers all aspects of transition related healthcare for Transgender persons. - Coverage specifically includes hormone therapy and Sex Re-assignment surgery inclusive of post operation formalities. - Treatment for the beneficiary shall be cashless. The Government of India provides for 100% of the approved expenditure.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be Transgender. - The applicant should not be availing similar benefits from any other schemes of the Central Government or State Government.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:****** ***Ensure Possession of Mandatory Identification*** - The applicant must possess the Transgender Certificate issued by the "[National Portal for Transgender Persons](https://transgender.dosje.gov.in/)", as this document is mandatory to avail the health insurance package.- Beneficiaries who have already received their certificates from the National Portal are automatically eligible to receive the insurance. **Step 2:****** ***Access the Benefits at an Empanelled Facility or Service Centre*** - The Transgender beneficiary or applicant possessing the Transgender Certificate should visit an empanelled hospital or a [Common Service Centre (CSE)](https://findmycsc.nic.in/csc/). - These empanelled hospitals are identified from the list of institutions already approved under the Ayushman Bharat Scheme. **Step 3:****** ***Verification of Certificate Details on the System*** - The applicant is required to present their registration Identification/Transgender person’s certificate serial number from the National Portal to the staff at the facility or centre. - The beneficiary's details will then be entered and verified on a real-time basis, adhering to the current Beneficiary Identification System procedure utilized for Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana beneficiaries. **Step 4:****** ***Obtain the Ayushman Transgender Health Card*** - If an individual does not possess the mandatory Transgender Certificate, they shall be redirected to the National Portal website to obtain the required document. - After successful verification of the Transgender Certificate, the eligible applicant will subsequently be issued the specific Ayushman Transgender Health card. ***Contact Us*** - **For General Queries:** 011-20893988, mahimanisd@gmail.com- **For Technical Queries:** +91 79 23268279, tghelp@mail.inflibnet.ac.in- **Working Hours:** 10:00 AM to 17:00 PM, Monday to Friday
