metadata.schemeName: Right to Education Act 2009 - Uttarakhand
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free education, textbooks, uniforms, and the benefits of the PM Poshan Yojana to children up to Class 8 in private schools, targeting rural and urban children from weaker and deprived sections of Uttarakhand.

page_content:
# Right to Education Act 2009 - Uttarakhand **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Student, Right To Education, Samagra Shiksha, Free Education | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Right to Education Act 2009” is implemented under the Samagra Shiksha Programme by the Secondary Education Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide free education, textbooks, uniforms, and the benefits of the PM Poshan Yojana to children up to Class 8 in private schools, targeting rural and urban children from weaker and deprived sections of Uttarakhand.
## Benefits - Under Section 12(1)(c) of the Right to Education Act, children from weaker and disadvantaged sections in rural and urban areas of Uttarakhand are provided free education, textbooks, uniforms, and the benefits of the PM Poshan Yojana up to Class 8 in private schools. - In private schools, 25% of the total seats in the entry-level class are reserved for children from weaker and disadvantaged sections under Section 12(1)(c) of the Right to Education Act.
## Eligibility Criteria **Children from the following categories will be eligible for admission up to Class 8 in private schools:** 1. **Children from weaker sections:** Those whose parents/guardians have an annual income of ₹55,000/- or less, or are BPL card holders. 1. **Children from disadvantaged classes:** SC, ST, and children belonging to the non-creamy layer of OBC, with a family annual income of up to ₹4.5 lakh. 1. Orphan children. 1. Children with physical disabilities. 1. Children living with HIV/AIDS or those dependent on parents who are HIV/AIDS positive. 1. Children dependent on disabled parents or parents affected by leprosy, with a family annual income of less than ₹4.5 lakh. 1. Children dependent on a divorced or widowed mother, with an annual family income of less than ₹80,000/-.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online Online applications are invited through an advertisement issued in February-March. Parents or guardians can apply online through the official portal or with the help of a cyber café. 1. Before applying, the following documents are mandatory for children from weaker and disadvantaged sections: passport-size photograph of the child, Aadhaar card of the child and parents/guardians, caste certificate, permanent residence certificate, BPL certificate or income certificate (as applicable), disability certificate (if applicable), husband’s death certificate (in case of widow), divorce certificate (in case of divorcee), and orphan certificate (if applicable). 1. After filling in the address details on the portal, the parent/guardian can view the list of schools available in their ward and must select the nearest school. Once the form is submitted online, a printout of the application, along with self-attested copies of the required documents, must be submitted to the office of the concerned Deputy Education Officer / Block Education Officer. 1. All submitted documents are verified by a committee at the development block level. The details of students found eligible are updated and verified on the online portal. 1. If the number of applications exceeds the available seats in private schools, the selection of children is done through an online lottery conducted at the state level.

metadata.schemeName: Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Awards (Commercial)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize and honor tiatr artistes who have contributed immensely for the development of tiatr, its song and music in the past, addressing the need to acknowledge their lifetime dedication to this traditional art form. The scheme provides a comprehensive recognition package.

page_content:
# Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Awards (Commercial) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Culture, Artist, Award, Commercial, Theatre | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Awards (Commercial)" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to recognize and honor tiatr artistes who have contributed immensely for the development of tiatr, its song and music in the past, addressing the need to acknowledge their lifetime dedication to this traditional art form. The scheme provides a comprehensive recognition package including a shawl, memento, citation, and cash award as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa, along with the prestige of being honored at a special function held annually on 14th December on the occasion of the Birth Anniversary of Joao Agostinho Fernandes, 'The Father of Tiatr'. The applicant must be not less than 60 years of age (with health-based relaxation provision) and must have at least 20 years of contribution in the field of tiatr with specific performance requirements based on their role. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted through recommendations from individuals/institutions and advertisements in local newspapers.
## Benefits **Award Components:** Shawl, memento, citation, and cash award as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa **Special Recognition Ceremony:** Honored at a special function organized on 14th December every year on the occasion of the Birth Anniversary of Joao Agostinho Fernandes, 'The Father of Tiatr' **Annual Limit:** Not more than 5 artistes from the field will be conferred with awards every year **Exclusivity:** Award conferred only once in a lifetime across all categories (Commercial/Non-Commercial Tiatr, Khell, Khell-Tiatr, or Konkani Cinema) _*The selected artiste must be compulsorily present in person to receive the award._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be not less than 60 years of age. - The applicant must have at least 20 years of contribution in the field of tiatr. - The applicant, if an actor/singer/Stage Manager/Lights provider/Make-up artist/Costume designer/Live Music/Background music provider/organizer/contractor, must have performed in at least 30 tiatrs. - The applicant, if a writer/director, must have written/directed at least 20 tiatrs. - *The age limit of 60 years may be relaxed if the health of the artist is not well. ##### ***Assessment Criteria*** The applicant's excellence as an actor, script writer, director, singer, lyricist, set designer will be considered. The applicant's receipt of any awards in their field will be evaluated. The applicant's innovations on the tiatr stage will be assessed. The applicant's songs (kantaram) recorded on records, cassettes, CDs/DVDs or online will be considered (if singer/musician). The applicant's work in dramas in other languages or films besides tiatr will be evaluated. The applicant's published books of scripts/lyrics will be considered (if script writer or lyricist). ##### ***Post-Selection Conditions*** The applicant must be compulsorily present in person to receive the award.
## Exclusions No person can receive this award more than once in their lifetime across any category.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ***Applications are accepted through recommendations from individuals/institutions and through advertisements in local newspapers. The Executive Board also has the right to nominate deserving artistes from outside the recommended list.*** **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ **Selection Process:** Selection is done based on the stated criteria through evaluation of recommendations and nominations by the Executive Board of Tiatr Academy of Goa. **Award Ceremony:** Selected awardees are honored at a special function organized on 14th December every year on the occasion of the Birth Anniversary of Joao Agostinho Fernandes, 'The Father of Tiatr'.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to make our younger generation aware of the contribution and sacrifices of Tiatr artistes of yesteryears. TAG has formulated this scheme so that occasional visits to these veteran artistes will make them feel that TAG cares for them during their old age.

page_content:
# Visit to Old/Sick Artistes **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Artist, Culture, Social Welfare, Financial Assistance, Allowance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Visit to Old/Sick Artistes" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to make our younger generation aware of the contribution and sacrifices of Tiatr artistes of yesteryears. TAG has observed that many veteran tiatr artistes who have contributed to the development of tiatr immensely in the past, today have become old, and often pass their time in sickness/loneliness. Therefore, TAG has formulated this scheme so that occasional visits to these veteran artistes will make them feel that TAG cares for them during their old age.
## Benefits - Members of tiatr fraternity will visit these sick/old artistes at their residences or if admitted, visit the hospital and inquire about their health. - TAG will provide the vehicle or travelling allowance to travel and refreshments/working meal to the members who volunteer to visit the old/sick artistes. - During the first visit of this nature, one-time financial assistance of Rs. 10,000/- (or as fixed by TAG) by cheque will be gifted to the artiste which he/she can use for his/her medical expenses.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. TAG will identify the sick/old tiatr artistes based on reports from the fraternity. 2. The artistes who have contributed at least 10 years towards tiatr (Commercial or Non-commercial) /khell tiatr/ khell or the writer/director who has staged at least 10 tiatrs (Commercial or Non-commercial) /khell tiatr/ khell will be eligible. 3. Members of tiatr fraternity must visit these sick/old artistes at their residences or if admitted, visit the hospital and inquire about their health.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*TAG reserves the right to make any changes in the rules._

metadata.schemeName: Production of Tiatr in Villages/Urban Areas/Educational Institutions
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to explore and develop hidden singing and acting talents among youths in villages by promoting tiatr activities. It provides financial and technical support to produce tiatr in original format for local communities.

page_content:
# Production of Tiatr in Villages/Urban Areas/Educational Institutions **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Artist, Culture, Program, Village, Singing, Acting | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Production of Tiatr in Villages/Urban Areas/Educational Institutions" by the Tiatr Academy of Goa under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa, aims to explore hidden singing and acting talents among the youths in villages and provide encouragement to develop such talents by promoting tiatr activities among villagers, addressing the need to nurture local artistic capabilities in rural and urban areas including educational institutions. The scheme provides financial and technical support for various aspects including direction, live band, outside artistes, stage setting, background music, costumes, make-up, and light effects, along with technical guidance through directors from Tiatr Academy of Goa's Panel of Directors.
## Benefits - **Financial Support:** Tiatr Academy of Goa will provide financial support to the extent as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa towards various aspects: Direction, Live Band (with at least 2 blowing instruments), Outside Artistes, Stage Setting, Background Music, Costumes, Make-up, Light Effects.- **Technical Guidance:** Provision of director from Tiatr Academy of Goa's Panel of Directors who will direct village talents and produce the tiatr.- **Director Expenses:** The expenditure incurred in engaging the director will be borne by Tiatr Academy of Goa.- **Marketing Materials:** Provision of one banner which should be compulsorily displayed on one of the two front side wings of the stage.- **Documentation:** Tiatr Academy of Goa may video film the performance at Kala Academy.- **Observer Support:** Tiatr Academy of Goa may depute an observer from its Panel of Observers to see whether the performance has been made as per the norms of the scheme.- **Payment Method:** Payment will be made directly to the service providers.- **Sponsorship Policy:** Sponsorship from businessmen, firms etc. may be taken.
> ***Conditions*** _*The performance of the tiatr should be staged in the village/urban area of production._ _*The tiatr should be shown to the people free without charging any tickets._ _*Submit statement of expenditure enclosing all original bills (stamped receipt if the amount exceeds ₹5,000/-)._ _*Provide 20 invitation cards/entry passes to Tiatr Academy of Goa well in advance from the middle of rows A, B, or C._ _*Return banner to Tiatr Academy of Goa after the show is staged._ _*Payment will be made only after the receipt of the observer's certificate._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an Educational Institution, Cultural Association, Dramatic Troupe, or Individual. - The applicant must be interested in promoting Tiatr culture in the village. - The applicant must be from the particular village/urban area/parish (in case of Mumbai, Sindhudurg and other parts of the country). - The participating artistes must be from the particular village/urban area/parish (Educational Institutions only). - A maximum of 3 artistes from outside the village/urban areas/parish must be allowed to act as well as sing in the tiatr. - The tiatr must be produced in its original format including 6 or 7 acts (podd'dde) with at least 4 'cantos' and comedy linked to the story of the play. - The tiatr must include at least 14 'Kantaram' which includes at least 2 Duets, 1 Duo, 2 Trios, 1 Quartet/Quintet, 2 Choral Songs and Solos. - The applicant must not make any adverse remark in any form either written or verbal against any Governments/Individuals/Institutions or anything against caste, creed and religion in the scripts/lyrics of songs/performances/speeches which may hurt the sentiments of anybody. - The applicant must communicate the schedule of practices to Tiatr Academy of Goa well in advance. - The applicant must discuss with Tiatr Academy of Goa and decide who will be the Chief Guest/Guest of Honour at the performance well in advance. - The applicant must ensure this is the first performance of the tiatr for which financial assistance is sought from Tiatr Academy of Goa.
***Script and Performance Requirements*** - The script and songs may be written/composed by anyone from within the village or elsewhere but acting and singing must be done by the artistes from the particular village/urban area/parish. - Musicians may be from anywhere and not necessarily from the village. - Advertising Requirements: In all advertisements, oral, or print or electronic media, banners, etc. the following must be inserted/published/announced 'This Tiatr is organized in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa'.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ _*Applications are considered on a "First come First Serve" basis, subject to the availability of funds._ _*The application should reach Tiatr Academy of Goa 30 days in advance of the date of staging the tiatr._ _*The cheque will be issued in the name appearing at Serial Number 1 of the application form (name of individual/registered association/dramatic troupes/educational institution)._
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:****** ***Schedule Coordination & Chief Guest Arrangement*** The applicant must communicate the schedule of practices to Tiatr Academy of Goa well in advance. Discuss with Tiatr Academy of Goa and decide regarding the Chief Guest/Guest of Honour at the performance well in advance. **Step 2:****** ***Collect Banner & Provide Invitation Cards*** The applicant must collect the banner from the office of Tiatr Academy of Goa and arrange for its compulsory display on one of the two front side wings of the stage during the performance. The applicant must provide 20 invitation cards/entry passes to Tiatr Academy of Goa well in advance, ensuring these seats are from the middle of the rows A, B, or C for proper viewing of the performance. **Step 3:****** ***Stage Performance*** The applicant must stage the tiatr in the village/urban area of production ensuring all conditions are met including free admission for public, proper acknowledgment of Tiatr Academy of Goa collaboration in all advertisements and media, and maintaining the approved script and format. **Step 4:****** ***Observer Coordination, Documentation and Reporting*** The applicant must cooperate with the observer deputed by Tiatr Academy of Goa from its Panel of Observers who will certify that the performance was in accordance to Tiatr Academy of Goa's norms, as payment will be made only after receipt of the observer's certificate. The applicant must document the performance through photographs and submit 5 copies to Tiatr Academy of Goa for records, ensuring two photographs show the Tiatr Academy of Goa banner during performance. **Step 5:****** ***Submit Financial Documentation & Return Materials*** The applicant must prepare and submit a detailed statement of expenditure with all original bills (stamped receipts if amount exceeds ₹5,000/-) to Tiatr Academy of Goa for direct payment to service providers. The applicant must return the Tiatr Academy of Goa banner to the office after the show is staged to complete the programme requirements and maintain the academy's inventory.

metadata.schemeName: Promotion of Duets/Duos/Trios/Quartets/Quintets/Choral Songs
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to preserve the traditional concept of singing of duets/duos/trios/quartets/quintets/choral songs which has been on the decline. It provides cash prizes and certificates to singers participating in various traditional singing categories.

page_content:
# Promotion of Duets/Duos/Trios/Quartets/Quintets/Choral Songs **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Singer, Competition, Artist, Culture, Music, Tradition | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Promotion of Duets/Duos/Trios/Quartets/Quintets/Choral Songs" was launched by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. The scheme aims to preserve the traditional concept of singing of duets/duos/trios/quartets/quintets/choral songs, which has been on the decline, and to ensure that the correct concept as done traditionally by the tiatr stage artistes of yesteryears is followed. The scheme provides cash prizes ranging from ₹1,000/- to ₹6,000/- for various categories and certificates to winners and participants. The applicant must be aged either above 16 years to 25 years or up to 16 years on the day fixed for submission of application and must present original compositions with interactive lyrics. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
## Benefits - Best Duet: 1st Prize - ₹3,000/-, 2nd Prize - ₹1,500/-. - Best Duo: 1st Prize - ₹3,000/-, 2nd Prize - ₹1,500/-. - Best Trio: 1st Prize - ₹4,500/-, 2nd Prize - ₹2,250/-. - Best Quartet/Quintet: 1st Prize - ₹6,000/-, 2nd Prize - ₹3,000/-. - Best Choral Song: 1st Prize - ₹2,000/- to ₹4,000/- (maximum 4 participants), 2nd Prize - ₹1,000/- to ₹2,000/- (maximum 4 participants). - Best Lyrics: 1st Prize - ₹2,000/-, 2nd Prize - ₹1,000/-. _*Travelling allowance provided to every participant._ _*Certificates awarded to winners and participants in both categories._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be aged either above 16 years to 25 years or up to 16 years on the day fixed for submission of application. - The applicant must present original compositions that have not been recorded on any audio albums. - The applicant must ensure that songs which have won 1st, 2nd and 3rd prizes in any competitions organized by Kala Academy/Art & Culture Department/Tiatr Academy of Goa are not considered for first three prizes in this competition. - The applicant must not have participated in popular tiatr performances. - The applicant must participate in any one of the three sections: Section 1 (Duet or Duo), Section 2 (Trio or Quartet), or Section 3 (Quintet or Choral). - The applicant must ensure that duets are sung by a male and female singer with interactive lyrics depicting two different characters. - The applicant must ensure that duos are sung by two male singers or two female singers with interactive lyrics depicting two different characters. - The applicant must ensure that trios are sung by three singers with interactive lyrics depicting three different characters. - The applicant must ensure that quartets/quintets are sung by four/five singers with interactive lyrics depicting four/five different characters. - The applicant must ensure that choral songs are sung by two, three or four singers in different voices.
## Exclusions - Singers who have participated in popular tiatr are not eligible to participate in this competition. - Songs that have won prizes in previous Kala Academy/Art & Culture Department/Tiatr Academy of Goa competitions are not eligible for first three prizes.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ _*The application must be submitted to the office of the Tiatr Academy of Goa at least 30 days in advance of the proposed programme date._ _*Applications are considered on a "First come First Serve" basis, subject to the availability of funds._

metadata.briefDescription: The Government of Sikkim has been providing Cash Incentive Awards to Meritorious Sports persons of Sikkim who have won Gold, Silver, Bronze in the respective sports disciplines at the Zonal Level competitions and above, and have represented Sikkim in international competitions as National team(s).

page_content:
# Cash Incentive Award to Bonafede Meritorious Sportspersons **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Sikkim | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Provision Of Cash Incentive Awards To Meritorious Sportspersons Of Sikkim | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Incentive Awards in the form of Cash assistance to Meritorious Sports Persons of Sikkim constitute a Government policy aimed at encouraging the youth to pave their future by engaging themselves in any sports. The scheme seeks to promote all-round development physically, socially, mentally and emotionally, thereby, contributing to the overall wellbeing of citizens in general. The award has been introduced with a view to encourage and motivate sportspersons in their pursuit of excellence. The scheme applies for sub-junior/cadet, junior and senior level of sports competitions with equal quantum of awards for both men & women. However, the achievement in an unauthorized or invitational tournament will not be considered under this scheme. Only tournaments organized under the aegis of Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports/ SAI/ recognized Sports Federation at the zonal, national and international levels will be eligible. The disbursement of the cash award under this scheme is organized annually. Eligibility is restricted to sports persons who are Bonafide domiciles of Sikkim.

## Benefits 1. Recognition and motivation 2. Financial Support 3. Equal Opportunities/ Gender equality across all age group 4. Promotion of Sports culture 5. Holistic development of individual

## Eligibility Criteria 1. Medal winner in recognized Games/Competitions/ Tournaments/ Championship etc. 2. Eligible for Zonal Level Competitions and above. 3. Bonafede/possessing domicile of Sikkim State 4. Tournaments organized under the aegis of Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports/ SAI/ recognized Sports Federation. 5. Both Olympic and Non-Olympic Sports Disciplines 6. Achievement in Veteran tournaments is not included in this scheme.
## Exclusions 1. Unauthorized/ Invitational tournaments 2. Non-domicile candidate 3. Unauthorized sports disciplines 4. Veteran tournaments
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline 1. Invites application through State Sports Associations in format 2. Screening by the Department Committee 3. Approval of the Government 4. Preparation of cash Award for eligible sports persons in terms of Government Notification 5. Disbursement of Cash Awards in any occasion e.g. National Sports Day, State Government functions etc.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support ST students enrolled in ITIs and recognized training institutes by providing a monthly stipend of ₹400 for a duration of 12 months.

page_content:
# Swami Vivekanand Scholarship for Technical Diploma in Professional Courses **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Stipend, Student, Scheduled Tribe, Technical Diploma, Courses | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Swami Vivekanand Scholarship for Technical Diploma in Professional Courses" scheme was launched by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat. It aims to promote educational development among scheduled tribe (ST) students by supporting them in technical and professional training. Under this scheme, stipends are provided to the students undergoing training in state government or government-recognized Private industrial training institutes (ITIs) and centers, enabling them to meet academic and living expenses.
## Benefits - A monthly stipend of ₹400 for 12 months for the ITI and professional courses.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a state government industrial training institute (ITI), or a government-recognized Private ITI, or a recognized one-year professional course. 1. The applicant’s family annual income should not exceed ₹1,20,000 in rural areas. 1. The applicant’s family annual income should not exceed ₹1,50,000 in urban areas.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit the Digital Gujarat Portal: [https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/) **Step 2:** On the home page, click on ‘Register’ and the applicant will be redirected to the registration form page. **Step 3:** Enter your Mobile Number, Email, Set Password, and then click on ‘Save’. **Step 4:** After successful registration, the applicant can login through his/her User Name (Mobile No./Email ID) and Password. **Step 5:** Now, click on ‘My Profile’ to update your profile and fill in all the mandatory information. **Step 6:** After filling in profile details, click on ‘Update Profile’. The profile will be updated after entering the verification Code (OTP). **Step 7:** Now under services, select ‘Scholarship Services’ and then click on ‘SC Scheme’. **Step 8:** Select the Financial Year for which you want to apply for and then click on ‘Change Financial Year’. **Step 9:** Select the scheme, read the interaction carefully, and then click on ‘Continue to Service’. **Step 10:** Fill in the application form completely and upload all the relevant documents. **Step 11:** Now, click on ‘Save as Draft’ and agree with the terms & conditions, and submit the application form by clicking on ‘Confirm & Final Submit’. > **Instructions:** **Note 1:** Photo uploading for all applicants is mandatory. **Note 2:** Application will be considered complete only when all sections are completed. **Note 3:** Only one application per applicant will be acceptable for a scholarship. If any student submits more than one application either from a single institute or from multiple institutions his/her all applications will be rejected by the competent authority and no request from any side will be entertained. **Note 4:** In case of any wrong/misleading information provided in the application shall lead to rejection of the application by Department Authorities. **Note 5:** All required documents must be carefully scanned as per the instructions given. **Note 6:** The student has to fill his/her application carefully as there is no provision for institution change once the application is submitted successfully. **Note 7:** The unreadable uploaded documents will allow the competent authority to reject the student application. **Note 8:** Direct Individual submission of this application form will not be accepted in case of students studying inside the state. Only outside students have to fill out their form online and submit his/her application form to their native district officer. page_content:
# Raising the Standard of Tiatr **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Artist, Stage, Performance, Training, Culture, Reimbursement | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Raising the Standard of Tiatr" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to improve the quality and standard of Tiatr performances, which is the most popular dramatic form of Goa. The scheme provides opportunities for actors, directors, backstage artists, and script writers to witness high-standard dramas in Hindi, Marathi, English, and other languages, by reimbursing the amount spent on purchasing tickets for up to two persons. The applicant must submit a brief report about the drama witnessed, highlighting its positive and negative points, along with the counter-foils of the tickets, for the reimbursement to be processed. The scheme is implemented by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted by submitting required documents to the office.
## Benefits - Reimbursement of the value of ticket(s) for witnessing high-standard dramas. - To cover the cost incurred by artists for purchasing tickets to watch high-standard plays, thereby encouraging them to improve their performance quality. _*The value of the ticket(s) will be reimbursed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa after a brief report about the drama seen and the counter-foils of tickets are submitted to the office._ _*The artist who has witnessed the drama must submit a brief report highlighting the positive and negative points of the play._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a director, script writer, artist, or backstage artist. - The applicant must submit a self-attested copy of their Aadhaar Card along with the application.

metadata.schemeName: PM-Special Training of Geriatric Caregivers
metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to train and create a professional cadre of geriatric caregivers to meet the increasing demand for specialized care for senior citizens. It offers skill development and certification in geriatric care job roles to Indian citizens, ensuring professional services for the elderly.

page_content:
# PM-Special Training of Geriatric Caregivers **Ministry:** Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Skills & Employment, Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Training, Skill, Health, Certification | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "PM-Special Training of Geriatric Caregivers" was launched by the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India. The scheme aims to bridge the gap in supply and increasing demand in the field of geriatric caregivers, provide more professional services to senior citizens, and create a cadre of professional caregivers in geriatrics. The scheme provides training in four specific job roles: Geriatric Caregiver (Institutional & Home Care), Elderly Caretaker (Non-Clinical), Elderly Care Companion, and Wellness Therapist for Elderly, with an emphasis on physical, mental, and overall well-being of the elderly through a multi-disciplinary approach, including on-job training for specific courses. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment with the help of the National Institute of Social Defence. The applications for this scheme are accepted through registration on the Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH).
## Benefits > ***Skill Training*** The scheme provides training to candidates in four specific job roles: Geriatric Caregiver (Institutional & Home Care) (480 hours), Elderly Caretaker (Non-Clinical) (360 hours), Elderly Care Companion (450 hours), and Wellness Therapist for Elderly (570 hours). > ***On-Job Training (OJT)*** For job roles as mandated by the National Council for Vocational Education and Training, On-Job Training is provided, with its duration guided by the approved qualification pack. > ***Assessment and Certification*** The skill assessment is conducted by empaneled Assessment Agencies, and a certificate is made available to candidates in physical and digital form, along with corresponding 'credits' as per the National Credit Framework of MSDE. The assessment fee is provided under the scheme. > ***Re-assessment Opportunity*** Every candidate is offered one chance of re-assessment free of cost, to be borne from the scheme. > ***Placement Support*** Apprenticeship is promoted, and training linked to captive placements (training and placement within the same industry) will be encouraged. Trainees are also encouraged to participate in Rozgar Melas for placement, with Training Institutes having tie-ups for proper placement.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a citizen of India. - The applicant must meet the minimum age as specified in the respective job role. - The applicant must be less than 40 years of age. - The applicant must have the minimum education qualification as per the required job roles. - The applicant must not indulge in any substance abuse.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ##### **Official Website** [https://www.skillindiadigital.gov.in](https://www.skillindiadigital.gov.in)
**Step 1:****** ***Account Registration*** Navigate to the Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH) at https://www.skillindiadigital.gov.in, and click "Register". Provide your mobile number and verify via OTP. Provide your email ID. Set a strong password of minimum 8 characters. Complete the basic registration form and proceed to profile creation. **Step 2:****** ***Profile Creation and e-KYC*** Fill in your complete personal details including full name, date of birth, gender, category, and current address. Enter your Aadhaar number and click "Verify Aadhaar" for automatic e-KYC. The system will auto-populate your basic details and send OTP to your Aadhaar-linked mobile number for final authentication. Ensure all information matches exactly with your Aadhaar card. Upload the required documents in the specified file format and file size. **Step 3:****** ***Course and Institute Selection*** Browse through available geriatric caregiver training courses. Select your preferred training course. Choose up to three empaneled training institutes in order of preference. The system will allocate seats based on availability and your preference order during final selection process. **Step 4:****** ***Application Review and Submission*** Carefully review all entered information, uploaded documents, and selected preferences in the application preview section before submission. Read and accept the terms and conditions, scheme guidelines, and declaration. Click "Submit Application" to generate unique Application Reference Number (ARN) and receive confirmation SMS and email.
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:****** ***Verification and Selection*** The application verification (15-30 working days) by Project Appraisal Committee under Joint Secretary of DoSJE. Selected candidates receive training institute allocation, batch schedule, and joining instructions through registered communication channels. **Step 2:****** ***Training Enrollment and Support*** Report to assigned training institute as per schedule provided in selection notification with original documents for physical verification. Complete the free training program. Upon successful completion, receive government-recognized certification.
##### **Grievance Redressal** **Email:** secretary-sje@nic.in **Phone:** +91-11-23382065 **Address:** Shastri Bhavan, Dr. Rajendra Prasad Road, New Delhi - 110001

metadata.schemeName: Soil Health Card Scheme - Uttarakhand
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide Soil Health Cards to all farmers in the state, helping them understand the nutrient composition of their soil and the type and quantity of fertilizers suitable for their crops.

page_content:
# Soil Health Card Scheme - Uttarakhand **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Farmer, Soil Health, Agriculture, Soil Testing | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Soil Health Card Scheme” is implemented by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide Soil Health Cards to all farmers in the state, helping them understand the nutrient composition of their soil and the type and quantity of fertilizers suitable for their crops.
## Benefits - To provide Soil Health Cards to all farmers in the state. - The soil of each farmer’s field is tested at soil testing laboratories, which are operational in all 13 districts. - Farmers receive detailed information about the nutrient content of their soil, along with recommendations on the type and quantity of fertilizers best suited for their crops. - Soil testing is provided free of cost to farmers. - In hilly areas, a Soil Health Card is issued for agricultural land up to 2.5 hectares, while in plain areas, it is issued for land up to 10 hectares. Each card is valid for three years.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The farmer must own agricultural land in the state and be actively engaged in farming activities.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - First, the farmer must collect a soil sample from his or her field. The process is as follows: The farmer should identify six locations in his or her field from which he or she wishes to collect samples. He or she should clean the area from which the sample is to be taken, such as removing the grass on top of the soil. Dry soil is used for soil testing. If the collected soil sample is moist, it should be dried in the shade to allow it to air dry. - To collect a sample, dig a V-shaped pit 6 inches deep, 6 inches long, and 4 inches wide with a shovel or hoe. Collect approximately 1–2 inches of soil from the top to the bottom along the edge of the pit. Remove this collected soil and place it in a clean area. Collect soil from six locations in this manner. Once the soil is collected, mix it thoroughly and remove any pebbles, stones, grass, or roots. Divide the thoroughly mixed soil into four equal parts, discarding two, and retain the remaining two. Mix the remaining two parts thoroughly again, then divide them into four equal parts, discarding two. Repeat this process until you have half a kilogram of soil left. Half a kilogram of soil is a suitable sample for testing. - This half-kilogram soil sample should be kept in a clean bag, and a slip should be put in the bag in which the farmer’s name, complete address, Khasra number, mobile number, and information about the crop he or she wants to grow are mentioned. Along with the sample, the Aadhar card, residence certificate, and mobile number should also be included. - Farmers can submit this sample to the soil testing laboratory of their district themselves or through the Assistant Agriculture Officer of their Panchayat. After submission, when this sample is tested, the farmer is provided with his or her soil health card, according to which he or she can carry out farming and use manure and fertilizers. If a farmer in a remote district is unable to reach the headquarters, he or she can avail of the soil testing facility by contacting the in-charge of the Agriculture Department of his or her Panchayat, and the Aadhar card, residence certificate, and mobile number will be required.

page_content:
# Namo Saraswati Vignan Sadhana Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Education, Student, Science Stream Scholarship | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Namo Saraswati Vignan Sadhana Yojana" by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to create ample opportunities for technologically educated and skilled youth in the state by encouraging students to enter and complete science stream education up to Class 12th. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹25,000/- over two years to students of Class 11th and 12th to support their education in science and help them complete their board examinations successfully.
## Benefits - **Class 11th Benefit:** ₹10,000/- per annum, paid as a monthly stipend of ₹1,000/- for 10 months. - **Class 12th Benefit:** ₹15,000/- per annum. Students will receive a monthly stipend of ₹1,000/- for 10 months (₹10,000) - **Additional Benefit:** ₹5,000/- after passing the Class 12th board examination.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a student. - The applicant must have studied in a government or grant-in-aid school in Class 9th and 10th. - The applicant must have scored 50% or more in the Class 10 board examination. - The applicant must have taken admission in the science stream in a government, grant-in-aid, or self-financed school recognized by GSHSEB (Gujarat Secondary and Higher Secondary Education Board) or CBSE (Central Board of Secondary Education). - If the applicant has studied in a recognized self-financed school for Class 9 and/or 10, the family’s annual income must be ₹6,00,000/- or less.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - **Student Registration:** Schools must register eligible students on the Child Tracking System (CTS) portal of Vidya Samiksha Kendra. - **Verification:** The Director of Schools will verify applications with the help of the District Education Officer, and upload the final list of eligible students on the dedicated "Namo Saraswati" portal. - **Payment:** Assistance is disbursed directly into the beneficiary’s mother’s bank account (or the student’s account, if required) through DBT.

metadata.schemeName: Chief Minister Scholarship Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "Chief Minister Scholarship Scheme" by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students for pursuing medical, engineering, diploma, and higher education courses.

page_content:
# Chief Minister Scholarship Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Higher Education, Diploma, Degree Scholarship, Medical Education Scholarship | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Chief Minister Scholarship Scheme" by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to encourage higher education by providing financial assistance to meritorious students who have passed Class 10th or Class 12th and secured admission in diploma, degree, or higher education courses. The scheme provides varying amounts of financial support based on the course type and merit.
## Benefits
**Benefit Type****Details of Assistance****Number of Beneficiaries**Financial Assistance for Medical and Dental CoursesUp to ₹5,00,000/-250 StudentsFinancial Assistance for Engineering/Technology, Pharmacy Diploma to Degree, Ayurveda/Homeopathy, Nursing, Physiotherapy, Para-medical CoursesUp to ₹1,00,000/-1,130 StudentsFinancial Assistance for Diploma CoursesUp to ₹50,000/-120 StudentsFinancial Assistance for Higher Education CoursesUp to ₹10,000/-1,000 Students

## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be a student. - The applicant must have passed the Class 10th or Class 12th examination. - The applicant must have secured admission in a diploma course, a degree course after diploma, or a degree course after Class 12th. - The applicant must be pursuing medical, dental, engineering, technology, pharmacy, Ayurveda, homeopathy, nursing, physiotherapy, para-medical, or higher education courses. - The applicant must have a family annual income of less than or equal to ₹4,50,000/-.


## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Students must register on the [Official Website](https://scholarships.gujarat.gov.in/) using their Standard 10th or Standard 12th seat number. Do not use any spaces or special characters when entering the seat number. **Step 2:** Students applying for a Diploma to Degree course should use their Diploma enrollment number for registration. **Step 3:** The student's name must be entered exactly as it appears on their Standard 10 or 12 original marksheet. **Step 4:** Enter the passing year according to the marksheet (e.g., 2024). Provide a personal mobile number that will remain active throughout the entire course of study, as important updates will be sent via SMS to this number. **Step 5:** Enter and verify your 12-digit Aadhaar card number. **Step 6:** Fill in the correct ration card details, including the ration card number and the student's member ID number. **Step 7:** Provide accurate bank account details and an active email ID. **Step 8:** Enter the percentage from the marksheet; if percentages are not available, calculate them according to the rules of the university or board. **Step 9:** When selecting a stream, students from Arts and Commerce streams should choose "General Stream," while Science students should select "Science Stream".

# Preservation of Tiatr Literature **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Literature, Documentation, Song, Academia, Music | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Preservation of Tiatr Literature" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to preserve the literature related to Tiatr/Khell Tiatr/Khell, their scripts, lyrics of songs (kantaram), music, scripts of one-act plays, and encourage script writers and lyricists to publish their works in book form. The scheme addresses the issue that, although thousands of tiatrs have been produced and staged and songs (kantaram) composed and sung over the decades, not many books of Tiatr/Khell tiatr/Khell/One Act Plays scripts and lyrics of songs (Kantaram) have been published. The scheme provides printing of scripts of tiatrs/khell tiatrs/khells, one-act plays, lyrics of kantaram with or without music in book form in Konkani in Roman Script, and payment of honorarium along with free copies to eligible writers.
## Benefits ##### ***Printing Services*** - Tiatr Academy of Goa will print scripts of tiatrs/khell tiatrs/khells, one-act plays, lyrics of kantaram with or without music in book form in Konkani in Roman Script. - Minimum of 500 copies of each book will be printed.
##### ***Category-wise Benefits*** > ***Category I (Deceased or Inactive Tiatr Artistes)*** - One-time honorarium as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa for each tiatr script/anthology of songs. - 25 copies of books will be given to the writer or legal heir. - Books will be published by Tiatr Academy of Goa from its funds allotted to the scheme. > ***Category II (Active Tiatr Artistes)*** - 200 books will be given to the artiste. - One-time honorarium as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa for each tiatr script/anthology of songs. - Books will be published by Tiatr Academy of Goa from its funds allotted to the scheme. > ***Category III (Individual Artiste/Publisher Self-Publishing)*** - 100% of the cost of printing will be paid by Tiatr Academy of Goa on proper verification of rates. - Must give 100 books to Tiatr Academy of Goa free of cost. - Not entitled for any honorarium from Tiatr Academy of Goa.
##### ***Conditions*** _*The manuscript must adhere to traditional formats as approved by Tiatr Academy of Goa._ _*There should not be any adverse remark made in any form either written or verbal against any Governments/Individuals/Institutions or anything against caste, creed and religion in the scripts/lyrics of songs which may hurt the sentiments of anybody._ _*If proved to contain adverse remarks, Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right not to print the book and refrain from making payment or recall the payment made to the concerned._
## Eligibility Criteria ##### **General Eligibility** The applicant must be a tiatr artiste or the legal heir of a deceased tiatr artiste. ##### **Category-wise Eligibility** ***Category I:*** - The applicant must be a tiatr artiste who has expired or is living but not active on the tiatr stage. - The applicant must submit scripts of Tiatr/Khell tiatr/Khell/One Act Plays. - The applicant must have a minimum collection of 50 songs with or without musical scores if submitting only songs (kantaram). ***Category II:*** - The applicant must be a tiatr artist who is active on the tiatr stage. - The applicant must submit scripts of Tiatr/Khell tiatr/Khell/One Act Plays. - The applicant must have a minimum collection of 100 songs with or without musical scores if submitting only songs (kantaram). ***Category III:*** - The applicant must be an individual artist/publisher who wishes to publish Scripts of Tiatr/Khell tiatr/Khell/One Act Plays on his/her own. - The applicant must ensure the book conforms to all norms of the scheme. ##### ***Preference*** Scripts/lyrics/music written by tiatr artistes of yesteryears will be given first preference.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields: name of the applicant. Attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._
> ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** _Recommendation Board Review_ The submitted manuscript will be reviewed by the Recommendation Board consisting of 2 members appointed by Tiatr Academy of Goa who will recommend whether the books can be published or not. **Step 2:** _Approval and Soft Copy Submission_ If approved by the Recommendation Board, submit a soft copy of the manuscript on a Compact Disc/Digital Versatile Disc/pen drive to Tiatr Academy of Goa. **Step 3:** _Editorial Review_ The approved manuscript will be edited by a member of Editorial Board for spelling and orthography checking. **Step 4:** _Publication Process_ Upon successful completion of all review processes, Tiatr Academy of Goa will proceed with printing minimum 500 copies of the book in Konkani in Roman Script. **Step 5:** _Benefit Distribution_ Receive the designated benefits as per the applicable category including honorarium payment and free book copies as specified in the scheme guidelines.
> ***Application Processing*** _*Applications will be processed on 'First Come First Serve' basis._ _*Applications will be considered as per the availability of funds._ _*Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to make any changes in the rules._

page_content:
# Documentation of Tiatr through Research Work **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Research, Documentation, Book, Writer, Academia, Music | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Documentation of Tiatr through Research Work" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage research work in the field of Tiatr and facilitate writers to take up research work in different aspects of Tiatr, its Song & Music. The scheme provides publication of research work in book form with a minimum of 500 copies printed and remuneration as fixed by TAG as per the researcher's experience. The applicant must be a researcher interested in writing books on tiatr after doing thorough research and must submit three typed copies of the manuscript for approval. The scheme is implemented by the Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG). The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
## Benefits > ***Publication Benefits*** - TAG will publish the research work in book form after thorough research on the subject. - The publication may be in English or Konkani (Roman Script). - TAG will print a minimum of 500 copies of the book. - 100 copies will be given to the writer. - The remaining copies will be used by TAG for various purposes. > ***Financial Benefits*** The author/researcher will be given remuneration as fixed by TAG as per his/her experience for the research work undertaken. > ***Editorial Support*** - The manuscript approved by the Recommendation Board shall be edited by a member of Editorial Board. - Editing will include checking for spelling and orthography. ***Conditions*** _*The manuscript received from the author/researcher will be considered for publication only after getting approval from the Recommendation Board appointed by TAG._ _*The author/researcher will have to provide TAG, 3 (three) typed copies of the manuscript._ _*If approved, the author/researcher will have to submit a soft copy of the manuscript on a Compact Disc/Digital Versatile Disc/pen drive._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a researcher interested in writing books on tiatr after doing thorough research on the subject. - Preference will be given to any researcher who has already done research on any aspect of Tiatr, its Song & Music.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields: name of the applicant, complete address, contact number, email address, Aadhaar Card number, Permanent Account Number Card number, name of the research, and aspects of tiatr on which research is done. Attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment_
> ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** _Recommendation Board Review_ The submitted manuscript will be reviewed by the Recommendation Board consisting of 2 members appointed by TAG. The board members will be paid a suitable honorarium as fixed by TAG for the work undertaken. **Step 2:** _Approval and Soft Copy Submission_ If the manuscript is approved by the Recommendation Board, submit a soft copy of the manuscript on a Compact Disc/Digital Versatile Disc/pen drive to the Tiatr Academy of Goa. **Step 3:** _Editorial Process_ The approved manuscript will undergo editing by a member of the Editorial Board, which includes checking for spelling and orthography. **Step 4:** _Publication and Remuneration_ Upon completion of the editorial process, TAG will proceed with printing a minimum of 500 copies of the book and provide remuneration to the author/researcher as per the fixed rates based on experience.

# Sakhi Niwas - Working Women's Hostel **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Women and Child | **Tags:** Working Woman, Hostel, Accommodation Facilities | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Sakhi Niwas - Working Women's Hostel" is implemented by the Department of Women Empowerment & Child Development, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide hostel facilities for women with higher education or professional training, as well as working women, to stay in urban areas.
## Benefits - Under this scheme, hostels have been arranged for women to stay in urban areas by paying a nominal fee. - Facilities include: Accommodation, Mess, Library, Gym, TV Hall, Creche, and more.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must be a woman pursuing higher education or professional training, or a working woman.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - At present, hostel facilities are operational in the districts of Dehradun, Haridwar, and Udham Singh Nagar. - Applicants need to visit the hostel, submit a form along with their Aadhaar card and family details, and pay the required fees to stay in the hostel.

metadata.schemeName: Vahan Aksmat Sahay Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide immediate medical assistance and financial support to road traffic accident victims. It offers comprehensive medical treatment packages for various injury types with cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals.

page_content:
# Vahan Aksmat Sahay Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Vehicle, Accident, Medical, Treatment, Injury, Health, Emergency | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched in 2020, the scheme "Vahan Aksmat Sahay Scheme" by the Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide immediate medical assistance and financial support to victims of road traffic accidents to ensure timely treatment and reduce mortality rates. The scheme provides medical treatment packages ranging from ₹1,000/- to ₹45,000/- for various types of injuries and covers emergency medical procedures, surgeries, and hospitalization for accident victims. The applicant must be a victim of road traffic accident requiring immediate medical treatment and the treatment must be provided at empanelled hospitals under the scheme. The scheme is implemented by Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Gujarat and applications are accepted through participating hospitals where treatment is provided.
## Benefits **Medical Treatment Packages** Comprehensive treatment packages ranging from ₹1,000/- to ₹45,000/- covering various types of injuries:
**Package-wise Benefits** - Simple Injury-I (Package 1): ₹1,000/- for treating simple wounds, injection Tetanus Vaccination, analgesic, antibiotics, general conditions check, cleaning, suturing and dressing - Simple Injury-II (Package 2): ₹2,500/- including face and scalp wounds, change of soiled cloth with disposable dress, intravenous line, multiple lacerated wounds suturing - Deglove Injury of Extremities (Package 3): ₹12,000/- for wound debridement in operation theatre under anaesthesia, intravenous line, intravenous antibiotics, remaining wounds suturing and inpatient treatment - Simple Fracture Without Anaesthesia (Package 4): ₹1,500/- for closed reduction, cleaning, suturing, dressing of wounds, fracture stabilization with splint - Closed Fracture Reduction Under Anaesthesia for First Fracture (Package 5): ₹4,000/- including closed fracture reduction under short general anaesthesia with plastering and inpatient treatment - Closed Fracture Reduction Under Anaesthesia for Additional Fracture (Package 6): ₹5,500/- for additional fractures with similar treatment as Package 5 - Dislocation Reduction Under Anaesthesia (Package 7): ₹8,000/- for joint dislocation reduction under general anaesthesia and inpatient treatment - Open Reduction Internal Fixation-Small Bone (Package 8): ₹17,250/- including internal/external fixation of fracture in compound fractures, flap cover and inpatient treatment - Open Reduction Internal Fixation-Large Bone (Package 9): ₹40,250/- for large bone fractures with similar treatment as Package 8 - Inter Costal Drainage One Side (Package 10): ₹8,000/- including intercostal drainage and inpatient treatment - Inter Costal Drainage Bilateral (Package 11): ₹11,000/- for bilateral intercostal drainage with inpatient treatment - Inter Costal Drainage Bilateral with Intensive Care Unit (Package 12): ₹12,000/- with Intensive Care Unit stay - Inter Costal Drainage Bilateral with Intensive Care Unit and Ventilator (Package 13): ₹14,000/- including ventilator support - Blunt Injury Abdomen (Package 14): ₹10,000/- for suspected blunt injury abdomen with stabilization as inpatient - Blunt Injury Abdomen with Intensive Care Unit Stay (Package 15): ₹12,000/- including Intensive Care Unit stay - Supra Pubic Cystostomy (Package 16): ₹5,000/- including supra pubic cystectomy and inpatient treatment - Immobilization for Suspected Spine Injury (Package 17): ₹5,000/- for non-operative management using spinal brace/collar - Cervical Spine Injury-Skeletal Tong Traction (Package 17): ₹25,000/- with tong traction - Spine Injuries with Computed Tomography/Magnetic Resonance Imaging (Package 18): ₹7,000/- including Computed Tomography scan/Magnetic Resonance Imaging - Tracheostomy (Package 19): ₹5,000/- for tracheostomy procedure - Head Injury with Intensive Care Unit Stay Conservative (Package 20): ₹7,000/- for non-operative management with Intensive Care Unit stay - Head Injury with Intensive Care Unit Stay with Ventilator (Package 21): ₹15,000/- including ventilator support - Head Injury with Intensive Care Unit Surgical Intervention (Package 22): ₹25,000/- for operative management including burr hole surgery - Blood Transfusion (Package 23): ₹1,500/- per unit (maximum admissible 3 units) - Road Traffic Accident Injuries Associated with Burns Conservative Management (Package 24): ₹4,000/- for conservative management of burns - Intensive Care Unit Stay Other than Head Injury (Package 25): ₹4,000/- for non-head injury Intensive Care Unit care - Pelvic Injury-Conservative Management (Package 26): ₹20,000/- for non-operative management with pelvic belt and traction - Pelvic Injury-External Fixation with Implant (Package 27): ₹45,000/- for stabilization with external fixation and haemodynamic stabilization
**Mode of Disbursement** Cashless Treatment: Treatment provided at empanelled hospitals without upfront payment.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a victim of road traffic accident. - The applicant must require immediate medical treatment for injuries sustained in the accident. - The applicant must receive treatment at hospitals empanelled under the Vahan Aksmat Sahay Scheme. - The applicant must have Medico Legal Case registered for the accident. - The applicant must have police intimation with acknowledgment for the road traffic accident.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** _Emergency Treatment at Empanelled Hospital_ In case of a road traffic accident, the victim should be immediately taken to the nearest empanelled hospital under the Vahan Aksmat Sahay Scheme for emergency medical treatment. The hospital will provide immediate medical care as per the severity of injuries. **Step 2:** _Medico Legal Case Registration_ The hospital authorities will ensure that a Medico Legal Case is registered with the local police station as it is mandatory for all road traffic accident cases. The hospital will coordinate with the police for proper documentation of the accident and injuries. **Step 3:** _Treatment Package Assessment_ The treating doctor will assess the nature and severity of injuries and determine the appropriate treatment package from the 27 available packages under the scheme. The treatment will be provided as per the standardized protocols defined for each package. **Step 4:** _Documentation Collection_ The hospital staff will collect all required documents including Medico Legal Case register details, police intimation copy, pre and post-treatment photographs, medical records, investigation reports, and hospital bills as specified for the respective treatment package. **Step 5:** _Cashless Treatment Provision_ The empanelled hospital will provide cashless treatment to the accident victim as per the approved package amount. No upfront payment is required from the patient or family members for the covered treatment under the scheme. **Step 6:** _Claim Processing and Settlement_ The hospital will submit the claim along with all required documents to the scheme authorities for processing and settlement. The payment will be directly settled between the government and the empanelled hospital. **Step 7:** _Discharge and Follow-up Care_ Upon completion of treatment, the patient will be discharged with proper discharge summary and follow-up instructions. Patients are advised to retain copies of all medical records and treatment documents for future reference and any follow-up care requirements.

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nidan Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free quality diagnostic facilities at all government health institutions in Gujarat. It benefits rural population by offering essential laboratory tests, X-ray, sonography services without charge at nearby government healthcare centers.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Nidan Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Healthcare, Diagnosis, Laboratory, Rural, Medical | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched in 2015-16, the scheme "Mukhyamantri Nidan Yojana" (also known as "Free Laboratory Testing Scheme") by the Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide quality diagnostic facilities without charge at all government health institutions and ensure timely and accurate diagnosis of diseases like malaria, tuberculosis, cancer, diabetes, hypertension to reduce morbidity and mortality in communities. The scheme provides free essential pathology, biochemistry, hematology, microbiology testing services at all government health institutions and strengthens existing laboratory facilities with quality equipment and trained staff along with regular supply of reagent kits. The applicant must be seeking healthcare services at government health facilities and require diagnostic testing for medical conditions. The scheme is implemented through a three-tier healthcare structure consisting of Sub Health Centers, Primary Health Centers, Community Health Centers, Sub-District Hospitals, District Hospitals and Medical Colleges with a total budget allocation of ₹200.94 crores, and applications are accepted offline at respective government healthcare facilities.
## Benefits > **Primary Benefits** - Free Laboratory Testing Services: All essential pathology, biochemistry, hematology, and microbiology tests provided without any charge. - Diagnostic Facilities: X-ray, sonography, and Electrocardiography services at Community Health Centers - Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage: Testing for communicable and non-communicable diseases, maternal and child health conditions. > **Service Delivery** - Timely Diagnosis: Early detection of diseases like malaria, tuberculosis, cancer, diabetes, hypertension. - Quality Equipment: Modern diagnostic equipment and trained laboratory technicians. - Regular Supply: Continuous availability of reagent kits and testing materials. - Accessibility: Services available at doorstep through Sub Health Centers, Primary Health Centers, Community Health Centers, Sub-District Hospitals, District Hospitals, and Medical College hospitals. > **Implementation Structure** - Total Budget: ₹200.94 crores allocated for the scheme. - Two-Phase Implementation: First phase focuses on strengthening existing facilities, second phase adds new equipment and services. - Coordination System: Multi-tier coordination cells from state to facility level for effective implementation. > **Conditions for Availment** - Services available only at government healthcare institutions. - Testing must be prescribed by qualified medical officers. - Regular maintenance and quality checks of equipment ensured through designated coordination cells.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be seeking healthcare services at any government health facility in Gujarat. - The applicant must require diagnostic testing as prescribed by a qualified medical officer. - The applicant must visit designated government healthcare institutions including Sub Health Centers, Primary Health Centers, Community Health Centers, Sub-District Hospitals, District Hospitals, or Medical College hospitals.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** _Visit Government Healthcare Facility_ Visit the nearest government healthcare facility (Sub Health Center, Primary Health Center, Community Health Center, Sub-District Hospital, District Hospital, or Medical College hospital) during working hours with all required documents. **Step 2:** _Medical Consultation_ Consult with the qualified medical officer or doctor available at the facility who will assess your medical condition and determine the necessary diagnostic tests required for proper diagnosis and treatment. **Step 3:** _Prescription Receipt_ Obtain a written prescription from the medical officer specifying the required laboratory tests, X-ray, sonography, or Electrocardiography services needed for your medical condition. **Step 4:** _Laboratory Registration_ Proceed to the laboratory or diagnostic section of the healthcare facility with your prescription and identity documents, where the laboratory technician will register your case and assign a unique identification number. **Step 5:** _Sample Collection and Testing_ Undergo the prescribed diagnostic procedures including sample collection for laboratory tests, X-ray imaging, sonography, or Electrocardiography as per the medical officer's prescription under the supervision of trained technical staff. **Step 6:** _Report Collection_ Collect your diagnostic test reports from the laboratory or diagnostic section as per the timeline specified by the facility, which may vary depending on the type of tests conducted. **Step 7:** _Follow-up Consultation_ Return to the medical officer with your test reports for interpretation of results, further medical advice, and continuation of treatment as necessary for your healthcare needs.
