metadata.schemeName: SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to equip beneficiaries with skills for employability and entrepreneurship at taluka/village level across Gujarat. It provides skill development training through Short-Term Training and Special Projects for diverse beneficiaries.

page_content:
# SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0 **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Skill, Training, Youth, Entrepreneurship, Certification, Placement | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0"was launched by the Gujarat Skill Development Mission (GSDM), Labour and Employment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide access to skill development programmes to a wide range of beneficiaries at taluka/village level, enhancing employability and competitiveness in the job market while promoting entrepreneurship. The scheme provides Short-Term Training in National Skills Qualifications Framework Level 1, 2, and 3 courses along with Gujarat Council of Vocational Training courses, and implements Special Projects for marginalized and vulnerable groups. The applicant must be a domicile of Gujarat, looking for fresh skills, reskilling, upskilling opportunities. The scheme is implemented by GSDM through empanelled Implementation Partners across all 33 districts of Gujarat. The applications are accepted online through the GSDM portal.
## Benefits ##### ***Training Benefits*** - Short-Term Training of approximately 300 hours duration in National Skills Qualifications Framework/Gujarat Council of Vocational Training aligned courses. - On-the-Job Training as an integral part of Short-Term Training with duration determined by specific job roles. - Specialized training courses for Special Projects tailored to meet specific needs of marginalized and vulnerable groups. - Training conducted at Saksham Centers established at taluka/village level. - Access to certified Training of Trainers trainers endorsed by respective Sector Skill Councils. - Industry expert and entrepreneur guest lectures on rotational basis. ##### ***Assessment and Certification Benefits*** - Assessment and certification carried out by Sector Skill Councils/Gujarat Council of Vocational Training. - Assessment and certification fees paid directly by Gujarat Skill Development Mission. - Candidates eligible for assessment with minimum 70% attendance for classroom training and 70% for On-the-Job Training. ##### ***Employment Support Benefits*** - Placement assistance and employment opportunities from Implementation Partners. - Multiple placement options including wage employment, probation with stipend/salary, service aggregator portal registration, job work acceptance, self-employment, and apprenticeship opportunities. - Post-placement tracking and support services. ##### ***Infrastructure and Facility Benefits*** - Training centers with basic amenities including drinking water and separate toilets for boys and girls. - Aadhaar-based biometric attendance system and Internet Protocol-based Closed-Circuit Television cameras with Digital Video Recorder systems. - Teaching aids, furniture, fittings, and equipment as per job role requirements. ##### ***Conditions*** - Minimum 70% attendance required for classroom training to be eligible for completion. - Minimum 70% attendance required for On-the-Job Training to be eligible for completion. - Original Aadhaar card verification required during assessment to prevent duplication. - Adherence to batch timings from earliest 7:00 AM to latest 7:00 PM with minimum 4 hours and maximum 8 hours per day training.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a domicile of Gujarat. - The applicant must be minimum 14 years of age as per labour law for non-hazardous occupations. - The applicant must be maximum 59 years of age for Short Term Training. - The applicant must be maximum 65 years of age for Special Projects. - The applicant must be looking for fresh skills, reskilling, or upskilling opportunities for Short Term Training. - The applicant must be out of education, school/college dropout, or unemployed youth for Short Term Training. - The applicant must belong to marginalized, vulnerable groups requiring special attention or specific job roles for Special Projects. > ***Eligibility for Special Projects*** The applicant must belong to one of the following categories: _Jail Inmates, Former Prisoners, Juvenile homes, Scheduled Castes, Women, Members of the Transgender Community, Members of the Beggar Community, Senior Citizens and Old age homes, Patients recovered from Mental illness, Children in Shelter Homes and Orphanages, Scheduled Tribes, Economically Backward Communities, Persons with Disabilities, Rural Artisans, or Migrant Workers._
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:****** ***Registration, Login and Profile Setup*** - Visit the [official website](https://skills.gujarat.gov.in) of Gujarat Skill Development Mission and navigate to the SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0 application portal. - Create a new user account on the portal by providing basic personal information including name, mobile number, and email address. Verify your mobile number through OTP sent via SMS and verify email address through verification link. - Login to your registered account using credentials and complete your detailed profile including personal information, educational qualifications, employment status, and contact details. Upload a recent passport-size photograph in JPEG format with maximum file size of 100kb. **Step 2:****** ***Selection of Scheme, Job Role, and Training Center*** - Navigate to the SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0 scheme section and select the appropriate training category - either Short Term Training or Special Projects based on your eligibility and requirements. Browse through the available NSQF/GCVT aligned job roles listed on the portal. - Select your preferred job role based on your interest, aptitude, and career objectives from the available options in your district/taluka. - View the list of empanelled Implementation Partners and their Saksham Centers in your preferred taluka/village location. - Select your preferred training center based on location convenience and course availability. **Step 3:****** ***Filling Application Form and Document Upload*** - Fill the comprehensive application form with mandatory fields including personal details, educational background, employment history, family information, and preference details. Ensure all information is accurate and matches with supporting documents. - Upload all required documents in PDF format with maximum file size of 2MB per document. Ensure documents are clear, legible, and properly scanned with all four corners visible. **Step 4:****** ***Application Review and Submission*** - Review all entered information and uploaded documents for accuracy and completeness. Make necessary corrections if required and submit the application form. Note down the application reference number for future tracking. - Receive application submission confirmation message on registered mobile number and email address. Download and save the application acknowledgment receipt for future reference.

metadata.schemeName: Oral Documentation of History of Tiatr
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to preserve the oral history of tiatr for future generations through documentation of veteran artistes' experiences. It provides video recording and remuneration to eligible veteran tiatr artistes.

page_content:
# Oral Documentation of History of Tiatr **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Artist, Culture, Tiatr, Heritage, Remuneration | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Oral Documentation of History of Tiatr" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to preserve the rich experiences of veteran tiatr artistes who have contributed immensely to the development of Tiatr, as their experiences form a part and parcel of the history of Tiatr for future generations. The scheme provides video recording of artistes' experiences on High Definition or higher format camera with preservation on Digital Versatile Disc at Tiatr Academy of Goa's Library and a onetime remuneration as fixed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applicant must have made at least 20 years contribution to the Konkani stage and must be a script writer, director, actor, singer, musician, backstage artiste or organizer involved in tiatrs. The scheme is implemented by the Tiatr Academy of Goa and applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
## Benefits > ***Financial Benefits*** - Onetime remuneration as fixed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa to the artiste to be documented. - Additional amount as decided by the Tiatr Academy of Goa for artistes living outside Goa. - Remuneration to the interviewer as fixed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. > ***Non-Financial Benefits*** - Video recording of artiste's experiences on High Definition or higher format camera. - Preservation of documentation on Digital Versatile Disc at Tiatr Academy of Goa's Library. - One copy of the Digital Versatile Disc provided to the artiste concerned. - Potential upload of recording on Tiatr Academy of Goa's website, other internet sites, or other media channels.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a veteran artist who has contributed to the development of Tiatr. - The applicant must be a script writer, director, actor, singer, musician, backstage artiste involved in stage setting, light effects, background music, costumes, make-up, or those involved in organizing tiatrs. - The applicant must have made at least 20 years of contribution to the Konkani stage. - The applicant who is a writer or director must have scripted at least 15 tiatrs. - The applicant who is other than writer or director must have participated in at least 20 tiatrs. > ***Preference, Selection and Implementation*** - At least five artistes will be considered for documentation in a financial year. - Artistes will be selected by the Managing Committee of Tiatr Academy of Goa. - Preference will be given to old and sick artistes.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. The application form requires details including the name of the artiste, address, contact number, email, Aadhaar Card number, and aspects of tiatr on which the artiste has contributed to the tiatr stage. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Provide detailed information about your contribution to the tiatr stage on a separate sheet as indicated in the form. Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - **Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment received for future reference._ _*The Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to make any changes in the rules of the scheme._

metadata.schemeName: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Residential Hostel
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free hostel facilities to children (both boys and girls) aged 6 to 18 years who are enrolled in nearby schools for formal education. In addition, children are provided with a monthly stipend of ₹200/-.

page_content:
# Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Residential Hostel **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Housing & Shelter | **Tags:** Hostel, Subhash Chandra Bose, Stipend, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Residential Hostel” is an initiative under the Samagra Shiksha Programme, implemented by the Secondary Education Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide free hostel facilities to the children (both boys and girls) aged 6 to 18 years who are enrolled in nearby schools for formal education. There are a total of 13 residential hostels in Dehradun (Baniyawala, Araghar, Jhadipani, Nabha House- Rishikesh), Haridwar (Alipur, Laladhang, Mohitpur), Pauri (Srinagar, Peethsain), Champawat and Udham Singh Nagar (Gadarpur, Kashipur, Sitarganj).
## Benefits - All children residing in the hostels are enrolled in nearby schools for formal education. - All hostel facilities are provided free of cost. - Children are also given a monthly stipend of ₹200/-.
## Eligibility Criteria Free hostel facilities are provided to boys and girls aged 6 to 18 years who: - Belong to BPL families or whose family's annual income is less than ₹55,000/-, or - Belong to SC/ST/OBC or minority communities, or - Have one or both parents deceased, or - Are children with disabilities, or - Are ragpickers, beggars, or from urban deprived and weaker sections.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - Before the commencement of the academic session, the Hostel Warden, Block Education Officer, or District Project Officer conducts wide publicity and invites applications for the vacant hostel seats. The application form can be downloaded from the Samagra Shiksha website [https://ssa.uk.gov.in/](https://ssa.uk.gov.in/) or obtained from the hostel warden. - For orphan, begging, or ragpicking children, all necessary documents are prepared at the hostel level. For other children, the required documents include the child’s photograph, Aadhaar card, birth certificate, permanent residence certificate, caste certificate, mobile number, Aadhaar card of the parent or guardian, and BPL certificate or ration card in case of BPL families, or an annual income certificate up to ₹55,000/-. - All the above documents, along with the application form, can be submitted by the parents or guardians to the concerned hostel. Admission is granted by the management committee after reviewing all the parameters and based on the availability of seats in the hostel.

metadata.schemeName: Residential- Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalaya/ Rajiv Gandhi Abhinav Vidyalaya
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free and accessible education for children from Class 6 to 12 by offering free education, accommodation, meals, study materials, sports facilities, and other essential services across all Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalaya / Rajiv Gandhi Abhinav Vidyalaya in the state.

page_content:
# Residential- Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalaya/ Rajiv Gandhi Abhinav Vidyalaya **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Student, Meals, Free Education, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Class | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Residential - Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalaya/ Rajiv Gandhi Abhinav Vidyalaya" scheme is implemented by the Secondary Education Department under the Department of Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide free and accessible education for children from Class 6 to 12 by offering free education, accommodation, meals, study materials, sports facilities, etc. across all Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalaya / Rajiv Gandhi Abhinav Vidyalaya in the state.
## Benefits - Students from Class 6 to 12 are provided with free accommodation, education, meals, sports facilities, and other essential services. - In these schools, 50% of the total seats are reserved for girls and 50% for boys, with 80% of the seats reserved for students from rural areas and 20% for students from urban areas. Reservations for SC, ST, OBC, EWS, orphans, and other eligible categories are applicable within these seats. - Admissions to these schools are only for Class 6.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be studying in Class 5 in Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have passed Classes 3 and 4 from the same school where the applicant is currently studying in Class 5.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - For admission, the Uttarakhand Board of School Education, Ramnagar conducts an entrance examination. The Board invites applications from students through advertisements published every year from September to December. - The application form can be downloaded from the Board’s website: [https://ubse.uk.gov.in](https://ubse.uk.gov.in/)/. Along with the form, the applicant must attach and submit the following documents to the school where they are currently studying: photograph, Aadhaar card, caste certificate, Economically Weaker Section (EWS) certificate (for general category), orphan certificate, mark sheets of Classes 3 and 4, and the admission card of Class 5. - All completed application forms are submitted to the Block Education Officer’s office by the respective school. After submission, the applicant receives the admission card from the school and must appear for the entrance examination in February. - Based on the merit list, the school informs the selected applicant, who then takes admission in Class 6 at a residential Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalaya / Rajiv Gandhi Abhinav Vidyalaya.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension of ₹20,000/- to the widowed wife or widower husband of democracy fighters of the state who were imprisoned under MISA/DIR during the Emergency period from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977.

page_content:
# Loktantra Senani Samman Pension Scheme for Widowed Wife or Widower Husband of Democracy Fighters of the State Imprisoned under MISA/DIR during Emergency Period (from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Pension, Emergency Period, Widow, Democracy Fighter, Widower | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Loktantra Senani Samman Pension Scheme" is implemented by the Police Department under the Department of Home, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension to the widowed wife or widower husband of democracy fighters of the state who were imprisoned under MISA/DIR during the Emergency period from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977.
## Benefits **Pension Amount:** ₹20,000/- per month
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a widow or widower of a recognized democracy fighter. 1. The applicant’s deceased spouse must have been imprisoned under MISA/DIR during the Emergency period from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - The application has to be submitted to the concerned District Magistrate. - Based on the report/recommendation of the District Magistrate, the pension will be sanctioned at the Government level after obtaining the approval of the Hon’ble Departmental Minister or the Hon’ble Chief Minister. - The prescribed application format is not available. As proof, the applicant must submit evidence that his/her late husband or wife was receiving the Loktantra Senani Pension, or that he/she was imprisoned under MISA/DIR during the Emergency period (from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977).

page_content:
# National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm: Maintenance and Input Cost for Intercropping in Oilpalm **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Edible Oil, Oil Palm, Intercropping Assistance, Maintenance Support, Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme component "Maintenance and Input Cost for Intercropping in Oilpalm" launched under the "National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm" scheme by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation, Government of Gujarat. aims to promote the cultivation of oil palm, enhance domestic production, and reduce dependency on imports. The scheme provides assistance to farmers for maintenance and intercropping during the four-year gestation period of oil palm plantations, ensuring the timely provision of essential inputs such as seeds, fertilizers, crop protection materials, and other related resources.
## Benefits - **First Year:** ₹10,500/-. - **Second Year:** ₹10,500/-. - **Third Year:** ₹10,500/-. - **Fourth Year:** ₹10,500/-.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/) Portal. **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side, then click on "Beneficiary Registration" and select any one from the 'Farmer' or 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. **Step 3:** Select the District, Taluka, and Village, choose 'what type of account holder you are?', enter your Account Number and Name, solve the Captcha, and click 'Save and Next'. **Step 4:** Enter your Mobile Number and Email address, click 'Send OTP', enter the received OTP, create and confirm a Password, solve the Captcha, and click 'Submit'. > **Login Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/) Portal. **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side of the homepage. On the home page, click on ‘Schemes’ and then click on ‘Agricultural Schemes’. **Step 3:** Now select the scheme, click on the ‘Apply’ button, and an application page will open. **Step 4:** Click on the "Apply New" button and submit a new application. **Step 5:** Click on the "Update Application" button to add corrections to the application. **Step 6:** Once the application is done, confirm it. **Step 7:** Take a printout of the confirmed application. > **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_Contacts.aspx)

# Sainik School Scholarship Located Outside the Uttarakhand **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Sainik School, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Sainik School Scholarship Located Outside the Uttarakhand" is implemented by the Secondary Education Department under the Department of Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from Uttarakhand who are studying in classes 6 to 12 at Sainik Schools located outside the state.
## Benefits **Rate of Scholarships:** - ₹40,000/- per annum for students from families with a monthly income up to ₹12,000/-. - ₹30,000/- per annum for students from families with a monthly income of ₹12,001/- to ₹15,000/-. - ₹20,000/- per annum for students from families with a monthly income of ₹15,001/- to ₹18,000/-. - ₹10,000/- per annum for students from families with a monthly income of ₹18,001/- to ₹22,000/-.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must be studying in Classes 6 to 12 in a Sainik School located outside Uttarakhand. - The scholarship will be awarded on the basis of the applicant’s family income. - The applicant is not eligible if the monthly family income exceeds ₹22,000/-.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - The student studying in a Sainik School located outside Uttarakhand will apply for a scholarship in that school. - Along with the application, the student must submit the following documents: a valid family income certificate issued by the tehsil, permanent residence certificate, Aadhaar card, and proof of an Aadhaar-linked bank account. All Sainik Schools located outside the state will forward the applications to Sainik School Ghorakhal. Sainik School Ghorakhal will compile the applications, prepare a proposal, and send it to the department. - The department will allocate funds to the concerned schools through Sainik School Ghorakhal, and the schools will disburse the scholarship to the students via DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer).

metadata.schemeName: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries: Training of Scheduled Caste trainees Gujarat
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase fish production and provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Caste (SC) people engaged in inland fisheries activities.

page_content:
# Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries: Training of Scheduled Caste trainees Gujarat **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Fish Production, Fish Farming, Fishermen, Fish Farmer, Training Of Scheduled Caste Trainees | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries" with the component of "Training of Scheduled Caste Trainees" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to increase fish production and provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Caste (SC) people engaged in inland fisheries activities. Through this scheme, financial assistance in the form of a stipend is provided to SC beneficiaries undergoing fisheries training to enhance their knowledge and skills. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries, Government of Gujarat. **Objectives:** - To increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to scheduled caste (SC) people involved in inland fisheries activities. - To boost fish farming or fishing activities in freshwater bodies by scheduled caste (SC) fish farmers and fishermen. - Fishing in reservoirs, aquaculture in ponds, and catch from rivers increase fish production and boost inland fisheries through scheduled caste (SC) fish farmers and fishermen. - The main objective is to provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Caste fishermen in the state and increase fish production.
## Benefits 1. The trainee is paid a stipend of ₹1,250/- after completing ten days of training. 1. The stipend is paid at the rate of ₹125/- per day.
> **Training Duration:** 10 days of fisheries training. > **Frequency of Disbursement:** Once in a lifetime.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community. 1. The applicant should be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant should be involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant can be an individual, a society, a self-help group, an association, a reservoir monopoly, or a private unit. 1. The applicant must have a bank account in their own name. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.
> **Preference/Reservation:** The scheme specifically benefits Scheduled Caste fishermen under the inland fisheries scheme.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Visit the Nearest District Fisheries Office in your respective district. **Step 2:** Collect the Prescribed Application Form for the training component, i.e, "Training of Scheduled Caste Trainees" under Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries. **Step 3:** Fill the Application Form completely with accurate details. **Step 4:** Attach the Required Documents, including identity proof, SC certificate, and bank account proof. **Step 5:** Submit the Application in person to the concerned official at the District Fisheries Office.

metadata.schemeName: Tool Assistance Scheme for Pottery Artisans
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide essential tools like electric chalk and electric footmill to individual artisans with a 75% subsidy. It benefits pottery workers, particularly those of Prajapati/Kumbhar caste, by offering instrumental assistance and requiring a 25% beneficiary contribution.

page_content:
# Tool Assistance Scheme for Pottery Artisans **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Tool, Equipment, Artisan, Pottery, Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Tool Assistance Scheme for Pottery Artisans" by the Gujarat Matikam Kalakari & Rural Technology Institute, Industries and Mines Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial support to individual artisans for procuring essential tools like electric chalk and electric footmill, offering a substantial 75% subsidy on the tool cost. The scheme offers this significant subsidy, requiring a 25% beneficiary contribution, and ensures that assistance is provided solely in the form of instrumental support, rather than cash. The applicant must fulfill specific criteria, including being directly involved in pottery work, belonging to the Prajapati/Kumbhar caste or being another associated artisan, and falling within the prescribed age group of 18 to 50 years. The procurement of Tool under this scheme is managed by the Gujarat Rural Industries Marketing Federation (GRIMCO), and applications are accepted at the office of the institution as per the prescribed format.
## Benefits - Provision of tools such as an electric chalk and an electric footmill. - 75% subsidy on the cost of the tool. - The instrument assistance is to be used solely for the purpose for which it was given and for the potter's work. - The assistance will be given only in the form of instrumental assistance and not in cash.
_*The beneficiary must submit 25% of their contribution amount to the office of the institution through a demand draft in the name of 'GMK & RTI' of an authorized bank on the day disclosed by the organization._ _*The applicant must use the instrument assistance only for the purpose for which it has been given and for the matter involving the potter's work._ _*If the applicant misuses the assistance, the amount of tool assistance given will be recovered by the revenue organization._ _*During verification by an officer of the institution, if the instrument assistance is found not to have been used for the intended purpose, the amount of the instrument assistance given will be withdrawn._ _*The benefit of resource support will be available to only one person per family._ _*The delivery of the tool must be checked upon receipt, as no complaint of any kind of instrument will be taken into account after delivery._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be directly involved in the business of the Prajapati/Kumbhar caste. - The applicant should be directly involved in pottery work or pottery. - The applicant will have to give a certificate of competent authority for the purpose of doing pottery along with the application form. - The applicant can be another artisan associated with the pottery business who does pottery, provided they give a certificate of meaning along with the application form. - The applicant's age should be between 18 and 50 years. - The applicant must be the only person in their family applying for the benefit of resource support.
**Post-Selection Conditions** - The applicant shall have to use the instrument assistance for the purpose for which the instrument assistance has been given, only for that purpose and for the matter involving the potter's work. - The applicant must ensure the instrument assistance is used as intended; otherwise, the assistance amount will be withdrawn by the institution.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Steps for New Registration** **Step 1:** Visit the [eKutir portal](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in). In the right pane of the landing page, click "[For New Individual Registration, click Here](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in/Registration.aspx)". **Step 2:** On the registration page, fill in all mandatory fields (marked with an asterisk): Full Name (in English), Aadhaar Card Number, Gender, Date of Birth, Mobile Number, E-mail, Password (confirm the password by typing it again). Fill in the Captcha Code, and click "Register". **Step 3:** A confirmation pop-up will display the entered name, mobile number, and other details. If all the details are correct, click "Confirm" to proceed. If any information is incorrect, click "Cancel", make the necessary corrections, and then click "Register" again. **Step 4:** Upon successful registration, the User ID and Password will be sent to your registered mobile number via SMS. If an email address has been provided, the credentials will also be sent via email.
**Steps for Login Procedure and User Profile Update** **Step 1:** Visit the [eKutir portal](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in). In the right pane of the landing page (in the "Login to Portal" section), provide your User ID, Password, and the Captcha Code. Then click "Login". **Step 2:** Upon first login, the user must complete the "User Profile" by providing personal and organisational details. All fields marked with an asterisk are mandatory. Some fields will already be pre-filled based on the information provided during registration. _*Most of these details can later be updated from the “View Profile” section, except for the fields initially filled during registration._
**Steps for Scheme Application** **Step 1:** After logging in and completing the profile, the system displays schemes relevant to the user on the homepage. Click on the name of the scheme that you intend to apply for. You will be redirected to the online application form of the scheme. The application form is divided into multiple tabs. **Step 2:** In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. For each uploaded document, the corresponding document number must be entered wherever required. Click the “Save & Next” button to proceed to the subsequent tabs. **Step 3:** Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections. Acknowledge and agree to the terms and conditions, declaration, and privacy policy (if any) by ticking the designated checkbox. **Step 4:** Clicking “Save & Next” in the last tab of the application form generates an application number, which is displayed on the screen. The applicant must record this number for future reference. If the applicant wishes to print the application, they may click the “Print Application” button. _*If you do not wish to continue with the application at that point, you may click "Cancel"._
**Application Printing and Modification** - If the user wishes to print the application, they may click “Print Application.” - If the application has been returned for revision, a “Modify” button will appear. The user can then edit the application and resubmit it.
**Helpdesk/Grievance Redressal** - Call 9909926280 / 9909926180. - Connect with the [District Industries Centre (DIC)](https://www.cottage.gujarat.gov.in/Home-2140795B5D2D-282472282472-2824725B5D2D) of your district.
**Check Application Status** Visit the [Application Status](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in/ViewApplicationStatus.aspx) page Provide the Application Number of the scheme, and your Date of Birth. Then click "View Status".
**Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://e-kutir.gujarat.gov.in/ApplicationDocuments/GMK/IP/banhedhari.pdf) of the application form, or obtain the application form from the institute. **Step 2:** The applicant must ensure the application form is filled with complete details and all necessary certificates and documents are prepared. **Step 3:** The beneficiary must submit their 25% contribution amount to the office of the institution. This payment is to be made through a demand draft in the name of 'GMK & RTI' of an authorized bank on the day disclosed by the organization. A copy of the receipt of this payment must be submitted to the organization. **Step 4:** The application form, along with all the complete details and necessary documents, including a copy of the beneficiary contribution receipt, must be sent to the office of the institution - ***Gujarat Matikam Kalakari & Rural Technology Institute, Nr. GH-4, Sector 12, Gandhinagar - 382 016, Sector-12, Gujarat- India, +91-79-23251681, +91-79-23251665, dir-gmkrti@gujarat.gov.in*** **Step 5:** The applicant must submit copies of the certificates provided with the application form to the institution for verification as and when required. **Step 6:** The procurement process of the tool is carried out by the Gujarat Rural Industries Marketing Federation (GRIMCO). Once the tool is received by the organization from GRIMCO, it will be distributed to the applicants. The applicant will have to obtain the delivery of the tool at their own expense on the date and at the place specified by the institution. No separate cost or charge will be paid to the applicant for carting the tool.
_*Upon Delivery Upon receiving the tool, the applicant must thoroughly check its delivery. No complaints regarding any kind of instrument will be taken into account after the delivery has been made and checked._ _*After the instrument assistance is provided, an officer of the institution will personally examine the applicant regarding the use of the instrument assistance. If, during this verification, it is found that the instrument assistance has not been used for its intended purpose (potter's work), the amount of the assistance given will be withdrawn._ _*Applicants are encouraged to keep a copy of their submitted application and all relevant receipts for future reference._

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme “Assistance to Farmers for Mini Tractor and Power Tiller in Farm Mechanization Program”  aims to support mechanization in agriculture through financial aid for the purchase of mini tractors and power tillers to all eligible farmers across the state.

page_content:
# Assistance to Farmers for Mini Tractor and Power Tiller in Farm Mechanization Program **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Agricultural, Farm Mechanization, Subsidy, Mini Tractor, Power Tiller | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Assistance to Farmers for Mini Tractor and Power Tiller in Farm Mechanization Program” by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to improve agricultural productivity and reduce manual labor burden by providing financial assistance for the purchase of mini tractors and power tillers to farmers. The scheme offers a subsidy based on the horsepower of the machinery and the applicant's category to promote inclusive agricultural mechanization and improve efficiency in farming operations.
## Benefits > **Mini Tractors up to 20 HP and Power Tillers above 8 BHP:** - **General Category Farmers:** Financial assistance of ₹45,000/- or 40% of the equipment cost, whichever is less.- **SC/ST Farmers:** Financial assistance of ₹60,000/- or 50% of the equipment cost, whichever is less. > **Power Tillers Below 8 BHP:** - **General Category Farmers:** Financial assistance of ₹40,000/- or 40% of the equipment cost, whichever is less.- **SC/ST Farmers:** Financial assistance of ₹50,000/- or 50% of the equipment cost, whichever is less.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be engaged in agricultural practices and require mechanization support. - The applicant should intend to purchase either a mini tractor up to 20 HP, or a power tiller (either above or below 8 BHP).
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/) Portal. **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side, then click on "Beneficiary Registration" and select any one from the 'Farmer' or 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. **Step 3:** Select the District, Taluka, and Village, choose 'what type of account holder you are?', enter your Account Number and Name, solve the Captcha, and click 'Save and Next'. **Step 4:** Enter your Mobile Number and Email address, click 'Send OTP', enter the received OTP, create and confirm a Password, solve the Captcha, and click 'Submit'. > **Login Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/) Portal. **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side of the homepage. On the home page, click on ‘Schemes’ and then click on ‘Agricultural Schemes’. **Step 3:** Now select the scheme, click on the ‘Apply’ button, and an application page will open. **Step 4:** Click on the "Apply New" button and submit a new application. **Step 5:** Click on the "Update Application" button to add corrections to the application. **Step 6:** Once the application is done, confirm it. **Step 7:** Take a printout of the confirmed application. > **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_Contacts.aspx).

page_content:
# Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Organic Farming, Certification Assistance, Organic Input Subsidy, Farmer | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy" by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat aims to promote sustainable agricultural practices by encouraging farmers to adopt organic farming methods. The scheme provides financial support for the registration and certification processes conducted by the Gujarat Organic Products Certification Agency (GOPCA) and Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA)-approved agencies. It also offers input cost assistance per hectare, enabling farmers to reduce chemical usage and enhance soil health.
## Benefits - **Organic Farming Registration and Certification Assistance (GOPCA):** The scheme provides 75% at-source assistance in cost to the farmer for registration and certification when undertaken through the Gujarat Organic Products Certification Agency (GOPCA).- **Organic Farming Registration, Certification, and Transportation Assistance (APEDA-approved agencies):** When certification is done through APEDA-approved organic certification agencies, the scheme offers 50% assistance in registration, certification, and transportation fees. The maximum benefit for certification support is limited to ₹2,000/- per hectare.- **Input Assistance for Organic Farming:** Farmers are also eligible for input assistance amounting to ₹5,000/- per hectare to promote organic farming practices.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be engaged in organic farming activities.

metadata.schemeName: "Subsidy for Orthodox & Speciality Tea Unit for Plant & Machinery" under the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme"
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure long-term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and to incentivize manufacturers to move from Crush, Tear, Curl tea to Orthodox tea production. The scheme is implemented by the Finance Department and the Industries & Commerce Department, Government of Assam.

page_content:
# "Subsidy for Orthodox & Speciality Tea Unit for Plant & Machinery" under the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme" **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Assam | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Subsidy, Tea, Production, Incentive, Industry, Machinery | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched in 2020, the scheme "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme (ATISIS)" by the Finance (Institutional Finance) Department, Government of Assam, aims to ensure long-term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and to incentivize manufacturers to move from Crush, Tear, Curl tea to Orthodox tea production. The scheme is implemented by the Finance Department and the Industries & Commerce Department, Government of Assam, through multiple implementing agencies, including banks and the District Industries & Commerce Centre. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through a dedicated portal with a Direct Benefit Transfer mechanism for reimbursement.
## Benefits **Benefit Amount:** 25% of the cost of Plant & Machinery. **Maximum Amount:** ₹30,00,000/- or 25% of actual cost, whichever is less. **Validity Period:** Units starting production on or after 01-04-2020 and before 31-03-2028. **Claim Period:** Within 12 months of the start of commercial manufacturing activities. **Disbursement Mode:** Direct Benefit Transfer as reimbursement. **Post-Selection Condition:** Manufacturing unit shall not sell the machinery before expiry of at least 5 years from start of manufacturing.
## Eligibility Criteria **General Eligibility** - The applicant must be a tea plantation across all sizes. - The applicant must be a tea manufacturing unit manufacturing Crush, Tear, Curl Tea, Orthodox Tea, or Speciality tea including Green tea, Oolong Tea, White tea, Yellow tea and Purple tea. - The applicant must be located entirely in Assam. - The applicant must not have any part of the plantation or manufacturing facility located outside the State of Assam.
**Plant & Machinery Subsidy Specific Eligibility** - The applicant must be manufacturing Orthodox tea, Green tea, White tea, Oolong tea, Singhpo tea, Purple Tea, Yellow tea or other Speciality tea (not manufactured through Crush, Tear, Curl process). - The applicant must have started production on or after 01-04-2020 and before 31-03-2028. - The applicant must be either an entirely new unit or an existing unit which has expanded its capacity by creating additional infrastructure for production of Orthodox and Speciality Tea. - The applicant must use all new machinery (no subsidy available on second hand machinery or parts of a machine). - The applicant must not have claimed any similar subsidy under any other scheme of the Government of India or the State.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Registration Process** **Step 1:** Visit the [dedicated portal](https://atisis.assam.gov.in/atsisver/login.html) of "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives" Scheme. Click on the "New User Registration" option. **Step 2:** In the registration form, fill in basic details including name, mobile number, and email address. Create a username and password following the portal's password policy. Verify your mobile number through one-time password verification. Complete Captcha Code verification. Submit the registration form. **Step 3:** Check your registered email for the account activation link. Click on the activation link to activate the account. Log in to the portal using registered credentials. **Step 4:** Upload all supporting documents of eligibility in the prescribed format. Fill in complete unit details, including location, type of tea production, and capacity. Submit the unit registration form. Wait for registration approval.
**Application Process** **Step 1:** Log in to the portal using registered credentials. Navigate to the "Apply for Benefits" section. Select the scheme component that you intend to apply for. **Step 2:** Fill in the prescribed application form with all mandatory fields. Upload all supporting documents as mentioned in the portal. Ensure file formats and file size restrictions are followed as per the portal guidelines. Review all entered information for accuracy. **Step 3:** Upload documents in the specified format and size. Ensure all documents are clear and legible. Complete document verification checklist. **Step 4:** Review the complete application before submission. Apply online. _*Note down the application reference number. Save a copy of the submitted application form._ _*Applicants are strongly encouraged to save a copy of the submitted application, confirmation message, and application reference number for future reference and tracking purposes._
**Application Status Tracking** Log in to the portal to check application status. Track application progress through different stages of verification. Receive Short Message Service alerts throughout the process, including registration, fund release, etc. _*For Technical Support, please write to atisis.assam@gmail.com._
**Disbursement Process** The Finance Department releases the benefit directly to the beneficiary's bank account. Short Message Service alerts sent for funds disbursement. The beneficiary receives the Direct Benefit Transfer in a registered bank account.

metadata.schemeName: State Mountaineering Reward Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides awards in the field of mountaineering is in place to enthusiastically engage and inspire the youth of the state towards risky and adventurous activities like summiting, mountaineering and rock climbing and to honour and commend the youth of the state.

page_content:
# State Mountaineering Reward Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Summiting, Mountaineering, Rock Climbing, Youth, Adventure | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "State Mountaineering Reward Scheme" was launched by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide awards in the field of mountaineering is in place to enthusiastically engage and inspire the youth of the state towards risky and adventurous activities like summiting, mountaineering and rock climbing and to honor and commend the youth of the state who have achieved exceptional achievements in the field of mountaineering. Under the scheme, a cash award, a memento, and a certificate will be awarded to each of the adventurers of the state every year for their outstanding achievements in the field of mountaineering.
## Benefits A cash award of ₹25,000/-, a memento, and a certificate will be awarded to each of the adventurers of the state every year for their outstanding achievements in the field of mountaineering.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a native of Gujarat. - The applicant should have climbed a height of 7,000 meters once or a height of more than 6,000 meters twice. - The climbing achievement of the applicant must be confirmed by the Director of the Indian Mountaineering Foundation (IMF). - The applicant should not be involved in any criminal activity. ****This award can also be given posthumously, for which the legal heir of the awardee will have to apply.***
## Exclusions A person who has previously received an award in this field will not be eligible for the award.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Visit to [official website](https://sycd.gujarat.gov.in/) of the Sports, Youth & Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat. **Step 2:** Click on the "Schemes" section on the website. A list of available schemes will appear. From the list of schemes, select "State Mountaineering Reward Scheme." **Step 3:** A new page will display the scheme details. Scroll down on this page to find and download the "Application Form for State Mountaineering Award [(Annexure-A](https://commi-synca.gujarat.gov.in/writereaddata/Portal/Images/pdf/State-Mountaineering-Award-form.pdf)). **Step 4:** Fill out the application form completely and clearly. page_content:
# Taluka Level Personality Development and Yogasan Training Camp for Scheduled Caste **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Scheduled Caste, Personality Development, Yoga Training, Physical And Mental Health | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Taluka Level Personality Development and Yogasan Training Camp for Scheduled Caste" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to facilitate holistic personality development—physical, mental, and spiritual—among Scheduled Caste youth aged between 14 and 35 years by organizing 7-day free training camps. metadata.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of New Fresh Water Fin Fish Hatchery - Gujarat
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities.

page_content:
# Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of New Fresh Water Fin Fish Hatchery - Gujarat **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Fish Farming, Biofloc, Recirculating Aquaculture System, Fish Hatchery | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland)" with the component of the Establishment of New Fresh Water Fin Fish Hatchery, introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims provide financial assistance for various inland fisheries activities, establishment of freshwater hatcheries, and support for advanced fish farming methods are provided to individuals, societies, self-help groups, associations, reservoir leaseholders, and private entities involved in inland fisheries activities. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State Governments, with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% from the Government of Gujarat.
> **Objective:** - Increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. - Assistance is provided for accelerating inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodies, increasing inland fish production and boosting inland fisheries. - Except for water bodies or ponds, in less land, less water, Biofloc with source as well, Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS). By creating fish tanks with this method, more fish production can be obtained on less land and less water. If more beneficiaries get the benefit of the subsidy of this scheme, more fish production can be achieved with less water sources and less land. - Inland fish production capacity can be increased by the establishment of freshwater hatcheries.
## Benefits For the Establishment of New Fresh Water Fin Fish Hatchery, the unit cost of the project is ₹30,00,000/-. Assistance is provided as follows: 1. **General category:** 40% of the unit cost.1. **Women, Scheduled Caste (SC), and Scheduled Tribe (ST) categories:** 60% of the unit cost.1. **Funding structure:** - 60% contribution from the Government of India. - 40% contribution from the State Government.
> **Frequency of Disbursement:** Once in a lifetime benefit per eligible beneficiary for this specific component.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be an individual, society, self-help group, association, reservoir lease holder, or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-owners, the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhar Card/Passport as proof of identity.
> **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:** - All categories (General, Women, Scheduled Caste, and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side, then click on "Beneficiary Registration" and select any one from the 'Farmer' or 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. **Step 3:** Enter the 'Company Name' and Address if you have selected 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. And for all select the District, Taluka, and Village, choose 'what type of account holder you are?', enter your Account Number and Name, solve the Captcha, and click 'Save and Next'. **Step 4:** Enter your Mobile Number and E-mail address, click 'Send OTP', enter the received OTP, create and confirm a Password, solve the Captcha, and click 'Submit'.
> **Login Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side of the homepage. On the home page, click on ‘Schemes’ and then click on ‘Agricultural Schemes’. **Step 3:** Now select the scheme, click on the ‘Apply’ button, and an application page will open. **Step 4:** Click on the "Apply New" button and submit a new application. **Step 5:** Click on the "Update Application" button to add corrections to the application. **Step 6:** Once the application is done, confirm it. **Step 7:** Take a printout of the confirmed application.
> **Contact Us:** [**Click here**](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_Contacts.aspx)**.**

# Scholarships and Stipends **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Sports Stipend, Scholarship, Medal Winners, Athletes | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Scholarships and Stipends" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to promote excellence in sports by offering financial support to individuals who have represented the state at national-level events and have won medals. This initiative is designed to reduce the financial burden on athletes and to recognize their achievements at the national level, thereby motivating them to continue their athletic pursuits and strive for excellence. metadata.schemeName: Artist Honor (Gaurav Award)

page_content:
# Artist Honor (Gaurav Award) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Cash Prize, Artist, Fine Arts, Honor Of Artist, Award | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Artist Honor (Gaurav Award)” scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Lalit Kala Academy under the Sports, Youth and Culture Activities Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to recognize and honor artists who have made a lifetime contribution in the field of fine arts, specifically in painting, sculpture, and graphic arts, and have achieved outstanding accomplishments. Every year, a total of nine (9) artists are honored under this scheme, three in painting, three in sculpture, and three in graphic arts with the Gaurav Award. This award has been conferred annually since 1964-65.
## Benefits **Award Details:** - Cash prize of ₹51,000/- per artist. - Copper plate, citation, and shawl presented during the award ceremony. - Exhibition of artworks held for 5–7 days at Ravishankar Raval Kala Bhavan, Ahmedabad. - Catalogue publication of Gaurav Award-winning artists and their art. **Number of Awards:** - Total of 9 artists are honored every year. - 3 in painting, 3 in sculpture, and 3 in graphic arts.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The artist must be a resident of the State of Gujarat. 1. The artist must be associated with the field of fine arts, specifically in Painting, Sculpture or Graphic Arts. 1. The artist must have made a lifetime contribution in their respective field. 1. The artist should have achieved outstanding accomplishments or the highest level of recognition in their art form. 1. The applicant must be active in the art community and have a recognized body of work.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline > **Application Process: Applications are invited annually through public advertisements (daily newspapers).** **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the Gujarat State Lalit Kala Academy and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Gujarat State Lalit Kala Academy. > **Post-Application Process:** **Step 1:** A committee reviews and shortlists applicants based on merit. **Step 2:** The final selected artists are notified and invited to the award ceremony. **Step 3:** Awards are distributed along with the art exhibition and catalogue release.

# "Orthodox or Specialty Tea Production Subsidy" under the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme" **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Assam | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Subsidy, Tea, Production, Incentive, Industry | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched in 2020, the scheme "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme (ATISIS)" by the Finance (Institutional Finance) Department, Government of Assam, aims to ensure long-term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and to incentivize manufacturers to move from Crush, Tear, Curl tea to Orthodox tea production. The scheme is implemented by the Finance Department and the Industries & Commerce Department, Government of Assam, through multiple implementing agencies, including banks and the District Industries & Commerce Centre. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through a dedicated portal with a Direct Benefit Transfer mechanism for reimbursement.
## Benefits **Benefit Amount:** ₹10/- per kilogram for Orthodox tea, Green tea, White tea, Oolong tea, Singhpo tea, Purple Tea, Yellow tea, or other Specialty tea **Special Rate:** ₹12/- per kilogram for applications of Financial Year 2023-24 only (tea production year 2022-23). **Validity Period:** Extended from Financial Year 2023-24 to 2027-28. **Disbursement Mode:** Direct Benefit Transfer as reimbursement. **Claim Deadline:** Latest by 30th June on completion of every financial year. **Additional Benefit:** Provided in addition to any other subsidy claimed from the Tea Board of India or any other agency.
## Eligibility Criteria **General Eligibility** - The applicant must be a tea plantation across all sizes - The applicant must be a tea manufacturing unit manufacturing Crush, Tear, Curl Tea, Orthodox Tea, or Speciality tea including Green tea, Oolong Tea, White tea, Yellow tea and Purple tea - The applicant must be located entirely in Assam - The applicant must not have any part of the plantation or manufacturing facility located outside the State of Assam
**Production Subsidy Specific Eligibility** - The applicant must be manufacturing Orthodox tea, Green tea, White tea, Oolong tea, Singhpo tea, Purple Tea, Yellow tea or other Speciality tea (not manufactured through Crush, Tear, Curl process). - The applicant must have started production on or after 1st of April, 2020.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Registration Process** **Step 1:** Visit the [dedicated portal](https://atisis.assam.gov.in/atsisver/login.html) of "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives" Scheme. Click on the "New User Registration" option. **Step 2:** In the registration form, fill in basic details including name, mobile number, and email address. Create a username and password following the portal's password policy. Verify your mobile number through one-time password verification. Complete Captcha Code verification. Submit the registration form. **Step 3:** Check your registered email for the account activation link. Click on the activation link to activate the account. Log in to the portal using registered credentials. **Step 4:** Upload all supporting documents of eligibility in the prescribed format. Fill in complete unit details, including location, type of tea production, and capacity. Submit the unit registration form. Wait for registration approval.
**Application Process** **Step 1:** Log in to the portal using registered credentials. Navigate to the "Apply for Benefits" section. Select the scheme component that you intend to apply for. **Step 2:** Fill in the prescribed application form with all mandatory fields. Upload all supporting documents as mentioned in the portal. Ensure file formats and file size restrictions are followed as per the portal guidelines. Review all entered information for accuracy. **Step 3:** Upload documents in the specified format and size. Ensure all documents are clear and legible. Complete document verification checklist. **Step 4:** Review the complete application before submission. Apply online. _*Note down the application reference number. Save a copy of the submitted application form._ _*Applicants are strongly encouraged to save a copy of the submitted application, confirmation message, and application reference number for future reference and tracking purposes._
**Application Status Tracking** Log in to the portal to check application status. Track application progress through different stages of verification. Receive Short Message Service alerts throughout the process, including registration, fund release, etc. _*For Technical Support, please write to atisis.assam@gmail.com._
**Disbursement Process** The Finance Department releases the benefit directly to the beneficiary's bank account. Short Message Service alerts sent for funds disbursement. The beneficiary receives the Direct Benefit Transfer in a registered bank account.

page_content:
# Gujarat Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Standard 1st to 10th **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Education, Student, Scheduled Tribe | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Gujarat Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Standard 1st to 10th" by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance for educational development to Scheduled Tribe students studying in Classes 1st to 10th. Through this scheme, scholarships are annually provided to boys, girls, and extremely backward students from Classes 1st to 10th.
## Benefits The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of scholarships. The amounts are as follows: > **For Boys** - Class 1 to Class 8: Annual scholarship of ₹750/-. - Class 9 to Class 10: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000/-. > **For Girls** - Class 1 to Class 5: Annual scholarship of ₹750/-. - Class 6 to Class 10: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000/-. > **For Extremely Backwards Students** - Class 1 to Class 8: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000/-. - Class 9 to Class 10: Annual scholarship of ₹1,500/-.
> **Mode of Disbursement:****** The benefits to the beneficiaries will be disbursed through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method. > **Frequency of Disbursement:****** The scholarship is provided annually.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should belong to Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a Scheduled Tribe student. 1. The applicant must be studying in Class 1st to 10th.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 01:** The applicant may visit the [official website](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/) of the Digital Gujarat Portal. **Step 02:** On the home page, click on ‘Register’ and the applicant will be redirected to the registration form page. **Step 03:** Enter your Mobile Number, Email, Set Password and then click on ‘Save’. **Step 04:** After successful registration, the applicant can log in through his/her User Name (Mobile No./Email ID) and Password. > **Login Process:** **Step 01:** The applicant may visit the [official website](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/) of the Digital Gujarat Portal. **Step 02:** On the home page, click on ‘Login’ and the applicant will be redirected to the Login page using your credentials. **Step 03:** Now, click on ‘Services’ and select "Scholarship Services" from the drop-down. **Step 04:** Now, under services, select ‘Scholarship Services’ and then click on ‘Scheduled Tribe’. **Step 05:** Select the Financial Year for which you want to apply and then click on ‘Change Financial Year’. **Step 09:** Select the scheme, read the interaction carefully, and then click on ‘Continue to Service’. **Step 10:** Fill in the application form completely and upload all the relevant documents. **Step 11:** Now, click on ‘Save as Draft’ and agree with the terms & conditions, and submit the application form by clicking on ‘Confirm & Final Submit’. > **Instructions:** **Note 01:** Photo uploading for all applicants is mandatory. **Note 02:** Application will be considered complete only when all sections are completed. **Note 03:** In case of Any wrong/misleading information provided in the application shall lead to rejection of the application by the Department Authorities. **Note 04:** All required documents must be carefully scanned as per the instructions given. **Note 05:** Student has to fill his/her application carefully as there is no provision for institution change once the application is submitted successfully. **Note 06:** The unreadable uploaded documents will allow the competent authority to reject the student's application. **Note 07:** Direct Individual submission of this application form will not be accepted in case of students studying inside the state.

page_content:
# Free Medical Assistance (Gujarat) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Expensive Medical Treatment, Tuberculosis, Cancer, Leprosy, HIV, Sickle Cell Anaemia, Thalassemia | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Free Medical Assistance" by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance for expensive medical treatments to people of Scheduled Tribes. Through this scheme, monetary aid is provided to Scheduled Tribe individuals suffering from diseases like tuberculosis, cancer, leprosy, HIV/AIDS, sickle cell anaemia, and thalassemia, as well as for serious maternity cases and anaemia in women.
## Benefits Financial assistance is provided to Scheduled Tribe individuals for medical treatment. The revised rates, effective from April 1, 2024, are as follows:
**S. No.****Name Of Disease****Current rate of assistance****Proposed Rate of Assistance****A Type:**1In Serve Cases Of Labour₹500/- per case₹2,000/- per case2For Female Genital Mutilation₹150/- per case₹2,000/- per case3Decay₹500/- every month until the pain is gone₹2,000/- every month until the pain subsides4Leprosy₹800/- per month until the pain is gone₹2,000/- every month until the pain subsides**B Type:**1CancerUntil then, ₹1,000/- per month will cure the pain.₹2,500/- every month until the pain subsides2For AIDS₹1,000/- every month until the pain subsides₹2,500/- every month until the pain subsides3Sickle cell anaemia₹500/- every month until the pain is gone₹2,500/- every month until the pain subsides4Thalassemia₹500/- per patient every month until the pain is relieved.₹2,500/- per patient every month until the pain is relieved.> **Mode of Disbursement:** The financial assistance will be disbursed through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). For HIV/AIDS patients, the payment will be made by cheque. > **Frequency of Disbursement:** Monthly until the patient recovers from tuberculosis, cancer, leprosy, AIDS, sickle cell anaemia, and thalassemia. Per case for serious maternity cases and anaemia in women. > **Validity:** The assistance is provided until the patient recovers from specified diseases.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should belong to Gujarat. - The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Tribe. - The applicant's family income must be less than or equal to ₹6,00,000/-. - For HIV/AIDS patients, the annual income limit is ₹27,000/- for rural areas and ₹35,000/- for urban areas.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the Office of the [Chief District Health Officer](https://nhm.gujarat.gov.in/Images/pdf/1_CDHO.pdf), and request the hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the [Chief District Health Officer.](https://nhm.gujarat.gov.in/Images/pdf/1_CDHO.pdf)

metadata.schemeName: Education Loan Scheme for Backward Classes Haryana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide education loans to members of the Backwards Classes for pursuing professional and technical education. Through this scheme, financial assistance in the form of education loans is provided to eligible Backwards Class students.

page_content:
# Education Loan Scheme for Backward Classes Haryana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Pursing, Professional Degree, Technical Degree, Graduation | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Education Loan Scheme for Backward Classes" by the Haryana Backwards Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam, Government of Haryana, aims to provide education loans to members of Backward Classes for pursuing professional and technical education at the graduate and higher levels. Through this scheme, education loans are provided to eligible Backward Classes students to help them pursue professional and technical courses. The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam.
## Benefits 1. Education loan for pursuing professional and technical education at the graduate and higher levels. 1. The maximum loan amount provided is ₹15,00,000/- for studies in India. 1. The maximum loan amount provided is ₹20,00,000/- for studies abroad. 1. The interest rate is 4% per annum. 1. For girl students, the interest rate is 3.5% per annum.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be between 18 to 55 years of age. 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The annual family income of the applicant should not exceed ₹3,00,000/- in both rural and urban areas. 1. The applicant should belong to Backward Classes. 1. The applicant should have obtained admission for any professional and technical courses approved by an appropriate agency, such as AICTE, Medical Council of India, UGC, etc., in a duly accredited/recognised institute. 1. The applicant should have a minimum of 50% marks in the qualifying exam, i.e., the exam whose qualification is a prerequisite for the course. 1. The applicant should have a Pariwar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID).
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ##### ***Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal*** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details,i.e., Name, Email ID, Mobile Number & password. Click on ‘Submit’. **Step 3:****** Verify the OTP received in the provided Email and Mobile Number. Alternatively, click on the Verification Link to activate the profile. ##### ***Apply for the Scheme*** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:****** The “Sign in here” option is available on the right side of the screen. Fill in the required credentials and click on the ‘Login’ button. **Step 3:** In the opened window, click on “Scheme/Services list”, and a list of schemes will appear on the screen. **Step 4:** Now, select the scheme and click on “Apply for Service/Scheme”. **Step 5:** Fill in all the details in the online application form and click on "Submit". ##### ***Track Your Service Online*** - **Track Application/Appeal:** [Click here](https://status.saralharyana.nic.in/). - **Track Ticket:** [Click here](https://eticketing.saralharyana.nic.in/CitizenViewComplaints.aspx). ##### ***Track Your Service Through SMS*** - **Registered Mobile Number:** Type 'SARAL' and send it to 9954699899 to track your application. - **Other Mobile Number:** Type SARAL<space><Application ID/Ticket No.> and send to 9954699899 to track your application/ticket. ##### ***Contact Us*** - **Helpline:** 0172-3968400 - **Email:** saral.haryana@gov.in ##### ***NOTE:*** > **Govt. Charges:** No Fee. > **Service Charges:** ₹10/-. > **Atal Seva Kendra Service Charges:** ₹10/-.
**Mode:** Online - via CSC The eligible applicant may visit the nearest Atal Seva Kendra with all the required documents to apply for the scheme.
