metadata.schemeName: New Swarnim Yojana (for women only) GNTDNT
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to achieve economic upliftment by providing self-employment with dignity. Through this scheme, loans for self-employment at an annual interest rate are provided to women beneficiaries of nomadic and denotified castes living below the poverty line.

page_content:
# New Swarnim Yojana (for women only) GNTDNT **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Women and Child | **Tags:** Self Employment, Business, Loan, Nomadic And Denotified Castes | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "New Swarnim Yojana (For Women Only)" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to empower women of nomadic and denotified castes living below the poverty line to achieve economic upliftment by getting self-employment with dignity. Under this scheme, women beneficiaries will be able to do business/occupation of their choice. The Gujarat Nomadic and Denotified Tribes Development Corporation implement the scheme.
## Benefits 1. The maximum loan limit is up to ₹2,00,000/-. 1. The interest rate will be 5% per annum. 1. Under this scheme, 100% loan of the business/occupation amount is provided. 1. The loan amount will consist of 95% National Corporation contribution, 5% State Government contribution and zero beneficiary contribution.
> **Repayment:** The loan amount, including interest, will have to be repaid in 60 equal monthly instalments.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a woman from a nomadic or denotified caste. 1. The applicant's family annual income limit for income eligibility will be up to ₹3,00,000/- (with effect from 1/4/2018). 1. The applicant's age should be at least 21 years and not more than 50 years as on the date of application. 1. The applicant must have experience in a technical and skilled trade/business.
> **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:** > At least 50% of the total loan amount will be allocated for families having an annual income of up to ₹1,50,000/-.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Step 1: Visit the Official Portal** - Go to the [Official Website](https://gndcdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) Gujarat Nomadic and Denotified Tribes Development Corporation. - Scroll down on the homepage, find the "New Swarnim Yojana" and click on "Apply Now". - You will be directed to the [application form](https://gndcdconline.gujarat.gov.in/SchemeEducation/AddEdit). > **Step 2: Access and Fill Out the Application Form** - Complete all sections under "Applicant information," including full name, father/husband's name, gender, complete address details, contact numbers, Aadhaar No., parents/husband/guardian occupation and income details. Also provide Date of Birth, Age, Caste, and Subspecies. Also, if you are disabled and provide a percentage. - For each applicable qualification (SSC, HSC, Diploma, Degree, Graduation), tick the checkbox and fill in the Degree, Board/University Name, Academic year, and Percentage obtained. - Fill in details about the college/institution admitted to, university affiliation, course name, enrollment number, organisation address, website, course duration (in years and semester), and date of admission. - Specify who accredited the course/institution, their name, and address. Proof of accreditation must be submitted. - Select "Yes" or "No" for "Have you obtained admission through government-mandated admission?". - If staying in a hostel, provide the Hostel name, Hostel address, and Hostel contact number. - Fill in the requested loan amounts for Admission Fee, Tuition Fee, Examination Fee, Hostel Fee, Estimated cost of books/stationery, and Other fees. - List details of any physical assets owned (land, house, government property, NCC, LIC, KVP, etc.). - Indicate if anyone in the family works in a government/private sector job. If "Yes," provide Name, Designation, Place, and Salary details. - Fill in the Bank Account Number, select the Bank Name from the dropdown, provide the Branch Name, Name as per Account, select Bank Account Type (Saving/Current), and enter the MICR Code and IFSC Code. > **Step 3: Review and Final Submission** - Carefully review each module. Use the preview option to examine the application before final submission. Fill out the provided "CAPTCHA" and Click on “Submit”. > **Track and Review Status** - Applicant will receive an Application ID/Reference Number. Save or print the acknowledgement for future tracking. - Go to the [Official Website](https://gndcdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) Gujarat Nomadic and Denotified Tribes Development Corporation. - Scroll down and locate the Know App Status. Click on "Know App Status". - Select the Scheme name, Enter App No., and Birth Date. Fill out the Captcha and click on Submit.

metadata.schemeName: Shilpi Gram Scheme (Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to re-establish traditional artisan skills among SC/ST communities. It provides free training, infrastructure support, and marketing opportunities to artisans in selected artisan villages.

page_content:
# Shilpi Gram Scheme (Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Skill Training, Artisans, Crafts | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Shilpi Gram Scheme (Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe)" scheme was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to preserve, promote, and develop traditional artisan crafts among Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes in Uttarakhand. Under this scheme, free skill development training, infrastructure development, raw material support, and marketing facilities are provided to SC/ST artisans in identified artisan villages. > **Objectives:** - To identify and revive traditional crafts as sustainable livelihood options. - To categorize artisans into skilled, semi-skilled, and unskilled and provide training accordingly. - To create awareness, provide orientation training, and develop artisan skills. - To promote new technologies and designs and set up raw material depots. - To provide marketing support through exhibitions, fairs, and permanent haats. - To collect baseline data for planning financial assistance, marketing, and welfare.

## Benefits **Free Skill Training:** - Training is offered at three levels — awareness & orientation, basic training, and vocational training. **Infrastructure Support:** - Development of artisan villages with electricity, water, roads, and common facilities. **Marketing Assistance:** - Support for exhibitions, fairs, permanent haats, and promotion of Uttarakhand-branded craft products. **Raw Material Support:** - Establishment of raw material depots like Wool Bank, Wood Bank. **Recognition & Awards:** - Awards for outstanding artisans and participation in national/international fairs. **Exposure Visits:** - Exposure tours to other states with advanced handicrafts. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicant's annual income should not exceed ₹1,05,600 in rural areas and ₹1,29,840 in urban areas.

## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ***Application Process:*** **Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the [application form](http://www.ukbvvn.org.in/Download/ApplicationFormFormatJeevika.pdf) from the official website. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the office of the Development Block Office. ***Selection Process:*** **Step 1:** A selection committee chaired by the Chief Development Officer (CDO) selects institutions and trainees.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme “Khel Pratibha Puraskar” by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat aims to recognize and encourage sportspersons by providing cash prizes ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹5,00,00,000 to national and international medal winners across the state.

page_content:
# Khel Pratibha Puraskar **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Sports Awards, Cash Prize, Athlete | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Khel Pratibha Puraskar” by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat aims to financially support and honour sportspersons from Gujarat who have earned medals at national and international levels by awarding them cash prizes between ₹10,000/- and ₹5,00,00,000/- depending on the level and nature of their sporting achievement. The scheme intends to inspire athletic excellence and acknowledge the hard work and dedication of Gujarat’s athletes on prestigious platforms.
## Benefits - **Cash Prize:** An amount ranging from ₹10,000/- to ₹5,00,00,000/-.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a sportsperson. - The applicant should have won a medal at a national or international level. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat or should be representing Gujarat officially in the sporting event.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the homepage of the [Sports Authority of Gujarat](https://sportsauthority.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on the “Registration” button on the upper-right side of the page. **Step 3:** Fill in all the required details as per the form and submit it. **Application Process:** **Step 1:** After registration, check your registered email for login credentials. **Step 2:** Select “Player” as the user type and log in using the credentials received. **Step 3:** Click on the concerned scheme name and proceed with the application.

page_content:
# Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Three Wheeler with Ice Box Including E-rickshaws for Fish Vending - Haryana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Subsidy, Fish, Fishries, Three Wheeler, Ice Box | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Three Wheeler with Ice Box Including E-rickshaws for Fish Vending” is a scheme component under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY), implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. This is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme that aims to strengthen fish transportation infrastructure by promoting hygienic and efficient fish transportation and retailing through mobile outlets. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible beneficiaries for purchasing e-rickshaws equipped with ice boxes for direct fish selling.
## Benefits **Tangible Benefits:** - Project Cost: ₹3,00,000/- per unit (for purchasing a three-wheeler e-rickshaw equipped with an ice-box for selling fish.) - Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category of beneficiaries. - Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra. 1. The applicant should ensure that the fish transport facility (e-rickshaw) is maintained in working condition. 1. The applicant is eligible to purchase only one new three-wheeler e-rickshaw with an ice box for fisheries activities under this scheme. 1. The applicant should agree that neither the Central Government nor the State Government shall be held responsible for any financial or operational losses incurred in the procurement, operation, maintenance, or management of the fish transport facilities.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number & password. Fill in the required credentials and click on the ‘Login’ button. **Step 3:** In the opened window, click on “Scheme/Services list” and a list of schemes will appear on the screen. **Step 4:** Now, select the scheme and click on “Apply for Service/Scheme”. **Step 5:** Fill in all the details in the online application form and click on "Submit". > **Track Your Service Online:** - **Track Application/Appeal:** [Click here](https://status.saralharyana.nic.in/). - **Track Ticket:** [Click here](https://eticketing.saralharyana.nic.in/CitizenViewComplaints.aspx). > **Track Your Service Through SMS:** - **Registered Mobile Number:** Type SARAL and send to 9954699899 to track your application. - **Other Mobile Number:** Type SARAL<space><Application ID/Ticket No.> and send to 9954699899 to track your application/ticket. > **Contact Us:** **Helpline:** 0172-3968400 **Email:** saral.haryana@gov.in > **Fees For Service:** - Government Charges: ₹0 (No Fee) - Service Charges: ₹10 - Atal Seva Kendra Charges: ₹10
**Mode:** Online - via CSC The eligible applicant may visit the nearest Atal Seva Kendra with all the required documents to apply for the scheme.

metadata.schemeName: Late Jaswantsinhji Thakor and Late Rasiklal Andhariya Classical Music Scholarship
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "Late Jaswantsinhji Thakor and Late Rasiklal Andhariya Classical Music Scholarship" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department aims to promote classical music education by providing annual scholarships to eligible Gurus and their disciples across Gujarat.

page_content:
# Late Jaswantsinhji Thakor and Late Rasiklal Andhariya Classical Music Scholarship **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Classical Music, Music Scholarship, Music | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Late Jaswantsinhji Thakor and Late Rasiklal Andhariya Classical Music Scholarship" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to preserve and promote classical music in Gujarat by offering financial support to eligible Gurus for imparting training and to their disciples for receiving it. The scheme facilitates a 10-month classical music training period where selected Gurus can train up to 2 disciples, and both Gurus and disciples receive monetary assistance. The scheme is implemented by Gujarat Rajya Sangeet Natak Akademi, Gandhinagar, which releases a public advertisement annually inviting applications.

## Benefits > **For Gurus:** - Financial assistance of ₹1,000/- per month for a duration of 10 months (i.e., ₹10,000/- per disciple) for training up to 2 disciples. > **For Disciples:** - A scholarship of ₹10,000/- per annum, calculated at ₹1,000/- per month for 10 months, for receiving classical music training from the selected Guru.
## Eligibility Criteria > **For Gurus:** - The applicant should be a classical music artist. - The applicant should have completed formal education in classical music or must possess at least 7 years of experience in teaching classical music. - The applicant should be capable of training a maximum of 2 disciples during the 10-month training period. > **For Disciples:** - The applicant should be a student of classical music residing in Gujarat. - The applicant should be undergoing training under an eligible Guru selected under this scheme. - The applicant should submit a certificate of training provided by the Guru.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Applications are invited once every year through a public advertisement by Gujarat Rajya Sangeet Natak Akademi. **Step 2:** Applicants must submit the prescribed application form along with required documents to the designated address. **Step 3:** The selection committee evaluates the applications and selects eligible Gurus and disciples. **Step 4:** Both Guru and disciple must submit a report of training conducted and received over 10 months. **Step 5:** Upon successful verification, scholarship amounts are disbursed directly to the beneficiary accounts.

metadata.schemeName: Mahila Samruddhi Yojana (GSKVN)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to female Safai Kamdars and their dependents to start small businesses. Through this scheme, loans for various self-employment ventures are provided to eligible female individuals.

page_content:
# Mahila Samruddhi Yojana (GSKVN) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Women and Child | **Tags:** Small Business, Loan, Interest, Shops | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Mahila Samruddhi Yojana (GSKVN)" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat Government, aims to provide financial assistance to female Safai Kamdars and their dependents to start small businesses. Through this scheme, loans for various self-employment ventures are provided to eligible female individuals. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Safai Kamdar Vikas Nigam (GSKVN).
## Benefits 1. An individual loan of ₹1,00,000/- is provided. 1. The interest rate on the loan is 4%. 1. The loan is intended for various businesses/occupations such as Mandap Decoration, Computer, Electrical Shop, Animal Husbandry, Grocery Shop, Bamboo Work, Sewing Work, Embroidery, Beauty Parlour, Mobile Repairing, etc.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a native resident of Gujarat State. 1. The applicant must be a sanitation worker or a dependent woman. 1. The applicant must be female. 1. The applicant's age should not be less than 18 years and not more than 50 years on the date of the advertisement.
## Exclusions

## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Go to the [eSamajKalyan portal](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/index.aspx?HodID=Mgt3fh4h1dSAcTIdCEHhzQ==) and navigate to the "Gujarat Safai Kamdar Development Corporation" section under the Corporation menu. **Step 2:** Click on "Mahila Samruddhi Yojana" and then Apply Now. **Step 3:** Click on "New User? Please Register Here". **Step 4:** Enter the required details and click Register.
> **Application Process:** **Step 1:** Enter your User ID, Password, and Captcha Code, then click "Login". **Step 2:** Read the scheme details carefully and click OK. **Step 3:** If your permanent address is correct, confirm it. Otherwise, enter your correct address. **Step 4:** Click Save & Next to proceed. Upload the relevant documents. **Step 5:** If you need to make changes, click "No, Cancel". If all details are correct, click "Yes, Submit". **Step 6:** Click Save Application. Note down your Application Number for future reference. You can also take a printout by clicking Print Application.
> **Check Application Status:** [Click here](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/ViewApplicationStatus.aspx).

metadata.schemeName: Transportation Scheme (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide loans for the purchase of auto rickshaws and loading vehicles. Through this scheme, financial assistance for vehicle purchase is provided to the Rabari and Bharwad castes from the socially and educationally backwards classes.

page_content:
# Transportation Scheme (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Auto, Rickshaw, Loading Vehicle, Rabari Caste, Bharwad Caste | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Transportation Scheme" by the Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide loans for the purchase of auto rickshaws and loading vehicles. Through this scheme, financial assistance for vehicle purchase is offered to the Rabari and Bharwad castes from the socially and educationally backwards classes. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam.
## Benefits Loans are provided on an individual basis to purchase auto rickshaws and loading vehicles. - Maximum Loan Limit: ₹2,00,000/- - Interest Rate: 6% per annum - Loan Amount: 95% of the vehicle cost - Beneficiary Contribution: 5% of the vehicle cost
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should belong to the Rabari and Bharwad castes from the socially and educationally backwards classes. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 and 45 years. 1. The applicant's annual income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1: Register on the Official Portal** - Go to the [Official Website](https://ggdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) Gujarat Gopalak Development Corporation.- Scroll down on the homepage, find the "Transportation Scheme," and click on "Apply Now". - You will be directed to the [application form](https://ggdconline.gujarat.gov.in/SchemeTransport/AddEdit). **Step 2: Access and Fill Out the Application Form** - Select "Transport", enter Unit Cost, and specify the Required Loan Amount. - Provide Aadhaar, Ration, Voter ID, full name (Last, First, Father/Husband), address, district, taluka, village, PIN, date of birth, age (21-45 as of 14/08/2023), caste, subcaste, phone, mobile, email, gender, and marital status. - Enter income certificate number, issue date, issuing officer's name, total annual family income (up to ₹ 3,00,000/-), and parent/guardian's occupation. - If "Physically Handicapped," select "Yes" or "No". If you selected "Yes", provide the percentage (in %). - Indicate if any family member works in a government or private job. If "Yes," provide their Name, Designation, Place, and Salary details. - Select your Education Qualification: Uneducated, Educated, Graduation, Post Graduation, or Other Degree. - If you have taken a past loan, select "Yes" or "No". If you selected "Yes", provide loan details (date, amount, paid, remaining) and your account number. - Enter driving license number and expiry date. For passenger vehicles, select "Yes" or "No". If you selected "Yes", provide the base number. For transport vehicles, select "Yes" or "No". If you selected "Yes", provide the transport license number. - Provide the dealer's name, address, vehicle name, and vehicle price. - Provide bank account number, bank name, branch name, name as per account, account type (Saving/Current), MICR code, and IFSC code. **Step 3: Review and Final Submission** - Carefully review each module. Use the preview option to examine the application before final submission. Fill out the provided "CAPTCHA" and Click on “Submit”.
**Track and Review Status** - Applicant will receive an Application ID/Reference Number. Save or print the acknowledgement for future tracking. - Go to the [Official Website](https://ggdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) Gujarat Gopalak Development Corporation.- Scroll down and locate the Know App Status. Click on "Know App Status". - Select the Scheme name, Enter App No., and Birth Date. Fill out the Captcha and click on Submit.

metadata.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana - Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh
metadata.briefDescription: This initiative provides academic fees and maintenance allowances to support students from Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh pursuing higher education outside the Union Territories

page_content:
# Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana - Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh **Ministry:** Ministry of Education | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Education, Financial Assistance, Scholarship | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description > **Background** An Expert Group was constituted by the Prime Minister on 18th August, 2010 in the context of enhancing employment opportunities among youths of Union Territories of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh to formulate job plan involving public and private sectors. Among the key recommendations of the Expert Group, one was to offer 5000 fresh scholarships per annum to encourage the youth of J&K and Ladakh to pursue higher studies outside the UTs. The proposal arises out of the identified strategy of a human resource development initiative focused on improving skill set through improving access to education
> **Objective** To provide academic fee (tuition and other admissible fee) and maintenance allowance (to bear expenses on account of hostel & mess fee, cost of books and other incidental charges) to students belonging to J&K and Ladakh who, after passing Class XII or equivalent examination, secure admission in Government colleges/institutions and other select institutions outside the UTs of J&K and Ladakh through AICTE’s counselling process under the supernumerary quota created by the Government except in medical courses. Scheme was launched in the year 2011 and modified from time to time to make the scheme student friendly. The scheme also envisages to build capacities of the youth of J&K and Ladakh to enable them to compete with their peers in the national mainstream and exposure to other states and union territories’ culture, language, and livelihood and promote the understanding of ‘Ek Bharat Shrestha Bharat.’.
> **SCOPE** Under the scheme 5000 fresh scholarships are available per annum. Out of these, 2070 scholarships are for General Degree Courses, 2830 for Professional/Engineering courses and 100 for Medical Courses. The number of scholarships for Engineering and Medical Studies would be kept flexible, subject to the ceiling of 5000 fresh scholarships per annum and subject to the savings accruing from any shortfall in the number of students opting for General Degree courses
## Benefits **Rate of Scholarships, Academic Fee & Maintenance Allowance:** > **Stream: General Degree** - Number of Scholarships: 2070 (fixed) - Academic Fee (Upper limit): ₹30,000/- - Maintenance Charges (Fixed): ₹1,00,000/-*
> **Stream: Professional/Engineering/B.Sc.Nursing / B. Pharmacy/ B. Architecture (subject to NATA)/HMCT Degree** - Number of Scholarships: 2830 (flexible) - Academic Fee (Upper limit): ₹1,25,000/- - Maintenance Charges (Fixed): ₹1,00,000/-*
> **Stream: Medical/BDS or equivalent Medical Stream (subject to NEET, wherever applicable)** - Number of Scholarships: 100 (flexible) - Academic Fee (Upper limit): ₹3,00,000/- - Maintenance Charges (Fixed): ₹1,00,000/-* > *Not exceeding ₹1,00,000 per annum (in ten equal installments to meet hostel, mess, books, stationery & other incidentals). Fresh students admitted in the academic session 2024-25 onwards maintenance allowance will be paid through NSP portal. > The number of scholarships for engineering and medical studies would be kept flexible, subject to the ceiling of 5000 fresh scholarships per annum and subject to the savings accruing from any shortfall in the number of students opting for general degree courses
> **Disbursement of Scholarship:** - The scholarship towards academic fees will be paid directly to the Institution as per claim or as per rate fixed by the respective State Fee Regulatory Authority or as fixed by any Regulatory Authority appointed by the Government, whichever is less and within the overall ceiling fixed for the course. - All the Institutions may note that the upper ceiling of the Academic Fee inclusive of all admissible components taken together is ₹1,25,000/- for the Professional / Engineering Stream; ₹30,000/- for General Stream and ₹3,00,000 for Medical Stream. - Even if the total fee of the institute is more than the ceiling, neither AICTE shall reimburse the extra amount nor the institute can charge the same from the students. - The fixed maintenance allowance of ₹1,00,000 per annum for all streams will be paid to the bank account of the student through NSP portal using the PFMS gateway in 10 monthly installments of ₹10,000/- each. > **Duration of Scholarships:** - The scholarships granted under the scheme are renewed in subsequent classes subject to good conduct and maintenance of attendance as prescribed by the respective institution. - Students failing to get promoted to the next class/level would get the scholarship in the following year subject to the condition that if the student fails again for the second time, then he/she would forfeit the scholarship, and the scholarship would not be renewed for the subsequent years. - If a scholar is unable to appear in the annual examination owing to illness and/or on account of any unforeseen incident, the scholarship may be renewed for the next academic year on submission of a medical certificate and other proof to satisfy the Head of the Institution who will also certify the same. The scholarship will not be paid twice for the same year of study.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. Candidates should be domicile of Union Territories of J&K and Ladakh. 1. Candidates must have passed 12th examination from JKBOSE or CBSE affiliated schools located in UTs of J&K and Ladakh. 1. The family income of the Candidate should be less than or equal to ₹8,00,000 per annum. 1. The candidate who wants to take admitted under the Lateral Entry Scheme have to pass a Diploma in Engineering from the Polytechnic Institutes recognized by the Directorate of Technical Education(DTE), UTs of J&K and Ladakh. 1. Candidates are compulsorily required to apply online on the AICTE web-portal and verify their documents through nearest Facilitation Centers of UTs of J&K and Ladakh within time frame. 1. Admission under the Lateral Entry Scheme will be subject to allocation of seats / vacant seats of the preceding year in the Engineering Stream and in the relevant stream only. 1. Merit list will be prepared for HSC and Lateral Entry students and the same shall be displayed on the student’s portal only for conduction of online counselling for final allotment of seats in colleges to eligible candidate’s subject to choice filling/availability of scholarships.
## Exclusions > **Categories of Candidates NOT eligible under the SSSJ&KL:** 1. Candidates pursing courses through Open Universities. 1. Student availing benefit of any other scholarship Scheme from any Central/State/UT Government Schemes or any scheme run by any autonomous body under them. 1. Candidates gaining admission through ‘Management Quota’. 1. Candidates pursuing Diploma course. 1. Candidates pursuing Post-Graduate level studies, in any discipline. 1. Candidates having family income over Rs. 8.00 Lakh per annum. 1. Not applied through online registration in the AICTE Portal. 1. Taking admission in the Colleges other than the prescribed colleges given in AICTE Portal. 1. Admission through Agents /NGOs.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Sequence of Events for HSC and Diploma (Lateral Entry) Students** Step: 1 - Notification in Newspaper & on AICTE website. Step: 2 - Registration on[ NSP portal for OTR registration](https://scholarships.gov.in/otrapplication/#/login-page) & application submission by the candidate in [SSSJKL portal.](https://www.aicte-jk-scholarship-gov.in/) Step: 3 - Verification of documents at the Facilitation cum Documents Verification Centre. Step: 4 - Choice of filling from candidate’s login on SSSJKL portal. Step: 5 - Announcement of Merit List on SSSJKL portal. Step: 6 - Online Counselling by AICTE (Multiple Rounds). Step: 7 - Grievance redressal through AICTE [Centralized Support System.](https://css.aicte.gov.in/login) Step: 8 - Reporting to the allotted Institution Physically and upload the auto – generated) joining report. Step: 9 - Registration on NSP portal using SSSJKL candidate id for [NSP Application id](https://scholarships.gov.in/ApplicationForm/login). Step: 10 - Verification of NSP Application Form by institute and AICTE on NSP portal. Step: 11 - Disbursal of Scholarship to Verified Candidates by NSP.
> **Sequence of Events for Own My own and all Medical Students** Step: 1 - Notification on AICTE website. Step: 2 -Registration on [NSP portal](https://scholarships.gov.in/otrapplication/#/login-page) for OTR registration & application submission by the candidate in [SSSJKL portal.](https://www.aicte-jk-scholarship-gov.in/) Step: 3 - Verification of documents at the Facilitation cum Documents Verification Centre. Step: 4 - Announcement of Merit List on SSSJKL portal. Step: 5 - Grievance redressal through AICTE [Centralized Support System.](https://css.aicte.gov.in/login) Step: 6 - Participation in competitive exam counseling (NEET, JEE, CUET, etc.). Step: 7 - If seat allotted, report to the allotted Institution Physically and complete the joining formalities. Step: 8 - Upload documents (counseling allotment letter, fees receipt, institute ID card) in SSSJKL portal's entrance exam tab. Step: 9 - Institute uploads auto-generated joining report on SSSJKL portal after candidate's application approval. Step: 10 - Registration on NSP portal using SSSJKL candidate id for [NSP Application id](https://scholarships.gov.in/ApplicationForm/login). Step: 11 - Verification of NSP Application Form by institute and AICTE on NSP portal. Step: 12 - Disbursal of Scholarship to Verified Candidates by NSP.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to create self-employment for women from the backward classes. Through this scheme, low-interest rate loans are provided to female beneficiaries.

page_content:
# Mahila Samruddhi (Gujarat Backward Caste Development Corporation) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Loan, Woman, Small Scale Credit, Self Empowerment, Backward Classes | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Mahila Samruddhi" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide a small-scale credit scheme for creating self-employment for women from backward classes. Through this scheme, low-interest rate loans are provided to female beneficiaries, enabling them to undertake a business of their choice. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Backward Class Development Corporation. The primary objective is to empower women from socially and educationally backward classes by facilitating self-employment opportunities.
## Benefits 1. The maximum loan limit under this scheme is up to ₹1,25,000/-. 1. The interest rate on these schemes will be 4% per annum. 1. In these schemes, 95% of the unit cost will be provided as a loan, where 95% will be contributed by the National Corporation and 5% by the State Government. 1. This loan is to be repaid in 48 equal monthly installments, including interest.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be female. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to a socially and educationally backward class, specifically Other Backward Classes (OBC). 1. The total annual income of the applicant's family should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 and 45 years on the date of application. 1. The applicant must have experience in a business requiring technical and other skills.

metadata.schemeName: Personal Accident Assistance Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support and compensation to farmers, agricultural laborers, and Mandi laborers in Uttarakhand who suffer injury or death due to accidents while engaged in agricultural work or operating agricultural equipment.

page_content:
# Personal Accident Assistance Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Agricultural Laborer, Farmer, Mandi Worker, Accident | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Personal Accident Assistance Scheme” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Agricultural Production & Marketing Board under the Department of Agriculture, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support and compensation to farmers, agricultural laborers, and Mandi laborers in Uttarakhand who suffer injury or death due to accidents while engaged in agricultural work or operating agricultural equipment.
## Benefits Under the Mandi Act of Uttarakhand, farmers, agricultural labourers, and Mandi labourers working in Mandi areas regulated by the state, who are engaged in agricultural activities or the operation of agricultural equipment such as power equipment, digging or deepening wells and ponds for irrigation, using tractors for threshing or transporting produce, or performing other fieldwork are covered under the scheme operated by the Mandi Marketing Board through Mandi Committees. In case of physical injury or death resulting from an accident, the scheme provides them with compensation.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age to be eligible to claim compensation.
## Exclusions - Accidents not related to agricultural activities - Incidents occurring outside the jurisdiction of the Mandi Samiti. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - For the above-mentioned accident, the affected farmer/laborer must report it to the local market committee or district officer as soon as possible, and in any case, within 45 days. Upon receiving the accident report, an investigation will be conducted by the individual or a market committee employee within a maximum of 15 days. - In the event of the death of the victim, in addition to their legal representative or heir, the claim form must be signed by two close relatives as witnesses for verification. If the claim application is verified by the village head or two members of the Panchayat, all entries, signatures, thumb impressions, or severed handprints must be certified or verified by the secretary, chairman, or administrator of the concerned market committee. - In the case of accidental death, a death certificate, postmortem report, or panchnama prepared by a doctor at the primary health center or district hospital must be submitted. In special circumstances, a panchnama for cremation must also be provided. - In the case of an accident, it is mandatory to attach a medical certificate, two color photographs (postcard size) of the severed or damaged body parts, and a certificate attested by two close relatives. - The claim form must be completely filled out. The market committee must also confirm the accident and attach a comprehensive investigation report. - The claim form must be completed and signed by the applicant, including the left or right thumb impression. If the left thumb is missing, the right thumb impression may be used. If both thumbs are missing, the fingerprint of the working hand may be used. If both hands are missing, the fingerprint of the front of the missing hand must be used. This applies to both men and women. - After scrutiny by the Secretary of the Market Committee, the entire claim form, along with their recommendation, will be sent to the Chairman or Administrator for approval and sanction of payment. As mentioned at the end of the claim form, before accepting the claim, the Chairman/Administrator will have it scrutinized by Revenue Department officials. The claim will be approved within one month wherever possible; however, in special circumstances, the Chairman/Administrator may extend this period. After approval, the Chairman/Administrator will send the claim form to the Managing Director of the Uttarakhand Agricultural Produce Marketing Board for payment. The Mandi Board will then prepare a draft of the claim amount in the name of the claimant and send it to the concerned Mandi Secretary for disbursement.

# Financial Assistance for UPSC/APSC Mains Exam

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Assam | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** UPSC, Examination, Financial Assistance, Education, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
Launched for the current year, the scheme "Financial Assistance for UPSC/APSC Mains Exam" by the Directorate of Welfare of Plain Tribes & Backward Classes, Assam, aims to support ST and OBC/MOBC students appearing in the final examination of APSC/UPSC. The scheme provides financial assistance to eligible candidates who have cleared the preliminary exam. To qualify, applicants must belong to the ST or OBC/MOBC community of Assam and have passed the APSC/UPSC preliminary exam in the current year. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Welfare of Plain Tribes & Backward Classes, Assam. Applications are accepted offline via a prescribed format available on the official website.

## Benefits
Financial Assistance is provided, subject to eligibility verification and fund availability.

## Eligibility Criteria
- The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribes (ST)/Other Backward Classes (OBC)/More Other Backward Classes (MOBC) community of Assam.
- The applicant must have passed the Assam Public Service Commission (APSC) or Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) Preliminary Examination in the current year.

_*Fulfilling eligibility does not guarantee benefits, as the Selection Committee has the right to reject applications without assigning reasons._

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
**Step 1:** Visit the [Official Website](https://www.directorwptbc.assam.gov.in) of the Directorate of Welfare of Plains Tribes and Backward Classes, Assam. Download the prescribed format of the application form.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, before the deadline, to the Directorate of Welfare of Plain Tribes & Backward Classes, Assam, Rukmini Nagar, Dispur Last Gate, Satrinivash Path, Guwahati-6.
_*Applicants are advised to retain a copy of the submitted application and acknowledgment for future reference._

Eligible organizations must be registered and have prior experience in tribal culture promotion. _* The Selection Committee may reject applications without justification._ _* Organizations must ensure submitted information is accurate; false details may lead to disqualification._

# Financial Assistance to Scheduled Tribe (Plains) Students for Coaching for Getting Admission into Medical/Engineering/IIT/etc. **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Assam | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Coaching, Financial Assistance, Scheduled Tribe, Medical, Engineering, IIT | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Financial Assistance to Scheduled Tribe (Plains) Students for Coaching for Getting Admission into Medical/Engineering/IIT/etc." was launched by the Directorate of Welfare of Plain Tribes and Backward Classes, Government of Assam. The scheme aims to provide financial support to eligible ST (P) students for coaching to crack competitive entrance examinations for Medical, Engineering, and Indian Institutes of Technology (IIT). The scheme offers reimbursement for coaching expenses incurred by students and prioritizes merit-based selection. To be eligible, the applicant must belong to the ST (P) community and must be undergoing or have completed coaching (within the last one year) for the specified entrance exams. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Welfare of Plain Tribes and Backward Classes, Assam, and applications are accepted offline via submission to the Directorate’s office. ## Benefits Financial reimbursement for coaching expenses related to Medical/Engineering/IIT entrance exams. ## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (Plains) community. - The applicant must be undergoing or have completed coaching (within the last one year) for Medical/Engineering/IIT entrance examinations. - The applicant must have appeared/passed the 10+2 examination. _*Selection is based on merit (percentage secured in the Matriculation Examination)._ ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take print of the [prescribed format](https://directoratetribalaffairsplain.assam.gov.in/sites/default/files/swf_utility_folder/departments/directorate_wpt_uneecopscloud_com_oid_4/how_do_i/level_1/application_form_for_coaching.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the Director, Welfare of Plain Tribes and Backward Classes, Assam, Rukmini Nagar, Guwahati - 781 006. _*Applicants are advised to retain a copy of the submitted application and acknowledgment for future reference._
**Post-Application Processes** **Step 1:** Applications are scrutinized by a Selection Committee. **Step 2:** Beneficiaries are approved based on a merit list (Matriculation Examination percentage). **Step 3:** Selected candidates receive financial assistance as per scheme guidelines.

metadata.schemeName: Indira Amma Bhojanalya
metadata.briefDescription: The primary objective of the scheme is to provide nutritious and affordable food to the poor and needy sections of society and to economically strengthen rural women's self-help groups (SHGs) by providing continuous income-generating employment through the operation of these canteens.

page_content:
# Indira Amma Bhojanalya

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child | **Tags:** Canteen, Cheap Food, Affordable Food, Food At Subsidized Rate, SHG, Women Self-help Group | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Indira Amma Bhojanalaya" was introduced by the Rural Development Department, Government of Uttarakhand, aims to arrange and operate cheap food canteens in the state.  The primary objective of the scheme is to provide nutritious and affordable food to the poor and needy sections of society and to economically strengthen rural women's self-help groups (SHGs) by providing continuous income-generating employment through the operation of these canteens. The canteens are operated by women's self-help groups under the supervision and control of the Chief Development Officer (CDO). The canteens will be established in the headquarters of each district.

## Benefits
1. Nutritious and affordable food at subsidized rates.
2. **Subsidized Rates:** 

- The consumer pays ₹25/- per plate in hilly areas.
- The consumer pays ₹20/- per plate in Dehradun, Haridwar, Udham Singh Nagar, and Nainital districts.
- A subsidy of ₹10/- per plate is borne by the State Government.

3. The Urban Development Authority, Municipal Corporation, or Municipality provides free space, furniture, and other essential resources required for the operation of the canteen.
4. Uttarakhand Power Corporation and Uttarakhand Jal Sansthan provide electricity and water, respectively, free of cost.
5. The arrangement of fuel/LPG gas for running the canteen is made through the District Supply Officer.
6.**** Provides continuous income-generating employment, leading to economic strengthening for women's Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
> **Conditions:**


1. Maximum 1,200 plates of food are to be provided per day in high-population districts like Dehradun, Haridwar, and Udham Singh Nagar.
1. A maximum of 800 plates of food are to be provided per day in other districts.
1. Canteens opened solely for employees within office premises are not eligible for subsidy.
1. The State Government reserves the right to determine future subsidies based on the canteen's annual income or profit.
1. Canteens aiming to become self-sustainable will continue to receive facilitator support from the State Government.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a women Self-Help Group (SHG) formed according to the guiding principles of the National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM).
   1. Self-Help Groups (SHGs) formed as per NRLM guidelines that are actively functioning and have received the minimum Revolving Fund (RF) — either under the restructured SGSY scheme or directly under NRLM, if not previously covered under SGSY — shall be eligible to operate the canteen.
   1.  In urban areas, self-help groups (SHGs) under the National Urban Livelihoods Mission (NULM) are also eligible to operate Indira Amma Canteens. The Rural Development Department provides grants to support these groups in running the canteens.

***Notes:***__ 

  - It is essential for self-help groups to maintain complete records of beneficiaries, including their names and places of residence, to ensure transparency and prevent any irregularities in receiving contributions provided by the state government.
  - SHGs formed under NRLM guidelines and having received the Community Investment Fund (CIF) or a Micro Credit Plan specifically for operating an Indira Amma Canteen will be given preference.
  - The tenure of operation of State Government funded/aided canteens operating in Municipal Corporation areas shall be maximum of 01 year and thereafter they will be eligible to operate the canteen again only after a period of 02 years.
  - Except Municipal Corporation areas, the tenure of operation of canteens funded/aided by the State Government in other institutions/offices/bodies etc. will be maximum 02 years. Thereafter, they will be eligible to operate the canteen again only after a period of 04 years.

## Exclusions
1. The applicant self-help group cannot be allotted more than one Indira Amma Canteen.
1. The use of any type of intoxicant or smoking within the Indira Amma Canteen premises is strictly prohibited; violation will lead to termination of the canteen operation.
1. Canteens opened within government office premises will not receive a subsidy.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
The concerned district will publish advertisements in at least two national newspapers for the selection of Self-Help Groups (SHGs). Visit your nearest Chief Development Officer under the National Urban Livelihoods Mission (NULM).
> **Note:** 


1. For opening any Indira Amma Canteen, advertisement will be given in at least 02 national newspapers by the concerned district for the selection of self-help group.
1. In selection, priority will be given to the self-help group of the same Nyaya Panchayat that wants to establish canteen in the Nyaya Panchayat or in the adjoining municipal body.
1. If more than one self-help group is found eligible for the same canteen then in such a case, the group will be selected on a lottery basis.
1. The records of the selected self-help group, like bank account number, MIS number, copy of passbook, photocopy of proposal for opening canteen of SHG, photograph of all the members of the group, etc., will be preserved after selection of the group in the concerned district.
1. The committee constituted under the chairmanship of the District Magistrate will also ensure that every member of the group to which Indira Amma Canteen is being allotted, and that group is completely as per the NRLM standards. Under no circumstances should anyone else be given the benefit under the said scheme.
1. More than one canteen cannot be allotted to a Self-Help Group.

metadata.schemeName: ICSSR Senior Fellowship
metadata.briefDescription: The Indian Council of Social scientific Research (ICSSR), under the Ministry of Education, offers a Senior Fellowship Scheme designed to assist accomplished Indian researchers in conducting advanced social science research.

page_content:
# ICSSR Senior Fellowship

**Ministry:** Ministry of Education | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** ICSSR Fellowships, Senior Fellowship, Social Science Research, Research Promotion, Social Scientists | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The Senior Fellowship Scheme is specifically designed for senior researchers who are between the ages of 45 and 70, affiliated with a UGC-recognized university, deemed university, institute of national importance, or ICSSR-recognized research institute, have a PhD and has made significant academic contributions in their fields through books, journal articles, or research initiatives. The fellowship is for two years with progress reports to be submitted every six months. An annual contingency grant of ₹40,000 and a monthly stipend of ₹45,000 are included in the fellowship to help with research-related costs. The applications for the fellowship are invited through advertising on the ICSSR website and social media platforms. The scheme covers a wide range of disciplines under the discipline of social sciences, with 26 major areas including priority research topics. All the scholars must submit a book-length final report, and at least two published research papers at the end of two years. The fellowship program supports dedicated academics to generate noteworthy research with national priorities and international academic standards with precise guidance on grant disbursement, monitoring, reporting, and the responsibilities of both the fellow and the affiliated institution. Given India's social science ecosystem, it seeks to promote research excellence, evidence-based research, and scholarship that is also relevant to policymakers.

## Benefits
1)	Monthly Fellowship amount @ Rs.45,000 per month
2)	Contingency Grant @ Rs.40,000 per annum
3)	API points as per the UGC Guidelines in force at the point of time

## Eligibility Criteria
1)	The applicant must be an Indian citizen.
2)	Must have a Ph.D. in any Social Science discipline. 
3)	Age: Between 45 to 70 years as on the last application date.
4)	Must have an established publication record in reputed journals or books.
5)	Must be affiliated with a UGC-recognized or ICSSR research institute.
6)	Should not be availing any other fellowship concurrently.
7)	Must not be a defaulter of ICSSR funds.

## Exclusions
1)	Those who are not fulfilling the edibility criteria.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
Step 01: Visit ICSSR website - [www.icssr.org](https://www.icssr.org) - and navigate to Fellowships section.
Step 02: Click on Senior Fellowship Scheme.
Step 03: Register/Login to the ICSSR portal.
Step 04: Fill the online application form.
Step 05: Upload documents and submit.

metadata.schemeName: ICSSR Post-Doctoral Fellowship
metadata.briefDescription: The Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR) offers Postdoctoral Fellowships to encourage original and quality research by young and mid-career scholars in the field of social sciences. It is designed for researchers who have just finished their Ph.D. in advanced social science research.

page_content:
# ICSSR Post-Doctoral Fellowship

**Ministry:** Ministry of Education | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** ICSSR Fellowships, Post-Doctoral Fellowship, Social Science Research, Research Promotion, Social Scientists | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
This scheme is open to Indian citizens under the age of 45 who hold a Ph.D. and have demonstrated research ability through earlier publications. All candidates must be affiliated with a Ministry of Education or UGC-recognized public-funded Indian university, and a senior faculty member (not less than an Associate Professor) from the same institution must supervise their study. The fellowship offers a ₹31,000 monthly grant and ₹20,000 annual contingency grant for a period of two years. The applications for the fellowship are invited through advertising on the ICSSR website and social media platforms. The scheme covers a wide range of disciplines under the discipline of social sciences, with 26 major areas including priority research topics. In addition to conducting full-time research, fellows are expected to provide progress updates on a regular basis and publish at least two research publications in reputable journals. The final submission includes published articles, audited financial data, summaries, and a book-length report. Given India's social science ecosystem, it seeks to promote research excellence, evidence-based research, and scholarship that is also relevant to policymakers.

## Benefits
1)	Monthly Fellowship amount @ Rs.31,000 per month
2)	Contingency Grant @ Rs.20,000 per annum
3)	API points as per the UGC Guidelines in force at the point of time
4)	Institutional overhead (7.5%) – supports the hosting institution.

## Eligibility Criteria
1)	The applicant must be an Indian citizen.
2)	Must be under 45 years of age (5-year relaxation for SC/ST/PwD).
3)	 Must possess a Ph.D. in a social science discipline.
4)	Must have demonstrable research competence via publications.
5)	Must affiliate with a public-funded Indian institution approved for Ph.D.
6)	 Must have a supervisor who is a serving faculty (Associate Professor or above).
7)	Applicant must not be a defaulter of any ICSSR grant/project/fellowship.

## Exclusions
1)	Those who are not fulfilling the edibility criteria.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
Step 01: Visit ICSSR website - [www.icssr.org](https://icssr.org) -  and navigate to Fellowships section.
Step 02: Click on Post-Doctoral Fellowship Scheme.
Step 03: Register/Login to the ICSSR portal.
Step 04: Fill the online application form.
Step 05: Upload documents and submit.

metadata.schemeName: Rural Technology Complex
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "Rural Technology Complex" by the Programme Implementation Department, Government of Uttarakhand, aims to enhance livelihood opportunities in the Himalayan region through the use of local, need-based and environment-friendly technologies.

page_content:
# Rural Technology Complex

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Rural Technology, Skill Development, Environment-Friendly Technology, Training Program, Self-Help Groups | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Rural Technology Complex" implemented by the Govind Ballabh Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (NIHE), aims to support livelihood enhancement in the Himalayan region through the application of need-based, eco-friendly technologies. The scheme involves the establishment of Rural Technology Complex(RTC) within institutional premises, where local technological needs are addressed by training participants in sustainable practices. These sessions, focused on skill development, aim to create awareness and equip trainees with techniques to improve their income generation capacities using low-cost and environmentally compatible tools. Training is provided at no cost, and is open to government officers, NGO representatives, educators, students, women, and rural self-help group members.

## Benefits
- **Free Training:** All training programmes under the scheme are provided at no cost.  - **Livelihood Enhancement:** Training equips individuals with skills for sustainable, eco-friendly income generation.  - **Practical Exposure:** Training includes hands-on learning and field demonstrations.  - **No Participation Charges:** There is no fee for training or the exposure visit to the Rural Technology Campus.

## Eligibility Criteria
- The applicant should belong to any of the following categories:


   1. A central or state government officer or staff member.
   1. A representative of a non-governmental organisation (NGO).
   1. A student from a recognised university or educational institution.
   1. A teacher or faculty member from any recognised educational institution.
   1. A rural woman or man interested in acquiring environment-friendly livelihood-based technological skills.
   1. A member of a registered self-help group (SHG).

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
- The applicant must send a request letter to the Director of the institute for a visit or training.

> **Note:**


  - For training lasting one to seven days, an advance payment must be made based on the package determined by the institute.
  - For awareness visits to rural technical premises, no fee is payable. This service is free of charge.

To objective is to motivate and encourage SC students to pursue higher studies and bring them at par with the rest.

page_content:
# Financial Incentive to SC Meritorious Girls Students **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Assam | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Incentive, Scheduled Caste, Student, Social Welfare, Merit | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The 'Financial Incentive to SC Meritorious Girls Students' scheme, administered by the Directorate of Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes, Government of Assam, provides financial assistance to deserving girl students from Scheduled Castes (SC). Eligibility is extended to those who have achieved 80% or higher marks in the HSLC examination. The scheme's objective is to motivate and encourage SC students to pursue higher education, thereby fostering their academic parity with the broader population through a substantial incentive. Assistance is contingent upon the applicant satisfying the stipulated eligibility criteria and the successful submission of required documentation. An incentive of ₹5,000/- will be disbursed to students as approved by the Selection Committee.
**The applications will be accepted through the myScheme platform from 04/07/2025 to 31/10/2025.** ***A DigiLocker account is required for application. Please refer to the Application Process section for details.***
## Benefits A financial incentive of ₹5,000/- is provided. ## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be currently enrolled as a student. - The applicant must be female. - The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste (SC) community of Assam. - The applicant must have secured a minimum of 80% marks in the HSLC examination held in 2025. - The annual income of the applicant's parents/guardians must not exceed ₹5,00,000/-.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **The applications will be accepted through the myScheme platform from 04/07/2025 to 31/10/2025.**
**Signup to DigiLocker** **Step 1:** Visit the [_DigiLocker Portal_](https://www.digilocker.gov.in/) or download the DigiLocker Mobile App ([_Android_](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.digilocker.android) _/_ [_iOS_](https://itunes.apple.com/in/app/digilocker/id1320618078)). **Step 2:** Click _"_[_Login/Register_](https://www.digilocker.gov.in/web/signup)_"_ and provide these details: Full name, Gender, Mobile number, Email ID, and Aadhaar Number. Create a 6-digit PIN. **Step 3:** Finally, click "Submit". Note the 6-digit PIN for future reference.
**Signin to myScheme** **Step 1:** At the top right corner of this page, click "Sign In". Provide your DigiLocker Mobile Number and the 6-digit PIN. **Step 2:** Click the "I consent to terms of use" checkbox, then click "Sign In". You will be directed to the DigiLocker Consent Page. **Step 3:** At the bottom of the page, click "Allow". You have now successfully signed in to myScheme.
**Scheme Application** **Step 1:** At the top of this page, click "Apply Now". The application form of the scheme will open. **Step 2:** Fill in all the mandatory fields of the application form, and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. **Step 3:****** Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections. **Step 4:** Click "Submit". You'll receive the following confirmation message: "Form Submitted Successfully!". **Step 5:** For future reference, click "Print" to print the form or to download the filled form as a PDF file. Else, click "Ok" to get redirected to the myScheme landing page.

metadata.schemeName: Atma Nirbhar Matsya Palan Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a 45% subsidy with credit linkage for fishery infrastructure to ST individuals, SHGs, and FPOs engaged in aquaculture.

page_content:
# Atma Nirbhar Matsya Palan Yojana

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Arunachal Pradesh | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Subsidy, Farmers, Scheduled Tribe, Self Help Groups, FPO, Loan | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The “Atma Nirbhar Matsya Palan Yojana (ANMPY)” was launched by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Arunachal Pradesh. It aims to promote self-reliant fish farming practices and enhance income generation among Scheduled Tribe (ST) beneficiaries through aquaculture activities. Under this flagship scheme, a credit-linked front-ended subsidy is provided for fisheries development to individual farmers, Self Help Groups (SHGs), and Farmers Producer Organizations (FPOs) in Arunachal Pradesh. 
> **Scheme Implementation**

The scheme is implemented by the District Fisheries Development Officers (DFDOs), under the supervision of District Level Screening Committees (DLSCs).

## Benefits
> **Benefits:**


1. 45% Government Subsidy.
1. 45% Bank Loan (credit-linked).
1. 10% Beneficiary Contribution.

## Eligibility Criteria
**Eligibility Criteria for Individual Farmers**

1. The applicant must be a Scheduled Tribe (ST) of Arunachal Pradesh.
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh. 
1. The applicant must be between 18 to 60 years of age.
1. The applicant must not be a bank defaulter.
1. The applicant must not be a government servant.
1. The applicant must have experience in fisheries or aquaculture.
1. The applicant must have sufficient and suitable land for aquaculture activity.

**Eligibility Criteria for Self-Help Groups (SHGs)**

1. SHGs must be affiliated with APRSLM (Arunachal Pradesh State Rural Livelihood Mission).
1. SHGs under NERCOMP (for Changlang) are also eligible.
1. SHGs must be actively engaged in fisheries or aquaculture.

**Eligibility Criteria for Farmers Producer Organizations (FPOs)**

1. The FPO must be registered.
1. The FPO must have at least 100 shareholders.
1. The FPO must have at least one audited balance sheet.
1. Only FPOs engaged in fisheries/aquaculture are eligible.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
***Interested and eligible students need to apply online on the*** [***Atma Nirbhar Yojana***](https://agri.arunachal.gov.in/atmanirbhar_yojana/) ***portal.*** 
**New User Registration**

   1. Select the "[Login](https://agri.arunachal.gov.in/atmanirbhar_yojana/login)" option.   1. Subsequently, click on the "[Register Here"](https://agri.arunachal.gov.in/atmanirbhar_yojana/user-register) link.   1. Complete the registration form with the requisite details, including your name, Aadhaar card number, email ID, and mobile number.
   1. Establish a password for your account.
   1. Upon successful registration, the applicant will receive a User ID and password.

***Login & Application Process:***

   1. [Log in](https://agri.arunachal.gov.in/atmanirbhar_yojana/login) using the provided User ID and password to access the application form.   1. Fill in the complete application form.
   1. Upload the required documents, including a photograph, caste certificate, residential certificate, and land ownership proof, etc.
   1. Submit the application form.

**Mode:** Offline
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the District Fisheries Development Office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
**OR**
The interested applicant downloads the [application form](https://cdn.s3waas.gov.in/s36c29793a140a811d0c45ce03c1c93a28/uploads/2023/06/2023062787.pdf) from the official website. 
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District Fisheries Development Officers.
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the District Fisheries Development Officers to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

metadata.schemeName: Free Bicycle Distribution to Students of Vimukt, Ghumantu and Ardhghumantu Communities
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free cycles to students studying in classes 6th to 11th in government and recognized private educational institutions and belonging to Denotified Tribes, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes communities of Rajasthan.

page_content:
# Free Bicycle Distribution to Students of Vimukt, Ghumantu and Ardhghumantu Communities

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Bicycle, Student, Denotified Tribes, Nomadic Tribes, Semi Nomadic Tribes | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The "Free Bicycle Distribution Scheme" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan, for students belonging to the Denotified Tribes, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes communities of Rajasthan. Under this scheme, free bicycles will be distributed to students from these communities who are studying in government and recognized private educational institutions/schools from Class 6 to Class 11, to facilitate their commute between home and school.

## Benefits
- Free bicycle distribution to students studying in classes 6th to 11th in government and recognized private educational institutions. - Equal distribution of benefits among boys and girls (50% boys and 50% girls).

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The applicant should belong to one of the Denotified Tribes, Nomadic Tribes, or Semi-Nomadic Tribes as notified by the Government of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be studying in the 6th, 7th, 8th, 9th, 10th, or 11th class.1. The applicant should be enrolled in a government or a private educational institution/school affiliated with the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education, Ajmer .
1. The applicant should have secured 60% or more marks in the previous academic year.
1. The students who has already availed the benefit of this scheme once will not be eligible.

> **NOTE:**

> Students belonging to a total of 32 communities (including 9 Denotified Tribes, 10 Nomadic Tribes, and 13 Semi-Nomadic Tribes) will be eligible as per Government [Order No. F-1(1)(2)S.W/63 dated 24.02.1964](https://sje.rajasthan.gov.in/Default.aspx?PageID=68), Annexure 'A'.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
***Application Process:***
**Step 1:** To avail of the benefits of the scheme, the applicant needs to contact their respective school.
**Step 2:** Submit copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required) to the respective school.
**Step 3:** The complete application process is managed by the school principal through the Shaladarpan Beneficiary module.
**Step 4:** The school will visit the [Shala Darpan](https://rajshaladarpan.rajasthan.gov.in/SD2/BSP/Home/HomePage.aspx), Rajasthan Portal.
**Step 5:** Using the school&amp;amp;#39;s login credentials (Login ID and Password), the school will help the student to fill out and submit the application form. 
**Step 6:** The institution will forward the application to the concerned District Education Officer (Headquarters), Elementary or Secondary Education.
***Post-Application Process:***
**Step 1:** The District Education Officer will compile and forward all verified applications of the district to the Directorate of Secondary Education, Rajasthan, Bikaner.
**Step 2:** Upon approval, bicycles will be distributed to the eligible students.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve employability through free skill training for youth of backward and extremely backward communities.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Pichhda Varg Evam Ati Pichhda Varg Kaushal Vikas Prashikshan Yojana

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Bihar | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Skills & Employment, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Backward Classes, Extremely Backward Classes, Skill Development, Training, Employment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Mukhyamantri Pichhda Varg Evam Ati Pichhda Varg Kaushal Vikas Prashikshan Yojana" was launched by the Backward Classes and Extremely Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Bihar. It aims to enhance the employability and income-generating capacity of youth from backward and extremely backward communities through skill development training. Under this scheme, free domain-specific skilling programs are provided to youth to help them become job-ready or self-employed. 
> **Scheme Implementation**

The scheme is implemented by the Bihar State Backward Classes Finance and Development Corporation, in coordination with the Bihar Skill Development Mission (BSDM).
> **Training**

Training is conducted through Skill Development Centres (SDCs) approved by BSDM under various sectors like IT, construction, beauty & wellness, and more.

## Benefits
**Free Skill Training:** 

- Domain Skilling Programs in various sectors like Apparel, Beauty & Wellness, Construction, Electronics, IT-ITES, Retail, etc.

**Certification:** 

- Candidates receive certificates post successful completion of training and assessment.

**Placement Support:** 

- Support for employment or self-employment opportunities after course completion.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should belong to the Backward Class or Extremely Backward Class category.
1. The applicant should be between 18 and 45 years of age.
1. The applicant should possess the Aadhaar number (mandatory for Aadhaar-based registration).

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
> **Application Process for the Applicant**

**Visit the Official Portal**

  - Interested candidates must visit the official website of the [Bihar Skill Development Mission](https://skillmissionbihar.org/) (BSDM). 
**Search for Nearest Skill Development Centre (SDC)**

  - On the homepage, click on “Click here for your nearest center”.
  - Then select “Kushal Yuva Program – Find Centers”.
  - Choose the KYP course, select a preferred search mode (e.g., by district, block, or pincode), and fill in the required details.
  - A list of Skill Development Centres (SDCs) matching the criteria will be displayed.

**Document Preparation**

  - The applicant must gather self-attested copies of all necessary documents (Aadhaar, caste certificate, residence proof, educational qualifications, etc.) as per the course requirements.

**Centre Visit and Registration**

  - The applicant should personally visit the nearest Skill Development Centre (SDC) for document verification and registration assistance.

> **Application Process for the Skill Development Centres**

**Candidate Identification**

  - Local SDCs identify eligible candidates from the Backward Class (BC) and Extremely Backward Class (EBC) categories through community outreach and awareness activities.

**Document Collection and Upload**

  - All required documents are collected from the candidate and uploaded to the BSDM portal by the SDC for record and processing.

**Aadhaar Verification**

  - The applicant's Aadhaar number is verified digitally to confirm identity and eligibility.

**Batch Formation**

  - A training batch is formed comprising a minimum of 20 and a maximum of 40 candidates.

**Approval by the Corporation**

  - Upon successful formation and verification of the batch, the Bihar State Backward Classes Finance and Development Corporation grants formal approval for the commencement of training.

**Training Delivery**

  - Certified trainers at BSDM-approved SDCs deliver domain-specific skill training under the prescribed curriculum. Attendance and performance are monitored digitally.
