metadata.schemeName: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (Ladakh)
metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1,000/- is provided to BPL individuals above 49 years of age, and widows aged 40 to 79 years belonging to the BPL category are also eligible, and the scheme is centrally sponsored and jointly funded by the Centre and State Governments.

page_content:
# Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (Ladakh) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Ladakh | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** BPL, Indira Gandhi, Pension, Widow | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The ‘Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme’ under the National Social Assistance Programme is implemented by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Ladakh. Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1,000 is provided to BPL individuals aged above 49 years, and widows aged 40 to 79 years belonging to the BPL category are also eligible. The scheme is centrally sponsored and jointly funded by the Centre and State Governments.
## Benefits Under this scheme, BPL people receive ₹1,000/-p per month.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Ladakh. 1. The applicant should be a widow. 1. The widow's age should be above 40 years. 1. The widow should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 1: Obtain the application form free of cost from the DSWO/TSWO, fill it completely, and attach proof of age, income, status, and address. Step 2: Submit the completed application to the concerned Tehsil Social Welfare Officer (TSWO) and get a proper receipt. Step 3: The TSWO consolidates eligible applications and forwards them to the District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO) for fund arrangement and sanction by the District Level Sanctioning Committee.

metadata.schemeName: Rajasthan Free Laptop Vitran Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free laptops to meritorious students of government schools in Rajasthan who have achieved outstanding results in Class 8, 10, and 12 examinations.

page_content:
# Rajasthan Free Laptop Vitran Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Laptop, Student, Digital Learning, Education | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Rajasthan Free Laptop Vitran Yojana” launched by the Education (Elementary and Secondary) Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to promote digital education by providing free laptops to meritorious students studying in government schools who have secured top ranks in Class 8, 10, and 12 examinations.
## Benefits - **Free Laptop Distribution:** Meritorious students will receive free laptops based on their performance in Class 8, 10, and 12 examinations.
## Eligibility Criteria > **For Class 8 Students:** - The applicant must be a student studying in a government school of Rajasthan. - The applicant must have obtained a minimum of 75% marks in the Class 8 Primary Education Eligibility Examination as per the state-level merit list. - The first 6,000 students at the state level who have obtained the required marks will be eligible for the benefit. - The first 100 students in each district who have obtained a minimum of 70% marks as per the district-level merit list will be eligible for the benefit. > **For Class 10 Students:** - The applicant must be a student studying in a government school of Rajasthan. - The applicant must have obtained a minimum of 75% marks in the Class 10 Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education Examination as per the state-level merit list. - The first 5,880 students at the state level will be eligible to receive the benefit. - The first 120 students who have obtained the highest ranks in the Praveshika Examination at the state level will be eligible for the benefit. - At the district level, the first 98 students in Class 10 who have obtained a minimum of 70% marks will be eligible for the benefit. - The first two students who have obtained the highest ranks in the Praveshika Examination at the district level will be eligible for the benefit. > **For Class 12 Students:** - The applicant must be a student studying in a government school of Rajasthan. - The applicant must have obtained a minimum of 75% marks in the Class 12 Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education Examination as per the state-level merit list. - The first 5,880 students from all streams at the state level will be eligible to receive the benefit. - The first 120 students who have obtained the highest ranks in the Upadhyay Examination at the state level will be eligible for the benefit. - At the district level, the first 98 students from all streams who have obtained a minimum of 70% marks in the Class 12 Examination will be eligible. - The first two students who have obtained the highest ranks in the Upadhyay Examination at the district level will be eligible for the benefit.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - Eligible students are identified automatically based on the merit lists prepared at the state and district levels. The laptops are distributed through the concerned government schools.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide insurance benefits in cases of natural death, accidental death, and disability to BPL and Aastha Card holders.

page_content:
# Pannadhay Jeevan Amrit Yojana (Janshree Insurance Scheme) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Social welfare & Empowerment, Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Insurance, BPL, Death Benefit, Accidental Benefit, Disability | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Pannadhay Jeevan Amrit Yojana (Janshree Insurance Scheme)" launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to provide financial benefits in cases of death and disability through providing insurance payouts to the nominee of the insured BPL and Aastha Card holders.
## Benefits - **Natural Death:** ₹30,000/- - **Accidental Death:** ₹75,000/- - **Permanent Total Physical Disability:** ₹75,000/- - **Loss of Two Limbs/Eyes:** ₹75,000/- - **Loss of One Limb/Eye Benefit:** ₹37,500/- **Note:** - Accidental death/permanent total disability/partial disability means the event must occur within three calendar months of the accident. - Excludes: deliberate self-inflicted injury, suicide or attempted suicide, injury or death caused by alcohol, drug abuse, riot, civil commotion, rebellion, war, injury caused by hunting, mountaineering, etc.
## Eligibility Criteria - Applicant should be BPL card holder. - Applicant should be Aastha card holder. - Applicant age limit should be between 18 to 59 years. - If the head of the family is even one day older than 60 years, the eldest person mentioned in the family card will be eligible. - The head of the family also has the option to either insure themselves or insure the primary breadwinner.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline > Submission of Eligible List: - The State Government provides the Life Insurance Corporation of India with a certified list of persons living below the poverty line and holding Aastha Cards. > **Claim Submission After Death** - In the event of the death of the insured person, a claim must be submitted within six months from the date of death. - The claim submission form ([Annexure-2](https://sje.rajasthan.gov.in/schemes/Panna2.pdf)) is to be completed by the insured person's nominee. This form will be completed by the insured person's nominee through the Gram Sevak Officer in rural areas and by the Executive Officer/Commissioner/Chief Executive Officer in urban areas and sent to the Jaipur office of the Life Insurance Corporation of India.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students of Rajasthan for pursuing higher education at top-ranked global and national universities.

page_content:
# Swami Vivekanand Scholarship for Academic Excellence Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Academic Excellence, Education, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Swami Vivekanand Scholarship for Academic Excellence Scheme” launched by the Higher Education Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to promote academic excellence by offering financial assistance to deserving students pursuing studies at globally recognized institutions.
## Benefits
**Category****Tuition Fee Course Duration (Maximum per annum)**Living Expenses During Course (Annual maintenance allowance, annual academic and equipment allowance, medical insurance premium, accommodation, TCS, etc., for all expenses and one-time expenses, visa fee, airfare for going abroad and coming to India in economy class, laptop, etc.)**E1****Living Expenses for Overseas Study:-** • For students applying before the application deadline for overseas study, living expenses during the course period are payable as follows:- **1.** One-time expenses up to ₹3,00,000/- will be paid only for the first year. **2.** Per month ₹1,00,000/-, but for the first month, in case of travelling abroad, **3.** For living expenses per month: ₹75,000/- • **Living expenses:** ₹1,00,000/- per month during the remaining course period. • **Students already studying abroad before the application deadline:** 1. No payment shall be made for the course period prior to the application date. 2. For the upcoming course period under the scheme, monthly living expenses payable ₹1,00,000 /-; • **For Study Within India:** -₹25,000 per month (₹3,00,000 yearly)**E2****85% of tuition fee or maximum ₹42,50,000/- lakh (whichever is lower) based on invoice issued by the university**Living expenses during the course period under the scheme: ₹50,000/- per month**E3****50% of the tuition fee based on the invoice issued by the University OR maximum ₹33,00,000/- (whichever is less)**No payment

## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Rajasthan. - The applicant’s age must be less than 35 years on July 1st of the financial year. - The applicant must fall under one of the following income categories: 1. **Category E1:** Family income up to ₹8,00,000/-. 1. **Category E2:** Family income between ₹8,00,000 and ₹25,00,000/-. 1. **Category E3:** Family income above ₹25,00,000/-. - The applicant must have secured a minimum of 60% marks or an equivalent grade in the qualifying examination. - The applicant must have received an offer letter, confirmation letter, or admission letter from a university/institution listed in the latest Times Higher Education Global Rankings or ranked in the top 150 overall in the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF). - The applicant studying in the second, third, or final year/semester is also eligible to apply, provided they are already enrolled in the [listed institutions](https://hte.rajasthan.gov.in/dept/dce/uploads/doc/svs_revguide_170424.pdf).

## Exclusions - The applicant who is permanently employed by the state or central government, their enterprises, or institutions receiving financial assistance from them is not eligible to apply for this scheme.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the official portal of Rajasthan Single Sign On: [https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/) **Step 2:** On the homepage, click on the "[Register here](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/register)" tab. **Step 3:** Select ‘Jan Aadhaar’ option for registration under the ‘Citizen’ tab. **Step 4:** Complete the registration process by entering your Jan Aadhaar Number. **Step 5:** After successful registration, you will receive a User ID (SSO ID) and Password. These credentials will allow you to check your application status and apply for scheme in the future. > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** To apply under the scheme, revisit the official portal of Rajasthan Single Sign On: [https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/) **Step 2:** On the homepage, click on the "[Login to RajSSO](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/signin)" tab. **Step 3:** Enter your username (SSO ID), password, and Captcha, then click ‘Login’. **Step 4:** Once logged in, update your profile. **Step 5:** Click on SJMS SMS icon, then click on "Scholarship (CE,TAD,MINORITY)" Icon. **Step 6:** Fill in the required information, and upload all necessary documents on the online portal. **Step 7:** After entering the information and uploading the documents, make sure to submit/save your application form.
**Mode:** Online - via CSC - Contact with nearest E-mitra center to apply for this service.

metadata.briefDescription: The Government of West Bengal has undertaken a housing project scheme named ” PRATYASHA” for Police Personnel (from Inspectors to Constables) working in the West Bengal Police to materialize their dreams of owning houses.

page_content:
# Pratyasha Scheme- West Bengal **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** West Bengal | **Categories:** Housing & Shelter | **Tags:** Police, House, Flats, Financial Assistance, Housing Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Govt. of West Bengal has undertaken a housing project scheme named " PRATYASHA" for Police Personnel (from Inspectors to Constables) working in the West Bengal Police to materialize their dreams of owning houses. The West Bengal State Police Housing Corporation will construct various types of flats with the financial assistance of Housing and Urban Development Corporation Ltd (HUDCO) and all Police Personnel would be welcome to fill in forms for their required housing assistance. **Procedure of allotment:** The flats will be allotted to the applicants through a lottery on a random selection basis. Unallotted flats, if any, after the lottery, will be allotted to the eligible allottees on a "first come first served" basis or through lottery on a random selection basis. In case the applications remain less than the no of flats of this project, then the allotments will be made on a first come first served basis ## Benefits 1. Construction of various types of flats for all Police Personnel of West Bengal. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. Any Police personnel in the ranks of Deputy Superintendent(Non-WBPS)/ Assistant Commissioner, Inspector, Sub-Inspector/ Sergeant, Assistant Sub-Inspector, Constable, and equivalent ranks of West Bengal Police and Kolkata Police can apply independently for dwelling units under this project as per their entitlement as mentioned below: a) Police personnel in the ranks of Deputy Superintendent(Non-WBPS)/ Assistant Commissioner, Inspector or Sub-Inspector/ Sergeant and equivalent ranks of West Bengal Police and Kolkata Police whose total pay (Basic Pay + Grade Pay) is ₹ 18,000/- (Rupees eighteen thousand) or more can apply for “A” category of dwelling units having flat area (approximate) 1123 sq. ft. per unit. b) Police personnel in the ranks of Inspector/ Sub-Inspector/ Sergeant or Assistant Sub-Inspector, Constable, and equivalent ranks of West Bengal Police and Kolkata Police whose total pay (Basic Pay + Grade Pay) is ₹15,000/- (Rupees fifteen thousand) or more can apply for “B” category of dwelling units having flat area (approximate) 926 sq. ft. per unit. c) Police personnel in the ranks of Assistant Sub-Inspector, Constable and equivalent ranks of West Bengal Police and Kolkata Police whose total pay (Basic Pay + Grade Pay) is ₹ 8,840/- (Rupees eight thousand eight hundred forty) or more can apply for “C” category of dwelling units having flat area (approximate) 794 sq. ft. per unit. 2. One Police personnel in the above-noted ranks will be eligible to submit only one application for this Scheme (No other family member may apply separately). 3. In the case of a joint application, only a member of the immediate family (spouse, parents, and children) is eligible to be the second applicant. The first applicant shall be the eligible personnel of West Bengal Police or Kolkata Police only. 4. Only one flat will be allotted to the eligible applicant if he/she is selected through lottery on a random selection basis. 5. The Corporation, however, reserves the right to relax any of these conditions whatsoever without assigning any reason.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 01:** The application form along with Information Guide and General Terms & Conditions may be downloaded from the website of West Bengal Police and Kolkata Police ([https://www.kolkatapolice.gov.in/](https://www.kolkatapolice.gov.in/)). [https://kolkatapolice.gov.in/images/PratyashaProject.pdf](https://kolkatapolice.gov.in/images/PratyashaProject.pdf) **Step 02:** Application shall be accompanied by an A/C Payee Demand Draft/ Pay Order/Banker’s Cheque drawn in favour of the “Managing Director, West Bengal Police Housing & Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited” on any Bank payable at Kolkata as per application money. Application with instruments payable outside Kolkata may be rejected at the discretion of WBPH & IDC Ltd. without citing any reason. **Step 03:** The applicants should provide the details of his/ her Name, Father’s/ Husband’s Name, and Telephone No. on the reverse of the Demand Draft/ Pay Order/ Banker’s Cheque for application money. **Step 04:** Application Form duly filled in and completed in all respect, duly signed by the applicant along with Demand Draft/ Pay Order/Banker’s Cheque for the amount as mentioned above and other documents of the General Terms & Conditions may be submitted at the office of West Bengal Police Housing & Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited, Araksha Bhawan (3rd Floor), BlockDJ, Sector-II, Salt Lake City, Kolkata- 700 091. **Step 05:** Applicants who wish to send their application by post, must send the application form along with application money as mentioned above, and other documents of General Terms & Conditions in the prescribed form, to the following address:- The Managing Director, West Bengal Police Housing & Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited, Araksha Bhawan (3rd Floor), Block-DJ, Sector-II, Salt Lake City, Kolkata- 700091.

page_content:
# Akanksha Housing Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** West Bengal | **Categories:** Housing & Shelter | **Tags:** Housing, West Bengal, State Government Employees | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Akanksha Housing Scheme was launched by the Housing Department, Government of West Bengal on 28/02/2014 to provide housing to the serving State Government employees. The present project is situated in premises No. 07/300, Block-DB, Action Area-ID at New Town, Kolkata - 700107 on a pilot basis. The project has been designed on a no-profit no-loss basis and without the cost of the land. The instant project is spread over 5.0599 acres of land and comprising of 13 towers. (7 nos. of G+10 Towers for Elegant, Premium and Classic categories and 6 nos. of Straight 4 towers for Economy and Standard categories) containing of 576 flats and 236 covered Car parking spaces and 35 open Car parking spaces (only for Elegant, Premium and Classic categories) with provision for Gymnasium, Club-House and Community Hall within the Complex.
## Benefits Housing for serving State Government employees of West Bengal on a transparent lottery basis. The houses so built are based on the following categories based on the grade pay of the employees:
1. ELEGANT for employees with grade pay of ₹8900/- & above, built-up area is 1434 sq. feet. It consists of three bedrooms, one drawing cum Dining, one kitchen, two balconies, two toilets, two water closets & one store room, available at the rate of ₹3100/- per Sq. ft., total price ₹44,45,400/-
2. PREMIUM for employees with grade pay Between ₹ 7601/- to ₹ 8899/-, built-up area is 1273 sq. feet. It consists of three bedrooms, one drawing cum Dining, one kitchen, two balconies, two toilets, & one water closet, available at the rate of ₹ 3100/- per Sq. ft., total price ₹39,46,300/-
3. CLASSIC for employees with grade pay Between ₹4801/- to ₹7600/-, built-up area is 924 sq. feet. It consists of two bedrooms, one drawing cum Dining, one kitchen, one balcony, & two toilets, available at the rate of ₹ 3100/- per Sq. ft., total price ₹28,64,400/-
4. ECONOMY for employees with grade pay Between ₹2901/- to ₹4800/-, built-up area is 710 sq. feet. It consists of two bedrooms, one living cum Dining, one kitchen, one balcony, one toilet and one water closet, available at the rate of ₹ 2200/- per Sq. ft., total price ₹15,62,000/-
5. STANDARD for employees with grade pay upto ₹2900/-, built-up area is 464 sq. feet. It consists of one bedroom, one master room, one kitchen, one balcony, and one toilet, available at the rate of ₹ 2200/- per Sq. ft., total price ₹10,20,800/-
The prices are purely tentative and may vary during the actual execution of the scheme till its completion. The difference of cost so varied will be charged at no profit no loss basis and should be paid by the allottee within sixty days from the date of demand. ## Eligibility Criteria All serving State Govt. employees as defined in West Bengal Service Rules, except those State Govt. employees who have their own housing scheme such as `Pratyasha’ for Policemen or similar housing schemes under Government of West Bengal stated in Memorandum No. FD-647 dated 29th August, 2014 of the Finance Department of Govt. of West Bengal may apply for New Town Project under `AKANKSHA HOUSING SCHEME’ (AHS). ## Exclusions The following categories of serving West Bengal State Government employees are ineligible to apply for Akanksha Housing Scheme: 1. West Bengal State Government employees already covered under any other housing scheme 1. All India Service officers. 1. Employees of local bodies like Panchayat, Municipalities, Corporations, etc. 1. Teaching/ non-teaching staff of non Govt. School & Colleges/Universities etc. even if those Institutions are aided or sponsored by state Govt. 1. Employees of various companies/undertakings like WBPDCL, WBSEDCL, CSTC, CTC, SBSTC, NBSTC, WBTEDCL, WBHIDCO, KMDA, KIT, KMWSA and etc. 1. Retired but reemployed Govt. employees. 1. Judicial Service Officers of West Bengal. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** https://wbhousing.gov.in/general-terms-condition

metadata.schemeName: BIRAC Incubator SEED Fund (SEED)
metadata.briefDescription: The BIRAC Incubator SEED Fund (SEED) provides early-stage funding through incubators to biotech startups so they can develop their ideas into viable products and launch successful businesses.

page_content:
# BIRAC Incubator SEED Fund (SEED) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Science And Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Science, IT & Communications | **Tags:** SEED Fund, Startups, Biotech, Businesses | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The BIRAC Incubator SEED Fund (SEED) Fund, under the Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India, provides financial support to technology startups during their initial stage of operations. The funding is provided to eligible startups through BIRAC-supported incubators, with the objective of strengthening their business and technology development and enhancing their ability to raise further investments from Angel Investors/Venture Capitalists or obtain loans from commercial banks and financial institutions. The scheme primarily supports Biotech, Med-Tech, and Life Sciences startups.
## Benefits • Seed funding as equity and equity linked instruments up to ₹30 lakh per startup.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. Incubator should have been supported through BIRAC’s BioNEST programme. 1. Incubator should be Operational for last three years. 1. Incubator should have in-house capacity in incubating & mentoring early stage Biotech / Life Sciences Startups. 1. Incubator should have established IP&TT facilitation services for startups. 1. Incubator must have prior experience in management of early-stage funding schemes or other grants.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online Step 1: Visit the official BIRAC [website.](https://www.birac.nic.in/index.php) Step 2: Click on “[Login](https://www.birac.nic.in/login.php)/[Register](https://www.birac.nic.in/login_instructions_new.php?scheme_type=9)” on the website. Step 3: If you are a new user, select “New User? Click Here to Register” and enter the required details. Step 4: Complete the registration and activate your account through the verification email received from BIRAC. Step 5: After activation, log in using your registered username and password. Step 6: Check the SEED Fund section and identify the relevant BioNEST incubator through which the funding is offered. Step 7: Contact/approach the eligible SEED Fund partner incubator and follow its application process. Step 8: Submit the required startup details, documents, and proposal as instructed by the incubator/BIRAC. Step 9: After submission, the proposal will be evaluated as per the applicable SEED Fund guidelines.

The scheme benefits students studying at under Graduate level in Science/Arts/Commerce, Engineering, Medical and Technical / Professional courses, Post Graduate level students pursuing Science/Arts/Commerce & Technical/Management. These scholarships will be sanctioned to deserving students on merit-cum-means criteria.

metadata.schemeName: National Agriculture Insurance Scheme
metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
metadata.briefDescription: The National Agriculture Insurance Scheme (NAIS) was introduced by the Government of India to provide comprehensive insurance coverage and financial support to farmers against crop losses due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.

page_content:
# National Agriculture Insurance Scheme **Ministry:** Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Farmers, Crop Insurance, Agriculture Subsidy, Natural Disaster Coverage | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The National Agriculture Insurance Scheme (NAIS) was introduced by the Government of India to provide comprehensive insurance coverage and financial support to farmers against crop losses due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases. The scheme promotes the stability of farm incomes and encourages farmers to adopt modern agricultural practices. > **Key Features** 1. Coverage for food crops, oilseeds, and selected commercial/horticultural crops. 1. Protection against crop loss due to natural calamities such as drought, flood, hailstorm, cyclone, pests, and diseases. 1. Coverage for different stages of the crop life cycle: - Sowing/planting risk. - Standing crop losses. - Post-harvest losses (due to specified perils). - Losses due to localized risks like hailstorms and landslides. 1. Subsidized premiums for small and marginal farmers. 1. Availability of the scheme across notified areas and seasons. > **Claim Process** - **Reporting** Losses: Inform the local agriculture office or insurer within 48 hours of the incident.- **Assessment**: Loss assessment will be conducted by a joint team comprising local authorities and insurance company representatives.- **Claim Settlement:** Upon verification, claims are directly transferred to the farmer’s bank account
## Benefits > **Comprehensive Crop Coverage:** - Protection against crop loss due to natural calamities (floods, droughts, hailstorms), pests, diseases, and localized risks. - Includes coverage for sowing, standing crops, and post-harvest losses. > **Subsidized Premiums for Small Farmers:** - Small and marginal farmers receive premium subsidies, making the scheme affordable for them. > **Affordable Premiums for All Farmers:** - Low premium rates for both loanee and non-loanee farmers, with premiums deducted from agricultural loans. > **Quick Claim Settlement:** - Fast processing and direct claim settlement to the farmer’s bank account. > **Encourages Better Farming Practices:** - Promotes risk mitigation and adoption of modern agricultural practices, increasing productivity. > **Wide Crop Coverage:** - Covers food crops, oilseeds, and horticultural crops, ensuring protection for most farmers. > **Nationwide Accessibility:** - Available to farmers across the country, making it a national safety net. **Premium Rates** - Food crops and oilseeds: - Kharif crops: 3.5% of the sum insured. - Rabi crops: 1.5% of the sum insured. - Commercial and horticultural crops: Actuarial premium rates apply. - The premium for Small & Marginal farmers is subsidised to the extent of 10% which is shared by the State Govt. and Govt. of India
## Eligibility Criteria > **Loanee Farmers:** 1. Farmers who avail seasonal agricultural operations (SAO) loans from financial institutions (banks, co-operative societies, etc.) are automatically covered under the scheme. 1. The coverage for loanee farmers is compulsory, and premiums are deducted from the loan amount. > **Non-Loanee Farmers:** 1. Non-loanee farmers can apply voluntarily for the insurance coverage. 1. The application must be submitted before the deadline for each crop season. > **Notified Crops and Areas:** 1. The crops to be insured and the areas where the scheme is applicable are announced by the government each year.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline > **Application Process for Loanee Farmers** **Step-1**: Loanee farmers need to visit their nearest bank or primary agricultural cooperative society (PACS) branch, where they have taken the loan. **Step-2:** The bank will automatically enroll the farmer in the NAIS. **Step-3:** Premiums are deducted directly from the loan amount at the time of disbursement > **Application Process for Non-Loanee Farmers** **Step-1: Visit the Bank or Insurance Office** - Go to the nearest branch of a bank that offers NAIS or visit the office of an authorized insurance company that provides coverage under NAIS. **Step-2: Fill the Application Form** - Fill out the application form for the National Agriculture Insurance Scheme. **Step-3: Provide Required Documents** - Submit required documents such as: - Aadhaar card or any government-issued identity proof. - Proof of land ownership or tenancy. - Crop sowing details (if applicable). - Bank account details for claim disbursement. **Step-4: Pay the Premium** - Pay the premium amount at the time of application. metadata.schemeName: Jai Johar (Old Age Pension) Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: “Jai Johar (Old Age Pension)” is a Social Security Scheme by the Tribal Development Dept, Govt of West Bengal. The scheme is aimed at the ST residents of West Bengal of the age of 60 years and above. A monthly pension of ₹ 1,000/- is transferred to the individual bank account of the beneficiary.

page_content:
# Jai Johar (Old Age Pension) Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** West Bengal | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Pension, Senior Citizen, Social Welfare, Financial Assistance, Scheduled Tribe | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched on 1st April 2020, “Jai Johar (Old Age Pension)” is a Social Security Scheme by the Tribal Development Department, Government of West Bengal. The scheme is aimed at the Scheduled Tribe (ST) residents of West Bengal of the age of 60 years and above who do not receive any other pension from any other authority. The amount of monthly pension of ₹ 1,000/- is transferred directly to the individual bank account of the beneficiary.
## Benefits - Monthly Pension Support: Financial assistance of ₹1,000/- is provided to eligible elderly ST beneficiaries to support their basic needs. - Income Security: Ensures minimum financial stability for aged persons with limited livelihood options. - Support for Vulnerable Groups: Focus on economically weaker elderly individuals in tribal communities. - Enhancement of Dignity: Enables beneficiaries to live with dignity and independence. - Direct Benefit Transfer: Pension is credited directly to beneficiaries' bank accounts. - Reduction in Financial Dependency: Helps reduce dependency on family members or informal sources. - Improved Social Welfare: Strengthens social security coverage among marginalized sections.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of West Bengal. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant should have attained the age of 60 years or more. 1. The applicant should not be a beneficiary under any other Social Security pension scheme. 1. The applicant should not be a recipient of Government pension or pension from any other organization. 1. The applicant should be an economically disadvantaged individual with limited or no stable income.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should request the prescribed format of the application form free of cost from the office of Block Development Officer (BDO) / Sub Divisional Officer (SDO) / Kolkata Municipal Corporation. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the concerned authority at: - Office of the BDO in rural areas. - [Office of the SDO](https://castcertificatewb.gov.in/contact_us) in Municipalities and Notified Areas- Commissioner Kolkata Municipal Corporation in KMC areas. > **Track Applicant & View Payment Status:** [Click here](https://samarth.wb.gov.in/track-applicant-public).

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free travel facility from home to school to tribal girls studying up to Class 8 in Scheduled Caste and Tribal Areas of Rajasthan, thereby ensuring uninterrupted access to education.

page_content:
# Free Travel Facility for Tribal Girls Studying up to Class 8th in Scheduled Caste and Tribal Areas of the State **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Free Travel Facility, Tribal Girls, Tribal Area, Girl Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched in 1994, the scheme “Free Travel Facility for Tribal Girls Studying up to Class 8th in Scheduled Caste and Tribal Areas of the State” by the Rajasthan State Transport Corporation under the Transport Department, Government of Rajasthan aims to facilitate free home-to-school travel for eligible tribal girl students through RFID-based travel access.
## Benefits - **Free Travel Facility:** Free travel facility is provided to eligible beneficiaries for commuting from home to school and back. - **Route Applicability:** The facility is applicable only within the Rajasthan State area.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a tribal girl - The applicant should be student. - The applicant should be studying up to Class 8. - The applicant should be studying in a school located in the Scheduled Caste or Tribal Areas of Rajasthan. - The applicant should be a permanent resident of Rajasthan. - The applicant should possess a valid school identity card issued by the concerned educational institution.

## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - **RSRTC Online RFID Registration Form:** [Click Here](https://rsrtcrfidsystem.co.in/OnlineApplication/MemberNewRegistration.aspx?Sid=1).

metadata.schemeName: Rajasthan Jan Aadhaar Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a unique family identification system in Rajasthan through the Jan Aadhaar Card, ensuring easy, transparent, and simplified delivery of government scheme benefits to residents.

page_content:
# Rajasthan Jan Aadhaar Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Jan Aadhaar Card, Direct Benefit Transfer, Digital Identity | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Rajasthan Jan Aadhaar Yojana” by the Planning Department, Government of Rajasthan aims to provide a multi-purpose Jan Aadhaar Card through offering unique family and individual identification numbers to all residents for accessing benefits via Direct Benefit Transfer.
## Benefits > **Identification and Access Benefit:** - The eligible family receives a 10-digit Family Identification Number. - Each family member receives an 11-digit Individual Identification Number. - The Jan Aadhaar Card is valid as proof of Identity, Address, and Relation. > **Direct Benefit Transfer Support:** - Eligible beneficiaries receive cash benefits directly into their bank accounts through DBT. - Non-cash benefits are provided after Aadhaar authentication near the beneficiary’s residence.
## Eligibility Criteria - All resident families of the State are eligible to get a Jan Aadhaar card by registering. > **Household Head Rules:** - The applicant should nominate a woman aged 18 years or above as the Head of Family. - The applicant may nominate a man aged 21 years or above as Head of Family if no eligible woman is available. - The applicant may nominate the eldest family member as Head of Family if neither of the above is available.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - The applicant can apply online through the official portal: [janaadhaar.rajasthan.gov.in](https://janaadhaar.rajasthan.gov.in/content/raj/janaadhaar/en/home.html).
**Mode:** Online - via CSC - The applicant can also apply through the nearest e-Mitra Centre.

metadata.briefDescription:
The scheme aims to provide cash awards to meritorious students of registered construction workers in Madhya Pradesh.
It supports students studying from Class 6 to 12 by offering annual scholarships based on their class and performance.

page_content:
# Cash Award Scheme for Meritorious Students of Madhya Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers: Classes 6 to 12 **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Madhya Pradesh | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Cash Award, Scholarship, Construction Workers, Education Incentive | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Cash Award Scheme for Meritorious Students of Madhya Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers: Classes 6 to 12” launched by the School Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh aims to encourage education among children of registered construction workers through providing annual cash awards to meritorious students.
## Benefits - **For Class 6 to 8 (Boys):** ₹500/- per year. - **For Class 6 to 8 (Girls):** ₹750/- per year. - **For Class 9 to 10 (Boys):** ₹750/- per year. - **For Class 9 to 10 (Girls):** ₹1,000/- per year. - **For Class 11 to 12 (Boys):** ₹1,000/- per year. - **For Class 11 to 12 (Girls):** ₹1,500/- per year.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a child (boy or girl) of a registered construction worker. - The applicant’s parent must be registered as a construction worker under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. - The applicant’s parents’ identity cards must be renewed. - The applicant must have passed the previous class in First Division. - The applicant must not be eligible for any other meritorious award. - The applicant must submit a verified copy of the mark sheet of the last two years. > **Note:** If both husband and wife are registered construction workers, only two children will be eligible to receive the scholarship.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The student must apply in the prescribed application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, provide all the mandatory details, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the supporting documents to the concerned authority. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted.

metadata.schemeName: SPARSH – Social Innovation Programme for Products Affordable & Relevant to Social Health
metadata.briefDescription: The SPARSH programme supports innovators in developing affordable health-related solutions so that essential healthcare products can reach and benefit underserved communities.

page_content:
# SPARSH – Social Innovation Programme for Products Affordable & Relevant to Social Health **Ministry:** Ministry Of Science And Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Science, IT & Communications | **Tags:** Social Health, SPARSH, Biotechnological, Scientists, Researchers | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The SPARSH (Social Innovation Programme for Products Affordable & Relevant to Social Health), under the Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India, supports innovators in developing affordable and accessible healthcare solutions to help ensure that essential health products reach and benefit underserved communities. OBJECTIVES - SPARSH, the social innovation initiative designed biotechnological interventions to address critical societal issues. - SPARSH revolves around nurturing "Social Innovators" within the biotech domain, equipped to identify community needs and gaps, and formulate innovative product developments or services to bridge these disparities.

## Benefits - Grant-in-aid assistance up to ₹50 lakh for a period of up to 18 months
## Eligibility Criteria • There are two components under the initiative – (i) Affordable Product Development and (ii) Social Innovation Immersion Program (SIIP). • Startups and entrepreneurs are eligible for Category A under Component **Specific eligibility criteria include the following:** • Biotechnology Indian startups (less than 3 years old) • Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) – less than 3 years old • Indian academic scientists, researchers etc.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online Step 1: Visit the official BIRAC [website.](https://www.birac.nic.in/index.php) Step 2: Click on “[Login](https://www.birac.nic.in/login.php)/[Register](https://www.birac.nic.in/login_instructions_new.php?scheme_type=9)” on the website. Step 3: If you are a new user, select “New User? Click Here to Register” and enter the required details. Step 4: Complete the registration and activate your account through the verification email received from BIRAC. Step 5: After activation, log in using your registered username and password. Step 6: Check the SEED Fund section and identify the relevant BioNEST incubator through which the funding is offered. Step 7: Contact/approach the eligible SEED Fund partner incubator and follow its application process. Step 8: Submit the required startup details, documents, and proposal as instructed by the incubator/BIRAC. Step 9: After submission, the proposal will be evaluated as per the applicable SEED Fund guidelines.

metadata.schemeName: Post-Matric Scholarship To VJNT Students - Maharashtra
metadata.briefDescription: The Government of Maharashtra has introduced a scheme namely “Post-Matric Scholarship to VJNT students” to encourage the students of the Vimukta Jatis & Nomadic Tribes (VJNT) to undergo Post-Matric Courses.

page_content:
# Post-Matric Scholarship To VJNT Students - Maharashtra **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Maharashtra | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Student, Scholarship, Post-Matric, Vimukta Jatis & Nomadic Tribes | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Government of Maharashtra launched a scheme namely “Post-Matric Scholarship to VJNT students” vide G.R. No. EBC 1068/83567/57 dated 24.12.1970 in 1970. This scheme was started by the Government to encourage the student of the Vimukta Jatis & Nomadic Tribes (VJNT) to undergo Post-Matric higher education. Objective: 1. To encourage the VJNT students to undergo Post-Matric Courses. 2. Providing financial assistance for education. 3. Creating a passion for higher education. 4. Providing students the opportunity to go to the mainstream of education through education. Under this scheme, benefits of Tuition Fees, Exam Fees, and Maintenance Allowance are paid to only VJNT category students. All the eligible VJNT students are paid maintenance allowance from ₹ 90 to ₹ 190 per month for hostellers and ₹ 150 to ₹ 425 per month for day scholar students. ## Benefits All the Eligible students of VJNT are paid maintenance allowance as under: 1. If Applicant selects Course Group A - for hostlers ₹425/- p.m. & Day Scholars (Non-Hostlers) ₹190/- p.m. (Duration -Admission date to till exam completion date) 1. If Applicant selects Course Group B - for hostlers ₹290/- p.m. & Day Scholars (Non-Hostlers) ₹190/-p.m. (Duration - Admission date to exam completion date) 1. If Applicant selects Course Group C - for hostlers ₹290/- p.m. & Day Scholars (Non-Hostlers) ₹190/- p.m. (Duration - Admission date to till exam completion date) 1. If Applicant selects Course Group D - for hostlers ₹230/- p.m. & Day Scholars (Non-Hostlers) ₹120/- p.m. (Duration - Admission date to till exam completion date) 1. If Applicant selects Course Group E - for hostlers ₹150/- p.m. & Day Scholars (Non-Hostlers) ₹90/- p.m. (Duration - Admission date to till exam completion date) 1. Tuition Fees, Exam Fees, and Maintenance allowance are paid 100% to applicants who are studying in government /aided/non-aided institutions in professional courses and non-professional courses. 1. If the Applicant gets admission in a government hostel then he will be eligible for only 1/3rd amount of the hostler. 1. For B.Ed and D.Ed courses: 100 % benefit (Tuition Fees, Exam Fees, and Maintenance Allowance) is applicable for D.Ed, and B.Ed courses. For students studying in Aided, UnAided for D.Ed and B.Ed courses the Fee structure is applicable as per Government rates for the same course. **Note: If the applicant takes an admission on or before the 20th of any month should entitle date maintenance allowance will be issued for that current month. Otherwise, maintenance allowance will be entitled from next month.** ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The parent's/Guardian's annual income should be less than or equal to ₹1.50 Lac. 1. Applicants should belong to the VJNT category. 1. Applicants must be residents of Maharashtra. 1. Applicants must be pursuing the education course approved by the government from the class Post-Matric. 1. Maintenance allowance & exam fees are paid to the applicant if the applicant gets promoted to the next higher class. 1. If the applicant fails in a particular year then he will get the Tuition Fees, Exam Fees, and Maintenance allowance of that particular academic year but he/she will not get the benefit until he/she gets promoted to the next higher class. 1. Applicant should come through CAP round for only professional courses. 1. Only two children (i) any number of girl applicants allowed. ii) Boys applicant maximum 2 of the same parent) of the same parents will be eligible for the Scholarship. 1. 75 % attendance is mandatory for the current year. 1. The applicant will be eligible for a scholarship if he/she changes the course Non – Professional to Professional but he will not be eligible if he/she changes the course from Professional to Non – Professional. 1. Scholarships/freeship will continue until the applicant completes one course. Ex. - 11th, 12th Arts - B.A., M.A., M.Phil., P.H.D. If, the applicant completed B.A and B.Ed. course and later after taking admission for M.A., for M.A. course he/she will not be allowed for scholarship/freeship. But after admission to M.B.A. after B.Ed, it can be eligible for scholarship/freeship as it is a professional postgraduate course. 1. Applicant studying in particular professional/Non-Professional course and availing benefits of scholarship/freeship for that academic course and if he/she wants to change his existing Professional / Non-Professional course in between academic years he/she will not be eligible for freeship/scholarship for further course. ##### **Renewal Policy:** - Applicants have to pass the previous year's examination. - In the case of VJNT, if the applicant fails for a year then the applicant is not paid any reimbursement for that particular year. - For Group A – If an applicant pursuing the Group-A course fails in the examination for the 1st time the award may be renewed. For second & sub sequent failure in any class, the Applicant shall bear his / her own expenses until he/she secures promotion to the next higher class. - For Group B,C,D,E - he/she has to secure promotion to a higher class (For second & subsequent failure in any class the applicant shall bear his / her own expenses until he/she secures promotion to the next higher class.) - If due to any medical condition or due to any unforeseeable event the Applicant cannot appear in the annual examination, the headmaster of the college can approve or certify that if the Applicant would have appeared in the annual examination, he would have been able to pass the examination. This will be only allowed if the head of the institution is satisfied by the submission of medical proof or any other required sufficient proof that the Applicant presents to the college. ## Exclusions 1. Students engaged in full-time employment are not eligible. 1. Repeaters are not eligible for the scholarship for that standard. After passing they are eligible for higher standards. 1. No scholarship will be paid to the students under this scheme from the date he/she accepts another Scholarship/stipend.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/RegistrationLogin/RegistrationLogin **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](https://mahadbt2.maharashtra.gov.in/). Select your preferred language (Marathi or English) using the toggle at the top-right. **Step 2:** Register / Log In: If you are a first-time user, click Register and complete registration on MahaSarathi to get your Maha ID. Existing users: click Login > Citizen Login, select login method (Maha ID, Aadhaar, or without Maha ID), and enter the OTP sent to your registered mobile. **Step 3:** Find Your Scheme: After login, click the Apply for Scheme tab on your dashboard. Use the search bar or Department / Scheme Type filters to locate the scheme you wish to apply for. Click the Description icon to view eligibility criteria, or Download GRs for the official Government Resolution. **Step 4:** Start the Application: Click Apply next to the scheme. The portal will automatically verify your eligibility. If eligible, select the Academic Year from the dropdown and click Proceed to Apply. **Step 5:** Fill the Application Form: Complete all sections of the form. Fields marked * (asterisk) are mandatory. The Smart Auto-fill feature will pre-populate details from linked government databases — review them for accuracy and correct if needed. **Step 6:** Upload Documents: Attach all required certificates and supporting files. Each file must be in PDF, JPG, or JPEG format and must not exceed 5 MB. Ensure scans are clearly legible — blurry or cut-off documents will be rejected. **Step 7:** Save or Submit: Click Save as Draft to save progress and continue later. Click Preview Application to review before submitting. When ready, click Submit Application. An Application Reference Number (ARN) will be generated — note it down. **Step 8:** Track Your Application: Visit the [official portal](https://mahadbt2.maharashtra.gov.in/track-application). Log in and click My Applications to check real-time status. If you face any issue, click the Grievance tab to raise a complaint. > **User Manual:** [Click here](https://mahadbt2.maharashtra.gov.in/documents/20118/0/MahaDBT_Help_OnlineApplicationProcess.pdf/dcc8df78-9fda-6da1-e956-f66d13acc05b?t=1779625359203).

page_content:
# Virasat Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Minority Artisans, Handicraft Loan, Concessional Interest, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Virasat Yojana" by the Minorities Affairs Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to support minority artisans through providing loans of up to ₹10,00,000/- to the skilled individuals and groups belonging to minority communities.
## Benefits - **Loan Assistance:** Loan up to ₹10,00,000/- is provided to eligible applicants.- **Interest Rate For Male Applicants:** Loan is provided at 5% interest rate to male handicraft artisans.- **Interest Rate For Female Applicants:** Loan is provided at 4% interest rate to female handicraft artisans.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must belong to a minority community. - The applicant must be a handicraft artisan. - The applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹1,20,000 in urban areas. - The applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹98,000 in rural areas.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant must visit the office of the District Minority Welfare Officer of the concerned district, or may download the [application form](https://minority.rajasthan.gov.in/pdfdownload/01302019173751PMApplication_for_Business_Loan.pdf) through the official website. **Step 2:** The applicant must obtain the application form from the office. **Step 3:** The applicant must fill in the required details in the form. **Step 4:** The applicant must attach the required documents. **Step 5:** The applicant must submit the application form at the same office.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide concessional educational loans up to ₹30,00,000 to minority youth for pursuing technical, professional, and job-oriented courses in India and abroad.

page_content:
# Educational Loan Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Educational Loan, Technical Courses, Technical Courses, Study Abroad, Minority, Self Employment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Educational Loan Scheme" implemented by the Rajasthan Minority Finance & Development Co-operative Corporation under the Department of Minority Affairs and Waqf, Government aims to facilitate job-oriented education through providing concessional loans up to ₹30,00,000 to minority youth for technical and professional courses in India and abroad.
## Benefits - **Loan For Courses In India:** Loan up to ₹20,00,000 is provided. Maximum ₹4,00,000 per year for courses up to 5 years. - **Loan For Courses Abroad:** Loan up to ₹30,00,000 is provided.: Maximum ₹6,00,000 per year for courses up to 5 years. - **Interest Rate (Credit Line I):** The loan is provided at 3% per annum. - **Interest Rate (Credit Line II):** Male applicants are charged 8% per annum. Female applicants are charged 5% per annum. - **Moratorium Period:** 6 months after course completion or employment, whichever is earlier. - **Repayment Period:** The loan must be repaid within 5 years.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must belong to a notified minority community: Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Parsis, and Jains. - The applicant must be between 16 to 32 years of age. - The applicant must be enrolled in a recognised technical, professional, or job-oriented course. - The applicant’s annual family income must be as per the following criteria: 1. **In rural areas under Credit Line I:** Must not exceed ₹98,000. 1. **In urban areas under Credit Line I:** Must not exceed ₹1,20,000. 1. **Under Credit Line II:** Must not exceed ₹6,00,000.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant must visit the office of the District Minority Welfare Officer of the concerned district, or may download the [application form](https://minority.rajasthan.gov.in/pdfdownload/01302019173920PMApplication_for_Education_Loan-1.pdf) through the official website. **Step 2:** The applicant must obtain the application form from the office. **Step 3:** The applicant must fill in the required details in the form. **Step 4:** The applicant must attach the required documents. **Step 5:** The applicant must submit the application form at the same office.

# SAMRIDH – Startup Accelerators of MeitY for Product Innovation, Development & Growth **Ministry:** Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** SAMRIDH, Startups, Information Technology, Companies | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The SAMRIDH – Startup Accelerators of MeitY for Product Innovation, Development & Growth programme, under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India, supports startups by providing funding, acceleration, and mentorship to help them develop innovative technology products, scale their businesses, and succeed in the market. **OBJECTIVES** • The SAMRIDH scheme supports existing and upcoming Accelerators to select and accelerate potential IT-based startups to scale. • The programme focuses on accelerating the startup by providing customer connect, investor connect, and internationalisation connect services. • The Scheme supports selected Accelerators for extending Accelerator services to startup and provide funding.

## Benefits • To startups: An investment of up to ₹40 lakh to the beneficiary startup(with an average of ₹30 lakh per startup per cohort). An equal matching private investment by the accelerator / investor of up to ₹40 lakh is disbursed to startups based on their current valuation and growth stage. • To Accelerators: Accelerators develop customized acceleration programs to fit the needs of each startup in the cohort and provide services ranging from customer connect, investor connect, capacity enhancement, product enhancement etc. for which they are provided a budget of ₹2 lakh per startup to a maximum of ₹20 lakh per cohort.
## Eligibility Criteria • Accelerators – registered as Section 8 company under Companies Act 2013 or as Society under Societies Registration Act (not-for-profit). • IT-based startups.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online Step 1: Visit the official MeitY Startup Hub website: [MeitY Startup Hub](https://msh.meity.gov.in/) Step 2: Click on Startups and select [Register](https://msh.meity.gov.in/register) to create a new account. Step 3: Enter the required details such as First Name, Last Name, Mobile Number, Email ID, Password, and Confirm Password. Step 4: Click Register to create your MSH account. Step 5: After successful registration, go to the Login page. MSH Login Step 6: Enter your registered Email ID and Password and click Login. Step 7: After login, access the Startup section and complete/update your startup profile with the required information. Step 8: Check the available schemes, programmes, or startup opportunities and select the relevant one. Step 9: Fill in the required application details and upload the documents requested for the selected programme. Step 10: Review the information and submit the application. Keep the application/reference details for future use.

metadata.schemeName: Training and Proficiency in Computer Applications
metadata.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to provide one year of computer training to SC/ST/OBC, minority, single women, widows, and persons with disabilities to improve their skills for government or private sector jobs.

page_content:
# Training and Proficiency in Computer Applications **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Himachal Pradesh | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Training, Computer Applications, Person With Disabilities, Students, Institutions | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Training and Proficiency in Computer Applications scheme", implemented by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Himachal Pradesh, aims to provide one year of training in computer applications and related activities to candidates belonging to SC, ST, OBC, minority communities, single women, widows, and persons with disabilities through recognized institutions, enabling them to become eligible for employment in the government and private sectors.
## Benefits - Training fee up to ₹1,350/- per month (₹1,500/- per month for specially abled candidates). - Monthly scholarship of ₹1,000/- during the training period (₹1,200/- for specially abled candidates). - After training, a 6-month proficiency period with a scholarship of ₹1,500/- per month (₹1,800/- per month for specially abled candidates).
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh. 1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Other Backward Class (OBC), or minority communities. 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 35 years of age. 1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. In the absence of BPL candidates, the applicant should have a family annual income of less than ₹2,00,000/-. 1. The applicant should possess the minimum educational qualification required for computer training.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step1: Obtain the application form and apply through the concerned District Welfare Officer or Tehsil Welfare Officer. Step2: Attach all required documents and submit the completed application within 30 days of the advertisement published in the newspaper. Step3: Submit the application in person to the District Welfare Officer/Tehsil Welfare Officer for verification and further processing.

metadata.schemeName: Self Employment to Disabled
metadata.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to make persons with disabilities self-reliant by promoting self-employment. It is applicable to individuals whose disability is 40% or more and whose annual income does not exceed ₹1.60 lakh in rural areas and ₹2.00 lakh in urban areas.

page_content:
# Self Employment to Disabled **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Himachal Pradesh | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Self Employment, Disabilities, Development, Financial Support | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Self-Employment for Disabled Persons scheme, under the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Himachal Pradesh, aims to make persons with disabilities self-reliant through self-employment. It is applicable to individuals whose disability is 40% or more and whose annual income does not exceed ₹2,00,000/-.
## Benefits - Loans for starting small-scale units. - Subsidy of ₹10,000/- or 20% of project cost. - Promotes self-employment for disabled persons.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a person with a disability of 40% or more. 1. The applicant’s annual income should not exceed ₹1,60,000/- in rural areas and ₹2,00,000/- in urban areas.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 1: The applicant should fill out the prescribed application form with all required details and documents. Step 2: The completed form should be submitted to the Managing Director, Minority Finance and Development Corporation or the concerned District/Tehsil Welfare Officer.

metadata.schemeName: Health Component of Labour Welfare Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide health care facilities to the Beedi workers, Cine workers & Non-Coal Mine workers {i.e. Iron Ore Mines, Manganese Ore & Chrome Ore Mines (IOMC) workers, Limestone & Dolomite Mines (LSDM) workers and Mica Mines workers} and to their dependants.

page_content:
# Health Component of Labour Welfare Scheme **Ministry:** Ministry Of Labour and Employment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Health & Wellness, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Labour, Worker, Health, Hospital, Disease, Medical, Treatment, Surgery, Medicine | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme namely Health Component of the Labour Welfare Scheme was launched by the Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India. The scheme aims to provide accessible free, and quality healthcare services to the bonafide Beedi workers, Cine workers & non-coal mine workers and their dependents with a network of 258 Dispensaries and 11 Hospitals located across the Country. The scheme also provides reimbursement of the expenditure at the prescribed rates incurred for specialized treatment in the recognized Hospitals in case of critical diseases i.e. Cancer, Tuberculosis, Heart Diseases, Kidney Transplantation, Hernia, Appendectomy, Ulcer, Gynaecological diseases, Prostate diseases and other Minor diseases to the beneficiaries. > **Objectives** The Scheme contemplates to Provide accessible, affordable, and quality healthcare services and also reimbursement of the expenditure to the bonafide workers and their dependents for their treatment of the Cancer, Kidney Diseases, Heart Diseases, Tuberculosis, Hernia, Appendectomy, Ulcer, Gynaecological diseases, Prostrate diseases, Cataract and other Minor diseases including diagnostic test/ investigation. > **Target Beneficiaries** - Beedi workers including Gharkhhata workers - Cine workers - Non-Coal Mines Workers {i.e. Iron Ore Mines, Manganese Ore & Chrome Ore - Mines (IOMC) workers, Limestone & Dolomite Mines (LSDM) workers and - Mica Mines workers > **Scheme Components** - Comprehensive health care services for workers and their immediate dependents. - Outpatient Care: Free Consultations, diagnostics and Medicines provide through Labour Welfare's Dispensaries and Central Hospitals located across the Country, - Inpatient Care: OPD/IPD Services provide to workers and their family members through Labour Welfare's Central Hospitals located across the Country. - Mobile Medical Units (MMUs), an on-site health clinic for workers at underserved rural/remote areas. - Reimbursement Of expenditure for following specialized treatment under the recognized Impaneled Government/Private Hospital in case of critical diseases, as under
## Benefits > **Financial Benefits:** S. No. Critical DiseaseNature of Assistance1.CancerRe-imbursement of expenditure up to ₹7,50,000/- on treatment, medicines and diet charges incurred by workers, and their dependents. 2.Heart DiseasesRe-imbursement of expenditure up to ₹2,00,000/- on treatment, medicines and diet charges incurred by workers and their dependents. 3.Kidney Diseases Re-imbursement of expenditure up to ₹3,00,000/- on treatment, medicines and diet charges incurred by workers and their dependents including charges for dialysis.4.Minor diseases like Tuberculosis, Hernia, Appendectomy, Ulcer Gynaecological diseases, Prostrate diseases, Cataract and other Minor diseases including diagnostic test/investigation.Re-imbursement of expenditure up-to ₹40,000/- on treatment, medicines and diet charges incurred for each disease to workers and their dependents. - The actual expenditure on the above items as charged by the hospital authorities in respect beds in General ward should be computed by the welfare organization for the purpose of deterring.
## Eligibility Criteria **Eligibility Criteria for LWS beneficiaries for availing reimbursement facilities.** 1. The total income of worker from all sources not exceeding ₹21,000/- per month or ₹2,52,000/- per annum and up-to the age of 60 Years. 1. The worker, who has completed minimum of six months of continuous service in Beedi/Cine/Non-Coal Mines industries on the date of reports with diseases to medical officer of Labour Welfare Organization shall be eligible for the reimbursement of the expenditure incurred on the above-mentioned diseases. 1. The dependents of the workers will be allowed for the reimbursement of the expenditure incurred on their treatment on the above-mentioned diseases, if the worker who has completed minimum of One years of continuous service in Beedi/Cine/Non-Coal Mines industries on the date reports with diseases of his/her dependents to Medical officer of Labour Welfare Organization. 1. The workers who are eligible for re-imbursement from their employers or from any other government's health schemes shall not be eligible for re-imbursement under this scheme and every claim for reimbursement shall be accompanied by a certificate form the employer or self-declaration from worker that the claimant is not eligible for re-imbursement from the employer or from any Other Government's Health Schemes. 1. For the purposes of this Scheme worker's family means, - Wife/Husband; - dependent and unmarried Child/Children up-to the age of 21 years; - dependent father/mother. > **NOTE:** The term dependency means that family member's income from all sources, including pension, cannot exceed Rs. 9,000 plus the applicable Dearness Relief (DR) on it at the time of consideration. This applies to various dependent family members, including parents, children (including divorced/separated daughters), and siblings except spouse(s).
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline > **Application Process** **Step 1:** The attending Labour Welfare Organization's medical officer identifies a need for referral to the empanelled hospital based on:- - Unavailability of necessary diagnostic or therapeutic services. - Requirement for specialized care not available at the Labour Welfare's Dispensary or Hospital. - Patient's request, if LWO's Medical Officer satisfied himself/herself. - Emergency situations requiring higher-level care. **Step 2:** Workers and their dependent who undergoes specialized treatment in a recognized/Impaneled hospital shall seek permission form the concerned Welfare Commissioner through Medical Officer, LWO before getting admitted or test in the hospital by submitting the recommendation of the Doctors/Medical Officers of recognized/empanelled hospital to the Labour Welfare Organization certifying that the patient required specialized treatment in a hospital (to be specified). **Step 3:** The permission must be given to the beneficiary within 07 days of submission. **Step 4:** The reimbursement claim of the expenditure for specialized treatment in a recognized/empanelled hospital shall be submitted with the Welfare Commissioner within 06 Months from Discharge for Hospital or from the date of Test/investigation. **Step 5:** The Welfare Commissioner shall settle the claim up to his/her delegated financial powers within 30 days from the date of submission. **Step 6:** The permission request from the worker should be submitted in Form A and the request for reimbursement of treatment charges and subsistence allowance etc. should be submitted in Form B. > **Beneficiary Enrolment & Identification** - Dedicated Portal for Beneficiary database linked to Aadhaar/unique identification number for the workers for Health cards with QR code and biometric authentication, based on workers data and existing registered databases i.e. e-Shram Portal. - Centralized digital health management system with Mobile and online enrolment facilities, OPD/IPD Registration, E-claims processing and digital medical records via Next Gen e-Hospital.

metadata.schemeName: Fertigation, Foliar Fertilization and Automation
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote fertigation, foliar fertilization, and micro-irrigation automation by providing 75% subsidy for approved fertilizers, chemicals, and automation units to improve water-use efficiency, nutrient management, crop productivity, and quality.

page_content:
# Fertigation, Foliar Fertilization and Automation **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Fertigation, Foliar Fertilization, Automation, Drip Irrigation, Micro Irrigation, Water Soluble Fertilizer, Liquid Fertilizer | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Fertigation, Foliar Fertilization and Automation" scheme is implemented by the Horticulture Department, Government of Rajasthan. The scheme aims to promote efficient nutrient management and irrigation automation by providing a 75% subsidy on department-approved fertilizers, chemicals, and automation units to eligible farmers. It encourages the adoption of fertigation, foliar fertilization, and automation technologies in high-tech horticulture, protected cultivation, and open-field cultivation. The scheme helps improve fertilizer-use efficiency, water-use efficiency, crop productivity, crop quality, and reduces manual intervention through automated irrigation systems.
## Benefits > **Fertigation Support:** - **Subsidy:** 75% subsidy on department-approved water-soluble fertilizers and liquid fertilizers supplied under the project. > **Foliar Fertilization Support:** - **Subsidy:** 75% subsidy on department-approved fertilizers and chemicals for recommended crops. > **Automation Support:** - **Subsidy:** 75% subsidy on approved micro-irrigation automation units. > **Improved Nutrient Management:** - Nutrients are supplied directly to the crop root zone through the drip irrigation system. > **Better Crop Productivity:** - Improves crop yield and crop quality through efficient nutrient application. > **Water Efficiency:** - Ensures efficient utilization of available irrigation water. > **Labour Saving:** - Automation reduces the manual operation of irrigation and fertigation. > **Accurate Irrigation:** - Delivers water and nutrients in the required quantity at the required time.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The farmer should have land ownership/ land lease (minimum 10 years and registered at competent level). 1. Drip irrigation plant should be installed at the farmer's place. In cases of foliar fertilization, micro/mini sprinkler or fountain irrigation plant should be installed. 1. The farmer should have permanent means of irrigation. 1. The farmer should be growing vegetables/ flowers/ fruit gardens/ other crops on drip plant under hi-tech horticulture. 1. The farmer should agree to adopt the fertigation schedule as per the departmental instructions and recommendations under the project. 1. The subsidy for fertigation/foliar fertilization will be payable only on the recommended crops. 1. The subsidy on micro irrigation automation will be payable in both cases of protected cultivation and open cultivation.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](https://rajkisan.rajasthan.gov.in/rajkisanweb/login/2#searchmenu). **Step 2:** Click on "Login using SSO ID" or "Login using Jan Aadhaar ID". **Step 3:** Complete the online application form for the scheme. **Step 4:** Upload the required supporting documents. **Step 5:** Submit the application online. **Step 6:** The competent committee will verify the site suitability and documents. **Step 7:** After approval, the beneficiary may undertake construction according to prescribed standards. **Step 8:** Physical verification will be conducted after completion of the work. **Step 9:** Eligible subsidy will be released through DBT as per the prescribed installment pattern. > **Contact Us:** - [District Office](https://agriculture.rajasthan.gov.in/dam/#/sm/jankalyan-category-and-entry-type/372028/7/3/14). - [Regional Office](https://agriculture.rajasthan.gov.in/dam/#/sm/jankalyan-category-and-entry-type/372027/7/3/13).
**Mode:** Online - via CSC - **Mode of Application:** Online - **Mode of Online Application:** E-Mitra - Applicants can apply by visiting their nearest [E-Mitra](https://reportsemitraapp.rajasthan.gov.in/WebSrc/Reports/rpt_search_new_emitra_ksk.jsp) center or online through their own E-Mitra account.

metadata.schemeName: New Establishment of Fruit Orchards
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the establishment of new fruit orchards by providing subsidy assistance to farmers for plantation materials, drip irrigation, fertilizers, and plant protection chemicals.

page_content:
# New Establishment of Fruit Orchards **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Fruit Orchard, Orchard Establishment, Fruit Plantation, Subsidy, Drip Irrigation, High Density Plantation | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "New Establishment of Fruit Orchards" is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme implemented by the Horticulture Department, Government of Rajasthan with 60% Central Government funding and 40% State Government funding. The scheme aims to promote the establishment and expansion of new fruit orchards by providing subsidy assistance to eligible farmers. Financial assistance is available for approved fruit crops under the National Horticulture Mission based on prescribed unit costs. Subsidy is provided for plantation materials, fertilizers, plant protection chemicals, and drip irrigation, subject to the prescribed conditions and survival of plants. The subsidy is transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account through RTGS.
## Benefits > **Subsidy for High-Value Crop (Papaya):** - Subsidy up to ₹30,000/- per hectare (without drip irrigation integration). - Subsidy up to ₹80,000/- per hectare (with drip irrigation integration). - Assistance available for a maximum of 4 hectares per beneficiary. > **Subsidy for High Density Orchards:** - Financial assistance is available for approved crops such as Mango, Guava and Pomegranate. - Subsidy amount varies according to crop, spacing, and approved unit cost. - Maximum eligible area is 4 hectares per beneficiary. > **Subsidy for Normal Density Orchards:** - Financial assistance is available for Aonla, Ber, Citrus (Orange, Sweet Lime, Lemon), Guava, Mango, and Pomegranate. - Subsidy amount depends on crop and approved unit cost. - Maximum eligible area is 4 hectares per beneficiary. > **Additional Subsidy:** - An additional 25% Top-up Subsidy is available under the Mukhyamantri Krishak Saathi Yojana, increasing the subsidy limit from 50% to 75%, subject to scheme provisions. > **Tribal Area Benefit:** - Subsidy is available at 50% of the approved unit cost for Scheduled Tribe areas.
## Eligibility Criteria > The following categories of citizens are eligible for setting up new fruit orchards: 1. Farmers.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - via CSC **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](https://rajkisan.rajasthan.gov.in/rajkisanweb/login/2#searchmenu). **Step 2:** Click on "Login using SSO ID" or "Login using Jan Aadhaar ID". **Step 3:** Complete the online application form for the scheme. **Step 4:** Upload the required supporting documents. **Step 5:** Submit the application online. **Step 6:** The competent committee will verify the site suitability and documents. **Step 7:** After approval, the beneficiary may undertake construction according to prescribed standards. **Step 8:** Physical verification will be conducted after completion of the work. **Step 9:** Eligible subsidy will be released through DBT as per the prescribed installment pattern. > **Contact Us:** - [District Office](https://agriculture.rajasthan.gov.in/dam/#/sm/jankalyan-category-and-entry-type/372028/7/3/14). - [Regional Office](https://agriculture.rajasthan.gov.in/dam/#/sm/jankalyan-category-and-entry-type/372027/7/3/13).
