metadata.schemeName: Application for Subsidy on Winning National Award
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides subsidy support to applicants whose film/project has received a National Award in approved categories such as Best Film, Best Director, Best Actor (Male/Female), National Integration/Social Message, etc.

page_content:
# Application for Subsidy on Winning National Award **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Chhattisgarh | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Artists, Financial Assistance, Award, Director, Actor | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Application for Subsidy on Winning National Award" has been introduced by the Culture and Archaeology Department, Government of Chhattisgarh under the Chhattisgarh Film Policy 2021 to encourage and recognize film projects that achieve national-level excellence. This service provides subsidy support to eligible applicants whose film/project has received a National Award in approved categories such as Best Film, Best Director, Best Actor (Male/Female), National Integration/Social Message, etc.
## Benefits - A subsidy of up to ₹1.00 Crore may be provided to an eligible applicant. - The subsidy shall be granted only once in a year and for any one award category.

## Eligibility Criteria 1. An applicant shall be eligible for subsidy under this scheme if the film/project has received a National Award in any of the following approved categories: - Best Film - Best Director - Best Actor - Best Actress - National Integration - Social Message - Any other category approved under the scheme guidelines
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1: Portal Access and Login** The applicant (or the authorized operator) must visit the [Sewa Setu Portal](https://sewasetu.cgstate.gov.in/home?lang=en), and login using either their Citizen credentials or through the Lok Sewa Kendra (LSK) login system to proceed with the application. **Step 2: Application Submission** The user must navigate to the application form of the scheme that they wish to apply for. In the form, enter all the required details accurately. In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. Ensure that all documents are clear, legible, and in the accepted file format before uploading. Once all required documents are successfully uploaded and the entered information is verified by the applicant, they must finally submit the application. **Step 3: Application Reference Number Generation** The portal generates an Application Reference Number (ARN). The applicant should save the ARN for all future correspondence and status tracking regarding their submitted application. > **Post-Application Process:** **Step 1:** **Preliminary Verification by Film Facilitation Cell** The application is received online by the Film Facilitation Cell, where the submitted application details and supporting documents are examined for completeness and correctness. If any discrepancies are found, the application is returned to the applicant for necessary corrections. **Step 2:** **Approval process by Film Facilitation Cell** Based on the verification: If the application is found satisfactory, it is forwarded to the Deputy Director for further examination. If any discrepancies or deficiencies are identified, the application is returned to the applicant for correction. If the application is found ineligible, it may be rejected with recorded remarks. **Step 3:** **Examination by Deputy Director** The Deputy Director reviews the application, committee recommendations, and all supporting documents to assess eligibility and compliance with the applicable guidelines. **Step 4:** **Approval process by Deputy Director** Based on the examination, the Deputy Director may forward the application with recommendation to the Director for approval. If any required document is incomplete, the application is returned to the applicant for correction. If the application is found ineligible, it is rejected with suitable remarks. **Step 5:** **Review by Director** The Director scrutinizes the application, recommendations, and supporting documents to ensure that all requirements have been fulfilled and that the case is suitable for approval. **Step 6:** **Final approval by Director** Based on the review: If approved, the Director applies the Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) through the system. If additional information or documents are required, the application is returned to the applicant for correction. If the application does not meet the prescribed criteria, it is rejected with remarks. **Step 7:** **Generation of Digitally Signed Sanction Order** Upon approval, a Digitally Signed Sanction Order is generated through the system using the Director's Digital Signature Certificate (DSC). **Step 8:** **Issuance of Sanction Order** The approved Digitally Signed Sanction Order is issued and made available to the applicant through the system. Upon issuance of the Sanction Letter, the Chairman, Chhattisgarh Film Vikas Nigam, is also informed. **Step 9:** **Disbursement of Subsidy through DBT** After issuance of the Sanction Order, the approved subsidy amount is processed through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mechanism and transferred to the beneficiary's registered bank account. **Step 10:** **Application Closure** After successful issuance of the Sanction Order and completion of all processing formalities, the application status is updated as Completed and the case is formally closed.

metadata.schemeName: Centenaries and Anniversaries Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to identify, support, and commemorate centenaries and special anniversaries of eminent personalities and events of historical and national importance under approved Commemorations.

page_content:
# Centenaries and Anniversaries Scheme **Ministry:** Ministry Of Culture | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Grant In Aid, Financial Assistance, Commemorate Centenaries, Eminent Personalities Anniversaries, Historical Events, National Events | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Centenaries and Anniversaries Scheme" by the C&M Division, Ministry of Culture, Government of India, aims to identify, support, and commemorate centenaries and special anniversaries of eminent personalities and events of historical and national importance under approved Commemorations. Through this scheme, grant-in-aid financial assistance is provided to the eligible ministries, departments, autonomous bodies, state/union territory governments, non-governmental organisations, and registered trusts to organise approved commemorative events and programs. The scheme is implemented by the C&M Division, Ministry of Culture, Government of India.
## Benefits The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of Grant-in-Aid (General) to organise approved commemorative Events, Programs, and Major Activities. > **Tangible Benefits and Intended Use:** 1. Monetary Grant-in-Aid: Funding is provided out of the allocated budget under the Centenaries and Anniversaries Scheme to cover the approved cost or actual cost of completion of the events, programs, or activities (whichever is less). 1. The total continuing budget outlay of the scheme is ₹750.00 Crores (allocated as ₹150 Crores per year for five financial years from 2026-27 to 2030-31, extending up to 31 March 2031). > **Conditions and Criteria Associated with the Benefits:** 1. The grant shall not be utilised for any purpose other than the purpose for which it is released. 1. In the case of Non-Governmental Organisations (NGOs) and Trusts, the implementing organisation must contribute a minimum of 30% of the approved program/event cost. 1. For Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs) and Trusts, proposals will only be considered if the program/event ensures a participation of a minimum of 500 public members. 1. Artist honorariums and payments must be made directly through Digital Benefit Transfer (DBT)/bank transfer. Cash payments are not permitted. 1. If any released funds are not utilised, the grantee institution shall refund the unutilised funds along with interest at the rate of 10 per cent. 1. No permanent construction, capital projects, civil works, or infrastructure works can be funded under this scheme (as these are subsumed under the "DESH" Scheme). 1. Any additional expenditure in program cost due to any reason must be met by the concerned organisation, as the financial liability of the Ministry of Culture remains unaltered as approved in the original program. > **Mode of Disbursement:** - Disbursements are made electronically. - Grants are released based on balances available in the Public Financial Management System (PFMS) as per the Expenditure-Advance-Transfer (EAT) module data. - Payments are made directly to the vendor(s) or beneficiary(ies) in their Aadhaar Seeded Account. > **Frequency and Split of Disbursement:** - **For Central Government, State Governments, and Autonomous Organisations:** - **First Instalment:** 75% of the grant-in-aid is released after the completion of all formalities for sanction of funds as per the approved Standard Operating Procedure (SoP). - **Second/Final Instalment:** The remaining 25% of the grant-in-aid is released after the completion of the events/programs and after completing all required formalities. - **For Non-Governmental Organisations (NGOs), Individuals, and Other Organisations:** - **First Instalment:** 60% of the grant-in-aid is released after the completion of all formalities for sanction of funds as per the approved Standard Operating Procedure (SoP). - **Second/Final Instalment:** The remaining 40% of the grant-in-aid is released after the completion of the events/programs and after completing all required formalities. > **Expected Time of Disbursement:** - The sanction letter in each case will be issued within 5 working days after receiving the concurrence of the Internal Finance Division (IFD). - For the release of subsequent instalments (Second Instalment), the grantee must submit the Utilisation Certificate, audited statement of accounts, progress report, and photographs/videos. For private trusts/societies, these must be submitted within 3 months from the date of release of the First Instalment.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a Government of India Ministry, Department, or their organisation. 1. The applicant must be a State Government or Union Territory Government Department. 1. The applicant must be an Autonomous Body. 1. The applicant must be a University or Educational Institution. 1. The applicant must be a Registered Society or Trust. 1. The applicant must be a Non-Governmental Organisation (NGO). 1. The applicant must be an institution or organisation associated with organising approved commemorative events and programmes. 1. The applicant must submit proposals that clearly establish a linkage with the approved commemoration theme, personality, or event. 1. The applicant must register itself on the Public Financial Management System (PFMS) of the Ministry of Finance, creating vendor(s)/beneficiary(ies) in the EAT/FAT module. 1. The applicant (in the case of Private Institutions and NGOs) must be registered under the NGO-Partnership System (NGO-PS) DARPAN portal of NITI Aayog. 1. The applicant (in the case of Private Institutions and NGOs) must be registered under the PFMS portal of the Ministry of Finance and must have a registration number issued by the concerned authority.
## Exclusions 1. Proposals involving infrastructure works, permanent construction, civil works, or other capital projects are excluded and shall not be considered under this scheme (as they are subsumed under the "DESH" Scheme). 1. Proposals received less than 45 days prior to the event date (or less than 30 days for Government/Autonomous bodies) will not ordinarily be considered, except under exceptional circumstances with recorded justification and competent authority approval.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** **Check the Approved Commemorations List:** - The applicant must first verify if their proposed program aligns with an ongoing or new commemoration approved by the National Implementation Committee (NIC). - The details of approved ongoing commemorations can be checked on the websites [https://culture.gov.in/](https://culture.gov.in/). **Step 2: Download and Review the Official Guidelines:** - The applicant must download and carefully read the following essential documents from the official website before submitting a proposal: - Scheme Guidelines – Centenaries and Anniversaries Scheme - Standard Operating Procedure (SoP) - Checklist of Documents **Step 3: Register on Mandatory Portals:** - **For Private Institutions and NGOs:** The applicant must be registered under the NGO-Partnership System (NGO-PS) DARPAN portal of Niti Aayog at [http://ngo.india.gov.in](http://ngo.india.gov.in) and obtain a Unique Identification Number.- **For All Applicants:** The applicant must register on the Public Financial Management System (PFMS) portal of the Ministry of Finance at [http://pfms.nic.in](http://pfms.nic.in). The applicant must implement the EAT (Expenditure-Advance-Transfer) Module and create its vendor/beneficiary details. **Step 4: Prepare the Proposal and Document Package:** - The applicant must compile a comprehensive proposal that clearly establishes a linkage with the approved commemoration theme, personality, or event. - The proposal package must include: - A detailed concept note highlighting historical and national significance. - Proposed activities, implementation plan, date, venue, and a minute-to-minute program schedule (including a mandatory day-wise structure if the program exceeds 1 day). - An item-wise estimated budget financial requirement. - All mandatory institutional documents (such as the Registration Certificate, PAN Card, last 3 financial years' Audited Accounts Statement, Bank Authorisation letter, Resolution, and Indemnity bond). - Documentary proof of a minimum 30% co-contribution (applicable only for NGOs and Trusts). **Step 5:** **Submit the Application Form and Proposal (Hard Copy):** - The applicant must send the complete proposal along with all prescribed documents to the official physical submission address: > Ministry of Culture, > Akam Secretariat, > 3rd Floor, > Janpath Hotel Building, > Janpath, New Delhi - 110001 - **Submission Timelines:** - **For NGOs and Trusts:** The complete proposal must be submitted a minimum of 45 days prior to the commencement of the proposed event date. - **For Government Ministries/Departments/Autonomous Bodies:** The proposal must be submitted a minimum of 30 days prior to the commencement of the proposed event date. **Step 6: Tracking and Scrutiny of the Application:** - Once received, each proposal is assigned a Unique Registration number. - The C&M Division will maintain a register tracking the status (under scrutiny, approved, rejected, or pending) and will display it monthly on [http://amritkaal.nic.in](http://amritkaal.nic.in). - The Commemoration Division will scrutinise the proposal for eligibility, completeness, and compliance within 7 working days. **Step 7: Rectify Deficiencies (If Communicated):** - If the proposal is found incomplete or deficient, the gaps will be communicated to the applicant. The applicant must comply and submit the missing details within: - 10 days for general events/activity proposals. - 15 days for proposals that include exhibitions or documentation. - Note: Failure to comply within the prescribed time may result in the closure of the proposal. **Step 8: Evaluation and Final Approval Technical Evaluation:** - Complete proposals are sent to the Expert Technical Committee (ETC), which reviews them based on relevance, technical feasibility, quality, public participation potential, and budget reasonableness within 15 days. - Committee Consideration: Recommended proposals are placed before the Commemoration Committee (CC) within 5 days of the ETC meeting for final budget examination and approval. - Sanction Issuance: Following the committee's nod, administrative approval is completed within 5 days, and a formal sanction letter is issued within 5 working days after receiving the concurrence of the Internal Finance Division (IFD). **Step 9: Receive First Instalment and Execute the Event** - Upon sanction, the first instalment of funds is electronically disbursed through PFMS directly into the applicant's account. - Central/State Governments and Autonomous bodies receive 75% as the first instalment. - NGOs, individuals, and other organisations receive 60% as the first instalment. - The organisation must then execute the commemorative events and programs as scheduled. **Step 10: Submit Post-Event Documents for Final Settlement** - After organising the event, the applicant must submit the final documents to the Ministry to claim the subsequent balance instalment (25% for government bodies; 40% for NGOs/Trusts). - The required closing documents include the Utilisation Certificate (UC) in the proper format, an audited statement of actual accounts/expenditure, a progress report, and supporting photographs or video clips. For private trusts and societies, these must be furnished within 3 months from the date of release of the first instalment.

page_content:
# Bal Yuwa Kirtankar Festival **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Festival, Children, Boys Girls, Academy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Bal-Yuwa Kirtankar Festival is a biannual event organized by the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Goa, aimed at encouraging children and young performers up to 16 years old to promote the traditional art of Kirtan. Selection of participants is conducted by Kala Academy and Haribhakt Parishad, Goa. Selected performers receive cash remuneration for their performances along with reimbursement of actual transport fares. ## Benefits **Bal Category:** - First Prize ₹ 5,000/- - Second Prize ₹ 3,000/- - Third Prize ₹ 2,000/- - 3 Consolation prizes of ₹ 1,000/- each **Yuva Category:** - First Prize ₹ 7,000/- - Second Prize ₹ 5,000/- - Third Prize ₹ 3,000/- - 3 Consolation prizes of ₹ 2,000/- each **Assistance available** : ₹ 500/- per performance/transport fare.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. **The Bal applicant:** Boys and girls aged 7 to 14 years are eligible to participate.1. **The Yuva applicant:** Boys and girls aged 15 to 21 years are eligible to participate.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Visit Kala Academy Goa and obtain the application form free of charge. **Step 2:** Complete the form and submit it to the Member Secretary, Kala Academy Goa within the specified deadline. **Step 3:** For any issues or complaints, contact the Member Secretary or Chairman of Kala Academy Goa.

metadata.schemeName: Area Expansion of Spices
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the expansion of new areas under spice cultivation by providing subsidy on eligible agricultural inputs to farmers.

page_content:
# Area Expansion of Spices **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Spices Cultivation, Horticulture Department, Input Subsidy, Seed Subsidy, National Horticulture Mission | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Area Expansion of Spices" is a centrally sponsored scheme implemented by the Horticulture Department, with 60% funding from the Central Government and 40% funding from the State Government, aims to promote the expansion of new areas under spice cultivation through providing subsidy on eligible agricultural inputs to farmers. The scheme supports cultivation only in areas where spice crops were not grown during the previous year. Farmers are provided with a crop-specific package of practices, literature and assistance for eligible inputs such as seeds, integrated nutrient management, and integrated pest and disease management. Subsidy is available for a minimum area of 0.50 hectares and a maximum area of 4 hectares. The scheme is delivered online through e-Mitra, and the implementation timeline is 180 days.
## Benefits > **Input Subsidy:** - Subsidy is provided for the expansion of new area under spice crops. - Subsidy is available on eligible inputs such as seeds, integrated nutrient management inputs, and integrated pest and disease management inputs. - The total eligible input cost considered is ₹13,750/- per hectare. - The subsidy is 40% of the eligible input cost, subject to a maximum of ₹5,500/- per hectare. > **Package of Practices:** - Farmers are provided with a leaflet/literature containing the package of practices for the respective spice crop. > **Seed and Input Supply:** - Seeds/tubers and seed treatment chemicals/bio-agents taken as prophylactic measures, along with demonstration inputs, are supplied after obtaining the farmer's 60% contribution. - Fertilizers, plant protection materials, and other eligible inputs are made available through cooperative institutions on a 40% subsidized rate against a permit issued by the Agriculture Supervisor/Assistant Agriculture Officer/Agriculture Officer.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a farmer.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - via CSC - **Mode of Application:** Online - **Mode of Online Application:** E-Mitra - Applicants can apply by visiting their nearest [E-Mitra](https://reportsemitraapp.rajasthan.gov.in/WebSrc/Reports/rpt_search_new_emitra_ksk.jsp) center or online through their own E-Mitra account. > **Note:** Applying for "Area Expansion of Spices" is free.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support both individual farmers and WSHGs in setting up broiler farms with a subsidy. Through this scheme, subsidy support is provided for the establishment and recurring costs to eligible beneficiaries.

page_content:
# Pranee Sampad Samrudhhi Yojana: Support to farmers for Broiler farming (500/1000/1500/2000/2500/3000 birds capacity) in Deep litter System in individual and WSHG mode **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Odisha | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Broiler Farming, Poultry Development, Deep Litter System, Women Self Help Group, DBT | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Support to farmers for Broiler farming (500/1000/1500/2000/2500/3000 birds capacity) in Deep litter System in individual and WSHG mode” was launched by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, Government of Odisha under sub scheme "Poultry Development" of Prani Sampad Samrudhhi Yojana (PSSY). It aims to support both individual farmers and WSHGs for setting up of Broiler farms with a capacity of 500/1000/1500/2000/2500/3000 birds with 60–80% subsidy. Through this scheme, subsidy support is provided for the establishment of a poultry shed, disposal pit, carcass, litter disposal pit, and recurring cost for one Broiler 500 birds’ capacity to eligible beneficiaries. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services. It is planned to cover 7900 individual farmers during the year. Broiler farms with a capacity of 500 birds in individual mode in a deep litter system with Rs. 1.8 lakh as the unit cost is taken as one unit, and accordingly, higher capacities are considered in multiple units. > **Objectives** 1. To strengthen the local Poultry Production System for enhancing livelihoods and also for the generation of additional income among the members of WSHG and individual farmers through broiler meat production. 1. To support the nutritional requirements of the people through the consumption of animal protein. 1. To build the capacity of the farmers for undertaking broiler farming in a deep litter system as a profitable mini-enterprise. 1. To create self-employment for unemployed youth, particularly in rural areas. 1. To improve the economic status of the rural underprivileged.
## Benefits ##### Capital Subsidy (If Opted for Shed) - Broiler 500 birds capacity is considered as one unit with a unit cost of ₹1,80,000/-. PWD (min. 40% disability) individuals @60% of the recurring cost₹0.8 Lakh/-₹0.48 Lakh/-Subsidy to General male @50% of the recurring cost₹0.8 Lakh/-₹0.40 Lakh/-> **Disbursement of Funds:** 1. The subsidy amount shall be released as back ended subsidy to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary/WSHG through the Direct Benefit Transfer mode only. 1. Frequency of Disbursement: - Two installments (50% + 50%) for the capital subsidy (if opting for the shed). - Single installment for recurring cost (if not opted for the shed). 1. Expected Time of Disbursement - After the construction of the poultry shed, the disposal pit, carcass, and litter disposal pit, and after induction of chicks (for capital subsidy). - After the construction of the disposal pit, carcass, litter disposal pit, and induction of chicks (for recurring cost).
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident/domicile of the state of Odisha. 1. The applicant must be an individual farmer or a Women Self Help Group. 1. The applicant may set up a broiler farm of 500/1000/1500/2000/2500/3000 bird capacity as per their own choice. 1. The applicants belonging to the SC, ST, Women, Transgender & PWD (minimum 40% disability) category are eligible for 60% subsidy of the unit cost. 1. The applicant belonging to the General male category is eligible for 50% of the unit cost. 1. The applicant must have land for the establishment of a broiler unit. The proposed site must be verified by the Block Level Inspection Team. 1. The applicant belonging to Transgender persons must enclose the certificate issued by the District Magistrate as per “The Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019”. 1. The applicant belonging to Persons with Disabilities must enclose disability certificate issued by the competent authority indicating 40% or more disability. 1. The applicant must have Aadhaar linked bank account for the release of subsidy through the Direct Benefit Transfer mode. > **Preference / Priority / Reservation / Relaxation** 1. The target can be interchangeable among the reserved categories. 1. In case of non-availability of a beneficiary in the reserved category, the target can be interchangeable with the General category. 1. Beneficiaries will be selected on first come first serve basis.
## Exclusions 1. Those WSHG who have availed subsidies previously or are on the verge of getting subsidies in similar types of schemes of the Government of India or the State Government shall not be included under this scheme. 1. If the individual member of WSHG has availed a subsidy under this scheme as a member of WSHG in Group mode during 2022-23,2023-24 & 2024-25 or the prior year, then they will not be eligible to take up the scheme individually. 1. If any member of one family gets the benefit as a member of WSHG, then the other family member cannot avail the benefit under the scheme as a group activity. 1. A family will not be eligible for subsidy under the same scheme if any of its members has got subsidy during the last three years.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant interested in availing of the subsidy shall apply to the [Go-Sugam Portal](https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/home/scheme-list) through a registration process by submitting the requisite documents. **Step 2:** Visit the official website: [https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/home](https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/home) **Step 3:** Click on “Apply” and then click on “Register Now” **Step 4:** On the registration page, fill in the mandatory details (Name, Email, Mobile Number, Address, and Password) and click on "Register". The login credentials will be sent to your registered Email ID / Mobile Number. > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the official website: [https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/home](https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/home) **Step 2:** Click on “Scheme & Services” and then select the scheme by its name. **Step 3:** Click “Apply” and log in. [https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/citizen-portal/login](https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/citizen-portal/login) **Step 4:** On the application page, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload the required documents in the appropriate file size and file type. metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide welfare benefits, including old-age pension, and financial assistance, to eligible registered construction workers through the Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

page_content:
# Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB): Old-Age Pension **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Mizoram | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Construction Workers, Labour Welfare, Old Age Pension | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Old-Age Pension" under the Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB) is implemented by the Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Government of Mizoram to provide welfare benefits to eligible registered construction workers. The Board has been constituted under the Building and Other Construction Workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act, 1996, and a Welfare Fund has been established for eligible members. Eligible Indian citizens aged 18 to 60 years who has been engaged as a construction worker for at least 90 days in a year may apply for membership. Registered members may receive old-age pension, and financial assistance based on the applicable conditions.
## Benefits > **Old-Age Pension:** - A member attaining 60 years of age is entitled to a monthly pension of ₹1,000/-. - A minimum membership period of 3 years is required to qualify for the pension. - The member must submit a Life Certificate every April to confirm continued eligibility. > **Pension to Surviving Spouse:** - In the event of the death of a pensioner, 50% of the monthly pension then in payment may continue to be paid to the surviving spouse.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an Indian citizen. - The applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age. - The applicant must have been engaged as a construction worker for at least 90 days in a year. - The applicant must be engaged as a contractor or employee in one of the covered categories of construction work. > **Contractors or employees engaged in the following categories of work:** 1. Carpenter 2. Mason 3. Cement Mason 4. Painter 5. Helper (Construction Works) 6. Electrician 7. Wireman 8. Fitter 9. Welder 10. Plumber 11. Iron and Aluminium Worker 12. Blacksmith 13. Lumberjack 14. Sand Extraction Worker 15. Stone Quarry Worker 16. Stone Breaker 17. Road and Earthwork Labourer 18. JCB/Dozer Operator 19. Construction Machine Operator 20. Construction Driver 21. Brick Factory Worker > **Membership Fee:** - A one-time Registration Fee of ₹25/- shall be payable at the time of enrolment. - A monthly subscription of ₹10/- is payable to maintain active membership. Alternatively, an advance payment of ₹120/- may be made to cover one year's subscription. - Members wishing to pay the Membership/Renewal Fee in advance may do so for a period of up to three (3) years. - Membership must be renewed within one (1) year from the date of expiry, in accordance with [Section 17 of the BOCW (RE&CS) Act, 1996](https://lesde.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2024/05/bbadc4155d1796a962f3883e14e4cc9c/pages-145-bocw-recs-act-1996.pdf).
## Exclusions - Workers who are already registered under any other State/Union Territory Welfare Board in India shall not be eligible for membership under this Board.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Eligible registered members of the Welfare Board may apply for the respective welfare schemes by submitting the prescribed scheme-specific application form, duly filled in and accompanied by the requisite supporting documents, through the prescribed offline mode. **Step 2:** The application forms and supporting documents shall be as specified by the Welfare Board for the respective scheme/benefit. - **Application Form for Registration under the Board**: [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2023/06/70c9592db154bfccb04514f40e9b5ea8/pages-103-registration-form.pdf).- **Application Form for Old-Age Pension**: [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2024/01/14e90c69e5c39890dd3e562a28c2ae9d/pages-103-lic-pension-claim-form.pdf). > **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/page/whom-to-contact).

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kamdhenu Yojana: Cash Incentive Sub-scheme for Dairy Farmers
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to empower dairy farmers pouring milk at MPCS by providing additional income opportunities, ensuring a balanced milk supply for OMFED during lean seasons. Through this scheme, 1,25,000 milk-pouring members of MPCS under OMFED are expected to benefit.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Kamdhenu Yojana: Cash Incentive Sub-scheme for Dairy Farmers **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Odisha | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Dairy Farmers Incentive, Milk Producers Cooperative Societies, Milk Pouring Subsidy, Lean Season Support, DBT | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Cash Incentive Sub-scheme for Dairy Farmers" was launched by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, Odisha, under Mukhyamantri Kamdhenu Yojana (MKY). It aims to empower dairy farmers pouring milk at MPCS by providing additional income opportunities, ensuring a balanced milk supply for OMFED during lean seasons, and supporting the working capital needs of the dairy farmers. Through this scheme, cash incentives will be provided to the dairy farmers who pour milk at MPCS during the lean season, i.e., from 1st September to 28th February. The scheme is implemented through OMFED. The scheme aims to benefit 1,25,000 milk pourer members of MPCS under OMFED. All MPCS members supplying milk on a regular basis during the lean season (September to February) to Milk Producers Cooperative Societies (MPCS) are eligible for getting the benefit. The incentive amount will be directly transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of milk pourers through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT through Aadhaar Enabled Payments System). > **Objectives** 1. To empower dairy farmers pouring milk at MPCS by providing additional income opportunities, ensuring a balanced milk supply for OMFED during lean seasons, and supporting the working capital needs of the dairy farmers.
## Benefits > **Cash Incentive for Milk Poured at MPCS** **No. of Days Milk Poured (Out of 180 Days)****Incentive (₹/Ltr.)**60–89 days₹1.0090–119 days₹2.00120–149 days₹3.00150–179 days₹4.00180 days &amp; above₹5.00> **Disbursement of Funds:** 1. The incentive amount will be directly transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of milk pourers. (DBT through Aadhaar Enabled Payments System). 1. The amount will be released every 3 months, i.e., in 2 phases over the span of 6 months, based on the number of days poured and the quantity of milk poured by the dairy farmer: - Phase 1: December (for September to November collection) - Phase 2: March (for December to February collection)
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident/domicile of Odisha. 1. The applicant should be a regular pouring member of Milk Producers Cooperative Society (MPCS). 1. The applicant should be supplying milk to MPCS during the lean season (1st September to 28th February). 1. The applicant should supply the required standard of milk without any attempt at adulteration. 1. The applicant should keep the milk passbook up to date regularly. 1. The applicant should submit the correct name, membership number, and Aadhaar-linked bank details. 1. The applicant should be a milk pourer member of MPCS under OMFED.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The MPCS member who wants to avail the benefits of the scheme shall submit a copy of his/her Aadhaar card and a copy of the first page of his/her bank passbook to the MPCS Secretary. **Step 2:** MPCS shall compile eligible farmer-wise milk collection details and prepare the data in the prescribed format as attached in Annexure-I, including verified Aadhaar and bank details. **Step 3:** The Society Secretary shall send the compiled and filled Excel sheet to the respective Milk Union, and the General Manager, Milk Union, shall verify and send the countersigned copy to the P&I Division of OMFED. **Step 4:** OMFED will create a platform in which these details will be filled, and a milk pourers database will be created with verified Aadhaar and bank details. **Step 5:** Milk Unions must submit the data to OMFED headquarters on a monthly basis, and the progressive incentive amount will be calculated for Phase-1 and Phase-2 at the OMFED headquarters by P&l section (in December for Phase 1, i.e., Sept to Nov collection & in March for Phase-2, i.e., Dec to Feb collection) and then submitted to the finance section of OMFED for disbursal of the incentive amount to Aadhaar linked bank account of the farmer. > **Note:** 1. Eligible farmer-wise milk collection details must be submitted in the prescribed format attached as [Annexure-I of the guideline](https://fard.odisha.gov.in/sites/default/files/2025-09/Cash%20Incentive%20sub%20scheme%20for%20Dairy%20Farmers%20under%20MKY.pdf). 1. Data compilation, verification, and submission to OMFED must strictly follow the prescribed reporting format and verification process.

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kamdhenu Yojana: Female Calf Rearing Sub-scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the scientific rearing of female calves to increase productivity and strengthen the dairy sector. Through this scheme, calf feed assistance is provided to eligible beneficiaries for rearing selected female calves.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Kamdhenu Yojana: Female Calf Rearing Sub-scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Odisha | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Female Calf Rearing Support, Dairy Farmers, Calf Feed Assistance, Dairy Productivity Enhancement | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Female Calf Rearing Sub-Scheme (FCRS)" was launched by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, Odisha, under Mukhyamantri Kamdhenu Yojana. It aims to promote the scientific rearing of female calves to increase productivity and strengthen the dairy sector in the State. Through this scheme, assistance in the form of calf feed support is provided to eligible beneficiaries for rearing selected female calves. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, Odisha, Cuttack, through the Chief District Veterinary Officers and OMFED. The assistance is provided in a phased manner for the rearing of female calves from birth up to a specified age as per guideline provisions. Selection, verification, and monitoring are carried out through Block Veterinary Officers and Chief District Veterinary Officers. The scheme provides support for a fixed number of calves per beneficiary as specified in the guideline. > **Objectives** 1. To enable the dairy farmers to protect and nourish female calves for better growth. 1. Provision of adequate health care & in time de-worming. 1. To sustain the improved germ-plasm created through genetic up-gradation. 1. To reduce delayed maturity in graded heifers through supplementation of balanced feed. 1. To encourage dairy farmers to adopt scientific management of calves.
## Benefits 1. **Calf Feed Support:** Provision of **1400** kg of concentrate calf feed per calf in 8 phases at **50**% subsidized cost through OMFED. The calf feed will be provided through Milk Producers Cooperative Societies (MPCS) for areas where MPCS is present or through Block Veterinary Officer (BVO) / Livestock Inspector (LI) for areas where MPCS is not present. 1. **Insurance Coverage:** The female calves booked under the scheme will be insured with **100**% subsidy for 2 years, with an insured value of ₹**15,000**/- per calf. 1. **Health Support:** The calves will be provided with routine de-worming and vaccination free of cost. > **Disbursement of Benefits:** 1. Calf feed is supplied physically in 8 phases at 50% subsidized cost through OMFED. The insurance premium is borne fully by the Government for two years. 1. The frequency of the disbursement of Calf feed is provided in 8 phases during the rearing period.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident/domicile of Odisha. 1. The applicant should be a dairy farmer. 1. The applicant should possess eligible female calves born through Artificial Insemination (AI). 1. The applicant should have female calves between 3 & 8 months of age at the time of selection under the scheme. 1. The applicant is eligible to avail the benefit for a maximum of 2 female calves per year for female calves born from a Crossbred (CB) cow through AI. 1. The applicant is eligible to avail the benefit for a maximum of 4 female calves per year for female calves born from non-descript/indigenous/graded cow through AI. > **Preference / Priority / Reservation / Relaxation** 1. Preference should be given to ST, SC, PWD, Women, Transgender & Small/ Marginal farmer and MPCS members while selecting beneficiaries.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant interested in availing of the subsidy shall apply to the Go-Sugam Portal through a registration process by submitting the requisite documents. **Step 2:** Visit the official website: [https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/home](https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/home) **Step 3:** Click on “Apply” and then click on “Register Now” **Step 4:** On the registration page, fill in the mandatory details (Name, Email, Mobile Number, Address, and Password) and click on "Register". The login credentials will be sent to your registered Email ID / Mobile Number. > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the official website: [https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/home](https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/home) **Step 2:** Click on “Scheme & Services” and then select the scheme by its name. **Step 3:** Click “Apply” and log in. [https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/citizen-portal/login](https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/citizen-portal/login) **Step 4:** On the application page, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload the required documents in the appropriate file size and file type. Upon successful submission of the application, the applicant will get an Application Reference ID. > **Check Application Status:** **Step 1:** Click on the “Track Status” link on the menu. **Step 2:** Enter the Application ID or Mobile Number to get the application status. > **Further Processing & Implementation Steps:** **Step 1:** All willing dairy farmers, i.e., members of Milk Producers Cooperative Societies (MPCS) or non-MPCS members having a female calf born out of Artificial Insemination (AI), shall mandatorily apply through the GO-SUGAM portal. After receipt of the application, a joint verification shall be conducted by the Block Veterinary Officer (BVO), the concerned Livestock Inspector/Veterinary Technician, and the MPCS Secretary (where applicable). Verification regarding the birth of the calf out of AI shall be confirmed through the [Bharat Pashudhan Portal](https://bharatpashudhan.ndlm.co.in/). **Step 2:** The consolidated list of applicants in the prescribed format, placed at Annexure-II, duly signed by the MPCS Secretary (where applicable), BVO, and Livestock Inspector/Veterinary Technician, shall be submitted to the concerned Chief District Veterinary Officer (CDVO) for final selection during the District Level Committee (DLC) meeting. Beneficiaries shall be selected on first come first serve basis if applications exceed the target, with priority based on the age of the calf. **Step 3:** On approval by the DLC, the CDVO shall issue a Go-ahead letter and share the approved list with OMFED, General Manager (Milk Union), concerned BVOs, and MPCS Secretaries. The BVO/VAS/AVAS shall facilitate tagging (if not done earlier), insurance (insured value ₹15,000/-), de-worming, and vaccination of selected female calves. Selected calf data shall be uploaded on the DSS portal within 7 days of issuance of the Go-ahead letter, along with geo-tagged photographs. **Step 4:** Upon uploading of selected calf data on the DSS portal, OMFED shall ensure the timely supply of calf feed in 8 phases for 2 years through MPCS in MPCS areas and through CDVO/BVO in non-MPCS areas. Milk Unions shall upload feed supply details on the DSS portal. Calf Cards and FCRS Registers shall be issued for recording feed supply, vaccination, de-worming, insurance details, and body weight. Monitoring shall be conducted at the Block, District, and State levels as per guideline. > **Note:** 1. The consolidated list of verified applicants must be prepared in the prescribed format, placed at Annexure-II (FCRS Joint Verification Report), and submitted to CDVO for DLC approval (not of concern to the applicant). 1. District-wise targets for implementation are provided in Annexure-I.

page_content:
# Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB): Benefits in the Event of Death **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Mizoram | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Construction Workers, Death Assistance, Labour Welfare, Funeral Assistance, Building And Other Construction Workers | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Benefits in the Event of Death" under the "Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board Benefits for Workers" is implemented by the Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Government of Mizoram, to provide welfare assistance to eligible construction workers and their families. The Welfare Fund has been established under the Building and Other Construction Workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act, 1996. Eligible Indian citizens aged 18 to 60 years who have worked as construction workers for at least 90 days in a year can apply for membership. Registered members can receive specified welfare assistance, including death assistance and funeral assistance, subject to the applicable conditions.
## Benefits - **Workplace Accident:** Assistance of up to ₹3,00,000/- is provided in case of death arising from an accident at the workplace. - **Death Due to Other Causes:** Assistance of up to ₹1,00,000/- is provided where death is unrelated to the member's work. - **Refund of Contributions:** The accumulated monthly contributions of ₹10/- paid by the deceased member are also refunded. - **Funeral Assistance:** ₹5,000/- is provided in respect of a deceased member.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an Indian citizen. - The applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age. - The applicant must have been engaged as a construction worker for at least 90 days in a year. - The applicant must be engaged as a contractor or employee in one of the covered categories of construction work. > **Contractors or employees engaged in the following categories of work:** 1. Carpenter 2. Mason 3. Cement Mason 4. Painter 5. Helper (Construction Works) 6. Electrician 7. Wireman 8. Fitter 9. Welder 10. Plumber 11. Iron and Aluminium Worker 12. Blacksmith 13. Lumberjack 14. Sand Extraction Worker 15. Stone Quarry Worker 16. Stone Breaker 17. Road and Earthwork Labourer 18. JCB/Dozer Operator 19. Construction Machine Operator 20. Construction Driver 21. Brick Factory Worker > **Membership Fee:** - A one-time Registration Fee of ₹25/- shall be payable at the time of enrolment. - A monthly subscription of ₹10/- is payable to maintain active membership. Alternatively, an advance payment of ₹120/- may be made to cover one year's subscription. - Members wishing to pay the Membership/Renewal Fee in advance may do so for a period of up to three (3) years. - Membership must be renewed within one (1) year from the date of expiry, in accordance with [Section 17 of the BOCW (RE&CS) Act, 1996](https://lesde.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2024/05/bbadc4155d1796a962f3883e14e4cc9c/pages-145-bocw-recs-act-1996.pdf). > **Where a member has not formally nominated a beneficiary from among family members prior to death, the assistance shall be disbursed in accordance with the following order of priority:** 1. Spouse (Wife/Husband) 1. Minor son/daughter 1. Unmarried adult children (eldest first) 1. Parents of the deceased member residing in the same household 1. Divorced or widowed daughter 1. Divorced or widowed daughter-in-law 1. Claims must be submitted within six (6) months from the date of the member's death.
## Exclusions - Workers who are already registered under any other State/Union Territory Welfare Board in India shall not be eligible for membership under this Board.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Eligible registered members of the Welfare Board may apply for the respective welfare schemes by submitting the prescribed scheme-specific application form, duly filled in and accompanied by the requisite supporting documents, through the prescribed offline mode. **Step 2:** The application forms and supporting documents shall be as specified by the Welfare Board for the respective scheme/benefit. - **Application Form for Registration under the Board**: [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2023/06/70c9592db154bfccb04514f40e9b5ea8/pages-103-registration-form.pdf).- **Application Form for Death Assistance**: 1. **Natural Death:** [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2023/02/cf7888567961f2c21c5d1e8d0e82f9c3/pages-103-natural-death-benefit.pdf).1. **Accidental Death:** [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2023/02/e1d86a7c13639603a9c9ea5279d19ebe/pages-103-accidental-death-benefit.pdf). > **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/page/whom-to-contact).

page_content:
# Choir(Hymn) Singing Competition **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Singing, Academy, Prizes Awarded, Financial Support | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Choir (Hymns) Singing Competition" is a cultural initiative of the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa, aimed at promoting talent in choir singing. Participation is invited through press notes published in local newspapers, and entry forms along with rules and regulations are available at the Kala Academy. ## Benefits **Assistance Available** - To-and-fro transport facility for participating groups. - ₹3,000/- as preparatory charges for participation. **Prize Amounts** - 1st Prize: ₹50,000/- - 2nd Prize: ₹30,000/- - 3rd Prize: ₹20,000/- - Two Consolation Prizes: ₹10,000/- each
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicants should be Goan artists, choir groups, institutions, or churches. 1. The group performance should be 10–15 minutes, with up to 3 minutes allowed for stage setting.
## Exclusions

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide welfare and medical assistance to eligible registered construction workers of the Mizoram Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board in cases of hospitalization, accidental injury, serious illness, and specified chronic ailments.

page_content:
# Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB): Benefits in the Event of Illness and Accidental Injury **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Mizoram | **Categories:** Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Construction Workers, Medical Assistance, Accidental Injury, Serious Illness, Chronic Ailments, Hospitalization, Cancer, Heart Disease | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Benefits in the Event of Illness and Accidental Injury” under the "Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board Benefits for Workers" is implemented by the Mizoram Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Government of Mizoram, aims to provide welfare benefits to eligible registered construction workers in cases of hospitalization due to accidents or serious illness and specified chronic ailments. Eligible members may receive ₹1,000/- per day for hospitalization due to an accident or serious illness, subject to a maximum of ₹50,000/- in a single year. Members with specified chronic ailments may receive financial assistance of up to ₹1,00,000/- towards treatment costs as a one-time benefit.
## Benefits > **Hospitalization Due to Accident or Serious Illness:** - A member hospitalized due to an accident or serious illness is eligible for ₹1,000/- per day from the date of admission. - The benefit is subject to a maximum of ₹50,000/- in a single year. **Financial Assistance for Chronic Ailments:** - A member diagnosed with Cancer, Chronic Renal Failure, Cerebrovascular Accident/Stroke, or Heart Disease requiring surgical intervention may receive financial assistance of up to ₹1,00,000/- towards treatment costs. - The assistance is payable as a one-time benefit. - The member continues to remain eligible for the standard medical benefits provided by the Board in addition to this assistance.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an Indian citizen. - The applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age. - The applicant must have been engaged as a construction worker for at least 90 days in a year. - The applicant must be engaged as a contractor or employee in one of the covered categories of construction work. > **Contractors or employees engaged in the following categories of work:** 1. Carpenter 2. Mason 3. Cement Mason 4. Painter 5. Helper (Construction Works) 6. Electrician 7. Wireman 8. Fitter 9. Welder 10. Plumber 11. Iron and Aluminium Worker 12. Blacksmith 13. Lumberjack 14. Sand Extraction Worker 15. Stone Quarry Worker 16. Stone Breaker 17. Road and Earthwork Labourer 18. JCB/Dozer Operator 19. Construction Machine Operator 20. Construction Driver 21. Brick Factory Worker > **Membership Fee:** - A one-time Registration Fee of ₹25/- shall be payable at the time of enrolment. - A monthly subscription of ₹10/- is payable to maintain active membership. Alternatively, an advance payment of ₹120/- may be made to cover one year's subscription. - Members wishing to pay the Membership/Renewal Fee in advance may do so for a period of up to three (3) years. - Membership must be renewed within one (1) year from the date of expiry, in accordance with [Section 17 of the BOCW (RE&CS) Act, 1996](https://lesde.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2024/05/bbadc4155d1796a962f3883e14e4cc9c/pages-145-bocw-recs-act-1996.pdf).
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Eligible registered members of the Welfare Board may apply for the respective welfare schemes by submitting the prescribed scheme-specific application form, duly filled in and accompanied by the requisite supporting documents, through the prescribed offline mode. **Step 2:** The application forms and supporting documents shall be as specified by the Welfare Board for the respective scheme/benefit. - **Application Form for Registration under the Board**: [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2023/06/70c9592db154bfccb04514f40e9b5ea8/pages-103-registration-form.pdf).- **Application Form for Medical Assistance**: [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2023/08/67fafbc17e73c03471fbcbb9936bcd82/pages-103-medical-assistance-form.pdf). > **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/page/whom-to-contact).

metadata.schemeName: Government Guest House Scheme for Tourists
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide tourists an opportunity to experience unique stays at government guest houses located at scenic and eco-tourism destinations across Rajasthan at affordable prices.

page_content:
# Government Guest House Scheme for Tourists **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Travel & Tourism | **Tags:** Government Guest House, Tourism, Tourist Accommodation, Eco-Tourism, Tourist Facilities | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Government Guest House Scheme for Tourists" is implemented under the Department of Tourism, Government of Rajasthan, as part of Tourism Policy 2020. It aims to provide tourists with unique staying experiences in government guest houses located at scenic locations with natural habitats across the State. The scheme offers government guest houses belonging to the Water Resources Department, Public Works Department, and Forest Department to tourists at affordable prices. It provides diverse accommodation options through eco-friendly stays while supporting preservation of ecosystems and biodiversity. The scheme also promotes rural life, indigenous arts, crafts and culture and enhances employment opportunities.
## Benefits - **Government Guest House Accommodation:** Tourists can avail budgeted lodging at scenic and eco-tourism destinations. - **Accommodation Facilities:** Hygienic air-conditioned or ventilated rooms with other property-wise amenities are available. - **Affordable Accommodation:** Government guest houses are offered to tourists at affordable prices. - **Day Use Facility:** Rooms may be offered for up to 8 hours from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM at 50% of the prevailing tariff, subject to availability. - **Early Check-In/Late Check-Out:** Up to 2 hours may be permitted; any further period attracts payment of 20% of the room tariff, subject to availability. - **Booking Extension:** Booking extension is permitted on payment of 100% advance and subject to room availability. - **Additional Services:** Kitchen, laundry, dry cleaning, sightseeing, travel ticket booking and transport services may be available on full payment. - **Eco-Tourism Experience:** The scheme provides accommodation at scenic locations with natural habitats. - **Rural and Cultural Experience:** The scheme promotes rural life and indigenous arts, crafts and culture of Rajasthan.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a tourist or guest seeking accommodation in a government guest house covered under the scheme. - The applicant must make a booking request for self or on behalf of another person. - The applicant must make 100% advance payment along with applicable taxes as per Government policy. - The applicant must provide correct booking details. - The applicant must produce the payment receipt and photo identity proof at the time of check-in. - The applicant must comply with the booking, accommodation and cancellation terms and conditions of the concerned property. - The applicant must obtain booking confirmation from the concerned Department where confirmation is required. - Accommodation is subject to availability of rooms.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant must submit a booking request to the concerned Government Department or accommodation unit. **Step 2:** For Water Resources Department guest houses, bookings are accepted through email by the concerned office of the Executive Engineer of the Department or accommodation unit. **Step 3:** The concerned Department confirms the booking subject to availability. **Step 4:** The confirmation is mailed to the applicant at the given email address. **Step 5:** The applicant must make 100% advance payment through electronic mode. **Step 6:** The applicant must preserve the payment receipt and email confirmation. **Step 7:** The applicant must produce the payment receipt and photo identity proof at the time of arrival. **Step 8:** The Manager or Unit In-Charge allots the room according to the booking and availability.

metadata.schemeName: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme (PLI 1.2) for Specialty Steel
metadata.briefDescription: under this scheme to promote domestic manufacturing of specialty steel by encouraging incremental investment, increasing production of value-added steel, enhancing technological capabilities, and reducing import dependence while generating employment.

page_content:
# Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme (PLI 1.2) for Specialty Steel **Ministry:** Ministry Of Steel | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Specialty Steel, Company, PLI, Business | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Specialty Steel Scheme under the Ministry of Steel, Government of India, aims to enhance domestic manufacturing by providing incentives on the incremental production of notified specialty steel products. The scheme defines eligibility based on incremental investment and incremental sales over a baseline. It includes provisions for application, project management, approval, incentive calculation, and disbursement through a structured mechanism involving the Project Management Agency (PMA) and the Empowered Committee.
## Benefits 1. Incentive on incremental sales of manufactured specialty steel 1. Encouragement for investment in plant, machinery, and technology 1. Promotion of domestic value addition 1. Support for employment generation 1. Development of advanced steel manufacturing capabilities
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a company registered in India under the Companies Act, 2013, engaged in the manufacture of identified specialty steel grades, ensuring end-to-end domestic manufacturing wherein input material is melted and poured within the country. 1. A maximum of 20% of the total value addition may be undertaken through third parties; however, the incentive shall be claimed only by the company manufacturing the eligible end product sub-category. 1. The net worth of the applicant company, including that of its group companies, shall not be less than 30% of the total committed investment, based on audited financial statements of the immediately preceding financial year. 1. In the case of new companies or group companies incorporated after 31/03/2025, the net worth shall be at least 30% of the total committed investment prior to the date of application submission.Where an applicant applies for multiple product sub-categories, the net worth requirement shall be evaluated with reference to the total committed investment across all applied sub-categories. 1. The applicant must meet the prescribed minimum threshold values for incremental production, capacity, and investment as specified under the scheme guidelines. 1. Only those investments classified as eligible under the prescribed provisions shall be considered for the purpose of calculating investment. 1. An eligible company may avail benefits under other schemes, subject to applicable provisions; however, the same investment and sales shall not be considered for incentives under other PLI schemes. 1. Companies availing benefits under this scheme are not restricted from applying to PLI schemes of other Ministries or Departments for products not covered under this scheme. 1. Projects that have received or are expected to receive incentives under previous rounds of the PLI Scheme for Specialty Steel shall not be eligible to participate in the current round.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online Step 1 : The applicant shall access the official PLI portal and open the [online registration page.](https://plimos.mecon.co.in/ords/plimos/r/102/login?session=11655018078065) Step 2 : The applicant shall enter company details, including Company Name, Corporate Identification Number (CIN), and Incorporation Date. Step 3 : The applicant shall provide details of the authorized contact person, including name, designation, mobile number, and email ID. Step 4 : The applicant shall create and confirm a password as per the prescribed requirements. Step 5 : The applicant shall enter the captcha code and submit the registration form. Step 6 : Upon successful submission, a unique registration linked to the CIN shall be created, and only one registration per CIN shall be permitted. Step 7 : The registered mobile number and email ID shall be used for all future communications and login purposes. Step 8 : The applicant shall log in using the registered CIN and password to proceed with the application process. **Note Points** 1. The applicant must be a company registered in India under the Companies Act, 2013, and must not be classified as NPA, wilful defaulter, or fraud, and should have no insolvency proceedings admitted before NCLT. 1. The application shall be submitted within 30 days from the date of launch of the PLI Scheme 1.2. 1. The application must be submitted by an authorized signatory duly empowered by the Board of Directors or Managing Director. 1. Financial Year 2024–25 shall be considered as the base year for calculations under the scheme. 1. Capacity enhancement may be undertaken through capacity addition (new units) or capacity augmentation (existing units). 1. Incremental production shall be calculated based on production derived from sales compared to the corresponding previous period. 1. Limiting investment shall be 80% of the committed investment and must be achieved at the time of incentive claim. 1. Incentives shall be provided for a maximum period of five years commencing from FY 2025–26.

metadata.schemeName: E-YUVA Scheme: BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows (for post graduates and above)
metadata.briefDescription: BIRAC’s Innovation fellows shall apply as an individual and are required to work full time at EYC. BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows are expected to initiate biotech startups. Hence, only proposals with potential to commercialize innovative products and technologies will be considered for support.

page_content:
# E-YUVA Scheme: BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows (for post graduates and above)

**Ministry:** Ministry Of Science And Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Science, IT & Communications | **Tags:** E-YUVA, Innovation, Fellow, Translational Research, Fellowship, Post Graduate | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme “Empowering Youth for Undertaking Value Added Innovative Translational Research (E-YUVA)” was started by the Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC) to promote a culture of applied research and need-oriented (societal or industry) entrepreneurial innovation among young students and researchers. The scheme provides funding support (through fellowship and research grant), technical and business mentoring, exposure to bio incubation model, orientation to an entrepreneurial culture, etc. to students at various levels including undergraduates, post-graduates, and post-doctoral.
**The scheme provides support under the following two categories:**

  - BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows (for post graduates and above)
  - BIRAC’s E-YUVA Fellows (for under graduate students)

**BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows (for post graduates and above):**
BIRAC’s Innovation fellows shall apply as an individuals and are required to work full-time at EYC. BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows are expected to initiate biotech startups. Hence, only proposals with the potential to commercialize innovative products and technologies will be considered for support.
> **Areas covered:**

BIRAC Innovation Fellowship proposals can be submitted in any domain including Healthcare, Lifesciences, Diagnostics, Medical Devices, Drugs, Vaccines, Drug Formulations and delivery systems, Industrial Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Agriculture, Secondary agriculture, Waste Management, Sanitation, Clean Energy and Artificial Intelligence/IoT/ Automation with application in any of these areas. BIRAC encourages interdisciplinary proposals from any stream that can help the conversion of innovative ideas into biotech products and technologies in any of the above fields.
> **Nature of Proposals supported:**


  - Translational research proposals to develop innovative products and technologies with the potential to address unmet needs.
  - BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows are expected to initiate biotech startups. Hence, only proposals with the potential to commercialize innovative products and technologies will be considered for support.

> **Number and Duration of Fellowship:**


  - Each EYC can have 3 Innovation Fellows at any given time.
  - Fellowship is provided for a period of 18 months with a provision of 6 months extension only for deserving cases.

> **Expected Deliverable:**

The scheme’s mandate is to promote and encourage young students to embrace translational research to develop innovative products and technologies addressing unmet needs. The work supported through BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows are expected to work towards

  - Individual to Company(I to C) conversion
  - IP creation

## Benefits
**BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows will receive fellowship grants and annual research grants as mentioned below:**
> **Fellowship grant:**


   1. INR 30,000/- per month for Post-graduate fellow
   1. INR 50,000/- per month for Post-doctoral fellow

> **Annual research grant:**


   1. INR 3,00,000/- per year for Post-graduate fellow
   1. INR 5,00,000/- per year for Post-doctoral fellow

**Note:** EYCs and BIRAC provide continuous mentoring support to fellows, including but not limited to Technical Mentoring, IP Support, Legal Support, Networking, and Outreach, Training, Regulatory Advice, Business Mentoring and Fundraising.

## Eligibility Criteria
> **Post Graduate Fellow:**


   1. An Indian Student who has completed a Master's degree in any field of science is eligible to apply for this fellowship.
   1. The fellow should apply within 3 years of completion of the degree (**Females are exempted from this condition**).
> **Post-Doctoral Fellow:**


   1. An Indian student who has completed a Ph.D. in any field of science is eligible to apply for this fellowship.
   1. The fellow should apply within 2 years of completion of the degree (**Females are exempted from this condition**).
> **Other requirements:**


  - BIRAC’s Innovation fellows are required to work full-time at EYC.
  - Students pursuing PhD cannot be considered for fellowship grants.
  - Selected fellows cannot pursue PhD during the fellowship tenure.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
> **Application Process:**

**Step 01:** The applications for fellowships will be invited at the national level through advertisements in national dailies/website/ suitable magazines. 
**Step 02:** Online application submission needs to be done through the BIRAC website. ([https://birac.nic.in](https://birac.nic.in/e_yuva.php)/)
**Step 03:** Applicants need to create a user account on BIRAC’s website followed by filling up of online application form. [Click here for a step-by-step guide for the application](https://www.birac.nic.in/webcontent/1643877161_Step_by_step_guide_for_E_YUVA_application.pdf)
**Note:** In the application form, the applicant will be asked to indicate up to 3 choices for E-Yuva Centres. [Click here for E-YUVA Centers contact details](https://www.birac.nic.in/webcontent/1643177697_EYC_contact_details.pdf)
> **Selection Process:**

**Step 01:** The Centre-wise list of applicants will be created and sent to E-cells/respective Centre for eligibility check and further evaluation.
**Step 02:** The shortlisted applicants/teams will be called for a presentation before a Technical Expert Committee along with BIRAC nominees at respective EYCs.
**Step 03:** The selected applicants will be called as BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows and will enter into an agreement with EYC.
