metadata.schemeName: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Pharmaceuticals
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial incentives on the incremental sales (over Base Year) of pharmaceutical goods and in-vitro diagnostic medical devices to selected applicants based on pre-defined selection criteria. The applicant must be a manufacturer of pharmaceutical goods.

page_content:
# Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Pharmaceuticals **Ministry:** Ministry Of Chemicals And Fertilizers | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Manufacturer, Entrepreneur, Company, Incentive, Investment, Production, Pharmaceutical | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Pharmaceuticals" was launched by the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, Department of Pharmaceuticals. The scheme aims to enhance India’s manufacturing capabilities by increasing investment and production in the sector and contributing to product diversification to high-value goods in the pharmaceutical sector. The scheme provides financial incentives on the incremental sales (over Base Year) of pharmaceutical goods and in-vitro diagnostic medical devices to selected applicants based on pre-defined selection criteria. The scheme is implemented by the Small Industries Development Bank of India. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the dedicated Project Management Agency portal.
## Benefits - The scheme has a total financial outlay of ₹1,50,00,00,00,000/-. - The incentive is provided on the net incremental sales of eligible products over a period of 6 years (Financial Year 2022-23 to Financial Year 2027-28). - The rate of incentive for Category 1 and Category 2 products is 10% for the first four years (Financial Year 2022-23 to 2025-26), 8% for the fifth year (Financial Year 2026-27), and 6% for the sixth year (Financial Year 2027-28). - The rate of incentive for Category 3 products is 5% for the first four years (Financial Year 2022-23 to 2025-26), 4% for the fifth year (Financial Year 2026-27), and 3% for the sixth year (Financial Year 2027-28). - The incentive allocation ceiling is ₹1,10,00,00,00,000/- for Group A, ₹22,50,00,00,000/- for Group B, and ₹17,50,00,00,000/- for Group C. - The maximum incentive per applicant is capped at ₹10,00,00,00,000/- for Group A, ₹2,50,00,00,000/- for Group B, and ₹50,00,00,000/- for Group C. ****Applicants must submit a claim for disbursement of incentive online on an annual basis within one month of the closure of the financial year.*** ****75% of the claim amount is released immediately upon order, and the remaining 25% is released after the submission of final audited accounts.*** ****Selected applicants must furnish a self-certified quarterly review report within 30 days from the end of each quarter.***
## Eligibility Criteria ##### ***Common Eligibility*** - The applicant must be a manufacturer of pharmaceutical goods registered in India. - The applicant must be engaged in the manufacturing of eligible pharmaceutical products covered under the three defined categories. - The applicant must not claim incentives for the same product under the Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Bulk Drugs or any other Production Linked Incentive Scheme. ##### ***Group A Applicants*** - The applicant must have a Global Manufacturing Revenue of pharmaceutical goods or in-vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices greater than or equal to ₹50,00,00,00,000/- (₹5,000 crores) in the Financial Year 2019-20. - The applicant must achieve a minimum cumulative investment of ₹10,00,00,00,000/- (₹1,000 crores) over a period of 5 years. - The applicant must achieve a minimum turnover of eligible products of ₹50,00,00,000/- (₹50 crores) in the first year (Financial Year 2022-23). ##### ***Group B Applicants*** - The applicant must have a Global Manufacturing Revenue of pharmaceutical goods or in-vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices between ₹5,00,00,00,000/- (₹500 crores) and ₹50,00,00,00,000/- (₹5,000 crores) in the Financial Year 2019-20. - The applicant must achieve a minimum cumulative investment of ₹2,50,00,00,000/- (₹250 crores) over a period of 5 years. - The applicant must achieve a minimum turnover of eligible products of ₹10,00,00,000/- (₹10 crores) in the first year (Financial Year 2022-23). ##### ***Group C Applicants*** - The applicant must have a Global Manufacturing Revenue of pharmaceutical goods or in-vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices less than ₹5,00,00,00,000/- (₹500 crores) in the Financial Year 2019-20. - The applicant must achieve a minimum cumulative investment of ₹50,00,00,000/- (₹50 crores) over a period of 5 years. - The applicant must achieve a minimum turnover of eligible products of ₹1,00,00,000/- (₹1 crore) in the first year (Financial Year 2022-23). ##### ***Group C (MSME) Applicants*** - The applicant must fall under the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) category within Group C. - The applicant must achieve the Committed Investment (total eligible investment committed by the applicant) over a period of 5 years. - The applicant must achieve a minimum turnover of eligible products of ₹50,00,000/- (₹50 lakhs) in the first year (Financial Year 2022-23). ##### ***Continuation Criteria*** - The applicant must achieve a 7% growth in sales over the previous Financial Year for subsequent years (Financial Year 2023-24 onwards) to claim incentives.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ***The scheme is implemented through a Project Management Agency, which is the Small Industries Development Bank of India. Applicants must apply online through the designated portal.*** **Step 1:** Access the official online portal at [https://pli-pharma.udyamimitra.in](https://pli-pharma.udyamimitra.in). **Step 2:** Register on the portal and fill out the application form with all required details regarding Global Manufacturing Revenue, investment commitments, and product categories. **Step 3:** Submit the non-refundable application fee as prescribed in the guidelines. **Step 4:** The Project Management Agency will process the applications and select applicants based on the ranking methodology within 90 days of the application window closure. **Step 5:** Receive the approval letter from the Project Management Agency if selected. **Step 6:** Submit a Bank Guarantee of the prescribed amount and an Undertaking in favor of the Department of Pharmaceuticals within two weeks of the issuance of the approval letter. **Step 7:** Submit claims for incentive disbursement annually through the online portal along with supporting documents within one month of the financial year's closure.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide one-time financial assistance for serious illness, accident, or calamity-related medical treatment to artists and litterateurs.

page_content:
# Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Serious Illness / Accident / Calamity Assistance **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Madhya Pradesh | **Categories:** Sports & Culture, Social welfare & Empowerment, Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Calamity, Illness, Accident, Artists, Litterateurs | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Serious Illness / Accident / Calamity Assistance” scheme has beenn launched by the Department of Culture, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to artists and litterateurs suffering from serious or long-term illnesses, accidents, or calamities. Under this scheme, one-time financial support is provided to meet medical treatment expenses that the beneficiary cannot afford.
## Benefits **Financial Assistance** - One-time financial assistance of up to ₹50,000. - Provided for serious or long-term illness, accident, or calamity-related treatment. **Mode of Disbursement** - Direct bank transfer to the beneficiary account.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be an artist or a litterateur. 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be suffering from a serious or long-term illness, accident, or calamity. 1. The applicant’s (husband/wife) monthly income should not exceed ₹10,000. 1. The total family income should not exceed ₹20,000 per month. 1. The writer/artist's fully dependent spouse, fully dependent parents, dependent minor brothers and sisters, dependent minor children, dependent widowed daughter, and dependent differently-abled brothers and sisters are eligible to get assistance.
## Exclusions 1. The applicant should not be a government employee. 1. The applicant should not be employed in autonomous or semi-government institutions.

# Inter-Caste Marriage Award **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Himachal Pradesh | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Inter-Caste, Marriage, Award, Scheduled Caste | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Inter-Caste Marriage Award " has been launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Himachal Pradesh. The objective of the scheme is to eliminate the practice of untouchability by encouraging marriages between the Scheduled Castes and other castes.
## Benefits Under this scheme, a person from another caste who marries a person from a Scheduled Caste receives ₹50,000/- or an amount decided by the Government from time to time.
## Eligibility Criteria **Eligibility Criteria for Inter-Caste Marriage Award:** 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh. 1. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** The interested applicant can download the [application form](http://esomsa.hp.gov.in/sites/default/files/Inter%20Caste%20%20Marriage%20Form_0.pdf) from the official website. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Concerned District Welfare Officer/Tehsil Welfare Officer. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the Concerned District Welfare Officer/Tehsil Welfare Officer to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

metadata.schemeName: Madhya Pradesh Janani Suraksha Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, cash incentives are provided to pregnant women and their motivators for delivery in government or accredited private hospitals.

page_content:
# Madhya Pradesh Janani Suraksha Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Madhya Pradesh | **Categories:** Women and Child | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Pregnant, Women, Maternal | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Janani Suraksha Yojana" was launched by the Department of Public Health and Medical Education, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to promote institutional deliveries among pregnant women to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality by providing cash incentives to women delivering in government and accredited private hospitals, as well as to motivators (ASHA workers or family escorts) who assist them.
## Benefits > **Financial Assistance:** - ₹1,400 to rural pregnant women delivering in government or accredited private hospitals. - ₹1,000 to urban pregnant women for institutional delivery. - ₹350 incentive to the motivator (ASHA or escort) assisting a rural woman for delivery. - ₹200 incentive to the motivator (ASHA or escort) assisting an urban woman for delivery. - ₹250 as transport allowance, if the motivator or family arranges transportation to the hospital. - Free hospital stay and maternal health services in government or accredited private hospitals.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a pregnant woman. 1. The applicant should deliver in a government or accredited private hospital. 1. The applicant should belong to a BPL (Below Poverty Line) or Antyodaya family.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Registration** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Website of "[Madhya Pradesh Lok Sewa Guarantee Portal](https://mpedistrict.gov.in/MPL/CitizenRegistration.aspx)". **Step 2:** On the homepage, click "Citizen Registration". You will be taken to the registration page. **Step 3:** On the registration page, fill in all the mandatory fields (name, mobile number, gender, and captcha) and click "Verify Mobile Number." **Step 4:** A verification code will be sent to your mobile number. Enter the code and complete the registration. **Application** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Website of "Madhya Pradesh Lok Sewa Guarantee Portal". **Step 2:** Enter your User ID, Password, and Captcha Code, and click "Login." **Step 3:** Click on "Apply Online Service" and select the scheme you intend to apply for. **Step 4:** In the scheme's online application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size (fields marked with * are mandatory), and click "Submit".
**Mode:** Offline - The applicant must approach a government or accredited private hospital for institutional delivery. - The applicant must submit her BPL/Antyodaya Card and identity proof for eligibility verification.

page_content:
# Ambubhai Purani Award **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Gymnasium, Award, Sports | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Ambubhai Purani Award" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to promote the development of gymnasiums and traditional Indian physical culture by honoring individuals who have shown exceptional contribution in this field. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹51,000/- and state-level recognition to outstanding individuals, fostering motivation and continuity in preserving indigenous physical training traditions. metadata.briefDescription: The scheme under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) provides input cost subsidy for freshwater aquaculture in newly constructed ponds to expand fisheries production in Haryana.

page_content:
# PMMSY: Inputs for fresh water Aquaculture including Composite fish culture, Scampi, Pangasius, Tilapia etc - Haryana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Aquaculture, Fish Farmers, Subsidy, Entrepreneurs | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Inputs for fresh water Aquaculture, including Composite fish culture, Scampi, Pangasius, Tilapia, etc, introduced by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to expand fisheries production in Haryana. This centrally sponsored scheme is jointly funded 50% by the Central Government and 50% by the State Government. It provides input cost subsidies for the first crop in newly constructed ponds under PMMSY, aiming to promote aquaculture in urban and semi-urban areas.
## Benefits - The project cost is: 4,00,000/- per hectare > **Subsidy Distribution:** 1. 40% of the project cost for General Category beneficiaries 1. 60% of the project cost for SC/Women beneficiaries ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana with a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant will be eligible for input cost subsidy provided by the State Government only for the expansion of fisheries in urban or semi-urban areas under the construction of new ponds. 1. The applicant will receive central financial assistance only for the initial fish crop (fertilizer) in newly constructed ponds. 1. The applicant will be eligible for central financial assistance on input costs only if the pond is properly prepared for fisheries. 1. The applicant may use land on a long-term registered lease, provided the lease period is at least 7 years, for eligibility under this scheme. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details,i.e., Name, Email ID, Mobile Number & password. Click on ‘Submit’. **Step 3:** Verify the OTP received in the provided Email and Mobile Number. Alternatively, click on the Verification Link to activate the profile.

Fill in the required credentials and click on the ‘Login’ button. **Step 3:** In the opened window, click on “Scheme/Services list”, and a list of schemes will appear on the screen. **Step 4:** Now, select the scheme and click on “Apply for Service/Scheme”. **Step 5:** Fill in all the details in the online application form and click on "Submit".

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "Publication Support Scheme for Fine Arts" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to encourage the publication of fine arts books through financial assistance provided to artists and art institutions.

page_content:
# Publication Support Scheme for Fine Arts **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Fine Arts, Book Publication, Artist Grant, Art Institutions | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Publication Support Scheme for Fine Arts" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to increase awareness about fine arts and promote the publication of fine arts literature by supporting artists and art institutions financially. Under this initiative, applications are invited annually through paid newspaper advertisements, and 2 (two) artists/art institutions are provided assistance for the publication of fine arts books.. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Fine Arts Academy.

## Benefits - **Financial Assistance:** 50% of the total printing cost or a maximum of ₹20,000/- (whichever is lower).
## Eligibility Criteria - An individual artist or an art institution working in the field of fine arts is eligible for this scheme.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** The interested applicant should download the prescribed format of the [application form](https://lalitkalaacademy.gujarat.gov.in/writereaddata/Portal/Magazine/Document/1_34_3_Pustak-Prakashan-Sahay.pdf) for the "Publication Support Scheme for Fine Arts" scheme. **Step 2:** In the application form, provide all the mandatory details, including career details in the field of art, photographs, or color slides of work (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the supporting documents to the Gujarat State Fine Arts Academy. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority at the Academy office to whom the application has been submitted. **Note:** Applications for book publication are invited every year through advertisement in daily newspapers. > **Contact Us:** > Gujarat State Academy of Fine Arts > Ravi Shankar Rawal Kala Bhavan, > Opposite Bhaikaka Bhavan, > Law Garden, Ellisbridge, > Ahmedabad - 380006. > 079-26425562 > 079-26562558

page_content:
# Award of Fellowship to Most Eminent Artist **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Eminent Artist, Fellowship, Visual Arts, Retired Artists | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Award of Fellowship to Most Eminent Artist" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to recognize and financially assist artists aged 60 years or above who have retired from professional artistic practice and have made distinguished contributions in the field of plastic arts at the national level. The fellowship is intended to support such artists by enabling them to acquire necessary equipment and continue contributing meaningfully to the arts. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Fine Arts Academy. In this scheme, 10 artists are given a monthly fellowship of ₹5,000/- for one year, and it is extendable for a maximum of two years, depending on the quality and impact of the artist’s continued work. ## Benefits - **Monthly Fellowship:** ₹5,000/-. ## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be an artist. - The applicant must be 60 years or older. - The applicant should be retired from the professional field of plastic arts. - The applicant should have attained national-level fame and established a distinct identity through excellence in painting, sculpture, or graphic arts. ## Exclusions

# Green Business Scheme - Haryana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** E-rickshaw, Compressed Air Vehicle, Solar Energy Gadgets, Poly Houses, Loan, Green Business | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Green Business Scheme" is implemented by the Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (HSCFDC) in collaboration with the National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC) within the state of Haryana. Under this scheme, loans of up to ₹2.00 lakhs are provided to Scheduled Caste residents of Haryana for undertaking income-generating activities such as e-rickshaws, compressed air vehicles, solar energy gadgets, polyhouses, and similar ventures. Activities that contribute to mitigating the greenhouse effect are eligible for assistance under this scheme.

The Corporation provides margin money @10% of the project cost. 1. The Corporation (HSFDC) provides a subsidy of 50% of the total project cost, with a maximum amount of subsidy being ₹10,000/- of the total project cost.

metadata.schemeName: PMMSY: Construction of New ponds for Saline /Alkaline areas-Haryana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to expand fisheries in various urban and semi-urban areas. Through this scheme, subsidies for the construction of new ponds and central financial assistance for the initial fish crop on newly constructed ponds are provided to beneficiaries.

page_content:
# PMMSY: Construction of New ponds for Saline /Alkaline areas-Haryana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Construction, Ponds, Fish Crop, Lease | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana: Construction of New Ponds for Saline/Alkaline Areas" by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Haryana, aims to expand fisheries in various urban and semi-urban areas. Through this scheme, subsidies for the construction of new ponds and central financial assistance for the initial fish crop on newly constructed ponds are provided to beneficiaries. The scheme considers ponds with a long duration and a registered lease period of at least 7 years for grants. ## Benefits - The project cost is ₹8,00,000/- per hectare. - The subsidy is limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category and 60% of the project cost for Scheduled Caste (SC) and women beneficiaries.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The construction of new ponds subsidy will be provided by the state government for the expansion of fisheries in various urban/semi-urban areas only under the construction of new ponds under the Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) scheme. 1. Only central financial assistance will be provided to the beneficiaries for the initial fish crop only on the fertiliser of newly constructed ponds. 1. Central financial assistance on the construction of new ponds will be provided only on ponds prepared for fisheries. 1. Under this scheme, ponds whose pond duration will be for a long time, and the registered lease period will be at least 7 years, will be considered for a grant on those ponds. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details, i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number & password. metadata.schemeName: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 30-Ton Capacity - Haryana
metadata.briefDescription: The subsidy for 30-ton capacity ice plants/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 30 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.

page_content:
# PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 30-Ton Capacity - Haryana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Business & Entrepreneurship, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Entrepreneurs, Fish Farmers, Cold Chain Infrastructure, Fish Preservation | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Ice Plant/Cold Store of minimum 30-ton capacity, introduced by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to provide the subsidy to support the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 30 tons to strengthen fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana. This centrally sponsored scheme is jointly funded 50% by the Central Government and 50% by the State Government. Beneficiaries must submit an undertaking in their DPR/SCP to keep the unit operational, bear all post-construction costs, and ensure ice is supplied to fishers and fish farmers at affordable prices.
## Benefits - The project cost is ₹120,00,000/- > **Subsidy Distribution :** 1. A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category. 1. A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant must submit an undertaking in the DPR/SCP to bear all operational, maintenance, and post-construction management costs, and to ensure the continuous operation of the ice plant/cold storage. 1. The applicant must note that central assistance will be provided based on the actual cost, within the overall ceiling specified under the relevant PMMSY sub-components. 1. The applicant must ensure that the ice produced is supplied to fishers and fish farmers at an affordable price. 1. The applicant must either own the project land or hold it on a long-term registered lease of at least 10 years to be eligible. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number & password. metadata.schemeName: Stipends to Students of NT/DNT Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme “Stipends to Students of NT/DNT Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC” by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, supports education for NT/DNT Caste students by providing a monthly stipend for one year.

page_content:
# Stipends to Students of NT/DNT Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Education, Nomadic Tribe And Denotified Tribe, Stipend, ITI, Vocational Courses | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Stipends to Students of NT/DNT Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC” by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat aims to promote inclusive education by financially supporting students from economically weaker sections pursuing technical and vocational education after SSC. The initiative offers a stipend of ₹400 per month to aid the academic progress and reduce the dropout rate among underprivileged youth. The scheme is implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department. It specifically benefits those enrolled in professional or Government ITI courses and belonging to families with an annual income not exceeding ₹6,00,000/-. ## Benefits - **Stipend:** A monthly stipend of ₹400/- is given to NT/DNT Caste students for one year of recognized professional and Government ITI courses. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to Nomadic Tribe and Denotified Tribe (NTDNT) communities. 1. The applicant should be a student who has passed the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) examination. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized professional or Government Industrial Training Institute (ITI) course. 1. The applicant’s individual and family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/- per annum.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **How to Register:** **Step 1:** Visit the Digital [Gujarat portal](http://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** The user should click on the "Click to register" option. Fill all details and click on "Save". > **How to Log In:** **Step 1:** Visit the Digital [Gujarat portal](http://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** The user should click on the "Login" option. **Step 3:** Enter all details and click on "Login". > **How to Apply for a New Service:** **Step 1:** After logging in, select the relevant department. **Step 2**: Choose the specific service to apply for within that department. **Step 3:** Fill out all required details in the application form. **Step 4:** Upload, attach, or browse necessary documents. Alternatively, import documents directly from DigiLocker. **Step 5:** Carefully review all entered information. **Step 6:** Submit the application. **Step 7:** Once the application is completed, proceed to payment to download the certificate. **Step 8:** Upon successful payment, the certificate will be available for download. > **Digital Gujarat (Help Desk)** Contact No : 18002335500

metadata.schemeName: Krishak Utpadak Kshati Sahayata Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and compensation to farmers in the event of loss or damage to crops, livestock, or agricultural land caused by fire, flood, or heavy rains in the notified areas of the state.

page_content:
# Krishak Utpadak Kshati Sahayata Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Agriculture, Damage Assistance, Farmer, Natural Calamities, Crop Damage, Compensation | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Krishak Utpadak Kshati Sahayata Yojana” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Agricultural Production & Marketing Board under the Department of Agriculture, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and compensation to farmers in the event of loss or damage to crops, livestock, or agricultural land caused by fire, flood, or heavy rains in the notified areas of the state.
## Benefits Damage caused by fire accidents to standing crops, harvested crops in the field, crops stored in barns for threshing, or residual produce in the notified market areas of Uttarakhand State, as well as damage to property and livestock due to fire in the farmer’s house, and damage to agricultural land due to floods or rain-induced soil erosion, all such losses make farmers eligible to receive compensation under this scheme.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a minimum of 18 years of age to submit and receive a claim.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - For reporting fire or flood accidents, the affected farmer/producer must submit an application in the prescribed format (available free of cost at the Mandi Samiti office) to the Secretary, Chairman, Administrator, or Tehsildar of the concerned Mandi Samiti area within seven days of the incident. - The received claim will be investigated by the Secretary of the Market Committee, and the inquiry must be completed within one week. The final report shall be submitted to the Chairman/Administrator of the Mandi Committee in the prescribed format attached to the claim form. In areas where the Mandi Committee does not have an office, the concerned Tehsildar will conduct the inquiry and forward it to the respective Mandi Committee. - After thorough scrutiny of the claim form by the Mandi Samiti office, the payment process will be initiated with the approval of the Chairman/Administrator of the Mandi Samiti. - All the above proceedings should be completed within two months, and in special circumstances, the Chairman/Administrator of the Mandi Committee may extend the time period as required. - For the payment of assistance claims, the Mandi Board will prepare a bank draft of the sanctioned amount in the name of the claimant and send it to the Secretary of the concerned Mandi Committee for disbursement.

metadata.briefDescription: This scheme awards cash incentives to NCC cadets who demonstrate outstanding performance in the current year's RDC, TSC, VSC, or NSC camps, recognizing six gold medal recipients with ₹3,000/- and six silver medal recipients with ₹2000/-.

page_content:
# Rajya/Mukhyamantri Swarn/Rajat Padak Protsahan Puraskar **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Education, Cash Incentive, NCC | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description "Rajya / Mukhyamantri Swarn / Rajat Padak Protsahan Puraskar" implemented by the Department of Education, Government of Uttarakhand, aims to promote excellence in National Cadet Corps (NCC) training by incentivizing high-performing cadets. Through this scheme, cadets who win gold or silver medals during RDC (Republic Day Camp), TSC (Thal Sainik Camp), VSC (Vayu Sainik Camp), or NSC (Nav Sainik Camp) are awarded cash prizes. The scheme is implemented by NCC Group Headquarters through a structured selection and recommendation process. ## Benefits - **Gold Medal Winners:** A cash award of ₹3,000/- each is given to 6 cadets who achieve gold medals during NCC training and camps.- **Silver Medal Winners:** A cash award of ₹2,000/- each is given to 6 cadets who achieve silver medals during NCC training and camps. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be an NCC cadet. 1. The applicant must have demonstrated outstanding performance in one of the following camps during the current training year: RDC (Republic Day Camp), TSC (Thall Sainik Camp), VSC (Vayu Sena Camp), or NSC (Nau Sainik Camp). 1. The applicant must be among the top 6 performers for the gold medal or the next 6 performers for the silver medal. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Application forms are filled by all NCC Units. **Step 2:** Filled applications are forwarded by the Units to the Group Headquarters. **Step 3:** Group Headquarters conducts necessary verification. **Step 4:** After verification, Group Headquarters sends the applications to the Directorate. **Step 5:** At the Directorate, a Board of Officers is formed to scrutinize the applications and related documents/board proceedings. **Step 6:** Based on performance and scrutiny, cash awards are allocated to the top 6 cadets (gold) and next 6 cadets (silver).

metadata.schemeName: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grah Aawas (Home-Stay) Vikas Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote rural and eco-tourism by encouraging local residents to develop homestay facilities, thereby generating employment and income opportunities within the state.

page_content:
# Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grah Aawas (Home-Stay) Vikas Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Travel & Tourism, Housing & Shelter | **Tags:** Homestay, Tourism, Subsidy, Loan, Construction Of Houses | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Deen Dayal Upadhyay Grah Aawas (Home-Stay) Vikas Yojana” has been started by the Department of Tourism, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote rural and eco-tourism by encouraging local residents to develop homestay facilities, thereby generating employment and income opportunities within the state.
## Benefits - There is a provision for financial assistance to permanent residents/native of the state who take a loan for the construction of homestays. - In hilly areas, a subsidy of up to 50% of the project cost, subject to a maximum of ₹15.00 lakh, is provided along with an interest grant of up to ₹1.50 lakh for the first five years. - In plain areas, a subsidy of up to 25% of the project cost, subject to a maximum of ₹7.50 lakh, is provided along with an interest grant of ₹1.00 lakh for the first five years. The beneficiary’s contribution at the time of availing the loan must be 12.5%. - The subsidy is applicable only when the loan is taken. - In addition to the construction of new houses, funds/subsidy are also provided for the upgradation of old buildings, including their extension, renovation, improvement, and construction of toilets, as mentioned above.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. This benefit is provided as a subsidy for the construction of homestays across the state of Uttarakhand, excluding areas under Municipal Corporations and Municipalities. 1. The applicant must be a native of Uttarakhand. 1. The building owner, who resides in the building with their family, may construct a minimum of one and a maximum of six guest rooms. 1. Upon construction of a new homestay or renovation of an existing one, the property must be registered with the Uttarakhand Tourism Development Council. 1. Preference will be given to buildings constructed or developed in the traditional hill-style architecture.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online The applicant must apply online through [https://msy.uk.gov.in/ ](https://msy.uk.gov.in/)under Deendayal Upadhyay Griha Awas (Homestay) Vikas Yojana. Registration requires an Aadhaar card and an Aadhaar-linked mobile number. The following documents must be attached during application: date of birth certificate, educational qualification certificate (optional), permanent residence certificate, land/building-related documents, plan layout (anganan), written certificate from the Pradhan regarding non-availability of land in the municipality, NOC for purchasing fire extinguisher/fire department approval, map approval by the authorized department/institution, and SC/ST/OBC/Ex-servicemen certificate, if applicable. After submission, the application is forwarded to the District Tourism Development Officer (DTDO) of the concerned district. The DTDO schedules a committee meeting under the chairmanship of the District Magistrate and calls the applicant for an interview. If the committee finds the proposal satisfactory, it is sent to the bank from which the applicant intends to take the loan. The proposal is submitted online to the bank, which then initiates the loan approval process. Once approved, the bank notifies the Tourism Officer and credits the loan amount to the applicant’s account. After completing the construction or renovation of the homestay, the applicant must submit a written notice to the Tourism Officer confirming project completion. The new homestay must then be registered. A joint inspection is conducted by the District Tourism Development Officer and the relevant bank branch manager. After confirmation of project completion, the inspection report is submitted, the homestay begins hosting visitors, and the department transfers the approved subsidy directly to the bank account associated with the loan.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme “S.P. Nautiyal Sangrahalaya” implemented by the Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology, provides insights into the Great Himalayas through geological maps, charts, models, and educational exhibits, displaying rock, mineral, and fossil samples from the entire Himalayan region.

page_content:
# S.P. Nautiyal Museum

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Travel & Tourism, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Educational Exhibits, Visitor | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme “S.P. Nautiyal Sangrahalaya” implemented by the Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology, offers a deep insight into the Great Himalayas. The museum showcases geo-scientific maps, charts, specimens, models, and various educational and awareness-generating exhibits. Samples of rocks, minerals, and fossils found throughout the Himalayan region are also displayed here. This museum serves as a valuable resource for understanding the geology and natural history of the Himalayas.

## Benefits
- **Educational Insight:** Provides in-depth knowledge and understanding of the Great Himalayas through geo-scientific exhibits.  - **Awareness Generation:** Raises awareness about the geological and natural heritage of the Himalayan region.  - **Diverse Exhibits:** Offers a wide range of exhibits including maps, charts, models, and actual samples of rocks, minerals, and fossils.  - **Accessibility:** Open to both national and international visitors, making it a globally accessible resource for Himalayan studies.

## Eligibility Criteria
- The applicant can be any national/ international visitor, or a large group/ an institution seeking a guided tour.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
> **For Individuals/Families:**


- If an individual or a family wishes to visit the Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology Museum, they can visit on any working day (Monday to Friday, from 9:30 AM to 5:30 PM). It is advisable to obtain prior permission by sending an email to rksehgal@wihg.res.in or by calling 0135-2525263 / 118.

> **For Large Groups/Institutional Tours:**


- For guided tours for large groups or institutional visits, it is mandatory to obtain prior permission from the Director of the Institution: director@wihg.res.in

page_content:
# University Scholarship (Ph.D.) - Uttarakhand **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Researcher, PhD, Student, Scholar | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “University Scholarship (Ph.D.)” scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar, under the Department of Agriculture, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance in the form of scholarships to students who are pursuing a Ph.D. programme for 36 months or have submitted their rough thesis.
## Benefits **Rate of Scholarship:** ₹6,000/- per month.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a Ph.D. program at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar. 1. The scholarship is awarded to students who have been pursuing their Ph.D. for 36 months or have submitted their rough thesis, whichever occurs earlier.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - To award fellowships to new and existing students from the date of their registration, the respective Heads of Departments invite applications on the prescribed form, following the procedure established in 1994–95 and approved by the Vice-Chancellor. The scholarship is renewed monthly based on academic progress. - This fellowship of ₹6,000/- per month is awarded to two students admitted to each Ph.D. program, based on merit determined by their scores in various examinations related to their academic qualifications. The Heads of Departments prepare a merit list and submit it to the office, along with their recommendations and the applications received from all students in their departments. - The Dean of Student Welfare then places these recommendations before a previously constituted committee for awarding the fellowships. The committee’s recommendations are approved by the Registrar and the Vice-Chancellor, and the list of selected students is issued through an office order by the Dean of Student Welfare. The fellowship amount is disbursed by the Director, Research Office.

metadata.schemeName: Deployment of Prantiya Rakshak Dal (PRD) Volunteers (For volunteer)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial security to PRD volunteers aged 18 to 42 years by paying a daily honorarium for their assistance in police duties and deployment in various offices.

page_content:
# Deployment of Prantiya Rakshak Dal (PRD) Volunteers (For volunteer) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** PRD Volunteers, Rakshak Dal, Youth, Police Assistance, Employment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Deployment of Prantiya Rakshak Dal Volunteers” was launched by the Department of Youth Welfare and prantiy rakshak dal (PRD), Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial security to PRD volunteers aged 18 to 42 years by paying a daily honorarium for their assistance in police duties and deployment in various offices.
## Benefits Under this scheme, PRD volunteers are paid a daily honorarium of ₹570/- for providing police assistance and performing duties in various offices.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a youth (male or female) aged between 18 and 42 years. 1. The applicant must be a Prantiya Rakshak Dal (PRD) volunteer.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - Various departments submit their requirements for PRD volunteers to the Youth Welfare and PRD Department as needed. Based on these requirements, the department invites applications through advertisements, and district-wise dates are scheduled for physical measurements and examinations. - To participate in the examination, applicants must submit their birth certificate, mobile number, bank account details, permanent residence certificate, caste certificate, and educational qualification certificate. - PRD volunteers are selected based on the merit of the physical examination by a committee headed by the District Magistrate. Selected PRD (uniformed) volunteers undergo 22 days of paramilitary training followed by 15 days of retraining. After completing the training, they are deployed on duty, and their honorarium for the deployment period is paid directly through DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer).

page_content:
# Uniform Assistance for Other Backward Classes (Minority) Students Studying in Standard 1st to 8th

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Uniform Assistance, Education, Other Backward Classes, Minority | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Uniform Assistance for Other Backward Classes (Minority) Students Studying in Standard 1st to 8th" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat aims to promote education and reduce the economic burden on families of minority students from the Other Backward Classes (OBC) by providing them with uniform assistance. The scheme ensures that eligible students from classes 1 to 8 studying in government and aided primary schools receive ₹900/- to cover the cost of three sets of school uniforms.

## Benefits
- **Financial Assistance:** ₹900/- is provided to each eligible student for the purchase of three pairs of school uniforms.

## Eligibility Criteria
- The applicant should be a student.
  - The applicant should belong to the state of Gujarat.
  - The applicant should be studying in Class 1st to Class 8th.
  - The applicant should be enrolled in a government or government-aided primary school.
  - The applicant must belong to the Other Backward Classes (OBC) under the minority category.

**Mode:** Online

**Step 1:** Visit the [Digital Gujarat](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/) portal.

**Step 6:** Submit the application.
**Step 7:** Once the application is completed, proceed to payment to download the certificate.
**Step 8:** Upon successful payment, the certificate will be available for download.

Contact No : 18002335500

metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, fish farmers are provided insurance coverage of ₹5 lakh in case of accidental death/total permanent disability, ₹2.5 lakh for partial disability, & ₹50,000 for hospitalization. No premium is required to be paid by fish farmers, entire cost of the insurance is fully borne by Dept.

page_content:
# Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Accident Insurance Scheme - Uttarakhand **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Insurance, Fish Farmer, Accidental Death, Disability, Fisherman | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Accident Insurance Scheme", a sub-component of the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana, is implemented by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial security to fish farmers in the event of accidental death, permanent disability, or hospitalization.
## Benefits **Under this scheme, an annual insurance coverage is provided as follows:** - ₹5,00,000/- in case of accidental death or total permanent disability. - ₹2,50,000/- for partial disability (such as loss of limbs, fingers, or partial loss of vision/hearing/speech, etc.). - ₹50,000/- for hospitalization expenses due to accidents. - The fish farmer is not required to pay any insurance premium. The entire premium amount is borne by the Department.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be engaged in fish production or fishing as a profession. 1. The applicant may belong to any caste category, including General, Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Other Backward Class (OBC), or be a woman. 1. The applicant’s age must be between 18 and 70 years at the time of enrollment.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - To avail of the benefits under the scheme, eligible beneficiaries can obtain the insurance application form through the field personnel of the Fisheries Department. - The duly filled application form must be submitted along with the fisherman’s Aadhaar card, bank account details, birth certificate, permanent residence certificate, nominee details, and Aadhaar card. The insurance premium is paid by the department. After the fisherman is insured, the department will issue the relevant insurance certificate. - In the event of an accident, death, or hospitalization, the beneficiary’s family must immediately inform the field personnel/officers of the Fisheries Department in the concerned area. - In case of an accident, the claim form along with the necessary documents, such as a medical certificate, death certificate, hospitalization certificate, and insurance certificate, must be submitted. The claim amount will then be disbursed accordingly.

metadata.schemeName: Pre-Examination Coaching Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, free coaching and monthly scholarships are provided to eligible Scheduled Tribe students appearing for exams like IAS, PCS, engineering, medical, NDA, Group ‘C’ exams and other competitive examinations.

page_content:
# Pre-Examination Coaching Scheme

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Scholarship, Scheduled Tribe, Student, Free Coaching, Competitive Exams | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Pre-Examination Coaching" was introduced by the Tribal Welfare Department, Uttarakhand Government. The scheme aims to enhance employment opportunities for Scheduled Tribe (ST) students by preparing them for competitive examinations. Under this scheme, free coaching and monthly scholarships are provided to eligible Scheduled Tribe students appearing for exams like IAS, PCS, engineering, medical, NDA, Group ‘C’ exams and other competitive examinations. The scheme is implemented by the government, non-government, and private institutions approved by the state.

## Benefits
**Free Coaching:**

- Provided for competitive exams such as IAS, PCS, Engineering, Medical, Nursing, NDA, Group ‘C’, and others.

**Monthly Scholarship:**

- ₹1,500/- per month for external (non-local) students.
- ₹750/- per month for local students.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe community.
   1. The applicant should be a student. 
   1. The applicant should be preparing for competitive examinations such as IAS, PCS, Engineering, Medical, Nursing, NDA, or Group ‘C’ exams.
   1. The applicant should have passed High School, Intermediate, or Graduation.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
> **Application Process for the Student:**

**Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the office of the Tribal Welfare Department and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the office of the Tribal Welfare Department.
> **Notes:**


   1.  Applications for the selection of coaching institutes are invited through newspapers, and institutes are selected after approval at the government level.
   1. Applications are also received from students, and preference for selection in coaching is given based on the marks obtained in high school, intermediate, or graduation.

# Skill Development and Economic Empowerment **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Skill Development, Vocational Training, Visually Challenged, Divyang, Computer Literacy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Skill Development and Economic Empowerment" by the is a central sector scheme that aims to provide inclusive vocational training and empower visually challenged individuals for economic self-reliance. Through this scheme, training is provided in various trades such as computer operations, stenography, programming assistance, secretarial assistance, and other technical fields. Additionally, students are provided with free meals, hostel accommodation, library facilities, teaching aids, and medical care. The scheme is implemented by the National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities, Dehradun.

## Benefits > **Free Vocational Training:** - Provides training in various professional courses, including Computer Operator, Stenographer, Mushroom Producer, Radio Jockey, Data Entry Operator, Reflexology, and Gardener. > **Essential Skill Training:** - Offers training in Braille orientation and mobility, computer typing, Hindi and English, and home management skills. > **Modern Learning Tools:** - Senior students receive smartphones and laptops to facilitate modern and convenient studies. > **Comprehensive Support for Trainees:** - Free food and accommodation are provided. - Commuting allowance is given for participation in the program. - Uniforms are provided. - Library facilities are accessible. - Medical facilities are available. - Accessible teaching materials are supplied. - Assistive devices are provided.

metadata.schemeName: Provision of Special Assistance for Development of Low-Cost Educational Materials (SIPDA)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support for the development and supply of low-cost educational materials for visually impaired students. Through this scheme, grants are provided to implementing agencies for purchasing and producing assistive learning devices.

page_content:
# Provision of Special Assistance for Development of Low-Cost Educational Materials (SIPDA)

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Visually Impaired Student, Education, Braille Press, Digital Book Production | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Provision of Special Assistance for Development of Low-Cost Educational Materials (SIPDA)" under the Scheme for Implementation of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 (SIPDA), aims to financially support the creation and modernization of assistive educational tools for visually impaired students pursuing school and higher education. Through this scheme, implementing agencies receive grants to procure, produce, and enhance the capacity of institutions producing educational aids such as Braille presses and digital books. The scheme is implemented by the National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities (NIEPVD).

## Benefits
- **Support for Braille Presses:** Assistance is given for the installation of new Braille presses and enhancement of the capacity and modernization of existing Braille presses.  - **Upgradation of Talking Book Studios:** Financial support is offered for increasing the capacity and modernization of existing Talking Book Studios.  - **Creation and Enhancement of Digital Book Production Centers:** Grants are available for setting up new Digital Book Production Centers and modernizing existing centers to improve production capabilities.  - **Support for Large Print Book Production:** Funding is provided for establishing new Large Print Book Production Centers and increasing the capacity and modernization of existing large print facilities.

## Eligibility Criteria
> **Individual Eligibility:**


  - The applicant must be a visually impaired student enrolled in school or pursuing higher education.
  - The applicant must have a valid Unique Disability ID (UDID) card issued by the competent authority.

> **Institutional Eligibility:**


  - The agency must be approved for SIPDA projects.
  - The agency must be actively involved in the development, production, or distribution of educational materials for persons with visual disabilities.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
> **For Institutional Applicants:**

**Step 1:** The implementing agency should prepare a project proposal outlining the infrastructure to be established or upgraded.
**Step 2:** The proposal should be submitted to NIEPVD or the concerned state authority for review and approval.
**Step 3:** Once approved, funds are disbursed as per the sanctioned amount.
**Step 4:** The agency must maintain transparency in utilization and submit reports and utilization certificates as required.
> **For Student Beneficiaries (if applicable):**

**Step 1:** The student should approach an approved implementing agency.
**Step 2:** Submit necessary documents such as Aadhaar, UDID, and school/college ID.
**Step 3:** The agency will facilitate access to learning materials based on availability and eligibility.
> **Website:** [niepvd.nic.in](https://niepvd.nic.in/)

> **Telephone No.:** 7579278149

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Alpasankhyak Protsahan Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme supports minority community candidates of Uttarakhand by offering financial incentives for competitive exam preparation. Incentives are provided at different stages of success in exams like UPSC, UKPSC (including judicial services), and entrances to IITs & IIMs.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Alpasankhyak Protsahan Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Minority Community, Student, Entrance Examination, Competitive Examination, UPSC, Preparation Of Examination, UKPSC | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Mukhyamantri Alpasankhyak Protsahan Yojana” was launched by the Minority Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage and support candidates from the minority community of Uttarakhand by providing financial incentives for the preparation of competitive examinations. These incentives are given at various stages of success in examinations conducted by bodies such as the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), Uttarakhand Public Service Commission (UKPSC) (including combined competitive and higher judicial services exams), as well as entrance examinations for national-level institutions like IITs and IIMs.
## Benefits **The following incentives are provided to candidates from the minority community for their preparation:** **For the All India Civil Services Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC):** - ₹75,000/- after passing the Preliminary Examination and applying for the Main Examination. - ₹25,000/- for interview preparation after passing the Main Examination. **For the Uttarakhand State and Subordinate Services (Direct Recruitment), Combined Competitive Examination, Higher Judicial Service, and Provincial Civil Services (Judicial) conducted by the Uttarakhand Public Service Commission (UKPSC):** - ₹60,000/- after passing the Preliminary Examination and applying for the Main Examination. - ₹20,000/- for interview preparation after passing the Main Examination. **For admission to national-level institutes through entrance examinations:** - Group A: Admission to IITs and IIMs – ₹60,000/- after clearing the entrance examination and securing admission. - Group B: Admission to AIIMS, IISc Bangalore, IISER (Kolkata & Bangalore), national-level medical colleges recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI), National Institutes of Technology (NITs) recognized by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), National Law Universities recognized by the Bar Council of India (BCI), and through the Common Law Admission Test (CLAT) – ₹50,000/- after passing the entrance examination and securing admission.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to a minority community (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Parsi, Buddhist, or Jain). 1. The applicant must have successfully cleared either the Preliminary or Main Examination stage of UPSC, UKPSC (Combined Competitive or Higher Judicial Services), or the entrance examination of a national-level institution (such as IITs, IIMs, etc.). 1. The annual income of the applicant’s parents/guardians (including the applicant’s own income, if any) must not exceed ₹4.50 lakh. 1. The grant amount will be released only after the candidate submits the admit card of the relevant examination and the original application form/certificate of success to the competent authority.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - Applicants can obtain the application form from the Directorate or the District Minority Welfare Office, or they may download it from the website [https://minoritywelfare.uk.gov.in/](https://minoritywelfare.uk.gov.in/hi/scheme/%e0%a4%ae%e0%a5%81%e0%a4%96%e0%a5%8d%e0%a4%af%e0%a4%ae%e0%a4%82%e0%a4%a4%e0%a5%8d%e0%a4%b0%e0%a5%80-%e0%a4%85%e0%a4%b2%e0%a5%8d%e0%a4%aa%e0%a4%b8%e0%a4%82%e0%a4%96%e0%a5%8d%e0%a4%af%e0%a4%95-%e0%a4%aa/). - The application must be submitted within thirty days of clearing the examinations conducted by the State Public Service Commission or the Union Public Service Commission, and within thirty days of securing admission in a national-level institute after clearing its entrance examination. At present, the process is conducted offline. - The application form must be accompanied by a recent passport-size photograph certified by a gazetted officer, educational qualification certificates, a self-declaration minority community certificate, a permanent residence certificate, a valid income certificate, the admit card of the concerned examination, proof of success in the examination, details of an Aadhaar-linked bank account, a copy of the Aadhaar card, and an affidavit. The affidavit must declare that the benefit has not been availed earlier in the current financial year, specify whether the attempt is the first, second, or third, and state clearly whether the applicant is in government service. After verifying the details, the completed form must be submitted to the District Minority Welfare Officer’s office within one month of the result being declared. - The original certificates of the candidate are verified by the competent authority, and the candidate may be called for this purpose. Once the verification is found to be correct, eligible applications are forwarded from the district level to the Directorate for budget allocation. The Directorate then consolidates all proposals and submits them to the government. - On receiving the budget, the Directorate releases funds to the districts as per the demand, and the respective district offices transfer the sanctioned amount directly into the candidate’s Aadhaar-linked bank account. - If a candidate qualifies in two or more examinations in the same financial year, benefits will be provided under only one scheme, depending on the option exercised by the candidate.

page_content:
# ICSSR International Collaboration

**Ministry:** Ministry of Education | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** ICSSR Travel Grant, Participation In International Conference Abroad, Social Science Research, Develop New Insights And Enlarge Research Perspective, PhD & Post-Doctoral Scholars And Faculties | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
Through this programme, it promotes academic links amongst the social scientists in India and abroad, provides opportunity to develop new insights and to enlarge their research perspective and contribute to the advancement and dissemination of knowledge in social science subjects. Under this scheme, the financial assistance is provided to Indian scholars, who have been invited to contribute and present papers at International Conference abroad. Invitation received from global subject associations/reputed international organisations/universities are given preference.  Applications are invited in all broad disciplines within the domain of social sciences. Faculties with regular service in public funded Universities / Deemed-to-be-Universities/Colleges, Institutes of National Importance as defined by MoE / UGC, and ICSSR Research Institutes/Recognized Institutes having a PhD degree are eligible to apply. PhD/PDF scholars in the advanced stage of their research are also eligible. The applications shall be accepted at least three months before the due date of the Seminar/Conference. Faculties will be eligible for financial assistance up to 50% of the total cost of visit under this scheme. However, the faculties belonging to SC/ST, Persons with Benchmark Disability and Doctoral/Post-Doctoral scholars (without pay protection) will be considered for full financial assistance. The expenditure are reimbursed on submission of the original boarding pass, attendance certificate, statement of expenditure and a brief report on the Seminar/Conference/ Workshop/Proceedings.

## Benefits
1)	Airfare – As per actuals
2)	Visa fee - As per actuals
3)	Travel Insurance - As per actuals
4)	Registration Fee – up to US$200
5)	Maintenance – As per the Ministry of External Affairs notifications

## Eligibility Criteria
1)	The applicant must be an Indian citizen.
2)	Faculties with regular service having a PhD degree are eligible to apply. 
3)	PhD/PDF scholars in the advanced stage of their research are eligible. 
4)	If the paper is co-authored, priority will be given to the first author. But a No Objection Certificate (s) from the second author(s) is must. 
5)	Must be affiliated public funded Universities / Deemed-to-be-Universities/Colleges, Institutes of National Importance as defined by MoE / UGC, and ICSSR Research Institutes/Recognized Institutes

## Exclusions
1)	Those who are not fulfilling the edibility criteria.
2)	Scholars, who have been invited for poster presentation or chair a session or chosen as    conveners/rapporteurs or invited to attend a workshop/training/refresher/summer/winter course are not eligible.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
Step 01: Visit ICSSR website - [www.icssr.org](https://icssr.org) - and navigate to International Collaboration section.
Step 02: Click on Paticipation in International Conference Abroad Scheme.
Step 03: Register/Login to the ICSSR portal.
Step 04: Fill the online application form.
Step 05: Upload documents and submit.

metadata.schemeName: Maa-Badi / Maa-Badi Day-Care Centre Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to impart basic education, nutrition, and awareness to tribal children aged 6–12. The scheme offers meals, learning material, and other support through community-run centres.

page_content:
# Maa-Badi / Maa-Badi Day-Care Centre Scheme

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Women and Child | **Tags:** Education, Scheduled Tribes, Maa Badi, Nutritious Meals, Child Care | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Maa-Badi / Maa-Badi Day-Care Centre Scheme" was introduced by the Tribal Area Development Department, Government of Rajasthan, during the year 2007–2008. It aims to provide basic primary education, nutritional support, and awareness on health and sanitation to out-of-school children from Scheduled Tribes (ST), Kathodi, and Sahariya communities in remote tribal areas. Under this scheme, free education (classes 1st to 4th), nutritious meals, uniforms, and learning materials are provided to tribal children aged 6 to 12 years residing in areas where the nearest school is 1.5–2 km away. The scheme is implemented by the Tribal Area Development Project Office with community participation and employs local educated tribal youth and women. 
> **Objectives:**


- Enroll 30 tribal children aged 6 to 12 years at each Maa-Badi Centre, giving preference to girls.
- Provide free breakfast and mid-day meals to enrolled children.
- Distribute uniforms, shoes, socks, ties, belts, and sweaters to each child.
- Prevent migration of children of agricultural laborers by ensuring consistent education.
- Involve mothers of enrolled children in food preparation on a rotational basis with honorarium.
- Link tribal women to adult literacy programs through Maa-Badi centres.
- Create awareness about government schemes on health, nutrition, and sanitation.
- Operate centres through local Village Development Committees with oversight from technical staff.

## Benefits
**At these centers, children are provided following benefits:**

- Free primary education (classes 1st to 4th).- Breakfast and nutritious mid-day meals.
- Free uniforms, school bags, shoes, socks, sweaters, ties, and belts.
- Free sports equipment etc.

**Day-Care Centre Specific Benefits:**

- Full-day (9:00 AM to 5:00 PM) operation.
- 2 education facilitators and 3 assistants at each centre.
- Meals are provided twice a day.

**Maa-Badi Centre Specific Benefits:**

- Operates as per the school calendar.
- 1 education facilitator and 2 assistants per centre.
- Breakfast and one mid-day meal.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a child aged 6 to 12 years.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe, Kathodi, or Sahariya community.
1. The applicant should reside in Udaipur, Dungarpur, Banswara, Pratapgarh, Sirohi, or Rajsamand districts.
1. The applicant should not currently be enrolled in any formal school.
1. The applicant should reside in areas where the nearest school is at least 1.5–2 km away.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the Maa-Badi Centre and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Maa-Badi Centre.

metadata.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to pilgrims undertaking a pilgrimage to the Sindhu River in the Ladakh region of India. Under this scheme, selected beneficiaries receive reimbursement of their travel expenses, up to a maximum of ₹10,000/- per pilgrim.

page_content:
# Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme - Rajasthan

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Travel & Tourism | **Tags:** Reimbursement, Pilgrimage, Pilgrim, Sindhu | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme" was introduced by the Devasthan Department, Government of Rajasthan, on 1st April 2016. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to pilgrims undertaking a pilgrimage to the Sindhu River in the Ladakh region of India. Under this scheme, selected beneficiaries receive reimbursement of their travel expenses, up to a maximum of ₹10,000/- per pilgrim. 
> **Total Number of Beneficiaries**

The scheme is limited to 200 pilgrims per year. If there are more applicants than available slots, selection will be by lottery.

## Benefits
- Reimbursement of 50% of actual travel expenses, up to a maximum of ₹10,000 per pilgrim.

> **Note:**

Payment is made via online bank transfer or through account payee cheque or demand draft, depending on departmental conditions.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant's age should be 21 years or above.
1. The applicant should not be a person who subsists on alms.
1. The applicant should not be an income tax payer.
1. The applicant should not be a retired employee/officer of the Central Government/State Government/Central & State Government Undertakings/Local Body.
1. Only one-time assistance per lifetime is permitted.

**Note:** Only the person selected by the Devasthan Department, Rajasthan is eligible to get the benefit of the scheme.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
> **Application Process**

**Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the [application form](https://devasthan.rajasthan.gov.in/Files/sindhu_darshan_2024.pdf) from the official website. 
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Assistant Commissioner’s Office, Devasthan Department.
> **Note:.**


  - The application must be submitted within 2 months of pilgrimage completion.
  - The application submitted no later than December 31, 2024.

> **Selection & Approval Process**


  - Only individuals selected by the Devasthan Department are eligible for the grant.
  - After completion of the pilgrimage, submit proof of expenses and certified documents to the Assistant Commissioner.
  - The Assistant Commissioner will verify and forward all valid applications to the Commissioner, Devasthan Office, Udaipur.
  - If applications exceed 200, a computerized lottery will be conducted.
  - In case of families applying together, only 3 members per family will be considered.
