metadata.schemeName: Madhya Pradesh Lok Vaniki Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide for the management of tree covered areas located on private land and revenue land under the MP Public Forestry Act, 2001. The scheme benefits landowners, Gram Panchayats, or Gram Sabhas by allowing them to undertake the scientific management of their tree covered areas.

page_content:
# Madhya Pradesh Lok Vaniki Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Madhya Pradesh | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Forest, Management, Village, Panchayat, Trees, Land | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Madhya Pradesh Lok Vaniki Yojana” was launched by the Forest Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to manage private and revenue tree covered areas. The scheme provides for the scientific management of tree covered areas located in private and revenue lands, where the management is proposed voluntarily by the landowner, Gram Panchayat, or Gram Sabha. Key features include the creation of technical management plans (Prabandh Yojana) which are subject to approval by the competent authority. The applications for this scheme are accepted by submitting the proposal to the Divisional Officer (Van Mandal Adhikari) or the Range Officer (Van Kshetra Adhikari).
## Benefits - Authorization for scientific management of tree-covered areas.
##### ***Conditions*** - _The designated Landowner, Gram Panchayat, or Gram Sabha must implement the Technical Management Plan according to the activities and conditions specified within the plan._ - _For "Lok Van" (Public Forest) management plans, the Gram Sabha must authorize the implementation of the specified activities through a resolution of the Social Audit Committee._ - _If the management plan involves harvesting timber, the concerned Landowner, Gram Panchayat, or Gram Sabha must provide advance notification regarding the proposed date of harvesting to the Range Officer (Van Kshetra Adhikari) or Tehsildar, at least seven days prior to the proposed date._ - _The Landowner, Gram Panchayat, or Gram Sabha must maintain a register regarding the trees harvested, using the prescribed format within the Technical Management Plan._ - _All subsequent operations and transactions mentioned in the Technical Management Plan must be completed within the stipulated time._ - _The implementation of the approved Technical Management Plan will be monitored by the Competent Authority (Samyak Pradhikari) through a committee or other authorized official under the supervision of the Divisional Officer (Van Mandal Adhikari)._ - _The approval of the Technical Management Plan may be revoked if there is a violation of the defined conditions or rules._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a landowner who desires to take responsibility for the management of any tree covered area. - The applicant must be a Gram Panchayat or a Gram Sabha who desires to take responsibility for the management of any tree covered revenue land located within its jurisdiction. - The applicant must apply to the Tehsildar (Revenue) for the demarcation and management of the land as "Lok Van" (Public Forest), if the land is tree covered revenue land. - The applicant must submit the management proposal to the Divisional Officer (Van Mandal Adhikari) or the Range Officer (Van Kshetra Adhikari). - The applicant (Landowner) must attach a declaration regarding land title/possession, including an attested photocopy of the latest land records (Khasra). - The applicant (Gram Panchayat/Gram Sabha) must submit a resolution to the Tehsildar (Revenue) after getting the land demarcated and handed over for management as "Lok Van".
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ##### **Step 1:****** ***Initiation of the Management Proposal*** - The applicant, if a landowner wishing to manage a tree covered area, must submit a proposal to the Divisional Officer (Van Mandal Adhikari) or the Range Officer (Van Kshetra Adhikari). - If the applicant is a Gram Panchayat or Gram Sabha wishing to manage tree covered revenue land, they must apply to the Tehsildar (Revenue) to have the land demarcated and managed as "Lok Van" (Public Forest).
##### **Step 2:****** ***Land Demarcation and Handover (Required for Gram Panchayat/Gram Sabha)*** - The Tehsildar (Revenue) must decide on the application for land demarcation within 30 days. - If the Tehsildar decides to proceed, the demarcation must be completed within 15 days, and the land must subsequently be handed over to the concerned Gram Sabha or Gram Panchayat.
##### **Step 3:****** ***Preparation of the Technical Management Plan*** - After the initial proposal and demarcation steps (if applicable) are completed, the concerned Landowner, Gram Panchayat, or Gram Sabha must prepare a detailed Technical Management Plan for the tree covered area. - This plan must outline the specific management activities to be undertaken, such as regulating cutting, conservation measures, timber harvesting, enrichment planting, soil conservation, and biodiversity conservation, over the specified working periods.
##### **Step 4:****** ***Submission of the Technical Management Plan for Approval*** - For proposals concerning private forests, the Technical Management Plan, along with five copies, must be submitted to the Divisional Officer (Van Mandal Adhikari) using the format prescribed in [**Form 1**](https://upload.indiacode.nic.in/showfile?actid=AC_MP_74_265_00015_00015_1697454194461&type=rule&filename=rule_lokvaniki_2002.pdf).- For proposals concerning "Lok Van" (Public Forest) on revenue land, the Technical Management Plan, along with five copies and a resolution passed by the Gram Panchayat or Gram Sabha, must be submitted to the Divisional Officer (Van Mandal Adhikari) using the format prescribed in [**Form 2**](https://upload.indiacode.nic.in/showfile?actid=AC_MP_74_265_00015_00015_1697454194461&type=rule&filename=rule_lokvaniki_2002.pdf).
##### **Step 5:****** ***Scrutiny and Technical Verification of the Proposal*** - The Competent Authority (Samyak Pradhikari), or a representative authorized by them, will conduct a physical inspection or inquiry of the area mentioned in the plan to verify the details and ensure the plan's feasibility. - Based on the inquiry report, the Competent Authority may propose amendments or corrections to the submitted Technical Management Plan.
##### **Step 6:****** ***Final Approval Process*** - The Divisional Officer (Van Mandal Adhikari) is responsible for approving the Technical Management Plan. - However, if the Technical Management Plan involves timber harvesting exceeding 10 cubic meters, the Competent Authority must submit the plan for the prior approval of the State Government, through the Principal Chief Conservator of Forests, within 30 days of receiving the proposal.
##### **Step 7:****** ***Communication of Decision and Final Documentation*** - The Competent Authority must communicate the order of approval (in [**Form 3**](https://upload.indiacode.nic.in/showfile?actid=AC_MP_74_265_00015_00015_1697454194461&type=rule&filename=rule_lokvaniki_2002.pdf) for private land or [**Form 4**](https://upload.indiacode.nic.in/showfile?actid=AC_MP_74_265_00015_00015_1697454194461&type=rule&filename=rule_lokvaniki_2002.pdf) for "Lok Van") or the order of rejection, stating the reasons, to the applicant.- If the plan involves harvesting less than 10 cubic meters and no decision is communicated within 30 days of submission, the Technical Management Plan is deemed approved from the date of expiry of that 30-day period.
After approval, the Competent Authority sends a copy of the approved plan along with the approval order to the concerned Landowner, Gram Panchayat, or Gram Sabha and also forwards a copy of the approval order and the relevant extracts of the plan to the concerned Tehsildar (Revenue) for entry into the land records (Bhumi Abhilekh).

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide Social Security and Financial Support for healthy living to those engaged in traditional occupations/businesses and motorcycle pilots. It offers monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000/- to eligible persons of Goan Origin who meet specified age and income criteria.

page_content:
# Scheme to Grant Monthly Financial Assistance to the Persons Engaged in Traditional Occupations/Businesses including Motorcycle Pilots **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Pilot, Livelihood, Business, Occupation, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Scheme to Grant Monthly Financial Assistance to the Persons Engaged in Traditional Occupations/Businesses including Motorcycle Pilots” was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to provide Social Security and Financial Support for healthy living to the persons engaged in occupations/businesses who earn their livelihood and continue to do so even today through traditional occupations/businesses including motorcycle pilots. The applications for this scheme are accepted through the Block Development Officer (B.D.O.) of the respective Taluka in the prescribed Form in Annexure-I.
## Benefits - Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000/- (Rupees one thousand only) shall be provided by the Government to the eligible persons. - The financial assistance sanctioned under the Scheme shall be released in the Saving Bank Account of the beneficiaries through Electronic Clearance System (ECS).
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be of Goan Origin. - The family income of the applicant from all sources must not exceed ₹1,50,000/- per annum. - The applicant must not be less than 50 years of age. - The applicant should be engaged in the traditional occupations/businesses/motor-cycle pilot activities for at least 10 (ten) years before applying for financial assistance under this Scheme. - The applicant must still be continuing the traditional business/occupation including motorcycle pilot activity. - The applicant must be declared medically unfit to carry out such activity. - The applicant must not be a beneficiary availing financial assistance under Dayanand Social Security Scheme/Kala Sanman Scheme or under any other similar scheme of the Government where monthly allowance is paid in any name/form. _*Beneficiaries availing financial assistance under Griha Adhar Scheme shall be entitled for availing benefits under this Scheme subject to fulfillment of eligibility conditions laid under this Scheme._ ##### ***Criteria Regarding Proof of Activity*** - The applicant having valid registration certificates from the competent authority of the traditional business activities being carried by him may apply under the Scheme. - In case the applicant is unable to submit documentary evidence from the concerned authorities regarding his/her traditional business activity, then he/she may submit an affidavit sworn before Executive Magistrate or Notary Public stating his/her nature of traditional activities being carried and since when, etc.
## Exclusions Beneficiaries availing financial assistance under Dayanand Social Security Scheme/Kala Sanman Scheme or under any other similar scheme of the Government where monthly allowance is paid in any name/form shall not be eligible for claim of financial assistance under this Scheme.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goaprintingpress.gov.in/downloads/1213/1213-38-SI-OG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the ***Block Development Officer (B.D.O.) of the respective Taluka***. ##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** **Verification by the Block Development Officer** - The concerned Block Development Officer (B.D.O.) shall verify the details provided by the applicant through the Field Assistant attached to the BDO's office or any other employee working under the BDO’s control. - The BDO must then forward the eligible applications, along with a recommendation for sanction, to the Director of Social Welfare. **Step 2:** **Scrutiny and Sanctioning** - The Director of Social Welfare shall conduct a detailed scrutiny of the eligible applications received from the BDOs. - After scrutiny, the Director places the applications before the Sanctioning Committee, which is composed of the Minister for Social Welfare (Chairperson), an expert person having knowledge of traditional occupation/businesses (Member), and the Director of Social Welfare (Member Secretary). ##### ***Disbursement of Financial Assistance*** The sanctioned financial assistance shall be disbursed to the beneficiaries in their Saving Bank Account. The payment is processed monthly using the Electronic Clearance System (ECS).

It offers a reimbursement of 50% of the installation expenditure, capped at ₹5,000/- (Indian Rupees 5,000/-) per device, to eligible entities.

page_content:
# Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Upgradation in Transportation through Tracking Devices **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Transportation, Subsidy, Reimbursement, Logistics, Vehicle | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme” was launched by the Department of Industries, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the development of the logistics and warehousing industry in the State. The “Subsidy towards Upgradation in Transportation through Tracking Devices” component of the scheme provides a one-time allowance, covering 50% of the expenditure incurred for the installation of tracking devices on goods carriers. The maximum amount reimbursed is strictly limited to ₹5,000/- (Indian Rupees 5,000/-) per tracking device, per truck or carrier. This benefit is provided on a first-come, first-served basis, aiming to benefit a maximum of 1,000 trucks/carriers in a fiscal year. Support under this scheme is available solely to Entities or transport operators that possess a fleet and provide cargo transportation services within Goa, whether by land or water. Applications are required to be submitted through the Goa Online Portal.
## Benefits - A one-time allowance covering 50% of the expenditure incurred for the installation of tracking devices on goods carriers. - The maximum reimbursement is limited to ₹5,000/- (Indian Rupees 5,000/-) per tracking device, per truck or carrier. ##### ***Disbursal*** - The benefits are subject to a first-come, first-served basis. - The Government aims to benefit a maximum of 1,000 trucks/carriers in a fiscal year. - Each entity is entitled to benefit from this scheme once per year. - Claims pertain to expenses incurred after the official announcement of the Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. ##### ***Conditions*** - The Entity undertakes to refund 10 times the concessions claimed if found to have been obtained by misrepresentation of facts or in case of misuse. - The Entity shall allow and/or grant free access to any official authorized by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce for conducting inspection/supervision of the unit or the registers or holding discussions with the employed employees for ensuring proper utilization of the financial incentives/subsidies granted by the State Government. - The Entity shall submit to the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce all the necessary reports, information and documents specified under the scheme or as required or directed by the DITC (Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce). - If, after disbursement, it is found that the information or documents submitted are incorrect, the Government of Goa/Director of Industries, Trade and Commerce shall revoke the subsidy, and the Entity shall pay back the financial incentives received.
## Eligibility Criteria - The Entity must be only applicable for non-mega industries. - The Entity must own a business unit in Goa and provide Logistics and Warehousing services in Goa. - Support under the scheme shall be provided only to the entities who are Logistics and Warehousing services providers. - The Entity must have a Permanent Account Number (PAN). - The Entity must regularly file the Income Tax Returns in the name of the legal entity (proprietor, firm, or company, etc.). - The Entity must be in continuous operations for a minimum period of six months post the date of notification of Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The Entity must have incurred the expenses (for claiming reimbursement) post the date of launch of the Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The Entity must not have claimed similar benefit under any other scheme/program of State or Central Government. - The Entity must provide Minimum 40% local employment (employees who are employed continuously during the claim year and are on the payroll of the unit for that year shall be considered). - The Entity or transport operator must possess a fleet and provide cargo transportation services within Goa, whether by land or water. - Transport operators and their commercial vehicles must be registered in one of the Regional Transport Offices (RTO) in Goa and must maintain valid registration credentials. - The tracking device purchases must have been made subsequent to the introduction of the ‘Logistics and Warehousing Policy, 2023’. - The application for reimbursement should only be submitted subsequent to the acquisition of the fleet intended for tracking device installation. ##### ***Preference/Quantum of Benefit*** - The quantum of benefit shall be defined by the proportion of Goan employees on payrolls. - If the Quantum of Goan Employment on payrolls is 60% or above, the Entity is eligible for 100% of the benefits. - If the Quantum of Goan Employment on payrolls is More than 40% but less than 60%, the Entity is eligible for 80% of the benefits. - If the Quantum of Goan Employment on payrolls is Less than 40%, the Entity is Ineligible.
## Exclusions - Expenses related to subscription services or software are excluded from this benefit. - The subsidy does not extend to the costs associated with software for tracking devices installed in goods carriers. - The reimbursement is strictly limited to the costs associated with the purchase and installation of the tracking device.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online _*The entity who wishes to avail incentives must first be registered on the Goa Online portal (www.goaonline.gov.in) and must have already obtained necessary business approvals through the portal._ **Step 1:****** Visit the [Official Web Portal](https://goaonline.gov.in/) of Goa Online. At the top right corner, click "[Register](https://goaonline.gov.in/Public/userRegistration_af)". **Step 2:****** On the next page, verify your Email ID and Mobile Number using OTP. You will be redirected to the Registration Page. **Step 3:****** On the Registration Page, fill in all the mandatory fields of the registration form. Create a Login Name and a strong Password. Carefully read the Declaration and the Terms & Conditions, and tick the checkboxes. Fill in the Captcha Code, and click "Register/Signup". **Step 4:****** Login to the website using your Login Name and Password. Fill in the Captcha Code, and click "Login". **Step 5:****** In the top ribbon, click on "Services", then click on "[IT Services](https://goaonline.gov.in/AllServices?cat=IT)". Click on **"Incentives on Logistics and Warehousing Sector"**. You will be taken to the application form for the scheme. Fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents. **Step 6:****** Submit the application. A unique registration number will be generated. Note this number for future reference.

##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** **Query Resolution by DITC.** Upon receipt of the application, the DITC should raise queries to the applicant for any shortfall in the application form or the documents submitted. **Step 2:** **Inspection and Verification.** Upon successful verification of the applications and documents, DITC should designate an official to inspect the Entity and verify all the records/documents as per the verification-cum-recommendation checklist (Annexure X). The inspecting officers are required to upload the inspection reports in the portal within 48 hours, and this report will be made available to the entrepreneur through their login. **Step 3:** **Due Diligence by Goa-IPB.** After receipt of the Inspection Report, the application is marked to the Chief Executive Officer, Goa Investment Promotion and Facilitation Board (Goa-IPB) for due diligence. **Step 4:** **Appraisal Note Preparation.** After receiving the recommendation from the Chief Executive Officer (Goa-IPB), DITC will prepare the appraisal note for the case for placing before the Incentive Review Committee. **Step 5:** **Sanction by Incentive Review Committee.** DITC will call for the Incentive Review Committee meeting, which shall scrutinize and sanction the claims after deliberation on the incentive application. **Step 6:** **Final Disbursement.** After receipt of the Incentive Review Committee recommendations, DITC will prepare the approval note for placing before the Accounts Department for disbursing incentives. All sanctioned claims will be organized chronologically and disbursed to the respective entities following due procedure. **Step 7:** **Follow-up Inspections.** The concerned inspecting officers shall inspect the units once every six months after the first inspection or from the date of the previous inspection. Subsequent claims received may be processed based on the earlier inspection/performance report filed without inspecting the unit again physically.

metadata.schemeName: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) for Custom Hiring Centres / Big Farmers - Uttarakhand
metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, individual large farmers, farmer groups, cooperatives, self-help groups, and custom hiring centres in the state can purchase agricultural equipment at a subsidized rate, with the Government of India providing a maximum subsidy of 40%.

page_content:
# Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) for Custom Hiring Centres / Big Farmers - Uttarakhand **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Farmer, Agricultural, Mechanization, Subsidy, Custom Hiring Centre, Self-help Group | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization for Custom Hiring Centres / Big Farmers” is implemented by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote agricultural mechanization and enhance farm productivity by facilitating access to modern farm machinery. Under this scheme, individual large farmers, farmer groups, cooperatives, self-help groups, and custom hiring centres in the state can purchase agricultural equipment at a subsidized rate, with the Government of India providing a maximum subsidy of 40%.
## Benefits Under the Custom Hiring Centre component (for groups of farmers involved in buying, renting, or selling agricultural equipment), farmer groups, cooperatives, FPOs, self-help groups, and individual farmers can purchase equipment valued between ₹10.00 lakh and ₹100.00 lakh. The Government of India provides a maximum subsidy of 40% on such purchases.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a large farmer (owning 5 hectares or more of land), a cooperative group, self-help group, or a custom hiring centre in Uttarakhand. 1. The farmer or group must have cultivable land located in Uttarakhand. 1. For an individual large farmer, their name must be recorded in the revenue records. For a group, the names of all group members must be listed in the agricultural land documents.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - After receiving the target from the Government of India, the Agriculture Department, through the District Chief Agriculture Officer’s Office, publishes an advertisement inviting applications for the purchase of machinery at a subsidized rate. - To avail of this scheme, farmers/groups must apply within the dates specified in the advertisement. Applications can be submitted online through the SMAM portal ([https://agrimachinery.nic.in](https://agrimachinery.nic.in/)) either by the farmers/groups themselves or via the nearest Common Service Center (CSC). - To apply online, farmers are required to upload their Aadhaar card along with an Aadhaar-linked mobile number, bank account details, land certificate, and caste certificate if applicable. In the case of group applications, it is mandatory to provide the bank account of the group or Custom Hiring Centre, a photo of the group president, Aadhaar cards of all group members, and the land documents of all members. All documents must correspond to the district in which the agricultural land is located. Farmers/groups who are unable to apply online can seek assistance from the Agriculture Department’s development block-level officer. - Once the application is submitted, the farmer/group receives a registration number or certificate. Using this registration number, the farmer/group can purchase the required equipment from a panel firm approved by the Agriculture Department, as listed on the portal, and upload the purchase bills. The bills are then verified by Agriculture Department personnel, and the subsidy amount is directly disbursed to the farmer’s/group's bank account through DBT. - The scheme follows a “first-come, first-served” system. District-wise targets are set, and once a district’s target is reached, farmers/groups will need to apply again in the following year to avail the benefits of the scheme.
**Mode:** Online - via CSC Applications can be submitted online by visiting the nearest Common Service Center (CSC), along with all the relevant documents.

metadata.schemeName: Grant In Aid Hostels
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide boarding and lodging facilities to tribal students who wish to pursue primary, secondary and higher secondary education. Free lodging and boarding facilities are provided to intended beneficiaries who are students studying in standards 5th to 12th.

page_content:
# Grant In Aid Hostels **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Housing & Shelter, Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Student, Scheduled Tribe, Hostel, Education, Grant | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Grant In Aid Hostels" was launched in 1969 by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide boarding and lodging facilities by government registered organizations to the tribal students who wish to pursue primary, secondary and higher secondary education. the scheme provides free lodging and boarding facilities, addressing the challenge that the Scheduled Tribe population has a lower literacy level due to the absence of secondary and higher secondary schools in tribal areas, causing students to leave studies after getting primary education. The scheme is implemented by Non-Governmental Organizations. the applications for this scheme are accepted at the district level at the office of the concerned Project Administrator/Assistant Commissioner (Vigilance).
## Benefits Free lodging and boarding facilities are provided to the students. ***Conditions for NGOs*** - The voluntary institution must agree to adhere to the current rules for Backward Class Hostels and any future changes. - The voluntary institution must agree to comply with administrative or other instructions received from the Tribal Development Department and the Director, Tribal Development.
## Eligibility Criteria > ***For the Student*** - The applicant must be a student. - The applicant must be from a Scheduled Tribe. - The applicant must be studying in standard 5th to 12th. - The applicant’s family annual income must be up to ₹1,20,000/- for rural area. - The applicant’s family annual income must be up to ₹1,50,000/- for urban area. > ***For the Institution*** - The applicant must be a voluntary institution. - The applicant must be registered under one of the following acts: Public Trusts Act 1950, Societies Registration Act 1860 - The applicant organization must have a bank balance (liquidity/working capital) certificate showing an amount exceeding ₹15,000/-. - The building must be suitable and equipped with complete facilities, including water and electricity, and available at the demanded site for the hostel. > ***Preference/Priority*** - Preference must be given to selecting hostels only in places where there is currently no hostel facility. - Priority should be given to backward and remote areas during hostel selection.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The representative of the NGO must obtain the prescribed application form from the Office of the concerned Project Administrator/Assistant Commissioner (Vigilance) at the district level by paying ₹10/- in cash. **Step 2:** In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents. Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, to the designated staff at the Office of the concerned Project Administrator/Assistant Commissioner (Vigilance). **Step 3:** Submit the application within the prescribed period (generally 30th August of the respective year). The applicant must pay the non-refundable application processing fee of ₹50/- directly at the concerned office where the form was obtained. > ***Post-Application Process*** After the application is successfully considered and accepted (sanctioned), the applicant institution must then pay a non-refundable fee of ₹500/- using a Challan.

metadata.schemeName: Compensation for Human Death or Injury Caused by Wild Animals
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial relief to victims or families affected by wild animal attacks in both urban and rural areas through timely monetary compensation.

page_content:
# Compensation for Human Death or Injury Caused by Wild Animals **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Madhya Pradesh | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Deceased, Injured, Wild Animal | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Compensation for Human Death or Injury Caused by Wild Animals” scheme is launched by the Forest Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial relief to the families of deceased persons or individuals injured due to attacks by wild animals. The scheme covers both urban and rural areas and ensures quick assistance through a time-bound process.
## Benefits **Compensation Amount:** - **In case of death:** ₹4,00,000 is paid to the deceased’s legal heir or family member after deducting any temporary assistance already given and the actual cost of medical treatment before death.- **In case of injury:** Actual medical expenses are reimbursed, along with ₹500 per day (maximum ₹50,000) if hospitalized, after deducting any temporary assistance already provided. **Expected Time of Disbursement:** - Within 3 working days in case of death. - Within 7 working days in case of injury. **Mode of Disbursement:** - The payment is made directly to the beneficiary’s bank account via e-payment.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a victim of a wild animal attack, resulting in injury or death. 1. The applicant should submit proof that the injury or death was caused by a wild animal (excluding snakes, monitor lizards, and other poisonous creatures). 1. In the case of death, the applicant must be a legal heir, family member, or relative of the deceased person.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Registration** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Website of "[Madhya Pradesh Lok Sewa Guarantee Portal](https://mpedistrict.gov.in/MPL/CitizenRegistration.aspx)". **Step 2:** On the homepage, click "Citizen Registration". You will be taken to the registration page. **Step 3:** On the registration page, fill in all the mandatory fields (name, mobile number, gender, and captcha) and click "Verify Mobile Number." **Step 4:** A verification code will be sent to your mobile number. Enter the code and complete the registration. **Application** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Website of "Madhya Pradesh Lok Sewa Guarantee Portal". **Step 2:** Enter your User ID, Password, and Captcha Code, and click "Login." **Step 3:** Click on "Apply Online Service" and select the scheme you intend to apply for. **Step 4:** In the scheme's online application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size (fields marked with * are mandatory), and click "Submit".
**Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the nearest Forest Range Office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Forest Range Office. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the Forest Range Office to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide short-term working capital loans for livestock activities by offering eligible livestock farmers interest-subsidized loans for operational purposes through banks.

page_content:
# Kisan Credit Card (Pashupalan) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Madhya Pradesh | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Loan, Livestock, Cooperative Society, Interest Rate, Farmer, Agriculture | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Kisan Credit Card (Pashupalan)" scheme is launched by the Animal Husbandry and Dairy Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The schheme provides short-term working capital loans to livestock farmers at subsidized interest rates. Eligible livestock farmers, dairy producers, and members of primary agricultural credit cooperative societies can avail financial support for operational purposes through banks.
## Benefits - Short-term working capital loan for livestock activities through the Kisan Credit Card system. - Interest subsidy is provided on loans sanctioned under the scheme. - Expected Time of Disbursement: Typically within 15 days of application approval.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be a livestock farmer or a member of a primary agricultural credit cooperative society. 1. The applicant should require short-term working capital for livestock activities, including dairy production.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process** **Visit the Official Website:** - Go to [https://samast.mponline.gov.in/portal/](https://samast.mponline.gov.in/portal/) **Create Your Profile:** - Click on “[Create Profile](https://samast.mponline.gov.in/portal/register).”- Fill in the required basic details such as Name, Mobile Number, Gender, Email ID, Date of Birth, etc. - Click on “Next.” **Verify Basic Details:** - Re-enter your Date of Birth and Mobile Number. - Enter the Captcha Code and click on “Profile Banaye.” - An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to verify your profile. **Complete Aadhaar e-KYC:** - Enter your Aadhaar Number, Registered Mobile Number, and Captcha Code. - Click on “Send OTP” and verify using the Aadhaar OTP to complete the e-KYC process. > **Application Fill Process** **Fill Application Form:** - Select the "Scheme Name" - Enter your Samagra ID, Mobile Number, Address, and Business/Personal Details. - Upload the required documents. - Click on “Save & Next.” **Pay Application Fee:** - Proceed to Online Payment and complete the fee payment securely. **Submit & Print:** - After successful submission, note down your Application ID. - Download and print the Application Form for future reference.
**Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the banks, district nodal officers, or dairy cooperatives office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the banks, district nodal officers, or dairy cooperatives office. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the banks, district nodal officers, or dairy cooperatives office to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

# Doodh Sanjeevani Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Health & Wellness, Women and Child | **Tags:** Child, Woman, Pregnant, Mother, Student, Milk | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Doodh Sanjeevani Yojana" was launched by the Department of Education, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide fortified, flavored, double toned pasteurized milk to students, pregnant women and lactating women. The scheme is implemented by the Anganwadi Centers and also by the Child Development Project Officers.
## Benefits > ***For the Students (Education Department)*** ◦ The scheme aims to provide nutritious food to the students. ◦ The students get 200 milliliters of flavoured milk per day. ◦ The milk provided is fortified with added 3% fat, 24 grams carbohydrate, 7 grams protein, Vitamin A 500 International Units, and Vitamin D 40 International Units. ◦ This provision is served five days in a week. > ***For Women & their Child (Women & Child Development Department)*** ◦ Children in the age group of 6 months to 6 years registered at Anganwadi centers receive 100 milliliters of fortified, flavored, double toned pasteurized milk, five days a week. ◦ Pregnant and lactating mothers registered at Anganwadi centers receive 200 milliliters of fortified, flavored, double toned pasteurized milk, twice in a week.
## Eligibility Criteria For the Students ◦ The student must be studying in an elementary school. ◦ The student must be studying in a Balvatika or in Standard 1st to 8th. ◦ The student must be a studying in a Government, Grant-in-Aid, or Primary School located in one of the 28 talukas of the developing tribal areas of Gujarat.
For Women & their Child ◦ The applicant must be a child registered at an Anganwadi center between 6 months and 6 years of age. ◦ The applicant must be a pregnant mother/lactating mother registered at an Anganwadi center.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline 1. The intended beneficiaries receive the fortified, flavored milk directly at the premises (school or Anganwadi center) upon meeting eligibility criteria, and therefore typically do not need to apply separately for this scheme. 2. For scheme implementation related details, - The students should inquire about the process at their primary school. - Pregnant Mothers, or lactating mothers should inquire at the Anganwadi Center.

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Aarogya Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana, launched on 1 May 2021, aims to reduce medical expenses by offering free treatment for 1,798 procedures in government and empanelled private hospitals. Eligible NFSA, SECC 2011 families, contract workers, small farmers, and others can avail benefits.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Ayushman Aarogya Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Health, Free Treatment, Healthcare | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Rajasthan’s Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana (launched 1 May 2021) provides cashless health insurance to reduce out-of-pocket expenses and ensure quality treatment through government and empanelled private hospitals. Eligible families include NFSA, SECC 2011, contract workers, small/marginal farmers, and COVID-19 relief beneficiaries, while others may join by paying a premium.
## Benefits Under the Chief Minister Ayushman Arogya Yojana, along with the eligible families of NFSA and SECC currently benefiting from it, contractual workers, small and marginal farmer families and destitute and helpless families who received Covid-19 ex-gratia amount last year will get free insurance cover and apart from these categories, other remaining families of the state can join the scheme on payment of premium amount of Rs 850/- and the remaining 50 percent premium amount will be borne by the state government.
Free range family: - Farmers (Small and Marginal) of the State, eligible beneficiary families under the State Food Security Act (NFSA), eligible families as per Socio Economic Census (SECC) 2011 - Contract workers - Contract workers working in all departments/boards/corporations/government companies of the state. - Destitute and helpless families receiving COVID-19 ex-gratia payment from the state government - Fee: Nil.
Fixed premium family - Those other families of the state who are not government employees/pensioners, i.e. are not taking benefits under the Medical Attendance Rules, can join the scheme by paying the prescribed premium. - Fee: ₹850/-
## Eligibility Criteria 1. Free Category : - Families eligible under the National Food Security Act (NFSA). - Families identified under the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011. - Contractual employees working in state departments, boards, corporations, and government companies. - Small and marginal farmers. - Destitute and helpless families who received COVID-19 ex-gratia relief in the previous year. 1. Premium Category : - Families not included in the free category. - Families who are not government employees or pensioners. - Families who are not availing benefits under the Medical Attendance Rules. - These families can enroll by paying ₹850 per year per family (50% of the premium), while the remaining 50% is borne by the State Government.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - **Registration Process for Categories Receiving Free Benefits:** 1. Families eligible under the Food Security Act and eligible families as per the Socio-Economic Census 2011 are already eligible under the scheme. Therefore, they do not need to register. 1. Beneficiaries will be required to register on the scheme's registration portal, a link to which is available on the scheme's official website: https://maayojana.rajasthan.gov.in/. Beneficiaries can register online using their SSO ID or by visiting an e-Mitra center. 1. For registration, beneficiaries must have their Aadhaar card/JAN Aadhaar card number/JAN Aadhaar card registration receipt number and Aadhaar card number. 1. Before registration, e-authentication will be performed via OTP on the mobile number registered in the applicant's Aadhaar card, for which the applicant must have the Aadhaar card/Aadhaar card number. 1. Applications for registration of contract workers under the scheme will be verified online by the nodal officer of the concerned department and updated regularly. 1. Small and marginal farmers who are not linked to the Aadhaar card can have their land holdings seeded into the Aadhaar card through e-Mitra, as per the procedure prescribed on the Aadhaar portal. 1. After seeding, the family can be registered online or through e-Mitra on the above-mentioned registration portal of the scheme. 1. After successful registration, the beneficiary will be able to print the policy document.
- **Category eligible for benefits by paying ₹850/- per family per year:** 1. Beneficiaries must register themselves online on the scheme's registration portal or through e-Mitra. These beneficiaries must pay a premium of ₹850 per family per year to the respective e-Mitra center or through digital payment mode. After successful registration, beneficiaries will be able to print the policy document. 1. A detailed step-by-step process for registering under the scheme through e-Mitra or in-person is available on the scheme's website https://maayojana.rajasthan.gov.in/. 1. Registration Fee: Beneficiaries in both categories are not required to pay any fee at the e-Mitra center. The fee for successful registration, premium payment, and printing of the policy document on pre-printed paper will be borne by the State Government.

- **Process for availing benefits under the scheme: The following steps will be followed to avail free treatment under the scheme:** - Identification of Eligible Family: Eligible families will be identified through their Jan-Aadhaar card number/Jan-Aadhaar EID/policy document/Aadhaar card. Therefore, provide this information to the health guide present at the scheme counter at the time of admission to the hospital to ensure the family's eligibility. - Identification of Beneficiary: Once the family's eligibility is confirmed, the patient's eligibility will be verified. For this purpose, by entering the Jan-Aadhaar card number or registration number into the software, the family category and family member details will be displayed. The patient will be identified and biometrically verified. A live photo will be taken in front of the web camera at the time of admission and discharge. - **The patient will only be eligible for benefits under the scheme if the selected category and family member details are displayed in the scheme software.** - Treatment of the patient will begin according to the package available under the scheme. - Provisions for treatment of children up to one year of age: Even if the name of the eligible family is not included in the Jan-Aadhaar card details, a provision has been made to provide treatment under the scheme to children up to one year of age. For this purpose, treatment can be provided by generating the child's TID in the name of any available family member registered in the Jan-Aadhaar card. - If the name of a child above one year of age is not included in the Jan-Aadhaar card, treatment for that child is not possible under the scheme. (In such a situation, the family should be advised that the child's name can be added to the Jan-Aadhaar card by presenting the birth documents at any e-Mitra center.) However, free treatment under the scheme will be available only after the name is added to the Jan-Aadhaar card. - Provisions regarding treatment for children under five years of age: Biometric verification and the presentation of a photo ID are not mandatory for treatment of children under five years of age. A child's TID can be generated by biometric verification of another family member listed on the family identity card.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage all round development of the Tiatr in all aspects by providing encouragement to commercial tiatr directors and producers to bring in development in stage setting, addressing the need for improved theatrical infrastructure and production quality.

page_content:
# Financial Assistance to Commercial Tiatr Troupes/Directors/Producers for Stage Setting **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Theatre, Director, Producer, Stage, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Financial Assistance to Commercial Tiatr Troupes/Directors/Producers for Stage Setting" was launched by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage all round development of the Tiatr in all aspects by providing encouragement to commercial tiatr directors and producers to bring in development in stage setting, addressing the need for improved theatrical infrastructure and production quality. The scheme provides financial assistance to six commercial tiatr troupes/directors/producers annually for stage setting development, with specific conditions including mandatory completion of fifteen performances and display of Tiatr Academy logo on stage sets.
## Benefits - Financial assistance as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa will be provided to six commercial tiatr troupes/directors/producers annually for stage setting development. - Disbursal is made only upon completion of fifteen performances of the tiatr mentioned in the application. - Payment is processed as a one-time benefit per beneficiary. _*Tiatr Academy of Goa logo must be displayed on the front visible frames of the stage set._ _*The stage set designed under this scheme cannot be given on hire to others._ _*No adverse remarks against any individual, government, or political parties are permitted during the use of the set._ _*Work on the stage set must commence only after receiving written approval from Tiatr Academy of Goa._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must have been on the commercial tiatr stage for at least five years. - The applicant must have five years experience on the commercial tiatr stage along with the application. - The applicant must be a commercial tiatr troupe, director, or producer. ***Selection Process*** - A maximum of six commercial tiatr troupes/directors/producers will be selected annually. - If more than six applicants apply, selection will be decided by way of lots. - Remaining applicants will be wait listed and provided with financial assistance in the following financial year. - In case of withdrawal by any selected applicant, the next applicant on the waiting list will be given preference for allotment.
## Exclusions The beneficiary will not be entitled to avail the benefit again under this scheme for the next five years from the date of receiving the financial assistance.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ***Applications are invited through announcements in local dailies by way of advertisements, press releases, and internet notifications by Tiatr Academy of Goa.*** **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. Alternatively, visit the office of Tiatr Academy of Goa to collect the prescribed application form for the scheme. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ > ***Selection Process*** Tiatr Academy of Goa will select six applicants annually, with selection by lots if more than six applications are received, and remaining applicants will be placed on a waiting list. > ***Approval Process*** Selected applicants must obtain written approval from Tiatr Academy of Goa before commencing work on the stage set.

metadata.schemeName: Scholarship Scheme of Sainik School Chhingchhip, Mizoram
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to award financial scholarships to eligible boys of Mizoram domicile who are admitted to Sainik School Chhingchhip, specifically to foster their development and prepare them for future entry into the officer’s cadre of the Armed Forces. Benefits include coverage for School Fee, etc.

page_content:
# Scholarship Scheme of Sainik School Chhingchhip, Mizoram **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Mizoram | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Student, Scholarship, Education, Tuition, Defence, Stipend | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Scholarship Scheme of Sainik School Chhingchhip, Mizoram" was launched by the School Education Department, Government of Mizoram. The scheme aims to award scholarships to all eligible boys of Mizoram domicile who qualify and are admitted to Sainik School Chhingchhip. The objective of establishing the school is to facilitate the all-round development of a child’s personality and remove regional imbalance in entry into the officer’s cadre of the Armed Forces via the National Defence Academy. The scheme provides financial assistance covering School Fee, Dietary Charge, and Clothing Money, with the quantum of benefits depending entirely upon the income level of the parent or guardian.
## Benefits ***Benefit Component:*** School Fee, Dietary Charge, Clothing Money (New/Subsequent Year) ***Parent Income Category (per month):*** Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe: Up to ₹50,000/- OR General Category: Up to ₹25,000/- ***Benefit Rate:*** Rate I (Full) ***State Government's Share:*** 100% of Fee/Charge + ₹2,000/- (For Fee only) ***Central Share:*** NIL
***Benefit Component:*** School Fee, Dietary Charge, Clothing Money (New/Subsequent Year) ***Parent Income Category (per month):*** Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe: ₹50,000/- to ₹1,00,000/- OR General Category: ₹25,000/- to ₹50,000/- ***Benefit Rate:*** Rate II (50%) ***State Government's Share:*** 50% of Fee/Charge + ₹1,000/- (For Fee only) ***Central Share:*** 50%
***Benefit Component:*** School Fee, Dietary Charge, Clothing Money (New/Subsequent Year) Parent Income Category (per month): Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe: Above ₹1,00,000/- OR ***General Category:*** Above ₹50,000/- ***Benefit Rate:*** Rate III (None) ***State Government's Share:*** NIL ***Central Share:*** 100%
- The scholarships cover approved compulsory fees payable to the Institution, with the State’s share disbursed to the Institution by the awarding authority, the Mizoram Scholarship Board. - The State’s share of the scholarship is disbursed to the Institution (Sainik School Chhingchhip). - The scholarship is available for only one year for studying in any class but is renewable as per Rules/Condition. For renewal, the scholarship is paid following the month up to which the same was paid in the previous year. - Cadets are expected to use the sanctioned scholarship amounts to purchase necessary textbooks, stationery, and related items.
***Conditions*** - The award is tenable from the stage it is given until the completion of the course. - Continuation is subject to the student demonstrating satisfactory progress, maintaining good conduct, and ensuring regularity in attendance. - The award will be discontinued if the student fails to secure annual promotion, unless unavoidable reasons are certified by the competent authority of the scheme. - If a student repeats a class, they will not receive a scholarship for that specific class for the second or subsequent year. - If a cadet is declared medically unfit by the appropriate medical authority for entry into the National Defence Academy, the scholarship awarded shall be discontinued from the date the cadet is declared unfit. - The value of the scholarship may be reduced at the sanctioning authority's discretion if the Principal reports that any scholar is without textbooks or stationery. - The scholarship may be cancelled, stopped, or further payments withheld if the student makes unsatisfactory progress or is guilty of misconduct, such as resorting to or participating in strikes or irregular attendance.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should belong to Mizoram State only. - The applicant must qualify in the Annual Entrance examination conducted by the All India Sainik School Society. - The applicant must be admitted to Sainik School Chhingchhip, Mizoram. - The applicant must not be covered under any other Scholarship scheme. - The applicant must submit Income certificates/salary certificates at the time of admission for the grant of scholarship. - For Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST): The income of the parent/guardian should not exceed ₹1,00,000/- (One lakh) per month. - For General Category: The income of the parent/guardian should not exceed ₹50,000/- (Fifty Thousand) per month. - The applicant must not be more than one child of the same parents’/guardians eligible for the said scheme. _*The scholarship will be discontinued if the cadet is found medically unfit for entry into the National Defence Academy._ _*The scholarship will be cancelled and the amount recovered if the student is found to have obtained the scholarship by false statements, and the student will be blacklisted forever._ _*The student is liable to refund the scholarship amount if they discontinue the studies for which the scholarship was awarded during the course of the year._
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** ***Qualifying the Entrance Examination and Securing Admission*** - The applicant must first appear for and successfully qualify in the Annual Entrance examination conducted by the All India Sainik School Society to become eligible for consideration. - Following qualification, the applicant must secure admission to Sainik School Chhingchhip, Mizoram, as the scholarship is specifically available only for studies in this institution. **Step 2:** ***Submission of Financial Documentation at Admission*** - At the time of formal admission to the Sainik School, the parent or guardian of the eligible student must submit the necessary financial documentation to the concerned Institution for the grant of scholarship. - This mandatory submission includes providing valid Income certificates and/or Salary certificates to determine the applicable scholarship rate (Rate I, II, or III) based on the financial criteria for the Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, or General Category. **Step 3:** ***Institutional Submission to the Awarding Authority*** - After the Institution finalizes the selected and admitted lists, it shall compile and forward the list of eligible cadets to the Nodal Department. - The scheme's administrative authority is the Mizoram Scholarship Board, which serves as the Nodal Department responsible for administration and implementation.
> ***Scholarship Disbursal and Reimbursement*** - The Mizoram Scholarship Board, acting as the awarding authority, will disburse the State’s share of the approved scholarship amount directly to the Institution. - This payment method ensures that the Institution is reimbursed for all the approved compulsory fees that the cadet is liable to pay. > ***Renewal and Continuation Check*** - The scholarship is provided for one year and is renewable according to the scheme's Rules and Conditions. - For subsequent years, the scholarship payment will follow the month up to which it was paid in the preceding year, contingent upon the student maintaining satisfactory academic progress and conduct.

metadata.schemeName: Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and around Forest Areas: Assistance for Loss of Cattle Due to Wild Animal Attacks
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to owners of domestic animals who suffer losses due to attacks by wild animals in forest areas and their surroundings. Under this scheme, a grant ranging from ₹3,000 to ₹40,000 per animal is provided, depending on the species and extent of loss.

page_content:
# Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and around Forest Areas: Assistance for Loss of Cattle Due to Wild Animal Attacks **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Domestic Animals, Wild Animal Attacks, Compensation, Livestock Loss, Loss Of Cattle | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Assistance for Loss of Cattle Due to Wild Animal Attacks” is a sub-component of the umbrella scheme “Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and Around Forest Areas”, which is implemented by the Department of Forest, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to owners of domestic animals who suffer losses due to attacks by wild animals in forest areas and their surroundings.
## Benefits **At present, the following compensation amounts are provided in case of animal loss due to attacks by wild animals:** **Type of Animal Loss****Total Payable Amount****Share of State Disaster Response Fund****Share of Human Wildlife Conflict Relief Distribution Fund**Milch Animals- Buffalo / Cow / Camel / Yak / Mithun etc. (Per Animal)₹30,000/-₹30,000/----Agricultural and Transport Animals – Camel, Horse (per Animal)₹40,000/-₹25,000/-₹15,000/-Mule (per Animal)₹40,000/-₹16,000/-₹24,000/-Bull (per Animal)₹25,000/-₹25,000/----Heifer/Donkey/Pony (per Animal)₹16,000/-₹16,000/----Sheep/Goat/Pig (per Animal)₹3,000/-₹3,000/----
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The compensation is applicable only for the loss of domestic animals caused by any of the following wild animals: - Tiger - Leopard - Snow Leopard - All three species of Bear - Hyena - Wild Boar - Crocodile/Gharial - Snake
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - In the event of the killing of domestic animals or cattle, the carcass shall be removed from the incident site only after confirmation by the village head or any currently serving public representative. If any poison or pesticide is applied to the carcass, or if it is tampered with in any manner, the ex-gratia payment will not be admissible. The owner must report the killing in writing to the concerned range office within two days of the incident. - Upon confirmation of the killing of domestic animals or cattle by wild animals, firstly by the village head of the area or any currently in-charge public representative, along with the forest guard of the concerned area, 20% of the total payable amount for the incident will be provided to the owner in advance from the available funds. The remaining amount will be disbursed after receipt of the final investigation report. - The certificate of killing of cattle by wild animals will be issued by the concerned Range Officer. Thereafter, the Divisional Forest Officer/Deputy Director shall have full authority to approve and disburse the ex-gratia payment based on the final investigation report submitted by the Assistant Conservator of Forests/Wildlife Warden. In this regard, the Divisional Forest Officer/Deputy Director shall ensure that all relevant information is sent to the Chief Wildlife Warden. The final investigation report will be made available within one month of the incident. If the report does not confirm that the cattle were killed by wild animals, the advance amount already provided to the owner will be recovered as revenue. ***Note: The Forest Department has issued a toll-free number (1800-890-9715) for reporting any human-wildlife accidents or the presence of wildlife in populated areas anywhere in the state.***

# Tiatr Competition for Educational Institutions at Higher Secondary/College/University Level **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Culture, Artist, Student, Competition, Theatre | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Tiatr Competition for Educational Institutions at Higher Secondary/College/University Level" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage and develop Tiatr activities among students of educational institutions at higher secondary, college, and university levels, recognizing the enthusiasm shown by students in involving themselves in traditional Tiatr performances. The scheme provides financial support for production expenses and awards mementos and certificates to winners in various categories including best performance, individual artistes, direction, and technical aspects.
## Benefits ***Financial Support:*** Educational institutions receive financial assistance as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa to meet expenses for music (live band with at least two blowing instruments), light effects, stage setting, background music, makeup, costumes, refreshments for rehearsals, and transport ***Performance Platform:*** 15 educational institutions get opportunity to participate in production and staging of Tiatr ***Awards and Recognition:*** Mementos and certificates (no cash prizes) awarded in multiple categories including: - Best Performance (1st, 2nd, 3rd prizes) - Individual Artistes Acting (1st and 2nd prizes for male and female) - Best Comedian (male and female) - Best Direction (1st, 2nd, 3rd prizes) - Technical categories: Best Setting, Light Effects, Music, Background Music, Makeup, Costumes - Best Singer Solo (1st and 2nd prizes for male and female) - Best songs categories: Duet, Duo, Trio, Quartet/Quintet, Choral Song - Best Lyrics (1st and 2nd prizes) - Best Script (1st and 2nd prizes) ***Video Documentation:*** One copy of Digital Versatile Disc provided free of cost to participating institutions ***Direct Entry Privilege:*** First three award winners of previous year's competition get direct entry provided their entries are received before due date _*All payments made by cheques in the name of educational institutions._ _*Awards distributed at special function announced by Tiatr Academy of Goa._
> ***Conditions*** - The applicant must maintain adherence to traditional Tiatr format as approved by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must ensure Tiatr duration between 2 to 3 hours including interval of minimum 10 minutes and maximum 15 minutes. - The applicant must ensure no adverse remarks against any governments, individuals, institutions, or anything against caste, creed, and religion in scripts, lyrics, performances, or speeches. - The applicant must submit final typed copy of script and songs 3 days before competition commencement. - The applicant must limit prior performances of the script to maximum 2 shows before competition.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an educational institution at higher secondary, college, or university level. - The applicant must ensure Tiatr script is either new or from any script published by reputed Tiatr writers. - The applicant must ensure Tiatr follows traditional format with 6 to 7 acts with at least 4 cantos. - The applicant must include comedy linked to the story of the play. - The applicant must include at least 8 kantaram including 1 duet (interactive), 1 duo (interactive), 1 trio (interactive), 1 quartet/quintet (interactive), 1 choral song, and solos. - The applicant must ensure not more than 2 shows of the given script have been performed prior to competition.
## Exclusions Musicians can participate in more than one troupe, but other artistes cannot.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Wait for the scheme announcement in local press which will provide details about application deadlines and requirements.** **Step 1:** During the application period announced in local newspapers, visit the office of Tiatr Academy of Goa and collect the prescribed application form for the scheme. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Within the stipulated time period announced in local press, submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** Provide refundable security deposit of ₹3,000/- in the form of cash or demand draft in favour of Member Secretary, Tiatr Academy of Goa payable at Panaji along with the entry form. Note that cheques will not be accepted for this payment. _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** Await feedback from Tiatr Academy of Goa within 10 days regarding script scrutiny, suggestions for improvement, or potential rejection if script does not meet format requirements. **Step 2:** If more than 15 applications are received, attend the meeting of all applicants where selection of 12 remaining troupes will be done by lots, with first three previous year winners getting direct entry. ##### ***Post-Selection Processes*** **Step 1:** Submit final typed copy of script, typed copy of songs (kantaram), cast of the tiatr, summary of songs, and complete list of artistes including technicians and backstage artistes to Tiatr Academy of Goa during office hours 3 days before competition commencement date. **Step 2:** Prepare for performance at the place and day identified by Tiatr Academy of Goa, ensuring Tiatr duration is between 2 to 3 hours including interval of 10-15 minutes and follows all prescribed format requirements. **Step 3:** Stage the Tiatr performance according to the schedule announced in local newspapers, subject to evaluation by panel of judges appointed by Tiatr Academy of Goa.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides a prestigious annual award consisting of a shawl, memento, citation, and cash purse of ₹50,000/-, with recognition given at a special function held on 24th April every year on the anniversary of the release of the first Konkani film 'Mogacho Anvddo' by late Al-Jerry Braganza.

page_content:
# Lifetime Contribution to Konkani Cinema Award **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Artist, Cinema, Award, Culture, Heritage | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Lifetime Contribution to Konkani Cinema Award" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to recognize and honor artistes including tiatr artistes who have contributed immensely for the development of Konkani Cinema in the past, addressing the need to acknowledge their significant contributions to this cultural art form. The scheme provides a prestigious annual award consisting of a shawl, memento, citation, and cash purse of ₹50,000/-, with recognition given at a special function held on 24th April every year on the anniversary of the release of the first Konkani film 'Mogacho Anvddo' by late Al-Jerry Braganza, 'The Father of Konkani Cinema'.
## Benefits **Cash Award:** ₹50,000/- as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa. **Honorary Items:** Shawl, memento, and citation presented to the awardee. **Recognition Ceremony:** Special function held on 24th April every year on the anniversary of the first Konkani film. _*The awardee must be present in person to receive the award at the ceremony._ _*The award ceremony attendance is mandatory - no proxy or representative acceptance is allowed._ _*Once received, the award cannot be conferred again in the recipient's lifetime across any category._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be not less than 60 years of age. - The applicant must have contributed to Konkani Cinema development. **Relaxation** - The age limit of 60 years may be relaxed if the health of the artiste is not well. **Selection Considerations** - The applicant should demonstrate excellence as an actor, script writer, director, playback singer, lyricist, producer, or composer. - The applicant may have received awards in their respective field. - The applicant should have done innovation on the Konkani Cinema front. - The applicant, if a singer/musician, should have songs recorded on vinyl records, Compact Discs, Digital Versatile Discs, online platforms, or brought out in video format. - The applicant may have worked in films of other languages in various capacities including acting, directing, singing, composing music, composing lyrics, designing sets, providing background music, or designing light effects. - The applicant, if a script writer or lyricist, may have published books of their scripts or lyrics.
## Exclusions The applicant cannot receive the award more than once in their lifetime across any category (Tiatr, Khell, Khell-Tiatr, or Konkani Cinema).
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Recommendations are invited from individuals and institutions for deserving candidates. **Step 2:** Advertisements are published in local newspapers seeking nominations. **Step 3:** The Executive Board of Tiatr Academy of Goa reviews all recommendations and may also select deserving artistes from outside the recommended list. **Step 4:** Selection is made based on the specified criteria including years of service, excellence in their field, awards received, innovations made, and published works. **Step 5:** The selected artiste is informed and must confirm their availability to attend the award ceremony in person.
