metadata.schemeName: Prime Minister’s Rural Development Fellows Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide short term catalytic support to the District Administration in backward districts to improve programme delivery and simultaneously develop a cadre of Development Facilitators. Fellows receive professional experience, structured learning, and a monthly stipend.

page_content:
# Prime Minister’s Rural Development Fellows Scheme **Ministry:** Ministry Of Rural Development | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Youth, Professional, Fellowship, Rural, Training | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Prime Minister’s Rural Development Fellows Scheme" by the Department of Rural Development, Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India, aims to provide a short-term work opportunity for young women and men who possess academic or professional expertise that will serve the district administration in improving programme delivery and interface with the marginalized section of the population, thereby aiming to reduce developmental and governance deficits. The scheme provides structured learning and hands-on professional experience in rural development and poverty reduction, offering Fellows opportunities to act as Development Facilitators and assist District Administration, particularly in backward districts, while participating in a post-graduate degree programme through distance learning and contact sessions, leading to a post-graduate degree in Development Practice.
## Benefits ##### ***Stipend Package*** - The Fellow shall be entitled to a consolidated stipend package of ₹50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) per month during the orientation period. - The Fellow shall be entitled to ₹75,000/- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand only) per month during the first year of the Fellowship (post-orientation). - The Fellow shall receive a 10% increment during the second year, subject to satisfactory performance. - This package is deemed to cover the Fellow’s honorarium, boarding and lodging expenses during orientation, accommodation/house rent during the rest of the Fellowship period, health insurance, life and disability insurance cover, and any other contingency expenses. - Travel reimbursement will be based on actual costs and restricted to AC-II tier train fare by the shortest route or equivalent, plus local transport cost. Women Fellows with children below five years are allowed the travel cost of a care-giver if the care-giver accompanies the Fellow with her child. ##### ***Other Benefits*** - Participation in a post graduate degree programme through distance learning and contact sessions leading to a post graduate degree in Development Practice. - Award of a Fellowship Certificate and an appropriate post graduate degree in Development Practice upon satisfactory completion of engagement and course requirements. - Office facilities made available by the District Collector, including suitable space, a computer/laptop, and internet connectivity free of charge. - Provision of suitable modes of transport by District administration while travelling within the district for regular work. ##### ***Disbursement of Stipend*** - During the orientation programme, the stipend shall be paid by the National Rural Livelihood Promotion Society through the Programme Mentor. - Post-placement, the National Rural Livelihood Promotion Society shall pay the monthly stipend to the Fellows by providing budgetary support to the State Rural Livelihood Mission society. - The State Rural Livelihood Mission society shall make direct deposits into the bank account of each Fellow immediately upon confirming the attendance of the Fellow from the District Collector at the end of the month. - The second-year increment is subject to the Fellow’s satisfactory performance as determined by the National Rural Livelihood Promotion Society in consultation with the Programme Mentor. > ***Conditions*** _*It is mandatory for the Fellows to purchase suitable health insurance and life and disability insurance coverage for the entire duration of the Fellowship, including the orientation period._ _*The Fellow shall not take up any type of employment with any other person, firm, or agency during the tenure of the Fellowship._ _*On successful completion of Fellowship, the Fellow is required to spend at least one year in public service as a paid full-time employee of the State Rural Livelihood Mission in the State she/he is assigned to._ _*Failure to join or complete the required one year of public service mandates the Fellow to return to the National Rural Livelihood Promotion Society the entire amount spent on academic programmes during the Fellowship (including orientation), plus an amount equivalent to the stipend of the last three months of the Fellowship period as compensation._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a citizen of India. - The applicant's age must be between 22 years and 27 years at the time of application. - The applicant must hold at least a graduate degree from a recognized University with a four-year degree course. - The applicant must hold a post-graduate degree from a recognized University in case the graduate degree course duration was less than four years. - The applicant's one-year post graduate course will also be considered valid for eligibility if it is regular, full time, and if the degree/equivalent diploma is recognized by the All India Council for Technical Education/Medical Council of India/University Grants Commission. - The applicant must have achieved at least 50% marks in the aggregate or equivalent grade at the graduate or Post-graduate level, whichever is qualifying. - The applicant must possess physical fitness, certified by Government Medical Hospital, for the arduous nature of the work. - The maximum age limit will be 32 years for candidates belonging to the Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe category. > ***Other Conditions*** _*Fifteen percent (15%) of seats are reserved for Scheduled Castes._ _*Fifteen percent (15%) of seats are reserved for Scheduled Tribes._
## Exclusions The applicant, who has been provisionally selected in the final result sheet for Prime Minister’s Rural Development Fellowship in an earlier stint, will not be allowed to avail the fellowship if he/she did not complete the full term of that prior Fellowship.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:****** ***Public Advertisement and Accessing Application Format*** The Central Government seeks applications for selection of Fellows through public advertisements. Interested applicants must access and obtain the application format that is notified by the Central Government for submission. **Step 2:****** ***Submission of Application and Shortlisting*** Applicants must submit their completed application form according to the specified format and guidelines provided in the public advertisement. Candidates who meet the initial requirements will be shortlisted for the subsequent phases of the selection process. **Step 3:****** ***Assessment and Selection Testing*** Shortlisted candidates will be required to participate in appropriate testing methods designed to ascertain their motivation, leadership capabilities, professional skills, and pro-poor orientation. The final selection is based on this overall assessment process.

metadata.schemeName: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve the socio-economic status of PVTGs by saturating families and habitations with basic facilities and services. It provides 11 critical infrastructure and welfare interventions, including housing, water, electricity, and connectivity.

page_content:
# PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Tribal Affairs | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Housing & Shelter, Utility & Sanitation, Health & Wellness, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Tribal, PVTG, Infrastructure, Housing, Health, Education, Livelihood, Skilling | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “PM- Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN)” was launched by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India, aims to improve the socio-economic status of Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) by bridging gaps in health, education, and livelihoods, and by saturating PVTG communities and families with basic facilities and services. The scheme provides 11 critical interventions through nine line Ministries/Departments, focusing on ensuring access to pucca houses, safe drinking water, road and mobile connectivity, electricity, and vocational education for individual households and habitations. A unique aspect is the inter-ministerial convergence, with the Ministry of Tribal Affairs serving as the nodal ministry while each participating ministry implements its respective Central Sector and Centrally Sponsored schemes.
## Benefits ##### ***Housing*** - Provision of pucca houses to all eligible Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group households having kaccha houses (Target: 4,90,000 households). - The basic unit cost of the house is enhanced to ₹2,00,000/-, with additional facilities raising it to ₹2,39,000/-. ##### ***Road Connectivity*** - Construction of connecting roads (Target: 8,000 KM) linking approximately 6,500 Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group villages. - The construction cost per Kilometer would be ₹1,00,00,000/-. ##### ***Drinking Water*** - Provision of piped water supply/Functional Household Tap Connection (FHTC) to all Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group households. - Community water supply will be provided to villages/habitations with a population of less than 20 households. ##### ***Health*** - Deployment of Mobile Medical Units (MMUs) (Target: 1,000 MMUs) in Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group habitations/villages. - The cost is ₹33,88,000/- per MMU per annum, with Operational Expenditure (Op Ex) as per norms. ##### ***Education Hostels*** - Construction of residential hostels (Target: 500 hostels) in existing schools in Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group areas. - The cost is ₹2,75,00,000/- per hostel construction, subject to the actual estimate as per existing cost sharing ratio. ##### ***Anganwadi Centers (AWCs)*** - Construction of Anganwadi Centers (Target: 2,500 AWCs) in Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group habitations/villages. - The unit cost is ₹12,00,000/- per Anganwadi Center. ##### ***Livelihood (VDVKs)*** - Setting up of Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVKs) (Target: 500 VDVKs). - An amount of ₹15,00,000/- meant for 300 members will be released on a pro rata basis. ##### ***Multipurpose Centers (MPCs)*** - Construction of Multipurpose Centers (Target: 1,000 MPCs). - The unit cost is ₹60,00,000/- per unit. ##### ***Solar Power/Electricity*** - Provision of solar power solutions to 1,00,000 Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group households. - Funding is ₹50,000/- per household or actual cost for 300 Watt supply. ##### ***Telecom Connectivity*** Installation of mobile towers (Target: 3,000 mobile towers) in all uncovered villages/habitations.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must belong to a Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group (PVTG) community. - The applicant must reside in one of the 18 States and Union Territories having a notified Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group population. - The applicant household must be identified as eligible through the physical survey conducted by state governments using the mobile application on the PM Gati-shakti Portal. ***Eligibility Specific to Interventions*** - The applicant household seeking a pucca house must currently reside in a kaccha house. - The applicant household seeking solar power solutions must be an unelectrified household not covered under the Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS). - The applicant household seeking an on-grid electricity connection shall be an identified beneficiary household under PM-JANMAN, irrespective of standard eligibility criteria under the Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS) for the State and Electricity distribution company (DISCOM).
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:****** ***Initiation of Identification and Physical Survey*** - The State Governments initiates a detailed physical survey of each Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group habitation to ascertain the gaps regarding the 11 critical interventions covered under the mission. - The data gathered during this exhaustive survey is simultaneously updated and cross-verified on a mobile application developed on the PM Gati-shakti Portal. **Step 2:****** ***Facilitation of Application Filing for Eligible Beneficiaries*** - The Block Level Implementation Team, consisting of officers designated by the District Collector, will be responsible for identifying each beneficiary family who has not yet been saturated with entitlements and will facilitate the necessary application filing for the respective schemes. - The District Level Committee is also responsible for the registration and filling of applications of eligible beneficiaries for each scheme covered under the mission. **Step 3:****** ***Verification and Project Approval*** - Following the application filing and preliminary eligibility checks, certain proposals for infrastructure, such as the sanctioning of Multi-Purpose Centers, must be forwarded by the Secretary/Principal Secretary, State Tribal Welfare Department to the Ministry of Tribal Affairs. - These proposals are subsequently examined by the relevant division, approved by the Mission Director of PM-JANMAN, and granted financial concurrence by the Internal Finance Division.

metadata.schemeName: Tiatr Script Writing Competition
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage new generation playwrights to create quality Tiatr scripts and enrich Konkani language. It provides cash prizes and publication opportunities for original traditional format scripts.

page_content:
# Tiatr Script Writing Competition **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Culture, Artist, Writer, Script, Competition | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Tiatr Script Writing Competition" by the Tiatr Academy of Goa aims to encourage new generation of Tiatr playwrights to script better quality of Tiatrs and enrich the Konkani language through annual script writing competitions. The scheme provides cash prizes up to ₹15,000/- for winning scripts and opportunities for publication with honorarium payments, along with certificates for recognition of literary excellence in traditional Konkani theatre. The applicant must write original scripts in traditional tiatr format with minimum 6-7 podd'de and at least 4 Cantos, and must submit scripts that have not been published or performed earlier. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa and applications are accepted through offline submission of typed copies with duly filled application forms.
## Benefits ##### ***Cash Prizes*** - 1st Prize: ₹15,000/- - 2nd Prize: ₹10,000/- - 3rd Prize: ₹5,000/- ##### ***Additional Benefits*** - **Certificates:** Provided to first three prize winners.- **Publication Opportunity:** Prize winning scripts can be printed in book form at Tiatr Academy of Goa's cost (subject to No Objection Certificate from script writer).- **Honorarium:** ₹5,000/- one-time payment for published scripts (in addition to prize money).- **Complimentary Copies:** 100 copies of the published book provided to script writer. ##### ***Conditions*** - Scripts must comply with content guidelines - no adverse remarks against any Governments/Individuals/Institutions or anything against caste, creed and religion - For publication benefits, script writers must provide No Objection Certificate to Tiatr Academy of Goa.
## Eligibility Criteria ##### ***Basic Requirements*** - The applicant must write scripts on themes as specified by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must ensure the script has not been published or performed earlier. - The applicant must write original scripts only. ##### ***Script Format Requirements*** - The applicant must write scripts in traditional tiatr format. - The applicant must include minimum 6 to 7 podd'de in the script. - The applicant must include at least 4 Cantos in the script. - The applicant must write scripts in Konkani language using Roman script. - The applicant must ensure comedy is inter-related to the main plot (however, comedy may be absent in religious tiatr). ##### ***Content Guidelines*** - The applicant must ensure scripts do not contain adverse remarks against any Governments/Individuals/Institutions. - The applicant must ensure scripts do not contain content against caste, creed and religion that may hurt sentiments.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields. Attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment_ ##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:****** ***Evaluation Process*** The submitted scripts will be evaluated by a panel of judges appointed by Tiatr Academy of Goa, whose decision will be final and binding. The judging process will assess scripts based on quality, format compliance, and adherence to specified themes. **Step 2:** **Result Declaration and Prize Distribution** Winners will be announced after the judging process is completed, and the first three best scripts will receive cash prizes and certificates as specified. Prize winners will be contacted for any additional procedures related to publication opportunities.

metadata.schemeName: Lifetime Contribution to Khell/Khell-Tiatr Awards
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize veteran Khell/Khell-Tiatr artistes who have made significant contributions to this traditional art form. It honors deserving artistes with lifetime achievement awards and cash burse.

page_content:
# Lifetime Contribution to Khell/Khell-Tiatr Awards **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Artist, Award, Theatre, Culture, Heritage | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Lifetime Contribution to Khell/Khell-Tiatr Awards" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to recognize the immense contribution of Khell and Khell-Tiatr artistes who have significantly contributed to the development of this traditional art form, addressing the need to honor veteran performers who have dedicated their lives to preserving and promoting this cultural heritage. The scheme provides a prestigious lifetime achievement award consisting of a shawl, memento, citation, and cash burse of ₹50,000/- to deserving artistes, with a comprehensive selection process that evaluates excellence in acting, script writing, directing, singing, lyrics writing, set designing, and other theatrical contributions. The applications are accepted through recommendations from individuals/institutions and advertisements in local newspapers.
## Benefits - Cash burse of ₹50,000/- awarded to selected artistes. - Prestigious recognition through shawl, memento, and citation. - Special honor ceremony held annually on 24th October on the Birth Anniversary of Rosario Rodrigues, 'Promoter of Khell-Tiatr'. - Maximum 3 artistes are honored each year. _*The selected artistes must be compulsorily present in person to receive the award._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be not less than 60 years of age. - The applicant must have at least 10 years of contribution in the field of Khell-Tiatr. - The applicant must demonstrate excellence as an actor, script writer, director, singer, lyricist, set designer, or other theatrical role in Khell/Khell-Tiatr. - The applicant who is an actor/singer/stage manager/lights effects provider/make-up artist/costume designer/live music/background music provider must have performed in at least 10 khell-tiatrs. - The applicant who is a writer/director must have written/directed at least 10 khell-tiatrs. _*Award can only be received once in a lifetime across all related categories._ ##### ***Evaluation Considerations*** - The applicant's innovative contributions to the presentation of Khell/Khell-Tiatr will be evaluated. - The applicant's work in other languages or films beyond Khell/Khell-Tiatr will be considered. - The applicant's published books of scripts/lyrics will be taken into account. - The applicant's previous awards in the field will be considered. ##### ***Relaxation*** Age limit may be relaxed if the health of the artiste is not well.
## Exclusions The applicant cannot receive the award if they have previously been honored with Lifetime Contribution Awards in Tiatr (Commercial/Non-Commercial), Khell, Khell-Tiatr, or Konkani Cinema.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ***The application is through recommendations from individuals or institutions, or through response to advertisements in local newspapers.*** **Step 1:** The applicant must take a printout of the prescribed format of the application form. Alternatively, the interested applicant should visit the Tiatr Academy of Goa, and request the hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the designated staff. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields: - ***Recommender Information:*** Fill in the complete details of the recommender including name, full address, contact numbers (landline and mobile), Aadhaar Card number, and provide a brief description of the recommender (limited to 100 characters).- ***Nominee Details:*** Complete the nominee section with full personal information including name with title (Mr./Mrs./Miss), stage name, father's name, mother's name, date of birth, age, educational qualification, correspondence address, phone numbers (landline and mobile), Aadhaar Card number, and email identification.- ***Contribution Details:*** Select the applicable contribution categories by ticking the appropriate boxes (Actor, Singer, Musician, Director, Producer, Writer, Lights, Setting, Sound, Promoter/Organizer, or Other with specification). Provide detailed information for each selected category including the number of Khell-Tiatrs involved and names of at least 10 productions.- ***Additional Achievements:*** Fill in information about gramophone records, Compact Discs, Digital Versatile Discs produced, film appearances, published books of Khell-Tiatrs, and awards won for contributions to the Khell-Tiatrs stage. **Step 3:** Paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required). Attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 4:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ ##### ***Selection Process*** The Executive Board evaluates applications based on the stated criteria through recommendations and also reserves the right to select deserving artistes from outside the recommended list.

page_content:
# All Goa One-Act Play Competition in Konkani **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Culture, Artist, Competition, Drama, Award | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "All Goa One-Act Play Competition in Konkani" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to attract youth towards dramatic activities and provide ample opportunities to showcase their talents in dramatics while promoting Goan culture through Konkani theatre. The scheme provides cash awards for the top 3 performances along with mementos and certificates, individual awards for various categories like direction, acting, music, and stage setting, and reimbursement of transport costs as per Regional Transport Office norms. The applicant must be an individual, club, or association capable of presenting a One-Act Play in Konkani with duration between 35 to 45 minutes, and must submit a typed copy of the play in Roman script along with written permission from the playwright. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
## Benefits - Cash awards for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd best performances (amount as decided by Tiatr Academy of Goa). - Mementos and certificates for top 3 performances. - Individual awards with mementos (no cash) for Direction, Male Actor, Female Actor, Background Music, Stage Setting, Light Effects, Make-up, and Script. - Reimbursement of transport expenses as per Regional Transport Office norms. - Video recording of all plays for preservation in Tiatr Academy of Goa Library. _*Performance must not contain adverse remarks against any governments, individuals, institutions, or anything against caste, creed, and religion._ _*Participants must abide by all competition rules and regulations._ _*Any violation may result in disqualification and forfeiture of benefits._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an individual, club, or association. - The applicant must present a One-Act Play in Konkani language. - The applicant must ensure the play duration is not less than 35 minutes and not more than 45 minutes. - The applicant must ensure participation only when at least 5 groups are participating in the competition.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ _*Applications are considered on a "First come First Serve" basis, subject to the availability of funds._ _*Performance date and time will be determined by draw of lots._ _*If applicant withdraws after schedule is drawn, full security deposit will be forfeited._

page_content:
# Competition of Zomnivoilo Khell **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Culture, Artist, Folk, Competition, Stage | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Competition of Zomnivoilo Khell" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to preserve and promote the traditional folk theatre of Goa called 'The Khell', also known as 'Fell' or 'Zomnivoilo Khell', by organizing annual competitions in different parts of Goa to maintain this cultural heritage for future generations. The scheme provides financial assistance towards production costs for participating troupes and creates a platform for showcasing traditional Khell performances through structured competition format. The applicant must be an institution or individual with a Khell that has been staged during the current carnival season and must comply with the traditional format requirements including 8 to 10 cantos with specific duration limits. The scheme is implemented by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline through prescribed application forms.
## Benefits - Financial assistance towards production costs as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa from time to time. - Mementos awarded to first three winning positions (no cash prizes). - Video recording of all performances for preservation in Tiatr Academy of Goa library. - Complimentary Digital Versatile Disc copy of the performance provided to the director. - Platform for showcasing traditional Khell performances to wider audiences.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an institution or individual organizing a Khell performance. - The applicant must have staged the Khell during the current carnival season. - The applicant must comply with the exact format of Zomnivoilo Khell comprising 8 to 10 songs called Cantos. - The applicant must ensure each canto consists of 2 verses and one chorus with limited dialogues. - The applicant must maintain the duration of each Khell between 40 to 60 minutes. - The applicant must ensure comedy in the Khell is related to the story. - The applicant must use traditional musical instruments including drums and two blowing instruments. - The applicant must ensure no adverse remarks are made against any governments, individuals, institutions, or anything against caste, creed, and religion. - Artists can participate in only one group and one Khell (except musicians who can participate in multiple Khells). - Mandatory attendance at discussion session on positive and negative aspects of performances. - No adverse remarks against any governments, individuals, institutions, or anything against caste, creed, and religion. - The three Khell troupes which won 1st, 2nd, and 3rd places in the previous competition receive direct entry provided they apply within stipulated time.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ ##### ***Selection Process*** If more than 12 applications are received, attend the meeting of all applicants where selection of 9 remaining troupes (after 3 direct entries from previous winners) will be done through lottery system. **Step 1:****** ***Await Communication*** Wait for communication regarding the date, time, and place of staging of the Khell performances which will be provided well in advance to all selected participating groups. **Step 2:****** ***Attend Mandatory Discussion*** Participate in the compulsory discussion session on positive and negative aspects of performances at the Conference Hall of Tiatr Academy of Goa, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Campal, Panjim on the appointed date and time. **Step 3:****** ***Performance and Payment*** Perform the Khell as scheduled and receive the financial assistance cheque issued in the name of the applicant as mentioned in Serial Number 1 of the application form.

metadata.schemeName: Scheme of Assistance to State Scheduled Castes Development Corporations
metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide economic development assistance to Scheduled Castes living below the poverty line through financial support and credit facilitation. It provides share capital, margin money loans, and subsidies to Scheduled Castes families for employment-oriented schemes.

page_content:
# Scheme of Assistance to State Scheduled Castes Development Corporations **Ministry:** Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Scheduled Caste, Employment, Agriculture, Industry, Transport, Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Scheme of Assistance to State Scheduled Castes Development Corporations" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment (DoSJE), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE), Government of India. The scheme aims to provide economic development assistance to Scheduled Castes living below the poverty line through State Scheduled Castes Development Corporations functioning in 23 States and 4 Union Territories, addressing the financial mobilization challenges faced by this community. The scheme provides share capital contribution in the ratio of 49:51 between Central Government and State Governments, along with financial assistance in the form of margin money loans at low interest rates and subsidies to reduce repayment liability. The applicant must belong to Scheduled Castes and must be living below the poverty line. The scheme is implemented by State Scheduled Castes Development Corporations. The applications for this scheme are accepted through State Channelizing Agencies.
## Benefits - Financial assistance in the form of margin money loans at low rate of interest. - Subsidy provision to reduce repayment liability of beneficiaries. - The quantum and ceiling of subsidy is the same as for schemes under Integrated Rural Development Programme. - Credit support facilitation through tie-ups with financial institutions, banks, National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation, and National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must belong to Scheduled Castes. - The applicant must be living below the poverty line.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the [nearest office](https://socialjustice.gov.in/writereaddata/UploadFile/List%20of%2027%20SCDCs%20with%20addresses.pdf) of the SCDC of their state. SCDCs generally have their offices in each district. Obtained the prescribed format of the application form for the scheme. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the office of the SCDC. _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._

page_content:
# Investment Grant for Farmers with More than 2 Hectares of Agricultural Land **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Agricultural Land, Crop Losses, Natural Calamities, Investment Grant, Farmer, Disaster | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Investment Grant for Farmers with More than 2 Hectares of Agricultural Land” is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Disaster Management Authority under the Department of Disaster Management, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to farmers owning more than 2 hectares of agricultural land who suffer crop losses due to natural disasters.
## Benefits Under this scheme: 1. ₹8,500/- per hectare for unirrigated areas. 1. ₹17,000/- per hectare for areas with assured irrigation. 1. ₹22,500/- per hectare for all types of evergreen crops. In cases where crop damage exceeds 33%, assistance will be provided only up to a maximum limit of 2 hectares per farmer.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident farmer of Uttarakhand engaged in agricultural activities within the state. 1. The financial assistance will be applicable only for the area actually sown with crops.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Information about the disaster and the resulting damage is received from various sources. The concerned Patwari verifies the damage and records it in the P-20 form. The Patwari’s report is subsequently verified by the Tehsildar and the Sub-Divisional Magistrate. Approval is then obtained from the District Magistrate. Once the District Magistrate’s approval is received, relief funds are disbursed to the concerned beneficiaries at the Tehsil level.

It provides relief, rehabilitation, and support to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes victims of atrocities and incentives for inter-caste marriages.

page_content:
# Centrally Sponsored Scheme for Implementation of the Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955 and the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 **Ministry:** Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Relief, Rehabilitation, Marriage, Court | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Centrally Sponsored Scheme for Implementation of the Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955 and the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment (DoSJE), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE), Government of India. The scheme aims to ensure effective implementation of the Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955 and the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989, addressing the constitutional mandate to abolish untouchability and prevent atrocities against Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes members. The scheme provides central assistance for relief and rehabilitation of atrocity victims and incentives for inter-caste marriages. It facilitates functioning and strengthening of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes Protection Cells, Special Police Stations, exclusive Special Courts, awareness generation programs, and comprehensive support systems for affected communities.
## Benefits ##### ***Financial Assistance*** - Relief and rehabilitation support for atrocity victims (specific amounts vary by state implementation). - Incentive amounts for inter-caste marriages ranging from ₹10,000/- to ₹5,00,000/- depending on the state. - Central assistance provided to states on 50:50 basis and 100% assistance to Union Territories. ##### ***Institutional Support*** - Functioning and strengthening of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes Protection Cells. - Special Police Stations establishment and operation. - Setting up and functioning of exclusive Special Courts for speedy trial. - 192 Exclusive Special Courts established across 13 states for faster case resolution. ##### ***Other Benefits*** - Awareness generation programs. - Legal support through specialized court system. - Administrative support through dedicated protection cells.
## Eligibility Criteria ##### ***For Atrocity Relief*** - The applicant must be a from a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe. - The applicant must be a victim of atrocities as defined under the Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955 or the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989. ##### ***For Inter-Caste Marriage Incentives*** - The applicant must be part of an inter-caste marriage where one partner belongs to Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Visit the Social Welfare Department of your respective State Government or UT Administration. Take guidance from the concerned staff to determine whether your case falls under atrocity relief provisions of the Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955 and the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989, or under inter-caste marriage incentive provisions. **Step 2:** Submit your application through the prescribed procedures of the Social Welfare Department, following their specific format and guidelines. In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains all the essential details.
***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** Your application will be processed by the concerned State Government or Union Territory Administration authorities who will verify eligibility and documentation as per the scheme guidelines. **Step 2:** Upon approval, relief amounts, or incentive payments will be disbursed through the established financial mechanisms of your respective State Government or Union Territory Administration.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme recognizes and honors non-commercial artistes who have contributed immensely for the development of tiatr, its song and music through yearly Tiatr Festivals/Competitions organized by Kala Academy and by organizing tiatrs in villages, as well as artistes who have enriched Konkani Tiatr.

page_content:
# Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Awards (Non-Commercial) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Award, Artist, Culture, Achievement, Heritage | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Awards (Non-Commercial)" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to recognize and honor non-commercial artistes who have contributed immensely for the development of tiatr, its song and music through yearly Tiatr Festivals/Competitions organized by Kala Academy and by organizing tiatrs in villages, as well as artistes who have enriched Konkani Tiatr and Konkani Song through All India Radio, Doordarshan and other media platforms. The scheme provides lifetime recognition awards consisting of a shawl, a memento, a citation, and a cash burse as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa, with special consideration given to excellence in acting, script writing, directing, singing, lyric writing, set designing, and innovative contributions to the tiatr stage.
## Benefits - The Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Award (Non-Commercial) consists of a shawl, a memento, a citation, and a Cash Burse as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa - Recognition and honor at a special function on 2nd January on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Lucasinho Ribeiro the 'Pioneer of Tiatr' - Lifetime achievement recognition for contribution to tiatr field - Awards are conferred annually with not more than 5 artistes receiving the award each year. - Awards are presented at a special function on 2nd January.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be not less than 60 years of age. - The applicant should have at least 10 years contribution in the field of tiatr. - The applicant should demonstrate excellence as an actor, script writer, director, singer, lyricist, set designer, or other relevant role. - The applicant should have performed in at least 10 tiatrs if working as actor/singer/stage manager/lights provider/make-up artist/costume designer/live music/background music. - The applicant should have written/directed at least 10 tiatrs if working as a writer/director. ***Relaxation*** The age limit of 60 years may be relaxed if the health of the artiste is not well. ***Post-Selection Conditions*** *The selected artistes will have to be compulsorily present in person to receive the award. *Tiatr Academy of Goa will confer Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Awards only once in a lifetime be it in Tiatr (Commercial/Non-Commercial) or Khell or Khell-Tiatr or Konkani Cinema.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ***(This scheme operates through a recommendation system rather than direct individual applications)*** **Step 1:** Individuals or institutions can recommend deserving artistes by submitting the recommendation form along with complete nominee details. In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 2:** Submit the duly filled and signed recommendation form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** ##### ***Alternative Method*** The Executive Board of Tiatr Academy of Goa may also select deserving artistes from outside the recommended list through their own assessment and advertisements in local newspapers. ##### ***Selection Process*** **Step 1:** Selection is done based on established criteria considering years of service, excellence in specific roles, awards received, innovations on tiatr stage, recorded works, contributions to other language dramas or films, published materials, minimum 10 years contribution, and specific performance requirements based on role. **Step 2:** The Tiatr Academy of Goa Executive Board reviews all recommendations and makes final selections based on the established criteria, with successful candidates being notified for the award ceremony attendance.

metadata.schemeName: Promotion of Tiatr Through Academic Activities
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to foster interest in Tiatr among students and enthusiasts through academic activities like talks, symposia, seminars, and workshops. It covers activity expenditures, honorarium for resource persons, and provides materials, benefiting educational institutions and individuals.

page_content:
# Promotion of Tiatr Through Academic Activities **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Student, Academic, Workshop, Culture, Awareness, Seminar, Grant | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Promotion of Tiatr Through Academic Activities" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to create interest in Tiatr among students of educational institutions and tiatr lovers in villages and cities. The scheme provides for the creation of awareness about tiatr, its song, and music through academic activities such as talks, symposia, seminars, and workshops. These activities, which must have at least 20 participants, can be organized by the Tiatr Academy of Goa alone or in collaboration with other institutions or individuals, with the Academy covering various expenditures and providing necessary materials. The scheme is implemented by the Tiatr Academy of Goa on a 'First Come First Serve' basis, and applications for this scheme are accepted as per the availability of funds.
## Benefits • **Awareness Creation:** Awareness about Tiatr, its song, and music will be created through academic activities such as talks, symposia, seminars, and workshops. • **Resource Person Honorarium:** Resource persons will be paid an honorarium, as fixed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa, for every session, with the amount dependent upon the distance from their residence to the venue. • **Expenditure Coverage:** The Tiatr Academy of Goa will cover the expenditure incurred on Resource Persons, refreshments, and food (lunch or dinner) served to participants. Additionally, any other miscellaneous expenditure made in organizing the activity by an institution or individual by way of collaboration will be taken care of by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. • **Provision of Materials:** The Tiatr Academy of Goa will provide essential materials, including a backdrop, certificates for the participants, and stationery. • **Documentation Coverage:** The Tiatr Academy of Goa will document the Symposia, Seminar, or Workshop, and the expenditure incurred on this documentation will be borne by the Tiatr Academy of Goa.
> **Conditions** _*Prior approval will be required from the Tiatr Academy of Goa before finalizing the resource persons, if the activity is organized in collaboration with others._ _*The cost of refreshments or food to be served must be verified and approved by the Tiatr Academy of Goa before finalization._ _*The scheme will be implemented strictly on a ‘First Come First Serve’ basis._ _*Applications will be considered, and benefits disbursed as per the availability of funds._
## Eligibility Criteria • The applicant must be an educational institution or an individual interested in collaborating with the Tiatr Academy of Goa to organize academic activities for promoting Tiatr. • The applicant must ensure the number of participants for conducting the Symposia, Seminar, or Workshop shall be at least 20. • The applicant must obtain prior approval from the Tiatr Academy of Goa before finalizing resource persons, if the activity is organized by others in collaboration. • The applicant must get the cost of refreshments or food to be served verified and approved by the Tiatr Academy of Goa before finalizing them.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the copies of the mandatory documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ *The application will be considered on a 'First Come First Serve' basis and is subject to the availability of funds.

metadata.schemeName: Trekking Traction Centre Home-stay Grant Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote tourism and improve local livelihoods in rural areas near trekking routes. The scheme provides financial assistance to villagers for constructing or renovating home-stays in traditional hill-style architecture, ensuring quality accommodation for tourists.

page_content:
# Trekking Traction Centre Home-stay Grant Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Travel & Tourism | **Tags:** Construction Of Building, Traction Centre, Trekking, Home-stay | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Trekking Traction Centre Home-stay Grant Scheme” was launched in 2020 by the Department of Tourism, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provides financial assistance to villagers for constructing or renovating home-stays in traditional hill-style architecture, ensuring quality accommodation for tourists.
## Benefits Under this scheme, villages located within a 2-kilometer radius of the identified tracking traction center are eligible for benefits. For the construction of buildings with toilets along the identified routes, a grant of ₹60,000/- per room is provided. In cases where building repairs are required, a grant of ₹25,000/- per room is provided, for up to a maximum of six rooms.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. This benefit is applicable only to villages located within a 2-kilometer radius of the trekking traction center identified by the Tourism Department, and these villages must be separate from urban areas. 1. There is no obligation to take out a loan. 1. The applicant must be a native of a village in Uttarakhand near the traction center and must reside, or intend to reside, with their family in the proposed homestay. 1. Guest rooms should be provided for a minimum of one and a maximum of six. 1. The homestay must be registered with the department, or if newly constructed, it must be registered upon completion. 1. Preference will be given to buildings constructed or developed in the traditional hill-style architecture.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - Residents of villages notified by the department can obtain the prescribed application form from the office of the District Tourism Development Officer or the Tourism Welcome Center. Along with the application form, applicants must submit the following documents: a birth/age certificate, educational qualification certificate, Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Other Backward Class/Ex-Servicemen certificate (if applicable), a certificate proving Uttarakhand nativity, proof of residence in the same area, and land/building ownership documents. - After submission of the application to the District Tourism Development Officer or Tourism Welcome Center, a committee is constituted under the chairmanship of the District Magistrate. The applicant is then called for an interview by the committee. If found suitable in the interview, the applicant is selected. Upon completion of the construction or repair work, a technical committee constituted by the district conducts an inspection. If the work is found satisfactory, the District Magistrate recommends the disbursement, and the department transfers the sanctioned amount for the construction or repair of the homestay directly to the applicant’s bank account. - Identification of Villages – The committee constituted by the District Officer with the District Tourism Development Officer as Member Secretary, identifies eligible villages. Villages may also be proposed for inclusion if they are developing within a 2-kilometer radius of the trekking route; in such cases, the village head, block head, or MLA submits a proposal to the department. The tourism officer then conducts an investigation. A meeting is held under the chairmanship of the District Magistrate to determine whether the village qualifies for the trekking traction route. The meeting minutes and proposal are sent to the Uttarakhand Tourism Development Council, which conducts its own verification. If found eligible, the council officially notifies the concerned villages.

metadata.schemeName: PMMSY: Refrigerated vehicles - Gujarat
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the purchase of vehicles. Through this scheme, subsidy benefits are provided to general, women, and SC/ST category beneficiaries.

page_content:
# PMMSY: Refrigerated vehicles - Gujarat **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Construction Of Plant, Storage, Fishermen, Fish Sellers | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)” with the component of "Refrigerated vehicles", introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to modernise cold chain infrastructure to preserve fish health, uplift fishermen, and enhance value chain efficiency. Through this scheme, financial support is provided to fishermen and related beneficiaries for constructing ice plants or storage units with a minimum capacity of 30 tonnes, ensuring hygienic fish storage and better returns. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State Governments, with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% contribution from the State Government.
> **Objective of the scheme** - Marine production in the Gujarat state is one of the leading in the country. The state lags behind in exports due to non-norms. So cold storage/ice plant modernization is necessary to keep the fish in healthy condition. - Insulated vehicle, three wheeler with ice box including e-rickshaw, and live fish vending center to deliver the fish in hygienic condition to the consumer, so that the consumer (customer) can get fresh and clean fish from the local area and get good returns to the sellers. - Around 27,000 small and large boats are operating in the state. To strengthen the safety and security of the fishermen and increase the income of the boat owner, replacement of the existing boats is necessary to increase the sea growth of the existing boats.
## Benefits 1. The unit cost of a refrigerated vehicle is ₹25,00,000/-. 1. 40% assistance (up to ₹10,00,000/-) is provided for general category beneficiaries. 1. 60% assistance (up to ₹15,00,000/-) is provided for women and SC/ST category beneficiaries.
> **Conditions:** - The benefit will be available as per the target (category) allocated by the Government of India. - The benefit is available once in a lifetime.
> **Mode of Disbursement:** Contribution is shared: 60% by the Government of India and 40% by State Governments. > **Frequency of Disbursement:** One-time assistance. > **Validity:** Once in a lifetime for eligible beneficiaries.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. The applicant should hold a fishing license. 1. The applicant should complete the online registration on the [iKhedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/).1. The applicant should obtain in-principle approval before purchase of the floor plan. 1. The applicant should have his/her own bank account. > **Preference/Reservation/Relaxation:** - Women, SC, and ST beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance of the unit cost. - General category beneficiaries are eligible for 40% assistance of the unit cost.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side, then click on "Beneficiary Registration" and select any one from the 'Farmer' or 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. **Step 3:** Enter the 'Company Name' and Address if you have selected 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. And for all select the District, Taluka, and Village, choose 'what type of account holder you are?', enter your Account Number and Name, solve the Captcha, and click 'Save and Next'. **Step 4:** Enter your Mobile Number and E-mail address, click 'Send OTP', enter the received OTP, create and confirm a Password, solve the Captcha, and click 'Submit'.
> **Login Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side of the homepage. On the home page, click on ‘Schemes’ and then click on ‘Agricultural Schemes’. **Step 3:** Now select the scheme, click on the ‘Apply’ button, and an application page will open. **Step 4:** Click on the "Apply New" button and submit a new application. **Step 5:** Click on the "Update Application" button to add corrections to the application. **Step 6:** Once the application is done, confirm it. **Step 7:** Take a printout of the confirmed application.
> **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_Contacts.aspx).

metadata.schemeName: Swami Vivekananda Exam Oriented Residential Training
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide exam-oriented residential training for aspiring candidates seeking recruitment in defence and police forces. It offers comprehensive coaching and preparation for Army, Air Force, Navy, Paramilitary and Police recruitment examinations.

page_content:
# Swami Vivekananda Exam Oriented Residential Training **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Training, Defence, Army, Navy, Police, Examination, Recruitment, Employment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Swami Vivekananda Exam Oriented Residential Training" was launched by the Directorate of Employment and Training, Department of Labour and Employment, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide comprehensive residential training to aspiring candidates for recruitment in Army, Air Force, Navy, Paramilitary Forces and Police Forces, addressing the need for specialized coaching and preparation to enhance success rates in defence and police recruitment examinations. The scheme provides exam-oriented residential training programs and coaching facilities specifically designed for defence services examinations and conducts comprehensive preparation sessions covering written examinations, physical fitness training, personality development, and interview preparation. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat state and must be aspiring for recruitment in Army, Air Force, Navy, Paramilitary Forces or Police Forces with appropriate age and educational qualifications as per the respective service requirements. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Employment and Training under the Labour and Employment Department, Government of Gujarat and applications for this scheme are accepted through designated employment exchanges and training centers across the state.
## Benefits > **Training and Coaching Support** - **Residential Training:** Comprehensive exam-oriented coaching in residential format.- **Defence Examination Preparation:** Specialized training for Army, Air Force, Navy recruitment examinations.- **Police Force Training:** Preparation for Police Force recruitment examinations.- **Paramilitary Force Coaching:** Training for Central Armed Police Forces and other paramilitary recruitment.
> **Training Components** - **Written Examination Preparation:** Subject-wise coaching and mock tests.- **Physical Fitness Training:** Physical preparation as per service requirements.- **Personality Development:** Communication skills and confidence building.- **Interview Preparation:** Mock interviews and counseling sessions.
> **Conditions** - Regular attendance in all training sessions and activities. - Compliance with residential training center rules and regulations. - Participation in mock tests and assessment programs. - Maintenance of discipline and conduct as per training center guidelines.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be aspiring for recruitment in Army, Air Force, Navy, Paramilitary Forces or Police Forces. - The applicant must meet the age criteria as prescribed for respective defence and police services. - The applicant must possess minimum educational qualifications as required for the specific service examination they are preparing for. - The applicant must have completed relevant educational requirements as per Central Government norms for defence services. - The applicant must meet basic physical fitness standards for defence and police services. - The applicant must be medically fit as per general health requirements. - The applicant must be willing to undergo rigorous physical training programs. - The applicant must belong to economically weaker sections or demonstrate financial need for training assistance. - The applicant must not be receiving similar training assistance from other government schemes simultaneously.
## Exclusions

## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:****** ***Registration with Employment Exchange*** The applicant must first register with the nearest District Employment Exchange office in Gujarat and obtain a valid employment registration number for accessing training programs. **Step 2:** ***Medical and Physical Fitness Assessment*** The applicant must undergo preliminary medical check-up and physical fitness assessment at the designated center to ensure they meet basic standards for defence training. **Step 3:** **Training Program Inquiry** The candidate should visit the Directorate of Employment and Training office / the nearest District Employment Office / the Designated Training Center and request the hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form for the scheme "Swami Vivekananda Exam Oriented Residential Training". **Step 4:** ***Form Completion and Documentation*** The candidate should fill the application form completely with accurate personal details, educational background, preferred service category (Army/Navy/Air Force/Police/Paramilitary), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 5:** ***Application Submission and Interview*** The completed application with all documents must be submitted at one of the following - - Directorate of Employment and Training, Block No. 1, 3rd Floor, Dr. Jivraj Mehta Bhavan, Gandhinagar - 382010. - District Employment Exchanges across all districts in Gujarat. - Designated Training Centers (as notified by the Directorate of Employment and Training). _*The applicant is advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and acknowledgment receipt for future reference._ **Step 6:** ***Selection and Admission*** The candidate may be required to appear for a preliminary interview or counseling session. Based on the evaluation of application, documents verification, and interview performance, selected candidates will be notified about their admission to the residential training program. **Step 7:** ***Training Commencement*** Selected candidates must report to the designated training center on the specified date with necessary personal items and documents for the commencement of the residential training program.

# Akhil Bhartiya Sanskrit Shodh Sammelan **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Sanskrit, Sanskrit Conference, Scholar, Research In Sanskrit Literature, Research Papers | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Akhil Bhartiya Sanskrit Shodh Sammelan” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Sanskrit Academy, Haridwar, under the Department of Sanskrit Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide a platform (Sanskrit Conference) for scholars, professors, lecturers, teachers, and students engaged in teaching, learning, and research to present their findings.
## Benefits At the Sanskrit Shodh Sammelan, participants gain knowledge through new research in Sanskrit literature, exchange ideas, learn the methodology of writing research papers, and receive certificates.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. Acharyas, co-acharyas, assistant acharyas, lecturers, assistant professors, teachers, and research scholars from all states of the country who are engaged in study, teaching, or research are eligible to participate.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline In accordance with the rules and regulations of the Academy, researchers must complete the application form and submit their research paper on the prescribed subject via email by the due date. Those whose papers are found eligible by the Research Paper Evaluation Committee will be invited to participate.

# National Mission on Edible Oil- Oil Palm: Harvesting Tools **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Edible Oil, Agricultural Equipment Subsidy, Cutter, Wire Mash | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme component "Harvesting Tools" launched under the "National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm" scheme by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation, Government of Gujarat, aims to promote oil palm cultivation by increasing production in the state and reducing dependency on imported oil palm. metadata.schemeName: Dr. Shivanand Nautiyal Scholarship
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1,500/- per month for a duration of 10 months to meritorious students from the Garhwal and Kumaon divisions who secure top ranks in the examination conducted by SCERT Uttarakhand.

page_content:
# Dr. Shivanand Nautiyal Scholarship **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Garhwal, Kumaon, Kumaon | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Dr. Shivanand Nautiyal Scholarship" scheme is implemented by the Secondary Education Department under the Department of Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from the Garhwal and Kumaon divisions who secure top ranks in the examination conducted by SCERT Uttarakhand.
## Benefits Out of the top 100 students in the qualifying examination conducted by SCERT Uttarakhand, 50 students from the Garhwal Division and 50 students from the Kumaon Division will receive ₹1,500/- per month for a period of 10 months.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must belong to either the Garhwal or Kumaon Division of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an institutional student of Class 8 in any government, local body, or government-aided school (excluding central and residential schools) in Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have passed the annual Class 7 examination with a minimum of 50% marks (40% for reserved categories). 1. There is no restriction on the annual income of parents or guardians. 1. The scholarship will be awarded for a period of 4 years, from Class 9 to Class 12.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - To appear in the scholarship examination, students can obtain the application form from the office of the Block Education Officer or download it from the School Education Department’s website ([https://schooleducation.uk.gov.in](https://schooleducation.uk.gov.in/)/) or SCERT Uttarakhand’s website ([https://scert.uk.gov.in](https://scert.uk.gov.in/)/) during September–October every year. A photocopy of the application form is also valid. No application or examination fee is charged. - While filling out the application form, students must attach a passport-size photograph, Aadhaar card, Class 7 mark sheet, caste certificate, and disability certificate (if applicable). All information must be filled in correctly, and the completed form should be submitted to the Principal of the school where the student is enrolled. - The Principal will verify the form based on the attached documents and school records, attest the photograph, and forward the verified form to the Block Education Officer’s office by the tentative date of 12 November. - After submission, the Block Education Officer issues the admit card. Students can collect the admit card either from their school or the Block Education Officer’s office. - The examination is conducted every year in the month of January. - After the successful completion of the process, the school Principal informs the student. The student must provide their Aadhaar card and Aadhaar-linked bank account details to the school, following which the scholarship amount is transferred directly to the student’s bank account.

metadata.schemeName: RMEWF- Financial Assistance to Orphan Children of ESM
metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, ₹3,000 per month (paid annually) is provided to eligible orphan children of ex-servicemen for educational and settlement support.

page_content:
# RMEWF- Financial Assistance to Orphan Children of ESM **Ministry:** Ministry Of Defence | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Orphan, Children, Ex-servicemen | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "RMEWF- Financial Assistance to Orphan Children of ESM" scheme was launched by the Kendriya Sainik Board (KSB), Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare, Ministry of Defence, Government of India. Under this scheme, a monthly assistance paid annually is provided to support the orphan’s education and settlement. The scheme is implemented by the Kendriya Sainik Board Secretariat in coordination with Zila Sainik Boards (ZSB) and Rajya Sainik Boards (RSB). > **Scheme Aim:** The aim of this aid gratis is to provide a small measure of relief from total penury to an orphaned child of an ESM.
## Benefits - Financial assistance of ₹3,000/- per month disbursed annually to each orphan child. > **NOTE:** Direct credit to the beneficiary’s bank account via Electronic Clearing Service (ECS)**.**
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a legitimate offspring of an Ex-Serviceman, with details recorded in the Service Book. 1. The applicant must be a son below 21 years of age or an unmarried daughter. 1. The applicant must have lost both parents (ESM and spouse). 1. The application must be recommended by the respective Zila Sainik Board (ZSB).
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ***Interested and eligible students need to apply online at the*** [***Kendriya Sainik Board Secretariat***](https://www.ksb.gov.in/)***.*** **New User Registration** 1. Select the "Register" option. 1. Complete the registration form with the requisite details, including your name, Aadhaar card number, email ID, mobile number, and bank details. 1. Establish a password for your account. 1. Upon successful registration, the applicant will receive a User ID and password. ***Login & Application Process:*** 1. Log in using the provided User ID and password to access the application form. 1. Click "New Application" and select the scheme name. 1. Fill in the complete application form. 1. Upload the required documents, including a photograph, caste certificate, residential certificate, and bank passbook etc. 1. Click on the "Save & Forward" and take the printout of the application form. 1. The applicant submits the printed application along with all the required documents to the District Sainik Board.” > **NOTE:** Once the application reaches KSB Sectt., the staff and officers at KSB carry out vetting and approval of the application. Final payment is made online in due course based on the availability of funds in AFFD.

## Benefits 1. The assistance provided is 75% of the purchase price of power/machine-driven equipment or ₹ 4500/- whichever is less. (Maximum one unit per account is allowed.)

## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Approach the Gram Sevak in your village for access to "Power Operated Plant Protection Equipment" under the scheme.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage academic excellence among students entering Classes 11 and 12 by providing financial assistance to meritorious students who have secured 80% or more marks in the Uttarakhand Board Examination of Class 10.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Scholarship Scheme (Secondary Level- Class 11 & 12) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Higher Secondary, Student, Scholarship, Meritorious Students | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Scholarship Scheme (Secondary Level – Classes 11 & 12)” is implemented by the Secondary Education Department under the Department of Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage academic excellence among students entering Classes 11 and 12 by providing financial assistance to meritorious students who have secured 80% or more marks in the Uttarakhand Board Examination of Class 10 .
## Benefits ***Rate of Scholarship:*** - **For Class 11th Students:** ₹1,200/- per month for 1 year.- **For Class 12th Students:** ₹1,200/- per month for 1 year.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The student must have secured at least 80% marks in the Uttarakhand Board Examination of Class 10 while studying in a state government school or a government-aided non-government school (excluding central and residential schools). 1. The student must maintain 75% attendance and 75% marks in Class 11. SC/ST students will be given a 5% relaxation in marks and attendance in the board examination. 1. There is no income criterion for the parent/guardian of the student under this scholarship. 1. The student cannot avail benefits under multiple state scholarship schemes simultaneously
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - To avail this scholarship, students are not required to appear for any examination. The department selects the students based on their board examination results. - To avail the benefits of this scheme, students must submit their Aadhaar card, Aadhaar-linked bank account, caste certificate, and the Uttarakhand Board passing certificate along with the application form. The scholarship amount is transferred to the student’s bank account once the school receives the allocated budget.

> **Frequency of Disbursement:** The benefit can be availed once every 5 years. > **Remark:** As per conditions No. 5, 16, 17, 19 and 22 of [Appendix-1](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in/Schemeatoz.aspx). (Refer Scheme No. 35)

# National Mission on Edible Oil- Oil Palm: Replanting of Old Oil Palm Garden **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Edible Oil, Oil Palm, Oil Palm Replanting, Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme component "Replanting of Old Oil Palm Garden" launched under the "National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm" scheme by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation, Government of Gujarat, aims to enhance oil palm production and lower dependency on imports by supporting farmers in uprooting and replanting old oil palm gardens that have reached the age of 25–30 years. The scheme provides a subsidy of ₹250 per plant for uprooting, replacing, and digging new pits, thereby ensuring sustainable cultivation practices and long-term productivity.
## Benefits **Subsidy:** ₹250/- per plant (uprooting, replacing, and digging of new pit).
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.
## Exclusions
