metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Scholarship Scheme (Junior Level)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote academic excellence among students entering Classes 6, 7, and 8 by providing financial assistance to meritorious students, based on their performance in a competitive examination conducted by the SCERT, Uttarakhand.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Scholarship Scheme (Junior Level) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Meritorious Student, Junior Level | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Scholarship Scheme (Junior Level)” is implemented by the Secondary Education Department under the Department of Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote academic excellence among students entering Classes 6, 7, and 8 by providing financial assistance to meritorious students, based on their performance in a competitive examination conducted by the State Council of Educational Research and Training (SCERT), Uttarakhand.
## Benefits **Rate of Scholarship:** - **For Class 6th Students:** ₹600/- per month for 1 year.- **For Class 7th Students:** ₹700/- per month for 1 year.- **For Class 8th Students:** ₹800/- per month for 1 year.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The student must have passed Class 5 (institutional) from a Government School or Government-aided private school of the state (excluding Central and Residential schools) and must be studying in Class 6. 1. The applicant must qualify in the competitive examination conducted by SCERT, Uttarakhand. 1. Based on the examination results, a student securing a position in the top 10% of the total participants will be eligible to avail the benefits of this scheme. 1. The selected student must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance and secure at least 60% marks in Classes 6 and 7. For SC/ST students, a relaxation of 5% is provided in both marks and attendance requirements. 1. There is no income criterion for the parents/guardians of the student under this scholarship. 1. A student cannot avail double benefits under multiple state scholarship schemes.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - To appear in the scholarship examination, a student can collect the application form from the Block Education Officer’s office or download it from the School Education Department’s website ([https://schooleducation.uk.gov.in](https://schooleducation.uk.gov.in/)) or the SCERT Uttarakhand website ([https://scert.uk.gov.in/](https://scert.uk.gov.in/)) during the months of June-July every year. At present, the application process is offline, and no application or examination fee is required. - While filling the application form, the student must attach a passport-size photograph, Aadhaar card, Class 5 passing certificate, admission card for Class 6, caste certificate if applicable, disability certificate if applicable, and Aadhaar-linked bank account details. The student must ensure that all information provided in the form is correct and then submit it to the Principal of the school where he or she is studying. - The Principal verifies the form on the basis of documents and school records, attests the photograph, and forwards the form to the Block Education Officer’s office by the stipulated date, which is usually around 21st August. After verification, the Block Education Officer issues the admit card. - Students can collect the admit card from their school or from the Block Education Officer’s office. The examination is conducted every year in September in an objective-type multiple-choice format. Students who are placed in the merit list are informed by the Principal, after which the scholarship amount is directly credited to the student’s bank account.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve the health and well-being of both mothers and their newborn girl children by providing essential item kits after the institutional delivery of pregnant women registered at an Anganwadi Centre.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Mahalakshmi Kit Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Health & Wellness, Women and Child | **Tags:** Girl Child, Mahalakshmi, Woman, Kit | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Mukhyamantri Mahalakshmi Kit Yojana" has been launched by the Department of Women Empowerment & Child Development, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to improve the health and well-being of both mothers and their newborn girl children by providing essential item kits after the institutional delivery of pregnant women registered at an Anganwadi Centre.
## Benefits In the state, after the institutional delivery of a pregnant woman, the following benefits will be provided: - The woman will receive one Mahalakshmi kit for the birth of each of her first two girl children. - In the case of twins, the woman will be given one Mahalakshmi kit, and each child will receive a separate Mahalakshmi kit.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a pregnant woman registered with an Anganwadi Centre and eligible to receive a Mahalakshmi Kit after delivery. 1. The beneficiary must not be an income tax payer.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline After the institutional delivery of a pregnant woman registered at an Anganwadi Centre, a Mahalakshmi Kit is provided as a benefit. The following items are included in the kit for mothers and their newborn girl children: - **For Mothers:** Dry fruits, socks, scarf, towel, shawl, blanket, bedsheet, sanitary pads, mustard oil, soap, and nail cutter.- **For Newborn Girl Child:** Cotton/warm cap, socks, diaper, towel, baby soap, rubber sheet, warm blanket, and vaccination card.

metadata.schemeName: Destitute Widow Pension Scheme - Uttarakhand
metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1,500/- is provided to widows whose family income does not exceed ₹4,000/- per month or who belong to the BPL category, and who are not receiving any other pension benefits.

page_content:
# Destitute Widow Pension Scheme - Uttarakhand **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child | **Tags:** Destitute, Widow, Pension, BPL | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Destitute Widow Pension Scheme" has been launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to help destitute widows meet their basic needs and improve their quality of life. Under this scheme, a monthly pension is provided to widows whose family monthly income is up to ₹4,000/- or who belong to the BPL category, and who are not availing of any other pension benefits.
## Benefits A pension of ₹1,500/- per month is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a widow. 1. The widow must be at least 18 years of age. 1. The widow’s family monthly income should not exceed ₹4,000/-, or she must possess a valid BPL (Below Poverty Line) certificate. 1. The widow must not be receiving any other pension benefits.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** https://socialwelfare.uk.gov.in/files/b-Widow_pension.pdf The applicant can apply online either by themselves or through a Common Service Center (CSC) via the Department’s Pension Portal ([https://ssp.uk.gov.in](https://ssp.uk.gov.in)), the [UMANG](https://web.umang.gov.in) Mobile App, or the Apuni Sarkar Portal ([https://eservices.uk.gov.in](https://eservices.uk.gov.in)). **The following documents are mandatory at the time of applying:** Applicant’s mobile number, Passport-size photograph (attested by Gram Pradhan / V.P.D.O. / certified by Councillor), Photocopy of Aadhaar card and Voter ID card, Husband's Death Certificate, CBS bank account details (linked/seeded with Aadhaar), Valid family income certificate or BPL certificate, Copy of family register (for rural areas only), Copy of the resolution passed in the open meeting of Gram Panchayat (for rural areas) / certified by Councillor (for urban areas) **All the above documents must be issued from the district where the application is being submitted.** > For verification of the online application form in rural areas, the final decision is taken by the District Social Welfare Officer after recommendations from the Gram Panchayat Development Officer, Assistant Social Welfare Officer, and Block Development Officer, respectively. In urban areas, verification and recommendation are done by the Assistant Social Welfare Officer and Sub-District Magistrate. If the application is found correct, the District Social Welfare Officer approves it, after which the pension payment process is initiated. **The pension is credited to the applicant’s bank account one month after the approval of the application.**

page_content:
# Scheme for Hotel and Restaurant Projects **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Puducherry | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship, Travel & Tourism | **Tags:** Entrepreneur, Tourism, Project, Hotel, Tourist, Restaurant | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Scheme for Hotel and Restaurant Projects” was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC), Department of Industries & Commerce, Puducherry. The scheme aims to financially assist entrepreneurs for setting up entrepreneurs setting up of hotel/restaurant projects in urban areas. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.
## Benefits - Financial Assistance to entrepreneurs for setting up of hotel / restaurant projects in urban areas. - The Loan Limit is need based. - The Project Cost must not exceed ₹12,00,00,000/-. - The Repayment Period is upto 10 years including moratorium period.
## Eligibility Criteria Entrepreneurs setting up hotel / restaurant projects in urban areas are eligible.
## Exclusions

# Scheme for Small Road Transport Operators (SRTOs) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Puducherry | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Transport, Loan, Vehicle, Entrepreneur, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Scheme for Small Road Transport Operators (SRTOs)" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC), Department of Industries & Commerce, Puducherry. The scheme aims to extend financial assistance for acquiring new transport vehicles, specifically goods and passenger vehicles. The scheme provides financial assistance covering up to 70% of the cost of the vehicle, excluding road tax and insurance. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
## Benefits - Financial assistance is provided up to 70% of the cost of the vehicle. - The calculation for the financial assistance excludes the cost of road tax and insurance. - The assistance is intended to meet the expenditure towards the cost of the chassis and body building for new transport vehicles (Goods and Passenger vehicle). - The maximum repayment period is 58 monthly instalments. - The repayment period includes a moratorium period of a maximum of 3 months. - A concessional rate of interest of 0.5% less than the normal rate is charged for units promoted by Women, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, or Differently abled persons. **Financial Norms:** [https://pipdic.in/financial_norms](https://pipdic.in/financial_norms)

## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a resident of Puducherry. - The applicant must be seeking financial assistance for acquiring new transport vehicles, which include Goods vehicles and Passenger vehicles. - The applicant must not be seeking financial assistance for second-hand vehicles.
## Exclusions Second-hand vehicles are not eligible for assistance.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide registered farmers engaged in aromatic cultivation with a fair price and a guaranteed market for their produce.

page_content:
# Minimum Support Price for Aromatic Oils/Products - Centre for Aromatic Plants **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Aromatic Cultivation, Farmer, Aromatic Plants, Minimum Support Price, Aromatic Oil | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Minimum Support Price for Aromatic Oils/Products” scheme is implemented by the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP), Selaqui, Dehradun, under the Department of Horticulture, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide registered farmers engaged in aromatic cultivation with a fair price and a guaranteed market for their produce.
## Benefits - Farmers can sell 25 varieties of aromatic oils/products at the prescribed price to the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP). - Farmers are ensured a fair price and a guaranteed market for the aromatic oils they produce.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The farmer must be engaged in the cultivation of aromatic plants. 1. The farmer must be registered with the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP), Selaqui, Dehradun.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - If a farmer is willing to sell the aromatic oils/products of the 25 identified species at the prescribed minimum support price (details of prices are available on the website), they must first contact CAP, Selaqui. The farmer will then bring the produced oil at their own expense, along with photocopies of the crop registration form, bank statement, and other relevant documents. - The CAP office tests the quality of the oil in its laboratory, and only after passing the quality test are the essential oils/products accepted for purchase. The purchase amount is then transferred directly to the farmer's bank account. If the quality of the oil does not meet the prescribed standards, it will not be purchased.

metadata.schemeName: Incentives to Industries For Training Prospective Employees Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to address the skill gap in Goa by supporting industrial units to provide demand-driven Short Term Training Courses through recognized institutions, thereby creating manpower suitable for the industry. It offers reimbursement for 60% of training costs up to ₹60,000/- per trainee.

page_content:
# Incentives to Industries For Training Prospective Employees Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Employee, Training, Enterprise, Incentive, Skill, Manufacture | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Incentives to Industries For Training Prospective Employees Scheme” was launched by the Directorate of Industries, Trade & Commerce, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to create manpower suitable to the needs of the Industry and to provide specific skill training to Goan youth to improve their employability by optimally utilizing the infrastructure available in Government and private institutions. The scheme provides reimbursement of 60% of training costs for prospective employees subject to a maximum of ₹60,000/- per employee and ₹7,20,000/- per unit per year. The applications for this scheme must be submitted offline.
## Benefits - Reimbursement of 60% of training costs for prospective employees. - Maximum reimbursement of ₹60,000/- per employee. - Maximum reimbursement of ₹7,20,000/- per unit per year. - The benefit is for demand-driven Short Term Training Courses. _*The benefits under this scheme are subject to recommendation by the Task Force Committee (TFC)._ _*The benefits are subject to budgetary allocation._ ##### ***Conditions*** - _The payment made to the trainees by the employer, such as stipend, wages, or allowances, shall not be considered as cost of training under this scheme._ - _No Promissory Estoppel shall be applicable if benefits are discontinued in case the budgetary allocation is exceeded._ - _The applicant shall allow and/or grant free access to any official authorized by the Directorate of Industries, Trade & Commerce for conducting inspection or supervision of the unit or the registers, or for holding discussions with employed employees, to ensure proper utilization of the financial incentives/subsidies granted by the State Government._
## Eligibility Criteria ##### ***For the Enterprise*** - The applicant must be a Micro, Small, Medium, or Large manufacturing enterprise. - The applicant must have registered under the Goa State Incentives to Encourage Investments Scheme (Umbrella Scheme). - The training must be conducted only through approved Skill Training Providers (STPs). - The course must be a demand driven Short Term Training Course. - The scheme shall not be applicable to cases which have claimed similar benefit under any other scheme/program of Government of Goa. - The prospective employees/trainees must be between the age of 18 to 42 years. - The prospective employees/trainees must fulfill the criteria of being a Goan as defined in the scheme. ##### ***For the Trainee*** - The trainee must satisfy one of the following criteria to be considered a Goan: - The person must be born in the State of Goa. - The person must have a 10 years Residence Certificate issued by the Mamlatdar. - The person must have any other document indicating residence in Goa issued by the Government of India or Government of Goa or its organisations, issued prior to 10 years, to the satisfaction of the Task Force Committee (examples include Driving license, Ration card, Electoral Photo Identity Card (EPIC), or Passport).
## Exclusions The benefit does not extend to refresher courses or retraining courses.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ***The applicant unit must first register as a Micro, Small, Medium, or Large manufacturing enterprise under the Goa State Incentives to Encourage Investments Scheme (Umbrella Scheme) to be eligible for incentives under this scheme.***
##### ***Step 1: Prepare and Submit a Training Proposal to the Skill Training Provider*** - The employer shall draft and submit a detailed proposal for the training to the Skill Training Provider (STP), specifying the contents (theory and/or practical), duration, number of trainees, details of on-site training (if any), and the required physical infrastructure. - The approved STP will use this proposal to determine the course fees, which the employer must then pay. ##### ***Step 2: Access and Complete the Application Form*** - The applicant must obtain and fill out the [specified application format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/target-schemes.pdf) for the Incentives to Industries for Training Prospective Employees Scheme.- The form requires specific details, including the unit's registration number under the umbrella scheme, Skill Training Provider details, course name, number of eligible Goan trainees (aged 18 to 42 years), fees paid, and the amount claimed. ##### ***Step 3: Submit the Claim Application and Supporting Documents*** - The applicant shall submit the completed application form, along with all supporting documents listed in the scheme's checklist, to the Directorate of Industries, Trade & Commerce. ##### ***Scrutiny by the Task Force Committee*** The application will undergo scrutiny, and the eligible units will be recommended by the Task Force Committee (TFC). ##### ***Reimbursement of Benefits*** Upon successful recommendation and subject to budgetary allocation, the approved amount shall be disbursed to the eligible unit. ##### ***Where to Apply*** Applications should be submitted to the Directorate of Industries, Trade & Commerce (DITC), Udyog Bhavan, Panaji.

metadata.schemeName: Scheme for Providing Counseling to the Trainees of Government Industrial Training Institutes at Directorate of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide youth-friendly counseling services in Government Industrial Training Institutes, delivered by appointed Counselors, to assist trainees suffering from mental, physical, or psychological stress. The benefit is the provision of a safe, confidential space.

page_content:
# Scheme for Providing Counseling to the Trainees of Government Industrial Training Institutes at Directorate of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Skills & Employment, Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Trainee, Counseling, Industry, Mental Health, Supervision | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Scheme for Providing Counseling to the Trainees of Government Industrial Training Institutes at Directorate of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship" was launched by the Directorate of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to spot the trainees of Industrial Training Institutes undergoing mental, physical related stress and provide solace and a safe, confidential vent to release their stress, anguish, grievances, guilt, or feeling of unrest/complain of neglect. The scheme provides youth-friendly counseling services delivered by appointed Counselors, along with dedicated supervision and data entry support staff.
## Benefits ##### ***Provision of Counseling Services*** - Youth-friendly counseling services are provided to assist distressed students to think more clearly and positively and develop the skills required to find their way forward. - Counselors discuss and assist trainees with various concerns, including Stress Management, adjusting to the Industrial Training Institute environment, life transitions and changes, difficulties in family relationships, depression, anxiety, anger, physical, sexual, and emotional abuse, thoughts of suicide, trauma, and other feelings that cause discomfort. ##### ***Monetary Remuneration (For Contract Staff)*** - Remuneration for Counselors is ₹28,000/-. - Remuneration for the Supervisor is ₹35,000/-. - Remuneration for the Data Entry Operator is ₹20,000/-. ##### ***Conditions*** - The appointment of the Counselor, Supervisor, and Data Entry Operator is on a contract basis for a period of 12 months. - The renewal of the contract shall be strictly based on the performance of the staff member, which will be assessed by the constituted Committee. - The Directorate of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship will pay the remuneration from the funds provided by the State Government or by the Government of India through any Centrally Sponsored Schemes.
## Eligibility Criteria ##### ***Eligibility for the Trainee (The Applicant)*** - The applicant must be a trainee studying in Government Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) under the Directorate of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (DSDE) in the State of Goa. ##### ***Eligibility for the Counselor Profile*** - The applicant must not exceed the age limit of 45 years. - The applicant must possess a Regular Masters degree in Clinical/Counseling Psychology OR Masters in Social Work (MSW) with specialization in medical and psychiatric. - OR The applicant must possess a Regular Graduation in Psychology (6 units), Social Work, or Home Science (Human Resources) from a University Grants Commission (UGC) recognized College and a Diploma in Guidance and Counseling from a recognized Institution. - The applicant must have a minimum of 1 year experience in Counseling. - The applicant must possess a 15 years residence certificate. - The applicant must possess knowledge of Konkani. - The applicant should possess knowledge of Marathi. ##### ***Eligibility for the Supervisor Profile*** - The applicant must not exceed the age limit of 45 years. - The applicant must possess a Regular Masters Degree in Clinical/Counseling Psychology OR Masters in Social Work (MSW) with specialization in medical and psychiatric. - The applicant must possess a Diploma in Guidance and Counseling from a recognized institution. - The applicant must have a minimum of 3 years experience in Counselling. - The applicant must have experience of conducting training and workshops. - The applicant must possess a 15 years residence certificate. - The applicant must possess knowledge of Konkani. - The applicant should possess knowledge of Marathi. - The applicant should possess a Master of Philosophy (M. Phil) or Doctor of Philosophy (Ph. D.) in Psychology. ##### ***Eligibility for the Data Entry Operator Profile*** - The applicant must not exceed the age limit of 45 years. - The applicant must have passed the Higher Secondary School Certificate Examination (HSSCE) from a recognized Institution. - The applicant must possess a certificate confirming completion of a course in Computer for a minimum period of 3 months from a recognized Institute. - The applicant must possess a 15 years residence certificate. - The applicant must possess knowledge of Konkani. - The applicant should possess knowledge of Marathi.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ****The process described below outlines the selection of contract staff (Counselors, Supervisor, Data Entry Operator) to implement the scheme for trainees.*** ##### ***Step 1: Committee Constitution*** The Directorate of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (DSDE) shall constitute a dedicated Committee for the specific purpose of selecting the Counselors, Supervisor, and Data Entry Operator. ##### ***Step 2: Conducting Selection Interviews*** The Committee constituted by the Department shall conduct walk-in interviews as the official method for selecting the eligible candidates for the positions of Counselors, Supervisor, and Data Entry Operator. ##### ***Step 3: Contract Appointment and Renewal*** Selected candidates will be appointed on a contract basis for a period of 12 months. The Directorate of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship may subsequently renew this contract strictly based upon the staff member's performance, which will be assessed by the aforementioned selection committee.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance irrigation facilities for farmers in Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance for the construction of tubewells and ponds, thereby improving water availability, supporting horticultural development, and increasing agricultural productivity.

page_content:
# Tubewell Installation /Pond Construction **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Tubewell Installation, Pond Construction, Farmer, Irrigation | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Tubewell Installation/ Pond Construction” is implemented by the Department of Horticulture, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to enhance irrigation facilities for farmers in Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance for the construction of tubewells and ponds, thereby improving water availability, supporting horticultural development, and increasing agricultural productivity.
## Benefits Under this scheme, to promote the development of irrigation facilities, farmers are provided a 50% subsidy on the total cost for the construction of new tubewells or ponds, up to a maximum of ₹90,000/- per unit (limited to one unit per farmer).
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and must hold a valid Udhyan Card. 1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease. 1. The farmer must confirm the availability of water in the concerned area. 1. A farmer is eligible for a subsidy for the construction of one tube well/pond.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - The application form can be obtained from the officers/personnel working at the Horticulture Mobile team Centres. It can also be downloaded from the department's website: [https://shm.uk.gov.in](https://shm.uk.gov.in/). Along with the application form/proposal, the applicant must submit land-related documents such as Khasra and Khatauni, a lease certificate (in case of leased land), Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Udhyan Card, bank account details, and mobile number. At present, the application process is offline. - If the applicant faces any difficulty while completing the application, the personnel at the concerned Horticulture Mobile team Centre will provide assistance. The completed application form must be submitted at the same office. The personnel at the Horticulture Mobile team Centre then forward the proposal to the district level, which further forwards it to the Directorate. After the Directorate approves the farmers’ proposals, an approval/work order is issued to the respective districts. - Once a farmer’s proposal is approved, the district officer sends an acceptance letter and also informs the farmer over the phone. The farmer then begins constructing the tube well/pond, after which an on-site inspection is conducted by departmental personnel. Based on the inspection report, the subsidy amount is transferred directly to the farmer’s bank account.

## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Applications must be submitted at the Horticulture Mobile team Centres. metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community who have cleared the Civil Services Preliminary Examination. The benefits support their preparation for the Mains Examination to ensure their success.

page_content:
# Financial Assistance to Students who Cleared Civil Services Prelims Conducted by UPSC/APSC **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Assam | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Student, Scholarship, Stipend, Education, UPSC, Exam | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Financial Assistance to Students who Cleared Civil Services Prelims Conducted by UPSC/APSC” was launched by the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Welfare Department, Government of Assam. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community who have cleared the Civil Services Preliminary Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission or Assam Public Service Commission during the current year, so that they are supported in their preparation for the Mains Examination and succeed. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
## Benefits - Financial assistance to students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community who have cleared the Civil Services Preliminary Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission/Assam Public Service Commission during the current year. - The assistance is intended to support them in their preparation for the Mains Examination and succeed.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam and must belong to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community. - The applicant must produce a valid Caste certificate which is duly certified/issued by the District Commissioner of the concerned district or his/her designated officer. - The applicant should have cleared the Civil Services Preliminary Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission/Assam Public Service Commission during the current year. - The applicant must produce his/her copy of the admit card and result of the Civil Services Preliminary Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission/Assam Public Service Commission. - The applicant should not be a Government service holder.
## Exclusions - The applicants who have cleared both the Civil Services Preliminary Examinations Conducted by the Union Public Service Commission and Assam Public Service Commission in the same year shall be considered for scholarship only for the Union Public Service Commission Prelims. - The applicant should not be a Government service holder.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ##### ***Step 1:*** ***Portal Access and Scheme Selection*** **A. Navigating to the Portal:** The applicant must first open the official Tea Tribes Welfare Department URL, www.ttwd.assam.gov.in, and then click the "Online Application" link to be redirected to the [SIRISH application portal](https://sirishassam.in/). **B. Initial Login or Registration:** New users must register themselves on the online portal, while existing users will log in using the username and password created during prior registration. **C. Selecting the Scheme:** Once the applicant is logged into the Dashboard, they must select the appropriate scholarship scheme from the dropdown menu available. ##### ***Step 2:********* **Entering Personal Details** **A. Inputting Mandatory Data:** The applicant proceeds to enter Personal Details where all required information in the application form must be accurately provided. **B. Specifying Location Details:** Location data, including District, Assembly Constituency, and Sub-Division, must be selected, along with other essential address details like Village/Town. **C. Saving Personal Information:** After filling in all necessary fields in this step, the applicant must click on the "Save Form Details" button to proceed further with the application. ##### ***Step 3:********* **Document Upload** **A. Uploading Required Files:** Under the Upload Documents tab, the applicant must upload all required supporting documents in the specified image formats (e.g., JPG/JPEG). **B. Document Formatting Check:** All uploaded documents must adhere to specified maximum file sizes (e.g., photo maximum 50 KB, other documents generally 100 KB) before they can be saved. ##### ***Step 4:********* **Updating Bank Details** **A. Providing Account Information:** The applicant must enter the Bank Account Number and the name of the bank under the "Update Bank Details" tab. **B. Entering Branch Identification:** Details essential for electronic transfer, specifically the Bank Branch Name and the corresponding IFSC Code, must be accurately provided. **C. Securing Financial Data:** Once all bank details have been correctly entered, the applicant must click on the "Save Bank Details" button to confirm the information. ##### ***Step 5:********* **Preview and Final Submission** **A. Application Review:** "Preview Application and Final Submission", displays all details entered in the form for a thorough and final check. **B. Final Confirmation:** After cross-checking all information and uploaded documents for accuracy, the applicant must confirm the application by clicking the "Proceed with Submit Application" button. **C. Tracking Status:** Upon successful submission, an application number will be visible on the screen, allowing the applicant to view the status under the "APPLICATION STATUS" tab.

metadata.schemeName: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM)
metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to boost entrepreneurship and innovation among SC students and SC differently-abled youth by providing focused support to translate innovative, technology-oriented business ideas into successful commercial enterprises. It offers equity funding and hand-holding support.

page_content:
# Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Entrepreneurship, Innovation, Youth, Scheduled Caste, Student, Incubation, Startup | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission" was launched on 30th September 2020, by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India. The scheme aims to promote innovation and enterprise in Scheduled Caste students studying in higher educational institutions and to support 1,000 innovative ideas through synergistic work with the Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) set up by the Department of Science and Technology (DST). The scheme provides equity support to young Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs so they can translate their start-up ideas into commercial ventures, with successful ventures potentially qualifying for venture funding. The scheme is implemented by the Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC). The applications are accepted online.
## Benefits - Provision of equity assistance up to ₹30,00,000/- over a period of 3 years for identified innovative ideas from Scheduled Caste students in Technology Business Incubators (TBIs). - The assistance covers costs toward Technology Business Incubator (TBI) accommodation cost, Hardware, Software, Fellowship, Travel and marketing, Intellectual Property (IP) filing, Tool-room expenses, and Co-workers. - Successful ventures would further qualify for venture funding up to ₹15,00,00,000/- from the Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC). - The Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC) shall extend all support in the form of hand-holding, guidance, and mentoring. ##### ***Disbursement Details*** - The maximum capital of ₹30,00,000/- is disbursed at ₹10,00,000/- every year over a period of 3 years. - The fund infused shall be in the form of Equity, Optionally Convertible Preference Shares (OCPS), or Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS). - The tenure of financial assistance under Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM) is 10 years, starting from the date of the first disbursement. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The equity assistance is subject to satisfactory evaluation of the progress by the concerned Technology Business Incubator (TBI)._ - _The financial assistance shall be released to the entities/Companies promoted by these young Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs._ - _Selected participants must form or have a private limited or limited company where the Scheduled Caste entrepreneur holds at least 51% shareholding._ - _The entrepreneurs must bear the expenses required for forming a company during the 3-year incubation period._ - _The entity must maintain the 51% Scheduled Caste shareholding along with management control until the assistance under the Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM) is present in the company._ - _The conversion of shares provided as funding to equity will be a maximum of 49% stake and will occur only after 3 years, differing on a case-to-case basis._ - _Proprietary Firms, Partnership Firms, One Person Company (OPC), Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs), or any other establishment incorporated under any law in force should convert itself into a Private Limited or Public Limited company before receiving assistance under the fund._
## Eligibility Criteria ***The following SC / SC Divyang youth would be eligible for support under ASIIM:*** - Youth who have been identified by the TBIs, Atal Incubation Centers (AICs), Technology / Industrial Parks, Science and Technology Parks of India (STPI) being promoted by Department of Science & Technology (DST) or other than DST and other incubation centers supported by Government of India. - Youth who are identified for incubation by reputed private TBIs. - Students who have been awarded under the Smart India Hackathon or Smart India Hardware Hackathon being conducted by Ministry of Education. - Innovative ideas focusing on the socio-economic development of the society identified in the TBIs in public or private sectors. - Start-ups nominated and supported by corporates through CSR funds.
## Exclusions Investments in negative sectors as per the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) guidelines are not eligible under this fund.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ##### ***Registration*** Navigate to the [official link for online application](https://www.vcfsc.in/asiim/Venture-Capital-Fund-for-Scheduled-Castes.aspx). Click on "Create an Account". You will be taken to the registration page. Fill in all the mandatory fields and register. _*If required, verify your Email ID and Mobile Number via OTP._ _*If you are prompted to create a password, ensure the password meets security requirements._ ##### ***Application*** **Step 1:** Navigate to the [official link for online application](https://www.vcfsc.in/asiim/Venture-Capital-Fund-for-Scheduled-Castes.aspx). Use the credentials you created during registration to log in. Navigate to the online form of the scheme you intend to apply for. **Step 2:** In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections. **Step 3:** Acknowledge and agree to the terms and conditions, declaration, and privacy policy (if any) by ticking the designated checkbox. Click "Submit" to submit your application. You'll receive a confirmation message.
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:****** ***Recommendation and Submission of Proposals*** - To identify potential entrepreneurs, Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) (set up under the aegis of the Department of Science and Technology) shall be contacted and informed to recommend potential young Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs for assistance. - Other Technology and Management Schools shall also be contacted and informed for the purpose of recommending potential young entrepreneurs working in their Incubation Centres. - Other applications/proposals received directly from various Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Caste Divyang Start-ups will also be taken up as per the guidelines of the fund. **Step 2:****** ***Selection and Automatic Incubation*** - The start-up ideas presented by Scheduled Caste (SC)/Scheduled Caste Divyang students that have been selected by the Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) will be automatically selected for incubation under the Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM). **Step 3:****** ***Company Formation and Compliance*** - Prior to receiving assistance, selected participants who are not already incorporated must convert their Proprietary Firms, Partnership Firms, One Person Company (OPC), Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs), or other establishments into a Private Limited or Public Limited company. - The incorporated company must ensure that the Scheduled Caste entrepreneur maintains at least a 51% shareholding, along with management control, which must be sustained until the assistance under the Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM) remains in the company.
##### ***Fund Disbursement and Monitoring*** - Financial assistance, provided as equity, Optionally Convertible Preference Shares (OCPS), or Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS), shall be released to the Companies promoted by these young Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs. - The disbursement of equity assistance, which totals ₹30,00,000/- over 3 years (₹10,00,000/- annually), is contingent upon the satisfactory evaluation of the progress by the concerned Technology Business Incubator (TBI). ##### ***Grievance Redressal / Help & Support*** - Official contact details for the Investment Manager, IFCI Venture Capital Funds Limited, are provided: 16th Floor, IFCI Tower, 61, Nehru Place, New Delhi – 110019. - Applicants can call 011 - 4173 2507/09/18/67/70/76/81/82/90 or 011 - 26453359/46/19/43. - The official email address for queries regarding the Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM) is asiim@ifciventure.com. - Additionally, a Grievance Redressal portal is available.

page_content:
# Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana - Uttarakhand **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Fisheries, Subsidy, Fish Farming, Fish Farmer, Fishermen | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana” is a centrally sponsored scheme implemented by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote the growth of the fisheries sector by providing financial assistance and technical support for modern fisheries activities, thereby increasing fish production, improving livelihood opportunities, and encouraging the adoption of advanced fisheries infrastructure among eligible beneficiaries.
## Benefits A 60% subsidy is provided to SC/ST and Women beneficiaries for pond construction, trout units, rearing units, RAS, biofloc units, cage culture, cold storage, motorcycles with ice boxes, fish kiosks, ornamental fisheries, feed mills, hatcheries, and similar activities. A 40% subsidy is provided for all other categories, and a 20% subsidy is provided specifically for large RAS units. **Table-1:** **Activity/Item****Unit Cost per Hectare****Grant (General Category)****Grant (Women/SC/ST)****Maximum Limit/Grant Limit**Construction and investment of new ponds₹11 lakh (per hectare)₹4,40,000/-₹6,60,000/-Maximum 2 hectares individual &amp; 20 hectares society/group etc. Trout Raceways and Investment (Nos.) 50 sq.m. per unit₹5,50,000/-₹2,20,000/-₹3,30,000/-Maximum 4 units individual &amp; 20 units society/group etc.Large RAS (8 tanks)/Large Biofloc Unit (50 tanks)₹50,00,000/-₹10,00,000/-₹12,50,000/-Maximum 1 UnitMedium RAS (6 tanks)/Medium Biofloc Unit (25 tanks)₹25,00,000/-₹10,00,000/-₹15,00,000/-Maximum 1 UnitSmall RAS (1 tank) / Small Biofloc Unit (7 tanks)₹7,50,000/-₹3,00,000/-₹4,50,000/-Maximum 1 UnitEstablishment of Trout Fish Hatcheries ₹50,00,000/-₹20,00,000/-₹30,00,000/-Maximum 1 UnitCold Water RAS Unit₹20,00,000/-₹8,00,000/-₹12,00,000/-Maximum 1 UnitFish Kiosk₹10,00,000/-₹4,00,000/-₹6,00,000/-Maximum 1 Unit**Table-2:** **Activity/Item****Unit Cost****Grant (General Category)****Grant (Women/SC/ST)****Maximum Limit/Grant Limit**Motor cycle with Ice Box₹75,000/-₹30,000/-₹45,000/-Maximum 1 UnitThree wheeler with Ice Box₹3,00,000/-₹1,20,000/-₹1,80,000/-Maximum 1 UnitRefrigerated/Insulated Vehicles₹25,00,000/-₹10,00,000/-₹15,00,000/-Maximum 1 UnitCold Storage Capacity 10 Tons₹40,00,000/-₹16,00,000/-₹24,00,000/-Maximum 1 UnitEstablishment of Cage₹3,000/- per cubic meter₹1,200/-₹1,800/-Maximum 1800 cubic meters for individual &amp; 7200 cubic meters for society/group etc. Backyard Ornamental Unit₹3,00,000/-₹1,20,000/-₹1,80,000/-Maximum 4 units for individual and 20 units for society/group etc.Feed Mill Capacity 2 Tons Per Day Production₹30,00,000/-₹12,00,000/-₹18,00,000/- Maximum 1 Unit
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant may belong to any caste category, including General, Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Other Backward Class (OBC), or be a woman. 1. The applicant must have availability of land and a water supply source.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - To avail the benefits of the scheme, the applicant must submit an application to the office of the Assistant Director of Fisheries/District Fisheries In-charge at the district level. The application should be submitted along with the following documents: Aadhaar card, land records, permanent residence certificate, caste certificate, bank account details, and mobile number. - ***In the future, the application process will be made available online through the*** [***Apuni Sarkar Portal***](https://eservices.uk.gov.in/)***.*** - After the application is submitted, a survey is conducted by the Fisheries Inspector/field personnel, and a proposal is prepared in consultation with the beneficiary. Once the proposal is finalized, the concerned district officer approves the work. Field personnel then supervise the implementation and provide technical assistance to ensure timely completion. Subsequently, the subsidy is transferred directly to the beneficiary’s bank account through DBT.

page_content:
# Pension Scheme for Craftsmen **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Artisan, Pension, Craftsman, Old Age, Senor Citizen, BPL | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Pension Scheme for Craftsmen” is implemented by the Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) Department under the Department of Industries, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support and social security to traditional artisans of Uttarakhand who are aged 60 years or above and belong to families living below the poverty line.
## Benefits Under this scheme, craftsmen aged 60 years or above who are already receiving an old age pension are provided with an additional incentive of ₹400/- per month.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an artisan/craftsman aged 60 years or above. 1. The applicant must be already receiving an old age pension from the government. 1. The applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. If the son or grandson of the artisan is 20 years of age or above and the family still lives below the poverty line, the applicant remains eligible. 1. The applicant must be engaged in traditional handicrafts such as stone, wood, iron, lamp, ringal, bamboo, and product development from natural fibres, or in any other crafts approved by the government from time to time.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - Application forms can be obtained from the office of the General Manager, District Industries Centre, or downloaded from the departmental website [https://doi.uk.org](https://doi.uk.gov.in/). - Along with the application form, applicants must submit the following documents to the General Manager, District Industries Centre of the concerned district: Aadhaar card, bank account details, proof of receiving old age pension, BPL certificate, birth certificate/Aadhaar as proof of date of birth, a certified copy of the family register to define the family, and a certificate confirming the applicant’s status as a craftsman. ***Selection Process:*** - The documents of eligible artisans are verified by a committee constituted under the chairmanship of the General Manager, District Industries Centre. Based on this verification, the eligible applicants are selected for the pension. - After selection, the additional incentive pension is disbursed quarterly into the artisan’s bank or post office account.

# Registration of Aromatic Plant Farmers - Centre for Aromatic Plants **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Aromatic, Farmer, Aromatic Plants, Registration | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Registration of Aromatic Plant Farmers” is implemented by the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP), Selaqui, Dehradun, under the Department of Horticulture, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to ensures that farmers are eligible to access the benefits of all schemes offered by CAP, including state and central government subsidies, technical guidance, training programs, and product clearance support.
## Benefits - Registration of farmers with the Aromatic Plant Centre (CAP) is mandatory to avail of the benefits of all the schemes run by the Aromatic Plant Centre. - After registration, CAP provides farmers with facilities such as subsidies provided by the State and Central Governments, technical information, training, product clearance, etc.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The farmer must either legally own agricultural land or have leased land for a minimum period of 10 years. 1. The farmer must be engaged in aromatic plant cultivation.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - It is mandatory for a farmer to register with the CAP office within three months of starting aromatic farming. An application for registration must be submitted to the Director, CAP, in the prescribed format. The registration form can be downloaded from the CAP website [https://www.capuk.in/index.php/services#](https://www.capuk.in/) or obtained from field personnel. - The registration form, along with land records and Aadhaar card, must be submitted to CAP or handed over to a field personnel. A CAP field personnel will then conduct an on-site inspection of the farm and recommend the registration. Following this recommendation, the Director, CAP, completes the registration and assigns a registration number to the farmer. A copy of the registration form can be obtained by mail or collected from the office.

metadata.schemeName: Uttarakhand Rajya Shilp Ratna Puraskar
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to honor exceptionally skilled artisans of the state for their outstanding contributions to the traditional craft sector. This annual award celebrates heritage, promotes excellence, and supports artisans whose expertise has preserved and enriched cultural craftsmanship.

page_content:
# Uttarakhand Rajya Shilp Ratna Puraskar **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Ratna Award, Shilp, Artisan, Traditional Crafts, Craftsperson | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Uttarakhand Rajya Shilp Ratna Puraskar” is implemented by the Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) Department under the Department of Industries, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to honour exceptionally skilled artisans of the state for their outstanding contributions to the traditional craft sector.
## Benefits - Every year, 25 artisans from the state of Uttarakhand are honored with the "Uttarakhand Rajya Shilp Ratna Puraskar." - Each selected outstanding artisan receives a cash prize of ₹1 lakh, along with a memento (symbolic representation), an angavastra (ceremonial stole) and a certificate of appreciation.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a skilled artisan. 1. The applicant must be at least 45 years of age. 1. The applicant must be proficient in traditional or extraordinary art forms and has made unprecedented contribution in the field of traditional crafts. 1. The artisans must have contributed to the training of young artisans. 1. The applicant must have at least 15 years of experience in a recognized traditional craft. 1. The applicant must not be employed in government/semi-government/cooperative institution/union. **Note:** Preference will be given to artisans who have received national/state-level awards.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - Application forms can be obtained from the General Manager of the District Industries Centres and can also be downloaded from the website [https://investuttarakhand.uk.gov.in/themes/backend/acts/act_english1541412900.pdf](https://investuttarakhand.uk.gov.in/themes/backend/acts/act_english1541412900.pdf) or viewed on the departmental website [https://doiuk.org/mysite/home](https://doi.uk.gov.in/)/. - The application form must be accompanied by the following documents: Aadhaar card, birth certificate or date of birth document, permanent residence certificate, a brief description of the guru/teacher who taught the craft, educational or vocational qualification certificates (if any), details of contributions to the craft, certificates of purchase of craft products, details of training provided to young artisans, information on major exhibitions participated in, details of average monthly income, and information on whether the artisan’s outstanding products have been purchased by museums, temples, or art critics. (Documents related to purchase details must be attached.) - After completing the form, applicants must submit it to the respective District Industries Centre. ***Selection Process:*** - Upon the recommendation of the District-Level Selection Committee, constituted under the chairmanship of the District Magistrate, the application forms of outstanding artisans along with the necessary certificates are forwarded to the State-Level Selection Committee, constituted under the chairmanship of the Principal Secretary, Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of Uttarakhand. - The State-Level Selection Committee then reviews the recommendations and applications received and finalizes the selection for the Uttarakhand Rajya Shilp Ratna Puraskar.

metadata.schemeName: District Plan - Sugarcane Development Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance sugarcane productivity & quality in Uttarakhand by providing financial & technical support to farmers for improved seed production, seed & soil treatment, pest & disease management, thereby promoting sustainable farming & strengthening the livelihoods of sugarcane growers.

page_content:
# District Plan - Sugarcane Development Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Sugarcane, Sugar, Sugarcane Seed, Farmer, Soil Treatment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Sugarcane Development Scheme” a sub-component of the District Plan, implemented by the Department of Sugarcane Development and Sugar Industry, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to enhance sugarcane productivity and quality in Uttarakhand by providing financial and technical support to farmers for improved seed production, seed and soil treatment, and pest and disease management, thereby promoting sustainable farming and strengthening the livelihoods of sugarcane growers.
## Benefits 1. **Scheme for Improved Sugarcane Seed Production:** A subsidy of ₹1,000/- per hectare (₹2,000/- per hectare for SC/ST farmers) is provided for established/base nurseries, and ₹500/- per hectare (₹1,000/- per hectare for SC/ST farmers) is provided for primary nurseries. 1. **Seed/Soil Treatment:** A 50% subsidy is provided in all sugar mill areas for chemicals used in seed and soil treatment. Of this, 25% is contributed by the government, while the remaining 25% is shared equally by the Sugarcane Development Council and the sugar mill. 1. **Sugarcane Stalk Base (Pedi) Management Program:** To protect ratoon sugarcane crops from pests and diseases, a 50% subsidy is provided in all sugar mill areas for pesticides used in pest and disease control. The subsidy comprises 25% contribution from the government, with the remaining 25% shared by the Sugarcane Development Council and the sugar mill.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer cultivating sugarcane. 1. The applicant must be a permanent member of a cooperative sugarcane development society. 1. The applicant must practice advanced sugarcane farming. 1. The applicant’s name must be registered in the land records of the state.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline To select sugarcane farmers for availing the benefits of this scheme, the selection is carried out after discussions with public representatives in the Gram Sabha meeting at the village level, followed by a survey conducted by the Sugarcane Supervisor, and final approval from the departmental officers (Sugarcane Development Inspector, Senior Sugarcane Development Inspector, and Assistant Sugarcane Commissioner).

metadata.schemeName: The Grant of Honorarium to Legal Researcher Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to engage Legal Research Assistants to handle legal issues and court matters for major Departments of the Administration, thereby ensuring timely submission of defense documents and reducing departmental embarrassment in Courts. It gives fixed honorarium of ₹25,000/- per month.

page_content:
# The Grant of Honorarium to Legal Researcher Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Puducherry | **Categories:** Public Safety,Law & Justice, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Researcher, Assistant, Law, Honorarium, Advocate, Legal | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "The Grant of Honorarium to Legal Researcher Scheme" was launched by the Law Department, Union Territory of Puducherry. The scheme aims to address the high volume of cases before various fora where Departments find it very hard to submit their defense documents (Affidavits/Reply Statements/Counter Affidavits) at the appropriate time through the Law Officers, leading to officers of the Administration facing unnecessary embarrassment before the Courts. The scheme provides for engaging 15 Legal Research Assistants on a fixed honorarium for an initial period of two years, potentially extendable for one more year, in order to obtain the services of the best incumbents and to follow up all legal issues including Court matter pending. The applications for this scheme are accepted by the Under Secretary to Government, Law Department, Chief Secretariat, Puducherry.
## Benefits - Research Assistant shall be paid ₹25,000/- per month (Rupees twenty-five thousand only) as honorarium, for their assignment. - The assignment will be initially for a period of two years from the date of engagement. - The assignment can be extended for a further period of not exceeding one more year, subject to the approval of the Secretary to Government (Law). - Research Assistants are permitted access to the Computers and internet facilities as available in the Law Department. - Research Assistant shall be entitled to one day Casual Leave for each Calendar Month. - The un-availed Casual Leave in a particular month may be carried forward, subject to a maximum of 2 days. - The maximum eligibility of Casual Leave in a Calendar Year is 8 days. ****Research Assistant shall not be entitled to any other allowances or perks.*** ****Research Assistant shall not be treated or deemed to be an employee either in the Law Department or of the service of the Department of the Union Territory of Puducherry.*** ##### ***Assignment Location*** _The Legal Researchers shall be attached to the major Departments of this Administration, including Law, Police, Education, Revenue, Health, Local Administration Department, Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms (D.P.&A.R.), Public Works Department, Social Welfare, Civil Supplies, Commercial Taxes, Industries and Commerce, Department of Women and Child Development, and Transport._ ##### ***Dress Code*** ***For Male Research Assistant:*** _White/Black Pant, White shirt, Black shoe._ ***For Female Research Assistant:*** _White/Off White Saree, White/Off-White blouse._ ##### ***Post-Selection Obligations*** - The Research Assistant must join their assignment within the period specified in their order of engagement. - The Research Assistant shall not be entitled to practice as an Advocate in any Court of Law or Tribunal or Authority during the currency of their assignment. - It will be obligatory for the Research Assistant, after accepting the assignment, to inform the Bar Council concerned, in writing, that he/she shall not practice as an Advocate as long as he/she continues with the assignment as Research Assistant. - The Research Assistant shall not be entitled to take up any employment or engagement of whatsoever nature either on full-time or part-time basis during the currency of their assignment. - The Research Assistant should mark their attendance in the Attendance Register which shall be duly authenticated by the respective Head of the Institution in which they are posted from time-to-time and the same shall be communicated to the Law Department, Puducherry. - The Research Assistant may be required to attend the Office on Saturday/Sunday and other holidays also, in addition to the normal working day, for which he/she shall not be paid any honorarium/remuneration. - The Research Assistant will be permitted to proceed on Casual Leave only with prior permission of the respective Head of Institution. - If any Research Assistant is found to be exceeding the permissible limit of 8 days of Casual Leave in a Calendar Year, necessary deductions will be made from their honorarium, on pro-rata basis. - If the Research Assistant intends to leave the assignment within a period of two years, they shall be required to give prior notice of one month. - The assignment of any Research Assistant may be discontinued even before the completion of one year, without notice, if his/her services are found to be unsatisfactory. - During the assignment, every Research Assistant shall maintain a high standard of reputation and integrity commensurate with the responsibilities entrusted to him/her.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a citizen of India. - The applicant must be a resident of Puducherry. - The applicant must be a Postgraduate in Law (2 years programme) from the recognized Universities in the Indian Union. - The applicant must not be pursuing Postgraduate Degree in Law or any other Degrees or Programmes requiring their compulsory attendance elsewhere. - The applicant must not have attained the age of 30 years as on 1st January or 1st July, preceding the last date fixed for submission of applications. - The applicant must not have attained the age of 32 years as on 1st January, 2023, if applying under the one-time age relaxation granted by the Honorable Lieutenant Governor of Puducherry. ****The educational qualifications and other eligibility criteria may be relaxed in case of exceptionally outstanding and deserving candidates by the Government.***
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant must access the [Official website](https://law.py.gov.in) of the Law Department, Union Territory of Puducherry, to [download the application proforma](https://law.py.gov.in/docs/Scheme_legal_reseracher_appl_invited-age%2032.pdf) (as prescribed in the scheme). Take a printout of the same. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). The applicant must also affix a self-attested passport size photo and complete the undertaking, declaring that the facts stated are true to the best of their knowledge and belief and undertaking to indemnify the Government for any falsehood. **Step 3:****** The completed application, along with copies of all enclosures, must be submitted to the ***Under Secretary to Government, Law Department, Chief Secretariat, Puducherry***. ***The submission must be completed on or before the specified deadline of 28th April of the respective year, by 05:45 P.M.*** ##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** **Appearing for Viva Voce** Eligible candidates will be intimated the date, time, and venue and will have to appear for a viva voce at Puducherry. Candidates must attend the viva voce on their own expenses. **Step 2:** **Final Selection and Engagement** - The final selection shall be based on merit and determined by a Committee comprising the Secretary to Government (Law), the Secretary to Government (Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms), and the Director of Prosecution. - The list of candidates selected by the Committee shall be subject to the approval of the Honorable Lieutenant-Governor, Puducherry, and the successful candidate must join the assignment within the period specified in their order of engagement.

metadata.schemeName: Livestock Mission Scheme - Interest Payment on Loan
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-employment opportunities at the local level by encouraging livestock-based entrepreneurship and reducing the financial burden on beneficiaries through payment of 90% of the bank loan interest by the State Government.

page_content:
# Livestock Mission Scheme - Interest Payment on Loan **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Livestock Mission, Interest Payment, Loan, Animal Husbandry, Buffalo, Cow, Sheep, Goat, Poultry, Pig | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Livestock Mission Scheme – Interest Payment on Loan” scheme has been introduced by the Department of Animal Husbandry, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote self-employment opportunities at the local level by encouraging livestock-based entrepreneurship and reducing the financial burden on beneficiaries through payment of 90% of the bank loan interest by the State Government.
## Benefits **For promoting self-employment at the local level, 90% of the interest subsidy on the bank loan taken by the applicant for setting up the following units is borne by the State Government:** ***Dairy Entrepreneurship Development Scheme:*** - 5 cow units - 10 cow units - 2 buffalo units - 5 buffalo units ***Load Carrier Entrepreneurship Development Scheme:*** - 1 mule unit - 2 mule unit ***Sheep and Goat Entrepreneurship Development Scheme:*** - Sheep/Goat (5 female + 1 male) - Sheep/Goat (10 female + 1 male) ***Pig Entrepreneurship Development Scheme:*** - Pig (5 female + 1 male) - Pig (10 female + 1 male) ***Poultry Entrepreneurship Development Scheme:*** - Commercial broiler farm for 1,000 birds - Small commercial layer farm for 250 birds
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an interested livestock farmer. 1. The livestock farmer must be eligible to avail a bank loan.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - The scheme will initially operate offline. Once the departmental portal becomes operational, beneficiaries will be required to apply and register through the portal. - Applicants must submit their applications to the District Level Implementation Unit (DLIA) at the district level, along with the bank’s consent letter for loan approval. After scrutiny of the applications received by the DLIA, a list of eligible applicants will be prepared. Upon completion of all formalities, final approval will be granted. The approved applications, along with the beneficiaries’ forms, will then be submitted through the concerned bank for further scrutiny and loan recommendation. - The bank will provide information on the amount of interest subsidy granted by the state government to the DLIA each quarter, corresponding to the beneficiaries’ approved loans. The DLIA will prepare a bill for the said amount and submit it to the treasury for payment. - The State Monitoring Committee will be established within the Animal Husbandry Directorate, Dehradun. The committee, under the control of the Director of Animal Husbandry, will monitor the progress of the scheme and ensure its proper implementation by issuing necessary instructions to district-level officers.

metadata.schemeName: The Punjab Financial Assistance to Acid Victims Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The objective of this Scheme is to provide monthly Financial Assistance to females who have been rendered 40% disabled due to acid attack. This scheme is fully state-sponsored.

page_content:
# The Punjab Financial Assistance to Acid Victims Scheme

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Punjab | **Categories:** Women and Child, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Acid Victim, Woman | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme “The Punjab Financial Assistance to Acid Victims Scheme” was launched by the Department of Social Security And Women & Child Development, Government of Punjab in the year 2017. The objective of the Scheme is to provide monthly Financial Assistance to females who have been rendered 40% disabled due to acid attack. This scheme is fully state-sponsored.

## Benefits
1. The Financial Assistance of ₹8,000/- per month is given to rehabilitate the victims of acid attack and make them self-reliant.

**Note:** The amount of payment is directly transferred to the account of the beneficiary by the directorate online.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The acid attack victim should be a resident of Punjab State.
   1. The females who have been rendered 40% disabled due to acid attack are eligible for the assistance.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
> **Application Process:**

The victim or victim's parents/guardian/legal heir/family member/any relative may submit an application to the concerned District Social Security Officer.
**Note 01:** The application is to be submitted to the District Social Security Officer.
**Note 02:** The application must be supported by a medical certificate duly issued by the Civil Surgeon.
**Note 03:** The ease for sanction of financial assistance to the victim shall be considered upon submission of an application to the concerned District Social Security Officer either by the victim herself or by her guardian /heir/family member/any relative, in a case where the victim has been rendered so disabled due to acid attack that she is not in a position to make an application herself.
**Grievances Redressal:** District Social Security Officer
> **Sanction of Cases-**

**Step 01:** On receipt of the application, the District Social Security Officer, after completing documentary formalities, shall immediately, and under no circumstances later than one week, submit the case to the Deputy Commissioner, who shall call the meeting of the District Level Committee within 7 days of the submission of the case by the District Social Security Officer.
**Step 02:** The District Level Committee, upon being satisfied that the applicant is eligible for financial assistance under the scheme shall sanction the case. If the committee is of the view that the case is liable to be rejected, the committee may reject the same after recording reasons for the same. Intimation of sanction or rejection of the application shall be sent to the applicant.
**Step 03:** It is clarified that under all circumstances, an application for the grant of financial assistance under the scheme shall be disposed of within a period of one month from the date of receipt of the case from the District Social Security Officer.
**Step 04:** The disbursement of the benefit under the scheme shall be payable with effect from the month wherein the incident of acid attack occurred or the date of publication of this notification, whichever is later, and the same shall be made only through the victim's Bank Account.
> **Appeal:**

An applicant aggrieved of the decision of the District Level Committee may submit an appeal to the Director, Department of Social Security and Development of Women & Children, Punjab within 15 days of the decision, who shall dispose of the same within one month by passing an appropriate order.
