metadata.schemeName: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
metadata.briefDescription: PECFAR is a fellowship to facilitate a two-way exchange of young early-career Indian and German researchers through short visits for networking and exploring avenues for collaboration and innovation in applied research.

page_content:
# Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research

**Ministry:** Ministry Of Science And Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Science, IT & Communications | **Tags:** Fellowship, Applied Research, IGSTC, Indo-German, Fellow, Germany | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
Indo-German Science & Technology Centre (IGSTC) established a joint initiative of the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India and the Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF), Government of Germany invites applications for “Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research (PECFAR)” from early-career Indian and German researchers to explore, connect and network for research collaboration in applied research.   
> **Aim of the Fellowship: The Fellowship intends to-**


  - Support Early Career Researchers to network and explore possibilities to grow in applied research.
  - Enhance the research capabilities and opportunities in the partner country on various aspects of S&T, entrepreneurship, collaborative research, innovation & lab utilization.
  - Create impetus to expand bilateral collaboration & research among young researchers.
  - Build well-knitted long-term cooperation with complementary partnerships through networking & interaction.

> **Fellowship Details:**


  - This fellowship is designed to facilitate a pair of Early Career Researchers to have a short visit to India/Germany for networking and explore avenues for collaboration and innovation in applied research.
  - The pair will be formed by an Indian and a German Early Career Researcher who shall submit a joint proposal.
  - The paired fellows can jointly plan the fellowship visits to the partner country (India/Germany).
  - The fellows may also utilize this award to connect and travel to other institutions in India/Germany and enhance their networking.

> **Formation of a Pair:**


  - Applicants shall form a pair consisting of one Indian & German Early Career Researcher holding regular positions in academia/research institution/industry or holding long-term nationally recognized fellowships (4 years and above).
  - Applicants are solely responsible for identifying & forming their respective pairs and acquiring acceptance letters from institutes/organizations of the paired fellows.


  - PhD students/Post-Docs affiliated with research institutions/industries are also encouraged to form a Pair.

> **Duration of Fellowship:**


  - The duration of the fellowship will be up to 2 months.
  - Extension in the duration of the fellowship shall not be entertained.

## Benefits
The financial support shall be provided as a time grant and it will be limited to:

1. Fellowship: € 2300 per month/fellow on a pro-rata basis.
1. Single round trip economy class airfare including visa fees and medical/travel insurance approximately ₹ 1 lakh (for Indian fellow) and € 1500 (for German fellow).

**Note 01:** IGSTC grant is only for covering monthly fellowship, round trip fare, visa, and travel/medical insurance.
**Note 02:** A one-time grant will be provided to cover the travel, accommodation, and daily expenses.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. Early Career Researchers holding regular positions in academia/research institution/industry or holding long-term nationally recognized fellowships (4 years and above) will be eligible to apply.
   1. The applicant should possess the minimum qualification as “Masters in Science/Bachelor in Engineering (4 years)”.
   1. PhD Students/Post-docs affiliated with research institutions/industries may also apply.
   1. The upper age limit of the applicant should be 35 years.

**Note 01:** The applicant with institutional affiliation shall submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the Head of the Institution at the time of the application.
**Note 02:** Applicants must define a detailed activity plan mentioning their objective, work plan, and expected outcomes for the duration of the fellowship.
**Note 03:** The Pair must complete his/her visits within 12 months from the initiation of the PECFAR Award.
**Note 04:** The time gap between the visits of the two Awardees should be less than 6 months.
**Note 05:** Any change in the proposed date of travel should be intimated to IGSTC 45 days before the visit is planned.
**Note 06:** The fellows will abide by the conduct, rules, and regulations of the Paired organization & the country.
**Note 07:** IGSTC will not be responsible for violation of any Rules and regulations by him/her.
**Note 08:** Each of the Awardees of the Pair must submit UC/SE along with the Fellowship visit report in the prescribed format at the end of their visits.
**Note 09:** Within 4 weeks of completion of the Fellowship, the Awardees must submit a detailed consolidated Fellowship completion report endorsed by the host institutions in the prescribed format along with representative photos to IGSTC. The travel support for both the Awardees will be reimbursed after the Awardees complete both their visits.
**Note 10:** The fellows must recognize and acknowledge the IGSTC fellowship in all online/print documents, communications, reports, publications, etc. on work resulting from the fellowship.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
> **Application Process:**

**Step 01:** The applicant may submit the application for online via the “[Application Portal](https://indo-germansciencetechnologycentre.my.salesforce-sites.com/ApplicantDashboard?campaign=Landing_Page_Pecfar)”.
**Step 02:** To start the online application, the applicant must register on the portal first using your email address.
**Step 03:** Enter a correct working email address when the applicant registers in the portal, as it will send a link for verification.
**Step 04:** Registration can be done by any one of the members of the Pair. Please note that this should be initiated by only one member of the Pair. In case it is done by both the members the portal may block the email ID of the one who registers later.
**Step 05:** Once the registration is completed, the applicant can add his/her partner from India/Germany. The one who registers in the portal first (from the Pair) will be known as the Primary applicant. The Partner will receive a link for registration and filling up the information.
**Step 06:** In case you do not receive an email for verification, please check your ‘SPAM’ or ‘JUNK’ folder. If you still fail to find the email, please reach us at pecfar@igstc.org.
**Step 07:** Both fellows (from India & Germany) must individually complete their application and save it as a draft version. The final submission of the application will be done by the Primary applicant only.
**Step 08:** It is the responsibility of the Primary applicant to make sure that the application is completed by his/her partner before final submission.
**Note 01:** Applicants must strictly follow the instructions given for application submission. Failure to do so may result in the rejection of the application.
**Note 02:** The applications should be submitted via the “[Online Application Portal](https://indo-germansciencetechnologycentre.my.salesforce-sites.com/ApplicantDashboard?campaign=Landing_Page_Pecfar)”. Submissions by any other means will not be accepted.
> **Selection Procedure/Evaluation:**

A joint selection committee of experts shall review the applications based on the credentials of the pairs, feasibility, scope, and quality of the joint proposal plan for the fellowship duration, and expected outcomes (including future plans emerging out of the visit, value addition to the parent organization of the fellows). The decision of the committee shall be considered final and binding.
> **Contact:**

**For queries:**
Phone: + 91- 011 -2654 3500
E-mail: pecfar@igstc.org

metadata.schemeName: Junior Research Fellowship
metadata.briefDescription: The Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India provides fellowships for pursuing research in biotechnology and life-sciences through the "DBT-Junior Research Fellowship" (DBT-JRF) Programme.

page_content:
# Junior Research Fellowship **Ministry:** Ministry Of Science And Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Research Scientist, Lecturer, Professor | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) from the Department of Biotechnology (DBT) is a fellowship program that provides financial support to students who are pursuing doctoral research in biotechnology and life sciences. The JRF program is open to all Indian nationals who have a master's degree in biotechnology or a related field.
## Benefits > The fellowship amount for the JRF program is ₹31,000 per month for the first two years and ₹35,000 per month for the remaining three years. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. Applicant must be Indian citizen. 1. Applicant must have a master's degree in biotechnology or a related field from a recognized university 1. Applicant must clear the GAT or NET exam in biotechnology or a related field 1. Applicant should not be more then 28 years for general and EWS category candidates and 33 years for SC/ST/PH category candidates 1. Applicant must be willing to pursue full-time doctoral research in biotechnology or a related field at a recognized university or research institution in India. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1: Qualify in the Biotechnology Eligibility Test (BET)** 1. The BET is a national-level entrance exam conducted by the Department of Biotechnology (DBT) to select candidates for the DBT-JRF program. The BET exam is held once a year, typically in the month of June. 1. To apply for the BET exam, applicant must have a master's degree in biotechnology or a related field from a recognized university. Applicant must also have a valid GATE score or a NET score in biotechnology or a related field.
**Step 2: Apply for the DBT-JRF program online** 1. Once applicant have qualified in the BET exam, applicant can apply for the DBT-JRF program online. The online application process typically opens in the month of July and closes in the month of August. 1. To apply for the DBT-JRF program online, applicant will need to create an account on the DBT website and fill in the required details. applicant will also need to upload the required documents, such as applicant's BET exam scorecard, research proposal, and NOC from the current employer (if applicable).
**Step 3: Appear for the interview** 1. Candidates who are shortlisted for the DBT-JRF program will be called for an interview. The interview will be held at a designated venue and will be conducted by a panel of experts. 1. The interview will be based on applicant's research proposal and applicant's overall knowledge of biotechnology and life sciences. Applicant will also be asked questions about applicant's research interests and career goals.
**Step 4: Check the final selection list** 1. The final selection list for the DBT-JRF program is usually announced within a few weeks of the interview. Applicant can check the final selection list online on the DBT website.

metadata.schemeName: Free Travel Facility for State Medalists in International Level Sports Events
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free travel facilities in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses to state residents who have won medals at international level sports events and represented India.

page_content:
# Free Travel Facility for State Medalists in International Level Sports Events **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Free Travel Facility, State Medalist, International Level Sports Event, Free Transport, Free Bus Travel, Sportsperson | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched on 10th August, 2010, the scheme “Free Travel Facility for State Medalists in International Level Sports Events” by the Rajasthan State Transport Corporation under the Transport Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to encourage international sports excellence through providing free bus travel to eligible state medalist sportspersons.
## Benefits - **Free Travel Facility:** Eligible beneficiaries are provided free travel in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation(RSRTC ) buses. - **Coverage of Buses:** The benefit is applicable across all categories of RSRTC buses, excluding Super Luxury buses. - **Route Applicability:** The facility is valid only on routes where RSRTC buses are operational.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a native resident of Rajasthan. - The applicant should have won a medal at an international-level sports event. - The applicant should have represented India.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant should present the original proof of participation and medal in the international sports event. **Step 2:** The applicant should submit the documents at the Rajasthan State Transport Corporation headquarters, Jaipur. **Step 3:** Upon verification of documents, the competent authority issues an identity card or RFID card. **Step 4:** The applicant can thereafter avail free travel in eligible RSRTC buses using the issued card.
**Mode:** Online - **RSRTC Online RFID Registration Form:** [Click Here](https://rsrtcrfidsystem.co.in/OnlineApplication/MemberNewRegistration.aspx?Sid=1).

# West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Family Pension **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** West Bengal | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Social Security, Transport Worker, Monthly Assistance, Family Pension | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Family Pension” by the Labour Department, is aimed at ensuring financial support for the families of unorganized transport workers in the state. Beneficiaries, upon retirement or unfortunate demise, will have 50% of their last drawn amount transferred monthly to their families through a Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system.
## Benefits - **Monthly Family Pension:** 50% of the amount last drawn by the beneficiary.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age at the time of enrolment. 1. The applicant must be an unorganized worker employed in the operation of commercial vehicles, such as cars, taxis, luxury taxis, light commercial vehicles, vans, auto-rickshaws, tempos, lorries, trucks, or buses. 1. The applicant’s vehicle must be used for commercial purposes and not solely for personal or family use. > **Note:** A nominee/ dependent of a beneficiary shall be entitled for the benefits.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Visit the “[eDistrict 2.0](https://edistrict.wb.gov.in/portal/home)” portal. Click on Log In/Sign Up. **Step 2:** In the User Login window, scroll down to the bottom and click on “Register”. **Step 3:** Fill in all the details carefully, enter a username, and click on “Register”. **Step 4:** Upon entering the One Time Password received on your mobile, you will be successfully registered. **Step 5:** Now in the User Login window, enter your Username or email and captcha and click on “Sign In”. **Step 6:** Enter the received O.T.P and click on “Submit”. **Step 7:** Upon successful Login, You will be redirected to the “Dashboard”. From the right side menu apply for the concerned scheme.

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Coaching Yojana-SBC
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free coaching and residential facilities to Specially Backward Class (SBC) students of Rajasthan for various competitive examinations through reputed coaching institutes.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Nishulk Coaching Yojana-SBC **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Free Coaching, Specially Backward Class, SBC, Hostel Facility | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Mukhyamantri Nishulk Coaching Yojana-SBC” launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to support Specially Backward Class (SBC) students through free coaching, hostel accommodation for various entrance and professional exams.
## Benefits - **Residential Facility:** Selected students will be provided with hostel accommodation under the departmental hostels. - **Coaching Facility:** Free coaching will be arranged in reputed local coaching institutes. > **Notes:** - Students availing benefits under this scheme will not be eligible to receive benefits under any similar central or state government scheme. - If a student’s attendance is below 80%, their name will be removed from coaching, and the payment for that month will not be made to the coaching institution. In case of unavoidable circumstances, the department will consider the student’s application. - No coaching institute shall collect any type of fee from the selected students; payment will be made directly by the department. - Applicants availing the benefit of the scheme will not be eligible for the benefit of the "Anuprati Scheme" run by the department.
## Eligibility Criteria - Applicants must be natives of Rajasthan. - Applicants must belong to the Specially Backward Class(SBC) community. - SC applicants must have secured 60% marks in Class 10th. - SC applicants seeking admission to IITs and medical colleges must have secured 70% marks in Mathematics and Science in Class 10. - Undergraduate students must have secured 60% marks in the second and third year of graduation. If the results are not declared within the previous year, the results will be considered. - Applicants must be studying regularly in Class 11th and 12th for admission to national-level technical/medical/law courses. - Applicants must reside in the Social Justice and Empowerment Department's hostels in Jaipur and Kota. - Applicants must be pursuing regular undergraduate/postgraduate studies at a government or recognized private college for CAT/MAT coaching for admission to national-level management institutes and IIMs. - The annual income of the family (from all sources) should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-.
> **Notes:** - Coaching facility will be available to students for a maximum period of two years for the entrance examinations of engineering and medical courses and for only one year for the entrance examinations of law and management courses. - Coaching facility for postgraduate courses will be provided to the students till the final year of graduation or till the next year of passing the graduation examination. - Students admitted to the coaching institute can complete the course only within the period of the contract with the coaching institute. If the contract with any institute is for a period of 2 years, then admission can be taken in the 2-year course in the first year of the contract but admission cannot be taken in the 2-year course in the second year.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the official portal of Rajasthan Single Sign On: [https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/) **Step 2:** On the homepage, click on the "[Register here](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/register)" tab. **Step 3:** Select ‘Jan Aadhaar’ option for registration under the ‘Citizen’ tab. **Step 4:** Complete the registration process by entering your Jan Aadhaar Number. **Step 5:** After successful registration, you will receive a User ID (SSO ID) and Password. These credentials will allow you to check your application status and apply for scheme in the future. > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** To apply under the scheme, revisit the official portal of Rajasthan Single Sign On: [https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/) **Step 2:** On the homepage, click on the "[Login to RajSSO](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/signin)" tab. **Step 3:** Enter your username (SSO ID), password, and Captcha, then click ‘Login’. **Step 4:** Once logged in, update your profile. **Step 5:** Click on SJMS SMS icon, then click on "HSMS (Hostel & RREIS)" icon **Step 6:** Fill in the required information, and upload all necessary documents on the online portal. **Step 7:** After entering the information and uploading the documents, make sure to submit/save your application form.

metadata.briefDescription: The "Miscarriage Benefit'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides financial benefits for miscarriage up to two times in a lifetime to the eligible female beneficiaries or the wives of male beneficiaries.

page_content:
# Miscarriage Benefit **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** West Bengal | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child, Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Labour, Building Worker, Construction Worker, Miscarriage, Women | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Miscarriage Benefit'' scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, West Bengal, is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this scheme, the Board shall provide financial benefits for miscarriage to the female beneficiary or wife in case of a male beneficiary who is registered for 1 year under the Board, subject to maximum 2 times in his/her whole life time.
## Benefits - **Quantum of Assistance:** ₹6,000/-. **Note:** The benefit shall be allowed for two times in beneficiarie's whole life time.
## Eligibility Criteria > **For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:** - The applicant should be a resident of West Bengal. - The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker. - The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. - The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year. > **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:** - The applicant should be a registered female member or wife of a male member Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of West Bengal. - The applicant should have gone through a miscarriage. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline > **Registration Process as a Building/ Construction Worker:** **Step 1:** To register as a beneficiary under the BOCW Welfare Board, an applicant worker should request Form-27 from the Assistant Labour Commissioners/ Beneficiary Registering Officers and should attach all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 2:** Application shall be submitted to the Assistant Labour Commissioners/ Beneficiary Registering Officers. > **Application Process of the Welfare Scheme:** **Step 1:** A registered worker should request Form-XII for the application from the Assistant Labour Commissioners/ Beneficiary Registering Officers and should attach all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 2:** Application shall be submitted to the Assistant Labour Commissioners/ Beneficiary Registering Officers for this benefit. > **Helpdesk:** Labour Department Department of Labour, Government of West Bengal, 12th Floor, N.S Building, Block-A, 1, Kiran Shankar Roy Road, Kolkata-700001 Helpline of Labour Department, Govt. of West Bengal (Shramik Sathi): 1800-103-0009 > **Note:** - Upon successful verification, the construction worker is registered and an identity card and passbook are issued to him/ her. ₹20/- as the registration fee and ₹30/- as yearly subscription is taken. The amounts taken are noted in the passbook and a receipt is issued. - After one year, the beneficiary's subscription is renewed upon payment of a renewal fee of ₹30/- and submission of an application in Form-27A. - If not renewed the registration of the beneficiary is cancelled after the expiry of one year. Fresh application for renewal to be submitted to the ALC for consideration.

# Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Large Cardamom Driers (nos) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Commerce And Industry | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Business & Entrepreneurship, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Agriculture, Farming, Farmers, Large Cardamom | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement – Large Cardamom Driers (Nos.) is implemented by the Spices Board, India under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. The objective of the scheme is to encourage large cardamom farmers to adopt scientific curing methods using improved drying equipment, thereby enhancing the quality of large cardamom for domestic and export markets. The scheme is implemented in accordance with the guidelines and modalities approved by the Competent Authority under the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom during the 15th Finance Commission period (2021–22 to 2025–26).
## Benefits - 33.33 % of cost of unit, subject to a maximum of ₹16,000/- per unit for General Category and 75% subject to maximum of ₹28,000/- per unit for NE/SC/ST & Kalimpong and Darjeeling District of West Bengal & 90% Spice Producer's Groups in Identified Clusters subjected to maximum ₹43,000/- - Marginal Cardamom growers having 0.10 ha to 0.40 ha can avail for 200 kg capacity bhatti or single door sawo / equivalent drier Small growers having 0.4 ha to 8 ha can avail 400 kg capacity bhatti or double door sawo / equivalent drier. Quantum of assistance limited to the capacity eligible for the applicant as above.
## Eligibility Criteria 1.The scheme applies to Sikkim, Darjeeling & Kalimpong district of West Bengal & other NE States 2. Designated Officials will conduct final inspection and recommend the eligible cases.
## Exclusions

metadata.schemeName: Employees' Pension Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme ensures retirement security for employees covered under the Code on Social Security, 2020, offering monthly pensions, family pensions, and withdrawal benefits. It targets workers in organized sectors, providing financial support post-retirement, during disability, or to dependents…

page_content:
# Employees' Pension Scheme **Ministry:** Ministry Of Labour and Employment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Employment, Pension, Retirement, Senior Citizen, EPFO | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched on 29th of June 2026, the "Employees' Pension Scheme, 2026" substituting “Employees’ Pension Scheme, 1995” is a social security initiative by the Government of India, implemented under Code on Social Security, 2020. The scheme ensures financial security for employees post-retirement, disability, or to their families in case of death. Key benefits include superannuation pension, early pension, and family pension. Eligible employees must be members of the Employees' Provident Fund Scheme, 2026, and their pay should not exceed ₹15,000/- per month. The scheme is implemented by the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO). Applications for this scheme are accepted both online and offline through EPFO portals and regional offices.
## Benefits > **Financial Assistance** - **Superannuation Pension:** Payable to members who retire at 58 years with at least 10 years of eligible service. Calculated as (Pensionable Salary × Pensionable Service) / 70. Monthly pension shall be determined on a pro-rata basis for every wage ceiling period. - **Early Pension:** Reduced pension for members retiring between 50-58 years, with a 4% reduction per year below 58. Payable if the member has rendered eligible service of 10 years or more.- **Monthly Member's Pension:** Calculated as (Pensionable Salary × Pensionable Service) / 70. Provided that the members' monthly pension shall be determined on a pro-rata basis for the pensionable service up to the 1st day of September, 2014 at the maximum pensionable salary of Rs. 6,500 per month and for the period thereafter at the maximum pensionable salary of Rs.15,000 per month.- **Minimum Pension:** ₹1,000 per month, subject to deductions for commutation or early pension.- **Widow Pension:** 50% of the member's pension or ₹1,000/month, whichever is higher.- **Children Pension:** 25% of widow pension per child (max 2 children) till 25 years of age. In case of permanent and total disablement, monthly pension payable irrespective of age and number of children in family.- **Orphan Pension:** 75% of the widow pension if no surviving spouse (max 2 orphans) till 25 years of age. The pension shall continue if the beneficiary is suffering from mental disorder or physical disability. - **Permanent Total Disablement Pension:** Minimum ₹1,000/- per month if the member is permanently disabled during service.- **Nominee Pension:** Member who is unmarried or without a spouse or an eligible child may nominate a person and the person is entitled to monthly pension equal to widow pension or ₹1,000/month, whichever is higher.- **Dependent Parent Pension:** In absence of no nomination, monthly pension equal to widow pension or ₹1,000/month, whichever is higher payable to dependent father. Upon his death, payable to dependent mother for life. - **Withdrawal Benefit:** For members who exit before completing 10 years of service shall avail withdrawal benefit after 36 months from last of date contribution became due, calculated as per Table D. > **Disbursement Conditions** - Pension starts from the date following the member's retirement, disablement, or death. - Early pension is reduced by 4% for each year the age falls short of 58 years. - Deferred pension increases by 4% for each year beyond 58 years, up to 60 years. - Family pension ceases on widow's remarriage or death. > **Mode of Disbursement:** - Not limited to Post Office, Nationalized Banks, treasuries, scheduled banks RRBs or cooperative banks through electronic or digital fund transfer system.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a member of the Employees' Provident Fund Scheme, 2026, or an exempted establishment under Section 143 of Code on social security, 2020. - The applicant's pay must not exceed ₹15,000/month (unless contributing additional 1.16% above this limit). - The applicant must have a minimum of 10 years of eligible service for pension. - The applicant must have contributed to the Pension Fund. > **For Superannuation Pension** - The applicant must be 58 years or above in age. - The applicant must have rendered at least 10 years of eligible service. > **For Early Pension** - The applicant must have rendered at least 10 years of eligible service. - The applicant must opt for early pension between 50 and 58 years of age. > **For Family Pension** - The applicant must be the spouse or child of a deceased member who met the eligibility criteria. - The applicant must provide proof of the relationship and the member's death. - The deceased member must have contributed for at least one month. > **Post-Selection Conditions** - The applicant must submit the required documents for verification. - The applicant must comply with EPFO guidelines for pension disbursement. **NOTE:** International workers are eligible under specific social security agreements.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **For Registration** **Step 1: Activate UAN (Universal Account Number)** Visit the [EPFO Unified Portal](https://unifiedportal-emp.epfindia.gov.in/epfo/). Click "For Employees" > "Member UAN/Online Services (OCS/OTCP)". Enter UAN, mobile number, and CAPTCHA code. Click "Request OTP". Enter the OTP received on your registered mobile and click "Validate OTP". You will be redirected to the UAN activation page. **Step 2: Set Password & Complete KYC** Create a password (8-12 characters, including 1 uppercase, 1 number, and 1 special character). Under "Manage", select "KYC" and upload documents (Aadhaar, PAN, bank details). KYC status will show as "Approved" after verification (takes 3-5 working days). > **For Application** **Step 1: Login to the EPFO Portal** Go to [EPFO Unified Portal](https://unifiedportal-emp.epfindia.gov.in/epfo/). Click "Employee Login" > Enter UAN, password, and CAPTCHA. Click "Sign In" after that proceed to enter the OTP sent to your registered mobile. Click Submit". You will land on the member dashboard. **Step 2: Navigate to Pension Claim** Under "Online Services", select "Form 10D". The pension application form will open. Fill in all the mandatory fields. Click "Save & Preview" to review entries. **Step 3: Upload Documents** Upload scanned copies (PDF/JPEG/PNG, max 2MB each). Click "Submit" to proceed to OTP verification. **Step 4: OTP Verification & Final Submission** Enter the OTP sent to your Aadhaar linked mobile and email. Click "Validate OTP & Submit". A success message with an acknowledgement number will appear. Save the acknowledgement number and screenshot of submission confirmation for future reference. > **Application Status Tracking** **Method 1:** EPFO Portal > "Track Claim Status" (using UAN + acknowledgement number). **Method 2:** EPFO Unified Portal > “Online Services” > “Track Claim Status” > **Help & Support / Grievance Redressal** **EPFO Helpdesk Number:** 14470 **Email:** rpfc.epfigms@epfindia.gov.in. **Online Grievance Portal:** [EPFiGMS](https://epfigms.gov.in/) (or visit the nearest office for grievances).

page_content:
# Free Travel Facility for Person Suffering from Various Diseases **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Free Travel Facility, Free Transport, Persons With Disabilities, Disease, Differently Abled | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched on 7th May, 2021, the scheme “Free Travel Facility for Person Suffering from Various Diseases” by the Rajasthan State Transport Corporation under the Transport Department, Government of Rajasthan aims to support persons suffering from Haemophilia, Asnkramak Leprosy, Autism Disease, Multliple Sclerosis Disease, Chronic Neurological Conditions, Perkins Disease, Multiple Disablities (Deaf/Blind), Acid Attack Victim, Thalassemia, Muscular Dystrophy and Sickle Cell Disease through providing free bus travel to eligible beneficiaries within operational RSRTC routes.
## Benefits - **Free Travel Facility:** Eligible beneficiaries are provided free travel in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation(RSRTC ) buses. - **Coverage of Buses:** The benefit is applicable to ordinary and express category RSRTC bus services. - **Route Applicability:** The facility is available only on routes where RSRTC buses are operational.

## Eligibility Criteria - Applicant must be a native resident of Rajasthan. - Applicant should not be an income tax payer. - Applicant must have Certificate (with 40%) issued from authorized subject specialist for Haemophilia Patient, Asnkramak Leprosy, Autism Disease , Mutliple Sclerosis Disease, Chronic Neurological Conditions, Perkins Disease, Multiple Disabilities (Deaf/Blind), Acid Attack Victim, Thalassemia, Muscular Dystrophy, and Sickle Cell Disease.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - **RSRTC Online RFID Registration Form:** [Click Here](https://rsrtcrfidsystem.co.in/OnlineApplication/MemberNewRegistration.aspx?Sid=1).
**Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant should obtain a medical certificate from an authorized medical board constituted by the Government of Rajasthan. **Step 2:** The applicant should collect all required documents for verification. **Step 3:** The applicant should apply for the issuance of an RSRTC RFID card at the designated center. **Step 4:** After successful verification, the RFID card is issued and used to avail free travel in eligible RSRTC buses.

metadata.schemeName: West Bengal Freeship Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The West Bengal Freeship Scheme (WBFS)has been launched by the Department of Higher Education,  Government of West Bengal. This freeship would be provided as a tuition fee waiver for the under Graduate students level in Engineering & Technology/ Pharmacy/ Architecture.

page_content:
# West Bengal Freeship Scheme

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** West Bengal | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Tuition Fee Waiver, Freeship, Financial Support, Engineering & Technology, Pharmacy, Architecture | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The West Bengal Freeship Scheme (WBFS) has been introduced from the year 2011 by the Department of Higher Education, Government of West Bengal. WBFS is for the under Graduate students level in Engineering & Technology/ Pharmacy/ Architecture programmes conducted by the self financing private Engineering and Technical Institutions of the State. The waiver is limited to the tuition fee for all the institutions concerned. All other fees except tuition fees will have to be borne by the beneficiary.

## Benefits
Benefits: Waiver for tuition fee.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. Candidate must be domicile of the West Bengal.
1. Merit rank in State Level/NationaI Level Entrance Examination.
1. Annual family income of the candidate must not be more than ₹ 2,50,000 /-.

## Exclusions
1. Candidates selected under Tuition Free Waiver (TFW) Scheme of All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) or West Bengal Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship Scheme will not be eligible under this WBFS.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
> **Registration Process:**


   1. Visit West Bengal [Freeship Scheme portal](https://wbfs.wb.gov.in/index.php).   1. Click on **“How to Apply”** on menu bar.   1. Read the instructions carefully, after that click on the checkbox to agree terms and then "**Proceed for Registration"**.   1. After proceed, the Registration form will be opened. Fill up the registration formand click on **“Submit”** button.   1. Now set and confirm a password after filling all the details very carefully.
   1. On clicking the "**Submit Registration"** button OTP will be sent to the given mobile number for authentication. After successful OTP verification the WBFS registration process will be completed.   1. After successful registration, an Applicant Id will be generated and the same will be sent to the registered email id.

> **Post-Registration Process:**


   1. Visit West Bengal [Freeship Scheme portal](https://wbfs.wb.gov.in/index.php).   1. Now at home page **Applicant Login** section, enter the **Applicant Id**, **Password**(Which was set during registration process), **Security Code** and then click on the "**Login"** button.   1. After successful login, Dashboard of the concerned applicant will be appeared. Click on "**Edit Profile"** or "**Edit Application"** to continue the application process.   1. First fill up the Basic Details form and then click on "**Save & Continue"** button. Star (*) marked fields are mandatory fields.   1. Now, Personal Details form will appear after successful submission of **Basic Details**. Fill up the form and then click on "**Save & Continue"** button.   1. After successful submission of Personal Details form, Scanned **Supporting Documents** form will be appeared. Upload all the necessary documents as required and then click on "**Submit Profile"** button. While uploading the documents, please maintain the File Format and File Size as instructed in the form.   1. After successful submission of the Application, a success message regarding the submission will be displayed. Applicants may download the Application details by clicking on the "**Download Profile"** button.   1. Click on "**Final Submit"** Application button to complete the application Process.   1. To view the Profile/Application, click on "**View Profile"** option in Dashboard or click on **"View Application"** option under Application Details tab in Menu area.

  - **Note: After final submission there is no option to modify the online application form.**
  - **User Manual:** [**Click here**](https://wbfs.wb.gov.in/readwrite/operations_manual_wbfs.pdf)**.**

page_content:
# Concessional Travel Facility for Home Guard Personnel **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Free Travel, Free Bus Travel, Transport, Home Guard | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Concessional Travel Facility for Home Guard Personnel” by the Rajasthan State Transport Corporation under the Transport Department, Government of Rajasthan aims to support serving Home Guards through providing 25% fare concession on eligible RSRTC bus services within the state.
## Benefits - **Free Travel Facility:** Eligible beneficiaries are provided 25% concession on passenger fare. - **Coverage of Buses:** The concession is applicable on ordinary and express category RSRTC buses. - **Route Applicability:** The concession is valid for travel within the state boundary of Rajasthan only. > **Note:** - **Issuance Fee:** RFID cards will be issued to active Home Guard volunteers at a prescribed fee of ₹40/- per card. - **Scope of Concession:** The 25% discount applies to the applicable fare for travel within the Rajasthan state borders in Ordinary and Express buses. - **No Double Benefit:** Volunteers already receiving free or other discounted travel facilities are not eligible for this concession. Only one type of discount can be used. - **Exclusions:** The discount applies only to the passenger fare. Additional charges such as accident compensation surcharges, human resource surcharges, toll taxes, IT fees, and other taxes must be paid in full.
## Eligibility Criteria - Applicant should be a native resident of Rajasthan state. - Applicant should be a serving member of Homegaurds. > **Note:** - **Identification:** While traveling, volunteers must carry their official photo ID issued by the Home Guard Department. Failure to produce this ID will result in being charged the full standard fare. - **Validity:** The validity and renewal of the RFID card will align with the validity of the Home Guard Department's ID card. If a cardholder ceases to be a Home Guard volunteer for any reason, the facility will be withdrawn.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - **RSRTC Online RFID Registration Form:** [Click Here](https://rsrtcrfidsystem.co.in/OnlineApplication/MemberNewRegistration.aspx?Sid=1).
**Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant should apply for the issuance of an RFID card at the designated RFID card center. **Step 2:** The applicant should submit the required documents at the RFID card center for verification. **Step 3:** After verification, the RFID card is issued and can be used to avail concessional travel in RSRTC buses.

page_content:
# Agri-Clinic and Agribusiness Centers Scheme (ACABC) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Agriculture Infrastructure, Agribusiness, Agri-Clinic, Agriculture Entrepreneurship, Self Employment, Agriculture Training, Credit Linked Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Agri-Clinic and Agribusiness Centers Scheme (ACABC)” implemented by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India, in association with NABARD and MANAGE, aims to support agriculture development through providing training, credit-linked subsidy, and entrepreneurship opportunities to agriculture professionals. The scheme promotes establishment of Agri-Clinics and Agri-Business Centres for providing expert advisory and agriculture-related services to farmers. It supplements public extension services and encourages use of trained professionals in the agriculture sector. Eligible candidates receive free residential training, handholding support, loan assistance, and subsidy benefits for setting up agriculture ventures. The scheme also promotes better farming methods, farm equipment services, input supply, and allied agricultural activities.
## Benefits - **Free Residential Training:** The beneficiaries receive 45 days free residential training in collaboration with Nodal Training Institutes (NTIs). - **Handholding Support:** The beneficiaries receive support for availing loan and subsidy for up to 1 year. - **Loan Assistance:** Loan assistance up to ₹20,00,000/- is available for individual projects and up to ₹1,00,00,000/- for group projects consisting of 5 individuals. - **Collateral Free Loan:** No collateral security is required for loans up to ₹5,00,000/-. - **Flexible Repayment Period:** The repayment period for the loan ranges from 3 years to 10 years. - **Subsidy Benefit:** General category beneficiaries receive 36% subsidy, while women, SC/ST, North Eastern, and Hill State beneficiaries receive 44% subsidy on the eligible project cost. - **Credit Linked Subsidy:** The scheme provides credit-linked, composite, and back-ended subsidy with a lock-in period of 3 years.
## Eligibility Criteria - **Age:** 18 to 60 years. - Education: 1. Graduation and above level in Agriculture and allied subjects, Biological sciences such as Environmental science, Botany, Zoology and chemistry as recognized by UGC, ICAR/SAUs, and other organizations approved by MoA&FW, GoI. 1. Diploma courses with more than 60 % content related to Agriculture and allied subjects. 1. Intermediate course in Agriculture and allied subjects with at lease 55% marks.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - **Online Application Form for Training:** [Click here](https://acabcmis.gov.in/ApplicantReg.aspx).

metadata.briefDescription: The AgriSURE Fund supports agri-startups and rural enterprises with funding and resources so they can develop innovative farming and rural solutions, improving livelihoods and strengthening the agricultural sector.

page_content:
# AgriSURE – Agri Fund for Startups & Rural Enterprises **Ministry:** Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Agricultural, Farming, Startups, Employment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The AgriSURE – Agri Fund for Startups & Rural Enterprises, under the Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India, supports agri-startups and rural enterprises through funding and other resources to develop innovative solutions for agriculture and rural development, improve livelihoods, and strengthen the agricultural sector. **OBJECTIVES** • With a focus on technology-driven, high-risk, high-impact ventures, AgriSURE is designed to fuel growth and foster innovation in the agricultural and rural startup ecosystem. A blended capital fund of ₹750 crore with SEBI-registered Category II, Alternative Investment Fund (AIF), contributions from the Government of India is ₹250 crore, NABARD is ₹250 crore, and ₹250 crore is being mobilized from banks, insurance companies, and private investors. • Aims to support innovative, technology-driven, high-impact startups in agriculture and allied sectors, improve the farm produce value chain, including support for FPOs/FPCs, farm mechanisation, IT-based solutions and rural enterprises, attract more investment into the agri and rural startup ecosystem through AIFs and direct investments, and create employment opportunities and encourage youth entrepreneurship in agriculture.

## Benefits • Investment through two routes: Fund of Funds Scheme with ₹450 crore corpus and Direct Scheme with ₹300 crore corpus. • Supports around 85 startups, with ticket size up to ₹25 crore, subject to investment merit and fund guidelines. • Provides grant-in-aid, incubation and mentoring support to eligible agri startups.
## Eligibility Criteria • Startups working in agriculture and rural development sectors. • SEBI-registered Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs), sector-specific, sector-agnostic and debt AIFs that invest in agri/rural startups

## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > Eligible startups or AIFs can approach NABVENTURES. [https://nabventures.in/agrisure.aspx](https://nabventures.in/agrisure.aspx)

metadata.schemeName: LEAP Fund – Launching Entrepreneurial Driven Affordable Products
metadata.briefDescription: The LEAP Fund supports entrepreneurs in creating affordable, innovative products so more people can access useful technologies while encouraging business growth.

page_content:
# LEAP Fund – Launching Entrepreneurial Driven Affordable Products **Ministry:** Ministry Of Science And Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Science, IT & Communications | **Tags:** LEAP Fund, Technologies, Startups In Biotech, Businesses | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The LEAP Fund (Launching Entrepreneurial Driven Affordable Products), under the Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India, supports entrepreneurs and potential biotech startups in piloting and commercialising innovative and affordable products and technologies. The fund aims to make useful technologies more accessible to people while promoting business growth and helping startups strengthen their potential to attract venture capital investment.
## Benefits • Funding support of more than ₹30 lakh and up to ₹1 crore per startup. Startups eligible and suitable for up to the threshold of ₹30 lakh investment support will be considered under the SEED fund and not the LEAP fund. • BioNEST Bioincubators (LEAP fund partners) will be given up to ₹5 crore fund/ partner for investing in potential startups against equity and equity-linked instruments.
## Eligibility Criteria **The LEAP fund committee shall consider the proposals of eligible Incubators for the implementation of the LEAP Fund. The eligibility parameters include the following:** i. Incubator should have been supported through BIRAC’s Bio-NEST programme. ii. Incubator should be BIRAC’s SEED fund partner. iii. Incubator should be Operational since last 05 years, with at least 5 resident startups in Biotech/med-tech/life science. iv. Incubator should have in-house capacity in incubating & mentoring early stage Biotech / Life Science start up. v. Incubator should have established IP&TT facilitation services for startups. vi. Incubator must have prior experience of 04 years in management of early stage funding schemes or other grants. vii. Incubator should have investment in start-ups and/or entrepreneurship development experience.

## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online Step 1: Visit the official BIRAC [website.](https://birac.nic.in/leapFundNew.php) Step 2: Click on “[Login](https://birac.nic.in/login.php)/[Register”](https://birac.nic.in/birac_registration_page.php) on the website. Step 3: If you are a new user, select “New User? Click Here to Register” and enter the required details. Step 4: Complete the registration and activate your account through the verification email received from BIRAC. Step 5: After activation, log in using your registered username and password. Step 6: Check the LEAP Fund section and identify the relevant BioNEST incubator through which the funding is offered. Step 7: Contact/approach the eligible LEAP Fund partner incubator and follow its application process. Step 8: Submit the required startup details, documents, and proposal as instructed by the incubator/BIRAC. Step 9: After submission, the proposal will be evaluated as per the applicable LEAP Fund guidelines.

metadata.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Education to the Wards of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM Workers – Pre & Post-Matric
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to fund the pre-matric and post-matric education of wards belonging to specific mine, beedi, and cine workers. It provides annual scholarships between ₹1,000/- and ₹25,000/- based on the student's academic level and course type.

page_content:
# Financial Assistance for Education to the Wards of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM Workers – Pre & Post-Matric **Ministry:** Ministry Of Labour and Employment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Direct Benefit Transfer, Education, Financial Assistance, Scholarship, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Financial Assistance for Education to the Wards of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM Workers – Pre & Post-Matric" was launched by the Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India. The scheme aims to provide educational scholarships to the children of Beedi, Iron Ore, Manganese & Chrome Ore, Limestone, Dolomite, Mica, and Cine workers. The scheme provides annual financial assistance ranging from ₹1,000/- to ₹25,000/- directly to the beneficiaries via Direct Benefit Transfer. The applicant must be studying in a recognized institution and meet the stipulated parental occupation and income thresholds. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the National Scholarship Portal.
## Benefits > **Financial Assistance Rates:** - Class I to IV (for the purchase of dress/books, etc.): ₹1,000/- per annum. - Class V to VIII: ₹1,500/- per annum. - Class IX: ₹2,000/- per annum. - Class X: ₹2,000/- per annum. - Class XI to XII: ₹3,000/- per annum. - ITI: ₹6,000/- per annum. - Polytechnic: ₹6,000/- per annum. - Degree Courses : ₹6,000/- per annum. - Professional Courses: ₹25,000/- per annum. > **Mode of Disbursement:** - The benefits under the scheme are transferred through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system.

## Eligibility Criteria 1. Either of the parents of the students should be Beedi, Iron Ore Manganese & Chrome Ore Mines, Limestone & Dolomite Mines, Cine worker with at least six months service. This also includes Contract/Gharkhata (Home Based) workers also. 1. Total monthly Income of the Worker's family from all sources should not exceed as under: - Beedi Workers: ₹10,000/- - Mine Workers: a) The Mine workers doing manual, unskilled, highly skilled and clerical work are eligible for availing all facilities under different welfare schemes of Labour Welfare Organization irrespective of the wages paid to them. b) The persons employed in supervisory and managerial capacity are eligible for availing the facilities under different welfare schemes subject to the wage limit of ₹10,000/- per month. facilities under different welfare schemes of Labour Welfare Organization irrespective of the wages paid to them. c) Cine workers - "An amount not exceeding ₹8,000/- per month where such amount is paid monthly or an amount not exceeding ₹1,00,000/- where it is paid by way of lump sum or instalments; as remuneration of a cine worker for the purpose of this Act. 1. The Applicant must have passed the last qualifying examination in first attempt. However, Students promoted to the next class are also eligible to apply for the above scholarships. 1. Candidates for the award of scholarships should have taken regular admission for studies at recognized institutions in India in any course of general or technical education, including medical, engineering and agricultural studies. 1. The Educational Institute must be Government/Government Recognized Institute. 1. students receiving financial aid from other scholarships or stipends (one merit based scheme and welfare based schemes, subject to his/her eligibility for the scheme) are eligible to apply from AY 2026– 27, as per scheme eligibility criteria under the Labour Welfare Scheme (Education). 1. There is no need to provide bank account details for DBT payments. The scholarship amount will be disbursed through the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). Therefore, it is mandatory that the Aadhaar number is linked to only one bank account for DBT related payments. “Bharat Aadhaar Seeding Enabler (BASE) ” can be done in NPCI portal. (Further instructions as per NSP/NPCI guidelines time to time).

## Exclusions **The scholarship sanctioned is liable to be cancelled on the following occasions** 1. If the scholar is found to have obtained a scholarship by false statements. 1. If the scholarship discontinues his/her studies, the scholarship shall be stopped from the date of such discontinuance. 1. If the scholar changes the subject of the course of study for which the scholarship was originally awarded or changes the Institution of study without the prior approval of the Welfare Commissioner. 1. If the parent(s) of the scholar ceases to be a Beedi/Mine/Cine worker. **The following category of students is not eligible for the award of scholarships under the scheme** 1. Students who, after passing one stage of education, are studying in the same stage of education in a different subject. e.g. B.Sc. after B.Com. or B.Com. after B.A. or M.A. in one subject after M.A. in another subject. 1. Students who after having completed their educational career in one professional line, continue education in a different professional line, e.g. L.L.B. after B.T. or B.Ed. 1. The Scholars pursuing studies through Correspondence are not eligible.

## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **New Registration** **Step 1:** Visit the [New Registration](https://scholarships.gov.in/home) page of the [National Scholarships Portal](https://scholarships.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Guidelines for Registration will appear. Scroll to the bottom. Read the undertaking carefully and Accept the Terms. Click “Next”. **Step 3:** In the next window, enter your mobile number and OTP. Then click “Verify”. After successful verification, continue with e-KYC process (as applicable). **Step 4:** Once completed, your reference number will be generated and the same will be sent to your registered phone number. > **OTR ID Number Generation** **Step 1:** Download and install these apps from the Google Play Store - - [AadhaarFaceRD services](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.gov.uidai.facerd&pli=1) - [NSP OTR App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.gov.scholarships.nspotr&pli=1) **Step 2:** After opening the mobile app, select the option “eKYC with FaceAuth” highlighted in red. **Step 3:** Enter the allotted reference number and click on “Send OTP” to receive OTP on your Mobile Number. Enter the OTP and captcha in the screen and click "Next". **Step 4:** Click on “Proceed for Face Authentication” button highlighted in red. On Successful completion of face-authentication OTR Number will be generated and will also be sent on your registered mobile no. > **Fresh Application** **Step 1:** Visit the applicant Login page of the National Scholarships Portal. Enter your OTR Number and password. Type the Captcha and click “Login”. **Step 2:** On the next screen, provide the OTP received on your registered mobile number. You will be directed to the Password Reset screen. Create a new password and confirm. Click “Submit”. You will be directed to the “Applicant’s Dashboard”. **Step 3:** On the left pane, click “Application Form”. The fields marked as * are compulsory. Fill in the details and upload the documents. **Step 4:** You can either click on “Save as Draft” to complete the application later. Else, click “Final Submit” to submit the application. > **Track Payment Status** > The student can track their payment status from the template “Know Your Payment” in the [PFMS Portal](https://pfms.nic.in/SitePages/Users/LoginDetails/Login.aspx), either by indicating their Aadhaar Number, Bank Account number or NSP Application ID. > **NOTE:** - The National Scholarships Portal will provide the timelines for opening & closing of the portal. - Online applications will be verified at two levels i.e. by the Institute, where the student is studying and thereafter by the concerned State Higher Education Department or any other Agency/ Official nominated by the State as State Nodal Agency (both for fresh and renewal applicants). - Students will not be permanently debarred for scholarships due to delay in renewal or verification. However, students will have to submit renewal applications within a cut-off date. Renewal for that year will not be allowed if an applicant misses this deadline. - Students are advised to follow the instructions given on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) time to time. - Application Process for students may kindly be seen at the link given below:-[https://scholarships.gov.in/studentFAQs](https://scholarships.gov.in/studentFAQs)- Student FAQ PDF on NSP Portal :- [https://scholarships.gov.in/public/FAQ/NSP_FAQsORApplicationUsermanul_ V2.2.pdf](https://scholarships.gov.in/public/FAQ/NSP_FAQsORApplicationUsermanul_V2.2.pdf)- How to the OTR (One time Registration) by the Students :- [https://scholarships.gov.in/public/FAQ/OTR%20FAQ%20v1.4.pdf](https://scholarships.gov.in/public/FAQ/OTR%20FAQ%20v1.4.pdf) - The standard Operating Procedure to submit application details by the students may be seen at the student Section of the NSP website as detailed below on can click the link :- [https://scholarships.gov.in/public/FAQ/NSP_SOP.pdf](https://scholarships.gov.in/public/FAQ/NSP_SOP.pdf)

metadata.schemeName: Free Travel Facility for Hearing Impaired Persons
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free travel facility in ordinary, express, and night bus services operated by the Rajasthan State Transport Corporation to hearing impaired persons residing in Rajasthan.

page_content:
# Free Travel Facility for Hearing Impaired Persons **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Free Travel Facility, Hearing Impaired Persons, Differently Abled, Specially Abled, Person With Disabilities | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Free Travel Facility for Hearing Impaired Persons" by the Rajasthan State Transport Corporation under the Transport Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to facilitate mobility by providing free travel in ordinary, express, and night bus services to hearing impaired residents of Rajasthan.
## Benefits - **Free Travel Facility:** Eligible beneficiaries are provided free travel in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation(RSRTC ) buses. - **Coverage of Buses:** The facility is applicable on ordinary, express, and night bus services. - **Route Applicability:** Free travel is allowed up to the routes where Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses are operational.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan. - The applicant should not be an income tax payer. - The applicant should be a hearing-impaired person certified by an authorized subject specialist.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - **RSRTC Online RFID Registration Form:** [Click Here](https://rsrtcrfidsystem.co.in/OnlineApplication/MemberNewRegistration.aspx?Sid=1).
**Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant should apply for issuance of an RFID Card by submitting the prescribed documents. **Step 2:** The applicant is required to submit one passport-size photograph along with the application. **Step 3:** The application is to be submitted at the office of the Chief Manager of the Rajasthan State Transport Corporation.

# Spice Development Program (Minikit) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Madhya Pradesh | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Spice Development, Minikit Distribution, Horticulture | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Spice Development Program (Minikit)” launched by the Horticulture and Food Processing Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to promote spice cultivation through the distribution of minikits of ginger, turmeric, garlic, coriander, and chilli to farmers across all districts.

## Benefits - **Distribution of Spice Minikits:** Minikits of major spices such as ginger, turmeric, garlic, coriander, and chilli are distributed in all districts of Madhya Pradesh.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - The applicant should contact the District Office of the Horticulture Department.

metadata.schemeName: E-Bhugtan Protsahan Yojna
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote e-trading and e-payment in agricultural marketing by providing cash incentives and financial benefits to farmers and traders for transactions through the e-platform (e-NAM).

page_content:
# E-Bhugtan Protsahan Yojna **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** E-Payment Incentive, E-Trading Promotion, Agriculture, Farmer, Incentive, Cash Rewards | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched on 21st February, 2018, the scheme "E-Bhugtan Protsahan Yojna" by the Agriculture Marketing Department under the Agriculture Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to encourage e-auction and e-payment through providing cash rewards and fee benefits to farmers and traders using the e-NAM platform. It also ensures that farmers receive the rightful official benefit of their agricultural produce through transparent digital payments.
## Benefits > **Cash Rewards:** The scheme provides cash rewards to farmers and traders at the following levels: - State Level - Division Level - Mandi Level > **Transfer of Mandi Fee Share to Farmers:** - After sale through the e-platform, based on the issued e-sale slip (e-parchi) 25% of the assessed mandi fee is transferred to the farmer. > **Reimbursement of Charges to Traders:** - Traders making e-payments are eligible for: - 100% reimbursement of bank and agency charges and fees.
The reimbursement is provided by the concerned Mandi Committee.
## Eligibility Criteria > **For Farmers:** - The applicant should be a farmer who has completed an e-auction through the e-NAM project. - The applicant should have received payment through e-payment mode after the auction. > **For Traders:** - The applicant should be a licensed trader participating through the e-platform. - The applicant should have conducted e-auction and issued an e-sale slip (e-vikray parchi). - The applicant should have made payment to farmers through e-payment. - The applicant should ensure that at least 25% of total sale slips and payments are processed through the e-platform. > **For Mandi Level Awards:** - The applicant mandi should qualify only if at least 25% of total agricultural produce sales are done through e-auction and e-payment. - For State Level Awards - The applicant division/block should qualify only if licensed traders under subordinate mandi committees make at least 25% of farmer payments through the e-NAM platform.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant should register on the e-NAM platform. **Step 2:** The applicant should conduct agricultural produce sale through e-auction. **Step 3:** The applicant should complete payment through e-payment mode. **Step 4:** The concerned Mandi Committee verifies transactions and eligibility. **Step 5:** Incentives, rewards, and reimbursements are released to eligible beneficiaries.

metadata.schemeName: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Scholarship For Higher Education (SHE)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)" aims to attract students to study basic and natural Science subjects at undergraduate and postgraduate levels and pursue research as a career by providing scholarships to interested and deserving students.

page_content:
# Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Scholarship For Higher Education (SHE) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Science And Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Education, Scholarship, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)" is a component of the “Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research (INSPIRE)”, which is a flagship programme of the Department of Science and Technology (DST), under the Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India. The scheme aims to attract students to study basic and natural Science subjects at undergraduate and postgraduate levels and pursue research as a career by providing scholarships to interested and deserving students. Under the SHE component, 12,000 scholarships (From the SHE-2017 batch onwards), each valued at ₹ 80,000/- are announced annually to students pursuing Bachelor and Masters level courses in Basic and Natural Science areas.
> **Tenure** 1. Selected candidates will be supported for a maximum period of five years, starting from the 1st year B.Sc., B.S., Int. M.Sc./Int.M.S. or until the completion of the course, whichever is earlier. 1. Continuation of the scholarship for the selected candidates is based on good academic performance in the examinations conducted by the University and upon the recommendation by the Head of the Institution.
The following subjects under Basic and Natural Sciences are within the scope of INSPIRE Scholarship for pursuing B.Sc./B.S./Int. M.Sc./Int. M.S. courses: (1) Physics (2) Chemistry (3) Mathematics (4) Biology (5) Statistics (6) Geology (7) Astrophysics (8) Astronomy (9) Electronics (10) Botany (11) Zoology (12) Biochemistry (13) Anthropology (14) Microbiology (15) Geophysics (16) Geochemistry (17) Atmospheric Sciences & (18) Oceanic Sciences. Courses other than these subjects such as Engineering, Medicine, Military Science, Defence Studies, Agriculture, Psychology, Seed Technology, Home Science, Geography, Economics, Education (including B.Sc.-B.Ed. dual degree course), Biotechnology, Computer Science, Computer Applications, Bioinformatics, Instrumentation, Information Technology, Physical Education, courses in Distance Education mode at Open Universities and other professional courses etc. are NOT supported.
## Benefits 1. The scholarship is valued at ₹ 80,000/- per annum. 1. Each candidate will receive an annual scholarship @ ₹ 5000/- per month with a total value of ₹ 60,000/-. 1. All the SHE scholars are required to undertake summer research projects under an active researcher in any recognized research centre across India. 1. A summertime Mentorship grant of ₹ 20,000/- will be paid every year. 1. The scholarship will be transferred to the scholar’s State Bank of India (SBI) bank account directly through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. ## Eligibility Criteria (a) Meritorious Students with aggregate marks within the top 1% of their Class XII examination of any State/ Central Education Board in India are eligible. In addition, the student must be pursuing courses in Natural and Basic Sciences at the B.Sc., B.S., and Int.M.Sc./M.S. level. **OR** (b) Those students who have secured ranks in the JEE of IIT, AIPMT (within the top 10000 ranks), and are presently pursuing Natural and Basic Science courses in India at the B.Sc., B.S., Int. M.Sc./M.S. level. **OR** (c) Students with aggregate marks within the top 1% of their Class XII examination of any State/ Central Education Board in India and pursuing Integrated M.S. courses in Natural and Basic Sciences at IISERs, NISER and Department of Atomic Energy Centre for the Basic SciencesUniversity of Mumbai and Visva-Bharati, Shanti Niketan. **OR** (d) Students who have been selected under Kishore Vaigyanik Protsahan Yojana (KVPY) and pursuing Bachelor/Master level courses in Natural Sciences. **OR** (e) National Talent Search Examination (NTSE) scholars, Jagadish Bose National Science Talent Search (JBNSTS) scholars and International Olympiad medallists pursuing Bachelor/ Master level courses in Natural Sciences are also eligible. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** https://www.online-inspire.gov.in/ > **Call for Applications** The call for applications will be advertised on the [INSPIRE Web Portal](https://www.online-inspire.gov.in).
> **Application Process** **Step 1:** Log in to the portal by entering the registered email id as user name and the registered password. If you are already logged in, go to Step 2. **Step 2:** Upon logging in, a screen will appear where you have to click the ‘Scholarship’ link. **Step 3:** Click the Related Link icon in the right-hand corner. To view and print the Offer Letter, please click the ‘View Offer Letter’ link. Please read the Offer Letter carefully before going to Step 4. **Step 4:** Fill in the State Bank of India Account details carefully in the respective fields. Upload a scanned copy of the first page of the SBI passbook containing the account number and name. **Step 5:** Press Submit button. After the successful submission of bank details, a pop-up message will appear stating that ‘Your bank details updated successfully’. **Step 6:** Go to the Related Link icon. Click the ‘Documents for BSc/MSc’ icon. **Step 7:** Upload your documents one by one by selecting ‘Documents for the year’, ‘Mark Sheets’ and ‘Performance Report’. **Step 8:** Press Submit button. You will be notified if your documents are incomplete or need further clarification’. **Step 9:** Press the Logout button.

As the Department receives a large number of applications, the selection process on average takes at least four months from the last date of submission of the application. 1. Provisionally selected students are required to log into the online portal to download the offer letter. 1. A list of selected and rejected students will also be displayed on the home page of INSPIRE Web Portal.

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Yuva Sambal Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide unemployment allowance and enhance employability by linking graduates with skill training and internships. It also ensures financial support to eligible unemployed youth until they secure employment or self-employment.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Yuva Sambal Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Skills & Employment, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Unemployment Allowance, Youth, Financial Assistance, Employment Exchange, Monthly Allowance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched on 1st January, 2022, the scheme "Mukhyamantri Yuva Sambal Yojana" by the Directorate of Employment, Department of Skill, Employment & Entrepreneurship, Government of Rajasthan, aims to support unemployed graduates through providing monthly allowance, skill training, and internship opportunities to eligible youth.
## Benefits - Unemployment Allowance: ₹4,000 per month for male applicants; ₹4,500 per month for women, Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), transgender, and specially-abled applicants. - Skill Training And Internship: Mandatory skill training and internship are linked with the scheme. Allowance is discontinued if internship is not completed. > **Note:** Benefit is provided for a maximum of 2 years or until employment/self-employment, whichever is earlier.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a domicile of Rajasthan. - The maximum age must be 30 years for general category; 35 years for SC, ST, women, transgender, and specially-abled applicants. - The applicant must hold a graduate degree from a recognized university. - The applicant, if a married woman with a degree from another state, must be married to a Rajasthan domicile. - The applicant must be unemployed; not employed in government or private sector; not self-employed. - The applicant must not be receiving any other allowance, scholarship, or financial assistance from government sources. - The applicant must not have been dismissed from any government service. - The applicant must be registered with a local employment office before applying; registration must be active; multiple registrations lead to disqualification. - The applicant must continue employment registration during the benefit period.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - via CSC **Step 1:** Applicants eligible for unemployment allowance may apply online to the Local Employment Office where they are registered or they may apply online through any e-Mitra kiosk or by logging in with their own SSO ID on the departmental portal Employment Exchange Management System (EEMS). **Step 2:** The application window is open once a year from 01 April to 30 June. **Step 3:** The applicant must fill in the required details and upload e-signed documents. **Step 4:** The system automatically selects eligible candidates on 01 July based on availability within the 2,00,000 annual cap. **Step 5:** The applicant must provide details of a single savings bank account in any Reserve Bank of India (RBI) scheduled bank.
