metadata.schemeName: Smart Farming & Agriculture Development Programme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve agricultural productivity and income of Scheduled Tribe farmers by providing improved seed minikits, irrigation pipe lines, storage bins, movable threshing floors, plant protection equipment, and horticulture demonstrations.

page_content:
# Smart Farming & Agriculture Development Programme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Agriculture, Farmer, Post Harvest Infrastructure, Seed Minikit Distribution, Seed Minikit Distribution | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Smart Farming & Agriculture Development Programme" by the Tribal Area Development Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to improve agricultural productivity and income of Scheduled Tribe farmers through providing seed minikits, irrigation pipeline support, storage bins, movable threshing floors, plant protection equipment, and horticulture demonstrations. It also aims to promote efficient water use, reduce post-harvest losses, and encourage the adoption of improved farming practices among tribal farmers. The scheme is funded by Centre.
## Benefits - **Free Seed Minikits:** The scheme provides 100% subsidized seed minikits for Kharif, Rabi, and Zaid seasons to ensure maximum production. - **Vegetable Production:** Students and farmers receive 100% subsidized vegetable seed minikits to meet nutritional requirements and increase income. - **Irrigation Infrastructure:** A 90% subsidy is provided for irrigation pipelines to reduce water losses and improve water use efficiency. - **Post-Harvest Management:** Farmers receive a 90% subsidy on seed storage bins and movable threshing floors to harvest crops easily and store them safely. - **Crop Protection:** Plant protection (PP) equipment is distributed at a 90% subsidized rate to protect crops from insect and pest attacks.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) community. - The applicant must be a resident of the Tribal Sub-Plan (TSP) Scheduled Area in Rajasthan. - The applicant must possess valid land holdings for agricultural purposes. - The applicant must reside in one of the following districts: Udaipur, Banswara, Dungarpur, Pratapgarh, Sirohi, Chittorgarh, Rajsamand, or Pali.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - via CSC - **Where to Apply:** Applicants can apply by visiting the nearest [E-Mitra kiosk](https://reportsemitraapp.rajasthan.gov.in/WebSrc/Reports/rpt_search_new_emitra_ksk.jsp).
**Mode:** Offline - **Obtaining Forms:** The applicant can obtain the application form from the office of the Deputy Director of Agriculture (Extension) in Udaipur, Banswara, Dungarpur, Pratapgarh, Sirohi, Chittorgarh, Rajsamand, or Pali. - **Submission Venue:** The completed application form must be submitted to the Deputy Director of Agriculture (Extension) office in Udaipur, Banswara, Dungarpur, Pratapgarh, Sirohi, Chittorgarh, Rajsamand, or Pali.

metadata.schemeName: Ph.D. Visiting Students Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide collaborative research opportunities to Ph.D. students from Indian institutions through short-term research visits at IIST.

page_content:
# Ph.D. Visiting Students Scheme **Ministry:** PMO | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Research Collaboration, Ph D Students, Visiting Students Scheme, Research Internship | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Ph.D. Visiting Students Scheme” implemented by the Department of Space, aims to provide collaborative research opportunities to Ph.D. students through access to research facilities and faculty collaboration at the Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology. Under the scheme, eligible Ph.D. students from Indian institutions can visit IIST for a duration of 1 to 3 months. Students must identify a faculty member with matching research interests and submit a detailed research plan through the online portal. The application requires endorsement from the parent institution and approval from the internship committee. Visiting students can access facilities such as laboratories, library, and canteen using a temporary ID card issued during the approved visit period.
## Benefits - **Research Experience Certificate:** Students receive a research experience certificate after successful completion of the visit and submission of required documents. - **Hostel Food Facility:** Students can avail of the hostel food facility by purchasing food coupons in advance. - **Administrative Charges:** Students must pay a nominal administrative fee of ₹100/- during the visit.
## Eligibility Criteria - Ph.D. students affiliated with an Indian institution, university, or college will be considered for visits lasting between 1 and 3 months. The student has to submit an Endorsement Certificate for the visit from the student's parent institution. - Please note that filling up the contact details of the research supervisor is mandatory. - The detailed research plan, duration of the visit, and intended use of IIST facilities, such as laboratory equipment, must be provided.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** IIST offers avenues for collaborative research for Ph.D. students from other institutions through the Ph.D. Visiting Students Scheme. **Step 2:** The student can find the IIST Faculty with matching/complementary research areas. With the endorsement of his Ph.D. supervisor and after mutual agreement with his supervisor and the faculty at IIST, the student can apply through the portal on the IIST website, which will remain open year-round. **Step 3:** The application requires a detailed work plan to be carried out at IIST. **Step 4:** Faculty at IIST will endorse the applicant’s visit and forward it to the internship committee for approval. **Step 5:** The student will receive the confirmation letter from the Dean of Student Activities for planning the visit.

page_content:
# Vocational Training (Dalit Varg Vayevsaik Prashikshan Yojna) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Himachal Pradesh | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scheduled Castes, Training Programme, Private Institution, Master Craftsman | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Vocational Training (Dalit Varg Vyavsaik Prashikshan Yojna)", has been launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment through the HP Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes Development Corporation, Government of Himachal Pradesh, provides vocational training to SC/ST youth in traditional and non-traditional trades through ITIs, private institutions, and master craftsmen, with a training duration of up to 12 months.
**Approved List of Trades:** 1. Handloom Khadi – 12 months 1. Motor Driving – 6 months 1. Motor Mechanic / Auto Scooter Repair – 12 months 1. Shoe Making – 12 months 1. Electronics – 12 months 1. Plumber – 6 months 1. Electrician / Motor Binding – 12 months 1. Welding / Steel Fabrication / Black Smith – 6 months 1. Pruning & Orchard Operation – 12 months 1. Carpentry – 12 months 1. Foam Making – 6 months 1. Beautician – 6 months 1. Bamboo Work – 6 months 1. Barber – 6 months 1. Cutting / Tailoring – 12 months 1. Computer – 12 months
## Benefits - Vocational training is provided for a duration of up to 12 months. - A stipend of ₹500/- per month is given if the training is undertaken in the home district. - A stipend of ₹750/- per month is provided if the training is undertaken outside the home district.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a member of a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribes family. - The applicant should be a bonafide resident of Himachal Pradesh. - The applicant should have an annual family income not exceeding ₹22,000/- per annum. - The applicant should be between 18 and 35 years of age.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 1: Obtain and fill the prescribed [application form](https://himachalservices.nic.in/hpscstdc/PDFs/Training.pdf) and attach all required documents. Step 2: Submit the completed application to the concerned District Manager or Corporation office for verification. Step 3: After approval, the application is forwarded to the HP SC/ST Development Corporation for further processing.

metadata.schemeName: Raja Ramanna Chair (RRC) Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to utilize the expertise of active retired scientists, engineers, and technologists by engaging them in research and development projects, academic activities, mentoring, and studies related to critical technologies identified by the Department of Atomic Energy.

page_content:
# Raja Ramanna Chair (RRC) Scheme **Ministry:** PMO | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Research Fellowship, Retired Scientists, Atomic Energy Research, Research And Development, Technologists, Nuclear Technology | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Raja Ramanna Chair (RRC) Scheme” implemented by the Department of Atomic Energy aims to utilize the services of active retired scientists, engineers, and technologists through providing honorarium, research support, and research opportunities to experienced professionals in critical and sensitive technologies. Under the scheme, selected awardees work on research and development projects identified by the Department of Atomic Energy in host institutes such as DAE units, universities, national laboratories, or institutes. The awardees also contribute through mentoring young scientists, participating in public outreach programs, delivering lectures, and writing technical publications or books related to atomic energy. The nominations are reviewed by a high-level committee constituted by the Chairman, Atomic Energy Commission. The scheme tenure is initially for 3 years and may be extended by 2 years subject to performance and age limit conditions.
## Benefits > **Honorarium:** - The awardee receives an honorarium of ₹1,00,000/- per month. - The honorarium is subject to the condition that the honorarium plus pension must not exceed the last pay drawn at the time of retirement. - The honorarium is taxable at source. > **Research Support Grant:** - The awardee receives a research support grant of ₹1,50,000/- per annum. - The grant can be utilized for commuting, domestic travel, official meetings, and conferences. > **Research Staff Support:** - Reimbursement for one research staff member, such as a Junior Research Fellow (JRF), Senior Research Fellow (SRF), or Research Associate (RA) is provided at actual rates fixed by DAE. - The tenure of the research staff remains co-terminus with the tenure of the awardee. > **Research Opportunity:** - The awardee gets an opportunity to work on critical and sensitive technologies identified by DAE. - Academic And Mentorship Activities - The awardee can deliver lectures, mentor young scientists and engineers, and participate in human resource development activities. > **Publication And Outreach Support:** - The awardee may undertake public outreach activities and write monographs or books related to atomic energy. > **Leave Benefit:** - The awardee is entitled to 30 days leave in a year with honorarium. - Prior permission is required for foreign travel during leave.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a retired scientist, engineer, or technologist from units of the Department of Atomic Energy, including aided institutions. - Preference is given to applicants involved in front-line scientific research, development of sensitive and/or critical technologies in DAE units, and fellows of major science or engineering academies. - The applicant must have rich experience in the selected research area. - The applicant must possess domain knowledge related to the selected topic. - The applicant must have expertise in the area of the topic selected for the award.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** The applications are on a nomination basis. The head of the host institute interested in hosting the candidates shall send the nomination as a PDF attachment to the email id: **rrcadmin@dae.gov.in** **Step 2:** A hard copy of the same also needs to be sent to the undersigned i.e.: > **Under Secretary (R&D-II),** > **Anushakti Bhavan,** > **C.S.M Marg** > **Mumbai - 400001**

# Scholarship to Disabled Students-Himachal Pradesh **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Himachal Pradesh | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarships, Student, Disabled, Education | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Scholarship to Disabled Students scheme, under the Government of Himachal Pradesh and the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Directorate of SCs, OBCs & Minority Affairs, provides scholarships to students with disabilities studying in government-run educational institutions whose disability is assessed at 40% or more by the medical board, without any income limit.
## Benefits **Classes 1 to 5** - Day Scholar: ₹625/- per month - Hosteller: ₹1,875/- per month
**Classes 6 to 8** - Day Scholar: ₹750/- per month - Hosteller: ₹1,875/- per month
**Classes 9 and 10** - Day Scholar: ₹950/- per month - Hosteller: ₹1,875/- per month
**Class 11 and 12 (10+1 & 10+2) / Post-Matric Courses** - Day Scholar: ₹1,250/- per month - Hosteller: ₹2,500/- per month
**Diploma Courses after 10+2** - Day Scholar: ₹1,875/- per month - Hosteller: ₹3,750/- per month
**Undergraduate Courses (BA / B.Sc / B.Com, etc.)** - Day Scholar: ₹1,875 per month - Hosteller: ₹3,750 per month
**LLB / B.Ed / Postgraduate Courses (MA / MSc / M.Ed / PG Diploma)** - Day Scholar: ₹2,250 per month - Hosteller: ₹3,750 per month
**Professional Courses (BE / B.Tech / MBBS)** - Day Scholar: ₹3,750 per month - Hosteller: ₹5,000 per month

## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 1: The applicant should fill out the prescribed [application form](http://esomsa.hp.gov.in/sites/default/files/APPLICATION%20FORM%20FOR%20GRANT%20OF%20SCHOLARSHIP%20TO%20THE%20DISABLED-40737356.pdf) and attach the required documents (income certificate, disability certificate, and Himachali certificate).
Step 2: The applicant should submit the completed application through the concerned school/institution to the District Welfare Officer.

# Fish Development Programme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Fish Development, Fish Seed, Fisheries, Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Fish Development Programme" implemented by the Tribal Area Development Department, Government of Rajasthan aims to enhance fish production through providing subsidies, training, and technical support to tribal beneficiaries. It supports fisheries activities in reservoirs and promotes self-employment. The scheme is funded by centre.
## Benefits - **First Year Subsidy:** Provision of 100% subsidy for the reservoir lease amount and fish seed collection costs. - **Second Year Equipment Subsidy:** Provision of 100% subsidy for boats and nets to facilitate efficient fishing. - **Fish Seed Subsidy:** Provision of 50% subsidy on the cost of fish seeds during the second year of the project. - **Marketing Support:** Provision of bicycles equipped with ice boxes to assist beneficiaries in the effective marketing of fish. - **Insurance Coverage:** Provision of insurance facilities specifically for the fishermen involved in the project. - **Technical Assistance:** Provision of technical support for scientific methods to increase fish production, hunting, and marketing.
## Eligibility Criteria - **Targeted Beneficiary:** Tribal people of the Tribal Sub-Plan area. - **Eligibility:** Local tribal woman/ man.
## Exclusions

metadata.briefDescription: To promote the growers for on-farm production of vermicompost by constructing vermicompost units in the farm itself to produce quality vermicompost for maintaining soil fertility to promote organic production of spices

page_content:
# Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Organic Farming: Construction of vermicompost unit (nos) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Commerce And Industry | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Farm, Farming, Spices, Agriculture | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom – Organic Farming: Construction of Vermicompost Units is implemented by the Spices Board, India, under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India. The scheme aims to encourage spice growers to produce vermicompost on their farms by establishing vermicompost units. This helps in the production of high-quality organic manure, improves soil fertility, and promotes the organic cultivation of spices. The scheme is being implemented in accordance with the modalities and guidelines approved by the Competent Authority under the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom during the 15th Finance Commission period (2021–22 to 2025–26).
## Benefits 1. 33.33% of cost one-ton capacity of vermicompost unit @ ₹ 4500/- for Gen and 75% @ ₹ 10,000/- for SC/ST 1. Spices growers having holdings from 0.10 ha to 8.00 ha. A grower having an area upto 4 ha will be eligible to avail a maximum of 1 unit and a grower having area above 4 ha and upto 8 ha will be eligible to avail a maximum of 2 units under the scheme. 1. The size of the vermicompost unit construction will be 2.7 m x 0.9 m x 0.9 m with a capacity to produce one ton in two cycles. 1. Locally available customized units with the above production capacity are also eligible for assistance with supporting bills and documents of purchase and the assistance will be limited to eligible % of assistance of actual cost.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. All the spice growing States and regions/UTs of India 2. Designated Officials will conduct final inspection and recommend the eligible cases. 3. Preference will be given to farmers who are members of ICS and groups/FPOs
## Exclusions

Step 3: Select the relevant service/scheme name. Step 4: Fill in the required details in the application form. Step 5: Submit the application.

metadata.schemeName: Solar Power Pump Project (Component ‘B’) – PM Kusum
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide solar-powered irrigation pumps at subsidized cost to farmers who lack electricity connections or depend on diesel-based irrigation systems.

page_content:
# Solar Power Pump Project (Component ‘B’) – PM Kusum **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Solar Pump Subsidy, Irrigation Support, Renewable Energy, Farmer, Horticulture, Standalone Solar Pump, Agriculture Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Solar Power Pump Project (Component ‘B’) – PM Kusum” implemented by the Horticulture Department, Government of Rajasthan, is a centrally sponsored scheme that aims to provide standalone solar-powered irrigation pumps up to 7.5 HP capacity at subsidized rates to farmers for agricultural and horticultural purposes. The scheme is funded in the ratio of 50% by the Central Government and 50% by the State Government. It targets farmers without electricity connections and those dependent on diesel pumps. The project is implemented under the Jawaharlal Nehru National Solar Mission (JLNNSM). The scheme is operational for a period of 5 years.
## Benefits > **Subsidy on Solar Pump:** - Up to 60% subsidy on total cost of solar pump installation. - Central Government provides 30% subsidy. - State Government provides 30% subsidy. > **Farmer Contribution:** - Remaining 40% cost to be borne by the farmer. - Up to 30% of farmer’s share can be availed as bank loan. > **Pump Capacity Support:** - Subsidy applicable up to 7.5 HP capacity. - For a 10 HP pump installation, subsidy limited to 7.5 HP only. > **Irrigation Support:** - Solar pumps are provided for irrigation in agriculture and horticulture crops.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must not have an agricultural electricity connection. - The applicant must be dependent on diesel pumps or other irrigation sources. - The applicant must use drip, mini sprinkler, micro sprinkler, or sprinkler irrigation systems. - The applicant must be using high-tech horticulture methods such as greenhouse, shade net house, or low tunnels (if applicable). - The applicant must have an existing irrigation water source recorded in land records (Jamabandi or revenue records). - The applicant must submit an affidavit if irrigation is done using diesel pumps. - The applicant must have water storage structures like farm pond, diggi, or water tank (if no electricity connection). - The applicant from dark zone or black zone areas may also apply. - The applicant must surrender the electricity connection application (if already applied) with consent to become eligible. - Preference is given to small and marginal farmers.
## Exclusions - The applicant must not already have an agricultural electricity connection. - The applicant must not have previously availed subsidy under solar pump scheme.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** The applicant must apply online through the [Raj Kisan Sathi Portal](https://rajkisan.rajasthan.gov.in/rajkisanweb/login/2#searchmenu). **Step 2:** Selection is based on the priority of online application submission. **Step 3** Eligible applicants are shortlisted and approved for installation. > **User Manual:** [Click here](https://rajkisan.rajasthan.gov.in/ManualNew/Video/B22286FA4F33454598EA346405AA7A18.mp4).

metadata.schemeName: Global Engagement Scheme: Festival of India
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide artists practising Indian art forms with an opportunity to perform abroad. Funding for international travel, performance opportunities, and logistical support is provided to Indian artists, dancers, musicians, and cultural troupes selected for performance abroad.

page_content:
# Global Engagement Scheme: Festival of India **Ministry:** Ministry Of Culture | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Artists, Indian Art Forms, International Travel, Indian Artists, Dancers | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Global Engagement Scheme: Festival of India" component of the Global Engagement Scheme by the ICR Division, Ministry of Culture, Government of India aims to provide artists practising Indian art forms an opportunity to perform abroad under the banner of 'Festival of India'. Through this component, funding for international travel, performance opportunities, and logistical support is provided to Indian artists, dancers, musicians, and cultural troupes selected for performance abroad. The component is implemented by the Ministry of Culture in coordination with Indian Missions abroad, through a Standing Committee, a Festival of India (FOI) Cell, and a Screening Committee. > **Objectives:** - Promote Indian Culture abroad. - Strengthen bonds of foreign countries with India. - Promote bilateral cultural contracts. - Project India's cultural image abroad. - Promote inbound tourism. > **Institutional Set-up:** - A Standing Committee, chaired by the Secretary (Culture), includes representatives from ICCR, Ministry of Tourism, Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, Planning Commission, Financial Advisor of the Ministry of Culture, DG, Archaeological Survey of India (ASI), and other related departments/agencies; it decides on the selection of countries, events, and time span. - A Festival of India Cell coordinates with participating agencies to prepare a consolidated proposal covering artist selection, delegation size, travel dates, venues, timings, logistics, accommodation, cargo handling, and other details. - A Screening Committee facilitates participation of non-government agencies/persons having expertise in performing arts, literature, and exhibitions; graded and empanelled persons are listed on the Ministry of Culture website. > **Events covered:** - Dance (classical, folk, contemporary, fusion), - Music (vocal, instrumental, sufi, classical, semi-classical, carnatic, contemporary), - Exhibitions, - Theatre, - Folk Arts including Mehendi artists and puppetry, - Literary Festival (from Sahitya Akademi), - Food Festival, - Film Festival, - Yoga, - Fashion Show/Textile Exhibition
## Benefits 1. Ministry of Culture meets expenditure on the selected delegation, including international passage, performance fees, visa fee, travel insurance, cost of extra baggage, and lodging in 3 or 4 star hotels. 1. Ministry also supports venue hiring charges and publicity expenses. 1. Missions are expected to explore sponsorship through local government and/or public-private funding for venues, other infrastructure (sound system, lighting), local hospitality, and local transportation, to the extent possible, before including such expenditure in the budget — this ensures maximising the limited budget for Festival of India. 1. Indian Missions are encouraged to organize Food Festivals, Film Festival, Yoga, and Fashion Show or Textile Exhibition as part of the Festival, for which the Ministry facilitates contacts with the concerned Ministry or organization. 1. Ministry of Culture also sends cultural troupes from its Zonal Cultural Centres for folk dances/music, and from autonomous organizations such as Sangeet Natak Akademi and Kalashetra for classical dance/music; exhibitions and/or lectures through museums, Lalit Kala Akademi, or Sahitya Akademi are also supported. > **Mode of Disbursement:** - Funds are not given directly to artists; the Ministry identifies a nodal agency in India for making arrangements for international passage booking, visas, and payment of performance fees to the artists. > **Frequency/Timing of Disbursement:** - The approved budget is released in two instalments 75 percent after financial and administrative approval, and the balance on conclusion of the festival, on receipt of utilization certificates. > **Validity/Conditions:** - Ministry of Culture expects constant feedback before, during, and after the festival period; Missions should send reports, photographs, and video recordings, if made.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should have expertise in the field of performing arts, literature, exhibitions, or related disciplines. 1. The applicant should be graded by the Screening Committee and empanelled; the list of empanelled persons is uploaded on the website of the Ministry of Culture. 1. The applicant should belong to the outstanding or promising category of artists on the empanelled list, from which the Indian Mission selects the art form.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - Once the dates of the Festival and suggestions from the Missions are received for activities proposed to be included, the approval of the Hon'ble Minister of Culture is obtained. - After approval of activities by the Minister, Missions work out the detailed programme of the festival, including precise dates for each performance and venues in each city, along with the estimated budget for activities to be funded by the Ministry of Culture. - The Ministry identifies a nodal agency in India for making arrangements for the cultural troupes, such as booking of international passage, visas, and payment of performance fees to the artists. - The approved budget is released in two instalments 75 percent after financial and administrative approval, and the balance on conclusion of the festival, on receipt of utilisation certificates. - Ministry of Culture expects constant feedback before, during, and after the festival period; Missions should send reports, photographs, and video recordings (if made).

metadata.briefDescription: Indira Gandhi Sukh Shiksha Yojana aims to provide financial assistance for the children of widow / destitute / abandoned women and disabled parents whose family income does not exceed ₹ 1,00,000 per annum from all sources, to ensure proper education for these children.

page_content:
# Indira Gandhi Sukh Shiksha Yojana-Himachal Pradesh **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Himachal Pradesh | **Categories:** Women and Child | **Tags:** Women, Children, Destitute, Education, Abandoned | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Indira Gandhi Sukh Shiksha Yojana under" the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Himachal Pradesh, aims to provide financial assistance to children of widows, destitute or abandoned women, and persons with disabilities whose annual family income from all sources does not exceed ₹1,00,000, to support their education.
## Benefits - (0-18 Years) Financial Assistance of ₹ 1,000 per month per child. - (18-27 Years) The Government will bear the educational expenses incurred after admission to any Graduate/Postgraduate Degree or Diploma Course, PhD, JBT, NTT, Nursing, or any other professional educational course in Government educational institutions, universities, or colleges situated within the State of Himachal Pradesh. - Hostel fees and mess charges (where the hostel is operated by a Government institution) for eligible children aged 18-27 years shall also be borne by the State Government. - If hostel facilities are not available in the institution, Rent/PG Charges/House Rent of ₹3,000 per month shall be provided.
## Eligibility Criteria > Children of widow / destitute / abandoned women and persons with 70% or above disability whose family income does not exceed ₹ 1,00,000 per annum from all sources.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Sign-Up Process for First-Time Users – HimSeva Portal** Step 1: Visit the [HimSeva Portal.](https://himseva.hp.gov.in/) Step 2: If you are a first-time user, click on [“Citizen Login.”](https://himseva.hp.gov.in/#) Step 3: Scroll down and click on “New User Sign Up for Citizen Login.” Step 4: Select any one of the available options: Aadhaar Number, Him Pariwar ID, Him Member ID, or Ration Card. Step 5: If you select Aadhaar Number, enter your Aadhaar number and click on “Consent for Aadhaar KYC.” Step 6: Click on “Get OTP” and enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number. Step 7: Complete the registration process. You can now log in to the HimSeva Portal and access the available services and schemes. **How to Apply for a Scheme** Step 1: Visit the [HimSeva Portal ](https://himseva.hp.gov.in/)and select the scheme you want to apply for. Step 2: [Log in ](https://himseva.hp.gov.in/pages/staticSite/new_home.xhtml)using HimAccess ID, Mobile, or Other option. Step 3: Fill in the required basic details and upload the necessary documents. Step 4: Read the terms and conditions carefully and fill all mandatory (*) fields. Step 5: Review and submit the application form. Step 6: Download the confirmation receipt for future reference.

metadata.schemeName: Mahatma Gandhi Jan Bhagidari Vikas Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure community participation in rural development, create employment opportunities, and develop community assets in rural areas of Rajasthan.

page_content:
# Mahatma Gandhi Jan Bhagidari Vikas Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Rural Development, Community Participation, Rural Infrastructure, Community Assets, Panchayati Raj, Rural Employment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Mahatma Gandhi JanBhagidari Vikas Yojana" is implemented by the Rural Development and Panchayati Raj Department, Government of Rajasthan. The scheme aims to ensure the participation of the local community in rural development by creating community assets and generating additional employment opportunities. It promotes self-reliance and community ownership in the creation and maintenance of public assets. The scheme also supports the improvement of the living standards of families residing in rural areas through community-led development works.

## Benefits - **Community Development Works:** Construction of community assets required for village development. Conservation, development, protection, and maintenance of community assets. - **Employment Generation:** Creation of additional employment opportunities in rural areas. - **Community Participation:** Encourages active participation of the local community in the creation and maintenance of community assets. - **Rural Development:** Promotes self-reliance and self-dependence among rural communities. Helps improve the living standards of rural families.
## Eligibility Criteria - After the full amount of the desired public contribution is deposited in cash, administrative/technical/financial approval will be issued within the stipulated period, subject to the availability of budget as per the powers given under the Rural Works Directory (in vogue) and as per the prescribed procedure. - The basis of priority for approval of works registered under the scheme will be kept from the proposals received Panchayat Samiti-wise and not on the basis of priority of proposals received in the district. - Panchayat Samiti-wise sub-allocation of the budget allotted/approved to the district under the scheme will be done by the District Collector on the basis of the ratio of the number of Gram Panchayats under this scheme. - The works will be implemented by Panchayati Raj Institutions/Government Departments. - The work will be done by the implementing agency by actively involving the donors/public contributors or their representatives.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Deposit the prescribed public contribution amount in cash. **Step 2:** Ensure availability of the required budget under the scheme. **Step 3:** Obtain administrative, technical, and financial approval as per the prescribed procedure and Rural Works Manual. **Step 4:** Submit the proposal through the concerned Panchayat Samiti. **Step 5:** The District Collector allocates the approved budget among Panchayat Samitis based on the number of Gram Panchayats. **Step 6:** Approved development works are implemented by Panchayati Raj Institutions or Government Departments. **Step 7:** The implementing agency associates the donor, public contributor, or their representative during the execution of the work.

metadata.schemeName: Folk Art Festival
metadata.briefDescription: The "Folk Art Festival" is a cultural initiative of the Art, Culture and Museums Dept, Government of Goa, aimed at providing a common platform for all folk performing groups in the state to interact, share ideas, and showcase their talent in a competitive spirit while preserving traditional forms.

page_content:
# Folk Art Festival **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Festival, Folk Performing, Academy, Financial Support | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Folk Art Festival" is a cultural initiative of the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa, aimed at providing a common platform for all folk performing groups in the state to interact, share ideas, and showcase their talent in a competitive spirit while preserving traditional folk art forms. Participation is invited through press notes in local newspapers. The festival is organized at the regional level, and selected groups from these events qualify to perform at the state-level festival, held at venues decided by the Kala Academy. ## Benefits **Assistance Available** - To and fro transportation charges for participating groups. - Preparatory expenses as decided by the Kala Academy from time to time. **Cash Prizes** **Regional Level (6 Centres)** - 1st Prize: ₹3,000/- - 2nd Prize: ₹2,000/- - 3rd Prize: ₹1,500/- - 3 Consolation Prizes: ₹1,000/- each **State Level** - 1st Prize: ₹10,000/- - 2nd Prize: ₹7,500/- - 3rd Prize: ₹5,000/- - 4th Prize: ₹3,000/- - 2 Consolation Prizes: ₹1,500/- each **Entry to Public** - Free entry for all visitors
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a Goa folk performing group actively involved in preserving and promoting traditional folk art forms of Goa. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 1: Obtain the entry form from the office of Kala Academy Goa (free of charge) and fill in all required details. Step 2: Submit the duly filled entry form to the Member Secretary, Kala Academy Goa within the stipulated deadline.

metadata.schemeName: Seminar/ Workshop
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide farmers with information on various horticulture programmes and connect them with entrepreneurs engaged in horticulture activities through state-level and district-level seminars/workshops.

page_content:
# Seminar/ Workshop **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Horticulture, Farmer Training, Seminar, Workshop, Awareness Programme | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Seminar/ Workshop" is a centrally sponsored scheme implemented by the Horticulture Department, Government of Rajasthan, with a funding pattern of 60% Central Government and 40% State Government. The scheme aims to increase farmers' awareness of various horticulture programmes and facilitate interaction between farmers and horticulture entrepreneurs through seminars and workshops. The topics of the seminars/workshops are selected based on the specific needs of each district. The programmes are conducted only at designated government training centres such as Centres of Excellence, Integrated Horticulture Intensive Training Centres (IHITC), ATMA Project Offices, Krishi Vigyan Kendras, Agricultural Research Centres, and Agricultural Training Centres.
## Benefits - **Technical Literature:** Beneficiaries receive technical literature related to horticulture. - **Knowledge Enhancement:** Farmers receive information on various horticulture programmes. - **Farmer-Entrepreneur Interaction:** Farmers get an opportunity to interact with entrepreneurs associated with horticulture activities. - **District-Specific Training:** Seminar/workshop topics are selected according to district-specific requirements.
## Eligibility Criteria > Following qualification has been set for Seminar/ Workshop: - All willing farmers of the state/districts.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Obtain the application form free of cost from the concerned office of the Horticulture Department. **Step 2:** Fill in the application form with the required details. **Step 3:** Attach the mandatory supporting documents. **Step 4:** Submit the completed application to the concerned office of the Horticulture Department. **Step 5:** Participate in the seminar/workshop as scheduled by the department.

metadata.schemeName: Delhi Arogya Kosh
metadata.briefDescription: “Delhi Arogya Kosh” (DAK) is a registered society which provides financial assistance to the extent of ₹5,00,000/- to the needy eligible patients for treatment of any illness/disease in Government Hospital.

page_content:
# Delhi Arogya Kosh **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Delhi | **Categories:** Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Arogya Kosh, Delhi, Financial Assistance, Family Health | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description "Delhi Arogya Kosh" is a registered society that provides financial assistance to needy eligible patients requiring treatment for illnesses, diseases, or medical interventions in Government Hospitals. Financial assistance of up to ₹5,00,000/- is provided for eligible treatment in Government Hospitals run by the Delhi Government, Central Government, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Autonomous Institutes, or Local Bodies in the National Capital Territory of Delhi. The scheme also provides financial assistance for specified diagnostic imaging services and identified surgeries for eligible patients under the applicable guidelines. Eligible patients may also receive free identified surgeries through empanelled hospitals and specified diagnostic services through empanelled diagnostic centres, subject to the applicable conditions.
## Benefits - **Financial Assistance for Treatment:** Financial assistance of up to ₹5,00,000/- is provided for eligible treatment, illness, disease, or medical intervention in Government Hospitals run by Delhi Government or Central Government or Local Bodies or Autonomous Hospitals under State Government.
## Eligibility Criteria - Patients with annual family income up to ₹3,00,000/- are eligible. - The patient should be a bonafide resident of Delhi for the last 3 years ( prior to the date of submission of the application). - The patient requiring treatment for any illness/ treatment/ intervention in a Government Hospital run by Delhi Govt. /Central Govt. /AIIMS /Autonomous Institutes of the State Govt. /Local Bodies.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** http://health.delhigovt.nic.in/wps/wcm/connect/083fff004d3a3c1181a5f5d1e963ea50/DAJSAl.pdf?MOD=AJPERES&lmod=95301809&CACHEID=083fff004d3a3c1181a5f5d1e963ea50 **Step 1:** Download the [application form](https://dgehs.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/inline-files/dajsal.pdf). **Step 2:** Check the List Of [Dak Empanelled Hospitals](https://dgehs.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/inline-files/dak_19.pdf) For Free Surgery Scheme. **Step 3:** A Complete application form along with all the requisite documents is processed by the concerned hospital and sent to the Director of General Health Services through e-office for his approval. **Step 4:** Thereafter, the application needs approval from the Finance Department, GNCTD and is thence forwarded to Chairman, DAK for their approval, respectively. **Step 5:** Financial Assistance up to Rs. 25,000/- is sanctioned at the level of Directorate General Of Health Services (DGHS), up to Rs. 1.5 lakh is sanctioned at the level of DGHS after approval of the finance department. **Step 6:** Financial Assistance above Rs. 1.5 lakh upto Rs. 5 lakhs is sanctioned at the level of Chairman, DAK **Step 7:** After the due approvals from the competent authority on rotation, the application comes back to Patient Welfare Cell and the sanctioned amount is issued in favour of the concerned Government Hospital through the ECS facility. **Step 8:** The concerned hospital is informed regarding the patient and the sanctioned amount for further necessary action at the level of the hospital. **Step 9:** The applicant, too, is informed through a letter sent by Speed-post and, if a contact number is available, telephonically.

metadata.schemeName: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (Himachal Pradesh)
metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a monthly pension is provided to elderly persons aged 60 years and above belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families to provide financial support. This is a centrally sponsored scheme for elderly members of BPL families.

page_content:
# Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (Himachal Pradesh) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Himachal Pradesh | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** BPL, Indira Gandhi, Old Age, Pension, Senior Citizen | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme, implemented by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Himachal Pradesh, is a centrally sponsored scheme that provides a monthly pension to elderly men and women aged 60 years and above belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families. The objective of the scheme is to provide social security and financial support to elderly persons who are members of families living below the poverty line.
## Benefits - Beneficiaries aged 60 to 79 years: ₹1,000/- per month - Beneficiaries aged 70 years or above: ₹1,500/- per month
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Himachal Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a senior citizen. 1. The applicant should be 60 years of age or older. 1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant shall submit the prescribed application form to the concerned Panchayat, Tehsil Welfare Officer, or District Welfare Officer, along with the required documents. **Step 2:** Eligible applicants are identified in the Gram Sabha meeting, and the verified list along with the proposal is forwarded to the Tehsil Welfare Officer for scrutiny and completion of formalities. **Step 3:** After due verification, the applications are submitted to the District Welfare Officer, who grants final approval for sanction of benefits.

metadata.schemeName: National Renewable Energy Internship Scheme
metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of New and Renewable Energy
metadata.briefDescription: The "National Renewable Energy Internship Scheme" by MNRE provides internship opportunities to facilitate students pursuing undergraduate/graduate/post-graduate degrees (Engineering, Science, Management, Law, etc) or research scholars enrolled in recognized institutes/universities.

page_content:
# National Renewable Energy Internship Scheme **Ministry:** Ministry Of New and Renewable Energy | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Renewable Energy, Internship, Student, Graduation | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "National Renewable Energy Internship (NREI) Scheme" by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) provides internship opportunities to facilitate students pursuing undergraduate/graduate/post-graduate degrees or research scholars enrolled in recognized institutes/universities within India or abroad, as “Interns”. The students of various Engineering, Science, Management, law and other streams may undertake internships in the Ministry and in organizations under its aegis to understand various activities of the Ministry to become Researchers/Managers in the renewable energy area. These interns will be attached to the senior-level officers of the Ministry in various Programme Divisions. These interns can work for a period of two months to six months. The scheme also provides opportunities to personnel engaged in projects related to policy research/promotion/demonstration and deployment of renewable energy in national and international research/institutes and financial institutions to work as Interns in the Ministry /its organisations.
> **Purpose** The "Interns" shall have an opportunity to learn about the Ministry’s functioning, programmes and policy, and issues in Renewable Energy and contribute to generating inputs such as analysis, technical reports/ technology advancement/ project reports/policy papers, etc. for the furtherance of the objectives of this Ministry.
> **Period** The internship is available twice a year based on the MNRE requirement.
> **Number** A maximum of 20 interns per year.
> **Duration** Will be from two to six months to be counted from the day of the start of the internship. No intern would be allowed to repeat or extend the internship. ## Benefits > **Stipend** A stipend amount of ₹ 15,000/- per month will be provided for physical internships only. **NOTE:** For virtual internships, the stipend will not be provided.
> **Certificate of Internship** Certificates will be issued to the interns on satisfactory completion of their internship and evaluation of their Report/Paper by the concerned.
> **Logistic Support** MNRE shall provide them with internet facilities and other necessities as deemed fit by the concerned Heads for physical internship. **NOTE:** Interns will be required to have their own Laptops. They shall also make their own lodging and boarding arrangements. ## Eligibility Criteria The applicant should be pursuing a graduate or post-graduate degree course in Engineering/ Management/ Law/ Science stream/Renewable Energy in a recognized University/institution within India or abroad. OR The applicant should be working in the Renewable Energy area in National, International, and Non-Governmental Institutes/organisations.
**NOTE:** MNRE will have the power to relax any of the above conditions mentioned, in respect of any deserving candidate. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** www.hrd.mnre.gov.in **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](www.hrd.mnre.gov.in) of the MNRE. **Step 2:** In the Online Application Form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload the required documents (self-attest if required) in the mentioned filesize and filetype. **Step 3:** Click "Submit", and note down the Application ID for future reference.
**NOTE 1:** The students/candidates can apply on a half-yearly basis (preferably July and January) online only. **NOTE 2:** The intern must clearly indicate the area of interest. (Ministry’s thrust research areas & programme areas/vision can be obtained from the website). **NOTE 3:** The application shall be made at least one month before the expected date of joining and not more than 3 months in advance from the date of commencement.
> **Selection Process** **Step 1:** All applications will be scrutinized by the Selection Committee constituted by the Ministry. **Step 2:** Offers will be sent to selected interns subject to the availability of slots, consent of the concerned Division and approval of the Selection Committee. The HRD division will upload the list of selected candidates on the MNRE website.

metadata.schemeName: Prime Minister’s Internship Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide internship opportunities to one crore youth in top 500 companies in five years. Through this Scheme, youth will gain exposure for 12 months to real-life business environment, across varied professions and employment opportunities.

page_content:
# Prime Minister’s Internship Scheme

**Ministry:** Ministry of Corporate Affairs | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Internship, Youth, Employment Opportunities, Training, Monthly Assistance, Skill Development | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme “Prime Minister’s Internship Scheme” was launched by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India. The scheme aims to provide internship opportunities to one crore youth in top 500 companies in five years. Through this Scheme, youth will gain exposure for 12 months to real-life business environment, across varied professions and employment opportunities.
The purpose of this scheme is envisaged as an arrangement between the intern and the company in which the company provides an opportunity for the intern to get training, and gain experience and skills within the real-life environment of the business or organization that helps in bridge the gap between academic learning and industry requirements, in turn, assisting enhancement of her/his employability.
**Scope:**
The Scheme is separate from all the existing schemes related to skill development, apprenticeships, internship and student training programmes, etc. being implemented across all the States & UTs of India, and will run independently of all such Central/State schemes.
**Internship Duration:**
Duration of the Internship shall be 12 months. At least half of the internship period must be spent in the actual working experience/ job environment, and not in the classroom.

## Benefits
- 12 months real-life experience in India's top companies
  - Monthly assistance of ₹4500/- by Government of India and ₹500/- by Industry
  - One-time Grant of ₹6000 for incidentals
  - Insurance coverage for every intern under Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana and Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana by Government of India.

**Note 1:** Monthly assistance will be paid to the interns for the entire duration of 12 months of the internship.
**Note 2:** A one-time grant will be disbursed to each intern by the government through Direct Benefit Transfer, upon the intern's joining at the internship location.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The candidate belongs to Indian nationality.
   1. The candidate’s age should be between 21 to 24 years (as on the last date for submission of the application). 
   1. The candidate should not be full-time employed.
   1. The candidate should not be engaged in full-time education.
   1. The candidate enrolled in online/distance learning programmes are eligible to apply.
   1. The candidate should be completed High School, Higher Secondary School, possess a certificate from an ITI, hold a diploma from a Polytechnic Institute, or are graduates with degrees such as BA, B.Sc, B.Com, BCA, BBA, B.Pharma, etc.
   1. The candidate family income should not exceed ₹8,00,000/-.

## Exclusions
**The following persons are ineligible to participate:**

   1. Graduates from IITs, IIMs, National Law Universities, IISER, NIDs, and IIITs.
   1. Those having qualifications such as CA, CMA, CS, MBBS, BDS, MBA, any master's or higher degree.
   1. Those undergoing any skill, apprenticeship, internship or student training programme under Central Government or State Government schemes.
   1. Those who have completed apprenticeship, training under National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) or National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) at any point.
   1. If the annual income of any of the family members of the candidate exceeds ₹8 lakhs.
   1. If any member of the family is a permanent/regular government employee.

**Note: For the purposes of the Pilot Project:**

   1. "Family" means self, parents and spouse.
   1. "Government" means Central and State Governments, UT administration, Central and State PSUs, statutory organizations, local bodies etc.
   1. "Employee" means regular/ permanent employees but does not include contractual employees.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
**Registration Process:**
Step 1: Visit the [official website](https://pminternship.mca.gov.in/login/) Prime Minister Internship Scheme.
Step 2: Click on “Youth Registration” on the top-right corner or “Register Now” in the PM Internship Offers section.
Step 3: Enter a mobile number linked to your Aadhaar and confirm via OTP.
Step 4: Password Setup- Use the OTP to log in and update the password upon first login. 
Step 5: Profile Creation e-KYC- Required for profile completion. You can complete e-KYC through:

  - DigiLocker: Connect using Aadhaar; requires your Aadhaar-linked mobile number and DigiLocker security PIN.
  - Fill personal information, contact information, education, bank details, skills & languages and upload certificates. 

**Internship Application Process:**
Step 1: Click on [View & Apply](https://pminternship.mca.gov.in/login/) Internship.
Step 2: After viewing details, if interested, click the “Apply” icon in the Action column.
Step 3: Fill all mandatory fields and Click the “Submit” icon to complete the internship application process.
**Track Application:**
Step 1: Go to "[Track Your Application](https://pminternship.mca.gov.in/login/)" on the candidate account page
Step 2: Use the table to see updates on offers received, accepted, or waitlisted for each internship.

The award is distributed on 8th August every year.

metadata.schemeName: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme targets manufacturers of components / sub-assemblies of Air Conditioners & LED Lights and offers 4–6% incentive on incremental sales to boost localization, reduce imports, and build a domestic supply chain.

page_content:
# Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Commerce And Industry | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** PLI, White Goods, DPIIT, AC, LED, Incentive | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme targets manufacturers of components / sub-assemblies of Air Conditioners & LED Lights and offers 4–6% incentive on incremental sales to boost localization, reduce imports, and build a domestic supply chain.
**Objective & Scope** The objective is to boost domestic manufacturing, reduce import dependence, build a strong component ecosystem for white goods, and position India in the global supply chain.
The scheme targets companies that invest in manufacturing components or sub-assemblies for: - Air Conditioners (ACs) — e.g. compressors, copper tubes, heat exchangers, motors, control assemblies, etc. - LED Lights — e.g. LED chips & packaging, LED drivers, LED engines, light-management systems, and other components in the LED-light value chain.
**Implementation Period & Financial Outlay** - The scheme runs from FY 2021-22 to FY 2028-29 - Total approved outlay is Rs 6,238 crore. - Incentives under the scheme are provided for a period of 5 years on incremental sales (after one / two year gestation period), over the base year.
## Benefits 1. Eligible companies get financial incentives ranging from 4% to 6% — on net incremental sales of goods manufactured in India under the scheme. 1. The goal is to significantly raise domestic value addition — from existing ~15–20% to ~75–80%. 1. Large incremental production and exports of AC & LED components. 1. Creation of substantial employment (direct + indirect) across manufacturing ecosystem. 1. Development of a complete “component-to-final-product” ecosystem, reducing dependence on imports.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. Incentive under the Scheme shall be provided to Companies making brown field or green field Investments for manufacturing in target segments in India. 1. Eligibility shall be subject to achievement of thresholds of net incremental sales of Eligible Products for the respective financial year over the base year or net incremental sales of eligible products over the base year or FY 2020-21, whichever is higher, as the case may be and cumulative incremental investment in the preceding financial year, which shall not be less than the threshold investment as detailed in Appendix-I or Appendix IA of the Scheme Guidelines, as the case may be. 1. In case an applicant does not meet criteria of threshold investment and threshold net incremental sales for any given year, the applicant shall not be eligible for disbursement of incentive for that particular financial year. However, the applicant will not be restricted from claiming incentive for subsequent years during the tenure of the Scheme, provided eligibility criteria of cumulative committed investment and threshold net incremental sales are met for such subsequent financial years. 1. The incremental sales of eligible products should be commensurate with created production capacity from investments committed under the scheme. 1. For the purpose of determining eligibility of an applicant with respect to incremental investment, the investment covered under any other PLI Scheme of Govt. of India of the Applicant shall not be considered for determining eligibility under this PLI Scheme and vice-versa. 1. In every financial year for which the incentive is claimed, the net sales turnover of eligible products of the selected applicant and its group companies shall not be less than the sum of their net sales turnover of eligible products manufactured in India in the base year for applicants meeting the pre-qualification criteria on the basis of financial attributes of base year and higher of net sales turnover of eligible products in the base year or FY 2020-21, for applicants meeting the pre-qualification criteria on the basis of financial attributes of FY 2020-21; along with the corresponding threshold incremental net sales turnover of the selected applicant as detailed in Appendix-1 or Appendix-IA of the Scheme Guidelines, as the case may be. 1. For applicants opting for initial investment period as 1st April, 2021 to 31st March, 2023, the first and last year of achieving the required corresponding threshold incremental sales for availing the PLI shall be FY 2023-2024 and FY 2027-28 respectively as detailed in Appendix -IA of the Scheme Guidelines.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online Application Link: [https://pliwg.dpiit.gov.in/](https://pliwg.dpiit.gov.in/)
Step 01: Check Eligibility Step 02: Prepare Required Documents Step 03: Register on the PLI-WG Online Portal Step 04: Fill the Online Application Form Step 05: Upload All Required Documents Step 06: Pay the Application Fee Step 07: Submit the Application Step 08: Evaluation by PMA Step 09: Approval by Competent Authority Step 10: Post-Approval Compliance

metadata.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Visually Challenged Teachers
metadata.briefDescription: Financial assistance scheme providing up to ₹36,000 annually to visually challenged permanent college teachers for reader assistance, Braille books, and learning aids. Implemented by University Grants Commission to support teaching, research, and academic independence.

page_content:
# Financial Assistance To Visually Challenged Teachers **Ministry:** Ministry of Education | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Reader Allowance Scheme, Financial Assistance For Disabled Faculty, Higher Education Disability Grant, Learning Aids Support | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Scheme has been formulated to help visually challenged permanent teachers to pursue teaching and research with the help of a Reader and by using teaching and learning aids by way of providing Reader’s Allowance and funds for the purchase of Braille books, recorded materials, etc.
**OBJECTIVE** To provide a facility to help visually challenged permanent teachers to achieve self-dependence by using various aids for teaching, learning, and research.

## Benefits Allowance to visually challenged permanent teachers will be Rs.36000/- p.a. The amount is to be utilized for the following purposes: 1. Payment to Reader 1. Purchase of Braille Books/ Material 1. Purchase of recorded materials 1. Any other related/ required material/equipment for research, teaching, and learning. The amount payable to Reader shall not exceed Rs.50/- per hour. The College shall reimburse the amount to visually challenged teachers on receipt of the actual amount received by the Reader and actual expenditure incurred by the visually challenged teacher subject to a maximum of Rs.36000/- per annum. Bills, in original, will be required to be submitted by the teacher to the college. However, these are not required to be submitted to the UGC. The scheme will end with the Plan period. ## Eligibility Criteria All the visually challenged teachers who are working in colleges in India, which are included under [Sections 2(f) and 12B of the UGC Act](https://www.ugc.gov.in/recog_college.aspx#:~:text=**%20Apart%20from%20inclusion%20of,funds%20from%20the%20Central%20Government.), are covered under the scheme. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **PROCEDURE FOR APPLYING** **Step 1**: Go to the [Prescribed Format (Page 09) ](chrome-extenhttps://www.ugc.gov.in/pdfnews/1112642_Person-with-Disability-guidelines.pdf)For Getting Financial Assistance Towards Visually Handicapped Teachers Of College. **Step 2**: Fill out all the details. **Step 3**:The proposal may be sent directly to the respective Regional Offices of the UGC along with the proposal for the Twelfth Plan showing a consolidated list of all the visually challenged teachers in the Institute including self-financing colleges covered under [12(B) of the UGC Act, 1956 ](https://www.ugc.gov.in/oldpdf/ugc_act.pdf)are eligible to receive the grant.
**PROCEDURE FOR APPROVAL BY THE UGC** The UGC would analyze and approve the proposal at its own level. Once the proposal is approved, the first installment of the admissible grant will be released by the UGC.
**RELEASE OF GRANT BY THE UGC** The first installment will be released with the letter of approval. However, subsequent installments would be paid on receipt of the Utilization Certificate of the previous grant together with the Statement of Expenditure incurred in the previous year. Details pertaining to visually challenged teachers be appended with it.
**PROFORMA FOR SUBMITTING THE PROPOSAL** The Colleges are requested to submit their proposal in the prescribed format only.

metadata.schemeName: PM Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
metadata.briefDescription: PM SVANidhi is a micro-credit scheme launched on 1st June 2020 by the MoHUA to provide handholding support to street vendors. The scheme facilitates a working capital collateral-free loan of ₹10,000, with subsequent loans of ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 with a 7% interest subsidy.

page_content:
# PM Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)

**Ministry:** Ministry Of Housing & Urban Affairs | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Skills & Employment, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Street Vendors, Working Capital Loan, Enhanced Livelihood, Digital Empowerment, Affordable Credit | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
PM SVANidhi is a central-sector micro-credit scheme launched on 1st June 2020 by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) to provide handholding support to street vendors. The scheme facilitates a working capital collateral-free loan of ₹10,000, with subsequent loans of ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 with a 7% interest subsidy. The scheme focuses on increasing the digital footprint in India by promoting the use of digital transactions among street vendors. To incentivize the adoption of digital transactions, a cashback of up to ₹100 per month is given to Street Vendors. 
**Aim:**
The scheme aims to formalize the street vendors and open up new opportunities for this sector to move up the economic ladder. Street vendors represent a very important constituent of the urban informal economy and play a significant role in ensuring availability of the goods and services at affordable rates at the doorstep of the city dwellers. They are known as vendors, hawkers, thelewala, rehriwala, theliphadwala, etc. in different areas/ contexts. The goods supplied by them include vegetables, fruits, ready-to-eat street food, tea, pakodas, bread, eggs, textile, apparel, footwear, artisan products, books/ stationary, etc. The services include barber shops, cobblers, pan shops, laundry services, etc.

## Benefits
- Financial assistance of up to ₹10,000 is provided to street vendors to help them restart and expand their businesses.
- The loan is provided at a low-interest rate of 7%, making it easier for street vendors to repay the loan.
- No collateral is required to avail of the loan, making it more accessible to street vendors.
- There is no processing fee to apply for the scheme, making it cost-effective for street vendors.
- The loan amount can be used for any purpose related to the street vending business, such as buying raw materials, paying rent, or purchasing equipment.
- The scheme provides financial stability to street vendors and helps them to become self-reliant.
- The loan repayment period is one year, which gives street vendors sufficient time to repay the loan.
- The scheme encourages entrepreneurship and helps to create employment opportunities.
- The scheme is aimed at providing financial assistance to street vendors affected by the COVID-19 pandemic, helping them to recover from the economic impact of the pandemic.
- The scheme is implemented at the national level and is available in all States and Union Territories, making it accessible to street vendors across the country.

## Eligibility Criteria
- Street vendors in possession of Certificate of Vending / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs).
- The vendors, who have been identified in the survey but have not been issued Certificate of Vending / Identity Card.
- Street Vendors left out of the ULB-led identification survey or who have started vending after completion of the survey and have been issued a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) to that effect by the ULB / Town Vending Committee (TVC).
- The vendors of surrounding development/ peri-urban/rural areas vending in the geographical limits of the ULBs, who have been issued a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) to that effect by the ULB / TVC.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
**Official Portal/Link:** https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in/
**Step 1:** Visit [https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in/ ](https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in/)and click on the "Log In" button on the homepage. 
**Step 2:** Enter Mobile number and captcha. Click request OTP. 
**Step 3:** After successful login, select valid "vendor category" among the available options. Enter "**Survey Reference Number**" (SRN) which is mandatory.
**Step 4:** On entering these basic details, fill the application form online, upload the relevant documents and submit.
**Note:** 

- For any kind of clarification and access detailed stepwise process, refer [User Manual](https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in/Default/ViewFile/?id=Helping+User+Manual+For+First+Term+Other+State.pdf&path=MiscFiles).- For any query one can call on the toll free number i.e 1800111979 between 9.30 AM to 6.00 PM on Monday to Saturday except national holidays.

**Mode:** Offline
1. Understand the information documents required to fill the [Loan application form (LAF)](https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in/Default/ViewFile/?id=PM+SVANidhi+LAF.pdf&path=MiscFiles) for the Scheme. 1. Keep all the information ready before you start the application process.
1. Ensure mobile phone is linked to Aadhaar number. 
1. This will be required for e-KYC/Aadhaar validation during online application process. 
1. It will also help you to get letter of Recommendation from ULB (in case required). 
1. It will also help you avail future benefits under Government welfare schemes.
1. Check your eligibility status as per scheme Rules. 
1. One will fall in one of the [4 categories of Street vendors](https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in/Home/PreApplication). 1. Check your status and the documents/ information which you need to keep ready.

metadata.schemeName: Advanced Vocational Training Scheme
metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Skill Development And Entrepreneurship
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide innovative, effective and integrated training opportunities for work force who need new skills to enjoy the dignity that comes with employment, independence and self-reliance.

page_content:
# Advanced Vocational Training Scheme **Ministry:** Ministry Of Skill Development And Entrepreneurship | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Training Courses, Short Term Skill, Industry Relevant Courses, Skill Upgradation, Hostel Facility, Tailor Course | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Advanced Vocational Training Scheme (AVTS)" has been launched by the Directorate General of Training (DGT), Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Government of India. It aims to upgrade and update the skills of the industrial workforce through short-term modular training. Through this scheme, short-term training courses of 1 to 6 weeks are provided to industrial workers, technicians, supervisors, engineers, instructors, and technical students for skill upgradation. The scheme is implemented by National Skill Training Institutes (NSTIs) under the Directorate General of Training (DGT), including NSTIs at Mumbai, Kanpur, Howrah, Hyderabad (Vidyanagar), Chennai, Hyderabad (Ramanthapur), Ludhiana, Dehradun, Calicut, Bangalore, Jamshedpur, and other centres. The training is offered in selected skill areas through regular and tailor-made courses designed as per the requirements of industries and establishments. The institute is equipped with workshops, laboratories, hostel facilities, and other infrastructure to support training. The scheme was launched in collaboration with UNDP/ILO and is delivered through modular courses to meet the training demands of industries and institutions. > **Mission:** - To continuously upgrade the skills of the industrial workforce for higher productivity - Bridging the gap between academics and industries for suitable placement for the young generation in technical fields > **Objective:** - To ensure a steady flow of skilled worker to the industries in different trades. - To raise the quality and quantity of the industrial production by systematic training of potential workers. - To enhance employability of educated youth for skilled and supervisory jobs through training. - To upgrade and update the skills of technical personnels of industries, Govt. Departments and Organizations for diversification in production and keeping them abreast with the technological advancement. - To conduct need-based training Program for industries, departments and organizations in the form of tailor-made programs. - Rendering consultancy in training/production techniques.
## Benefits > **Short-Term Skill Training:** - Training duration ranges from 1 week to 6 weeks. - Courses are modular and industry-oriented. > **Industry-Relevant Courses:** - Training provided in emerging sectors such as: - Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Cloud Computing - Cyber Security - CAD/CAM/CNC - Hydraulics and Pneumatics - Automobile Engineering - Welding Technology - Electronics and Electrical Systems - Solar Technology - Fashion Designing - Aeronautical Structure > **Tailor-Made Training Programs:** - Courses are designed according to the requirements of industries and establishments. > **Skill Upgradation:** - Helps industrial workers, engineers, and technicians update skills with the latest technologies. > **Infrastructure Support:** - Access to workshops, laboratories, library, hostel, and training facilities. > **Affordable Fee Structure:** - Application Fee: ₹100/- per participant per course - Gymkhana Fee: ₹10/- per course - Tuition Fee (Per Week): - Government Departments: ₹1,250/- (Regular), ₹2,500/- (Tailor-made) - Medium/Large Industries: ₹2,000/- (Regular), ₹4,000/- (Tailor-made) - Small Scale Industries/Private Candidates: ₹1,000/- - Technical Institutes: ₹1,000/- (Regular), ₹2,000/- (Tailor-made) - State Directorates: NIL > **Hostel Facility:** - Limited hostel available on a first-come, first-served basis. - Charges: ₹100/- per day per participant. > **Mode of Disbursement:** Training services are provided directly through NSTIs at Mumbai, Kanpur, Howrah, Hyderabad (Vidyanagar), Chennai, Hyderabad (Ramanthapur), Ludhiana, Dehradun, Calicut, Bangalore, Jamshedpur, and other centres.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should have a minimum qualification of ITI, Diploma, or Engineering in the relevant trade or branch. 1. The applicant who is currently appearing in ITI/Diploma/Engineering may also apply. 1. The applicant may be an industrial worker, technician, supervisor, or engineer. 1. The applicant from government departments or the private sector with a technical qualification can apply. 1. The applicant from the public sector or private industry personnel may apply. 1. The applicant with experience in the relevant field may also take admission.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline 1. Identify the relevant AVTS short-term course from the course schedule. 1. Prepare nomination/application for the selected course. 1. Submit the nomination to NSTI at least 15 days before the course commencement. 1. Obtain the application form through the institute's communication (offline/official contact). 1. Make payment of the application fee of ₹100/- and the gymkhana fee of ₹10/-. 1. Prepare Demand Draft in favour of: - “Drawing & Disbursing Officer (DDO), RDAT-UP”, payable at NSTI. 1. Submit the Demand Draft at the time of admission or pay through the available online mode. 1. Report to NSTI on the course start date. 1. Pay the tuition fee on the first day of course commencement. 1. If required, apply for hostel facility (subject to availability). 1. Attend training from 09:00 AM to 05:30 PM (Monday to Friday).

The target group of this scheme is the ‘single girl child'.

page_content:
# Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship For Single Girl Child **Ministry:** Ministry of Education | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Women and Child | **Tags:** Girl Child, Fellowship, PhD | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship for Single Girl Child (SJSGC) is a Fellowship Scheme by the University Grants Commission (UGC), Department of Higher Education, for pursuing research work leading to the award of a Ph.D. degree. The target group of this scheme are the ‘single girl child’, i.e. the only girl child in the family without having any brother or sister. A girl scholar who is one of the twin daughters/fraternal daughters is also eligible to apply for fellowship under the scheme. The number of slots for the fellowship will be decided every year on the basis of eligible applications complete in all respects, received through online mode.
**Objectives of the Scheme -** i. To support the higher education of single girl children in Social Sciences. ii. To recognize the value of observance of the small family norm. iii. To recognize the norm of single girl children in society. iv. To propagate the concept of single girl child norm. v. To promote single girls in society. ## Eligibility Criteria (i) Any single girl child of her parents pursuing Ph.D. in any stream/subject in recognised Universities/Colleges/ Institutes is eligible to apply under the scheme.
(ii) The scheme is applicable to such a single girl child who has registered herself in regular, full-time Ph. D. program.
(iii) Admission to Ph.D. Course in part-time/distance mode is not covered under the scheme. A scholar is not eligible for fellowship if the research is intended/pursued through open/ part-time distance education mode or part-time mode.
(iv) Girl students up to the age of 40 years for general category and 45 years for the reserved categories i.e. SC/ST/OBC and PWD (Persons with Disabilities) as on the last date of submission of online application are eligible.
(v) Both the scholar receiving the fellowship and the institution concerned, where the scholar is pursuing her Ph.D are responsible to ensure that the terms and conditions of these schemes are followed properly and only the eligible candidates get the fellowship. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** https://frg.ugc.ac.in/
