metadata.schemeName: National Food Security Scheme (Priority Households - White Ration Card) - Uttarakhand
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure food security for economically vulnerable and priority households in Uttarakhand by providing them with a guaranteed monthly supply of food grains at subsidized rates. Under the scheme, the eligible households are entitled to 5 kg of food grains per person per month.

page_content:
# National Food Security Scheme (Priority Households - White Ration Card) - Uttarakhand **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Ration Card, Food Distribution, White Card, Priority Household | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "National Food Security Scheme (Priority Households - White Ration Card)" is implemented by the Department of Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to ensure food security for economically vulnerable and priority households in Uttarakhand by providing them with a guaranteed monthly supply of food grains at subsidized rates.
## Benefits Under the scheme, 5 kg of food grains per person per month are provided, including 2 kg of wheat at ₹2.00 per kg and 3 kg of rice at ₹3.00 per kg. At present, from 1 January 2023, food grains are being distributed free of cost.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. A household/person is eligible under the scheme if they meet any of the following criteria: - A household with a monthly income of less than ₹15,000/- or not having an Antyodaya Ration Card. - A tribal household residing in a tribal or border area/widow/single woman/person suffering from an incurable disease/person with a disability/person aged 60 years or above, who is the head of the family, with a monthly income of less than ₹15,000/-. - A household whose total irrigated land, as per revenue records, is less than 2 hectares; or has less than 1 hectare irrigated and 2 hectares unirrigated; or has a total area of less than 4 hectares of unirrigated land. - A person engaged in occupations such as rickshaw pulling, porter work, labor, rag picking, cobbling, blacksmithing, carpentry, rural artisanal work, domestic service, or sanitation work. - A household that cultivates land belonging to another farmer. - A household residing in a slum or hut in an urban area, living in Uttarakhand since or before the date specified in the relevant Government Order. - A household whose annual income does not attract liability under the Income Tax Act. - A person who is homeless and separated from their social class, residing in organizations or ashrams such as widows’ ashrams, child reform homes, beggars’ homes, leprosy ashrams, orphanages, ashrams for the mentally ill or handicapped, or old age homes. Eligible households or persons, once identified according to the above criteria, will be selected in ascending order based on the lowest number in the BPL list prepared from surveys conducted by the Rural Development Department for rural areas.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - The applicant must first obtain an application form from the office of the Gram Panchayat Development Officer or the District Supply Officer. The application must include the family’s Aadhaar card, photograph, phone number, bank account details, gas connection, voter ID/PAN card, an income certificate showing income less than ₹15,000/-, electricity bill, the applicable eligibility certificate, and a declaration stating that the family is not holding an Antyodaya card. The applicant must submit the application form along with all the documents to the respective Gram Panchayat Development Officer. - After verification, the officer adds the name to the records and forwards the case with a recommendation to the Food Supply Department for further action. The ration cards are issued in each district based on the population targets set by the Government of India. A new ration card is issued only when a vacancy arises. The individual can obtain the ration card from the office of the District Supply Officer/Supply Inspector/Regional Food Officer within 10 days. - If no proposal has been submitted by the Gram Panchayat, the applicant must submit the application form in the prescribed format, along with the above documents, to the office of the Gram Panchayat Development Officer or District Supply Officer. Afterward, the Gram Panchayat Development Officer/District Supply Officer conducts verification, and if the applicant is found eligible and a vacancy exists, digitization is carried out.

metadata.schemeName: Fish Farming Diversification (Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe) Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote economic empowerment and livelihood diversification among Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe communities through fisheries-based activities.

page_content:
# Fish Farming Diversification (Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe) Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Subsidy, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Fish Farmer, Fish Farming, Poultry Farming | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Fish Farming Diversification (Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe) Scheme” scheme was introduced by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote economic empowerment and livelihood diversification among Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe communities through fisheries-based activities such as duck, poultry, and horticulture-based fisheries.
## Benefits Under this scheme: - Fishermen who already own ponds are provided a 60% subsidy for repairing or improving their ponds, or for undertaking duck/poultry farming and other integrated activities. - To connect landless individuals with fish processing and marketing businesses, a 60% subsidy of ₹1,50,000/- is provided against the cost of a mobile fish stall amounting to ₹2,50,000/-. - A 60% subsidy of ₹42,000/- is provided against the cost of ₹70,000/- for the improvement of a 100-square-meter pond. - A 60% subsidy of ₹3,00,000/- is provided against the cost of ₹5,00,000/- for the improvement of a 10-hectare pond in plain areas. - A 60% subsidy of ₹83,000/- is provided against the cost of ₹1,39,000/- for establishing one integrated unit (chicken/duck/banana/papaya) in mountainous areas. - In plain areas, a grant of 60%, i.e. ₹3,96,000/-, is provided against the cost of construction of one integrated unit valued at ₹6,60,000/-.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a native of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicant should be engaged in fish production and possess a pond or be landless and interested in engaging in fish processing or marketing businesses to be eligible. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - To avail the benefits of the scheme, eligible beneficiaries are required to submit an application for pond improvement, integrated fisheries, or fish processing/marketing business to the office of the Assistant Director of Fisheries or District Fisheries In-charge at the district level. - For applications related to pond improvement or integrated fisheries, the applicant must attach the following documents: Aadhaar card, land records, permanent residence certificate, caste certificate, bank account details, mobile number, and pond details. - For fish processing/marketing, the application must include: Aadhaar card, permanent residence certificate, caste certificate, bank account details, and mobile number. ***In the future, the application process will be made available online through the*** [***Apuni Sarkar Portal***](https://eservices.uk.gov.in/)***.*** - After submission of the application, a survey is conducted by the fisheries inspectors or field personnel, and a proposal is prepared in consultation with the beneficiary. Once the proposal is finalized, it is approved by the concerned district officer. Thereafter, under the supervision and technical guidance of field staff, the pond repair/improvement work, integrated activities, or fish stall setup is completed. Following the successful completion of work, the subsidy amount is disbursed through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) on the basis of a work completion certificate.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote safe and institutional deliveries by providing free accommodation to pregnant women, especially from disaster-prone areas, near district hospitals.

page_content:
# Promotion of Institutional Delivery **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Women and Child, Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Mother, Newborn, Childcare, Pregnant Woman, Institutional Delivery | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Promotion of Institutional Delivery” is implemented by the Department of Medical Health and Family Welfare, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote safe and institutional deliveries by providing free accommodation to pregnant women, especially from disaster-prone areas, near district hospitals.
## Benefits In all districts, especially considering road blockages during disasters, arrangements are being made in coordination with the Health Department and the Women and Child Development Department to provide free accommodation for pregnant women from identified areas in the “One Stop Centre” (run by the Women Empowerment Department). These centres, operated as Birth Waiting Rooms near District Hospitals, allow women to stay up to 15 days before their expected delivery date, ensuring that in case of emergencies or disasters, they can be promptly admitted to the nearest hospital for a safe institutional delivery. A “One Stop Centre” has been established in every district.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a pregnant woman.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline The facility can be availed by contacting the nearest ASHA worker, Anganwadi centre, or ANM.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage milk production and ensure fair remuneration to cattle farmers by providing financial incentives based on the quality of milk supplied to cooperative societies.

page_content:
# Dugdh Mulya Protsahan Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Milk, Cooperative Society, Milk Production, Cattle | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Dugdh Mulya Protsahan Yojana” was launched by the Department of Dairy Development, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage milk production and ensure fair remuneration to cattle farmers by providing financial incentives based on the quality of milk supplied to cooperative societies.
## Benefits Under this scheme, in addition to paying the price of milk to cattle farmers who supply milk to milk cooperative societies, an incentive of ₹4.00 per litre or ₹3.00 per litre is also paid, as per the prescribed standards.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a member of a milk-producing cooperative society supplying milk to the society.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - Members who supply milk to the cooperative society are paid ₹3.00 per litre for the prescribed standard (7.50% to 7.99% fat-free solids) and ₹4.00 per litre for 8.00% or higher fat-free solids. - The incentive is credited to the milk society members through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into their bank accounts. For this purpose, milk suppliers must provide their bank account details to the cooperative society.

# Uttarakhand Oon Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Wool, Weaving, Pension, Khadi Village, Artisans, Spinning, Weaver | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Uttarakhand Oon Yojana” has been implemented by the Uttarakhand Khadi and Village Industries Board under the Department of Industries, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote traditional wool spinning and weaving activities in the state while providing sustainable employment opportunities to local artisans and weavers.
## Benefits Under the scheme, four regional offices of the Regional Superintendent of Industries (Wool) have been established at Chamba, Srinagar, Almora, and Jaspur. These offices oversee spinning and weaving activities through departmental spinning/production centers. - Trainees who are willing to work in spinning and weaving are selected and provided with wool/NMC spinning wheels. They can carry out spinning and weaving either at the departmental centers or at their own homes. Weavers are compensated for their work according to rates fixed by the Khadi Commission, Government of India, ensuring year-round employment. - To support weavers and spinners, the Khadi & Polyvastra Artisan Welfare and Pension Trust has been established in the state. Upon registration, each artisan receives a 12% contribution from the artisan and a 12% contribution from the department. Additionally, artisans are entitled to receive 25% of their annual spinning and weaving wages as a bonus.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age. 1. No educational qualification is required for availing the benefits under this scheme.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - Beneficiaries are selected based on departmental requirements through the public representative of the relevant area, the District Village Industries Officer, and the respective Regional Superintendent of Wool Industries. - Interested applicants can contact the Khadi and Village Industries Office of their respective district or the Regional Superintendent of Wool Industries Office in Chamba, Srinagar, Almora, and Jaspur.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance through banks to facilitate the establishment of new micro (nano) enterprises as well as the expansion of existing businesses.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Swarozgar Yojana Ati Sukshm (Nano) Udhyam **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Entrepreneur, MSME, Self-Employment, Employment, Micro Enterprises, Nano Enterprises | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Mukhyamantri Swarozgar Yojana Ati Sukshm (Nano) Udhyam” is implemented by the Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) Department under the Department of Industries, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance through banks to facilitate the establishment of new micro (nano) enterprises as well as the expansion of existing businesses.
## Benefits To strengthen small entrepreneurs and businessmen in rural and urban areas, financing of up to ₹50,000/- is provided through banks for setting up micro enterprises or businesses. This financial assistance is also available for the expansion of existing businesses. The subsidy structure is as follows: - Subsidy for Category A districts: 35% for the general category (maximum ₹17,500/-) and 40% for the special category (maximum ₹20,000/-). - Subsidy for Category B and B+ districts: 30% for the general category (maximum ₹15,000/-) and 35% for the special category (maximum ₹17,500/-). - Subsidy for Category C and D districts: 25% for the general category (maximum ₹12,500/-) and 30% for the special category (maximum ₹15,000/-). The category-wise classification of districts is provided in [Annexure-2](https://uk.gov.in/department92/library_file/file-04-12-2023-06-02-23.pdf) (Page No. 157).
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age. 1. No educational qualification is required for availing the benefits under this scheme. 1. The applicant must hold an account with the financing bank in the concerned area. 1. The applicant or entity must not be a defaulter of any bank, nationalized bank, financial institution, or cooperative bank/institution.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - To avail the benefits of the scheme, applications must be submitted online through the portal [https://msy.uk.gov.in](https://msy.uk.gov.in/)/. Eligible applications are then forwarded online to banks for funding. Financial assistance may be provided under the scheme for both new projects and for upgrading existing small-scale enterprises. - The documents required for the application include the applicant’s photograph, Aadhaar card, permanent residence/domicile certificate, special category or caste certificate (if applicable), a copy of project details, affidavit, education certificate, bank account details, disability certificate (if applicable), and ration card. All self-attested documents must be uploaded online through the online portal. - The prescribed subsidy will be released only after the project established under the scheme has been successfully operational for a continuous period of one year.

metadata.schemeName: Ex-Gratia Payment for Loss of Hands, Legs, Eyes, or Vision
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial relief to individuals who suffer physical disabilities such as loss of limbs or vision as a result of disasters or while participating in relief and preparedness activities. Under this scheme, financial assistance between ₹74,000/- to ₹2,50,000/-is provided.

page_content:
# Ex-Gratia Payment for Loss of Hands, Legs, Eyes, or Vision **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Disability, Disaster, Financial Aid, Loss Of Limbs | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Ex-Gratia Payment for Loss of Hands, Legs, Eyes, or Vision” is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Disaster Management Authority under the Department of Disaster Management, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial relief to individuals who suffer physical disabilities such as loss of limbs or vision as a result of disasters or while participating in relief and preparedness activities.
## Benefits Under this scheme, an ex-gratia grant of ₹74,000/- is provided to each affected person. In cases where the disability exceeds 60%, a higher amount of ₹2,50,000/- per person is provided.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be either disaster-affected individual or involved in disaster relief or preparedness-related activities. 1. The extent and cause of the disability must be certified by a doctor from a government hospital or dispensary.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Information about the disaster and the resulting damage is received from various sources. The concerned Patwari verifies the damage and records it in the P-20 form. The Patwari’s report is subsequently verified by the Tehsildar and the Sub-Divisional Magistrate. Approval is then obtained from the District Magistrate. metadata.schemeName: Assistance Scheme for Handloom Spinning-Weaving Women Workers
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support to traditional women workers whose primary occupation is handloom weaving, spinning, or related weaving activities. Under this scheme, eligible women workers are provided with handloom equipment, including looms & related equipment, worth upto ₹25,000/-.

page_content:
# Assistance Scheme for Handloom Spinning-Weaving Women Workers **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Women and Child | **Tags:** Artisan, Handloom, Spinning, Weaving, Woman, Woman Weaver | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Assistance Scheme for Handloom Spinning-Weaving Women Workers” is implemented by the Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) Department under the Department of Industries, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support to traditional women workers whose primary occupation is handloom weaving, spinning, or related weaving activities.
## Benefits Under this scheme, for providing handloom / pantloom / frameloom and other related tools and equipment to selected women workers, 90% of the total cost (up to a maximum of ₹25,000/-) will be borne by the department, while the remaining 10% will be contributed by the beneficiary herself.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a woman worker who belong to a family whose ancestral occupation is weaving, spinning, knitting, or allied handloom activities. 1. Preference will be given to women workers who have experience in the handloom sector but are unable to carry out weaving work due to the unavailability of a loom. 1. The woman worker must be registered with the Government of India or Government of Uttarakhand.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - Application forms can be obtained from the General Manager, District Industries Centre, or downloaded from the departmental website at [https://doi.uk.org](https://doi.uk.gov.in/). - Along with the application form, applicants must submit a copy of their Aadhaar card, bank account details, relevant registration certificate (if registered with the Government of India or the State Government), and other documents, photographs, or certificates related to handicrafts or weaving. These documents should be submitted through the General Manager of the concerned District Industries Centre. ***Selection Process:*** - A committee constituted under the chairmanship of the General Manager, District Industries Centre, will select eligible women workers at the district level as per the prescribed criteria. The list of selected beneficiaries along with the necessary details will be forwarded to the Directorate of Industries for approval. After approval, 90% of the sanctioned amount will be transferred directly to the bank accounts of the selected women workers.

metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a grant of up to ₹3,500/- is provided for the purchase of individual aids, which may be increased to a maximum of ₹7,000/- in special cases. Additionally, ₹500/- is provided for the repair of prosthetic limbs and other assistive equipment.

page_content:
# Grant for Purchase and Repair of Various Assistive Devices/Equipment for Persons with Disabilities **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Devices, Person With Disability, Differently-abled Person, PwD, Divyang | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Grant for Purchase and Repair of Various Assistive Devices/Equipment for Persons with Disabilities” has been implemented by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to enhance the mobility and functional independence of persons with disabilities by providing financial assistance for the purchase and repair of essential assistive devices. Under this scheme, a grant of up to ₹3,500/- (maximum ₹7,000/- in special cases) is provided for the purchase of individual aids and ₹500 for the repair of prosthetic limbs and assistive equipment.
## Benefits > **Grant Amount:** - ₹50/- to ₹3,500/- for the purchase of assistive devices (maximum ₹7,000/- in special cases). - ₹500/- for repair of artificial limbs and assistive equipment.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should be a person with a disability. 1. The applicant should have a minimum disability of 40%. 1. In the case of a minor beneficiary, the monthly income of parents/guardians should not exceed ₹4,000/-. 1. The applicant should have a medical recommendation from a Government Medical Officer or specialist recommending the device or its repair. ## Exclusions

The applicants should complete the application form himself/herself and submit it to the concerned Assistant Social Welfare Officer. The District Social Welfare Officer’s office will process the application as per the prescribed rules. Thereafter, payment will be made to the beneficiary through the treasury.

metadata.schemeName: State Government-Run Old Age and Infirm Homes
metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, free residential, food, clothing, and healthcare are provided to destitute elderly individuals above 60 years in state-run residential facilities.

page_content:
# State Government-Run Old Age and Infirm Homes **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Housing & Shelter, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Old-age Home, Infirm Home, Senior Citizen, Shelter, Home For Disabled Persons | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “State Government-Run Old Age and Infirm Homes” scheme has been launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide shelter and essential care to destitute elderly residents of the state. Under this scheme, senior citizens are provided free accommodation, meals, clothing, and healthcare in state-run residential facilities. Currently, two homes are operational in the districts of Chamoli & Bageshwar.
## Benefits The following facilities are provided to elderly individuals in government-run Old Age and Infirm Homes: - Free accommodation - Free nutritious meals - Free clothing - Free medical care, etc. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should be a male or female. 1. The applicant's age must be 60 years or above. 1. There is no income ceiling for eligibility. 1. The applicant must not have a communicable disease (certified by a government doctor). ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - The application can first be submitted by the concerned elderly woman or man at the office of the District Magistrate/Magistrate or the District Social Welfare Officer/Superintendent of the Government-Run Old Age and Infirmary Home. A copy of the family register, a copy of the Aadhaar card, and a report from the Pradhan/ Councillor must be attached to the application. - Thereafter, the District Magistrate forwards the matter for investigation by the Revenue Department, which includes obtaining the report of the Revenue Inspector, the recommendation of the Tehsildar, and a medical certificate from a doctor stating that the applicant’s illness is not contagious to other inmates. - After completing the investigation and reviewing the submitted application, the District Magistrate/Magistrate issues an order permitting the concerned person to reside in the Government-Run Old Age and Infirmary Home. The individual may then take residence in the said home.

metadata.schemeName: Maintenance Grant for Children with Disabilities from Birth
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹700/- per month to parents or guardians for the care of children below 18 years of age with more than 40% disability.

page_content:
# Maintenance Grant for Children with Disabilities from Birth **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Women and Child | **Tags:** Childcare, Grant, Differently Abled, PwD, BPL | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Maintenance Grant for Children with Disabilities from Birth” has been implemented by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to provide financial assistance to parents or guardians for caring for their children below 18 years of age with more than 40% disability.
## Benefits ₹700/- per month is provided to parents or guardians for caring for their children.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must be the parent or guardian of a child with more than 40% disability. - The child must be below 18 years of age. - The family’s monthly income must be less than ₹4,000/- or the family must belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** : https://socialwelfare.uk.gov.in/files/HandicapFormat0-18_1.pdf - The applicant can apply online either by themselves or through a Common Service Center (CSC) via the Department’s Pension Portal ([https://ssp.uk.gov.in](https://ssp.uk.gov.in)), the [UMANG](https://web.umang.gov.in/) Mobile App, or the Apuni Sarkar Portal ([https://eservices.uk.gov.in](https://eservices.uk.gov.in)). - The following documents are mandatory at the time of applying: Applicant’s mobile number, Passport-size photograph (attested by Gram Pradhan / V.P.D.O. / certified by Councillor), Photocopy of Aadhaar card and Voter ID card, CBS bank account details (linked/seeded with Aadhaar), Valid family income certificate or BPL certificate, Certificate of disability of more than 40%, child's birth certificate, Copy of family register (for rural areas only), Copy of the resolution passed in the open meeting of Gram Panchayat (for rural areas) / certified by Councillor (for urban areas) - All the above documents must be issued from the district where the application is being submitted. - For verification of the online application form in rural areas, the final decision is taken by the District Social Welfare Officer after recommendations from the Gram Panchayat Development Officer, Assistant Social Welfare Officer, and Block Development Officer, respectively. In urban areas, verification and recommendation are done by the Assistant Social Welfare Officer and Sub-District Magistrate. If the application is found correct, the District Social Welfare Officer approves it, after which the pension payment process is initiated. - But along with the above documents, a certificate of disability of more than 40% and a UID certificate from the Chief Medical Officer will also have to be given. - The pension amount will be credited to the parent's bank account within one month after the application is approved.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides loans of up to ₹50,000/- to construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) for the purchase or construction of a house, at a minimum interest rate of 5% per annum.

page_content:
# Financial Assistance for Purchase or Construction of House (UKBOCWWB) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Housing & Shelter | **Tags:** Loan, House, Construction Worker, Building Worker, Labour | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Financial Assistance for Purchase or Construction of House” scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide loans to registered construction workers for the purchase or construction of a house at a minimal interest rate.
## Benefits 1. Under the scheme, registered construction workers are eligible to receive an advance loan amount of up to ₹50,000/- for the purchase or construction of a house, subject to the conditions specified by the Board. 1. Interest of at least 5% per annum is applicable on this loan. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. To avail an advance loan for the purchase or construction of a house, the worker must have been a member of the fund for at least five years and should have a minimum of 15 years remaining until superannuation/retirement age.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - via CSC - The online application is submitted through Shramik Suvidha Kendras. - Along with the application form, the applicant must attach the Shramik Card, Aadhaar Card, bank account details, and a handwritten self-declaration certificate stating that no assistance has been taken from any other department for the same purpose. - If the application is verified and found correct during the departmental investigation, the advance amount is disbursed, on which the worker is required to pay interest at the rate of 5% per annum. - Proof of completion of the work must be submitted to the Secretary of the Board within six months from the date of withdrawal of the advance. The sanctioned advance amount shall be recovered in equal installments as determined by the Board.

metadata.schemeName: Uttarakhand Compensation Scheme for Women Victims/Survivors of Sexual Offences and Other Crimes, 2020
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance/compensation ranging from a minimum of ₹3 lakh to a maximum of ₹10 lakh to women victims and survivors of sexual offences, as well as to other women victims of crime in the state.

page_content:
# Uttarakhand Compensation Scheme for Women Victims/Survivors of Sexual Offences and Other Crimes, 2020 **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Public Safety,Law & Justice, Women and Child | **Tags:** Compensation, Women, Crimes, Woman Victim | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Uttarakhand Compensation Scheme for Women Victims/Survivors of Sexual Offences and Other Crimes, 2020” has been implemented by the Uttarakhand State Legal Services Authority, Nainital, under the Department of Law, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and compensation to women victims and survivors of sexual offences, as well as other women victims of crime in the state.
## Benefits - Women victims of crime are provided financial assistance/compensation ranging from a minimum of ₹3 lakh to a maximum of ₹10 lakh. - Upon receipt of an application for compensation, the State/District Legal Services Authority may pass an order to provide immediate first aid or medical benefits free of cost to the victim/dependent, or an immediate relief amount of ₹5,000/- or ₹10,000/-, as required. This amount shall be disbursed immediately by the Member-Secretary, State Legal Services Authority or District Legal Services Authority. - If a woman is a victim of sexual violence or an acid attack and is covered under more than one offence, she will be entitled to receive a consolidated amount of compensation.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. All women of the state/their dependents, who are victims of gang rape, rape, unnatural sexual assault, pregnancy due to rape, abortion or loss of fertility resulting from violence, loss of life, disability, physical or mental injury requiring rehabilitation, burns, or acid attacks, will be eligible to receive compensation under the scheme.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - Compensation is awarded in two forms: **interim compensation and final compensation**. Interim compensation provides immediate relief to the victim after a crime, which may include an order for free medical treatment or a monetary sum of up to ₹10,000/-, as required. Final compensation offers financial assistance to the victim, ranging from ₹3 lakh to ₹10 lakh, depending on the nature of the crime. - **For interim compensation,** immediately after the registration of a First Information Report (FIR), the Senior Superintendent of Police, Superintendent of Police, Circle Officer, or Station House Officer must compulsorily share its hard or soft copy with the State Legal Services Authority or District Legal Services Authority. This enables the authorities to automatically verify the facts and provide interim compensation in eligible cases. The victim or dependent may also apply directly by submitting an application along with their Aadhaar card, copy of the FIR, and medical certificates to the District or State Legal Services Authority, or they can apply online through the Victim Compensation option available on the National Legal Services Authority website. - **For final compensation**, the victim, dependent, or the concerned police station in-charge can apply to the State or District Legal Services Authority. The application must include the FIR, charge sheet, medical certificate, details of the court in which the case is pending, relevant orders if the case has been disposed of, and other case-related details if the matter is still under hearing. Additionally, documents related to any interim relief received, orders, bills or receipts of treatment expenses, proof of financial loss, and supporting certificates must also be submitted. Alternatively, an online application can be made through the Victim Compensation option on the National Legal Services Authority website. Once submitted, the competent authority or committee will investigate the case and disburse the compensation to the victim or dependent. - If the victim or dependent faces difficulty in applying due to lack of legal knowledge, they may seek free legal assistance from a paralegal volunteer or a panel lawyer. A list of paralegal volunteers and panel lawyers is available on the official website of the State Legal Services Authority.
**Mode:** Online The applicant may apply online through the “Victim Compensation” option available on the website of the National Legal Services Authority at [https://nalsa.gov.in/](https://nalsa.gov.in/)

# Scholarship to Poor Students **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Student, Undergraduate, Postgraduate, Sanskrit University | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Scholarship to Poor Students” is implemented by Uttarakhand Sanskrit University, Haridwar, under the Department of Sanskrit Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to economically disadvantaged students enrolled in undergraduate and postgraduate programs at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University.
## Benefits Under this scheme, one student from each undergraduate and postgraduate class at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University is awarded a scholarship equal to the tuition fee of their respective class.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The student must be enrolled in an undergraduate or postgraduate course at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University. 1. The student must have the lowest annual family income among all students in the same course, class, or subject.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - A Scholarship Cell has been established at the university level to manage scholarship applications. The cell provides application forms to students, who are required to complete the form and submit it along with their high school certificate, Aadhaar card, income certificate, bank account details, and university identity card. - After scrutinizing the applications, the cell publishes a list of eligible students. Upon administrative and financial approval, the scholarship funds are transferred directly to the bank accounts of the eligible students.

page_content:
# Operation/implementation of Vidhik Seva Rath **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Public Safety,Law & Justice | **Tags:** Free Book, Legal Awareness, Mobile Van, Vidhik Seva Rath, Legal Services | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Operation/Implementation of Vidhik Seva Rath” has been implemented by the Uttarakhand State Legal Services Authority, Nainital, under the Department of Law, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to spread legal awareness and provide information about welfare schemes to people in both urban and remote rural areas, ensuring that citizens are informed about their rights and available government benefits.
## Benefits - Under the public awareness programme, the mobile van of the State Legal Services Authority, "Vidhik Seva Rath", is sent to visit every urban area and remote rural areas of two to three districts every month and various welfare schemes run by the central and state government are shown through films. - The book "Saral Kanooni Gyan Mala" published on various subjects is distributed free of cost.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. All residents of the areas visited by the van can benefit from these programs. The team members assigned to the tour inform the public about the schemes using a projector installed in the "Vidhik Seva Rath".
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - When the Vidhik Seva Rath visits an area, relevant information can be obtained, and for receiving books, the name, address/telephone/mobile number, and signature of the concerned person are recorded in the book distribution register. The books are provided free of cost. - Information about the arrival of the Vidhik Seva Rath in your area is shared through paralegal volunteers, whose names, mobile numbers, and other details are available on the Uttarakhand State Legal Services Authority website: [www.slsa.uk.gov.in](https://www.slsa.uk.gov.in/). - If any person, woman, or child is in urgent need of the books mentioned above, they can obtain them by submitting a written request to the District Authority's office at the district headquarters. No documents or identity cards are required for this purpose.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide skill upgradation training along with country-specific training to the youth of the state, enabling them to secure employment opportunities abroad.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Kaushal Unnayan and Vaishvik Rojgar Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Employment, Skill Upgradation, Youth, Training, Hospitality, Nursing | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Mukhyamantri Kaushal Unnayan and Vaishvik Rojgar Yojana” was launched by the Department of Skill Development and Employment, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide skill upgradation training along with country-specific training to the youth of the state, enabling them to secure employment opportunities abroad.
## Benefits - Under this scheme, youth of Uttarakhand are provided with skill upgradation training in various domains such as language, culture, work ethics, nursing, and hospitality, along with country-specific training. - The training is provided as per the demand of foreign employers to enable the youth to secure suitable service and job opportunities abroad.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a youth of Uttarakhand.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - Youth interested in overseas employment can register on the [Apuni Sarkar portal](https://eservices.uk.gov.in/). The registration process requires basic details such as the preferred field of work, educational qualification certificates, and passport information. - After registration, applicants will be invited for a screening test. Those who qualify will become eligible for training. - Upon selection, candidates must submit their Aadhaar card, bank account details, and permanent residence certificate. Training may be provided in either residential or non-residential mode. - The State Government bears 20% of the total training cost. If the trainee avails a loan for up to 60% of the training cost, the State Government will subsidize 75% of the loan interest. In cases where no loan is taken, only 20% of the cost will be covered by the State Government. Trainees can apply for the loan during the training period, with assistance provided by the concerned department. - After completing the training, the employing company or institution conducts a test or interview. Only candidates who pass will be sent for overseas employment. - The registration process on the [Apuni Sarkar portal](https://eservices.uk.gov.in/) remains open throughout the year.

The scheme aims to organize camps and awareness programs across urban and rural areas to inform and empower vulnerable groups such as women, children, senior citizens, workers in the unorganized sector, persons with disabilities, acid attack survivors and victims of trafficking about their legal rights.
## Benefits For the effective implementation of public welfare schemes of the Hon’ble National Legal Services Authority (NALSA), New Delhi, the District Legal Services Authorities, Tehsil Legal Services Committees, and the Uttarakhand State Legal Services Authority also organize multi-purpose camps, awareness programs, debate competitions, painting competitions, and essay competitions across urban areas and remote rural regions.

Individuals, women, and children from all walks of life particularly workers in the unorganized sector, persons with mental illness or disabilities, acid attack survivors, senior citizens, and victims of trafficking and commercial sexual exploitation are provided information about their legal rights. 1. # Award Scheme for Candidates Selected in NDA, IMA, OTA, INA, IAF **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Award, Financial Assistance, Armed Forces Examination, NDA, IAF, IMA, OTA, INA | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Award Scheme for Candidates Selected in NDA, IMA, OTA, INA, IAF” was introduced by the Higher Education Department, Government of Uttarakhand. metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-reliance among persons with disabilities through grants, term loans, and margin money assistance.

page_content:
# Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Disabled)

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Skills & Employment, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Person With Disability, Self-employment, Loan, Margin Money, Shop | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The "Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Disabled)" scheme was launched by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to empower persons with disabilities by providing financial assistance for sustainable self-employment and livelihood generation. Under this scheme, the beneficiaries are supported with a mix of grants, subsidized loans, and margin money for term loans, shop construction, and bank-linked enterprises.

## Benefits
**Term Loan Scheme:**


  - Project Cost: ₹75,000/-
  - Grant: 20% or ₹10,000/-, whichever is less
  - Term Loan: ₹65,000/- at 6% annual interest rate


**Shop Construction Scheme:**


  - Project Cost: ₹50,000/-
  - Grant: 20% or ₹10,000/-, whichever is less
  - Margin Money Loan: ₹40,000/- at 4% annual interest rate, repayable in 60 monthly installments


**Margin Money Loan Scheme for Bank Supported Loan:**


  - Project Cost: Up to ₹2,00,000/-
  - Grant: 20%, maximum of ₹10,000/-
  - Margin Money: 25% of the project cost at 4% annual interest rate, repayable in 36 monthly installments

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must possess a minimum of 40% disability. 
1. The applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹2,00,000 in urban areas and ₹1,60,000/- in rural areas.
1. The applicant’s age must be between 18 and 50 years.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
***Application Process:***
**Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the [application form](http://www.ukbvvn.org.in/Download/ApplicationFormFormatJeevika.pdf) from the official website. 
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the office of the Vikas Khand (Block Development) Office. 
&lt;br&gt;

***Selection Process:***
**Step 1:** The application will be forwarded to the District Social Welfare Officer.
**Step 2:** A District-Level Committee, headed by the District Social Welfare Officer, will review the proposals and select beneficiaries.

page_content:
# Nandaa Gaura Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Girl Child, Nanda, Gaura | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Nandaa Gaura Yojana" has been launched by the Department of Women Empowerment and Child Development, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for up to two girls in a family. The assistance is given in two installments per girl child: the first installment is provided at the time of birth if the girl is born in a hospital or ANM center, and the second installment is given when the girl passes Class 12th.
## Benefits Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to two girls of an eligible family in two installments for each girl child: - ₹11,000/- at the time of birth. - ₹51,000/- when the girl passes Class 12. For the first installment, the application must be submitted within six months of the girl’s birth, and the child must be born in a hospital/ANM center. For the second installment, the application can be submitted when the girl passes Class 12. Applications are invited from July to November of the same year in which she passes. If applied in the next year, the application will not be considered valid. The second installment will be granted only if the girl has passed Class 12 from the Uttarakhand Board, Secondary Education Board of other states, CBSE, ICSE, or the National Institute of Open Schooling, New Delhi, and the girl must be unmarried.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant family must be permanent residents of Uttarakhand. 2. The family’s monthly income should not exceed ₹6,000/-, or the family should belong to the BPL category to be eligible. 3. The benefit is applicable for up to two girls per family. 4. It is mandatory for the mother/father/guardian to submit an affidavit regarding availing or not availing the benefit of the scheme for other girl children in the family in the past. The affidavit must include the following declarations: - All information regarding movable and immovable properties and other details sought by me have been provided correctly. - I certify that this benefit is being availed for my first/second daughter. - No facts have been concealed by me. - I have provided the details of all family bank accounts along with bank statements for the last one year. - In the case of applying after passing Class 12, I confirm that my daughter is unmarried. 5. Girls living in Nari Niketan, Balika Niketan, orphanages, or other state government-aided homes will be exempted from the requirement of birth certificate, permanent residence certificate, income certificate, or parent’s name to avail the benefit after passing Class 12.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** https://nandagaura.uk.gov.in/ - To avail the benefits of this scheme, the girl child or her parents/guardians must register on the official portal [https://www.nandagaurauk.in](https://www.nandagaurauk.in/) - Aadhaar card and mobile number are mandatory for registration. After completing the registration, it is necessary to upload the required documents within the stipulated time to apply for benefits. - For claiming benefits at the birth of a girl child, the following documents are required: Maternal Child Immunization/MCP (Vaccination) card, latest passport size photograph of the girl child, birth registration certificate, mother’s institutional delivery certificate, signature of the mother/father/guardian, Aadhaar card, PAN card, bank account linked with Aadhaar, mobile number, and permanent residence certificate. - For claiming benefits after passing the 12th standard, the applicant must submit: latest passport size photograph, signature, Aadhaar card, PAN card, bank account linked with Aadhaar, permanent residence certificate, high school certificate, mark sheet and certificate of passing Class 12th, or a self-attested mark sheet in case of passing from National Open School or other recognized institutions. Additionally, a copy of the admission record in higher education (if available) and a certificate of passing Class 12th issued by the Principal (for institutional students only) are required. - In addition to the above, the following documents are necessary for availing benefits under both installments: certificate of Anganwadi worker, ration card, copy of family register or certificate issued by member/councilor, income certificate or BPL certificate, house tax receipt issued by the urban/rural local body or, in the absence of a house tax receipt, a certificate issued by the village headman/councilor, documents of rent agreement (if applicable), copy of bank passbook or one-year bank statement of all family members, family status assessment from the Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC), affidavit, other relevant documents, copies of the last three electricity bills of the family, and the latest water bill (or mention in the affidavit if no connection exists). - Once the online application is submitted, verification will be carried out by the concerned department. If all documents and details are found correct after verification, the benefit amount is credited directly into the applicant’s bank account, subject to the availability of budget.

# Pension Scheme for Elderly, Destitute Artists, Litterateurs and Writers of Uttarakhand State **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Pension, Artists, Writer, Litterateurs | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Pension Scheme for Elderly, Destitute Artists, Litterateurs, and Writers of Uttarakhand” was introduced by the Department of Culture and Endowments, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to elderly and impoverished artists, litterateurs and writers who have dedicated their lives to the development of art, culture, and literature and have made significant and distinguished contributions.
## Benefits The department provides a monthly pension of ₹3,000/- to the beneficiaries under this scheme.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be an elderly, destitute artist, litterateur, or writer from Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have dedicated their life to the development of art, culture, and literature. 1. The applicant must have made significant and distinguished contributions in their field. 1. The applicant must be at least 60 years of age. 1. The applicant must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - To avail the benefits under the pension scheme, applicants can register and apply through the “Apuni Sarkar Uttarakhand” portal available at [https://eservices.uk.gov.in](https://eservices.uk.gov.in/). Along with the application form, the eligible applicant must submit complete details of themselves and their family, along with necessary documents such as Aadhaar card, permanent residence certificate of Uttarakhand, PAN card, bank account details, educational qualification certificate, caste certificate, birth certificate or age certificate issued by a medical officer, a certificate related to artist/litterateur/writer issued by a government, semi-government, non-government or other recognized institution, a certificate of being an artist, and a recommendation from the district administration. - The process is considered complete only after these documents are uploaded on the portal by signing up at the "Apuni Sarkar Uttarakhand” Portal, [https://eservices.uk.gov.in](https://eservices.uk.gov.in/). After the submission, the applications are scrutinized by the Director General/Director and then presented before a committee constituted under the chairmanship of the Secretary/Principal Secretary. The committee verifies the submitted documents and calls the concerned artist for an interview. If found eligible during the interview and document verification, the pension is recommended. Subsequently, the Directorate of Culture disburses the approved pension amount to the artist every month. - In the event of the death of an artist or litterateur, the monthly pension is transferred to their spouse as a dependent. At present, the Directorate of Culture is providing monthly pension benefits to a total of 123 elderly and indigent artists.

page_content:
# Procedure for Admission in Government Child Care Institution, Government Communication Home and Open Shelter Home **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Housing & Shelter, Women and Child | **Tags:** Child Care Institution, Government Communication Home, Open Shelter Home, Orphan Children, Destitute Children, Abandoned Children | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Procedure for Admission in Government Child Care Institution, Government Communication Home, and Open Shelter Home” has been implemented by the Women Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to support orphaned, destitute, abandoned, neglected, and vulnerable children by providing them with clothing, food, accommodation, medical care, counselling, education, training, and other essential facilities.
## Benefits In the institutions and homes, children are provided with free facilities such as clothing, food, accommodation, medical care, counselling, entertainment, training, and education. Along with these facilities, children are also provided day care facility based on their needs.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. In Government Child Care Institutions, orphaned/destitute children, abandoned children, surrendered children, exploited and neglected children, and victimized children are admitted. 1. In Government Communication Homes, children who are in conflict with the law or have violated the law are admitted. 1. In Open Shelter Homes, destitute children living on the roadside, beggars, ragpickers, and children from slums who do not attend school are admitted.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Through the Child Welfare Committee and the Juvenile Justice Board, concerned children are admitted to the respective institutions. Complaints can also be lodged through the toll-free number 1098. At present, the following institutions/homes have been established in the state: - Government Child Care Institutions: A total of 05 institutions established in Dehradun, Haridwar, and Almora. - Government Communication Homes: A total of 10 homes established in Almora, Dehradun, Haridwar, Nainital, Uttarkashi, Pauri, and Udham Singh Nagar. - Open Shelter Homes: A total of 07 homes established in Dehradun, Nainital, and Haridwar.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹600/- for students in Class 1 to 5 and ₹960/- for students in Class 6 to 8, to regularly enrolled disable students.

page_content:
# Scholarship to Divyang Students (Class 1 to 8) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Student, PwD, Disabled Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Scholarship to Divyang Students (Class 1 to 8)” scheme has been implemented by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to regularly enrolled disable students from Class 1 to 8.
## Benefits ***Rate of Scholarships:*** - **Class 1 to 5:** ₹600/- - **Class 6 to 8:** ₹960/-
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a disabled student. 1. The applicant must be studying in Class 1 to 8. 1. The applicant’s annual family income must be less than ₹24,000/-. 1. The student must not availing benefits from any other scholarship scheme.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - Students can apply online for scholarship by visiting the NSP Portal of Government of India [(https://scholarships.gov.in/]((https://scholarships.gov.in/)). - The following documents will be attached with the application: Aadhaar card of the applicant, mobile number, certified photo and CBS bank account which is Aadhaar linked/seeded, previous class passed mark sheet, disability certificate, income certificate, self-declaration certificate that the applicant is not taking benefit of any other scholarship scheme of the government. - The student sends the application to his/her educational institution; the concerned educational institution verifies the application form and forwards it online to the District Social Welfare Officer. - The District Social Welfare Officer examines the received application form and gets the complete application forms physically verified. Incomplete applications (which can be corrected) are temporarily marked as defective, otherwise they are completely rejected. The scholarship amount is paid to the eligible applicants directly in their bank account in the financial year as per the availability of budget.

metadata.schemeName: Teelu Rauteli Pension Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of ₹1,200/- to male and female individuals above 18 years of age who have incurred a partial disability of 20% to 40% while performing agricultural activities.

page_content:
# Teelu Rauteli Pension Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Pension, Agricultural Activities, Disability, PwD | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Teelu Rauteli Pension" has been launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to male/female individuals above 18 years of age who have incurred a partial disability of 20% to 40% while performing agricultural activities.
## Benefits - A pension of ₹1,200/- per month is provided to each eligible beneficiary.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be male or female engaged in agricultural activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must be 20% to 40% disabled while performing agricultural work. 1. There is no income limit to avail the benefits of the scheme.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online The applicant can apply online either by themselves or through a Common Service Center (CSC) via the Department’s Pension Portal ([https://ssp.uk.gov.in](https://ssp.uk.gov.in)), the [UMANG](https://web.umang.gov.in) Mobile App, or the Apuni Sarkar Portal ([https://eservices.uk.gov.in](https://eservices.uk.gov.in)). **The following documents are mandatory at the time of applying:** Applicant’s mobile number, Passport-size photograph (attested by Gram Pradhan / V.P.D.O. / certified by Councillor), Photocopy of Aadhaar card and Voter ID card, Certificate from the Agriculture Officer confirming injury while performing agricultural work, Disability certificate issued by the Chief Medical Officer for 20% to 40% disability, Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card, CBS bank account details (linked/seeded with Aadhaar), Copy of family register (for rural areas only), Copy of the resolution passed in the open meeting of Gram Panchayat (for rural areas) / certified by Councillor (for urban areas) **Income certificate is not required.** **All the above documents must be issued from the district where the application is being submitted.** > For verification of the online application form in rural areas, the final decision is taken by the District Social Welfare Officer after recommendations from the Gram Panchayat Development Officer, Assistant Social Welfare Officer, and Block Development Officer, respectively. In urban areas, verification and recommendation are done by the Assistant Social Welfare Officer and Sub-District Magistrate. If the application is found correct, the District Social Welfare Officer approves it, after which the pension payment process is initiated. **The pension is credited to the applicant’s bank account one month after the approval of the application.**

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kalyani Vivah Sahayta Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to widowed women during remarriage. It offers a one-time support of ₹2,00,000 to eligible kalyani beneficiaries.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Kalyani Vivah Sahayta Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Madhya Pradesh | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child | **Tags:** Widow, Marriage, Financial Assistance, Social Security | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Mukhyamantri Kalyani Vivah Sahayta Yojana" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The aim to provide social security and financial support to widowed women at the time of their remarriage. Under this scheme, a one-time financial assistance is deposited into the beneficiary’s savings bank account to help ensure economic stability and dignified reintegration into family life.
## Benefits Financial assistance of ₹2,00,000 is provided to widowed women at the time of their remarriage > **NOTE:** - Financial assistance is directly deposited into the beneficiary’s bank savings account. - The assistance is provided only once in a lifetime.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a widowed woman (Kalyani). 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh, and her spouse must also be a permanent resident. 1. The applicant must be 18 years or older, and her husband must be 21 years or older at the time of marriage. 1. The applicant must not be an income taxpayer. 1. The applicant must not be a government employee of the state, central government, or government-funded corporations and institutions. 1. The applicant must not be receiving a family pension from any government source. 1. There is no restriction of BPL under the scheme. 1. The husband must not have any living wife from a previous marriage. 1. There will be no compulsion to marry in a mass marriage ceremony for the Kalyani Vivah Yojana; individual marriages will also be considered valid. 1. The Kalyani has minor children, the responsibility for the children's upkeep will be jointly borne by the Kalyani and her husband.
## Exclusions 1. The applicant cannot claim benefits from other marriage assistance schemes such as Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah/Nikah Yojana or Nishaktjan Vivah Protsahan Yojana 1. Marriages performed before 06 April 2018 are not eligible. 1. The Kalyani's (widow's) marriage is solemnized in a mass marriage ceremony under the Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah/Nikah Yojana, only the benefit of the Kalyani Vivah Yojana will be admissible. 1. The Kalyani herself is disabled, or her husband is disabled, or both spouses are disabled, only the benefit of the Kalyani Vivah Sahayta will be admissible in that situation as well.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Application Process** **Step 1:** The applicant visit the official website [Vivah Portal](https://vivahportal.mp.gov.in/Default.aspx#) **Step 2:** Click on the "[Apply for Kalyani Marriage](https://vivahportal.mp.gov.in/Public/Pages/Online_Registration_Kalyani.aspx)" and fill Applicant Profile Entry - Enter the 9-digit Samagra ID of the applicant (Kalyani). - Verify the auto-populated profile details such as name, date of birth, district, etc. - If any discrepancy is found, initiate data updation before proceeding. **Step 3:** Groom Details Entry - Enter the 9-digit Samagra ID of the applicant’s husband. - Verify his profile details with the submitted documents. - If correct, select YES to move to the next process. **Step 4:** Entering Additional Information - Personal and Eligibility Details - Enter the applicant’s mobile number, Aadhaar number (if available), occupation, and annual income. - Enter the husband’s Aadhaar number (if available). - Record all eligibility-related declarations: Not an income tax payer, a government employee/officer and not receiving family pension **Step 5:** Bank Account Information Carefully enter the IFSC code and bank account number of the applicant. **Step 6:** Uploading Marriage Details & Documents - Marriage Information - Enter the following details accurately: Type of marriage, Place and Date of marriage - Marriage certificate issue date, certificate number, and name/designation of issuing authority - Joint photograph of the applicant and her husband (marriage photo) - Marriage certificate **Step 7:** Registering and Locking the Application After all entries and uploads are completed, Register the application. Review all details once again. Click Lock Application to forward it for verification and approval. > **Approval / Rejection Process** **Step 1:** The Joint/Deputy Director logs in and selects “Mukhyamantri Kalyani Vivah Sahayata Yojana” from the portal menu. **Step 2:** Based on the verification of documents and committee recommendations, approve (Sanction) or reject the application. **Step 3:** After approval, navigate to the list of sanctioned applications. **Step 4:** Generate Sanction Order” next to the beneficiary’s name. > **Appeal Process** If the appellate authority does not resolve the application within the prescribed time limit or if the application is rejected, the applicant may file an appeal as follows: - First Appellate Authority: Divisional Commissioner - Time Period: 30 working days - Second Appellate Authority: Commissioner, Social Justice and Disabled Welfare - Time Period: 30 working days **NOTE 1:** The applicant must submit proof that her previous husband is deceased (death certificate). **NOTE 2:** The applicant must apply within 1 year of marriage.
**Mode:** Offline > **Application Process** **Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the application form page no. 6 ([Annexure A](https://socialjustice.mp.gov.in/uploads/schemes/Order__64(1).pdf)) from the official website. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the respective Collector Office or the Joint/Deputy Director (Social Justice and Disabled Welfare). > **Approval Process** **Step 1:** A Verification Committee, chaired by the Chief Executive Officer (District Panchayat), examines the application and documents. **Step 2:** The committee forwards its recommendation to the District Collector for approval or rejection. **Step 3:** The District Collector is the final sanctioning authority. **Step 4:** The Collector must approve or reject the application within 30 days. > **Appeal Process** If the appellate authority does not resolve the application within the prescribed time limit or if the application is rejected, the applicant may file an appeal as follows: - First Appellate Authority: Divisional Commissioner - Time Period: 30 working days - Second Appellate Authority: Commissioner, Social Justice and Disabled Welfare - Time Period: 30 working days **NOTE 1:** The applicant must submit proof that her previous husband is deceased (death certificate). **NOTE 2:** The applicant must apply within 1 year of marriage.

metadata.schemeName: Kisan Credit Card Scheme for Fisheries- Chief Minister Fishermen Prosperity Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide short-term loans for fisheries. It offers zero-percent interest working capital to the fish farmers through cooperative banks.

page_content:
# Kisan Credit Card Scheme for Fisheries- Chief Minister Fishermen Prosperity Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Madhya Pradesh | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Credit Card, Loan, Fishermen, Fish Farmer | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Kisan Credit Card Scheme for Fisheries” is a component scheme under the "Chief Minister Fishermen Prosperity Scheme" launched by the Fisheries Welfare and Fisheries Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. Under this scheme, working capital is provided at a zero percent interest rate through cooperative banks to the fish farmers engaged in fisheries operations. The scheme offers interest subvention to ensure affordable credit for beneficiaries and reduce their financial burden.
## Benefits - Short-term working capital loans for fisheries activities under the Kisan Credit Card (KCC) facility. - Fish farmers receive interest subvention, enabling access to zero-percent interest loans through cooperative banks. - The loan amount is determined as per bank norms and scheme provisions, based on the financial requirement of the fish farmer.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a landholding farmer, marginal farmer, small farmer, fish farmer, livestock owner, BPL beneficiary, unorganized worker card holder, or registered worker. 1. The applicant must be engaged in fisheries activities.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the District Fisheries Office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District Fisheries Office.
