metadata.schemeName: Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and around Forest Areas: Assistance for Damage to Houses Due to Wild Elephant Attacks
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to residents of Uttarakhand whose houses, boundary walls, huts, or kutcha structures are damaged by wild elephants.

page_content:
# Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and around Forest Areas: Assistance for Damage to Houses Due to Wild Elephant Attacks **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Housing & Shelter | **Tags:** Damage To Houses, Elephant, Wild Elephant Attacks, Damage | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Assistance for Damage to Houses Due to Wild Elephant Attacks” is a sub-component of the umbrella scheme “Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and Around Forest Areas”, which is implemented by the Department of Forest, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to residents of Uttarakhand whose houses, boundary walls, huts, or kutcha structures are damaged by wild elephants.
## Benefits **At present, the following compensation amounts are provided in the event of house damage caused by wild elephants:** **Type of House****(a) Completely Damaged/ Destroyed House****Total Amount payable (in ₹ per house)****Share of State Disaster Response Fund (in ₹ per house)****Share of Human Wildlife Conflict Relief Distribution Fund (in ₹ per house)**Kutcha house/ Pakka house (Completely damaged)(i) Kutcha house (ii) Pakka house₹95,000/-₹95,000/---Kutcha House (Partially damaged)Kutcha House (Partially damaged)₹20,000/---₹20,000/-Damage to boundary wall of a pucca house and partial damage to a pucca house(b) Partially Damaged House (i) A pucca house (other than a hut) where the damage is at least 15%₹15,000/-₹5,200/-₹9,800/-Damage to boundary wall of a pucca house and partial damage to a pucca housePartially Damaged House (i) Kutcha house (other than hut) where the damage is at least 15% ₹3,200/-₹3,200/---In case of damage to hut or house made of strawDamaged/destroyed hut₹5,000/-₹4,100/-₹900/-
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The compensation is provided for damage to houses caused by wild elephants in and around forest areas of Uttarakhand.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - In case of damage to a house due to an attack by wild elephants, the incident must be reported in writing to the concerned Range Office within two days. It will then be immediately verified by the Forest Inspector or Deputy Forest Range Officer. After the damage has been jointly assessed by the Naib Tehsildar and the Range Officer of the concerned area, the investigation report will be submitted to the Assistant Conservator of Forests/Wildlife Warden, who will conduct a final investigation and forward the report to the Divisional Forest Officer/Deputy Director within one month. - Upon receiving the final report, the Divisional Forest Officer/Deputy Director has full authority to approve and disburse the ex-gratia compensation. The Divisional Forest Officer/Deputy Director will also ensure that complete details of the case are communicated to the Chief Wildlife Warden. ***Note: The Forest Department has issued a toll-free number - 1800-890-9715. Anyone can use this number to report human-wildlife incidents or the presence of wildlife in populated areas anywhere in the state.***

# Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and around Forest Areas: Assistance for Crop Losses Due to Wild Animal Attacks **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Crop Losses, Wild Animal Attacks, Compensation For Crop Losses, Wild Animal, Farmer | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Assistance for Crop Losses Due to Wild Animal Attacks” is a sub-component of the umbrella scheme “Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and Around Forest Areas”, which is implemented by the Department of Forest, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to farmers for crop losses caused by wild animals in forest areas and their surrounding regions, thereby mitigating economic losses and supporting farmers’ livelihoods.


## Benefits **At present, the following compensation amounts are provided in the event of crop damage caused by wild animal attacks:** **Type of Agricultural Crop****Total Amount Payable (per Acre)****Share of Human Wildlife Conflict Relief Distribution Fund**Sugarcane (Entire Crop)₹25,000/- per acre₹25,000/- per acrePaddy/Wheat/Oilseeds (Entire Crop)₹15,000/- per acre₹15,000/- per acreIn case of damage to all types of crops other than those mentioned above (Entire Crop)₹8,000/- per acre₹8,000/- per acre
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The compensation is applicable for crop damage caused by wild elephants, wild boars, nilgai, kakar, sambar, chital, and monkeys.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - The information must be submitted in writing to the local forest officer within two days of the incident. Following this, the Tehsildar/Patwari and the local forest officer of the area will jointly verify and assess the crop damage. The investigation report will then be forwarded to the concerned Assistant Conservator of Forests/Wildlife Warden through the Range Officer. - The Assistant Conservator of Forests/Wildlife Warden is required to submit the final investigation report to the Divisional Forest Officer/Deputy Director within two months of the incident. Upon receiving the final report, the Divisional Forest Officer/Deputy Director has full authority to approve and disburse the ex-gratia compensation. The Divisional Forest Officer/Deputy Director will also ensure that complete details of the case are communicated to the Chief Wildlife Warden. ***Note: The Forest Department has issued a toll-free number – 1800-890-9715. Anyone can use this number to report wildlife incidents, including accidents involving humans or the presence of wildlife in populated areas anywhere in the state.***

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote solo theatrical performances and encourage talent in the field of drama across Gujarat. A state-level solo drama competition is organized with cash prizes awarded to winners and special category performers.

page_content:
# Solo Drama Competition **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Drama, Competition, Artist, Theatre, Award, Prize | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Solo Drama Competition" was launched by the Department of Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to promote solo theatrical performances and encourage talent in the field of drama across Gujarat by organizing a state-level competition that recognizes excellence in acting, direction, writing, and scene composition. The scheme provides cash prizes to winning participants, with the first prize winner receiving ₹2,000/- and the second prize winner receiving ₹1,500/-, along with special category awards of ₹500/- each for Original Drama, Best Director, Best Writer, and Best Scene Composition. The applicant must be willing to participate in the state-level solo drama competition and perform a solo theatrical act.
## Benefits - First prize winner receives ₹2,000/-. - Second prize winner receives ₹1,500/-. - Original Drama category winner receives ₹500/-. - Best Director receives ₹500/-. - Best Writer receives ₹500/-. - Best Scene Composition receives ₹500/-. _*The benefits are disbursed as one-time cash prizes awarded after the competition results are declared._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be willing to participate in a solo drama competition. - The applicant must perform a solo theatrical act as per the competition requirements.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Visit the official website of 'Mari Yojana' at [https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in). In the search bar provided at the top of the page, type 'Competition'. All the schemes of the Government of Gujarat having the word 'Competition' will be listed. **Step 2:** From the list, click on the scheme 'Solo Drama Competition'. You will be taken to the schemes page. Navigate and download the application form of the scheme. The application form is available in both Gujarati and English languages, and the applicant should take print of the form in their preferred language. **Step 3:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 4:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the designated authority at the Gujarat State Sangeet Natak Academy. **Step 5:** After successful submission, the applicant will receive an acknowledgement or reference number. The applicant should save this reference number for future correspondence and tracking of the application status.
> ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** Once the application is approved, the applicant will be notified about the date, time, and venue of the state-level solo drama competition. The applicant must attend the competition at the scheduled time and perform their solo drama act before the judges. **Step 2:** After the competition concludes, the results will be evaluated and declared by the organizing committee. Winners will be notified through official channels, and prizes will be distributed to the first and second prize winners, as well as special category award recipients as per the scheme guidelines.

metadata.schemeName: Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and around Forest Areas: Assistance in case of Death/Injury/Disability due to Wild Animal Attack
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide timely financial assistance and relief to individuals or their dependents in cases of death, injury, or disability caused by attacks from wild animals such as tigers, leopards, elephants, bears, crocodiles, snakes, and other specified species in and around forest

page_content:
# Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and around Forest Areas: Assistance in case of Death/Injury/Disability due to Wild Animal Attack **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Wild Animal Attack, Injury Compensation, Death Compensation, Disability Assistance, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Assistance in Case of Death/Injury/Disability Due to Wild Animal Attack” is a sub-component of the umbrella scheme “Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and Around Forest Areas”, which is implemented by the Department of Forest, Government of Uttarakhand. The aim of the scheme is to provide timely financial assistance and relief to individuals or their dependents in cases of death, injury, or disability caused by attacks from wild animals such as tigers, leopards, elephants, bears, crocodiles, snakes, and other specified species in and around forest areas.
## Benefits ***The following compensation amounts are currently given in case of injury/death of a person due to wildlife attack:*** **Type of Human Injury****Rates payable for ex-gratia amount as per Human Wildlife Conflict Relief Distribution Rules, 2024****As per Norms of State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF)****Source of Payment : Amount payable from State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF)****Source of Payment : Amount payable under Human Wildlife Conflict Relief Distribution Fund Rules 2024**Minor Injury1. ₹15,000/- 2. 16,000/- A deep wound that requires hospitalization: 1. ₹5,400/- per person 2. ₹16,000/- per person₹9,600/- per personSerious Injury₹1,00,000/-A deep wound that requires hospitalization: 1. ₹5,400/- per person 2. ₹16,000/- per person1. ₹94,600/- per person 2. ₹84,000/- per personPartial Disability₹1,00,000/-Loss of any body part (including penis) or eye/eyes: Disability between 40% and 60%: ₹74,000/- per person. ₹74,000/- per person₹26,000/- per personTotal Disability₹3,00,000/- ₹3.00 lakh per person for disability exceeding 60%, subject to certification by a doctor from a Government hospital or dispensary confirming the extent and cause of the disability.₹2,50,000/- per person₹50,000/- per personIn Case of Death of an Adult or a Minor₹6,00,000/- ₹4.00 lakh per person: This includes individuals involved in relief operations or preparedness activities, subject to certification of the cause of death by the competent authority.₹4,00,000/- per person₹2,00,000/- per person***However, for compensation provided for human injury caused by wild animals, it is illegal for family members or any other person to claim the ex-gratia amount if an elderly, medically unfit, disabled, mentally unstable, or minor person is left alone in the forest and is harmed by wild animals.***
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant or their dependent must have suffered death, injury, or disability due to an attack by a wild animal such as: - Tiger - Leopard - Snow Leopard - Wild Elephant - All three species of bear - Hyena - Wild Boar - Crocodile / Gharial - Snake
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - In the event of death, serious injury, or disability caused by a wild animal, 30% of the total compensation amount payable for the incident will be provided to the victim or dependent as an advance. This will be based on the confirmation of the incident by the village head of the affected area, any currently serving public representative, and the forest guard of the concerned area. The advance will be provided within a maximum of 48 hours (excluding public holidays) from the receipt of information regarding the loss of life or property. - The remaining amount will be paid upon receipt of the final investigation report. For the payment of the compensation, the Aadhar card, mobile number, and bank account details of the victim or dependent are required. - In cases where a person is killed, seriously injured, or disabled by a wild animal, a certificate issued by a state government doctor must be submitted to the office of the concerned Divisional Forest Officer (DFO) or Deputy Director. The DFO/Deputy Director will then have full authority to approve or release the ex-gratia payment based on the final investigation report prepared by the concerned Assistant Conservator of Forests or Wildlife Warden. The DFO/Deputy Director will also forward complete details of the case to the Chief Wildlife Warden. - The final investigation report must be submitted within 15 days of the incident. Before making the final payment of the ex-gratia amount, a certificate will be obtained from the Revenue Department regarding the dependents of the deceased. If the final investigation report does not confirm that the victim was killed, seriously injured, or disabled by a wild animal, the advance amount paid to the victim or dependent will be recovered as revenue. **Note:** The Forest Department has issued a toll-free number, 1800-890-9715, where any person can report human-wildlife incidents or the presence of wildlife in populated areas anywhere in the state.

metadata.schemeName: Scheme For Residential Education For Students in High Schools in Targeted Areas (SHRESHTA): Mode 2 - NGO Operated Schools
metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
metadata.briefDescription: The sub-scheme aims to provide quality education and opportunities to students from SC communities through grant-in-aid institutions run by Non-Governmental Organizations and residential high schools, addressing the gap in service deficient Scheduled Caste dominant areas in the education sector.

page_content:
# Scheme For Residential Education For Students in High Schools in Targeted Areas (SHRESHTA): Mode 2 - NGO Operated Schools **Ministry:** Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Student, Education, School, Hostel, Grant | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The umbrella scheme "Scheme for Residential Education for Students in High Schools in Targeted Areas (SHRESHTA)" was launched by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India. The scheme has a sub-scheme/component called "SHRESHTA Mode 2: Non-Governmental Organization Operated Schools". The sub-scheme aims to provide quality education and opportunities to students from Scheduled Caste communities through grant-in-aid institutions run by Non-Governmental Organizations and residential high schools, addressing the gap in service deficient Scheduled Caste dominant areas in the education sector. The scheme provides financial assistance to Non-Governmental Organization operated schools and hostels for school fees and residential charges for Scheduled Caste students, along with infrastructure support and monitoring mechanisms to ensure quality education delivery.
## Benefits ##### ***Financial Assistance*** _(Electronic transfer through e-Anudaan portal and Public Financial Management System)_ **Primary Level Students** - Residential: ₹44,000/- per Scheduled Caste student per year. - Non-residential: ₹27,000/- per Scheduled Caste student per year. - Hostel only: ₹30,000/- per Scheduled Caste student per year. **Secondary Level Students** - Residential: ₹55,000/- per Scheduled Caste student per year. - Non-residential: ₹35,000/- per Scheduled Caste student per year. - Hostel only: ₹30,000/- per Scheduled Caste student per year. **Non-Recurring Grants (Every 5 Years)** - Secondary Residential School (100 students): ₹3,85,000/- for fixed items plus ₹900/- per student. - Secondary Non-residential School (100 students): ₹3,07,500/- fixed. - Secondary Hostel (100 students): ₹2,30,000/- for fixed items plus ₹900/- per student. - Primary Residential School (100 students): ₹2,72,500/- for fixed items plus ₹900/- per student. - Primary Non-residential School (100 students): ₹1,95,000/- fixed. - Hostel for destitute Children (100 students): ₹2,30,000/- for fixed items plus ₹900/- per student. ##### ***Attendance-Based Grant Disbursement*** - 75% or more attendance: Full grant. - 50% to less than 75% attendance: 75% of grant. - 25% to less than 50% attendance: 50% of grant. - Less than 25% attendance: No grant (without valid grounds).
## Eligibility Criteria ##### ***Eligibility for the Organization*** - The applicant must be a reputed school chain, Corporate Social Responsibility foundation, or reputed organization running good quality schools. - The applicant must be registered and working in quality school education. - The applicant must have schools recognized by the State Government and affiliated to State or Central Boards. - The applicant must have a properly constituted Managing Committee with powers, duties and responsibilities clearly defined in written Constitution. - The applicant must have appropriate administrative structure and duly constituted Managing or Executive Committee. - The applicant must be initiated and governed by its own members on democratic principles. - The applicant must be a non-profit entity. - The applicant should have its own website for pro-active disclosure of information. - The applicant must be registered on the Non-Governmental Organization Darpan portal of National Institution for Transforming India Aayog. - The applicant must have been receiving Grant-in-aid and showing satisfactory performance. - The applicant must maintain higher classes up to at least Class 12th. - The applicant organization running primary schools (Classes 1st to 8th) must upgrade to Secondary or Senior Secondary Schools (up to at least Class 10th) before 2027. ##### ***Eligibility for the Student*** - The beneficiary must belong to Scheduled Caste community. - The beneficiary must be admitted in schools run by eligible Non-Governmental Organizations under this scheme. ##### ***Infrastructure-related Eligibility Requirements*** - The applicant must have one classroom for each class or section. - The applicant must have sufficient benches and desks or chairs and tables for all students. - The applicant must provide one decent cot and bed for every child in residential facilities. - The applicant must have light and fans for every classroom and residing room. - The applicant must have female service staff, wardens and chowkidars for girls' residential schools with adequate security provisions. - The applicant must have one toilet and bathroom for every 10 children maintained in clean and hygienic condition. - The applicant must have hygienic kitchen and dining room. - The applicant should provide nutritious and sufficient food to students thrice a day with maintained records. - The applicant must provide clean and safe drinking water facility to students. - The applicant should arrange regular doctor visits with maintained records and keep first-aid boxes and emergency medicines. - The applicant should provide 4 sets of uniforms including shoes per year to students with maintained distribution records. - The applicant should have games and sports facility, physical education, yoga, and playground available for students. - The applicant must install Closed Circuit Television cameras with linkage to website for live streaming. - The applicant must have Aadhaar based attendance system integrated into central portal. ##### ***School Performance Standards*** - The applicant school must have Class 10th and Class 12th pass percentage not less than average Board result of the State or Central Board. - The applicant must have qualified and well-trained teachers as per standards of State or Central Board. - The applicant must have teachers in High Schools who are at least graduates in their respective fields with Bachelor of Education qualification. - The applicant must maintain minimum 6 teachers in a school and minimum 2 teachers in a hostel. - The applicant should pay honorariums to teachers and staff in time as per minimum rates prevailing in the district.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:****** ***Registration and Application Submission*** - Organizations must register on the NGO Darpan portal and get a project ID from the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment. - Submit your application on the e-Anudaan portal between April 1st and June 30th. - Include all required details for your organization, project, and students (both new and renewals). **Step 2:****** ***Document Preparation and Submission*** - Gather and submit key documents like project details, budget, and previous year's performance reports. - Upload all necessary forms to the e-Anudaan portal. - While state government recommendations are ideal, applications may still be considered after a project inspection. **Step 3:****** ***Physical Inspection and Verification*** - A team from the Ministry's Programme Management Unit will inspect your organization. - The inspection, preferably during the first academic quarter, will assess your infrastructure and performance. - Continued grant support depends on demonstrating satisfactory performance and adherence to all scheme guidelines. **Step 4:****** ***Agreement and Bank Account Setup*** - You must sign an Agreement Bond to receive assistance. - Set up a joint-operation bank account for electronic fund transfers. - All bank account details must be verified through the Public Financial Management System before funds can be released. **Step 5:****** ***Grant Release and Ongoing Compliance*** - Grants are released in three installments after the application is complete and the inspection report is submitted. - Maintain separate accounts for scheme grants and submit utilization certificates to continue receiving funding. - Your organization is required to maintain proper records and provide real-time updates on your website and the e-Anudaan portal. ***Application Deadlines:*** Portal opens on 1st April for renewal students and closes on 30th June for fresh student entries annually. ***Application Status Tracking:*** Status can be tracked through e-Anudaan portal at www.grants-msje.gov.in with real-time data management information system integration. ***Grievance Redressal / Help & Support:*** Applications and queries to be addressed through e-Anudaan portal www.grants-msje.gov.in under Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment supervision.

metadata.schemeName: Award Winning Tiatr Festival
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to popularize award winning tiatrs by organizing annual festivals in various Talukas of Goa. It provides financial remuneration to directors/producers of prize-winning tiatrs for staging performances.

page_content:
# Award Winning Tiatr Festival **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Culture, Artist, Director, Producer, Competition | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Award Winning Tiatr Festival" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to popularize award winning tiatrs by organizing an annual festival comprising of tiatrs which have won 1st, 2nd and 3rd places in various competitions, and will be organized in various Talukas of Goa with venues decided by Tiatr Academy of Goa. The scheme provides financial remuneration to directors/producers for staging their award-winning tiatrs and covers payment to service providers for arranging stage, lights, sound etc. when no furnished auditorium is available. The applicant must be a director/producer of a tiatr that has won 1st, 2nd or 3rd place in specified competitions and must submit self-attested copies of Aadhaar and Permanent Account Number Card along with the application. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
## Benefits ##### ***Financial Remuneration for Tiatr Performance*** - Tiatr Academy of Goa Popular Tiatr winners: ₹40,000/- for each tiatr. - Kala Academy Group 'A' winners: ₹35,000/- for each tiatr. - Kala Academy Group 'B' winners: ₹30,000/- for each tiatr. - Tiatr Academy of Goa Children Tiatr winners: ₹25,000/- for each tiatr. ##### ***Infrastructure Support*** - Payment to service providers for arranging stage, lights, sound etc. at rates fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa (applicable when no furnished auditorium is available). ##### ***Performance Platform*** - Opportunity to showcase award-winning tiatrs in various Talukas of Goa. - Venues for the festival will be decided by Tiatr Academy of Goa.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be the director/producer of a tiatr that has won 1st, 2nd or 3rd place in any of the following competitions: - The applicant must be the director/producer of a tiatr that won 1st, 2nd or 3rd prize in Tiatr Academy of Goa Popular Tiatr Competition. - The applicant must be the director/producer of a tiatr that won 1st, 2nd or 3rd prize in Kala Academy Group 'A' tiatr Competition. - The applicant must be the director/producer of a tiatr that won 1st, 2nd or 3rd prize in Kala Academy Group 'B' tiatr Competition. - The applicant must be the director/producer of a tiatr that won 1st, 2nd or 3rd prize in Tiatr Academy of Goa Children's Tiatr Competition. ***Post-Selection Conditions*** - Presentation of tiatr including kantaram should be done exactly the way it was presented in the respective competitions. - The tiatr should be shown without charging tickets. - Non-adherence to performance norms may result in withholding the payments. - Tiatr Academy of Goa may depute an observer to verify whether the performance is as per the norms.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._

metadata.schemeName: Remembering Tiatr Artistes of Yesteryears - Organisation of Special Dedicated Programmes
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to make younger generation aware of the contribution and sacrifices of great tiatr personalities of the past. It provides collaboration and financial assistance to produce special dedicated programmes on late artistes.

page_content:
# Remembering Tiatr Artistes of Yesteryears - Organisation of Special Dedicated Programmes **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Artist, Culture, Program, Show, Auditorium | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Remembering Tiatr Artistes of Yesteryears - Organisation of Special Dedicated Programmes" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to make the younger generation aware of the contribution and sacrifices of great tiatr personalities of the past who are no more with us, addressing the problem that today's younger generation does not know much about these pioneers whose contribution to Goan tiatr is immense. The scheme provides collaboration with troupes/institutions/individuals for producing special dedicated programmes on the lives of particular artistes and financial assistance with auditorium/hall facilities for staging programmes. The applicant must be a troupe/institution/individual willing to produce special programmes dedicated to particular artistes and must obtain No Objection Certificate from the nearest family members of the late artiste. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa and applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
## Benefits **Financial Assistance:** Tiatr Academy of Goa will provide financial assistance as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa for each show. **Infrastructure Support:** Provision of auditorium/hall to stage the programme. **Village Performances:** Financial assistance as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa for erecting temporary pandal, providing stage, sound, etc. for village performances. **Additional Shows:** Option for additional 2 shows in villages at an amount as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa plus additional amount as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa for Pandal/Hall/Auditorium including Stage, Sound, etc. **Documentation:** Tiatr Academy of Goa will document the programme and preserve it at Tiatr Academy of Goa's library. **Marketing Materials:** Provision of banner for tiatr performances and logo for musical shows. **Number of Shows:** Maximum of 4 shows at different places including 1 show at the area of residence. _* Tiatr Academy of Goa has no objection if sponsorship is taken by the producer from other sources._
> ***Conditions*** _*All shows must be shown to the public free without charging any tickets._ _*Programme duration should be at least 2 hours for musical show and 3 hours for tiatr._ _*Display Tiatr Academy of Goa banner compulsorily on front side wing of stage for tiatr or minimum size of 6ft. x 10ft. backdrop with Tiatr Academy of Goa logo for musical show._ _*Return banner to Tiatr Academy of Goa after all shows are staged._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a troupe, institution, or individual. - The applicant must wish to produce and stage a special programme dedicated to a particular artiste of yesteryears. - The applicant must obtain No Objection Certificate from the nearest family members of the late artiste. - The applicant must invite family members compulsorily for the function. - The applicant must stage the inaugural show preferably in Panjim, Margao or in the village of the artiste where he resided. - The applicant must submit the proposal well in advance giving all details of the programme including script and lyrics to be presented including the names of the artistes. - The applicant must comply with all conditions specified by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must not make any adverse remark in any form either written or verbal against any Governments/Individuals/Institutions in the scripts/song lyrics/performances/speeches. - In all advertisements, oral, print or electronic media, banners, etc., the following must be inserted/published/announced: 'This programme is held in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa'. _* Tiatr Academy of Goa has no objection if sponsorship is taken by the producer from other sources._
***Programme Content Requirements*** - The programme must include staging of tiatr/one-act plays written by the artistes of yesteryears. - The programme can include musical activities such as songs and music composed and sung by the late artiste if he/she was a singer or music composer/musician. - The programme should include narration of history of the life of the late artiste to whom the programme is dedicated.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. Alternatively, the applicant may visit the office of Tiatr Academy of Goa to collect the form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ _*Applications are considered on a "First come First Serve" basis, subject to the availability of funds._ _*Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to make any changes in the rules._ _*If adverse remarks are proved, Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to disqualify the performance and refrain from making payment or recall the payment made._
##### **Post Application Processes** **Step 1:****** ***Coordinate with Tiatr Academy of Goa*** The applicant must discuss and decide about the Chief Guest/Guest of Honour well in advance with Tiatr Academy of Goa, as the President or Vice President of Tiatr Academy of Goa will either be the Chief Guest/Guest of Honour at the function. **Step 2:** ***Collect Banner and Materials*** The applicant must collect the banner from the office of Tiatr Academy of Goa before the performances (for tiatr) or arrange for backdrop with Tiatr Academy of Goa logo (for musical shows) and ensure proper display during all shows. **Step 3:** ***Stage Performances*** The applicant must stage the approved programme ensuring all conditions are met including free admission for public, proper acknowledgment of Tiatr Academy of Goa collaboration in all advertisements and media, and maintaining the specified duration for each type of performance. **Step 4:** ***Documentation and Reporting*** The applicant must document the programme through photographs and submit 5 copies to Tiatr Academy of Goa for records, ensuring two photographs show the Tiatr Academy of Goa banner during performance. **Step 5:** ***Submit Financial Documentation*** The applicant must prepare and submit a detailed statement of expenditure with all original bills (stamped receipts if amount exceeds ₹5,000/-) to Tiatr Academy of Goa for reimbursement of approved expenses. **Step 6:** ***Return Materials*** The applicant must return the Tiatr Academy of Goa banner to the office after all shows are completed to maintain the academy's inventory and complete the programme cycle.
##### ***Application Deadline*** Applications must reach the office of Tiatr Academy of Goa at least 30 days in advance along with typed script/lyrics.

metadata.schemeName: Popular Tiatr Competition
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to bring about all round development of Popular Tiatr through annual competitions. It provides cash prizes and awards to tiatr groups and individual artists performing in traditional tiatr format across Goa.

page_content:
# Popular Tiatr Competition **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Artist, Culture, Competition, Award, Acting, Singing | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Popular Tiatr Competition" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to bring about all round development of Popular Tiatr by organizing annual competitions in different parts of Goa, preserving and promoting the traditional format of tiatr performances. The scheme provides cash prizes ranging from ₹2,000/- to ₹2,00,000/- for various categories including performance, direction, acting, singing, and technical aspects, along with mementos and certificates for winners. The applicant must have completed at least 5 performances including Kantaram during the period from 1st April 2018 to 31st December 2018 and must perform in specified auditoriums across Goa. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline through submission of application forms along with required documents.
## Benefits ##### ***Cash Prizes for Performance Categories*** 1st Prize: ₹2,00,000/- and Memento; 2nd Prize: ₹1,50,000/- and Memento; 3rd Prize: ₹1,00,000/- and Memento ##### ***Individual Artist Awards (Acting)*** - 1st Prize (Male): ₹10,000/-; 2nd Prize (Male): ₹5,000/- - 1st Prize (Female): ₹10,000/-; 2nd Prize (Female): ₹5,000/- - Best Comedian (Male): ₹10,000/-; Best Comedian (Female): ₹10,000/- - Best Supporting Artist (Male): ₹5,000/-; Best Supporting Artist (Female): ₹5,000/- - Best Actor in Negative Role (Male): ₹5,000/-; Best Actor in Negative Role (Female): ₹5,000/- ##### ***Best Direction Awards*** 1st Prize: ₹15,000/-; 2nd Prize: ₹10,000/-; 3rd Prize: ₹5,000/- ##### ***Technical and Other Aspects*** - Best Setting: ₹10,000/-; Best Light Effects: ₹10,000/- - Best Live Music: ₹15,000/- (To be shared by all Musicians) - Best Make-up: ₹5,000/-; Best Costumes: ₹5,000/- - Best Background Music: ₹10,000/- ##### ***Best Singer Awards (Solo)*** - 1st Prize (Male): ₹10,000/-; 2nd Prize (Male): ₹5,000/- - 1st Prize (Female): ₹10,000/-; 2nd Prize (Female): ₹5,000/- - Child Artist (Male): ₹2,000/-; Child Artist (Female): ₹2,000/- ##### ***Best Actor (Child Artists)*** Child Artist (Male): ₹2,000/-; Child Artist (Female): ₹2,000/- ##### ***Other Songs Categories*** - Best Duet: ₹10,000/-; Best Duo: ₹10,000/-; Best Trio: ₹15,000/- - Best Quartet/Quintet: ₹20,000/- - Best Choral Song (Maximum four singers): ₹10,000/- - Best Comedy Kantar (solo): ₹5,000/- ##### ***Script and Lyrics Awards*** - Best Lyrics (1st Prize): ₹5,000/- - Best Script (1st Prize): ₹10,000/- - Best Script (2nd Prize): ₹5,000/- ##### ***Additional Benefits*** - Performance Fee: ₹5,000/- (only if the applicant gives consent to video record the performance). - Free DVD Copy: One copy of the performance recording will be provided to the applicant. - Video Recording: Expenditure on video recording will be borne by Tiatr Academy of Goa.
_*Awards will be announced and distributed in a specially organized Award Distribution Ceremony._ _*All prizes are one-time cash awards._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must have completed at least 5 performances including Kantaram during the period from 1st April to 31st December. - The applicant must perform in specified auditoriums including Ravindra Bhavan Margao, Gomant Vidya Niketan Margao, Hanuman Natyagraha Mapusa, Kala Academy Panjim, Rajiv Gandhi Kala Mandir Ponda, Ravindra Bhavan Vasco, Ravindra Bhavan Sanquelim, or Ravindra Bhavan Curchorem. - The applicant must present popular tiatrs having traditional format of the tiatr. - The applicant must maintain the traditional format strictly as specified. - The applicant must communicate the date, time and place of staging of the tiatr in the competition to the organizers at least 15 days in advance from the date of performance. - The applicant must arrange for 6 passes for the Judges and the Organizers at the performance of the Competition show. - The applicant must ensure live music with a band consisting of at least 5 instruments which shall include drums, keyboard, bass, guitar and 2 blowing instruments. - (Optional) The applicant may include child artists up to 12 years of age for special awards in singing and acting. ***Other Conditions*** - The tiatr must be strictly presented as per the given traditional format wherever it is staged. - If the format is not maintained, the tiatr will not be eligible for 1st, 2nd and 3rd prize, however individual prizes will be given for deserving artists. - The decision to award or not to award the prizes shall depend entirely on the recommendations of the panel of judges. - Political songs should be performed without exceeding the limits of freedom of expression, and criticizing individuals by taking name or displaying images or character assassination will not be allowed.
## Exclusions - The applicant cannot include Kantaram presented in the Kala Academy Tiatr Competitions in the Popular Tiatr Competition, unless a tiatr from the Kala Academy's Competition is admitted in the Popular Tiatr Competition. - The applicant cannot participate artists including technicians and backstage artists in more than one group and one Tiatr, however musicians and stage setting personnel can participate in more than 2 Tiatrs.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ***Applications will be invited by releasing press notes and advertisements in the local dailies. Applicants should regularly monitor these announcements for application opening dates.*** **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:****** ***Await Scheduling Communication*** After successful submission, wait for communication from organizers regarding the date, time and venue allocation for the competition performance. The judgment will be conducted from 5th January 2019 to 5th February 2019 at respective auditoriums. **Step 2:****** ***Confirm Performance Schedule*** Once the performance schedule is communicated, confirm participation and ensure all logistical arrangements including arranging 6 passes for judges and organizers at the performance venue. **Step 3:****** ***Stage the Performance*** Present the tiatr performance strictly as per the traditional format at the assigned auditorium during the competition period. Ensure compliance with all technical requirements including live music band with minimum 5 specified instruments. _*The judgment will be conducted in January-February at respective auditoriums._ _*The decision of the panel of judges will be final and binding, and no correspondence regarding results will be entertained._

metadata.schemeName: Children's Tiatr Competition
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage the development of Tiatr by providing a platform for children aged up to 16 years to participate in traditional Konkani theatre productions. The scheme benefits Educational Institutions, Sports and Cultural Associations, and Individual Producers.

page_content:
# Children's Tiatr Competition **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Student, Competition, Theatre, Culture, Artist, Award | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Children's Tiatr Competition" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage the development of Tiatr by providing a platform for children aged up to 16 years to participate in traditional Konkani theatre productions, addressing the growing enthusiasm among students and individuals to involve children in Tiatr activities. The scheme provides financial support to participating groups and awards mementos and certificates across multiple categories including best performance, individual artistes, direction, technical aspects, and musical components. The applicant must ensure all child performers are aged 16 years or below on the application submission date and themes must be compulsorily based on the lives of children only. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline through prescribed application forms.
## Benefits - Financial support as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - Financial assistance covers expenditure towards Music (Live Band with at least two blowing instruments), Light Effects, Stage Setting, Background Music, Make up, Costumes, Refreshments for rehearsals, and Transport. - All payments made by cheques in the name of the Educational Institutions, Sports and Cultural Associations, or Individual Producer. - Free DVD copy of the recorded performance provided to the producer or director. - Mementos and certificates awarded to winners in different categories (No Cash Prizes). - Video recording of all tiatrs for preservation in Tiatr Academy of Goa Library. - First three award winners of the previous year's Children Tiatr Competition get direct entry into the festival.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an Educational Institution, Sports and Cultural Association, or Individual Producer. - The applicant must ensure all child performers are aged up to 16 years on the date fixed for submission of application. - The applicant must ensure themes of Tiatr are compulsorily based on the lives of children only. - The applicant must ensure the duration of the tiatr is not less than one hour and a half and not more than two hours and a half (including interval of minimum 10 minutes and maximum 15 minutes). - The applicant must present the Tiatr in the traditional format as approved by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must ensure the Tiatr has 6 to 7 acts (podd'dde) with at least 4 cantos. - The applicant must ensure comedy is linked to the story of the play. - The applicant must include at least 8 Kantaram which should include 1 duet (Interactive), 1 Duo (Interactive), 1 Trio (Interactive), 1 Quartet/Quintet (Interactive), 1 Choral Song and Solos. > ***Priority*** - The first three award winners of the previous year's Children Tiatr Competition will get a direct entry into this festival, provided their entries are received before due date. > ***Other Conditions*** - Not more than 2 shows of the given script must have been performed prior to the performance at the competition. - No adverse remarks against any Governments, Individuals, Institutions or anything against caste, creed and religion in the scripts, lyrics of songs, performances, or speeches. - Artistes including technicians and backstage artistes whose names appear in the submitted list shall be permitted to participate only under that troupe (Only musicians can take part in more than one troupe).
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ***(The scheme announcement will be made in the local press. Wait for this official announcement before proceeding with the application)*** **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ _*Applications are considered on a "First come First Serve" basis, subject to the availability of funds._ _*If any applicant withdraws after the schedule is drawn by Tiatr Academy of Goa, full security deposit will stand forfeited._ _*15 Educational Institutions, Sports and Cultural Associations, or Individual Producers will be given an opportunity to participate._ _*In case Tiatr Academy of Goa receives more than 15 applications, a meeting of all applicants will be called and the selection of remaining 12 troupes will be done by lots._ _*In case any of the 15 participants withdraws from the competition, the vacant place will be filled by the Troupe which is first on the waiting list._
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:****** ***Await Script Scrutiny Feedback*** After submission, Tiatr Academy of Goa will scrutinize the script to verify whether it is related to the lives of children and check the interactive nature of kantaram. Feedback, if any, will be provided to the applicant within 10 days. The Academy has the right to make suggestions for improvement or reject the script completely if found unrelated to children's lives. **Step 2:****** ***Participate in Selection Process (If Applicable)*** If more than 15 applications are received, attend the meeting called by Tiatr Academy of Goa where selection of the remaining 12 troupes will be done by lots. The first three award winners of the previous year get direct entry if their applications are received before the due date. **Step 3:****** ***Submit Final Documentation Before Competition*** Submit the final typed copy of the script, typed copy of songs (kantaram), cast of the tiatr, and summary of songs to Tiatr Academy of Goa during office hours exactly 3 days before the date of commencement of the tiatr competition. **Step 4:****** ***Participate in Competition*** Stage the Tiatr at the place and day identified by Tiatr Academy of Goa according to the announced schedule. The performance will be judged by a panel of judges appointed by the Academy, and their decision will be final and binding on all participants.

metadata.schemeName: Gaura Shakti Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The objective of scheme is to prevent crimes against women & girls and to ensure prompt action in case of any incident. Under this, a three-tier support system is set up with Mahila Desks at police stations,Women Safety Helpline & Counselling Cells at district level, & a State Women Safety Helpline.

page_content:
# Gaura Shakti Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Public Safety,Law & Justice, Women and Child | **Tags:** Women Safety, Girl Safety, Women Counselling Cell, Crimes Against Women | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Gaura Shakti Yojana” is implemented by the Police Department under the Department of Home, Government of Uttarakhand. The objective of the scheme is to prevent crimes against women and girls and to ensure prompt action in case of any incident. Under this, a three-tier support system has been established in the state, comprising Mahila Desks at the police station level, Women Safety Helpline and Women Counselling Cells at the district level, and the State Women Safety Helpline at the state level. Under this scheme, efforts are being made to structurally strengthen the three-tier system, enhance transparency in functioning, create awareness among women and girls about their rights, and provide them training in self-defence. Additionally, the responsibilities of police officers have been clearly defined at every level to ensure effective implementation.
## Benefits Under this Scheme, the following steps have been taken by Uttarakhand Police to prevent crimes against women and ensure women’s safety: 1. A Quick Reaction Team (QRT) has been formed under the Women Help Desk at every police station. On receiving a complaint related to women at the police station, the QRT immediately reaches the spot and acts as the first responder, providing all possible assistance to the victim. 1. Identification of Hot Spots and sensitive areas with regard to crimes against women is being carried out. CCTV cameras/lights are being installed in such Hot Spots, and their regular monitoring is ensured. 1. Regular patrolling by Cheetah, Mahila Cheetah, and CPU teams is conducted during the opening and closing hours of schools, colleges, and coaching institutes. 1. A team comprising Women Help Desk In-charges and four constables, named “Team Gaura”, has been constituted. The team regularly organizes awareness programmes to educate students on safety, drugs, traffic rules, cybercrime, etc. To strengthen this initiative, about 3,000 awareness booklets have been distributed to districts from the headquarters. 1. From 20th to 22nd February 2023, a total of 35 women personnel appointed to Team Gaura from all districts were provided Self-Defense Instructor Course (Level-I) training. In continuation, the process of providing Level-II training to these personnel is underway. These trained women police personnel are regularly conducting training programmes in schools, colleges, and other institutions across districts to teach self-defense techniques to girl students.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. Women and girls of the state are eligible to receive assistance under this scheme.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline In view of the safety of women and the prompt redressal of their complaints, the “Gaura Shakti Module” has been developed under the Uttarakhand Police App. After registration, the registrant remains in direct one-to-one contact with the designated Women Police Officer of the concerned police station. For effective implementation, a detailed SOP has been prepared, and all concerned officials have been trained at the headquarters level. In addition, a separate mobile number has been allotted to the in-charges of Women Help Desks in all police stations. Through this app, women can also easily register complaints online. To ensure 24×7 accessibility, the Police Department has made the following platforms available for reporting crimes against women/girls or for registering complaints: 1. Dial 112 – with trained female police personnel available round-the-clock. 1. WhatsApp number at Police Headquarters – 9411112780 1. “Women Help Desk” at every police station. 1. Uttarakhand Police App – “Gaura Shakti Module” / SOS feature 1. Police station / outpost With the objective of making every police station in the state more women-friendly, at least one Woman Sub-Inspector and four Women Constables have been deployed at each police station. - The Uttarakhand Police also ensures payment of compensation amounts as per rules under the Crime Victim Assistance Scheme, 2013. Further, the Uttarakhand Sexual Crime and Other Crimes Victim/Survivor Women Compensation Scheme, 2020 has been implemented for women victims. All concerned officials have been directed to assist crime victims in obtaining compensation under both schemes and to coordinate with the concerned departments as required. - Keeping in mind the sensitivity of cases involving women, investigations of sexual crimes against women are conducted exclusively by Women Officers. To ensure quality investigations, a booklet containing detailed SOPs and instructions has been issued by the headquarters and distributed to all women investigators. For scientific evidence collection in such cases, Sexual Assault Evidence Collection (SAEC) Kits are being provided to districts as needed. - Cases registered under POCSO and rape are being disposed of within the prescribed timelines. According to the ITSSO Portal, Uttarakhand ranks third at the national level in the timely disposal of such cases within two months. - Under the provisions of the Juvenile Justice Act, 2015, a Special Juvenile Police Unit (SJPU) has been constituted in each district under the chairmanship of the Senior Superintendent of Police. Additionally, a Child Welfare Police Officer (CWPO) has been appointed at every police station. Child-friendly police stations have also been established in every district.

# Fellowship Scholarship Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Fellowship, Higher Education, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Fellowship Scholarship Scheme" by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students who secure 70% or more marks in Class 10th and are pursuing higher secondary or higher education. The primary objective is to encourage education among the Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Physically Backward Classes, and other eligible categories by providing monetary support based on their merit in Class 11th and subsequent studies.
## Benefits - **Annual Scholarship:** Financial assistance is provided every year to eligible students.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must have secured at least 70% marks in Class 10th. - The applicant must be pursuing higher secondary school (Class 11th onwards), college, or higher education. - The applicant’s personal/ family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000/-.
## Exclusions

page_content:
# Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Interschool Choreographic Dance Competition **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** School, Dance, Competition, Artist, Culture | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Interschool Choreographic Dance Competition" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to inculcate values of patriotism, national integration, and communal harmony in children through an inter-school competition of choreographic dancing on Konkani songs focused on these themes. The scheme provides monetary prizes ranging from ₹3,000/- to ₹10,000/- along with mementos and certificates for winners, and traveling allowances ranging from ₹2,000/- to ₹4,000/- based on distance traveled by participating groups. The applicant must be an educational institution with a dance group consisting of not less than 6 or more than 10 dancers and must perform on only one patriotic song in Konkani. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa and applications for this scheme are accepted offline with the submission of a physical application form along with a recorded copy of the song on Compact Disc.
## Benefits ##### ***Monetary Benefits*** **Prize Money for Standard 1st-4th Category** - 1st Prize: ₹7,000/- plus memento and certificate. - 2nd Prize: ₹5,000/- plus memento and certificate. - 3rd Prize: ₹3,000/- plus memento and certificate. - Best Choreographer: ₹3,000/- plus memento and certificate. **Prize Money for Standard 5th-10th Category** - 1st Prize: ₹10,000/- plus memento and certificate. - 2nd Prize: ₹7,000/- plus memento and certificate. - 3rd Prize: ₹5,000/- plus memento and certificate. - Best Choreographer: ₹3,000/- plus memento and certificate. **Traveling Allowance** - Groups from within 10 kilometers radius: ₹2,000/-. - Groups from more than 10 kilometers and less than 20 kilometers: ₹3,000/-. - Groups from 20 kilometers or more distance: ₹4,000/-. ##### ***Non-Monetary Benefits*** - Mementos and certificates for all prize winners. - Refreshments provided for participants and their in-charge. - Recognition and exposure through inter-school competition platform.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an educational institution. - The applicant must form a dance group consisting of not less than 6 dancers. - The applicant must form a dance group consisting of not more than 10 dancers. - The applicant must choose to participate in either Standard 1st-4th category or Standard 5th-10th category. - The applicant must perform on only one patriotic song in Konkani language. - The applicant must not use fusion of different songs in their performance. - The applicant must provide a recorded copy of the song on Compact Disc along with the application form. ***Compliance Requirements*** - The applicant must read and understand all rules and regulations of the organization. - The applicant must abide by all competition rules and regulations. - The applicant must accept that the decision of the panel of judges will be final and binding. - The applicant must accept that Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to make any changes in the rules.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ _*The application must be submitted to the office of the Tiatr Academy of Goa at least 30 days in advance of the proposed programme date._ _*The competition permits only 25 participants on first come first serve basis._

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote dairy entrepreneurship among women, Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and general category members of cooperative societies by providing financial assistance through subsidies and loans for the purchase of milch cows and buffaloes.

page_content:
# Rajya Samekit Sahkari Vikas Yojana - Ganga Gaay Mahila Dairy Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Women and Child | **Tags:** Ganga, Dairy Farmer, Woman, Cooperative Societies, Cow, Milk Production | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Ganga Gaay Mahila Dairy Yojana” is implemented under the Rajya Samekit Sahkari Vikas Yojana by the Department of Dairy Development, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote dairy entrepreneurship among women, Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and general category members of cooperative societies by providing financial assistance through subsidies and loans for the purchase of milch cows and buffaloes.
## Benefits ***The following benefits are provided to members of milk-producing cooperative societies for purchasing cows or buffaloes::*** **For members of the general category:** - A grant of 50% and a loan of 40% is approved through the District Cooperative Bank for the establishment of a unit of 2, 3, and 5 dairy animals (including animal purchase, insurance, transportation expenses, cattle shed, milk van, etc.), and the remaining 10% is borne by the beneficiary. - The dairy department will provide a grant of ₹80,000 for 2 animals, ₹1,23,250 for 3 animals, and ₹2,03,625 for 5 animals. **For Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and women members (of any caste):** - For the establishment of units for 2, 3 and 5 dairy animals (covering animal purchase, insurance, transportation, cattle shed including calf, milk van, etc.), a 75% grant and a 25% loan are approved through the District Cooperative Bank. - The dairy department will provide funds of ₹1,20,000/- for 2 animals, ₹1,84,875/- for 3 animals, and ₹3,05,438/- for 5 animals. - A minimum of 2 animals must be purchased, and taking a loan is mandatory to receive the subsidy.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a member of a milk-producing cooperative society. (Individuals who are not currently members can become eligible by joining a cooperative society.) 1. The applicant must belong to the General, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, or Women category. 1. The applicant must intend to purchase cows (with a minimum milk yield of 12 liters per day) or buffaloes (with a minimum milk yield of 10 liters per day). 1. The applicant must purchase animals from outside the state. 1. The applicant must purchase a minimum of two (2) animals. 1. To avail of the subsidy, it is mandatory to take a loan for the purchase of milch animals.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - It is mandatory for the applicant to be a member of the society. Any member above 18 years of age in the concerned Gram Panchayat or rural area can obtain membership by depositing a ₹25.00 membership fee with the nearest society secretary and receiving a receipt. It is not necessary to be a cattle rearer to become a member. - The application form can be obtained from the milk cooperative society or the nearest district cooperative bank. The form must be submitted along with Aadhaar card, bank account details, caste certificate, cooperative society membership number (if applicable), and movable/immovable property or land certificate. If the above documents are not available, two guarantors who are members of the milk society must be provided. - If a loan has been taken from any institution, its details along with the number of animals to be acquired must be submitted to the milk cooperative society. The Society Secretary certifies the application. The Manager/Chief Manager of the Milk Producers Cooperative Union Ltd. and the Assistant Director of Dairy provide recommendations after scrutiny. - After receiving the recommendations, the application is submitted to the bank. Once the bank verifies all documents, the loan is approved according to the beneficiary’s eligibility, and the loan amount is disbursed to the beneficiary’s account. - Upon receiving the funds, the Dairy Cooperative Society/Dairy Department’s Purchase Society informs the beneficiary and accompanies them to purchase animals from department-listed dairy farms outside the state. The Purchase Society selects and purchases the animals, inspects their health, and delivers them to the owner’s home. The owner does not have to pay any money to departmental personnel. - If the beneficiary is not satisfied with the animals from the listed firm, they must notify the relevant District Manager in writing. After receiving permission, the Purchase Society will provide animals from an alternative source outside the state.

metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide access to high quality education to students from Scheduled Caste communities in best private residential schools. It provides scholarships and bridge courses to meritorious Scheduled Caste students selected through national entrance test.

page_content:
# Scheme For Residential Education For Students in High Schools in Targeted Areas (SHRESHTA): Mode 1 - SHRESHTA Schools (Best CBSE Private Residential Schools) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Education & Learning | **Tags:** School, Student, Scholarship, Education, Tuition | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Scheme For Residential Education For Students in High Schools in Targeted Areas (SHRESHTA)" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India from 2023-24 to 2025-26. The scheme aims to provide access to high quality education to students from Scheduled Caste communities in the best private residential schools in the country, thereby securing their future opportunities and filling the gap in service deficient Scheduled Caste dominant areas in the education sector. Under the "SHRESHTA Schools (Best CBSE Private Residential Schools)" mode, the scheme provides scholarships covering school fees including tuition fees and hostel fees including mess charges, along with bridge courses to help students adapt to the new environment. The applicant must be a Scheduled Caste student with parental income not exceeding ₹2,50,000/- per year and must qualify through the National Entrance Test for SHRESHTA conducted by National Testing Agency.
## Benefits ##### ***Scholarship Coverage*** School fee including tuition fee and hostel fee including mess charges as per following limits: - Class 9th: ₹1,00,000/- per student per annum. - Class 10th: ₹1,10,000/- per student per annum. - Class 11th: ₹1,25,000/- per student per annum. - Class 12th: ₹1,35,000/- per student per annum. ##### ***Bridge Course Support*** - Up to 10% of annual fee provided separately for bridge course extending up to 3 months. ##### ***Mode of Disbursement*** - Direct transfer to school accounts through e-Anudaan portal. - Within 30 days from date of confirmation of admission on Information Technology portal. ##### ***Additional Benefits*** - _Automatic Progression__:_ Students admitted in Class 9 or 11 shall automatically be funded for next classes till they complete 12th class.- _Bridge Course_: Conducted outside school hours covering academic topics and personality development.- _Counsellor Support_: Schools designate one teacher as counsellor to resolve difficulties faced by students.- _Future Connectivity_: Students may be connected to Post Matric Scholarship Scheme or Top-Class Education Scheme for further studies. _*The applicant must pass the exams of the previous class to continue receiving funding for subsequent years._ _*The applicant must maintain enrollment in the assigned SHRESHTA school._ _*If student leaves after admission and payment of fee, it must be brought to notice of Central Government immediately and fees paid should be refunded to Consolidated Fund of India._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste community. - The applicant must be studying in recognized schools - Private or Government or Local Body schools. - The income of the parents of the applicant must not exceed ₹2,50,000/- per year. - The applicant seeking admission in Class 9th must have passed Class 8th in the academic year immediately preceding the year of admission. - The applicant seeking admission in Class 11th must have passed Class 10th in the academic year immediately preceding the year of admission. - The applicant must qualify in National Entrance Test for SHRESHTA conducted by National Testing Agency.
## Exclusions The applicant should not be covered under Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme of the Department.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Access the official [National Testing Agency portal](https://www.nta.ac.in/) and register for National Entrance Test for SHRESHTA. Complete the registration process by providing personal details, educational qualifications, and uploading required documents including caste certificate and income certificate. **Step 2:** Take the National Entrance Test for SHRESHTA conducted by National Testing Agency across the country. The test will assess merit for admission to SHRESHTA schools and results will determine eligibility for school selection process. **Step 3:** After the examination, check the results on National Testing Agency portal to verify qualification status and merit position. Qualified candidates will be eligible to participate in the web counselling process for school selection. **Step 4:** Access the web counselling system developed by National Informatics Centre to exercise choice of SHRESHTA schools. Select preferred schools from the available options based on merit rank and availability of seats in chosen institutions. **Step 5:** Once a school is allotted through the counselling process, confirm the selection within the stipulated time frame. The selected school will automatically admit the student without any further test or evaluation process. **Step 6:** Report to the assigned SHRESHTA school and complete all admission formalities as directed by the school authorities. The school will provide necessary assistance for students to settle down in the new environment and hostel facilities. **Step 7:** Participate in the bridge course conducted by the school outside school hours if required. The bridge course will cover topics to help catch up with the rest of the class and enhance capability to adapt to the school environment. ##### ***Selection Process*** - The applicant will be selected based on merit obtained in National Entrance Test for SHRESHTA. - The applicant will be offered choices of SHRESHTA schools through web counselling system. - The applicant may participate in multiple rounds of web-counselling to ensure all seats are filled.

metadata.schemeName: Tiatr Research Scholarship Program
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage college and university students to undertake research in Tiatr, its song, and music. It provides scholarships and publication opportunities for research work, targeting students pursuing Graduation, Post-Graduation, and PhD studies.

page_content:
# Tiatr Research Scholarship Program **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Student, Research, Scholarship, Culture, Education | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Tiatr Research Scholarship Program" was launched by the Tiatr Academy (TAG) under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage young students to undertake research in different aspects of Tiatr, its song, and music. The scheme provides scholarships to college and university students for research related to Tiatr, which must be conducted in English and Konkani (Roman script only). It also includes the publication of the approved research work in book form by TAG, with 100 copies provided to the student concerned in addition to the scholarship amount. The applicant must submit a report of the research carried out duly signed by either the guide or the head of the institution.
## Benefits > ***Scholarship Amount*** The amount of each scholarship will be decided by Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) from time to time. > ***Publication of Research Work*** The research work of the students will be printed by Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) in book form after approval by the Recommendation Board. > ***Copies of Published Work*** Each student concerned will receive 100 copies of their printed research work in addition to the scholarship amount. > ***Number of Scholarships*** TAG will offer scholarships in three categories every year: ◦ PhD: 1 scholarship ◦ Post-Graduation: 3 scholarships ◦ Graduation: 6 scholarships _*Scholarships will be for every academic year._ _*A scholarship will be given only once in a particular category; however, the same applicant is free to apply for other categories in subsequent academic years._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a bonafide student who does research work or a project related to Tiatr. - The applicant must conduct research work in English and Konkani (Roman script only). - The applicant should have secured at least 50% marks in the last examination. - The applicant must submit a report of the research carried out, duly signed either by the guide or the head of the institution.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields: name of the applicant. Attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._
