metadata.schemeName: Commemoration of Jubilees/Birth Anniversaries of Tiatr Artistes of Yesteryears
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to commemorate the significant contributions of deceased Tiatr artistes, making the younger generation aware of their legacy. It provides financial assistance, publicity, and venue support for organizing cultural programmes celebrating jubilee/birth anniversaries of these pioneers.

page_content:
# Commemoration of Jubilees/Birth Anniversaries of Tiatr Artistes of Yesteryears **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Artist, Culture, Program, Financial Assistance, Stage, Music | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Commemoration of Jubilees/Birth Anniversaries of Tiatr Artistes of Yesteryears" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to make our younger generation aware of the contribution and sacrifices of Tiatr artistes of yesteryears. The scheme provides for organizing functions to celebrate jubilee/birth anniversaries of deceased Tiatr artistes, including wide publicity through print and electronic media, display and garlanding of portraits, cultural programmes (tiatr and songs), and financial assistance along with provision of auditoriums/halls and additional amounts for village programmes. Applications for this scheme are accepted at least 30 days in advance on a "First come First Serve" basis, subject to the availability of funds.
## Benefits - **Financial Assistance:** An amount as fixed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa.- **Auditorium/Hall Provision:** Provision of an auditorium or hall by the Tiatr Academy of Goa to stage the programme.- **Additional Financial Assistance for Village Programmes:** An additional amount as fixed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa for hall charges or stage erection charges if the programme is held in a village.- **Programme Staging:** A maximum of 4 shows at 4 different places, including 3 shows in Panaji, Margao, Curchorem, Vasco, or any other city, and 1 show compulsorily staged in the artiste’s area of residence.- **Optional Additional Shows:** An additional 2 shows may be granted for performance in villages only, subject to the availability of funds, at an amount (as fixed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa) plus an additional amount (as fixed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa) for Pandal/Hall/Auditorium including Stage, Sound, etc..- **Publicity:** Wide publicity will be given through print and electronic media.- **Banner Provision:** One banner for Tiatr performances, to be collected from and returned to the office of the Tiatr Academy of Goa, must be displayed on the front side wing of the stage.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an organizing institution or an individual. - The applicant must propose a programme to celebrate jubilee/birth anniversaries of artistes of yesteryears who are no longer living. - The applicant must ensure the programme aims to make the younger generation aware of the contribution and sacrifices of these Tiatr artistes. - The applicant must ensure the programme includes the narration of the history of the life of the late artiste to whom the programme is dedicated. - The applicant must ensure the family members of the deceased artiste are compulsorily invited for the function. - The applicant must give the proposal well in advance, providing all details of the programme, including typed script and lyrics to be presented, and the names of the artistes. - The applicant must insert/publish/announce "This programme is held in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa" in all advertisements, whether oral, print, or electronic media, and on banners. - The applicant must display the Tiatr Academy of Goa’s banner on the front side wing of the stage if it is a Tiatr, and return it after all shows. - The applicant must display a banner of minimum size 6ft.x10 ft. carrying the Tiatr Academy of Goa’s logo as a back drop if it is a Musical Show. - The applicant must discuss with the Tiatr Academy of Goa and decide about the Chief Guest/Guest of Honour well in advance. - The applicant must ensure the President/Vice President of the Tiatr Academy of Goa will either be the Chief Guest or Guest of Honour at the function. - The applicant must ensure the duration of the programme is at least 2 hours. - The applicant must ensure there are no adverse remarks made in any form, either written or verbal, against any Government/Individual/Institution, etc., or anything against one’s caste, creed, and religion which may lead to hurting religious sentiments.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ _*The application must be submitted to the office of the Tiatr Academy of Goa at least 30 days in advance of the proposed programme date._ _*Applications are considered on a "First come First Serve" basis, subject to the availability of funds._

metadata.schemeName: Self Employment Scheme Gujarat
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides unemployed tribal persons with affordable loans ranging from ₹50,000 to ₹5,00,000 at a 4% annual interest rate, aiming to help them establish self-employment opportunities.

page_content:
# Self Employment Scheme Gujarat **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Skills & Employment, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Self Employment, Opportunity, Scheduled Tribe, Loan | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Self Employment Scheme" was launched by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial support to unemployed tribal individuals by offering affordable loans for self-employment opportunities. Under this scheme, loans ranging from ₹50,000 to ₹5,00,000 are provided at a concessional interest rate to enable beneficiaries to start any of the 85 identified businesses.
## Benefits - **Monetary Benefit:** Loan assistance between ₹50,000 and ₹5,00,000, depending on the chosen business activity.- **Interest Rate:** 4% per annum.- **Coverage:** Applicable for 85 different types of businesses as identified by the department.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. - The applicant must be unemployed at the time of applying.

## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ##### ***Registration Process*** - Visit the Gujarat Tribal Development Corporation [official website](https://adijatinigam.gujarat.gov.in/home). - Click on the "[APPLY FOR LOAN](https://adijatinigam.gujarat.gov.in/gtdcloan)".- Select the scheme name "Foreign Study". - Fill the registration form: Full Name (as per Aadhaar Card), Gender, Date of Birth, Aadhaar Number, Mobile Number, Uder name, Password for login, Confirm Password. - Click on the "Sign Up. - After successful registration, User ID and Password will be generated. ##### ***Application Process*** - Enter User ID, Password, and Captcha Code. - After login, schemes applicable to your caste will be displayed. - Click on the scheme you want to apply for. - Fill the "Application Form" and upload the required documents - Click Save Application. The system will generate an Application Number. - Click Print Application.

# 6% Interest Subsidy on Loans taken for Vehicle Purchase through Banks **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Employment, Opportunity, Subsidy, Loan, Scheduled Tribe | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "6% Interest Subsidy on Loans taken for Vehicle Purchase through Banks" scheme was launched by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat. page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Nahri Kendra **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Skills & Employment, Business & Entrepreneurship, Women and Child | **Tags:** Woman, Financial Assistance, Loan, Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Mukhyamantri Nahri Kendra" was launched by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to empower tribal women by providing them with livelihood opportunities through women-run centers. These centers promote the sale of tribal dishes and home-made products, thereby improving income and living standards. The system will generate an Application Number. - Click Print Application.

metadata.schemeName: Promotion of Tiatr Related Activities
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support institutions and individuals to organize tiatr-related cultural activities in Goa. It provides financial assistance for Konkani musical shows, competitions, and programs celebrating tiatr artists.

page_content:
# Promotion of Tiatr Related Activities **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Culture, Artist, Music, Competition, Heritage | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Promotion of Tiatr Related Activities" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to support cultural institutions and individuals in organizing various activities related to tiatr in their respective villages and towns to preserve and promote the traditional Konkani theatrical art form. The scheme provides financial support for organizing Konkani musical shows, singing competitions, acting competitions, one act plays, and programs celebrating the contribution of local tiatr artists both deceased and living but non-active, while ensuring these activities are made accessible to the public free of charge. The applicant must be a cultural institution or individual willing to organize tiatr-related activities and must submit applications within specified advance notice periods ranging from 8 to 30 days depending on the activity type. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa and applications for this scheme are accepted offline through prescribed application forms available at the Tiatr Academy of Goa office.
## Benefits ##### ***Financial Support Categories*** - ***Category A1*** ***- Konkani Musical Shows:*** Financial assistance for organizing shows with minimum 14 songs including duets, trios, quartets, choral songs, solos and at least 2 comedy skits.- ***Category A2*** ***- Singing Competitions:*** Financial assistance for organizing competitions with minimum 15 participants singing newly composed kantaram.- ***Category B1*** ***- Competitions:*** Financial assistance for acting competitions including monologue, dialogue, and one act play competitions.- ***Category B2*** ***- Celebrating Tiatr Artists:*** Financial assistance for organizing programs to remember and felicitate prominent tiatr artists. ##### ***Conditions*** - Programs must be staged free of charge to the public. - All promotional materials must acknowledge collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa. - Backdrop of minimum size 6 feet x 10 feet displaying Tiatr Academy of Goa logo is mandatory. - No adverse remarks against any governments, individuals, institutions, or content against caste, creed, and religion permitted. - Chief Guest and Guest of Honour must be decided in consultation with Tiatr Academy of Goa. - President or Vice President of Tiatr Academy of Goa will be the Chief Guest or Guest of Honour.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a cultural institution or individual organizing tiatr-related activities in Goa. - The applicant must organize activities in their respective villages or towns. - The applicant must ensure the program is staged free of charge to the public. - The applicant must agree to acknowledge Tiatr Academy of Goa collaboration in all promotional materials. - The applicant must ensure content does not contain adverse remarks against governments, individuals, institutions, or content against caste, creed, and religion. ***For Konkani Musical Shows*** - The applicant must ensure lyrics are newly composed and not recorded on any Audio/Video/Digital Versatile Disc Albums. - The applicant must arrange a band with minimum 5 instruments including drums, keyboard, guitar and 2 blowing instruments. - The applicant must organize minimum 14 songs including interactive duets, duos, trios, quartets/quintets, choral songs, solos and at least 2 comedy skits. - The applicant must submit typed lyrics and skit scripts at least 30 days in advance. ***For Singing Competitions*** - The applicant must ensure minimum 15 participants. - The applicant must ensure participants sing newly composed kantaram not recorded on any Audio/Video/Digital Versatile Disc Albums. - The applicant must arrange a band with minimum 5 instruments including drums, keyboard, guitar and 2 blowing instruments. - The applicant must provide competition rules to Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must submit typed song lyrics at least 8 days in advance. ***For Other Competitions*** - The applicant must submit application form at least 30 days in advance. ***For Celebrating Tiatr Artists*** - The applicant must focus on prominent tiatr artists such as actors, singers, writers. - The applicant must submit application form at least 15 days in advance.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ _*Applications are considered on a "First come First Serve" basis, subject to the availability of funds._
##### ***Application Deadline*** Submit the completed application form along with all required documents to Tiatr Academy of Goa office within the specified timeframe: - 30 days in advance for Musical Shows and Competitions. - 15 days in advance for Celebrating Tiatr Artists. - 8 days in advance for submission of song lyrics in Singing Competitions.
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** **Coordinate with Tiatr Academy of Goa** - After application acceptance, discuss and finalize the Chief Guest/Guest of Honour arrangements with Tiatr Academy of Goa, ensuring the President or Vice President of Tiatr Academy of Goa will serve in this capacity. **Step 2:** **Setup & Conduct the Event** - Arrange for the mandatory backdrop of minimum size 6 feet x 10 feet displaying Tiatr Academy of Goa logo and collaboration statement. Ensure all promotional materials, advertisements, banners include the mandatory acknowledgment "This programme is organized in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa". - Execute the approved tiatr-related activity ensuring compliance with all scheme norms including free admission to public, appropriate content guidelines, and proper collaboration acknowledgments throughout the program. **Step 3:** **Financial Documentation & Payment Request** - After the event, prepare a comprehensive statement of expenditure supported by original bills and stamped receipts for any expenses exceeding ₹5,000/- as required for payment processing. - Submit the statement of expenditure along with all original bills and stamped receipts to Tiatr Academy of Goa for payment processing, ensuring all documentation is complete and accurate.

metadata.schemeName: Production of Audio Albums of songs on Patriotism & National Integration
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to strengthen values of Patriotism & National Integration among Tiatr fraternity by promoting production of Konkani audio albums. It provides financial support for producing albums with at least 10 patriotic songs for distribution to educational institutions.

page_content:
# Production of Audio Albums of songs on Patriotism & National Integration **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Culture, Artist, Album, Song, Music | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Production of Audio Albums of songs on Patriotism & National Integration" was launched by the Tiatr Academy of Goa under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to strengthen the values of Patriotism & National Integration among members of Tiatr fraternity, addressing the problem that audio albums of Konkani songs of Patriotism & National Integration are rarely produced in Goa despite numerous audio albums of songs (Kantaram) in Konkani being produced. The scheme provides financial support as decided by Tiatr Academy of Goa for the production of audio albums containing at least 10 songs of Patriotism & National Integration and distribution of 300 copies to schools and groups participating in various competitions. The applicant must be a tiatr artiste (commercial or non-commercial). The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa and applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
## Benefits ##### ***Financial Support*** Tiatr Academy of Goa will give financial support as decided by Tiatr Academy of Goa for the production of the Album. ##### ***Distribution Channel*** Tiatr Academy of Goa will distribute 300 copies to schools & groups which participate in its various competitions and may also offer them to other schools, groups, individuals, etc. who are interested in promoting Patriotism & National Integration. ##### ***Commercial Rights*** The applicant is free to sell the remaining Compact Discs. ##### ***Sponsorship Permission*** The applicant may take sponsorship to meet the cost of production of Album. ##### ***Quality Assurance*** Lyrics will be scrutinized by the Recommendation Committee appointed by Tiatr Academy of Goa with advisory support to improve quality.
**Conditions** _*The applicant must produce the Audio album strictly following the specified norms._ _*Melody and musical arrangement must be appropriate to the content of the song._ _*Lyrics must be approved by the Recommendation Committee._ _*Official letter of acceptance must be obtained from Tiatr Academy of Goa before production._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a tiatr artiste (commercial as well as non-commercial). - The applicant must submit a typed copy of lyrics of songs to Tiatr Academy of Goa along with the application form. - The applicant must obtain approval of lyrics from the Recommendation Committee appointed by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must receive official letter of acceptance from Tiatr Academy of Goa before production. - The applicant must not make any adverse remark in any form either written or verbal against any Governments/Individuals/Institutions or anything against caste, creed and religion in the lyrics of songs which may hurt the sentiments of anybody. ##### ***Album Content Requirements*** - The audio album must include at least 10 songs of Patriotism & National Integration. - The album should not have solo songs only. - 50% of the songs must be group songs and children's songs. - Melody and musical arrangement must be appropriate to the content of the song. - The applicant will have to give 300 copies of Audio albums to Tiatr Academy of Goa. ##### ***Quality Control Process*** - Lyrics will be scrutinized by the Recommendation Committee. - Committee will be free to advise the lyricists to improve the quality of lyrics. - Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to disapprove the lyrics as per the opinion given by Recommendation Committee.
## Exclusions

## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ _*The application must be submitted to the office of the Tiatr Academy of Goa at least 30 days in advance of the proposed programme date._ _*Applications are considered on a "First come First Serve" basis, subject to the availability of funds._
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:****** ***Lyrics Scrutiny & Committee Feedback*** - The applicant must wait for the Recommendation Committee appointed by Tiatr Academy of Goa to scrutinize the submitted lyrics, during which the committee may advise improvements to enhance the quality of lyrics and ensure alignment with patriotism and national integration themes. - The applicant must incorporate any suggestions or improvements recommended by the Recommendation Committee to enhance the quality of lyrics, ensuring the content meets the required standards for patriotism and national integration themes. **Step 2:****** ***Official Approval & Acceptance Letter*** - The applicant must wait for the final decision from Tiatr Academy of Goa, as the academy reserves the right to disapprove the lyrics based on the opinion given by the Recommendation Committee, and will issue an official letter of acceptance if the lyrics are approved. - The applicant must obtain the official letter of acceptance from Tiatr Academy of Goa confirming approval of the lyrics before proceeding with the production of the audio album, as this letter is mandatory for proceeding to the production phase. **Step 3:****** ***Album Production & Financial Support*** - The applicant must plan the production of the audio album strictly following the approved norms including minimum 10 songs, ensuring 50% are group and children's songs, and that melody and musical arrangement are appropriate to the content of each song. - The applicant must coordinate with Tiatr Academy of Goa to receive the financial support as decided by the academy for the production of the album, and may also arrange additional sponsorship to meet the complete cost of production if needed. **Step 4:****** ***Produce Audio Album & Submit Required Copies*** - The applicant must produce the audio album following all specified norms and quality standards, ensuring professional recording quality and appropriate musical arrangements that complement the patriotic and national integration themes of the songs. - The applicant must provide 300 copies of the completed audio albums to Tiatr Academy of Goa as per the scheme requirements, which will be used by the academy for distribution to schools and groups participating in various competitions. **Step 5:****** ***Complete Documentation*** - The applicant must ensure all production documentation is complete and maintain records of the album production process, quality standards met, and compliance with all scheme norms for future reference and verification.

metadata.schemeName: PMMSY: Construction of Ice Plant/Storage of Minimum 10 Tonne Capacity - Gujarat
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the construction of ice plants/storage units of at least 10 tonne capacity, supporting fishermen and sellers to maintain fish in fresh and hygienic condition.

page_content:
# PMMSY: Construction of Ice Plant/Storage of Minimum 10 Tonne Capacity - Gujarat **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Construction Of Ice Plant, Storage, Fish, Fishermen, Fish Sellers | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)” with the component of "Construction of Ice Plant/storage of minimum 10 tonne capacity", introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to modernize cold storage and ice plant facilities to preserve fish in healthy condition and ensure hygienic delivery to consumers. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided for the construction of ice plants/storage units of a minimum 10-tonne capacity, enabling fishermen and fish sellers to maintain the freshness of fish and improve income opportunities. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State Governments, with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% contribution from State Governments.
> **Objective of the scheme** - Marine production in the Gujarat state is one of the leading in the country. The state lags behind in exports due to non-norms. So cold storage/ice plant modernization is necessary to keep the fish in healthy condition. - Insulated vehicle, three wheeler with ice box including e-rickshaw, and live fish vending center to deliver the fish in hygienic condition to the consumer, so that the consumer (customer) can get fresh and clean fish from the local area and get good returns to the sellers. - Around 27,000 small and large boats are operating in the state. To strengthen the safety and security of the fishermen and increase the income of the boat owner, replacement of the existing boats is necessary to increase the sea growth of the existing boats.
## Benefits Construction of Ice Plant/Storage (minimum 10 tonne capacity): - Unit cost is ₹40,00,000/- lakhs. The amount of assistance will be available at the rate of 40% of the unit cost for the beneficiary of the general category and 60% of the unit cost for the beneficiary of the women and ST/SC category. - The benefit will be available as per the target (category) allocated by the Government of India.
> **Remarks:** 60% contribution from Government of India and 40% contribution from State Governments is paid. > **Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits:** Once in a lifetime.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. The applicant should hold a fishing license. 1. The applicant should complete the online registration on the [iKhedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/).1. The applicant should obtain in-principle approval before purchase of the floor plan. 1. The applicant should have his/her own bank account. > **Preference/Reservation/Relaxation:** - Women, SC, and ST beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance of the unit cost. - General category beneficiaries are eligible for 40% assistance of the unit cost.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side, then click on "Beneficiary Registration" and select any one from the 'Farmer' or 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. **Step 3:** Enter the 'Company Name' and Address if you have selected 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. And for all select the District, Taluka, and Village, choose 'what type of account holder you are?', enter your Account Number and Name, solve the Captcha, and click 'Save and Next'. **Step 4:** Enter your Mobile Number and E-mail address, click 'Send OTP', enter the received OTP, create and confirm a Password, solve the Captcha, and click 'Submit'.
> **Login Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side of the homepage. On the home page, click on ‘Schemes’ and then click on ‘Agricultural Schemes’. **Step 3:** Now select the scheme, click on the ‘Apply’ button, and an application page will open. **Step 4:** Click on the "Apply New" button and submit a new application. **Step 5:** Click on the "Update Application" button to add corrections to the application. **Step 6:** Once the application is done, confirm it. **Step 7:** Take a printout of the confirmed application.
> **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_Contacts.aspx).

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to fishermen/fishermen's families in case of death or injury. Through this scheme, insurance coverage for death permanent partial disability is provided to eligible fishers.

page_content:
# Group Accident Insurance Scheme under PMMSY: Accidental death or Permanent Total Disability Gujarat **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Accident, Death, Disability, Fishermen | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Group Accident Insurance Scheme under PMMSY" with a component "Accidental death or Permanent Total Disability" is introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat. Insurance of Fishers is one of the sub-components of the PMMSY, and it provides insurance coverage to fishers, which includes fishermen, fish workers, fish farmers, and other individuals directly involved in fishing and related activities. The sub scheme offers coverage for death, permanent total disability (PTD). The National Fisheries Development Board (NFDB) and M/s Oriental Insurance Company Limited (OICL) implement the scheme. The premium cost is shared between the Central and State Governments, with no contribution from the beneficiary. The implementing agency of the scheme is the Commissioner of Fisheries.
> **Objective of scheme:** - To financially assist the fisherman/fisherman's family in case of death/injury.
## Benefits
**Sr. No.****Name of Component****Standard of assistance****Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits**1. Accidental death or Permanent Total Disability₹5,00,000/-Once to the legal heir after death
> **Mode of Disbursement:** - The claim amount is deposited directly into the claimant's, nominee's, or legal heir's savings account via Direct Bank Transfer (DBT). > **Expected Time of Disbursement:** - The insurance company will settle the claim within 15 working days of receiving the complete claim documentation. If a claim is not settled within this period, the insurance company will pay a simple interest of 10% on the admissible claim amount from the date of document submission until the payment date.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a fisher, which includes fishermen, fish workers, fish farmers, and any other person directly involved in fishing or fisheries-related activities. 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 70 years old. 1. The insured person should not have been 71 years of age on the date of the accident. 1. The applicant must be approved by the State/Union Territory (UT) fisheries department. 1. At the time of a claim, the claimant or insured fisher must be verified and certified by an "Appropriate Authority". 1. The applicant should have registered himself in the concerned district office.
## Exclusions **The scheme does not cover claims for death, injury, or disablement resulting from:** - Suicide or attempted suicide. - Self-inflicted injury. - Pregnancy, childbirth, or related consequences. - Pre-existing physical or mental defects or infections. - Influence of intoxicating liquor or drugs. - Venereal diseases or insanity. - Engaging in aviation or ballooning, except as a passenger on a licensed aircraft. - Committing a breach of law with criminal intent. - Ionizing radiation or radioactive contamination from nuclear fuel or waste. - Nuclear weapons material. - Service in the armed forces. - Murder by an immediate beneficiary or nominee. - War, invasion, civil war, rebellion, or other hostilities. - Natural death. - Funeral or ambulance charges (except for accidental hospitalisation claims). - Weekly compensation or child education funds.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline 1. Fishers or their legal heirs must submit the required documents to the concerned district office for assistance. 1. The claim details must be intimated within 90 days of the accident via one of the following recognised communication methods: - Letter to the Insurance Company/NFDB Insurance Cell/Intermediary. - Email to support@pmmsygais.com. - Through the IT & ITES platforms provided by the intermediary. - Via the NFDB Toll-Free Number (1800-425-1660). - To the "Appropriate Authorities". > **Note:** All claim documents must be submitted within 180 days of the accident.

# Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Scholarship Scheme (Secondary Level) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Student, Meritorious Students, Secondary Level | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Scholarship Scheme (Secondary Level)” is implemented by the Secondary Education Department under the Department of Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote academic excellence among students entering Classes 9 and 10 by providing financial assistance to meritorious students, based on their performance in a competitive examination conducted by the State Council of Educational Research and Training (SCERT), Uttarakhand.
## Benefits Rate of Scholarship: - **For Class 9th Students:** ₹900/- per month for 1 year.- **For Class 10th Students:** ₹900/- per month for 1 year.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The student must have passed Class 8 (institutional) from a Government School or Government-aided private school of the state (excluding Central and Residential schools) and must be studying in Class 9. 1. The applicant must qualify in the competitive examination conducted by SCERT, Uttarakhand. 1. The selected student must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance and secure at least 60% marks in Class 9. For SC/ST students, a relaxation of 5% is provided in both marks and attendance requirements. 1. Based on the examination results, a student securing a position in the top 10% of the total participants will be eligible to avail the benefits of this scheme. 1. There is no income criterion for the parents/guardians of the student under this scholarship. 1. A student cannot avail double benefits under multiple state scholarship schemes.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - To appear in the scholarship examination, a student can collect the application form from the Block Education Officer’s office or download it from the School Education Department’s website ([https://schooleducation.uk.gov.in](https://schooleducation.uk.gov.in/)) or the SCERT Uttarakhand website ([https://scert.uk.gov.in/](https://scert.uk.gov.in/)) during the months of June-July every year. At present, the application process is offline, and no application or examination fee is required. - While filling the application form, the student must attach a passport-size photograph, Aadhaar card, Class 8 passing certificate, admission card for Class 9, caste certificate (if applicable), disability certificate (if applicable), and Aadhaar-linked bank account details. The student must ensure that all information provided in the form is correct and then submit it to the Principal of the school where he or she is studying. - The Principal verifies the form on the basis of documents and school records, attests the photograph, and forwards the form to the Block Education Officer’s office by the stipulated date, which is usually around 21st August. After verification, the Block Education Officer issues the admit card. - Students can collect the admit card from their school or from the Block Education Officer’s office. The examination is conducted every year in September in an objective-type multiple-choice format. Students who are placed in the merit list are informed by the Principal, after which the scholarship amount is directly credited to the student’s bank account.

metadata.schemeName: Decentralized People’s Nursery
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase tree cover and support rural incomes by enabling individuals and institutions to raise tree seedlings. It offers financial assistance per seedling, with beneficiaries retaining ownership of the plants, encouraging commercial nursery activity.

page_content:
# Decentralized People’s Nursery **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Nursery, Seedlings, Afforestation, Farmers, Forestry, Environment, Rural | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Decentralized People’s Nursery" by the Social Forestry wing of the Principal Chief Conservator of Forest & Head of the Forest Force (HoFF), Government of Gujarat, aims to augment the income of farmers and increase tree cover by promoting afforestation activities. It allows individuals and institutions interested in raising seedlings to apply for assistance. The scheme typically involves a target of 20,000 seedlings to be raised by an applicant. A key feature is that ownership of the seedlings remains with the beneficiary, who is free to sell or use them without external permission. Financial compensation is provided in installments for the plants raised. The scheme is implemented by the Forest Department.
## Benefits **Financial Assistance for Raising Seedlings:** ₹2.20 per seedling is provided in three installments. **Ownership of Seedlings:** The beneficiary retains full ownership of the seedlings raised and can sell or use them without requiring permission from anyone. **Income Generation:** The scheme is recognized as a "very good income generating activity". **Accessibility of Plants:** Decentralized people's nurseries ensure the availability of plants within a reasonable distance of villages for extensive tree plantations in both rural and urban areas. **Targeted Benefits for Scheduled Caste Community:** Under the "Special Component Program (SCP)-Decentralised Peoples Nursery", similar benefits are extended to beneficiaries and beneficiary groups belonging to the Scheduled Caste community.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be interested in raising seedlings. - The scheme is open to all individuals. - The applicant must typically aim to raise a target of 20,000 seedlings. **Preference** - An applicant who can keep a piece of land reserved for the purpose of nursery for a minimum of twelve months. - An applicant who plans to undertake the nursery activity as a commercial activity and not merely a seasonal one on that piece of land. **Specific to Decentralized School / Kisan Nursery** - The interested stakeholder must submit an application in response to an advertisement in the local media. - Small and marginal farmers, Below Poverty Line (BPL) cardholder families, landless laborers, and schools can raise plants under this variant. **Specific to SCP-Decentralised Peoples Nursery** - The beneficiary or beneficiary group must belong to the Scheduled Caste community.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the prescribed format of the [application form](https://forests.gujarat.gov.in/writereaddata/images/pdf/2-kissan-nursery-request.pdf). **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to - _PCCF & HOFF, Gujarat State, Block A, 1st Floor, Aranya Bhavan,Opp, St.Xaviers School,Near Ch-3 Circle, Sector-10/A, Gandhinagar._ **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable). **NOTE:** Ensure that the application is submitted within the prescribed period, if any.

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Bhavishyalakshi Kaushalya Vikas Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to develop skills of youth through new age technology-based courses in manufacturing, service and other sectors to create skilled manpower in the state. It provides quality training and certification to Gujarat domicile students.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Bhavishyalakshi Kaushalya Vikas Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Youth, Skill, Training, Employment, Technology, Student, Certification | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Mukhyamantri Bhavishyalakshi Kaushalya Vikas Yojana (MBKVY)" by the Labour, Skill Development and Employment Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide skill development training to youth in manufacturing, service and other sectors through new age technology-based courses to meet current industry requirements and create skilled manpower in the state. The scheme provides short-term courses, digital training, future skill courses and new age courses with quality training according to current technology, along with practical training as per the latest technology requirements. The applicant must be a domicile of Gujarat state and must have passed at least Standard 10/12/Industrial Training Institute/Degree-Diploma. The scheme is implemented by Gujarat Skill Development Mission under the guidance of Steering Committee and Implementation and Monitoring Committee. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through skills.gujarat.gov.in portal.
## Benefits **Training Cost Coverage:** Training cost will be directly paid to the Training Provider's bank account based on Common Skilling Norms for National Skill Qualification Framework courses. **Assessment Fee Coverage:** Assessment fee for National Skill Qualification Framework courses will be paid to the concerned Assessment Agency as per set standards. **Industry-Demand Based Course Fees:** For new courses based on industry demand, training cost will be paid to training centers as determined by the Steering Committee. **Special Course Fees:** For special types of courses conducted by Skill Institutes/Industrial Training Institutes/Kaushalya The Skill University, training cost and method will be as approved by the Steering Committee. **Infrastructure Support:** Raw material, guest faculty, Training of Trainers, tools equipment, office expenses etc. will be covered under training cost for Industrial Training Institutes. **Certification:** Certification will be provided through concerned Sector Skill Councils/Gujarat Council for Vocational Training/Kaushalya The Skill University.
**Payment Milestones** _(as reviewed by Mission Director, Gujarat Skill Development Mission)_ - 30%: After commencement of training batch against valid candidates. - 40%: After certification of trainees (with respect to passed out trainees). - 30%: Based on placement results (final payment as per Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana guidelines).
## Eligibility Criteria - The trainees must be a domicile of Gujarat. - The trainees must have passed at least 10th Standard / 12th Standard / Industrial Training Institute / Degree-Diploma. - Trainees must be registered on the portal with Aadhaar number submission by Training Provider. - Training must be conducted only through trainers as per course guidelines and syllabus. - On Job Training must be made mandatory as per course requirements, with On Job Training/soft skills to be covered for others. - The Training Centers must carry branding of the MBKVY scheme. _*Monitoring will be portal-based and payments will be made based on portal data only._ _*For National Skill Qualification Framework courses, assessment and certification will be done through concerned Sector Skill Councils/Gujarat Council for Vocational Training/Kaushalya The Skill University._ _*For new courses based on industry demand, assessment will be conducted as per standards set by Gujarat Council for Vocational Training or Kaushalya The Skill University, with certification provided through Gujarat Council for Vocational Training and Kaushalya The Skill University._
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process** **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](https://skills.gujarat.gov.in) of Gujarat Skill Development Mission (GSDM). At the top right corner, click "Register". You will be taken to the registration page. **Step 2:** On the Registration Page, fill in all the mandatory fields: User group, Name of SPOC, Email Address, Mobile Number. If prompted, verify your Email ID and Mobile Number via OTP. Provide the Captcha Code and click "Register".
> **Application Process** **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](https://skills.gujarat.gov.in/) of Gujarat Skill Development Mission (GSDM). At the top right corner, click "Login". Login using your credentials created during the Registration Process. **Step 2:** To obtain center accreditation and affiliation for providing training, navigate to the online application form of the scheme. In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. **Step 3:** Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections. Finally, submit your application. You'll receive a confirmation message.

metadata.schemeName: Formation of Mahila Mangal and Yuvak Mangal Dal
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to form groups of interested women and men from Gram Panchayats across the state, who are 18 years of age or above, enabling them to avail the benefits of various schemes of the Youth Welfare and PRD Department and to collectively undertake business or livelihood activities.

page_content:
# Formation of Mahila Mangal and Yuvak Mangal Dal **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Group, Youth, Mahila Mangal Dal, Yuvak Mangal Dal | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Formation of Mahila Mangal and Yuvak Mangal Dal” was launched by the Department of Youth Welfare and prantiy rakshak dal (PRD), Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to form groups of interested women and men from Gram Panchayats across the state, who are 18 years of age or above, enabling them to avail the benefits of various schemes of the Youth Welfare and PRD Department and to collectively undertake business or livelihood activities.
## Benefits It is mandatory to form a group in order to avail the benefits of various schemes of the Youth Welfare and PRD Department and to collectively undertake any business activity.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be an interested woman or man. 1. The applicant must be a resident of a Gram Panchayat in Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - Formation of Mahila Mangal and Yuvak Mangal Dals – The Youth Welfare & PRD Department forms one Mahila Mangal Dal and one Yuvak Mangal Dal in each Gram Panchayat. - Any individual wishing to become a member of the Mahila Mangal Dal or Yuvak Mangal Dal must have a related proposal passed by the Gram Sabha and submitted to the concerned Regional Youth Welfare and PRD Officer.

metadata.schemeName: Food Bill Assistant for Medical & Engineering Students of SEBC
metadata.briefDescription: The Government of Gujarat provides financial assistance to students belonging to Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC) who are studying in self-financed medical and engineering colleges/universities.

page_content:
# Food Bill Assistant for Medical & Engineering Students of SEBC **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Student, SEBC, Medical, Engineering | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Food Bill Assistant for Medical & Engineering Students of SEBC" scheme was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial relief for food expenses to SEBC category students pursuing higher education in the medical and engineering fields. Under this scheme, financial assistance per month for a maximum of 10 months is provided to eligible students.
## Benefits - **Financial Assistance:** - ₹300/- per month (₹3,000/- annually) towards mess charges for most eligible SEBC students. - ₹700/- per month (₹7,000/- annually) towards mess charges for selected students (limited number of beneficiaries). - ₹1,500/- per month (₹15,000/- annually) for SEBC students studying in self-financed medical/engineering colleges and residing in hostels (with a fixed ceiling on the number of beneficiaries). - **Duration:** Maximum of 10 months in an academic year.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC). 1. The applicant should be pursuing a Medical or Engineering degree in a recognized institution. 1. The applicant must have passed HSC (Class 12th).1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-. 1. The applicant who is already availing similar mess assistance under any other government scheme is not eligible.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit the Digital Gujarat Portal: [https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/) **Step 2:** On the home page, click on ‘Register’ and the applicant will be redirected to the registration form page. **Step 3:** Enter your Mobile Number, Email, Set Password, and then click on ‘Save’. **Step 4:** After successful registration, the applicant can login through his/her User Name (Mobile No./Email ID) and Password. **Step 5:** Now, click on ‘My Profile’ to update your profile and fill in all the mandatory information. **Step 6:** After filling in profile details, click on ‘Update Profile’. The profile will be updated after entering the verification Code (OTP). **Step 7:** Now under services, select ‘Scholarship Services’ and then click on ‘SC Scheme’. **Step 8:** Select the Financial Year for which you want to apply for and then click on ‘Change Financial Year’. **Step 9:** Select the scheme, read the interaction carefully, and then click on ‘Continue to Service’. **Step 10:** Fill in the application form completely and upload all the relevant documents. **Step 11:** Now, click on ‘Save as Draft’ and agree with the terms & conditions, and submit the application form by clicking on ‘Confirm & Final Submit’.
> **Instructions****:** **Note 1:** Photo uploading for all applicants is mandatory. **Note 2:** Application will be considered complete only when all sections are completed. **Note 3:** Only one application per applicant will be acceptable for a scholarship. If any student submits more than one application either from a single institute or from multiple institutions his/her all applications will be rejected by the competent authority and no request from any side will be entertained. **Note 4:** In case of any wrong/misleading information provided in the application shall lead to rejection of the application by Department Authorities. **Note 5:** All required documents must be carefully scanned as per the instructions given. **Note 6:** The student has to fill his/her application carefully as there is no provision for institution change once the application is submitted successfully. **Note 7:** The unreadable uploaded documents will allow the competent authority to reject the student application. **Note 8:** Direct Individual submission of this application form will not be accepted in case of students studying inside the state. Only outside students have to fill out their form online and submit his/her application form to their native district officer. metadata.schemeName: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Field Demonstration (TASP & OTASP) Gujarat
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve the agricultural production and livelihood of Scheduled Tribe farmers. Through this scheme, subsidies on seeds, fertilizers, and demonstrations are provided to tribal cultivators.

page_content:
# Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Field Demonstration (TASP & OTASP) Gujarat **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Adivasi Farmers, Crop Production, Livelihood, Seeds, Fertilizer, Subsidies, Field Demonstration | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Distribution of Seeds of more productive varieties / Hybrid varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies, etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area (TASP)" with a component "Field demonstration (TASP & OTASP)" is introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide subsidized agricultural inputs to enhance productivity and livelihood of tribal farmers. Farmers belonging to scheduled tribes and tribal cultivators residing outside tribal areas can achieve higher production of agricultural crops and improve their livelihood by using plant protection equipment, tarpaulins, field demonstrations, micronutrients, agriculture fairs, water carrying pipelines, castor cake/neem cake/LFOM/green manure, pump sets, 100% water-soluble fertilizer, plant protection pesticides, etc. These tools and practices, when used according to scientific recommendations, can significantly increase crop production and, consequently, improve their livelihood.
## Benefits The assistance is provided within the limit of ₹4000/- for the demonstration of one acre (0.40 ha). A demonstration per account.
> **Frequency of Disbursement:** The benefit can be availed every years. > **Remark:** As per conditions No. 5, 16, 17, 19 and 22 of [Appendix-1](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in/Schemeatoz.aspx). (Refer Scheme No. 35). And condition number-14 is to provide the input material prescribed by the committee.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Tribe. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should be located in tribal areas OR be a tribal cultivator residing outside tribal areas. 1. The scheme excludes farmers from Dang district.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Approach the Gram Sevak in your village for access to the Field Demonstration (TASP & OTASP) under the scheme.

metadata.schemeName: Integrated Child Development Services- Uttarakhand
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve the nutritional and health status of all children aged 6 months to 6 years, along with pregnant women and lactating mothers in the state, by providing supplementary nutrition, immunisation, and regular health check-ups.

page_content:
# Integrated Child Development Services- Uttarakhand **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Women and Child | **Tags:** Child Development, Anganwadi Centre, Health Check-ups, Children, Pregnant Woman, Lactating Mother | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Integrated Child Development Services” is implemented by the Department of Women Empowerment & Child Development, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to improve the nutritional and health status of all children aged 6 months to 6 years, along with pregnant women and lactating mothers in the state, by providing supplementary nutrition, immunisation, and regular health check-ups.
## Benefits **The following services are provided free of cost through Anganwadi Centres:** - Supplementary nutrition, immunisation/vaccination, and related services for children between 6 months and 3 years. - Immunisation/vaccination, pre-school education, and related services for children aged 3 to 6 years. - Immunisation/vaccination, health check-ups, nutrition, and health education services for pregnant and lactating mothers.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. All children between 6 months and 6 years, as well as pregnant women and lactating mothers, are eligible to avail benefits under this scheme. 1. There is no income limit for availing the benefits of this scheme.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Registration for availing benefits under the scheme is done either by the Anganwadi worker of the concerned area or by the beneficiary herself by visiting the nearest Anganwadi Centre. The Aadhaar card of the pregnant woman, lactating mother, or child is required for registration. **The following benefits under the scheme are provided through Anganwadi workers, with beneficiary details registered on the Poshan Tracker mobile app:** - **Cooked Food:** Pre-school children aged 3 to 6 years, registered at Anganwadi Centres, are provided breakfast and freshly cooked meals 25 days a month at the centres. - **Take Home Ration (THR):** Wheat and fortified rice are provided every month to children aged 6 months to 3 years, children aged 3 to 6 years, severely malnourished children, as well as pregnant and lactating women through Anganwadi workers. In addition, immunisation, vaccination, and health check-ups are provided with the support of the Health Department.

metadata.schemeName: DESW Internship Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to engage Indian Youth as interns to gain firsthand experience and understanding of welfare, healthcare, resettlement, and administrative schemes meant for Ex-Servicemen.

page_content:
# DESW Internship Scheme **Ministry:** Ministry Of Defence | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Ex-Servicemen, Research, Graduate, Postgraduate, Students, Indian Youth, Interns | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "DESW Internship Scheme" by the Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare (DESW), Ministry of Defence, Government of India, aims to engage Indian youth as interns to gain firsthand experience and understanding of welfare, healthcare, resettlement, and administrative schemes meant for Ex-Servicemen. Through this scheme, the interns will undertake a structured study and submit a report that may contribute to policy or program improvements. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare (DESW).
> **Duration of Internship:** - **Minimum duration:** 2 months- **Maximum duration:** 12 months- Internships are available throughout the year, based on DESW requirements.
## Benefits 1. Opportunity to gain firsthand experience in welfare, healthcare, resettlement, and administrative schemes meant for Ex-Servicemen. 1. Structured research assignment on specific topics related to Ex-Servicemen welfare. 1. Issuance of a certificate of successful completion upon satisfactory performance. 1. Potential publication of selected reports or excerpts with due credit to the intern.
> **Scope of Work: Interns will be assigned specific topics related to:-** - Welfare schemes for Ex-Servicemen and their families. - Resettlement and rehabilitation programs. - Healthcare policies for veterans. - Administrative processes and challenges in veteran affairs.
> **Note: For Completion & Certification** > Interns shall submit their final report to the designated officer.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a citizen of India. 1. The applicant should be a graduate or postgraduate student from any recognised university or institution in any academic stream. 1. A No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the parent institution must be submitted along with the application.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:****** Visit the [official website](https://www.desw.gov.in/) of the Department of Ex-servicemen Welfare. **Step 2:****** Click on "Scheme" from the menu and select "DESW Internship Scheme". **Step 3:****** A new tab will appear. In the scheme guidelines, click on the highlighted “Click Here” link for the application form. **Step 4:** A [Google Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdn8__EYvlgsvAQoarxqXow5tv-3EFp94BkIMznpaoLssLfWA/viewform) will open as the Proforma of Application for the DESW Internship Scheme. **Step 5:****** Enter the Name of the Applicant, Father’s/Mother’s Name, Date of Birth, and select Nationality. **Step 6:****** Provide Address for Correspondence and Mobile Number. **Step 7:****** Fill 10th, 12th, Graduation and Post-Graduation Class Details: Board/Course Name, Year of Passing, Percentage Obtained and University Name (where required) **Step 8:****** Mention Current Course Pursuing (if any), Select Internship Duration (2 months to 1 year). Choose Area(s) of Interest from the given options. **Step 9:****** State whether you have previously interned with any Government body and provide details if applicable. **Step 10:****** Write a Statement of Purpose (Why do you want to join this internship?) (maximum 200 words). **Step 11:****** Agree to the Undertaking by the Applicant, select NOC Option (Not Applicable / Will Submit Before Joining) and review all entered information and click Submit to complete the application. _*Once approved for the interview, they are required to submit the hard copy of Resume, Statement of purpose (max 200 words), No Objection Certificate from institution._

metadata.schemeName: Stamp Duty Refund
metadata.briefDescription: The Government of Haryana offers reimbursement of stamp duty charges to incentivize industrial investment and infrastructure development across the state. This scheme provides financial relief on stamp duty paid during land or property registration for eligible sectors and locations.

page_content:
# Stamp Duty Refund **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Government of Haryana offers reimbursement of stamp duty charges to incentivize industrial investment and infrastructure development across the state. The Government of Haryana’s Stamp Duty Reimbursement Scheme offers financial relief on stamp duty paid during land or property registration to promote industrial investment and infrastructure development. The scheme primarily benefits eligible enterprises in Category B, C, and D blocks across sectors like IT, ESDM, Textiles, and Startups, offering 80% to 100% reimbursement based on location. Units must be registered under applicable industrial policies and apply within a defined period after the transaction.
## Benefits 1. **General Industrial Units:** 100% refund in 'D' category blocks; 75% in 'C' category blocks and 60% in 'B' category blocks on the land meant for industrial use, after commencement of commercial production within 5 years from the date of purchase of land.1. **Thrust Sectors/Bio Energy Enterprises [MSME]:** 100% refund in ‘C’ and 'D' category blocks; 80% in ‘B' category blocks on the land meant for industrial use, after commencement of commercial production within 5 years from the date of purchase of land. Note: Registered Farmer Producer Organization (FPO)/ Integrated Pack Houses (having grading, sorting, packaging etc facilities) shall also be eligible.1. **Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) – Thrust Sector [MSME]:** 100% reimbursement of stamp duty for setting up units in ‘B’, ‘C’, ‘D’ category blocks on the meant for Industrial use, after commencement of commercial production within 05 years from the date of purchase of land.1. **Data Centres and Co-Location Facility:** 100% refund of Stamp Duty throughout the State. Import Substitution Enterprises [MSME]: 100% refund in ‘B’, ‘C’ and ‘D’ category blocks on the land meant for industrial use, after commencement of commercial production within 5 years from the date of purchase of land.1. **Essential Sector Enterprises:** 100% refund in B, C & D category blocks on the land meant for industrial use, after commencement of commercial production within 5 years from the date of purchase of land.1. **Industrial Park:** 80% Stamp duty refund to the developer of Industrial Park/Estate in ‘C’ & ‘D’ category blocks.1. **Service Enterprises:** 50% refund of stamp duty in ‘C’ & ‘D’ category blocks and 30% in ‘B’ category blocks for new enterprise, after commencement of service within 5 years from the date of purchase of land.1. **Expansion/Diversification:** - This benefit shall also be applicable to Enterprises [Sr. no. 2(ii) to 2 (xi) above] undergoing 50% additional investment in plant and machinery for expansion/diversification of existing unit. - The Mega projects undertaking expansion/diversification & the identified service enterprises at Clause 2(xi) of the scheme with same criteria of Investment shall be treated as Mega Projects.
## Eligibility Criteria **Industrial Units (MSME, Large, Mega)** 1. Must commence commercial production after 01.01.2021 and within 5 years from the date of land purchase. 1. Land must be purchased before 31.12.2025. 1. Must file IEM/Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) and Haryana Udhyam Memorandum (HUM). 1. Not listed in the restrictive/negative list of the State Government. 1. Must have NOC/CLU, if applicable. 1. Unit must be in commercial production. 1. Must remain in production for at least 5 years.
**General Category Units** 1. Eligible under same criteria as MSME/Large units, even if not covered under thrust sectors.
**Industrial Parks / Estates (Developers) -** 1. Minimum area of 25 acres. 1. Must obtain Industrial License/NOC from competent authority. 1. Refund applicable after full infrastructure development. 1. Infrastructure must be developed within 5 years of land purchase (land purchased before 31.12.2025).

# New Swarnima Scheme (GBCDC) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Women and Child, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Self Employment, Women, Business, Loan, Backward Class | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "New Swarnima Scheme" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide a special scheme for self-employment of women from backward classes living below the poverty line. Through this scheme, financial assistance for chosen businesses is provided to female beneficiaries from socially and educationally backward classes. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Backward Classes Development Corporation.
## Benefits 1. **Loan Amount:** The maximum loan limit under this scheme is up to ₹200,000/- per beneficiary.1. **Interest Rate:** The interest rate in these schemes will be 5% per annum.1. **Loan Coverage:** 95% of unit cost financed by the national corporation (NBCFDC), 5% by the state government.
> **Repayment Terms:** Repayable in 60 equal monthly installments, including interest. > **Mode of Disbursement:** The loan amount is disbursed, with 95 percent of the unit cost from the national corporation and 5 percent from the state government.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should belong to a socially and educationally backward class. 1. The total annual income of the applicant's family should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 and 45 years as on the date of application. 1. The applicant must have experience in a business requiring technical and other skills.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](https://gbcdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) of the Gujarat Backwards Caste Development Corporation. **Step 2:** On the top menu bar, click on "Apply Online". **Step 3:** If you’re a new user, click on "New Registration" Enter personal details (name, mobile number, email, aadhaar number, etc.), create a password, and complete OTP verification. **Step 4:** Use your registered credentials (User ID and password) to log in. **Step 5:** Click on “New Application”. Select “Swayam Saksham Yojana” from the list of available schemes. **Step 6:** Fill out the Application Form, enter the following details: - Personal Information: Name, gender, date of birth, caste, etc. - Address Information: Permanent and correspondence address - Income Details: Monthly family income and source - Loan Requirement: Amount needed, proposed use (e.g., business, self-employment) - Bank Account Details: For loan disbursement **Step 7:** Upload scanned copies of the Caste certificate, Income certificate, Aadhaar card, Passport-size photo, Bank passbook (first page), and Residence proof. **Step 8:** Double-check all details. Click on “Preview” to verify. If all details are correct, click “Submit”. **Step 9:** The**** Applicant will receive an Application ID/Reference Number. Save or print the acknowledgement for future tracking.

page_content:
# Safety Audit **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Business | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Safety Audit Scheme by the Government of Haryana aims to promote safety practices within Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) by supporting them in conducting safety audits and implementing safety equipment. The scheme seeks to minimize workplace hazards and enhance industrial safety standards.
**Objective** The objective of the scheme is to promote safety audit which is a tool that can be utilized to improve safety and attitudes in the workplace. A safety audit is an inventory or checklist of items specifically geared to operations of an enterprise. It allows them to take action, correct hazards, and determine the appropriate actions to take to achieve the desired safety goals. Measuring safety performance also provides a baseline to compare future safety initiatives. It documents the effectiveness of safety program, identify compliance deficiencies, suggest safety solutions, improve the environment and personnel safety, reduce incidents and injuries and increase workplace safety.
## Benefits 1. 75% reimbursement of expenses incurred for conducting safety audits, up to ₹1,00,000/-. 1. 50% subsidy on cost of capital equipment required for safety measures, up to ₹5,00,000/-.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a Micro, Small, or Medium Enterprise (MSME), either newly established or existing. 1. The enterprise must be registered with the appropriate authority (e.g., Udyog Aadhaar / EM Part-II). 1. The safety audit must be conducted by auditors from a recognized ISO-certified agency. 1. The industrial units must also comply with the following conditions: - The item of manufacture should not fall in the restrictive list as notified by the State Government from time to time. - Investments in new plant, machinery and equipments focussed towards enhancing safety shall only be eligible for subsidy under this scheme. - The units should have obtained NOC/CLU from competent authority, if applicable. - The units should be in commercial production. - The units should be in regular production at the time of disbursement and the assistance shall not be released to the closed unit.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number & password. metadata.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Installation of Cage in Reservoir - Gujarat
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to boost inland fish production and employment in fisheries. It provides financial assistance for cage installation in reservoirs to eligible beneficiaries.

page_content:
# Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Installation of Cage in Reservoir - Gujarat **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Fish Farming, Biofloc, Recirculating Aquaculture System, Freshwater Hatcheries, Cage | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland)" with the component of Installation of Cage in Reservoir (PMMSY), introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and providing employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided for cage culture in inland reservoirs to encourage inland aquaculture and maximise fish production using advanced techniques. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State Governments, with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% from the Government of Gujarat. > **Objectives:** - Increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. - Accelerate inland fish farming activities in fresh water bodies, increase inland fish production and boost inland fisheries. - Except for water bodies or ponds In less land less water Biofloc with source as well, Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS). By creating fish tanks with this method, more fish production can be obtained in less land and less water. If more beneficiaries get the benefit of the subsidy of this scheme, more fish production can be achieved in less water sources and less land. - Inland fish production capacity can be increased by the establishment of freshwater hatcheries.
## Benefits 1. The capital unit cost is ₹1,500/- per cubic meter. 1. The operational cost is ₹1,500/- per cubic meter. 1. **Minimum area per cage:** 100 cubic meters.1. **For individual beneficiaries:** Assistance up to 1,800 cubic meters.1. **For Co-operative Societies / SHGs / Joint Liability Groups:** - 600 cubic meter per member - Maximum up to 7,200 cubic meters water area. 1. **Subsidy Rate:** - General Category: 40% of unit cost. - Women / Scheduled Castes / Scheduled Tribes: 60% of unit cost. - Government Share: 60% Central Government + 40% State Government.
> **Frequency of Disbursement:** One-time benefit for the eligible component.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be an individual, society, self-help group, association, reservoir lease holder, or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-owners, the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhar Card/Passport as proof of identity. > **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:** > All categories (General, Women, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe) will get benefit under the Inland Schemes. > Women, Scheduled Caste, and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries receive 60% of the unit cost as assistance.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side, then click on "Beneficiary Registration" and select any one from the 'Farmer' or 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. **Step 3:** Enter the 'Company Name' and Address if you have selected 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. And for all select the District, Taluka, and Village, choose 'what type of account holder you are?', enter your Account Number and Name, solve the Captcha, and click 'Save and Next'. **Step 4:** Enter your Mobile Number and E-mail address, click 'Send OTP', enter the received OTP, create and confirm a Password, solve the Captcha, and click 'Submit'.
> **Login Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side of the homepage. On the home page, click on ‘Schemes’ and then click on ‘Agricultural Schemes’. **Step 3:** Now select the scheme, click on the ‘Apply’ button, and an application page will open. **Step 4:** Click on the "Apply New" button and submit a new application. **Step 5:** Click on the "Update Application" button to add corrections to the application. **Step 6:** Once the application is done, confirm it. **Step 7:** Take a printout of the confirmed application.
> **Contact Us:** [**Click here**](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_Contacts.aspx)**.**
