page_content:
# Prof. Joseph Mundassery Scholarship Award **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Kerala | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Award, Education, College, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Prof. Joseph Mundassery Scholarship Award" was introduced by the Department of Minority Welfare, Government of Kerala. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to financially backward students from minority communities. Through this scheme, financial assistance in the form of scholarship amounts is provided to eligible students from Christian, Buddhist, Jain, Sikh, Muslim, and Parsi communities to pursue higher education. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Minority Welfare, Government of Kerala.
## Benefits - The students who score an A+ in Secondary School Leaving Certificate (SSLC)/Plus Two (12) or Technical High School Leaving Certificate(THSL) will get ₹10,000/-. - The undergraduate students with 80% marks will get ₹15,000/-. - The postgraduate student with 75% marks will get ₹15,000/-.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a permanent citizen of Kerala. - The applicant must belong to a minority community (Christian, Buddhist, Jain, Sikh, Muslim, or Parsi). - The applicant shall be from a below-poverty-line family. - The applicant shall be studying in any government school. - The annual income of the candidate’s family must be below ₹8,00,000/- per year. - The applicant pursuing SSLC, Plus Two, or Vocational Higher Secondary Education (VHSE) level must have a Full A+ grade to avail the scholarship. - The applicant pursuing undergraduate studies must have 80% marks to avail the scholarship. - The applicant pursuing postgraduate studies must have 75% marks to avail the scholarship.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](https://www.minoritywelfare.kerala.gov.in) of the Directorate of Minority Welfare. **Step 2:****** Locate and click on the "Scholarship". **Step 3:** Navigate to the "Scholarship" menu link and click on "Prof. Joseph Mundassery Scholarship Award". **Step 4:****** Click on "Apply Now". **Step 5:** For new scholarship applicants, first complete one-time registration and log in with your candidate details. **Step 6:** In the Registration Form, carefully enter the details step-by-step under Examination details (register number/roll number), Personal details, and Scholarship details tabs. **Step 7:** In the Upload details tab, upload the required documents (Photo, Signature, SSLC Certificate, Income Certificate, Ration Card Copy, Allotment Memo) in JPEG format under 100 KB size each. **Step 8:****** Only after uploading all required documents, the registration process will be considered complete. **Step 9:****** After completing the application submission, use the View/Print Application link to take a printout of the application form. > **Submission of Application Printout** - After submitting the scholarship application (either through new registration or login), click on "View/Print Application" to get a printout of your registration form. - Submit the printout of the registration form along with all the required supporting documents to the head of the institution where you are studying, within the specified deadline.

page_content:
# Term Loan Scheme (GNDTDC) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Business, Loan, Small-scale Business, Nomadic Tribes, Denotified Tribes | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Term Loan Scheme" is implemented by the Gujarat Nomadic and Denotified Tribes Development Corporation (GNDTDC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to promote self-employment among individuals from the Nomadic and Denotified Tribes communities by providing financial assistance for agriculture and allied activities, small-scale businesses, craftsmanship & traditional occupations as well as service-based businesses/trades. Under this scheme, beneficiaries can avail loans at concessional interest rates to purchase equipment, raw materials, or working capital.
## Benefits **Loan Amount Details:** - **Loan Amount:** Up to ₹20,00,000/-.- **Interest Rate:** 6% per annum. - **Loan Contribution:** 85% will be from the National Corporation, 10% from the State Government, 5% from the beneficiary.- **Repayment:** The total loan amount, including interest, must be repaid in 60 equal monthly instalments.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Nomadic Tribe or Denotified Tribe. 1. The applicant's family's annual income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 to 50 years on the date of application. 1. The applicant must have experience in the proposed trade/business. 1. The applicant will have to provide suitable collateral to get the loan. **Note:** At least 50% of the total loan amount under this scheme will be specifically allocated to families with an annual income of up to ₹1,50,000/-.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1: Visit the Official Portal** - Go to the [Official Website](https://gndcdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) Gujarat Nomadic and Denotified Tribes Development Corporation.- Scroll down on the homepage, find the "Term Loan" and click on "Apply Now". - You will be directed to the application form. **Step 2: Access and Fill Out the Application Form** - Complete all sections under "Applicant information," including full name, father/husband's name, gender, complete address details, contact numbers, Aadhaar No., parents/husband/guardian occupation and income details. Also provide Date of Birth, Age, Caste, and Subspecies. Also, if you are disabled and provide a percentage. - If you have taken a past loan, select "Yes" or "No". If you selected "Yes", provide loan details (date, amount, paid, remaining) and your account number. - Provide bank account number, bank name, branch name, name as per account, account type (Saving/Current), MICR code, and IFSC code. **Step 3: Upload Documents** - Go to "Upload Photo" in the menu, then upload your photograph and signature (each file less than 15 KB). Click "Save Photo and Signature" - Navigate to "Upload Document" in the menu and upload all required files (PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG only). **Step 4: Review and Final Submission** - Carefully review each module. Use the preview option to examine the application before final submission. Fill out the provided "CAPTCHA" and Click on “Submit”. **Track and Review Status** - Applicant will receive an Application ID/Reference Number. Save or print the acknowledgement for future tracking. - Go to the [Official Website](https://gndcdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) Gujarat Nomadic and Denotified Tribes Development Corporation.- Scroll down and locate the Know App Status. Click on "Know App Status". - Select the Scheme name, Enter App No., and Birth Date. Fill out the Captcha and click on Submit.

page_content:
# Junior/Senior Fellowship in the Field of Fine Arts **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Fine Arts, Artist, Fellowship, Painting, Sculpture | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Junior/Senior Fellowship in the Field of Fine Arts" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to nurture artistic talent and provide financial support for experimental, research-based, or revival-focused projects in the fields of painting, sculpture, and graphic arts. The scheme benefits both junior and senior artists of Gujarat by awarding them monthly stipends, thereby helping them undertake advanced training, revive endangered Indian or folk arts, and develop their careers in art. Under this scheme, 5 senior artists will be provided with a monthly stipend of ₹3,000/-, and 10 junior artists will be provided with a monthly stipend of ₹2,000/- for one year. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Fine Arts Academy.
## Benefits - **Fellowship for Senior Artists:** ₹3,000/-per month. - **Fellowship for Junior Artists:** ₹2,000/- per month.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a resident artist of Gujarat. - The applicant should be actively engaged in the field of painting, sculpture, or graphic arts.


## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should download the prescribed format of the [application form](https://lalitkalaacademy.gujarat.gov.in/writereaddata/Portal/Magazine/Document/1_36_3_felloship-application-form.pdf) for the "Publication Support Scheme for Fine Arts" scheme. **Step 2:** In the application form, provide all the mandatory details, including career details in the field of art, photographs, or color slides of work (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the supporting documents to the Gujarat State Fine Arts Academy. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority at the Academy office to whom the application has been submitted. **Note:** Applications for book publication are invited every year through advertisement in daily newspapers. > **Contact Us:** > Gujarat State Academy of Fine Arts > Ravi Shankar Rawal Kala Bhavan, > Opposite Bhaikaka Bhavan, > Law Garden, Ellisbridge, > Ahmedabad - 380006. > 079-26425562 > 079-26562558

page_content:
# "Interest Subvention on Working Capital" under the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme" **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Assam | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Subsidy, Capital, Interest, Incentive, Industry | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Interest Subvention on Working Capital" component of "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme (ATISIS)" by the Finance (Institutional Finance) Department, Government of Assam, aims to ensure long-term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and to incentivize manufacturers to move from Crush, Tear, Curl tea to Orthodox tea production. The component provides interest subvention on working capital loans at 3% per annum. The scheme is implemented by the Finance Department and the Industries & Commerce Department, Government of Assam, through multiple implementing agencies, including banks and the District Industries & Commerce Centre. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through a dedicated portal with a Direct Benefit Transfer mechanism for reimbursement.
## Benefits **Benefit Amount:** Interest subvention of 3% per annum on Working Capital Loan. **Maximum Claimable Amount:** ₹20,00,000/- per annum per unit (garden). **Validity Period:** Extended for five years till the end of the Financial Year 2027-28. **Applicable Financial Years:** 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26, 2026-27, and 2027-28. **Disbursement Mode:** Direct Benefit Transfer as reimbursement. **Claim Period:** On completion of every financial year.
## Eligibility Criteria **General Eligibility** - The applicant must be a tea plantation across all sizes - The applicant must be a tea manufacturing unit manufacturing Crush, Tear, Curl Tea, Orthodox Tea, or Speciality tea including Green tea, Oolong Tea, White tea, Yellow tea and Purple tea - The applicant must be located entirely in Assam - The applicant must not have any part of the plantation or manufacturing facility located outside the State of Assam
**Interest Subvention Specific Eligibility** - The applicant must have taken loan from a Scheduled Commercial Bank or a Public Financial Institution. - The applicant must have taken Working Capital Loan for activities directly related to plantation or manufacturing of Tea. - The applicant must have Working Capital sanctioned or renewed on or after 1st April of the financial year in which claim is to be made (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26, 2026-27 and 2027-28). - The applicant must not have loan accounts declared as Non-Performing Asset as per Reserve Bank of India guidelines on the date of filing claim. - The applicant must not have availed any interest subsidy under any other scheme.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Registration Process** **Step 1:** Visit the [dedicated portal](https://atisis.assam.gov.in/atsisver/login.html) of "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives" Scheme. Click on the "New User Registration" option. **Step 2:** In the registration form, fill in basic details including name, mobile number, and email address. Create a username and password following the portal's password policy. Verify your mobile number through one-time password verification. Complete Captcha Code verification. Submit the registration form. **Step 3:** Check your registered email for the account activation link. Click on the activation link to activate the account. Log in to the portal using registered credentials. **Step 4:** Upload all supporting documents of eligibility in the prescribed format. Fill in complete unit details, including location, type of tea production, and capacity. Submit the unit registration form. Wait for registration approval.
**Application Process** **Step 1:** Log in to the portal using registered credentials. Navigate to the "Apply for Benefits" section. Select the scheme component that you intend to apply for. **Step 2:** Fill in the prescribed application form with all mandatory fields. Upload all supporting documents as mentioned in the portal. Ensure file formats and file size restrictions are followed as per the portal guidelines. Review all entered information for accuracy. **Step 3:** Upload documents in the specified format and size. Ensure all documents are clear and legible. Complete document verification checklist. **Step 4:** Review the complete application before submission. Apply online. _*Note down the application reference number. Save a copy of the submitted application form._ _*Applicants are strongly encouraged to save a copy of the submitted application, confirmation message, and application reference number for future reference and tracking purposes._
**Verification Process** **Step 1:** Application is automatically routed to the concerned bank Bank verifies the amount of interest at 3%, borrower credentials, loan account classification as Standard, and interest servicing status. The Bank approves the application on the portal. **Step 2:** After verification, if claims are found in order, the Commissioner, Industries & Commerce Department forwards claims to the Finance Department. The Finance Department processes the claim for online reimbursement through Direct Benefit Transfer.
**Disbursement Process** The Finance Department releases the subsidy amount directly to the beneficiary's bank account. Short Message Service alerts sent for funds disbursement. The beneficiary receives the Direct Benefit Transfer in a registered bank account. **Application Status Tracking** Log in to the portal to check application status. Track application progress through different stages of verification. Receive Short Message Service alerts throughout the process, including registration, fund release, etc. **Important Deadlines** Claim on completion of every financial year. _*For Technical Support, please write to atisis.assam@gmail.com._

# Cash Award to Women Players of the State **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Sports, Women Athletes, Cash Prize | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Cash Award to Women Players of the State" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to promote participation of women in sports and recognize their achievements by awarding them cash incentives for outstanding performance in state-level and national-level competitions. Female athletes securing the first, second, or third position in individual or team sports at the state level, or representing Gujarat at national competitions, receive annual scholarships based on their rank and category. The scheme is implemented by the Sports Authority of Gujarat.
## Benefits - **First Position (Individual & Team Sports at State Level/ National Representation):** ₹4,800/- per year - **Second Position (Individual & Team Sports at State Level):** ₹3,600/- per year - **Third Position (Individual Sports at State Level):** ₹2,400/- per year
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a woman. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should have passed the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) examination. 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should have secured first, second, or third position in individual or collective sports competitions held at the state level. 1. The applicant should have represented Gujarat state in national-level sports competitions. 1. The applicant’s accomplishment must have occurred within the respective financial year.

page_content:
# District Level Sports School **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Sports, Young Athlete Training, School Sports Program | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched in 2013-14, the scheme "District Level Sports School" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide intensive sports training and quality education to young athletes by establishing district-level sports schools under a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model. The scheme seeks to identify sporting talent from events such as Khel Mahakumbh and train them using modern infrastructure, scientific methods, expert coaching, and proper nutrition, while ensuring access to formal school education. The initiative began with 9 schools (6 residential and 3 non-residential), and expanded to 24 schools by 2017-18, catering to over 2,500 students in 21 sports disciplines. Selected athletes receive benefits such as accommodation, food, school uniforms, books, sports kits, and equipment. An average of ₹2.25 lakh is spent per player annually, including ₹1 lakh Mediclaim security. The scheme is implemented by the Sports Authority of Gujarat (SAG).
## Benefits > **Monetary Support & Facilities:** - Players are provided with free education, stationery, books, accommodation, meals, school uniforms, and modern sports equipment and kits. > **Medical Insurance:** - A Mediclaim security cover of up to ₹1,00,000/- is provided to each selected athlete. > **Expert Coaching & Training:** - Intensive sports training is imparted in morning and evening sessions by expert coaches. In-school players receive additional training in 5 Physical Training (PT) periods.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be below 14 years of age. 1. The applicant must qualify under one of the following categories: - **Proven Talent (PT):** 1. The applicant should have already performed at School Games Federation of India (SGFI), State-level, or National-level sports events. 1. The applicant must participate in a selection camp for final admission. - **Young Talent (YT):** 1. The applicant should have participated and secured first place at Taluka/District/Corporation level in Khel Mahakumbh (Under-9 or Under-11 category). 1. The applicant must register for Khel Mahakumbh and undergo the selection process. - **In-School Talent:** 1. The applicant should be identified within a school already running the DLSS program.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline > **For Young Talent:** **Step 1:** The applicant must register under the [Khel Mahakumbh](https://khelmahakumbh.gujarat.gov.in/login) before reaching 13 years of age. **Step 2:** Upon qualifying, the names are registered automatically by the authorities for the next stage of selection. > **For Proven Talent:** **Step 1:** The applicant must send an email to dlss.sag@gmail.com with basic details like age, academic standard, game, and achievements. **Step 2:** The authorities will process the application and contact the candidate for further steps. > **Contact Us:** > Director General, Sports Authority of Gujarat > Sport,Youth & Cultural Activities Department > Administrative Building, Sector 13-B, > Near Kh-3 Circle, Near Vavol Railway Crossing, > Beside EVM warehouse, Gandhinagar - 382016 > Contact Number-97140 97760

page_content:
# Small Business Scheme (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Grocery Stores, Dairy Parlors, Animal Feed Sales Centers, Mobile Repair Shop, Computer Repair Shop | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Small Business Scheme" by the Social Justice & Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to support small businesses. Through this scheme, individual loans at an annual interest rate are provided to individuals from the SEBC Rabari and Bharwad communities for establishing businesses such as grocery shops, dairy parlours, animal food sales centres, and mobile-computer repair shops. Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam implements the scheme.
## Benefits 1. The maximum loan limit is ₹2,00,000/- per individual. 1. The interest rate is 6% per annum. 1. The loan amount disbursed is 95% of the total project cost. 1. The beneficiary Contribution is 5% of the total project cost.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should belong to the Rabari and Bharwad castes from the Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC). 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 and 45 years. 1. The applicant's annual income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1: Register on the Official Portal** - Go to the [Official Website ](https://ggdconline.gujarat.gov.in/)of Gujarat Gopalak Development Corporation.- Scroll down on the homepage, find the "Small Business Scheme," and click on "Apply Now". - You will be directed to the [application form](https://gbcdconline.gujarat.gov.in/SchemeSmallBusiness/AddEdit). **Step 2: Access and Fill Out the Application Form** - Select "Small Business Scheme", enter Unit Cost, and specify the Required Loan Amount. - Provide Aadhaar, Ration, Voter ID, full name (Last, First, Father/Husband), address, district, taluka, village, PIN, date of birth, age (21-45 as of 14/08/2023), caste, subcaste, phone, mobile, email, gender, and marital status. - Enter income certificate number, issue date, issuing officer's name, total annual family income (up to ₹ 3,00,000/-), and parent/guardian's occupation. - If "Physically Handicapped," select "Yes" or "No". If you selected "Yes", provide the percentage (in %). - Indicate if any family member works in a government or private job. If "Yes," provide their Name, Designation, Place, and Salary details. - Select your Education Qualification: Uneducated, Educated, Graduation, Post Graduation, or Other Degree. - If you have taken a past loan, select "Yes" or "No". If you selected "Yes", provide loan details (date, amount, paid, remaining) and your account number. - Provide bank account number, bank name, branch name, name as per account, account type (Saving/Current), MICR code, and IFSC code. **Step 3: Review and Final Submission** - Carefully review each module. Use the preview option to examine the application before final submission. Fill out the provided "CAPTCHA" and Click on “Submit”.
**Track and Review Status** - Applicant will receive an Application ID/Reference Number. Save or print the acknowledgement for future tracking. - Go to the [Official Website](https://ggdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) of Gujarat Gopalak Development Corporation.- Scroll down and locate the Know App Status. Click on "Know App Status". - Select the Scheme name, Enter App No., and Birth Date. Fill out the Captcha and click on Submit.

page_content:
# New Akanksha Scheme (Educational Loan) (GNDTDC) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Higher Education, Technical Education, Graduation, Post Graduation, Loan, Nomadic Tribe, Denotified Tribe | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "New Akanksha Scheme (Educational Loan)" is implemented by the Gujarat Nomadic and Denotified Tribes Development Corporation (GNDTDC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. Under this scheme, educational loans are provided to students belonging to Nomadic and Denotified Tribes communities for pursuing higher professional and technical education at the graduate and postgraduate levels.
## Benefits **1. Loan Amount:** The maximum loan limit for this scheme is up to ₹10,00,000/-. **2. Included Expenses:** The loan amount will include the following: - Admission and tuition fees - Expenses for books, uniforms, essential materials, and exam fees - Accommodation and food expenses - Insurance – Policy premium **3. Interest Rate:** - 4% per annum for male students - 3.5% per annum for female students **4. Contribution:** - 90% contribution from the Central Corporation, - 5% from the State Government, - 5% from the beneficiary **5. Repayment Period:** - The loan will have to be repaid in 60 equal monthly installments including interest. - The loan will be recovered within 6 months of completion of the course or upon getting a job, whichever is earlier.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Nomadic Tribe or Denotified Tribe. 1. The applicant's family's annual income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant should be pursuing one of the following courses: - MBA or its equivalent (AICTE-approved course) - MCA (Master of Computer Applications) or its equivalent (AICTE-approved course) - Graduate-level engineering course approved by IIT/AICTE or any other approved professional graduate-level course - Graduate-level medical course from a college recognized by the Medical Council of India - Diploma course in Nursing **Note:** At least 50% of the total loan amount will be allocated for families having an annual income of up to ₹1,50,000/-.
## Exclusions - Loan is not eligible in case of admission obtained under management quota.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1: Visit the Official Portal** - Go to the [Official Website](https://gndcdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) Gujarat Nomadic and Denotified Tribes Development Corporation.- Scroll down on the homepage, find the "Educational Loan (New Akanksha Yojana)" and click on "Apply Now". - You will be directed to the [application form](https://gndcdconline.gujarat.gov.in/SchemeEducation/AddEdit). **Step 2: Access and Fill Out the Application Form** - Complete all sections under "Applicant information," including full name, father/husband's name, gender, complete address details, contact numbers, Aadhaar No., parents/husband/guardian occupation and income details. Also provide Date of Birth, Age, Caste, and Subspecies. Also, if you are disabled and provide a percentage. - For each applicable qualification (SSC, HSC, Diploma, Degree, Graduation), tick the checkbox and fill in the Degree, Board/University Name, Academic year, and Percentage obtained. - Fill in details about the college/institution admitted to, university affiliation, course name, enrollment number, organisation address, website, course duration (in years and semester), and date of admission. - Specify who accredited the course/institution, their name, and address. Proof of accreditation must be submitted. - Select "Yes" or "No" for "Have you obtained admission through government-mandated admission?". - If staying in a hostel, provide the Hostel name, Hostel address, and Hostel contact number. - Fill in the requested loan amounts for Admission Fee, Tuition Fee, Examination Fee, Hostel Fee, Estimated cost of books/stationery, and Other fees. - List details of any physical assets owned (land, house, government property, NCC, LIC, KVP, etc.). - Indicate if anyone in the family works in a government/private sector job. If "Yes," provide Name, Designation, Place, and Salary details. - Fill in the Bank Account Number, select the Bank Name from the dropdown, provide the Branch Name, Name as per Account, select Bank Account Type (Saving/Current), and enter the MICR Code and IFSC Code. **Step 3: Review and Final Submission** - Carefully review each module. Use the preview option to examine the application before final submission. Fill out the provided "CAPTCHA" and Click on “Submit”. ***Track and Review Status*** - Applicant will receive an Application ID/Reference Number. Save or print the acknowledgement for future tracking. - Go to the [Official Website](https://gndcdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) Gujarat Nomadic and Denotified Tribes Development Corporation.- Scroll down and locate the Know App Status. Click on "Know App Status". - Select the Scheme name, Enter App No., and Birth Date. Fill out the Captcha and click on Submit.

page_content:
# Coaching Scheme for Divyang Students

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Divyang, Free Coaching, Disability Support, Competitive Exam Preparation | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Coaching Scheme for Divyang Students" by the National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities (NIEPVD), Dehradun, aims to empower students with benchmark disabilities by supporting their preparation for competitive exams such as SSC, RRB, Banking, Insurance, and UPSC. Through this scheme, free coaching, book allowance, transport/hostel allowance, disability and other allowances are provided to eligible candidates. The scheme is implemented by NIEPVD.

## Benefits
> **Financial Allowances:**


- Coaching fees.
- Transport or hostel allowance.
- Disability allowance.
- Book allowance.

## Eligibility Criteria
- The applicant must be a student with a benchmark disability (40% or more) as defined.
- The applicant must hold a valid disability certificate issued by a competent authority.
- The applicant must possess a Unique Disability ID (UDID).
- The applicant must have an Aadhaar number or Aadhaar enrollment number.
- The total annual family income of the applicant should not exceed ₹8,00,000/-.

## Exclusions
- The applicant should not have availed benefits under any other coaching scheme of the Center or  State Government.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
**Step 1:** Visit the official online application link: [Google Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdKNwhS-U9zGHNRRzwkpW8XUmjD3MgUUEq1faabeEi3Hwv5Hw/viewform)
**Step 2:** Fill in personal details including Aadhaar, UDID, and income-related details.
**Step 3:** Upload the required documents such as disability certificate, income proof, and photo.
**Step 4:** Submit the application form online.
> **Website:** niepvd.nic.in

> **Telephone No.:**0135-2736651, 2734016

> **Email:** tcab-niepvd@nivh.gov.in

metadata.schemeName: PMMSY: Installation of Cages in Reservoirs Scheme - Haryana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote cage fish farming. It provides grants per unit to the individuals and groups for sustainable aquaculture practices.

page_content:
# PMMSY: Installation of Cages in Reservoirs Scheme - Haryana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Fish Farming, Fishermen, Subsidy, Scheduled Caste, Women, General Category | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Installation of Cages in Reservoirs Scheme" was launched by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, under the umbrella scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana". It aims to promote sustainable aquaculture practices by supporting cage fish farming in water bodies. Under this scheme, a grant of ₹3,00,000/- per unit to the individuals and groups for setting up cage fish farms, thereby encouraging entrepreneurship, increasing fish production, and generating employment.
## Benefits **Grant Amount:** - ₹3,00,000/- per unit (per cage). **Grant Proportion:** - 40% of unit cost for General Category beneficiaries. - 60% of unit cost for Scheduled Caste/Women beneficiaries. **Cage Limit for Assistance:** - Up to 5 cages for individual farmers. - Up to 20 cages for registered cooperative societies/self-help groups/joint liability groups (with at least 10 members).
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be an individual farmer, cooperative society, self-help group, or joint liability group. 1. The cooperative society, self-help group, or joint liability group having a minimum of 10 members. 1. The applicant must possess a Family Identity Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant must obtain prior permission from the Government of Haryana and competent authorities. 1. The cage location must have year-round water availability and a minimum of 8 meters depth. 1. The applicant should take government permission for rearing exotic fish species. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details,i.e., Name, Email ID, Mobile Number & password. Click on ‘Submit’. **Step 3:** Verify the OTP received in the provided Email and Mobile Number. Alternatively, click on the Verification Link to activate the profile.

page_content:
# Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Solar System for fish/shrimp culture

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Subsidy, Solar System, Fish, Fish Farmer, Shrimp Culture | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Subsidy on Solar System for Fish/Shrimp Culture" is a component of the Intensive Fisheries Development Programme, implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to fish and shrimp farmers for the purchase/installation of solar systems. Under this scheme, subsidies for solar systems are offered to farmers who cultivate fish or shrimp on a minimum area of 2.5 acres. The subsidy benefit is granted only once per beneficiary for a single unit.

## Benefits
1. A subsidy of 60% on the total project cost amounting to ₹50,000 per kilowatt (KW) or a subsidy amount of ₹30,000 per KW, whichever is less, is provided.
1. The maximum limit for this subsidy is 30 KW for shrimp farmers.
1. The maximum limit for this subsidy is 10 KW for fish farmers.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchaan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant's age should be a minimum of 18 years.
1. The applicant should not be a government or semi-government employee.
1. A minimum of 2.5-acre area is required for fish/shrimp culture. 

> **Note:** The benefit/subsidy will be provided only once to a beneficiary on a single unit.

metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
metadata.briefDescription: The Component 1B of PM-MKSSY provides a one-time incentive to eligible applicants who have availed institutional credit for fisheries-related activities. The objective is to encourage formal credit adoption and support the repayment capacity of fisheries microenterprises.

page_content:
# Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-yojana (PM-MKSSY): COMPONENT 1B: One-Time Incentive for the Adoption of Aquaculture Insurance **Ministry:** Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Incentive, Aquaculture, Insurance, Fisheries, Credit | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-Yojana" is a Central Sector Sub-scheme under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY). It is administered by the Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Government of India. The scheme aims to formalise the fisheries sector and incentivise fisheries-based microenterprises and entrepreneurs to access institutional finance. Under Component 1B, the scheme provides a one-time incentive to eligible applicants who have availed institutional credit for fisheries-related activities. The objective is to encourage formal credit adoption and support the repayment capacity of fisheries microenterprises. To be eligible, the applicant must be registered on the National Fisheries Digital Platform (NFDP) and must have availed credit through a recognised financial institution. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Fisheries through the NFDP, and the application process is online. ## Benefits Financial assistance is provided as a one-time incentive to applicants who have successfully availed institutional credit for fisheries and aquaculture-related activities. **Frequency of Disbursement** - The incentive is one-time and non-recurring. - The incentive can only be availed once per eligible activity and applicant, and no repeated claims are permitted under Component 1-B. **Criteria for Disbursement** - The incentive is not linked to any performance benchmarks beyond initial loan sanction and disbursement. - Funds are released after successful validation and approval of the application by the Project Management Unit (PMU), Department of Fisheries. **Mode of Disbursement** The incentive is transferred directly to the verified bank account of the beneficiary through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mechanism. ## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a fisheries microenterprise or an individual engaged in fisheries or aquaculture-related activities. - The applicant must be registered on the National Fisheries Digital Platform (NFDP). - The applicant must have availed institutional credit from a recognised financial institution. - The applicant must possess a valid Aadhaar-seeded bank account for DBT purposes. - The applicant must submit documentary proof of loan sanction and disbursement. - The applicant must consent to the verification and validation process undertaken by the Department of Fisheries. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - The application process for availing benefits under Component 1-B of the PM-MKSSY is completely online and facilitated through the National Fisheries Digital Platform (NFDP). - The individual interested in applying to this scheme must have already availed of an institutional loan. - The application to this component can be made only once per applicant per eligible activity.
The detailed and sequential steps involved in the application process is given below: **Step 1:** **Visit the Official Website of the "National Fisheries Digital Platform (NFDP)"** The applicant must visit [the official website of NFDP](https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp/#/) using any web browser. Click on “Register” for new registration or “Login” if already registered. **Step 2:** **Complete the Registration Process on NFDP** If the applicant is not already registered, they must click on the “Register” button. Select the relevant applicant category (Individual / Organisation). The system will prompt for entering the mobile number with the country code (+91) followed by One-Time Password (OTP) verification. Post successful OTP authentication, the applicant must create a password in accordance with the portal’s password policy. **Step 3:** **Fill in Profile Information** After login, the applicant must proceed to complete the registration form by filling in the following details: Name as per Aadhaar, Aadhaar Number, Bank Account Number, IFSC Code, Category of enterprise (individual/organisation), Nature of activity (fisheries/aquaculture-related), Contact details and address. **Step 4:** **Upload Mandatory Documents** The applicant must upload clear, legible, and valid copies of the required documents, such as: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook or Statement, Loan Sanction Letter, Loan Disbursement Proof, Depository Account Statement (if applicable), Self-Declaration Form, NFDP Registration, Acknowledgement/Certificate. Each uploaded document must conform to the specified file format (PDF/JPEG) and size limits as mentioned on the portal. **Step 5:** **System-Based Validation and Data Integration** Upon submission of the application, the data entered by the applicant will undergo system-based checks and integration with other government databases to ensure authenticity. If any discrepancies or incomplete information are detected, the applicant will be notified to make necessary corrections. **Step 6:** **Credit Facilitation Support Application** Once the profile is validated, the applicant must navigate to the “Apply for Financial Assistance – Component 1-B” section on the NFDP. Here, the applicant must fill out the form specifying: Bank Name, Loan Amount, Loan Disbursement Date, Purpose of loan and intended fisheries activity, Upload all relevant loan documents. Upon completion, the application must be submitted for further processing. **Step 7:** **Application Review and Sanction** The submitted application is reviewed by Credit Intermediaries and the designated team at the Department of Fisheries. Verified and validated applications are approved by the PMU for disbursement. The application is sanctioned and marked for DBT processing. **Step 8:** **Disbursement of Financial Assistance** After approval, the Project Management Unit (PMU) in the Department of Fisheries, Government of India, will initiate the transfer of funds directly to the applicant’s verified bank account via the DBT mechanism.

# Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Establishment of Backyard mini RAS Units - Haryana

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Fisheries, Subsidy, Backyards, Water Source, Fish Farmer, Fish | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The “Establishment of Backyard Mini RAS Units” is a scheme component under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY), implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. This is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, aims to promote the setup of Mini Recirculatory Aquaculture System (RAS) units to enhance fish production and livelihood opportunities. Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of subsidies is provided to eligible beneficiaries for establishing these units. Various surface and groundwater sources such as canals, rivers, springs, open wells, and tube wells can be utilized for operating RAS units.

## Benefits
- Project cost: ₹50,000/- per unit
- Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category of beneficiaries.
- Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries.

> **Note:** 


- **General Category:** Ratio 16% State Share, 24% Central Share and 60% Beneficiary Share.- **Weaker sections/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Women and their co-operatives:** Ratio 24% State Share, 36% Central Share, 40% Beneficiary Share.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana.
   1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
   1. The applicant should provide documentary evidence of the availability of the requisite land free from all encumbrances, financial resources, necessary clearances/permissions.
   1. The water source for RAS units can be any surface or groundwater source, such as a canal, river, spring, open well, tube well, or ground well.
   1. The applicant should ensure that post-construction operation, management, and maintenance of the RAS will be carried out in a satisfactory manner by the beneficiaries at their own cost.
   1. The infrastructure created should have essential requirements for RAS, including water treatment units.
   1. The projects having land on a long-term registered lease shall also be considered for Central financial assistance under the scheme. However, the lease period/agreement shall not be less than a minimum period of 10 years.

page_content:
# APJ Abdul Kalam Scholarship **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Kerala | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Students, Financial Assistance, Academics, School | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Scholarship (APJAK) is administered by the Minority Welfare Department of Kerala for the academic year. This scholarship program aims to support students from various religious minority groups (Muslim, Christian (all denominations), Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) in Kerala. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Minority Welfare.
> **Note:** The last date to apply for fresh applications is February 3, 2025.
## Benefits 1. Financial support of ₹6,000/- per annum for selected scholars. 1. The scholarship is intended for students pursuing three-year diploma courses in government, aided, or government-approved self-financing polytechnic institutions.
> **Frequency of Disbursement:** > The scholarship is a one-time benefit.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Kerala. 1. The applicant must be a regular/scheduled student. 1. The applicant should belong to a religious minority community (Muslim, Christian (all denominations), Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi). 1. The applicant must be studying a three-year diploma course in a government, aided, or government-approved self-financing polytechnic institution. 1. The applicant must have secured admission in a merit seat in a government-approved self-financing polytechnic institution. 1. The applicant's family annual income should not exceed ₹8,00,000/- if from the APL (Above Poverty Line) category. 1. The applicant can be a second-year or third-year student. 1. The applicant must have an account in their own name in any nationalised bank or scheduled bank.
> **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:** - BPL (Below Poverty Line) category applicants will be given preference. - 30% of the scholarships are reserved for girls. If the specified percentage of girls is not met, eligible boys will also be considered for the scholarship. - The selection of minority students is based on family annual income and marks, proportionate to the population.
## Exclusions - The scholarship is provided only once to an eligible student. Students who received the scholarship in the previous year should not apply again.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](https://www.minoritywelfare.kerala.gov.in) of the Directorate of Minority Welfare. **Step 2:** Locate and click on the "Scholarship". **Step 3:** Navigate to the "Scholarship" menu link and click on "APJ Abdul Kalam (APJAK)". **Step 4:** Click on "Apply Online". **Step 5:** For new scholarship applicants, first complete one-time registration and log in with your candidate details. S**tep 6:** In the Registration Form, carefully enter the details step-by-step under Examination details (register number/roll number), Personal details, and Scholarship details tabs. **Step 7:** In the Upload details tab, upload the required documents (Photo, Signature, SSLC Certificate, Income Certificate, Ration Card Copy, Allotment Memo) in JPEG format under 100 KB size each. **Step 8:** Only after uploading all required documents, the registration process will be considered complete. **Step 9:** After completing the application submission, use the View/Print Application link to take a printout of the application form.
> **Submission of Application Printout** - After submitting the scholarship application (either through new registration or login), click on "View/Print Application" to get a printout of your registration form. - Submit the printout of the registration form along with all the required supporting documents to the head of the institution where you are studying, within the specified deadline.

# Freeship less than ₹1,00,000 (UG students only) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Students, Research, Education | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description "Freeship Less than ₹1,00,000" Scheme by the Dean Student Welfare, Govind Ballabh Pant Krishi Evam Praudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya, Government of Uttarakhand, aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious undergraduate students from economically weaker backgrounds. Through this scheme, a full tuition fee waiver is granted to selected students whose annual family income is less than ₹1,00,000. The benefit is especially extended to girls for an additional academic year. The scheme is implemented by the Office of the Dean Student Welfare in accordance with university regulations. Applications are scrutinized and the final list is approved by university authorities.

## Benefits - Eligible students get a 100% tuition fee waiver. - Aims to reduce the financial burden on low-income families and encourage academic excellence. - The fee waiver is directly applied during fee processing. - Granted once every academic year, at the beginning of the session. - Disbursed after the final selection list is approved by the Registrar and Vice Chancellor. - Validity: Boys: Up to 3 academic years Girls: Up to 4 academic years

## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be enrolled as an undergraduate student at Govind Ballabh Pant University. - The applicant’s annual family income should be less than ₹1,00,000. - The applicant must be among the best-performing students as per the university’s merit guidelines. - The applicant must submit the application in the prescribed format within the deadline ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 1: Applications are invited on a prescribed form from eligible and meritorious students.

Step 2: Based on the applications, the Dean Student Welfare prepares a list following the prescribed procedure.

Step 3: The list is forwarded to the Registrar and Vice Chancellor for approval.

Step 4: Once approved, the final list of selected students is issued by an office order.

Step 5: Approved students receive the tuition fee exemption accordingly.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme “Stipends to Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Classes for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC” by the Social Justice and Empowerment Dept., Gujarat, supports education for Socially and Educationally Backward Classes students by providing a monthly stipend of ₹400/-.

page_content:
# Stipends to Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Classes for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Education, Socially And Educationally Backward Classes, Stipend, ITI, Vocational Courses | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme “Stipends to Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Classes for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC” by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat aims to promote inclusive education by financially supporting students from Socially and Educationally Backward Classes pursuing technical and vocational education after SSC. The initiative offers a stipend of ₹400/- per month to aid the academic progress and reduce the dropout rate among underprivileged youth. The scheme is implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department. It specifically benefits those enrolled in professional or Government ITI courses and belonging to families with an annual income not exceeding ₹6,00,000/-.

## Benefits
- **Stipend:** A monthly stipend of ₹400/- is given to Socially and Educationally Backward Classes students for one year of recognized professional and Government ITI courses.

## Eligibility Criteria
- The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.
- The applicant should belong to Socially and Educationally Backward Classes.
- The applicant should be a student who has passed the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) examination.
- The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized professional or Government Industrial Training Institute (ITI) course.
- The applicant’s individual and family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/- per annum.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
> **How to Register:**

**Step 1:** Visit the Digital [Gujarat portal](http://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/). 
**Step 2:** The user should click on the "Click to register" option. Fill all details and click on "Save".
> **How to Log In:**

**Step 1:** Visit the Digital [Gujarat portal](http://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/). 
**Step 2:** The user should click on the "Login" option. 
**Step 3:** Enter all details and click on "Login".
> **How to Apply for a New Service:**

**Step 1:** After logging in, select the relevant department.
**Step 2**: Choose the specific service to apply for within that department.
**Step 3:** Fill out all required details in the application form.
**Step 4:** Upload, attach, or browse necessary documents. Alternatively, import documents directly from DigiLocker.
**Step 5:** Carefully review all entered information.
**Step 6:** Submit the application.
**Step 7:** Once the application is completed, proceed to payment to download the certificate.
**Step 8:** Upon successful payment, the certificate will be available for download.
> **Digital Gujarat (Help Desk)**

Contact No : 18002335500

metadata.schemeName: Free Training for Vehicle Drivers
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve the driving skills and employability of Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates by providing free, high-quality driving training, thereby reducing road accidents and promoting self-employment opportunities.

page_content:
# Free Training for Vehicle Drivers **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Skills & Employment, Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Free Training, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Driving Skills, Self-employment, Vehicle Driver | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Free Training for Vehicle Drivers” was introduced by the Transport Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to improve the driving skills and employability of Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates by providing free, high-quality driving training, thereby reducing road accidents and promoting self-employment opportunities.
## Benefits Under this scheme, training will be provided to vehicle drivers to enhance their driving skills, which will help reduce road accidents and enable them to pursue better self-employment opportunities.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ***Interested applicants can submit their applications in the prescribed format (available at the IDTR office) in offline mode at the Institute of Driving and Traffic Research (IDTR), Dehradun.*** ***Required Documents for Light Motor Vehicle (Vocational Course):*** - Aadhaar card of the applicant. - Caste certificate of the applicant. - One recent passport-size photograph. - High School Certificate or 8th Class Transfer Certificate. - A valid Light Motor Vehicle (Non-Transport) Driving License, at least one year old. ***For Heavy Vehicle (Vocational Course):*** - Aadhaar card of the applicant. - Caste certificate of the applicant. - One recent passport-size photograph. - High School Certificate or 8th Class Transfer Certificate. - A valid Light Motor Vehicle (Transport) Driving License. - The license must be at least one year old. ***For Refresher Courses:*** - Aadhaar card of the applicant. > **A valid Driving License to operate a Light or Heavy Motor Vehicle.** **Validity:** There is no time limit. **Renewal:** It is not required. **Fees:** Free of cost. **Process:** Applications are scrutinized, and eligible candidates are admitted to the training program on a first-come, first-served basis. **Process:** Applications can be submitted throughout the year, and training commences as soon as batches are formed.

metadata.schemeName: Financial Assistance to SC Students Appearing in the Mains Examination of UPSC
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial grants to the SC students for appearing in the UPSC Mains Exam. An amount upto ₹50,000/- is provided to each beneficiary, subject to budget provision. The assistance is extended depending on the applicant satisfying the eligibility criteria and the documents submitted.

page_content:
# Financial Assistance to SC Students Appearing in the Mains Examination of UPSC **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Assam | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Scheduled Caste, Student, UPSC, Exam, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The 'Financial Assistance to SC students appearing in the Mains Examination of UPSC' scheme, administered by the Directorate of Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes, Government of Assam, is designed to provide financial grants to Scheduled Caste (SC) students who qualify for the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) Mains Examination. Each eligible beneficiary will receive an amount of up to ₹50,000/-, subject to budgetary provisions. The disbursement of assistance is contingent upon the applicant satisfying the stipulated eligibility criteria and the successful submission of required documentation.
**The applications will be accepted through the myScheme platform from 04/07/2025 to 31/10/2025.** ***A DigiLocker account is required for application. Please refer to the Application Process section for details.***
## Benefits An amount of up to ₹50,000/- is provided to each beneficiary, subject to budget provision. ## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste (SC) community of Assam. - The applicant must have recently qualified for the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) Preliminary Examination held in 2025. - The annual income of the applicant's parents/guardians must not exceed ₹5,00,000/-. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **The applications will be accepted through the myScheme platform from 04/07/2025 to 31/10/2025.**
**Signup to DigiLocker** **Step 1:** Visit the [_DigiLocker Portal_](https://www.digilocker.gov.in/) or download the DigiLocker Mobile App ([_Android_](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.digilocker.android) _/_ [_iOS_](https://itunes.apple.com/in/app/digilocker/id1320618078)). **Step 2:** Click _"_[_Login/Register_](https://www.digilocker.gov.in/web/signup)_"_ and provide these details: Full name, Gender, Mobile number, Email ID, and Aadhaar Number. Create a 6-digit PIN. **Step 3:** Finally, click "Submit". Note the 6-digit PIN for future reference.
**Signin to myScheme** **Step 1:** At the top right corner of this page, click "Sign In". Provide your DigiLocker Mobile Number and the 6-digit PIN. **Step 2:** Click the "I consent to terms of use" checkbox, then click "Sign In". You will be directed to the DigiLocker Consent Page. **Step 3:** At the bottom of the page, click "Allow". You have now successfully signed in to myScheme.
**Scheme Application** **Step 1:** At the top of this page, click "Apply Now". The application form of the scheme will open. **Step 2:** Fill in all the mandatory fields of the application form, and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. **Step 3:****** Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections. **Step 4:** Click "Submit". You'll receive the following confirmation message: "Form Submitted Successfully!". **Step 5:** For future reference, click "Print" to print the form or to download the filled form as a PDF file. Else, click "Ok" to get redirected to the myScheme landing page.
**Helpdesk Contact Details** **Email:** assamdirectorateofwelfareofsc@gmail.com **Mobile Number:** 8638922415

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Bhed/Bakri (Sheep/Goat) Palak Uthan Yojana for Scheduled Castes
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to uplift Scheduled Caste beneficiaries. Through this scheme, sheep and goat units are provided free of cost, along with veterinary assistance, to eligible unemployed Scheduled Caste families.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Bhed/Bakri (Sheep/Goat) Palak Uthan Yojana for Scheduled Castes **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Sheep, Goat, Feeder, Scheduled Caste, Employment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Mukhya Mantri Bhed/Bakri (Sheep/Goat) Palak Uthan Yojana for Scheduled Castes" scheme is introduced by the Animal Husbandry and Dairying Department, Government of Haryana, which aims to uplift Scheduled Caste beneficiaries by providing them with sheep or goat units. Through this scheme, 10 female and 1 male sheep/goat units are provided free of cost. Through this scheme, free sheep or goat units, veterinary assistance, and assistance for purchasing wool are provided to unemployed residents of Haryana. The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Livestock Development Board (HLDB).
> **Long-term objectives of this scheme are as follows:** 1. To create self-employment opportunities through Sheep and Goat husbandry activities. 1. To upgrade and develop the Sheep and Goat breeds/germ plasm available in the State. 1. To increase income generation opportunities for the economically weaker segment of society.
## Benefits 1. **Sheep Unit:** 20 Ewes and one Ram with Green Fodder cum Salt Block Feeder free of cost. 1. **Goat Unit:** 20 Does and one Buck with Green Fodder cum Salt Block Feeder free of cost.1. **Veterinary Assistance:** All animals in the established unit will receive deworming, vaccination, and treatment free of cost by the concerned Veterinary Institution.1. **Wool Purchase Assistance:** Assistance for purchasing wool from the established unit will be provided by the department.
> **Financial Assistance in form of subsidy for establishment of Sheep/Goat unit** > **under the Scheme:-** 1. 100% subsidy for the establishment of a Sheep and Goat unit of 10 females and 1 male would be provided to the Scheduled Caste (SC). 1. Initially beneficiary has to bear purchase cost of Sheep and Goat unit by there-own for 25% of the unit cost which will be of ₹17,500/- per unit as margin money (proof for the same should be given by beneficiary), which would be provided to beneficiary account later on as per scheme guidelines. 1. In the case of SC Category, the Haryana Livestock Development Board (HLDB)/Government will provide financial assistance of 75% of the unit cost (₹52,500/- per unit) on the establishment of the livestock unit after the purchase of livestock to the seller within 15 days, upon submission of all requisite documents. 1. The financial assistance of balance 25% of unit cost (₹17,500/- per unit) in case of SC beneficiaries would be provided by the HLDB/Government in form of subsidy to beneficiary after two months of establishment of unit subject to verification of unit after purchase of all cases preferably by Deputy Director concerned himself or its representative not below the rank of Sub Divisional Officer/Semen Bank Officer other than purchase committee. 1. Beneficiaries shall have to purchase a complete/whole Sheep/Goat unit of 10+1 in one slot, and only one beneficiary per household could take the benefit of either Sheep or Goat unit under the scheme. 1. The financial assistance would be provided to the account of the seller through Concerned Semen Bank officer by the Managing Director, HLDB, out of the head of overall receipt of Milk Cess funds after verification and recommendation of the unit established by the Deputy Director concerned or its representative not below the rank of SDO/ SBO. The financial assistance may be delayed due to the unavailability of the budget or any other unforeseen circumstances. 1. The beneficiary would be provided veterinary assistance facilities (Treatment, vaccination and consultancy) by the concerned area veterinary institutions free of cost. Assistance for the purchase of wool from an established unit would be provided by the Department.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a Scheduled Caste 1. The applicant should be of 18 to 55 years of age. 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana 1. The applicant should be a Parivar Pehchaan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant should not be employed even in the Private Sector/ Govt. /Semi Govt. Organizations. 1. There would be no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements. 1. Any group/firm/organisation would not be permitted to apply under the Scheme, as the Scheme being individual beneficiary-oriented. 1. The applicant would have to submit a Self-Declaration in the format annexed as [Annexure-I (Page-9)](https://pashudhanharyana.gov.in/sites/default/files/documents/Scheme%202024-25/BhedBakri%20(SheepGoat)%20Palak%20Utthan%20Yojanafor%20the%20year%202024-25%20(N).pdf) on the portal for being unemployed and for undertaking to abide by other conditions as required under the Scheme.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 01:** The eligible applicant may apply online through the Official Portal- Antyodaya-SARAL Portal. [https://saralharyana.gov.in/](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 02:** If the applicant is not registered on the portal, he/she gets registered there. **Step 03:** For registration, click “[New User](https://saralharyana.gov.in/citizenRegistration.html)” under ‘Sign In Here’ and fill in all the mandatory details, i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, Password & State. Click on ‘Submit’. **Step 04:** Verify your mobile number and email ID through the received OTP and complete the registration process.
> **Login to apply for the scheme:** **Step 01:** To avail the benefits of the scheme, visit the Official [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) and log in through the email ID used while registering. **Step 02:** Enter Password & Captcha and click on ‘Login’. **Step 03:** After successful login, click on ‘Apply for Services’ and then ‘View all Available Services’ **Step 04:** Now, you can search for the scheme and click on the scheme to go ahead and fill out the application form. **Step 05:** Enter your Parivar Pehchan Patra number - Family ID and click on “Click here to Fetch Family Data”, which displays the family members registered under the given Family ID. **Step 06:** Select the beneficiary/applicant name and enter the OTP that is being sent to the selected family member for verification. Click on “Click to Verify” **Step 07:** Fill in all the mandatory details and upload all the mandatory documents. **Step 08:** Preview the application form and click on ‘Submit’.
> **Tracking of Application:** - Applicants can track their applications through the Official [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal](https://status.saralharyana.nic.in/) by entering their Department Name, Scheme Name, and Application Reference ID.
> **FEES FOR THE SERVICE:-** - **Govt. Charges:** No Fee - **Kendra Service Charges :** ₹ 10/- - **Atal Seva Kendra (CSC) Service Charges:** ₹ 30/-

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Uchcha Shiksha Shodh Protsahan Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote high-quality, interdisciplinary research in higher education institutions across state. The broad subject areas for research include Science, Arts & Humanities, Home Science, & Commerce & Management, while proposals in interdisciplinary subject areas are also encouraged.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Uchcha Shiksha Shodh Protsahan Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Science, IT & Communications, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Research Grant, Research, Higher Education, Student, Research Scholar, Professor | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Mukhyamantri Uchcha Shiksha Shodh Protsahan Yojana" was launched by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote high-quality, interdisciplinary research in higher education institutions across the state. The broad subject areas for research include Science, Arts and Humanities, Home Science, and Commerce & Management, while proposals in interdisciplinary subject areas are also encouraged.
## Benefits The maximum research grant provided by the state government is ₹15 lakh, which may be increased up to ₹18 lakh in special circumstances.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The regular professors working in state government colleges and state university campuses of Uttarakhand, as well as students and research scholars enrolled in regular programs at recognized institutions within the state, are eligible to apply. 1. A research proposal may also include a co-investigator alongside the principal investigator. 1. The broad subject areas for research include Science, Arts and Humanities, Home Science, and Commerce & Management, while interdisciplinary subjects will also be accepted. 1. Research related to the state that proves to be productive and useful in social, economic, contemporary, or other areas of special importance will be encouraged. 1. Priority will be given to problem-oriented, solution-driven, and action-based research topics (Problem and Action-Based Research Programme). 1. Research proposals may also be invited based on requests for specific issues raised by any department of the state government. 1. A maximum period of two years will be allowed for completing the research work, which may be extended by one additional year under special circumstances. 1. Only one research project will be permitted for any teacher or research scholar at a time.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - Researchers must submit their research proposals online through the Samarth portal ([https://uttarakhand.samarth.ac.in/index/site/login](https://uttarakhand.samarth.ac.in/index.php/site/login)). - During the application process, the proposal must be uploaded and forwarded by the institution’s Principal or Registrar within fifteen days of submission; otherwise, it will automatically move to the next level. - The proposal will then be evaluated by the Evaluation Committee, and the research grant will be released in three installments via DBT to the institution’s Research and Development Cell account. - Upon the written request of the Principal Investigator, the Principal or Registrar must make the grant available to the Principal Investigator or Researcher within three days. If this is not done, the State Research and Development Cell Committee must be informed through the Director of Education with clear written reasons, and the final decision will rest with the Secretary, Higher Education/Committee. - The first installment, amounting to 50% of the grant, will be released upon approval of the research proposal. - The second installment, amounting to 30%, will be released only after submission of the utilization certificate. - The third and final installment, amounting to 20%, will be released upon completion of the research work. - The research must be original and in accordance with UGC standards. - A Research Assistant will receive a stipend of ₹5,000 per month from the release of the first installment until the completion of the research work.

metadata.schemeName: Assistance to Pilgrims for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra - Rajasthan
metadata.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial support to residents of Rajasthan who successfully complete the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra organized by the Ministry of External Affairs, Govt. of India. Under this scheme, each pilgrim is granted financial assistance of up to ₹1,00,000/-.

page_content:
# Assistance to Pilgrims for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra - Rajasthan **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Travel & Tourism | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Tourism, Pilgrim, Yatra, Mansarovar, Kailash | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Assistance to Pilgrims for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra" scheme was introduced by the Devasthan Department, Government of Rajasthan, on 1st April 2011. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial support to residents of Rajasthan who successfully complete the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India. Under this scheme, financial assistance of up to ₹1,00,000/- is granted to each pilgrim, with a maximum of 100 beneficiaries selected per year. ## Benefits > **Financial Assistance** - ₹1,00,000 per selected pilgrim after completing the Yatra. > **Mode of Disbursement** Direct transfer to the beneficiary’s bank account via account payee cheque/demand draft, depending on departmental discretion. > **Note:** - The Yatra must be completed through the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India. - The benefit is available only once in a lifetime. - A maximum of 100 beneficiaries per year. - Selection via lottery if applications exceed the quota. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should have successfully completed the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India. 1. The applicant receives this grant only once in a lifetime. **Note 1:** 100 pilgrims are selected each year. If there are more applicants than available slots, selection is done through a lottery system. **Note 2:** After completing the trip, a certificate from the Ministry of External Affairs confirming the successful completion of the journey is required. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **The application dates are announced via departmental notification (typically between June to September)** **Step 1**: The applicant applying for the scheme for the first time needs to register using the icon “Applying for Yatra" and click on "New User” at the [Ministry of External Affairs](https://kmy.gov.in/?lang=en) portal by providing accurate and correct information as per their documents. **Step 2:** After successfully getting registration done, the applicant will get their “login details”. **Step 3:** Through “Email ID and Password,” the applicant will be able to login into the account using the icon “Existing User” at the Ministry of External Affairs portal. **Step 4:** After successful login to the portal, the welcome page appeared. On clicking the “Application Form” icon, the applicant will be directed to the application screen. **Step 5:** Now, the applicant may fill out the complete application form, and on clicking the “Final Submit” button, the application is finally submitted. **Step 6**: On successful submission of the application, the applicant will receive an SMS and e-mail after successful submission of the application, which can be used for future reference. > **Note:** - The printed application form with documents must be submitted within 2 months after completing the Yatra. > **Selection & Approval Process** **Step 1:** Applications are verified by the Sub-Divisional Officer or Assistant Commissioner of the Devasthan Department. **Step 2:** Documents are matched with the originals, and a verification note is made. **Step 3:** Applications are forwarded to the Assistant Commissioner for approval within 15 days. **Step 4:** Selection through a computerized lottery if applications exceed the annual quota. **Mode:** Offline > **Application Process** **Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the [application form](https://devasthan.rajasthan.gov.in/Files/kailash_masrover_form.pdf) from the official website. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Assistant Commissioner, Devasthan Department office. > **Note:.** - An application form with documents must be submitted within 2 months after completing the Yatra. > **Selection & Approval Process** **Step 1:** Applications are verified by the Sub-Divisional Officer or Assistant Commissioner of the Devasthan Department. **Step 2:** Documents are matched with the originals, and a verification note is made. **Step 3:** Applications are forwarded to the Assistant Commissioner for approval within 15 days. **Step 4:** Selection through a computerized lottery if applications exceed the annual quota.
