metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, students from National Minorities (Muslims, Sikhs, Buddhists, and Christians) studying in India receive scholarships for pre-matric education (Classes I–X) if they have secured at least 50% marks in their previous examination.

page_content:
# Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students belonging to National Minorities **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Ladakh | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Student, Scholarships, Education, Pre Matric | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Pre-Matric Scholarship for students belonging to National Minorities", implemented by the Ministry of Minority Affairs through the Social Welfare Department, Government of Ladakh, provides financial assistance to Muslim, Sikh, Buddhist, and Christian students studying in India in Classes I to X who have secured at least 50% marks in their previous examination.
## Benefits **Financial Assistance / Benefits:** **Admission Fee (Class VI to X):** - Hostellers: ₹500 per annum, subject to actuals - Day Scholars: ₹500 per annum, subject to actuals **Tuition Fee (Class VI to X):** - Hostellers: ₹350 per month, subject to actuals - Day Scholars: ₹350 per month, subject to actuals **Maintenance Allowance (for maximum 10 months per academic year):** **Class I to V:** - Hostellers: Nil - Day Scholars: ₹100 per month **Class VI to X:** - Hostellers: ₹600 per month, subject to actuals - Day Scholars: ₹100 per month **Note:** Hostellers include students who are staying in hostel of the school/institute concerned or those provided by the State Government/Union Territory Administration concerned.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be belonging to a National Minority community (Muslim, Sikh, Buddhist, or Christian). 1. The applicant should be studying in India. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in Classes I to X (Pre-Matric level). 1. The applicant should be have secured a minimum of 50% marks in the previous examination. 1. The applicant should be from a family where the parents’/guardians’ annual income does not exceed ₹1.00 lakh.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant should obtain the application form free of cost from the DSWO/TSWO/Institution, complete it with the help of the guardian, attach the required documents (income proof, address proof, marks, and occupation), and submit it to the Head of the Institution against a proper receipt. **Step 2:** The Head of the Institution should verify the applications, prepare a consolidated list of eligible students under the scheme, and forward it to the Zonal Education Officer for certification. **Step 3:** The Zonal Education Officer and DSWO should scrutinise and certify the list, and then the District Social Welfare Officer forwards it to the Director, Social Welfare, for fund sanction and arrangement.

page_content:
# Nirman Shramik Shiksha evam Kaushal Vikas Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Construction Worker, Education Assistance, Skill Development, Technical Training | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Construction Workers Education and Skill Development Scheme” by the Department of Labour, Government of Rajasthan aims to promote education and skill enhancement by providing financial assistance to registered construction workers and their dependents for schooling, higher education, technical education, and vocational training.
## Benefits - **Scholarship Amounts (School and Technical):** **Education Level****Male Student****Female / Specially-Abled**Class 6 to 8₹8,000/-₹9,000/-Class 9 to 12₹9,000/-₹10,000/-ITI₹9,000/-₹10,000/-Diploma₹10,000/-₹11,000/- - **Scholarship Amounts (Higher Education):** **Education Level****Male Student****Female / Specially-Abled**Graduation (General)₹13,000/-₹15,000/-Graduation (Professional)₹18,000/-₹20,000/-Post-Graduation (General)₹15,000/-₹17,000/-Post-Graduation (Professional)₹23,000/-₹25,000/- - **Cash Prizes for Meritorious Students:** CategoryAmountClass 8 to 10₹4,000/-Class 11 to 12₹6,000/-Diploma₹10,000/-Graduation₹8,000/-Post-Graduation₹12,000/-Graduation (Professional)₹25,000/-Post-Graduation (Professional)₹35,000/-

## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a child or the wife of a registered construction worker (beneficiary). - The applicant must be studying regularly in a government or recognized private school, college, ITI, or polytechnic institution. - The applicant must be studying in any class from Class 6 up to the Postgraduate level. - The applicant's parent (the worker) must have a valid registration identity card and have paid their contributions regularly. - The applicant must have gained admission to the next class, except after completing the final year of Class 12, Diploma, Graduation, or Post-Graduation. - The applicant must not have more than one other sibling receiving this scholarship, as it is limited to a maximum of two children per family. - The applicant (if the wife of a worker) must not be older than 35 years of age. - The applicant for a merit-based cash prize must have secured at least 75% marks (for Class 8 to 12) or at least 60% marks (for Diploma, Graduation, and Post-Graduation).
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step-1:** Applicant have to visit the [official portal](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/signin). **Step-2:** Click on the option “[Register](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/register)”. **Step-3:** Then you will be redirected to the SSO registration page. The registration page will appear with the following options. - Citizen **Step-4:** Choose the either one option from the Jan Aadhaar Or Google to process further. - Jan Aadhaar : Enter the Jan Aadhaar number, click on the ‘Next’ button, - Select your name, the name of the head of the family and all the other members and - Click on the ‘Send OTP’ button. Enter the ‘OTP’ and - Click on the ‘Verify OTP’ button to Complete the registration. - Google : Enter the Gmail ID, click on the ‘Next’ button, - Enter the password. - A new link appear on screen, now click on new SSO link. - SSO id will appear on screen, now create the password. - Enter Mobile number, click on registration. > **Application Process:** **Step-1:** Applicant have to visit the [official portal](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/signin). **Step-2:** After login, dashboard will open. **Step-3:** Click on “LDMS” option. **Step-4:** In LDMS, select "Welfare Schemes" from the side menu and select "BOCW Welfare Board". **Step-5:** Now click on "Apply for Scheme" on screen. **Step-6:** In this new page, will get a list of names of all the schemes of Rajasthan Shramik Card, out of which click on the name of the concerned scheme. **Step-7:** Fill out the all relevant detail and click on **"**Submit".
**Mode:** Offline - **Application Submission:** Every male or female student must fill out the scholarship application in the prescribed form (Form-1) and submit it to the local labor office or the office of any other officer/department authorized by the Divisional Secretary. - **Time Limit for Submission:** The application form can be submitted within a maximum of 6 months from the date of passing the class, or by the following March 31st, whichever is later. - **Verification and Payment:** After examining the submitted applications and required documents, approval will be issued by the senior-most officer of the local labor office or an officer authorized by the Divisional Secretary. Payment of the scholarship will be made into the beneficiary's bank account through electronic means (RTGS / NEFT) or via an account payee check.

## Benefits - **Tuition Fee Reimbursement:** The scheme reimburses the tuition fees paid by the beneficiary for admission in IIT/IIM listed institutions.
## Eligibility Criteria - Construction workers who are registered as beneficiaries with the board and are consistently making contributions will be eligible for this scheme. - The beneficiary son/daughter must have passed the entrance examination of IIT or IIM and secured admission as a regular student in a listed educational institution. - The tuition fees for the listed educational institution must have been paid by the beneficiary. - The total annual income of the candidate parents from all sources should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-. - If any information provided in the assistance application under the scheme is found to be false, the beneficiary concerned will be responsible for repaying the entire approved assistance amount along with interest in a lump sum.

page_content:
# Matric cum Means Scholarship for Students belonging to National Minorities **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Ladakh | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Matric Cum Means, Scholarship, Students, Minority Communities | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Matric-cum-Means Scholarship for Students Belonging to National Minorities" has been implemented by the Ministry of Minority Affairs through the Social Welfare Department, Government of Ladakh. Students from minority communities pursuing undergraduate or postgraduate professional/technical courses in a recognized institution are eligible to apply for this merit-cum-means scholarship. The scholarship is available for studies in India only and has been awarded through the Head of the Institution via the Social Welfare Department.
## Benefits **Hostellers:** **Maintenance Allowance:** ₹10,000/- per annum (₹1,000/- per month for 10 months) **Course Fee:** ₹20,000/- per annum or actual fee, whichever is less Full reimbursement of course fee for listed institutions **Day Scholars:** **Maintenance Allowance:** ₹5,000/- per annum (₹500/- per month for 10 months) **Course Fee:** ₹20,000/- per annum or actual fee, whichever is less Full reimbursement of course fee for listed institutions **Note**: Full reimbursement applies only for institutions listed on the Ministry of Minority Affairs website as notified by the Ministry.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a member of a Minority Community. 1. The applicant should have parent/guardian income not exceeding ₹2.5 lakhs per year. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in specified professional or technical courses. 1. The applicant should be studying in an institute listed under the scheme (70 institutions) to be eligible for full course fee reimbursement, or in another recognized institution to be eligible for course fee reimbursement up to ₹20,000 per annum. 1. The applicant should be studying in India and have secured at least 50% marks in the last qualifying exam (for fresh applicants) or in the previous exam (for renewal cases).
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Registration** **Step1:** Go to [national scholarship portal](https://scholarships.gov.in/) and click on "Student" and then "[One Time Registration (OTR)".](https://scholarships.gov.in/otrapplication/#/registration-page) **Step2:** Read the guidelines, check the box to provide the undertaking, and click "Continue". **Step3:** Enter your mobile number, receive an OTP, and verify it by entering the OTP **Step4:** Provide necessary documents like Aadhaar and Bank Account details to complete the registration. **Step5:** Ensure all the details you entered are correct, then click "Verified". **Step6**: After verification, you will receive your registration number on the registered mobile number.
**Steps to Apply for Scheme Benefits:** **Step1:** Visit the [national scholarship portal .](https://scholarships.gov.in/) **Step2:** Click on the "[Student](https://scholarships.gov.in/Students)" option and select[ "Apply For Scholarship."](https://scholarships.gov.in/ApplicationForm/#/login) **Step3:** Enter your OTR ([One Time Registration](https://scholarships.gov.in/otrapplication/#/registration-page)) number, password, CAPTCHA, and click "Login." **Step 4:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 5:** Once the form is completed and documents uploaded, click "Submit" and pay the application fee online. You will receive a registration number after successful payment and submission. **Step 6:** Print your application form for future reference.

# Padma Awardee Free Travel Facility **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Padma Awardee Free Travel, Gallantry Medal, Free Bus Travel | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched on 24th May, 2010, the scheme “Padma Awardee Free Travel Facility” by the Rajasthan State Transport Corporation under the Transport Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to provide free travel facilities in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses to eligible Rajasthan residents who are Padma Award recipients and gallantry medal awardees, as a mark of honor and recognition for their distinguished service.

## Exclusions

metadata.schemeName: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Assistance on Death and Permanent Disablement
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial relief to the beneficiaries in case of permanent disability due to accidents or their dependents/nominees in case of accidental or natural death.

page_content:
# West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Assistance on Death and Permanent Disablement **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** West Bengal | **Categories:** Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Social Empowerment, Transport Worker, Monthly Assistance, Death Assistance, Permanent Disablement | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Assistance on Death and Permanent Disablement” by the Labour Department, offers financial assistance to unorganised transport workers or their nominees/dependents during times of distress caused by death or disability. The relief includes monetary compensation for accidental or natural death, as well as graded benefits for permanent disabilities.
## Benefits > **Relief on Death:** 1. **For accidental death:** ₹1,50,000/-. 1. **For natural death:** ₹50,000/-. > **Relief on Permanent Disability:** 1. **For loss of one hand, one leg below the knee, one eye, or hearing capacity in one ear:** ₹25,000/-. 1. **For loss of a thumb:** ₹9,000/-. 1. **For loss of any other finger:** ₹4,000/- 1. **Maximum relief for total disablement:** ₹50,000/-.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age at the time of enrolment. 1. The applicant must be an unorganized worker employed in the operation of commercial vehicles, such as cars, taxis, luxury taxis, light commercial vehicles, vans, auto-rickshaws, tempos, lorries, trucks, or buses. 1. The applicant’s vehicle must be used for commercial purposes and not solely for personal or family use. > **Note:** A nominee/ dependent of a beneficiary shall be entitled for the benefits in case of death.
## Exclusions No assistance under this provision shall be allowed if such death or permanent disablement was : - Caused by intentional self-injury, suicide or attempted suicide, insanity or immorality or if the member was under the influence of intoxicating liquor, drug, or narcotic. - Caused by injuries resulting from riots, civil commotions, or racing of any kind. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step-1:** Visit the “[eDistrict 2.0](https://edistrict.wb.gov.in/portal/home)” portal. Click on Log In/Sign Up. **Step-2:** In the User Login window, scroll down to the bottom and click on “Register”. **Step-3:** Fill in all the details carefully, enter a username, and click on “Register”. **Step-4:** Upon entering the One Time Password received on your mobile, you will be successfully registered. **Step-5:** Now in the User Login window, enter your Username or email and captcha and click on “Sign In”. **Step-6:** Enter the received O.T.P and click on “Submit”. **Step-7:** Upon successful Login, You will be redirected to the “Dashboard”. From the right side menu apply for the concerned scheme.

metadata.briefDescription: The “Refund of Subscriptions for the Construction Workers” scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides reimbursement of the entire subscription, with 8% interest, to the beneficiary at age 60, after 3 years if they choose to leave the Board, or

page_content:
# Refund of Subscriptions for the Construction Workers **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** West Bengal | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Labour, Construction Worker, Subscriptions Refund | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Refund of Subscriptions for the Construction Workers” scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, West Bengal, is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this scheme, the entire subscription deposited by the beneficiary will be refunded with 8% interest to the subscriber on maturity at the age of 60 years or unwillingness to continue as a beneficiary under the Board after 3 years or to the nominee (legal heir) upon the death of the subscriber.
## Benefits - **Quantum of Assistance:** Subscription deposited by the beneficiary will be refunded with 8% interest to the subscriber. ## Eligibility Criteria > **For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:** - The applicant should be a resident of West Bengal. - The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker. - The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. - The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year. > **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:** - The applicant should be a registered member Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of West Bengal. - The applicant should reach the age of maturity i.e. 60 years. Or, - The applicant do not want to continue as a subscriber under the Board after 3 years of registration. Or, - The subscriber has lost his/her life due to death. (Applicant should be nominee (legal heir) of the subscriber. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline > **Registration Process as a Building/ Construction Worker:** **Step 1:** To register as a beneficiary under the BOCW Welfare Board, an applicant worker should request Form-27 from the Assistant Labour Commissioners/ Beneficiary Registering Officers and should attach all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 2:** Application shall be submitted to the Assistant Labour Commissioners/ Beneficiary Registering Officers. > **Application Process of the Welfare Scheme:** **Step 1:** A registered worker should request the application from the Assistant Labour Commissioners/ Beneficiary Registering Officers and should attach all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 2:** Application shall be submitted to the Assistant Labour Commissioners/ Beneficiary Registering Officers for this benefit. > **Helpdesk:** Labour Department Department of Labour, Government of West Bengal, 12th Floor, N.S Building, Block-A, 1, Kiran Shankar Roy Road, Kolkata-700001 Helpline of Labour Department, Govt. of West Bengal (Shramik Sathi): 1800-103-0009 > **Note:** - Upon successful verification, the construction worker is registered and an identity card and passbook are issued to him/ her. ₹20/- as the registration fee and ₹30/- as yearly subscription is taken. The amounts taken are noted in the passbook and a receipt is issued. - After one year, the beneficiary's subscription is renewed upon payment of a renewal fee of ₹30/- and submission of an application in Form-27A. - If not renewed the registration of the beneficiary is cancelled after the expiry of one year. Fresh application for renewal to be submitted to the ALC for consideration.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free coaching and residential facilities to Scheduled Tribe students of Rajasthan for various competitive examinations through reputed coaching institutes.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Nishulk Coaching Yojana-ST **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Free Coaching, Scheduled Caste, Hostel Facility, ST | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Mukhyamantri Nishulk Coaching Yojana-ST” launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to support Scheduled Tribe students through free coaching, hostel accommodation for various entrance and professional exams.
## Benefits - **Residential Facility:** Selected students will be provided with hostel accommodation under the departmental hostels. - **Coaching Facility:** Free coaching will be arranged in reputed local coaching institutes. > **Notes:** - Students availing benefits under this scheme will not be eligible to receive benefits under any similar central or state government scheme. - If a student’s attendance is below 80%, their name will be removed from coaching, and the payment for that month will not be made to the coaching institution. In case of unavoidable circumstances, the department will consider the student’s application. - No coaching institute shall collect any type of fee from the selected students; payment will be made directly by the department. - Applicants availing the benefit of the scheme will not be eligible for the benefit of the "Anuprati Scheme" run by the department.
## Eligibility Criteria - Applicants must be natives of Rajasthan. - Applicants must belong to the Scheduled Tribe community. - SC applicants must have secured 60% marks in Class 10th. - SC applicants seeking admission to IITs and medical colleges must have secured 70% marks in Mathematics and Science in Class 10. - Undergraduate students must have secured 60% marks in the second and third year of graduation. If the results are not declared within the previous year, the results will be considered. - Applicants must be studying regularly in Class 11th and 12th for admission to national-level technical/medical/law courses. - Applicants must reside in the Social Justice and Empowerment Department's hostels in Jaipur and Kota. - Applicants must be pursuing regular undergraduate/postgraduate studies at a government or recognized private college for CAT/MAT coaching for admission to national-level management institutes and IIMs. - The annual income of the family (from all sources) should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-.
> **Notes:** - Coaching facility will be available to students for a maximum period of two years for the entrance examinations of engineering and medical courses and for only one year for the entrance examinations of law and management courses. - Coaching facility for postgraduate courses will be provided to the students till the final year of graduation or till the next year of passing the graduation examination. - Students admitted to the coaching institute can complete the course only within the period of the contract with the coaching institute. If the contract with any institute is for a period of 2 years, then admission can be taken in the 2-year course in the first year of the contract but admission cannot be taken in the 2-year course in the second year.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the official portal of Rajasthan Single Sign On: [https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/) **Step 2:** On the homepage, click on the "[Register here](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/register)" tab. **Step 3:** Select ‘Jan Aadhaar’ option for registration under the ‘Citizen’ tab. **Step 4:** Complete the registration process by entering your Jan Aadhaar Number. **Step 5:** After successful registration, you will receive a User ID (SSO ID) and Password. # Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: ICCD for Large Cardamom in NE, Kalimpong & Darjeeling District (nos) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Commerce And Industry | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Agriculture, Cardamom, Farmer, Farming | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research & Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement – Improved Cardamom Curing Devices (ICCD) for Large Cardamom in the North Eastern Region, Kalimpong, and Darjeeling Districts is implemented by the Spices Board India under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India. The scheme aims to encourage large cardamom growers to adopt Improved Cardamom Curing Devices (ICCD) for drying cardamom, thereby improving the quality of the produce and enhancing its suitability for export. The scheme is being implemented in accordance with the modalities and guidelines approved by the Competent Authority under the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research & Development of Cardamom during the 15th Finance Commission period (2021–22 to 2025–26).

## Eligibility Criteria 1.Sikkim, Darjeeling & Kalimpong district of West Bengal & other NE States 2. Designated Officials will conduct final inspection and recommend the eligible cases.

# Silicosis Policy – Provision for Sustenance of Family **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Silicosis, Widow Pension, Sustenance Of Family, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Silicosis Policy – Provision for Sustenance of Family" launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to provide sustenance support through widow pension and Palanhar benefits to eligible families suffering from Silicosis.
## Benefits - **Widow Pension:** Provides widow pension to the wife of the Silicosis-affected person.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be suffering from Silicosis. - The applicant must be certified by the Medical Board. - The applicant must be working in a mine located in Rajasthan. - Resident of another state who is working in the mines of Rajasthan state or suffering from Silicosis certified by the Medical Board.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the official portal of Rajasthan Single Sign On: [https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/) **Step 2:** On the homepage, click on the "[Register here](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/register)" tab. **Step 3:** Select ‘Jan Aadhaar’ option for registration under the ‘Citizen’ tab. **Step 4:** Complete the registration process by entering your Jan Aadhaar Number. **Step 5:** After successful registration, you will receive a User ID (SSO ID) and Password. These credentials will allow you to check your application status and apply for scheme in the future. > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** To apply under the scheme, revisit the official portal of Rajasthan Single Sign On: [https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/) **Step 2:** On the homepage, click on the "[Login to RajSSO](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/signin)" tab. **Step 3:** Enter your username (SSO ID), password, and Captcha, then click ‘Login’. **Step 4:** Once logged in, update your profile. **Step 5:** Click on SJMS SMS icon, then look for the respective scheme information icon. **Step 6:** Fill in the required information, and upload all necessary documents on the online portal. **Step 7:** After entering the information and uploading the documents, make sure to submit/save your application form.

metadata.briefDescription: The “Old Age Pension To Handloom Weavers” scheme implemented by the MSME and Textiles Dept., aims to provide monthly financial assistance in the form of pension to a weaver member of a handloom cooperative society.

page_content:
# Old Age Pension To Handloom Weavers Under Coop. Fold **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** West Bengal | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Pension, Handloom Weavers, Old Age | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Old Age Pension To Handloom Weavers" scheme has been implemented by the Micro, Small & Medium Enterprise and Textiles Department, Government of West Bengal. The objective of the scheme is to provide monthly financial assistance in the form of pension to a weaver member of a handloom cooperative society.
## Benefits - An amount of ₹1000/- per month. ## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a resident of West Bengal. - The age of the applicant should be 60 years or above. - The applicant should be a weaver member of a handloom cooperative society. - The applicant should have worked for at least 10 years under the cooperative society on the date of making the application. - The applicant should not have any source of income. - The applicant should not be in a position to earn his/her livelihood. - The applicant should be permanently incapacitated for work due to physical or mental infirmity. - The applicant should not have any relation who can maintain him/her. - The applicant should not have availed any pension from the State Government or Government of India. **Note:** - Provided that the State Government may relax the condition regarding residence where the condition causes undue hardship. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Application may be obtained free of cost from the office of the Handloom Development officer of the area where the application resides. **Step 2:** Application for Pension shall be addressed to the Handloom Development Officer with all the required documents. > **Area wise address the office of the Handloom Development officer:** [Click here](https://westbengalhandloom.org/off_addrs#:~:text=Handloom%20Development%20Office%2C,-Contai%2C&text=Shreerupa%20Road%2C%20Floor%2D%20II%2C,Pin%2D%20721%20433.).

metadata.schemeName: West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024: Grant to Industrial Cooperative Society
metadata.briefDescription: “Grant to Industrial Cooperative Society” is a sub-scheme under "West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024”, by the MSME and Textiles Dept, Government of West Bengal. It aims to create, support and sustain an enabling ecosystem for strengthening creativity and capacity of the artisans.

page_content: # West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024: Grant to Industrial Cooperative Society **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** West Bengal | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Artisans, Financial Benefit, Purchase, Repair, Equipment, Tool Kits | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description “Grant to Industrial Cooperative Society” is a sub-scheme under “West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024", launched by the Micro, Small & Medium Enterprise and Textiles Department, Government of West Bengal on 7th March, 2024, and it shall remain in force for a period of five years. The objective of the scheme is to provide systematic financial support for tools, equipment, Workshed and other fixed assets to a group of at least 10 artisans coming under an industrial cooperative society. ## Benefits - ₹3,00,0000/- for tools/equipment, - ₹7,00,0000/- for Work Shed and other fixed assets. ## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should belong to any group of artisans. - The age of the applicant should be between 18-60 years. - Applicant should be engaged in traditional Craft/trade with hand tools/equipment/ small machines. - Applicant should be enlisted in the State Portal for artisans & weavers. - Applicant should be an Indian citizen permanent resident of West Bengal for the past 10 years. - For Work shed, an industrial cooperative society of the eligible artisans should possess a piece of land whereupon sheds will be constructed/ machines will be installed. ## Exclusions - Any central/state govt employee and his/her family members shall not be eligible. - Should not have availed of any assistance /grant from Central /State Govt. for the same purpose. - Handloom and Khadi weavers, and their societies (as they are covered under separate schemes). ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - [Applications](https://financialbenefitartisan.wb.gov.in/files/contents/public/forms/application_form_group_offline_form_v4.0_11.03.2024.pdf) by individual artisans or by the Cooperative Societies of the artisans are to be submitted at BDO'’s office for rural areas, at SDO’s office for Municipality areas and at the Municipal Corporation Office for the urban areas, as the case may be. **Helpdesk:** [Office Addresses and Contact Details (District Wise).](https://www.westbengalhandloom.org/off_addrs)

metadata.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana
metadata.briefDescription: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana was launched by the Department of Pharmaceuticals, in November 2008. Under the scheme, dedicated outlets known as Janaushadhi Kendras are opened to make quality generic medicines available to all at affordable prices.

page_content:
# Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana **Ministry:** Ministry Of Chemicals And Fertilizers | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Health & Wellness, Skills & Employment, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Medicine, Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, Entrepreneur, Janaushadhi, Generic Drugs | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP) was launched by the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers, in November 2008. Branded medicines are sold at significantly higher prices than their unbranded generic equivalents, though both are identical in therapeutic value. Given the widespread poverty across the country, making reasonably priced quality generic medicines available in the market benefits all sections of society. **Objectives:** To make quality generic medicines available at affordable prices to all, PMBJP was launched by the Government of India in November 2008. Under the scheme, dedicated outlets known as Janaushadhi Kendras are opened to provide generic medicines at affordable prices. As of March 2026, more than 19,000 Kendras are functional across the country. The product basket comprises 2,100 medicines and 300 surgical items. The scheme is implemented by the Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India (PMBI) [erstwhile BPPI], registered under the Societies Registration Act. **Objectives include:** - Ensuring access to quality medicines for all, especially the poor and deprived. - Creating awareness about generic medicines through education and publicity to counter the perception that quality is linked only to high prices. - Generating employment by engaging entrepreneurs in opening Kendras.
## Benefits > **The scheme is operated by government agencies as well as private entrepreneurs.** **1**. **Normal Incentive:** - PMBJKs run by entrepreneurs/Pharmacists/Trusts/Societies & Charitable Organizations linked with PMBI headquarters through PoS software receive incentives. - Incentive @ 20% of monthly purchase from PMBI, subject to a ceiling of Rs. 20,000 per month. - Disbursed on a 50:50 basis: - 6% incentive on purchase (up to Rs. 6,000). - 6% incentive for maintaining stock of 200 medicines (up to Rs. 6,000). **2**. **Special Incentive:** - One-time grant of Rs. 2 lakh for women entrepreneurs, SC/ST, Divyangjan, ex-servicemen, and entrepreneurs in aspirational districts, Himalayan, island, and North-Eastern regions. - ₹1.5 lakh reimbursement for furniture/fixtures. - ₹0.5 lakh reimbursement for computer, internet, printer, etc. **3**. **Affordable Medicines:** - Prices of Janaushadhi medicines are 50%–80% lower than branded medicines. **4.** **Quality Assurance:** - Medicines procured only from WHO-GMP certified suppliers. **5**. **Testing:** - Each batch is tested at NABL-accredited laboratories. **6**. **Margin:** - Operating agencies receive a 20% margin on MRP (excluding taxes) of each drug. > **Janaushadhi Suvidha Sanitary Napkin:** Launched on 27 August 2019, Janaushadhi Suvidha Oxo-biodegradable sanitary napkins are available at Rs. 1 per pad. - Distributed through all Kendras nationwide. - Cumulative sales crossed 100 crore pads by March 2026.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. **Individuals:** - The applicant must hold D. Pharma/B. Pharma degree or employ qualified pharmacists. 1. **Organizations/NGOs:** - The applicant must employ B. Pharma/D. Pharma degree holders. 1. **Government hospital premises (including medical colleges):** - Preference to reputed NGOs/charitable organizations though individuals are also eligible.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** http://janaushadhi.gov.in/Data/PMBJKs%20new%20form.pdf **Step 1:** Visit the official website on: [https://janaushadhi.gov.in/](https://janaushadhi.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on the ‘APPLY FOR KENDRA’ Tab. **Step 3:** Click on the ‘CLICK HERE TO APPLY’ Tab. **Step 4:** Click on the tab ‘REGISTER NOW” and fill in the applicant’s details with a unique Mobile number & Email ID. **Step 5:** After successful registration, the applicant will get an email containing a unique ‘USER ID & PASSWORD’ for Portal login **Step 6:** [Log in](https://onlineapp.pmbi.co.in/) with your USER ID and PASSWORD received or created through the registered email ID **Step 7:** The application processing fee amount must be deposited only in the PMBI's virtual account. **Step 8:** Fill out the application form carefully. - (Basic information with details of application processing fee of Rs. 5,000/- under Govt. Category) & - (Proposed Kendra Details) and other relevant details. **Step 9:** Upload the documents e.g., PACS ID, Certificate of Incorporation, PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank Statement for 6 months, etc. **Step 10:** Each document must be uploaded under a size of 200KB in PDF/JPEG/PNG/JPG format only. **Step 11:** Review the filled-out application & click on the final Submit button. > **Note:** After completing the above steps, the application form has been submitted successfully and confirmation will be shared on the registered email ID of the applicant. The applicant can also check their application status online at any time by login into the same portal or can call us on the helpline number 18001808080.

page_content:
# Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: HRD for implementation of the proposed program: Engaging Spice Extension Trainees **Ministry:** Ministry Of Commerce And Industry | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Engaging Spice, Extension Trainees, Unemployed, Youth | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: HRD for Implementation of the Proposed Programme – Engaging Spice Extension Trainees is implemented by the Spices Board, India under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. The objective of the scheme is to assist the Spices Board in implementing its programmes while improving the employability of technically qualified unemployed youth belonging to SC/ST and other eligible categories by engaging them as Spice Extension Trainees. The scheme is being implemented in accordance with the modalities and guidelines approved by the Competent Authority under the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom during the 15th Finance Commission period (2021–22 to 2025–26).
## Benefits 1. ₹20,000/- per personnel per month for training period of two years, as Spice Extension Trainees. 1. Selection will be minimum 70% from SC/ST category and remaining from General category. 1. Stipend as above and TA/DA will be provided as per norms.
## Eligibility Criteria 1.All spice growing States and regions in India/UT 2. Selection process depends on COVID protocols and sourcing of candidates through media and Board’s website. Selection will be through walk-in-test. 3.Selected candidates will undergo training as Spice Extension Trainee for assisting Board’s regular Officers on technical aspects and simultaneously getting trained on various aspects of spice cultivation, post-harvest improvement, export etc. 4.Selected candidates have to enter into an agreement with Spices Board 5.Training will be temporary, for a period of one year, likely to be extended for one more year depending on performance and getting automatically terminated on completion of two years or before as agreed in the prescribed MoU.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Registration** Step 1: The applicant should visit the [ServicesPlus](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/) website. Step 2: Click on the “[Register” ](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/citizenRegistration.html)option on the homepage. Step 3: Fill out the registration form by entering Full Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, Password, selecting State, and Captcha. Step 4: Review all details carefully and submit the registration form. Step 5: An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number or email; enter the OTP and click “Verify.” Step 6: Registration will be completed successfully, and a confirmation message will be displayed or sent via email. **Login** Step 1: The applicant should visit the ServicesPlus website and click on [“Login.”](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/loginWindow.do) Step 2: Enter your Email ID, Password, and Captcha. Step 3: Select the relevant service/scheme name. Step 4: Fill in the required details in the application form. Step 5: Submit the application.

metadata.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to stimulate employment creation, increase workforce formalization, and enhance employability. It provides financial incentives to first-time employees and offers wage subsidies to eligible employers for creating sustained jobs, especially in manufacturing.

page_content:
# Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana **Ministry:** Ministry Of Labour and Employment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Employee, Manufacturer, Subsidy, Literacy, Employment, Incentive | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana" was launched by the Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India. The scheme aims to promote the generation of sustained additional employment, increase the formalization of the workforce, and enhance employability. The scheme provides comprehensive financial assistance to first-time employees to navigate their learning curve and incentivizes eligible establishments, particularly in the manufacturing sector, for generating sustained additional employment over their established baseline. The applicant must regularly file the Electronic Challan-cum-Return along with provident fund contributions and fulfill the defined threshold criteria for new employment generation. The scheme is implemented by the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation. The applications for this scheme are accepted continuously during the registration period from 01.08.2025 to 31.07.2027 through the online updating of establishment details and employee Aadhaar authentication on the official portal.
## Benefits ##### **Part A:****** ***First-Timer Benefits*** - The scheme provides a one-time incentive of up to ₹15,000/- to assist first-time employees. - The first installment is up to a maximum of ₹7,500/-, calculated as half of the average Employees' Provident Fund wage for six continuous completed months. - The second installment is equal to the average of the twelve completed months' Employees' Provident Fund wage reduced by the first installment, restricted to a total incentive of ₹15,000/-. - The second installment will be kept in an appropriate saving instrument or deposit account for a specified period. - The incentives to the employees shall be paid through Direct Benefit Transfer using the Aadhaar Bridge Payment System to their Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts. - The incentive shall be disbursed within 45 days after fulfilling the eligibility condition and filing of the paid Electronic Challan-cum-Return.
##### **Part B:****** ***Support to Employers*** - The scheme provides incentives to the employer for two years in respect of employment generated over and above the baseline. - For the manufacturing sector, the incentive to the employer will continue for the third and the fourth year. - For additional employees with an Employees' Provident Fund wage less than or equal to ₹10,000/-, the benefit to the employer is up to ₹1,000/- per additional employment per month. - In respect of employees getting Employees' Provident Fund wages below ₹10,000/-, the incentive at the rate of 10 percent of the Employees' Provident Fund wage will be provided as an additional risk mitigation measure. - For additional employees with an Employees' Provident Fund wage greater than ₹10,000/- and up to ₹20,000/-, the benefit is ₹2,000/- per additional employment per month. - For additional employees with an Employees' Provident Fund wage greater than ₹20,000/- and up to ₹1,00,000/-, the benefit is ₹3,000/- per additional employment per month. - The benefits will be provided to all eligible establishments on a six-monthly lump-sum basis after the filing of six completed months' Electronic Challan-cum-Returns. - The incentive to the establishment shall be provided as a Direct Benefit Transfer to the Permanent Account Number-linked bank account of the establishment.
##### ***Conditions*** - _The employer must fulfill the threshold limit continuously, generating at least 2 additional employments with a baseline of less than 50, and at least 5 additional employments with a baseline of 50 or above._ - _The first-time employee must successfully complete the mandatory Financial Literacy Course available through the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation Employee portal to receive the second installment._ - _The benefits to the employer will not accrue for any month in which the employer is not eligible as per the threshold criteria laid out in the Scheme._
## Eligibility Criteria ##### ***Eligibility for Employees (First Timers)*** - The applicant must not have been a contributing member of the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation or an Exempted Trust prior to the commencement of the scheme. - The applicant must join an establishment during the scheme registration period from 01.08.2025 to 31.07.2027. - The applicant must have their Universal Account Number authenticated by Face Authentication Technology on the UMANG Application. - The applicant must have gross wages up to ₹1,00,000/- per month at the time of joining the establishment. - The applicant must have Electronic Challan-cum-Returns along with contributions filed for six continuous months. - The applicant must continue with the same establishment for the entire period of six months if they are employed in a seasonal industry. ##### ***Eligibility for Employees (Re-joinees)*** - The applicant must have a previous contributory membership of the Employees' Provident Fund. - The applicant must join an establishment registered with the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation or an exempted trust during the scheme registration period. - The applicant must have a Universal Account Number, which is Aadhaar-authenticated using biometric or face authentication technology. ##### ***Eligibility for Establishments (Employers)*** - The applicant must be covered under the Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952. - The applicant must have a unique Permanent Account Number. - The applicant must file the Electronic Challan-cum-Return along with contributions regularly. - The applicant must generate additional employment meeting the threshold of at least 2 additional employments if their baseline is less than 50. - The applicant must generate additional employment meeting the threshold of at least 5 additional employments if their baseline is 50 or above. - The applicant must provide details of their Permanent Account Number, Goods and Services Tax Network, and a Permanent Account Number linked Bank Account Number.
## Exclusions - The applicant must not have pending inquiries under Section 7A, 7B, or 7C of the Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952. - The applicant must not have a First Information Report filed against them by the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation for fraudulent practices. - The applicant must not have pending or decided inquiries relating to irregularities under the Atmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana scheme.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ##### ***Registration Process For Establishments*** **Step 1:** The employer must access the [official portal](https://pmvbry.epfindia.gov.in/) of the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation to initiate the deemed registration process for their existing or newly covered establishment. The establishment must ensure its standard records are fully compliant with current statutory mandates. **Step 2:** The employer must update and accurately provide their unique Permanent Account Number, Goods and Services Tax Network details, and a Permanent Account Number linked Bank Account Number within the portal to facilitate direct benefit transfers.
##### ***Registration Process For Employees*** **Step 1:** The employee must download and access the official UMANG Mobile Application on their smartphone to begin the registration process and securely generate a Universal Account Number for the scheme. **Step 2:** The employee must utilize the Facial Authentication Technology facility provided within the UMANG Application to authenticate their identity and successfully link their Aadhaar to the new Universal Account Number.
##### ***Application Process For Benefits Disbursement*** **Step 1:** The establishment must accurately file the monthly Electronic Challan-cum-Return along with the prescribed amount of provident fund contributions for all eligible newly joined employees and re-joinees through the designated online return portal. **Step 2:** The establishment must ensure the continuous filing of the Electronic Challan-cum-Return for six completed wage months to successfully trigger the automated six-monthly lump sum benefit calculation and subsequent disbursement process.
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** The first-time employee must log in to the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation employee portal and successfully complete the mandatory online Financial Literacy Course to become fully eligible for the second installment of their designated incentive. **Step 2:** The applicant can track their application and file any grievances related to eligibility or non-receipt of incentives using the online grievance redressal facility and escalation matrix provided by the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation, ensuring resolution within fifteen days.
##### ***Grievance Redressal / Help & Support*** The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation provides an online facility and a dedicated call center for the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana to assist stakeholders and resolve grievances within fifteen days. (Note: A specific internet "SOURCES" table was omitted as all information was exclusively derived from the provided document guidelines.)

metadata.schemeName: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The Bihar Government launched the Bihar Student Credit Card (BSCC) scheme to provide financial aid to applicants to complete their higher education.

page_content:
# Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Bihar | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Educational Loan, Student Empowerment, Financial Assistance, Higher Education | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Department of Education introduced a scheme named "**Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme**". Its aim is to provide financial aid to students to complete their higher education. In this scheme, the students can avail loans of up to ₹4 lakhs at minimal interest rates. They can utilize these funds for financing courses like B.Sc, B.A, B.Tech, or MBBS. This scheme is specifically for all those students who are interested in pursuing higher education but due to lack of financial resources, they are not able to pursue the same. ## Benefits The eligible students will get the following benefits under this scheme:- 1. A maximum loan amount of ₹4 lakh. 1. Loan can be availed for polytechnic, technical and general courses. 1. This assistance may be utilized for purchasing of books and laptops or pay any kind of fees. 1. Repayment of the loan starts once the course has been completed and student have secured a job. 1. The interest rate of the loan is 1% for Divyang, transgender, and girl students. 1. The recovery procedures are flexible since the loan is government-owned. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Bihar and must not be more than 25 years of age on the date of application. For postgraduate-level courses where the minimum educational qualification is graduation, the maximum age limit is 30 years. 1. The applicant must have been admitted or selected for admission to a higher education institution recognized by the competent regulatory authority of Bihar, another State, or the Central Government. 1. The applicant may avail the scheme for general higher education courses as well as various professional and technical courses. The list of eligible courses is provided in [Annexure-3](https://www.7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in/resources/Guideline.pdf) and may be amended from time to time by the Education Department, including the addition or deletion of courses. 1. If the applicant is staying in the hostel of the educational institution, the applicable amount must be made available to the applicant's educational institution. If the applicant is not staying in the hostel of the educational institution, the applicant must be provided living expenses, other than fees, at the prescribed rates specified in [Annexure-2](https://www.7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in/resources/Guideline.pdf), based on the city classification given in [Annexure-1](https://www.7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in/resources/Guideline.pdf). The Education Department may increase the accommodation and living expense rates as required based on inflation. 1. The applicant must have passed Class 12th or an equivalent examination from an institution recognized by the Government of Bihar. For Polytechnic courses, the applicant must have passed Class 10th. The applicant must also be a permanent resident of Bihar if they have passed Class 10th/12th/+2 (Class 10th for Polytechnic courses) from a school or board located in the bordering districts of Bihar in Jharkhand, Uttar Pradesh, or West Bengal. 1. The applicant must not avail the scheme for the same level of course for which they already hold a degree. This condition does not apply to technical or management courses. For example, an applicant holding a Bachelor’s degree in Science must not avail the scheme for pursuing another undergraduate degree in Arts, Science, or Commerce. However, the applicant may avail the scheme for pursuing courses such as M.B.A., M.C.A., etc., after completing graduation in Arts, Science, or Commerce. 1. If the applicant discontinues their studies midway for any reason, the remaining loan amount must not be made available by the financial institution or the institution. The remaining instalments of the education loan must be made available under the scheme only if the applicant continues studying in the concerned institution/course.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** https://www.7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in/addFtrUserPage 1. Visit [**https://www.7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in/**](https://www.7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in/) website. 1. Click the ‘New Applicant Registration’ button. 1. Fill the details, such as name, email ID, mobile number, Aadhaar number, and OTP and click the ‘Submit’ button. 1. A successful registration message will be displayed, and the applicants will receive the username and password by email and SMS. 1. Visit the [**https://www.7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in/**](https://www.7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in/) website and log in using the username and password. 1. Fill the details on the ‘Personal Information Page’ and click the ‘Submit’ button. 1. Selects the ‘BSCC’ option from the drop-down list and click the ‘Apply’ button. 1. Fill in the details on the BSCC form and submit it. A confirmation message and the acknowledgement number will be displayed. 1. The respective District Registration and Counseling Center (DRCC) will schedule an appointment and send an email and SMS informing the applicant about the date of the visit to the DRCC. 1. The applicant should visit the DRCC with self-attested documents and submit them to the Multi-Purpose Assistant (MPA) for verification. 1. After verification by the concerned authorities and loan sanction by the bank, the DRCC will send an SMS and email to the applicant informing the date the applicant should visit the DRCC to collect the ‘Student Credit Card’ and sanction letter of the loan. 1. The applicant should visit the bank to complete the documentation formalities after collecting the ‘Student Credit Card’ and the bank’s sanction letter from the DRCC. 1. The applicant will get the loan disbursement from the bank, and bank officials will inform the same to the DRCC. 1. The applicants can also track their application status on [**https://www.7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in/addapplicationStatus**](https://www.7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in/addapplicationStatus)**.**

page_content:
# National Pension Scheme for Traders And Self Employed Persons **Ministry:** Ministry Of Labour and Employment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Retailer, Shopkeeper, Traders, Self-employed Persons, Rice Mill Owners, Oil Mill Owners, Broker Of Real Estate, Owners Of Small Hotels And Restaurants | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "National Pension Scheme for Traders And Self-Employed Persons" was launched by the Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India in September 2019. The scheme aims to provide old age protection and social security to small-scale traders, retailers, and self-employed individuals. The scheme provides a voluntary and contributory pension under which the beneficiary receives a minimum assured monthly pension of ₹3,000/- after attaining the age of sixty years. The entry age for an applicant should be in the age group of 18 to 40 years with an annual turnover not exceeding Rs. 1.5 crore, who are not members of EPFO/ESIC/NPS(Government funded)/PM-SYM and are not income tax payers are eligible to the scheme. The applicant must make monthly contributions ranging between ₹55/- and ₹200/- per month depending upon the entry age of beneficiary till they attain the age of 60 years.
## Benefits > **Pension Benefit** - Each eligible subscriber under this scheme shall receive an assured minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000/- after attaining the age of sixty years. - The Government of India make a matching contribution into the subscriber's pension account every month. > **Family Pension on Death of Beneficiary** - After the receipt of the pension, if an eligible beneficiary dies, the spouse shall be entitled to receive fifty per cent of the pension received by such beneficiary as a family pension, which is applicable only to the spouse. > **Provisions for Permanent Disablement Before Age of Sixty** - If an eligible beneficiary has given regular contributions and becomes permanently disabled before attaining the age of sixty years, the spouse shall be entitled to continue with the scheme by payment of regular contributions. - In case of permanent disablement where the spouse does not continue, they can exit the scheme by receiving the share of contribution deposited by the subscriber, with interest as actually earned thereon by the Pension Fund or the savings bank interest rate, whichever is higher. > **Exit Before Completion of Ten Years** - In case an eligible beneficiary exits this scheme within a period of less than ten years from the date of joining, the share of contribution by them only will be returned with the savings bank rate of interest payable thereon. **NOTE:** Both voluntary and involuntary exits from the scheme are permitted only after completion of three years from the date of enrolment in the scheme. > **Exit After Ten Years but Before Age of Sixty** - If an eligible beneficiary exits after completion of a period of ten years or more from the date of joining but before the age of sixty years, their share of contribution only shall be returned along with accumulated interest thereon as actually earned by the Pension Fund or the savings bank interest rate, whichever is higher. > **Death of Beneficiary During the Contribution Period** • If an eligible beneficiary has given regular contributions and dies due to any cause, the spouse shall be entitled to continue with the scheme by payment of regular contributions. • If the spouse does not wish to continue after the beneficiary's death, they can exit by receiving the share of contribution paid by the beneficiary along with accumulated interest, as actually earned by the Pension Fund or at the savings bank interest rate, whichever is higher. > **Corpus Reversion After Death of Both Beneficiary and Spouse** - After the death of the beneficiary and his or her spouse, the corpus shall be credited back to the fund.

## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a Laghu Vyapari, self-employed person, shop owner, retail trader, rice mill owner, oil mill owner, workshop owner, commission agent, real estate broker, small hotel owner, or restaurant owner. 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 40 years of age. 1. The applicant must have an annual turnover that does not exceed ₹1,50,00,000/-. 1. The applicant must possess a savings bank account in their name. 1. The applicant must possess an Aadhaar Card or Aadhaar Number.

## Exclusions 1. The applicant must not be covered under any National Pension Scheme contributed by the Central Government. 1. The applicant must not be a member of the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) under the Employees’ Provident Fund and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952. 1. The applicant must not be covered under the Employees’ State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) Scheme under the Employees’ State Insurance Act, 1948. 1. The applicant must not be an income-tax payer or income-tax assessee. 1. The applicant must not be enrolled under the Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan Yojana administered by the Ministry of Labour & Employment.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - via CSC > **Registration Process** **Step 1:** The interested eligible person must visit their nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) to initiate the registration process offline. The applicant must carry prerequisites such as their Aadhaar Card and evidence of their bank account. **Step 2:** The Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE) at the centre will key in the Aadhaar number, name of the beneficiary, and date of birth as printed on the Aadhaar card. This step is necessary to authenticate the identity of the applicant in the system. **Step 3:** The VLE will complete the online registration by filling up essential details in the enrollment system. These details include the applicant's bank account information, mobile number, email address, GSTIN, annual turnover income, spouse details, and nominee details. **Step 4:** A self-certification process for the eligibility conditions will be completed by the applicant. Following this, the system will automatically calculate the monthly contribution amount payable according to the age of the beneficiary. > **Application and Payment Process** **Step 5:** The enrolled beneficiary will pay the first subscription amount in cash directly to the VLE. This initial contribution payment activates the subscription to the pension scheme. **Step 6:** An enrollment cum auto-debit mandate form will be generated and printed by the system. This mandate form must be signed by the beneficiary, after which the VLE will scan the document and upload it securely into the system. **Step 7:** A unique Vyapari Pension Account Number (VPAN) will be generated for the applicant to maintain their account records. Finally, a physical Vyapari Card will be printed and handed over to the beneficiary.

**Mode:** Online ***Self-Enrollment Login Process:*** - Visit the [Maandhan Homepage](https://maandhan.in/)- Click on Login. The Maandhan Login screen will appear. - Click on Self Enrollment. - Enter your Mobile Number. - Enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number. - Click on Proceed. - Complete Self Enrollment > **Note:** [Maandhan User Manual](https://maandhan.in/showfile.php?lang=1&level=1&ls_id=171&lid=260&page=101)

page_content:
# Integrated Scheme for Oil Seeds and Maize (ISOPAM) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Madhya Pradesh | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Oilseeds, Maize, Farmer, Subsidy, Agriculture | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Integrated Scheme for Oil Seeds and Maize (ISOPAM)” launched by the Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to increase the productivity of oilseed and maize crops through providing assistance and benefits to all categories of farmers in the state.
## Benefits - **Seed Purchase Subsidy:** Breeder Seed Purchase – 100% of the price fixed by the Government of India. - **Foundation and Certified Seed Production Subsidy:** For Soybean Crop ₹700/- per quintal for general category farmers and ₹200/- per quintal for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe farmers.

metadata.schemeName: Namo Drone Didi
metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to empower women by handholding them into a sustainable business model where they can increase their income, transforming the modern farming ecosystem with drone technology.

page_content:
# Namo Drone Didi **Ministry:** Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Drone Technology, Self Help Group, Agriculture Services, Subsidy, Training, Women Empowerment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Namo Drone Didi" by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India, aims to promote advanced agricultural technology through providing drones and financial support to Women Self Help Groups to enhance farm productivity and create sustainable livelihoods.
## Benefits > **Financial Assistance:** - **Subsidy on Drone Package:** The scheme provides an 80% subsidy on the drone package, subject to a maximum of ₹8,00,000/- per Self Help Group. - **Loan Support for Remaining Cost:** The remaining 20% amount can be availed as a loan under the Agricultural Infrastructure Financing Facility with a 3% interest subvention. - **Additional Loan Options:** Self Help Groups and Cluster Level Federations can also access loans from other Ministry of Rural Development schemes or CLF corpus funds. > **Training Support:** - **Drone Pilot Training Programme:** A 15-day training programme is provided for drone pilots, including 5 days of drone pilot training and 10 days of nutrient and pesticide application training.- **Drone Assistant Training Programme:** A 5-day training programme is provided for drone assistants.- **Free Training Provision:** Training is included in the drone supply package and is free of cost for beneficiaries. > **Employment and Income Generation:** - **Annual Income Opportunity:** Women Self Help Groups can earn more than ₹1,00,000/- annually by providing drone services to farmers. - **Livelihood and Employment Promotion:** The scheme promotes sustainable livelihood opportunities and rural employment for women. > **Technology Adoption in Agriculture:** - **Precision Farming Services:** The scheme supports precision application of fertilizers and pesticides, soil and field analysis, crop monitoring, and irrigation management using drones.- **Promotion of Nano-Fertilizers and Optimized Chemical Use:** The scheme encourages the use of nano-fertilizers and optimized chemical usage to reduce environmental impact.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a female member of a Self Help Group. - The applicant should be more than 18 years of age. - The applicant should have passed Class 10th. - The applicant should be enrolled in a Self-Help Group registered under Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana National Rural Livelihoods Mission.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant should enroll as a member of a Self Help Group registered under Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana National Rural Livelihoods Mission. **Step 2:** The State Level Committee identifies clusters and Cluster Level Federations for drone allocation. **Step 3:** Progressive Self Help Groups are shortlisted by Cluster Level Federations. **Step 4:** The Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana National Rural Livelihoods Mission finalises the list of eligible Self Help Groups and obtains approval from the Implementation Monitoring Committee. **Step 5:** The final list is shared with Lead Fertilizer Companies, which upload the selected Self Help Groups on the Drone Portal. **Step 6:** Selected Self Help Groups apply for loan support for the remaining drone cost under the Agricultural Infrastructure Financing Facility or other approved sources. **Step 7:** Selected women members undergo mandatory training at Remote Pilot Training Organisations. **Step 8:** Drones are procured and handed over to the approved Self Help Groups.

# Anuprati Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Minority Students, Minority Students, Higher Education Support, Scholarship, Financial Incentive, Union Public Service Commission, Competitive Exam | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Anuprati Yojana" by the Department of Minority Affairs and Waqf, Government aims to encourage minority students by providing ₹50,000/- incentive for success in competitive exams like Union Public Service Commission and Rajasthan Public Service Commission, and admission into reputed institutions such as Indian Institutes of Technology, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Indian Institutes of Management, National Institutes of Technology, and other recognised institutions.

metadata.schemeName: Internship Programs at IIST
tags: Indian Institute Of Space Science And Technology
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide internship and research opportunities in space science, technology, engineering, humanities, and related fields to undergraduate and postgraduate students through hands-on experience and research exposure at the Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology (IIST).

page_content:
# Internship Programs at IIST **Ministry:** PMO | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Internship, Indian Institute Of Space Science And Technology, Research, Space Science | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Internship Programs at IIST” implemented by the Department of Space, aims to provide internship and research opportunities to undergraduate, postgraduate, and Ph.D. students through exposure to advanced research and development activities in space science and technology. The program includes Summer Internship, Year-Round Internship/Project, and Ph.D. Visiting Schemes for students from Indian institutions and universities. Selected interns work with experienced faculty members on active research projects and gain practical experience using advanced laboratories and campus facilities. The internship duration ranges from 1 month to 2 months depending on the approved project. The internships are unpaid; however, students receive academic exposure, mentorship, research experience, and a project completion certificate after successful completion.
## Benefits - **Hostel Accommodation:** Hostel accommodation may be provided, subject to room availability during the internship period. - **Internship Completion Certificate:** A project completion certificate is issued after submission of the project report and endorsement certificate signed by the faculty supervisor. - **Administrative Charges:** Interns must pay a nominal administrative charge of ₹100/- at the time of joining.
## Eligibility Criteria - The candidate must be a regular undergraduate or graduate student at an Indian Institution or University, pursuing a degree in science, technology, engineering, mathematics, humanities, or other related fields. - The candidate has to submit a copy of the No Objection Certificate from an appropriate authority (Head of Department / Principal / Director of your Institution) at the time of application. - The applicant must be available full-time for a minimum of 1 month at the IIST campus during the internship period. - The applicant must have secured an overall CGPA of 6.5 or above (or equivalent) in the relevant discipline at the time of applying for the internship.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** The applicant must visit the official IIST internship portal and complete the online application form using a valid email ID and mobile number. **Step 2:** The applicant must enter personal details, academic qualifications, CGPA or percentage, institution details, and previous educational records. **Step 3:** The applicant must provide details of relevant courses, projects, workshops, scholarships, technical skills, and other academic or co-curricular activities. **Step 4:** The applicant must submit the contact details of faculty references and the institutional authority who can verify the academic information. **Step 5:** The applicant must select up to 5 internship topics in order of preference and upload the required documents, including resume or supporting files, if applicable. **Step 6:** The applicant must submit the application online and note the registration number generated after successful submission. - **User Manual:** [Click here](https://admission.iist.ac.in//internship/template/default/downloads/How%20to%20Apply.pdf).
