metadata.schemeName: Global Engagement Scheme: Grant-In-Aid To Indo-Foreign Friendship Cultural Societies
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to generate a greater understanding of India's culture and foster closer friendship with people of other countries. Through this component, financial grants are provided to Indo-Foreign Friendship/Cultural Societies actively functioning in foreign countries.

page_content:
# Global Engagement Scheme: Grant-In-Aid To Indo-Foreign Friendship Cultural Societies **Ministry:** Ministry Of Culture | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Financial Grants, Indo Foreign Friendship, Cultural Societies, Dance, Music, Photo Exhibitions, Workshops | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Global Engagement Scheme: Grant-In-Aid To Indo-Foreign Friendship Cultural Societies" component of the Global Engagement Scheme by the ICR Division, Ministry of Culture, Government of India aims to generate greater understanding of India's culture and foster closer friendship with people of other countries. Through this component, financial grants are provided to Indo-Foreign Friendship/Cultural Societies actively functioning in foreign countries. The component is implemented by the Ministry of Culture through Indian Missions abroad, with grants authorised via the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), and proposals examined by an Expert Committee. > **Objectives:** - Generate greater understanding of India's culture. - Foster closer friendship with people of other countries. - Promote interaction between eminent Indian scholars and their foreign counterparts through holding of seminars on related topics.
## Benefits > **Activities for which the Grant is given to the Cultural Societies recommended by the Indian Mission:** Grants under the scheme will be given primarily to cover expenses of the grantees on activities which help projection of India's cultural image and generation of greater understanding of its cultural heritage, and for promoting bilateral cultural contacts by organising the following: - Dance (classical, folk and workshops). - Music (vocal, instrumental, Sufi, classical, semi-classical, Carnatic, contemporary, workshops, etc.). - Photo Exhibitions on culture-related topics. - Exhibitions on Books and other culture-related topics/material. - Publication of Books/journals on culture. - Promotion of Hindi and other Indian languages by organising activities like Workshops, Essay Competition, Dictation and Valedictory Session, Kavi Sammelan and publication of a regional language magazine, etc. - Furnishing the premises of societies having adequate space with replicas of exhibits sourced from the Indian Mission in lieu of cash grant. - Visual Arts and Crafts such as such ceramics, drawing, painting, sculpture, etc. - Contemporary and Modern/Fine Art exhibitions. - Theatre: Drama, Skit, Mime, Mimicry and workshops. - Activities to promote Folk Arts viz Mehendi, Puppetry and Rangoli. - Classes/Courses in Yoga art. - Organisation of Literary events like Debate, Elocution, Creative Writing workshops, Book reading sessions, etc. - Organisation of lecture-demonstrations, seminars, symposiums and conferences on culture-related topics. - Discussions on Indian culture, history, civilisation by inviting eminent scholars, artists, etc. who are interested in Indian affairs can be sponsored. - Promoting interaction between distinguished visiting Indian academics, artists etc with their local counterparts, etc. - Celebrations of Indian festivals - Celebration of National days like India's Republic Day, International Day of Yoga, Indian Independence Day, Hindi Diwas, Gandhi Jayanti, etc. - Celebrations of Anniversaries and centenaries of great Indian personalities and other commemorations of National importance. In this regard, the following activities may be organised. - Organise plays on the theme - Use the theme for activities planned for National Days. - The Works of the personality be translated into major world languages and - Digital Library promotion through Indian Embassies. - Kavi Sammelans in regional languages. - Indian Vegetarian Food Festival to be organised by Indian Embassies abroad. - Commemorative postage stamp on Gandhi to be released. VII. Release of Commemorative coin. - Exhibitions of paintings, rare photographs, books, sculptures, artefacts. - National/International seminars, workshops, competitions, lectures. - Illumination of iconic buildings. > **Please Note:** This Scheme does not grant any funds for operational/ maintenance/capital creation cost of the societies.
> **Amount of Grant:** - The grant shall not ordinarily exceed ₹10,00,000/- (ten lakh) per annum per society. - There is no limit specified on funds authorised to the Mission, as this depends on the funds the Mission can utilise for cultural promotion as per the available number of societies. - An additional amount over and above the maximum limit, up to ₹25,00,000/- (twenty-five lakh), may be granted at the discretion of the Secretary (Culture) in consultation with the Financial Adviser (Culture), where the Ministry proposes to organise the Festival of India/culture weeks to enable expenditure towards hosting cultural troupes, etc.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant (society) should be an Indo-Foreign Friendship/Cultural Society actively functioning in a foreign country, with the object of fostering closer friendship and cultural contacts between India and the foreign country concerned. 1. The applicant should be actively engaged in the task of fostering friendly relations and projecting India's culture in the country concerned. 1. The applicant should have a definite and well-planned programme of activities, for which financial assistance by the Government of India is considered necessary. 1. The applicant should have gainfully utilised the earlier grant, if any, sanctioned by the Government of India.
## Exclusions 1. The scheme does not grant funds for operational, maintenance, or capital creation costs of the societies. 1. The applicant should not have been sanctioned grant-in-aid for the same activity/purpose from any other source. 1. No other bill for the same purpose and instalment should have already been paid earlier to the grantee. 1. The applicant (society) should not indulge in activities which are sectarian in nature. 1. Grants should normally be utilised for the activities of the society, and not for the direct activities of the Missions.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline 1. The Indian Mission ensures the society meets eligibility criteria that it is actively engaged in fostering friendly relations and projecting India's culture, has a well-planned programme of activities, and has gainfully utilised any earlier grant. 1. The Mission compiles and submits the proposal, comprising Details of the Society (Annexure A), Plan of Activities for the Current Financial Year (Annexure B), Certificate of No Corrupt Practices (Annexure C), Certificate of No Sectarian Activities (Annexure D), and the Utilisation Certificate (GFR 12-A) for any grant last sanctioned. 1. The Expert Committee, chaired by the Bureau Head In-charge of the ICR Division, with members from IFD, ICCR, and Sangeet Natak Akademi, and convened by the Director/DS (ICR), examines the proposal and recommends the quantum of grant for each society. 1. The competent authority sanctions the grant to the Bureau Head In-charge of the concerned Division for amounts up to ₹10,00,000/-, or, at the discretion of the Secretary (Culture) in consultation with the Financial Adviser (Culture), up to ₹25,00,000/- in special cases relating to Festival of India/culture weeks. 1. The grant is issued as an authorisation to the Indian Mission through the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), and the amount is placed with the Mission in their accounts. 1. The Mission informally checks the accounts of the grantee to satisfy itself that the grant has been properly utilised. 1. After utilising the grant, the society/Mission furnishes the Event Review Report (Annexure E) and a performance-cum-achievement report (2 copies) to the Ministry; video/photo/newspaper clips/audio material may be sent to icr-culture@nic.in and icrculture@gmail.com. 1. Any unspent balance with the grantee is surrendered to the Government without delay.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the establishment of new flower orchards by providing subsidy assistance to farmers for expanding floriculture cultivation.

page_content:
# Establishment Of New Flower Orchard **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Flower Orchard, Floriculture, Loose Flowers, Subsidy, Farmer | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Establishment Of New Flower Orchard" is a centrally sponsored scheme implemented by the Horticulture Department, Government of Rajasthan, with 60% Central Government funding and 40% State Government funding, and aims to promote the expansion of flower cultivation through subsidy assistance to farmers. The scheme provides financial support for establishing new flower orchards over an eligible area and encourages the cultivation of loose flowers such as native rose, marigold, chrysanthemum, and gaillardia. Recommended planting material should be procured from approved sources, and technical literature is provided to selected farmers regarding cultivation practices, marketing, maintenance, and utilization. The subsidy is first utilized for planting material, and the farmer is required to install an information board at the established orchard.
## Benefits > **Subsidy for New Flower Orchard** - Subsidy is available for establishing new flower orchards. - Assistance is admissible for 2.0 hectares of area. - The minimum project area must be 0.10 hectare. > **Estimated Cost:** - Estimated cost for loose flower crops is ₹40,000/- per hectare. - Subsidy for Small and Marginal Farmers. - Subsidy is 40% of the cost, subject to a maximum of ₹16,000/- per hectare. > **Subsidy for Other Farmers:** - Subsidy is 25% of the cost, subject to a maximum of ₹10,000/- per hectare. > **Technical Support:** - Selected farmers are provided technical literature on cultivation practices, flower marketing, maintenance, and utilization.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a farmer.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - via CSC - **Mode of Application:** Online - **Mode of Online Application:** E-Mitra - Applicants can apply by visiting their nearest [E-Mitra center](https://reportsemitraapp.rajasthan.gov.in/WebSrc/Reports/rpt_search_new_emitra_ksk.jsp) or online through their own E-Mitra account. > **Note:** - Applying for a vermicompost unit is free.

## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** A proposal is prepared for canal strengthening or expansion as per project requirements. **Step 2:** The proposal is submitted to the Project Officer, Tribal Area Development Department (TAD).

# Tribal Talent Recognition Program **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Incentive Award, Achievement Reward, Merit Recognition | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Tribal Talent Recognition Program" by the Tribal Area Development Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to recognize and encourage meritorious tribal students through providing incentive awards, certificates, and mementos to students aged 15 to 35 years for outstanding achievements.
## Benefits - **Incentive Award:** Incentive amount is provided to eligible students (amount not specified). - **Certificate and Memento:** Certificates, mementos, and citations are awarded to recognize achievements.
## Eligibility Criteria - The following categories of citizens are eligible for the Tribal Talent Award Ceremony: 1. Artists 2. Players 3. Students - The following reserved category citizens are eligible for the Tribal Talent Award Ceremony: 1. Scheduled Tribe. - Tribal students of the Scheduled Areas whose age is between 15 to 35 years and have achieved special achievements as per the eligibility criteria. > **Eligibility Criteria:** - The applicant should have been selected in the administrative or subordinate services of the Central or State Government. - The applicant should have been selected in the services up to Grade-B of the Central or State Government. - The applicant should have been appointed in reputed organizations within the private sector. - The applicant should have passed technical examinations such as AIEEE, IIT, CPMT, PMT, etc. - The applicant should have taken admission in recognized colleges after passing the technical examinations. - The applicant should have done exemplary work at the international or national level in the fields of art, music, or science. - The applicant should have studied regularly as a regular student in class 10th and 12th. - The applicant should have scored 75% or more marks in their board exams in the first attempt. - The applicant should have scored 65% marks in the first attempt in their undergraduate or postgraduate examinations. - The applicant should have obtained a Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) degree. - The applicant should have obtained a Chartered Accountant (C.A.) or Company Secretary (C.S.) degree. - The applicant should have been selected for a job in national-level institutions such as BARC, ISRO, AIIMS, IIM, IIS, etc.

## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - Candidates can obtain their application from M. L. Verma Tribal Research and Training Institute, Ashok Nagar Main Road, Udaipur, and submit it there.

metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
metadata.briefDescription: NGIS is a government scheme that helps nurture early-stage tech startups by providing incubation support, funding, and mentorship so they can develop strong, scalable business ideas.

page_content:
# STPI – Next Generation Incubation Scheme (NGIS) **Ministry:** Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Technology, Startups, DPIIT, Company, Internship | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Next Generation Incubation Scheme (NGIS), under the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India, is a government scheme that helps nurture early-stage tech startups by providing incubation support, funding, and mentorship so they can develop strong, scalable business ideas. **OBJECTIVES** • It is a startup incubation scheme by Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) under MeitY, aimed at strengthening India’s software product startup ecosystem, especially in Tier-II/III cities. It aims to handhold 300 tech startups across 12 STPI incubation locations in Tier-II/III cities.
## Benefits • Seed / risk funding up to ₹25 lakh for promising startups. • Access to state-of-the-art incubation infrastructure, labs, equipment, and testing facilities. • Mentoring, startup-connect, industry networking, marketing support, and product lifecycle guidance. • Internship / challenge grants for selected startups
## Eligibility Criteria • Indian startups working on software product development / technology-based solutions. • DPIIT-recognised startups are encouraged; individuals, academicians, researchers, entrepreneurs, LLPs, and partnership firms may also participate but may need to register as a private limited company if selected.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > Applicants can submit their proposals online through the STPI Startup Portal during open NGIS application calls.

page_content:
# Innovation & Agri-Entrepreneurship Program (RKVY) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Startups, DPIIT, Agricultural, Farming | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Innovation & Agri-Entrepreneurship Program (RKVY), under the Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India, supports agri-startups through funding, mentorship, and incubation to develop innovative solutions for agriculture and contribute to strengthening the agricultural sector. OBJECTIVES • To promote innovation and agri-preneurship by providing financial support and nurturing the incubation ecosystem. • To strengthen infrastructure in agriculture and allied areas.
## Benefits • Pre-seed support up to ₹5 lakh and seed-stage support up to ₹25 lakh via R-ABIs. • Provides grant-in-aid, incubation and mentoring support to eligible agri startups.

## Eligibility Criteria > DPIIT-recognised startups working in the agriculture and allied sectors are eligible to apply.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online

metadata.schemeName: Creation of Water Resources
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to develop water resources for ensuring life-saving irrigation to horticulture crops by providing subsidy for the construction of on-farm ponds and water reservoirs with plastic or RCC lining under the National Horticulture Mission.

page_content:
# Creation of Water Resources **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Water Resources, Irrigation, Farmers, Water Conservation, Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Creation of Water Resources" is a centrally sponsored scheme implemented by the Horticulture Department, Government of Rajasthan, with 60% Central Government funding and 40% State Government funding, and aims to ensure life-saving irrigation for horticulture crops through the creation of water resources for eligible farmers and farmer groups. The scheme provides financial assistance for constructing on-farm ponds and on-farm water reservoirs with plastic or RCC lining. It supports both individual farmers and farmer groups for rainwater storage and efficient water utilization. The water collected is intended to be used through water-saving irrigation methods such as drip and sprinkler irrigation. The scheme is implemented through online application and subsidy is released through Direct Benefit Transfer.
## Benefits > **Community Water Source:** - 100% subsidy on a unit cost of ₹20,00,000/- per unit for construction of an 100 m × 100 m × 3 m on-farm pond/on-farm water reservoir for a 10-hectare command area with minimum 500-micron BIS-standard plastic film or RCC lining. - For smaller water sources (minimum 50 m × 50 m × 3 m), subsidy is provided on a pro-rata basis according to the command area. > **Individual Water Source/Farm Pond:** - For an individual farmer, construction of a 20 m × 20 m × 3 m farm pond/dug well with 300-micron BIS-standard plastic film or RCC lining is eligible. - The unit cost is ₹1,50,000/-. - Subsidy is 50% of the unit cost, subject to a maximum of ₹75,000/-. - For smaller ponds or tanks, subsidy is provided on a pro-rata basis according to the command area. > **Installment Pattern for Plastic-Lined Water Sources:** - 20% after completion of excavation. - 50% after completion of plastic sheet laying. - 30% after completion of the work and final physical verification. > **Installment Pattern for RCC-Lined Water Sources:** - 30% after completion of the foundation floor. - 15% after completion of the first side wall. - 15% after completion of the second side wall. - 15% after completion of the third side wall. - 25% after completion of the fourth side wall and parapet wall. > **Validity:** - The assistance is provided as a one-time subsidy under the scheme.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an individual farmer or a farmer group.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](https://rajkisan.rajasthan.gov.in/rajkisanweb/login/2#searchmenu). **Step 2:** Click on "Login using SSO ID" or "Login using Jan Aadhaar ID". **Step 3:** Complete the online application form for the scheme. **Step 4:** Upload the required supporting documents. **Step 5:** Submit the application online. **Step 6:** The competent committee will verify the site suitability and documents. **Step 7:** After approval, the beneficiary may undertake construction according to prescribed standards. **Step 8:** Physical verification will be conducted after completion of the work. **Step 9:** Eligible subsidy will be released through DBT as per the prescribed installment pattern. > **Contact Us:** - [District Office](https://agriculture.rajasthan.gov.in/dam/#/sm/jankalyan-category-and-entry-type/372028/7/3/14). - [Regional Office](https://agriculture.rajasthan.gov.in/dam/#/sm/jankalyan-category-and-entry-type/372027/7/3/13).

metadata.schemeName: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (Nagaland)
metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme provides a monthly pension to elderly persons to support a dignified life. It aims to provide social security to vulnerable people, especially those living below the poverty line. The programme is fully funded by the Central Government.

page_content:
# Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (Nagaland) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Nagaland | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** BPL, Pension, Widow, Indira Gandhi | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme” under the National Social Assistance Programme is implemented by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Nagaland. The scheme provides a monthly pension to elderly persons to support a dignified life. It aims to provide social security to vulnerable people, especially those living below the poverty line. The programme is fully funded by the Central Government.

## Benefits The pension amount is ₹300/- per month and on attainment of the age of 80 years the beneficiary is entitled to get ₹500/- per month.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Nagaland. 1. The applicant should be a widow. 1. The applicant's age should be between 40 and 80 years. 1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant should not be receiving pension benefits under any social security scheme.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 1:The applicant submits the application at the District Welfare Office. Step 2:The District Level Committee verifies applications and forwards the selected beneficiaries for approval. Step 3: After approval, the pension amount is paid in cash by the District Welfare Officer.

page_content:
# Kala Mahotsav **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Mahotsav, Drama, Music, Dance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Kala Mahotsav" is a programme organized by the Art, Culture and Museums Department of Goa with the objective of providing people in remote areas the opportunity to witness quality performances in dance, drama, and music. The selection of artistes and performance items is carried out by the Kala Academy. The event typically spans 3 to 5 days, with cultural programmes held every evening for a duration of three hours at venues decided by the Kala Academy. ## Benefits **Assistance:** Honorarium is paid to the artistes by Kala Academy. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Goa with a background or proven interest in performing arts such as dance, drama, or music. 1. The applicant should be an individual artiste or part of a registered cultural group recognized by the Kala Academy or any government-affiliated cultural body. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Interested applicants must submit a duly filled application form along with relevant documents (such as proof of residence, performance experience, and group registration if applicable) to the Member Secretary, Kala Academy Goa, within the specified deadline. **Step 2:** The Kala Academy will verify the submitted applications and select eligible artistes or groups based on merit and suitability for the programme. Selected applicants will be notified by the Academy.

page_content:
# Nakshatra Utsav **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Dancers, Indian Music, Events, Artistes | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Nakshatra Utsav is a programme under the Department of Art, Culture and Museums, Goa, aimed at promoting talented upcoming artistes by providing them a state-level platform. The objective is to encourage young vocalists, instrumentalists, and dancers to showcase their talent and gain exposure that may lead to greater opportunities. **Participation:** Artistes are recommended by the Advisory Committee or authorities of Kala Academy. **Selection Procedure:** - Selected from the Faculty of Indian Music & Dance of Kala Academy. - Includes scholarship awardees of Kala Academy. - Also includes artistes from other institutions in Goa and accompanists. ## Benefits **Assistance available:** Suitable honorarium is paid to the main artistes and accompanists. The performance is adjudged by an Evaluation Committee and the best artistes are given opportunity to participate in other important musical events in and outside the State. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a young and upcoming artiste in the field of vocal music, instrumental music, or classical dance. 1. The applicant should be associated with Kala Academy, a scholarship awardee, or recommended by a recognized cultural institution in Goa. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 1: The applicant should prepare a detailed C.V. highlighting their training and performance experience. Step 2: Submit the C.V. in person or by post to the Member Secretary, Kala Academy Goa. Step 3: Wait for intimation from Kala Academy regarding selection. For any issues, contact the Member Secretary or Chairman, Kala Academy Goa.

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kisan Mitra Urja Yojna
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide additional electricity bill subsidy of up to ₹1,000/- per month (maximum ₹12,000/- per year) through adjustment in electricity bills to eligible rural agricultural electricity consumers of Rajasthan.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Kisan Mitra Urja Yojna **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Utility & Sanitation | **Tags:** Farmer, Electricity, Electricity Bill Assistance, Tariff Subsidy, Subsidy, Agricultural Power Consumers | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched on 1st May, 2021, the "Mukhyamantri Kisan Mitra Urja Yojna" implemented by the Energy Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to provide additional electricity bill subsidy to eligible rural agricultural electricity consumers through adjustment in their electricity bills. The scheme has been implemented from the billing month of May 2021. From the billing month of June 2023, eligible metered consumers using more than 2,000 units per month and flat-rate agricultural consumers having a connected load of more than 15 Horsepower (HP) receive an additional subsidy of up to ₹1,000/- per month, subject to a maximum of ₹12,000/- per year, in addition to the existing tariff subsidy. The subsidy is credited through an adjustment in the electricity bill.
## Benefits - **Electricity Bill Subsidy:** Eligible metered consumers using more than 2,000 units per month and flat-rate agricultural consumers having a connected load of more than 15 Horsepower (HP) receive an additional subsidy of up to ₹1,000/- per month, subject to a maximum of ₹12,000/- per year, in addition to the existing tariff subsidy.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a rural agricultural electricity consumer. - The applicant must belong to the general category. - The applicant must receive electricity under the Block Hours Supply category.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The eligible agricultural electricity consumer should approach the concerned electricity distribution company office. **Step 2:** Obtain the application form free of cost. **Step 3:** Fill in the application form with the required details. **Step 4:** Attach the required supporting documents, if applicable. **Step 5:** Submit the completed application to the concerned office. **Step 6:** The electricity distribution company verifies the applicant's eligibility. **Step 7:** On approval, the eligible subsidy is adjusted in the consumer's electricity bill.

metadata.schemeName: Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB): Benefits in the Event of Marriage
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a congratulatory grant of ₹10,000/- to eligible registered construction workers and up to 2 eligible children of members on the occasion of their first marriage.

page_content:
# Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB): Benefits in the Event of Marriage **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Mizoram | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child | **Tags:** Construction Workers, Marriage Benefit, Labour Welfare, Building And Other Construction Workers, Wedding Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Benefits in the Event of Marriage” under the "Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board Benefits for Workers" is implemented by the Mizoram Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Government of Mizoram, to provide financial assistance on the occasion of the first marriage of eligible members and their children. A member with continuous registration for at least 3 years is eligible for a congratulatory grant of ₹10,000/- for their first marriage. Up to 2 children of a member with continuous registration for at least 3 years are each eligible for a congratulatory grant of ₹10,000/- on their first marriage. The application must be submitted within 6 months from the date of marriage along with a wedding photograph.
## Benefits - **Member’s First Marriage:** A member with at least 3 years of continuous registration receives a congratulatory grant of ₹10,000/- for their first marriage. - **Children’s First Marriage:** Up to 2 children of a member with at least 3 years of continuous registration receive ₹10,000/- each for their first marriage. - **Application Validity:** The application must be submitted within 6 months from the date of marriage.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an Indian citizen. - The applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age. - The applicant must have been engaged as a construction worker for at least 90 days in a year. - The applicant must be engaged as a contractor or employee in one of the covered categories of construction work. > **Contractors or employees engaged in the following categories of work:** 1. Carpenter 2. Mason 3. Cement Mason 4. Painter 5. Helper (Construction Works) 6. Electrician 7. Wireman 8. Fitter 9. Welder 10. Plumber 11. Iron and Aluminium Worker 12. Blacksmith 13. Lumberjack 14. Sand Extraction Worker 15. Stone Quarry Worker 16. Stone Breaker 17. Road and Earthwork Labourer 18. JCB/Dozer Operator 19. Construction Machine Operator 20. Construction Driver 21. Brick Factory Worker > **Membership Fee:** - A one-time Registration Fee of ₹25/- shall be payable at the time of enrolment. - A monthly subscription of ₹10/- is payable to maintain active membership. Alternatively, an advance payment of ₹120/- may be made to cover one year's subscription. - Members wishing to pay the Membership/Renewal Fee in advance may do so for a period of up to three (3) years. - Membership must be renewed within one (1) year from the date of expiry, in accordance with [Section 17 of the BOCW (RE&CS) Act, 1996](https://lesde.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2024/05/bbadc4155d1796a962f3883e14e4cc9c/pages-145-bocw-recs-act-1996.pdf).
## Exclusions - Workers who are already registered under any other State/Union Territory Welfare Board in India shall not be eligible for membership under this Board.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Eligible registered members of the Welfare Board may apply for the respective welfare schemes by submitting the prescribed scheme-specific application form, duly filled in and accompanied by the requisite supporting documents, through the prescribed offline mode. **Step 2:** The application forms and supporting documents shall be as specified by the Welfare Board for the respective scheme/benefit. - **Application Form for Registration under the Board**: [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2023/06/70c9592db154bfccb04514f40e9b5ea8/pages-103-registration-form.pdf).- **Application Form for Marriage Assistance**: [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2023/02/cf995041968dc1452b2d6d83ba77a89b/pages-103-marriage-assistance-form.pdf). > **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/page/whom-to-contact).

metadata.schemeName: Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB): Maternity Assistance
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide welfare benefits to eligible construction workers registered with the Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, including maternity assistance for eligible female members.

page_content:
# Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB): Maternity Assistance **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Mizoram | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child | **Tags:** Construction Workers, Maternity Assistance, Labour Welfare, Pregnancy, Women | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Maternity Assistance" under the Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB) is implemented by the Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Government of Mizoram to provide welfare benefits to eligible registered construction workers. The Board has been constituted under the Building and Other Construction Workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act, 1996, and a Welfare Fund has been established for eligible members. Eligible Indian citizens aged 18 to 60 years who has been engaged as a construction worker for at least 90 days in a year may apply for membership. Registered eligible female members may receive the maternity assistance of ₹10,000/- for up to 2 children born after attaining membership.
## Benefits - **Maternity Assistance for Female Members:** Eligible female members receive ₹10,000/- for maternity assistance for up to 2 children born after attaining membership. - **Benefit Claim Validity:** The maternity assistance must be claimed within 6 months from the date of childbirth.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an Indian citizen. - The applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age. - The applicant must have been engaged as a construction worker for at least 90 days in a year. - The applicant must be engaged as a contractor or employee in one of the covered categories of construction work. > **Contractors or employees engaged in the following categories of work:** 1. Carpenter 2. Mason 3. Cement Mason 4. Painter 5. Helper (Construction Works) 6. Electrician 7. Wireman 8. Fitter 9. Welder 10. Plumber 11. Iron and Aluminium Worker 12. Blacksmith 13. Lumberjack 14. Sand Extraction Worker 15. Stone Quarry Worker 16. Stone Breaker 17. Road and Earthwork Labourer 18. JCB/Dozer Operator 19. Construction Machine Operator 20. Construction Driver 21. Brick Factory Worker > **Membership Fee:** - A one-time Registration Fee of ₹25/- shall be payable at the time of enrolment. - A monthly subscription of ₹10/- is payable to maintain active membership. Alternatively, an advance payment of ₹120/- may be made to cover one year's subscription. - Members wishing to pay the Membership/Renewal Fee in advance may do so for a period of up to three (3) years. - Membership must be renewed within one (1) year from the date of expiry, in accordance with [Section 17 of the BOCW (RE&CS) Act, 1996](https://lesde.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2024/05/bbadc4155d1796a962f3883e14e4cc9c/pages-145-bocw-recs-act-1996.pdf).
## Exclusions - Workers who are already registered under any other State/Union Territory Welfare Board in India shall not be eligible for membership under this Board.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Eligible registered members of the Welfare Board may apply for the respective welfare schemes by submitting the prescribed scheme-specific application form, duly filled in and accompanied by the requisite supporting documents, through the prescribed offline mode. **Step 2:** The application forms and supporting documents shall be as specified by the Welfare Board for the respective scheme/benefit. - **Application Form for Registration under the Board**: [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2023/06/70c9592db154bfccb04514f40e9b5ea8/pages-103-registration-form.pdf).- **Application Form for Maternity Assistance**: [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2024/12/3278deb9687a19ce8c3e288d00ae791c/pages-103-maternity-benefit.pdf). > **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/page/whom-to-contact).

page_content:
# Skill Up-Gradation with Job/Placement (SUJOP Scheme) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Himachal Pradesh | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Training, Skill Up, Job, Placement, Employment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Skill Up-Gradation with Job/Placement (SUJOP) Scheme", launched on 27th October 2016 by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Himachal Pradesh, aims to provide employment opportunities, after skill training, to persons with disabilities (more than 40%), helpless or widowed women, former residents of Nari Seva Sadan and Bal-Balika Ashram, and candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes, Other Backward Classes, and minority communities through various industrial units.
## Benefits - Training fee of amount ₹5,000/- per month for courses ranging from 3 months to 2 years through authorized institutions. - Living expenses of amount ₹5,000/- per month for residential and self-employed trainees. - Monthly scholarship of amount ₹1,000/- for non-residential trainees during training. - Monthly scholarship of amount ₹1,200/- for trainees with disabilities during training. - After training, a 6-month scholarship of amount ₹1,500/- per month (₹1,800/- per month for trainees with disabilities). - Authorized institutions provide employment opportunities for at least one year after completion of training.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a resident of Himachal Pradesh. - The applicant should be between 18 and 45 years of age. - The applicant should have an annual family income of less than ₹2,00,000/-. - The applicant should have more than 40% disability. - The applicant should have the minimum educational qualification from a recognized board or university.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 1: Eligible candidates obtain and submit the application form with required documents to the Tehsil Welfare Officer, District Welfare Officer, or concerned office. Step 2: The Director or authorized officer verifies the applications and selects candidates as per the prescribed rules.

page_content:
# Pranee Sampad Samrudhhi Yojana: Establishment of Chick Rearing Unit **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Odisha | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Chick Rearing Unit, Poultry Development, Farmer, DBT, Entrepreneur | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Establishment of Chick Rearing Unit" was launched by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, Government of Odisha under sub scheme "Poultry Development" of "Pranee Sampad Samrudhhi Yojana"(PSSY). It aims to establish Chick Rearing Units (with a capacity of 1000 chicks per batch, at 7 batches per annum) in the State. Through this scheme, subsidy is provided for the establishment of Chick Rearing Unit and infrastructure, including shed, disposal pit for waste disposal, carcass & litter disposal, and induction of chicks to farmers/entrepreneurs belonging to SC, ST, Women, Transgender, and Differently Able (minimum 40% disability) category and General category. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services through the Chief District Veterinary Officer and Block Veterinary Officer. The total fund requirement towards the Government supporting the establishment of chick rearing unit during the year is ₹58.00 lakh. Beneficiaries will be selected on first cum first serve basis. > **Objectives:** 1. To provide chicks of different age groups to the farmers for backyard poultry rearing. 1. To enhance the availability of Chicks (Low Input Technology Birds). 1. For easy availability of quality Chicks to Farmers nearby his/her locality.
## Benefits > **Subsidy Outlay (If Opted for Shed):** **Unit cost: ₹2.54/- Lakh** Subsidy₹ in Lakhs per unit1st Installment Subsidy (40% of the eligible amount) in ₹ (After construction of building, Disposal pit for waste disposal, carcass &amp; litter disposal pit)2nd installment subsidy (60% of the eligible subsidy) in ₹ (After induction of day old chicks in Chick Rearing Unit)Subsidy to SC, ST, women, Rs 91,440/- Transgender &amp; PWD (min. 40% disability) category @60% of the unit cost₹1.524/- lakh₹60,960/-₹91,440/-Subsidy to General male @50% of the unit cost₹1.27/- lakh₹50,800/-₹76,200-> **Subsidy Outlay (If Not Opted for Shed)** **Recurring cost: ₹0.74/- Lakh** Subsidy Recurring cost in Lakhs per unit 1st installment subsidy After construction of Disposal pit for waste disposal, carcass &amp; litter disposal pit &amp; induction of chicksSubsidy to SC, ST , women, Transgender &amp; PWD (min 40% disability) individuals @60% of the recurring cost ₹ 0.74/- lakh₹ 0.444/- lakhSubsidy to General male @50% of the recurring cost₹ 0.74/- lakh₹ 0.37/- lakh> **Mandatory Financial Condition:** 1. To ensure transparency, beneficiaries must make online payments (RTGS / NEFT / UPI) for any item costing ₹20,000/- or more, whether purchased from a single or multiple dealers/vendors. For such items, submission of the online transaction receipt is mandatory for subsidy release. > **Disbursement of Funds:** 1. The subsidy amount shall be released to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary through the Direct Benefit Transfer mode. 1. Frequency of Disbursement: - If opting for a shed, the subsidy is released in two installments (40% + 60%). - If not opting for the shed, the subsidy is released in a single phase.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident/domicile of Odisha. 1. The applicant must be a farmer/entrepreneur belonging to SC, ST, Women, Transgender & Differently Able (minimum 40% disability) category. 1. The applicant from the General category is also eligible under the scheme. 1. The applicant must have space/land for the establishment of a Chick Rearing Unit. 1. The applicant must complete the work within 2 months of the issue of the Go-ahead letter. 1. The applicant must continue the scheme for a minimum of 3 years. 1. The applicant must provide information about the completion of infrastructure/induction of chicks in the prescribed format for asset verification. > **Preference / Priority / Reservation / Relaxation** 1. Target beneficiaries include SC, ST, Women, Transgender, and Differently Able (minimum 40% disability). 1. The target can be interchangeable among the reserved categories. 1. In case of non-availability of a beneficiary in the reserved category, the target can be interchangeable with the General category. 1. Beneficiaries will be selected on first cum first serve basis. > **Note:** While availing a subsidy, the beneficiary family will be considered instead of an individual member of the family. However, if any member of one family gets the benefit as a member of the Women Self Help Group, then the other family member can avail any other scheme, as in a group activity profit for each of the group members may not be enough.
## Exclusions 1. One beneficiary family should not be provided with multiple benefits under one particular scheme. 1. A family will not be eligible for subsidy under the same scheme if any of its members has got subsidy during the last three years.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant interested in availing of the subsidy shall apply to the [Go-Sugam Portal](https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/citizen-portal/login) through a registration process by submitting the requisite documents. **Step 2:** Visit the official website: [https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/home](https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/home) **Step 3:** Click on “Apply” and then click on “Register Now” **Step 4:** On the registration page, fill in the mandatory details (Name, Email, Mobile Number, Address, and Password) and click on &quot;Register&quot;. The login credentials will be sent to your registered Email ID / Mobile Number. > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the official website: [https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/home](https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/home) **Step 2:** Click on “Scheme &amp; Services” and then select the scheme by its name. **Step 3:** Click “Apply” and log in. [https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/citizen-portal/login](https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/citizen-portal/login) **Step 4:** On the application page, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload the required documents in the appropriate file size and file type. Upon successful submission of the application, the applicant will get an Application Reference ID. > **Check Application Status:** **Step 1:** Click on the “Track Status” link on the menu. **Step 2:** Enter the Application ID or Mobile Number to get the application status. > **Post-Application & Implementation Process (As per Guidelines & Annexures):** **Step 1:** The proposed site of the applicant shall be visited by the Block Level Inspection Team, and an Initial Field Verification Report shall be prepared in Annexure–I certifying the correctness of land records and compliance with pollution control norms. **Step 2:** Based on the recommendation of the Block Level Inspection Team, the Chief District Veterinary Officer shall issue a Go-Ahead Letter in Annexure–II, mentioning eligibility category, subsidy entitlement, validity, and conditions of implementation. **Step 3:** - If opting for a shed, the beneficiary shall complete the construction of the poultry shed as per the specification and induct one batch of birds under the supervision of AVAS/VAS/BVO within 6 months from the issue of the Go-Ahead Letter. - If not opting for a shed, the beneficiary shall induct one batch of birds under the supervision of AVAS/VAS/BVO within 1 month from the issue of the Go-Ahead Letter. - After completion of each phase, the beneficiary shall inform the Block Veterinary Officer in the prescribed format under [Annexure–III](https://fard.odisha.gov.in/sites/default/files/2025-09/Establishment%20of%20Chick%20Rearing%20Unit%20under%20the%20sub-scheme%20Poultry%20Development.pdf) (Format for Intimation by Beneficiary) for asset verification. **Step 4:** The Block Level Inspection Team shall conduct asset verification and prepare the Asset Verification Report in Annexure–IV, including geo-tagged photograph, construction compliance, number of birds, source of procurement, and the eligible amount of assistance. Based on verification, the back-ended subsidy shall be released to Aadhaar linked bank account through the Direct Benefit Transfer mode. > **Note (As Per** [**Guidelines**](https://fard.odisha.gov.in/sites/default/files/2025-09/Establishment%20of%20Chick%20Rearing%20Unit%20under%20the%20sub-scheme%20Poultry%20Development.pdf)**):** 1. Annexure–I: Initial Field Verification Report by Block Level Inspection Team (site verification, land record confirmation, pollution control compliance). 1. Annexure–II: Go-Ahead Letter issued by the Chief District Veterinary Officer specifying eligibility, subsidy percentage, validity, and implementation conditions. 1. Annexure–III: Format for Intimation by Beneficiary for completion of infrastructure/induction of chicks requesting asset verification. 1. Annexure–IV: Asset Verification Report by Block Level Inspection Team, including geo-tagged photograph and recommendation for release of back-ended subsidy. 1. Annexure–V: Physical Target for Establishment of Chick Rearing Unit for Financial Year 2025-2,6, including district-wise allocation and category-wise breakup (SC, ST, Women, General Male).

metadata.schemeName: Prani Sampad Samruddhi Yojana: Goat / Sheep Farming through WSHG / Individual Mode (30+2 Capacity)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support 2000 numbers of WSHGs / Individual farmers to take up commercial goat/sheep rearing units for enhancing livelihood & income generation.

page_content:
# Prani Sampad Samruddhi Yojana: Goat / Sheep Farming through WSHG / Individual Mode (30+2 Capacity) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Odisha | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Goat Farming, Sheep Farming, WSHG Subsidy, Small Animal Development, DBT | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Goat / Sheep Farming through WSHG / Individual Mode (30+2 Capacity)” was launched by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, Government of Odisha, under Sub-Scheme – Small Animal Development (Umbrella Scheme under Prani Sampad Samruddhi Yojana). It aims to support 2000 numbers of WSHGs / Individual farmers to take up commercial goat/sheep rearing units for enhancing livelihood & income generation. Through this scheme, 60% & 50% subsidy are provided to WSHG members / Individual farmers for the establishment of 2000 nos. of Goat / Sheep rearing Units. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, Odisha, Cuttack. Under this State Plan scheme, 2000 WSHGs / Individual farmers will be covered during the year 2025-26. The subsidy amount shall be released directly to the bank account of the WSHG / Individual farmers through DBT mode in two phases after due asset verification . The goat/sheep unit will be fully managed by WSHG members / Individual farmers, and all the animals are to be ear tagged and insured for one year. > **Objectives** 1. To enhance the livelihood & income of WSHG members / Individual farmers through goat/sheep farming. 1. To increase meat production & meet the growing demand for meat in the state.
## Benefits > **Subsidy** 1. 60% subsidy of the unit cost, i.e., ₹1,38,000/- per unit for WSHGs / Women / SC / ST / PWD / TG beneficiaries. 1. 50% subsidy of the unit cost, i.e., ₹1,15,000/- per unit for Individual male general farmers > **Unit Cost Components (₹2,30,000/-)** 1. Construction of Goat / Sheep Shed – ₹54,000/- 1. Cost of animals (30 female + 2 male) – ₹1,62,000/- 1. Insurance premium for 1 year @ 7% for 32 animals – ₹11,340/- 1. Miscellaneous expenses – ₹2,660/- > **Disbursement of Funds:** 1. Subsidy is released directly to the bank account of the WSHG / Individual farmers through the Direct Benefit Transfer mode in two phases: - 40% of subsidy (₹55,200/- or ₹46,000/-) after the construction of the shed. - 60% of subsidy (₹82,800/- or ₹69,000/-) after stocking of the unit. 1. Expected Time of Disbursement of funds is: - 1st phase after completion and verification of the shed construction. - 2nd phase after complete stocking of the unit (30 does and 2 bucks) and verification.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident/domicile of the state of Odisha. 1. The applicant must be a WSHG / Individual farmer to be covered under the scheme. 1. The applicant must ensure that the proposal is for a new project only. 1. The applicant must provide land for the establishment of a goat/sheep unit. 1. The applicant must record the land availability status in the proceedings of the meeting convened for the purpose & it should be maintained in the meeting register (in case of WSHG). 1. The applicant must construct the goat shed near her / his own house (in case of individual mode). 1. The applicant must preferably be selected in such areas where grazing lands are available.
## Exclusions 1. Those WSHGs / Individual farmers who have availed subsidies in a similar type of scheme of the Government of India or the State Government previously shall not be included under this scheme. 1. The applicant shall not be selected under the scheme in case no land is available with any WSHG member.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant interested in availing of the subsidy shall apply to the [Go-Sugam Portal](https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/citizen-portal/login) through a registration process by submitting the requisite documents. **Step 2:** Visit the official website: [https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/home](https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/home) **Step 3:** Click on “Apply” and then click on “Register Now” **Step 4:** On the registration page, fill in the mandatory details (Name, Email, Mobile Number, Address, and Password) and click on "Register". The login credentials will be sent to your registered Email ID / Mobile Number. > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the official website: [https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/home](https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/home) **Step 2:** Click on “Scheme & Services” and then select the scheme by its name. **Step 3:** Click “Apply” and log in. [https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/citizen-portal/login](https://sugam.odisha.gov.in/website/citizen-portal/login) **Step 4:** On the application page, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload the required documents in the appropriate file size and file type. Upon successful submission of the application, the applicant will get an Application Reference ID. > **Check Application Status:** **Step 1:** Click on the “Track Status” link on the menu. **Step 2:** Enter the Application ID or Mobile Number to get the application status. > **Further Process After Online Application** **Step 1:** The DD/BVO/AVAS/VAS shall undertake verification of the proposed site along with the Block Level Inspection Team comprising DD/BVO of the concerned Block, AVAS/VAS of the concerned Veterinary Dispensary area, and Livestock Inspector / Veterinary Technician / Veterinary Sub Assistant Surgeon. The team shall take geo-tagged photographs (minimum 5 photographs from all directions) and ensure that the proposal is for a new project only. **Step 2:** On recommendation by the Block Level Inspection Team as per Annexure-I, the DD/BVO shall forward the applications through the Go-Sugam portal to the CDVO. The District Level Committee shall approve the applications, and the Go-ahead letter shall be issued by the CDVO as per Annexure-II. **Step 3:** After issuance of the Go-ahead letter, the WSHG / Individual farmer shall start construction of the goat/sheep shed within 60 days. After completion of the shed, the beneficiary shall inform the local VAS/AVAS/BVO/DD in the format enclosed at Annexure-III. The Block Level Inspection Team shall inspect the unit within one week and submit a completion report for the release of the 1st phase subsidy (40%) through Direct Benefit Transfer. **Step 4:** The WSHG / Individual farmer shall procure 30 female and 2 male goats/sheep. The animals shall be certified with the issue of a health certificate, ear tagged, and insured for one year. After complete stocking of the unit, the Block Level Inspection Team shall verify the unit and recommend the release of the 2nd phase subsidy (60%) through Direct Benefit Transfer. > **Note on Annexures:** - Annexure-I: Initial Field Verification Report by Block Level Inspection Team. - Annexure-II: Go-Ahead Letter for (30+2) Goatery / Sheepry Unit in WSHG / Individual Mode. - Annexure-III: Format for Intimation by WSHG / Individual Farmers for completion of shed/induction of animals. - Annexure-IV: Asset Verification Report by Block Level Inspection Team. - Annexure-V: Goat / Sheep Shed Specification. - Annexure-VI: District-wise Target for the year 2025-26.

# Prani Sampad Samrudhhi Yojana: Establishment of Mini Poultry Feed Mill **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Odisha | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Mini Poultry Feed Mill, Poultry Development, Rural Income Generation, Animal Husbandry Scheme, DBT | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Establishment of Mini Poultry Feed Mill under Poultry Development” was launched by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, Government of Odisha. It aims to support the establishment of 314 nos. of mini poultry feed mills. Through this scheme, subsidy support is provided for establishment of portable mini poultry feed mills of capacity 50 Kg per hour at individual level to address the problem of getting quality poultry feed at a cheaper price in rural level, to provide income generating opportunity in rural area and to encourage farmers and unemployed youth of rural areas into income generation through establishment of mini poultry mill units. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services through the Chief District Veterinary Officer and Block Level Inspection Team. It is planned to cover 314 beneficiaries. > **Objectives** 1. To establish portable mini poultry feed mills of capacity 50 Kg per hour at the individual level. 1. To address the problem of getting quality poultry feed at a lower price in rural level for establishing small poultry units. 1. To provide income generating opportunity in rural areas. 1. To encourage farmers and unemployed youth of rural areas into income generation through the establishment of mini poultry mill units.
## Benefits > **If Not Opted for the Shed:** Unit cost: ₹ 2.80 Lakh/- Subsidy₹ in Lakhs per unit1st installment subsidy (40% of the eligible amount) After construction of building2nd installment subsidy (60% of the eligible subsidy) After installation of plant and machinery in the poultry feed mill unitSubsidy to SC, ST, women, Transgender &amp; PWD (min. 40% disability) category @60% of the unit cost₹ 1.68/-₹ 67,200/-₹ 1,00,800/-Subsidy to General male @50% of the unit cost₹ 1.4/-₹ 56,000/-₹ 84,000/- > **If Opted for the Shed:** Unit cost: ₹ 2.05 Lakh/- SubsidyRecurring cost in Lakhs per unitSingle installment subsidy After installation of plant and machinery in the poultry feed mill unitSubsidy to SC, ST, women, Transgender &amp; PWD (min. 40% disability) category @60% of the unit cost₹ 2.05 Lakh/-₹ 1.23 Lakh/-Subsidy to General male @50% of the unit cost₹ 2.05 Lakh/-₹ 1.025 lakh/-> **Disbursement of Funds:** 1. Back-ended subsidy through Direct Benefit Transfer to Aadhaar linked bank account. 1. Frequency of Disbursement is given in 2 installments for the non-shed option; a single installment for the shed option. 1. Expected Time of Disbursement is after the construction of the building and after the installation of the plant and machinery, with asset verification.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident/domicile of the state of Odisha. 1. The applicant must be a willing farmer/entrepreneur belonging to ST, SC, Women, Transgender & Differently Able (min 40% disability) beneficiaries who will be eligible to avail support. 1. The applicant’s certificate of identity as transgender person issued by the District Magistrate as per The Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019 will be accepted for Transgender category. 1. The applicant’s certificate of identity as PWD issued by the certifying authority as per The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, will be accepted. 1. All beneficiaries covered under the scheme should have an Aadhaar linked to a bank account for subsidy. 1. While availing a subsidy, the beneficiary family will be considered instead of an individual member of the family. 1. The applicant’s family member may avail any other scheme as a group activity, provided the scheme is not in the same sector. > **Preference / Priority / Reservation / Relaxation** 1. PWD (min 40% disability) category will get 60% subsidy, and the General male will be provided 50% back ended subsidy. 1. The target can be interchangeable among the reserved categories. 1. In case of non-availability of a beneficiary in the reserved category, then the target can be interchangeable with the General category. 1. Beneficiaries will be selected on first cum first serve basis.
## Exclusions 1. One beneficiary family should not be provided with multiple benefits under one particular scheme. 1. A family will not be eligible for subsidy under the same scheme if any of its members has got subsidy during the last three years.

page_content:
# Mukhya Mantri Yuva Udyami Vikas Abhiyan (CM-YUVA) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttar Pradesh | **Categories:** Skills & Employment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Self-Employment, Skilled Youth, Loan, Interest Subvention | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Mukhya Mantri Yuva Udyami Vikas Abhiyan" scheme launched by the MSME and Export Promotion Department, Uttar Pradesh. The scheme aims to connect skilled young people with self-employment by establishing production/service-related enterprises through providing interest-free and guarantee-free loans, interest subvention, and margin money.
## Benefits > **First Phase** - 100% interest free collateral guarantee free loan for 04 years for projects up to ₹5,00,000/-. - General category beneficiaries will have to contribute 15% of the project cost, OBC 12.5%, SC/ST/Divyang 10% and beneficiaries of aspirational districts- Chitrakoot, Chandauli, Fatehpur, Balrampur, Siddharthnagar, Shravasti and Bahraich will have to contribute 10% of their own contribution. - 10% margin money grant on project cost and CGTMSE reimbursement for 04 years. - Land and building will not be included in the project cost and it will be mandatory to have a minimum of 10% of the total project cost in the form of term loan. > **Second Phase** - The candidate who makes full refund of the principal/penal interest taken in the first stage will be eligible. - Projects can be set up up to ₹10,00,000/-, but 50% interest subsidy will be given on loans up to ₹7,50,000/- for 03 years. - The loan must have a minimum term loan of 10% of the project cost and may include the cost of workshop/workshed. - CGTMSE coverage for 03 years.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant age should be between 21 to 40 years. 1. The applicant educational qualification should be minimum class 8th passed, Intermediate or equivalent preferred.1. The applicant should have trained under Vishwakarma Shram Samman Yojana, ODOP Training Scheme, SC/ST/OBC Training Scheme, UP Skill Development Mission or should have obtained skill related certificate/degree/diploma etc. from any recognized educational institution.
## Exclusions

page_content:
# DPIIT Internship Scheme **Ministry:** Ministry Of Commerce And Industry | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Internship, DPIIT, Student, Under Graduate, Post Graduate, Research Scholar | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce & Industry has been implementing internship scheme for the students pursuing Under Graduate/Post Graduate degree or are Research Scholars enrolled in recognized University/Institution within India or abroad. The objective behind the internship scheme is to give exposure to the students to understand the working culture of Govt. of India and exposure to the schemes being run by this Department. Students can choose a period of their choice ranging from one month /two months / three months as per their requirements. The applications will be accepted online mode only. ## Benefits **Stipend:** - Interns would be paid a stipend of **₹10,000/-** per month. The processing of payment towards the stipend amount will be initiated after the completion of the internship period. **Number of Interns:** - Maximum Number of Interns selected at a time will not be more than 20. **Period of Internship:** - The period of Internship shall be minimum one month and maximum three months. - After completing internship, students will be awarded an Experience Certificate. - Those who will not satisfactorily complete the requisite period of internship will not be awarded any certificate or stipend. ## Eligibility Criteria Applicants pursuing Graduation/Post Graduation/Research in following domain are eligible to apply:- - Engineering - Management - Law - Economics - Finance - Computers - Library Management **Note 01:** Candidates from other domains can also be considered based on requirements on case to case basis. **Note 02:** Interns shall be required to submit a brief report/paper at the end of their assignment to the concerned Divisional Head about their learning experience. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** https://dpiit.gov.in/internship/internship-scheme.php > **Application Process:** **Step 01:** To apply for the Internship, the applicant may submit the application form: [https://dpiit.gov.in/internship/internship-scheme.php](https://dpiit.gov.in/internship/internship-scheme.php) **Step 02:** Fill in the all the mandatory details in the form and agree with terms & conditions. **Step 03:** Verify your Mobile Number and Email ID. **Step 04:** Click on "Submit". > **Selection Procedure:** **Step 01:** All the applications received through online mode in the Department will be compiled at one place in the Establishment Division. **Step 02:** Sections/divisions will send their requirement of “Interns” to Establishment Division. **Step 03:** On receipt of a request from Division/Section for intern/s belonging to a particular discipline, the database of the available applications of that discipline will be provided to the concerned Division/section. **Step 04:** The concerned Division/section will transparently adopt a procedure and select the student(s) with the approval of the concerned Wing Head (AS/JS/DDG) based on their requirement and inform the same to Estt. G Section. Thereafter, Estt. G Section will obtain approval of Dir/DS (Estt) and send the offer of internship to selected Interns. **Note 01:** _Online portal on DPIIT’s shall be henceforth open during the period from 1st March to 30th April and 1st September to 31st October of every year_ _for receiving applications from Students for internship._ **Note 02:** Applications received during the period from **1st March** - **30th April** shall be considered for internship during the period from June-August of every year. The database of Students who have applied during March- April will be deleted from server in the end of August. **Note 03:** Applications received during the period from **1st September- 31st October** shall be considered for internship during the period from November to January of every year. The database of Students who have applied during September-October will be deleted from the server in the end of January.

metadata.schemeName: ICMR-Junior Research Fellowship
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and research opportunities to eligible candidates through Junior Research Fellowship for pursuing Ph.D. programmes in medical and social science fields.

page_content:
# ICMR-Junior Research Fellowship

**Ministry:** Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** JRF, Research, Fellowship, ICMR, Life Science, Social Science, SRF | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
ICMR-Junior Research Fellowship (ICMR-JRF) examination is the first step in the process of admission to the PhD/Research Programme through the council's support. ICMR holds a national-level examination for determining the eligibility of Indian National candidates for the award of Junior Research Fellowships (JRF) through the Indian Council of Medical Research. The award of Junior Research Fellowship to the successful eligible candidates will depend on their finding placement in a medical college/hospital/university / national laboratory/institution of higher learning and research as applicable. The award of JRF is made on a merit basis by holding an entrance examination after issuing a countrywide admission notice.
> **Scheme of Test:**


  - The test will consist of one paper of 2 hours duration.
  - The paper will consist of 2 Sections. The Aptitude Section (Section A) will have 50 questions on (i) scientific phenomenon in everyday life; (ii) general knowledge in sciences; and (iii) common statistics. All these questions would be compulsory with each question carrying 1 mark. The subject Specific Section (Section B & C) would pertain to (B) Life Sciences and (C) Social Science. The candidate may attempt questions in either of the two areas. Each area of section B & C would have 100 questions and the candidate may attempt any 75 questions in the predesigned area of Section B or C. Candidates are required to indicate the option for Section B or C in the application form too.
  - Each question carries one mark. Negative marking @ 0.25 will be made for each of the wrong answers. The questions in both sections would appear in English only.
  - The final result will be based on an aggregate of 55 % marks obtained in both the sections for the General category and OBC and 50% for SC/ST and physically handicapped.

> **The test will be held in the following streams:**


  - Aptitude test (common for all) (2) Life Sciences (3) Social Sciences.
  - Subjects covered under Life Sciences include microbiology, physiology, molecular biology, genetics, human nutrition, human biology, biotechnology, biochemistry, biophysics, immunology, pharmacology, zoology, environmental sciences, botany, public health veterinary science, and bioinformatics. Subjects covered under Social Sciences include psychology, sociology, home sciences, statistics, anthropology, social work, and health economics.

A total of 150 Fellowships would be awarded. 120 Fellowships would be awarded for work in the field of biomedical sciences with emphasis on Life Sciences (like microbiology, physiology, molecular biology, genetics, human biology, bioinformatics, biotechnology, biochemistry, biophysics, immunology, Pharmacology, zoology, environmental science, botany, veterinary sciences, bio-informatics, etc.). Thirty Fellowships would be awarded for work with an emphasis on Social sciences like psychology, sociology, home science, statistics, anthropology, social work, and Health Economics.

   1. Two separate merit lists, one comprising the candidates qualifying for life sciences and the second for those candidates qualifying for social sciences, will be made on the basis of their performance in the above test.
   1. The candidates selected for the JRF programme of ICMR would be permitted to enroll themselves in the Ph.D. programme of any University recognised by the UGC/MCI. However, the JRF programme would not have any connection with the Ph.D. programme. The validity of the fellowship awarded to a candidate will be six months.


  - Another 100 candidates would be selected for consideration for positions of JRF under various research schemes of ICMR (subject to fulfilling the conditions for appointment under the schemes) for the duration of that scheme. These JRFs would also be permitted to complete a Ph.D. while working in the scheme if enrolled. The validity of the result will be two years for placement in ICMR-funded projects.
  - SC/ST/OBC/Physically handicapped (PH) applicants will be given such special consideration as per policy guidelines.
  - Candidates qualifying for the award of JRF will receive a fellowship from ICMR.

## Benefits
1. The Junior Research fellows will be paid a monthly stipend of ₹31,000/- for the 1st & 2nd year.
   1. The Senior Research Fellow (SRF) (if upgraded after completion of two years of JRF) will be paid a monthly stipend of ₹ 35,000/- for the 3rd, 4th & 5th years.
   1. There is an annual contingency grant of ₹20,000/-.
   1. The tenure for the JRF will be two/three years. The duration of an SRF will be for a maximum of three years. However, the total duration is five years.

> **HRA & Medical Benefits:**


   1. All Research Fellows may be allowed hostel accommodation in the parent institute wherever available and those residing in a hostel provided by the parent institute OR a hostel by another University/Institute will not be eligible for HRA.
   1. Medical benefits will be allowed to a Fellow as per the rules of the Institution where they are working. ICMR will not bear any financial burden in this regard.

> **Leave Salary and Other Service Benefits:**


   1. A Fellow will be eligible for casual leave & maternity leave as per Govt. rules.

**Note 01:** The Fellow will not be treated as an employee of the ICMR.
**Note 02:** The applicant should not draw any stipend or salary or be in receipt of any other type of financial assistance except leave salary during the fellowship.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The candidate should have a Post Graduate degree (M.Sc./MA) in basic science or a Post-Graduate degree (M.Sc./MA) in a professional course with 55% marks for General/Other Backward Class (OBC) and 50% for SC/ST/Physically Handicapped (PH)/Visually Handicapped (VH).
   1. The students having degrees like B. Tech/M. Tech in biomedical sciences, B. Pharma/M. Pharma or D. Pharma are not eligible.
   1. The upper age limit is 28 years [upper age limit relaxable up to five years in case of candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/PH/VH and female candidates, three years in the case of OBC category].

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
**Step 01:** The advertisement is published in leading English Newspapers of India usually during March/April and also on the [official website](https://main.icmr.nic.in/content/junior-research-fellowships-jrf).
**Step 02:** The eligible candidates can fill out the application forms on the official website after the official release of the notification.
**Step 03:** The entrance examination is usually held in the first/second week of July.
**Step 04:** The candidates will be selected on the basis of marks obtained in the examination.
**Step 05:** The final result will be based on an aggregate of 55 % marks obtained in both the sections for the General category and OBC and 50% for SC/ST and physically handicapped.
**Step 06:** The list of successful candidates will be available on the ICMR website. Selected candidates must join their respective Ph.D. courses on the prescribed date as indicated in their admission letter.
**Note 01:** Before applying, candidates are advised to go through the admission notice published in the advertisement in various Newspapers and the instructions given therein carefully.
**Note 02:** Incomplete applications will not be considered and no correspondence will be entertained.
