metadata.schemeName: Motorcycle Taxi Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing interest-free loans for purchasing motorcycles or scooters to operate as motorcycle taxis, thereby enhancing tourism connectivity and generating livelihood opportunities in the state.

page_content:
# Motorcycle Taxi Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Motorcycle, Taxi, Self-Employment, Scooter, Interest-Free Loan | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Motorcycle Taxi Yojana” was introduced by the Cooperative Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote self-employment among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing interest-free loans for purchasing motorcycles or scooters to operate as motorcycle taxis, thereby enhancing tourism connectivity and generating livelihood opportunities in the state.
## Benefits - The applicant will be provided an interest-free loan for a period of 2 years to purchase scooters or motorcycles for transporting tourists/travelers from one place to another at major tourist destinations. - The loan will cover 75% of the total cost or ₹1.75 lakh per scooter/motorcycle, whichever is lower. The remaining 25% of the amount must be arranged by the applicant. - An applicant can purchase a maximum of 10 scooters/motorcycles.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years old and not more than 55 years old. 1. The applicant must possess a valid license issued by the Transport Department. 1. The applicant must not be a defaulter of any financial or cooperative institution. 1. The applicant must have a minimum CIBIL (Credit Information Bureau India Limited) score of 700 or above.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - The applicant will obtain the application form from the cooperative bank in their area to purchase a scooter or motorcycle. - Along with the application form, the following documents must be attached and submitted to the concerned bank: Aadhar card, birth certificate, bank account details, permanent residence certificate, quotation and ex-showroom price of the scooter/motorcycle, driving license, and details of two sureties. - After submission, the applications will be scrutinized and then sent to the District Level Committee constituted under the chairmanship of the District Magistrate/Chief Development Officer. The applications will be presented before the committee for selection. - The applications of applicants selected by the committee will be forwarded to the concerned bank branches through the District Cooperative Bank Head Office. After completing the prescribed formalities, the bank will issue a loan sanction letter, and the sanctioned loan amount will be sent directly to the institution or firm from which the scooter or motorcycle is to be purchased. - The maximum period of the loan will be 3 years. The loan will be recovered in 35 equal monthly installments, starting one month after the date of disbursement.

metadata.schemeName: Labour Card and Renewal of Labour Card
metadata.briefDescription: Under  this facilities, a labour card is issued to workers engaged in construction, repair, maintenance, and related activities, enabling them to avail the benefits of all welfare schemes provided by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare

page_content:
# Labour Card and Renewal of Labour Card **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Labour Card, Building Worker, Construction Worker, Labour, Unorganized Worker | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Labour Card and Renewal of Labour Card” facilities is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour Department, Government of Uttarakhand. Under this scheme, a labour card is issued to workers engaged in construction, repair, maintenance, and other construction works such as bridges, roads, airstrips, etc.
## Benefits - The labour card is mandatory to avail the benefits of all schemes offered by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. - The labour card also be used as an identification document for building and construction workers.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a worker engaged in construction, repair, maintenance, or related activities involving government and non-government buildings, as well as other construction works such as bridges, roads, airstrips, irrigation projects, water drainage systems, embankments, tunnels, flood control structures, power generation, transmission and distribution, water works, oil and gas installations, dams, canals, reservoirs, pipelines, towers, television towers, mobile/telephone towers, etc. 1. The workers under MNREGA (such as labourers, masons, electricians, plumbers, etc.) and other construction workers are also eligible. 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age. 1. The applicant must possess a certificate confirming that they have worked as a construction or other related worker for at least 90 days in the previous year.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - via CSC - Building and construction workers can register or renew their labour card online through the nearest Jan Suvidha Kendra or Shramik Suvidha Kendra. - To apply online, the applicant must submit two passport-size photographs along with the application form. For age verification, any one of the following documents is required: 10th certificate, birth certificate, certificate issued by a medical officer, notarized affidavit of the construction worker, voter identity card, ration card, or a certificate issued by the Village Panchayat Officer, Village Head, or Councillor. - A certificate of having worked as a construction worker for at least 90 days in the previous year, along with a nomination form for nominating legal heirs, must also be submitted. - The applicant is further required to provide the Aadhaar card, ration card, Aadhaar-linked bank account details, self-certification or self-declaration form (available only at Jan Suvidha Kendra or Shramik Suvidha Kendra), and Aadhaar cards of dependents. After uploading all the required documents, a registration fee of ₹100/- must be deposited. - The application is then forwarded to the concerned department. If the documents are verified and found correct, the worker’s details will be entered in the Labour Register, and the registration number assigned will serve as the worker’s official registration number. - Once the registration is approved, the Registration Officer will issue a Photo Identity Card, which the worker can collect from the Public Service Centre of the concerned department or from the office of the Labour Department. This card is valid for three years. ***Renewal Process:*** - The application for renewal must be submitted before the completion of three years. - For every renewal cycle of three years, the construction worker is required to deposit a contribution of ₹100/-. If a worker fails to renew the card within the stipulated time, they will not be eligible to avail the benefits in the future. However, with the permission of the authorized officer, the membership may be reinstated by depositing the outstanding amount. This facility of reinstatement can be availed only twice.

page_content:
# Seemant Parvatiya Janpad Baal Vigyan Mahotsav **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Science, IT & Communications | **Tags:** Scientist, Student, Science Competition, Science Festival, UCOST | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Seemant Parvatiya Janpad Baal Vigyan Mahotsav” is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Council for Science and Technology (UCOST) under the Science and Technology Department, Government of Uttarakhand. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline All students from classes 6th to 12th can participate at the block level. The students selected at the block level then participate at the district level, and those selected at the district level get an opportunity to participate at the state level.

# Allotment of Commercial Shops **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Commercial Shop, Business, Trader, Shop Allotment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Allotment of Commercial Shops” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Agricultural Production & Marketing Board under the Department of Agriculture, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote ease of doing business for licensed traders by providing them with well-located commercial shops in market yards (mandis).
## Benefits The scheme facilitates ease of doing business for traders by allotting them with commercial shops.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must hold a valid trader’s license issued by the Mandi Committee.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ***Application Process:*** - Upon receiving information regarding shop allotment (through notices published in newspapers and displayed at public places), the applicant must obtain the application form from the committee office by paying the prescribed fee. - Complete the form with the required information and submit it to the committee office within the stipulated time. ***Selection Process:*** - Allotment of commercial shops is carried out by the Shop Allotment Committee. - Traders are selected based on the available shops and the applications received, giving priority in descending order to those who have deposited the highest market fees in the last three years.

page_content:
# Sponsorship for Employment **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Employment, Contractual Employment, Ex-serviceman, UPNL | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Sponsorship for Employment" is implemented by Uttarakhand Purv Sainik Kalyan Nigam Limited (UPNL) under the Sainik Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide employment opportunities to ex-servicemen and their legal dependents by sponsoring them for contractual posts. Under this scheme, eligible candidates are sponsored for various departmental positions based on demand and their qualifications.
## Benefits Under this scheme, employment opportunities are provided to ex-servicemen and their legal dependents by sponsoring them for contractual posts through outsourcing.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an ex-serviceman (Army, Navy, or Air Force), their legal dependent, or a widow of an ex-serviceman (Veer Nari).
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - Firstly, the eligible candidates (ex-servicemen and their legal dependents) fill out the online application/enrollment form for the desired post on the UPNL website: [www.upnl.co.in](https://upnl.co.in/default.aspx), based on their district, qualifications, and preferred location. - Based on the district-wise demand for posts received from various departments and the eligibility/qualification criteria for those posts, UPNL forwards the names of enrolled candidates with the relevant qualifications to the concerned department for selection, following district-wise and priority order of nomination. - As per the demand received from the department, UPNL sends the names of six enrolled candidates for each vacant post to the concerned department for consideration. - The final selection of candidates is made by the department according to its rules, and the information is subsequently communicated to UPNL.

page_content:
# Swanath Scholarship Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Technical Education, Diploma, Orphan, Student, Graduation | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Swanath Scholarship Scheme” is implemented by the Department of Technical Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support to diploma and graduate-level students who are orphans, whose parents or either parent has died due to COVID-19, or who are dependents of martyrs from the military or central armed forces.
## Benefits Eligible students at the diploma or graduation level will receive financial assistance of ₹50,000/- per annum.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an orphan, have lost one or both parents due to COVID-19, or be a dependent of a martyr from the military or central armed forces. 1. The applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000/-.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - These scholarships are administered by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). Applications under the AICTE schemes are invited through the [National Scholarship Portal](https://scholarships.gov.in/) (NSP) between September and December, and scholarships are awarded based on merit. - Applicants are required to submit their high school and intermediate mark sheets and certificates, along with an income certificate. For this scheme, the death certificate of the candidate’s parent(s) is also required. - Students must first apply online through the institute where they are enrolled. The application is then verified by the concerned Principal, followed by verification by the State Level Officer (SLO), and finally forwarded to the AICTE, New Delhi.

metadata.schemeName: Out of Turn Employment to Sportspersons in State Services
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide job opportunities to medal-winning sportspersons of Uttarakhand, who have represented the state in international and national games, by offering them out-of-turn employment in various state services.

page_content:
# Out of Turn Employment to Sportspersons in State Services **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Sports & Culture, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Employment, Sports Quota Jobs, Athletes, Jobs, Sportspersons, Sports | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Out of Turn Employment to Sportspersons in State Services” was launched by the Department of Sports, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide job opportunities to medal-winning sportspersons of Uttarakhand, who have represented the state in international and national games, by offering them out-of-turn employment in various state services.
## Benefits Under this scheme, medal-winning players from Uttarakhand who have represented the state in International or National Games are provided out-of-turn employment on Gazetted and Non-Gazetted posts (from Level-3 to Level-10) across various government departments.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. State players/sportspersons who have won gold, silver, or bronze medals in international or national games, such as the Olympic/Paralympic Games, World Cup/World Championship, Asian Games, Commonwealth Games, Asian Championship, Commonwealth Championship, SAF Games, and National Games, are eligible under the scheme. 1. Players/sportspersons participating in any of the following sports will be considered eligible: Athletics, Archery, Badminton, Basketball, Boxing, Canoeing & Kayaking, Cycling, Diving, Equestrian, Fencing, Football, Golf, Handball, Hockey, Judo, Lawn Tennis, Shooting, Rowing, Sailing, Swimming, Table Tennis, Taekwondo, Volleyball, Weightlifting, Wrestling, Baseball, Chess, Cricket, Kabaddi, Karate, Kho-Kho, and Mallakhamb. 1. The player/sportsperson must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The player/sportsperson must have represented the state of Uttarakhand in the National Games in the year and competition for which they are applying for employment.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - As outlined in Government Order No. 728/VI-3/2023-33(7)2014, dated 14.09.2023, the Sports Directorate will receive vacancy details from the relevant departments and publish advertisements in newspapers to recruit eligible athletes. Upon receiving applications directly from the Director, Sports Directorate, the committee will review the applications and submit its recommendations within two months. - The Sports Department will forward the committee’s recommendations to the respective departments. Selected medal-winning athletes will be appointed to supernumerary positions by the relevant department within four months. - For employment, athletes must possess the minimum educational qualifications required for the position. However, the committee may consider granting exemptions or relaxations for medal-winning athletes regarding mandatory or preferred qualifications. If a medal winner does not possess the required educational qualifications at the time of appointment, the department will allow the athlete up to four years to acquire the necessary qualifications. - Medal-winning athletes must submit their applications to the sports offices within two years (for seniors) and three years (for juniors) after achieving their success. Applications must include the completed form along with the medal-winning certificates, Aadhaar card, and permanent residence certificate. - Medal-winning athletes from 10 years ago and 5 years ago will be eligible to apply within 12 months from the date of issuance of this Government Order.

metadata.schemeName: Assistance for Purchase of Traditional Musical Instruments and Costumes for Scheduled Caste/Tribe Individuals
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support scheduled caste and scheduled tribe individuals whose livelihood depends on traditional arts by providing them with essential musical instruments and costumes.

page_content:
# Assistance for Purchase of Traditional Musical Instruments and Costumes for Scheduled Caste/Tribe Individuals **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Musical Instruments, Folk Artists, Costumes, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Artist | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Assistance for Purchase of Traditional Musical Instruments and Costumes for Scheduled Caste/Tribe Individuals" scheme was launched by the Department of Culture and Endowments, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to support scheduled caste and scheduled tribe individuals whose livelihood depends on traditional arts by providing them with essential musical instruments and costumes.
## Benefits - Persons belonging to the Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes, whose source of income is through their traditional art, and who do not possess musical instruments or costumes, are provided with traditional musical instruments (such as Dhol, Damaun, Masakbeen, Ransingha, Trumpet, Nagada, Shield, Sword, etc.) and costumes free of cost to help them sustain their livelihood. - The instruments are provided only once in a lifetime.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a folk artist. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicant's monthly income must not exceed ₹2,000/-. 1. Only one set of musical instruments is provided per artist in a family under this scheme.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - The Directorate of Culture publishes an advertisement for providing traditional musical instruments and costumes to eligible SC/ST individuals. - Following the advertisement, the concerned individuals are required to submit to the Director of the Culture Directorate a certificate of monthly income of ₹2,000/- issued by the Tehsildar, a certificate of artist/instrument, Aadhaar card, caste certificate, bank account details including account number and IFSC code, PAN card, permanent residence certificate, and an affidavit stating that the beneficiary has not received any grant under other schemes. - Eligible beneficiaries are selected by a committee constituted under the chairmanship of the Secretary of Culture at the Directorate level. After the selection process, beneficiaries can collect the musical instruments from the Directorate.

metadata.schemeName: Minority Scholarship Scheme for Class 1 to 10
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide scholarships to students belonging to minority communities who are studying in Classes 1 to 10 in any recognized government/non-government educational institution in Uttarakhand.

page_content:
# Minority Scholarship Scheme for Class 1 to 10 **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Minority Community, Scholarship, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Minority Scholarship Scheme for Class 1 to 10” was launched by the Minority Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide scholarships to students belonging to minority communities who are studying in Classes 1 to 10 in any recognized government/non-government educational institution in Uttarakhand.
## Benefits At present, the State Government provides the following **monthly scholarships** for students from Class 1 to 10: - **Class 1 to 5:** ₹50/-- **Class 6 to 8:** ₹80/-- **Class 9 to 10:** ₹120/-
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must belong to a minority community (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Parsi, Buddhist, or Jain). 1. The applicant must be studying in Classes 1 to 10. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized government/non-government educational institution in the state of Uttarakhand.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** https://scholarships.gov.in/# - Minority community students studying in Classes 1 to 10 can register at any time through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP 2.0) at [https://scholarships.gov.in](https://scholarships.gov.in/). Registration requires an Aadhaar number and an Aadhaar-linked mobile number. - During registration, students provide basic information such as their name, parents’ names, and educational qualifications. Upon successful registration, a student ID and password are generated. - For applying to the scholarship, the department publishes advertisements in newspapers or on the NSP portal, inviting online applications within a stipulated period. - Students must log in using their registered ID and password or register if not already done, and select their school or institution during the application process. - While applying, students are required to upload mandatory documents, including educational certificates, Aadhaar card, bank account linked with Aadhaar, permanent residence certificate, self-declaration certificate of minority community, income certificate, certificate of studying in school, and a passport-size photograph. In addition, offline copies of these documents must be submitted to the school or institution for verification. - Once submitted, the application reaches the school’s Institute Nodal Officer (INO), who verifies the documents and forwards the application to the State Nodal Officer (SNO). The SNO then forwards the applications to the Ministry of Minority Affairs, Government of India after a random selection process (2% of applications). - If all documents and eligibility criteria are verified and found correct, the scholarship amount is directly transferred to the student’s bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

metadata.schemeName: Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Scheduled Tribes)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among Scheduled Tribe individuals through financial support, including loans, margin money, and grants.

page_content:
# Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Scheduled Tribes) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Scheduled Tribe, Loan, Margin Money, Self-employment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Scheduled Tribe)" scheme was launched by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote sustainable self-employment and income generation among Scheduled Tribe individuals by supporting viable livelihood projects. Under this scheme, financial assistance, including a bank loan is provided to the beneficiaries for setting up income-generating units with a total project cost between ₹50,000 and ₹2,00,000. ## Benefits > **Financial Assistance:** - Project Cost: Between ₹50,000/- and ₹2,00,000/-. - Bank Loan: 60% of the project cost - Margin Money: 30% of the project cost, repayable at 7% annual interest in 60 monthly installments - Grant: Up to ₹50,000/-. > **Beneficiary Contribution:** - No contribution for project cost up to ₹1,00,000/- - 10% contribution for project cost between ₹1,01,000/- and ₹2,00,000/-

## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant's age must be between 18 and 50 years. 1. The applicant’s annual family income should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ***Application Process:*** **Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the [application form](http://www.ukbvvn.org.in/Download/ApplicationFormFormatJeevika.pdf) from the official website. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the office of the Vikas Khand (Block Development) Office. <br> ***Selection Process:*** **Step 1:** The application will be forwarded to the District Social Welfare Officer. **Step 2:** A District-Level Committee, headed by the District Social Welfare Officer, will review the proposals and select beneficiaries.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹50,000/- to permanent residents of the state who have successfully completed the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra, irrespective of their religion or caste.

page_content:
# Financial Assistance to Permanent Residents of Uttarakhand for Religious Pilgrimages **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Travel & Tourism | **Tags:** Kailash, Mansarovar, Yatra, Financial Assistance, Religious Pilgrimages | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Financial Assistance to Permanent Residents of Uttarakhand for Religious Pilgrimages” was introduced by the Department of Culture and Endowments, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to permanent residents of the state who have successfully completed the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra, irrespective of their religion or caste.
## Benefits The Uttarakhand State Government provides financial assistance of ₹50,000/- to permanent residents of the state, irrespective of religion or caste, who successfully complete the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra organized by the Government of India.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have successfully completed the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra organized by the Government of India. 1. The applicant must have undertaken the journey through the Kumaon Mandal Vikas Nigam.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online Permanent residents of the state who have completed the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra via the Pithoragarh Yatra route can apply online through the [Apuni Sarkar portal](https://eservices.uk.gov.in/), after receiving a recommendation from the Kumaon Mandal Vikas Nigam. The main documents required for the application are as follows: 1. Permanent/Domicile Certificate of Uttarakhand 1. Travel Completion Certificate issued by the Ministry of External Affairs, along with other travel-related documents 1. Photocopy of bank passbook showing the account number and IFSC code 1. Photocopy of PAN card 1. Photocopy of Aadhaar card After submission, the application forms are scrutinized by the Director's office. If the documents are found to be correct, the reimbursement amount is credited to the concerned individual.

# Sanskrit Chhaatr Pratiyogita **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Sanskrit Education, Sanskrit Competition, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Sanskrit Chhaatr Pratiyogita” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Sanskrit Academy, Haridwar, under the Department of Sanskrit Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote Sanskrit education among students by organizing Sanskrit competitions. Under this scheme, Sanskrit competitions are organized at various levels for both junior (Class 6 to 10) and senior (Class 11 to post-graduation) categories. A total of six competitions are conducted in each category, namely Sanskrit Drama, Sanskrit Group Song, Sanskrit Group Dance, Sanskrit Debate, Sanskrit Auspicious Speech, and Sanskrit Shlokacharan.
## Benefits Separate six Sanskrit competitions for junior and senior categories are organized at every level. The prize distribution is as follows: **Development Block Level** - **Team Events:** Minimum prize of ₹300/- and maximum prize of ₹800/-- **Individual Competition:** Minimum prize of ₹300/- and maximum prize of ₹500/- **District Level** - **Team Events:** Minimum prize of ₹400/- and maximum prize of ₹2,000/-- **Individual Competition**: Minimum prize of ₹400/- and maximum prize of ₹800/- **State Level** - **Team Events:** Minimum prize of ₹6,000/- and maximum prize of ₹25,000/-- **Individual Competition:** Minimum prize of ₹2,000/- and maximum prize of ₹4,000/-
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The institutional students studying in the junior classes (Class 6 to 10) and senior classes (Class 11 to post-graduation) of any government, private, or non-governmental school/college in Uttarakhand are eligible to participate. 1. The students pursuing B.Ed., Ph.D., or Diploma courses are not eligible for participation.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline This competition is held once a year, typically between September and November. An advertisement or notification is issued and sent to the relevant District Coordinator and Block Coordinator. After students are selected at the school or college level, they are recommended by their principal and presented to the Block Education Officer/Block Coordinator for participation. 1. Prizes are awarded to participants or teams that secure first, second, and third place in the block-level competition. All first- and second-place finishers then advance to the district-level competition. 1. At the district level, prize money is awarded to participants or teams securing first, second, and third place. All first-place winners at the district level advance to the state-level competition, where prize money is awarded to the first, second, and third-place winners.

## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline There is no selection process; all eligible students from Classes 1 to 8 are provided free uniforms or the corresponding financial assistance.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Chhaatrvrtti Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Higher Education, NCC | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Mukhyamantri Chhaatrvrtti Yojana" has been launched by the Department of Education, Government of Uttarakhand, aims to support eligible NCC cadets through financial incentives to encourage continued participation in education and NCC training. Through this scheme, scholarship amounts ranging from ₹600/- to ₹2,400/- are provided annually to eligible NCC cadets at group and unit levels. Annual cash scholarships are awarded at both group and unit levels to junior and senior division NCC cadets. The scheme is implemented by designated Group Headquarters and Unit Offices under the administrative control of the State Directorate of NCC.
## Benefits > **Group Level:** - For Senior Division/Senior Wing cadets: ₹2,400/-. - For Junior Division/Junior Wing cadets: ₹1,200/-. > **Unit Level:** - For Senior Division/Senior Wing cadets: ₹1,200/-. - For Junior Division/Junior Wing cadets: ₹600/-. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be an NCC cadet. 1. The applicant must have passed the 10th or 12th class or an equivalent examination in the previous academic session. 1. The applicant must have completed two years of NCC training. 1. The applicant must have maintained a minimum of 80% attendance in each year of NCC training. 1. The applicant must be currently pursuing higher education. 1. The applicant must not be receiving any other general or special scholarship from the State Government. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The Group Headquarters/Units collect applications in the prescribed format from cadets of schools/colleges where NCC is functional. **Step 2:** Each Group Headquarters constitutes a "Board of Officers" to review and verify applications. **Step 3:** The board also handles the processing of cadets’ application forms and all related documents. **Step 4:** The complete application set, including the filled form and caste certificate certified by the competent authority, is submitted to the Directorate. **Step 5:** Upon approval at the Directorate level, the scholarship amount is sanctioned and disbursed.

# Scheme for Marketing Organisations **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Puducherry | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Entrepreneur, Marketing, Project, Renovation, Village, Product | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Scheme for Marketing Organisations” was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC), Department of Industries & Commerce, Puducherry. The scheme aims to financially assist the Individuals / Partnership Concerns / Private Limited / Public Limited Companies for setting up new sales outlets or undertaking renovation/expansion of existing outlets of marketing Village & Small Industries (VSI) products. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.
## Benefits - Financial assistance is provided for the purpose of setting up new sales outlets or undertaking renovation and expansion of existing outlets for marketing Village and Small Industries (VSI) Products. - The maximum total cost of the project that can be considered under this scheme must not exceed ₹25,00,000/-. - A down payment of at least 50% of the Value of goods purchased is mandatory.
## Eligibility Criteria Individuals / Partnership Concerns / Private Limited / Public Limited Companies experienced in marketing of Village & Small Industries (VSI) products are eligible.
## Exclusions

## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **User Manual:** [https://pipdic.in/uploads/PIPDIC_docs/user_manual.pdf](https://pipdic.in/uploads/PIPDIC_docs/user_manual.pdf) **How to Apply:** [https://pipdic.in/how_to_apply](https://pipdic.in/how_to_apply) **Applicant Login:** [https://pipdic.in/customer_login](https://pipdic.in/customer_login) **Application Link:** [https://pipdic.in/forms](https://pipdic.in/forms) **Grievance Form:** [https://pipdic.in/grievance_form](https://pipdic.in/grievance_form) ##### ***Registration Process*** ##### **Step 1:****** ***Registration and Profile Creation*** Visit the [PIPDIC website.](https://pipdic.in/,) Click "Login". Click the “New customer” link under the “Login” menu, enter a username, email-id, password, and captcha, and then click the "Register" button. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Email Verification and Login*** - Use the registered email-id to log in. An OTP is sent to the registered email address. - The applicant is then required to enter the OTP and click "Login" to access to the customer dashboard. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Profile Update*** - Upon successful login, the customer needs to update their profile by accessing the "Edit Profile" option (top right corner of the dashboard). - The applicant must provide all required details. Click "Submit".
##### ***Application Process (Loan Application)*** ##### **Step 1:****** ***Accessing the Loan Application Form*** - To initiate the loan application process, the applicant must navigate from the customer dashboard by clicking on the "Applications" tab. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Reviewing Checklist and Accepting Terms*** - A pop-up window displaying a checklist of General Terms and Conditions, interest rate structure, investigation fees, and collateral security norms will appear for review. - Carefully read this checklist, confirm that all necessary documents have been gathered as requested, and click the “I Agree” button to proceed to the application form. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Filling the Loan Application Form*** Fill the multi-step application form, providing appropriate details in all mandatory fields across the required steps. ##### **Step 4:****** ***Declaration and Submission*** The applicant must carefully read and agree to the comprehensive declaration provided within the application form (covering confirmation of true information, absence of unauthorized borrowing arrangements, and consent to verification) before finally ticking the "I agree to terms" checkbox and clicking the final "Submit" button for the main application form. ##### **Step 5:****** ***Promoter Bio-Data and Document Upload*** The system will redirect the applicant to enter the Biodata of the Promoter, Partner, or Director, which is typically a multi-step process. The necessary KYC and supporting documents must be uploaded by clicking the "Choose File" button next to each field. ##### **Step 6:****** ***Application Fees Payment*** - Once the entire application and bio-data submission is complete, pay the applicable application fee. - If selecting online payment, the system automatically redirects the applicant to the payment summary page, where they verify their details and make the payment. ##### **Step 7:****** ***Receiving and Saving Payment Receipt*** - Upon successful payment, the user is redirected back to PIPDIC website, where a receipt for the application fee paid is generated. - The applicant can print this receipt or save it to their computer as a PDF for future reference.
##### ***Application Status Tracking and Support*** The customer can monitor the status of their submitted application (which will initially show a status like 'UNDER REVIEW') by clicking the "View My application" link on the dashboard and selecting the relevant loan application in the drop-down menu. ##### ***Application Fees*** - For loans up to ₹25,00,000/-, the application fee is ₹100/-. - For loans above ₹25,00,000/-, the application fee is ₹200/-. ##### ***Grievance Redressal / Help & Support*** - The applicant can contact the Managing Director, Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited at No.60, Romain Rolland Street, Puducherry 605001. - The office phone number is 0413-2334361. - The email address for contact is info@pipdic.com. - The General Manager (Administration) can be contacted via mobile at 9894653835.

page_content:
# Scheme Of Assistance To Women Entrepreneurs (Mahalir Udavi) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Puducherry | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Industry, Entrepreneur, Loan, Asset, Woman | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Scheme Of Assistance To Women Entrepreneurs (Mahalir Udavi)" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC), Department of Industries & Commerce, Puducherry. The scheme aims to extend financial assistance to new or existing Micro Enterprises promoted exclusively by women entrepreneurs or consisting of a majority of women entrepreneurs. The scheme provides a loan for acquiring fixed assets and/or meeting the working capital requirement for setting up new Small Scale Industry Units or Micro Enterprises, with financial assistance considered up to a maximum of 75% of the project cost, provided the total project cost does not exceed ₹20,00,000/-. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.
## Benefits - Financial assistance shall be considered up to a maximum of 75% of the project cost. - The loan is provided for acquiring fixed assets. - The loan is provided to meet the working capital requirement. - A concessional rate of interest of 0.5% less than the normal rate is charged for units promoted by Women. - A 50% concession is provided on the investigation fee. - The maximum term loan repayment period is 10 years. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The project cost shall not exceed ₹20,00,000/-._ - _The Promoter’s contribution must be 25% of the project cost._ - _The Debt Equity Ratio (DER) shall be 3:1._ - _Repayment period is a maximum of 10 years, which includes a moratorium period of a maximum of 2 years, depending upon the period of implementation._ - _Collateral security in the form of immovable property shall be offered as per the lending policy of the Corporation._ - _Apart from collateral security, proposed fixed assets must be covered by mortgage and/or hypothecation._ - _For units promoted by women entrepreneurs, the value of the immovable property to be offered as collateral security is reduced and fixed at 50% of the loan amount._
## Eligibility Criteria All existing and new SSI/Tiny units promoted exclusively by women entrepreneurs / consisting of majority of women entrepreneurs.
## Exclusions

The scheme aims to assist existing units that are classified as 'A' Category Good Borrowers, who are existing assisted units of Medium Scale Industry and Small Scale Industry, to acquire fixed assets and undertake expansion, modernization, or replacement of machinery. The scheme provides loan limits ranging from a minimum of ₹5,00,000/- to a maximum of ₹150,00,000/-. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
## Benefits - Financial assistance is available for a minimum amount of ₹5,00,000/- and a maximum amount of ₹150,00,000. - An interest concession of 1% less than the normal rate is provided for 'A' Category borrowers. - The loan funds are intended to be used to acquire fixed assets for setting up of new units. - The loan funds are intended for expansion, modernization, purchase of balancing equipment, and replacement of machinery or equipment of existing units. - The repayment period is 3 to 5 years, excluding the moratorium period. ##### ***Conditions*** - _Fixed assets in existing units assisted by other institutions or banks must be free from encumbrance._ - _Collateral security in the form of immovable property must be offered as per the lending policy of the Corporation._ - _The value of immovable property situated in the Union Territory of Puducherry to be offered shall be not less than the amount of term loan sanctioned._ - _If the immovable property is situated outside the Union Territory of Puducherry, the value must be not less than 150% of the loan amount in the case of land with building._ - _If the immovable property situated outside the Union Territory of Puducherry is only land, the value of the same shall be not less than 200% of the loan amount._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an existing assisted unit classified as ‘A’ Category. - The applicant must be an existing assisted unit of Medium Scale Industry or Small Scale Industry classified as ‘A’ Category. - The existing assisted unit must be in operation for more than 3 years. - The existing assisted unit must be regular in repayment. - The existing assisted unit must be regular in repayment without availing re-schedulement. - The applicant can be an existing assisted unit by other institutions or Banks which satisfies the criteria under Good Borrowers, and its fixed assets must be free from encumbrance. - The applicant can be an existing transport loanee who has settled the loan promptly.
## Exclusions

# Financial Assistance for Purchase of Battery Operated Vehicles **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Puducherry | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Transport & Infrastructure, Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Investment, Vehicle, Battery, Subsidy, Loan | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Financial Assistance for Purchase of Battery Operated Vehicles” was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC), Department of Industries & Commerce, Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to eligible residents of Puducherry for the purchase of Battery Operated vehicles. The scheme provides financial support, including an investment subsidy of ₹80,000/- provided by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, Govt. of India, specifically for Companies or Societies. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.
## Benefits - Investment subsidy of ₹80,000/- is provided. - The subsidy is provided by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy Sources, Government of India. - This investment subsidy is specifically provided only for Companies or Societies. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The applicant must provide a Promoter’s Contribution of 10% on the cost of the vehicle._ - _The collateral security required in the form of immovable property, if situated in the Union Territory of Puducherry, shall be valued at not less than the amount of the term loan sanctioned._ - _If the immovable property used as collateral security is situated outside the Union Territory of Puducherry, its value must be not less than 150% of the loan amount in the case of land with a building, or not less than 200% of the loan amount if the property offered is only land._ - _If the unit is promoted by Women / Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe / Differently abled persons, the value of the property to be offered as collateral security is reduced and fixed at 50% of the loan amount._
## Eligibility Criteria The applicant must be a resident of Puducherry.
## Exclusions

metadata.schemeName: Mushroom Production and Marketing Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote mushroom cultivation among farmers by providing subsidized inputs, training, and support for marketing, thereby increasing their income and encouraging entrepreneurship in the sector.

page_content:
# Mushroom Production and Marketing Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Mushroom, Marketing, Farmer, Pasteurized Compost | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Mushroom Production and Marketing Scheme” is implemented by the Department of Horticulture, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote mushroom cultivation among farmers by providing subsidized inputs, training, and support for marketing, thereby increasing their income and encouraging entrepreneurship in the sector.
## Benefits Under this scheme, the following assistance is provided: - Pasteurized compost is provided at a 50% subsidy on the total cost, up to a maximum of 50 quintals per beneficiary. Similarly, mushroom spawn (seed) is provided at a 50% subsidy on the total cost, up to a maximum of 25 kg per beneficiary. No cash is given; the pasteurized compost and spawn are provided directly by the department. - Seven-day training for mushroom growers is provided (₹1,050/- per beneficiary), of which ₹700/- is transferred to the beneficiary’s account through DBT, and ₹350/- is used for training materials and related expenses. - Farmers/mushroom growers who produce mushrooms under the scheme can sell their produce in local markets or mandis.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer interested in mushroom cultivation.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - To avail the benefits of this scheme, the applicant must first download the application form/proposal format from the department's website [https://shm.uk.gov.in/](https://shm.uk.gov.in/) or obtain it from the concerned Horticulture Mobile team Centre office. The applicant must then prepare the proposal in the prescribed format. - If there is any difficulty in preparing the proposal, the Horticulture Mobile team Centre personnel will assist. The application requires land documents, Aadhaar card, PAN card, bank account details, expected income from mushroom cultivation, and any previous training certificates. The completed proposal must then be submitted to the office. - If the farmer does not have sufficient funds, they may apply for a loan from the bank. The application form is then sent directly to the Horticulture Mission, where it is evaluated by a committee. Upon approval, the applicant is informed via telephone and receives an acceptance letter from the office of the Director of the Horticulture Mission or the Chief Mushroom Development Officer. - Interested farmers can obtain pasteurized compost and spawn from the relevant district office. This entire process is currently conducted offline. Eligible beneficiaries are allocated up to 50 quintals of compost and 25 kg of spawn on a first-come, first-served basis, depending on budget availability. - For training, an application must be submitted to the Horticulture Mobile team Centre. After receiving the request, the department schedules the training and informs the farmer by phone. The farmer can then attend the training on the scheduled date.

# Registration of Herb Cultivators - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Herbal, Herbs, Herb Cultivator, Registration | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Registration of Herb Cultivators” is implemented by the Herbal Research and Development Institute (HRDI), mandal gopeshwar chamoli under the Department of Horticulture, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to register cultivators who grow medicinal and aromatic plants, make the process of using their cultivated herbs easier, and stop the illegal collection of herbs from forests.
## Benefits Registration of farmers cultivating medicinal and aromatic plants, simplification of the extraction process for cultivated herbs, and prevention of illegal exploitation of herbal resources from forest areas.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a cultivator of medicinal and aromatic plants. 1. The applicant must either have their own resources on their measured land or be a cultivator encouraged by the Herbal Research and Development Institute, or a cultivator beneficiary supported by any other organization, institute, department, or voluntary organization.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline After physical verification by the Institute’s Surveyor Assistant, the actual cultivated area is registered. The Surveyor Assistant prepares the registration form in the prescribed format, attaches the applicant’s Aadhaar card and the land’s Khasra details, and sends it to the Director of the Herbal Research and Development Institute, mandal gopeshwar chamoli. After obtaining the Director’s approval, the concerned District Coordinator completes the registration.

page_content:
# Issuing Legal Production Certificate (LPC) to Producers of Medicinal Plant Products for Export - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Herbal Products, Herbs, Export Of Products, Legal Production Certificate, Medicinal Plant | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Issuing Legal Production Certificate (LPC) to Producers of Medicinal Plant Products for Export” is implemented by the Herbal Research and Development Institute (HRDI), mandal gopeshwar chamoli under the Department of Horticulture, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to facilitate the lawful export of endangered and CITES-listed medicinal plant species such as Kuth, Kutki, etc. by issuing Legal Production Certificates (LPC) to cultivators who legally grow these species on their own measured land.
## Benefits There is a ban on the export of products of certain endangered and CITES species, but the objective of this policy is to facilitate the export of endangered species like Kuth, Kutki, etc. produced legally in the measured land.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must be legally cultivating endangered plants such as Kutha, Kutki, etc., on their own measured land.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline To apply, the cultivator must submit a demand letter from the importer along with the registration certificate issued by the Herbal Research and Development Institute, mandal gopeshwar chamoli and the pass issued by the Bhesaj Vikas Ikai. These documents must be submitted to the Herbal Research and Development Institute. The Institute, after requesting the concerned Divisional Forest Officer, and along with the Forest Department, Bhesaj Vikas Ikai, and the Herbal Research and Development Institute, conducts a joint physical verification. Based on this verification, the concerned Divisional Forest Officer is recommended to issue the LPC. Thereafter, the LPC is issued by the Forest Department under the Wildlife Protection Act of India.

page_content:
# Financial Incentives for Certification and Intellectual Property Rights Reimbursement Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Hospital, Institution, Enterprise, Certification, Incentive | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Financial Incentives for Certification and Intellectual Property Rights Reimbursement Scheme" was launched by the Department of Industries, Trade & Commerce, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage industrial units and eligible service providing units/institutions operating in the State of Goa to obtain National and International Certification, maintain requisite standards of quality, promote technological up-gradation, and encourage the registration of Intellectual Property Rights (IPRs) to enhance competitive strength and protect innovation. The scheme provides financial reimbursement for actual expenditure incurred in acquiring recognized certifications and covers professional and registry fees related to IPR registration, subject to specific monetary ceilings for the entire validity period.
## Benefits - Reimbursement of charges to the extent of 100% of actual expenditure per certification. Subject to a combined ceiling of ₹8,00,000/- only for the entire period of the scheme. - Reimbursement of 50% of the professional fees for registration and fees paid to the registry for registration of Intellectual Property Rights. Subject to a maximum ceiling of ₹15,00,000/- for the entire period of the scheme. ##### ***Conditions for Disbursement*** - _The reimbursement for certification will include eligible charges incurred to obtain the certificate._ - _The reimbursement for certification will not include charges of lodging/boarding, refreshment, and travel._ - _If the applicant has availed reimbursement under any other similar scheme of the Central Government for a particular certification, the reimbursement under this scheme is restricted only to the balance amount after deducting the Central Government assistance already availed._ - _The benefits under this scheme are subject to budgetary allocation._ ##### ***Post-Disbursal Obligations*** - The beneficiary shall allow and/or grant free access to any official authorized by the Directorate of Industries, Trade & Commerce for conducting inspection/supervision of the unit or the registers or holding discussions with the employed employees for ensuring proper utilisation of the financial incentives/subsidies granted by the State Government.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be one of the following - (a) An Industrial Unit in all Categories operating in Goa. (b) A Hospital recognized by the Government of Goa and operating in Goa. (c) An Educational Institution recognized by the Government of Goa and operating in Goa. - The applicant must have obtained Certification from Indian Standard Institute (ISI), International Standard Organization (ISO) or any other recognised National/International Certification for quality standards and/or Intellectual Property Rights (IPRs) as accepted by the Task Force Committee. - The applicant must not have claimed this benefit under any other scheme/program of the Government of Goa. - The applicant must not be taking or have taken any benefit under any policy of the Department of Information Technology, Government of Goa.
## Exclusions The applicant is not entitled to benefits if the Certification obtained is Statutory certification under any relevant provisions of the law.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The eligible unit must take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/target-schemes.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to - Directorate of Industries, Trade & Commerce (DITC), Goa.

page_content:
# Financial Assistance to the Family of Temple Employees **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Puducherry | **Categories:** Sports & Culture, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Employee, Death, Financial Assistance, Insurance, Temple, Welfare | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Financial Assistance to the Family of Temple Employees" was launched by the Hindu Religious Institutions and Wakf Department, Union Territory of Puducherry. The scheme aims to grant financial assistance to the family of the temple employee who expires while in service. The scheme provides an amount of ₹5,000/- under the Group Insurance Scheme and an amount of ₹20,000/- under the Chief Minister’s Welfare Fund. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
## Benefits **Financial Benefit:** An amount of ₹5,000/- is granted under the Group Insurance Scheme. **Financial Benefit:** An amount of ₹20,000/- is granted under the Chief Minister’s Welfare Fund. **Intended Use of Benefit:** The amounts are granted to the family of the temple employee who expire while in service.

metadata.schemeName: Distribution of Materials to Promote Herbal Cultivation in Uttarakhand - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand
metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, there is a special provision for the free distribution of seeds or saplings of medicinal plants up to 3 nali and seeds or saplings of aromatic plants up to 5 nali to farmers belonging to border districts, Scheduled Castes/Tribes, and Below Poverty Line (BPL) categories.

page_content:
# Distribution of Materials to Promote Herbal Cultivation in Uttarakhand - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Herbal Research, Herbal, Distribution Of Seeds, Distribution Of Saplings, Medicinal Plant, Farmer | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Distribution of Materials to Promote Herbal Cultivation in Uttarakhand” scheme is implemented by the Herbal Research and Development Institute (HRDI), mandal gopeshwar chamoli under the Department of Horticulture, Government of Uttarakhand. Under this scheme, there is a special provision for the free distribution of seeds or saplings of medicinal plants up to 3 nali and seeds or saplings of aromatic plants up to 5 nali to farmers belonging to border districts, Scheduled Castes/Tribes, and Below Poverty Line (BPL) categories. **(Note: At present, all willing farmers are being benefited under this scheme.)**
## Benefits - To encourage the cultivation of herbs, a 50% government subsidy will be provided on herbal plantation materials, inputs, and related items. - By distributing seeds/saplings of medicinal plants such as Atis, Kutki, Kuth, Jatamansi, Chirayta, Van Kakri, Pyrethrum, Taggar, Manjith, Coleus, Sarpagandha, Shatavar, Silybum, Pippali, Mandukparni/Brahmi, Amymesus, Stevia, and Tilpushpi up to 3 nali, and seeds or saplings of medicinal and aromatic plants such as Feran, Black Cumin, Large Cardamom, Rosemary, Geranium, Lemongrass, Chamomile, Bay Leaf, and Amymesus up to 5 nali free of cost, farmers are encouraged to cultivate medicinal and aromatic plants and are motivated towards self-employment. - To extend the subsidy facilities provided by the State and Central Governments to farmers, ensure the availability of technical information, provide training facilities, offer the benefits of processing systems, and prepare documentation and a database of cultivation activities.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and must have legally measured land in their name. 1. The applicant must be interested in the cultivation of herbs.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline The selection of farmers is carried out after physical verification by the Surveyor Assistant of the Herbal Research and Development Institute (HRDI), mandal gopeshwar chamoli posted in the concerned development block of each district. To obtain seeds or saplings, interested farmers must register their names in the list of selected farmers by submitting the Khasra of their land along with a photocopy of their Aadhaar card.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote sustainable livelihoods and economic empowerment of the urban poor by providing financial support and guidance for establishing self-employment ventures, strengthening their family’s economy, and generating new employment opportunities.

page_content:
# Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM): Self-Employment Programme – Uttarakhand **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Self-Employment, Livelihood, Urban Area, Employment, Interest Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Self-Employment Programme" is an initiative under the Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM), implemented by the Nagar Nigam Dehradun under the Department of Urban Development, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote sustainable livelihoods and economic empowerment of the urban poor by providing financial support and guidance for establishing self-employment ventures, strengthening their family’s economy, and generating new employment opportunities.
## Benefits - **Under the Self-Employment Programme**, the beneficiary in urban areas enhances their livelihood while strengthening their own and their family’s economic condition. - **Under the Self-Employment Programme**, the beneficiary is provided a loan of up to ₹2.00 lakh through the bank. - There is a provision for interest subsidy under the **Self-Employment Programme**, where 7% of the interest is borne by the beneficiary and the remaining is shared by the Government of India and the State Government. - **Under the Self-Employment Programme**, the beneficiary can generate new employment and also expand existing employment opportunities.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary is eligible for this scheme under the municipal body area. 1. The annual income of the beneficiary's family must be less than ₹3.00 lakh, as per the standards of the Government of India.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - Under the Self-Employment Programme, the application form must be obtained from the municipal body. The beneficiary must attach the following with the application form: Aadhaar card, income certificate or a self-declared ₹10/- affidavit (stating that no loan has been taken earlier from any bank), a project report of the activities to be undertaken by the beneficiary with an estimated cost of up to ₹2.00 lakh, one passport-size photograph, address proof such as a ration card or electricity bill, bank passbook, and photocopies of all the above documents. The completed application form along with these documents must be submitted to the municipal body. The application process at the municipal level is free of charge. - At the municipal level, the applications under the Self-Employment Programme are scrutinized. - The loan application form under the Self-Employment Programme is presented before a task force committee constituted by the municipal body. The task force examines the application form by reviewing the documents attached by the beneficiary and interacting with the beneficiary. After this process, the beneficiary’s loan application form is sent by the municipal body to the concerned bank.

metadata.schemeName: Scheme for SSI / MSI Sector (PIPDIC)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to extend financial support to establish new, or expand/modernize existing, Small Scale Industry and Medium Scale Industry units. Benefits include term loans up to ₹10,00,00,000/- for fixed asset acquisition.

page_content:
# Scheme for SSI / MSI Sector (PIPDIC) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Puducherry | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Enterprise, Partnership, Cooperative, Company, Loan, Business | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Scheme for SSI / MSI Sector" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC), Department of Industries & Commerce, Puducherry. The scheme aims to extend financial assistance for new enterprises to establish Micro, Small, or Medium units and for expansion, modernization, or diversification by existing units. The scheme provides financial assistance for acquiring fixed assets such as purchasing land, constructing buildings, and procuring machinery, equipment, electricals, and miscellaneous fixed assets. The scheme is implemented by PIPDIC, and applications for this scheme are accepted online.
## Benefits - Financial assistance (Term Loan) up to a maximum of ₹10,00,00,000/- per project. - Loan proceeds may be used for acquiring fixed assets, including the purchase of land, construction of buildings, and procurement of machinery, equipment, electricals, and miscellaneous fixed assets. - The maximum repayment period is 8 years, which includes a maximum moratorium period of 2 years. ##### ***Benefit Disbursement Criteria*** - The Debt Equity Ratio (DER) must be 3:1 for loans up to ₹25,00,000/-. - The Debt Equity Ratio (DER) must be 2:1 for loans above ₹25,00,000/-. ##### ***Conditions*** - Collateral security in the form of immovable property must be offered as per the lending policy of the corporation. - The valuation of properties offered as security must be assessed by engaging Chartered Engineers or valuers from the approved panel of the Corporation. - In respect of immovable property situated in the Union Territory of Puducherry, the value of the property offered must be not less than the amount of the term loan sanctioned. - In respect of immovable property situated outside the Union Territory of Puducherry, the value of land with building offered must be not less than 150% of the loan amount. - If the property offered outside the Union Territory of Puducherry is only land, its value must be not less than 200% of the loan amount. - For units promoted by Women, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, or Differently Abled persons, the value of the property to be offered as collateral security is fixed at 50% of the loan amount.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must belong to the Small Scale or Medium Scale sector. 2. The applicant organization must be one of the following forms: - Proprietary Concern - Partnership Firm - Co-operative Society - Private Limited Company - Public Limited Company 3. The loan application purpose must be for one of the following purposes: - Setting-up New Small-Scale Units - Setting-up New Medium Scale Units - Expansion of Existing Units - Modernization of Existing Units - Diversification of Existing Units - Any other activities eligible for assistance under the scheme. 4. The total project cost ceiling must not exceed ₹20,00,00,000/-.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ##### ***Registration Process*** ##### **Step 1:****** ***Registration and Profile Creation*** - The applicant must access the [PIPDIC website.](https://pipdic.in/,) Click "Login".- To register as a new customer, the applicant must click the “New customer” link under the “Login” menu, enter a username, email-id, password, and captcha, and then click the "Register" button. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Email Verification and Login*** - Following successful registration, the applicant must use the registered email-id to log in, which initiates the process of sending an OTP to the registered email address. - The applicant is then required to enter the OTP received in the email and click the final "Login" button to gain access to the customer dashboard. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Profile Update*** - Upon successful login, the customer needs to update their profile by accessing the "Edit Profile" option, which is typically found in the top right corner of the dashboard. - The applicant must provide all required details, such as Name, Email, Contact Number, and Aadhaar Number, and conclude this step by clicking the "Submit" button located at the bottom of the page.
##### ***Application Process (Loan Application)*** ##### **Step 1:****** ***Accessing the Loan Application Form*** - To initiate the loan application process, the applicant must navigate from the customer dashboard by clicking on the "Applications" tab, and then following the specific menu path corresponding to the required loan amount, such as **Applications > Loan Applications > Upto 25 Lakhs Application or Above 25 Lakhs Application.** ##### **Step 2:****** ***Reviewing Checklist and Accepting Terms*** - A pop-up window displaying a checklist of General Terms and Conditions, interest rate structure, investigation fees, and collateral security norms will appear for review. - The applicant must carefully read this checklist, confirm that all necessary documents have been gathered as requested, and click the “I Agree” button to proceed to the application form. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Filling the Loan Application Form*** - The applicant must proceed with filling the multi-step loan application form, providing appropriate details in all mandatory fields across the required steps. - This includes selecting the activity (Manufacturing, Job Work, Service) and the proposal type (New Project, Expansion, Modernisation, Diversification, Others), and clearly specifying the requested Term Loan and Working Capital assistance amounts. ##### **Step 4:****** ***Declaration and Submission*** - The applicant must carefully read and agree to the comprehensive declaration provided within the application form (covering confirmation of true information, absence of unauthorized borrowing arrangements, and consent to verification) before finally ticking the "I agree to terms" checkbox and clicking the final "Submit" button for the main application form. ##### **Step 5:****** ***Promoter Bio-Data and Document Upload*** - Following the submission of the main loan application, the system will redirect the applicant to enter the Biodata of the Promoter, Partner, or Director, which is typically a multi-step process. - During this stage, the necessary KYC and supporting documents, such as copies of PAN Card, Voters Identity, Ration Card, and Aadhaar Card, must be uploaded by clicking the "Choose File" button next to each field and selecting the required document from the computer's file explorer. ##### **Step 6:****** ***Application Fees Payment*** - Once the entire application and bio-data submission is complete, the customer must pay the applicable application fee. ##### **Step 7:****** ***Online Payment Execution*** - If selecting online payment, the system automatically redirects the applicant to the payment summary page, where they verify their details and click "Pay". - The user is then directed to the "PAYU BIZ" third-party payment gateway, where they must enter their debit card, credit card, or banking details, click "Pay Now," and confirm the transaction by entering the OTP received via SMS. ##### **Step 7:****** ***Receiving and Saving Payment Receipt*** - Upon successful payment, the user is redirected back to the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited website, where a receipt for the application fee paid is generated. - The applicant can print this receipt or save it to their computer as a PDF for future reference.
##### ***Application Status Tracking and Support*** The customer can monitor the status of their submitted application (which will initially show a status like 'UNDER REVIEW') by clicking the "View My application" link on the dashboard and selecting the relevant loan application in the drop-down menu. ##### ***Application Fees*** - For loans up to ₹25,00,000/-, the application fee is ₹100/-. - For loans above ₹25,00,000/-, the application fee is ₹200/-. ##### ***Grievance Redressal / Help & Support*** - The applicant can contact the Managing Director, Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited at No.60, Romain Rolland Street, Puducherry 605001. - The office phone number is 0413-2334361. - The email address for contact is info@pipdic.com. - The General Manager (Administration) can be contacted via mobile at 9894653835.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure food security for the poorest and most vulnerable families by providing them with subsidized food grains under the Antyodaya category in the state. Under the scheme, eligible beneficiaries receive 35 kg of food grains and 1 kg of sugar per ration card at subsidized rates.

page_content:
# National Food Security Scheme (Antyodaya Anna Yojana - Pink Ration Card) - Uttarakhand **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Ration Card, Food Distribution, Pink Card, Antyodaya, Anna | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “National Food Security Scheme (Antyodaya Anna Yojana – Pink Ration Card)” is implemented by the Department of Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to ensure food security for the poorest and most vulnerable families by providing them with subsidized food grains under the Antyodaya category in the state.
## Benefits Under the scheme, each Pink Ration Card holder receives 35 kg of food grains (13.30 kg of wheat at ₹2.00 per kg and 21.70 kg of rice at ₹3.00 per kg) along with 1 kg of sugar at ₹13.50 per kg. At present, from 1 January 2023, food grains are being distributed free of cost to all ration card holders in the state.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must belong to the Antyodaya category of the state. 1. The following families/persons are eligible under the Antyodaya category: - Families in which any member is eligible for a disability pension and the total monthly family income is less than ₹4,000/-. - BPL families. - Individuals infected with HIV.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Targets have been set for each district under the Antyodaya Anna Yojana. ***Procedure for removal of name from the Antyodaya category:*** - If a person is no longer eligible for the Antyodaya category, the individual must inform the District Supply Officer. After the department conducts an inspection and confirms the information to be true, the cardholder is removed from the Antyodaya category. The District Supply Officer also carries out periodic inspections and takes necessary action. If a person is found to be above the Antyodaya category, removal proceedings are initiated. In both urban and rural areas, if a person’s name is to be removed from the Antyodaya category, a proposal is presented in an open meeting of the Gram Sabha. Once the proposal is approved, the concerned Gram Panchayat Development Officer removes the person from the records. After informing the District Supply Officer/Supply Inspector with a recommendation for further action, the department removes the individual from the Antyodaya category. If information is received from a third party, the department investigates the Antyodaya cardholder and, if the information is found to be correct, removes the cardholder from the Antyodaya category. ***Procedure to add name to the Antyodaya category:*** - The applicant must first obtain an application form from the office of the Gram Panchayat Development Officer or the District Supply Officer. The application must include the family’s Aadhaar cards, photographs, phone number, bank account details, gas connection details, voter ID/PAN card, income certificate, electricity bill, and a copy of the resolution passed in the Gram Panchayat’s open meeting declaring the family as an Antyodaya family. The applicant must submit the application form along with all the required documents to the respective Gram Panchayat Development Officer. - After verification, the officer adds the name to the records and forwards the case with a recommendation to the Food Supply Department for further action. Antyodaya ration cards are issued in each district based on the population targets set by the Government of India. A new ration card is issued only when a vacancy arises. The individual can obtain the ration card from the office of the District Supply Officer/Supply Inspector/Regional Food Officer within 10 days. - If no proposal has been submitted by the Gram Panchayat, the applicant must submit the application form in the prescribed format, along with the above documents, to the office of the Gram Panchayat Development Officer or District Supply Officer. Afterward, the Gram Panchayat Development Officer/District Supply Officer conducts verification, and if the applicant is found eligible and a vacancy exists, digitization is carried out.
