metadata.schemeName: Revised Scheme For Incentives To Milk Producers
metadata.briefDescription: BRIEF DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to encourage farmers and youth in Goa to take up Dairy business to increase local milk production and achieve state self-sufficiency. It offers a 40% composite subsidy on milk proceeds (incentive and cattle feed subsidy) to eligible resident farmers.

page_content:
# Revised Scheme For Incentives To Milk Producers **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Farmer, Producer, Dairy, Business, Youth, Incentive, Subsidy, Milk | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Revised Scheme For Incentives To Milk Producers" was launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to develop the Dairy sector and make Goa self-sufficient in milk production by encouraging farmers to engage in dairy business, thereby making it more lucrative and increasing local milk production. The applications for this scheme are accepted through the respective Veterinary Dispensary/Hospital via the registered cooperative society/group, which submits monthly reports for payment processing.
## Benefits - A composite subsidy amounting to 40% (forty percent) of the proceeds of milk supplied to the Dairy Co-operative Society/Bachat Gat/Self Help Group. - Incentive on milk: 32.28% (thirty-two point two eight percent). - Incentive on cattle feed: 7.72% (seven point seven two percent). - The scheme is linked to the cattle feed subsidy scheme. ##### ***Disbursement*** - Monthly disbursement of benefits to beneficiary's Bank account via Electronic Clearing System (ECS). - The beneficiary must have a Bank account in any Bank having a core banking system/Electronic Clearing System (ECS). ##### ***Mandatory Obligations*** - The beneficiary must produce their own milk at their Dairy Farm. - The beneficiary must not procure milk from others and pour it to the Dairy Co-operative Society/Bachat Gat/Self Help Group in their name. - The quantity of milk supplied and the number of milch animals reared by the farmers will be checked by the departmental area officer in addition to the supervisor/officials from the concerned organization. - In case of any fraud or malpractice regarding milk supply or animal count, the Department shall stop the composite subsidy (incentive on milk and feed) forthwith. - If fraud or malpractice occurs, the benefit of all schemes will be withdrawn. - In matters of fraud or malpractice, the decision of the Director will be final and binding on the party.
## Eligibility Criteria The applicant must be a farmer from Goa. The applicant must be a bona fide resident of Goa for at least the preceding five years. The applicant must be a member of the Dairy Co-operative Society/Bachat Gat/Self Help Group registered with the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services. The applicant must register their Dairy Farm with the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services through the respective Veterinary Dispensary/Hospital. The applicant must own a cattle shed with milch animals. The applicant must produce their own milk (and not procure milk from others then pour it to the group/society in their name). The applicant must be mandatorily registered with the Agricultural Department, as an Agriculturist under the Agricultural Database.
## Exclusions The applicant must not procure milk from others and pour it to the Dairy Co-operative Society/Bachat Gat/Self Help Group in his name.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ##### **Step 1:****** ***Dairy Farm Registration*** - The applicant must register their Dairy Farm with the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services by visiting the respective Veterinary Dispensary/Hospital, [providing comprehensive details](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/Revised-Schemes-For-Incentives-To-Milk-Producers.pdf) about their operation.- These details include the number of animals, state of lactation of each animal, milk yield, date of calving, and the address of the cowshed where the animals are located. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Securing Group Membership*** - The applicant must acquire membership in a Dairy Co-operative Society, Bachat Gat, or Self Help Group, ensuring the chosen group is registered with the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services. - The relevant group/society is responsible for maintaining a complete list of its members, allotting a unique membership number to each farmer, and submitting this list to the Department at the beginning of the scheme. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Opening a Bank Account*** - The beneficiary must open a Bank account in any Bank that operates using a core banking system or Electronic Clearing System (ECS) to enable the Department to effect the composite subsidy payment directly.
##### **Application/Reporting Process (Monthly Cycle)** ##### **Step 1:****** ***Submitting Monthly Supply Data to the Area Officer*** - The Dairy Co-operative Society/Bachat Gat/Self Help Group must submit a monthly consolidated report, provided in triplicate (both soft copy and hard copy), to the area Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director. - This report must detail the total quantity of milk supplied by each farmer, the corresponding amount of payment received by the farmer for that month, and the beneficiary's Bank account number, branch name, and Magnetic Ink Character Recognition (MICR) code. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Report Certification by Group Officials*** - The required monthly reports must be duly signed by the Secretary and the Chairman of the Dairy Co-operative Society/Bachat Gat/Self Help Group, and verified and certified by the Supervisor of the group/society. - All such reports must reach the area Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director latest by the 8th day of the month subsequent to the month it pertains to. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Verification and Certification by Area Officer*** - The Area Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director shall certify the statement received from the group/society after conducting verification using the registers maintained by them and the fortnightly bill payment statements issued by the group.
##### **Post-Application Process (Disbursement Cycle)** ##### **Step 1:****** ***Bill Preparation and Verification*** - The local Area Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director shall forward the certified statement to the authorized agency for bill preparation by the 15th day of the month. - The authorized agency must then submit the prepared bills back to the local Area Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director by the 22nd day of the month. The Area Officer then verifies and certifies the bills received from the agency. ##### **Step 2:** **Final Submission and Payment** - The local Area Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director must forward the certified bill, along with a copy of the certified statement, to the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services by the 25th day of the month. - Upon receipt of the certified bill from the Area Officer, the payment of the composite subsidy at 40% is effected through the beneficiary’s bank account using the Electronic Clearing System (ECS).

metadata.schemeName: Goa (Subsidy to Clay Idol Makers) Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage Goan artisans to continue traditional clay idol making by providing a subsidy of ₹100/- per idol, supporting registered local craftsmen in preserving cultural heritage and ensuring livelihood sustainability.

page_content:
# Goa (Subsidy to Clay Idol Makers) Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Artisan, Subsidy, Cottage, Industry, Handicraft, Employment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Goa (Subsidy to Clay Idol Makers) Scheme” was launched by the Department of Industries, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to revive the traditional Goan cottage industry of clay idol making and motivate local artisans by providing financial support through subsidies. It addresses the decline of this art form due to competition from cheaper alternatives such as Plaster of Paris and polyfibre. The scheme provides a subsidy of ₹100/- per idol and grants up to ₹15,000/- per artisan annually. The applicant must be a traditional clay idol maker registered with the Goa Handicrafts, Rural and Small Scale Industries Development Corporation Limited (GHRSSIDC) and must produce idols within Goa. The scheme is implemented through GHRSSIDC, and applications are accepted offline.
## Benefits - Subsidy of ₹100/- per clay idol made by registered artisans, with minimum idol size of 1 foot. - Maximum subsidy limit: ₹15,000/- per artisan per year. - Applicable only for idols actually produced and sold within the State of Goa. **Disbursement:** Cheque in favour of the artisan after fund receipt from Government. **Availment:** Beneficiaries must maintain sale records and provide proof of production and sale as prescribed.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a traditional clay idol maker or artisan from the State of Goa. - The applicant must be registered with GHRSSIDC as a clay idol manufacturer. - The applicant must personally manufacture idols within Goa; imported or traded idols are not eligible. - The applicant must have a workshop or production unit within Goa for manufacturing idols such as Ganesh, Durga, Saraswati, or Mother Mary. - The subsidy is applicable only for idols used for religious purposes (e.g., Ganesh Chaturthi, Christmas) and not for decorative items. - The applicant must maintain records of idols produced and sold, including size, price, buyer details, and sale date. - The applicant must comply with physical inspection by GHRSSIDC officials.
## Exclusions - Unsold idols are not eligible for subsidy. - Idols used for decorative items are not eligible for subsidy.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://goaprintingpress.gov.in/downloads/0809/0809-17-SI-OG.pdf) of the application form. Alternatively, the applicant may obtain the prescribed format from ***GHRSSIDC, Craft Complex, Neugi Nagar, Panaji, North Goa, Goa - 403 001,*** upon payment of ₹1/- per form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the ***Managing Director, GHRSSIDC Ltd., Panaji-Goa.*** ##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1****:** GHRSSIDC officials will physically inspect the applicant’s workshop to verify production capacity and conduct a physical count of clay idols in the artisan’s presence. **Step 2:****** An Appraisal Committee consisting of the Chairman, Managing Director, a nominated Director, and a Government representative will review applications for approval on a first come, first served basis. ##### ***Benefit Disbursement*** - Upon approval, subsidy payment is issued via cheque in favour of the registered artisan after receiving funds from the Government. - Beneficiaries must maintain sales records and submit the utilisation certificate for subsequent releases.

metadata.schemeName: E-Rickshaw Kalyan Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among unemployed youth in the state by providing affordable loans for purchase of e-rickshaws, thereby enhancing their livelihoods. Under this scheme, loans are provided to unemployed youth for purchase of e-rickshaws at an annual interest rate of 9%.

page_content:
# E-Rickshaw Kalyan Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** E-Rickshaw, Unemployed Youth, Loan, Self-Employment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “E-Rickshaw Kalyan Yojana” was launched by the Cooperative Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote self-employment among unemployed youth in the state by providing affordable loans for the purchase of e-rickshaws, thereby enhancing their livelihoods.
## Benefits - Under this scheme, loans are provided to unemployed youth for the purchase of e-rickshaws at an annual interest rate of 9%. Additionally, under the Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana, savings account holders receive an insurance cover of ₹2.00 lakh for an annual premium of ₹12/-. - Beneficiaries aged between 18 and 50 can also avail benefits under the Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana by paying a premium of ₹330/- through their savings accounts.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant should be currently unemployed. - The applicant must possess a valid driving license. - The applicant must not be more than 55 years of age.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - To obtain a loan for purchasing an e-rickshaw, applicant must visit the nearest cooperative bank and collect the application form. It is mandatory for the applicant to open an account with the respective cooperative bank, and both the applicant and two guarantors must be designated as nominal members of the bank. - The application form must be submitted along with the following documents: a dealer’s quotation, details of two guarantors, a permanent residence certificate, Aadhaar card, bank account statement from the relevant bank, voter ID card with a local address, electricity or water bill in the applicant’s name, and a valid driving license. Unemployed individuals residing in urban, semi-urban, or rural areas who are renting a house must also provide a tenancy certificate along with the Uttarakhand Permanent Resident Certificate. - Once the application and documents are submitted, the bank reviews and approves the loan. Upon approval, the bank disburses the funds directly to the dealer. The applicant is then required to repay the loan in daily or monthly installments, along with interest at an annual rate of 9%.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides a grant of ₹20,00,000–₹12,000 and a monthly allowance of ₹5,000–₹1,500 to gallantry awardees as a mark of honor and recognition for their valor.

page_content:
# Grants-in-aid and Monthly Grants to Soldiers Decorated With Gallantry Decorations **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Madhya Pradesh | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Soldier, Ex-servicemen, Gallantry Award | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Grants-in-aid and Monthly Grants to Soldiers Decorated With Gallantry Decorations” scheme was launched by the Home Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to honor and support soldiers and ex-servicemen who have been conferred with gallantry awards for their acts of bravery and distinguished service.
## Benefits **One-Time Grant Assistance:** - Depending on the category of the gallantry award, a one-time grant ranging from ₹20,00,000 to ₹12,000 is provided to the awardee. **Monthly Allowance:** - Soldiers or ex-servicemen receive a monthly allowance between ₹5,000 and ₹1,500, based on the class of gallantry decoration received.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be a serving or retired soldier/ex-serviceman who has received a Gallantry Award recognized by the President’s Secretariat.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:****** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the District Sainik Welfare Office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District Sainik Welfare Office.

metadata.schemeName: Lakhpati Didi Yojana - Uttarakhand
metadata.briefDescription: The primary objective of the scheme is to improve the economic status of women in Uttarakhand by empowering them to become financially self-reliant and achieve the status of “Lakhpati Didis.”

page_content:
# Lakhpati Didi Yojana - Uttarakhand **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Women and Child | **Tags:** Lakhpati Didi, Woman, SHG | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Lakhpati Didi Yojana” is implemented by the Department of Rural Development, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme was launched by the Honorable Prime Minister of India with the primary objective of improving the economic status of women and enabling them to become Lakhpatis. Under this initiative, the Honorable Chief Minister of Uttarakhand has committed to enabling 1.5 lakh women members to achieve the status of Lakhpati Didis by 2025. As part of the scheme, the Uttarakhand State Rural Livelihood Mission has already recognized 40,270 women associated with self-help groups as Lakhpati Didis in 2022-23 and 52,729 women in 2023-24.
## Benefits Under this scheme, to brand and market the products manufactured by self-help groups, the Uttarakhand State Rural Livelihood Mission has established 17 Saras Centers, 2 state-level Uttara outlets, 24 Growth Centers, and 7 Millet Bakeries. Additionally, the groups’ products are sold at various Saras Melas, helping to increase their income and improve their livelihoods.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a woman associated with a self-help group. 1. Women beneficiaries from hilly and plain areas, aged between 18 and 65 years, are eligible to avail the benefits of this scheme.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Women associated with self-help groups under the National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM), who are engaged in various income-generating activities, are selected at the block level. Members of women’s groups whose annual income is less than ₹1 lakh are eligible for selection at the development block level. For information regarding the Lakhpati Didi Yojana, assistance can be obtained from the District Mission Manager or District Thematic Expert at the district level, and the Block Development Officer or Block Mission Manager at the development block level.

metadata.schemeName: Training Classes In Veda/Devaram
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to conduct training classes in Veda, Devaram, and Nalayira Divya Prabantham for divine worship/Poojas. It benefits eligible candidates by providing religious training in Saivaite and Vainavaite temples, and provides an honorarium of ₹1,000/- per month to the instructing pandits.

page_content:
# Training Classes In Veda/Devaram **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Puducherry | **Categories:** Skills & Employment, Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Training, Temple, Worship, Tradition, Culture | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Training Classes in Veda/Devaram" was launched by the Hindu Religious Institutions and Wakf Department, Union Territory of Puducherry. The scheme offers specialized training classes in Veda, Devaram, and Nalayira Divya Prabantham. These subjects are required for divine worship/Poojas. The classes are conducted in various Saivaite and Vainavaite temples in the Puducherry region to provide instruction to eligible candidates. The instructing pandits (teachers) are provided an honorarium of ₹1,000/- per month. Applications are collected by receiving them from some of the important temples of the Puducherry region.
## Benefits - Provision of training classes in Veda, Devaram, and Nalayira Divya Prabantham, which are required for divine worship/Poojas. - Instructing pandits are provided an honorarium of ₹1,000/- per month. - The honorarium is given once every three months. - The honorarium is disbursed upon the pandits furnishing attendance particulars of the students who attended the Veda classes.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an eligible candidate to receive the training. - The applicant must be a resident of Puducherry. - The applicant must know how to read, write, and speak Tamil fluently. - The applicant must be interested in receiving specialized training classes in Veda, Devaram, and Nalayira Divya Prabantham.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format of the application form](https://hri.py.gov.in/resources/docs/Citizen_Charter.pdf). **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form, along with the documents, to the concerned authority at the temple. _*The processing time for the application shall be 15 days._

metadata.schemeName: CA/ICWA CMA /CS Scholarship
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide scholarships to students from minority religious communities studying Chartered Accounts/Cost & Management Accounts/Company Secretaryship courses. Through this scheme, a scholarship is provided to eligible students.

page_content:
# CA/ICWA CMA /CS Scholarship **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Kerala | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Chartered Account, Cost & Management Account, Company Secretaryship, Course | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "CA/ICWA CMA /CS Scholarship" by the Kerala State Minority Welfare Department aims to provide scholarships to students from minority religious communities studying Chartered Accounts/Cost & Management Accounts/Company Secretaryship courses. Through this scheme, a scholarship amount is provided to eligible students. The scheme is implemented by the Kerala State Minority Welfare Department.
## Benefits 1. The scholarship amount of ₹15,000/- is provided. 1. The scholarship is provided to students from minority religious communities.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Kerala. 1. The applicant must belong to Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Parsi, or Jain religious communities. 1. The applicant's annual family income should be below ₹8,00,000/-. 1. The applicant must be appearing for intermediate or final year examinations of Chartered Accounts, Cost & Management Accounts, or Company Secretaryship courses. 1. The applicant must have secured 60% marks in Plus Two/B.Com or other degrees. 1. The applicant should have an account in any nationalised bank in their own name.
> **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:** - Preference will be given to applicants belonging to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category. - In the absence of BPL applicants, applicants from minority religious communities with an annual income up to ₹8,00,000/- in the Above Poverty Line (APL) category will be considered. - Selection will be based on merit and income.
## Exclusions - Applicants who have received this scholarship in previous years are not eligible to apply.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](https://www.minoritywelfare.kerala.gov.in) of the Directorate of Minority Welfare. **Step 2:** Locate and click on the "Scholarship". **Step 3:** Navigate to the "Scholarship" menu link and click on "CA/ICWA (CMA)/CS Scholarship (IWCS)". **Step 4:** Click on "Apply Online". **Step 5:** For new scholarship applicants, first complete one-time registration and log in with your candidate details. **Step 6:** In the Registration Form, carefully enter the details step-by-step under Examination details (register number/roll number), Personal details, and Scholarship details tabs. **Step 7:** In the Upload details tab, upload the required documents (Photo, Signature, SSLC Certificate, Income Certificate, Ration Card Copy, Allotment Memo) in JPEG format under 100 KB size each. **Step 8:** Only after uploading all required documents, the registration process will be considered complete. **Step 9:** After completing the application submission, use the View/Print Application link to take a printout of the application form.
> **Submission of Application Printout** - After submitting the scholarship application (either through new registration or login), click on "View/Print Application" to get a printout of your registration form. - Submit the printout of the registration form along with all the required supporting documents to the head of the institution where you are studying, within the specified deadline.

metadata.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Scaling Mount Everest and Other Inaccessible Mountains of the World
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "Financial Assistance for Scaling Mount Everest and Other Inaccessible Mountains of the World" aims to promote mountaineering by providing financial aid to successful climbers, including up to ₹15,00,000 for those who scale Mt. Everest.

page_content:
# Financial Assistance for Scaling Mount Everest and Other Inaccessible Mountains of the World **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Mountaineering, Everest Climbing, Adventure Sports | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Financial Assistance for Scaling Mount Everest and Other Inaccessible Mountains of the World" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to encourage and reward mountaineers who demonstrate extraordinary courage and determination by scaling some of the most difficult mountain peaks in the world. The scheme offers tiered financial assistance based on the height and difficulty of the peak climbed, ranging from ₹50,000 to ₹15,00,000, with the maximum incentive awarded to individuals who successfully scale Mt. Everest. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner, Youth Services and Cultural Activities, Gandhinagar.
## Benefits > **Financial Support for Mountaineers:** - Financial assistance ranging from ₹50,000/- to ₹10,00,000/- is provided to individuals depending on the height and difficulty of the mountain scaled. - A maximum of ₹15,00,000/- is provided to those who successfully climb Mount Everest.


## Eligibility Criteria > **Eligibility Criteria for Adventurer:** - The applicant should have successfully scaled Mount Everest or other inaccessible mountains of the world. - The applicant should be aged between 18 to 45 years as on 31st December of the respective year. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat, Mount Abu, or any other Indian state. - The applicant from Gujarat or Mount Abu should have completed a coaching course from the Swami Vivekananda Mountaineering Institute, Mount Abu. - The applicant must be physically and mentally fit. - The applicant must not have any criminal record. - The applicant who has already participated once in the camp during the same year will not be allowed to participate again. > **Eligibility Criteria for Coach or Instructor:** - The applicant should have provided services in Artificial Rock Climbing Courses or Coaching Courses held at Mount Abu. - The applicant must have completed the Method of Instructor Course and Search and Rescue Course. - The applicant should possess sufficient mountaineering experience and certifications relevant to instructing rock climbing activities. > **Eligibility Criteria for Subject Experts:** - The applicant must be one of the following: - A subject expert or experienced individual from any Ministry or Department of the Government. - A representative of an international or national mountaineering association or institution recognized by the government. - A person who has received National or International awards/medals or has similar significant achievements in mountaineering from recognized associations. > **Note:** Preference will be given to applicants who are participating for the first time.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should download the prescribed format of the [application form](https://commi-synca.gujarat.gov.in/writereaddata/Portal/Magazine/Document/1_216_3_revised-mount-everest-sahay-application-form-01092018.pdf). **Step 2:** In the application form, provide all the mandatory details, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the supporting documents to the below mentioned address. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. > **Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department** > **Commissioner, Youth Services and Cultural Activities, Gujarat State, Block: 11, Third Floor, Dr. Jivraj Mehta Bhavan, Sector-10,** > **Gandhinagar, 382010.** > **Mobile: 079-23254095, 079-23252995** > **Mail: commi-synca[at]gujarat[dot]gov[dot]in** > **Website: http://sycd.gujarat.gov.in**

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage female students from Haryana to pursue higher education and reduce their interest burden. Through this scheme, financial assistance and an interest subsidy are provided to eligible female students.

page_content:
# Education Loan Scheme: Haryana Women Development Corporation **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Women and Child | **Tags:** Higher Education, Technical Diploma, Graduation, Post Graduation, Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Education Loan Scheme" by the Haryana Women Development Corporation, Government of Haryana, aims to encourage women and girls from Haryana to pursue higher education at graduate, postgraduate, doctoral, and post-doctoral levels, both within the country and abroad, while reducing the interest burden on students and guardians. Through this scheme, financial assistance and a 5% interest subsidy per annum are provided to female students. The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Women Development Corporation. > **Objectives:** 1. To encourage women/girls belong to Haryana State to pursue higher education at Graduate/Post Graduate/Doctoral/Post Doctoral level in the country and abroad. 1. To reduce the interest burden on the student / Guardian.
## Benefits 1. **Financial Assistance:** Provided to female students under a Bank tie-up Education Scheme.1. **Interest Subsidy:** The Corporation will provide an interest subsidy of 5% per annum to the banks.1. **Reduced Interest Burden:** The scheme aims to reduce the interest burden on the student/guardian.1. **Specific Interest Subsidy Condition:** The Haryana Women Development Corporation (HWDC) will pay up to 5% interest subsidy on Education Loans to those female students who have availed the Education Loan from SBI Group and whose parents are employees of these banks and are being provided Education Loan at a lesser interest rate than the rate of interest for the general public. Hence, only the difference in interest of the subsidy will be paid by HWDC.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a Haryana domicile girl. 1. The applicant can be a child of a Haryana Government employee. 1. The applicant can pursue higher education, professional/technical diploma/graduate/postgraduate, doctoral/post-doctoral level in the country and abroad. 1. There are no preconditions for income. 1. There are no preconditions of caste. 1. There are no preconditions for religion. 1. The scheme is applicable for studies in India and abroad.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details, i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number & password. Click on ‘Submit’. **Step 3:** Verify the OTP received in the provided Email and Mobile Number. Alternatively, click on the Verification Link to activate the profile. > **Login to Apply for the Scheme:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** The “Sign in here” option is available on the right side of the screen. Fill in the required credentials and click on the ‘Login’ button. **Step 3:** In the opened window, click on “Scheme/Services list”, and a list of schemes will appear on the screen. **Step 4:** Now, select the scheme and click on “Apply for Service/Scheme”. **Step 5:** Fill in all the details in the online application form and click on "Submit". > **Track Your Service Online:** - **Track Application/Appeal:** [Click here](https://status.saralharyana.nic.in/). - **Track Ticket:** [Click here](https://eticketing.saralharyana.nic.in/CitizenViewComplaints.aspx). > **Track Your Service Through SMS:** - **Registered Mobile Number:** Type SARAL and send to 9954699899 to track your application. - **Other Mobile Number:** Type SARAL<space><Application ID/Ticket No.> and send to 9954699899 to track your application. > **Contact Us:** **Helpline:** 0172-3968400 **Email:** saral.haryana@gov.in > **Note:** > **Govt. Charges:** No Fee > **Service Charges:** ₹ 10 > **Atal Seva Kendra Service Charges:** ₹ 10
**Mode:** Online - via CSC The eligible applicant may visit the nearest Atal Seva Kendra with all the required documents to apply for the scheme.

page_content:
# Micro Finance Scheme (GNDTDC) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Small Scale Business, Self-employment, Loan, Nomadic Tribes, Denotified Tribes | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description
The scheme "Micro Finance Scheme" is implemented by the Gujarat Nomadic and Denotified Tribes Development Corporation (GNDTDC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to promote self-employment among individuals from the Nomadic and Denotified Tribes communities by providing financial assistance to start a small-scale business/enterprise. Under this scheme, beneficiaries can avail loans at concessional interest rates to purchase equipment, raw materials, or working capital.
## Benefits **Loan Amount Details:** - **Loan Amount:** Up to ₹1,25,000/-.- **Interest Rate:** 5% per annum. - **Loan Contribution:** 90% will be from the National Corporation, 5% from the State Government, 5% from the beneficiary.- **Repayment:** The loan amount will have to be repaid in 48 equal monthly installments, including interest.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Nomadic Tribe or Denotified Tribe. 1. The applicant's family's annual income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 to 50 years on the date of application. 1. The applicant should have experience & technical skill in the proposed trade/business. 1. The applicant will have to provide suitable collateral to get the loan. **Note:** At least 50% of the total loan amount under this scheme will be specifically allocated to families with an annual income of up to ₹1,50,000/-.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1: Visit the Official Portal** - Go to the [Official Website](https://gndcdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) Gujarat Nomadic and Denotified Tribes Development Corporation.- Scroll down on the homepage, find the "Micro Finance" and click on "Apply Now". - You will be directed to the application form. **Step 2: Access and Fill Out the Application Form** - Complete all sections under "Applicant information," including full name, father/husband's name, gender, complete address details, contact numbers, Aadhaar No., parents/husband/guardian occupation and income details. Also provide Date of Birth, Age, Caste, and Subspecies. Also, if you are disabled and provide a percentage. - If you have taken a past loan, select "Yes" or "No". If you selected "Yes", provide loan details (date, amount, paid, remaining) and your account number. - Provide bank account number, bank name, branch name, name as per account, account type (Saving/Current), MICR code, and IFSC code. **Step 3: Upload Documents** - Go to "Upload Photo" in the menu, then upload your photograph and signature (each file less than 15 KB). Click "Save Photo and Signature" - Navigate to "Upload Document" in the menu and upload all required files (PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG only). **Step 4: Review and Final Submission** - Carefully review each module. Use the preview option to examine the application before final submission. Fill out the provided "CAPTCHA" and Click on “Submit”. ***Track and Review Status*** - Applicant will receive an Application ID/Reference Number. Save or print the acknowledgement for future tracking. - Go to the [Official Website](https://gndcdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) Gujarat Nomadic and Denotified Tribes Development Corporation.- Scroll down and locate the Know App Status. Click on "Know App Status". - Select the Scheme name, Enter App No., and Birth Date. Fill out the Captcha and click on Submit.

metadata.schemeName: New Swarnima Yojana for Women (GTKVN)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote economic upliftment of women from Thakor & Koli communities living below poverty line by supporting them in self-employment ventures. Under this scheme, 100% financial support up to ₹1,00,000/- is provided to eligible women for starting a business/trade of their choice.

page_content:
# New Swarnima Yojana for Women (GTKVN) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship, Women and Child | **Tags:** Business, Entrepreneurship, Loan, Self-Employment, Woman, BPL, Thakor Caste, Koli Caste | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "New Swarnima Yojana" is implemented by the Gujarat Thakor and Koli Vikas Nigam (GTKVN) under the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to promote economic upliftment of women from Thakor and Koli communities living below poverty line by supporting them in self-employment ventures. Under this scheme, 100% financial assistance up to ₹1,00,000/- is provided to eligible women for starting a business or trade of their choice.
## Benefits - **Loan Amount:** Up to ₹1,00,000 for eligible business/trade activities.- **Interest Rate:** 5% per annum.- **Loan Coverage:** 100% of the approved project/business cost.- **Repayment Term:** 60 equal monthly installments (5 years), including interest.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a woman. 1. The applicant should belong to Thakor or Koli community. 1. The applicant should be between 21 and 50 years of age on the date of application. 1. The applicant’s annual family income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The woman applicant should have experience related to the proposed business/trade. 1. The applicant will have to provide suitable collateral to get the loan. > **Note:** At least 50% of the total credit is reserved for applicants from families with income up to ₹1,50,000/- annually.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Visit the [official website](https://gtkdconline.gujarat.gov.in/) of the Gujarat Thakor and Koli Vikas Nigam. **Step 2:** On the top menu bar, click on "Apply Now". **Step 3:** Click on the loan scheme name. **Step 4:** Select the loan category and fill in the loan amount. **Step 5:** Fill out the Application Form, enter the following details: - Personal Information: Name, gender, date of birth, caste, etc. - Address Information: Permanent and correspondence address - Income Details: Monthly family income and source - Loan Requirement: Amount needed, proposed use (e.g., business, self-employment) - Bank Account Details: For loan disbursement **Step 6:** Upload scanned copies of the Caste certificate, Income certificate, Aadhaar card, Passport-size photo, Bank passbook (first page), and Residence proof. **Step 7:** Double-check all details. Click on “Preview” to verify. If all details are correct, click “Submit”. **Step 8:** Applicant will receive an Application ID/Reference Number. Save or print the acknowledgement for future tracking.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide self-employment loans to women from minority communities. Financial assistance with a 20% subsidy is provided to widows, divorced women, and abandoned women from minority communities. The scheme is implemented by the KSMDFC.

page_content:
# Self-Employment loan scheme for Minority Widows, Divorcees / Abandoned Women **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Kerala | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Divorce, Women, Loan, Subsidy, Employment, Minority | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Self-Employment loan scheme for Minority Widows, Divorcees / Abandoned Women" was introduced by the State Minority Welfare Department, Government of Kerala. The scheme aims to provide self-employment loans to women from minority communities. Through this scheme, government financial assistance with a 20% subsidy is provided to widows, divorced women, and abandoned women from minority communities. The scheme is implemented by the Kerala State Minority Development Finance Corporation.
## Benefits - Financial assistance of up to ₹1,00,000/- as a government subsidy. - Maximum loan amount of ₹5,00,000/-. - The interest rate on the loan amount (excluding subsidy) is 6%.
> **Conditions/Criteria Associated with Benefits:** A 20% subsidy (maximum ₹1,00,000/-) is provided on the loan amount. - For a loan amount of ₹1,00,000/-, the subsidy is ₹20,000/-. - For a loan amount of ₹2,00,000/-, the subsidy is ₹40,000/-. - For a loan amount of ₹3,00,000/-, the subsidy is ₹60,000/-. - For a loan amount of ₹4,00,000/-, the subsidy is ₹80,000. - For a loan amount of ₹5,00,000/-, the subsidy is ₹1,00,000/-. _*At each stage of disbursement, photos and bills must be submitted._ _*Direct inspection will be conducted at each stage of disbursement._ _*An additional interest of 6% will be charged for misuse of funds._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must belong to a minority community (Muslim, Christian, Buddhist, Sikh, Parsi, Jain). - The applicant should be a widow, divorced woman, or abandoned woman. - The applicant's age should be between 20 and 60 years. - The applicant's family's annual income should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-. > **Preference/Priority** - Priority will be given to mothers of children below 18 years of age. - Priority will be given to widows from families identified through the extreme poverty identification survey.
## Exclusions - The following types of land are not accepted as collateral: Kuzhikanam, Verumpattom, Devaswam Verumpattom, pledged land, and agricultural fields (if patta is not received). - Residential land less than 4 cents will not be accepted as collateral.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:****** Visit the [official website](https://minoritywelfare.kerala.gov.in/) of the Directorate of Minority Affairs and check on "News & Updates". Select the "Self-Employment loan scheme for Minority Widows, Divorcees / Abandoned Women" and obtain the application form. Alternatively, you can also visit the [official website ](https://ksmdfc.org/)of KSMDFC and go to the "Application Form" section and select the "[Application Form for Widows' Loan Subsidy"](https://ksmdfc.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Widows-application-form.pdf). Take a printout and fill out the [application form](https://minoritywelfare.kerala.gov.in/pdfnewsflash/imbichi.pdf). **Step 2:****** Attach the required copies of documents (Income Certificate, Caste/Age Certificate, Certificate proving applicant is a widow/divorced/abandoned woman) for primary verification. **Step 3:****** Submit the filled application form, either directly or by post, to the respective Regional Office of the Kerala State Minority Development Finance Corporation in your district.
_*Attend the interview, bringing all original documents mentioned in the "Documents Required - For Interview" section._ _*If the loan is approved, submit the additional required documents as per the chosen guarantee type (officer guarantee or property guarantee)._ _*The loan will be sanctioned as per the Corporation's rules and government regulations_

page_content:
# Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Mini Fish Feed Mills of Production Capacity of 2 Ton /Day **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Fish, Fish Farmer, Fish Production, Entrepreneur, Mini Fish Feed Mill | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Mini Fish Feed Mills of Production Capacity of 2 Ton /Day” is a scheme component under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY), implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. This is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, aims to strengthen inland aquaculture infrastructure by promoting the establishment of small-scale fish feed mills. Under this scheme, financial assistance, in form of subsidy, is provided to individuals for setting up mini feed mills, ensuring the local availability of quality fish feed at affordable prices for fishers and fish farmers.
## Benefits **Tangible Benefits:** - Project Cost: ₹30,00,000/- per unit - Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for General Category of beneficiaries. - Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/ SC/ST/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant/beneficiary should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID). 1. All operational, maintenance, and post-construction management costs of the infrastructure facilities shall be borne by the beneficiary. 1. The beneficiary should ensure that the Fish Feed Mill remains in functional condition. 1. The beneficiary should supply the feed produced from the government-assisted Fish Feed Mill/Plant to fishers and fish farmers at an affordable price. 1. The applicant should either own the land or have it on a registered lease agreement valid for a minimum of 10 years.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number & password. page_content:
# PMMSY: Insulated Vehicles - Haryana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Fish Farmer, Vehicle, Financial Assistance, Transportation | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Insulated Vehicle" scheme was launched by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, under the umbrella scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana". It aims to promote efficient and hygienic fish transportation systems. Under this scheme, a financial grant is provided to the beneficiaries for purchasing insulated (reefer) vehicles used in fish transportation. It seeks to minimize post-harvest losses, improve fish value chains, and enhance earnings of fish farmers by enabling cold-chain logistics.
## Benefits **Financial Assistance:** - Financial grant of up to ₹20,00,000/- per unit for the purchase of an insulated (reefer) vehicle. **Grant Limits:** - 40% of the unit cost for general category beneficiaries. - 60% of the unit cost for Scheduled Caste (SC) and women beneficiaries. > **Note** - Subsidy is applicable for one vehicle per beneficiary only. - Central assistance is released only after initiating fishery activity. - The applicant should agree that any losses in procurement, operation, or maintenance are their own responsibility, and not that of the Government of India or Haryana.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a fish farmer. 1. The applicant must possess a Family Identity Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant must ensure that the fish transportation facility is maintained in working condition. 1. The applicant must not have availed a grant for a similar insulated (reefer) vehicle earlier.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number & password. page_content:
# Shravan Tirthdarshan Yojna

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Travel & Tourism, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Pilgrim, Travel, Tourism, Heritage | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Shravan Tirthdarshan Yojna" by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance to senior citizens for pilgrimage travel. The scheme covers travel expenses through authorized agents and ensures comfortable pilgrimage arrangements. To be eligible, the applicant must be a senior citizen of Gujarat and registered under the scheme through an authorized travel agent or organizer. The scheme is implemented by the Government of Gujarat, and applications are accepted offline.

## Benefits
**Financial Assistance for Pilgrimage Travel Expenses**

- Upto ₹5,000/- per person for travel by State Transport (ST) buses.
- Upto ₹7,000/- per person for travel by Private Buses.

_*The financial assistance provided is subject to actual travel cost or the above-mentioned amount, whichever is lower._
_*Only group travel is allowed (minimum 20 pilgrims required)._

## Eligibility Criteria
- The applicant must be a senior citizen aged 60 years or above.
- The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat.
- The applicant must not have availed of the benefit previously under this scheme.
- The applicant must be physically fit to undertake the journey.
- The pilgrimage must be booked through an authorized travel agent/organizer.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://yatradham.gujarat.gov.in/Documents/Scheme_2022-8-23_752.pdf) of the application form.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields (details of the authorized travel agent/organizer, details of the pilgrims), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to your nearest District Social Welfare Office.
_*Retain a copy of the submitted application for reference._

# PMMSY: Large Fish Feed Mill of Production Capacity of 20 Ton /Day Scheme - Haryana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Fish Farmer, Production, Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Large Fish Feed Mill with Production Capacity of 20 Ton/Per Day" scheme was launched by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY), it aims to strengthen post-harvest infrastructure and enhance fish feed production to support sustainable aquaculture. Under this scheme, a grant is provided to beneficiaries for setting up a large fish feed mill, with 40% subsidy for general category and 60% for Scheduled Caste/Women beneficiaries.
## Benefits **Monetary Assistance:** - Grant of ₹20,00,000/- per unit for establishing a fish feed mill with 20-ton/day capacity. **Subsidy Provisions:** - 40% subsidy on unit cost for General Category beneficiaries. - 60% subsidy on unit cost for Scheduled Caste and women beneficiaries.

## Eligibility Criteria 1. Beneficiary must have Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The Beneficiaries will submit an undertaking in the DPR to the effect that all operational, maintenance and post construction management costs of the infrastructure facilities will be borne by them and the Fish Feed Plant will be kept in operational condition. 1. Central assistance for Fish Feed Mill will be as per actual cost within the overall ceiling indicated in the respective sub-components/activities under PMMSY. 1. The Beneficiary will ensure supply of feed produced from the government assisted Fish Feed Plant to the fishers and fish farmers at affordable price. 1. ## Description
The “Motor Cycle with Ice Box” is a scheme component under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY), implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. This is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, aims to strengthen fish transportation infrastructure and ensure the freshness and quality of fish during transit. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to fishers for purchasing motorcycles equipped with ice boxes, ensuring efficient and hygienic fish transport.

- Project Cost: ₹75,000/- per unit

metadata.schemeName: Jyoti Gramodyog Vikas Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides margin money subsidies (25–30%) for new rural industrial projects (₹1,00,000/- to 25,00,000/-) to artisans, entrepreneurs, and SHGs, leveraging a 24-hour electricity supply in villages. Beneficiaries must be aged 25–50 years with a Class 10th education.

page_content:
# Jyoti Gramodyog Vikas Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Business, Rural, Village, Artisan, SHG, Subsidy, Margin Money | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched on 7th September 2015, the scheme "Jyoti Gramodyog Vikas Yojana" by the Commissioner of Cottage and Rural Industries, Industries & Mines Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to promote rural entrepreneurship by providing financial assistance (margin money subsidy) for setting up new village industries in areas with 24x3-phase electricity supply. The scheme targets individual artisans, entrepreneurs, and Self-Help Groups (SHGs) with project costs ranging from ₹1,00,000/- to ₹25,00,000/-. It offers 25–30% margin money subsidy (higher for SC/ST/women/PH candidates) to incentivize production-oriented ventures. Applications are submitted offline through District Industries Centres (DICs), and subsidies are disbursed after a 2-year successful project run. ## Benefits > **Margin Money Subsidy** **For General Category** - 25% for projects up to ₹10,00,000/-. - 25% on first ₹10,00,000/- + 10% on remaining cost (up to ₹25,00,000/-). **For SC/ST/Women/Physically Handicapped** - 30% for projects up to ₹10,00,000/-. - 30% on first ₹10,00,000/- + 10% on remaining cost (up to ₹25,00,000/-).
> **Project Cost Coverage** - Includes machinery, raw materials, and working capital (max 10% of total cost). - Excludes land/building expenses. > **Disbursement** The subsidy is credited to the beneficiary’s account after 2 years of successful operation (upon verification by DIC). ## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be aged between 25 to 50 years. - The applicant must have passed at least Class 10 from a recognized educational board. - The applicant must possess at least one year of experience in the proposed business activity or relevant training from a recognized institution. - The applicant must be either an individual artisan/entrepreneur or part of a Grade-II active Self Help Group engaged in small-scale production. The applicant's proposed project must be located in a rural area with a population not exceeding 20,000. - The applicant must not represent a partnership firm, private limited company, joint venture, HUF, or similar commercial entity. - For SC/ST, women, and physically handicapped applicants, additional benefits are provided as specified in the benefits section. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the District Industries Centre (District Ughogh Kendra) of their district, and collect the prescribed format for scheme application from the designated staff. OR The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://cottage.gujarat.gov.in/FileExplorer/JGVY.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the designated staff. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the staff to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

metadata.schemeName: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 20-Ton Capacity - Haryana
metadata.briefDescription: The subsidy for 20-ton capacity ice plant/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 20 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.

page_content:
# PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 20-Ton Capacity - Haryana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Business & Entrepreneurship, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Entrepreneurs, Fish Farmers, Fish Preservation, Cold Chain Infrastructure | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Ice Plant/Cold Store of minimum 20-ton capacity, introduced by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to provide the subsidy for 20-ton capacity ice plant/cold storage units, supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 20 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana. This centrally sponsored scheme is jointly funded 50% by the Central Government and 50% by the State Government. Beneficiaries must submit an undertaking in their DPR agreeing to keep the unit operational, cover all post-construction costs, and supply ice to fishers and fish farmers at affordable prices.
## Benefits - The project cost is ₹80,00,000/- > **Subsidy Distribution :** 1. A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category. 1. A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant must submit an undertaking in the DPR to bear all operational, maintenance, and post-construction management costs, and to ensure the continuous functioning of the ice plant/cold storage. 1. The applicant must note that central assistance will be provided as per the actual cost, subject to the ceiling limits under relevant PMMSY sub-components. 1. The applicant must ensure that the ice produced is supplied to fishers and fish farmers at an affordable price. 1. The applicant must either own the project land or hold it on a long-term registered lease of at least 10 years to be eligible. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number & password. Click on ‘Submit’. **Step 3:** Verify the OTP received in the provided Email and Mobile Number. Alternatively, click on the Verification Link to activate the profile.
> **Login to Apply for the Scheme:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** The “Sign in here” option is available on the right side of the screen. Fill in the required credentials and click on the ‘Login’ button. **Step 3:** In the opened window, click on “Scheme/Services list”, and a list of schemes will appear on the screen. **Step 4:** Now, select the scheme and click on “Apply for Service/Scheme”. **Step 5:** Fill in all the details in the online application form and click on "Submit".
> **Track Your Service Online:** - **Track Application/Appeal:** [Click here](https://status.saralharyana.nic.in/). - **Track Ticket:** [Click here](https://eticketing.saralharyana.nic.in/CitizenViewComplaints.aspx).
> **Track Your Service Through SMS:** - **Registered Mobile Number:** Type SARAL and send to 9954699899 to track your application. - **Other Mobile Number:** Type SARAL<space><Application ID/Ticket No.> and send to 9954699899 to track your application/ticket.

metadata.schemeName: Braille Equipment Provision
metadata.briefDescription: The "Braille Equipment Provision" scheme aims to empower persons with visual disabilities to live independently by supporting their writing, computing, mobility, and entertainment needs. Through this scheme, Braille equipment is manufactured and made available to individuals and institutions.

page_content:
# Braille Equipment Provision

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Disabled Person, Divyang, Braille Devices, Visual Disability, Assistive Technology | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The "Braille Equipment Provision"  scheme aims to facilitate the independent functioning of visually impaired individuals by providing them with Braille equipment for writing, computing, entertainment, and mobility. Through this scheme, Braille devices are manufactured and distributed at subsidized rates to persons with visual disabilities and institutions like special schools. The scheme is implemented by the National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities, Dehradun,

## Benefits
- **Subsidized Access of Braille Appliances:** Makes Braille equipment affordable by providing it at subsidized rates to visually impaired persons, special schools, and institutions.

## Eligibility Criteria
- A person with visual impairment/ a Special School/ Organisation serving visually impaired persons shall be eligible under this scheme.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should fill in the [order format](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s36ee69d3769e832ec77c9584e0b7ba112/uploads/2024/11/202411291559430123.pdf) with all required details such as item names, quantities, and rates, and submit it along with the payment through Bank Draft, NEFT, or RTGS.
**Step 2:** The order will be confirmed after receiving the payment through Bank Draft/ NEFT/ RTGS in the name of Director NIVH, 116-Rajpur Road, Dehradun, along with 10% Packing charges extra on the actual cost of the appliances and Freight charges extra (as applicable). Rates are inclusive of 5% G.S.T.
> **FOR FURTHER DETAILS PLEASE CONTACT:**

**Workshop For Manufacturing Braille Appliances (MBA)**
**National Institute for the Empowerment of**
**Persons with Visual Disabilities (Divyangjan)**
**116-Rajpur Road, Dehradun - 248 001 (Uttarakhand)**
**Phone: 0135 -2742145, 2744491**
**E-mail: director-niepvd@nivh.gov.in**
**mbaniepvd@gmail.com**
**Visit us at: www.nivh.gov.in**

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme “Stipends to Students of Minority Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC” by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, supports education for Minority Caste students by providing a monthly stipend for one year.

page_content:
# Stipends to Students of Minority Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Education, Minority Caste, Stipend, ITI, Vocational Courses | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Stipends to Students of Minority Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC” by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat aims to promote inclusive education by financially supporting students from economically weaker sections pursuing technical and vocational education after SSC. The initiative offers a stipend of ₹400 per month to aid the academic progress and reduce the dropout rate among underprivileged youth. The scheme is implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department. It specifically benefits those enrolled in professional or Government ITI courses and belonging to families with an annual income not exceeding ₹6,00,000/-. ## Benefits - **Stipend:** A monthly stipend of ₹400/- is given to Minority Caste students for one year of recognized professional and Government ITI courses. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to Minority Caste. 1. The applicant should be a student who has passed the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) examination. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized professional or Government Industrial Training Institute (ITI) course. 1. The applicant’s individual and family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/- per annum.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **How to Register:** **Step 1:** Visit the Digital [Gujarat portal](http://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** The user should click on the "Click to register" option. metadata.schemeName: Sanskrit Shodh Chhaatravrtti Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The aim of the scheme is to encourage and support high-quality research in Sanskrit by providing financial assistance to meritorious Ph.D. students across state universities.

page_content:
# Sanskrit Shodh Chhaatravrtti Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Student, PhD, Sanskrit, Research | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Sanskrit Shodh Chhaatravrtti Yojana” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Sanskrit Academy, Haridwar, under the Department of Sanskrit Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The aim of the scheme is to encourage and support high-quality research in Sanskrit by providing financial assistance to meritorious Ph.D. students across state universities.
## Benefits - A research scholarship of ₹40,000/- per year is awarded to 20 students registered for a Ph.D. in Sanskrit at universities across Uttarakhand. - The scholarship is provided for a period of three years at ₹40,000/- per year and must be renewed by submitting an application each year/semester.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a student registered for a Ph.D. in Sanskrit at any university in Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to the General, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, and Economically Weaker Section. 1. A total of 20 research scholars are eligible for the scholarship, including 10 from the General category, 5 from Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, and 5 from Economically Weaker Section (EWS) certificate holders. 1. Selection will be based on the highest marks obtained in the NET examination.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - Applications for research scholarships are invited annually through advertisements published in daily newspapers and on the Academy's website. - Applicants must submit their applications along with all required documents, including Aadhaar card, NET examination mark sheet, academic certificates, Ph.D. registration certificate, and bank account details. - After evaluation by a selection committee, eligible research scholars are awarded annual scholarships to support their research in Sanskrit.

metadata.schemeName: Freeship less than ₹1,00,000 (UG students only)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "Freeship Less than ₹1,00,000 only for UG students" by the Dean Student Welfare, GBPUAT, Pantnagar aims to support meritorious undergraduate students from low-income families. This Freeship scheme provides full tuition fee exemption to eligible students.

page_content:
# Freeship less than ₹1,00,000 (UG students only) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Students, Research, Education | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description "Freeship Less than ₹1,00,000" Scheme by the Dean Student Welfare, Govind Ballabh Pant Krishi Evam Praudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya, Government of Uttarakhand, aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious undergraduate students from economically weaker backgrounds. Through this scheme, a full tuition fee waiver is granted to selected students whose annual family income is less than ₹1,00,000. The benefit is especially extended to girls for an additional academic year. The scheme is implemented by the Office of the Dean Student Welfare in accordance with university regulations. Applications are scrutinized and the final list is approved by university authorities.
## Benefits Eligible students get a 100% tuition fee waiver.

Aims to reduce the financial burden on low-income families and encourage academic excellence.

The fee waiver is directly applied during fee processing.

Granted once every academic year, at the beginning of the session.

Disbursed after the final selection list is approved by the Registrar and Vice Chancellor.

Validity:

Boys: Up to 3 academic years

Girls: Up to 4 academic years
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be enrolled as an undergraduate student at Govind Ballabh Pant University. - The applicant’s annual family income should be less than ₹1,00,000. - The applicant must be among the best-performing students as per the university’s merit guidelines. - The applicant must submit the application in the prescribed format within the deadline. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 1: Applications are invited on a prescribed form from eligible and meritorious students.

Step 2: Based on the applications, the Dean Student Welfare prepares a list following the prescribed procedure.

Step 3: The list is forwarded to the Registrar and Vice Chancellor for approval.

Step 4: Once approved, the final list of selected students is issued by an office order.

Step 5: Approved students receive the tuition fee exemption accordingly

metadata.schemeName: Student Program Under AcSIR
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "Student Program Under AcSIR" implemented by the Academy of Scientific and Innovative Research (AcSIR), aims to promote high-quality research and leadership development in Earth Sciences through doctoral education. It provides research opportunities to geoscience postgraduate students.

page_content:
# Student Program Under AcSIR **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Education, Geoscience Research, PhD Program, Postgraduate, Himalayan Geology | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Student Program Under AcSIR" by the Academy of Scientific and Innovative Research (AcSIR), Government of India aims to promote high-quality interdisciplinary research by enrolling eligible postgraduate candidates into PhD programmes. Through this scheme, students receive fellowships, training, and research opportunities in Earth Sciences, with the broader goal of preparing future leaders in the geoscience domain of the Himalayas. ## Benefits - **Advanced Research Opportunities:** The program provides opportunities for conducting high-quality, interdisciplinary research in various fields of Himalayan Geo-science. - **Leadership Development:** The scheme aims to develop leaders in the field of Himalayan Geo-science through the PhD program. - **Career Advancement:** Successful completion of the PhD program leads to a postgraduate degree, enhancing career prospects in the field. ## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must have a postgraduate degree (M.Sc./M.Tech.) in any discipline of Earth Sciences. - The applicant must hold a valid national-level fellowship such as: 1. NET-JRF (UGC/CSIR). 1. INSPIRE Fellowship. 1. Any other equivalent national fellowship. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the official online [application portal](https://acsiriphd.emli.in/) and create a Username/Application Log-In by clicking on the “Sign Up here” option. **Step 2:** Log in using the credentials received on your registered email ID, and click on “Complete your application” to proceed. **Step 3:** Fill out the application form as per the instructions mentioned in the portal and upload the following mandatory and applicable documents in the specified format and size **Step 4:** Choose the relevant Admission Route for the iPhD Program: - **Fresh Candidate (Not registered in PhD at AcSIR)**: Choose a research area and lab preference. Eligible for AcSIR-NIF Innovation Doctoral Fellowship. - **AcSIR PhD Student:** Submit Enrolment Letter and Thesis Research Proposal. Eligible for lump sum research support through AcSIR faculty. - **NIF Employee:** Submit Permission from Director, NIF and Proposed Research Problem. metadata.schemeName: Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali Paryatan Swarojgar Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote tourism-based self-employment and entrepreneurship among unemployed residents of Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance and subsidies for the development of tourism-related infrastructure and services. This scheme is applicable in entire Uttarakhand.

page_content:
# Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali Paryatan Swarojgar Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Travel & Tourism | **Tags:** Veer Chandra Singh, Tourism, Loan, Self-Employment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali Paryatan Swarojgar Yojana” was launched by the Department of Tourism, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote tourism-based self-employment and entrepreneurship among unemployed residents of Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance and subsidies for the development of tourism-related infrastructure and services. This scheme is applicable in entire Uttarakhand.
## Benefits Under this scheme, both vehicle items (ordinary bus, taxi, max, electric bus) and non-vehicle items (hotel/paying guest scheme, construction of motor garage/workshop, establishment of fast food centres, establishment of Sadhna Kutir Yoga Meditation centres, adventure activities, establishment of modern tourist information centres with P.C.O. facility, development of tented residential facilities, establishment of sales centres for local handicrafts and symbolic items, establishment of bakery, establishment of laundry, purchase of equipment for terrain bikes, star gazing and bird watching for tourism, herbal tourism, purchase and operation of kayaking/boats, caravan/motor home tourism, purchase of angling equipment, construction of museums containing memorabilia and establishment of memorabilia/souvenir centres, construction of floating hotels, and establishment of centres for providing trekking equipment, suits, jackets, etc. on rent) are included. Apart from the above, applicants can also submit any innovative project based on the attractions and characteristics of their particular area. **The following grants/subsidies are provided under the scheme:** (a) **Non-vehicle items:** A grant of up to 33% of the project cost, with a maximum of ₹33.00 lakh in hilly areas, and up to 25% of the project cost, with a maximum of ₹25.00 lakh in plain areas. (b) **Vehicle items:** A grant of up to 25% of the project cost, with a maximum of ₹10.00 lakh in both hilly and plain areas. For specific buses/electric buses—pushback 30 and 42 seater (2*2), pushback 26–28 seater, and 42 seater (2*2) electric/air-conditioned buses—a grant of 50% of the project cost, up to a maximum of ₹20.00 lakh, is provided. This provision applies only to buses/electric buses meeting the prescribed criteria, with a maximum of 50 buses/electric buses eligible per financial year. ***To avail the subsidy under the scheme, the applicant must contribute 12.5% of the total project cost as Margin Money.***
## Eligibility Criteria 1. To avail the benefits of this scheme, the applicant must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. If land is required for implementing the scheme, the applicant must either be the owner of the land or, if the land is in the name of a close relative, the mortgage of the land will be acceptable as priority security. If the landowner becomes a partner with the applicant as a co-borrower or guarantor, the grant amount will be payable only to the applicant. 1. The applicant can also avail the benefits of the scheme on leased land, provided the lease period exceeds the loan repayment period and the applicant is not a defaulter of any bank or financial institution. 1. Definition of Unemployed - an unemployed person is one who is not currently engaged in any business, enterprise, or profession.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - To avail the benefits of the scheme, applications must be submitted online through the MSY Portal: [https://msy.uk.gov.in/](https://msy.uk.gov.in/frontend/web/index.php). During the application process, the applicant is required to upload the following documents: Aadhaar card, Aadhaar-linked mobile number, permanent residence certificate, photograph, identity proof, affidavit, proof of the proposed work, proof of proposed investment, educational qualifications, bank account details, caste certificate, disability certificate (if applicable), ration card, valid driving license (for vehicle purchases), training-related documents (for non-vehicle projects), and any other relevant documents. - After submission, the application is forwarded to the District Tourism Development Officer of the concerned district. The District Tourism Officer schedules a meeting of the committee, chaired by the District Magistrate, and calls the applicants for an interview on the scheduled date. Following the interview, the approved proposals are sent online to the bank branch selected by the applicant for obtaining a loan. The bank initiates the loan approval process. Once approved, the bank informs the District Tourism Officer and disburses the loan amount to the applicant’s account. - Upon completion of the vehicle purchase or non-vehicle project, the applicant must notify the District Tourism Development Officer. Subsequently, departmental officials conduct an inspection. After verification and confirmation of completion, the department releases the approved grant to the applicant’s bank branch in accordance with the regulations. - Applications can be submitted at any time. Loans under the scheme are sanctioned by banks at prescribed interest rates and in accordance with bank regulations.
