metadata.schemeName: Skill Development
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "Skill Development" by the Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology, aims to impart practical training to postgraduate students in various Earth Science disciplines, including structural and evolutionary geology, geochemistry, geomorphology, glaciology, magnetostratigraphy, etc.

page_content:
# Skill Development

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Education, Skill Development, Geoscience, Earth Science, Postgraduate Research | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Skill Development" implemented by the Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology aims to enhance the practical knowledge and research capabilities of students pursuing Earth Science and allied subjects. Through this scheme, specialised summer and winter training programmes are offered to postgraduate and integrated postgraduate students in disciplines such as geochemistry, sedimentology, tectonics, geomorphology, environmental geoscience, and paleontology.

## Benefits
- **Research Experience:** Provides opportunities for self-sponsored research work, allowing students to gain practical experience in Earth Sciences.  - **Seasonal Training:** Offers valuable summer and winter training programs, enhancing practical skills and knowledge in specialized geological disciplines.  - **Exposure to Diverse Fields:** Exposes students to a wide array of sub-disciplines within Earth Sciences, such as structural geology, geochemistry, glaciology, engineering geology, palaeontology, and environmental geology.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant must possess a postgraduate degree in any discipline of Geosciences, Earth Sciences, or allied fields.
   1. The applicant may also be pursuing an integrated postgraduate degree course and should be in the fourth or fifth year of the curriculum.
   1. The applicant must be from fields such as geophysics, geochemistry, structural geology, sedimentology, paleontology, environmental geoscience, and related disciplines.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
**Step 1:** Visit the official website of WIHG at [https://www.wihg.res.in./](https://www.wihg.res.in./).
**Step 2:** Look for announcements or notifications regarding the Kaushal Vikas (Skill Development) programme.
**Step 3:** Download or access the application form or online registration link.
**Step 4:** Fill out the form with all required personal, academic, and institutional details.
**Step 5:** Upload or attach the required documents as specified in the guidelines.
**Step 6:** Submit the application as per instructions.

page_content:
# Green Skill Development Programme (GSDP) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Environmental Training, Eco-Livelihood Skills, Self-Employment Training, Biodiversity Education | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Harit Kaushal Vikas Karyakram" implemented by the Govind Ballabh Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (NIHE), aims to promote sustainable and eco-friendly livelihoods through nature-based skill development. Through this scheme, free skill training is provided to farmers, students, and youth to support self-employment and prepare them for government-backed programs as master trainers. It covers subjects like ornithology, wildlife conservation, natural interpretation, and biodiversity communication. The program is aligned with the Green Skill Development Program (GSDP) and is accessible through online applications via the official portal. ## Benefits - **Skill Development Training:** Free-of-cost training in environment-related fields such as bird identification, wildlife conservation, biodiversity interpretation, and eco-tourism education. - **Self-Employment Opportunities:** Empowers youth and farmers to pursue independent livelihood avenues through knowledge-based interventions. - **Government Scheme Readiness:** Makes candidates eligible for roles under various central/state schemes and government-supported training projects. ## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a student. - The applicant should have completed at least 10th standard. - The applicant should be a farmer/ youth or individual seeking self-employment. - The applicant should be below 55 years of age at the time of application. - The applicant should have an interest in environmental and ecological training topics such as wildlife, biodiversity, or natural resource interpretation. ## Exclusions

The aim of the scheme is to promote and popularize the Sanskrit language and literature by encouraging poets who compose and recite poetry in Sanskrit.
## Benefits An honorarium of ₹2501/- is given to each invited poet.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The fifteen Sanskrit poets from Uttarakhand and other states, who compose and recite poetry in Sanskrit, are invited.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline The Kavi Sammelan is organized by the Uttarakhand Sanskrit Academy to commemorate national and state festivals. The program coordinator prepares a list of renowned Sanskrit poets from schools, colleges, and universities across the country. The proposed list is submitted to the competent authority for approval. Based on the approved list, poets recommended by the Secretary of the Uttarakhand Sanskrit Academy are invited to recite their poetry.

Each eligible beneficiary will receive an amount of up to ₹50,000/-, subject to budgetary provisions. The disbursement of assistance is contingent upon the applicant satisfying the stipulated eligibility criteria and the successful submission of required documentation.
***A DigiLocker account is required for application. Please refer to the Application Process section for details.*** ## Benefits An amount of up to ₹50,000/- will be provided to each beneficiary, subject to budget provision. ## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must belong to a Other Backward Class (OBC) community of Assam. - The applicant must have recently qualified for the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) Preliminary Examination held in 2025. - The annual income of the applicant's parents/guardians must not exceed ₹5,00,000/-. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Signup to DigiLocker** **Step 1:** Visit the [_DigiLocker Portal_](https://www.digilocker.gov.in/) or download the DigiLocker Mobile App ([_Android_](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.digilocker.android) _/_ [_iOS_](https://itunes.apple.com/in/app/digilocker/id1320618078)). **Step 2:** Click _"_[_Login/Register_](https://www.digilocker.gov.in/web/signup)_"_ and provide these details: Full name, Gender, Mobile number, Email ID, and Aadhaar Number. You'll receive the following confirmation message: "Form Submitted Successfully!". **Step 5:** For future reference, click "Print" to print the form or to download the filled form as a PDF file. metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage and motivate students belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) communities who are studying in Sanskrit schools from Class 6 to Class 12 in Uttarakhand by providing financial scholarships to support their education.

page_content:
# Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Sanskrit Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Students **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Sanskrit, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Sanskrit Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Students” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Sanskrit Academy, Haridwar, under the Department of Sanskrit Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage and motivate students belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) communities who are studying in Sanskrit schools from Class 6 to Class 12 in Uttarakhand by providing financial scholarships to support their education.
## Benefits **Scholarship Amount:** - Students from Class 6 to Class 12 will be provided ₹3,012/- per year, at the rate of ₹251/- per month.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a student studying in Class 6 to Class 12 at Sanskrit schools in Uttarakhand. 1. The student must belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe community. 1. A total of 200 students studying in Class 6 to Class 12 at Sanskrit schools in the state will be eligible for the scholarship. 1. The student must possess a valid caste certificate issued by a competent authority.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Institutional students belonging to Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe, studying in Sanskrit schools or colleges, who possess a caste certificate, Aadhaar card, and bank account, will submit their documents to the concerned Principal. The Principal will forward the documents along with their recommendation to the Assistant Director, Sanskrit Education, Uttarakhand, who will then send it to the Director. After the Director’s approval, the scholarship will be disbursed online by the Uttarakhand Sanskrit Academy.

page_content:
# Samuhik Kanya Vivah Sahayata Yojana (UKBOCWWB) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Group Marriage, Construction Worker, Daughter, Labour | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Samuhik Kanya Vivah Sahayata Yojana" was launched by the Labour Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and support for the marriage of daughters of registered construction workers through organized group marriage events. The scheme is implemented by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Uttarakhand. ## Benefits - ₹61,000/- will be provided as financial assistance to registered construction workers for the marriage of their daughters. - ₹10,000/- per couple will be paid to the organizer to cover expenses incurred in organizing the mass marriage. - ₹5,000/- will be provided to each bride and groom for purchasing their wedding attire.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a registered construction worker. 1. In the case of a mass marriage, registration must be completed at least 15 days prior to the scheduled date of the marriage.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - via CSC - Applications for mass marriage can be submitted at least 15 days prior to the scheduled date. - It is mandatory to attach the necessary documents with the application form. The daughter and the proposed groom should be at least 18 years and 21 years of age, respectively. Aadhar authentication of the daughter of the construction worker is required under the mass marriage scheme. A self-attested copy of the birth certificate, school leaving certificate, or family register verifying age must be submitted, and the marriage card should be certified and verified by the local village head, tehsildar, member, or councilor. - Additionally, a self-written certificate stating that the applicant has not received assistance from any other department in this regard must be provided.

metadata.schemeName: Research Fellowship Scheme for Scheduled Tribe Candidates
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the Scheduled Tribe candidates from Scheduled Areas and the Saharia Area of Rajasthan to register themselves as research scholars with all recognized Central/State/Deemed/Private University located in any part of India for pursuing Ph.D. Programme.

page_content:
# Research Fellowship Scheme for Scheduled Tribe Candidates

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Fellowship, PhD, Student, Scheduled Tribe, Research Scholar | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Research Fellowship Scheme for Scheduled Tribe Candidates" was launched by the Tribal Area Development Department, Government of Rajasthan. The scheme aims to support the Scheduled Tribe candidates from Scheduled Areas and the Saheria Project Area to register themselves as research scholars with all recognized Central/State/Deemed/Private University located in any part of India for pursuing Ph.D. Programme. Under this scheme, monthly fellowships and contingency grants are provided to tribal research scholars enrolled in Ph.D. programmes at recognized universities across India. The scheme is implemented by the M.L. Verma Tribal Research & Training Institute, Udaipur.
***Area's Cover:***
Banswara , Chittorgarh, Dungarpur , Pali, Sirohi, Udaipur, Baran, Rajsamand, Pratapgarh.

## Benefits
***Financial Assistance:***

  - The selected scholar shall be paid @ ₹15,000/- per month.
  - A contingency grant of ₹40,000/- shall be given to the candidate for meeting the recurring expenditure viz. books/ Journals/Traveling/Stationery etc.

***Tenure:***
The tenure of the scholarship shall be for a period of maximum five years from the date of sanction from the Tribal Research Institute or completion of Ph.D. whichever is earlier.
***Extension of Fellowship Term & Final Payments:***
The scholarship term shall not be extended under any circumstances. If, per chance, the candidate fails to complete his/her Ph.D work within the period of five years, the final installment of scholarship (equivalent to six month and last installment of contingency) shall be withheld until the Ph.D. is awarded to the candidate.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
   1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe community.
   1. The applicant should be a resident of Scheduled Area of Rajasthan or a resident of Shahbad and Kishanganj tehsils of Baran district (Saheria Project Area).
   1. The applicant should have completed Post-graduation with at least 50% marks from a recognized university.
   1. The applicant should be registered in a recognized Central/State/Deemed/Private University in India for pursuing a Ph.D. programme.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
***Application Process:***
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should contact the M.L. Verma Tribal Research & Training Institute, Udaipur and request a copy of the prescribed format of the application form and collect filled-in applications.
**OR**
The interested applicant downloads the [application form](https://jankalyanfile.rajasthan.gov.in//Content/UploadFolder/Advertisement/Achievements/2024/Dec/29138_ACH_0061a449-cb9d-46ae-a833-6bfe20d5e27a.pdf) from the official website. 
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Supervisor, Head of Department, and Dean of the institution.
***Post-Application Process:***
**Step 1:** The Screening Committee (comprising Director, Dy. Director, a nominated representative, and Associate Professor of TRI) will evaluate the applications based on faculty-wise merit and conduct personal interviews.
**Step 2:** Final selection will be based on overall competence and recommendation of the committee.
**Note:** Submit the completed application in the month of July, when the notification is released through newspapers and the departmental website.

# Pension Scheme to the Dependents (Husband/Wife) of Identified State Agitators, Other than those Who either went to Jail for 7 Days or were Injured During the Uttarakhand State Movement, after the Death of the Agitator **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Uttarakhand State Movement, Pension, Agitator | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Pension Scheme to the Dependents (Husband/Wife) of Identified State Agitators, Other than those Who either went to Jail for 7 Days or were Injured During the Uttarakhand State Movement" scheme is implemented by the Police Department under the Department of Home, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension to the dependents (husband/wife) of such identified state agitators who do not fall under the category of agitators jailed for 7 days or injured during the movement, and who were neither receiving agitator pension or any other government pension, nor employed in government service.
## Benefits **Pension Amount:** ₹4,500/- per month
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be the dependent (husband/wife) of a deceased identified state agitator. 1. The deceased agitator must not fall under the category of those who went to jail for 7 days or were injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement. 1. The deceased agitator must not have been receiving agitator pension or any other pension from a government source, nor employed in government service.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - The application must be submitted to the office of the District Magistrate of the concerned district. - The required documents must be attached with the application form, and the pension will be sanctioned only after verification by the District Magistrate.

The "Awarding Teleeducation Scholarships To Afghan Students" scheme under e-VidyaBharati Network Project, launched by the Ministry of External Affairs in October 2019, aims to provide 1000 scholarships annually to Afghan students for pursuing various UGC-approved online Undergraduate and Postgraduate programs from Indian universities. It promotes India as a global hub for higher education and enables Afghan nationals to receive quality education in fields such as Business Administration, Commerce, Computer Science, Arts, and more.
> **Tenure of scholarship:**

It should be the endeavor of each student to complete the UG, PG, programmes within prescribed time period of 3 years, 2 years, respectively. However, any relaxation will be strictly as per UGC guidelines.

## Benefits
The scholarship amount covers the entire degree programme fee including:

  - Tuition fees,
  - Admission fees,
  - Examination fees,
  - E-content charges,
  - Other charges like registration fee, re-examination, and award of degree, etc.

> **Note:** 


  - The passed students are awarded Degree online and physical copies of degrees/certificates are also sent to Indian Mission in Kabul, and students need to collect from Indian Mission in Kabul.

## Eligibility Criteria
- The applicant must be a national of Afghanistan.
  - The applicant must possess a valid Afghan National ID or Passport.
  - The applicant must be between 18 to 35 years of age as on July 1 of the academic year.
  - The applicant must meet the minimum academic qualifications required by the respective Indian university for the chosen program.
  - The applicant must ensure proficiency in English to understand and complete the program, as the medium of instruction is English.
  - The applicant must apply only for one program under the e-VB project.
  - The applicant must not be enrolled in any other ongoing program under the e-VB project.

> **Note:**


  - Applicants must check the eligibility criteria/pre-requisites for admission to a particular programme/course on the respective university portal and then apply.
  - Students who have already obtained a degree under e-VB project (at the time of announcement of the new academic session) and willing to avail scholarship under e-VB project for pursuing another degree, may also apply afresh through iLearn portal to process their application

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
> **Registration of Learners at iLearn Portal:**

**Step 1:** Visit [iLearn ](https://ilearn.gov.in/)portal and Click "Login/Register".
**Step 2:** On the sign-up page, click on “Sign Up Now”. Enter Email ID and click “Send Verification Code”.
**Step 3:** Enter Verification Code sent to your mail ID and enter - New Password & Confirm New Password & Display Name & click "CREATE".
**Step 4:** Enter details like First Name, Last Name, Mobile Number, Country residing in currently and Learning Center and click on “I’M NOT A ROBOT”, then Click "Register". New User ID will be created for that particular Name and ID.
> **Selection of Programme and Universities:**

**Step 1:** Upon Login, students can explore programs based on degree type and category by clicking on “Explore Programmes”.
**Step 2:** Click on Browse more to get the More filters like- Course Duration, Course Exam Date, Course Term and Partner Institutions.
> **Submission of Enrolment form at University/HEI Portal:**

**Step 1:** Click on the course to select the particular university and the particular course where the page will be directed to the respective university's Signup/ Registration page.
**Step 2:** Click on “Click here for new Registration” to sign up. Enter the email ID and captcha and click on “Verify”
**Step 3:** Once verified click on Sign In and enter the below details and click on “Login”.
**Step 4:** Once Login Student will be redirected into University Application forms.
**Step 5:** Fill in all the tabs with required details and clock on submit to complete the enrollment form submission.
> **ICCR e-VB Alumni:**


  - Student should fill up the Alumni Form available on [iLearn ](http://www.ilearn.gov.in/)portal ICCR as well as on [India Alumni](http://www.indiaalumni.almaconnect.com/) portal after completing the course and before award of final degree. This will help alumni of e-VB to be in touch for future eVB activities and will also be helpful in future for Indian Missions/Posts abroad. to remain engaged with the Alumni.
> **Contact Us:**  support@ilearn.gov.in

page_content:
# Bicycle Distribution Scheme for Girl Students of Economically Weaker Section

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Women and Child | **Tags:** Girl Student, EWS, Bicycle | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The "Bicycle Distribution Scheme" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan, for girl students belonging to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) of Rajasthan. Under this scheme, free bicycles will be distributed to 5,800 girl students from the EWS category, who are studying in government schools from Class 6 to Class 8, to facilitate their commute between home and school.

## Benefits
Under this scheme, free bicycles will be distributed to girl students from the EWS category.
***Number of beneficiaries:***

1. Total: 5,800 beneficiaries
1. Number of Beneficiaries Class-wise:


- Class 6th: 1,933- Class 7th: 1,933- Class 8th: 1,934

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a girl student.
1. The applicant should be studying in Class 6, 7, or 8 in a government school in Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should belong to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) category.
1. The annual income of the applicant’s parents/guardian should be less than ₹1,00,000/-.
1. The applicant should have secured at least 60% marks in the previous examination.

**Note:** Preference will be given based on merit (marks obtained).

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
**Application Process:**
**Step 1:** To avail of the benefits of the scheme, the applicant needs to contact their respective school.
**Step 2:** Submit copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required) to the school.
**Step 3:** The school will visit the [Shala Darpan](https://rajshaladarpan.rajasthan.gov.in/SD2/BSP/Home/HomePage.aspx), Rajasthan Portal.
**Step 4:** Using the school&#39;s login credentials (Login ID and Password), the school will help the student to fill out and submit the application form. 
**Post-Application Process:**
**Step 1:** After verification, the Head of the Institution will forward the application to the concerned District Education Officer (Headquarters), Primary/Secondary Education.
**Step 2:** The District Education Officer (Headquarters), Primary/Secondary Education, will compile and forward all the applications from the district to the Directorate of Secondary Education, Rajasthan, Bikaner, for further action.

metadata.schemeName: Merit cum Means Scholarship: Polytechnic Institutions
metadata.briefDescription: "Merit cum Means Scholarship: Polytechnic Institutions" is a scholarship scheme by the Technical Education Department, Government of Chhattisgarh. The scheme provides ₹600/- per month to eligible students for pursuing education from recognized Polytechnic Institutions in Chhattisgarh.

page_content:
# Merit cum Means Scholarship: Polytechnic Institutions **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Chhattisgarh | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Education, Student, Polytechnic, Institution | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description "Merit cum Means Scholarship: Polytechnic Institutions" is a scholarship scheme by the Technical Education Department, Government of Chhattisgarh. The scheme provides ₹600/- per month to eligible students for pursuing education from recognized Polytechnic Institutions in Chhattisgarh. To be eligible, the student must have passed the 10+2 examination or the 10th/12th examination from any recognised institution located in Chhattisgarh with a minimum of 45% marks. The total annual income of the student's father/guardian should not exceed ₹ 2,50,000/-. ## Benefits Scholarship of ₹600/- per month. ## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a native resident of Chhattisgarh. - The applicant must be a Student. - The applicant must be currently studying in a recognised Polytechnic Institution in Chhattisgarh. - The applicant must have passed the 10+2 examination or the 10th/12th examination from any recognised institution located in Chhattisgarh with a minimum of 45% marks. - The total annual income of the student's father/guardian should not exceed ₹ 2,50,000/-.
**OTHER CONDITIONS** - Without special approval from the government, no student will receive more than one scholarship at the same time. However, if the institution where he is studying has given him any fee concession, then he will be entitled to continue receiving it. - If any scholarship becomes vacant during its duration, then the approving authority can give such scholarships for its unexpired period to the next eligible and deserving candidate from the merit list. - Only those students will be eligible to receive scholarships who have passed the qualifying examination from any testing body of Chhattisgarh. But children of such permanent government employees of Chhattisgarh can be exempted from this condition who are on deputation to the Government of India or any other state government. - Such students will not be eligible to receive scholarships who are in full-time employment. In this regard, only one concession can be given that any such student who is regularly studying in a recognised institution and is receiving any scholarship can be allowed to do part-time work. - In special cases not covered under the provisions of these rules, the government will provide special scholarships to eligible students at the rate prescribed for each course of study, based on poverty and merit. The total annual expenditure incurred in this regard will not exceed the budget limit. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the **Office of the Principal of the Institution** and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the institute staff. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the staff. The Principal will verify the documents and forward the application to the Directorate for approval (New applications) or process the renewal (for existing beneficiaries). **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the staff to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Hunar Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free training in trades such as sewing, embroidery, knitting, plumbing, electronics, and in Information Technology fields including computer hardware, software, networking, accounting, and more, to individuals belonging to minority communities.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Hunar Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Minority Community, Free Training, Skill Development, Self-employment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Mukhyamantri Hunar Yojana” was launched by the Minority Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to enhance employability and self-reliance among minority community individuals by offering free training in various traditional and modern trades.
## Benefits Under this scheme, free training is provided along with an honorarium during the training period. The honorarium is paid as follows: - ₹2,000/- for 100 hours of training, - ₹2,500/- for 150 hours of training, - ₹4,000/- for 250 hours of training, - ₹4,500/- for 300 hours of training, The training is conducted through implementing agencies, and the honorarium is disbursed based on attendance. A minimum of 90% attendance is mandatory.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a man or woman belonging to a minority community (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Parsi, Buddhist, or Jain). 1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 and 45 years. 1. The applicant must have completed education either from a Government school or from a Madrasa. 1. For traditional training courses such as sewing, embroidery, plumbing, electronics, knitting, etc., the applicant must be at least Class 5 pass or literate. 1. For Information Technology courses (Computer Hardware, Software, Networking, Accounting, etc.), the applicant must have passed at least High School. 1. The annual family income should not exceed ₹3,50,000/- in rural areas and ₹4,50,000/- in urban areas.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - Under this scheme, training is provided through voluntary organizations. The Minority Welfare Department publishes advertisements inviting applications for training, after which interested candidates can obtain the application form from the Minority Welfare Office. - The completed application form must be submitted to the office along with Aadhaar card, permanent residence certificate, minority certificate, income certificate, and educational qualification certificate. Applicants are then called for an interview by the selection committee constituted at the district level under the chairmanship of the District Minority Welfare Officer or the District Social Welfare Officer, who also serves as the ex-officio District Manager. - At the time of the interview, candidates are required to present the original copies of all their documents for verification. After selection, the training is provided by the designated institute. - Training programs are organized every year, and applicants may also submit their forms to the Minority Welfare Office in advance, even before the advertisement, so that their applications can be considered when the training sessions commence.

metadata.schemeName: Incentive Scheme for Meritorious Students of Economically Backward Class of General Category
metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a one-time financial assistance of ₹15,000/- along with a certificate of appreciation is awarded to top 100 meritorious students of Class 10 & each stream of Class 12, who are listed in state-level merit list of Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education, Ajmer.

page_content:
# Incentive Scheme for Meritorious Students of Economically Backward Class of General Category

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Student, Meritorious, Economically Backward Class | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The "Incentive Scheme for Meritorious Students of Economically Backward Class of General Category" was launched by the Education Department, Government of Rajasthan. Under this scheme, a one-time financial assistance of ₹15,000/- along with a certificate of appreciation is awarded to the top 100 meritorious students of Class 10 and each stream (Science, Commerce, Arts) of Class 12, who are listed in the state-level merit list of the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education (RBSE), Ajmer. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Secondary Education, Rajasthan, Bikaner.

## Benefits
> **Financial Assistance:**


  - One-time financial assistance of ₹15,000/- is provided to economically backward students from the general category studying in government and private schools.

> **Certificate of Appreciation:**


  - An official certificate is awarded along with the monetary benefit.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
   1. The applicant should be a student.
   1. The applicant should belong to the economically backward class from the general category.
   1. The applicant should be studying in a government or private school.
   1. The applicant should have passed Class 10th, Praveshika, Class 12th (Science/Commerce/Arts), or Varishta Upadhyay examination conducted by Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education (RBSE), Ajmer.   1. The applicant should have secured a minimum of 75% marks in the qualifying examination.
   1. The applicant’s parents’ combined annual income from all sources should be less than ₹2,50,000.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
> **Application Process:**

**Step 1:** To avail of the benefits of the scheme, students should fill out the online application form through the institution head (principal) of their respective school.
**Step 2:** Eligible students are identified by the head of their institution.
**Step 3:** Submit copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required) to the respective school.
**Step 4:** The school will visit the [Shala Darpan, Rajasthan](https://rajshaladarpan.rajasthan.gov.in/SD4/Home/Public2/Default.aspx) Portal.
**Step 5:** Using the school's login credentials (Login ID and Password), the school will fill and submit the application form. 
> **Post-Application Process:**

**Step 1:** The institution head forwards the online application to the concerned District Education Officer (DEO) Headquarters (Primary/Secondary Education).
**Step 2:** The District Education Officer compiles and forwards the verified applications of all eligible students from the district to the Directorate of Secondary Education, Rajasthan, Bikaner.
**Step 3:** Post-verification, the incentive amount is disbursed to the students&#39; bank accounts.

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Asahaya Punarwas Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and rehabilitation support to destitute individuals who are orphaned, abandoned by their parents, or have no one to care for them. Beneficiaries receive one-time financial aid and support for admission to day-care centers or old-age homes.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Asahaya Punarwas Yojana

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Orphan, Senior Citizen, Rehabilitation, Destitute, Day-care Centers, Old-age Homes | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The "Mukhyamantri Asahaya Punarwas Yojana" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Rajasthan. The scheme aims to provide financial aid and rehabilitation support to to destitute individuals who are completely dependent, orphaned, abandoned by their parents, or have no one to care for them. Under this scheme, men and women are provided one-time financial assistance and support for admission to day-care centers or old-age homes.

## Benefits
> **One-Time Financial Assistance:**


- Under this scheme, eligible women and men receive a one-time financial assistance of up to ₹2,000/-.

> **Admission to Day-Care Centers and Old-Age Homes:**


- Admission into day-care centers and old-age homes run by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department and funded by the state and central government.

> **Provision for Pension Approval:**


- If the destitute applicant qualifies for Old Age Pension, Widow Pension, or Disability Pension, then the pension will be sanctioned within one month of identification.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a resident of the Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should belong to one of the following categories:


- Destitute individual with no one to care for them.
- Individual abandoned by their parents.
- Orphaned, destitute or completely dependent individual.

**Note:** The applicant should not already be receiving benefits under pension schemes (for financial aid support).

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
> **Application Process:**

**Step 1:** The applicant may submit application on a plain paper to the district collector of their respective district.
**Step 2:** In the application, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Upon receipt, the application is scrutinized and approved by the Zila Parishad (District Council).

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Hunar Vikas Yojana- Higher Education/Technical Education
metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, the State Government provides financial assistance to eligible boys and girls enrolled under the Palanhar Scheme to pursue higher or technical education, based on their qualifications and interest in employment-oriented courses.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Hunar Vikas Yojana- Higher Education/Technical Education

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Skills & Employment, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Higher Education, Technical Education, Career Opportunity, Student, Palanhar | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The "Mukhyamantri Hunar Vikas Yojana – Higher Education/Technical Education" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Rajasthan, with the objective of providing technical or higher education to beneficiary boys and girls under the State Government’s Palanhar Scheme, to help them become self-reliant. The scheme aims to make every possible effort to ensure employment opportunities and a dignified livelihood for these beneficiaries upon completion of their higher or technical education.
Under this scheme, the State Government provides financial assistance to eligible boys and girls enrolled under the Palanhar Scheme to pursue higher or technical education, based on their qualifications and interest in employment-oriented courses.
The scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Rajasthan, at the state level and by the Deputy Director/Assistant Director, Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, at the district level.

## Benefits
> **Higher Education /Technical Education Benefits:**


- Financial assistance for career-oriented higher or technical education (graduation/post-graduation courses). 

> **Mode of Disbursement:**


- Reimbursement of the actual course fee through bank account transfer.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a beneficiary under the Palanhar Scheme of Rajasthan.
   1. The applicant should have completed 15 years of age.
   1. The applicant’s maximum age should not exceed 21 years or till course completion (whichever is earlier).
   1. The applicant should be pursuing education from a university/college/technical educational institution recognized by the Government of India/State Government.
   1. Financial assistance is applicable for regular higher or technical education at the graduate or postgraduate level.
   1. The applicant should not be receiving any scholarships or grants for higher/technical education from the Central or State Government.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
> **Application Process:**

**Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the [application form](https://sje.rajasthan.gov.in/siteadmin/Uploads/202402231257087804.pdf) from the official website. 
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Deputy Director/Assistant Director, Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, at the district level.
**Step 4:** After verification, course fees will be reimbursed to the student’s bank account.
**Note:** Apply for fee reimbursement within 3 months of admission.

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Hunar Vikas Yojana- Professional/Technical Training
metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, vocational/technical training is provided to Palanhar beneficiary boys & girls through recognized training providers such as the Rajasthan Skill & Livelihood Development Corporation, Rajasthan Knowledge Corporation Ltd., it is etc. recognized by the State or Central Govt.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Hunar Vikas Yojana- Professional/Technical Training

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Professional Training, Technical Education, Skill Development, Vocational Training, Palanhar | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The "Mukhyamantri Hunar Vikas Yojana - Professional/Technical Training" scheme was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Rajasthan, with the objective of providing vocational and technical skill development training to beneficiary boys and girls under the State Government’s Palanhar Scheme, to make them self-reliant. The scheme aims to make every possible effort to provide employment opportunities and a respectable livelihood to these beneficiaries after the completion of their training.
Under this scheme, vocational/technical training is provided to Palanhar beneficiary boys and girls through recognized training providers such as the Rajasthan Skill and Livelihood Development Corporation (RSLDC), Rajasthan Knowledge Corporation Limited (RKCL), Jan Shikshan Sansthan, or industrial training institutes recognized by the State or Central Government.
The scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Rajasthan, at the state level and by the Deputy Director/Assistant Director, Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, at the district level.

## Benefits
***Professional/Technical Training Benefits:***

  - Vocational/technical training will be provided to Palanhar beneficiary boys/girls through recognized training providers by the Rajasthan Skill and Livelihood Development Corporation / Rajasthan Knowledge Corporation Limited (RKCL) / Jan Shikshan Sansthan / industrial training institutes recognized by the state government/central government.
  - The State Government will reimburse the prescribed fees and other expenses to the training provider institute for the related program. 
  - If the boy/girl wants to avail hostel or any other prescribed facility/fee (mess fee, stationery and dress fee) of the concerned institute, then that will also be reimbursed.
  - A maximum of 2 training programmes can be availed under this scheme, provided the beneficiary is below 21 years of age or till the completion of the respective course.
  - The boy / girl receiving training under the scheme will be given a training certificate by the concerned institute / training provider.

**Note:** Fees and other expenses will be provided directly to the concerned training institute after admission of the boy / girl in the respective programme.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a beneficiary under the Palanhar Scheme of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should have completed 15 years of age.
1. The applicant’s maximum age should not exceed 21 years, or till course completion (whichever is earlier).

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
> **Application Process:**

***To avail of the benefits of the scheme, the applicant needs to contact their recognized training institution.***
**Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the [application form](https://sje.rajasthan.gov.in/siteadmin/Uploads/202402231257087804.pdf) from the official website. 
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the recognized training institution.
**Step 4:** The recognized training institution forwards the student&#39;s application to the District Officer, Social Justice and Empowerment Department, with the training program details.
> **Post-Application Process:**

**Step 1:** Verification and approval are to be completed within one month.
**Step 2:** Fees and additional costs will be reimbursed directly to the institution.

metadata.schemeName: Union Territory of Lakshadweep Pension Scheme for Old Age
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500/- to senior citizens in the UT. The scheme covers persons above 60 years of age who do not have any source of income.

page_content:
# Union Territory of Lakshadweep Pension Scheme for Old Age **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Lakshadweep | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Old Age, Pension, Senior Citizen | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Union Territory of Lakshadweep Pension Scheme for Old Age" was introduced by the Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs Department, Union Territory of Lakshadweep, aims to provide monthly financial assistance to senior citizens in the UT. The scheme covers persons above 60 years of age who do not have any source of income. The District Panchayat and Village (Dweep) Panchayats (VDPs) of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep implement the scheme to ensure smooth processing and disbursement. The pension amount is directly transferred to the beneficiary’s bank account. ## Benefits - Eligible beneficiaries receive a pension of ₹1,500/- per month (₹18,000/- per annum). **Mode of Disbursement:** - The pension amount is disbursed directly to the beneficiary’s bank account. **Frequency of Disbursement** - The pension amount is disbursed on a monthly basis. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep. 1. The applicant should be above 60 years of age. 1. The applicant’s monthly income should not exceed ₹1,500/- (₹18,000 per annum). 1. The applicant should not have any source of income. 1. The applicant should not be a beneficiary of any other similar pension scheme provided by the government. **Note:** Priority is given to applicants who do not have financial support from family members. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Application Process:** **Step 1:** The eligible applicants may collect the application form from the nearest Village (Dweep) Panchayat office. **Step 2:** Carefully fill out the application form and attach all supporting documents. **Step 3:** Submit the completed application form along with the required documents to the Executive Officer at the Village (Dweep) Panchayat office. **Post-Application Process:** **Step 1:** The application is verified by the members of the Evaluation Committee of the respective Village (Dweep) Panchayat. **Step 2:** After successful verification, the application is forwarded to the Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat (HQ), Kavaratti, for further processing. **Step 3:** The forwarded application undergoes re-verification by District Panchayat officials. **Step 4:** Upon successful re-verification at the District Panchayat level, the list of eligible pensioners is prepared through the Public Financial Management System (PFMS) and submitted to the Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs Department for payment processing. **Step 5:** Payments are made through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode, money is paid through Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Agriculture, Farmer, Crop Protection, Crop Storage | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The "Farm Storage Structure Scheme" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to provides financial assistance to farmers for constructing crop storage structures on their farms. It ensures protection from unforeseen weather conditions like rain and storms and enables farmers to store their produce until market prices are favorable.

## Benefits
**Name of the Component****Standard of Assistance****Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming  Benefits**Crop Storage Structure50% of the total cost or ₹75,000/- whichever is lessOnly once

## Eligibility Criteria
- The applicant must be a land-holding farmer.
- The applicant must belong to the Gujarat state.

**Note:**

- In case of joint account, beneficiary farmers shall be entitled to benefit only one of the holders of their land mentioned in 8-A subject to the consent of other account holders.

## How to Apply

**Step 7:** Take a print out of the confirmed application.

**Step 1:** After applying, they must print the application, sign or provide a thumb impression, and keep a copy.

**Step 3:** The farmer must construct the storage structure as per government rules within the specified timeframe.
**Step 4:** After construction, the signed application and assistance case paper must be submitted to the concerned office for financial support.
> **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_Contacts.aspx).

metadata.schemeName: Prime Minister Early Career Research Grant
metadata.briefDescription: This programme is initiated by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) to assist researchers to initiate their research career in a new institution with a flexible budget and progressive initiatives for ease of doing research.

page_content:
# Prime Minister Early Career Research Grant

**Ministry:** Ministry Of Science And Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Science, IT & Communications | **Tags:** Research Grant, Researcher, ANRF, Research, PhD, Science, Engineering | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The “Prime Minister Early Career Research Grant” is a program initiated by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), under the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India. It aims to assist researchers to initiate their research career in a new institution with a flexible budget and progressive initiatives for ease of doing research.
**Objectives:**

  - To empower and support the early career researchers in their pursuit of research excellence, providing them with an enabling environment to effectively conduct research with ease and flexibility.
  - To contribute in positioning the country as a global leader in science and technology as well as creating a vibrant research ecosystem.
  - To produce research of the highest quality, bringing in new skills, breakthrough ideas and the zest to explore new frontiers, thereby expanding the boundaries of knowledge.

## Benefits
***Nature & duration of support:***

  - Research rant up to ₹60 lakh plus overheads for a period of three years.
  - The measures for ease of doing research include flexibility to utilize resources under recurring head; flexibility in manpower recruitment; enhanced travel, contingency and overhead charges; and support for expenses related to open access publications and patent filing charges.
  - International travel for project related activities is also permitted.
  - Maximum of 700 grants would be awarded per year across all subject areas.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be an Indian citizen.
   1. Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) or Persons of Indian Origin (PIO) working as regular employees in any publicly funded and recognized R&D laboratories/institutions in India are eligible to apply as Principal Investigator (PI), in collaboration with an Indian Co-PI, provided they meet the eligibility criteria specified by ANRF (ANRF Funding Guidelines for PIO/OCI).
   1. The applicant should hold a Ph.D. degree in Science or Engineering or an MD/MS/MDS/MVSc degree.
   1. The applicant should be in a regular academic/research position at a recognized academic institution, national laboratory, or any other recognized R&D institution.
   1. The applicant is eligible to apply within two years of joining the institution.
   1. The upper age limit is 42 years, with a relaxation of three years for SC/ST/OBC/Physically Challenged and women candidates.
   1. The applicant should not have received funding under YSS, ECR, SRG, CRG (erstwhile EMR), EMEQ, or any other project grant from the erstwhile SERB or ANRF.

***Other conditions***

  - An applicant is eligible to apply only one proposal during a call.
  - Only a one-time career grant will be provided.
  - Extension of the project tenure is not permitted under this programme.

***Termination and transfer of the project:***

   1. If any Principal Investigator (PI) wishes to terminate the project, they shall inform ANRF immediately with proper justifications. The implementing institute should not incur any expenditure from the date of termination of the project or the date of resignation of the PI. The institute must also arrange for the submission of relevant documents.
   1. ANRF reserves the right to terminate the project at any stage if it is convinced that (i) appropriate progress is not being made (ii) the grant has not been utilized properly (iii) furnishing of false information or suppression of factual information.
   1. Projects sanctioned under this programme cannot be transferred to any other person/s.
   1. Transfer of approved/sanctioned PM ECRG project to another institution will be considered only in the following cases: (i) From private/public/government institution to any other public/government institution (ii) General administrative transfers in government or public funded institutions. Change of institute will not be considered in any other cases.

## Exclusions
1. Research Associates, Post doctoral Fellows, Ad-hoc faculties, Guest faculties, Visiting Scientists, Consultants, Project Fellows and faculty members whose contract is renewed every year are not eligible.
   1. Co-PIs are not allowed except in the case of Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) or Person of Indian Origin (PIO).

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
**Step 1:** Applicants should first register in the ANRF online portal, [Click here to register](https://www.anrfonline.in/ANRF/Registration).
**Step 2:** After log-in, applicants are required to fill in all the mandatory fields under User Profile section, which includes Bio-data, Photo, Institute address, etc.
**Step 3:** Some of the details of a proposal like Project Title (max 500 characters), Project summary (max 3000 characters), Keywords (max 6), Objectives of the project (max 1500 characters), Expected output and outcome of the proposal (max 1500 characters), Budget (Research Personnel, Consumables, Travel, Equipment, Contingency, Overheads) have to be entered at the time of proposal submission.
**Step 4:** Other relevant information of the proposal has to be uploaded as a single PDF file, not more than 10 MB, as a Technical Document (TD). [Download Template](https://www.anrfonline.in/ANRF/AbstractFilePath?FileType=E&FileName=OTD_ECRG.pdf&PathKey=DOCUMENT_TEMPLATE)
***Mode of application & selection***

  - The Call for applications will be notified through the website- [https://www.anrfonline.in](https://www.anrfonline.in).  - The application should be submitted online at [https://www.anrfonline.in](https://www.anrfonline.in) (Note : Already registered PIs with the SERBONLINE portal ([www.serbonline.in](https://www.serbonline.in)) may Login using the same credentials).  - Selection will be based on the recommendations of Expert Committee.

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Kerala | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Garden, Environment, Plant, Irrigation, Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Arka Vertical Garden" by the State Horticulture Mission-Kerala aims to popularize user-friendly vertical garden structures designed and developed by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) - Indian Institute of Horticultural Research, Bengalaru under Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY). The scheme helps in attaining self-sufficiency in the production of safe-to-eat vegetables ensuring food and nutritional security for families. It is open to residents of Kerala State who can apply for a single unit of Arka Vertical Garden structure. The scheme is implemented by the State Horticulture Mission-Kerala.

## Benefits
**Total Cost of One Unit of Arka Vertical Garden:** ₹22,100/-.
**Subsidy Amount per Unit:** ₹15,525/-.
**Beneficiary Contribution:** ₹6,575/- per unit.
The beneficiaries are also provided with the following - 

- One unit of Arka Vertical Garden structure of one square meter area that can be installed.
- The structure includes 4 tiers with 16 pots, and 80 kilograms of enriched planting medium (coir pith).
- Seeds of various crops like spinach, chilli, palak, amaranthus, brinjal, cluster beans, etc..
- Plant nutrition and protection materials.
- Water storage facility with 25-litre capacity.
- Drip irrigation system.
- The structure has wheels attached, allowing it to be moved according to sunlight availability.

## Eligibility Criteria
- The applicant must be a resident of Kerala.
- The applicant must not have availed Arka Vertical Garden structure during the previous year.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
> **Registration Process**

**Step 1:** Visit the[ Official Website](https://www.serviceonline.gov.in/login.do) of ServicePlus. In the top right corner of the homepage, click "[Register](https://www.serviceonline.gov.in/citizenRegistration.html)".
**Step 2:** In the Registration Form, the following fields are mandatory: Full Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, Password, State, and Captcha Code.
**Step 3:** Fill in all the mandatory fields. If required, verify your Email ID and Mobile Number via OTP.
**Step 4:** When creating the password, ensure the password meets security requirements.
**Step 5:** Agree to abide by the Terms of Use outlined by ServicePlus, then click "Submit".
**NOTE 1:** The password should be at least '9' characters with at least one special character (!@#$%^&*), one numeric, one small case and one upper case letter.
**NOTE 2:** Don't repeat the same character more than 2 times consecutively, and don't enter in alphabetical order.
> **Application Process**

**Step 1:** Visit the [Official Website](https://www.serviceonline.gov.in/login.do) of ServicePlus. In the top right corner of the homepage, click "[Login](https://www.serviceonline.gov.in/loginWindow.do)". 
Provide the Login ID & Password, agree to abide by the Terms of Use outlined by ServicePlus, then click on ‘Login’.
**Step 2:** After login, expand the left pane, click on ‘Apply for Services', then click "View all available services". A list of all the available services will be displayed. Filter the services by State/UT and/or by Name of the Scheme.
**Step 3:** Click on the scheme you intend to apply for. You will be taken to the online application form of the scheme. In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields, fill in the captcha code, and click "Submit" to submit the application.
_*Remit the beneficiary contribution of ₹6,575/- per unit in advance along with the application through online mode_
> **Post-Application Processes**

**Step 1:** The State Horticulture Mission-Kerala will select beneficiaries based on the priority order of application submission. The selected beneficiaries will be notified.
**Step 2:** The beneficiary must be present at the installation site when the Arka Vertical Garden structure is delivered. Submit the duly filled application form with Aadhar Number at the time of installation. The structure will be installed and set up at the beneficiary's premises
_*Applications will be prioritized based on their order of submission._
_*The beneficiary must cooperate with periodic inspections conducted by the State Horticulture Mission._
_*The structure must be used only for the purposes outlined in the project guidelines._
_*Any misuse may result in the beneficiary having to refund the subsidy amount._

# Grant on Passing the Written Examination of Competitive Examinations for Recruitment in Armed Forces

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Grant, Coaching, Ex-servicemen, Competitive Examinations, Armed Forces | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Grant on Passing the Written Examination of Competitive Examinations for Recruitment in Armed Forces" was introduced by the Department of Sainik Welfare, Government of Rajasthan. Under this scheme, a grant of ₹15,000/- is provided from the Amalgamated Fund to the children of ex-servicemen who pass the written examination of CDS, NDA, IMA, OTA, Air Force, or Naval Academy, for the purpose of coaching. This scheme is applicable to applications received on or after 1st July, 2020.

## Benefits

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be the child of an ex-serviceman.

page_content:
# Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for the Children of Parents/Guardians Engaged in Unclean and Hazardous Occupations - Goa

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Pre Matric, Scholarship, Unclean, Hazardous Occupation, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The "Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for the Children of Parents/Guardians Engaged in Unclean and Hazardous Occupations" is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme implemented by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to support, through financial assistance, parents of children belonging to Other Disadvantaged Categories for education of their wards studying at the Pre-Matric stage so that their participation improves, the incidence of drop-out especially in the transition from the primary to the next level and elementary to the secondary stage is minimized, they perform better and have a better chance of progressing to the Post-matric stage of education.

## Benefits
***Assistance:***
With effect from 2022-23, the students shall be given a consolidated academic allowance, as follows:

- Day Scholar: ₹3,500/- per annum
- Hosteller: ₹8,000/- per annum (For Class III-X)

**Note:** In addition, a 10% extra allowance shall be given to Divyang (Disabled) students. The disability as defined under the relevant Section of Right of the persons with Disability Act, 2016. The appropriate Government shall designate persons, having requisite qualifications and experience, as certifying authorities, who shall be competent to issue the certificate of disability.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a student.
2.	The applicant should be a resident of Goa.
3.	The applicant’s parents/guardians should be engaged in an unclean or hazardous occupation.
4.	The student should be studying in Class I to X on a full-time basis.
5.	Scholarship will be admissible to the children/wards of parents/guardians who, irrespective of their caste/religion belong to one of the following categories:

  - Persons who are Manual Scavengers as defined under section 2(I) (g) of Manual Scavengers Act 2013
  - Tanners & Flayers;
  - Waste pickers and
  - Persons engaged in hazardous cleaning as defined in Section 2(1) (d) of [Manual Scavengers Act 2013](https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/8868/1/a2013-25msact.pdf). For the purpose of classification in this category, the eligible candidates will be required to submit a certificate from District Social Welfare officer/ identified officer of Local body/ Civic Agency/any such authority as designated by the State Government.
6.	There is no family income ceiling under this component of the Scheme.
7.	A scholarship holder under this scheme will not hold any other educational scholarship for the purpose of studying in class I to X. If awarded any other educational scholarship for studying in classes I to X, the students can avail of either of the two scholarships as per his/her choice and should inform the awarding authority to the Head of the Institution about the option made.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
**Step 1:** Visit the Official Website [https://cmscholarship.goa.gov.in/](https://cmscholarship.goa.gov.in/)
**Step 2:** Click on Registration. After Landing on the Registration Page, Select Student Registration and Click on “Click Here” to proceed.
**Step 3:** Fill out the [Student Registration Form](https://cmscholarship.goa.gov.in/fregister.aspx) to Register yourself (one-time registration) with your basic details. 
**Step 4:** Login using the user ID and password shared after the registration process (through SMS).
**Step 5:** After Registration, Apply for the scheme you are eligible for (as per the category selected by the student, a list of eligible schemes will be shown after they log in)
**Step 6:** Upload all required documents.
**Step 7:** Submit to School/Institution.

page_content:
# Devnarayan Pratibhawan Chhatra Protsahan Yojana

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Student, Special Backward Classes, Devnarayan | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The "Devnarayan Pratibhawan Chhatra Protsahan Yojana" scheme was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan. The scheme aims to encourage academic excellence among students belonging to Special Backward Classes (SBC). It provides an annual financial incentive to students pursuing education from Class 10th to postgraduate level in government schools or colleges.

## Benefits
- Financial assistance of ₹3,500/- per year per student.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The applicant’s family’s annual income should not exceed ₹2,00,000/-.
1. The applicant should be studying in a government school or college.
1. The applicant should have passed class 10th to graduation with a first division.1. The applicant should have obtained at least 48% marks in the postgraduation first year and be enrolled in the final year.
1. The applicant should belong to one of the Special Backward Class communities:


- Banjara, Baldiya, Labana
- Gadia-Lohar, Gadoliya
- Gurjar, Gujjar
- Raika, Raibari (Debasi)

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the principal of the respective government school/college where the student is enrolled and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the principal of the respective government school/college. 
***For detailed information regarding the scheme, please contact:***

  - District Office of the Social Justice and Empowerment Department in the concerned district.

# Financial assistance to Meritorious Scheduled Tribe Students who have Passed First Division from Board and University

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Student, Financial Assistance, Scheduled Tribe, Tribal, Higher Education | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The "Financial Assistance to Meritorious Scheduled Tribe Students Who Have Passed in First Division from Board and University" scheme was launched by the Higher Education Department, Government of Rajasthan. The objective of the scheme is to motivate meritorious Scheduled Tribe students of Rajasthan who are pursuing regular courses in colleges to achieve first division. The scheme is being implemented by the Commissionerate of College Education, Rajasthan, Jaipur, from the financial year 2023–24.

## Benefits
- A one-time financial incentive of up to ₹3,500/- will be provided to students, at the rate of ₹350/- per month for a maximum of ten months.

**Note:** The incentive amount will be directly transferred to the student's bank account linked with their Jan Aadhaar through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a student. 
   1. The applicant should have passed the 12th standard examination from the Madhyamik Shiksha Board/Central Board of Secondary Education with a first division, securing 60% or more marks.
   1. The applicant should have secured at least 48% marks in the first year examination to be eligible for the incentive in the second year.
   1. The applicant should have secured at least 48% marks in the second year examination to be eligible for the incentive in the third year.
   1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category.
   1. The applicant's parents/guardian/husband should not be income tax payers.
   1. The student should be a native of Rajasthan.
   1. There should be no gap in the applicant's studies after passing the board examination.
   1. The applicant should be enrolled as a regular student in general education in a government college.
   1. Students residing in government hostels are not eligible for benefits under this scheme.
   1. The applicant must possess a Jan Aadhaar Card and an Aadhaar Card.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online - via CSC
**Step 1:** The applicant should gather copies of the necessary documents needed to apply for the concerned scheme.
**Step 2:** The applicant should visit the nearest E-Mitra Center and complete the Biometric Verification Process.
**Step 3:** The applicant should ensure that the E-Mitra Center agent completes all mandatory fields in the application form and uploads copies of all required documents.
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

The scholarship is provided to students from Class 5th to 12th and higher education, who have passed their previous class and are studying in Madhya Pradesh. The benefits are granted once a year, provided the applicant does not receive a scholarship from any other department and applies in the prescribed format. ## Benefits **Class-wise Scholarship Amount:** - Class 5th to 8th – ₹2,000/- - Class 9th & 10th – ₹4,450/- - Class 11th & 12th – ₹4,700/- - ITI (Certificate Course) – ₹5,000/- - Polytechnic (Diploma Course) – ₹5,000/- - General Graduate (BA, B.Com, B.Sc, BBA) – ₹7,700/- - Engineering (BE/B.Tech) – ₹10,000/- - MBBS/BDS – ₹12,500/- - Pharmacy, Ayurvedic, Homeopathic (UG, PG, Diploma), Paramedical, Nursing Courses – ₹9,000/- - Law Courses – ₹10,000/- - General PG Courses (MA, M.Com, M.Sc, MBA) – ₹7,700/- - ME/M.Tech – ₹11,500/- - PGDM & Other Management Diplomas – ₹7,700/- ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a child of a worker employed in an industrial institution/establishment covered under the M.P. Labour Welfare Fund Act 1982. 1. The applicant should be studying as a regular student in an educational institution in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should have passed the previous class. 1. The applicant should not be receiving a scholarship from any other department. 1. The applicant should be studying in Class 5th to 12th, ITI, Polytechnic, General Graduate, Engineering, MBBS, BDS, Pharmacy, Paramedical, Nursing, Law, PG Courses, M.E./M.Tech, PGDM, or other management diploma courses. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Register on the Portal** **Step 1:** Visit the Lok Seva Guarantee Madhya Pradesh[ Portal.](https://mpedistrict.gov.in/MPL/Index.aspx) **Step 2:** Click on "[Citizen Registration](https://mpedistrict.gov.in/MPL/CitizenRegistration.aspx)" and fill in the required details. **Step 3**: Verify your mobile number by clicking "Click here to Verify your Mobile No." **Step 4**: After verification, you will receive a Registration Number on your registered mobile and email. **Login to the Portal** **Step 1:** Go to the Lok Seva Guarantee Madhya Pradesh[ Portal](https://mpedistrict.gov.in/MPL/Index.aspx) again. **Step 2:** Click on ["Login](https://mpedistrict.gov.in/MPL/Login.aspx)", enter your Email/Mobile/User ID and Password, and log in. **Step 3:** Select "Labour Department" and choose the scheme name. **Step 4:** Complete the [form](https://mpedistrict.gov.in/MPL/ServiceForms.aspx) by entering all required details (marked with *). **Step 5:** Upload all necessary documents, such as ID proof and other relevant certificates. **Step 6:** After completing the form and uploading the documents, click Submit
**Fee Structure** - No administrative fee is charged by the Board for availing this service. - If the application is submitted through a Public Service Centre, the applicant is required to pay the prescribed service fee as determined by the e-Governance/Public Service Centre. **Appeal Process** **First Appeal** - The first appeal must be submitted to the Assistant Welfare Commissioner, M.P. Labour Welfare Board. - The appeal will be reviewed and resolved within 30 working days. **Second Appeal** - If the applicant is dissatisfied with the decision of the First Appellate Authority, a Second Appeal can be filed. - The second appeal must be submitted to the Welfare Commissioner, M.P. Labour Welfare Board for final resolution.

It aims to provide financial assistance to farmers for constructing community-based water tanks/storage structures to ensure efficient water use through drip irrigation.

page_content:
# To Assist the Farmers for Construction of Community Base Water Tank/Storage Structure for Efficient Use of Water Through Drip Irrigation **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Agriculture, Farmer, Water Resources, Community Base Water Tank | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "To Assist the Farmers for Construction of Community Base Water Tank/Storage Structure for Efficient Use of Water Through Drip Irrigation" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to support farmers in protecting their crops from losses due to irregular rainfall and increasing the state's irrigated area. By constructing water tanks, farmers can optimize water usage, enhance irrigation efficiency, and boost agricultural production. ## Benefits
**Name of the Component****Standard of Assistance****Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits**Water Tank50% of the cost or ₹9,80,000/- whichever is lessOnce in a lifetime
## Eligibility Criteria > **For Individual Farmers:** - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must belong to the Gujarat state. - The water tank must be constructed on the applicant’s own farmland. - The farmer must have adopted the [Micro Irrigation System (MIS)](https://pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=2003188).- The farmer must cover at least one hectare of land per 75 cubic meters of water tank under MIS. > **For Group of Farmers:** - The group must consist of two or more farmers. - The group must belong to the Gujarat state. - The group must select one farmer as the leader, who will submit the application on behalf of the group. - The water tank must be constructed on the land of one of the farmers in the group. - Each member of the group must have adopted the [Micro Irrigation System (MIS)](https://pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=2003188).- The group must cover at least one hectare of land per 75 cubic meters of water tank under MIS. > **Note:** - No separate registration is required for the group; they only need to submit a mutual consent certificate. - The benefit is available only once in a lifetime (For both Individual and Group of Farmers). ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at I-Khedut Portal: [https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/) **Step 2:** On the home page, click on ‘Schemes’ and then click on ‘Agricultural Schemes’. **Step 3:** Now select the scheme, click on the ‘Apply’ button and an application page will open. **Step 4:** Click on "Apply New" button and submit a new application. **Step 5:** Click on the "Update Application" button to add corrections to the application. **Step 6:** Once the application is done, confirm it. **Step 7:** Take a print out of the confirmed application. **Step 8:** Applicant can also check their Application Status/View/Print/Upload Application details from the below link: [https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/public/frm_Applicant_Corner.aspx](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/public/frm_Applicant_Corner.aspx) - **Note:** Application will be accepted on the principle of first come, first serve bases within the target limits. > **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_Contacts.aspx).
