metadata.schemeName: Information, Monitoring, Evaluation and Social Audit (I-MESA): Evaluation and Studies
metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
metadata.briefDescription: The "Evaluation and Studies" component of the scheme aims to establish institutionalized mechanisms for achieving transparency and accountability, generating lessons learned for real-time program improvement, and ensuring effective knowledge dissemination among stakeholders and targeted beneficiary.

page_content:
# Information, Monitoring, Evaluation and Social Audit (I-MESA): Evaluation and Studies **Ministry:** Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Evaluation, Research, Institution, Feedback, Evidence | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Information, Monitoring, Evaluation and Social Audit (I-MESA)" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India. The "Evaluation and Studies" component of the scheme aims to establish institutionalized mechanisms for achieving transparency and accountability, generating lessons learned for real-time program improvement, and ensuring effective knowledge dissemination among stakeholders and targeted beneficiaries. The scheme provides for evaluation studies to be undertaken at regular intervals, preferably every two years, by reputed Agencies/Organizations or other Institutes.
## Benefits ##### ***Financial Assistance/Funding*** Funds are sanctioned by the Ministry for approved evaluation projects covering a specified period. > ***Items Covered under Funds (Costs met by the Ministry)*** - Salaries and allowances of the project staff of the study and honorarium for the Project Director. - Travel expenses undertaken in relation to the project. - Consultancy charges. - Printing costs. - Equipment and books. - Computer and tabulation costs. - Contingency and Overhead charges (Overhead charges are calculated up to 5% of the total cost of Personnel, Travel, Printing, Equipment and books, Computer and machine tabulation costs, and Contingency). ##### ***Fund Disbursal Installments*** The funds are released in three installments - **First Installment:** 20% (released after the receipt of Performance Security).- **Second Installment:** 50% (released on submission and presentation of the draft report).- **Third Installment:** 30% (released after acceptance of the report by the Department, along with submission of 8 copies of the final report, 20 copies of the summary report and its soft version, audited Statement of Accounts, and Utilization Certificate). ##### ***Conditions*** - The successful bidder must submit a Performance Bank Guarantee issued by any scheduled commercial bank for 8% of the contract value. - The Organization must execute a bond in favor of the President of India to abide by the terms and conditions attached to the funds. - The Organization must maintain separate accounts for this fund, which will remain open to inspection by representatives of the Government of India, including the Comptroller and Auditor General of India. - The Organization must refund any unspent balance out of the fund within 30 days from the date of completion of the Project. - Any unspent balance not refunded within 30 days, or funds required to be refunded due to failure to abide by conditions, will attract a penal interest of 15% per annum thereon.
## Eligibility Criteria ##### ***For the Organization/Agency/Institute*** - The applicant must have requisite qualifications to undertake evaluation studies of schemes and programmes of the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment. - The applicant must not have been blacklisted. - The applicant must accept all the terms and conditions of the Notice Inviting Tender, including commercial and general terms and conditions. - The applicant must be willing to undertake the assignment in the given timeframe. ##### ***For the Project Director/In-charge of the Project*** - The applicant should have the necessary experience in the use of statistical tools. - The applicant should have experience in the social sector. - The applicant should have at least 5 years’ experience of evaluation of studies on the social sector.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ##### ***Step 1: Initiation and Invitation of Bids*** - The process begins when the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment invites E-Bids/Bids or willingness from qualified Organizations, Agencies, or Institutes to undertake evaluation studies of its schemes and programmes. - The Department may also consider limited tendering or selection on nomination basis depending on the specific need. ##### ***Step 2: Preparation and Submission of Technical and Financial Bid*** - The Project Director/In-charge of the project must prepare the proposal, ensuring they possess the required experience (at least 5 years in social sector evaluation and experience in statistical tools). - The proposal must be submitted through the head of the Organization or the Registrar of the University. - The bidder must submit all necessary documents, including the Technical Bid, Financial Bid, Earnest Money Deposit (or proof of exemption), and an undertaking accepting all terms and conditions of the Notice Inviting Tender. ##### ***Step 3: Bid Evaluation and Notification of Award*** - A Committee evaluates the received proposals, utilizing technical criterion parameters indicated in the Tender document to shortlist qualified bidders. - Offers received without the Earnest Money Deposit are summarily rejected (unless exempted). - The Department issues a Letter of Award (LoA) in duplicate to the successful bidder, briefly mentioning the rates, terms, and conditions. ##### ***Step 4: Contract Finalization and Initial Compliance*** - The successful bidder must return one copy of the LoA duly signed as a token of acceptance, along with a contract bond and the Performance Security (Performance Bank Guarantee for 8% of the contract value) within the stipulated time indicated in the LoA. - The Ministry then issues a sanction letter for the approved project, detailing the sanctioned amount for each sub-head of the evaluation study. - The first installment of 20% of the funds is released after the Ministry receives the Performance Security. ##### ***Step 5: Project Execution and Progress Monitoring*** - The Organization proceeds with the project execution, maintaining separate accounts for the sanctioned funds. - The Project Director must submit progress reports to the Ministry along with certified statements of expenditure actually incurred and estimates for the remaining period. - The Ministry conducts a monthly review of the project's progress. If the Organization delays the submission of the report by the due date, a penalty of 0.5% of the cost of the study per week will be levied. ##### ***Step 6: Draft Report Submission and Second Fund Release*** - The Organization must prepare and submit the draft report to the Ministry upon completion of the preliminary findings. - The Organization is also required to make a presentation of the draft report before the Ministry. - Upon the submission and presentation of the draft report, the second installment of 50% of the funds is released. ##### ***Step 7: Final Report Acceptance and Final Fund Release*** - The Ministry examines the draft report, and the Project Director is responsible for revising it if discrepancies are noted. - After acceptance of the report, the Project Director submits eight copies of the final report, 20 copies of the summary report (along with soft versions), the audited Statement of Accounts, and the Utilization Certificate. - The third and final installment of 30% of the funds is released after acceptance of the final report and submission of these required documents. ##### ***Step 8: Project Conclusion and Fund Settlement*** - The Organization must preserve all collected raw data (such as filled in schedules, reports, photographs, etc.) in electronic form and transfer all raw data and ownership of the data to the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment. - Any unspent balance from the sanctioned funds must be refunded by the Organization within 30 days from the date of completion of the Project. - The Organization should save a copy of all correspondence, reports, and financial documentation for its records.

# Conducting Outreach Programmes in Various Fields **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Science, IT & Communications | **Tags:** Science Education, Research, Outreach Program, Science Awareness Centre | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Conducting Outreach Programmes in Various Fields” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Science Education and Research Centre (USERC) under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote scientific awareness among students, teachers, and the general public by conducting outreach programmes and activities in various fields of science through both online and offline modes, thereby making science education and research more accessible across the state.
## Benefits In order to make the benefits of science education and research accessible to every individual in the state, information regarding the development of scientific consciousness and the dissemination of scientific knowledge among students, teachers, and the general public through online and offline mediums is disseminated through various social media sites, USERC Science Awareness Centres (currently 200 in the state), and USERC Nodal Officers working in higher education.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a student or a person (general public) from Uttarakhand.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline There is no fixed duration for outreach programs; some last one day, while others span multiple days. To participate, USERC first solicits applications through a Google form, after which all students are free to join. In offline programs, students from nearby schools and the general public can participate, with information provided by the relevant venue or USERC Science Awareness Centres.

# National Livestock Mission: Entrepreneurship Development Scheme - Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Entrepreneurship, Poultry Farming, Piggery Farming, Livestock, Livestock Mission | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Entrepreneurship Development Scheme”, a sub-component of the National Livestock Mission, is implemented by the Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board (ULDB) under the Department of Animal Husbandry, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote employment generation through entrepreneurship development in the small ruminants, poultry, piggery, and the fodder sectors by providing financial and institutional support to individuals and organized groups under the National Livestock Mission.
## Benefits Under this scheme, employment generation is promoted through entrepreneurship development in the small ruminants, poultry, piggery, and the fodder sector.
## Eligibility Criteria The applicant must belong to one of the following eligible categories: - Individual Entrepreneur - Self Help Group (SHG) - Farmer Producer Organization (FPO) - Farmers Cooperative (FCO) - Joint Liability Group (JLG) - Section 8 Company

The process involves the following steps: - Screening of Applications by the State Implementing Agency. - Loan Approval by the designated lender. - Recommendation by the State Level Executive Committee (SLEC). - Sanction of Subsidy by the Animal Husbandry and Dairying Department. - For detailed guidelines on the release of subsidy, please visit the department’s website [www.dahd.nic.in](https://dahd.gov.in/) or contact the State Animal Husbandry Department.

# Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Production of Musical Programme or Tiatr **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Song, Music, Program, Artist, Culture | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Production of Musical Programme or Tiatr" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to project patriotism, nationalism, and communal harmony through tiatrs, songs and music, addressing the need to promote these values through cultural performances and artistic expression. The scheme provides remuneration as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa to successful applicants and covers actual charges of hall/auditorium or pays a lump sum amount for performances held in makeshift pandals, along with video recording of the activity with one Digital Video Disc copy provided to the applicant. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
## Benefits - Remuneration as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa will be provided to the applicant. - Reimbursement of actual charges of the hall/auditorium or payment of lump sum amount as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa if performance is held in makeshift pandal. - Video recording of the activity/programme will be done by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - One copy of the Digital Video Disc will be provided to the applicant. - Maximum of 4 shows of the programme will be staged by Tiatr Academy of Goa at various places. - One banner will be provided by Tiatr Academy of Goa for compulsory display.
> ***Conditions*** - All shows must be shown to public free of charge. - Duration of the musical programme or tiatr should be not less than two hours. - In all advertisements, oral, print or electronic media, banners, the following must be inserted/published/announced: 'This programme is promoted by Tiatr Academy of Goa'. - A few seats should be reserved by the organizer(s) for the representatives of Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The Tiatr Academy of Goa banner should be compulsorily displayed at one of the two front side wings of the stage and returned after all shows. - The organizing institution/individual will have to discuss with Tiatr Academy of Goa and decide about the Chief Guest or Guest of Honour well in advance.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an individual/organization/educational institution/club. - The applicant must propose an activity that is a tiatr/musical programme on the theme of patriotism/national integration/communal harmony. - The applicant must ensure the duration of the musical programme or tiatr is not less than two hours. - The applicant must submit the application along with typed script/lyrics at least 30 days before the date of staging the programme. - The applicant must attach No Objection Certificate from the lyricist/writer/director concerned if they are not the lyricist/writer/director of the proposed activity. - The applicant must ensure scripts/lyrics do not contain any adverse remarks against any Governments/Individuals/Institutions or anything against caste, creed and religion.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ _*The scheme will be implemented on 'First Come First Serve' basis._ _*Applications will be considered as per the availability of funds._
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:****** ***Programme Coordination*** Upon approval, the organizing institution/individual will coordinate with Tiatr Academy of Goa to discuss and decide about the Chief Guest or Guest of Honour well in advance, with the President or Vice President of Tiatr Academy of Goa or nominee serving in this capacity. **Step 2:****** ***Banner Collection and Display*** The applicant must collect the Tiatr Academy of Goa banner from their office and ensure compulsory display at one of the two front side wings of the stage during performances. **Step 3:****** ***Performance Implementation*** The applicant must stage the approved programme ensuring all conditions are met including free public access, reservation of seats for Tiatr Academy of Goa representatives, and proper acknowledgment in all promotional materials. **Step 4:****** ***Post-Performance Requirements*** After completion of all shows, the applicant must return the Tiatr Academy of Goa banner to their office, and the payment cheque will be issued in the name of the applicant as appearing at Serial Number 1 of the application form.

metadata.schemeName: Namo Laxmi Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "Namo Laxmi Yojana" by the Education Department, aims to reduce the dropout rate of girls in secondary and higher secondary education by providing financial assistance for completing studies from Class 9th to 12th.

page_content:
# Namo Laxmi Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Girls Education, Financial Assistance, Scholarship | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Namo Laxmi Yojana" by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to encourage girls studying in government, aided, and private schools in Gujarat to complete their education from Class 9th to 12th by providing direct financial assistance. Each eligible girl will receive a total financial support of ₹50,000/- on completion of classes 9th to 12th under this scheme.
## Benefits > ***Total Financial Assistance:*** - Each eligible girl will receive a total financial support of ₹50,000/- on completion of classes 9th to 12th in government, aided, and private schools.
> **Class 9th-10th Benefit:** - ₹10,000/- per annum (₹500/- per month based on attendance × 10) and the remaining 50% will be credited via DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer) after passing the Class 10th board examination.
> **Class 11th-12th Benefit:** - ₹15,000/- per annum (₹750/- per month based on attendance × 10) and the remaining 50% will be credited via DBT after passing the Class 12th board examination.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a girl. 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be studying in Class 9th to 12th in any Government, Government-aided, or private secondary/higher secondary school in Gujarat. 1. The applicant must have an annual family income of less than or equal to ₹6,00,000/-. 1. The applicant must maintain regular attendance to be eligible for monthly assistance.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Applicants should request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the School authority. **Step 2:** In the application form, provide all the mandatory details, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the supporting documents to the District Education Officer. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted.

metadata.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Troupes Going to Mumbai/Poona and Other Parts of the Country & Vice Versa
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to compensate Goan dramatic troupes for transportation expenses when staging Tiatrs in Mumbai, Poona, and other parts of India, and vice versa. It offers financial assistance to promote Goan Tiatr, benefiting directors and writers of Goan and Mumbai/Poona troupes.

page_content:
# Financial Assistance to Troupes Going to Mumbai/Poona and Other Parts of the Country & Vice Versa **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Culture, Artist, Stage, Performance, Tour, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Financial Assistance to Troupes Going to Mumbai/Poona and Other Parts of the Country & Vice Versa" by the Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG), Goa, aims to compensate Goan dramatic troupes towards their transportation costs, recognizing that staging Tiatrs in Mumbai, Poona, and other parts of the country is not always financially viable. The scheme provides financial support to cover transport expenses for Goan troupes staging a minimum of five shows of the same Tiatr in Mumbai/Poona, or for Mumbai/Poona troupes staging five shows in Goa. Benefits can also be availed for only one show staged in other locations such as Kolkata, Delhi, Gujarat, Nagpur, Bangalore, or Udaipur. Applications for this scheme are accepted one month in advance of the performance date, on a 'First Come First Serve' basis, and are subject to the availability of funds.
## Benefits - The scheme provides financial support to compensate for transportation expenses incurred while staging Tiatrs, thereby promoting Goan Tiatr. - The extent of the financial support shall be fixed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa.
> ***Conditions*** _*The Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) may appoint a representative to witness the performance, and payments will be released based on their report._ _*A compulsory announcement stating ‘This Tiatr is organized in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG)’ must be made both before the commencement of the Tiatr and again during the interval._ _*No adverse remarks must be made, either in written or verbal form, against any Governments, Individuals, Institutions, or on the basis of caste, creed, or religion within the scripts, song lyrics, performances, or speeches. If such remarks are proven, the Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) reserves the right to disqualify the performance and either withhold payment or recall any payment already made to the applicant._ _*For performances at Mandd Sobhann, Mangalore, the payment will only be made after a certificate of performance is issued by the Mandd Sobhann._
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be the writer or director of the Tiatr. 2. The applicant must stage the Tiatr as per its traditional format. 3. The applicant's Tiatr must have 6 or 7 acts (podd’dde). 4. The applicant's Tiatr must include the following - - At least 4 ‘cantos’ and comedy linked to the story of the play. - At least 10 ‘Kantaram’. 5. The applicant's 'Kantaram' must include the following - - At Least 2 Duets. - At Least 1 Duo. - At Least 1 Trio. - At Least 1 Quartet/quintet. - At Least 1 Choral Song and Solos. 6. The applicant must not have any adverse remark made in any form (written or verbal) against any Governments, Individuals, Institutions, or anything against caste, creed, and religion in the scripts, lyrics of songs, performances, speeches, etc., which may hurt the sentiments of anybody. 7. All advertisements, press notes, banners, tickets, and handbills must explicitly state that ‘This Tiatr is organized in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG)’. 8. The applicant's troupe must stage a minimum of 5 shows of the same Tiatr in Mumbai/Poona (if a Goan troupe) or 5 shows in Goa (if a Mumbai/Poona troupe) to qualify for transport support. 9. The applicant's troupe can avail benefit even if only one show is staged in other places like Kolkata, Delhi, Gujarat, Nagpur, Bangalore, Udaipur, etc. 10. The applicant can avail the scheme only twice in a financial year for two different Tiatrs.
> ***Earmarking*** 1. For performances at Mandd Sobhann at Mangalore, financial assistance is extended to two troupes from Goa. 2. Of these two Tiatrs for Mandd Sobhann, one should be from Commercial Troupes and one from a prize-winning Troupe of Goa Kala Academy ‘A’ Tiatr Competition.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. The form may also be obtained directly from the office of the Tiatr Academy of Goa, requiring a physical visit to the office for collection. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the copies of the mandatory documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** **Deadline:** The submission must be made at least one month in advance of the scheduled performance date. _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ *The application will be considered on a 'First Come First Serve' basis and is subject to the availability of funds.
> ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** _Await Performance Witnessing and Verification_ Upon application, the Tiatr Academy of Goa may choose to appoint and depute its own representative to witness the Tiatr performance. This representative will observe the show in Mumbai, Poona, or any other specified location and subsequently submit a report to the Tiatr Academy of Goa for review.
**Step 2:** _Release of Financial Assistance_ Based on the report provided by the Tiatr Academy of Goa's representative, the financial assistance payments will be released to the concerned applicant. For Tiatrs performed at Mandd Sobhann in Mangalore, the payment will be disbursed only after a formal certificate of performance has been issued by Mandd Sobhann, Mangalore.

metadata.schemeName: Promotion of Konkani Songs with Choreography & Dancing
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote Konkani songs by presenting them with choreography and dancing to attract youth towards Konkani cultural performances. It provides cash prizes, mementos, certificates and traveling allowances to participating groups in organized competitions.

page_content:
# Promotion of Konkani Songs with Choreography & Dancing **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Artist, Youth, Choreography, Dance, Culture, Competition | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Promotion of Konkani Songs with Choreography & Dancing" was launched by the Tiatr Academy of Goa, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to promote Konkani songs by presenting them with choreography and dancing, attracting youth towards Konkani 'kantar' and improving the presentation quality of Konkani cultural performances. The scheme provides cash prizes ranging from ₹2,000/- to ₹7,000/- for winners along with mementos and certificates, and traveling allowances between ₹1,000/- to ₹2,000/- based on distance traveled by participating groups. The applicant must form a group of 6 to 10 participants and submit a recording of one selected Konkani song at the time of application. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa and applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
## Benefits ##### ***Cash Prizes for Performance*** - First Prize: ₹7,000/- plus memento and certificate. - Second Prize: ₹5,000/- plus memento and certificate. - Third Prize: ₹3,000/- plus memento and certificate. - Special Prize for Best Choreographer: ₹2,000/- plus memento and certificate. ##### ***Traveling Allowance*** - Groups traveling up to 10 kilometers radius: ₹1,000/-. - Groups traveling within 10-20 kilometers radius: ₹1,500/-. - Groups traveling 20 kilometers or more: ₹2,000/-.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must form a group consisting of 6 to 10 participants. - The applicant must submit a recording of one selected Konkani song at the time of application. - The applicant must not perform fusion of songs as it will result in automatic disqualification. - The applicant must abide by all rules and regulations of the competition organized by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must accept that the decision of the judges will be final and binding.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date. **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - ***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001*** _*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._ _*The application must be submitted to the office of the Tiatr Academy of Goa at least 30 days in advance of the proposed programme date._ _*Applications are considered on a "First come First Serve" basis, subject to the availability of funds._ > ***Post-Application Process*** **Step 1:** Competition Details Wait for Tiatr Academy of Goa will communicate the venue, date, and other competition details to participating groups. **Step 2:** Participate in Competition Attend the competition at the designated venue and perform the registered Konkani song with choreography and dancing.

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Gyansetu Merit Scholarship Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: This scheme introduced by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to support meritorious students by providing scholarships from Class 6th to Class 12th in selected schools.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Gyansetu Merit Scholarship Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Education, Student, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Mukhyamantri Gyansetu Merit Scholarship Yojana" by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat aims to select 30,000 brilliant students who have completed their Class 5 education consecutively in government, aided, or RTE-approved schools and provide them with scholarships to study in selected government, aided, or private schools from Class 6th to Class 12th. The selection is done through a Common Entrance Test conducted by the State Examination Board, Gandhinagar.
## Benefits > **Government Schools and Government -aided Schools (Approved by Education Department):** - For Class 6th to 8th: ₹5,000/- per year. - For Class 9th to 10th: ₹6,000/- per year. - For Class 11th to 12th: ₹7,000/- per year. > **Private (Selected) Schools:** - For Class 6th to 8th: ₹20,000/- per year. - For Class 9th to 10th: ₹22,000/- per year. - For Class 11th to 12th: ₹25,000/- per year. > **Frequency of Disbursement:** - Disbursed annually in two installments; the first 50% is given after confirmation of at least 80% attendance in the first semester.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must have studied Classes 1st to 5th in a Government/ Government-aided/ RTE-approved self-financed primary school in Gujarat. 1. The applicant must have passed the Common Entrance Test (CET) conducted by the State Examination Board and be listed in the merit list. 1. The applicant must have taken admission in Class 6th in a Government/ Government-aided/ RTE-approved self-financed primary school in Gujarat.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the official website: [http://gssyguj.in](https://gssyguj.in/). **Step 2:** Register online using the 18-digit CTS Aadhaar UDI number. **Step 3:** Provide mobile number, verify using OTP, and set a password to complete registration. > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** Log in using the registered Aadhaar number and password. **Step 2:** Fill out the online application form carefully, including personal details, school details (UDISE number), category (SC/ST/OBC/General/EWS), and residence type (Urban/Rural). **Step 3:** Upload the required documents including caste certificate (if applicable). **Step 4:** Preview the form, save and submit it online. **Step 5:** Take a printout of the submitted form for future reference. **Step 6:** Regularly check the website and registered mobile number for updates and merit list announcements. > **Contact Us:** **Commissioner of Schools** **Address:** Block-9, 1 st floor, J.M.Bhavan, Old sachivalaya, Gandhinagar **Tel. no. :** 079-23254011 **Other office:** 079-23254014 **E-mail:** gssyguj@gmail.com

metadata.schemeName: Procedure for Admission to Government Women Welfare and Rehabilitation Centre and Women's Home
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide support to women above 18 years of age who are orphans, destitute, abandoned, found on roads, or mentally and physically disabled. Such women are provided with clothing, food, accommodation, medical care, counselling, entertainment, and training facilities free of cost.

page_content:
# Procedure for Admission to Government Women Welfare and Rehabilitation Centre and Women's Home **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Housing & Shelter, Women and Child | **Tags:** Women Welfare, Rehabilitation Center, Mahila Griha, Destitute Woman, Orphan, Abandoned Woman, Disabled Woman | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Procedure for Admission to Government Women Welfare and Rehabilitation Centre and Women's Home” is implemented by the Women Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide support to women above 18 years of age who are orphans, destitute, abandoned, found on roads, or mentally and physically disabled. Such women are provided with clothing, food, accommodation, medical care, counselling, entertainment, and training facilities free of cost.
## Benefits Women above 18 years of age who are mentally and physically disabled, or destitute women, are provided with clothing, food, accommodation, medical care, counseling, entertainment, and training facilities free of cost.
## Eligibility Criteria Women above 18 years of age who are orphans, destitute, abandoned, found on roads, mentally or physically disabled, or involved in immoral trafficking are eligible.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline The woman herself or any citizen can provide information about mentally or physically disabled women, or destitute women in their area, by calling helpline number 181. Information can also be given to the Police, SDM, City Magistrate, or District Magistrate of the concerned area. After receiving the information, the Police rescue the woman, conduct medical and other necessary examinations, and on the orders of the District Magistrate, send her to the Government Women Welfare and Rehabilitation Centre or Mahila Griha. The list of such centres is as follows: 1. Government Women Welfare and Rehabilitation Centre (Mental), Kedarpuram, Dehradun. 1. Government Women Welfare and Rehabilitation Centre, Kedarpuram, Dehradun. 1. Government Women Welfare and Rehabilitation Centre (Protection Home), Nainital. 1. Government Women Welfare and Rehabilitation Centre (Protection Home), Kotdwar. 1. Government Destitute Women Workshop and Training Centre, Pithoragarh.

metadata.schemeName: Loans to Tribal Students for Higher Studies Abroad
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme's purpose is to offer financial assistance to tribal students for higher education abroad. It provides a loan of up to ₹15,00,000 at a 4% annual interest rate.

page_content:
# Loans to Tribal Students for Higher Studies Abroad **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Student, Loan, Higher Education, Scheduled Tribe, Foreign Study | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Loans to Tribal Students for Higher Studies Abroad" scheme was launched by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to tribal students who wish to pursue higher education in foreign universities. Through this scheme, eligible Scheduled Tribe (ST) students can avail a loan at a concessional interest rate of 4% per annum.
## Benefits **Monetary Benefit:** - Loan of up to ₹15,00,000 or the actual cost of study/training abroad, whichever is lower. **Interest Rate:** - 4% per annum. **Penalty Interest:** - 2.5% per annum for late repayment. **Beneficiary Contribution:** - No contribution is required from the beneficiary. **Repayment Terms:** - Repayment to be made in 60 monthly installments. - Repayment starts 6 months after completion of studies. - Early repayment is permitted.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant must have secured special merit in Matriculation, Higher Secondary, Indian School Certificate, or its equivalent examination. 1. The applicant must have secured admission to a recognized foreign university for higher education. 1. The applicant must have passed the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) or equivalent examination.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ##### **Registration Process** - Visit the Gujarat Tribal Development Corporation [official website](https://adijatinigam.gujarat.gov.in/home). - Click on the "[APPLY FOR LOAN](https://adijatinigam.gujarat.gov.in/gtdcloan)".- Select the scheme name "Foreign Study". - Fill the registration form: Full Name (as per Aadhaar Card), Gender, Date of Birth, Aadhaar Number, Mobile Number, Uder name, Password for login, Confirm Password. - Click on the "Sign Up. - After successful registration, User ID and Password will be generated. ##### **Login and Application Process** - Enter User ID, Password, and Captcha Code. - After login, schemes applicable to your caste will be displayed. - Click on the scheme you want to apply for. - Fill the "Application Form" and upload the required documents - Click Save Application. The system will generate an Application Number. - Click Print Application.

metadata.schemeName: Loan For Commercial Pilot Training
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to offer affordable loans of up to ₹25,00,000 at a 4% annual interest rate to tribal students who want to pursue pilot training.

page_content:
# Loan For Commercial Pilot Training **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Pilot Training, Opportunity, Schedule Tribe, Loan | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Loan For Commercial Pilot Training" scheme was launched by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to support Scheduled Tribe (ST) students in pursuing professional pilot training by providing affordable loans. Under this scheme, tribal students can avail a loan at a concessional interest rate, enabling them to secure high-quality training and good employment opportunities.
## Benefits **Monetary Benefit** - Loan of up to ₹25,00,000 or the actual cost of training, whichever is lower. **Interest Rate** - 4% per annum. **Penalty Interest** - 2.5% per annum on delayed repayments. **Beneficiary Contribution** - No contribution is required from the applicant. **Repayment Terms** - Repayment begins 1 year after the loan disbursement date. - Repayment period is 144 monthly installments (12 years). - Includes 10 years for principal repayment and 2 years for interest repayment. - Early repayment is permitted.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant must have passed Matriculation, Higher Secondary, Indian School Certificate, or an equivalent examination. 1. The applicant must have secured admission to a recognized commercial pilot training institute. 1. The applicant should have passed Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC).
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ##### ***Registration Process*** - Visit the Gujarat Tribal Development Corporation [official website](https://adijatinigam.gujarat.gov.in/home). - Click on the "[APPLY FOR LOAN](https://adijatinigam.gujarat.gov.in/gtdcloan)".- Select the scheme name "Foreign Study". - Fill the registration form: Full Name (as per Aadhaar Card), Gender, Date of Birth, Aadhaar Number, Mobile Number, Uder name, Password for login, Confirm Password. - Click on the "Sign Up. - After successful registration, User ID and Password will be generated. ##### ***Application Process*** - Enter User ID, Password, and Captcha Code. - After login, schemes applicable to your caste will be displayed. - Click on the scheme you want to apply for. - Fill the "Application Form" and upload the required documents - Click Save Application. The system will generate an Application Number. - Click Print Application.

# Subsidy For Battery Operated Three-Wheelers **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Battery Operated Three-Wheelers, Electric Scooter Subsidy, Electric Vehicle, Renewable Energy, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Subsidy For Battery Operated Three-wheelers" by the Climate Change Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to encourage the use of clean energy-based vehicles for the transportation of passengers and goods, thereby reducing dependency on petrol and mitigating pollution. Beneficiaries, including rickshaw drivers, women entrepreneurs, startups, unemployed youth, educational institutions, cooperatives, NGOs, local bodies, and yatras, can avail a subsidy on a reimbursement basis after purchasing battery-operated three-wheelers from Gujarat Energy Development Agency (GEDA) authorized manufacturers and dealers.

## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be an individual (such as rickshaw drivers, women entrepreneurs, startups, educated unemployed individuals) or an institution (such as cooperatives, NGOs, educational institutions, local bodies, yatras). 1. The applicant must purchase a battery-operated three-wheeler from a GEDA-authorized manufacturer or dealer. 1. The applicant must apply through authorized dealers linked with GEDA.

metadata.schemeName: Gujarat State Electric Vehicle Policy
metadata.briefDescription: The policy aims to transition Gujarat's transportation sector towards electric mobility and establish the state as a manufacturing hub for electric vehicles. It provides subsidies for electric vehicle purchases and charging infrastructure development to promote sustainable transportation.

page_content:
# Gujarat State Electric Vehicle Policy **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Transport & Infrastructure, Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Vehicle, Manufacturing, Subsidy, Infrastructure, Transport, Technology, Environment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Gujarat State Electric Vehicle Policy 2021" by the Ports and Transport Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to transition the state's transportation sector towards electric mobility, make Gujarat a manufacturing hub for electric vehicles and ancillary equipment, encourage start-ups and investment in the field of electric mobility, and improve environmental quality by reducing air pollution. The policy provides capital subsidies up to ₹10,000/- per kilowatt hour for electric vehicle purchases and 25% capital subsidy on equipment for charging infrastructure limited up to ₹10,00,000/- per station for the first 250 commercial public electric vehicle charging stations. The policy is implemented by the Ports and Transport Department as the nodal department with Energy and Petrochemicals Department handling charging station subsidies.
## Benefits > ***Electric Vehicle Purchase Incentives*** - 2-Wheeler: ₹10,000/- per kilowatt hour (maximum ex-factory price ₹1,50,000/-) - 3-Wheeler: ₹10,000/- per kilowatt hour (maximum ex-factory price ₹5,00,000/-) - 4-Wheeler: ₹10,000/- per kilowatt hour (maximum ex-factory price ₹15,00,000/-) > ***Charging Infrastructure Incentives*** - Capital Subsidy: 25% on equipment/machinery limited up to ₹10,00,000/- per station - Electricity Duty Exemption: 100% exemption for electric vehicle charging stations during policy period - Eligibility: First 250 commercial public electric vehicle charging stations > ***Manufacturing Benefits*** All provisions of Gujarat Industrial Policy-2020 applicable to electric vehicle manufacturing sector Support for setting up or upgrading facilities for electric vehicle manufacturing > ***Conditions*** _*The beneficiary can avail subsidy under only one state government scheme and cannot claim subsidy under multiple schemes._ _*Maximum subsidy amount is limited to maximum battery capacity of the vehicle._ _*Maximum subsidy should not exceed 40% of ex-factory price of the vehicle._ _*The amount whichever is less will be given as subsidy to the beneficiary._ _*Charging stations must adhere to Ministry of Power guidelines and standards dated 01.10.2019._ _*Charging station subsidy available only to those who have not availed subsidies under any other Government of India schemes._
## Eligibility Criteria ##### ***Electric Vehicle Purchase Subsidy*** - The applicant must purchase electric vehicles that have taken subsidy under Government of India's Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Hybrid and Electric Vehicles in India Scheme dated 8th March 2019 and any amendments thereafter. - The applicant must ensure the vehicle's ex-factory price falls within the prescribed threshold limits for each segment. - The applicant must not have claimed subsidy under any other state government scheme run by different departments. - The applicant must authenticate documents for vehicle purchase to receive Direct Benefit Transfer. ##### ***Charging Infrastructure Subsidy*** - The applicant must set up commercial public electric vehicle charging stations for 2-wheelers, 3-wheelers, and 4-wheelers. - The applicant must not have availed subsidies under any other promotional schemes under Government of India policies or schemes. - The applicant must ensure charging stations meet guidelines and standards of Ministry of Power Circular dated 1st October 2019 and any amendments thereafter. - The applicant must be among the first 250 commercial public electric vehicle charging station developers. ##### ***Manufacturing Incentives*** - The applicant must be involved in manufacturing electric vehicles and their components. - The applicant must comply with provisions of Gujarat Industrial Policy-2020 and subsequent applicable policies.
## Exclusions Agriculture connection holders cannot charge electric vehicles from existing connections under existing tariff.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - Upon authenticating the document for the purchase of the vehicle, the subsidy shall be disbursed directly to the customer via DBT mode from the State Transport Department. - The subsidy amount will be calculated based on kilowatt-hour capacity for vehicles or a 25% capital subsidy for charging infrastructure, subject to maximum limits and eligibility conditions.

metadata.schemeName: Project Sankalp
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide industry-led vocational skilling to enhance youth employability and meet industry demand for skilled manpower. It offers sector-specific training, apprenticeship, and employment opportunities, benefiting youth with better job prospects.

page_content:
# Project Sankalp **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Skill, Training, Employment, Youth, Apprenticeship, Certification | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Project Sankalp" was launched on 15th July 2020 by the Gujarat Skill Development Mission (GSDM), Labour and Employment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to revolutionize vocational skilling, making India the global skill capital with globally competitive skills and competencies. The scheme provides an industry-led vocational skilling program, enabling the industry to fulfill its demand for skilled manpower and providing youth with sustainable employment opportunities. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Skill Development Mission. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the GSDM portal.
## Benefits > **Training Cost Reimbursement** The Industry Partner will receive reimbursement for training costs per candidate per hour: - NSQF Category 1 Job Roles: ₹49. - NSQF Category 2 Job Roles: ₹42. - NSQF Category 3 Job Roles: ₹35.10. - GCVT Job Roles and Company-Specific Job Roles: ₹36.75 (which is 75% of the Category 1 NSQF job role training cost). _*The training cost for NSQF Job Roles is subject to amendments as per MSDE notification, and the cost for GCVT and Company-specific job roles will also change accordingly._ > ***Assessment Cost Reimbursement*** GSDM will reimburse the assessment cost directly to the respective Sector Skill Council (SSC), Gujarat Council of Vocational Training (GCVT), or Kaushalya Skill University (KSU) for both fresher trainees and existing employees. _*Any re-assessment cost for candidates who were absent or failed the first assessment, or for existing workers/employees, must be borne by the Industry Partner._ > ***No Training Fee for Youth/Beneficiaries*** No fee of any kind will be charged from the youth or beneficiaries for the training.
## Eligibility Criteria - The Fresher Trainees must have a domicile of Gujarat. - The age of Fresher Trainees must be between 18 and 35 years. - The Existing Employees could be from Pan-India. - The age of Existing Employees must be between 18 and 55 years. > **Relaxations & Preferences** - The scheme focuses on the inclusion of Special Groups such as Women, Persons with Disability (PwD), Below Poverty Line (BPL), Scheduled Caste (SC), and Scheduled Tribe (ST). - A relaxation of ten years may be given to Women, PwD, BPL, SC, and ST candidates for fresher trainees.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Step 1:** ***Access the GSDM Portal & Initiate Registration*** - To begin, the applicant should visit the [Skills Gujarat portal](https://skills.gujarat.gov.in/project-sankalp.htm). On the displayed login screen, the applicant must locate and click on the "[Register](https://skills.gujarat.gov.in/gsdmdev/Registration/Index)". This action will prompt the system to initiate the candidate registration process, allowing new users to create an account. > **Step 2:****** ***Complete Basic Registration Details*** - The applicant will be required to provide all the mandatory details in the registration form. - The system will generate One Time Passwords (OTPs), which will be sent to both the registered email ID and the mobile number provided by the applicant. - A verification screen will appear, where the applicant must accurately enter the "Email OTP" and "Mobile OTP" received. > **Step 3:****** ***Confirm Verification and Receive Login Credentials*** - After entering both OTPs, the applicant should click the "Verify & Save" button. If the OTPs are successfully verified, a confirmation message will appear, indicating successful basic registration. - Subsequently, the "User Name" and "Password" for the account will be generated and shared with the applicant via their registered email ID and mobile number. > **Step 4:****** ***Initial Login and Password Creation*** - Using the newly received "Username" and "Password," along with the Captcha displayed on the login screen, the applicant should log in to their account. - For security purposes, the system will then prompt the applicant to create a new password by entering a "New Password" and re-entering it in the "Enter Confirm Password" field, followed by another Captcha. - The applicant must click "Submit" to finalize the new password. > **Step 5:****** ***Complete Full Registration*** - Once logged in with the new password, the applicant will proceed to the Full Registration section. - Here, they must provide all the mandatory details and upload the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. - The applicant must carefully read and then click "I Agree to the Terms and Conditions" to confirm the correctness of all the information updated during the registration process. - Finally, they should click "Save and Continue" to submit their complete registration details. > **Step 6:****** ***Access Candidate Dashboard and Utilize Resources*** - Upon successful full registration, the applicant will be directed to their Candidate Dashboard. - From this dashboard, they can access various features, including the "TC Locator / KVK Locator" to search for the Nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or Training Center. - Additionally, they can click on "Interest Assessment Test," which redirects them to http://gujarati.careerguide.com/my-profile, to start and view their psychometric test report. _*No fee of any kind should be charged from the youth or beneficiary for the Project Sankalp training._

metadata.schemeName: Mukhya Mantrir Nijut Moina Aasoni
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support ten lakh girl students with financial grants as admission incentives for Higher Secondary, Graduation, and Post-Graduation studies to eradicate child marriage. It benefits unmarried girl students domiciled in Assam with monthly financial assistance.

page_content:
# Mukhya Mantrir Nijut Moina Aasoni **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Assam | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Girl, Student, Education, Graduation, Female, Incentive, Scholarship | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched in August 2024, the scheme "Mukhya Mantrir Nijut Moina Aasoni" by the Higher Education Department, Government of Assam, aims to support ten lakh girl students with financial grants as admission incentives to continue their education in Higher Secondary, Graduation, and Post-Graduation studies, serving as a crucial step towards eradicating child marriage and its associated harmful practices. The scheme provides monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 for Class 11-12 students, ₹1,250 for graduation students, and ₹2,500 for post-graduation students for a maximum of ten months per year, and ensures regular attendance and discipline among beneficiaries through institutional monitoring. The applicant must be an unmarried girl student domiciled in Assam enrolled in government and venture educational institutions (excluding private institutions) and must maintain 75% attendance in the previous year for existing beneficiaries. The scheme is implemented by the Higher Education Department, Government of Assam through a portal-based system where applications are accepted offline at respective educational institutions and verified online through institutional portals.
## Benefits > **Financial Assistance** - Higher Secondary (Class 11-12): ₹1,000 per month for maximum 10 months totaling ₹10,000 per year. - Graduation (Bachelor of Arts/Bachelor of Science/Bachelor of Commerce): ₹1,250 per month for maximum 10 months totaling ₹12,500 per year. - Post-Graduation (Master of Arts/Master of Science/Master of Commerce/Bachelor of Education): ₹2,500 per month for maximum 10 months totaling ₹25,000 per year.
> **Disbursement Details** - **Mode:** Direct Benefit Transfer through bank accounts on monthly basis.- **Frequency:** Monthly for maximum 10 months per academic year.- **Validity:** No incentive during summer vacation or vacations extending more than one month.- **Exclusion Period:** Scheme not effective during June and July every year for academic session 2025-26.
> **Conditions for Availment/Continuation** - Regular class attendance required (75% attendance for existing beneficiaries). - Adherence to institutional discipline and rules and regulations. - No engagement in disruptive behavior, cheating, ragging, vandalism, or misconduct. - Students must not drop out of courses during benefit period. - No arrear amounts will be provided for missed periods. - Violation of rules results in withdrawal of benefits under the scheme.
> **Exclusions from Other Benefits** - Students receiving scooter under Banikanta Kakati Award (Pragyan Bharati Scheme) are not eligible unless they opt out of scooter benefit. - Higher Education Department's Mobility grant scheme has been merged with this scheme.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a girl student domiciled in Assam irrespective of economic status. - The applicant must be enrolled in government and venture educational institutions for Higher Secondary, Graduation (Bachelor of Arts/Bachelor of Science/Bachelor of Commerce), or Post-Graduation (Master of Arts/Master of Science/Master of Commerce/Bachelor of Education) courses. - The applicant must be a regular student (no correspondence or part-time students). - The applicant must be unmarried except for those enrolled in Post-Graduation and Bachelor of Education categories. - The applicant must maintain institutional discipline and adhere to all rules and regulations. - The applicant must attend classes regularly and maintain 75% attendance for existing beneficiaries.
## Exclusions - Married girls will not be eligible for the scheme except those in the P.G. and B. Ed. category. - In-service girls, admitted to B.Ed. course on deputation, will not be eligible for the scheme. - Daughters of Ministers/MPs and MLAs are not eligible for the Nijut Moina scheme.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** _Application Form Collection_ Collect the prescribed application form from the respective educational institution (school, college, or university) where you are currently enrolled, ensuring you have all required documents ready for submission. **Step 2:** _Form Completion and Submission_ Fill up the prescribed application form with correct and complete details including personal information, academic records, bank account details, and submit the duly filled form to the Head of Institution (Principal/Registrar) of your current educational metadata.schemeName: Silicosis Financial Assistance Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to heirs of workers engaged in Akik occupation who died due to silicosis disease. It benefits the families of deceased workers with monetary compensation of ₹1,00,000/- as support for occupational disease-related deaths.

page_content:
# Silicosis Financial Assistance Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Health & Wellness, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Silicosis, Labour, Worker, Rural, Disease, Heir, Compensation | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched in 2006, the scheme "Silicosis Financial Assistance Scheme" by the Gujarat Rural Workers Welfare Board, Labour and Employment Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance to the heirs of self-reliant persons carrying on occupation of Akik who suffer from the serious disease of silicosis in the state, addressing the occupational health hazards faced by workers in the Akik industry. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- to the heirs of affected workers as a security measure and compensation for the occupational disease. The applicant must be the heir of a self-reliant person who was engaged in Akik occupation and died due to silicosis disease in Gujarat state. The scheme is implemented by Gujarat Rural Workers Welfare Board under Labour and Employment Department. The applications for this scheme are accepted through the prescribed process.
## Benefits **Financial Assistance:** ₹1,00,000/- (one lakh rupees) per case. **Purpose:** Financial assistance to heirs of deceased workers who died due to silicosis. **Nature:** One-time payment as compensation.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be the legal heir of a deceased person who was engaged in Akik occupation. - The applicant must be the heir of a self-reliant person who carried on occupation of Akik in Gujarat state. - The applicant must be the heir of a person who died due to serious disease of silicosis. - The applicant must be the heir of a worker whose death occurred due to occupational silicosis while engaged in Akik work. - The applicant must establish the occupational nature of the silicosis disease in relation to Akik work.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the Office of the Government Labour Officer, and request the hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the authority given below - Office of the Government Labour Officer (Rural) in the case of worker living in rural area. Office of the Government Labour Officer (Industry) in the case of worker living in urban area. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable). **Step 5:** The concerned authorities will verify the submitted documents and establish the eligibility of the applicant as legal heir and confirm the occupational nature of silicosis disease. **Step 6:** The board will assess the case to confirm that the deceased was engaged in Akik occupation and that the death was due to silicosis disease as per medical evidence. **Step 7:** Upon successful verification and assessment, the case will be processed for approval and financial sanction by the competent authority.

metadata.schemeName: Whale Shark Conservation Programme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to protect the endangered Whale Shark, the world's largest fish, along the Gujarat coast, a crucial breeding site. It mitigates threats from fishing by providing compensation for damaged nets and cultivates a strong conservation ethic among local fishermen and the broader public.

page_content:
# Whale Shark Conservation Programme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Fishermen, Whale, Shark, Compensation, Marine, Wildlife | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched in 2004, the "Whale Shark Conservation Programme" by the Forests and Environment Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to tackle the problem of incidental catch and conserve the magnificent Whale Shark species, ensuring its protection along the Gujarat coast. The scheme provides full legal protection to Whale Sharks, listing them under Schedule-I of the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972 since May 28, 2001, marking it as the first fish protected by Indian law. It also features a compensation scheme for fishermen whose nets are damaged during rescue operations, and introduced a self-documentation process for claims in 2012. The fishermen must actively participate in rescue operations by reporting trapped Whale Sharks and assisting in their release. The scheme is implemented by the Forests and Environment Department. Applications for compensation under this scheme are accepted through reporting incidents to the forest range office or by self-documentation.
## Benefits > **Compensation for Damaged Nets** Fishermen are paid compensation not exceeding ₹25,000/- (twenty-five thousand rupees) in lieu of nets that are damaged or cut during rescue operations involving trapped Whale Sharks. > **Conditions for Benefit Availment/Disbursement** - The rescue operation must be documented through videography or photography for compensation to be paid. - The fishermen must take photographs of trapped Whale Sharks, release them on the spot, and then submit this information and photographs after returning to the coast to receive their compensation.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a fisherman, particularly from the Kharva and Koli communities residing in the coastal talukas of Veraval, Sutrapada, and Mangrol in Junagadh district. - The applicant's fishing net must incur damage or require cutting during an operation to rescue a trapped Whale Shark. - The applicant, or the rescue team involved, must ensure the rescue operation is thoroughly documented through either videography or photography. - The applicant, under the self-documentation scheme, must photograph the trapped Whale Shark, release it on the spot, and then submit these photographs along with incident details to the Forests and Environment Department after returning to the sea coast.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** _Transmitting Information to Land_ The crew of a fishing boat or trawler must transmit information about a Whale Shark getting trapped in their nets to personnel on land. **Step 2:** _Forwarding Information to Forest Range Office_ This transmitted information is subsequently forwarded to the respective forest range office, which is responsible for initiating rescue efforts. **Step 3:** _Organizing a Rescue Operation_ Upon receiving the information, the staff at the forest range office organizes a comprehensive rescue operation by gathering available beat guards, local labourers, fisheries personnel, a boat, and other necessary resources. **Step 4:** _Releasing the Whale Shark_ A designated rescue boat then departs for the site where the Whale Shark is trapped. Upon reaching the location, the staff, volunteers, and workmen proceed to cut the nets and safely release the fish. **Step 5:** _Documenting the Operation_ The entire rescue operation, from the sighting to the release of the Whale Shark, is thoroughly documented through either videography or photography. **Step 6:** _Receiving Compensation_ Following the successful and documented rescue operation, compensation is paid to the fishermen in accordance with the established guidelines for damaged nets. **Step 7:** _Self-Documentation and Claiming Compensation (Option Since 2012)_ Fishermen have the option, introduced since 2012, to personally document the incident by taking photographs of the trapped Whale Shark and releasing it on the spot. After returning to the sea coast, they are required to submit this information and the photographs to the Forests and Environment Department to claim their compensation.
> **Help & Support / Grievance Redressal** - For any assistance or to address grievances related to the Whale Shark Conservation Programme, applicants can utilize the official contact channels provided by the Forests and Environment Department, Gujarat. - General FAQs and a Forest Helpline Number are available on the department's website for citizen queries and support. > **Contact Details** - Specific contact details for Forest Officers are available on the main website of the Principal Chief Conservator of Forest & Head of the Forest Force, Government of Gujarat. - The Gujarat Biodiversity Board, a partner in conservation, can be reached at ***5th Floor, Aranya Bhavan, Sector-10A, Gandhinagar, with a phone number: (079) 23257950.*** > **Conclusion** - Upon completing the compensation claim process and submitting all necessary documentation, applicants are strongly advised to retain a copy of their submitted information and any acknowledgment receipts for future reference and tracking purposes. - This practice helps in verifying submissions and facilitating any follow-up queries regarding the compensation claim.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "National Mission For Sustainable Agriculture-Parmparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (NMSA-PKVY)" is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme that aims to promote organic farming practices through providing financial assistance for organic inputs and infrastructure support to farmers.

page_content:
# National Mission For Sustainable Agriculture-Parmparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (NMSA-PKVY) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Organic Farming, Sustainable Agriculture, Infrastructure Support | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "National Mission For Sustainable Agriculture-Parmparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (NMSA-PKVY)" is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme that aims to promote traditional and sustainable organic farming practices among farmers by providing financial support and infrastructure assistance. The scheme extends financial assistance for a maximum of 2 hectares per farmer for organic farming inputs, infrastructure development for on-farm organic input production, and related activities.
## Benefits - **Financial Assistance:** Assistance is provided for a maximum of 2 hectares per farmer for inputs for organic farming, on-farm input production infrastructure, etc.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/) Portal. **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side, then click on "Beneficiary Registration" and select any one from the 'Farmer' or 'Institutional' or 'Except For the Farmer' as the Beneficiary Type. **Step 3:** Select the District, Taluka, and Village, choose 'what type of account holder you are?', enter your Account Number and Name, solve the Captcha, and click 'Save and Next'. **Step 4:** Enter your Mobile Number and Email address, click 'Send OTP', enter the received OTP, create and confirm a Password, solve the Captcha, and click 'Submit'. > **Login Process:** **Step 1:** The applicant may visit and apply online at the [I-Khedut](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/) Portal. **Step 2:** Click on 'Login' from the top right-hand side of the homepage. On the home page, click on ‘Schemes’ and then click on ‘Agricultural Schemes’. **Step 3:** Now select the scheme, click on the ‘Apply’ button, and an application page will open. **Step 4:** Click on the "Apply New" button and submit a new application. **Step 5:** Click on the "Update Application" button to add corrections to the application. **Step 6:** Once the application is done, confirm it. **Step 7:** Take a printout of the confirmed application. > **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_Contacts.aspx)

# Vocational Education Programme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Vocational Education, Skill Development, Training, Student, Government Secondary Schools | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Vocational Education Programme” is a scheme under the Samagra Shiksha Programme, implemented by the Secondary Education Department, Government of Uttarakhand. ## Benefits Under the programme, 08 sectors approved by the Government of India are being implemented under NSQF to provide vocational education alongside academic education for students of classes 9 to 12 in selected schools, where they receive both vocational education and training.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be studying in classes 9 to 12 in one of the 200 selected government secondary schools of Uttarakhand.

For this, no separate application is required. - There is also no need to submit any documents for the selection of vocational education subject.

page_content:
# Kasturba Gandhi Residential Girls’ Hostel **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Housing & Shelter, Women and Child | **Tags:** Hostel, Girl Student, Upper Primary Level, Secondary Level, Kasturba Gandhi | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Kasturba Gandhi Residential Girls’ Hostel” is an initiative under the Samagra Shiksha Programme, implemented by the Secondary Education Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage girls’ participation in education at the upper primary and secondary levels and to provide quality education to girls from disadvantaged groups studying in Classes 6 to 12.
## Benefits Girls from various disadvantaged groups such as socially disadvantaged classes (Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Minorities, and Backward Classes), economically weaker sections, and girls with special needs are identified and enrolled in the hostels at the upper primary and secondary levels (Classes 6 to 12).
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant (girl student) must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should be a studying at the upper primary or secondary level (Class 6 to Class 12). 1. In line with the target group of the scheme, 75% of the seats in KGBVs are reserved for girls from SC, ST, OBC, and minority communities, while the remaining 25% are reserved for girls from families living Below Poverty Line (BPL). 1. In addition, girls from economically weaker families (with an annual income of less than ₹55,000/-) or those who have lost both parents or one parent will also be eligible for admission.

School leaving certificate / certificate of never having attended school / affidavit / declaration. 1. BPL certificate / ration card. 1. Income certificate / caste certificate. 1. Certificate stating that the distance between the school and the residence is more than 3 km.

# Assistance to Co-operative Irrigation Societies (Trible Area) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Irrigation, Co-operative Irrigation Societies, Farm Productivity, Tribal Area Farmers | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Assistance to Co-operative Irrigation Societies (Tribal Area)" by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to increase farm productivity by offering financial support to irrigation co-operative societies formed by tribal area farmers. The scheme focuses on forming such societies and facilitating water distribution by setting up electric pumps and motors on wells and agar creeks.
## Benefits - **Monetary Support:** Financial help is provided for the installation of electric motors and pumps on wells and agar creeks to enhance irrigation facilities.
## Eligibility Criteria - Cooperative irrigation societies formed by small and marginal farmers, or any other farmers, are eligible under this scheme. - The society should be located within the state of Gujarat. - The Scheme is applicable to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should prepare the application on plain paper. **Step 2:** In the application form, provide all the mandatory details, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the supporting documents to the District Registrar's Office. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted.

# Pandit Deendayal Educational Excellence Award **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Academic Excellence, Award, Student, Top Performer Schools | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Pandit Deendayal Educational Excellence Award" scheme is implemented by the Secondary Education Department under the Department of Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote academic excellence among schools and students by providing cash awards to the best-performing schools at the high school and intermediate levels at the state level, as well as to students securing top positions in the Uttarakhand Board High School and Intermediate Examinations.
## Benefits > **For Schools:** The 3 schools giving the best results at the state level are awarded prizes of: - ₹10,00,000/-, ₹5,00,000/-, and ₹3,00,000/- at the Intermediate level. - ₹8,00,000/-, ₹4,00,000/-, and ₹2,00,000/- at the High School level. > **For Students (Intermediate Level):** - Students securing 1st, 2nd, and 3rd positions: ₹21,000/-, ₹15,000/-, and ₹11,000/- respectively. - Students securing 4th to 10th positions: ₹5,100/- each. > **For Students (High School Level):** - Students securing 1st, 2nd, and 3rd positions: ₹15,000/-, ₹11,000/-, and ₹8,000/- respectively. - Students securing 4th to 10th positions: ₹5,100/- each.
## Eligibility Criteria > **For School:** 1. The applicant school must be among the 3 best-performing schools at the Uttarakhand Board high school or intermediate level school at the state level. > **For Student:** 1. The applicant student must be among the top 10 rank holders in the Uttarakhand Board Council Examination at High School or Intermediate level examination.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - The Secondary Education Department, Uttarakhand, receives the list from the Board after the examination results are declared. After obtaining approval from the competent authority for the amount to be awarded to high school and intermediate students securing top 10 positions in the Board examinations, the list is forwarded to the Chief Education Officer. - The concerned Chief Education Officer issues drafts to the respective schools according to the number of eligible students. The schools then provide these to the students directly or, in some cases, distribute the funds through award ceremonies. - Under this scheme, students are not required to submit any application.
