metadata.schemeName: PRL's Vikram Sarabhai Postdoctoral Fellowship (VISHWAS)
metadata.briefDescription: The Vikram Sarabhai Postdoctoral Fellowship (VISHWAS) program is an initiative by the Physical Research Laboratory (PRL) to honor the legacy of Prof. Vikram Sarabhai by supporting young doctorates to pursue groundbreaking research in fundamental science with societal impact.

page_content:
# PRL's Vikram Sarabhai Postdoctoral Fellowship (VISHWAS) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Science And Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Scholarship, Fellowship, Research, Post Doctoral | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Vikram Sarabhai Postdoctoral Fellowship (VISHWAS) launched by the Department of Space, Ministry of Science and Technology is aimed at providing financial support to highly motivated young PhD holders to conduct advanced research in fundamental sciences with societal implications. The fellowship is designed to foster innovative and cutting-edge research in areas pursued by the Physical Research Laboratory (PRL), aligned with the vision of Prof. Vikram Sarabhai.

## Benefits > **Number of VISHWAS Fellowships:** 3
> ***Scholarship Amount:*** - Scholars receive ₹1,00,000/- per month with HRA and other facilities as per PRL/DOS rules.
> ***Duration:*** - Maximum of 2 years (subject to successful annual reviews). It may be extended for one additional year based on justification and approval.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be an Indian national. 1. PhD should have been awarded within the last four years (from the application deadline). 1. The applicant's age should be 35 years or below on the last date of application. 1. The applicant should have a first-class academic record throughout their academic career. 1. The applicant should submit a strong research proposal aligned with PRL’s research areas. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step-01:** The applicant visits the [PRL website](https://www.prl.res.in/prl-eng/) and navigate to the "Opportunities" section. **Step-02:** Click on "Job Vacancies & Fellowship Programs" and select "PRL's Vikram Sarabhai Postdoctoral Fellowship (VISHWAS)" to access the online [application form](https://www.prl.res.in/~pdf/VISHWAS_form.html). **Step-03:** Fill out the online application form by completing all the mandatory fields and attaching self-attested copies of the required documents. **Step-04:** Submit the application by clicking on the "Submit" button. Upon submission, you will receive an application ID for future reference.
**NOTE:** - Applicants must arrange recommendation letters from at least three non-PRL referees. These letters should be emailed directly to the Chairperson, PDF Committee at: pdf@prl.res.in. - Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, either online or in person, for the final selection.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase affordable rental housing infrastructure. Through this scheme, land identification and government housing development support are provided.

page_content:
# Scheme for Promotion of Affordable Rental Smart Housing (SPARSH 2.0): Government Affordable Rental Housing Development Support **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu | **Categories:** Housing & Shelter | **Tags:** Afforable Rental Housing, Land Identification, Government Housing, Economically Weaker Section, Rent Subsidy, Labour | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Scheme for Promotion of Affordable Rental Smart Housing (SPARSH 2.0)” implemented through verticals "***Incentivising government departments, PSUs, autonomous bodies to either use their vacant residential complexes for stay of urban poor by renting them out on outsourcing model or construction of such new SPARSH 2.0 housing complexes on vacant land under their ownership***" by the Labour & Employment Department, UT Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu aims to expand affordable rental housing stock through government participation and institutional support. Through this scheme, land identification, housing development support, and conversion of existing vacant government housing are provided for affordable rental housing purposes. The scheme is implemented by Municipalities, District Panchayats, Public Sector Undertakings, Autonomous Bodies, and other government agencies in coordination with the Department of Labour & Employment. The scheme promotes the creation of at least 1 SPARSH 2.0 housing complex by each participating authority. Existing government housing stock may also be converted into affordable rental housing complexes. Construction may be carried out through own funds or through Grant-in-Aid support. The scheme contributes towards the creation of long-term affordable housing infrastructure. > **Objectives:** - To address the vision of “Aatma Nirbhar Bharat Abhiyan” by creating a sustainable ecosystem of affordable rental housing solutions for workers in industries, construction sites, and other weaker sections. - To achieve the objective of “Housing for All” by promoting affordable rental housing for workers and labourers. - To create a conducive environment by incentivising public and private entities to invest in affordable rental housing stock. - To increase the productivity of industries by improving the health and well-being of workers. - To reduce the financial burden on workers due to treatment costs and wage loss. - To increase the happiness and quality of life of workers. - To harmonize the Affordable Rental Housing Complexes (ARHC) Scheme guidelines with the SPARSH Scheme.
## Benefits 1. All municipalities, District Panchayats, PSUs, and Autonomous bodies within UT of DNH-DD shall be obliged to identify lands in their respective jurisdictions with the help of concerned revenue departments, and to construct at least one SPARSH 2.0 housing or to run at least one SPARSH 2.0 housing on houses already under their possession in their respective jurisdictions 1. Such municipalities, District Panchayats, PSUs, and Autonomous bodies within UT of DNH-DD shall do so either through their own funds, or if the same is not viable, through Grant in Aid allotted to them. 1. In order to be eligible under SPARSH 2.0, the units constructed under this vertical shall follow the same norms as mentioned in Vertical 2.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should belong to Dadra And Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. 1. The applicant should be the owner or authorised representative of the housing complex. 1. The housing complex should fulfil SPARSH 2.0 infrastructure norms. 1. The housing complex should possess a valid construction permission and/or occupancy certificate. 1. The applicant should agree to reserve at least 66% dwelling units for Economically Weaker Section beneficiaries. 1. The applicant should agree to maintain the housing complex and waste management systems.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The owner or authorised representative of the housing complex should obtain Form A prescribed under the scheme. **Step 2:** The applicant should fill out Form A and attach all required supporting documents. **Step 3:** The completed application should be submitted to the concerned officer designated by the Secretary, Labour, for the respective district. **Step 4:** The nodal officer shall verify the application within 30 days. Technical verification may also be conducted through the Associate Town Planner or other competent authority. **Step 5:** After successful verification, the nodal officer shall issue the Registration Certificate in Form B. **Step 6:** The nodal officer shall execute an agreement with the owner as prescribed under the scheme. **Step 7:** The registration shall be verified annually. Registration may be cancelled if the scheme conditions are violated.

metadata.schemeName: Mission Vatsalya (Child Protection Services and Child Welfare Services)
metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Women and Child Development
metadata.briefDescription: This scheme aims to ensure, sustain, and strengthen child protection at the family and community levels, promote family-based non-institutional care, and provide financial support to children in need.

page_content:
# Mission Vatsalya (Child Protection Services and Child Welfare Services) **Ministry:** Ministry of Women and Child Development | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Women and Child | **Tags:** Childcare, Childhood, Vatsalya, Child Protection | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Mission Vatsalya (Child Protection Services and Child Welfare Services)" is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme of the Government of India, implemented by the Ministry of Women and Child Development. The scheme aims to strengthen child protection systems and ensure the overall well-being of children across the country. **Key objectives:** - To prioritise children in all administrative processes, keeping the centrality of the child at the core of all activities and actions undertaken under the Mission. - To ensure the best interests of the child while designing and delivering projects and programmes, and to take affirmative action to enable children to grow up in a happy family environment supported by a strong social safety net. - To ensure children’s rights to survival, development, protection, and participation. - To establish essential services and strengthen emergency outreach, family- and community-based non-institutional care, institutional care, counselling, and support services at the national, regional, state, and district levels. - To ensure an appropriate inter-sectoral response at all levels through coordination and networking with allied systems, promoting convergence for seamless service delivery to children. - To strengthen child protection at the family and community levels by equipping families and communities to identify risks and vulnerabilities, and by creating and promoting preventive measures to protect children from abuse, neglect, and exploitation. - To encourage private sector partnerships and interventions within the legal framework to support child welfare initiatives. - To raise public awareness and educate communities about child rights, vulnerabilities, and government-sponsored protection measures, and to engage communities at all levels as key stakeholders in ensuring the best interests of children. - To build the capacities of duty bearers and service providers at all levels. - To monitor progress using objective parameters against clearly defined outputs and outcomes. - To ensure the participation of Panchayats and Urban Local Bodies at village, ward, and urban cluster levels for sustained assessment, implementation of appropriate interventions, and regular monitoring to develop a robust social safety net for children.
## Benefits **Financial Support for Vulnerable Children** - Children living with biological parents or extended families receive financial assistance to meet their education, nutrition, and healthcare needs, helping prevent separation from families. **Family-Based Foster Care Support** - Children without parental care are placed with biologically unrelated foster families, ensuring a nurturing home environment. Foster parents receive financial assistance to support the child’s care, protection, and rehabilitation. **Legal and Safe Adoption Opportunities** - Children declared legally free for adoption are placed in permanent family settings through Specialised Adoption Agencies (SAAs), ensuring their long-term emotional and social well-being. **After-Care Support for Independent Living** - Children exiting Child Care Institutions at the age of 18 are provided financial assistance up to 21 years, extendable to 23 years, to support education, skill development, employment, and smooth reintegration into society. **Monthly Financial Assistance** - A monthly grant of ₹4,000 per child is provided to State Governments under Sponsorship, Foster Care, or After-Care to ensure sustained support. **Strengthened Child Protection Systems** - State Governments are encouraged to provide additional grants and proactively identify children in need of care and protection with the support of Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs) and Urban Local Bodies. **Transparent Approval and Monitoring Mechanism** - Every district establishes a Sponsorship and Foster Care Approval Committee (SFCAC) to review, approve, and sanction assistance, ensuring accountability and timely support. **Compliance with Legal Framework** - All non-institutional care interventions are implemented in accordance with the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act and Rules, ensuring legality, safety, and child-centric care.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant child must be below 18 years of age for Sponsorship, Foster Care, and Adoption. 1. The applicant child must be 18 years or above for After-Care support (up to 21 years, extendable to 23 years). 1. The applicant caregiver family shall be eligible for financial support if the annual family income is below ₹8 lakh per annum or as prescribed by the Ministry of WCD from time to time. 1. The applicant child must be willing to stay with the foster family.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The State Government/District Administration shall constitute a Selection Committee headed by the District Magistrate for the selection of District Child Protection Unit (DCPU) staff. **Step 2:** Vacancies shall be advertised by the District Administration, and eligible candidates shall submit their offline applications with the required documents. **Step 3:** Applications shall be screened based on prescribed qualifications and experience. Police background verification shall be mandatory before appointment. **Step 4:** Final selection shall be made by the Selection Committee. Appointment shall be subject to performance review, confidentiality norms, and scheme guidelines.

metadata.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to reward outstanding sportspersons for their achievements at the global level. It aims to simplify eligibility, improve the award process, motivate athletes to achieve higher, and inspire young people to take up sports.

page_content:
# Scheme of Cash Incentive to Medal Winners in International Sports Events and their Coaches **Ministry:** Ministry Of Youth Affairs & Sports | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Medal, Sports, Events, Awards | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Scheme of Cash Incentives to Medal Winners in International Sports Events and their Coaches", implemented by the Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports under the Department of Sports, Government of India, was introduced in 1986 to reward outstanding sportspersons for their achievements on the global stage. Over the years, the scheme has been revised to enhance its effectiveness. The latest amendment aims to streamline eligibility criteria, improve the disbursement process, incentivise higher achievements, and motivate athletes to serve as inspiring role models for the younger generation to take up sports.
## Benefits > For all international events except the Olympics, Paralympics, Asian Games, Para-Asian Games, and Commonwealth Games, cash incentives will be paid based on the number of participating countries.

Amount of IncentiveIn a team event In an individual eventFullThe number of participating countries shall be at least 12 or the maximum permissible number of participants, whichever is lower.The number of participating countries shall be at least 16 or the maximum permissible number of participants, whichever is lower. HalfThe number of participating countries is in the range of 6 to 11.The number of participating countries is in the range of 8 to15.One-thirdThe number of participating countries shall be between 4 and 5.The number of participating countries shall range from 4 to 7.
Note: No cash incentive shall be given if the number of teams in any event is less than 4.
## Eligibility Criteria The cash incentive shall be awarded exclusively for the sports disciplines specified.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 1: The sportsperson must submit the application through the Department of Sports’ designated portal within six months of the event. Step 2: If all required details are already available, the application submission may be waived. Step 3: Late applications will not be accepted; no relaxation is allowed for missing the deadline. Step 4: The achievements of the sportsperson and coaches will be verified by authorised agencies or official databases before approval.

page_content:
# Buti Foundation Award **Ministry:** Ministry Of Science And Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Skills & Employment, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Award, Scientist, Engineer, Research | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Buti Foundation Award, established in 2007 by the Buti Foundation, New Delhi, is a biennial award recognizing innovative and outstanding research in the field of Plasma Science & Technology. The award aims to honor a Scientist/Engineer under the age of 45 years for their significant contributions to this field. The award includes a medal and a cash prize. ## Benefits - **Award Amount:** ₹50,000/-- **Award Recognition:** Medal ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a Scientist/Engineer. 1. The applicant’s age should be 45 years as of 1st January 2021 (born on or after 02.01.1976). 1. The applicant should have conducted innovative and outstanding research in the field of Plasma Science & Technology in India.

Under IGNOAPS, citizens living Below Poverty Line and 60 years or above in age are eligible to apply. A monthly pension of ₹ 200 up to 79 years and ₹ 500 thereafter.

page_content:
# NSAP - Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme

**Ministry:** Ministry Of Rural Development | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** BPL, Pension, Senior Citizen, Social Welfare | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme "Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)" is one of the five sub-schemes of the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP). Under IGNOAPS, citizens living Below Poverty Line and 60 years or above in age are eligible to apply. A monthly pension of ₹ 200 up to 79 years and ₹ 500 thereafter.
The Government of India, on 15th August 1995, introduced the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) as a fully funded Centrally Sponsored Scheme targeting the destitute, defined as any person who has little or no regular means of subsistence from his / her own source of income or through financial support from family members or other sources, to be identified by the States and UTs, with the objective of providing a basic level of financial aid. NSAP is being administered by the Ministry of Rural Development. This program is being implemented in rural areas as well as urban areas. 
NSAP represents a significant step towards the fulfillment of the Directive Principles of State Policy enshrined in the Constitution of India which enjoin upon the State to undertake within its means a number of welfare measures. These are intended to secure for the citizen's adequate means of livelihood, raise the standard of living, improve public health, provide free and compulsory education for children, etc. 
**The NSAP at present includes five sub-schemes as its components -** 
a) Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
b) Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
c) Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
d) National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS)
e) Annapurna Scheme
**Objectives of NSAP -** 
1.  Provides social assistance benefits to poor households in the case of death, maternity, or old age of the breadwinner.
2.  Ensure minimum national standards, in addition to the benefits, the States are currently providing or might provide in the future.
3.  Ensure uniform social protection to the beneficiaries across the country without interruption.
**Expansion to cover all eligible BPL persons -** 
In 2007, the scheme was expanded to cover all eligible persons Below Poverty Line (BPL).

## Benefits
A monthly pension of ₹ 200 up to 79 years and ₹ 500 thereafter.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be living Below Poverty Line.
1. The applicant should be at least 60 years of age.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
- One can download UMANG App or visit website [https://web.umang.gov.in/web_new/home](https://web.umang.gov.in/web_new/home) - The citizen can login using mobile number and OTP.
- Once logged In, citizen can search for NSAP.
- Click on “Apply Online”
- Fill the basic details, choose the mode of payment of pension, upload photo and click on “Submit”.

metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Environment,forests and climate change
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage the demand for environment-friendly products that cause lesser adverse impacts on the environment. It provides an Ecomark label for products meeting specified environmental criteria to eligible producers, manufacturers, importers, and exporters.

page_content:
# Ecomark Scheme of India (ECOMARK) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Environment,forests and climate change | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Manufacturer, Producer, Importer, Exporter, Certification, Compliance, Recognition | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Ecomark Scheme of India (ECOMARK)" was launched by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India. The scheme provides an "Ecomark" label for products that meet specified environmental criteria with respect to resource consumption and environmental impacts, enabling consumers to make informed purchase decisions. The applicant must submit an application for the grant of Ecomark to the Central Pollution Control Board in Form 1. The scheme is implemented by the Central Pollution Control Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the Ecomark web portal.
## Benefits - The scheme grants an Ecomark label to the product. - The Ecomark granted to the product shall be valid for a period of three years or until a change in the Ecomark criteria for the product, whichever is earlier. ##### ***Conditions*** - Every holder of Ecomark shall submit an annual report to the Central Pollution Control Board online through the web portal on or before the 31st May of every year. - Every person who has been granted an Ecomark in respect of a product shall affix on such product an Ecomark label granted under these rules. - The holder of Ecomark shall allow the Central Pollution Control Board or the registered agencies to undertake such inspection and verification as may be considered necessary for ensuring compliance. - The holder of the Ecomark shall grant access to the premises in which the product concerned is produced or kept to the Central Pollution Control Board and the registered agency.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a producer, manufacturer, exporter, or importer of products specified under the First Schedule of the rules. - The applicant must have a license or a certificate of conformity of Indian Standards granted under the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016. - The applicant must comply with the mandate of the Quality Control Orders issued by the Central Government, if applicable. - The applicant must fulfill the criteria for the grant of Ecomark specified under the corresponding entries of the First Schedule.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ##### **Step 1:****** ***Accessing the Ecomark Portal*** The applicant must access the [centralized online Ecomark web portal](https://cpcb.nic.in/ecomark-licence/) developed by the Central Pollution Control Board for making applications and tracking Ecomark certification. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Submitting the Application Form*** The applicant must fill and submit an application for the grant of Ecomark for a product which complies with the specified conditions to the Central Pollution Control Board. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Verification of the Product*** On receipt of the application, the Central Pollution Control Board shall, by itself or through a designated Verifier, verify whether the product complies with the required environmental conditions. ##### **Step 4:****** ***Preparation and Submission of the Report*** After making such verification, the Central Pollution Control Board or the Verifier shall prepare a report and submit it within a period of sixty days from the date of such verification. ##### **Step 5:****** ***Grant of the Ecomark Certificate*** On receipt of the verification report, if the Central Pollution Control Board is satisfied that the product complies with the conditions, it may grant the Ecomark to the product.

metadata.schemeName: NAMO Shree Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure proper nutritional support to pregnant women and lactating mothers and encourage institutional deliveries. It provides financial assistance of ₹12,000/- to eligible women beneficiaries covering expenses from conception to delivery.

page_content:
# NAMO Shree Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Women, Maternal, Pregnancy, Financial, Health, Nutrition, Delivery | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched in 2024, the scheme "NAMO Shree Scheme" by the Women and Child Development Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to ensure that every pregnant woman and lactating mother of the state gets proper nutritional support and also encourages them to have institutional deliveries for women's empowerment and improving maternal health. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹12,000/- to eligible women beneficiaries and covers expenses from conception to delivery of the child. The applicant must be Gujarat's pregnant woman or a lactating mother, whose family income is not more than ₹8,00,000/- per year, and must deliver a child in any government or private hospital. The scheme is implemented by the Women and Child Development Department of the Gujarat Government, and registration under this scheme is done at the time of the first antenatal check-up through an Accredited Social Health Activist or Auxiliary Nurse Midwife Worker at the nearest Anganwadi Centre.
## Benefits > **Financial Assistance Amount** Eligible women beneficiaries receive ₹12,000/- from conception to delivery of the child for their first two live children, distributed in phases.
> **Disbursal for First Pregnancy** - ₹5,000/- at the time of registration (₹2,000/- from State Government and ₹3,000/- from Central Government) - ₹2,000/- after six months of pregnancy (from the State Government) - ₹3,000/- immediately after institutional delivery (from the State Government) - ₹2,000/- after the 14-week vaccination (from the Central Government)
> **Disbursal for Second Pregnancy** - ₹2,000/- at the time of registration - ₹3,000/- after six months of pregnancy - ₹6,000/- after institutional delivery (amount given by the Central Government if the newborn is a girl and by the State Government if the newborn is a boy) - ₹1,000/- from the State Government after the 14-week vaccination
**Mode of Disbursement:** The Amount is transferred directly into the beneficiary woman's bank account through installments. **Additional Benefits:** Beneficiary women are also eligible to avail the benefits of other Central Government schemes like Pradhan Mantri Matritva Vandana Yojana and Janani Suraksha Yojana.
**Conditions for Availment** A certificate from the Medical Institution of Delivery is required for the last installment.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be from Gujarat. 2. The applicant must be a pregnant woman or a lactating mother. 3. The applicant must belong to one of the following categories: - Scheduled Tribe - Scheduled Caste - Beneficiary of the National Food Security Act - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana Beneficiary - Below Poverty Line families - E Shram Card holder women beneficiary - Women who are farmers - Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act beneficiary 4. The applicant's family income must not be more than ₹8,00,000/- per year. 5. The applicant must deliver the child in any government or private hospital. 6. The applicant must register at the time of the first antenatal check-up.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** _Visit the Nearest Anganwadi Centre_ The applicant must visit their nearest Anganwadi Centre to initiate the registration process for the NAMO Shree Scheme. **Step 2:** _Registration by Accredited Social Health Activist or Auxiliary Nurse Midwife Worker_ The Accredited Social Health Activist or Auxiliary Nurse Midwife Worker at the Anganwadi Centre will register the pregnant woman in the NAMO Shree Scheme. The registration must be completed at the time of the first antenatal check-up. **Step 3:** _Final Approval Process_ The final approval for the scheme benefits will be provided by the Women and Child Development Department of the Government of Gujarat after processing the registration. **Step 4:** _Benefit Disbursement_ Once approved, the financial assistance amount will be disbursed in installments directly into the beneficiary's bank account as per the scheme guidelines. _*For receiving the final installment, the beneficiary must submit a Certificate from the Medical Institution of Delivery to complete the benefit disbursement process._ _*Applicants are advised to save copies of all submitted documents and acknowledgements for future reference._

metadata.schemeName: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship
metadata.briefDescription: The "INSPIRE FACULTY FELLOWSHIP" component provides opportunities to 100 persons every year with Ph.D. qualifications in the age group of 27-32 years for 5 years to carry out research in both basic and applied science areas including engineering, medicine, agriculture, and veterinary sciences.

page_content:
# Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship **Ministry:** Ministry Of Science And Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Science, IT & Communications, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Research, Fellowship, Faculty, Science, PhD | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "INSPIRE FACULTY FELLOWSHIP" component provides opportunities to 100 persons every year with Ph.D. qualifications in the age group of 27-32 years for 5 years to carry out research in both basic and applied science areas including engineering, medicine, agriculture, and veterinary sciences for establishing themselves as independent researchers. It grants an attractive fellowship for a duration of 5 years. The objective of the scheme is to encourage young researchers to continue research in areas of S&T, Medicine, Agriculture, Pharmacy, and Veterinary Sciences.
Purpose 1. To provide attractive opportunities for young achievers for developing independent scientific profiles and launch them toward fulfilling long-term careers. 2. To augment high-quality scientific manpower in scientific and educational institutions, especially the Central and State universities. 3. While vertical migration from the other INSPIRE components would be encouraged, the faculty fellowship component also provides the opportunity to meritorious candidates for lateral entry into INSPIRE scheme. 4. INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship provides an opportunity to post-doctoral fellows for carrying out independent research however does not guarantee a regular position after 5 years. ## Benefits > **Amount** 1. Each selected INSPIRE Faculty Fellow will be eligible to receive a consolidated amount of ₹1,25,000/- per month as a fellowship with an annual increment of ₹2,000/-. 1. In addition, a Research Grant of ₹7,00,000 every year for 5 years will also be provided to each successful candidate including the carry-forward amount, if any, from the previous year. 1. The consolidated amount of ₹1,25,000/- per month is an all-inclusive fellowship and taxable as per the Indian IT Act.
> **Duration** 1. The INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship is for a maximum period of 5 (five) years. ## Eligibility Criteria > **Essential** 1. Indian citizens and People of Indian origin with PIO status having Ph.D. degrees (in science, mathematics, engineering, pharmacy, medicine, and agriculture-related subjects) from any recognized university in the world. 1. Candidates should possess a minimum of 60% (or equivalent CGPA) marks throughout their academic profile starting from the Senior Secondary Examination (Class 12 onwards). 1. Those that have submitted their Ph.D. theses and are awaiting the award of their degree shall also be eligible. However, selection for the Fellowship will be confirmed only after the Ph.D. degree is awarded. 1. The upper age limit as of 1st January of the respective year of advertisement, is 32 years for General Category. However, for SC, ST, and Women candidates, the upper age limit will be 37 years. For persons with benchmark disabilities (Divyangjan with not less than 40 percent of a specified disability), the upper age limit will be 42 years. 1. Publication(s) in highly reputed journals demonstrating the outstanding research potential of the candidate. 1. Candidates who are employed in regular/contractual positions within India may also apply for INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship for improvement and enhancement in their career prospects but, upon selection, the candidates will need to resign (no lien or deputation or any type of leave would be accepted) from the current job and organization before taking up the INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship. 1. Candidates, who get selected for regular positions in any institute/university after submission of the IFF application, would be entitled to receive the Research Grant only as INSPIRE Faculty Fellows.
> **Desirable** 1. Candidates who are within the top 1% in Class 12 examination, IIT-JEE rank holders, 1st rank holders either in graduation or post-graduation level university examinations. ## Exclusions No Fellow shall avail of two fellowships concurrently during the tenure of this Fellowship period. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** https://www.online-inspire.gov.in > **Mode of Application** 1. Eligible candidates need to submit applications ONLINE through the portal of INSPIRE program only. No other mode of submission of the application is permitted. 1. To apply ONLINE, please visit the [website ](https://online-inspire.gov.in)and follow the process described therein. After the successful submission of the application online, the candidate may obtain a printout of the application and keep it for his/her personal reference.
> **Method of Selection** 1. The Indian National Science Academy (INSA), New Delhi, in coordination with DST, is implementing this INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship Scheme up to the stage of recommendation of candidates for INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship. 1. A three-tier selection process, viz. evaluation by discipline-based Expert Committees, followed by the recommendations of the Apex Level Committee and INSPIRE Faculty Award Council. Based on the recommendations of these Committees, DST makes the final selection.

metadata.schemeName: Assistance to Voluntary Organisations for Promotion of the Official Languages in the Field of Law
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to propagate and develop literature in the field of law in Hindi and other regional languages. It provides financial grants to voluntary organisations for publishing legal books, commentaries, and journals.

page_content:
# Assistance to Voluntary Organisations for Promotion of the Official Languages in the Field of Law **Ministry:** Ministry Of Law and Justice | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Public Safety,Law & Justice, Science, IT & Communications | **Tags:** Institution, Language, Legal, Literature, Law, Books | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Assistance to Voluntary Organisations for Promotion of the Official Languages in the Field of Law" was launched by the Legislative Department, Government Of India. The scheme aims to propagate and develop literature in the field of law in Hindi and other regional languages. The scheme provides financial assistance covering up to 85% of the anticipated net expenditure for producing legal literature, such as commentaries, treatises, and law journals. The applicant must be a voluntary organisation undertaking activities conducive to the enrichment and use of Official Languages in the legal field. The scheme is implemented by the Ministry Of Law And Justice. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline via submission to the Official Languages Wing at Shastri Bhawan, New Delhi.
## Benefits - Financial assistance in the form of a grant not exceeding 85% of the anticipated net expenditure involved in the implementation of the project or activity. - The grants are paid in installments depending on the nature of activities to be undertaken and the progress of the work. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The organisation must bear the balance of the estimated expenditure on the scheme or project._ - _All assets created out of the grant must not be transferred to any person or institution without the prior concurrence of the Government of India._ - _If the organisation ceases to exist, the equipment purchased out of the central grant will revert to the Government of India._ - _The accounts of the organisation must be properly maintained and submitted as required for checking by the Legislative Department or Indian Audit And Accounts Department._ - _The organisation must exercise the utmost economy in its working._ - _The grant must be utilized strictly for the purpose for which it was sanctioned._ - _Progress reports about the project must be furnished at regular intervals._ - _An audited statement of expenditure and a report on the work done must be furnished immediately after the completion of the project or before drawing a subsequent installment._ - _The organisation must submit a Utilisation Certificate in respect of the grant received during the preceding year._ - _Such number of copies, not exceeding five, of all publications brought out with central assistance must be supplied to the Legislative Department free of cost._ - _The organisation must maintain an audited record of the assets acquired or created wholly or substantially with the help of the grant in the prescribed proforma._ - _The author of a published book must use the Hindi legal terms occurring in the authoritative texts of the Central Acts, State Acts, or the Legal Glossary published by the Official Languages Wing._ - _The organisation must give an undertaking to complete the project within a reasonable time fixed by the Government._
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a voluntary organisation or institution. - The applicant must propose a project or activity for the development and propagation of literature in the field of law in Hindi or other regional languages. - The applicant must undertake activities such as proposing commentaries, treatises, books, law journals, compendiums, or other relevant publications. - The applicant must agree to bear the balance of the estimated expenditure for the proposed project.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ##### **Step 1:****** ***Procuring and Preparing the Application Form*** The applicant must obtain the [prescribed application form](https://www.legislative.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/07/71d6d251531656818d22b048aa08fff8.pdf) for financial assistance under the Central Government. The applicant must carefully fill out the application form in duplicate and ensure all required details regarding the organisation, assets, and project features are accurately provided. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Gathering and Attaching Required Documents*** The applicant must compile all the necessary supplementary documents, such as the institutional prospectus, audited accounts, and manuscript copies. The applicant must ensure that these duplicate documents are securely attached alongside the completed application forms. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Submitting the Application Offline*** The applicant must submit the complete application package to the ***Joint Secretary and Legislative Counsel at the Official Languages Wing, Room No. 742, 7th Floor 'A' Wing, Shastri Bhawan, New Delhi-110001.***

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "CMAT - Scheme for Award to Distinguished Artistes" is a scheme by the Dept. of Art & Culture, Govt. of Manipur, to encourage and felicitate the artistes (in the field of culture) belonging to different fields for their achievements such as winning National Awards namely Padma Award, etc.

page_content:
# Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) - Scheme For Award To Distinguished Artistes **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Manipur | **Categories:** Sports & Culture, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Artist, Award, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) - Scheme for Award to Distinguished Artistes" is a scheme by the Dept. of Art & Culture, Govt. of Manipur, to encourage and felicitate the artistes (in the field of culture) belonging to different fields for their achievements such as winning National Awards namely Padma Awards, Sangeet Natak Akademi, Sahitya Akademi, Lalit Kala Akademi Awards including Young Awardees, National Film Award winners and on winning any national level competitions, and International Awards in the field of Art & Culture. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a domicile of the state of Manipur. 1. The applicant should be National Award winners viz Padma Awardee, Sangeet Natak Akademi Awardee, Sahitya Akademi Awardee, Lalit Kala Akademi Awardee, and Zonal Cultural Centre’s Award including Young Awardees, National Level Competition, and National Film Awards for individuals and groups. 1. metadata.schemeName: Research and Development Programme in Water Sector
metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Water Resources,River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to solve water sector problems through effective research and development. It provides Grants-in-Aid to academicians, universities, laboratories, government departments, and Non-Governmental Organizations to fund basic, applied, and action research projects.

page_content:
# Research and Development Programme in Water Sector **Ministry:** Ministry Of Water Resources,River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Science, IT & Communications | **Tags:** Academician, Investigator, University, Laboratory, Fellowship, Remuneration, Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Research and Development Programme in Water Sector" was launched by the Ministry of Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation. The scheme aims to provide solutions to the problems related to the water sector through effective research and development for achieving sustainable development and self-reliance. The scheme provides Grants-in-Aid for basic research, applied research, and action research, detailing key provisions such as remuneration for research personnel, travel expenses, infrastructure costs, experimental charges, and overhead charges. The applicant must submit a well-written research proposal clearly stating a synopsis of the work already done, objectives, methodology, estimated cost, duration of the scheme, milestones, and the phasing of physical and financial progress. The scheme is implemented by the Indian National Committees and the Research and Development Division of the Ministry of Water Resources, and the applications for this scheme are accepted offline by submitting physical copies to the concerned committee.
## Benefits - The scheme provides Grants-in-Aid for Basic Research, Applied Research, and Action Research. - The scheme provides remuneration and emoluments for research personnel assisting the investigators. - The revised monthly emoluments are ₹25,000/- for a Junior Research Fellow, ₹28,000/- for a Senior Research Fellow, and ₹36,000/- to ₹40,000/- for Research Associates across different levels. - The grant funds the cost of conducting experiments, including consumables, wages for full-time non-research personnel, and third-party services like typing and lab analysis. - The grant provides travel expenses connected with the research, including one long-distance journey by one person once a year for attending a research and development session or committee meeting. - The scheme provides infrastructure funding for the purchase of equipment of a permanent nature, software, and necessary meteorological or satellite data. - The scheme provides overhead charges to the host institute for facilities like infrastructure, staff, water, electricity, and communication. - For projects costing up to ₹1,00,00,000/-, overhead charges are provided at 10% of the total cost for educational institutions and Non-Governmental Organizations, and at 8% for laboratories and institutions under Central Government Departments. - The scheme provides a contingency budget provision up to 5% of the total cost or ₹1,00,00,000/- (whichever is less) for unforeseen situations. - Funds are provided by direct transfer of money into the bank account of the appropriate authority in the institute. - The funds are released in installments commensurate with the progress of the work and actual requirements during the financial year. ##### ***Conditions*** - The beneficiary institute must provide full infrastructural facilities by way of accommodation, water, electricity, and communication for the smooth implementation of the project. - Non-Governmental Organizations and Private Institutions must bear 50% of the equipment cost from their own resources. - The overhead expenses shall actually be paid to the institute by the Ministry Of Water Resources only after the completion of the research scheme and the acceptance of the final report. - The Principal Investigator must submit an annual progress report indicating milestones achieved and a utilization certificate to the concerned Indian National Committee on or before the 30th of June every year to receive further installments. - The Principal Investigator must refund any unspent balance or unused funds along with interest accrued to the Pay and Accounts Office via a crossed demand draft after the completion of the scheme.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an academician or expert working in Indian Institutes of Technology, recognized universities, recognized engineering and agricultural colleges, or Water and Land Management Institutes. - The applicant must be an expert from an organization under the Ministry Of Water Resources or from a research and development institute or laboratory of the Central or State Government. - The applicant must be from an Indian Non-Governmental Organization registered under the relevant Society Act. - The applicant must be from a non-profit making recognized Indian Private Research and Development Institution registered with the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research. - The applicant must propose a research topic that falls within the subject domain or priority areas related to the respective Indian National Committee. - The applicant must ensure the proposed research has not been done elsewhere to avoid duplication. - The applicant must identify the probable users of the new technology and end-users of the results of the proposed research. - The applicant must not seek funding for foreign travel, salaries of regular employees of the institute, or honorariums for investigators. - The applicant must not utilize the grant for the construction, maintenance, or repair of buildings, or the purchase of vehicles and air conditioners. - The applicant must complete any previous ongoing research projects funded by the Ministry of Water Resources before a new research proposal can be considered. - The applicant must be an Indian citizen to be eligible for research fellowships and associateships. - The applicant must ensure the upper age limit for Junior Research Fellow, Senior Research Fellow, and Research Associate is 28, 32, and 35 years respectively on the day of application. ##### ***Desirable Criteria*** The applicant should associate a Co-Principal Investigator in the research scheme. ##### ***Post-Selection Conditions*** - The applicant must execute a bond with two sureties to the President of India if applying as a Non-Governmental Organization. - The applicant must maintain a separate audited account and register for permanent or semi-permanent assets acquired solely out of the project grant. - The applicant must publish research papers emerging out of the research scheme in leading journals with prior approval of the Ministry of Water Resources. - The applicant must acknowledge the assistance received from the funding agency in all publications and patent findings. ##### ***Relaxation*** The applicant should note that the upper age limit for fellowships is relaxable for Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Classes, Women, and physically handicapped candidates.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline ##### **Step 1:****** ***Preparing the Research Proposal*** The applicant must carefully read the guidelines and prepare a comprehensive research proposal stating a synopsis of the work already done, objectives, methodology, estimated cost, duration, milestones, and physical and financial phasing. The estimated cost must be structured into specific expenditure heads, supported by necessary quotations and justifications. ##### **Step 2:****** ***Securing End User Views*** The applicant must identify possible end-users for the results of the proposed research. The applicant must then obtain their views and enclose a certificate from at least two such end-users along with the proposal. ##### **Step 3:****** ***Submitting the Application*** The Principal Investigator must get the proposal duly recommended and endorsed by the Head of the Institute. The applicant must then submit five physical copies of the proposal along with a soft copy in PDF and Word format to the concerned Indian National Committee secretariat. ##### **Step 4:****** ***Evaluating and Reviewing the Proposal*** The Indian National Committee secretariat will examine the proposal, allocate an identification number, and send it to peer reviewers and committee members. The committee may ask the Principal Investigator to submit a revised proposal after incorporating the views of the experts and reviewers. ##### **Step 5:****** ***Approving the Scheme*** The applicant will be invited to present the proposal before the committee for discussion. The recommended proposals will be forwarded to the Research And Development Division for administrative approval and a formal sanction order will be issued by the competent authority. ##### **Step 6:****** ***Executing the Bond and Releasing Funds*** The Principal Investigator and the Head of the Institution must submit the acceptance of the terms and conditions. Non-Governmental Organizations must execute a prescribed bond with two sureties, after which the Ministry will process the release of the first installment of funds directly into the bank account of the institution.
##### ***Application Process Detailing*** **Where to Apply:** Applications must be sent physically to the Secretariats of the Indian National Committee on Surface Water (Sewa Bhawan, R.K. Puram, New Delhi), the Indian National Committee on Ground Water (Jamnagar House, Mansingh Road, New Delhi), or the Indian National Committee on Climate Change (National Institute of Hydrology, Roorkee) depending on the research domain. **Application Deadlines:** The research proposal can be submitted at any time during the year. **Grievance Redressal / Help & Support:** Director, Research And Development Division, Ministry of Water Resources, Wing No. 4, I Floor, West Block No.1, R.K. Puram, New Delhi - 110066. Telephone and Fax: 011-26104082. Email: watrnd-mowr@nic.in.

metadata.schemeName: National Agriculture Market
metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
metadata.briefDescription: Launched on 14th April 2016, e-NAM is a pan-India electronic trading platform that links existing mandis to create a unified online market for agricultural commodities, promoting “One Nation One Market” and enabling transparent, efficient, and nationwide agri-trade.

page_content:
# National Agriculture Market **Ministry:** Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** APMC, Electronic Trading, E-payment, E-bidding | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched on 14th April 2016 by the Prime Minister of India, the e-National Agriculture Market (e-NAM) is a pan-India electronic trading portal designed to integrate existing APMC (Agricultural Produce Market Committee) mandis across the country into a unified online platform, enabling “One Nation One Market” for agricultural commodities. Implemented by the Small Farmers Agribusiness Consortium (SFAC) under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare, Government of India, the platform streamlines agricultural marketing by offering single-window services such as commodity arrivals, AI-based quality assaying, e-bidding, and direct e-payment to farmers. It aims to enhance transparency, efficiency, and competitiveness in agricultural trade while expanding market access for farmers and reducing information asymmetry. In Jammu & Kashmir, 11 mandis, including Narwal (Jammu) and Parimpora (Srinagar), have been integrated with e-NAM since May 2020.
> **Key Objectives:** - Facilitate nationwide integration of markets through a common e-platform for agricultural trade. - Standardize marketing and transaction procedures across all APMC mandis. - Expand farmers’ access to buyers and markets for better price discovery and reduced information gaps. - Promote quality-based bidding through the establishment of assaying systems. - Ensure stable pricing and availability of quality produce to consumers.
## Benefits > **For Farmers:** - Access to Pan-India Markets through a digital trading platform. - Real-time Price Discovery based on demand and supply. - Transparency in auction and payment processes. - Better Prices through wider buyer participation. - Online Payment directly to farmers' bank accounts. - Free Quality Testing (Assaying) of produce in markets. - Reduced Information Asymmetry—farmers can see prices and make informed decisions. > **For Markets (APMCs/RMCs):** - One-time Grant of up to ₹30 lakh per market for hardware, internet, assaying labs, etc. - Free e-NAM Software is provided with customization for each state. - Support Staff (1 person per market) provided for 1 year at no cost. - Provision to use Cold Storages & Warehouses as market sub-yards. - Infrastructure Support for setting up: 1. e-auction halls. 1. assaying labs. 1. electronic weighbridges. 1. training facilities. > **For State Governments / UTs:** - Eligibility for Central Funding upon adopting key APMC Act reforms: 1. Single trading license for the state. 1. Single-point market fee. 1. Legal provision for e-trading. - Support for Soil Testing Labs (STLs) under related schemes (NMSA/RKVY). - Training, Dispute Resolution Mechanism, and linking more markets to e-NAM.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant State/UT must allow a single trading license valid across the State, issued through suitable legislation or executive orders. - The process should be liberal, without barriers like high deposits, quantity restrictions, or mandatory purchase centers. 1. The applicant State/UT must ensure single-point levy of market fee, applicable only at the first wholesale transaction. - No additional charges should be levied on subsequent wholesale transactions of the same produce. 1. The applicant State/UT must provide legal and infrastructural support for e-auction/e-trading, through relevant amendments or executive provisions. - The applicant must submit proposals in the prescribed format and fulfill all three core reforms above to be eligible for the one-time grant for infrastructure setup (hardware, internet, assaying equipment, etc.). 1. The applicant must commit to: - Trading 100% of selected commodities through e-NAM in the proposed markets. - Providing or linking markets to Soil Testing Laboratories (STLs). - Covering extra implementation costs beyond the sanctioned amount. - Bearing costs of software maintenance after 5 years. - Registering the implementing agency on the PFMS portal and submitting necessary bank details to the Department. 1. The applicant State/UT, if lacking an APMC Act or not enforcing it, must: - Identify an appropriate institution/organization. - Frame enforceable guidelines to enable e-trading, including trader registration, transaction norms, and infrastructure provisioning. 1. The applicant private market, if applying, must: - Be recommended by the concerned authority. - Provide all necessary infrastructure and services (e.g., analyst, assaying facilities) at its own expense.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Guidelines for farmers:** 1. Users can register by Clicking [**here**](http://enam.gov.in/NAMV2/home/other_register.html). 1. Select “Registration Type” as “Farmer” and select the desired “APMC”. 1. Provide a valid email ID, as you will receive your Login ID and Password on it. 1. Once successfully registered, you will receive a login ID and a temporary password at the given email. 1. Log in to the dashboard by clicking the icon on [**www.enam.gov.in/web**](https://www.enam.gov.in/web/). 1. You will see a flashing message on the dashboard: “Click here to register with APMC.” 1. Click on the flashing link, which will redirect you to the registration page for filling or updating details. 1. Your application will be sent for approval to your selected APMC after KYC is completed. 1. After successfully logging in to your dashboard, you will be able to see all APMC address details. 1. After successful submission, the user will receive an email confirming that the application has been submitted to the concerned APMC, with the status shown as Submitted, In Progress, Approved, or Rejected. 1. Once approved by the APMC, you will receive your eNAM Farmer Permanent Login ID (e.g., HR866F00001) and password for complete access to the e-NAM platform at your registered email address. 1. Alternatively, you can contact your respective Mandi/APMC for the same. > **Registration Guidelines for Trades:** 1. Users will have to register by visiting [**http://enam.gov.in/NAMV2/home/other_register.html**](http://enam.gov.in/NAMV2/home/other_register.html)**.** 1. Select “Registration Type” as “Trader” and choose the appropriate “APMC” or State Level option. 1. Provide your passport-size photograph and correct email ID to receive your login ID and password at the same address. 1. After successful registration, you will receive your login ID and a temporary password at your provided email ID. 1. Log in to the dashboard by clicking the icon on [**www.enam.gov.in**](https://www.enam.gov.in/web/). 1. Then you will see a flashing message on the dashboard: “Click here to register with APMC.” 1. Click on the flashing link, which will redirect you to the registration page for filling or updating details. 1. Your application will be submitted for approval to your selected APMC or SAMB (in case of a Unified License). 1. After successfully logging in to your dashboard, you will be able to see the arrivals and trade activities happening in the APMC for notified commodities in eNAM. 1. You will see a flashing message on the dashboard: “Click on the link.” 1. It will redirect you to the registration page to submit your license and KYC details as a trader. 1. Your details will be submitted for approval by your selected APMC. 1. Once successfully submitted, you will receive an email confirming the status of the application as Submitted, In Progress, Approved, or Rejected. 1. Its status can be viewed by logging in to the dashboard, as explained earlier. 1. For a permanent login ID (e.g., HR866T00001) and password, visit your respective Mandi/APMC and verify your license number. 1. After successful approval by the APMC, eNAM Trader/CA IDs and passwords will be sent to the provided email address. 1. Trader/CA users can participate in online trade using the provided login ID and password.
> **For FPOs/FPCs:** FPOs/FPCs can register on e-NAM Portal via the website ([**www.enam.gov.in**](https://www.enam.gov.in/web/)) or mobile app or provide following details at the nearest e-NAM mandi: 1. Name of your FPOs/FPCs. 1. Name, address, email ID, and contact number of the authorized person (MD/CEO/Manager). 1. Bank account details (Name of bank, branch, account number, IFSC code).
> **For Mandi Board:** States (State Agricultural Marketing Boards) interested in integrating their mandis with NAM are required to carry out the following reforms in their APMC Act: 1. Provide for a single (unified) trading license valid across the state. 1. Implement a single-point levy of market fees across the state. 1. Include provisions for e-auction/e-trading as modes of price discovery.

metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
metadata.briefDescription: This fellowship is meant for those who have a proven track record as evident from their research publications & recognitions. Support is provided for 225 Post-Doctoral Fellowships for candidates for a period of 1 year, to encourage specialized research in emerging area.

page_content:
# Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Post-Doctoral Fellowships (PDF) **Ministry:** Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Science, IT & Communications, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Visvesvaraya PhD, Electronics And IT, Post-Doctoral, Fellowship, Fellow, Research, PDF | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Post-Doctoral Fellowship (PDF)” is a component of the “Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT”, implemented by the Digital India Corporation under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India. The objective of the scheme is to promote R&D, create an innovative ecosystem, and enhance India’s competitiveness in the knowledge-intensive sectors of Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES). This fellowship is meant for those who have a proven track record as evident from their research publications and recognitions. Support is provisioned for 225 Post-Doctoral Fellowships for candidates for a period of one year, to encourage specialized research in emerging areas.
## Benefits ***Nature of Support:*** - **Research Fellowship:** ₹1.08 Lakh/Month - **Contingency Grant:** ₹1 Lakh for 1 year (on re-imbursement and pro-rata basis depending on the period spent under the award). The claim would be submitted by the awardee through respective institution to PhD Cell in prescribed format. - The fellowship is tenable only in India and can be implemented in any of the recognized & eligible academic and R&D institutions. - Contingency Grant can be used for minor equipment, consumables and similar items relevant to the research work. The host institution should provide necessary administrative and infrastructural support for the PDF fellow. - There is no provision for providing research personnel support under the scheme. The fellow is expected to undertake the research objectives by himself/herself during the entire duration of the fellowship. - PDF is a full-time assignment. The fellows are not eligible to receive any other fellowship from any Government or Non-Government source during the tenure of the fellowship. - Post-doctoral positions are non-transferrable. The research work is to be carried out in the same eligible institution at which PDF seat is allocated and the fellow is enrolled. ***Duration of Support:*** - The fellowship is purely a temporary assignment, and is tenable for a period of 1 year. - The award will be for one year initially and extendible based on performance review by PhD Cell, DIC, MeitY.
## Eligibility Criteria Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme is an institutional scheme wherein eligible institutions submit proposals requesting PDF seats against an active call for proposal by Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme, DIC, MeitY.
1. The call for proposal for PDF seats will be notified by PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY through the web portal https://phd.dic.gov.in/ and/or email. 2. Proposals for allotment of PDF seats are to be submitted by eligible institutions only. Suitable number of seats would be allotted to institutions for further enrollment of PDF fellows on these seats following the scheme guidelines. 3. The institution may design/have its own application form for advertisement of PDF; however, the guidelines for PDF are to be followed which must include the following:
1. The PDF applicant should be an Indian citizen. 1. The PDF applicant must have obtained PhD degree from a recognized University with first class (in terms of grades, etc.) in all preceding levels and a good academic record throughout. 1. The eligible participating institution must ensure that the PDF applicant should have completed PhD within the past 5 years on the last date of submission of application to the institution. 1. The upper age limit for the fellowship is 40 years on the date of submission of application to the eligible participating institution. 1. A suitable Mentor/Guide under whom the proposed research would be carried out, must be identified by the institution. 1. Mentor/Guide of PDF fellow must hold a regular academic/research position in a recognized institution in India. He/she should hold a Ph.D. degree in Science or Engineering. 1. Preference would be given to the PDF applicants who have active industry linkages and their research proposal is directed towards industry specific problems. 1. The research proposal of the PDF applicant, to be submitted to the institution, should define clear objectives, outcomes and deliverables against the award. 1. PDF applicants currently in regular employment will not be considered. However, scientists or researchers with temporary positions in academia or research institutions would be considered however, they would be required to relinquish their current roles if selected for the fellowship. 1. PDF applicants should not have completed their PhD at the same institution where the PDF fellowship is to be awarded. 1. The applicant must have a proven track record as evident from their research publications and recognitions. 1. The applicant should not be availing any other fellowship. ***Discontinuation of the Fellowship*** 1. If any fellow wishes to discontinue the fellowship, the institution should inform PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY immediately. One month’s notice is to be given by the institution before the date of discontinuation. 1. The implementing institution should not incur any expenditure from the date of termination of the award/project or the date of resignation of the fellow. The institution will responsible for submission of work report and other requisite documents. 1. In case the post-doctoral fellow undertakes any full/part-time assignment, his/her PDF award under the scheme would be discontinued. 1. PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY reserves the right to hold/ stop/ discontinue the fellowship at any stage, if - Appropriate progress is not being made. - The grant is not being utilized properly. - Violation/ Non-compliance of guidelines. - Any other reason, which is deemed appropriate by PhD Cell, DIC, MeitY.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme is an institutional scheme wherein eligible institutions submit proposals requesting PDF seats against an active call for proposal by Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme, DIC, MeitY.
***Mode of Application:*** 1. Proposals for allotment of PDF seats are to be submitted by eligible institutions only. Suitable number of seats would be allotted to institutions for further enrollment of PDF fellows on these seats following the scheme guidelines. 1. The call for proposal for PDF seats will be notified by PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY through the web portal [https://phd.dic.gov.in/](https://phd.dic.gov.in/) and/or email. 1. The institution may design/have its own application form for advertisement of PDF; however, the guidelines for PDF are to be followed. **Note:** - Just fulfilling the minimum eligibility criteria should not entitle a candidate to be selected. - PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY may change the T&C at its discretion, if deemed necessary.

page_content:
# Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi

**Ministry:** Ministry Of Home Affairs | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Rajbhasha, Puraskar, Hindi, Official Language, Award | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual

## Description
The scheme “Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for Writing Original Book in Hindi” was launched by the Department of Official Language, Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India with an objective to encourage writing books originally in Hindi and to promote Official Language. Under the scheme, the citizens of India will be awarded as follows:-

  - Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar for writing original book in Hindi on knowledge and science-based subjects.
  - Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar for writing original book in Hindi on Forensic Science, Police, Criminology Research and Police Administration.
  - Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar for writing original book in Hindi on subjects related to Culture, Religion, Arts and Heritage.
  - Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar for writing original book in Hindi in the field of law.

> **Objective:**

(A) Various Ministries/Departments/Offices/Undertakings/Banks etc. of the Central Government also deal with technical subjects in their official Work. The difficulty is being faced to increase the use of Hindi in official work due to scarcity of books in Hindi on the subjects based on technology, science, forensic science, police, criminology research, police administration, culture, religion, arts, heritage and in the field of law. In addition, employees do face difficulties in doing their official work in Hindi as they are less acquainted or non-acquainted with Hindi terminologies of these subjects. The Department of Official Language is undertaking this scheme with the sole objective to encourage writing books in Hindi on the above-mentioned subjects. 
(B) Various Ministries/Departments have undertaken different award schemes related to Hindi at the national level. Department of Official Language has been made the sole Nodal Department for book schemes related to Hindi. Hence, relevant schemes among the award schemes related to Hindi being run by various Ministries/ Departments at the national level have been incorporated under the scheme. It has been decided to discontinue the other award schemes. If any Ministry/Department, in the future, wishes to undertake any other award scheme related to Hindi it shall mandatorily consult with the Department of Official Language before taking up any such scheme to avoid repetition of the award scheme.

## Benefits
**Award Scheme Summary:**
> **A.	Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar for writing original book in Hindi on knowledge and science based subjects:**


  - First Prize: ₹2,00,000/-, a certificate and a memento
  - Second Prize: ₹1,25,000/-, a certificate and a memento
  - Third Prize: ₹75,000/-, a certificate and a memento

> **B.	Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar for writing original book in Hindi on Forensic Science, Police, Criminology Research and Police Administration**


  - First Prize: ₹1,50,000/-, a certificate and a memento
  - Second Prize: ₹1,00,000/-, a certificate and a memento

> **C.	Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar for writing original book in Hindi on subjects related to Culture, Religion, Arts and Heritage**


  - First Prize: ₹1,50,000/-, a certificate and a memento
  - Second Prize: ₹1,00,000/-, a certificate and a memento

> **D.	Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar for writing original book in Hindi in the field of law**


  - First Prize: ₹1,50,000/-, a certificate and a memento
  - Second Prize: ₹1,00,000/-, a certificate and a memento

**Note 01:** Copyright on the award-winning book will remain with the Authors/Publishers.
**Note 02:** Awardees coming from places other than the place fixed for distribution of the award will be given to and fro fare for 2nd AC and daily allowance as per rules of the Government of India. Arrangements for lodging will be made by him/her at his/her own expense.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The author/co-author should be a citizen of India.
   1. The book should be written in the genres mentioned as follows:-


  - Engineering, Electronics, Computer Science, Physics, Biology, Energy, Space Science, Medicine, Chemistry, Information Technology, Management, Psychology, etc; Contemporary subjects such as Liberalisation, Globalisation, Consumerism, Human Rights and Pollution etc.
  - Forensic Science, Police, Criminology Research and Police Administration etc.
  - Culture, Religion, Arts and Heritage etc.
  - Subject related to Law

> **General Conditions:**


   1. In case of Author is more than one, each co-author must fill out the proforma separately.
   1. Under the scheme only those books which are original works of the author in Hindi, are accepted. Translated books are not accepted.
   1. Books awarded previously by any government organization will not become eligible. The author of the book must inform the Department of Official Language immediately if the book is awarded under any other award scheme before the declaration of the awards under the above-mentioned schemes.
   1. Under the scheme, books published from 1st January to 31st December are acceptable.
   1. The book should be an analytical review of the subject it deals with. Books written in the form of a thesis for a Ph.D., poems, novel, story, play etc., or textbooks will not be eligible under the scheme.
   1. The author/co-author will be responsible for facts and figures given in the book and must give references wherever possible as proof.
   1. If a person has received a prize under any scheme of the Department of Official Language during the preceding three years, his/her entry shall not be considered. However, a co-author, (if any) can participate in the scheme. The co-author will be given the amount proportionately.
   1. The books should contain at least 100 pages.
   1. If the Evaluation Committee arrives at a conclusion that none of the books, received as entries, is suitable for the award, the decision of the committee in this regard will be considered as final.
   1. In case the book selected for the award has more than one author the award money will be divided equally among them.
   1. Only books with ISBN will be accepted under the scheme.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
> **Procedure for sending the entries:**

**Step 01:** The applicants need to visit the official website of the department and download the [application proforma](https://rajbhasha.gov.in/sites/default/files/gaurav_puraskar_28june23e.pdf).
**Step 02:** Fill out the author entry proforma with accurate details and send it to the department before the last date so declared.
**Note 01:** Applicant is required to send three copies of the book invariably with each entry. The copies will not be returned.
**Note 02:** An author may send only one entry under the scheme.
**Note 03:** The entry should be sent along with the proforma given in the Annexure; otherwise the same would not be accepted.
> **Evaluation Procedure of Books:**


   1. Books will be evaluated by a committee constituted by the Department of Official Language based on the criteria set by the Department of Official Language. A Joint Secretary, Department of Official Language will be the Chairperson of the committee. If necessary, the Committee may include non-official renowned scholars/experts along with official members. 
   1. The next of kin of the authors, who are sending their entries, will not be included in the Evaluation Committee.
   1. An official from the Ministry/Department concerned with the subject may be included in the Evaluation Committee for evaluation of the entries.
   1. The Evaluation Committee shall have the right to take advice from specialists/experts on the subject before deciding on a book.
   1. The evaluation committee will determine the assessment criteria themselves.
   1. In the absence of consensus about the award the decision will be made by the majority. In case for and against votes are equal on any decision, then the Chairperson shall have the right to vote to arrive at a decision.
   1. The Department of Official Language will take decision on recommendations made by the Evaluation Committee.

> **Declaration and distribution of awards:**


  - Decision regarding the award will be intimated through a letter/email to all the awardees and placed on the website of the Department of Official Language.
  - Distribution of the Awards will be held on the date fixed by the Department of Official Language.
