metadata.schemeName: Mukhya Mantri Kashtgaar Videsh Parshikshan Yatra Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance farmers’ knowledge and capacity by providing overseas exposure visits to learn advanced agricultural techniques and tools.

page_content:
# Mukhya Mantri Kashtgaar Videsh Parshikshan Yatra Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Travel & Tourism | **Tags:** Agricultural Tour, International Training Tour, Overseas Exposure Visit, Modern Farming Technology, Farmer Capacity Building | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description Launched on 21st February, 2018, the scheme “Mukhya Mantri Kashtgaar Videsh Parshikshan Yatra Yojana” by the Agriculture Marketing Department under the Agriculture Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to improve farmers’ skills through overseas study tours, providing exposure to modern farming technologies for progressive farmers. This scheme supports progressive farmers in adopting improved farming practices for better crop quality and market prices.
## Benefits - **Knowledge Of New Agricultural Technologies:** Beneficiaries will gain practical knowledge of modern farming techniques, tools, and equipment used in other countries through overseas visits. - **Exposure To International Farming Practices:** Farmers will get direct exposure through overseas visits and discussions with farmers in selected countries. - **Improvement In Crop Quality And Market Value:** The scheme supports farmers in improving crop quality so that they can obtain better prices in the future. - **Capacity Building Of Progressive Farmers:** The scheme enhances the skills and abilities of progressive farmers, horticulture farmers, livestock rearers, and fish farmers. > **Training Schedule & Journey Details:**

**S.No.****Journey Description****Estimated Duration**1.Departure to the destination1 Day2.Visit to agricultural fields; gaining knowledge of production methods through on-farm training.2 Days3.Visits to local agricultural universities, research institutes, and research laboratories; interacting with experts and scientists to learn about advanced agricultural techniques.3-4 Days4.Visiting agricultural markets of the respective country; studying storage, transportation, and local marketing systems/market networks; studying processing and consumer markets.1 Day5.Visit to an international agricultural exhibition/expo and sightseeing of local tourist spots.1 Day6.Arrival back to the home country.1 DayTotal Estimated Duration10 Days

## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should belong to the farmer category. - The applicant should be a progressive farmer engaged in advanced farming and agricultural marketing. - The maximum age for participation is 65 years. > **Other Requirements:** - **Passport:** Farmers are responsible for obtaining their own passports. The state government will not provide recommendations for this, and a photocopy of the passport must be submitted with the application.- **Medical Examination:** Selected members must undergo a medical examination; only those found fully healthy according to the rules will be allowed to travel.- **Insurance:** Selected farmers must arrange their own necessary insurance as per the regulations of the destination country. > **Financial Guidelines** - **Grant Validity:** The government grant is valid only for the duration of the study tour.- **Payment of Grant:** The grant amount will be paid directly by the state government to the designated foreign travel organizing company.- Farmer’s Contribution: Farmers must pay any travel costs exceeding the grant amount to the organizing company within the specified timeframe. - **Documentation:** All required documents must be submitted to the relevant company within the deadline; failure to do so allows the State Level Selection Committee to cancel the selection. > **Travel Conduct and Destinations** - **Destinations:** Farmers may be sent to countries including Holland, Germany, Canada, USA, Spain, Chile, Peru, Brazil, South Africa, New Zealand, Kenya, Australia, South Asian countries, and other nations selected by the Rajasthan government.- **Group Travel:** Members must travel with the group according to the department's scheduled program and return home immediately after the tour ends.- **Stay Extensions:** Staying abroad after the tour for any reason is strictly prohibited; violators will be held personally responsible and may face legal action.- **Liability:** In the event of an accident during the trip, the individual member is responsible. All members must submit a letter of undertaking to this effect.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant should present the duly filled application (refer to the scheme guideline) to the District Level Committee. **Step 2:** The District Level Selection Committee will examine and verify all received applications. **Step 3:** The District Level Committee will conduct an interview of each applicant farmer during the scrutiny process. **Step 4:** After evaluation, the District Level Committee will prepare the complete details along with its recommendation. **Step 5:** The recommended applications will then be forwarded to the State Level Committee for final consideration and selection.

metadata.schemeName: Lokprasar Prakalpo Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme “Lokprasar Prakalpo Scheme” was launched by the Department of Information & Cultural Affairs, Government of West Bengal in 2014 to revive the Folk and Tribal Culture in their respective genre across various zones and districts in the State.

page_content:
# Lokprasar Prakalpo Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** West Bengal | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Folk, Artists, Tribal Culture, Pension, Financial Assistance, Performance Fee | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Lokprasar Prakalpo Scheme” was launched by the Department of Information & Cultural Affairs, Government of West Bengal in 2014 to revive the Folk and Tribal Culture in their respective genre across various zones and districts in the State. The scheme is primarily for the financially distressed rural Folk Artists as identified under the laid out procedure to enlist and ensure them with alternative economic support along with scope to further their domain folk culture hence preserving the cultural heritage of different parts of Bengal. The main objectives of the scheme are – 1. To bestow dignity on folk artists by issuing them identity cards 2. To uphold the traditional folk forms of Bengal 3. To revive nearly extinct folk forms of art and culture 4. To uplift the socio-economic conditions of artists associated with folk culture ## Benefits 1. Issuing identity cards to each folk artiste. 2. Under the scheme, the veteran and distressed folk-artistes who are above 60 years of age will get a monthly pension of ₹1000/-. 3. The enlisted folk artists under the age of 60 years, who are engaged in publicity campaigns in different departments, have been receiving ₹1000/- per month as a retainer fee. 4. The state government will arrange the minimum income for folk artists by engaging them in the public campaign programme on development projects such as Kannyasree, Yubasree, Sikshasree, etc. and programmes like Nirmal Bangla, Sarbo Sikhsa Avijan, etc. 5. Performance Fees: Performance-based fees @₹1000/- per head per day as and when engaged to perform their own genre mostly at any Government programme like fair/festival/Krishi Mela/Sabala Mela, etc. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant may have a lineage or belong to a family practicing a given folk form or may belong to a tribal cultural/dance team or a folk-based instrumentalist as recognized by the Folk & Tribal Cultural Centre. 1. The applicant must be between 18 to 60 years. 1. The applicants above 60 years will be eligible for pension. 1. The applicant must be a resident of West Bengal.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** For taking benefit of this scheme, the applicant needs to contact their District Information & Cultural Affairs Department. **Step 2:** The Department of Information & Cultural Affairs publishes notifications in various vernacular newspapers from time to time in order to impanel the Folk artists through auditions in different phases held at the district. **Step 3:** Interested and eligible Folk artists may apply in the prescribed format for the necessary selection procedure. **Step 4:** After successful verification, the applicant can avail the benefit of the scheme.

page_content:
# Free Travel Facility for Persons With Orthopedic Disability/Locomotor Disability **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Free Travel Facility, Orthopedic Disability, Locomotor Disability, Free Bus Travel, Persons With Disabilities, Differently Abled, Specially Abled | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Free Travel Facility for Persons With Orthopedic Disability/Locomotor Disability" by the Rajasthan State Transport Corporation under the Transport Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to facilitate free travel by providing zero-fare bus journeys to eligible persons with orthopedic or locomotor disabilities across operated routes.
## Benefits - **Free Travel Facility:** Eligible beneficiaries are provided free travel in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation(RSRTC ) buses. - **Coverage of Buses:** The facility is applicable on ordinary, express, and night bus services. - **Route Applicability:** Free travel is allowed up to the routes where Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses are operational.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a permanent resident of Rajasthan. - The applicant should not be an income tax payer. - The applicant should be a person suffering from orthopedic disability or locomotor disability. - The applicant should possess a medical disability certificate indicating at least 40 percent disability, issued by an authorized medical authority. - The applicant should hold a valid RFID Card issued by the Rajasthan State Transport Corporation.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **RSRTC Online RFID Registration Form:** [Click Here](https://rsrtcrfidsystem.co.in/OnlineApplication/MemberNewRegistration.aspx?Sid=1).

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide opportunities for minority entrepreneurs and artisans to display and sell their products at exhibitions organized by the National Minorities Development and Finance Corporation.

page_content:
# Bazar Sahayata Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Minority Entrepreneurs, Handicrafts, Exhibition Support, Free Stall, Travel Allowance, Daily Allowance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Bazaar Sahayata Yojana" by the Department of Minority Affairs and Waqf, Government of Rajasthan, aims to promote minority entrepreneurs through providing free stalls, travel fare, and daily allowance to showcase and sell products in exhibitions organized by NMDFC. The program has been operational since 2002-03 to support local craftsmanship. The duration of the exhibition is normally 2 weeks. It is a fully centrally sponsored scheme. > **Participants:** Artisans / Individuals beneficiary (2 beneficiaries for stall); preference would be given to SHGs having 10-15 members; Stalls would be allocated in the ratio of 2:1::SHGs: Artisans/ Individuals beneficiaries.




## Benefits - **Free Exhibition Space:** Provision of a stall at no cost for the display and sale of products. - **Travel Allowance:** 2nd Class sleeper or ordinary bus fare for 2 persons (on actual). - **Daily Allowance:** Provision of a daily allowance of ₹500/- for living expenses, the amount of which depends on the specific exhibition venue. - **Market Exposure:** Opportunity for entrepreneurs to interact directly with customers and expand their business network.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must belong to a minority community. - The applicant must be an entrepreneur, especially a handicraft artisan.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant must visit the office of the District Minority Welfare Officer of the concerned district. **Step 2:** The applicant must obtain the application form from the office. **Step 3:** The applicant must fill in the required details in the form. **Step 4:** The applicant must attach the required documents. **Step 5:** The applicant must submit the application form at the same office.

# Schemes of HP Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Himachal Pradesh | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Backward Classes, Below Poverty Line, Finance, Development Corporation, Loan | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Scheme "Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation", has been launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Himachal Pradesh, aiming to uplift the social, educational, and economic status of people belonging to notified backward classes living below the poverty line. Under the Swarnima Yojana, loans are provided to women living below the poverty line from backward classes for self-employment at the rate of 5% interest.
## Benefits 1. Loans from ₹50,000 to ₹5,00,000/- are provided at 6% interest for activities such as agriculture, handicrafts, traditional business, small and cottage industries, and transport services. 1. Loans above ₹5,00,000/- are provided at an interest rate of 7%. 1. Under the Swarnima Yojana, women from backward classes living below the poverty line are given self-employment loans at 5% interest. 1. Interest-free education loans up to ₹75,000/- are provided for higher education to students whose family income is below ₹98,000/- per year. 1. For technical and vocational education, loans up to ₹5,00,000/- are available at 4% interest for boys and 3.5% interest for girls.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Himachal Pradesh. 1. The applicant should belong to a backward class. 1. The applicant’s age should be between 18 and 55 years. 1. Applicants living in rural areas must have an annual income of less than ₹98,000/-. 1. Applicants living in urban areas must have an annual income of less than ₹1,20,000/-.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 1: Fill the prescribed application form and attach all required documents. Step 2: Submit the application to the concerned District Welfare Officer or Tehsil Welfare Officer. Step 3: After verification, the application is processed by the Corporation.

metadata.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to provide loans to urban and rural SC/ST families for setting up and running businesses. Loans up to ₹5 lakh are offered at 6% interest, and loans from ₹5 lakh to ₹30 lakh at 8% interest through the National SC/ST Development Corporation.

page_content:
# Him Swablamban Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Himachal Pradesh | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Loans, Banking, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Families | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Him Swablamban Yojana has been launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Himachal Pradesh, provides loans to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe families in rural and urban areas for self-employment projects in agriculture and allied activities, service and transport sectors, and industrial sectors, with project funding through a mix of promoter contribution, margin money loan, and term loan support.
## Benefits - Loans up to ₹5,00,000/- are available at an interest rate of 6%. - Loans from ₹5,00,000/- to ₹30,00,00/- are available at an interest rate of 8%.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a member of a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe family. 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 55 years of age. 1. For transport loans, the applicant should be between 20 and 53 years of age. 1. The applicant should have a valid driving license for the concerned vehicle (for transport loans). 1. The applicant should be living below the poverty line. 1. The applicant should have an annual income of up to ₹98,000/- in rural areas. 1. The applicant should have an annual income of up to ₹1,20,000/- in urban areas. 1. The applicant should not be a defaulter of any bank or financial institution.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 1: Obtain and fill the prescribed application form and attach all required documents. Step 2: Submit the completed application to the concerned District Manager or Corporation office for verification. Step 3: After approval, the application is forwarded to the HP SC/ST Development Corporation for further processing.

# Janjati Swarojgar Yojna **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship | **Tags:** Self-Employment, BPL, Business, Loan, Subsidy, Tribal Self-Employment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Janjati Swarojgar Yojna" by the Tribal Area Development Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to foster self-employment among tribal youth through providing a subsidy of up to ₹10,000 to the eligible unemployed BPL tribal individuals residing in the Tribal Sub-Plan area. It supports the economic growth of the tribal community by facilitating access to capital for various service and retail activities.
## Benefits - **Financial Subsidy:** The government provides a subsidy of 50% of the unit cost or ₹10,000, whichever is less. - **Intended Use:** The assistance is for establishing self-employment units such as tailoring, cement net manufacturing, leather work, blacksmith, readymade garments, fruit-vegetable stalls, bullock carts, fancy items, electrical shops, mechanic shops, cycle shops, radio/TV service centers, flour mills, or grocery shops.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a resident of the Tribal Sub-Plan area in the state of Rajasthan. - The applicant must be a member of a tribal family belonging to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category. - The applicant must be an unemployed youth (male or female).
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - **Obtain and Fill Application:** Obtain the prescribed application form and fill in the required details accurately. - **Submission:** Submit the completed application form along with the necessary documents to the office of the District Regional/Assistant Manager, Rajasthan Tribal Area Development Cooperative Federation (Rajasangh). - **Internal Approval:** The Regional/Assistant Manager reviews and approves the application.

metadata.schemeName: National Horticulture Mission - Vermi Compost Unit
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote organic farming by providing subsidy support for the establishment of vermi compost units and HDPE vermi beds to farmers.

page_content:
# National Horticulture Mission - Vermi Compost Unit **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Vermi Compost, Organic Farming, Subsidy, Horticulture, Farmer, HDPE Vermi Bed | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "National Horticulture Mission - Vermi Compost Unit" implemented by the Horticulture Department, Government of Rajasthan, is a centrally sponsored scheme that aims to promote organic input production through providing a subsidy for the establishment of vermi compost units and HDPE vermi beds to farmers. The scheme is funded in the ratio of 60% by the Central Government and 40% by the State Government. It supports farmers in setting up infrastructure for organic compost production. The subsidy is released after physical verification by officials. The unit must be maintained for at least 3 years.
## Benefits - **Subsidy for Vermi Compost Unit:** 50% of cost; maximum ₹50,000/- per unit (30 ft × 8 ft × 2.5 ft size). - **Subsidy for HDPE Vermi Bed:** 50% of cost; maximum ₹8,000/- per unit (12 ft × 4 ft × 2 ft size as per IS 15907:2010). - **Support Materials And Inputs:** Provision of earthworms, bio-culture (Trichoderma, PSB, Azotobacter), neem cake, and tools. - **Technical Guidance:** Training and technical information provided for organic input production. - **Mode Of Disbursement:** Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) through Treasury via RTGS. - **Frequency of Disbursement:** One-time subsidy.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must practice horticulture crops on their own land. - The applicant must have minimum 0.4 hectare of own land. - The applicant must have adequate livestock, water, and organic material availability. - The applicant must be selected under organic farming programmes; priority is given to such farmers/areas. - The applicant must establish the unit as per prescribed size and standards. - The applicant must procure earthworms from authorized sources such as ATC or registered institutions. - The applicant must give an undertaking to operate the unit for at least 3 years. - The applicant must allow physical verification by authorized officials.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - **Mode of Application:** Online - **Mode of Online Application:** E-Mitra - Applicants can apply by visiting their nearest [E-Mitra](https://reportsemitraapp.rajasthan.gov.in/WebSrc/Reports/rpt_search_new_emitra_ksk.jsp) center or online through their own E-Mitra account. > **Note:** Applying for a vermicompost unit is free.

metadata.schemeName: DAE-Homi Sethna Chair (DAE-HSC)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to utilize the expertise of retired scientists, engineers, and technologists by providing honorarium and research support for carrying out research and development activities in identified areas of the Department of Atomic Energy.

page_content:
# DAE-Homi Sethna Chair (DAE-HSC) **Ministry:** PMO | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Science, IT & Communications | **Tags:** Retired Scientists, Retired Engineers, Research And Development, Atomic Energy, Nuclear Power | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “DAE-Homi Sethna Chair (DAE-HSC)” implemented by the Department of Atomic Energy aims to utilize the expertise of retired scientists, engineers, and technologists through providing opportunities to undertake research and development, policy studies, and planning activities in critical and strategic sectors related to atomic energy. Under the scheme, selected awardees work on projects and policy issues identified by the Department of Atomic Energy. The awardees may also participate in public outreach activities, academic lectures, mentorship of young scientists and engineers, and preparation of technical publications or books related to atomic energy. The scheme provides a monthly honorarium and support grant to eligible awardees during the approved tenure. Nominations are invited through host institutes throughout the year and are reviewed by a high-level committee constituted by the Chairman, Atomic Energy Commission.
## Benefits > **Monthly Honorarium:** - The awardee receives an honorarium of ₹1,00,000/- per month. - The total of honorarium and pension must not exceed the last pay drawn by the awardee at the time of retirement. > **Support Grant:** - The awardee receives a support grant of ₹1,50,000/- per annum. - The support grant can be used for local commuting to the host institute and domestic travel for official work. > **Research Opportunity:** - The awardee gets an opportunity to work on critical and strategic research, policy, and planning projects identified by the Department of Atomic Energy. > **Academic And Mentorship Activities:** - The awardee may participate in lectures, mentoring young scientists and engineers, and public outreach programmes. > **Leave Facility:** - The awardee is entitled to 30 days leave per year with honorarium.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a retired scientist, engineer, or technologist from units of the Department of Atomic Energy, including aided institutions. - Preference is given to applicants involved in front-line scientific research, development of sensitive and/or critical technologies in DAE units, and fellows of major science or engineering academies. - The applicant must have rich experience in the selected research area. - The applicant must possess domain knowledge related to the selected topic. - The applicant must have expertise in the area of the topic selected for the award.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** The applications are on a nomination basis. The head of the host institute interested in hosting the candidates shall send the nomination as a PDF attachment to the email id: **hscadmin@dae.gov.in** **Step 2:** A hard copy of the same also needs to be sent to the undersigned i.e.: > **Under Secretary (R&D-II),** > **Anushakti Bhavan,** > **C.S.M Marg** > **Mumbai - 400001**

page_content:
# Civil Services Coaching Assistance **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Himachal Pradesh | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Student, Civil Services, Coaching, Financial Support | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Civil Services Coaching Assistance Scheme", effective from 1 April 2015 under the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Himachal Pradesh, provides a one-time financial assistance of ₹30,000/- to all bonafide residents of Himachal Pradesh, regardless of income or caste, who qualify the preliminary examination for Civil Services conducted by the Union Public Service Commission. The amount is given directly to the candidate, who can choose the coaching institute as per their preference. The assistance is meant to support the candidate, not the institute.

## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 1: The applicant should obtain and fill the prescribed [application form](http://esomsa.hp.gov.in/sites/default/files/Civil%20Services%20Coaching%20Assistance_0.pdf) along with required documents. Step 2: The applicant should submit the completed form to the Director, Empowerment of SC, OBC, Minorities, and Specially Abled Persons, Himachal Pradesh for verification and approval.

metadata.briefDescription: To establish organic seed banks in the growers’ field for multiplication of planting materials of indigenous varieties of ginger and turmeric having rich intrinsic value and herbal spices to retain purity and serve as a source for quality planting materials

page_content:
# Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Organic Farming: Organic Seed bank (Ha) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Commerce And Industry | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Business & Entrepreneurship, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Agriculture, Organic Seed, Herbal Spices, Bank | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Organic Farming – Organic Seed Bank (Ha) is implemented by the Spices Board, India, under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India. The scheme aims to establish organic seed banks in the fields of spice growers for the multiplication of planting materials of indigenous varieties of ginger, turmeric, and other herbal spices with high intrinsic value. It seeks to preserve varietal purity and ensure the availability of quality planting materials for organic spice cultivation. The scheme is being implemented in accordance with the modalities and guidelines approved by the Competent Authority under the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom during the 15th Finance Commission period (2021–22 to 2025–26).
## Benefits 1. 50% of cost of production @ ₹37,500/- per Ha for ginger and turmeric and ₹22,500/- for herbal spices whichever is less under Gen category and 75% of the cost for SC/ST at a maximum of ₹ 56,000 for Ginger and turmeric and ₹ 34,000/- per Ha for herbal spices of indigenous varieties which are selected for organic cultivation. 1. Individual growers of any of Indigenous varieties of spices viz., Cochin ginger of Kerala, Nadia Ginger of NE states, Alleppey finger turmeric of Kerala, Rajapuri turmeric of Maharastra, Lakadong / Megha Turmeric of Meghalaya and herbal spices of Tamil Nadu having holding size from 0.10 ha to 8 ha who are under organic certification are eligible to avail benefits under this component. A grower/group can avail assistance under the scheme for a maximum of 3 years at a maximum of 2 ha./beneficiary. 1. An ICS without suitable land of its own can avail the assistance for establishing a seed bank in its name in a suitable land of a member in the group identified for the purpose, for distribution of seeds among its members on cost price, by entering into an agreement with the farmer identified for the purpose. The agreement can either be a part in the mandatory contract signed by the farmer with ICS for certification or a separate agreement with consent for sparing his/her land for the purpose and releasing the assistance from Spices Board to the ICS.
## Eligibility Criteria 1.Preference for Sikkim, other NE States and then Kerala, Tamilnadu & Maharashtra and other states 2. Designated Officials will conduct final inspection and recommend the eligible cases.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Registration** Step 1: The applicant should visit the [ServicesPlus](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/) website. Step 2: Click on the “[Register” ](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/citizenRegistration.html)option on the homepage. Step 3: Fill out the registration form by entering Full Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, Password, selecting State, and Captcha. Step 4: Review all details carefully and submit the registration form. Step 5: An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number or email; enter the OTP and click “Verify.” Step 6: Registration will be completed successfully, and a confirmation message will be displayed or sent via email. **Login** Step 1: The applicant should visit the ServicesPlus website and click on [“Login.”](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/loginWindow.do) Step 2: Enter your Email ID, Password, and Captcha. Step 3: Select the relevant service/scheme name. Step 4: Fill in the required details in the application form. Step 5: Submit the application.

page_content:
# Mushroom Production-Rajasthan **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Mushroom Production, Mushroom Cultivation, Production Unit, Spawn Production Unit, Compost Unit, Subsidy, Farmers | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Mushroom Production" is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme implemented by the Horticulture Department, Government of Rajasthan, with 60% funding from the Central Government and 40% funding from the State Government, to promote mushroom cultivation through financial assistance for establishing mushroom production, spawn production, and compost units. The scheme provides subsidy for eligible infrastructure and machinery required for mushroom production in the private sector. Applicants are required to obtain a bank term loan, submit a detailed project proposal, and complete the unit within the prescribed period after approval. ## Eligibility Criteria > The following categories of citizens are eligible for "Mushroom Production": - Farmers.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - via CSC - **Mode of Application:** Online - **Mode of Online Application:** E-Mitra - Applicants can apply by visiting their nearest [E-Mitra](https://reportsemitraapp.rajasthan.gov.in/WebSrc/Reports/rpt_search_new_emitra_ksk.jsp) center or online through their own E-Mitra account. > **Note:** Applying for "Mushroom Production" is free.

# Rejuvenation of Senile Orchards **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Senile Orchards, Orchard Rejuvenation, Fruit Tree Replanting, Interplanting, Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Rejuvenation of Senile Orchards" is a centrally sponsored scheme implemented by the Horticulture Department, Government of Rajasthan, with 60% Central Government and 40% State Government funding. The scheme aims to increase the productivity of old and senile fruit orchards by providing financial assistance for rejuvenation and restoration activities. Assistance is provided for replacing old trees, replanting, interplanting, pruning, nutrient management, plant protection, and other orchard improvement activities. The subsidy is released through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) after verification of completed works.
## Benefits - **Subsidy Amount:** 50% of the approved cost, subject to a maximum of ₹20,000/- per hectare. - **Maximum Coverage:** Subsidy is available for a maximum area of 2 hectares per beneficiary. - **Replanting Support:** Assistance for quality planting material required for replanting and interplanting. - **Pruning Support:** Assistance for pruning old trees and adopting recommended orchard management practices. - **Nutrient Management:** Assistance for fertilizers, micronutrients, and plant growth regulators. - **Plant Protection:** Assistance for chemical and biological insecticides and fungicides. - **Horticulture Tools:** Assistance for horticultural tools required for pruning and orchard operations.
## Eligibility Criteria > The following qualification has been set for "Rejuvenation of Senile Orchards" : 1. Farmers / Farmer Group.

metadata.schemeName: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (Nagaland)
metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme provides a monthly pension to elderly persons to support a dignified life. It aims to provide social security to vulnerable people, especially those living below the poverty line. The programme is fully funded by the Central Government.

page_content:
# Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (Nagaland) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Nagaland | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** BPL, Old Age, Pension, Senior Citizen | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The “Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension” Scheme under the National Social Assistance Programme is implemented by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Nagaland. The scheme provides a monthly pension to elderly persons to support a dignified life. It aims to provide social security to vulnerable people, especially those living below the poverty line. The programme is fully funded by the Central Government.
## Benefits People aged 60–79 years get ₹200/- per month, and those aged 80 years or above get ₹500/- per month.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Nagaland. 1. The applicant should be 60 years of age or older. 1. The applicant should be from a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant should not be receiving pension benefits under any social security scheme.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 1:The applicant submits the application at the District Welfare Office. Step 2:The District Level Committee verifies applications and forwards the selected beneficiaries for approval. Step 3: After approval, the pension amount is paid in cash by the District Welfare Officer.

# Tiatr Day Celebration **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Tiatr, Celebration, Academy, Programme | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Tiatr Day Celebration" is organised by the Kala Academy under the Department of Art and Culture, Government of Goa, to commemorate 17th April as Tiatr Day every year. On this occasion, Tiatr artists are felicitated, and a special Tiatr performance is staged. A press note is released in local dailies to invite the general public, Tiatr enthusiasts, and artists to the event, and invitation cards are sent to VIPs, institutions, and selected felicitants.
Selection Procedure: The Advisory Committee (Tiatr) of Kala Academy selects the felicitants based on their seniority and significant contributions to the Tiatr stage. The programme for the Tiatr Day celebration is finalised by the Advisory Committee (Tiatr) and approved by the authorities of Kala Academy.
## Benefits **Recognition:** Felicitant artists are honoured with a memento and a shawl by distinguished personalities. **Support:** Transportation is provided to felicitants, and entry for the public is free.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be a senior Goan Tiatr artist who has made significant contributions to the Tiatr stage to be eligible for felicitation.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the Kala Academy, Goa, and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the [**Office of Tiatr Academy of Goa**](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/3RD-ALL-GOA.pdf#:~:text=Detailed%20Rules%20and%20Regulations%20of%20the%20competition%2C,is%20June%206%2C%202025%20during%20office%20hours.), Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Campal, Panaji, Goa. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the academy staff. **Authority for Redressal of Grievances:** Member Secretary/Chairman, Kala Academy Goa.

metadata.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial incentives to persons associated with fisheries and aquaculture for registration, successful loan facilitation, and aquaculture insurance. It promotes capital investment, job creation, and employment retention through performance-based grants.

page_content:
# Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-Yojana (PM-MKSSY) **Ministry:** Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Fisheries, Aquaculture, Financial Assistance, Loan, Insurance, Stakeholder | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-Yojana (PM-MKSSY)" is being implemented by the Ministry of Fisheries Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Department of Fisheries, Government of India as the Central Sector Sub-Scheme under the ongoing PMMSY for a period of four years in all the States and Union Territories. > **Objectives:** - Gradual Formalisation of fisheries sector by creating work-based Identities for fishers, fish farmers and other stakeholders under a National Fisheries Digital Platform (NFDP). - Facilitating access to institutional finance. - Incentivization of adoption of aquaculture insurance. - Incentivizing fisheries Microenterprises for improving fisheries sector value chain efficiencies through Performance Grant. - Incentivizing micro and small fisheries enterprises for adoption and expansion of fish and fishery product safety and quality assurance systems.
## Benefits - Persons Associated with Fisheries and Aquaculture will get a Certificate of Registration along with ₹ 100 after successful completion of one-time registration process on the NFDP platform providing all necessary documents and information as per the approved operational guidelines. - Individuals Associated with Fisheries and Aquaculture will get success fees of ₹ 3000 to ₹ 5000 (depending on the loan amount) for successful loan after approval of the loan application and loan disbursement by the bank, the Stakeholder will upload the loan approval letter and documents supporting loan disbursement to the beneficiary on the NFDP. - Individuals Associated with Aquaculture will get One time Aquaculture Insurance Incentive upon paid premium purchase of the insurance policy; the insured shall submit a claim for availing the “one-time incentive” on NFDP, against the purchase of aquaculture insurance as per the approved operational guidelines. - Fisheries and Aquaculture Stakeholder will get Performance grant towards the incentive through respective component under Component 2 & 3 of the PM-MKSSY against the Capital Investment and Job Creation / maintenance as per the approved Operational guidelines.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. Fisheries and Aquaculture Stakeholder (Individual and organisations) involved in the fisheries value chain shall be eligible for registration on the NFDP. 1. Fisheries and Aquaculture Stakeholder involved in the fisheries value chain shall be eligible for one time success fees on successful disbursement of loan amount. 1. Fisheries and Aquaculture farmers having up to 4hectares aquaculture farm size or equivalent unit shall be eligible for one time aquaculture insurance incentive. 1. Fisheries and Aquaculture Stakeholder (Micro and Small Enterprises) will get Performance grant under Component 2 & 3 of the PM-MKSSY against the Investment and Job Creation /maintenance as per the approved Operational guidelines.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process: Apply as an Individual/Organization** **Step 01:** Select [**New User Registration**](https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp/#/registration) from the top menu or from the Apply for Sub-scheme Benefits under PM-MKSSY section on the Home Page. **Step 02:** Click Apply as an Individual/Organization button as per your Profile. **Step 03:** Enter Aadhaar Number or Pan card Number. Check consent box, click on 'Validate Aadhaar' button. **Step 04:** Enter OTP received on Aadhaar linked mobile number. Click on validate button. After successful validation next screen will ask for Mobile number. **Step 05:** Enter mobile number. Enter Captcha. Click on Next button. **Step 06:** Enter OTP received on mobile number. Click on validate button. After successful validation, the NFDP Registration form will open. **Step 07:** Fill in the complete Registration details. as per your profile: Personal/Organization Information, Address, Occupation & Bank Details & submit. **Step 08:** Note your NFDP Registration Number and download your Provisional NFDP Registration certificate by clicking the Download Certificate button. > **Login Process:** **Beneficiary Login**- [https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp_benificary/#/login](https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp_benificary/#/login) **Credit Facilitation**- [https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp/#/credit-facilitation](https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp/#/credit-facilitation) **Aquaculture Insurance**- [https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp/#/insurance](https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp/#/insurance) **Performance grant**- [https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp_benificary/#/performance-grant](https://nfdp.dof.gov.in/nfdp_benificary/#/performance-grant)
**Mode:** Online - via CSC **Step 01:** The interested eligible applicant must visit their nearest [Common Service Centre](https://locator.csccloud.in/) (CSC) to initiate the registration process offline. **Step 02:** The applicant must carry prerequisites such as their Aadhaar Card and evidence of their bank account, etc.

metadata.schemeName: Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB): Disability Pension
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide welfare benefits, including disability pension and financial assistance, to eligible registered construction workers through the Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

page_content:
# Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB): Disability Pension **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Mizoram | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Construction Workers, Disability Pension, Financial Assistance, Building And Other Construction Workers | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Disability Pension" under the "Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board" is implemented by the Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Government of Mizoram, to provide welfare benefits to eligible construction workers. The Board has been constituted under the Building and Other Construction Workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act, 1996. A Welfare Fund has been established for providing admissible benefits to registered members. Eligible workers who become incapacitated due to injury or serious illness may receive a monthly disability pension and financial assistance based on the severity of the condition.
## Benefits - **Disability Pension:** A monthly pension of ₹1,000/- is payable to an eligible member who becomes incapacitated for work before attaining 60 years of age due to injury or serious illness, with 40% or more disability certified by the Medical Board. - **Financial Assistance:** Financial assistance of up to ₹1,00,000/- is provided depending on the severity of the disability or condition. - **Surviving Spouse Benefit:** In the event of the death of a pensioner, 50% of the monthly pension then in payment may continue to be paid to the surviving spouse.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an Indian citizen. - The applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age. - The applicant must have been engaged as a construction worker for at least 90 days in a year. - The applicant must be engaged as a contractor or employee in one of the covered categories of construction work. > **Contractors or employees engaged in the following categories of work:** 1. Carpenter 2. Mason 3. Cement Mason 4. Painter 5. Helper (Construction Works) 6. Electrician 7. Wireman 8. Fitter 9. Welder 10. Plumber 11. Iron and Aluminium Worker 12. Blacksmith 13. Lumberjack 14. Sand Extraction Worker 15. Stone Quarry Worker 16. Stone Breaker 17. Road and Earthwork Labourer 18. JCB/Dozer Operator 19. Construction Machine Operator 20. Construction Driver 21. Brick Factory Worker > **Membership Fee:** A one-time Registration Fee of ₹25/- shall be payable at the time of enrolment. A monthly subscription of ₹10/- is payable to maintain active membership. Alternatively, an advance payment of ₹120/- may be made to cover one year's subscription. Members wishing to pay the Membership/Renewal Fee in advance may do so for a period of up to three (3) years. 4. Membership must be renewed within one (1) year from the date of expiry, in accordance with [Section 17 of the BOCW (RE&CS) Act, 1996](https://lesde.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2024/05/bbadc4155d1796a962f3883e14e4cc9c/pages-145-bocw-recs-act-1996.pdf).
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Eligible registered members of the Welfare Board may apply for the respective welfare schemes by submitting the prescribed scheme-specific application form, duly filled in and accompanied by the requisite supporting documents, through the prescribed offline mode. **Step 2:** The application forms and supporting documents shall be as specified by the Welfare Board for the respective scheme/benefit. - **Application Form for Registration under the Board**: [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2023/06/70c9592db154bfccb04514f40e9b5ea8/pages-103-registration-form.pdf).- **Application Form for Disability Pension**: [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2023/02/29b356cda8e71d9afbec26b63de60a0f/pages-103-disability-benefit.pdf). > **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/page/whom-to-contact).

metadata.schemeName: Input Assistance to Develop Network of Fish Seed Growers for Early Bred Spawn
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase fish fingerling availability during the monsoon. Through this scheme, input support is provided to fish farmers, WSHGs, PFCS, and private entrepreneurs.

page_content:
# Input Assistance to Develop Network of Fish Seed Growers for Early Bred Spawn **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Odisha | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Fish Seed Rearing, Early Bred Spawn, State Plan Scheme, Fisheries Subsidy, Input Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Input Assistance to develop Network of Fish Seed Growers for Early Bred Spawn" was launched by the Fisheries and Animal Resources Development Department, Government of Odisha. It aims to increase fish fingerling availability in the state at the start of the monsoon season. Through this scheme, input support from the State Plan Scheme amounting to ₹200.00/- lakhs is provided to existing fish farmers, Women Self Help Groups, Primary Fishermen Cooperative Societies, private entrepreneurs, and individuals. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Fisheries, Odisha, Cuttack. Fish seed rearing is taken up in 400 Acres of tanks by existing farmers, Women Self Help Groups, Primary Fishermen Cooperative Societies, and private entrepreneurs in all 30 districts of the state. In total, 24 crore fry and 3 crore fingerlings are produced and supplied to local grow-out farmers and for reservoir stocking within the same block or district. The assistance is limited to 1.00 Acre water spread area per beneficiary. > **Objectives** 1. To increase the fish fingerlings availability in the state during the start of the monsoon season. 1. To establish fish seed rearing in 400 Acres (160 Ha) among existing farmers, WSHGs, PFCS, and private entrepreneurs across the state. 1. To produce fry and advanced fingerlings to supply to local grow-out farmers and for reservoir stocking within the same block or district. 1. To contribute to achieving self-sufficiency in fish seed production in the state. 1. To provide income and job opportunities to at least 800 farmers and individuals in the state.
## Benefits 1. **Total Project Cost and Government Assistance:** - Total Project Cost: ₹400.00/- Lakhs - Government Assistance: ₹200.00/- Lakhs (Input support from State Plan Scheme) 1. **Unit Cost Per Acre:** - Unit Cost per Acre: ₹1,00,000/- - Input cost for one crop cycle of fish fingerling production (fry, feed, biosecurity bird fence net, seed harvest drag net, etc.). - Fish seed rearing for production of fry and fingerlings from spawn (8 Lakh fry and 1 Lakh fingerling production per Acre in a 3–4 month seed rearing cycle). 1. **Component-wise Cost and Subsidy Per Acre:** Per Acre, the total unit cost for fish seed rearing is ₹1,00,000/-, which includes ₹30,000/- for Spawn or Fry (30 Lakh Spawn / 1.50 Lakh Fry), ₹36,000/- for 600 kg Powder/Pellet Feed, ₹16,000/- for Biosecurity Bird Fencing Net (1 lump sum), and ₹18,000/- for Seed Harvest Drag Net (1 lump sum); under this, General Category beneficiaries are eligible for 40% subsidy amounting to ₹12,000/- for spawn/fry, ₹14,400/- for feed, ₹6,400/- for biosecurity bird fencing net, and ₹7,200/- for seed harvest drag net, totaling ₹40,000/- per Acre, whereas SC/ST/Women Category beneficiaries are eligible for 60% subsidy amounting to ₹18,000/- for spawn/fry, ₹21,600/- for feed, ₹9,600/- for biosecurity bird fencing net, and ₹10,800/- for seed harvest drag net, totaling ₹60,000/- per Acre. 1. **Subsidy Pattern:** - 40% subsidy assistance shall be provided to General Category beneficiaries. - 60% subsidy assistance shall be provided to SC / ST / Women Categories of beneficiaries. - Assistance shall be limited to 1.00 Acre water spread area per beneficiary. - Government assistance shall be given only one time for fish seed rearing, limited to a single beneficiary. 1. **Conditions Attached to Subsidy:** 1. The beneficiary shall procure the fish spawn/fry from Government / OPDC fish hatcheries or from registered private hatcheries which were supported by the Directorate for Fisheries during the year 2021-22 under State Plan, OIIPCRA, and PMMSY. 1. The subsidy shall be released based on the actual water area of the rearing tank and proportionate spawn stocking by the fish seed grower as per the above table. 1. OPDC will supply fish larval feed / Starter in powder form/pellet feed at a subsidised rate. 1. Beneficiaries shall procure the biosecurity bird fencing net and seed harvest drag net from OPDC at cost basis. 1. Beneficiaries shall submit the bills/receipts to the District Fisheries Officer for the release of subsidy after completion of one cycle of fish seed production. 1. Subsidy shall be released after verification of the seed rearing farm and bills/receipts by the District Level Committee. 1. No subsidy shall be released for fish larval feed/starter feed since this component is supplied directly to the beneficiary by OPDC at subsidized prices. > **Disbursement of Funds:** - Subsidy shall be released by the District Fisheries Officer. - Release shall be after completion of one crop cycle. - Release shall be after field verification. - Release shall be based on actual water spread area and proportionate spawn stocking. - Release shall be after verification by the District Level Committee. - One-time assistance will be provided and will be limited to a single beneficiary.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident/domicile of the state of Odisha. 1. The applicant must be individuals, fish farmers, WSHGs, or private entrepreneurs having a minimum of 0.25 Acre (0.1 Ha) tank suitable for rearing fish seed. 1. The applicant must have a minimum water spread area of 1 Acre (0.40 Ha) tank per applicant. 1. The applicant must have their own perennial tank or leased tank with a minimum 1 Acre water spread area, with a minimum of 3 year lease agreement, which is suitable for rearing fish spawn/fry to fingerling size during the early breeding period. 1. The applicant must rear fish spawn/fry to be procured and stocked by the beneficiaries during the period March to June. 1. The applicant must procure the spawn/fry from Government/OPDC fish hatcheries or from registered private hatcheries that were supported by the Directorate of Fisheries during the previous year under the State Plan, OIIPCRA, and PMMSY. 1. The applicant must not have availed any subsidy assistance through the department in any Govt agencies earlier for the fingerling rearing programme. 1. The applicant must have registered with the DFOs for accreditation and completion for private fish seed grower. 1. The applicant must possess identity and residential proof, including an Aadhaar Card. 1. The applicant must have a bank account in his/her name.
## Exclusions 1. Government assistance shall be given only one time for fish seed rearing, limited to a single beneficiary.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The scheme shall be advertised through the Departmental website, newspapers, and wall posters in the District and Block Fisheries Offices across the state, and the district-wise physical and financial target for Input Assistance under the scheme will be fixed by the Directorate of Fisheries according to their potential. **Step 2:** Interested fish seed growers shall apply to the concerned District Fisheries Officer (DFO) through the Assistant Fisheries Officer (AFO) in the prescribed format as specified in [Annexure-I](https://fard.odisha.gov.in/sites/default/files/2023-03/10.%20Input%20Assistance%20to%20Develop%20Network%20of%20Fish%20Seed%20Growers%20for%20Early%20Bred%20Spawn%20Guideline%202022-23.PDF), along with a self-attested passport-size photograph, Aadhaar Card copy, bank details, including the first page of pass book, water spread area details, finance mode (bank/self-finance), and self-declaration. **Step 3:** Upon receipt of the applications, the DFO will arrange within 7 days a site inspection of the fish seed farm by the concerned AFO; the AFO shall assess the suitability of the fish seed nursery/rearing pond, take geo-tagged photographs along with the beneficiary, measure the water spread area, assess spawn requirement using perforated spawn measuring cup (180 ml for 1 lakh spawn), and forward the Field Verification Report in Annexure-II format along with documents and geo-tagged photographs to the DFO within 7 days of field inspection. **Step 4:** The selection of beneficiaries shall be made in a transparent manner by the DFO, and the DFO shall issue a Go-ahead letter to the selected beneficiaries to take up the rearing of fish spawn/fry. **Step 5:** The beneficiary shall install the biosecurity bird fencing net around the fish seed tank and thereafter procure fish spawn/fry from Government/OPDC fish hatcheries or from registered private hatcheries supported by the Directorate of Fisheries during 2021-22 under State Plan, OIIPCRA and PMMSY; the AFO shall remain present at the time of stocking, take geo-tagged photographs and certify the stocking. **Step 6:** The spawn/fry shall be reared by the fish seed grower using fish larva feed/Starter in powder form/pellet feed supplied by OPDC at subsidized prices, following Standard Operating Procedure for pre-stocking management, acclimatization, spawn assessment, and feed management as given by the Directorate of Fisheries. **Step 7:** A District Level Inspection Team (DLIT) comprising District Fisheries Officer and Assistant Fisheries Officer/SFTA/JFTA In-Charge of the block shall undertake joint field inspection when the fish seed reaches fingerling stage, take geo-tagged photographs of the fish seed rearing tank with beneficiary, and verify bills/receipts; the DFO shall release subsidy to beneficiaries through DBT/RTGS/NEFT towards Spawn/Fry, Biosecurity Net and Drag Net as per eligibility within 30 days of submission of bills and receipts through AFO, and no subsidy shall be released towards Powder/Pellet Feed since it is supplied directly by OPDC at subsidized prices. **Step 8:** The DFO shall maintain records on spawn stocking, inspection reports and geo-tagged photographs, develop and upload a complete digitalized database on the department website, submit Monthly Progress Report in Annexure-III format to the Directorate of Fisheries, Odisha, Cuttack, and the scheme shall be monitored by the State Level Monitoring Committee constituted at the Directorate of Fisheries; project evaluation shall be undertaken by the agency engaged by Government and audit shall be conducted by Internal Audit of Fisheries & ARD Department and Principal Accountant General (A&E), Odisha. > **Note:** 1. **Annexure-I** – Application Form: Includes applicant details, category (Gen/SC/ST/OBC), water spread area, finance mode (bank/self-finance), Aadhaar Card copy, bank details, and self-declaration signed by applicant and recommended by AFO. 1. **Annexure-II** – Field Verification Report: To be submitted by AFO to DFO after physical verification, certifying eligibility, water spread area, and quantity of spawn to be stocked. 1. **Annexure-III** – Monthly District-Level Progress Report: To be submitted by DFO to the Directorate of Fisheries containing details of applications received, verified, go-ahead letters issued, stocking completed, subsidy entitlement, and assistance disbursed.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide insurance coverage to dairy animals to safeguard farmers against financial loss due to the death of insured animals. Through this scheme, insurance coverage is provided to eligible dairy farmers with premium subsidy support.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Kamdhenu Yojana: Go-Sampad Bima Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Odisha | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Livestock Insurance Scheme, Dairy Animal Insurance, Farmers, Insurance Coverage | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme "Go-Sampad Bima Yojana (GBY)" was launched by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, Odisha, under Mukhyamantri Kamdhenu Yojana. It aims to enhance the financial security of livestock farmers through the implementation of a comprehensive insurance scheme that safeguards against the loss of milch animals due to death. Through this scheme, beneficiaries can avail insurance coverage for milch cows and she-buffaloes for 1 year, 2 years, or 3 years with Government premium subsidy support. The scheme is implemented by the Director, Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, Odisha, Cuttack, through Odisha Livestock Resources Development Society (OLRDS) and field functionaries in coordination with empanelled insurance intermediaries engaged by the Insurance Company. The death of cattle due to disease, accidents, or natural calamities is covered under the scheme. The benefit of the subsidy is restricted to a maximum of 5 animals per household, though additional animals may be insured without subsidy by paying the full premium. > **Objectives** - To enhance the financial security of livestock farmers through the implementation of a comprehensive insurance scheme that safeguards against the loss of milch animals due to death.
## Benefits > **Insurance Coverage** 1. Insurance coverage is provided against the death of milch cows and he-buffaloes due to: - Disease - Accidents - Natural calamities 1. Coverage period: 1 year / 2 years / 3 years as opted by the beneficiary. > **Premium Subsidy** 1. Governments Share: 85% of the insurance premium 1. Farmers Share: 15% of the insurance premium 1. Subsidy is restricted to a maximum of 5 animals per household. 1. Premium Rate: **Policy Period****Premium Rate**1 Year2.65%2 Years4.505%3 Years6.36%> **Valuation of Milch Animals** 1. The maximum value of a cow having milk yield of 10 litres or more per day will be ₹**90,000**/- for those procured under the sub-scheme Gopalan Yojana of Mukhyamantri Kamdhenu Yojana (MKY) and Mukhyamantri Krushi Udyoag Yojana (MKUY). 1. The value of non-scheme animals will be calculated as per NABARD norms (i.e., ₹**6,500**/- litre of milk produced for crossbred animals and ₹**9,000**/- litre of milk produced by indigenous animals) and assessment of the animal's body condition by local AVAS/ VAS/ BVO. 1. The maximum value of a she-buffalo having milk yield of 8 litres or more per day will be ₹**90,000**/- for those procured under the sub-scheme Buffalo Entrepreneurship Development of MKY, and she buffaloes procured under MKUY. 1. The value of non-scheme buffaloes will be estimated as per the assessment of the animal's body condition and will be finalised by local AVAS/ VAS/BVO. > **Mode of Disbursement:** 1. 85% premium paid by OLRDS to the Insurance Company. 1. Claim amount transferred directly to the farmer’s bank account upon approval. > **Frequency of Disbursement:** 1. Premium paid once per policy. 1. Claim settled upon an admissible death claim. > **Expected Time of Disbursement:** 1. Policy bond issued within 3 days of receipt of proposal. 1. Claim settled within 15 days of receipt of complete documents. 1. Delay beyond 15 days attracts 12% compound interest per annum payable by the Insurance Company.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident/domicile of Odisha. 1. The applicant should be a dairy farmer having milch animals (indigenous, exotic, graded & crossbred cows and she-buffaloes). 1. The applicant must be willing to insure milch cattle for 1/2/3 years as per choice. However, animals procured under the Buffalo Entrepreneurship Development Scheme (BEDS) and Gopalan Yojana (GPY) must be insured for 3 years. 1. Preference shall be given to those who have not availed of the scheme earlier. > **Note:** 1. The age of the animals to be insured under the Gosampad Bima Yojana (GBY) is as follows: - Milch Cows (Indigenous/Crossbred/Exotic/Graded): Eligible from 2 years to 8 years. - Milch Buffaloes: Eligible from 3 years to 8 years
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline > **Insurance Enrollment & Policy Issuance** **Step 1:** Willing farmers are identified by LI/VT/VAS/Insurance Intermediary through awareness campaigns. The intermediary arranges a meeting within a fortnight with the farmer and AVAS/VAS/BVO to initiate insurance. **Step 2:** Tagging (if required, using NDDB 12-digit ear tag), health certification, valuation, registration on Bharat Pashudhan Portal, and 360-degree / 4-sided geo-tagged photographs (or coloured photographs in remote areas) are completed. Existing NDDB tags are not replaced. **Step 3:** Required documents are collected: Health Certificate with ear tag number, Aadhaar or Government ID proof, first page of bank passbook with IFSC, and geo-tagged photographs. Tagging, certification, and valuation must be completed before premium collection. **Step 4**: Farmer pays 15% premium share (cash/UPI/bank transfer); 85% Government share is paid by OLRDS. The intermediary transfers the premium electronically to the Insurance Company. Coverage becomes effective immediately upon receipt of the farmer's share. SMS confirmation is sent. **Step 5:** The insurance company issues a policy bond within 3 days of receipt of the proposal through CDVO/Intermediary and communicates it to the farmer (soft or hard copy). SMS is sent once the policy is generated. > **Claim Intimation & Settlement (In Case of Death)** **Step 6:** In case of death, the farmer must intimate LI/Insurance Company/Intermediary within 24 hours (maximum 3 working days). For a natural calamity or a missing animal, intimation must be within one week. Post-mortem by AVAS/VAS/BVO must be completed within 72 hours of first intimation. If the carcass is unavailable, the SRC report is accepted. **Step 7:** Claim documents to be submitted include: claim intimation, filled claim form, policy document, post-mortem report with ear tag (or SRC report), two geo-tagged photographs of deceased animal (or coloured photographs in remote areas), bank passbook copy, identification proof certified by a veterinary doctor, and death entry in BVO diary. **Step 8:** The insurance company processes the claim within 3 days and settles it within 15 days of receipt of complete documents. Approved compensation is transferred directly to the farmer’s bank account. Delay beyond 15 days attracts 12% compound interest per annum. Rejection must be intimated via SMS with reasons. Delayed intimation beyond a fortnight may result in “No Claim” or payment up to 75% at the insurer’s discretion. Loss of policy, sale of animal, or missing ear tag must be updated within 48 hours as per the prescribed procedure.

# Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme-Himachal Pradesh **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Himachal Pradesh | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Below Poverty Line, Disability, Indira Gandhi, Pension, PwD | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension" Scheme was introduced by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Himachal Pradesh, to provide social security to persons with disabilities. The scheme covers disabled individuals aged 18 to 79 years who are members of selected families living below the poverty line. Eligible persons must have a certificate of severe disability (80% or more) issued by a medical board constituted under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.

The applicant’s age should be between 18 and 79 years. 1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant shall submit the prescribed application form to the concerned Panchayat, Tehsil Welfare Officer, or District Welfare Officer, along with the required documents. **Step 2:** Eligible applicants are identified in the Gram Sabha meeting, and the verified list along with the proposal is forwarded to the Tehsil Welfare Officer for scrutiny and completion of formalities. **Step 3:** After due verification, the applications are submitted to the District Welfare Officer, who grants final approval for sanction of benefits.

page_content:
# Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB): Skill Development **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Mizoram | **Categories:** Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Construction Workers, Skill Development, Training | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The scheme “Skill Development” under the "Mizoram Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board Benefits for Workers" is implemented by the Mizoram Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Government of Mizoram, aims to enable registered construction workers and their dependent family members to establish wage or self-employment ventures for enhanced remuneration. It provides opportunities to upgrade and acquire skills through National Skills Qualifications Framework aligned short-term training courses. The scheme also aims to create a highly qualified workforce in accordance with the demands of modern industry. Six Training Providers are empanelled, and all Training Centers are National Skill Development Corporation accredited with certified trainers.
## Benefits - **Skill Development Training:** Registered members and their dependent family members can undergo skill development training through Training Providers empanelled with the Welfare Board.- **Short-Term Courses:** Eligible candidates can undertake National Skills Qualifications Framework aligned short-term training courses.- **Employment Opportunities:** Training supports opportunities for wage or self-employment ventures.- **Industry-Oriented Skills:** The scheme provides opportunities to acquire and upgrade skills according to modern industry requirements.- **Training Sectors:** Courses and job roles are offered across 8 sectors under the National Skill Development Corporation.- **Training Providers:** Training is provided through 6 Training Providers empanelled by the Welfare Board.- **Training Centers:** All Training Centers are National Skill Development Corporation accredited and have certified trainers for the proposed job roles and courses.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be an Indian citizen. - The applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age. - The applicant must have been engaged as a construction worker for at least 90 days in a year. - The applicant must be engaged as a contractor or employee in one of the covered categories of construction work. > **Target Trainees/ Beneficiaries:** - Registered members under MBOCWWB and their dependent family members. > **Contractors or employees engaged in the following categories of work:** 1. Carpenter 2. Mason 3. Cement Mason 4. Painter 5. Helper (Construction Works) 6. Electrician 7. Wireman 8. Fitter 9. Welder 10. Plumber 11. Iron and Aluminium Worker 12. Blacksmith 13. Lumberjack 14. Sand Extraction Worker 15. Stone Quarry Worker 16. Stone Breaker 17. Road and Earthwork Labourer 18. JCB/Dozer Operator 19. Construction Machine Operator 20. Construction Driver 21. Brick Factory Worker > **Membership Fee:** - A one-time Registration Fee of ₹25/- shall be payable at the time of enrolment. - A monthly subscription of ₹10/- is payable to maintain active membership. Alternatively, an advance payment of ₹120/- may be made to cover one year's subscription. - Members wishing to pay the Membership/Renewal Fee in advance may do so for a period of up to three (3) years. - Membership must be renewed within one (1) year from the date of expiry, in accordance with [Section 17 of the BOCW (RE&CS) Act, 1996](https://lesde.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2024/05/bbadc4155d1796a962f3883e14e4cc9c/pages-145-bocw-recs-act-1996.pdf).
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Eligible registered members of the Welfare Board may apply for the respective welfare schemes by submitting the prescribed scheme-specific application form, duly filled in and accompanied by the requisite supporting documents, through the prescribed offline mode. **Step 2:** The application forms and supporting documents shall be as specified by the Welfare Board for the respective scheme/benefit. - **Application Form for Registration under the Board**: [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2023/06/70c9592db154bfccb04514f40e9b5ea8/pages-103-registration-form.pdf).- **Application Form for Skill Development Assistance**: [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/page/scheme-on-skill-development-of-mbocwwb). > **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://bocw.mizoram.gov.in/page/whom-to-contact).

metadata.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide the Youth of West Bengal, who have entrepreneurial skills and want to be self-reliant by setting up micro enterprises, access to institutional finance for their credit needs.

page_content:
# West Bengal Bhabishyat Credit Card Scheme (WBBCCS) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** West Bengal | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Youth Entrepreneurship, Self Employment, Micro Enterprise, Institutional Finance, Bank Loan, Government Subsidy, Credit Guarantee | **Target Beneficiaries:** Individual ## Description The "West Bengal Bhabishyat Credit Card Scheme (WBBCCS)" is implemented by the Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises and Textiles Department, Government of West Bengal. The scheme aims to provide institutional finance to the youth of West Bengal through bank loans and government subsidy for setting up micro enterprises. It supports eligible beneficiaries in manufacturing, service, trading/business, and farm sector activities. The scheme encourages entrepreneurship, self-employment, income generation, and employment creation in both rural and urban areas. It came into effect from 1st April 2023 and will remain operational for 5 years, unless amended or withdrawn earlier.
## Benefits - **Eligible Project Cost:** Financial assistance for eligible manufacturing, service, trading/business, and existing or new enterprises with project cost up to ₹5,00,000/-. - **Government Subsidy:** Margin money subsidy of 10% of the project cost, subject to a maximum of ₹25,000/-. - **Bank Loan:** Bank loan for the remaining approved project cost after deducting the government subsidy, with a government-subsidized interest rate of 4% per annum. - **Guarantee Coverage:** 100% bank loan guarantee coverage jointly by Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE) and the Government of West Bengal. Maximum coverage of CGTMSE: 85%; Maximum coverage of the State Government: 15%
## Eligibility Criteria - Indian National and residing in West Bengal for past 10 years. - Any eligible individual including Motor Transport Workers, Building and other Construction Workers aged between 18-55 years. - Only one person from one family is eligible where 'family' means self and spouse.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Regitration:** **Step 1:** To submit form in onilne, applicants need to register online as a New User and Login with valid credentials on the [official portal](https://bccs.wb.gov.). **Step 2:** Online registraton is to be done with the information like 'Individual name, 'valid email' and 'valid mobile no.' **Step 3:** Thereafter, fill-up the necessary information as mentioned in the online application **Step 4:** Security Code/OTP will be forwarded to the regisered emailID/Mobile no. to complete the registration process accordingly. **Note:** Junk/inappropriate values in profile may lead to deactivation of User ID. > **Log in & Application:** **Step 1:** Upon successful Registration, Click on "Log In". **Step 2:** Click on the link ‘Click here to Fill Up the Form’ **Step 3:** Start to fill-up the application and input details as per the application form **Step 4:** Then proceed for uploading of necessary ‘supporting documents’. **Step 5:** Click on the ‘Apply Now’ button to Complete the Application Submission Process. > **User Manual:** [Click here](https://bccs.wb.gov.in/files/contents/user_manual/1_wbccs_um_applicant_level_01042023.pdf). > **DIC/Sub-DIC Contact Information:** [Click here](https://bccs.wb.gov.in/area/dic.html).
**Mode:** Offline > Offline [forms](https://bccs.wb.gov.in/files/contents/sar_125_micro_small_medium_enterprises_department_no._1115-msmet__8_page.pdf) may be collected from the following offices: - For Rural area: BDO office - For Municipal area: SDO Office - For Corporation area, including KMC area: at DIC/Sub-DIC Office and designated KMC offices. > **DIC/Sub-DIC Contact Information:** [Click here](https://bccs.wb.gov.in/area/dic.html).
