metadata.schemeName: NIJASHAREE HOUSING SCHEME
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme “NIJASHAREE HOUSING SCHEME” is an initiative by the Govt. of West Bengal which envisages the construction of multi-storied Lower Income Group (LIG)/Middle Income Group (MIG) flats on the public lands belonging to the State Government, local bodies and parastatals.

page_content:
# NIJASHAREE HOUSING SCHEME **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** West Bengal | **Categories:** Housing & Shelter, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** House, Flats, Lower Income Group, Middle Income Group | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The Government of West Bengal is determined to provide a `Basha’ (house) to all the people belonging to the Lower Income Group (LIG) and the Middle Income Group (MIG). There is a growing demand for housing amongst families belonging to the low and middle-income categories. In order to cater to the housing needs of the Lower Income Group and the Middle Income Group, the Housing Department felt the need to make provisions for affordable housing, and decided to introduce a new Housing Scheme, namely "NIJASHREE HOUSING SCHEME". Salient Features of The Scheme: - The scheme envisages the construction of dwelling units of a minimum of 16 flats in a block of G + 3 buildings on the government lands, lands of local bodies, and other parastatals. - 1BHK flats, with a minimum built-up area of 35.15 square meters (378 sq. ft.), will be constructed for the LIG category, and 2BHK flats, having a minimum built-up area of 50.96 square meters (559 sq. ft.), will be constructed for the MIG category. - The unit cost will be determined on the basis of the actual cost of construction of the superstructure, substructure, and internal infrastructure including sanitary and plumbing, internal electrification, etc., incidental therein. - No cost of land shall be taken into account while computing the unit cost. This freehold land will be treated as a subsidy to the beneficiary. - The unit cost and standard built-up area may vary, depending on the location and quantum of the land available, as well as the land development cost and the schedule of rates applicable to the area, at the time of construction. - Off-site infrastructure like the construction of internal roads, boundary wall, outside electrification, making of a drainage system, installation of lights in the campus and water supply shall not be added to the cost of the housing development scheme NIJASHREE, i.e., the purchaser will not have to pay for such infrastructure. - Credit-linked subsidies to the eligible beneficiaries will be facilitated by the Housing Department, as per the existing scheme.
## Benefits - Under this scheme, a `Basha’ (house) will be allotted to all the people belonging to the Lower Income Group (LIG) and the Middle Income Group (MIG) by lottery on ownership basis. - Credit-linked subsidies to the eligible beneficiaries will be facilitated by the Housing Department, as per the existing scheme. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. Monthly family income should be ₹15,000 or less for the Lower Income Group (LIG). 1. Monthly family income should be ₹30,000 or less for the Middle Income Group (MIG). 1. The beneficiary should not have any pucca house/flat in his/her name, or in the name of any family (family includes spouse, unmarried sons or daughters) member in the state. 1. The applicant must be an inhabitant of the same district in which the project is to be implemented. 1. One applicant can apply for one flat only for his/her family. Any person allotted with a flat in the scheme cannot apply for the same scheme in another project in his/her district.
**Note 01:** The selection of beneficiaries and allotment of flats will be done through a transparent lottery in the respective district/sub-division. **Note 02:** The waiting list of the eligible applicants, consisting of 20% of the total flats under each category (i.e. LIG and MIG), will be prepared in case the number of applicants is more than the number of flats in a particular project.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Official Portal/Link:** http://wbhousing.gov.in/nijashree

metadata.schemeName: Swarojgar Yojna- Himachal Pradesh
metadata.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to improve the economic condition of Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe families living below the poverty line by providing training and loans for self-employment and business activities.

page_content:
# Swarojgar Yojna- Himachal Pradesh **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Himachal Pradesh | **Categories:** Business & Entrepreneurship, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Below Poverty Line, Scheduled Tribes, Scheduled Castes, Loan, Families | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The Swarojgar Yojana, implemented by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Himachal Pradesh through the HP Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes Development Corporation, provides loans to eligible beneficiaries in both rural and urban areas. Under the scheme, the maximum loan limit is ₹50,000, with a capital subsidy of 50% of the project cost up to ₹10,000, and an effective interest rate of 4% after interest subsidy, subject to regular repayment.
## Benefits **Benefits of the Scheme:**
1. Maximum loan amount of up to ₹50,000/-. 1. Capital subsidy of 50% of the project cost, up to ₹10,000/-. 1. Reduced interest rate of 4% after subsidy, subject to regular repayment.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a bonafide resident of Himachal Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a member of a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe family. 1. The applicant should have an annual income of up to ₹35,000 in both rural and urban areas. 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 55 years of age. 1. The applicant should not be a defaulter of any bank or financial institution.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 1: Obtain and fill the prescribed [application form](https://himachalservices.nic.in/hpscstdc/PDFs/LoanSubs(SelfEmpl-Rehab).pdf) and attach all required documents. Step 2: Submit the completed application to the concerned District Manager or Corporation office for verification. Step 3: After approval, the application is forwarded to the HP SC/ST Development Corporation for further processing.

page_content:
# Ghee, Oil and Dal Distribution to Sahariya and Kheruya Family **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Health & Wellness, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Sahariya Tribe, Kherua Tribe, Nutritional Support, Free Food Distribution | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description Launched in 2012, the scheme "Ghee, Oil and Dal Distribution to Sahariya and Kherua Family" by the Tribal Area Development Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to combat malnutrition through providing monthly free nutritional supplements like ghee, oil, and dal to eligible Sahariya and Kherua tribal families in Baran. This initiative targets the specific dietary needs of these tribal communities to improve their overall health standards.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the production of Azolla in the backyard of farmers for feeding the animals to reduce the concentrate feed cost through easy availability of biomass rich in protein. Through this scheme, the establishment cost of a Cemented Azolla Unit is provided to a farmer.

page_content:
# Azolla Cultivation in Cemented Pit **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Odisha | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Azolla Cultivation, Dairy Farmers Support, Farmer, Financial Assistance, Cemented Azolla Unit | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme “Azolla Cultivation in Cemented Pit” was launched by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services, Odisha. It aims to promote the production of Azolla in the backyard of farmers for feeding the animals to reduce the concentrate feed cost through the easy availability of biomass rich in protein. Through this scheme, the establishment cost of one Cemented Azolla Unit is given, and onetime back ended assistance will be provided to each farmer. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, Odisha, Cuttack, through the Chief District Veterinary Officers and their field functionaries. The unit size of azolla pit shall be 6 ft x 6 ft x 8 inches (2 mt. x 2 mt. x 0.2 mt). During the year, 15000 units of cemented Azolla units will be established. All willing farmers who own at least one cattle will be eligible to avail support under the Azolla Cultivation Programme. > **Objectives** 1. This programme will promote the production of Azolla in the backyard of farmers for feeding the animals to reduce the concentrate feed cost through easy availability of biomass rich in protein.
## Benefits 1. The establishment cost of one Cemented Azolla Unit is ₹**3000**/-, and onetime back ended assistance will be provided to each farmer. > **Mode of Disbursement** 1. Onetime back-end assistance > **Expected Time of Disbursement** 1. Before the release of funds, the selected beneficiary list of the block on submission by BVO is to be scrutinized & approved by the District-level Fodder Development Committee under the Chairmanship of CDVO.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident/domicile of Odisha. 1. The applicant must be a willing farmer. 1. The applicant must own at least one cattle. > **Preference / Priority / Reservation / Relaxation** 1. The applicant who is a dairy farmer with at least one milch animal is primarily targeted. 1. The applicant household can avail the benefit of one Azolla production unit only. 1. One household will be assisted with one Azolla unit for more extensive coverage, and that will serve as a source of Azolla Seed Culture unit for the other interested farmers of that locality in the future.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The BVO will select the farmer in consultation with the Para Vet/LI of the locality and the concerned Milk Route Supervisor of OMFED (In case of selection of MPCS members) for implementation of the programme. **Step 2:** The selected beneficiary list of the block on submission by BVO shall be scrutinized & approved by the District level Fodder Development Committee under the Chairmanship of CDVO prior to release of funds. **Step 3:** The Go-ahead letters to the selected farmers shall be issued by the CDVOs. **Step 4:** The farmer shall report to the local Veterinary Officer/ L.I regarding the completion of the civil construction within 30 days from the issue of the Go-ahead letter. Then he/she will arrange all other required inputs for starting the production of Azolla. **Step 5:** The demonstration on the Azolla cultivation shall be the responsibility of the local L.I with the assistance of the fodder staff posted at CDVO/ SDVO offices. **Step 6:** The list of beneficiaries selected in each district shall be uploaded in the DSS portal by the respective CDVOs, and the CDVOs shall keep the records of the beneficiary in the prescribed proforma enclosed herewith at Annexure-II. **Step 7:** The Utilization Certificate on completion of the programme shall be sent to the Directorate by the CDVO in OGFR Form No.-7A. > **Review and Monitoring Mechanism** **Step 8:** Block Veterinary Officer (BVO) should cross check at least 5% of the Azolla units under his jurisdiction, and from the district level, CDVO, ADVO (AW), ADVO (LP) will inspect at least 2% of Azolla units. The LIs/ VTs/ Fodder Staff will be tied up for providing handholding support to the farmers, and the CDVO will submit a monthly report on the implementation of the scheme to the Directorate of AH & VS, Odisha. The progress made under the scheme shall be placed before the District Level Fodder Task Force constituted in each district for appraisal during its meeting. District-wise progress on the scheme will be reviewed on monthly basis by the Directorate of AH&VS, and once in two months by the Fisheries and Animal Husbandry Development Department (F&ARD) under the chairmanship of Principal Secretary, F&ARD. > **Note:** 1. The details oft he target for each district are enclosed in [Annexure-I](https://fard.odisha.gov.in/sites/default/files/2025-09/Guidelines%20Azolla%20Cultivation.pdf). 1. The prescribed proforma for beneficiary records is enclosed at [Annexure-II](https://fard.odisha.gov.in/sites/default/files/2025-09/Guidelines%20Azolla%20Cultivation.pdf). 1. The structure should be so constructed that there should not be any seepage of water.

page_content:
# Surakshit Matritva Aashwasan Yojana **Ministry:** Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Health & Wellness, Women and Child | **Tags:** Pregnant, Health | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description SUMAN Yojana or Surakshit Matritva Aashwasan Yojana is a maternity benefit initiative launched by the Ministry of Union Health and Family Welfare. This program provides affordable and quality healthcare solutions to pregnant women and newborns. Under this scheme, pregnant women, sick newborns, and mothers receive zero expense access up to six months after delivery. They receive treatment from quality hospitals and professionals. The PMSMA programme allows four antenatal check-ups during the 1st trimester and check-ups under Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan.
**Objectives of the SUMAN scheme-** 1. This scheme offers zero expenses and access to detection and management of complications during and after pregnancy. 1. Pregnant women can avail a zero-expense delivery and C-section facility at public health facilities. 1. SUMAN scheme ensures zero-tolerance for denial of services to children and pregnant women. 1. Pregnant women also receive free transport from home to the health facility and drop back after discharge. 1. This initiative facilitates respectful care with privacy and support for breastfeeding. 1. Facilities such as services for sick newborns and neonates and vaccination are offered for zero cost. ## Eligibility Criteria All pregnant women and newborns are eligible to avail of the benefits under the PM SUMAN Yojana. Following are the general requirements - 1. Pregnant women from all categories, including APL and BPL, are eligible to get the benefits 1. Newborns aged 0 to 6 months old will be able to avail the benefits of this scheme 1. After delivery, lactating mothers up to 6 months from delivery are also eligible for this scheme. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline

metadata.briefDescription: The "Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana (Developing Caste Welfare) (NT-DNT)" provides financial assistance of up to ₹1,20,000/- to the people belonging to Nomadic Tribes and Denotified Tribes.

page_content:
# Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana (Developing Caste Welfare) (NT-DNT)

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Housing & Shelter | **Tags:** Housing, Nomadic And Denotified Tribe, Social Welfare | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
The "Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana (Developing Caste Welfare) (NT-DNT)" is a welfare scheme by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department of Gujarat. Under this scheme, eligible applicants from the Nomadic Tribe (NT) and Denotified Tribe (DNT) are given up to ₹1,20,000/- for constructing a house. Priority is given to individuals from BPL families.

## Benefits
- **Financial Assistance:** Up to ₹1,20,000/- for house construction.

## Eligibility Criteria
- Applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
  - Applicant must belong to the [Nomadic Tribe (NT)/ Denotified Tribe (DNT)](https://socialjustice.gov.in/writereaddata/UploadFile/Draft%20List%20of%20Denotified%20Tribes%20for%20Mail.pdf).  - Applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹6,00,000/-.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
> **Registration Process:**

**Step 1:** Go to the  [eSamajKalyan portal](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/index.aspx?HodID=Mgt3fh4h1dSAcTIdCEHhzQ==) and navigate to the "Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana (Developing Caste Welfare)  (NT-DNT)" section under the menu option.
**Step 2:** Click on "Apply Now".
**Step 3:** Click on "New User? Please Register Here".
**Step 4:** Enter the required details and click Register.
> **Application Process:**

**Step 1:** Enter your User ID, Password, and Captcha Code, then click "Login".
**Step 2:** Read the scheme details carefully and click OK.
**Step 3:** If your permanent address is correct, confirm it. Otherwise, enter your correct address.
**Step 4:** Click Save & Next to proceed. Upload the relevant documents.
**Step 5:** If you need to make changes, click "No, Cancel". If all details are correct, click "Yes, Submit".
**Step 6:** Click Save Application. Note down your Application Number for future reference. You can also take a printout by clicking Print Application.
> **Check Application Status:** [Click here](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/ViewApplicationStatus.aspx).

metadata.schemeName: Kaidi Sahay Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The "Kaidi Sahay Yojana" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, provides financial assistance of ₹25,000/- to the family of a prisoner who is the sole or main earner, to support them through self-employment.

page_content:
# Kaidi Sahay Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Prisoner Family Aid, Social Welfare | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The Kaidi Sahay Yojana, initiated by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, aims to provide financial relief to families of prisoners who are undergoing sentences in jails and are the main or sole earners of their households. Under this scheme, a one-time financial assistance of ₹25,000/- is granted to the prisoner’s family, ensuring that they can sustain themselves through self-employment during the imprisonment period. ## Benefits - **Financial Assistance:** A one-time assistance of ₹25,000/-. ## Eligibility Criteria - Applicant must be a family member of a prisoner currently serving sentence in a state jail in Gujarat. - The prisoner should be the sole or main earner of the family. - The prisoner's family must be economically dependent on the prisoner. - The total family income should not exceed ₹1,50,000/- per annum. - The family should not be fragmented (i.e., should be living together and dependent on the prisoner).
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Visit the District Jail/ Sub Jail/ District Social Defense Office and obtain the [application form](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in/ViewForm.aspx). **Step 2:** Fill out the form with all required details and attach the necessary documents (Self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the completed application to the office of the District Welfare Officer/ Sub Jail.

# Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Marriage Assistance **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Madhya Pradesh | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Marriage, Driver, Conductor, Daughter | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The “Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Marriage Assistance” scheme has been launched by the Transport Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the marriage of daughters of registered transport vehicle drivers and conductors belonging to the unorganized sector to reduce the financial burden on low-income families.
## Benefits 1. Financial assistance for the marriage of daughters of registered transport vehicle drivers or conductors. 1. Assistance is provided as per the prevailing rates and conditions of the "[Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana](https://socialjustice.mp.gov.in/schemes/view/SWhoak9tZGNSMnpISG9jbndQckN4UT09)". - Under this scheme, the following assistance is provided: - Each eligible bride (including girls, widows, or abandoned women) participating in the mass marriage ceremony will receive a total of ₹49,000/- through an Account Payee Cheque, on the day of the mass marriage ceremony.The organizing body that conducts the mass marriage ceremony will receive ₹6,000/- per beneficiary. > **NOTE:** - A total of ₹55,000/- is provided per beneficiary under the scheme. - The monetary amount is as notified by the Social Justice Department under the Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana and may change from time to time.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a registered transport vehicle driver or conductor. 1. The applicant should possess a valid commercial driving license or conductor's license issued in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant’s name should be registered on the Samagra Portal. 1. The applicant’s daughter should be unmarried at the time of application. 1. The marriage should be conducted as per the conditions of the Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana. 1. The applicant should not be a government employee.
## Exclusions

# Financial Assistance for funeral and other activities in case of death of a worker's - Haryana Labour Welfare Board

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Death, Worker, Labour, Funeral, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
The scheme "Financial Assistance for Funeral and Other Activities in Case of Death of a Worker" is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB) under the Labour Department, Government of Haryana. The scheme aims to provide financial support to the family or dependent of a deceased worker to cover funeral and related expenses. Under this scheme, an assistance amount of ₹15,000/- is provided to the dependent/family of the deceased worker.

## Benefits
1. Financial assistance of ₹15,000/-.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be fully dependent on the deceased worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
1. The deceased worker should have had an active membership under the Haryana Labour Welfare Board at the time of death.
1. The applicant should not have previously availed benefits under this scheme.
1. There is no minimum service period or ceiling required under this scheme.
1. The application should be submitted within two years from the date of the worker’s death.

page_content:
# Assistance for Daughter's Marriage

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Marriage, Widow, Daughter, Ex-servicemen, Sainik | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
The "Assistance for Daughter's Marriage" scheme, introduced by the Department of Sainik Welfare, Government of Rajasthan, aims to provide financial support to widows of ex-servicemen for their daughters' marriages. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹25,000/- per daughter is provided for a maximum of two marriageable daughters of widows of ex-servicemen up to the rank of Havaldar, who are not receiving the Marriage Grant from the Kendriya Sainik Board (KSB). The financial assistance, drawn from the Amalgamated Fund, is payable to the beneficiary upon applying within one year from the date of marriage.

## Benefits
- Financial assistance of ₹25,000/- per daughter (up to two daughters) is provided.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
   1. The applicant should be the widow of an ex-serviceman of the rank of Havildar or below.
   1. The assistance is available for a maximum of two daughters of the widow of an ex-serviceman.
   1. The daughter should be at least 18 years of age at the time of marriage.
   1. The daughter’s name should be duly recorded in the ex-serviceman’s discharge book or Part-2 order.
   1. The applicant should possess a valid Ex-Serviceman/Widow Identity Card issued by the respective District Sainik Welfare Office.
   1. The applicant should not have received marriage assistance for the same purpose from the Kendriya Sainik Board.
   1. The application should be submitted within one year from the date of marriage to be eligible for assistance under this scheme.
   1. Widows of ex-servicemen who are classified as Battle Casualties or Physical Casualties (attributable cases) are not eligible under this scheme, as marriage assistance in such cases is provided by the Army Headquarters.
   1. If the applicant is eligible for the Daughter Marriage Assistance Scheme run by the Kendriya Sainik Board for ex-servicemen, then financial aid from the Amalgamated Fund shall not be granted.
   1. The benefit shall be extended only to the widow of an ex-serviceman who meets the definition of an ex-serviceman as prescribed by the Government of India.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
***Application Process:***
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the office of the District Sainik Welfare Officer and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
**OR**
The applicant should download the [application form](https://sainikkalyan.rajasthan.gov.in/content/dam/doitassests/sainikwelfare/pdf/Amalgamatedfundschemes/Daughter%27s%20Marraige.pdf) (Page No. 4) from the official website. 
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District Sainik Welfare Officer. 
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the District Sainik Welfare Officer to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission and a unique identification number (if applicable).
**NOTE:**

  - The application must be submitted within one year of the marriage date.
  - The application should be made through the same District Sainik Welfare Officer from whom the ex-serviceman/widow's identity card was issued.

***Post-Application Process:***
**Step 1:** The District Sainik Welfare Officer will verify the application and documents.
**Step 2:** Verified applications will be forwarded to the Director, Sainik Kalyan Vibhag, Rajasthan. A committee will review applications every six months.
**Step 3:** If approved, the financial assistance will be transferred online to the applicant’s bank account.
**Step 4:** The District Sainik Welfare Officer will inform the applicant about the payment status.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide BPL-equivalent benefits to families with two or more specially-abled members. Under this scheme, eligible families receive free medical treatment, ration supplies, and other welfare benefits.

page_content:
# Aastha Yojana

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Health & Wellness, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Persons With Disabilities, Medical Treatment, Ration, Welfare Benefits, PwD, Astha Card | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
The scheme "Aastha Yojana" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Rajasthan. It aims to provide BPL-equivalent benefits to families with multiple specially-abled members. Under this scheme, eligible families receive free medical treatment, ration supplies, and other welfare benefits. To avail of the benefits, a family must possess an Aastha Card, and their annual income should not exceed ₹1.20 lakh.

## Benefits
- Aastha cardholder families receive benefits similar to BPL families, including free medical treatment and ration supplies.

**Note:** Aastha cardholders are entitled to benefits from all BPL-related schemes run by different state government departments.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The two or more members should be specially abled from the same family.
1. The applicant must have a disability of 40%.
1. The annual family income should not exceed ₹1,20,000/-.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit office of the District Social Justice & Empowerment Office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District Social Justice & Empowerment Office.
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the District Social Justice & Empowerment Office to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission and a unique identification number (if applicable).

page_content:
# Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Differently Abled Person, Education, Children, PwD | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
The scheme "Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana" was implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to provide financial assistance for the upbringing and education of children of specially-abled parents. Under this scheme, children receive monthly financial support based on their age to ensure their well-being and education. To be eligible for assistance, the child must attend an Anganwadi/school between the ages of two to five years and study in school after the age of 6 years.

## Benefits
1. Financial assistance of ₹500/- per month for children aged 0-6 years.
1. Financial assistance of ₹1,000/- per month for children aged 6-18 years.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant must be a resident of Rajasthan.
1. Only children aged 0 to 18 years of specially-abled parents are eligible for assistance.
1. The child must be between 2 to 5 years of age and enrolled in an Anganwadi or school.
1. Children above the age of 6 must be studying in a recognized educational institution.
1. The family's annual income should not exceed ₹1,20,000/-.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online - via CSC
**Step 1:** The applicant should gather copies of the necessary documents needed to apply for the concerned scheme.
**Step 2:** The applicant should visit the nearest E-mitra Center and complete the Biometric Verification Process.
**Step 3:** The applicant should ensure that the E-mitra Center agent completes all mandatory fields in the application form and uploads copies of all required documents.
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

page_content:
# Gadiya Lohar Maharana Pratap Bhawan Nirman Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Housing & Shelter | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Bhawan Nirman, Maharana Pratap, Gadia Lohar, House Construction | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme "Gadiya Lohar Maharana Pratap Bhawan Nirman Yojana" was introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹1,20,000/- is provided in three instalments to Gadiya Lohar families in Rajasthan for the construction of permanent houses and ensuring their settlement. ***Objectives:*** - To provide permanent houses to the Gadiya Lohar families. - To provide financial assistance in three installments for house construction. - To promote the social and economic integration of Gadiya Lohars community. ## Benefits **Financial Assistance:** - ₹1,20,000/- is provided to each eligible beneficiary. **Mode of Disbursement:** - First Installment: ₹40,000/- is provided after verification of land ownership and submission of required documents. - Second Installment: ₹40,000/- is disbursed after verification of construction progress. - Third Installment: ₹40,000/- is given upon completion of construction and submission of utilization proof. **Frequency & Validity:** - This is a one-time financial grant. - The entire house construction must be completed within one year from the approval of the first installment. ***Note:*** - If a beneficiary misuses the grant, legal action will be taken, and the amount will be recovered. - The constructed house cannot be sold or transferred for 20 years. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should belong to the Gadiya Lohar community. 1. The applicant should own a plot for house construction. 1. The applicant or their family should not own any other house within the district or anywhere in Rajasthan. ## Exclusions

Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission and a unique identification number (if applicable).

metadata.schemeName: Stipend Scheme for Grandchildren of Freedom Fighters
metadata.briefDescription: "Stipend Scheme for Grandchildren of Freedom Fighters" aims to honour the third-generation descendants of freedom fighters by providing financial assistance for higher education. Eligible students receive a monthly stipend and an annual allowance for books to support their education.

page_content:
# Stipend Scheme for Grandchildren of Freedom Fighters

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Stipend, Education, Financial Assistance, Scholarship, Student | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
Launched in 2010-11, the scheme "Stipend Scheme for Grandchildren of Freedom Fighters" by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Haryana, aims to honour the third-generation descendants of freedom fighters by providing financial assistance for higher education. Through this scheme, eligible students receive a monthly stipend and an annual allowance for books to support their education. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Higher Education, Haryana. The stipend is available for students pursuing non-professional courses in government and government-aided colleges and universities within the state. The assistance is provided on a merit basis and is subject to attendance and good conduct requirements.

## Benefits
**Financial Assistance**
Eligible students receive ₹1,000 per month as a stipend for 12 months and ₹2,000 per year as an allowance for books.
**Coverage**
The scheme applies to students pursuing non-professional courses in government and government-aided colleges and universities in Haryana.
**Good Conduct Requirement**
Scholarship installments are released only upon obtaining a good conduct and attendance certificate from the principal/head of the institution.
**Reinstatement Condition**
If a student drops out but re-joins and attends at least 50% of classes in three months, both the previously due installment and the current quarter’s installment are released.
**Mode of Disbursement**

- Payment is made via electronic transaction to the student’s bank account.
- In exceptional cases, payment may be made through a demand draft.

**Frequency of Disbursement**
The stipend is paid in four instalments per year:

- September: For July & August
- November: For September & October
- January: For November & December
- March: For January to June

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a grandchild (third generation) of a freedom fighter.
1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should be enrolled in a government or government-aided college/university in Haryana.
1. The applicant should be pursuing a non-professional course.
1. The applicant should have passed the previous examination based on which admission was granted.
1. The applicant should maintain satisfactory attendance and conduct.
1. The applicant should not have failed the previous year’s university examination.

**Reinstatement Criteria:**
If a student drops out but re-joins classes and maintains at least 50% attendance for three months, the previous and current quarter’s stipend is released.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
> **Registration**

**Step 1:** Visit the [Official Website](https://harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in/) of the "Centralized Scholarship Portal" of the Department of Higher Education, Haryana.
**Step 2:** In the menu ribbon, click "Student > [Student Registration](https://harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in/StudentRegistration)".
**Step 3:** On the next page, provide your Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID) and click "Search".
_*Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) is mandatory for availing of any Scholarship benefit. Students are advised to ensure their all particulars such as Name, DOB, Aadhar No. etc are fully updated in PPP before applying for any scholarship scheme._
**Step 4:** A List of the members of your family will be displayed. Select the checkbox against your name and click "Generate OTP". Enter the OTP received on your registered Mobile Number and click on "Verify OTP".
**Step 5:** After OTP verification, you will be taken to the registration page. In the registration form, all the mandatory fields get auto-filled. You only need to cross-check the information.
**Step 6:** Select your Department and College. Create a Password and click "Register".
> **Application**

**Step 1:** Visit the [Official Website](https://harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in/) of the "Centralized Scholarship Portal" of the Department of Higher Education, Haryana.
**Step 2:** In the right corner of the menu ribbon, click "[User Login](https://harchhatravratti.highereduhry.ac.in/UserLogin)". Use the username and password created during your registration to log in.
**Step 3:** Navigate to the online form of the scheme you intend to apply for. In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections.
**Step 4:** Click "Apply" to submit your application. You'll receive a confirmation message.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a lumpsum grant (maximum ₹20,000/-) to the dependent family in case of death of the artist. The one-time financial assistance amount is disbursed to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing Service (ECS) mode. The applications are accepted offline.

page_content:
# Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Lumpsum Grant **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Sports & Culture, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Artist, Family, Death, Financial Assistance, Dependent | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi" was launched by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. The "Lumpsum Grant" component of the scheme aims to provide a lumpsum grant (maximum ₹20,000/-) to the dependent family in case of death of the artist. The one-time financial assistance amount is disbursed to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing Service (ECS) mode. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline.
## Benefits - Financial Assistance in the form of a lumpsum grant, maximum of ₹20,000/- shall be provided. - The one-time financial assistance amount is disbursed to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing Service (ECS) mode. > ***Conditions*** - The wife/husband of the late artist shall be considered first for the grant. - In the event of the wife/husband predeceasing the late artist, the benefit shall be passed on to the unmarried/unemployed sons/daughters of the deceased artist as the case may be in equal ratio.
## Eligibility Criteria - The deceased artist must have been Goan, i.e., born and brought up in Goa. - The deceased artist must have been recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. - The deceased artist must not have been less than 50 years in age. (The Government may relax the age criteria for deserving cases under special circumstances.) - The applicant must be the dependent family member of the deceased artist. - The wife/husband of the late artist shall be considered first for the grant. - In the event of the wife/husband predeceasing the late artist, the benefit shall be passed on to the unmarried/unemployed sons/daughters of the deceased artist as the case may be in equal ratio. - The annual income of the family of the deceased artist (from all the sources) must be less than ₹25,000/- per annum.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** Visit the office of the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa, and collect the prescribed application form for the scheme. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the completed application form along with all required documents directly to the ***Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa.***
##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** The Directorate shall forward the application to the sub-committee for scrutinizing the application thoroughly. The Director shall give its recommendations to the sub-committee. **Step 2:** The sub-committee shall consider the received applications and recommend the applicants which are considered fit by the sub-committee to avail the benefits under this scheme. The committee shall decide the quantum of assistance to be released to the needy artist. **Step 3:** After the committee decides on the quantum of assistance, the approval from the Government shall be obtained for disbursement of the financial assistance. **Step 4:** After obtaining Government approval, the Director shall disburse the one-time financial assistance amount to the applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode to the bank account.

# Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Financial Assistance For Funeral of the Artist **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Sports & Culture | **Tags:** Death, Funeral, Artist, Relief, Family | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi" was launched by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. ##### ***Post-Application Processes*** **Step 1:** The Directorate shall forward the application to the sub-committee for scrutinizing the application thoroughly. The Director shall give its recommendations to the sub-committee. **Step 2:** The sub-committee shall consider the received applications and recommend the names which are considered fit by the sub-committee to avail the benefits under this scheme. metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides compensation ranging from ₹60,000/- for sterilization failure to ₹4,00,000/- for death following sterilization, along with coverage for treatment costs up to ₹50,000/- for complications arising within 60 days post-operation.

page_content:
# Family Planning Indemnity Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Goa | **Categories:** Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Family, Sterilization, Compensation, Death, Indemnity, Healthcare, Medical, Insurance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme "Family Planning Indemnity Scheme" was launched by the Directorate of Health Services, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to provide compensation for death, failure, or complications following sterilization operations, addressing the financial burden and risks associated with family planning procedures. The scheme provides compensation ranging from ₹60,000/- for sterilization failure to ₹4,00,000/- for death following sterilization, along with coverage for treatment costs up to ₹50,000/- for complications arising within 60 days post-operation.
## Benefits **Section A:** Death following sterilization (inclusive of death during sterilization operation) in hospital or within 7 days from discharge - ₹4,00,000/-. **Section B:** Death following sterilization within 8-30 days from discharge - ₹1,00,000/-. **Section C:** Failure of sterilization - ₹60,000/-. **Section D:** Cost of treatment in hospital and up to 60 days arising out of complications following sterilization operation - Actual cost not exceeding ₹50,000/-. > ***Conditions*** _*The claimant must accept the compensation amount as full settlement with no further claim rights._ _*The claimant must warrant the truth of all particulars provided, with forfeiture of compensation for false statements._ _*The claimant must agree that the compensation covers all aspects of the claim with no additional benefits._
## Eligibility Criteria ##### ***For Beneficiary (Person who underwent Sterilization)*** - The applicant must be a person who has undergone sterilization operation under family planning program. - The applicant must have undergone sterilization operation at an authorized health facility. - The applicant must be able to provide documentary evidence of the sterilization procedure. ##### ***For Claimant (Family Member or Legal Representative)*** - The applicant must be a legal claimant or family member of the person who underwent sterilization (in case of death or incapacitation). - The applicant should have legal authority to represent the beneficiary in case of death or inability to claim. > ***Conditions*** _*The applicant must report complications, failure, or death within the specified timeframes as per scheme guidelines._ _*The applicant must submit the claim through proper medical channels with certification from authorized medical officers._
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** ***Initial Reporting and Documentation*** - Visit the health facility where sterilization was conducted and report the case of death, failure, or complication to the Medical Superintendent or Health Officer. - Begin collecting all required documents including original sterilization certificates, case papers, identity documents, and bank details from relevant sources. **Step 2:** ***Form Completion and Medical Certification*** - Complete Part A of the [Claim Form cum Medical Certificate](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/Family-Planning-Indemnity-Scheme.pdf) with accurate personal details, sterilization operation information, and nature of claim.- Submit all medical records and completed Part A to the Chief Medical Officer or equivalent designated officer at district level for medical certification. **Step 3:** ***Application Submission*** - Collect the medically certified claim form (Part A and Part B completed) from the certifying officer. - Submit the complete application with all required original documents and photocopies to the [respective health facility](https://dhs.goa.gov.in/pages/pios-and-apios) where sterilization was performed. **Step 4:** ***Follow-up and Verification*** - Maintain regular contact with the health facility to track progress as the case moves through District Indemnity Scheme Committee review. - Provide any additional information or documentation if requested during the committee verification process. **Step 5:** ***Payment Processing*** - The District Committee forwards the verified case to the state office (State Health Society) for final approval and processing. - Upon state approval, compensation amount is disbursed directly to the beneficiary's bank account as specified in the claim form.

metadata.schemeName: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Maternity Assistance
metadata.briefDescription: This scheme provides financial assistance to eligible registered drivers and conductors to support their maternity-related needs during childbirth.

page_content:
# Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Maternity Assistance **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Madhya Pradesh | **Categories:** Women and Child, Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Maternity Assistance, Child Birth, Drivers, Conductors, Paternity | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The “Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Maternity Assistance” scheme has been launched by the Transport Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. Under this scheme, financial support during childbirth is provided to eligible women drivers or the wives of registered male drivers and conductors to ensure income security during maternity and paternity periods.
## Benefits - Financial assistance equivalent to 45 days of wages at the Collector Rate is provided to the registered woman driver or conductor. - In case the registered beneficiary is male, financial assistance equivalent to 45 days of wages at the Collector Rate is provided to his wife. - An additional amount equivalent to 15 days of wages at the Collector Rate is provided as paternity leave compensation to the father of the child. - A cash assistance of ₹1,000 is provided towards delivery-related expenses under the Janani Suraksha Yojana.
## Eligibility Criteria > **General Eligibility:** 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a registered transport vehicle driver or conductor. 1. The applicant should hold a valid commercial driving or conductor license issued in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant’s name should be registered on the Samagra Portal. > **Maternity-Specific Eligibility:** 1. The applicant should be a registered female driver or conductor or the wife of a registered male driver or conductor. 1. The applicant should be applying for maternity assistance for not more than 2 deliveries. 1. The applicant should comply with the norms prescribed under the Janani Suraksha Yojana for delivery-related benefits.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline > **Samagra ID Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the official website: [samagra.gov.in](https://samagra.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on the option “Register Family” or “Register Member”. **Step 3:** Enter the Aadhaar number and other required information. **Step 4:** Enter the OTP received on the registered mobile number. **Step 5:** Carefully fill in all the required details and upload the necessary documents. **Step 6:** Enter the captcha code and click on “Submit Application.” > **Offline Samagra ID Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the nearest Lok Seva Kendra, MP Online Kiosk, or Common Service Center (CSC). **Step 2:** Provide the required documents and necessary information to complete the registration process. > **After Samagra Registration:** **Step 1: Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the [application form](https://transport.mp.gov.in/sites/default/files/documents/yojna_20150001.pdf) (Page No. 9) from the official website. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District or Regional Transport Office.

metadata.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Construction of Toilet (UKBOCWWB)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹12,000/- to registered construction workers for building toilets. The assistance is disbursed in two installments: the first installment of ₹8,000/- and the second installment of ₹4,000/-.

page_content:
# Financial Assistance for Construction of Toilet (UKBOCWWB) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Toilet, Construction Worker, Labour, Building Worker, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The “Financial Assistance for Construction of Toilet” scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support to registered construction workers for building toilets. The financial assistance is disbursed in two installments.
## Benefits > Under the scheme, registered construction workers receive financial assistance of ₹12,000/- in two installments for the construction of toilets. - **First Installment:** ₹8,000/- - **Second Installment:** ₹4,000/-
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - via CSC - The online application can be submitted through Shramik Suvidha Kendras. At the time of application, the following documents are required: Shramik Card, Aadhaar Card, Self-Declaration Certificate, Aadhaar-linked bank account details, and a photograph showing the worker along with the toilet under construction. The photograph must clearly show the toilet with concrete walls, roof with lintel, tank, water arrangement, and seat. - Land-related documents of the site where the toilet is constructed, such as Dakhal Kharij/Khatauni/Registry or land ownership certificate, along with a permanent residence certificate, must also be attached. Additionally, an affidavit is required stating that the applicant has not availed benefits from any other scheme and has not applied for assistance from any other department. - If the application is verified and found correct during the departmental investigation, the first installment is credited to the applicant’s bank account. After completion of the construction, the applicant must reapply after one month with all relevant documents to receive the second installment of ₹4,000/-.

metadata.schemeName: Uttarakhand Shaheed Kosh Anudan
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to widows/dependents of soldiers & paramilitary personnel who were martyred in wars, border clashes, or internal security operations. Under this scheme, a one-time grant of ₹10 lakh is provided, subject to eligibility criteria.

page_content:
# Uttarakhand Shaheed Kosh Anudan **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Shaheed Kosh, Martyrs, Dependents, Sainik, Soldiers | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme "Uttarakhand Shaheed Kosh Anudan" is implemented by the State Sainik Board under the Sainik Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to provide financial assistance to the widows/dependents of soldiers and paramilitary personnel who were martyred in wars, border clashes, or internal security operations. Under this scheme, a one-time lump sum grant of ₹10 lakh is provided, subject to eligibility criteria based on the martyr’s family status.
## Benefits - **One-Time Grant:** ₹10,00,000/- per martyr
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should be a widow or dependent of a soldier or paramilitary force personnel martyred in a war, border conflict, or internal security operation. > **Distribution Criteria:** (a) In case the martyr was married: - Widow (Veer Nari) – 60% of the grant amount - Parents – 40% of the grant amount (b) If the parents are not alive, then the full prescribed amount shall be given to the widow (Veer Nari) and where the widow (Veer Nari) is not alive then 40% of the prescribed amount shall be given to the parents and 60% shall be distributed equally among all the dependent children. (c) In a situation where the parents and the widow (Veer Nari) are not alive, the prescribed amount shall be divided equally among all the dependent children. (d) In a situation where the widow (Veer Nari) is not alive and has no children, the entire prescribed amount will be given to the parents.(e) In a situation where the martyr is unmarried or widower, the prescribed amount will be given to the parents.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - After obtaining the application form from the District Sainik Welfare Office, the applicant must submit it to the concerned office. - The following documents are required for the application: Bank account passbook, preliminary report related to war, part-two order of the record office/Director General's office related to the war incident, battle casualty certificate of martyr soldier, relationship certificate issued by the related record office/Director General's office of dependents, discharge book, identity card of dependents, Certificate of non-payment of ex-gratia grant issued by the District Sainik Welfare and Rehabilitation Office, Certificate of battle casualty/operational casualty issued by the Director General, Paramilitary Forces (for Paramilitary Forces), Certificate of battle casualty/operational casualty issued by the Director General, Central Armed Police Forces (for Central Armed Police Forces) - After verification of the applications at the District Sainik Welfare Office level, the approved amount is paid to the applicants found correct through DBT.

metadata.schemeName: Payment of Ex-Gratia Amount on Death of the UPNL Employee During Service
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- to the legal dependents of deceased UPNL employees in the event of the employee’s death during their service period.

page_content:
# Payment of Ex-Gratia Amount on Death of the UPNL Employee During Service **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Ex-gratia, Dependents, Death, UPNL | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme "Payment of Ex-Gratia Amount on Death of UPNL Employees During Service" is implemented by Uttarakhand Purv Sainik Kalyan Nigam Limited (UPNL) under the Sainik Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the legal dependents of deceased UPNL employees in the event of the employee’s death during their service period.
## Benefits A one-time ex-gratia payment of ₹1,00,000/- shall be made from the UPNL fund to the family/legal dependents of a UPNL employee in the event of the employee’s death during the service period.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a legal dependent of the deceased UPNL employee. 1. The deceased employee must have been a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have been nominated during the service period of the deceased employee to receive the ex-gratia amount.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline In the event of the death of a UPNL employee during service, the legal dependent must submit the application form to the UPNL Headquarter Office at the earliest, along with the following documents: 1. Death certificate of the employee 1. Service certificate from the department of the deceased employee, as per the enclosed format 1. Aadhaar card of the dependent 1. Bank account details of the dependent (photocopy of passbook) 1. Photograph of the dependent 1. Copy of Aadhaar card of family members along with a certified copy of the family register 1. No Objection Certificate on an affidavit of ₹10/- from other dependents mentioned in the family register, along with a certificate stating that the ex-gratia grant has not been paid to them previously

page_content:
# Incentive Honorarium to Parents of Permanent Residents of Madhya Pradesh who enroll their Daughter in Defence Services **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Madhya Pradesh | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child | **Tags:** Ex-servicemen, Daughter, Parents, Indian Armed Forces | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The “Incentive Honorarium to Parents of Permanent Residents of Madhya Pradesh who enroll their Daughter in Defence Services” scheme was launched by the Home Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. Under this scheme, a monetary incentive per year is provided to the parents of daughters who are serving or have served in the defense services.
## Benefits **Annual Honorarium:** - ₹20,000 per year is granted to the parents whose daughters are serving or have retired from the defense services. **Mode of Disbursement:** - The sanctioned amount is directly credited to the beneficiary’s bank account through the District Sainik Welfare Office.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be the mother or father of a daughter serving or retired from any recognized defense service (Army, Navy, or Air Force). 1. The applicant’s daughter must be serving in a recognized defense unit or retired not more than five years ago.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ##### ***Registration*** **Step 1:** Visit the official website of "[Sainik Welfare](https://sainikkalyan.mp.gov.in/Home.aspx)", and click "Log-in". **Step 2:** In the online registration form, fill the following mandatory fields: Email ID, Mobile Number. Create a password and confirm. Finally, click "Submit" to complete the registration. **Step 3:** After successful registration, the User ID and Password will be generated. ##### ***Application*** **Step 1:** Visit the official website. Sign in using your Username and Password created during registration. **Step 2:** Navigate to the online form of the scheme. In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. **Step 3:** Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections. Click "Save Application". You'll receive a confirmation message upon successful submission of the application, along with an "application number". Click "Print Application" to print the application.
**Mode:** Offline > **Application Process** **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the District Sainik Welfare Office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the respective District Sainik Welfare Office. > **Post-Application Process** **Step 1:****** The District Sainik Welfare Officer verifies the service certificate and domicile details. **Step 2:****** Verified applications are forwarded to the Directorate of Sainik Welfare, Madhya Pradesh, Bhopal. **Step 3:****** The Directorate sanctions and allocates the funds to the respective District Sainik Welfare Office. **Step 4:****** The honorarium amount is then credited directly to the applicant’s bank account.

metadata.schemeName: Shaadi Mubarak Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: In order to prevent child marriages and support marriage expense of financially distressed families, on 02nd October 2014, Government of Telangana (GoTS) introduced a welfare scheme called “Shaadi Mubarak’’, providing financial assistance for marriages of minority community girls.

page_content:
# Shaadi Mubarak Scheme

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Telangana | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child | **Tags:** Shaadi, Marriage, Girl, Minority | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
In order to prevent child marriages and support the marriage expense of financially distressed families, on 02nd October 2014, Government of Telangana introduced a welfare scheme called “Shaadi Mubarak’’, providing financial assistance for marriages of minority community girls.
       The main objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to the newly wedding brides who belong to minority families. Under this scheme at the time of marriage of the bride financial aid will be transferred into the bank account of the mother. This scheme will prevent early marriages and will also increase the literacy rate among girls as only those girls who have attained 18 years of age or more can apply for this scheme. Through the implementation of this scheme, many benefits will be availed for the brides who are about to get married in Telangana state. Incentives such as financial funds will be provided to the bank account of the bride’s mother so that the marriage of the bride can take place smoothly and without any disturbance because of the property.

## Benefits
1. Under the Scheme, one-time financial assistance of ₹1,00,116 /- at the time of marriage shall be granted to every unmarried girl belonging to the minority community with effect from October 2, 2014 subject to the eligibility condition.
   1. The financial assistance of ₹1,25,145/- is provided to the parents of disabled girls.

**Note:** The "Shaadi Mubarak" is only a one-time financial assistance and can be availed only once in a lifetime.

## Eligibility Criteria
1.	The unmarried girl should belong to the minority community.
2.	The unmarried girl should be a resident of Telangana state.
3.	The unmarried girl should have completed 18 years of age at the time of marriage.
4.	The wedding of the minority community girl should be on or after October 2, 2014.
5.	The combined income of the Parents shall not exceed ₹2,00,000/- per annum.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
**Step 01:** To avail of the benefits of the scheme, the applicants shall apply online by accessing the website  “[Telangana ePass](https://telanganaepass.cgg.gov.in/)”. 
**Step 02:** Scroll down the homepage and click on “Kalyana Lakshmi Shaadi Mubarak”.
**Step 03:** Under “Shaadi Mubarak Services For Minority”, click on ‘Registration’.
**Step 04:** Fill out the [registration form](https://telanganaepass.cgg.gov.in/ShaadiMubharak.do) completely and click on ‘submit’.
**Note 01:** Under the tab ‘Print/Status’, the applicant can check the status of the application and take a printout of the application form for future reference.
**Note 02:** Under the tab ‘Edit/Uploads’, the applicant can edit the application form and upload other relevant documents.

metadata.briefDescription: Launched on 1st January 2006, the “Ladli Social Security Allowance Scheme” is a flagship social-security scheme by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Haryana. The family receives ₹2,750/- per month for 15 years after either of the two parents completes 45 years of age.

page_content:
# Ladli Social Security Allowance Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Social Security, Girl, Allowance, Financial Assistance, Daughter, Allowance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description Launched on 1st January 2006, the scheme “Ladli Social Security Allowance Scheme” is a flagship social-security scheme by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Haryana. Through this scheme, the eligible family receives benefits for 15 years after either of the two parents completes 45 years of age. A sum of ₹2,750/- per month per family is provided to the families who have solely girl child/children. The parent(s) should be either domicile of Haryana or should be working for the Government of Haryana. ## Benefits ₹2,500/- per month for 15 years, after either of the two parents completes 45 years of age. **NOTE 1:** The benefit will be paid to the mother. In case the mother is deceased, the benefit will be paid to the father. **NOTE 2:** After 60 years the scheme will be converted to "Old Age Samman Allowance" scheme. ## Eligibility Criteria - The biological single parent/parents of the family should be domiciled in Haryana or should be working for the Government of Haryana. - The family should have no son, whether biological or adopted. - The family should have one or more girl children. - The gross annual income of the family, from all sources, should not exceed ₹2,00,000/-. **NOTE:** The benefit will be paid to the mother. In case the mother is deceased, the benefit will be paid to the father. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the Office/ Sub-Office of the [District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO)](https://socialjusticehry.gov.in/telephone-no-of-dswos-in-haryana/), and request the hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications. Portal. **Step 2:** In the "SIGN IN HERE" section, click "New user? Register here". **Step 3:** The registration form will open in a new window of the browser. Fill in all the mandatory fields of the form. Create a strong password. The password should be at least '9' characters with at least one special character(!@#$%^&*), one numeric, one small case and one upper case letter (i.e ADmin@357). page_content:
# Natural Death Relief - Telangana

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Telangana | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Construction Worker, Natural Death | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
The "Natural Death Relief - TBOCWWB" scheme was launched by the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, LET&F (Labour) Department Telangana. The scheme aims to provide relief amount to the nominee, dependents, or legal heirs of a deceased worker ₹1,00,000/- in case of natural death. The scheme is effective from 01.05.2018 and aims to support the families of deceased workers with financial assistance to help cover funeral expenses and provide additional relief.

## Benefits
- **The relief amount ₹1,00,000/- provided to the nominee, dependants, or legal heirs.**

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be the nominee, dependent, or legal heir of the deceased construction worker.
1. The deceased should be a registered building and other construction workers with the Telangana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The death of the deceased worker must be due to natural death.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
**Step-1:** The interested applicant visits the [official website](https://tbocwwb.telangana.gov.in/index.html) and clicks on "[Downloads](https://tbocwwb.telangana.gov.in/new_downloads.html)" at the top of menu options.
**Step-2:** Now click on the download button corresponding to the scheme name.
**Step-3**: In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step-4:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the concerned officer in the labour department. 
**Step-5:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

page_content:
# Child Adoption - Tamil Nadu **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Tamil Nadu | **Categories:** Women and Child, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Adoption, Child, Accommodation, Parents, NGO | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme "Child Adoption - Tamil Nadu" was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a family for orphaned, abandoned, destitute and neglected children. According to Central Adoption Resource Authority (CARA), “adoption is a process by which a child who is abandoned / separated from biological parents, becomes the legitimate child of a new set of parents referred to as adoptive parents, with all the rights, privileges and responsibilities that are attached to this relationship”. ## Benefits - Accommodation, food, and health care to the babies till they are given in adoption. - A family to the destitute child and a child to childless parents. > **Special concessions are given to female government employees to adopt children:** - Special adoption leave of 270 days is extended to female government servants of the state government who adopt a child below one year. The leave is eligible only from the date of legalization of adoption. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The parents must have at least two years of a stable marital relationship. 1. The single prospective adoptive parents should be between 30-55 years of age. 1. An unmarried/single male persons are not eligible to adopt a girl child. 1. The parents should have adequate financial resources to upbring the child. 1. Age Criteria: - **For a child up to 4 years old:** 1. Maximum composite age of the Prospective Adoptive Parents: 90 years. 1. For a single Prospective Adoptive Parent: Minimum age 25 years, maximum age 45 years. - **For a child above 4 years up to 8 years old:** 1. Maximum composite age of the Prospective Adoptive Parents: 100 years. 1. For a single Prospective Adoptive Parent: Minimum age 25 years, maximum age 50 years. - **For a child above 8 years up to 18 years old:** 1. Maximum composite age of the Prospective Adoptive Parents: 110 years. 1. For a single Prospective Adoptive Parent: Minimum age 25 years, maximum age 55 years.



## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the office State Adoption Resource Agency/Directorate of Social Defence/Concerned Probation Officer and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the concerned staff. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the State Adoption Resource Agency/Directorate of Social Defence/Concerned Probation Officer. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme - II" was launched by the Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to assist poor parents in getting their daughters married & to promote education status.

page_content:
# Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme - II **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Tamil Nadu | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child | **Tags:** Marriage, Financial Assistance, Daughter, Gold | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme "Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme - II" was launched by the Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide assistance of ₹50,000/- to poor parents in getting their daughters married and to promote the educational status of poor girls. The bride should have completed 18 years of age at the time of marriage.
## Benefits - Financial assistance of ₹50,000/-. - One sovereign (4gm) 22-carat gold coin for making Thirumangalyam. **NOTE:** The benefit will be given in the bride's mother or father's name. In case of the death of the parents, it will be given to the bride. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a girl. 1. The bride should be 18 years or above at the time of marriage. 1. The bride should be a degree holder from a regular college, Distance Education / Government recognized Open University Or diploma holder should have qualified from Institutions recognized by the Directorate of Technical Education, Government of Tamil Nadu. 1. The bride's family income should not exceed ₹24,000/- per annum. 1. The assistance is given to only one girl in a family. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the District Social Welfare Officers and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District Social Welfare Officers. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the District Social Welfare Officer/Extension Officer (SW)/Rural Welfare Officer (Women) to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable). **NOTE:** The application should be submitted within 40 days before the date of the marriage. In exceptional circumstances, applications can be accepted up to one day before the marriage.
