metadata.briefDescription: The "Marriage Assistance'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Karnataka, is a welfare scheme that provides financial support to registered construction workers for the marriage expenses of their own or their two (2) dependent children's marriages.

page_content:
# Marriage Assistance (K.B.O.C.W.W.B) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Karnataka | **Categories:** Women and Child, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Labour, Building Worker, Construction Worker, Marriage, Weeding | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The "Maternity Benefit/Delivery Assistance'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Karnataka, is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this Scheme, financial support shall be provided to registered construction workers who have one (1) year of membership with the Board before the marriage, to cover expenses for either their own marriage or their two (2) dependent children's marriages.
## Benefits - **Financial Assistance:** ₹60,000/- for the worker's own marriage or their two (2) dependent children's marriages. > **Note:** The family of a registered construction worker can avail this assistance only twice, However, there shall be only one claim in respect of a given marriage irrespective of the number of registered construction workers in the family.
## Eligibility Criteria > ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:*** - The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker). - The applicant should be a minimum of 18 years of age. - The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year. > **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:** - The applicant should be a registered construction worker Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Karnataka or a dependent child of the worker. - The membership with the Board should be at least one (1) year before the marriage. - The family can avail of this assistance only twice. - The son or daughter must be of legal age for marriage. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > ***Registration Process as a Building/ Construction Worker:*** **Step 1:** Visit the official [Website ](https://kbocwwb.karnataka.gov.in/login)of Karnataka Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (KBOCWWB) and click on “Register”. **Step 2:** Select “Register as New Construction Worker” then enter your mobile number as per the Aadhaar Registered and verify with the received OTP. **Step 3:** From the dashboard, click on “Registration”. **Step 4:** Fill in all the mandatory details and upload the required documents. Click on “Final Submit” to complete the registration process. > **Application Process of the Welfare Scheme:** **Step 1:** Visit the official [Website ](https://kbocwwb.karnataka.gov.in/login)of Karnataka Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (KBOCWWB) and click on “Login”. ***Step 2:*** Enter your registered mobile number and the received OTP. **Step 3:** From the dashboard, click on “Schemes” (After the user Registration is approved, the user can access the schemes page). **Step 4:** Select the concerned scheme. Fill in all the mandatory details and upload the required documents. **Step 5:** Review the details and check the declaration box. Now click on “Submit” to complete the application process. > **Renewal Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the official [Website ](https://kbocwwb.karnataka.gov.in/login)of Karnataka Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (KBOCWWB) and click on “Login”. Step 2: Enter your registered mobile number and the received OTP. **Step 3:** From the dashboard, click on “Renewal”. Fill in mandatory details and upload the required documents. **Step 4:** Review the details and click on “Submit” to complete the renewal process. > **Note:** - **Renewal:** Every construction worker must renew their registration with the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board every 3 years. If not renewed within this period, a 1-year grace period is granted. After that, the registration becomes invalid. - **Timeline:** Application for this benefit should be submitted within 6 months of the marriage. > **Helpdesk:** Karnataka Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, **Address:** Karmika Bhavan, Dairy Circle, Bannerghatta Road, Bangalore-29. **Office No:** 080-29753078 **E-mail:** labour.commissioner42@gmail.com [List of District Office.](https://karbwwb.karnataka.gov.in/7/district-office/en) [List of Taluk Offices.](https://karmikaspandana.karnataka.gov.in/page/Contact+Us/Labour+Inspector/en)

metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹20,000/- is provided to the bereaved household in the case of the natural, unnatural, or accidental death of the primary breadwinner of a family living Below the Poverty Line (BPL).

page_content:
# National Family Assistance Scheme- Chhattisgarh

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Chhattisgarh | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Family, Financial Assistance, Death Of Breadwinner, BPL | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
The scheme "National Family Assistance Scheme" is implemented by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Chhattisgarh. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to the bereaved household in the case of the natural, unnatural, or accidental death of the primary breadwinner of a family living Below the Poverty Line (BPL). This scheme is centrally sponsored.

## Benefits
- Under this scheme, the eligible family will receive a lump sum amount of ₹20,000/-.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a native of Chhattisgarh.
   1. The applicant should be a family member of the deceased person.
   1. The deceased person should have been the primary breadwinner on whom the family primarily depended for income.
   1. The family should have lost the primary breadwinner due to natural, unnatural, or accidental death.
   1. The family of the deceased primary breadwinner should be living Below Poverty Line (BPL).
   1. At the time of death, the deceased primary breadwinner should have been between 18 and 59 years old.

**Note 1:** The term "family" includes the husband, wife, minor children, unmarried daughters, and dependent parents.
**Note 2:** If there is more than one earning member in the family, assistance will be provided only upon the death of the member whose income contributes the most to the family.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
> **In Rural Areas:**

**Step 1:** The applicant, who fulfills the eligibility criteria, may visit the office of the Gram Panchayat and collect the [application form](https://sw.cg.gov.in/sites/default/files/nfbs_1.pdf), which is available free of cost.
**Step 2:** Fill out the application form and submit it to the Gram Panchayat. You will receive an acknowledgment receipt from the Gram Panchayat.
**Step 3:** The Gram Panchayat will review and recommend the application and then forward it to the District Panchayat within 07 days.
> **In Urban Areas:**

**Step 1:** Eligible applicants should visit the office of the concerned Municipal Corporation, Municipality, Nagar Panchayat, or Panchayat Raj institution to collect the application form, which is available free of cost.
**Step 2:** Fill out the [application form](https://sw.cg.gov.in/sites/default/files/nfbs_1.pdf) and submit it to the respective office (Municipality/Municipal Corporation/Nagar Panchayat). You will receive an acknowledgment receipt from the office.
**Note 1:** The concerned urban body/District Panchayat has the authority to approve or reject the applications.
**Note 2:** If a printed application form is not available, you may submit your application on plain paper.

metadata.briefDescription: "Skill Upgradation and Vocational Education Scheme: For Worker's Children'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Dept. of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides full course fees, boarding and lodging assistance to the children of registered workers who acquire Skill from technical institutions.

page_content:
# Skill Upgradation and Vocational Education Scheme: For Worker's Childrens (P.B.O.C.W.W.B) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Punjab | **Categories:** Education & Learning | **Tags:** Labour, Building Worker, Construction Worker, Skill Upgradation, Vocational Education | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The "Skill Upgradation and Vocational Education Scheme: For Worker's Childrens'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this scheme, the Board will provide full course fees, boarding and lodging assistance to the children of registered workers who acquire Skill from technical institutions such as ITIs/ Polytechnic colleges etc. ## Benefits **Financial Assistance:** - Full course fee for admission fee/ coaching fee. - Full course fee for hostel boarding/ lodging. ## Eligibility Criteria > ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:*** - The applicant should be a resident of Punjab. - The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker). - The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. - The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year. - The applicant should have a monthly income of ₹15,000/- or below. - The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law. - The applicant should not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)/ National Pension System (NPS)/ Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC). - The applicant should not be an income tax payer. > ***For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:*** - The applicant should be a child of a registered construction worker Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab. - The applicant should have acquired skill training from technical institutions such as ITIs/ Polytechnic colleges etc. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - via CSC > **Registration Process as a Building/ Construction Worker:** - For new registration of workers please approach the nearby Sewa Kendra or Registering officers/ Labour Inspector. > ***Application Process of the Welfare Scheme:*** - To apply for benefits of the concerned welfare scheme, please approach to nearby Sewa Kendra or Registering Officers/ Labour Inspector of your area. > ***Note:*** - **Registration with the Board:** A construction worker becomes a member of the board by filling out Application Form No 28 along with depositing registration fees of ₹ 25/- only (once in life) and ₹ 10/- per month as contribution fees. A worker at a time can get himself registered for a minimum period of 1 year & maximum period of 5 years. The registered worker is called 'Beneficiary' of the Board. > **Important Links:** - **Check Your Registration Application Status:** Registered workers can check their registration application status through visiting this [link ](http://bocw.punjab.gov.in/Login.aspx?Id=1)upon entering their Registration Number. - **Download Registration Card:** Registered workers can download their registration Registration Card through visiting this [link ](https://bocw.punjab.gov.in/Login.aspx?Id=1)upon entering their Registration Number. - **Check your Scheme Application Status:** Registered workers can check their scheme application status through visiting this [link ](https://bocw.punjab.gov.in/Login.aspx?Id=1)upon entering their Registration Number. - **CSC Locator:** Visit this [link ](https://www.apnacsconline.in/csc-locator/punjab/)to search nearest Common Service Center (CSC) of your area. - **List of Sewa** **Kendra:** Visit this [link ](https://punjab.gov.in/documents/10191/1112286/Final+List-V1.0.pdf/6ab437f3-f04c-427d-a2b7-dd49515f075b)to see the list of Sewa Kendra. > **Helpdesk:** > Punjab Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board > **Address:** Labour Bhawan Model Welfare Centre Phase 10, Sector 64, Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab, 160062 > **Phone :** +91 172-2540125 > **Email :** bocwhq@gmail.com > **For Bocw Portal Related Queries (Technical Support):-** > **Phone :** +91 172-2540125 > **Email :** bocwhq@gmail.com > **Office Visiting Hours :** Monday to Friday > (09:00 AM to 05:00 PM) **Mode:** Offline > ***Registration Process as a Building/ Construction Worker:*** **Step 1:** To register as a beneficiary under the BOCW Welfare Board, an applicant worker should download [Form No-28](http://bocw.punjab.gov.in/userfiles/file/Registration%20Form%2028%20updated.pdf) and attach all the mandatory documents (self attested, if required). **Step 2:** Application shall be submitted to the Labour Inspector of your area. > ***Application Process of the Welfare Scheme:*** **Step 1:** A registered worker should download [Form No-44A](https://bocw.punjab.gov.in/userfiles/file/Forms/performa44a.pdf) and attach all the mandatory documents (self attested, if required). **Step 2:** Application shall be submitted to the Labour Inspectors of your area. > ***Note:*** - # Permanent Disability Pension Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Punjab | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Labour, Building Worker, Construction Worker, Disability Pension, PwD, Person With Disability | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The "Permanent Disability Pension Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. metadata.schemeName: Mukhya Mantri Himachal Health Care Scheme-HIMCARE
metadata.briefDescription: Mukhya Mantri Himachal Health Care Scheme-HIMCARE is a health insurance scheme providing cashless treatment coverage up to Rs. 5.00 lakh per year per family in empanelled hospitals. It aims to cover families not included in the Ayushman Bharat scheme.

page_content:
# Mukhya Mantri Himachal Health Care Scheme-HIMCARE **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Himachal Pradesh | **Categories:** Health & Wellness | **Tags:** BPL, Health Insurance, Cashless Treatment | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description **Mukhya Mantri Himachal Health Care Scheme-HIMCARE** is a health insurance scheme under the Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of Himachal Pradesh to provide cashless treatment coverage up to ₹5,00,000/- per year per family provided in the empanelled hospitals. In case of more than five members, the remaining members are enrolled as a separate unit subject to the capping of five members for each such additional unit. This scheme is being implemented on a co-payment basis. Hospitals empanelled under Ayushman Bharat within the State are also empanelled for HIMCARE and are providing cashless treatment to the beneficiaries by making online entries through Transaction Management System. The claims are being reimbursed through the host-to-host payment system directly in the bank account of the concerned hospital after checking the complete claim papers submitted by these institutions through the online system.
1. For target groups covering below categories have the Zero Premium amount. - BPL (Not covered under Ayushman Bharat), - Registered Street Vendors (Not covered under Ayushman Bharat), - MNREGA worker who have worked minimum 50 days under MNREGA during previous financial year or current financial year. - Children living in Orphanages. 1. For target groups covering below categories have the premium rate ₹365/- per year. - Ekal Naaris, - Disabled >40%, - Mid-Day meal workers, - Daily Wage Workers (Govt., Autonomous Bodies, Societies, Boards & Corporations etc. under the control of State Government), - Part Time Workers (Govt., Autonomous Bodies, Societies, Boards & Corporations etc. under the control of State Government) - Contractual Employees (Govt., Autonomous Bodies, Societies, Boards & Corporations etc. under the control of State Government) - Outsource Employees. 1. Beneficiaries not covered under category-I and category-II or who are not Govt. servants/pensioners or their dependent family members, having the premium amount ₹1,000/- per year. ## Benefits 1. Cashless Treatment: The scheme provides cashless treatment coverage, allowing beneficiaries to receive medical services without upfront payment at empanelled hospitals. 1. Comprehensive Coverage: HIMCARE offers coverage up to ₹5,00,000/- per year per family, ensuring that families have access to quality healthcare services without financial burden. 1. Inclusion of Previously Uncovered Families: The scheme targets families who were not covered under the Ayushman Bharat scheme, extending health insurance benefits to a broader population. 1. Categorization for Differential Premium Rates: Beneficiaries are categorized into different groups based on their occupation or socioeconomic status, with corresponding premium rates to make healthcare more affordable for all eligible individuals. 1. Wide Range of Eligible Beneficiaries: The scheme covers various groups such as BPL families, registered street vendors, MNREGA workers, senior citizens above 70 years, children living in orphanages, disabled individuals, Anganwari workers, ASHA workers, and more. 1. Easy Enrollment Process: Enrollment can be done online through the official website or at Lok Mitra Kendra/Common Service Centers, making it convenient for beneficiaries to apply and upload necessary documents. 1. Empanelled Hospital Network: Beneficiaries can receive cashless treatment in empanelled hospitals within Himachal Pradesh, including prestigious institutions like PGIMER Chandigarh and GMCH Sector 32 Chandigarh, ensuring access to quality healthcare facilities. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh. 1. Families not covered under the Ayushman Bharat Yojana (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana) are eligible to apply for the HIMCARE scheme. 1. Applicant should be HIMCARE card holder. 1. The scheme is available to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families, Above Poverty Line (APL) families, Senior citizens and daily wage earners, widows, single women, and persons with disabilities. ## Exclusions 1. Non-Coverage of Government Servants and Pensioners: The scheme does not provide coverage for government servants, pensioners, or their dependent family members. They are not eligible to enroll in HIMCARE. 1. Non-Coverage of Beneficiaries Already Covered Under Ayushman Bharat: Families that have already been selected and covered under the Ayushman Bharat scheme, based on SECC 2011 and RSBY, are not eligible for coverage under HIMCARE. The scheme targets those left out of Ayushman Bharat. 1. Non-Coverage of Beneficiaries Who Do Not Fall under Eligible Categories: Individuals who do not fall under the eligible categories defined by the scheme, such as those not belonging to BPL families, registered street vendors, MNREGA workers, senior citizens above 70 years, or other specified groups, are excluded from the coverage provided by HIMCARE. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online - via CSC **Official Portal/Link:** www.hpsbys.in 1. Locate the nearest Lok Mitra Kendra (LMK) or [**Common Service Center**](https://ddtg.hp.gov.in/csc/) (CSC). 1. Visit the LMK or CSC and inform them about your intention to apply for HIMCARE. 1. Provide the necessary information and documents to the staff at the center. 1. VLEs will assist you in filling out the application form and uploading the required documents online. 1. If you are applying through Lok Mitra Kendra/Common Service Centers, you may be required to pay an enrollment fee of ₹50/- per family unit of up to five members. 1. Once the application is submitted, it will be processed for verification. The concerned authorities will review the application and documents provided for authenticity and eligibility. 1. If the application is approved, an E-card will be issued to the eligible family. 1. The E-card will serve as proof of enrollment and will be used for availing cashless treatment under the scheme. **Mode:** Online 1. Apply for HIMCARE card on official [**website**](https://app.hpsbys.in/website/rationcardregistration.aspx). 1. Enter the ration card details and upload the Ration card scanned copy in the application. 1. Fill in the required details accurately, including personal information, contact details, and family details. 1. Once applicant has confirmed the Application form ,he/she won't be able to edit the application and if you are eligible for Premium Amount , then applicant will have to make payment within 30 days. 1. Upload the scanned copies of the required documents as per the category you fall under. 1. Submit the application form along with the uploaded documents.

metadata.schemeName: Mahatama Gandhi Bunkar Bima Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The Scheme “Mahatama Gandhi Bunkar Bima Yojana” was launched during 2005-06 by Handlooms, Textiles & Handicrafts Dept. of Govt. of Odisha to provide enhanced insurance cover to the handloom weavers in the case of natural as well as accidental death and in cases of total or partial disability.

page_content:
# Mahatama Gandhi Bunkar Bima Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Odisha | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Weavers, Handloom, Insurance, Death, Disability | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The Government of India introduced the “Bunkar Bima Yojana” in December 2003 which was a combination of “Janshree Bima Yojana” and the Add-on Group Insurance Scheme being implemented in collaboration with the Life Insurance Corporation of India. Since, 2005-06 this scheme has been implemented by the Handlooms, Textiles & Handicrafts Department of the Government of Odisha with the revised title “**Mahatma Gandhi Bunkar Yojana**”. The basic objective is: 1. to provide enhanced insurance coverage to the handloom weavers in the case of natural as well as accidental death and in cases of total or partial disability. 1. The concerned handloom authority in the state will finalize the insurance coverage, as the Life Insurance Corporation of India administers the scheme. The State Governments and the State Handloom Corporations/Apex/Primary Handloom Weavers Cooperative Societies/Unions/ Associations shall be actively associated in the implementation of the scheme by way of sensitizing the handloom weavers to join the scheme through advertisements through print and other media. **Premium Insurance Coverage:** The annual total premium of ₹ 330/- per member will be shared as under: 1. GOI contribution: ₹ 150/- 1. Weavers’ contribution: ₹ 80/- 1. LIC’s contribution: ₹ 100/- **Operational Modalities:** 1. The scheme is renewable every year and continuation of coverage is ensured only on payment of premium on the due date of renewal every year. 1. The premium amount shall be paid by the beneficiary only one-time for the whole year to the Life Insurance Corporation of India. 1. The premium, once paid, shall not be refunded. 1. Maximum number of renewals shall be effected each year. 1. The insurance coverage is ordinarily effective only after receipt of the entire amount of premium i.e. both the Government’s as well as beneficiary’s share. 1. In an unlikely situation where the Government’s share of the premium is not ready, the LIC shall accept the share of the beneficiary and affect the coverage accordingly. 1. The office of the State Director-in-charge of Handlooms & Textiles and its subordinate offices in the field shall be the Nodal agencies for implementation of the scheme. 1. Nodal agency will act for and on behalf of the insured members in all matters relating to the insurance cover. 1. LIC will get in touch with State Directors In-charge of Handlooms for identification of beneficiaries, furnishing forms, instructions etc. for maximum coverage of weavers under the scheme. **Release of Funds:** 1. For release of funds, LIC and the Authority In-charge of Handlooms in the State shall identify the weavers to be covered under the MGBBY. 1. The Central Government share of the premium will be released directly to the LIC. **Monitoring And Evaluation:** 1. Monitoring and evaluation of the progress of the Scheme will be done by the State Governments, which will submit quarterly physical and financial progress reports to the Development Commissioner for Handlooms. ## Benefits This scheme provide insurance coverage to handloom weavers as under: 1. In the event of the natural death of the weaver, a Sum Assured of ₹ 60,000 will become payable to the nominee. 1. In the cause of Accidental Death or Total Permanent Disability, a Sum Assured of ₹ 1,50,000/- will become payable to the nominee. 1. In case of Partial Disability, a Sum Assured of ₹ 75,000/- will become payable. 1. The scheme also provides scholarship to the children of parents who are covered under it under “Shiksha Sahyog Yojana”. 1. A scholarship of ₹ 600/- per six month per child is to be paid to students studying is standard IX to XII for a maximum period of four years or till they complete XII standard, whichever event occurs earlier. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The weaver should be earning at least 50% of his income from handloom weaving. 1. All weavers, whether male or female, between the age group of 18 and 59 years are eligible to be covered under the scheme, including minorities, women weavers, and weavers belonging to NER. 1. The weavers belonging to the State Handloom Development Corporations/Apex/ Primary Handloom Weavers’ Cooperative Societies will be covered under the Scheme. 1. Weavers outside co-operative can also be covered under the scheme on a certificate from the State Directorate of Handlooms that they are fulfilling the eligibility conditions. 1. The children of weavers who are covered under “Shiksha Sahyog Yojana” will also be eligible for scholarship and the benefit of scholarship is restricted to two children of the member covered. Both the children irrespective of gender based discrimination will be covered for scholarship. **NOTE:** 1. It will be the responsibility of the State Director in charge of Handlooms to verify the eligibility of the weavers who are proposed to be covered under the scheme. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Official Portal/Link:** https://handloom.odisha.gov.in **Step 01:** The application form shall be made available to the nodal agencies by the LIC. No medical certificate is required and self-certification would suffice the purpose. **Step 02:** A prospective beneficiary shall be required to fill up an application-cum nomination form and submit the same to the nodal agency along with his/her share of the premium. **Step 03:** On receipt of the above, the nodal agency shall scrutinize the application and if found eligible, shall accept the premium amount and forward the lists of such beneficiaries along with the premium amount to the LIC. **Step 04:** On receipt of the premium amount along with the list of beneficiaries from the nodal agencies, the LIC shall issue Cards/ Certificates to all the weavers covered under the scheme and it should be designed in such a way that the month/date of renewal should also be mentioned. The cards should be in vernacular language. This would enable weavers to claim their dues from LIC. **Step 05:** In the case of death or disability, the nominee/ beneficiary concerned shall submit his/her claim to the LIC through the nodal agency with required documentary evidence such as death certificate/post-mortem examination report/medical certificate/discharge certificate, and other related documents, as applicable. The nodal agency shall forward the claim, to the LIC within 15 days of receipt of the claim. LIC shall settle the claim within one month from the date of receipt of the claim and pay the amount to the beneficiary/ nominee directly by A/c Payee Cheque (under intimation to the Nodal Agency) or through the nodal agency. **Step 06:** In the event of non-payment of the insurance premium for the next year by the beneficiary, the insurance cover shall automatically cease. The beneficiary will however be free to rejoin the scheme in any subsequent year on payment of the required premium. **Step 07:** In case a handloom weaver changes his employment during the period of insurance from one Society or Corporation to another, he/she, as the beneficiary of the scheme, shall furnish intimation to the nodal agency. **Procedure for Scholarship:** **Step 01:** The member of "Mahatma Gandhi Bunkar Bima Yojana" whose child is eligible for a scholarship shall fill up an application form (available with the nodal agency) and submit it to the nodal agency. **Step 02:** The applications duly filled up and certified will be sent along with the list of beneficiary students by the nodal agency to the concerned LIC P & GS Unit for disbursement of scholarship under “Shiksha Sahayog Yojana”. The scholarship will be disbursed to the beneficiary students through the concerned nodal agency. **Step 03:** LIC will send the Account Payee Cheque in the name of the nodal agency along with a list of beneficiary students who will pass on the scholarship to eligible students. The nodal agency has to maintain records and submit certificates of utilization periodically to LIC, P&GS Unit. **Step 04:** No premium is charged either to the parent of the scholarship holder or to the nodal agency. It is an additional benefit given to the children of the parents covered under Mahatma Gandhi Bunkar Bima Yojana. If the premium under Mahatma Gandhi Bunkar Bima Yojana is not paid on the annual renewal date in such case, the child shall not be eligible for scholarship. **Step 05:** The beneficiaries have to be selected for “Shiksha Sahayog Yojana” out of the members covered under Mahatma Gandhi Bunkar Bima Yojana. The targeted beneficiary students of a State may be divided among the members covered under the "Mahatma Gandhi Bunkar Bima Yojana" in proportion to the number of lives covered within that State. The final selection shall be based on the criteria of the poorest of the poor, as the number of scholarships is limited and without any gender discrimination.

metadata.briefDescription: The Delhi government’s Mukhyamantri Tirth Yatra Scheme, under which people over the age of 60 are taken for a pilgrimage free of cost, is expected to restart in a month’s time. The scheme, which started in 2018, has been suspended for a year and a half because of Covid. Between 2018 and 2020.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Tirth Yatra Yojana - Delhi **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Delhi | **Categories:** Travel & Tourism | **Tags:** Tirth Yatra, Delhi, Travel, Tourism | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description **Details** Any resident of the national capital aged 60 or above can avail of the scheme after acquiring a certificate from a local MLA, stating that he lives in the legislator’s constituency. One attendant aged 21 or more can accompany each traveller. The government bears the expenses for the attendant too. The pilgrimage scheme had been halted due to COVID-19, but now it will be resuming. The “Mukhyamantri Tirth Yatra Yojna” was approved by the Delhi Cabinet on January 9, 2018. All expenses related to travel, food and accommodation are borne by the Delhi government. A total of 1,100 residents per assembly constituency can avail this facility in a year subject to the cap of total 77,000 residents per year. Since its formal launch, 38,000 beneficiaries (senior citizens) have travelled under the scheme, the statement added. Delhi Govt Tirth Yatra Online Registration form can be filled through e-district portal and anyone must not submit any manual application. For Delhi Govt Tirth Yatra Yojna, counters of SDM office, office of Tirth Vikas Samiti and MLA offices would serve as facilitation counters. Interested candidates can now apply online for Mukhyamantri Tirth Yatra Yojana 2023 at the official website for 1st trip to pilgrims.
## Eligibility Criteria **Eligibility** 1. The applicant/spouse must be a resident of the territorial jurisdiction of the NCT of Delhi. 1. The applicant must have completed 60 years of age (As of 1st January of the year in which the Application for availing the Yojana is submitted). 1. The applicant/spouse must NOT be employed with Central/State Government or Local/Autonomous bodies. 1. The applicant/spouse must NOT have ever availed of the scheme in the past. 1. The age of the attendant must be more than 21 years(In case opting for attendant). ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in

page_content:
# National Family Benefit Scheme - Uttar Pradesh **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttar Pradesh | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** National Family Benefit, Uttar Pradesh, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description **Detailed** The NFBS also known as Rashtriya Parivarik Labh Yojana was started by the UP government on in January 2016. Under this scheme, the families who have lost their lead earners will get a lump sum amount of money as compensation. To claim the compensation one must have applied to register under the scheme. The entire application process is available only online. There is no provision of offline application for the scheme.****
**Key Features** 1. The NFBS scheme is for below-poverty-line families. If the lead earner of the family has lost his/ her life, the next head of the family will get financial assistance from the state government of Uttar Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be aged between 18 years to 60 years. If the applicant is below 18 i.e. minor or above 60 that is old, then the applicant might not get the compensation amount. 1. The amount of the compensation is fixed at Rs. 30, 000/- which has increased from the earlier amount of compensation which is Rs. 20, 000/-. To apply for the scheme one must use the online process. The scheme does not have any offline mode of registration. 1. To avail the scheme, the yearly income of the family should not be more than Rs. 56, 450/- in urban areas and Rs. 46, 080/- in rural areas. The amount of compensation will be provided to the families only after the death of the lead earner or the only earning member of the family. ## Eligibility Criteria **Eligibility** 1. To apply for the scheme one must be living under the poverty line. 1. The applicant should not be aged less than 18 years or above 60 years. 1. The family income of the applicant should not be more than Rs. 56, 450/- if the family is from the urban area and Rs. 46, 080/- if the family is from the rural area. 1. Support will be provided to the family after the death of the only earner of the family. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** http:/nfbs.upsdc.gov.

metadata.schemeName: Panchayat Kalyan Kosh
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the families or dependents of Gram Pradhans, Kshetra Panchayat Pramukhs, Zila Panchayat Presidents, and all members of the three-tier Panchayat elected as representatives of the people, in the event of their death while in office.

page_content:
# Panchayat Kalyan Kosh

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttar Pradesh | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Panchayat Representative, Death, Financial Assiatance, Panchayat | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
The "Panchayat Kalyan Kosh" scheme was introduced by the Panchayati Raj Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the families or dependents of Gram Pradhans, Kshetra Panchayat Pramukhs, Zila Panchayat Presidents, and all members of the three-tier Panchayat elected as representatives of the people, in the event of their death while in office (excluding cases of suicide or involvement in criminal acts).

## Benefits
In the event of the death of a Panchayat Representative while in office, the following amounts will be provided to their families or dependents:

  - Pradhan of Gram Panchayat, Pramukh of Kshetra Panchayat, and Zila Panchayat President: ₹10,00,000/-
  - Member of Zila Panchayat: ₹5,00,000/-
  - Member of Kshetra Panchayat: ₹3,00,000/-
  - Member of Gram Panchayat: ₹2,00,000/-

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a family member or dependent of a deceased Panchayat Representative.
   1. Assistance is provided in the event of the death of a Panchayat Representative (Pradhan of Gram Panchayat, Pramukh of Kshetra Panchayat, Zila Panchayat President, or members of Zila Panchayat, Kshetra Panchayat, and Gram Panchayat) while serving in office.
   1. Assistance will not be provided in cases of suicide or involvement in criminal acts by the Panchayat Representative.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
**Official Portal/Link:** prdfinance.up.gov.in
**Step 1:** Family members or dependents of the deceased Panchayat representatives should apply directly through the [official website](https://prdfinance.up.gov.in/self_registration_kalyankosh_ben) of the Panchayati Raj Department, Uttar Pradesh.
**Step 2:** During registration on the Panchayat Kalyan Kosh portal, the dependent must fill out the application form in the prescribed format ([Appendix-1](https://prdfinance.up.gov.in/dist_pdf_kalyankosh/pk_niyamavli.pdf)) and upload the necessary documents.
**Step 3:** The District Panchayat Raj Officer will download the application submitted by the dependent from their login ID and obtain approval from the District Magistrate after a thorough review.
**Step 4:** Once approved by the District Magistrate, the District Panchayat Raj Officer will forward the application form to the Director of Panchayati Raj from their login ID for fund transfer.

metadata.schemeName: Maintenance Of Pregnant Desi Indigenous Cows Ration For BPL Families
metadata.briefDescription: The Department of Animal Husbandry, Government of Himachal Pradesh had introduced a scheme with the help of which balanced ration at the rate 3kg/day/cow or buffalo for maximum of two animals for three months during the last trimester of pregnancy at 50% subsidy.

page_content:
# Maintenance Of Pregnant Desi Indigenous Cows Ration For BPL Families

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Himachal Pradesh | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Pregnant Desi Indigenous Cows, Balanced Ration, BPL Families | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
The Department of Animal Husbandry, Government of Himachal Pradesh had introduced a scheme named "**Maintenance of Pregnant Desi/Indigenous Cows Ration for BPL families of all Categories of livestock farmers**" with the help of which a balanced ration of 3 kg per day for up to two cows or buffaloes for three months during the last trimester of pregnancy to BPL families shall be provided. The government and beneficiary share the cost of the ration on a 50:50 basis, and the cost of feed depends on approved rates.  This scheme may serve about 6.5 Lakh cows and buffaloes become pregnant every year in the state. This scheme may help BPL families and all categories of livestock farmers in the state to maintain a balanced and nutritious diet for pregnant Desi/Indigenous cows in the State. Maintaining a proper and balanced ration for pregnant Desi/Indigenous cows is crucial for the health of cows and the growth and development of calves. Providing a nutritious and balanced diet can also help reduce the risk of health complications during and after pregnancy. 
**Objectives:**

   1. Increase in milk production thereby providing more economic gains to the farmers.
   1. To reduce the inter-calving period which will ultimately result in more calves and higher milk production.
   1. To improve the health of pregnant cows so that their full milk production potential can be realized after parturition.
   1. To ensure the birth of healthy calves free of diseases and malnutrition so that they grow to become higher-producing animals.
   1. As the incentive is being given to Desi/Indigenous cows the farmers can be motivated to rear such animals.

## Benefits
**Benefits:**
The scheme for maintenance of pregnant Desi/Indigenous cows ration for BPL families of all categories of livestock farmers in Himachal Pradesh can have a significant impact on the health and livelihoods of farmers, as well as the overall development of the region. This scheme in _Himachal Pradesh can have several benefits,_****** such as:

   1. **Improved cow health:** A balanced and nutritious diet for pregnant cows can improve their health and reduce the risk of health complications during and after pregnancy.   1. **Improved calf growth and development:** A well-fed pregnant cow can provide better nutrition to the growing calf, leading to better growth and development.   1. **Increased milk production:** Adequate nutrition can improve the milk production of the cow, leading to increased income for the farmer.   1. **Better breed quality:** The scheme can also include provisions for breed improvement, leading to better quality Desi/Indigenous cows that can provide better milk yield and meat quality.   1. **Employment generation:** The scheme can create employment opportunities in the feed and fodder development sector, leading to better livelihoods for farmers.   1. **Reduced poverty:** The scheme can help BPL families and all categories of livestock farmers to improve their income and reduce poverty.   1. **Improved food security:** Improved milk production and better quality meat can contribute to better food security in the region.
**Expected Outcome:**

   1. After feeding a balanced ration during the last trimester of pregnancy, milk production increased by 2 ltr/day.
   1. With the assumption that during lactation of 300 days, the farmer will market this milk at @ 30/ltr, his income will increase by Rs.18000/year (Approx.).

## Eligibility Criteria
1. Livestock owners belonging to BPL families of all categories rearing Desi/Indigenous/crossbred cows.
   1. The subsidy will be provided to each BPL family of all categories maximum upto two Desi/Indigenous cows and their crosses.

## Exclusions
1. **Non-eligibility of non-BPL families:** The scheme may only be applicable to BPL families, and non-BPL families may not be eligible for the benefits of the scheme.   1. **Non-compliance with guidelines:** Farmers who do not comply with the guidelines and regulations of the scheme may not be eligible for benefits.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
**Official Portal/Link:** https://hpahdbt.hp.gov.in/Home/cow_ration_under_general_bpl
1. Visit the official [**website**](https://hpahdbt.hp.gov.in/Home/cow_ration_under_general_bpl) of the department of the Animal Husbandry, Government of Himachal Pradesh, which implements the specific scheme.1. The applicant may read the complete guidelines of the scheme for "**maintenance of pregnant Desi/Indigenous cows ration for BPL families of all categories of livestock farmers**" and if found eligible, may scroll down and click on the checkbox "**I agree with the terms & Conditions**" and click "**Proceed**" button.1. Once Proceed, online [**application form**](https://hpahdbt.hp.gov.in/Home/RegistrationCowsRationunderGeneralBPL) open.1. Fill the application form, upload the documents such as proof of BPL status, land documents, and bank account details and click Submit. 
1. Submit the application form and documents to the concerned department or authority.
1. Check the status & Follow up with the concerned department to track the status of the application.

**Note:**

1. It is important for farmers to keep a copy of the application form and documents submitted for future reference. Additionally, farmers should ensure that they comply with the guidelines and regulations of the scheme to ensure that they are eligible for the benefits of the scheme.
1. During the application form, the applicant can enter maximum 2 in the section "**Number of Cow**" and shall be required to enter the "**Ear Tag Number**" of each cow.

metadata.briefDescription: This scheme was introduced in 2018 by the Department of Social Security & Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Government of Odisha. The scheme's goal is to help people with disabilities live normal and dignified lives and to encourage others to marry people with disabilities.

page_content:
# Award Of Incentive For Marriage Between Persons With Benchmark Disabilities & Other Person

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Odisha | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Persons With Disability, Marriage | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
"**Award of Incentive for Marriage between Persons with Benchmark Disabilities & Other Person"** is a scheme introduced in 2018 by the Department of Social Security & Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Government of Odisha. The scheme's goal is to help people with disabilities live normal and dignified lives and to encourage others to marry people with disabilities. The government introduced this scheme to facilitate and fulfill mandates under Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and the National Trust for the Welfare of Persons with Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation and Multiple Disabilities Act, 1999.

## Benefits
1. The amount of incentive is fixed at ₹ 2,50,000/- and shall be disbursed to the couple through IFMS.
   1. The amount of incentive shall be locked in for 3 years. 
   1. Withdrawal is allowed in three phases with the withdrawal of 10% of the funds after 6 months, the next 10% after one year, and the balance of 80% of the funds after the successful completion of 3 years of the marriage. 
   1. The couple can withdraw under the joint signature.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The bridegroom and the bride must have completed 21 years and 18 years of age respectively at the time of the marriage. 
   1. Both of the spouses should be residents of Odisha State.
   1. The cash incentive award can be given to either of the spouses with a benchmark disability if another person marries a Person with a Benchmark Disability (Disability Percentage of 40% or above). 
   1. The said marriage should be dowry free.
   1. Neither of the spouses should have availed of the incentive award under this scheme earlier.
   1. The beneficiary qualifying for the incentive of both the Departments i.e. ST & SC Development, Minorities, and Backward Class Welfare Department, and the Department of SSEPD will be left to opt to avail the benefit under one Department to avoid duplication.

## Exclusions
1. Applicants who fraudulently avail or attempt even after having availed once benefits of the scheme shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to two years or with fine which may extend to Rs. 1,00,000/- or with both as prescribed under section 91 of Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016. In such cases, the Collector & District Magistrate, who is the sanctioning authority, shall initiate action accordingly, besides recovery of disbursed amount with 12% interest.
   1. In the event of divorce or dissolution of the marriage taking place within the time period 3 (three) years to 5 (five) years calculated from the date of receipt of the first installment of the incentive (i.e. 10% of the incentive), the spouse (either husband or wife) without disability, shall be liable to refund 50% of total amount as arrear of land revenue within one year of the occurrence failing which the principal amount with annual interest of 6.5% will be charged from him/her.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
**Official Portal/Link:** https://ssepd.gov.in:8443/swp/applyMarriageIncentiveScheme.htm
1. Visit the official website of the department i.e [**https://ssepd.odisha.gov.in/**](https://ssepd.odisha.gov.in/)   1. In the "Beneficiary Services" section, click "Marriage Incentive".   1. You will be redirected to the [**Online Application Form**](https://ssepd.gov.in:8443/swp/applyMarriageIncentiveScheme.htm).   1. Fill in the application form including UDID Certificate Number, upload the signature of your spouse and yourself, and click "Submit". 
   1. The applicants may take printout of the system-generated application on complete documentation for his/her record.

# National Family Benefit Scheme (Ladakh) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Ladakh | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** BPL, Death Of Breadwinner, Family, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The "National Family Benefit Scheme", implemented under the National Social Assistance Programme by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Ladakh, is a centrally sponsored scheme jointly funded by the Central and State Governments, which provides a one-time lump sum assistance of ₹20,000/- to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families on the death of the primary bread-earner aged 18–59 years, with the objective of ensuring social security, and the assistance is paid to the widow or unmarried daughter of the deceased.
## Benefits Provides a one-time lump sum cash assistance of ₹20,000/- to Below Poverty Line families on the death of the primary bread-earner.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a native of Ladakh. 1. The applicant should be a family living below the poverty line (BPL). 1. The applicant should have lost the primary breadwinner of the family. 1. The applicant should be the widow or unmarried daughter of the deceased. 1. The deceased bread-earner should have been between 18 and 59 years of age at the time of death.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step1: The applicant collects and fills the form from DSWO/TSWO with the required documents. Step2: The completed form is submitted to the TSWO, who forwards it to the Block Level Sanctioning Committee. Step3: The DSWO gets approval from the District Level Sanctioning Committee, and the payment is released to the beneficiary.

metadata.schemeName: Karma Sathi Prakalpa
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to help young entrepreneurs in the state establish new manufacturing enterprises and small businesses, including those offering services and trading. The scheme offers soft loans and subsidies for new income-generating projects.

page_content:
# Karma Sathi Prakalpa **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** West Bengal | **Categories:** Skills & Employment | **Tags:** Employment, Entrepreneur, West Bengal, Loan, Subsidy | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme "Karma Sathi Prakalpa" by the Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles, Government of West Bengal, aims to help young entrepreneurs in the state set up new manufacturing enterprises and small businesses, including services and trading. The scheme provides soft loans and subsidies for new income-generating projects. This assistance is intended for young and enthusiastic entrepreneurs in both rural and urban areas of the state, helping them become self-reliant and create gainful self-employment opportunities. The scheme is implemented by the State-owned Cooperative Bank, which provides the loans on soft terms. It is monitored at the district level by an Additional District Magistrate and at the state level by the Director of MSME. > **Objectives:** 1. To facilitate young entrepreneurs of the state in setting up new manufacturing enterprises and small businesses, including services and trading. 1. To create gainful self-employment opportunities in both rural and urban areas of the state.
## Benefits The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a soft loan and subsidies for new income-generating projects in manufacturing, service, and trading/business sectors. The total financial assistance available is up to ₹2,00,000/-. 1. **Project Subsidy:** A subsidy of 15% of the project cost is provided, with a maximum ceiling of ₹25,000/-.1. **Interest Subsidy:** This subsidy is paid to the entrepreneur on the annual interest they pay to the Cooperative Bank. - 50% of the interest is subsidised for timely repayment for a maximum period of 3 years. - 40% of the interest is subsidised for all other cases for a maximum period of 3 years.
> **Mode of Disbursement:** > **Bank Loan:** The State-owned Cooperative Bank disburses 95% or 90% of the loan amount as Cash Credit in two installments. - The first installment, which is 50% of the loan amount, is disbursed and linked to the applicant's Cash Credit Account. - The second installment is disbursed after the bank receives a certificate confirming the utilization of the first installment. > **Subsidies:** - **Project Subsidy:** Cooperative Banks submit claims for the project subsidy to the District MSME Facilitation Centre (MFC) on a quarterly basis. The MFC then sends a requisition to the Department, which releases the total subsidy amount to the West Bengal State Cooperative Bank Limited.- **Interest Subsidy:** The Chief Executive Officer of the West Bengal State Cooperative Bank submits a requisition for the interest subsidy on a half-yearly basis. The subsidy is then credited to the sanctioned and disbursed loan's Cash Credit account.- Disbursement for both subsidies happens through the portal, which is linked to the Integrated Financial Management System (IFMS). > **Validity:** - The interest subsidy is provided for a maximum period of three years. If the bank agrees to a longer loan repayment period (e.g., 5 years), the government's interest subsidy will still be limited to 50% of the interest paid in the first three years.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. Any intending or, prospective entrepreneur fulfilling the conditions below can apply. Only one member of a family shall be eligible to apply under this Scheme, where "family" means parents and spouse. - **Age:** Any intending or prospective entrepreneur in the age group 18 - 50 years(from the date of notification, September 2020).- **Educational Qualification:** Minimum Class VIII passed. Preference will be given to intending entrepreneurs who are registered with the Employment Bank.- Any new income-generating activity taken up for self-employment in manufacturing, services, and trading will be eligible for assistance under the scheme.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Manual Application Form :** The intended entrepreneur can get the prescribed Application Form [(Annexure-I)](https://wbmsme.gov.in/sites/all/themes/anonymous/pdf/FORMBengla.jpg) for free from several offices. Or, the Application Form may be obtained free of cost at the following offices: 1. Office of the Block Development Officer (BDO) in case the applicant resides in the rural area. 1. Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) in case the applicant resides in Municipal/Notified areas outside the areas of Kolkata Municipal Corporation. 1. Kolkata Municipal Corporation (KMC) in case the applicant resides in the KMC area. 1. MSME Facilitation Centre (MFC) of District Industries Centre (DIC) in the district.
**Physical Application Form under the scheme shall be submitted to:-** The Block Development Officer in case the intended entrepreneur resides in the rural areas, the Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer in case the intended entrepreneur resides in Municipal/Notified areas outside the areas of Kolkata Municipal Corporation and the Kolkata Municipal Corporation in case the intending entrepreneur resides in KMC area. Application Forms may also be submitted directly at the MSME Facilitation Centre (MFC) of the District Industries Centre (DIC) in the district.

page_content:
# Electrification of Wells and Electric Pumpset Distribution Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Well Electrification, Farmer, Agriculture, Electric Pumpset Subsidy, Tribal Farmers, Irrigation Support | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The "Electrification of Wells and Electric Pumpset Distribution Scheme" by the Tribal Area Development Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to support Scheduled Tribe farmers by providing subsidies for electric connections and pumpsets to the eligible tribal families. This initiative helps farmers secure reliable irrigation sources for their private agricultural lands.
## Benefits > **Financial Assistance For Electrification And Pumpset (E.P.S) (Per Unit Cost ₹35,000/-)** **Component****Assistance Amount****Conditions**Electricity Connection₹10,000/- or actual expenditure, whichever is lessDemand Note from Electricity Distribution Company Limited is requiredElectric Pumpset (EPS)₹15,000/- or actual expenditure, whichever is lessProvided only if the well is electrified or Demand Note is submittedPipeline Suction, Delivery / Sprinkler / Drip System₹10,000/- or actual expenditure, whichever is lessFor the irrigation distribution system
> **Diesel Pump Set (D.P.S) (Per Unit Cost ₹35,000):** **Component****Assistance Amount****Conditions**Diesel Pump With Engine₹25,000/-For irrigation, where an electric connection is not feasiblePipeline Support, Delivery Pipes, Sprinkler / Drip System₹10,000/-For water distribution

## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a farmer - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. - The applicant must own agricultural land in his or her own name. - The applicant must have been cultivating the land for at least 3 years. - The applicant must have a functional water source for irrigation; such as well, river, stream, or pond. - The applicant seeking electricity connection must submit Demand Note issued by concerned Electricity Distribution Company Limited. - The applicant applying for electric pump set must have electrified well; or must have submitted Demand Note for electrification.

## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - For the irrigation facilities to be provided under the scheme as above, farmers can apply in the prescribed form (those farmers who want an electricity connection on their wells can apply in the concerned Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. office and get the demand note along with the demand for other irrigation facilities) in the following offices:- 1. In the Non-Scheduled Area - District Council/ Panchayat Samiti/ Gram Panchayat.

metadata.schemeName: Sahariya Health Worker
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to raise health awareness and provide healthcare supervision for the Sahariya primitive tribe through dedicated community workers.

page_content:
# Sahariya Health Worker **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Sahariya Tribe, Health Awareness, De-addiction Awareness | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description Launched in 2013, the centrally sponsored scheme "Sahariya Health Worker" by the Tribal Area Development Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to create health consciousness among the Sahariya primitive tribe through providing dedicated health workers to support community medical programs and wellness initiatives for the Sahariya families. It focuses on improving health outcomes by facilitating services like vaccinations, family welfare, and malnutrition prevention.
## Benefits - **Health Awareness:** Workers create awareness regarding health and encourage the community to seek proper medical care. - **Tuberculosis Control:** Workers assist in the implementation of the Tuberculosis Control Program. - **Vaccination Support:** Workers help coordinate and ensure the community participates in various vaccination drives. - **Family Welfare:** Support is provided for family welfare programs to improve community reproductive health. - **Pulse Polio:** Participation and assistance in the Pulse Polio immunization campaigns. - **De-addiction Campaigns:** Awareness and support for drug de-addiction initiatives within the tribe. - **Malnutrition Prevention:** Workers collaborate with Auxiliary Nurse Midwives (ANM) to run malnutrition prevention programs.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must be a woman. - The applicant must belong to the Sahariya family.


## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant should obtain the application form from the Swachh Project Office, Shahbad, District Baran. **Step 2:** The applicant should fill in all required details in the application form. **Step 3:** The applicant should attach the required documents. **Step 4:** The applicant should submit the completed application form to the Swachh Project Office, Shahbad, District Baran.

metadata.schemeName: National Food Security Scheme-Rajasthan
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide subsidised wheat to eligible families in Rajasthan, including Antyodaya, Below Poverty Line (BPL), State BPL, and Priority Household (PHH) beneficiaries, to strengthen food security and ensure access to essential food grains.

page_content:
# National Food Security Scheme-Rajasthan **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Food Security, Wheat Distribution, Subsidised Food Grain, BPL | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme "National Food Security Scheme-Rajasthan" is a centrally sponsored scheme implemented by the Food and Civil Supplies Department, Government of Rajasthan, with 50% funding from the Central Government and 50% funding from the State Government. The scheme has been implemented in Rajasthan since 2 October 2013 under the National Food Security Act, 2013. Antyodaya families receive 35 kg of wheat per family per month, while other eligible beneficiaries receive 5 kg of wheat per unit per month. Wheat is supplied at ₹1 per kg to Antyodaya, BPL, and State BPL ration card holders, and at ₹2 per kg to other eligible PHH families. The scheme is intended to improve food security for eligible households across the state.
## Benefits > **Food Grain Entitlement:** - Antyodaya families: 35 kg of wheat per family per month. - Other eligible beneficiaries: 5 kg of wheat per unit per month. > **Subsidised Wheat Rate:** - Antyodaya, BPL, and State BPL ration card holders: Wheat at ₹1 per kg. - Priority Household (PHH) families: Wheat at ₹2 per kg.
## Eligibility Criteria > **The following categories of citizens are eligible for the National Food Security Scheme, 2013 (NFSA):** 1. Below the Poverty Line (BPL) families 1. Workers
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The applicant should submit a request for inclusion in the food security beneficiary list through the prescribed appeal process notified by the State Government. **Step 2:** The applicant should provide the required documents along with the application. **Step 3:** The concerned authority verifies the eligibility and ration card details. **Step 4:** After approval, the beneficiary can receive wheat through the authorised public distribution system.

metadata.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram Yojana (PMAAGY)
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to develop selected villages with significant Scheduled Tribe population into model villages by providing basic infrastructure and improving socio-economic conditions.

page_content:
# Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram Yojana (PMAAGY) **Ministry:** Ministry Of Tribal Affairs | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Tribal Development, Adarsh Village, Infrastructure Gap Filling, Village Development Plan, Central Assistance, Tribal Welfare | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram Yojana (PMAAGY)" by the Ministry Of Tribal Affairs, Government Of India, aims to transform villages with high Scheduled Tribe population into model villages through providing financial assistance for infrastructure gap filling and socio-economic development to the tribal communities. The scheme focuses on villages having at least 50% ST population. It supports the preparation and implementation of Village Development Plans. Funds are utilized for critical infrastructure gaps not covered under other schemes. Convergence with other Central and State schemes is encouraged for holistic development.
## Benefits - **Financial Assistance:** ₹20,38,000/- per village for infrastructure gap filling and development activities. - **Infrastructure Development:** Support for roads, drinking water, sanitation, education, health, and livelihood infrastructure. - **Village Development Plan (VDP):** Preparation and execution of need-based development plans for selected villages. - **Convergence Support:** Integration with existing Central and State schemes to maximize development impact. - **Awards And Incentives:** ₹5,00,000/- per village at State level for best performing villages and ₹10,00,000/- per village at National level for top selected villages.
## Eligibility Criteria > **General Eligibility** - The village must have at least 50% Scheduled Tribe (ST) population. - The village must have a population of at least 500 in plain areas; 250 in hilly/tribal areas. - The village must be selected by the State/UT Government based on criteria defined in the guidelines. > **Preference / Priority** - Preference is given to villages with higher ST population concentration. - Priority is given to villages with significant infrastructure gaps.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The State Government/UT Administration identifies eligible villages. **Step 2:** A Village Development Plan (VDP) is prepared for selected villages. **Step 3:** The plan is approved at the district and state level. **Step 4:** Proposal is submitted to the Ministry Of Tribal Affairs. **Step 5:** Funds are released after approval. **Step 6:** Implementation is carried out by local authorities with monitoring mechanisms.

page_content:
# Sardar Krushi Jyoti Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Utility & Sanitation, Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Electricity, Agricultural, Farmers, Consumers | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The “Sardar Krushi Jyoti Yojana” was launched by the Energy and Petro Chemicals Department, Government of Gujarat. The main objective of this scheme is to provide good service to the consumers by providing quality power supply by replacing existing old, dilapidated power wires/conductors and related goods of the agricultural feeders and if necessary, by dividing the agricultural feeders.
## Benefits - Replacement of old and dilapidated agricultural feeder wires and conductors. - Improvement in quality of electricity supply to farmers.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be connected to agricultural electricity feeders.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the Subdivisional Office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Subdivisional Office. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the Subdivisional Office to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

metadata.schemeName: Palak Mata-Pita Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The "Palak Mata-Pita Yojana" introduced on 29th August, 2009 by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, provides a monthly assistance of ₹3000 to foster parents raising orphaned children or children whose mother has remarried after the father's death.

page_content:
# Palak Mata-Pita Yojana

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Foster Parent, Orphan, Child Welfare, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
The "Palak Mata-Pita Yojana" introduced on 29th August, 2009 by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, aims to provide monthly assistance of Rs. 3000/- is paid to the close relative, guardian or relative who is taking care of the orphaned children who are studying and whose mother and father are both deceased or whose father is deceased and the mother has remarried. This assistance is paid through DBT.

## Benefits
**Financial Assistance:** ₹3,000/- per month.

## Eligibility Criteria
- The applicant must be a close relative, guardian, or foster parent taking care of the child.
  - The applicant must be caring for a child aged between 0 to 18 years.
  - The applicant must be taking care of a child whose both parents are deceased, or whose father is deceased and mother has remarried.
  - The applicant must ensure that the child between 3 to 6 years is enrolled in an Anganwadi center.
  - The applicant must ensure that the child above 6 years is enrolled in a school for compulsory education.
  - The applicant must submit a certificate from the school or institution every year confirming the child’s ongoing education.
  - The applicant must have an annual family income not exceeding ₹27,000/- in rural areas.
  - The applicant must have an annual family income not exceeding ₹36,000/- in urban areas.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
**Step 1:** Go to the  [eSamajKalyan portal](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/) and Register/Login.
**Step 2:** Fill in the online application form under "Palak Mata-Pita Yojana".
**Step 3:** Upload the required documents and Submit the application.

metadata.schemeName: Jharkhand Petrol Subsidy Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme "Petrol Subsidy Scheme" implemented by the Food, Public Distribution & Consumer Affairs Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide a petrol subsidy of ₹250 per month for two-wheelers to eligible NFSA/Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme beneficiaries.

page_content:
# Jharkhand Petrol Subsidy Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Jharkhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Subsidy, Petrol, Rural, Two-wheelers | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The "Petrol Subsidy Scheme" implemented by the Food, Public Distribution & Consumer Affairs Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide financial relief to economically disadvantaged families by offering a petrol subsidy for their two-wheelers. Under this scheme, beneficiaries under the National Food Security Act (NFSA) or Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme receive ₹25/- per liter of petrol for up to 10 liters monthly. ## Benefits ***Subsidy Amount*** - ₹25/- per liter of petrol for up to 10 liters monthly (₹250/month).
***Mode of Disbursement:*** - Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary's bank account. ## Eligibility Criteria > ***General Eligibility:*** 1. The applicant should possess a valid ration card under the National Food Security Act (NFSA) or Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme. 1. All family members listed in the ration card must have Aadhaar numbers linked and verified. 1. The applicant's Aadhaar should be linked to a valid bank account and an updated mobile number.
> ***Vehicle Eligibility:*** 1. The applicant's two-wheeler must be registered in their name and in the state of Jharkhand. 1. The applicant must possess a valid driving license. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > ***Registration Process:*** - Download the CMSUPPORT app or visit the official portal [jsfss.jharkhand.gov.in](https://jsfss.jharkhand.gov.in/).- Enter your ration card number and Aadhaar number. - An OTP will be sent to the mobile number linked to the Aadhaar. Verify the OTP. > ***Login Credentials:*** - Use your ration card number as the login ID and the last 8 digits of your Aadhaar as the password.
> ***Filling the Form:*** - Select your name from the family members listed on the ration card. - Enter your two-wheeler's registration number and driving license details. > **Verification Process:** - Submitted vehicle details are sent to the DTO (District Transport Office) for verification. - Post verification, the data is forwarded to the District Supply Officer (DSO) for final approval.
> ***Approval and Disbursement:*** - Once approved, the subsidy amount is transferred directly to the applicant's linked bank account through DBT.

# Swachh Bharat Mission – Urban 2.0 **Ministry:** Ministry Of Housing & Urban Affairs | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Utility & Sanitation, Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Toilet, Sanitation | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description A sanitation scheme for the construction of Individual Household Latrines (IHHL) for urban households. The Mission has the following components: 1. Household toilets, including conversion of insanitary latrines into pour-flush latrines. 1. Community toilets 1. Public toilets 1. Solid waste management 1. IEC & Public Awareness 1. Capacity building and Administrative & Office Expenses (A&OE) ## Benefits A Financial support of minimum 1. metadata.schemeName: Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) Phase II
metadata.briefDescription: A sanitation scheme for Visual cleanliness through Open Defecation Free (ODF) sustainability and effective management of solid and liquid waste in villages.

page_content:
# Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) Phase II **Ministry:** Ministry Of Jal Shakti | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** All | **Categories:** Utility & Sanitation, Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Swachh Bharat, Toilet, Sanitation, Rural, Grameen | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description Phase II of the Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) [SBM(G)], will focus on the sustainability of Open Defecation Free (ODF) status and Solid and Liquid Waste Management (SLWM) in rural India. The programme will work towards ensuring that no one is left behind and everyone uses a toilet. SBM(G) Phase-II will be implemented from 2020-21 to 2025-26 in a mission mode. The key objective of SBM(G) Phase II is to sustain the ODF status of villages and to improve the levels of cleanliness in rural areas through solid and liquid waste management activities, making villages ODF Plus. This includes: - ODF-Sustainability; - Solid Waste Management; - Liquid Waste Management; - Visual cleanliness.
## Benefits - **Construction of Individual Household Latrines (IHHLs):** Financial support of ₹12,000/- for APL and BPL rural households for toilet construction. - **Retrofitting of Toilets:** Addressing and fixing technological issues in existing toilets to improve functionality. - **Construction of Community Sanitary Complexes (CSCs):** At least one CSC in ODF-plus villages with over 100 households, prioritizing SC/ST areas and locations frequented by migrant workers. - **Solid Waste Management:** Establishment of compost pits and waste segregation systems in villages. - **Liquid Waste Management:** Installation of soak pits for greywater and stormwater management. - **Faecal Sludge Management (FSM):** Implementation of FSM through various means in peri-urban or densely populated areas. - **Operation and Maintenance:** Decentralised operation and maintenance of community sanitation assets in rural areas by Gram Panchayats. **Other Activities:** 1. IEC and special campaigns 1. Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav (AKAM) 1. Das ka Dam Swachhata har dam 1. Swachhata Filmon ka Amrit Mahotsav 1. Start-up Grand Challenge 1. Swachh Survekshan Grameen (SSG) Phase-II 1. Capacity Building Initiatives 1. Swachhata Action Plan (SAP) 1. Swachh Iconic Places (SIP).
## Eligibility Criteria 1. Only those households (BPL, SCs, STs, households with physically disabled person, landless labourers with homestead, small and marginal farmers, and women headed households) in villages which do not have toilets and have not received any benefit for toilet construction under any other Government programme earlier, are eligible to apply for incentive for construction of toilets under Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen). **Note 1:** The applications will be verified to ascertain the eligibility of the applicant household by the concerned block/district authorities and will be approved or rejected accordingly. **Note 2:** Only after approval of the application, the applicant will be eligible for receiving the incentive under the programme. **Note 3:** While selecting eligible households for providing incentive under the SBM(G), the following order of preference shall be ensured: A. Below Poverty Line (BPL) B. Above Poverty Line (APL) (i) SC/ST (ii) Persons with disability (divyangjan friendly toilet to be ensured) (iii) Landless labourers with homestead (iv) Small farmers (v) Marginal farmers (vi) Women-headed households. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the official website of Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) at [https://swachhbharatmission.ddws.gov.in/](https://swachhbharatmission.ddws.gov.in/) **Step 2:** On the home page, click on ‘Application Form for IHHL’ under the Citizen Corner section. **Step 3**: If you are not already registered, click on ‘[Citizen Registration](https://sbm.gov.in/SBM_DBT/Secure/DBT/DBT_Registration.aspx)’. Enter your mobile number and verify it using the OTP received. **Step 4:** After verifying your mobile number, enter your name, gender, address, state name, and the Captcha code. Then, click on the ‘Submit’ button. **Step 5:** A successful registration message will appear on the screen after submitting the details. > **Login to Apply under the Scheme:** **Step 1:** Visit the official website of Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) again at [https://swachhbharatmission.ddws.gov.in/](https://swachhbharatmission.ddws.gov.in/) **Step 2:** On the home page, click on ‘Application Form for IHHL’ under the Citizen Corner section. **Step 3:** Enter your registered mobile number, the received OTP, and the Security Code, then click on ‘[Sign-In](https://sbm.gov.in/sbm_dbt/secure/login.aspx)’. **Step 4:** After successfully signing in, click on ‘New Application’ under the ‘Modules’ section located on the left corner of the screen. **Step 5:** Complete the application form, upload the required documents, and click on the ‘Apply’ button. **Mode:** Offline **Official Portal/Link:** https://sbm.gov.in/sbm_dbt/secure/login.aspx **The construction of household toilets may be undertaken by:** - The individual beneficiaries themselves with support from agencies. - Community Model through agencies in the village. States may also decide to give the incentive to the individuals, or to communities where the model is adopted to trigger the demand in GPs/ Blocks/ Districts, or to the Gram Panchayats on the achievement of community objectives. **Note:** 1. Any incentive for the IHHL, provided to the community/ GP, if given, shall be used only for sanitation activities. 1. Government shall ensure that the quality of toilets is maintained through sample physical verification through its officers.
