metadata.briefDescription: "Sneha Sparsha" is a healthcare scheme by the Dept. of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of Assam. In this scheme, financial assistance shall be provided for specialized treatment of children below 12 years of age affected with some serious ailments.

page_content:
# Sneha Sparsha **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Assam | **Categories:** Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Disease, Child, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description Launched on 30th December 2021, the "Sneha Sparsha" is a healthcare scheme by the Dept. of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of Assam. In this scheme, financial assistance shall be provided for specialized treatment of children below 12 years of age affected with some serious ailments. Families with annual income less than ₹ 2,50,000 shall be eligible for availing benefits under the scheme, while priority shall be given to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families. ## Benefits > **Permitted procedure and the maximum amount admissible:**
**Bone Marrow Transplant:** Leukemia (Blood Cancer) and other conditions like Thalassemia, in which Bone Marrow Transplant may be considered as a mode of treatment, financial assistance up to ₹ 10,00,000 per case for referral of such cases to 'leading Hospitals outside the state equipped with facilities for such treatment.
**Cochlear Implant:** The scheme will offer financial assistance of up to ₹ 5,35,000 per case to BPL beneficiaries and ₹ 3,00,000 per case to APL beneficiaries for referral of such cases to a Hospital outside the state, if necessary.
**Liver Transplant:** The scheme will offer financial assistance of up to ₹ 16,00,000 per case to BPL beneficiaries and ₹ 10,00,000 per case to APL beneficiaries. Necessary arrangements shall be made for referral of such cases to leading Hospitals outside the state with state-of-the-art facilities for such treatment.
**Kidney Transplant:** The scheme will offer financial assistance of up to ₹ 3,00,000 per case to BPL beneficiaries and ₹ 2,00,000 per case to APL beneficiaries for referral of such cases to Hospitals outside the state, if necessary. **Artificial Limb:** The scheme will offer financial assistance of up to ₹ 1,00,000 for Cosmetic Limbs and up to ₹ 2,50,000 if a Motorized Artificial Limb is considered necessary.
**Blood Cancer:** For treatment of Blood Cancer in children with Chemotherapy, financial assistance of up to ₹ 1,00,000 per case will be given.
**Specialized Eye Surgery:** like Retinal Surgery or Posterior Segment Procedures, an amount of ₹ 15,000 will be given as assistance.
**Tumors:** Solid tumors needing costly investigations and treatment with Chemotherapy and Radiotherapy will be given financial assistance of up to ₹ 25,000. Children in need of cancer-related surgery will be given financial assistance of up to ₹ 50,000.
**Neurological Anomalies:** Hydrocephalus and Spina Bifida will be given assistance up to ₹ 50,000 for investigation, surgical treatment, and rehabilitation.
**Thalassemia:** Financial assistance of ₹ 1,00,000 will be provided to children suffering from Thalassemia, who are not fit for Bone Marrow Transplant but require specialized treatment like splenectomy, blood transfusion, and associated medicines.
**NOTE 1:** The rates notified are indicative and the actual admissible amount shall be fixed through a transparent process. **NOTE 2:** Out of these, the first five points shall be considered for referral outside the State, and the rest of the procedures (6 to 10) treatment is available in the Medical College Hospitals and other Hospitals inside the state. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The beneficiary should be a child below 12 years of age. 1. The beneficiary should be a resident of the state of Assam. 1. The beneficiary should be affected by some serious ailment(s). 1. The annual income of the family of the beneficiary should be less than ₹ 5,00,000, while priority shall be given to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** https://nhm.assam.gov.in/sites/default/files/swf_utility_folder/departments/nhm_lipl_in_oid_6/do_u_want_2_know/Sneha_Sparsha_Application_Form_2.pdf 1. The applications from the parents of the children in need of financial assistance under this scheme shall be submitted to the Office of the Mission Director and/or to the Sneha Sparsha Committee, Sneha Sparsha C/o Gauhati Medical College. 1. The applicants shall have to appear before the Sneha Sparsha Committee along with the patient on an appointed date to be notified by the Member Secretary, and submit all necessary documents for verification. The final selection shall be done by Sneha Sparsha Committee on the basis of the documents received.

page_content:
# Orunodoi 3.0 **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Assam | **Categories:** Women and Child, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Female, Financial Assistance, DBT, Women, Household, Divyangjan, Assam, Axom, Financial Inclusion | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description Orunodoi, described as the 'foremost bead' among the Ashtadash Mukutar Unnoyonee Maala, was announced by the then Hon'ble Finance Minister in his Budget Speech 2020-21. The scheme envisages women's empowerment, poverty alleviation, and socio-economic inclusion of financially vulnerable women of the state through sustained financial assistance on a monthly basis so that they are assured of minimum monthly cash flow. Since substantial time has elapsed, it is essential to update information and implement the scheme with improved standards and procedures. It is necessary to phase out Orunodoi 1.0 and Orunodoi 2.0, without transferring any legacy data, to effectively launch Orunodoi 3.0. However, while selecting the beneficiaries of Orunodoi 3.0, the district administration will take utmost care that the eligible beneficiaries of Orunodoi 1.0 and Orunodoi 2.0 are not removed/deleted from the scheme whimsically, unless they now do not conform to the Orunodoi 3.0 guidelines.
The basic precondition to become a beneficiary for Orunodoi 3.0 is that the individual must be enrolled under the National Food Security Act (NFSA) as a beneficiary. For the purpose of implementation of this scheme, the definitions of household, family, income criterion, etc., will be as per extant NFSA guidelines. This new phase of Orunodoi will have the provision of automatic AADHAAR seeding of beneficiaries, a proven method for efficiently disbursing benefits to Antyodaya across the country, as in Assam, almost every NFSA beneficiary are already AADHAAR seeded.

## Benefits 1) The Assam govt. runs this scheme for those women who belong to the low-income groups of society to support them financially.
2) Each beneficiary will get 1250 rupees per month on the very first date of every month. The Orunodoi 3.0 Scheme covers the expenses for medicines for taking care of health needs, which is 400 rupees per family; Rs. 200 per family is given to provide a 50% subsidy for the 4 kg of pulses of a family; 80 rupees are given as the 50% subsidy for 4 kg of sugar; 150 rupees are given for the fruits & vegetables; Rs. 150 are given for the essential needs; Rs. 170 for covid-19 expenses; and Rs. 250 for a subsidy for 50 units of electricity. And this amount is consolidated to Rs. 1250 per month for a family.
3) Orunodoi Scheme 3.0 will provide financial assistance of Rs. 1250 per month through Direct Benefit Transfer.
## Eligibility Criteria If any of the following criteria is observed in case of an applicant, it will be sufficient for inclusion under the scheme. 1. Widow, unmarried (above the age of 45 yrs) 2. Transgender 3. Person with disability, as defined in the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, irrespective of gender 4. Old/Infirm woman including those residing in Government registered old age home 5. Women of the Household, where earning members are either disabled or aged (more than sixty years of age) 6. Woman in household, where any member is suffering from HIV/ Thalassemia/ Haemophilia/ Cerebral Palsy/ Leprosy/ Autism spectrum disorder 7. Woman in household without shelter 8. Destitute woman living on alms 9. Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) woman beneficiary 10. Women in the household, composite income of which is less than Rs.2 lacs per annum.
## Exclusions 1. MPs, MLAS, CEMS, EMS, Ex MPs, Ex MLAS, Ex-CEMs, Ex-EMs. 2. Current Members of Panchayati Raj Institutions, Urban Local Bodies and Autonomous Councils/ VCDCs etc (in Sixth Scheduled districts). 3. Doctors, Engineers, Architects, Charted Accountants, Bank officials, Lawyers. 4. University, College, Higher Secondary, Junior College, High School, Upper Primary and Lower Primary School teachers including contractual/ temporary. 5. Any Government regular employee, pensioner or contractual employee (including Anganwadi worker, Mid-day meal worker, ASHA worker, ASHA supervisor, Gaon Pradhan) 6. Government contractors and suppliers, real estate builders, industrialists, trade license holders who pay income tax. 7. Businessmen/entrepreneurs, Shopkeepers, traders who pay income tax. 8. Land holders other than small and marginal categories. 9. Owning motorized four-wheeler vehicles. 10. Beneficiary under the 'Orunodoi Plus' scheme and any beneficiary of similar scheme, receiving the same cash benefit from State as Orunodoi 3.0, or more than that. 11. Composite household income exceeds the limits notified in the extant “Assam Food Security Rules” under the “National Food Security Act” (NFSA)
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Official Portal/Link:** https://govtschemes.in/sites/default/files/2022-08/Assam%20Orunodoi%20Scheme%20Application%20Form.pdf Step 01: The only way to apply for this scheme is through the application form. Step 02: To take benefit from the scheme, the family has to nominate a woman from their home.
Step 03: Then all the information of the nominated beneficiary will have to be filled in the Application Form as follows:
Applicant Details: • Block/ULB Name. • Gram Panchayat/Town Name. • Village Name/Ward Number. • Locality in Town. • Applicant First Name. • Applicant Middle Name. • Applicant Last Name. • Gender. • Age as on 01.04.2020. • House Number. • Locality. • Police Station Name. • Pin Code. • Contact/Mobile Number. Family Details: • Name. • Age. • Gender. • Relationship Status. • Priority Status: D - Divorced, S - Separated, W - Widow, DY - Divyang. Bank Account Details: • IFSC Code. • Bank Name. • Bank Branch Name. • Bank Account Number. • Annual Family Income. Documents to be Attached: • Bank Passbook First Page. (Yes or No). • Priority Supporting Documents. (Yes or No). • Any Other Document. (Yes or No).
Step 04: The duly filled Application Form by the applicant shall be submitted to her PS committee or in a Gram Panchayat Office. Step 05: After submission of the Application Form, an acknowledgement slip will be given to the applicant by the PS committee or in a Gram Panchayat Office.
Step 06: This acknowledgement slip will be the proof that the Applicant's Application Form has been submitted.
Step 07: Then various level committees will scrutinize the applications received and verify them thoroughly.
Step 08: After thorough verification, the list of selected and eligible beneficiaries will be uploaded on the DIDS portal and they will get the amount transferred to their bank accounts on the 10th day of every month.

# West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Assistance for Marriage **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** West Bengal | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Social Security, Transport Worker, Marriage Assistance, Women | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The “West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Assistance for Marriage” by the Labour Department, West Bengal, aims to provide financial support to individuals or families for marriage expenses. The scheme offers ₹10,000/- for the marriage of the beneficiary or their dependent children, with a maximum of two beneficiaries per family.
## Benefits - **For beneficiary:** ₹10,000/-. - **For dependent sons/ daughters (up to a maximum of two):** ₹10,000/-
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age at the time of enrolment. 1. The applicant must be an unorganized worker employed in the operation of commercial vehicles, such as cars, taxis, luxury taxis, light commercial vehicles, vans, auto-rickshaws, tempos, lorries, trucks, or buses. 1. The applicant’s vehicle must be used for commercial purposes and not solely for personal or family use. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Step 1:** Visit the “[eDistrict 2.0](https://edistrict.wb.gov.in/portal/home)” portal. Click on Log In/Sign Up. **Step 2:** In the User Login window, scroll down to the bottom and click on “Register”. **Step 3:** Fill in all the details carefully, enter a username, and click on “Register”. **Step 4:** Upon entering the One Time Password received on your mobile, you will be successfully registered. **Step 5:** Now in the User Login window, enter your Username or email and captcha and click on “Sign In”. **Step 6:** Enter the received O.T.P and click on “Submit”. **Step 7:** Upon successful Login, You will be redirected to the “Dashboard”. From the right side menu apply for the concerned scheme.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to construct water harvesting structures (Anicut) to prevent soil erosion, improve groundwater levels, and support tribal farmers in tribal sub-plan areas.

page_content:
# Construction of Water Harvesting Structure and Recharging of Ground Water **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Water Harvesting, Anicut Construction, Groundwater Recharge, Tribal Farmers, Soil Erosion Control, Tribal Area Development | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme "Construction of Water Harvesting Structure and Recharging of Ground Water" implemented by the Tribal Area Development Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to prevent soil erosion and enhance groundwater levels through construction of anicuts for tribal farmers. The scheme is funded by the Centre.
## Benefits - **Water Conservation:** Prevents rainwater from flowing away wastefully in hilly tribal terrains. - **Groundwater Recharging:** Increases the water table through systematic harvesting structures. - **Soil Protection:** Stops soil erosion on the lands of tribal farmers situated near drains and rivers. - **Infrastructure Restoration:** Provides for the repair and rejuvenation of previously constructed water harvesting structures.
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant group must belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. - The applicant group must be selected such that more than 50% of the land to be irrigated belongs to tribal farmers. - The applicant group must ensure that the number of tribal farmer beneficiaries is more than 50% of the total number of beneficiaries.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - **Submission:** The proposal or application must be submitted to the Project Officer, Tribal Area Development (TAD). - **Project Preparation:** A technical project report is prepared by the selected executive agency according to the scheme's objectives. - **Review:** The Project Officer (TAD) examines the project report against available funds. - **Approval for projects up to ₹5,00,000:** Approval is granted by the Project Officer (TAD) after getting consent from the District Collector. - **Approval for projects above ₹5,00,000:** The proposal is sent to the Commissioner, TAD (Udaipur/Jaipur) for State Government approval. - **Final Sanction:** Work begins only after receiving formal approval and a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the Water Resources Department.

metadata.schemeName: Swasthya Karmi Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to control tuberculosis in tribal areas by providing medical testing, DOTS treatment, and nutritional supplements to affected individuals.

page_content:
# Swasthya Karmi Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Tribal Health, Tuberculosis Control, Nutritional Support, Medicine Distribution, Sattu Distribution | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description Launched in 1996, the scheme "Swasthya Karmi Yojana" by the Tribal Area Development Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to control Tuberculosis through providing medical check-ups, DOTS medication, and nutritional supplements to the Scheduled Tribe population in areas lacking medical facilities. It utilizes village-level female health workers (Swasthya Karmi) to ensure patients receive medication and health support in remote areas.
## Benefits - **Medical Testing:** Identification of potential patients and sputum testing at nearby medical centers. - **Treatment Support:** Provision of medicines through the DOTS (Directly Observed Treatment, Short-course) method. - **Nutritional Supplement:** Provision of 3 kg of Sattu per month to every patient during the treatment period. - **Community Health Support:** Assistance in malnutrition, family welfare, first aid, vaccination, and maternal-child nutrition (MIYCN).
## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. - The applicant must be a tuberculosis (TB) patient.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - **Identification:** A female Swasthya Karmi (health worker) selected by the villagers identifies potential Tuberculosis patients in the village. - **Testing:** The health worker takes the potential patient to a nearby medical center for examination by a Health Department doctor. - **Verification:** The patient's sputum is tested to confirm the presence of Tuberculosis. - **Enrollment:** Upon confirmation of the disease, the patient is enrolled for treatment under the DOTS method. - **Support:** The patient receives medicines and nutritional supplements through the Swasthya Karmi. - **Form Collection/Submission:** Application forms can be obtained from and submitted to the concerned Swachh Project Office.

# Sahariya Bangala Nirman **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Housing & Shelter | **Tags:** Sahariya Tribe, Community Hall Construction, Community Welfare, Rural Infrastructure | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme "Sahariya Bangala Nirman" by the Tribal Area Development Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to support community cohesion through providing community hall facilities to the Sahariya families living in rural settlements. It addresses the financial barriers faced by the Sahariya community in renting private venues for their communal events.
## Benefits - **Provision of Community Hall:** The government provides infrastructure support by constructing a 'Bangala' (community hall) within the Sahariya settlement. - **Intended Use:** The facility is specifically designated for hosting social, cultural, and religious events for the community.

## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - **Resolution and Proposal:** The Gram Panchayat passes a formal resolution (Prastav) and prepares a proposal that includes the identification of suitable land. - **Submission to Panchayat Samiti:** The completed proposal, along with the land documents, is submitted by the Gram Panchayat to the Panchayat Samiti (Block level office). - **Forwarding to District Authorities:** The Panchayat Samiti reviews the proposal and forwards it to the office of the Additional Collector and Project Officer (Shahabad).

metadata.briefDescription: Under this scheme provides a monthly pension to elderly persons to support a dignified life. It aims to provide social security to vulnerable people, especially those living below the poverty line. The programme is fully funded by the Central Government.

page_content:
# The National Family Benefit Scheme (Nagaland) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Nagaland | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Below Poverty Line, Death, Family, Pension, Breadwinner | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The National Family Benefit Scheme under the National Social Assistance Programme is implemented by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Nagaland. The scheme provides a one-time financial assistance of ₹20,000 to a bereaved household in the event of the death of its primary breadwinner. For the purpose of this scheme, a woman who is a homemaker is also recognized as a breadwinner. The financial assistance is granted to the surviving member who, after a local inquiry, is identified as the head of the household. Under the scheme, the term “household” includes the spouse, minor children, unmarried daughters, and dependent parents of the deceased. In the case of the death of an unmarried adult, the household is considered to include minor brothers and sisters as well as dependent parents.
## Benefits Under this scheme, the amount under this scheme is a one-time grant of ₹20,000/-
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a resident of Nagaland. 1. The applicant should be a family member or dependent of the deceased breadwinner (an earning member of the family on whom the family primarily depended for income). 1. The family should be living Below the Poverty Line (BPL). 1. The deceased should have been between 18 and 60 years old.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Step 1:The applicant submits the application at the District Welfare Office. Step 2:The District Level Committee verifies applications and forwards the selected beneficiaries for approval. Step 3: After approval, the pension amount is paid in cash by the District Welfare Officer.

metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the economic, social, and infrastructure development of the MAGARA area by creating community assets, improving basic amenities, supporting livelihoods, and encouraging education, health, environment, culture, and tourism.

page_content:
# MAGARA Area Development **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Transport & Infrastructure | **Tags:** Rural Development, Panchayati Raj, Infrastructure Development, Community Assets, Village Development, Livelihood Development | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme "MAGARA Area Development" is implemented by the Rural Development and Panchayati Raj Department, Government of Rajasthan to promote the economic, social, and infrastructure development of the MAGARA area through the creation of community assets and the development of essential public facilities. It prioritizes works related to sanitation, safe drinking water, health services, rural internal roads, education, and village lighting. The scheme also supports the maintenance of assets created under development programmes. In addition, it promotes employment and livelihood opportunities through small and cottage industries, along with activities related to education, healthcare, archaeology, environmental protection, culture, and tourism.
## Benefits - **Economic Development:** Supports the economic development of the MAGARA area. - **Social Development:** Promotes the social development of local communities. - **Infrastructure Development:** Develops basic infrastructure in the MAGARA area. - **Community Assets:** Creates community and other public physical assets. - **Village Sanitation:** Prioritizes sanitation works in villages. - **Safe Drinking Water:** Supports the development of safe drinking water facilities. - **Health Services:** Promotes medical and healthcare-related infrastructure. - **Rural Roads:** Develops rural internal roads. - **Education Facilities:** Supports education-related development works. - **Village Lighting:** Improves lighting facilities in villages. - **Asset Maintenance:** Maintains assets created under the MAGARA Area Development Scheme and other development schemes. - **Employment Generation:** Promotes employment and livelihood opportunities. - **Small And Cottage Industries:** Supports the establishment of small and cottage industries and related resources. - **Environment And Heritage:** Supports works related to archaeology and environmental protection. - **Culture And Tourism:** Promotes art, culture, and tourism development.
## Eligibility Criteria - In the Magra region, 1715 villages of 16 Panchayat Samitis of 5 districts of the state namely Ajmer, Bhilwara, Chittorgarh, Rajsamand and Pali have been included.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - The nodal agency for approval and implementation of the Magra Regional Development Plan will be the District Council (Rural Development Cell) at the district level. Work approval will be issued based on an action plan approved at the state level.

metadata.schemeName: Goat Rearing Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase the income and raise the living standards of tribal women beneficiaries. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided for setting up goat units.

page_content:
# Goat Rearing Scheme **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Women, BPL, Disability, Scheduled Tribe, Farmer | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme "Goat Rearing Scheme" by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to increase the income of tribal women beneficiaries and improve their living standards. Under the State's Scheduled Tribe Sub-Scheme, an assistance scheme for setting up goat units (10 goats + 1 male goat) for tribal women beneficiaries is in effect, in which assistance is paid to the beneficiaries' bank accounts through DBT for purchasing goat units for tribal women. The scheme is implemented by the Development Support Agency of Gujarat (D-SAG).
## Benefits 1. Financial assistance is provided for setting up goat units, specifically 10 goats and 1 male goat. 1. The assistance amount is 50% of the total unit cost or a maximum of ₹45,000/-, whichever is less.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a tribal woman beneficiary. 1. The applicant's age must be between 18 and 60 years. 1. The applicant must be a tribal woman livestock keeper residing in Scheduled Areas, Pockets, and Clusters within tribal districts. 1. The applicant must be a Below Poverty Line (BPL) tribal woman livestock keeper with a BPL score between 0 and 20. 1. Only one person per family will receive the benefit under this scheme. 1. The scheme's benefit is ration card-based, meaning only one woman beneficiary per ration card can receive the benefit. 1. The applicant can avail the benefit of this scheme again after 10 years.
> **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation** The following priority order will be given for beneficiary selection: 1. Primitive Tribal Group (PVTG) livestock keeper women beneficiaries. 1. Tribal livestock keeper women beneficiaries holding Forest Rights Act (FRA) entitlement letters. 1. Other tribal livestock keeper women beneficiaries, with the following sub-priority: - Disabled tribal women. - Widowed or divorced tribal women. - BPL tribal women livestock keeper beneficiaries with the lowest score among those with a 0 to 20 BPL score.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online ##### ***Application Process*** **Step 1:** Visit the [official website of](https://dsagsahay.gujarat.gov.in/)[ ](https://dsagsahay.gujarat.gov.in/)[Development Support Agency of Gujarat (D-SAG)](https://dsagsahay.gujarat.gov.in/), [Tribal Development Department](https://dsagsahay.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on Beneficiary Registration. A [new page](https://dsagsahay.gujarat.gov.in/CitizenPortal/) will appears. Select "New beneficiary registration" if you are registering for the first time. **Step 3:** Register by entering your Ration Card Number and Mobile Number, then click GET OTP. **Step 4:****** Enter the One Time Password (OTP) received on your mobile number and click Register. **Step 5:****** Upon successful registration, a Success pop-up will appear. **Step 6:** Select your Applicant Type from the available options: Livestock Keeper, Farmer and Livestock Keeper, or Student/Trainee. Click Save. **Step 7:****** Fill in the General Details, Personal Details, Bank Details, as required, and click the Proceed button. Confirm by clicking OK on the pop-up. **Step 8:** Upload the required documents by clicking Choose File and then Upload File. **Step 9:****** After uploading all documents, a window will appear. page_content:
# Financial Assistance To Dependent Children Of Widows And Destitute Women **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Chandigarh | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child | **Tags:** Women, Widow, Social Welfare, Financial Assistance, Destitute | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme "Financial Assistance To Dependent Children of Widows And Destitute Women" is a Social Welfare scheme by the Department of Social Welfare, Women & Child Development, Govt. of Chandigarh. The objective of the scheme is to extend financial assistance to such children who are fatherless or whose parents (both mother and father) have died. The scheme is applicable to all the children of widow/destitute women under 18 years of age who have been deprived of parental no support or care after their parent's death or continued absence from home. The applicant should be a resident of UT of Chandigarh for more than 3 years. ₹ 1000/- per month per child is provided for upto two children in a family to meet the cost of maintenance and education. ## Benefits ₹ 1000/- per month per child is provided for up to two children in a family to meet the cost of maintenance and education. ## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant should be a widow/destitute woman or with a dependent child/children. OR the legal guardian of the child/children who have been deprived of parental support or care after their parent's death or continued absence from home. 1. The age of the child/children should be less than or equal to 18 years. 1. If parents of the child/children have died, the assistance will be provided to the legal guardian. 1. The widow/destitute woman or the legal guardian should be a resident of the UT of Chandigarh for more than 3 years. 1. The child should not be in receipt of family pension from any State/Central Govt.
**NOTE:** Children who have been given institutional care by government/NGO shall not be eligible for financial assistance. ## Exclusions Children who have been given institutional care by government/NGO shall not be eligible for financial assistance. ## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/viewServiceApplicationForm.do?serviceId=14280002&tempId=4993&templStatus=243&state=4&backButtonUrl= **Step 1:** Register on the [ServicePlus]() portal. metadata.briefDescription: The scheme “Educational Assistance to Children of Women Headed Families” was launched by the Social Justice Department, Government of Kerala. The scheme proposes to extend a helping hand to women-headed families by way of providing financial assistance to the education of children.

page_content:
# Educational Assistance to Children of Women Headed Families

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Kerala | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment, Education & Learning | **Tags:** Educational Assistance, Children, Woman, BPL, Priority Family, Scholarship | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
The scheme “Educational Assistance to Children of Women Headed Families” was launched by the Social Justice Department, Government of Kerala. The number of women-headed families in Kerala is very high. The majority of these families are living in deplorable conditions. The scheme proposes to extend a helping hand to these families by providing financial assistance for children's education. The women belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families/Priority families (Children of HIV/AIDS affected persons, socially discriminated persons, war widows, etc. are eligible irrespective of their BPL status). A family in which the husband of a woman is bedridden and unable to cover livelihood, due to stroke/or spinal injury can also get benefits under this scheme.

## Benefits
1.	Category I - Children below 5 years and between 1st to 5th standard: ₹300/- per month
2.	Category II - Between 6th to 10th standard: ₹500/- per month
3.	Category III - Plus one (11th Standard) & Plus two (12th Standard): ₹750/- per month
4.	Category IV - Degree and above: ₹1000/- per month

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a resident of Kerala State.
   1. The applicant should belong to the Below Poverty Line Family.
   1. HIV/AIDS-affected persons, socially discriminated persons, war widows, etc. are eligible irrespective of their BPL status.
   1. A family in which the husband of the woman is bedridden and not able to cover livelihood, due to stroke/or spinal injury is eligible to apply under the scheme.
   1. Only two children’s per family are eligible for this scheme.
   1. The child should study in Government or Government aided School or College.

## Exclusions
1. The child who avails of any other scholarship is not eligible for the assistance. A certificate for this has to be obtained from the head of the educational institution where the child studies.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
**Step 01:** The applicant should visit the nearest Anganwadi, Child Development Project Office, or social justice office in Kerala state. [Application Form](http://sjd.kerala.gov.in/DOCUMENTS/Downloadables/Application%20Forms/12014.pdf)
**Step 02:** The application form can collected from the Child Development Project Officer through Anganwadi Workers or it can be downloaded from the Official Website of the Social Justice Department, Kerala.
**Step 03:** The duly filled application form along with the documents prescribed will be forwarded to the concerned District Social Justice Office, Kerala.

metadata.schemeName: Hamara Ped Hamara Dhan
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage residents of Uttarakhand to plant and protect trees on their private land by providing financial incentives, thereby promoting environmental conservation, increasing green cover, and linking economic benefits with tree plantation.

page_content:
# Hamara Ped Hamara Dhan **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Agriculture,Rural & Environment | **Tags:** Incentive, Plantation, Tree, Plants | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme “Hamara Ped Hamara Dhan” has been launched by the Department of Forest, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage residents of Uttarakhand to plant and protect trees on their private land by providing financial incentives, thereby promoting environmental conservation, increasing green cover, and linking economic benefits with tree plantation.
## Benefits - Under this scheme, as an incentive for planting fuelwood, fodder, fruit, and timber species on private land, a Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR) will be created at the rate of ₹300/- per plant and mortgaged to the Divisional Forest Officer. - Based on the survival and success of the plants, the concerned beneficiary will receive the secured amount in the form of an FDR after three years. - A maximum of 100 plants per applicant/family will be eligible for this benefit each year.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have either their own private land or a joint landholding suitable for plantation. 1. There is no minimum land area requirement to avail the benefits under this scheme.
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - Application forms can be obtained free of charge from the office of the Divisional Forest Officer or downloaded from the Forest Department’s website at [https://forest.uk.gov.in/](https://forest.uk.gov.in/). The application form will include details such as the applicant’s name, address, land ownership, area status, and the desired plant species. - The completed application form must be submitted to the office of the Divisional Forest Officer for the concerned area. A contract will then be signed with the applicant on ₹10/- stamp paper. - Applicants will purchase the saplings at a discounted rate from the Forest Department, the Horticulture Department, or other institutions such as registered Mahila nurseries and Kisan nurseries. The applicant will be responsible for transporting the saplings to the planting site at their own expense. Technical assistance for planting the saplings can be obtained from the Forest Department. The applicant will be responsible for the planting and protection of the saplings. - After three years of planting, a joint inspection will be carried out by the village head, the Sarpanch of the respective forest panchayat, the Forest Range Officer, and a representative of the Revenue Department to assess the percentage of healthy surviving plants. Based on the inspection report, funds will be disbursed to the applicant’s account by the Forest Range Officer, in proportion to the number of healthy and surviving plants.

metadata.schemeName: Indira Gandhi Matritva Poshan Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: Under the scheme, women who conceive their second child and fulfill the prescribed conditions will receive cash assistance of ₹6,000/-, paid in five installments.

page_content:
# Indira Gandhi Matritva Poshan Yojana

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Women and Child | **Tags:** Child Care, Maternity, Pregnancy, Lactating Mother, Pregnant Woman | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
The scheme "Indira Gandhi Matritva Poshan Yojana (IGMPY)" was implemented on 1st November 2020 by the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Rajasthan, in five tribal districts of the state. The scheme aims to improve maternal and child nutrition, encourage institutional deliveries, and reduce maternal and infant mortality in tribal regions of the state. Under this scheme, a conditional cash benefit is provided to pregnant and lactating women for their second child, ensuring proper nutrition and healthcare.
> **Scheme Implementation**

The scheme is implemented by the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) under the Department of Women and Child Development. 
> **Area's Cover**

It primarily covers women in Banswara, Dungarpur, Pratapgarh, Udaipur, and Baran districts.

## Benefits
> **Financial Assistance:**


- A financial assistance of ₹6,000/- is provided in five conditional installments to the beneficiary.

**Installment****Conditions**AmountFirst InstallmentOn pregnancy registration at Anganwadi Centre and health check-up within 120 days (4 months) of pregnancy.₹1000Second InstallmentAfter completion of second antenatal check-up during the 6th month of pregnancy.₹1000Second InstallmentUpon delivery at a government or empanelled private hospital and registration of child’s birth.₹1000Second InstallmentOn successful administration of 3 key immunizations (BCG, OPV, DPT, Hepatitis B) within 105 days of birth.₹2000Second InstallmentAfter administration of measles vaccinations and child weight measurement at 9th months₹1000> **Validity:**


- Valid only for the birth of second child.

> **Mode of Disbursement:**


- Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary’s bank account.

> **NOTE:**

Beneficiaries who miss a stage's requirements won't receive payment for it. However, fulfilling later stage conditions will make them eligible for subsequent payments.

## Eligibility Criteria
1.	The applicant should be a married woman.
2.	The applicant should be a permanent resident of one of the five tribal districts of Rajasthan: Pratapgarh, Dungarpur, Banswara, Udaipur, or Baran.
3.	Woman will be eligible if they meet either of the following conditions:

  - She become pregnant with her second child on or after 1st November 2020.
  - She has registered her first antenatal check-up (ANC) for the second child after 1st November 2020.

4.	Pregnant or lactating woman working as Anganwadi worker, Anganwadi helper, Asha Sahayogi, or Saathin will also be eligible under the scheme, subject to fulfillment of the scheme’s conditions.
5.	In the event of abortion or stillbirth, the beneficiary woman will remain eligible for the scheme if she conceives again in the future.
6. The applicant should deliver her child at a government health facility or an empanelled private health institution.
7. The applicant should not have more than two living children.
> **Notes:**


  - Eligible beneficiaries will receive cash assistance in addition to benefits from other central and state government schemes such as Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY) and Rajshree Yojana.
  - The date of pregnancy will be calculated based on the last menstrual period (LMP) recorded in the Pregnancy and Child Tracking System (PCTS) online portal maintained by the Medical and Health Department.
  - If a beneficiary does not comply with any phase of the scheme, the payment for that phase will be withheld. However, if the beneficiary meets the conditions of subsequent phases, the payment for those phases will be disbursed accordingly.
  - The applicant must complete all health milestones and ensure the child's immunizations are done as per the schedule.

## Exclusions
1. The applicant should not be a regular employee of the Central Government, State Government, or a Public Sector Undertaking.
1. The applicant should not be receiving a similar benefit under any other prevailing scheme.
1. A woman who is in her second pregnancy and had twins in her first pregnancy.
1. In case of remarriage, a newly married couple (either of them) having one or more children from a previous marriage.
1. Any woman who is simultaneously eligible to receive installments from both the IGMPY and the Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) under the same conditions.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
> **Application Process**

This primarily applies to women pregnant with their second child on or after November 1st, 2020.
**Step 1:** The applicant visits your local Anganwadi center and registers their second pregnancy (This should ideally be done within 120 days of your Last Menstrual Period (LMP) to be eligible for the first installment).
**Step 2:** During registration at the Anganwadi center, you must provide your Jan-Aadhaar/Bhamashah ID and your mobile phone number. This is crucial for your details to be recorded in the PCTS (Pregnancy and Child Tracking System).
> **NOTE:**


- If you do not have a Jan-Aadhaar ID, you will need to obtain one. The Anganwadi worker will inform and guide you on how to do this, potentially directing you to e-Mitra centers or the online portal.
- Cooperate with the Anganwadi worker and ASHA Sahyogini/ANM for the recording of your pregnancy details, check-ups, delivery information, and child's immunization details in the PCTS.

> **Anganwadi Worker Role:**


- Identify and ensure eligible beneficiaries fulfill the scheme's conditions (as per points 2 & 3 of the guidelines).
- Ensure pregnant women get their first ANC registered in PCTS within 120 days of their last menstrual period.
- Ensure services are fully recorded in the RCH register and the JSY case closure form is submitted on PCTS by the 15th of each month.
- For private facility check-ups, ensure the ANM records it in the Mamta card for PCTS visibility.
- For institutional deliveries outside listed centers, collect the self-declaration form and provide one copy to the ASHA/ANM for PCTS entry.
- Assist the Woman Supervisor in verifying beneficiary eligibility.
- Inform and encourage beneficiaries without Jan-Aadhaar to obtain one.
- Submit amendment forms for any discrepancies found in PCTS data.

> **ASHA Sahyogini/ANM Role:**


- Ensure services are fully recorded in the RCH register.
- Submit the JSY case closure form on PCTS by the 15th of each month for eligible IGMPY beneficiaries.
- Record private facility check-ups in the Mamta card for PCTS visibility.
- Enter details from the self-declaration form into PCTS for deliveries in non-listed private facilities.
- Ensure family planning details are entered into PCTS by the 15th of each month.

> **Woman Supervisor (LS) Role:**


- Verify eligible women based on PCTS data against scheme rules in their Rajposhan web login.
- Initially, manually verify using printouts and Anganwadi worker assistance.
- Approve or reject beneficiary eligibility with reasons in Rajposhan.
- Ensure the beneficiary is registered at the correct Anganwadi center, is eligible, and has complete data in PCTS.
- Report reasons for ineligibility in Rajposhan.
- Submit amendment forms for data discrepancies in Rajposhan.
- Update beneficiary Jan-Aadhaar, bank details, IFSC code, and mobile number in Rajposhan based on amendment forms.
- Continuously monitor if new beneficiary registration forms are entered into PCTS.
- Enter data for new beneficiaries in Rajposhan (for lifting purposes initially).
- Verify the linking of the beneficiary's bank account to their Jan-Aadhaar via the Rajposhan portal.
- Amend beneficiary names in Rajposhan to match Jan-Aadhaar.

> **Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) Role:**


- Review and approve/reject beneficiary data for installment payments based on the Woman Supervisor's verification report.

# Financial Assistance Scheme for Dependents of Deceased Journalists and Litterateurs - Rajasthan

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Health & Wellness, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Journalist, Litterateur, Medical Assistance, Deceased Journalists, Dependent | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
The "Financial Assistance Scheme for Dependents of Deceased Journalists and Litterateurs" scheme was launched by the Department of Information & Public Relations (DIPR), Government of Rajasthan. The scheme aims to provide financial support to the dependents of deceased journalists and litterateurs in situations such as medical emergencies, unemployment, or when there is no other source of income. Eligible dependents under this scheme include an unemployed son below the age of 28 years, an unmarried daughter, the wife, and the parents of the deceased, provided they do not have any other means of financial support.
> **Scheme Implementation**

The scheme is implemented by a committee constituted by the state government and managed under the Rajasthan Journalist and Litterateur Welfare Fund. The objective is to promote social security and ensure the well-being of media personnel and literary contributors in Rajasthan.
> **Under the scheme, illness covers:**

Cancer, leprosy, valve replacement, angioplasty, bypass surgery, kidney transplant, brain stroke (brain and neurological diseases), epileptic seizures, severe injury in an accident, severe infectious diseases - brain infection, lung infection/pneumonia, severe infection in other organs of the body, general surgery - (hernia, appendix, stones in kidney and gall bladder), pregnancy (cesarean) and serious gynecological diseases, diseases related to excessive bleeding, paralysis/palsy, asthma, Alzheimer's, COVID-19, thyroid, etc.

## Benefits
> **Monetary Assistance for Medical Treatment:**


  - Up to ₹1,00,000/- for treatment of critical diseases (e.g., cancer, bypass surgery, kidney transplant, brain stroke, etc.).
  - In special cases, the committee may approve up to ₹2,00,000/-.

> **Monthly Financial Assistance:**


  - ₹1,000/- to ₹2,500/- per month for a maximum of one year.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a dependent of a deceased journalist or litterateur.
1. The deceased journalist or litterateur should have been a resident of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should fall under one of the following categories:


- Widow of the deceased journalist or litterateur with no other source of income.
- Unemployed son below 28 years of age.
- Unmarried daughter.
- Father or mother of the deceased, provided they have no other source of income.

**Note:** Financial assistance will be given to only one person at a time.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
> **Application Process**

**Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the Director, Directorate of Information & Public Relations, Rajasthan Government, Jaipur and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Director, Directorate of Information & Public Relations, Rajasthan Government, Jaipur.
> **Post Application Process:**


  - All applications will be reviewed by the Rajasthan Journalist Welfare Fund Committee.
  - Upon verifying eligibility and other necessary details, the Committee will issue appropriate orders, which will be implemented by the Member Secretary.

Under this scheme, a one-time financial assistance of ₹25,000/- is provided by the insurance company to the deceased's family to help reduce their economic burden.

page_content:
# Jan Samuh Bima Yojana

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Banking,Financial Services and Insurance | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Death, Swachh Project, Sahariya Community, Insurance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
The scheme "Jan Samuh Bima Yojana" was launched in 2019 by the Department of Tribal Area Development, Government of Rajasthan. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Sahariya families in the event of the death of the heads of the families (primary earning member). Under this scheme, a one-time financial assistance is provided by the insurance company to the deceased's family to help reduce their economic burden. The heads of these families are insured under the Swachh Project, and the insurance premium is paid by the Swachh Project.

## Benefits
> **Financial Assistance:** 


- The insurance company provides financial assistance of ₹25,000/- to the family in case of death of the insured person.

> **Insurance Premium:** 


- Fully paid under the Swachh Project.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be native Rajasthan.
   1. The applicant should be a family member or dependent of the deceased person. 
   1. The deceased person should belong to the Sahariya community.
   1. The deceased person should be a resident of the Baran district, Rajasthan.
   1. The insured person must be registered under the scheme before death.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
> **Survey & Selection:**


- A survey is conducted by the Swachh Project in Sahariya bastis of Baran district to identify eligible families.

> **Enrollment:**


- Eligible families members are enrolled under the insurance scheme by the Swachh Project.

> **Submission of Claim (in case of death of the insured):**


- The family must submit the required documents to the Swachh Project office at Shahabad.
- The documents are verified and forwarded to the insurance company.

## Description
The "Family Pension" scheme was launched by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Delhi. In this scheme, upon the death of the pensioner, the surviving spouse is provided 50% of the pension amount or ₹1,500/-, whichever is higher.

## Benefits
50% of the pension or ₹1,500/-, whichever is higher.

**DBOCWWB Department Number (Office Hours: 9:30AM - 6:00PM) :** 011-23813846

page_content:
# Deployment of Prantiya Rakshak Dal (PRD) Volunteers (For volunteer & their Dependents) **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** PRD Volunteers, Rakshak Dal, Dependents, Death, Permanent Disability | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme "Deployment of Prantiya Rakshak Dal (PRD) Volunteers" was launched by the Department of Youth Welfare and prantiy rakshak dal (PRD), Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to PRD volunteers, or to their dependents in the event of death, disability, or injury sustained while on duty.
## Benefits In the event of death, permanent disability, or an accident during duty under adverse conditions, financial assistance is provided as follows: - Death during communal riots: ₹2.00 lakh - Death during special high-risk duty: ₹1.50 lakh - Death during normal duty: ₹1.00 lakh - Permanent disability: Half of the ex-gratia amount admissible for the higher category. - Serious injury: One-fourth of the ex-gratia amount admissible.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a trained Prantiya Rakshak Dal (PRD) volunteer or a legal dependent of a PRD volunteer (in the event of the volunteer’s death).
## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline - In the event of the death of a PRD volunteer, or for their dependent, the application must be submitted to the District Youth Welfare and PRD Office along with the death certificate, training certificate, and survivor certificate. - In the event of a disability, a medical certificate must be submitted. - For a dependent, a copy of the dependent's birth certificate, survivor certificate, bank account details, and family register or ration card must also be provided. - After assessing the adverse circumstances, the department disburses the financial assistance to the PRD volunteer or their dependents.

metadata.schemeName: Grant in Case of Death Due to Disaster
metadata.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the families/dependents of individuals who lose their lives due to any disaster. Under this scheme, an amount of ₹4,00,000/- is given as ex-gratia to support the affected families.

page_content:
# Grant in Case of Death Due to Disaster **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Uttarakhand | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Disaster, Grant, Death, Ex-gratia | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The scheme “Grant in Case of Death Due to Disaster” is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Disaster Management Authority under the Department of Disaster Management, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the families or dependents of individuals who lose their lives due to any disaster.
## Benefits Under this scheme, the dependents of the deceased receive financial assistance of ₹4,00,000/- as an ex-gratia grant.
## Eligibility Criteria 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should be a disaster-affected person/ belong to a disaster-affected family or an individual involved in relief or pre-preparation related work.
## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline Information about the disaster and the resulting damage is received from various sources. The concerned Patwari verifies the damage and records it in the P-20 form. The Patwari’s report is subsequently verified by the Tehsildar and the Sub-Divisional Magistrate. Approval is then obtained from the District Magistrate. Once the District Magistrate’s approval is received, relief funds are disbursed to the concerned beneficiaries at the Tehsil level.

# Assistance On Death Of The Unregistered Worker (HBOCWWB)

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Unregistered Worker, Construction Worker, Accident, Financial Assistance, Dependent Family Member, Death | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
The scheme “Assistance on Death of the Unregistered Worker (HBOCWWB)” was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB), Labour Department Haryana. Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹2,50,000/- is provided by the Board to the legal heir/dependent family member of an unregistered worker who dies in an accident at the workplace.

## Benefits
1. Financial assistance of ₹2,50,000/- is provided by the Board to the legal heir/dependent family member of an unregistered worker who dies in an accident at the workplace.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a legal heir/dependent family member of an unregistered worker who dies in an accident at the workplace.
   1. The applicant should have a copy of the FIR in regard to the accident.
   1. The applicant should have a post-mortem report of the death of an unregistered worker.
   1. The applicant should have the certificate of being nominated/legal heir of the unregistered worker.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Online
**Official Portal/Link:** https://saralharyana.gov.in/

> **Step 01:** To avail of the benefits of the scheme, the applicant need to visit Official Portal -[Antyodaya-SARAL Portal](https://saralharyana.gov.in/)

> **Step 03:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number & password. Click on ‘Submit’.

> **Step 04:** Applicants will receive the login ID on their mobile number.

**Login to Apply for the Scheme:**
> **Step 01:** Visit the Official Portal -[Antyodaya-SARAL Portal](https://saralharyana.gov.in/)

> **Step 02:** The “Sign in here” option is available on the right side of the screen. Applicant needs to fill in their credentials and click on the ‘Login’ button.

> **Step 03:** In the opened window, click on “Scheme/Services list” and a list of schemes will appear on the screen.

> **Step 04:** Now, select the scheme and click on “Apply for Service/Scheme”.

> **Step 05:** Fill in all the details asked in the online application form and submit the application form.

metadata.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Kashmiri Migrants Families Scheme
metadata.briefDescription: Through the “Financial Assistance To Kashmiri Migrants Families Scheme” by the Dept of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt of Haryana, financial assistance of ₹1,250/- per month per family member is provided for five years to the Kashmiri families which have migrated from J&K to Haryana.

page_content:
# Financial Assistance To Kashmiri Migrants Families Scheme

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Haryana | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Kashmiri, Migrants, Financial Assistance, Jammu And Kashmir, Family | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
Launched on 1st April 2006, the scheme “Financial Assistance To Kashmiri Migrants Families Scheme” by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Haryana, financial assistance of ₹1250/- per month per family member is provided for five years to the Kashmiri families which have migrated from Jammu & Kashmir to Haryana and are living in various parts of the State. The financial assistance is subject to a maximum of ₹6,250/- per family.

## Benefits
Financial Assistance of ₹1,250/- per month per family member for 5 years, subject to a maximum of ₹6,250/- per family per month, provided for re-settlement.

## Eligibility Criteria
- The applicant family should have been displaced from Jammu & Kashmir.
  - The applicant family should have migrated to Haryana from Jammu & Kashmir.
  - The applicant family should be residing in Haryana.
  - The annual income of the family, from all sources, should not exceed ₹2,00,000/-.


  - The term ‘Family’ would mean 'the family of the applicant at the time of displacement from Jammu & Kashmir'.

## Exclusions
Any sub-division of the family after displacement from Jammu & Kashmir will not be recognized for additional financial assistance.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the Office/ Sub-Office of the [District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO)](https://socialjusticehry.gov.in/telephone-no-of-dswos-in-haryana/), and request the hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
OR 
The applicant should take print of the [application form](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s392bbd31f8e0e43a7da8a6295b251725f/uploads/2021/03/2021032590.pdf).
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the DSWO.
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

**Mode:** Online
**Official Portal/Link:** https://saralharyana.gov.in/
**Step 1:** Visit the official website of the &quot;[Antyodaya SARAL](https://saralharyana.gov.in/login.do?)&quot; Portal.
**Step 2:** In the &quot;SIGN IN HERE&quot; section, click &quot;New user? Register here&quot;.
**Step 3:** The registration form will open in a new window of the browser. Fill in all the mandatory fields of the form. Create a strong password. The password should be at least &#39;9&#39; characters with at least one special character(!@#$%^&amp;*), one numeric, one small case and one upper case letter (i.e ADmin@357). Fill in the captcha code and click &quot;Submit&quot;.
**Step 4:** An OTP will be sent to the email ID and the Mobile Number provided in the registration form. The OTP received will be for single use only and will be valid for 15 minutes from the time of request. The verification link received over email will be valid for 48 hours from the time of request. On successfully validating the Email ID and Mobile Number via OTP, the following message will be displayed to the user: &quot;You have successfully registered on https://saralharyana.gov.in/. Please login to the application using your email ID and password&quot;.
**Step 5:** Visit the official website of the &quot;[Antyodaya SARAL](https://saralharyana.gov.in/login.do?)&quot; Portal. In the &quot;SIGN IN HERE&quot; section, log in using your Login ID and Password.
**Step 6:** On the next screen, in the left pane, click on ‘Apply for Service’, then click &quot;View All Available Services&quot;.
**Step 7:** You will be shown a list of schemes/services. Click on the scheme you intend to apply for. You will be taken to its online application form.
**Step 8:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory details, click on ‘Self-Declaration’. Enter the verification code/Captcha and click on the ‘Submit’ button.
**Step 9:** Preview all the filled details and click on ‘Attach Annexure’. Upload all the mandatory documents and click on ‘Save Annexure’.
**Step 10:** After verifying all the details, click on the ‘Submit’ button. Take a printout of the generated ‘Acknowledgement Receipt’ for future reference.
<br>

> **Track Your Application/ Appeal**

**Through Portal**
**Step 1:** Visit the [SARAL Portal](https://status.saralharyana.nic.in/).
**Step 2:** Click &quot;Tracking Feature&quot;.
**Step 3:** Select the department and service from the dropdown menu.
**Step 4:** Enter your Appeal/ Application Reference ID (provided to you when you applied for the service) and click on &quot;CHECK STATUS&quot;.
**Through SMS**
From your registered mobile number, send the following SMS to 7738299899:
SARAL&lt;space&gt;Application ID
<br>

> **SARAL Helpline**

0172-3968400 (7:00 AM to 8:00 PM; Monday to Saturday, excluding Govt Holidays)
saral.haryana@gov.in
<br>

> **User Manual for Application**

https://saralharyana.gov.in/resources/homePage/6/pdf/Using%20Saral.pdf

metadata.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Chiranjeevi Swasthya Beema Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The state government has announced the implementation of 'Universal Health Coverage' in the state in the budget announcement 2021-22, in compliance of which Chief Minister Chiranjeevi Health Insurance Scheme was started in the state from May 1, 2021.

page_content:
# Mukhyamantri Chiranjeevi Swasthya Beema Yojana **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Rajasthan | **Categories:** Health & Wellness | **Tags:** Financial Assistance, Health Insurance, Family Welfare | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The Government of Rajasthan has always been in the forefront in making various innovations to provide health services to the citizens of the state. Rajasthan has also successfully operated free medicines and free tests in the state in the past, due to which the general public is getting the benefit of free medicines and tests in the government hospitals of the state. This scheme has been brought with the commitment of providing good health to all the citizens of the state by freeing them from the huge expenditure on medical treatment so that there is no compulsion of money in the treatment of suffering and serious diseases.
## Benefits 1. Cashless treatment facility up to Rs. 25,00,000/- will be provided to each family of Rajasthan. 1. National Food Security Act, the insurance premium of families eligible for Socio-Economic Census, small and marginal farmers and contract workers will be borne by the state government. 1. Other families will have to pay a premium of Rs. 850/- per year. ## Eligibility Criteria Under the scheme, eligible families have been divided into two categories- 1. **Category receiving free benefits:-** 100 percent of the premium of the eligible families of such category determined by the state government is paid by the government. Presently eligible families under Food Security Act, eligible families of Socio-Economic Census (SECC) 2011, contract workers working in state government departments/boards/corporations/government companies, small marginal farmers and those who received Covid-19 ex-gratia last year destitute and helpless families are included in the free category. 1. **Category receiving benefits by paying Rs.850/- per family per year:-** The families of the state who do not come under the category of free eligible families and are not government employees/pensioners and are not taking benefits under the Medical Attendance Rules They can avail the benefits of the scheme by paying 50% of the fixed premium Rs. 850/- per family per year. The remaining 50 percent of the premium will be borne by the government. 1. **All EWS** families are also proposed to be given the benefit of Chiranjeevi Yojana free of cost. ## Exclusions
## How to Apply **Mode:** Online **Official Portal/Link:** https://chiranjeevi.rajasthan.gov.in The [process ](https://chiranjeevi.rajasthan.gov.in/#/home)for registering category wise is as follows - **Registration process for free benefit category-** 1. The eligible families under the Food Security Act and the eligible families of the Socio-Economic Census 2011 are already benefited under the scheme. Hence they do not require registration. 1. metadata.briefDescription: The Vahli Dikri Yojana by the Government of Gujarat under the Women and Child Development Department . The scheme supports girl children by providing financial aid, free education, and insurance, encouraging higher education and reducing dropout rates.

page_content:
# Vahli Dikri Yojana

**Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Gujarat | **Categories:** Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Girl Child, Girl Education, Daughter, Financial Assistance | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family

## Description
The Vahli Dikri Yojana, launched by the Women and Child Development Department under the Government of Gujarat, aims to empower girl children by providing financial assistance to their parents. This scheme encourages families to educate and nurture their daughters by offering cash incentives, free education, and insurance coverage. By reducing the school dropout rate among girls and promoting higher education, the initiative seeks to foster gender equality and ensure a brighter future for young girls.

## Benefits
**Financial Assistance at Different Stages:**

- ₹4,000/- at the time of admission in 1st standard.
- ₹6,000/- at the time of admission in 9th standard.
- ₹1,00,000/- at the age of 18 years for higher education or marriage.

## Eligibility Criteria
1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.
1. The applicant should have a bank account.
1. The applicant should be one of the first two girl children of the family.
1. The annual family income should not exceed ₹2 lakh.
1. Girls born on or after 02-08-2019 should be eligible for financial assistance.

## How to Apply
**Mode:** Offline
**Application Process**
**Step 1:** Applicants can get the application form from the Anganwadi Centre/Gram Panchayat/ CDPO(ICDS) Office/District Women and child Officer office.
**Step 2:** Fill out the application form and attach all the required documents with it.
**Step 3:** Submit the Application Form along with the documents in the same office.
**Step 4:** Application Forms and Documents will be scrutinized by the concerned officials.
**Step 5:** The applicant will be informed through SMS about the eligibility or ineligibility.
**Step 6:** Eligible Beneficiaries will get financial assistance in their bank account once their application is finally approved by the department office.

metadata.schemeName: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana
metadata.briefDescription: The Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (AABY) is a social security scheme for rural landless households implemented by the Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India. The scheme provides insurance coverage to the head of the household or an earning member of the family in the age group of 18 to 59.

page_content:
# Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana **Ministry:** Ministry Of Labour and Employment | **Level:** Central | **States/UTs:** Assam | **Categories:** Social welfare & Empowerment | **Tags:** Bima, Insurance, Labour Welfare, DBT, Incentive | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description The Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (AABY) is a social security scheme launched by the Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India, and implemented through LIC. It provides death and disability coverage to members of 48 specific occupational/vocational groups, rural landless households, and unorganized workers. Beneficiaries aged 18–59 years pay subsidized annual premiums of ₹200 for insurance coverage. Additionally, scholarships are granted for children studying in grades 9–12, ensuring holistic family welfare.
## Benefits > **Life Insurance Coverage:** - Natural death: ₹30,000/- - Death due to accident: ₹75,000/- > **Disability Benefits:** - Total permanent disability (loss of two eyes or two limbs) due to accident: ₹75,000/- - Partial permanent disability (loss of one eye or one limb) due to accident: ₹37,500/- **Scholarship:** - Two children of the beneficiary studying between 9th to 12th Standard shall receive ₹100/- per month (for each child half yearly – on 1st July and on 1st January, each year).
> **Annual Premium Amount:** ₹200/- per member. - **Subsidy from Social Security Fund (SSF):** 50% of the total premium (₹100/-) is subsidized by the Government of India through the Social Security Fund (SSF). - **Premium Payment for Rural Landless Households (RLH):** The remaining 50% of the premium (₹100/-) is paid by the respective State Government or Union Territory. - **Premium Payment for Other Occupational Groups:** The remaining 50% of the premium (₹100/-) is covered by a combination of contributions from the Nodal Agency, the Member, and/or the State Government/Union Territory. ## Eligibility Criteria - The applicant should be aged between 18 and 59 years. - The applicant should normally be the head of the family or an earning member. - The applicant’s family should be categorized as below the poverty line (BPL) or marginally above the poverty line. - The applicant should belong to an identified occupational or vocational group. - The applicant should be part of a rural landless household. ## Exclusions

## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline > **Death Claim Procedure:** **Step 1:** The nominee of the deceased member submits a claim application to the designated official of the Nodal Agency along with the original death certificate and an attested copy. **Step 2:** The designated official verifies the submitted claim documents. **Step 3:** The Nodal Agency prepares a claim packet, including the completed claim form, the death certificate, and a certificate confirming the deceased was the head or earning member of a BPL or marginally above BPL family under eligible occupations. **Step 4:** The verified claim packet is forwarded to LIC for processing. > **Accident Claim Procedure:** **Step 1:** The nominee submits an application along with the Death Registration Certificate and additional documents, including the FIR, Post Mortem Report, Police Inquest Report, and Police Conclusion Report or Final Report. **Step 2:** The Nodal Agency verifies the documents and forwards the claim to LIC for further processing. > **Scholarship Claim Procedure:** **Step 1:** The member whose child is eligible for a scholarship fills out a scholarship application form twice a year and submits it to the Nodal Agency. **Step 2:** The Nodal Agency identifies the eligible students and prepares a list of beneficiaries. **Step 3:** The list, along with details such as the student’s name, school, class, member details, and NEFT information, is sent to LIC’s P&GS unit. **Step 4:** LIC disburses the scholarship amount directly to the beneficiary’s bank account through NEFT every half year on 1st July and 1st January.

metadata.briefDescription: "Pedalandariki Illu" is a Housing Scheme by the Revenue Department, Govt. of Andhra Pradesh. 25 lakh House Site Pattas have been announced for distribution to all the eligible beneficiaries residing in Rural & Urban areas on Saturation MoSaturation Mode irrespective of Caste, Creed, or Religion.

page_content:
# Pedalandariki Illu **Level:** State | **States/UTs:** Andhra Pradesh | **Categories:** Housing & Shelter | **Tags:** Housing, Below Poverty Line, Welfare | **Target Beneficiaries:** Family ## Description Launched by the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh, the "Pedalandariki Illu" is a Housing Scheme by the Revenue Department, Govt. of Andhra Pradesh. 25 lakh House Site Pattas have been announced for distribution to all the eligible beneficiaries residing in Rural & Urban areas on Saturation Mode irrespective of Caste, Creed, or Religion to facilitate the construction of houses for the homeless poor. The process of issue of House Site Pattas will be taken up on mission mode and distribution to all eligible houseless poor will be taken up. This scheme is also known as the "YSR Housing Scheme" and "YSR Awaas Yojana". ## Benefits > **Rural Area:** 1. One House Site Patta shall be issued for an extent of 1.5 Cents to an eligible household in the name of the woman beneficiary of the house. The patta shall be handed over to the beneficiary on the day of Ugadi, 2020. 1. The Housing Department shall issue sanctions for the construction of Individual Housing Units to the eligible beneficiary under the available schemes in a phased manner.
> **Urban Area:** 1. Housing Units shall be constructed following the G+3 pattern at the rate of about 100 units in an extent of Ac.1.00cts. 1. House Site Patta shall be issued as an Undivided Land Share for an extent of about 1.0 Cent to an eligible beneficiary in the name of the woman of the house. The patta shall be handed over to the beneficiary on the day of Ugadi, 2020. 1. Housing Units will be constructed and handed over to the beneficiaries by APTIDCO/ ULB/ other government agencies under available schemes.
**NOTE 1:** House Site Pattas shall be issued with the conditions laid down in BSO-21 & in terms of the Andhra Pradesh Assigned Lands (Prohibition of Transfer) Act, 1977 (As amended from time to time). **NOTE 2:** All individual plots shall be given a Unique Number similar to the 11-digit Bhoodhar Number.
## Eligibility Criteria > **A) Rural Area:** 1. The beneficiary shall belong to the identified Below Poverty Line (BPL) category household. 2. The beneficiary shall not have their own House/House Site anywhere in the State of Andhra Pradesh. 3. The Beneficiary shall not have been covered in any previous Housing Scheme of the State/Central Government. 4. The Beneficiary shall not have more than 2.5 acres of Wet Land or 5.00 acres of Dry Land.
> **B) Urban Area:** 1. The beneficiary shall not have an Own House/House Site anywhere in the State of Andhra Pradesh. 2. The beneficiary shall not have been covered in any previous Housing Scheme of the State/Central Government. 3. The beneficiary shall not have more than 2.5 acres of Wet Land or 5.00 acres of Dry Land. 4. The Annual Income (from all the sources) of the Household should not exceed Rs.3,00,000/- (Rupees three lakhs only). ## How to Apply **Mode:** Offline **Step 1:** The Applications shall be invited at Village/Ward Level considering the village/town as a unit respectively. **Step 2:** All applications shall be enquired by the Village/Ward Volunteers for adherence to the eligibility conditions. **Step 3:** The draft List of identified eligible beneficiaries shall be published at Village/Ward Secretariat calling for further claims & objections. **Step 4:** Grama/Ward Sabha shall be conducted to finalize the list of beneficiaries duly redressing the claims & objections. **Step 5:** The final list of beneficiaries shall be submitted for approval of the District Collector by the Tahsildars and Municipal Commissioners in the Rural and Urban areas respectively. **Step 6:** The final list of beneficiaries approved by the District Collector shall be published in the respective Village/Ward Secretariat. **Step 7:** In case of any further claims or objections, the Tahsildar/Municipal Commissioner shall function as the redressal officer duly taking approval from the District Collector.
